content: Listen...to...the wind flapping the mirage of the sea...
Search...for... who's flickering the fireworks and the stars...
Oh? ...You're finally awake...
How much do you remember... Your name, your face... Do you... remember who you are?
...Can you only remember these? Fate is so cruel...
But, it doesn't matter... As long as you still remember who you are, you won't lose everything...
Come. Come back to me... Your battle has begun.
...I will ...wait for you...

speaker: Alarm
content: Cleanup Squad! Level 1 alert! Unknown Sinner Invading—Unknown Sinner Invading!
——Buzz——Buzz——

speaker: Woman
content: You're finally awake... I've been waiting for you this whole time.

speaker: Woman
content: You don't look well. Did you have a nightmare? Tell me, what did you dream about?
Don't listen to her! This is an attack targeted at you!
On one side of the recovery pod, several researchers were squashed into the wall. The only conscious person is shouting at you desperately.

speaker: Trapped Researcher
content: Chief, don't leave the repair pod!  If you don't complete the repair program, your mind will be... Mmm——Mmm——!!!
Amid violent tremors, the man's face and voice are devoured by a formless darkness, falling into absolute silence.

speaker: Woman
content: I don't like being disturbed.

speaker: Woman
content: Great, now stand up. We've got a lot to do.
Stay away from him!
female_content: Stay away from her!

content: The bullets keep coming ceaselessly. With a few grunts, the woman before you collapsed onto you before she even had time to twitch once.
A series of rapid footsteps soon burst into the room.

speaker: Calm Female Voice
content: Those creatures are still alive. Don't stop shooting. Keep them under control.

speaker: Male Voice
content: Copy!

speaker: Calm Female Voice
content: Chief—${PlayerName}, can you hear me?

speaker: Calm Female Voice
content: Hold on. I'll get you out soon.

speaker: Male Voice
content: Deputy Chief, watch out!
Over you, the body suddenly jerks. Several monsters burst out from under the ground all of a sudden, separating you and the rescuers.

speaker: Calm Female Voice
content: Not dead yet? Protect Chief! Team Four, cover!

speaker: Calm Female Voice
content: ${PlayerName}, get away from her now!
You struggle to get up, but a hand presses you back into the icy liquid.
The woman who should've been dead props herself up. She slowly approaches with the foul smell of blood, trapping you in a narrow space.

speaker: Intruder
content: Where are you going? It's not over between us yet...

speaker: Intruder
content: I won't give up easily.
The woman brushes your cheek with her hand. Her nails scratch your skin, leaving a sting.

speaker: Intruder
content: Hmm... Heheh...
She presses down on the wound.

speaker: Intruder
content: I can't take you away now, in this case...

speaker: Intruder
content: This body... you can just give it to me.
She licks her finger and slowly gets up.
The terrifying smile on her face gradually blurs, even her body begins to distort and deform—and eventually turns into yours.

speaker: Intruder
content: Goodbye, ${PlayerName}.
She sits on the raised platform and leaves unhurriedly, with your face still on her.
A woman in uniform appears within your sight. She carefully holds you up and puts a coat on you.

speaker: Calm Woman
content: Sorry, I'm late. Are you hurt?

speaker: Calm Woman
content: I am <color=#fb9259>Nightingale</color>, your adjutant.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The consciousness repair program got disrupted, so your memory is severely damaged. You must be very confused right now, but...

speaker: Nightingale
content: The intruder stole your bio-information just now. She will use this disguise to break through all security systems and cause an even larger riot.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You're in extreme danger. Time is running out. Please leave with me now.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's because you are the top authority here, the new Chief of <color=#fb9259>Minos Bureau of Crisis Control</color>—${PlayerName}.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You are the top authority here, the new Chief of <color=#fb9259>Minos Bureau of Crisis Control</color>—${PlayerName}.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Not a moment goes by without those <color=#fb9259>rioters</color> wanting you dead.
You are escorted by guards through the confined corridor under the glaring lights and alarms. A huge guarded area appears before your eyes.

speaker: Warning System
content: Level 1 alert! Level 1 alert! Sinners escaped! Sinners escaped! Alert!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Here we go...

speaker: Nightingale
content: This is <color=#fb9259>Minos Bureau of Crisis Control</color>, the jail for the most vicious criminals.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Every criminal here is a great threat to the world, and you, Chief, are supposed to be the strongest force to restrain them.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But now, an intruder has sparked off a riot. The prisoners are completely out of control. The first thing these rioters will do is...
Bam—!!
The tempered glass in front of you suddenly exploded. Nightingale immediately protected you behind her and blocked the few people who bursted out.

speaker: Rioter
content: Hey, isn't this Adjutant Nightingale?

speaker: Rioter
content: Don't tell me that guy behind you is the new...Heh, look at his dumb face. I bet he's still just a loser.
female_content: Don't tell me that one behind you is the new...Heh, look at her dumb face. I bet she's still just a loser.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Chief, stand back.

speaker: Rioter
content: I didn't expect to be free again. I planned to just run away, but since you guys have taken such good care of me, how could I not repay you?

speaker: Rioter
content: Kill him! We can only be truly free if that man is dead!
female_content: Kill her! We can only be truly free if that woman is dead!

speaker: Guard Captain
content: Chief, Adjutant, get behind me!

speaker: Frantic Woman
content: Haha... I'm on my way home... almost home... but you're in my way again... the FAC is in my way again... haha...
A maniacal figure stood in your way out.

speaker: Nightingale
content: A Sinner?! Be careful everyone! The most dangerous enemy is approaching!

speaker: Frantic Woman
content: Since you came already, then let's chop you up together and take it home as a gift! Hahahaha!

speaker: Fleeing Archer
content: Hahaha, if you can't beat a little chainsaw maniac, then your time is over...

speaker: Fleeing Archer
content: Hey! MBCC trash! The Archer Queen of Syndicate is here! Get out of my way or eat my arrow!
Despite their best efforts to protect you, the guards were beaten back time and again.

speaker: Guard Captain
content: Sinners are hard to hold off! We won't last long! Adjutant Nightingale, please act quickly!

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Understood! The Bureau will never forget your sacrifices!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Force field recharge complete, activating shield function! Don't even think about going near him, you maniac!
female_content: Force field recharge complete, activating shield function! Don't even think about going near her, you maniac!

content: The shield was activated, keeping out all the pursuers.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Can you move, Chief? Quick, get out of here! That Sinner can trigger EMP and will destroy this kind of trap in no time.

speaker: Guard Captain
content: Adjutant Nightingale, take Chief away. You've got me here!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Thanks!
She turned around and pulled you into the secret passage. The surviving guards let out a final roar behind you, which is soon swallowed up by thugs' maniacal laughter.

speaker: Rioter
content: Die! Die! The world doesn't need jails!
She dragged you out of the secret passage and pressed a hidden button on the side. The wall opens, and an elevator door appears. The light indicates that it's approaching.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Please get in, Chief. The elevator will take you to the hidden mezzanine. You will be safe staying there. Don't leave until our backup arrives.

speaker: Choice
content: What about you?|You're coming with me.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I'll divert them.
Nightingale reloads her guns. The shouts of the approaching pursuers grow near. Her eyes and guns are trained ahead while the wound on her forehead continues to bleed.
The bright red irritates your nerves and pokes at the unknown corners of your fractured memories.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Don't hesitate, Chief. Your life is the most valuable, more so than everyone else here.
The enemies are here to kill you, and the persons in front of you may die to save you. They all call you Chief and say your life is valuable.
If you really are that valuable, then...

speaker: Choice
options: There must be something I can do.

speaker: Rioter
content: Look at his dumb face. I bet he's still just a loser.
female_content: Look at her dumb face. I bet she's still just a loser.

speaker: Rioter
content: Kill him! We can only be truly free if that man is dead!
female_content: Kill her! We can only be truly free if that woman is dead!

content: You vaguely sense that these desires to kill you mask their fear of you. The prisoners fear something that has not yet awakened in you. You have the potential power to suppress them.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...You want to fight like this?

speaker: Nightingale
content: No way! You've only just woken up from the disrupted repair program. You're still very weak, and your memory is...

speaker: Choice
content: These are my order and responsibility as the Chief.|Then I'll let you be my guide.
options: This is the decision I make as the "Chief."
Then I'll let you be my guide

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I've crossed the line. Chief, you're stronger than we think.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Copy that. Since you've chosen to fight, it's my duty to assist you as your adjutant.
She changed the command on the elevator, which changes the destination floor, and a red warning light suddenly flashes on the screen.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The Bureau can no longer hold on until the reinforcements arrive. There's only one way to bring an end to this crisis.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, a forbidden power lies dormant in the depth of this jail. It's more dangerous and powerful than our enemies.

speaker: Nightingale
content: That's <color=#fb9259>your power</color>. Awaken it. I'm sure you can control it.
Ding! The elevator doors open while rioters appear from around the corner. Before their bullets reach you, Nightingale pushes you into the elevator.

speaker: Choice
content: I will come back to save you.|Hold on. Don't die.
options: I will come back to save you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Go ahead, ${PlayerName}.
She doesn't respond directly. The moment the door closes, a powerful blast rocks the entire space.
When you are conscious again, the elevator has stopped in the dark. The metal door helplessly opens and closes again. Beyond the door is a cell in dead silence.
The bump on your head is throbbing with pain, but you have no time to waste. Trying to remember Nightingale's last instructions, you start to act.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The elevator will take you to the Bureau's real <color=#fb9259>restricted area</color>. Turn right after exiting the elevator. Get to the end of the third corridor and go down two floors.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Avoid anyone who is not a prison guard. If you hear anyone, hide in the nearest cell under the blanket. That woman has removed all restraints, so the cell doors will be open.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You want to get to the middle section of Area B-3, where you will find <color=#fb9259>the only prisoner who voluntarily</color> stays in the cage. Find <color=#fb9259>her</color>. Her number is...
This way! This way, Sir!
female_content: This way! This way, Ma'am!

speaker: Girl in Cell
content: A-are you the new guard?  I... I'm <color=#fb9259>Hella</color>.
female_content: A-are you the new guard? I... I'm <color=#fb9259>Hella</color>.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm not like those baddies. See? I didn't cause any trouble, nor did I try to escape.

speaker: Hella
content: But I'm scared... Those baddies are so scary. They... they wanted to kill me! They said they would come back to kill me later!

speaker: Hella
content: Sir, can you let me out, please?
female_content: Ma'am, can you let me out, please?

content: Is she the person you're looking for? You step back to survey this cell.

The lock on the cell door has clearly been damaged violently by a blunt object. The warning "<color=#fb9259>Unlock Failed</color>" flashes on the smashed screen—and a bent steel pipe is hidden at the young girl's feet.

speaker: Hella
content: Th-those baddies smashed it. I didn't do it. Trust me, Sir. Please let me out. I...
female_content: Th-those baddies smashed it. I didn't do it. Trust me, Ma'am. Please let me out. I…

speaker: Hella
content: I've begged you so many times! Are you gonna let me out or not?!!

The young girl reveals her true fierce self. Her hand reaches out of the cell and yanks you by the collar towards her. She is incredibly strong, hitting you against the glass and trapping your neck from behind with the cold steel pipe.
Observing with great difficulty, you can see sparks splash onto her white arm and create a burn, which, however, heals immediately.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't go against me, little guard... My power isn't to be messed with, and <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> aren't prisoners you can trap.

speaker: Hella
content: I don't have time to play with you. Before I count to five, open the door, or I'll strangle you!

speaker: Hella
content: Aaahhh—!!
A shadow suddenly dashed out before your eyes, then Hella screamed behind you and the pipe fell to the ground with a clang.

speaker: Hella
content: ...You bastard!
The cell door directly across from you two is wide open. The silent shadow creeps slowly, giving off an ominous aura.
In the middle of the shadow sits a slim figure against the wall.

speaker: Girl in Shadow
content: ...Come back.
The shadow immediately leaves Hella, passes you, and returns to the young girl before merging with the darkness.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, a forbidden power lies dormant in the depth of this jail. It's more dangerous and powerful than our enemies.
Is <color=#fb9259>she</color> the forbidden power?

speaker: Girl in Shadow
content: ...That's me.

speaker: S-019
content: ...Did Nightingale send you here? ...Are there new orders?
There isn't a hint of emotion in her voice, as if you're conversing with the dark wall.

speaker: Choice
options: Nightingale said you would become my power.
There is only Chief's order. Will you follow?

speaker: S-019
content: ...I see.

speaker: S-019
content: You're the new "<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>."

speaker: S-019
content: ...Are you ...the new "<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>?"

speaker: Hella
content: Let me out! Bastard! Let me kill him! I'll kill him!
female_content: Let me out! Bastard! Let me kill her! I'll kill her!

content: The shadow at the young girl's feet shudders and wriggles forward.
You soon hear the chilling cracking sound behind you. Hella's scream halts even before it escapes her mouth.

speaker: S-019
content: Keep quiet... Or it'll be your neck next time...
You don't have the courage to turn around. You watch the young girl across the room stand up, leave the darkness along with the flowing shadows at her feet, and walk towards you.
When you notice it, the shadow has already wrapped around your limbs. The chills seep into your veins and into your bones.

speaker: S-019
content: Don't move... It hates when prey struggles.

speaker: S-019
content: No. <color=#fb9259>S-019</color>, A-level <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color>. My ability is... the curse of nightmare.

speaker: S-019
content: Unlike those people outside, I... We are the real <color=#fb9259>criminals</color> in this place.

speaker: S-019
content: And the person who binds and traps us with the <color=#fb9259>shackles</color> is the Chief of this cage.

speaker: S-019
content: "Chief", have you... found the shackles?
She stares right into your eyes. The shadow has a grip on your throat. Its bone-chilling desire to kill irritates every single nerve in your body.

speaker: Choice
content: The order from Nightingale is...

speaker: S-019
content: I don't need her order anymore.
She lifts your hand and presses it lightly against her collarbone, then everything falls into darkness.
In the darkness, all you can see is this young girl in front of you. Under her icy gaze, a series of obscure words crawls into your body, crashing your head, screaming to tear your soul apart.

speaker: S-019
content: Stop <color=#fb9259>it</color>, or get killed.

speaker: S-019
content: You know what to do...

speaker: Nightingale
content: That's your power. Awaken it. I'm sure you can control it.

speaker: S-019
content: Find your shackles and <color=#fb9259>bind me</color>. Follow your instincts. This is why you exist.
Your hand starts to move uncontrollably and strangles the girl's neck. A scorching pain follows, while some crimson pattern surfaces on your skin.
The scorching pattern spreads to the young girl's skin, then stretches greedily beyond, piercing through the darkness and spreading through the entire space.

speaker: Hella
content: No! Stay away from me! No!!!
The crimson pattern creeps up Hella and binds her entire body like burning shackles, making it impossible for her to break free.
And the young girl who calls herself S-019 stares intently into your eyes in the same spot.
For a moment, you have grabbed hold of some strong power, like a glimpse of some insane madness...
You come back to your senses. When you turn back again, the door of Hella's cell is already broken. She collapses to the floor in agony.

speaker: Hella
content: Bastard... Bastard... I'll kill you as soon as I get the chance...

speaker: S-019
content: She can't.
S-019 looks at you. The shadow next to her is now clear in your eyes. This is the real form of that horrible nightmare, which can no longer terrify you.

speaker: S-019
content: Any Sinners branded with <color=#fb9259>the shackles</color> are at your disposal.
As she speaks, she turns her gaze toward the other side of the corridor.
The rioters are here. The commotion here draws their attention, and they are now shouting and rushing over.

speaker: S-019
content: You are now an actual Chief. Please give me orders. From now on, I only follow your orders.

speaker: S-019
content: Copy that.
Whenever they unleash that stranger power, the shackles in your hand will throb, like some kind of frantic power is burning.

Your vision gradually blurs, and your consciousness returns to that dream again.
In the dream, "you" are whispering to someone...
Come here, <color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>. This isn't over.
We agreed...
After a brief silence, someone reaches out to you. That person wants to move closer to you with intense emotions.
You try to take that hand, but the fractured dream pushes you away...

speaker: S-019
content: It's over.

speaker: S-019
content: Chief, are you hurt?
You shake your head, but your mind is still very confused. You don't know if those images happened in reality. Could they be the memories you lost?

speaker: Choice
content: Have we met before?

speaker: S-019
content: No.

speaker: Choice
content: But I know your name.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your name isn't S-019... It's <color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>.

speaker: S-019
content: ...I don't need that name anymore.

speaker: S-019
content: But if that's what you want, then call me by that name, Chief.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's time to go. Adjutant Nightingale is waiting for you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: …Great, you did it. You regained your power.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The most important thing is that you're alive.

speaker: Hella
content: I didn't expect you would survive either, adjutant. How... awesome.

speaker: Hella
content: Let's end this riot together! I believe ${PlayerName} can do it!
She puts on an innocent and harmless face as if she has never threatened you in her life.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Only two Sinners left... Did the rest of them manage to escape?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Well, having you here is all that matters. Let's leave the rest to the guards and chase after the woman.
That "woman" who forced you to wake up and disguised herself as you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: This riot is just a diversion. This won't be her real agenda.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We've got the coordinates, Chief. Please come with me.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Watch out. The enemy is here.
The sound of liquid flowing comes from the surrounding walls and under the ground. You watch several monsters taking shape slowly before your eyes.

speaker: Nightingale
content: This is a monster she created... Looks like we're very close to the target.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Let's clear this obstacle first. This creature is highly infectious. But as long as you don't let it go near you, it won't pose any threat.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Get ready to fight. I'll fight with you all.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is...

speaker: Nightingale
content: The underground Sinner experiment area... We've caught up.
The intruder stands operating quickly in front of a strange-looking pyramid with her face still looking like yours.

speaker: Intruder
content: Hehehe, don't waste your bullets, Miss Nightingale. You know that won't affect me.

speaker: Intruder
content: Or perhaps, are you so eager to shoot your own Chief?

speaker: Nightingale
content: You're nothing but a counterfeit.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Even if you could steal his bio-information, you can't replicate his power. Surrender, <color=#fb9259>Sinner Shapeshifter</color>.
female_content: Even if you could steal her bio-information, you can't replicate her power. Surrender, <color=#fb9259>Sinner Shapeshifter</color>.

speaker: Intruder
content: The "shackles" are quite tricky indeed, but there are still things I can do with this face.
As "he" speaks, "his" hand presses on the operation panel to activate the system.
female_content: As "she" speaks, "her" hand presses on the operation panel to activate the system.

speaker: System
content: Identity confirmed—${PlayerName}, the Chief of MBCC—Loading access—Permitting access.
The tip of the pyramid cracks opens into a narrow door. The intruder walks in while a gigantic figure blocks your way.

speaker: Hella
content: ****! What monster is this?!
Hecate, along with her "nightmare", stands in front of you.

speaker: Intruder
content: I will come back to you once I finish what I need to do. Until then, I'll let my <color=#fb9259>pet</color> keep you entertained.

speaker: Nightingale
content: She's buying time again... But watch out, this enemy is different from the ones we faced!

speaker: Nightingale
content: This monster is on a higher level. Chief, be on your guard.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...It's over.

speaker: Nightingale
content: 019, 098, stay here to contain the monster and protect ${PlayerName}. Leave the woman to me.

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe, don't worry. Leave him to me. I will! Aaahhh!
female_content: Hehe, don't worry. Leave her to me. I will—Aaahhh!

content: Bang—

The ground suddenly cracks and monsters of different sizes swarm out. Ignoring you, they're destroying the entire underground experiment area wantonly. One of them lifts up the intruder and returns to above the ground.

speaker: Intruder
content: Amazing. You guys are still alive. I was worried it would hurt you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I see... The riot and attacking ${PlayerName} are just diversions. Your real aim is to destroy this place.

speaker: Intruder
content: That's not true. I was dying to see ${PlayerName} and truly hoped the poor Sinners would be set free.

speaker: Intruder
content: I just... didn't expect anyone would stay voluntarily and accept your restraints.
She looks at Hecate.

speaker: Intruder
content: Why didn't you run away when you got the chance?

speaker: Hecate
content: I don't need freedom.

speaker: Intruder
content: Silly girl... This isn't what a Sinner would say.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's over now. You can't resist the Chief's shackles no matter what ability you have.

speaker: Intruder
content: Hmm...

speaker: Intruder
content: Try me.
The ground beneath your feet suddenly collapses. At the intruder's silent order, something wraps around you and shoots upward, the acceleration putting you in a daze momentarily.
Hecate releases the shadow, only to be blocked by the stacks of monsters. You're now left alone with that intruder once again.

speaker: Intruder
content: Well, what are you going to do to me? "The Sinner who dares to attack you."

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, use the shackles!
You grab the intruder's hand. The crimson pattern flows out of your hand once again to bind her body.
The crimson pattern burns that disguise of hers, making her face blurred again.

speaker: Intruder
content: So this is what it's like to be bound by the shackles... You've awakened an incredible power indeed.

speaker: Intruder
content: What a pity... I can't be caught just yet.
She grips your hand and moves it away. The crimson shackles on her shatter at once.
The blonde hair sways in the wind. The woman in front of you finally reveals her real face.

speaker: Blonde Woman
content: ...${PlayerName}, do you remember me?

speaker: Choice
content: I don't know you.
She smiles and cups her hands on your face.

speaker: Blonde Woman
content: Then remember it now. We'll see each other again when it's all over.
Gunshots sound. Several monsters fall off instantly, leaving a hole in the wall of white flesh, through which you see Nightingale with her gun aimed at you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: What exactly do you want?
The blonde woman laughs. You feel the grip on your body loosens, then you fall onto the flesh below and are quickly caught by Hecate.
In the meantime, the defeated white monster suddenly stands up and flaps its wings, creating an overwhelming gust.
In the midst of the smoke and dust, the woman slowly walks toward the creature.

speaker: Blonde Woman
content: The secret will be revealed one day, but not now.

speaker: Blonde Woman
content:
Look at your cities. Look at what monsters human sin is breeding...
This is the final revelry you will enjoy.
In the end, she looks over at you and gives you that familiar smile again.

speaker: Blonde Woman
content: ${PlayerName}, go witness the end of this revelry. Whatever happens, don't look away. If you can do it...

speaker: Blonde Woman
content: I'll be waiting for you at the end with all the answers you have been looking for.

speaker: Blonde Woman
content: Goodbye...
The white monster rises in a powerful current of air and breaks through the dome, disappearing into the night sky.

speaker: Nightingale
content: After the Bureau riots, many Sinners fled into the Syndicate Control Zone in the west, which sparked off major riots. There has been a surge in incidents and a rising death toll.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The <color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau</color> has confirmed the whereabouts of the mastermind behind the Bureau riot—<color=#fb9259>Suspect R</color>—in the Syndicate...

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...And is willing to provide you with intelligence, but first they need MBCC to solve the crisis in Syndicate right now.

speaker: Nightingale
content: This is an extremely dangerous <color=#fb9259>classified mission</color>, which requires you to lead a team of Sinners to infiltrate the destination, contact the local security precinct, and arrest the target Sinners to bring the situation under control.

speaker: Choice
options: Why isn't the Public Security Bureau stepping in?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Because that is the gangsters' territory—<color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color>.

speaker: Nightingale
content: That is the gangsters' territory—<color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color>.
Boom—

speaker: Hecate
content: Get down!
The local security precinct that has promised to support you is just ahead. Its grand gates have already been blasted down. Nearly a hundred gangs are fighting right under its nose.

As far as the eye can see, all the streets descend into chaos and madness. In the air is the mixture of sounds of gunfire, maniacal laughter, and wailing, while the smell of blood and smoke permeates the streets.

speaker: Hella
content: That's right. Screw the *** Public Security Bureau. We don't need to give a damn when we fight.
She picks up a pipe and sends a grenade flying high with a swing, which explodes into blazing fireworks and draws the attention of the rioters.

speaker: Hella
content: Phew—Ha—Fresh air! What I'm most familiar with.

speaker: Hella
content: Lackeys—Welcome to Syndicate!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Syndicate is the poorest and most chaotic area of the DisCity, a gang haven and lawless place that has continuously spread violence and chaos to the entire city throughout these twenty years, and the control measures have never been effective.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Eventually, the city council was forced to sign the <color=#fb9259>West District Order Management regulations</color>, which basically allowed the gangs' autonomy outside the law to alleviate the many social concerns caused by Syndicate.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Bluntly put, the <color=#fb9259>gangs</color> are the real rulers of Syndicate. They make the rules and the authorities have no say in it.

speaker: Hella
content: Ahem, let me translate: Where did this beautiful lady come from? Is she really our enemy? Do we have to kill her? What a shame!
This nonsense translation sparks off even more rage and anger. They come at you again with their weapons.

speaker: Hella
content: Uh-oh. They're getting excited. Chief, brace yourself. Your first show is about to begin.
The Sinner girl tilts her head and gives you a bright grin.

speaker: Hella
content: I'll try to keep you alive for a bit longer.

speaker: Hella
content: We won! It's been a long time since I had such a great fight!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, how come you didn't get hurt at all? What a shame. How did I protect you so well?

speaker: Choice
options: You look like you wanna give me a good beating.

speaker: Hella
content: Haha! Look at your wimpy face! Are you that scared of me?

speaker: Hella
content: Hmm... A fake smile. You still keep your guard up around me.
After all, she strangled you when you first met. Of course, you keep your guard up.

speaker: Hella
content: Look at you being so nervous. Tsk. You look so insecure as the Chief. How pathetic.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm starting to like you now, hehe.
That's not what she meant with that derisive look on her face. You ignore her and turn to the gangsters who got battered on the ground.

speaker: Gangster
content: *** the Sinners!!! ******!!! Monsters—Go to hell! Go—Mmmmm—Mmmm—

speaker: Hella
content: We need to be CIVILIZED and POLITE with our words to maintain the image of our Syndicate.
She shoves her steel pipe into the gangster's mouth and shuts his foul mouth.

speaker: Choice
options: Are the gangs coming for us?

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft, the gangsters will fight anyone. You're just unlucky. Don't be so obsessed with yourself.

speaker: Hella
content: This is a place of the <color=#fb9259>law of the jungle</color>. Every summer, the gangs fight themselves to death to be the "Syndicate Boss."

speaker: Hella
content:
Hundreds of passersby get dragged into these idiots' fights every year and die for nothing.
Be careful, Mr. Chief. Don't get yourself killed in your first mission!
female_content:
Hundreds of passersby get dragged into these idiots' fights and die for nothing.
Be careful, Ma'am. Don't get yourself killed in your first mission!

speaker: Hecate
content: It's your job to protect the Chief. I'll deal with you if you fail to do so.
Hecate is still as cold and stiff as always.
She may "follow your orders", but as someone whom you have no idea what's on her mind, she may be further away from you than you think.

speaker: Hella
content: Okay, okay, okay! I'm showing you the way now, alright? Get your monster away, you gloomy guy.

speaker: Hella
content: Strange. They should have had the final showdown a month ago. How come they are still so rowdy...?
The thugs on the ground have been beaten into silence, but they're still writhing around struggling and becoming more and more exhilarated that they even left bite marks on the steel pipes.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is not the ordinary power.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief! Stand back!
More thugs are stumbling toward you from street corners with bloodshot eyes and distorted faces, seemingly unable to control their bodies.
A distinctive figure appears in the mob.
It was a young, thin girl with gray hair. She stares at you with hollow eyes, while a dark mist emanates from her body—the shackles in your hands suddenly begin to shake.

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe. Now I remember that a group in Syndicate will be very interested in you.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...<color=#fb9259>Sinners</color>.

speaker: Hecate
content: Your shackles are an absolute restraint to Sinners, which means <color=#fb9259>you are their worst enemy</color>.

speaker: Hecate
content: They will try to kill you any way they can.
The gray-haired girl raises her hand, then the dark mist from her body spreads outward. Wherever the mist reaches, the thugs howl and furiously charge past her toward you.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's <color=#fb9259>Mania</color>!
The deranged rioters charge at you and more gangs are dragged into the mayhem.

speaker: Hella
content: They call it a classified operation? See? They already know.

speaker: Hella
content: Catch that Sinner! Find out who betrayed us!

speaker: Hecate
content: No, protect the Chief. The enemy is targeting.

Before the sentence was finished, a black beam jabs at you. You instinctively block it with your hand, but it is impossible to be blocked. Everything suddenly slows down. This moment, you lock eyes with the killer.
Those hollow eyes show no emotions. No bloodthirsty madness, nor the slightest confusion or hesitation—only your death is reflected in them.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!
Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang—!

speaker: Gray-haired Girl
content: Uhh!
The gray-haired girl tumbles down to the ground. The bullets miss the vital parts but leave several bloody holes on her lean body. Her face grows paler as she stumbles toward the dark alley.
Don't go after her!

speaker: Red-haired Man
content: The gangs ahead have been infected by her Mania. It's too dangerous. Follow me.
You turn into the dark alleys to escape the rioter fights. The whole area descends into chaos and madness.

The thugs are growing stronger, while their minds break down one after another. Sounds of gunfire, lights reflecting from swinging blades, they fly everywhere while the thugs are losing their minds to the desire of killing and destruction.

speaker: Red-haired Man
content: You big cheese from the east must have never seen this side of the DisCity.

speaker: Red-haired Man
content: The world's most prosperous and affluent megalopolis has been given the notorious name of "<color=#fb9259>The City of Sins</color>". The crime rate is increasing, yet the authorities see no solution.

speaker: Red-haired Man
content: It's all because of this <color=#fb9259>Mania plague</color>, which pollutes the minds, amplifies human evil, empowers the wicked, and leads to collective madness.

speaker: Red-haired Man
content: Those Sinner monsters are the source of the Mania.
Clang—!

speaker: Hella
content: Watch your mouth, scoundrel. Who did you call a monster?
Hella's pipe dents the rusted pipes in the alley. The man shoots Hella a cold glance while remaining indifferent.

speaker: Red-haired Man
content: It is precisely this evil power that comes from the Mania and spreads Mania. They have turned Syndicate into a mess.

speaker: Red-haired Man
content: Sorry, I haven't introduced myself yet.

speaker: Red-haired Man
content: I'm <color=#fb9259>Ted</color>, an informant and assistant for the local security precinct in Syndicate, and the one who knows about this operation. The Bureau sent me here to meet you.

speaker: Ted
content: You're cautious, which is a good thing in Syndicate.

speaker: Ted
content: Take this. It's from the Public Security Bureau. You've lost contact with your people for a while now, haven't you?
He takes out a headset and hands it to you. The headset starts ringing.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, it's me.

speaker: Hella
content: Nightingale?!

speaker: Ted
content: I'm a gangster in Syndicate and a victim of Mania. I want to wipe out those monsters and restore order in Syndicate.

speaker: Ted
content: That is why I need you. I know MBCC has the power to wipe them out.
After stepping out of the dark alley, the Public Security Bureau is right ahead indeed, but more thugs are also around.

speaker: Hecate
content: We're outnumbered. It's difficult to protect the Chief without cover here.

speaker: Hella
content: They are even rowdier now. Do we have no other support? Did the Public Security Bureau only send one jerk to meet you?!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Don't worry. MBCC will help you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Face 11 o'clock and advance 14 meters to find the <color=#fb9259>support</color> we prepared for you.

speaker: Hecate
content: There are enemies nearby. They will spot us soon.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's okay. Once you get there, the power there can help you breakthrough.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Got it, I'll buy some time.

speaker: Gangster
content: ****! It's **** everywhere, everywhere! Those **** Sinners!

speaker: Ted
content: Hurry up! They'll breakthrough soon.

speaker: Hella
content: Shut up, I'm trying to find it! Where's the armored car and the rocket artillery? Where are the supports they promised? There's only a *** dumpster here!
She furiously gives it a kick, then a low grunt sounds from the dumpster, in which hides a tied-up... woman dressed like a hooligan.
Let me go! Do the sheriffs just arrest anyone nowadays? What else have I done apart from delivering takeaways?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Sinner S-217, <color=#fb9259>K.K.</color> Use the shackles, Chief. She can be your power.

speaker: Choice
options: ...But she said she didn't do anything wrong.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We'll check her background later, which won't be difficult to do in Syndicate.

speaker: Hella
content: Phew, what a "timely" support. Why did you contact us earlier? Then we wouldn't have to suffer so much.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Syndicate is in constant turmoil, so its communication network isn't secure. Forcing it might expose us.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Besides, Chief ${PlayerName} has always been excellent on the field.

speaker: Choice
options: But I believe the intel has been leaked.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's still manageable. The Bureau is getting intelligence officers to spread decoys to divert those who are targeting you as soon as possible.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The support mission has been completed. Calls will be temporarily disabled until we identify the source of the leak and guarantee that intelligence is secured.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, the support may be limited, but the Bureau has always got your back.
Ted walks towards the hidden door in the Public Security Bureau and enters a string of keys on the electric lock to open the intercom.

speaker: Intercom
content: You find saints in churches and drunks in hotels.

speaker: Ted
content: We walk with the ten devils.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's the code for the Public Security Bureau.

speaker: Hella
content: Alright, alright, I know he's the informant now. Solve it quickly and get the hell outta here.
No response from the intercom. Ted enters it once again.

speaker: Ted
content: You can't stay here for long. That Sinner just now will surely spread the message out. They will be here in no time.

speaker: Ted
content: It's a Sinner organization. The freedom in Syndicate has turned it into a shelter for the Sinners.

speaker: Ted
content: They came here to escape from the authorities, many even formed their own forces, which is now difficult to break and very dangerous.

speaker: Ted
content: The Suspect R you're after is hiding out at the <color=#fb9259>SALVA Hospital</color> on the west of the square—that's a well-known Sinner force.

speaker: Ted
content: Since even you are now being tracked down... it's likely that those Sinners have joined forces with each other.

speaker: Ted
content: The situation isn't in your favor. You must return to the Public Security Bureau as soon as possible and make plans after sorting out the intel.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, the ground is shaking. It's a heavy tank... and it's a fleet.
Ted's face suddenly turns pale. Despite receiving no response from the intercom, he can't afford to wait any longer and yanks you to run toward the Public Security Bureau.

speaker: Ted
content: It's them!!
Boom—
The shock leaves you lightheaded. You hear the rumbling from the heavy tanks, gunfire and cannon fire, and the loud crash of concrete walls crumbling.

The dust dissipates, the building has been reduced to rubble. A tall figure appears above your head with feet on the collapsed wall, overlooking the streets. For a moment, you find yourself locking eyes with the person—
It is a Sinner, a very powerful one... Certainly not someone you are strong enough to defeat now.

speaker: Ted
content: Come on! The Public Security Bureau has been captured. Run for your life!
Ted's shout pulls you back to reality. Hecate, holding your hand, is pulling you and running into the alley toward the intersection from which you came.

speaker: Hecate
content: There are enemies ahead!

speaker: Ted
content: Break through! Even at the cost of your Sinners!

speaker: Ted
content: This is the last chance. It will be too late if they completely surround the place.
Your body isn't used to such strenuous exercise yet, and the murky air in the sewers makes you exhausted.

speaker: Hella
content: I remember them. They're <color=#fb9259>the Legion</color>! The most impressive gang in Syndicate these recent years. All the gangs are scared of them!

speaker: Hella
content: Was it their boss who made the Public Security Bureau with one blow? Wow! Don't tell me even she is targeting you?! I remember she's called, hmm... Zo—

speaker: Ted
content: She's the most terrifying monster in Syndicate. If she hadn't destroyed our order, Syndicate wouldn't be in such a state...

speaker: Ted
content: You can't fall into her hands, nor can any of us.
You think of the figure on the high-rise, which sends chills down your spine. Ted is analyzing something to himself as he mutters quickly and his face turns pale.

speaker: Ted
content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>Why is she here? Have we lost our cover? When? Damn it, only they...</size></color>

speaker: Ted
content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>No, they didn't go to the hospital, which means they don't know yet... the decoy has worked... That's right, that's why they had to come to the Public Security Bureau to find intel, which had already been disposed of...</size></color>

speaker: Ted
content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>That's right. There's still a way. We've still got time...</size></color>

speaker: Ted
content: Come back to the stronghold with me. My men are there watching SALVA. They can fight too. And plus your Sinners, we can win.

speaker: Ted
content:
It'll do if we attack SALVA before the Legion does and get the target out.
Go, now. Hurry up!

speaker: Hecate
content: Hold on.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's too risky. We must abort the operation if the Chief's safety is at risk.

speaker: Ted
content: Shut up. You just need to follow orders as a Sinner.

speaker: Hecate
content: I only follow the Chief's orders.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, should we proceed with the operation?
This is the worst opening possible. There is a leak of your intelligence, your support has been destroyed, and you don't know who betrayed you and who is on to you.
But...
Go witness the end of this revelry. Whatever happens, don't look away. If you can do it...
I'll be waiting for you at the end with all the answers you've been looking for.

speaker: Hecate
content: Please tell me your decision.

speaker: Hecate
content: The department only "discovered" the whereabouts of the fugitives and suspected her of being a suspect R. This intel can be wrong.
That's okay. You want to see her again and have many questions to ask her. Just allow yourself to take every small chance to catch her.
Besides, the target will shift soon. This may be the last chance.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Got it, I'll protect you.

speaker: Ted
content: Wise decision. Let's go. There may be riots on the road to the stronghold at any time. I'll find you some camouflage, but prepare yourself to fight at any time.
You nod then look at Hella. She has been very quiet.

speaker: Hella
content: What are you looking at me for? Go on. You have decided now. I'm not gonna go against you, am I?

speaker: Hella
content: But I'm just putting it out there—I hate gangsters. This jerk is definitely just using us. Don't trust him too much, dumbass.
You know it. You don't trust him completely. In fact, you have nothing to fully trust, including your memory.

speaker: Ted
content: The gangsters ahead aren't on our side, so be careful and go around them.

speaker: Ted
content: It's lucky that someone is causing trouble on the roof and drawing the attention of the enemies.

speaker: Gangster
content: Catch her!! She's a Sinner!! She can be very useful!!
You are too far away and can only make out that she is an archer. She is pretty strong fighting against so many on her own.
It's just that the figure drawing the bow looks somewhat familiar.

speaker: Hecate
content: She's very outnumbered. She's not gonna last long.

speaker: Choice
content: Save her.|Slip away now.

speaker: Hella
content: Ah, hold on, isn't that <color=#fb9259>EMP</color>? I remember her. She's the guy who got locked up nearby.

speaker: EMP
content: You think you can trap me, "the Archer Queen of Syndicate?"
Oh, it's her.

speaker: Hella
content: That sassy bow-drawing posture is too distinctive.

speaker: EMP
content: Ah, that stupid hat—Aren't you Hella, the loser?! You're here just in time.

speaker: EMP
content: Are you in awe of my heroic posture? Let me reward you with a chance to fight alongside "the Archer Queen of Syndicate!"

speaker: EMP
content: It's now or never. I can still treat you to a big bowl of Syndican noodles when this is over!

speaker: Hella
content: ...That dumbass isn't gonna hold out any longer.

speaker: Hecate
content: She is a fugitive Sinner, S-107. Danger Rating: B, which is the same as Hella. Arrest difficulty: Low.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm not on the same rating as that dumbass!!! Hecate, where's your respect?!

speaker: EMP
content:
Wait, what's that one-eyed gloomy idiot doing here? And the new Chief?
Hella, since when did you start working for the Bureau as a lapdog?!

speaker: EMP
content: And even working for the Chief who got beaten up by me and hid behind people's back like a loser?

speaker: Choice
options: I've changed my mind. Arrest her now.

content:
She looks like she can be a good fighter.
Besides, she treated you so “well”, it only makes sense to pay it back.

speaker: EMP
content: Hmm... Interesting. No one in the whole Syndicate can take my arrows.
Her fierce arrow flies past the gangs around her and shoots straight at the ground in front of you. The arc of electricity left by the arrow draws the attention of all the rioters toward you.

speaker: Gangster
content: Oh, isn't that Ted? He's got two Sinners with him. Hehe... What a treat!

speaker: EMP
content: Come on, I will beat you all up by myself!

speaker: Hella
content: Stop drawing them toward us, you jerk!

speaker: EMP
content: I surrender! Lord, surrender! Lord Hecate, stop!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, do you want to continue? Please give the order.

speaker: EMP
content: Chief!!!
She jumps straight off the roof and falls face down before you with a thud. She might as well just wail with her arms around your legs.

speaker: EMP
content: The new Chief of Minos Bureau of Crisis Control is so brave and awesome! I was wrong to underestimate you. Please forgive me, Chief!

speaker: Choice
options: So who was the one beating me up?

speaker: EMP
content: No one, no one! I wouldn't dare! My electricity can do nothing other than making someone numb. It certainly can't kill! Your teammates are all fine, Chief!

speaker: EMP
content: I have no choice in Syndicate. I need to know how to fake it to survive! B-but I'll repent of my ways!

speaker: Hella
content: Wow! how embarrassing for the "Archer Queen of Syndicate!" So are you gonna work for the Bureau as a lapdog now?!

speaker: EMP
content: Shut up! At least I've embraced freedom, but what about you? You couldn't even get out of your cage, am I right?

speaker: Hella
content: Shut up! You're Syndicate's disgrace!

speaker: EMP
content: Yuck! You're Minos's trash!

speaker: Choice
options: Cut the crap and arrest her first.
If you will fight for me.

speaker: EMP
content: Huh? No, no, no! I'm just a useless loser. I can't be of much help. Please stop! Hey! Stop it! St—stop—

speaker: EMP
content: At least don't put me in the front row in a fight!!!

speaker: Ted
content: We're almost there.
You carefully avoid the gangsters in the mayhem, but you can't actually get out of the battlefield.
The rotten odor of burnt proteins, the frenetic gunfire and screams, and the bitterness in your mouth—All of these irritate you.
SALVA is getting closer. The closer you get, the more tragic the situation is.

speaker: Ted
content: The news of SALVA hiding felony Sinners has spread throughout the city. It's the last straw the gangs can stand, who have decided to teach these jerks a lesson.

speaker: Hecate
content: But now they're killing each other.

speaker: Ted
content: That's because Mania has destroyed their sanity. SALVA knows how to take advantage of Mania more than the girl who attacked you.

speaker: Ted
content: Those devils didn't start the hospital to "save lives".
Ted doesn't reply and suddenly stops you and signals you to keep quiet.
On the other side of the street, several men in white robes are carrying a stretcher and doing something to the gangsters on the ground.

speaker: Ted
content: ...It's SALVA. Be careful not to get caught.
Most of the members of SALVA have mechanical prostheses and wear white robes with a broken and upside-down cross. An ambulance full of bullet holes is parked nearby.

speaker: Hella
content: SALVA is saving the gangsters?! They're too far away to hear what they're saying... Ah! They're fighting each other.
It is just a one-sided fight. A doctor-looking man slaps the injured gangster heavily, who then passes out and is put on a stretcher.

speaker: Ted
content: That is my subordinate. I sent him to spy on SALVA. I don't know how much more torture he will suffer if he gets taken away.

speaker: Ted
content: Wait! I've seen him before.
He looks at the leader of the SALVA doctors.

speaker: Ted
content: I remember him. He was the one who took in the target Sinner who escaped to SALVA.

speaker: Hecate
content: You mean we can get intel from him?

speaker: Ted
content: As long as you guys can control that guy.

speaker: Ted
content: Come on, Chief. Fight with your Sinners.

speaker: Hella
content: Gasp—These doctors are quite strong.

speaker: Ted
content: These people used to be gangsters in Syndicate and were taken in by SALVA and transformed into armed doctors.

speaker: Ted
content: It'll be difficult to pry intelligence out of them.
He steps forward and yanks up the surviving doctor, ignoring his howls and dragging him over to a seriously injured nurse. Seeing his injured companion completely throws him into a panic.

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: Laura, Laura, are you okay?! Get off me, you bastard! Laura!

speaker: Ted
content: Is she called Laura? Poor thing. She's on her death bed now. If you can answer my questions, I'll let you save her.

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: Go to *** hell, you ***!!!
Bang—
Ted shoots the nurse in the leg, who lets out a wretched shriek.

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: Stop!!!

speaker: Ted
content: Where is the Sinner you took in yesterday?

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: Sh-she's in the <color=#fb9259>basement</color>. A-Anne, the head nurse, sent her down there herself.

speaker: Ted
content: Then?

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: I-I don't know. I'm not allowed to go down there. I-It's their...

speaker: Ted
content: What did the Sinner have with her? Did she say anything?

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: No, I don't know. I didn't get close to her. Really! No! Please!! Don't shoot!!!

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: I heard her saying things like "inheritance... She's found something... Something about power..." That's all I heard. I know nothing, but I've told you everything I heard.

speaker: Ted
content: "<color=#fb9259>Inheritance</color>"... Hahaha! I knew she had it!

speaker: Ted
content: Did you notify the Legion of this? I know your medical director is friends with the Legion.

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: No, I don't know. The medical director <color=#fb9259>Iron</color> is away and hasn't returned yet, so we can't reach her.

speaker: Ted
content: Very well. Did you hear that, Chief? It's this "inheritance" that can control Mania and set off this crisis.

speaker: Ted
content: Even the Legion wants it. We have to get it as soon as possible and must not let it fall into the hands of others.

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: No... Please, Laura... is in so much pain, please...
Ted remembers he had agreed to let them go, then he aims his gun at Laura.

speaker: Ted
content: She's lost too much blood. This is how I'll save her. Don't worry. I have good aim.

speaker: SALVA Doctor
content: No!!!
Bang—The bullet misses. A shadow shifts his shooting.
Hecate acted on your orders. You failed to stop the first shot, but you won't allow him to make the second shot.

speaker: Choice
options: We've got the intel. It's enough.

speaker: Ted
content: ...This is how we do things in Syndicate, Chief. The enemy will never take it easy on us.

speaker: Ted
content: If he goes back and leaks intel about you, then SALVA will not let you off easily.

speaker: Ted
content: Chief, you are too kind... but Syndicate has no room for such kindness.

speaker: Ted
content: If he goes back and leaks intel about you, then SALVA will not let you off easily.

speaker: Ted
content: I know them. I know what SALVA wants and what they will do. I know it all, and it's disgusting!
As he speaks, a grenade flies over from behind and blows up the SALVA ambulance.
Flames rise from the explosion, in which are several moving shadows. They suddenly dash out.

speaker: Monster
content: Roaaahhh—!!!

speaker: Hecate
content: An ambush?

speaker: Ted
content: See, Chief. This is SALVA. They collect these monsters on the battlefield and create them in the hospital.

speaker: Ted
content: <color=#fb9259>Corruptor</color>—Remember this name. They are more powerful and dangerous than those pathetic Maniatic gangsters.

speaker: Ted
content: This is what a Maniac turns into, being consumed by the overwhelming power and completely transformed into a monster controlled by Mania.

speaker: Ted
content: Those in SALVA are collecting corpses of the Corruptors and carrying out shady experiments in the hospital basement to gain the power of the Mania.

speaker: Ted
content: <color=#fb9259>The medical director, Iron</color>, is crazy about developing various forbidden surgeries to distort the minds of the Syndicans with Mania to brainwash them.

speaker: Ted
content: SALVA's obsession with Mania is an open secret among the Syndicate gangs. Since they work with Suspect R to spark off this massive Mania plague, they must be trying to obtain greater power.

speaker: Hella
content: You keep calling Sinners monsters, culprits who spread Mania.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm a Sinner too. Are you gonna explode if I bite you?

speaker: Ted
content: ...How annoying. I offered to work together not so that a Sinner can give me attitude.

speaker: Ted
content: You should discipline her, Chief. Stop her barking around. Otherwise, even your lapdog will be gotten rid of.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm no one's lapdog! None of us are!
Hella is infuriated and smashes her steel pipe at Ted, who shows no fear but only a murderous look.
A chill runs down your spine as you recall the grenade that blew up the ambulance.
His men are already here. The guns must be aimed right at you and Hella!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!

speaker: Hella
content: Mmm!!
The moment you speak, you feel a burn in your hands, while red beams shoot out of Hella's skin branded with shackles like spikes.
She wails and falls to her knees as if she is drained of all strength, looking at you in shock.

speaker: Ted
content: Is this power...?!!!

speaker: Hella
content: Ow... It hurts... This again... What did you do? What did you jerk do to me again?!!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Sinners can never defy their master's order.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, never try to disobey the Chief.

speaker: Ted
content: You can suppress Sinners completely. This isn't any ordinary technology... What is it...

speaker: Ted
content: ...Chief, I was wrong to say you can't keep you men disciplined. What a surprise you are.
You are in a dangerous situation and can't afford to start a fight with him here. You have to leave first. You extend your hand to Hella.

speaker: Choice
options: Sorry, but it's for your own good.
Now isn't the time for a fight.

speaker: Hella
content: Get out of here!

speaker: Ted
content: Now I know how important they are to you. I'm very surprised... but I'll get my men under control.

speaker: Ted
content: Haha, good. I've never been able to read you, but seeing you getting angry made me feel a bit closer to you.

speaker: Ted
content: I didn't know how important they are to you. I'll get my men under control. Can't believe we dared to upset you. It's definitely our bad.

speaker: Ted
content: I'm very grateful. I've come up with many plans to take down the SALVA basement, but every one of them is extremely risky.

speaker: Ted
content: But it doesn't matter now that you're with us. Together, we'll be able to take down SALVA with minimal loss.
Now he knows his place. After seeing Ted off, you sit down against the wall and take a sip of water before you finally relax.
It wasn't necessary to go this far. In your position, you shouldn't have picked fights and shouldn't have taken unnecessary risks.
Yet, the trouble caused by those guys was too serious.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Forgive him this easily? He's just playing along in front of you. Who knows what he actually thinks?

speaker: Choice
options: I don't really believe him. It's just back-scratching.
That's fine. If he betrays, we'll be able to deal with him.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmm... How impressive, Chief. You really have thought it through and managed to get Ted to do what you want.

speaker: Hella
content: So was Ted right about—"they're important to you?"
You almost choke on the water.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? Was it just a bluff? Was it genuine? Did you help me because we are important to you?
It's a misunderstanding, of course! For your own safety, you can't let the Sinners stay emotionally unstable for a long time. Who knows what she'll do when she gets furious?

speaker: Hella
content: Come on, Chief, tell me!
But the girl you've always been wary of is now blinking eagerly, waiting for your answer... This may be a chance to gain her trust.

speaker: Choice
options: Yes, I care about you girls.

speaker: Chief
content: You feel happy and sad, get scared and hurt. It's just that you have strange abilities and are a bit annoying.

speaker: Chief
content: If this makes you a monster, then what about me who bind you with the "shackles"?

speaker: Hella
content: ...Pfft, stop finding similarities between us. I'm not as indecisive and awkward as you are.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm a free Sinner. One day, I'll break free from your shackles and regain my liberty again! You can keep your sentimentalism to yourself!

speaker: Chief
content: ...Perhaps you see the shackles as a despicable bondage. But to me, it is our only real connection.

speaker: Chief
content: I guess yes. I care about you guys a lot.

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft, who are you trying to fool? You think I'll fall for this?

speaker: Hella
content: Listen. One day, I'll break free from your shackles. I want my liberty! Liberty! See ya!
She shakes off her hand and turns back after skipping a few steps away.

speaker: Hella
content: Nevertheless... as a coward who only ever hides behind people, you deserve recognition for standing up for me.

speaker: Hella
content: Before dumping you, I'll help you one more time. You should cherish this opportunity.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't you need to take down whatever that crazy hospital is?
She gives you a smile, unlike the ones she gave you in the past.
A gang of thirty or so people is besieging an old converted warehouse, on top of which hangs a broken upside-down cross, overlooking this unprecedentedly bloody battle.
This is SALVA. In the middle of the battlefield stands the hospital, and your target is the basement underneath.

speaker: Hella
content: Seem like we got here too late. Are those gangsters attacking the hospital your men?

speaker: Ted
content: No, they're fighters from the Gonzales family. Looks like they heard the news too and have come to rob the place.

speaker: Ted
content: But how are they so powerful. Could it be that...?

speaker: Hecate
content: These gangsters look odd. They've been severely infested by Mania now.

speaker: Ted
content: Those idiots are too impatient.

speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
content: Oh, hey—it's Ted! Our little Teddie is here—What a pity. You came here too late. Hehehe.

speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
content: Kill him! Kill him! Kill him! SALVA is ours! It's ours!

speaker: Hella
content: Oh, dear. You haven't even taken down SALVA yet, and you're already fighting amongst yourselves. You gangsters will always be crappy.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}, stand behind me. Let me show you how to teach them a lesson!

speaker: Hella
content: I can't hold it any longer! Their brains are tougher than my pipe! How the *** can we defeat them?! Hecate! Come give me a hand!

speaker: Hecate
content: It's too dangerous here. Chief, come this way!

speaker: Hella
content: Don't just leave me here!
Hecate grabs your hand and pulls you into a dark alley.
After coming across a dumpster, she tosses you in and closes the lid. A foul smell envelops you, almost knocking you out.

speaker: Hecate
content: Stay here. Let us deal with the enemy.

To be slain by a Corruptor, or choke to death from garbage stench? The difference no longer matters to you. You instinctively reach out to push open the lid. The light shines through, illuminating a snow-white limb by your side.
Lying next to you inside the dumpster is a beautiful young maid.
Her fair, slender limbs are strewn with scars, and her skin is spotted with stains. The maid's eyes are wide open, lifeless and cold.
You restrain your panic and try to back away slowly from the maid's body. However, your hand sinks into the garbage and triggers a landslide inside the dumpster.
The body of the maid lands in your arms.
She is hard and heavy, ringing out metallic echoes whenever she hits something. The moment she touches you, her pupils light up.
You can't help but edge closer and observe the girl under the dim light. Her body has not yet decayed, nor did she have even a whiff of foul odor.
The battle stains splattered across her face made her wide-open eyes appear even sadder.
You can't help but reach out to wipe the stains from her face. The minute you touch her, you hear a whirring sound, and her pupils light up.

speaker: Broken Maid
content: Lo-lowering co-contamination. Clearing contamination. Removing barrier. Retrieving the body.

speaker: Broken Maid
content: Reboot. Rebooting system. System reboot failed. Initializing the system. Deleting memory... Work, fight... co... coffee...

speaker: Hecate
content:
What's happening?!
Is it a Sinner reaction?

speaker: Broken Maid
content:
Protect... Ma... Mary... Mary... Ma... ry...
I'm... so... rry...
Some liquid drips past her cheeks. Her joints twist and creak as she suddenly jerks up. Her head hits the top of the dumpster with a loud metallic bang.

speaker: Broken Maid
content: Initialization is complete. Reboot successful.

speaker: Broken Maid
content:
Hello, A.I. Maid III, <color=#fb9259>Labyrinth</color>, at your service.
Would you like me to start cleaning, Master?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Battle won. Battle command to protect object's return successfully. Hello.

speaker: Hella
content: ...A robot?

speaker: Hecate
content: Sinners can only be human.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: <color=#fb9259>Human</color>? There is a complete human nervous system in my body. Is this considered human?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I don't know.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: I am curious. You and I are very similar. Are you waiting for commands too?

speaker: Hecate
content: We are different.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: I am delighted. As a tool, I am more outstanding.
A screw pops out from this outstanding robot maid.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Oh, no! This body is severely damaged. Finding a repair site... SALVA, prosthesis repair center.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Apply. Master, can you pay to repair the body of your cutest maid?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Mary? Searching database. Search completed. I only have the record of you, Master. Is it someone important to you? Would you like me to find her for you?

content: Coffee. Do you want any? It is a program I am proud of. It will surely make you happy.
You guys won, but Ted's men are still beating up the defeated opponents with bloodshot eyes and fatal blows.
