Extreme pain and confusion are hitting you hard. You can vaguely hear Hecate's shouts, see the two figures running toward you, and see Zoya dart her gaze to the side to glance at them.
Feeling real fear at that moment, you instinctively grab her wrist with your right hand and feel your palm begin to burn...

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Hmm.

speaker: Hecate
content: Let him go!
female_content: Let her go!

content: The massive power gripping your wrist loosen. Your legs feel weak and you sit onto the ground, collapsing. Hecate and Hella rush to you in time, holding your arms to support you. But right now, even the Nightmare is terrified.

Having achieved her purpose, the fearsome commander acts as if nothing has happened. She shakes her right hand, now branded with the shackles, clenches her fist, and stares down at you, seeming amused.

speaker: Zoya
content: Hmm... I'll admit the reason behind your move is kinda cute.

speaker: Zoya
content: Alright, what's done is done, cut the grumbles.

speaker: Tall and Thin Man
content: ...How does it feel to be restrained?

speaker: Zoya
content: Nothing special. I need to try it to see.
When she finishes, she casually scoops up a worn sedan on the side and smashes it straight behind an abandoned container. Some startled shouts come out from there.
Apparently, a group of gangsters has been hiding there for a while. Having been spotted, they can only toughen up and charge.

speaker: Ambushing Gangsters
content: Set off the flare to have them get ready down there! We'll slow her down!

speaker: Ambushing Gangsters
content: We can't let the Legion take the inheritance!

speaker: Zoya
content: Good timing, come and be my sandbags. Let me see how these shackles can enhance my power.

speaker: Zoya
content: Hey, you two, protect your chief. Before I go down, he can't die.
female_content: Hey, you two, protect your chief. Before I go down, she can't die.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Hmm, it's kind of useful. Makes good insurance.
She's placidly getting rid of the filthy and wounded enemies, looking calm as if the shackles have no restrictive effect on her at all.

speaker: Hecate
content: That's what an S-Class Sinner is like...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, are you alright? Are you having any side effects from using the shackles on her?
Hecate hasn't left your side since, and her overly nervous look somehow lessens your anxiety.
I've never heard you need to take special precautions to use the shackles on S-Class Sinners. As the leader, it's our gain to have caught this big fish.
We're outnumbered now, but I'm sure we'll find a chance later. We'll come up with a way to get out of this...
What way?
The lanky advisor of the Legion suddenly emerges behind you.

speaker: Legion Advisor
content: Glad to see you're unharmed, our guests from Minos. Relax, I'm not here to kill anyone.

speaker: Legion Advisor
content: I'm <color=#fb9259>Earl</color>, the Legion's advisor. I'm here to sincerely ask for your cooperation.

speaker: Earl
content: The purpose of the Legion's current mission is to seize the trophy that should have belonged to us. That is, to retrieve the inheritance in the cave. I believe you understand that this is the gang's internal affair and it doesn't violate the Management Regulations.

speaker: Earl
content: We never intend to go against the authorities, we only need the Chief's assistance. As for our commander's temper... I beg your forgiveness.

speaker: Earl
content: The Legion will soon unify Syndicate. It's crucial for us to build a healthy relationship with the authorities early on.
He holds out a hand to you, but you don't take it.
Sensing vigilance in the two Sinners beside you, an alarm is sounding in your mind.

options: Was it you who called Zoya?
Was it you who separately interrogate them?

speaker: Earl
content: ...Yes.
This man has an intricate mind. He'll only look for partnership from someone who can benefit them. Now that you've already put the shackles on Zoya, he must be seeking compensation in other ways.
Seeing no response from you, he smiles and draws back his neglected hand.

speaker: Earl
content: ...I don't like dancing around the subject with the smart ones either, let me get to the point then.

speaker: Earl
content: I'm the second Sinner of the Legion, and my ability is precise explosion. While you were unconscious, I've already implanted a bomb inside your body.

speaker: Earl
content: Hold back your power, kid. Unless you want to see his head blow up right now.
female_content: Hold back your power, kid. Unless you want to see her head blow up right now.

options: This is the insurance you've taken for this partnership?
You don't approve of this cooperation at all.

speaker: Earl
content: After all, your shackles are too powerful. I hope the partnership is established with both parties on equal grounds.
This idea of equality sounds laughable.

speaker: Earl
content: Yes. But since the commander has chosen you, I must make sure her decision will turn out flawless.

speaker: Earl
content: Rest assured. As long as the commander still needs your shackles, I'll let you live till the end.

speaker: Earl
content: If you ever use the Forbidden Force on my commander, threaten her, or confine her... or if she were to die for any reason, I'll detonate the bomb immediately.

speaker: Earl
content: Once the mission ends successfully, I'll remove my power over you.
He turns to leave, the metallic prosthetic in place of his left leg clanging.
He's not going to let you live till the end or allow you to threaten the Legion. Once the mission ends, the bomb will go off so that their commander can have her freedom back.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait!
Having been unusually silent, Hella suddenly comes forward. Ever since you've been reunited, she's been seeming troubled, as if searching for something.

speaker: Hella
content: That girl with the motorbike... She's not with you guys, is she? The Legion only hired her to hunt us down, right?

speaker: Hella
content: Where... did she go?

speaker: Earl
content: She's finished her job. She's left.

speaker: Hella
content: Left? That's not possible, she was here to find me! She couldn't just leave without a wo —

speaker: Earl
content: Why don't you ask her yourself then? Are the shackles on you stopping you from doing that too?

speaker: Zoya
content: Let's go down, they've waited long enough.

Beneath the crypt, the ominous pulsations are still continuing. The gangsters are growing uneasy. They've obviously received the signals sent by the sentries, and the grand battle is ready to break out any moment now.

You've been dragged into this dogfight that you have nothing to do with. From now on, either trying to get yourself out of this situation or continuing with your mission will put you in a precarious position.
You come down into the crypt along a bare metal staircase. Up close, most of the facilities here seem long abandoned, but the scale of the structure is surprisingly big.

Intertwining rebar and iron sheets under the moonlight look like a magnificent forest of iron and steel. But the annual rings have been eaten through by rust and white sand has suffocated all vitality, and the place is totally forgotten.
You glance at Earl who's walking beside you.

options: I didn't know grand places like this existed in Syndicate.

speaker: Earl
content: ...They do, and there are many of them. This is probably a desert warehouse built a few decades ago, made to cope with the huge logistic needs of the DisCity's exports.

speaker: Earl
content: No need to look so surprised. Although Syndicate has become what it is now, over thirty years ago, it used to be the DisCity's true economic center and a mega industrial city.

speaker: Earl
content: Every piece of Hypercube extracted from DisSea was processed and went through the logistical and commercial preparation here. They were then shipped off to everywhere in the world with the West District's name printed on them.

speaker: Earl
content: Huge factories, warehouses, ports, and furnaces were everywhere. This place is only one of them. Its remote location has made it invisible, that's why it's still intact now.

speaker: Earl
content: It hasn't been destroyed by gangs, only forgotten. It's lured in some suspicious punks to squat in here.

options: What led to the fall of the West District?

speaker: Earl
content: A <color=#fb9259>massive explosion</color> blew up the mining area in DisSea, contaminating the lifeblood of the industrial city. The city went bankrupt and was abandoned, simple as that.
He smiles faintly.

speaker: Earl
content: Are you asking me all this because you've never studied the city's history, or you're really that unbothered by your own situation?

options: Info exchange with cooperating partners. Natural, isn't it?

content: You know he's monitoring you. Although you've ended up here because you had no other choices, you figure there's no need to be too anxious or hesitant. Having fully understood the situation, you've made your judgment.
Both the origins of Suspect R and the Mania may be hidden in the depths of this crypt. You need information as well as power. It's beneficial for you to side with the Legion.
You'll make sure you have perfect control over everything. You must.

options: You said there was suspicious stuff down here. What did you mean?

speaker: Earl
content: I meant, mind your step.
Black sparks suddenly emerge from the ground on the right lane ahead. Next, with a huge blast, countless pitch-black spikes are snaking up from underground.

speaker: Hella
content: A trap?!

speaker: Legionnaire
content: Aha! Here they are, finally!

speaker: Hecate
content: This is not just an ordinary trap. It's been contaminated, and the energy that activated it is—Mania power!

speaker: Hecate
content: Are there other Sinners among the gangsters?
Several strange figures are hiding in the shadow. With weirdly-shaped canes in their hands and in bizarre outfits, their bodies are crooked in abnormal positions.

speaker: Weird Woman
content: Die... die, you jinxed curse of Syndicate... O divine punishment! Rain down upon thee! Thou Voodoos shall smite thee!

speaker: Hecate
content: What's that power... Are they Sinners?

speaker: Hella
content: Don't be silly, those are just the clowning frauds of Thou Voodoos. They always say Sinners are demons and that we deserve divine punishment.
As you're talking, an entire magazine of bullets hits the iron box beside you. Behind you, several hidden gangsters jump on top of a rusty container.

speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
content: Haha! You've fallen for the trap. Die, die, die!

speaker: Hella
content: Humph, there are still Gonzales idiots left alive?

speaker: Hecate
content: Their strategies are well coordinated. It seems like they're ganging up against the Legion.

speaker: Hecate
content: Beware of those weapons. They're unusually powerful and the attacks can activate traps. Be very careful.

options: But this is also a good chance.

content: We should grab a few of those weapons. I'm curious about their power.

speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
content: Fire! Fire! The Legion is on the right! Fire! Red Falcon's little ****! Where's your cannon?

speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
content: Ahhhh!

The Red Falcon's cannoneer is thrown off from the top of the container, knocking down his companions like a tumbling sandbag. Of course, the group who's stepped onto the container is Zoya and her subordinates.

speaker: Legionnaire
content: Carnivore, Gonzales, Red Falcon... Oh! Even Thou Voodoos is here. Except for Ted, we've got everyone here.

speaker: Legionnaire
content: Tsk, I thought only Commander's funeral could bring in so many people.

speaker: Zoya
content: What a shame. Guess how many of them will make it out of here tonight and live till that day?

speaker: Legionnaire
content: Hahahaha—oh, Advisor!

speaker: Legionnaire
content: Relax, relax. Long live Boss Zoya, she's not gonna die anytime soon!
When Earl emerges with a glum face behind them, the joking lads immediately shut their mouths.

speaker: Earl
content: Yagyu is probably around here as well.

speaker: Earl
content: The gangs have been fighting for years, but they're now united to go against the Legion—you've successfully unified Syndicate, Commander.

speaker: Zoya
content: Awesome. Now that they're all gathered together, I don't need to look for them one by one.

speaker: Then... where can I find the remaining roses? Will Daddy... still come back?
content: I'll smash them all in a go.
Her gaze detaches from the calm and relaxed Legionnaires, and falls on the scattering gangsters down below who're looking absolutely terrified and flustered.
Very soon, they're subdued. You have to admit that when you're on her side, she's indeed very reliable.
With Zoya handling the main battleground, you have time to retreat to the side and take a look at the trophies.

speaker: Hella
content: Here, Thou Voodoos' cane.
The top of the cane is embellished with a bizarre crystal, bright red and gleaming. Although it's slightly different from the liquid Iron has shown you, you will never mistake this ominous feeling...
It's a <color=#fb9259>Mania Crystal</color>.

speaker: Earl
content: It's a Syndican specialty, a Mania weapon embedded with crystals.
He's already used to your spontaneous questions.

speaker: Earl
content: It offers different abilities through the activation of the Mania Crystal. The gangs use it against the Legion too. They desire power as strong as Sinners'.

speaker: Earl
content: They've got what they want. When a user attacks with the Mania weapon, their own mental activity will be amplified as well.

speaker: Earl
content: To put it simply, the more bloodthirsty the user becomes, the stronger the Mania weapon's effect.

options: And does the Legion want it too?

speaker: Earl
content: Only the weak imitate. We don't need that.

speaker: Earl
content: But you should still be careful. The Mania weapon won't cause severe contamination in the user directly, but that's only because the contamination is all transferred to the victim.

speaker: Earl
content: You better watch out for stray bullets around you.
The gangsters who've been subdued by Zoya have obviously gone insane.

speaker: Red Falcon mob
content: Use up your bullets before you go! Destroy as many of the Legionnaires as you can, turn them all into monsters!
Fretfully, they're blasting out all the bullets at the Legion, completely heedless of their own allies still on the battleground.

speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
content: No, no, don't do that —We're still here, don't shoot, wait till we've left before you...

speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
content: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!

speaker: Hella
content: He's turned into a Corruptor! Those Red Falcon scum are definitely doing it on purpose. They're betraying their allies to buy time!
As the bullets are about to hit the Legionnaires, several Gonzales guys are thrown out one after another to take this wave of contamination attack. They're howling and their bodies begin to distort.

speaker: Legionnaire
content: Commander!

speaker: Zoya
content: You guys, kill these monsters. I'm going after those spineless traitors!
Her voice is low. Before anyone can respond, she runs straight in the direction the Red Falcon has fled.

speaker: Earl
content: ...Even if she said that, handling this number of monsters while watching over several noobs is not that easy.

speaker: Hella
content: Cut the crap! If it hadn't been for the bomb, I would have already knocked off your head!

speaker: Earl
content: Oh? Then how about the Legion takes care of the front, and you take care of those guys at the back?

speaker: Earl
content: Just call for someone if you can't handle it anymore, the Legion will send help, Chief.

speaker: Hella
content: This bastard hasn't done anything at all. All he does is stand there and watch...

speaker: Earl
content: Because there's no need. Your chief is very outstanding.

speaker: Earl
content: ...Very outstanding.

speaker: Hecate
content: Have all the enemies been eliminated?

speaker: Earl
content: The commander is not back yet, meaning the battle is probably not finished yet. The smarter gangsters will certainly avoid her, go separate ways, and find a chance to attack us on their own.

speaker: Earl
content: A real guerilla will waste too much of our time...
He looks at you, eyes full of calculation and scheming.

options: That's your trouble. Not my business.
Do you need our help to fight?

speaker: Earl
content: ...You're right.
He looks at you, considers briefly, and gives a faint smile.

speaker: Earl
content: No, I'm sure you'll seize the chance to escape. If that happens, I'll have to detonate the bomb.

speaker: Earl
content: Just kidding.

speaker: Earl
content: Our partnership doesn't require you to fight. The Legion has got enough men. As long as the Chief is alive and refrains from escaping, that's enough.

speaker: Earl
content: How about this, if you want to stay safe, you can stay here. Hide yourselves well and take some rest.

speaker: Earl
content: I'm bringing some guys to help the commander clean up the trouble. Then I'll come back to pick you up.
He gives orders to his subordinates, then turns to add before setting off.

speaker: Earl
content: You're smart. Don't get yourself into trouble.

speaker: Earl
content: There are still too many gangsters hiding around here. Not all of them are brainless junkies like the Gonzales. Don't go wandering around. No one will come to save you if anything happens.

speaker: Earl
content: See you around. Remember, don't die.
Of course.
Once you've made sure he's out of sight, you borrow Hella's pipe and draw a huge arrow on the sandy ground pointing toward the dark alley. Then, you slip into it on your own.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, what is this for...?
As expected, several men in black suits soon come out from behind the container, each of them carrying an oriental-styled long sword.
Good evening, sir. <color=#fb9259>Yagyu</color> here.
female_content: Good evening, ma'am. Yagyu here.

content: Earl clearly wants to use you for some purpose, and you need more information of other sorts as well—for example, information about these gangsters.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=30>... How did you spot these rotten fish?</size>

speaker: Hella
content: <size=30>Be careful. The Yagyu members are well-dressed scumbags with no morals at all. If this guy claims to be an ordinary employee, don't believe him.</size>

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: We're from Yagyu Limited, a long-established registered company in the West District that operates with integrity. We're not a gang.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=30>Bah.</size>

speaker: Hecate
content: Are you following us?

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: I pay attention to you. Until tonight, I hadn't seen you in Syndicate, sir.
female_content: I pay attention to you. Until tonight, I hadn't seen you in Syndicate, ma'am.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: You're not with the Legion, are you, sir?
female_content: You're not with the Legion, are you, ma'am?

content: You use the lie you've made up: You're a newbie sheriff who'd just won Ted's favor, but then Ted was killed by SALVA. After escaping from the clinic, you unfortunately ended up in the Legion's hands.

You stress the fact that the Legion took you to the crypt because they seemed to think you were hiding some information about the inheritance. But knowing nothing at all, you only want to ensure your own safety and escape.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=30>No kidding, you'll fit in Syndicate quite well.</size>
Upon hearing your explanation, the Yagyu executive's eyes brighten up briefly and a wicked smile creeps up on his face.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: That's why you drew that mark to ask for help... It's very brave and resourceful of you to keep resisting, having already faced that woman.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: We can help you. Once we wipe out the entire Legion, Earl's curse will vanish automatically. You'll be free then.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: The gang alliance has already lain an ambush in the central elevator. That place will be the Legion's grave.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: That woman is overconfident. She thinks the inheritance is already in her hands, but she doesn't know about...
He chuckles coldly and lowers his voice.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: ...Her subordinate, the Sinner who escaped from SALVA and went out to do recon for her. She's supposed to be trapped underground now, half-dead.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Zoya has always been a jinx. Those who are close to her never end up well. If we're lucky, today may become the death anniversary of the whole Legion.
...R is half-dead?

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: You seem very concerned about her?
Facing his doubtful look, you steady your emotion and change the question.

options: I'm wondering what I can do.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: ...Haha, why don't you come with us now. Once we're back to our base, we'll discuss things in detail.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: No need to worry about that bomb, we can fake a combat scene to make him believe you were forced to leave instead of fleeing on your own...
Is this a chance to get away from the Legion? But will Earl and Zoya be fooled by the staged evidence?
Or, perhaps even if they believe you're forced, he'll still detonate the bomb without any hesitation?

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: You're a valuable talent, we'd like you to join us. You've <color=#fb9259>trained</color> two Sinners so well, no wonder you're Ted's friend.
As you're still considering, hearing Ted's name suddenly startles you.

options: What does it have to do with Ted?

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: In fact... Yagyu provides some special services too.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Sinners like Zoya have completely fallen. But those like the two beside you... Sinners this age can become very useful if they're properly trained.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Ted has had excellent achievements in this aspect.

options: Are you talking about a gray-haired Sinner girl?

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: You've met her? Yes, in fact, we sold her to Ted. We only knew Sinners were dangerous at that time, we never expected they could be trained like that...

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: They've got great power. More importantly, they obey and only take orders from you. Isn't that even better than the Mania weapon?

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: What a shame they were destroyed in SALVA yesterday. Otherwise, they would have stood here today and fought alongside us in the final battle.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: In order to defeat the Legion, we need stronger power... Something even stronger than the Mania weapon...
He smiles at you, but you're slowly clenching your fists, your nails digging into your palms uncontrollably.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: What do you think, sir? Surely these two beside you can...
female_content: So, what do you think, ma'am? Surely these two beside you can...

options: This is your true purpose, isn't it?

content: You don't care if I live or die, as long as you get the two Sinners.
The Yagyu executive's smile disappears.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, relax your hands. Your palms are bleeding.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Chief?
Hella grabs the pipe and stands before you.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't force yourself if you can't stand it anymore.

options: You guys are right, enough role play from me.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Humph... Liar, fool, you mere Sinners... Who exactly are you?! Are you a lackey of the Legion's after all?

options: Say whatever you want. It's time for your punishment.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Quit joking. Do you think there's no one else here?

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Come out, Thou Voodoos! Carnivore! Stop hiding! You're gonna just sit and watch Syndicate get taken over by others?!

speaker: Hecate
content: Those are the ones hiding around here. They're all carrying Mania weapons.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Hahaha, idiot! This is our territory, stocked full of our arms everywhere! We won't lose, we can't lose!

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Syndicate's order can't be spoiled further. This is our justice! We'll give you neither the inheritance nor Syndicate! It belongs to us!

speaker: Hecate
content: It's the Mania. Did they suffer a backlash from their own weapons?

speaker: Hella
content: Who knows? I say they've always been insane like this, Mania or not. Let's finish them off, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Hella
content: ...${PlayerName}? Are you okay?
Perhaps you're triggered by these people who're gradually losing their sanity, or you're suffering the side effects of overusing your potestas out of rage, your senses have become a lot sharper now.
You can clearly feel the nauseating presence clashing increasingly hard in the depths of the earth. Its influence over you has suddenly been amplified.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, I'll hold them off. Hella, you get Chief out of here and find the Legion.

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate, are you out of your mind?! What a crappy plan!

speaker: Hecate
content: Your safety is our priority, that's the order I've received. I can't let you take the risk.
The way this kid's mind works maddens you a bit, especially when she says things like this with a blank face.
You finally understand. It's not because she's cold and ruthless —in the face of orders, Hecate is blunt and stubborn, like a plank of wood.

options: You should listen to my orders
We'll only be worse off without you

speaker: Chief
content: If you really want me to live, stay beside me and protect me till the end.

speaker: Hecate
content: Is that an order?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Got it, I'll protect you, untill the end.

speaker: Hella
content: I didn't know there were so many people hiding around us. Could it be that all the gangsters have been lured here?

speaker: Hella
content: We've already made such a scene. Where are the guys from the Legion? I thought they said they'd protect us?
Bang bang —you're not sure if you feel your suddenly quickened heartbeat first or hear the loud noise first.
A massive truck suddenly crashes down from above, tumbling between you and the thugs. After some howls and cries, the other side quickly falls silent in fear.
Several familiar figures appear atop the truck. Even against the moonlight, you can still clearly see Zoya's cold eyes.

speaker: Zoya
content: Hmm, no wonder I barely found anyone, you've all come here for him, huh. I thought you wanted a fight with the Legion?
female_content: Hmm, no wonder I barely found anyone, you've all come here for her, huh. I thought you wanted a fight with the Legion?

speaker: Earl
content: You put out a good bait. Now everyone's here.

speaker: Hella
content: ****, he's fishing too?

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: No way... Where's the Red Falcon? They have... They've sent so many people and taken the most weapons. They couldn't have lost, they couldn't have...

speaker: Zoya
content: They were indeed numerous, I can't bring them all  back. I've only kept a few on me, take them as souvenirs.
She throws down a full handful of bloodied dog tags, smashing them onto the gangsters' faces. They yelp and fall onto the ground, backing up.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: No! Don't come over!

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Treacherous cowards. Even the authorities' lapdog has a thicker spine than you.
She curses and leaps down straight from the container, landing hard on the ground. She grabs the collar of one of the guys.
Debris keeps falling on his face, making him howl loudly in response.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Ahhhhhhhh! Mercy, mercy! I yield! I yield.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: It's all the boss's order. I-I'm only a salaried employee, I was forced into it!

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: I have to survive, and the only way to do it is to join a gang. You know what it's like. That's how things work in Syndicate! I had no other options!

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Spare me—I was forced into it, forced by life. It's all Syndicate's fault!
His howls are extremely sad, but Zoya's face is only growing colder. She draws out his long sword silently. Fine blood-red crystals are embedded on one side of the sword.

speaker: Zoya
content: You've got a good sword.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: ...Huh?

speaker: Zoya
content: A Mania weapon. The fancy type used for commendation within Yagyu. You've been taking good care of the sword. You love it and are proud of it.

speaker: Zoya
content: How many people did you kill with it to win this honor?

speaker: Zoya
content: Among them, how many were kids, civilians, and innocent people? Did they die? Or did they get infected with the Mania?

speaker: Zoya
content: When you wield the sword, are you happy? Are you proud? Are you counting your kills and waiting for the next prize?

speaker: Zoya
content: How many more good swords like this have you got?
She breaks the Mania long sword with her bare hand, then grips the Yagyu executive's neck.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Ah, ah... It's Syndicate... Syndicate turned me into... an evil person... It's not just me, it does that to everyone...

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: Spare me, you've already won. No one else can beat you. According to the rules, you're the overlord of Syndicate, you're the boss! I'll do whatever you say, just don't kill me!

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Yes. It's all Syndicate's fault. I'll destroy every part of it, including you.

speaker: Zoya
content: You've long become part of it.
Her hand tightens. The Yagyu executive grunts once, then goes quiet completely.

speaker: Zoya
content: Overlord? Haha, it's because of the desire for such a thing, this place has become what it is.

speaker: Zoya
content: I don't want to be your king. I want your death.
Dead silence. After a long while, she turns toward the Legion. Her voice has calmed down.

speaker: Zoya
content: I did it too quickly. Go and grill some of the other ones. Ask them where the inheritance is, who sent them, and who gave them the weapons.

speaker: Zoya
content: Once you're done, finish them off.
She stalks past you with her eyes staring straight ahead, but you still see the flames in her eyes vividly.
It's those icy flames again. You've finally confirmed that there's no future in her eyes, only an obsession with bringing destruction and death to the past.
You're no exception. You're the authorities' lapdog, her enemy.
You must get away from her.

speaker: Earl
content: That's the central elevator.
In front of you is a huge freight elevator that goes into the depths of the earth. Traces of recent frequent use are clearly visible.
The containers around it are shockingly piled full of various Mania weapons.

speaker: Zoya
content: So this is their arsenal, huh. No wonder they had the audacity to pick a fight with me.

speaker: Earl
content: The aboveground part is only a warehouse. The equipment for assembling weapons should be underground, kept together with the inheritance.
The underground waves are becoming more and more intense. The feeling is similar to that when a Sinner corrupts, and it makes you even sicker.

speaker: Zoya
content: Alright, all of you stand by here. Clean up the trash while you're at it.

speaker: Zoya
content: Now, I'll go down with the Bureau's guys to retrieve the inheritance.

speaker: Hella
content: Are you kidding me? We've already fought the whole day, none of us is risking our lives to go down with you!

speaker: Zoya
content: You don't have to come. I only need your chief to follow me.

speaker: Hella
content: You...!

options: What if I attack you when no one else is around?
Why the rush? You know what happened to your subordinate?

speaker: Zoya
content: Oh? You've given up resisting?

options: Because it's pointless to resist you.

speaker: Zoya
content: Haha, you were a lot tougher when you were dealing with Yagyu.
Her tone sounds a little complimentary. But you can't care less about such things now.

speaker: Zoya
content: Without me, you won't make it back out alive.

speaker: Chief
content: Also, I've seen too many people who want to kill me. You haven't got the kind of dead stare they have.
Indeed, you don't have that kind of stupid idea in your mind.
Both of their faces grow somber. It seems that the Yagyu executive was telling the truth, though that doesn't matter anymore.
You don't plan to go down with her.
Several contamination grenades blow up the stacked weapon boxes on the side. Black spikes are bursting out and clumping up to form filthy crawling creatures.

speaker: Remnant Red Falcon
content: You're not going down! I won't let you have the inheritance, and I won't let you have Syndicate! You all will die here!

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Seems that some of them fell through the cracks. Earl, protect the Bureau's team.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Haha, fine. If you can't hold it off, just scream for help.

speaker: Zoya
content: This time I'll save you.
No, this time you'll control how the story unfolds.

speaker: Hecate
content: <size=30>The Yagyu executive was right. There are indeed other ambushes.</size>

speaker: Hella
content: It's not gonna work, they're only dying for nothing. Hey, we gotta think about our next step. We can't really go down with her...

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate, attack coming on your right.

speaker: Hecate
content: I saw it.
A survived Yagyu member is growling as he charges at Hecate, his body entirely driven by a hysterical fear. Right now!
You push Hecate away and fall into the thug's grasp in her stead.

speaker: Tender steak paired with juicy cactus slices, followed by big gulps of icy mint tea... there's no greater comfort for Hella after a long day.
content: Chief!
Stop.
You murmur. Hecate reads your lips and stops her hand from releasing the Nightmare. At that moment, that ever changeless face suddenly seems confused.
The next second, his knife is already on your neck.

speaker: Earl
content: What happened?

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: Don't come near! Or I'll cut off his head!
female_content: Don't come near! Or I'll cut off her head!

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: Haha, haha... You lied that you were their enemy... The Legion seems to care about you a lot... You're my hostage now!
He moves while dragging you, retreating toward the secret passage behind him step by step.

speaker: Hella
content: You ***, give him back!
female_content: You ***, give her back!

speaker: Hella
content: ****, Zoya! Why are you standing there? Go and save him. He's only taken because of you...
female_content: ****, Zoya! Why are you standing there? Go and save her. She's only taken because of you...

content: The accident makes the whole Legion freeze. Earl looks at you hesitantly, then at his commander. He doesn't make his next move.
But Zoya is only staring into your eyes—and laughs.

speaker: Zoya
content: You're not gonna scream for help?
Her gaze is piercing. You struggle a little to show respect.

speaker: Zoya
content: Haha, I'll...
Hecate is wordlessly pulling back Hella who's gone berserk, while Zoya is only standing still and watching the Yagyu member drag you into the narrow passage roughly. You can't hear her last sentence.
Yagyu chops open the contaminated weapon box. The spikes burst out and block the road. Then he dragged you into darkness brutally.
This is the first step. You got rid of the Legion.

You've been taken to a secret warehouse. Some bizarre weapon boxes have been cracked open forcefully, scattering around on the ground chaotically. The dozen of remaining thugs are all gathered here, discussing their exit plan.

speaker: Remnant Red Falcon
content: I quit. I wanna go back! I shouldn't have believed your crap, I shouldn't have even...

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: You can't shirk a job like this! Those who ran away last time all got buried by their own bosses. This is a job from <color=#fb9259>them</color>, and your only option is to get it done! We must destroy the Legion!

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: And don't forget the weapons, the weapons they gave us! More and stronger Mania weapons!

speaker: Remnant Red Falcon
content: What good do weapons do! A few hundred people came and now there are only a dozen of us left. Even if we have all the Mania weapons in the world, what are we supposed to do with them?!

speaker: Remnant Red Falcon
content: You've all seen it. God knows what got into that woman, she's not fazed by contamination at all this time! We can't win!

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: We still have the hostage. Zoya needs that person. We can at least...

speaker: Remnant Thou Voodoos
content: Inheritance... We still have the inheritance... The voodoo's will lies there. The path she takes is filled with traps. Thou Voodoos will bring divine punishment to them...

speaker: Remnant Thou Voodoos
content: Go to... the second downward well, the path closer to the inheritance... It's here...

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: ...Alright, alright.

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: That's our only option now. The inheritance lies down there. If we're lucky enough, we can still flip things around. Take the hostage and get going.

You're lying on the ground and trying hard to gather information. At the same time, you swallow the pain, silently feel the shackles within you, and feel the presence of the Sinners on the other end of the shackles.
The unusually strong one has already gone down. The other two are approaching in your direction. Luckily enough, one of them probably has spotted the traces you left behind.
You've won half the bet. As the Yagyu member has said, the underground situation has already gone out of Zoya's control. She's not going to waste time on you. She will certainly choose to go down.
Before she comes back, Earl must be standing guard by the elevator. He can't leave his commander alone, and he absolutely won't kill you now and let the commander be exposed to contamination.
As long as the two Sinners can find you, you'll still be on track. As you're thinking, your captors have come before you.

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: Get up! Gotta go!

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: You're lucky you're still useful to us, otherwise I would *******
He drags you up roughly. The argument and the fact of their loss are obviously annoying him.
You must try to buy time. You can't be moved yet, at least not before they find you. With this thought, you grit your teeth and force a smirk.

options: ...It's kind of embarrassing to get mad because you've lost.

content: A punch lands hard on your head. The man in a suit has forgone all his grace. He grabs your collar and begins yelling.

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: ***** prick! You ******* lapdog of the Legion! Shut up! Shut up!

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: If it hadn't been for that stupid little trick you pulled on us, Yagyu's team wouldn't have been stopped there and gotten ruined by the Legion!

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: It's all your fault!! It's all your fault!! ****!
His eyes are bloodshot and his punches keep landing hysterically on your body one after another. He's taking out his rage from the loss on you.
Extreme pain makes you too weak to keep sensing, but your sanity remains. If he yells even more loudly, will the Sinners hear him?

options: Control yourself. Your life depends on your hostage now.

speaker: Remnant Yagyu
content: You ******! I'm gonna shoot you! ****!
Bang! With a huge blast, a black shadow jumps out behind you, charging at the man hitting you. He gets bounced off and hits a storage rack a few meters away, moaning.
The Nightmare is standing before you. Its shape makes it look like it's boiling. A low rumbling is flowing out from its core, as if it's raging.
Meanwhile, the girl's voice rings behind you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Please don't get hurt while I'm not around, Chief.

speaker: Hecate
content: You've given me the order to stay beside you and protect you untill the end. If that's what you want, please always stay within my sight.
A pair of warm hands hold your back gently, supporting your body covered in wounds. You can finally relax.

speaker: Hella
content: You run too fast! Did you find the Chief?! Ah, ${PlayerName}, you...

speaker: Hella
content: What the ****! Which bastard did this to you! Who did this!

speaker: Hella
content: (Blows) Let me massage it a little. Does it still hurt?

speaker: Hella
content: Oh no, ${PlayerName}. How could they do that to you, even I've never beaten you up like this... Why did you have to provoke them?
You want to say it looks worse than it feels, but it's rare to see these two look so worried about you...
Just let them be.

options: How did you guys find me?

content: It's not an easy route from the central elevator to here.

speaker: Hecate
content: Just like Chief can locate Sinners with the shackles, we can sense your presence too.

speaker: Hecate
content: Although it was very faint, I heard your call on the other end of the shackles.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's all thanks to the shackles that I could come back to your side.
Her voice is still so calm and expressionless. Meanwhile, the Nightmare floats to your side and rubs at your gently.

speaker: Hecate
content: Just as you expected, Zoya went down by the central elevator on her own. Earl is guarding the entrance.

speaker: Hecate
content: The underground situation is precarious for them as well. The Legion can't spare anyone to come and stop you.
Did they release these two to save you so that the shackles can be preserved and they can let others help finish off the remaining gangsters?

speaker: Hecate
content: To remove the Legion's control over Chief, we must get in touch with the Bureau before Zoya comes back from underground. We must look for ways to disable Earl's power.

speaker: Hecate
content: Let's go, Hella. We should leave this place.
At least until Zoya returns from underground, you will still be safe and free. You've never been closer to the target.

speaker: Thou Voodoos
content: <color=#fb9259>Inheritance</color>... We still have the inheritance... The voodoo's will lies there, the path she takes is filled with traps. Thou Voodoos will bring divine punishment to them...

speaker: Thou Voodoos
content: Go to... <color=#fb9259>the second downward well</color>, the path closer to the inheritance... It's <color=#fb9259>here</color>...

speaker: Hecate
content: But...
You kick open the weapon box left behind by the gangsters. They're still filled with Mania weapons.
According to Ted, Mania Crystal is a rare commodity, yet the gangsters here each have one of these. It's they who are distributing the weapons and spreading rumors about the inheritance.
Who are they? What do they have to do with the inheritance and the Mania crisis?

speaker: Hella
content: Wait... I... recognize this stuff.
She picks up the weapon box cracked open by the gangsters. It holds a broken jar with some blood-red liquid left inside.
A ring is printed on one spot, with a letter <color=#fb9259>P</color> marked in the center of the ring.

options: Is this a Mania Crystal in its liquid state?

speaker: Hella
content: No... That's not what it's called... I understand now, I should have recognized it sooner...

speaker: Hella
content: Mania Crystals are extracted from Sinners' bodies. This is an experiment done by those bastards...

speaker: Hella
content: But why is it here... They have already...
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The intense shaking interrupts your question, like a massive heartbeat coming from underground. You've never felt the inheritance's presence so strongly.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, let go!
The Nightmare knocks off the jar in Hella's hand. It smashes on the ground and suddenly lets out countless black spikes. They're wriggling and reproducing rapidly like living things.

speaker: Hecate
content: Who knew that tiny piece of Mania Crystal can turn into such a big one...
The ground beneath you suddenly crumbles. Countless longer and sharper contamination spikes are crashing through the concrete floor. You are falling down into a mezzanine level.
There are more weapon boxes with the letter P piled up here. Now, they're all bursting open from within and the contamination is pouring out.

speaker: Hella
content: Why is it here? Haven't they all...

speaker: Hella
content: Are they here for her?!

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella! Focus! Fight!
Filthy monsters are emerging one after another from the wriggling contamination!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...These Mania Crystals are going manic. Chief, we must get out of here. There's something dangerous lurking underground.

speaker: Hella
content: It's ahead of us...

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella...? Where are you going?

speaker: Hella
content: ...Those lingering ghosts! They're right ahead!
She rushes toward the source of the red light. It's a hidden door that's been blasted open.
Behind the hidden door is a narrow and well-concealed laboratory.
Light passes through several jars filled with red liquid and makes the entire narrow space blood-red. The jars are printed with the sharp text <color=#fb9259>"PARMA-Type 99"</color>.

speaker: Hella
content: These are...?
Bang!
Another wave of pulsations. Several jars blow up at the same time. The blood-red liquid spills out and is spreading on the floor.
Slowly, a few ominous shapes are gathering in the liquid. Although the features are smudged, the madness and bloodthirstiness still remind you of someone.

options: Is it that Legion's mercenary who attacked us?

speaker: Hecate
content: No, that's only the polymer of the contamination. It's more dangerous than that Sinner. Is it also caused by the Mania Crystals?

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, fight!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Hella?! What are you doing?
Hella is watching that contorted shape blankly, her whole body trembling.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Ninety-Nine?

speaker: Hecate
content: Get it together. That's not a human.

speaker: Hella
content: I know!
But she obviously can't hold up her body anymore. She flops down on the floor and starts dry-heaving.

speaker: Hella
content: I understand now... That's why those gangsters can use Sinner's power...

speaker: Hella
content: Damn it... Those bastards at Parma... How dare they do that to her... How could they do such a thing...

speaker: Hella
content: ...I don't want to say it.

speaker: Hecate
content: You have to at least explain this.

speaker: Hella
content: ...This is an experiment done by a bunch of scumbags.

speaker: Hella
content: Those Mania Crystals kept in the jars and robbed by the Syndican gangsters were all extracted from Sinners.

speaker: Hella
content: All those different Mania abilities held by the Mania weapons were all extracted from the Sinners with the respective abilities.

speaker: Hella
content: Those bastards tortured us all for this thing.

speaker: Hella
content: Those bastards, I have to kill them...
She smashes her fist onto the floor. Her hand is cut and the debris caught in the wound hinders her regeneration.
You hold her hand without saying anything, trying to calm her down.

speaker: Hecate
content: But we've never seen Mania Crystals go manic to this extent. Why would the substance extracted from Sinners turn into contamination?

options: It must be the effect of the inheritance.

speaker: Remnant Thou Voodoos
content: Go to... <color=#fb9259>the second downward well</color>, the <color=#fb9259>path</color> closer to the inheritance... It's here...
You finally find the second elevator. From the gap of the ajar door, filthy substances continue to leak out.

The sprightly young supply manager leans against the railing, tilting her head back to gaze at the sky, her body nearly folded in half. Shin, who is jotting notes on a clipboard, smiles wearily and places a hand on Emily's back to pull her up.
It must be an extremely evil power, something more fearsome and deeper than you can imagine. You feel fear, not because you want to escape, but because...
Fear is a premonition. If you ignore it, it's bound to cause even worse disasters.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, it's dangerous...
But the inheritance in the underground is even more dangerous, and so is the person going to retrieve it.
Should you turn back, or go even deeper?
That image before you parted ways emerges in your brain. Her eyes and that sentence you didn't catch are now appearing vividly in your mind.

speaker: Zoya
content: Haha, I'll...
See you down there.
You read her lips.

speaker: Hella
content: ...How far down have we gone?

speaker: Hecate
content: Less than 30 meters. Can't see the bottom yet... The crypt is deeper than I thought.
In the bottomless darkness beneath, the invisible evil presence is still throbbing and spitting murmurs of malice.

options: There could be enemies down there—Corruptors or monsters.

speaker: Hella
content: I get it... I get it! Look, I've got goose bumps all over. I'm not blind or deaf. I know nothing good is going on down there.

speaker: Hella
content: Since this place has something to do with Par... with Mania Crystals, it'll surprise no one if there are some demons or monsters lurking down there.

speaker: Hella
content: Brace yourself. There's gonna be an ugly battle the second we land.

speaker: Hecate
content: Looks like... we don't have to wait. They're already here.
Clank!

Without any warning, the elevator slams into some obstacle. Following a loud bang, the elevator crashes through something hard—a random array of crystals, perhaps, which are falling into pieces upon impact.
You can't see the bottom. The only sensation you are experiencing is the jerky descent of the elevator, which eventually gets stuck at an angle somewhere in the middle.

speaker: Hella
content: ****, is it broken?

speaker: Hecate
content: Not yet. But careful... We're trapped in the center of the contamination.
A faint light illuminates the deep shaft, whose walls are covered with huge contaminated spikes. It's these spikes that have brought the elevator to a halt.
(Rustling...)

speaker: Hella
content: ...What's that sound? There's something crawling in between the spikes...

speaker: Corruptor
content: Roarrrr!

speaker: Hella
content: Corruptors?

speaker: Hecate
content: It can't be. We took care of them long ago. This is something else!

speaker: Corruptor
content: Ooohhh... give it to me... give it to me...

speaker: Hella
content: Piss off!
She swings the water pipe and sends flying an approaching Corruptor.

speaker: Hella
content: Move! Move! This damn elevator has to be stuck in this awkward position. There's no way of getting out!

speaker: Hella
content:
If we don't do something, we'll be eaten alive sooner or later!
—Ah!
The elevator jerks and starts dropping. It travels a distance before coming to a shaky stop.

speaker: Hecate
content: There's something above. On the cable...
The top of the elevator is already gone. Hanging on the far end of the cable are several contorted shades, sawing away at the cable with their Mania machetes.

speaker: Corruptor
content: Sssss... Sssss...

speaker: Hella
content: They're cutting the cable?!
For a fleeting moment, you see in those soulless eyes naked murderous malice, something you've never seen before in other Corruptors.
After a flash of light from the steel, the thick and taut cable is severed. The elevator floor dips, and the elevator starts falling at a surprising speed.

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhhh!

options: Calm down! Take hold of me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The elevator has a braking mechanism. The spikes in the shaft help break the fall too. We're not free falling yet.

speaker: Hella
content: Listen to yourself. Why are you holding me so tight then? Who is more panicky here?

speaker: Hecate
content: The enemy below poses no threat for the moment, but watch out for attacks from above.

speaker: Hella
content: Attacks from above?
The last word has hardly come out. Several Corruptors jump down from above, landing on the already rickety elevator with a thump.

speaker: Hecate
content: This isn't the kind of murderous aura Corruptors are supposed to have. Is someone controlling them?

speaker: Hella
content: Haha... The elevator is falling into pieces, and they are jumping on board to die with us...

speaker: Hella
content: Hold tight, ${PlayerName}. Look at the height... We're counting on you to come up with something to save us from being smashed to a pulp.

speaker: Hella
content: We're near the bottom. We're gonna crash!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, hold on to me!
Clank!

speaker: Hella
content: Ouch... It hurts... Get up, you're on top of me.
As you're getting off Hella carefully, a hand from behind helps you to your feet. It belongs to Hecate. She looks all right too.

speaker: Hella
content:
I thought we were a pulp now. Why aren't we?
We were dropping so fast...

speaker: Hecate
content: The contaminated spikes around here melted just in time and acted like a buffer.

speaker: Hella
content: Haha... So we're lucky?

Supported by Hecate and Hella, you step off the shattered elevator gingerly onto the ground. The ruined elevator floor is buried underneath a mound of mushy, stinky flesh. You try your best to avert your eyes.

options: How long since they became Corruptors?

speaker: Hecate
content: Hard to say. They've been corrupted for a long time. But the contamination here is different from that triggering Mania crisis in the SALVA basement.

speaker: Hecate
content: At that time, I sensed the contamination resonates strongly with a specific person, with that girl. But here...
You can sense a strong presence ahead of you, throbbing slowly in the bowels of the crypt. It is radiating strong and murderous malice, nothing human-like.
It's more like a bewitchment, a curse that goes back a long way to the source.

options: It's probably the effect of the inheritance.

speaker: Hecate
content: Can you sense it?
Yes, that nauseating aura overpowers almost everything here—except her...
At the other end of the shackles, a Sinner, too powerful to ignore, is moving slowly.

speaker: Hella & Hecate
content: Hey!

speaker: Hecate
content: Where is she? Are the other Legion members coming with her?

You shake your head. She is coming down by the central elevator, still a distance away from you. You can't judge how many people have come with her, but you know that she has come for the same reason as you.

options: Let's go. Better get there before her.

speaker: Hecate
content: Understood. Hella, have you recovered?

speaker: Hella
content: Don't treat me like a liability. Let's go. This little injury will heal by itself in no time.

You cast one last glance over your shoulder. Giant spikes of contamination are protruding from the mountain of carcasses. They are like thorns in a growing frenzy. Tough and dense, they have pierced every inch of the elevator platform.
Only the spikes near where you fell have melted, and a narrow passage has formed. The bush of spikes seems to have gotten itself out of someone's way or has opened itself up to welcome someone in.
It's not Hella's power, nor Hecate's. Then whose power was it?
As Hella moves ahead, she inspects the massive cracks on the walls and the ground.

speaker: Hella
content: ...We're not alone. Someone was here before us.

The ground is studded with bullet holes, with occasional firearms and human remains. The remains have been assimilated by the contamination, but the fresh smell of blood bespeaks the recentness of the battle.

speaker: Hella
content: They were cut open by a large weapon, not a sword, but... an ax, a really heavy, big ax... The gangsters tried to block someone's way, but they failed...

speaker: Hella
content: It was only one person. How insanely powerful... The brutal way they fought does look a lot like Zoya. I bet they must be a demon bear, a demon bear with a huge ax at that.

speaker: Yagyu Executive
content: ...Her subordinate, the Sinner who escaped from SALVA and went out to do recon for her. She's supposed to be trapped underground now, half-dead.

speaker: Hella
content: Which bit of this is the work of someone half-dead?

speaker: Hella
content: Wait... What the **** is painted here?
She has touched a massive arrow painted with blood and is straining to look at the jumbled symbols below the arrow.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is a message. Hella, you... Can't read?

speaker: Hella
content: Damn it, it's because of the hideous handwriting!

speaker: Hecate
content: Let me take a look... It says, "Downwards, Be Careful." Can't you understand?

speaker: Hella
content: You're so annoying!
You step forward. The handwriting does look a bit crooked. It seems it took the writer quite an effort.
On the ground, a trail of blood extends from where the message was found. Hecate picks up something from beside the blood.

speaker: Hecate
content: She has been injured. This is a torn first-aid bandage... It comes from the <color=#fb9259>SALVA</color>.

options: Indeed the Sinner from the SALVA basement.

content: It's the Sinner you've been chasing—Suspect R. But this doesn't look like how the woman who woke you up would fight. What on earth is going on?
As you are pondering, the carcasses suddenly move.

speaker: Active Contamination
content: ...Drive away... Drive away...

speaker: Hecate
content: Their movements are a bit strange. Watch yourself.

speaker: Hella
content: Tsk, here they are again. This is definitely not the way Corruptors are supposed to be. What the heck is controlling them?

speaker: Hella
content: Haha... How outrageously powerful!
Among the shattered, hollow carcasses, the <color=#fb9259>Mania Crystals</color> embedded in the weapons become deformed and merge with the contamination, glowing an eerie red.

options: Are they controlled by Mania Crystals?

speaker: Hella
content: Surely those little rocks can't be that powerful, right? Hold on. Ted's men used the crystals too, but they didn't turn into this.

options: Something is wrong with the crystals in the weapons.
Something is wrong with this place.

speaker: Chief
content: The Mania Crystals in this crypt apparently possess a will of their own. This has been the case with monsters created from Type 99 Crystals.

speaker: Hella
content: She isn't that kind of person!
That's right. This probably has nothing to do with "99" herself. Its true master is...
Bang! With another wave of throbbing, the aura of the inheritance is getting stronger. As if responding to its call, the monsters before you begin to howl.

speaker: Hecate
content: There's no time. We must get through the passage and find the inheritance.

speaker: Hecate
content: The exit is right ahead. Hella, take the Chief out of here and stay clear of this place.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Okay. Good thinking. ${PlayerName}, hurry up!
She takes your hand and rushes you along out of the passage.

speaker: Hella
content: We're out. Hecate, do it!
As soon as Hecate steps out of the passage, she turns around and sets the Nightmare on the upper part of the exit. Instantaneously, huge blocks of sandstone come crashing down and block the exit.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...It's over.

speaker: Hella
content: Phew... Great. I was worried that they would turn liquid and seep out through the cracks. Those guys, and this place, were just so damn creepy.

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't let your guard down. We're out of the passage, but that's no guarantee that we're already out of the woods.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, can you sense the distance between us and the inheritance?
...No need to sense. At the end of the passage is a wide, deep pit. You are standing near its edge, looking down.
The pit is near 100 meters in diameter. The lone narrow lane spirals downwards to the bottom, connecting with a lonely island that floats at the very center.
In the heart of the island stands a stone altar, lifeless and chilling.

speaker: Hella
content: Ew... What's that thing? It's sickening...

speaker: Hella
content: Looks like something is moving at the bottom...

options: The inheritance is in that altar.

speaker: Hella
content: Doesn't it look suspicious? It's put right there for all to see. It's as if whoever put it there desperately wants people to know it has the inheritance in it.

speaker: Hecate
content: There might be some security measures put on it, like a mechanism or a trap.

options: Or maybe it has to be stored that way.

content: Looking down from this distance, you can't see every detail of the altar. But vaguely, you see some strange patterns engraved on it, like something used in a rite.
R is nowhere to be seen.
Zoya is still on the other side of the crypt. She might have come across some hurdle, as you feel she is making slow progress. Despite that, she keeps getting closer.

speaker: Hecate
content: Got it. Those Corruptors might be activated again. Chief, stay behind me...

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Watch out!
Out of nowhere, a gigantic ax cuts through the air from behind, coming at you spinning. Nightmare rushes forwards but is able to deflect its trajectory only slightly.
The ax flies overhead and lands heavily on the ground, sinking into the dirt and blocking your way ahead.

speaker: Hella
content: Who is this?! ...Uh!

Before Hella can turn her head around, a dark shade comes hurtling towards her and deals a blow that sends her flying a few meters. Inertia carries the dark shade along, who then stops in front of the ax.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Such power... It's a Sinner!

speaker: Hella
content: It's Master of Axes!
The dark shade rises slowly, picks up the heavy ax with one hand and hauls it over her shoulder. She turns around to face you, oozing murderous malice.
One person holding out against an army... An apt expression for my situation... Cough cough... Good for me.

speaker: Hella
content: Master of Axes?!

speaker: Hella
content: ...How come the Master of Axes is so tiny? How old is she?
Face your opponent! I'm <color=#fb9259>Horo</color>, a Legion warrior. I'm here to send you to meet your maker.

speaker: Horo
content: The inheritance belongs to the Legion. Keep this in mind, and die!

speaker: Hella
content: ****, What a fierce gal! This is a ******* mini version of Zoya!

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't back away. Her power is a far cry from Zoya's, and she is injured. We can take care of her.

speaker: Hella
content: But she's in a different league from street thugs as far as battle experience is concerned. Plus the way she fights, going all out... I couldn't even take one blow from her ax.

speaker: Hella
content: This is a demon bear all right, one capable of changing into human form! No doubt her shortness is a deception used for tricking her opponents!
Hardly has Hella finished her sentence when she is sent flying by the blunt side of the ax. Hecate immediately jumps in front of you.

speaker: Horo
content: You are their leader? Where did you capture these new Sinners to force them to fight?! You can't defeat Zoya, so you stoop to this!

speaker: Horo
content: You're despicable, you bastard gangsters! Who do you think you are, plotting against the Legion, against my boss?

speaker: Hecate
content: Is she under the influence of Mania? She is overexcited, but there's still a chance of bringing her out of it.

speaker: Hecate
content: Let me handle her. Chief, please find an opening to put the shackles on her, and do it fast!

speaker: Horo
content: Die!!!
The ax makes the earth shudder and beats back Nightmare. Horo's aura overwhelms everyone. Her unwavering determination to fight comes from her absolute loyalty to the Legion and Zoya.
People like her will not bow down to you even if they are defeated and shackled. This being the case, you decide to change tack...

options: Stop it! We're all on Zoya's side!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chi...
Before she can get the word out, you take a step forward and plants yourself in front of Hecate.
Horo's ax halts in mid-air, and you look into her eyes and talk in a measured tone.

speaker: Chief
content: We are free citizens from the Syndicate... We are mercenaries. We have been commissioned by the Legion to come down here to save you.

speaker: Horo
content: ...Mercenaries?

options: Right. Not for the inheritance, but to save you.

content: You've decided to borrow the identity of the mercenary named 99.

options: You just broke out of the MBCC, didn't you?

speaker: Horo
content: Hmph, what if I did?

speaker: Chief
content: You didn't return to the Legion, so Zoya sent a lot of people out to look for you. We're only part of the effort.

speaker: Horo
content: ...Why you?

options: There's a sort of friendship between us and the SALVA.

speaker: Chief
content: Only yesterday, together with Iron and Anne, we defeated Ted. It's then that we learned the news about you.
Horo stares at you, seemingly looking into her own memories, but she does not loosen her grip on the ax.

speaker: Horo
content: You said it's my boss who sent you here to save me... Where is she then?

speaker: Horo
content: She would either believe in me and wait in the fleet for my triumphant return, or lead by example and come to the battlefield herself.

speaker: Horo
content: She would certainly not entrust her important subordinate to some dodgy characters.

speaker: Horo
content: I've been guarding this place for a long time. The only visitors have been those animals from the gangs. Don't you try to deceive me!
Boom... From the other end of the pit comes continuous booming and vibration that penetrate the thick walls. It's Zoya... She is drawing near. You can't stall any longer.
The surrounding contamination is approaching and starts metamorphosing. But Horo pays no heed, her gaze fixed on you.
This is a look of great determination; she has absolute trust in someone and is willing to burn everything down for that trust. This determination can be taken advantage of...

options: Yeah, she came down there long ago to save you.

speaker: Chief
content: She asked us to stay up here, and she went down by the central elevator and went into the depths of the contamination to save you.
You point in Zoya's direction casually. As if on cue, vibrations issue from there.

speaker: Horo
content: What are you talking about? The central elevator is full of traps. My boss she...

speaker: Chief
content: Yeah, Zoya didn't return at the agreed time. The influence of the inheritance was greater than anyone had thought.

speaker: Chief
content: Your advisor, that Earl guy, he was concerned, so he paid us extra to come down here and lend a hand.

speaker: Chief
content: Zoya ordered in no uncertain terms that no Legion member shall follow her here, but we are just some lowly mercenaries. We "questioned" a couple of gangsters, found the secret elevator, and came down there... As simple as that.
Upon hearing the name Earl, Horo looks bemused for a second. Her furious desire to fight seems to cool drastically, and her face takes on a complex expression.

speaker: Horo
content: ...It's Earl who sent you? Because he's... concerned?

speaker: Horo
content: ...That bastard! Who needs his concern?
She leaps up, and comes at you, wielding her ax. Just one blow, and the contaminated Corruptor behind you is cut in half.

speaker: Horo
content: I believe you. Outsiders only know that Zoya is with the Legion, but you guys have met Earl. You are telling the truth.

speaker: Horo
content: I'll make up for roughing you up. Let me deal with this bunch of monsters first, and then you can take it out on me!

speaker: Hella
content: I can't believe she bought all that nonsense of yours and is fighting like a person being possessed! Is she stupid for real or just faking it?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Stay alert. We haven't seen her true colors yet.
Horo shrugs the remains off her shoulders, throws down her ax, which sinks into the ground, and turns to face you.

speaker: Horo
content: Sorry. You came to help, but all you got was a beating from me. I've brought discredit on the Legion.

speaker: Horo
content: Hit me, throw punches at me, as many as you like, until you have vented your anger.

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName}, our little friend here is asking you to hit her. Can you bring yourself to do that? Want me to do the honors?

speaker: Horo
content: Don't hold back! I am a Legion warrior who can hold her own, not some useless kid who hides behind someone else!

options: Clearing up the misunderstanding is enough. We have other business to attend to.
We can settle the score when we're back. One hundred punches won't be enough.

speaker: Horo
content: That's very magnanimous of you. I get what my boss sees in you. Now, take me to see her.

speaker: Horo
content: It's a deal! Now, take me to see her.

speaker: Horo
content: I meant to stay here, get rid of anyone coming here for the inheritance, and wait until my boss arrived.

speaker: Horo
content: But things have changed. Boss Zoya needs me now, I must be there.
...Of course you're not saying yes. You should stay away from Zoya as best you can, find the inheritance before her, and then leave.

options: That won't work. We should deal with the inheritance first.

speaker: Chief
content: Traps like that mean nothing to Zoya. The real risk is the inheritance; it would speed up the deterioration of the situation.

speaker: Horo
content: Are you asking me to turn my back on my boss?!

options: You would only be holding her back.
You need to have faith in her.

speaker: Chief
content: It's obvious that you're not recovered yet. Protecting yourself and taking care of the inheritance is what you can do for Zoya now.

speaker: Horo
content: I'm not that useless! I still can fight. Please, let me go and help my boss... Mmm...

speaker: Chief
content: Protecting you and taking care of the inheritance are what Earl paid us to do. Zoya can handle her end, and she'll meet up with us by the side of the inheritance.

speaker: Horo
content: I... I don't need his meddling! I still can fight. Let me go and help the boss... Mmm...
She gets worked up and makes to take a step forward, but she stumbles and falls onto the ground, unable to pick herself up.

speaker: Hella
content: I didn't know she's bleeding so profusely. Quick! Take her coat off.

You take care to remove the leather coat sticking to her body. Her tiny body is covered with wounds so deep that the bones are almost visible—new wounds that are oozing blood, mingled with old ones that have reopened.

speaker: Hecate
content: She did get first aid in the SALVA. She's indeed the Sinner hidden away by the SALVA.

speaker: Hella
content: How long had she been fighting down there by herself? Are Legion people all lunatics?
That didn't seem like her way... Or is this part of her shifting strategies?

speaker: Hecate
content: Should we put her under control with the shackles?

options: ...No, not for now. Let's carry her down. I've got something to ask her.

speaker: Horo
content: Ugh... Where... am I?
You're carrying her on your back, heading towards the depths where the stone altar is.

speaker: Horo
content: Where is Boss Zoya?
You point upwards. The vibrations running throughout the crypt are ongoing, getting ever closer. It's a countdown for you, but for Horo, it's hope and comfort.

speaker: Chief
content: When you are recovered and have taken care of the inheritance, she will praise you.

speaker: Horo
content: Ugh... All right...

speaker: Horo
content: Put me down... I can walk, I... am heavy. You are out of breath...
I can do this, you're small...
options: I can do this, you're small...

speaker: Horo
content: I AM NOT SMALL!
The tiny arms around your neck give a sudden tug that almost makes you fall backwards. Luckily, it lasted only a moment. It was more a reflex reaction than a result of her losing her temper.
She has lost a lot of blood, her body slightly cold. She sits slumped over your back limply, groaning every now and then, not unlike a sick child.

speaker: Horo
content: ...Thank you.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=30>You're so calculating! Came to relieve me only when she's about to wake up...</size>
She pouts her lips and mutters something under her breath at you. She's been carrying Horo all this way, and you've just relieved her; she is spent.
Burdened with that ridiculously heavy ax, Nightmare staggers along at the tail of the procession.

speaker: Hecate
content: She's awake. Question her now?
Yes. Horo's breathing caresses the side of your neck, weak, slow, and defenseless. There couldn't be a better time to question her.

options: What have you been through all this time?

speaker: Horo
content: Hmm...

speaker: Horo
content: At the beginning of the year, some gangsters tricked me into the police office... I was detained for a dozen days... then they found out I was a Sinner and transferred me to the MBCC... I was kept there for half a year.

options: What were you doing when the riot broke out in the Bureau?

speaker: Horo
content: ...No idea, I didn't know what happened... When the door opened, I ran and fought my way out... I had something really important to do.

options: I know what it was. You went to the SALVA.

speaker: Horo
content: No... not the SALVA. I came <color=#fb9259>here</color> the first chance I got...

speaker: Horo
content: Because the inheritance is <color=#fb9259>here</color>...

speaker: Horo
content: Once, while I was in the lockup, I woke up in the middle of the night, and I heard someone talking outside...

speaker: Horo
content: He said... The <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color> in the Rust has been moved, to a disused pit in the southern desert... It continues to produce forces... and they have to deal with the Legion as soon as possible...

speaker: Horo
content: This was very important... The moment I got out, I came here to find out about the truth... Then when I arrived, I saw...
Huge stone altar, some strange rite, red Crystals, and weapons.
Someone is experimenting on humans. I hid around the corner, trying to figure out what's going on.

speaker: Researcher
content: The conditions here are appalling... We can't make top-quality crystals here...

speaker: Researcher
content: Time is not enough, nor are Sinners. If we go on like this, the gangs, even with the weapons, won't be able to defeat the Legion!
Then use the inheritance.
Our customer wishes to get the power to defeat the Legion... And that's what we should deliver.
The <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color> exists for the sole purpose of granting wishes.

speaker: Researcher
content: You... you're not thinking about...
Take the stock out and invite everyone over. We're giving them a stronger force, strong enough to defeat the Legion.
They will be over the moon...

speaker: Experiment Subject
content: Ahhhhhhh!!!

speaker: Horo
content: Ugh...

speaker: Researcher
content: Who is there?! Find them and kill them!

speaker: Researcher
content: This place must not be exposed!
That was a hellish sight. I must tell the commander about all this, about Mania weapons, those men in black, and the inheritance...
I don't remember the last time I was so frightened. That thing... That power...
When I saw it, the only thought in my mind was to run away. I had to get out of here and inform the commander.
Can't let that power fall into the gang's hands. Can't allow it to endanger the Legion.

speaker: Horo
content: Get up, Horo... You can not lose...

speaker: Horo
content: The commander is waiting for me... The Legion is...

speaker: Horo
content: I have to get out of here... I have to...
...What's this little thing doing here?
...Hey, are you still alive?

speaker: Horo
content: <size=30><color=#dde2ed> I'm... not little...</size></color>
I'm looking for a green-haired gambler, a little kid about your age. She lost her mind and came here to seek revenge. Have you seen her?

speaker: Horo
content: <size=30><color=#dde2ed> I... am not... a little kid. I've... grown up...</size></color>
Sigh... Little brats are such a real headache.
I feel darkness swallowing me. I feel as if I'm suspended in the air, floating and drifting.
We're going to the hospital... Hang in there, don't die in my shadow...
Iron said Horo was hanging by a thread when she was brought to the SALVA. Who saved her? Perhaps the SALVA knows the answer.

options: Wait a second, what is this inheritance that you saw...

speaker: Horo
content: That power... can't let the gangs have it... They would use it against the Legion.

speaker: Horo
content: I have to... I will...

speaker: Hecate
content: She passed out.

speaker: Hella
content: Well... Let me sum this up. Some people were trying to make Mania weapons with the inheritance so that they could fight against the Legion, but Horo accidentally overheard about this.

speaker: Hella
content: While that shape-shifting demon was blowing up the Bureau, she escaped and came to the cave, where she verified the intel about the inheritance, but was beaten half-dead in the process. Later she was rescued by someone, who brought her to SALVA for emergency medical care.

speaker: Hella
content: In the end, this whole episode turned into a rumor—"MBCC escapee steals Mania-inducing power." This brought Ted and his fellow mad dogs to SALVA, where they actually caused a Mania incident.

speaker: Hella
content: Which means there isn't a Suspect R at all. The whole thing's the upshot of some internal strife among the gangs. We were dragged into this because of an erroneous piece of intel.

speaker: Hella
content: ...**** That Public Security Bureau is a useless piece of trash!

speaker: Hecate
content: It's also the MBCC's responsibility to find out the truth about Mania. Besides, the crisis remains unresolved.
Hecate's right. The mission is not finished yet, you should carry on. That threat from the Legion is hot on your heels, and more mysteries need unravelling.
But deep inside, the idea you've held on to is crumbling into dust...
The person that you have been chasing so relentlessly, by putting yourself in great danger, is not HER, but Horo.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief, be careful. The enemy is coming.
The contamination is pouring out from the pit below you and starts to encircle you. The crypt is not going to give you any chance to back away.

speaker: Hella
content: I have a foreboding feeling. This gigantic pit seems like a living thing...

speaker: Hella
content: Should we go on? Do we really have to find the inheritance?
There is no turning back...
The person on your back stirs at this moment.

speaker: Horo
content: ...When the battle started.

speaker: Horo
content: You, on the other hand, look spiritless! Where is that person who faced my ax head-on without a weapon in hand?

speaker: Hecate
content: He is not a combatant.
female_content: She is not a combatant.

speaker: Horo
content: Who cares? Once you step on the battlefield, you have to fight your enemy with everything you've got. There is no place in this world for kindness and tolerance towards deserters.

speaker: Horo
content: Put me down, give me my ax. I'll take care of it.

speaker: Hella
content: Stop talking nonsense. You're still recovering.

speaker: Horo
content: It's you who fail to grasp the situation here. The inheritance... it's being activated, just like before. If we don't contain it soon, we're all gonna die.

options: You won't be any help there, just stand aside.

content: In a way, this severely injured shorty does have a knack for encouraging people.

speaker: Horo
