speaker: Hesitant Mercenary
content: You can't destroy them. Just like this weapon, they're everywhere in Syndicate.

speaker: Discreet Woman
content: I say you draw too much attention to yourself. The strong ones are always misfits who make enemies everywhere they go. Now the whole Syndicate fears you and hates you, everyone is against you.

speaker: Discreet Woman
content: Alright... If that's what you want. You've paid up-front anyway. I'll bury your body when the time comes.

speaker: Raging Gangster
content: Monster! Wacko! Die, you bastard! We'll take revenge. We'll bring the most powerful weapons, we must make you pay for it. You made us do it!

speaker: Gloomy Man
content: Commander... Horo is missing.
In the distance, an iron tower collapses before your eyes. The loud boom expels the phantom-like figures.

Amid the ruins, a familiar figure is walking toward you shakily, seeming like she'll collapse any second. Her clothes are in tatters, and wounds cover her small frame. Yet she's still dragging on that huge ax and refuses to let go.

speaker: Maimed Horo
content: Commander... You've come... finally...

speaker: Maimed Horo
content: I've always wanted to... be able to... support you...
As she's speaking, countless bullets are flying in from all directions. The small body is twitching like a broken marionette in the shower of bullets, being hit into a pulp.

You hear the mad laughter of the gangsters. Some are venting their hatred, some are fighting for power. Countless dark hands are rushing out from the ruins, clawing at that broken body, wanting to tear her into pieces once more.

The heartbreaking pain enables you to feel your body again. Next thing you know, anger devours you like raging waves. You can't help yourself from running forward, but suddenly you hear a shocking growl...
Zoya's rage erupts like a volcano, the lava coating her as she charges at those enemies in limbo.
The battle is over. The indistinct dark shadows have vanished. Horo's ghost is nowhere to be found.
But Zoya is still before you, grabbing onto an enemy's twisted body and swinging her fist over and over again.

speaker: Teenage Zoya
content: Die! Die!! Die, all of you!!

Up close, you notice that's not the Legion's commander's outfit. Not yet tall and broad, she has bandages all over her body. Her attacks are hysterical, but lack the unusual power—they're only immature punches from a teenager.
Only the furious urge to destroy is unchanged in sixteen-year-old Zoya, perhaps even more intense.

speaker: Teenage Zoya
content: <size=44>I'm gonna kill all of you!!</size>
Her roars have grown husky and her fists are bloodied and raw. She is completely lost in rage.
I told you to stop! Don't get f***ing carried away!
A hand suddenly grabs her fist in the air, which makes the bloodthirsty Zoya even crankier. She turns back to glare angrily at the person stopping her, but is then stunned by who she sees.
It's a tall and broad middle-aged man in a sheriff's uniform.

speaker: Teenage Zoya
content: ...Leggett?
She says the name in a daze. The surrounding mist begins flowing slowly, filling up your vision.
The man is winding some bandages around her wounds.

speaker: Leggett
content: I can relate to your feeling. You cannot accept it, and you cannot forgive. You'd rather burn it all down and destroy everything than run away or compromise.

speaker: Leggett
content: But don't forget that although violence may help you beat your enemies, you can't use it to create a new future.

speaker: Leggett
content: How should I put it? I know this place has never given you any good memories, but I've lived longer than you have, and I've seen the good old days...

speaker: Leggett
content: When I was young, I never expected things would become as bad as they are now. Likewise, the situation may improve in the future, you're only limited by your imagination.

speaker: Leggett
content: You're very strong, and you'll only become stronger. You will gain many admirers and followers. You should lead them to write a brand new future rather than using your power solely to destroy.

speaker: Leggett
content: Before I retire, let your old man do something for you. Trust me just this once, Zoya. There's always hope in life.

speaker: Leggett
content: That fight I had with you among those thugs, that's the luckiest thing that's ever happened to me. And the best decision I've ever made is dragging you back and making you my buddy.
The shackles are growing hot, but in a warm and gentle way.

speaker: Leggett
content: Ugh... Ugh...

speaker: Gang Hitman
content: Oh, are you little Zoya? This geezer keeps mumbling about you... Too bad, you came too late.

speaker: Gang Hitman
content: There are questions you should never ask, and there are unspoken rules you should never challenge. Alas, our old sheriff didn't seem to understand these rules and was being stubborn, so someone paid me to do them a favor...

speaker: Gang Hitman
content: What's a Mania Crystal? You'll know when you experience it yourself... Hehehe... Do you wanna hear his last words? Ahahahaha...

speaker: Public Security Bureau Superiors
content: Leggett had repeatedly violated the West District Order Management Regulations, ignored warnings from his superiors, and purposely provoked conflicts. He'd long been removed from his position.

speaker: Public Security Bureau Superiors
content: Which means this case is an internal affair among gangs. The Public Security Bureau won't intervene. Also, haven't you already killed all of his murderers?

speaker: Public Security Bureau Superiors
content: Haha... Look at the power you possess. You're a Sinner now, aren't you?

speaker: Public Security Bureau Superiors
content: Seize her! You Sinner, you're the destroyer of order. Seize her! He's told you something, hasn't he? Root them out, root them out, root them out...
The gang hitman and the sheriff's faces are slowly overlapping, contorting, and splitting into countless filthy figures, growling and charging at Zoya.

speaker: Zoya
content: Haha... What a fool...

speaker: Zoya
content: Ol' man, that future you kept talking about, it doesn't exist...

speaker: Zoya
content: It doesn't exist!!

She lets out a guttural and heart-wrenching roar, pouring out all her regrets, grief, hatred, and bloodlust. The roar turns into growling purple flames, burning her everything and scorching your shackles.
You put yourself before her and face the reveling devils...
The frantic phantoms have been dispelled. Zoya is not hurt. She's half-kneeling behind you, and the purple flames plaguing her are gradually going out.
A child of six years old, perhaps even younger, is standing before you. She's too thin and too short, but her face is stripped of all the natural childish innocence, making it hard to tell her age.
As if having never felt any kind of protection or warmth, she's covered in wounds and scrawny. Her eyes reflect only all the cruelty and decadence of Syndicate, without even a hint of light in them.

speaker: Child Zoya
content: ...Is it over yet...
You reach out your arms to hug her, and she walks into your embrace. Then, she passes through you.

speaker: Child Zoya
content: Is it still not over... How much longer... do I have to wait...
She passes through your body like a ghost, murmuring and staggering forward, into that endless hell named Syndicate.
She keeps walking down the slowly collapsing street. The pedestrians are dispersing and fleeing, but they're all phantoms without physical bodies.
But the bullets are real, the flames are real, and the intensifying violence is real.
She walks past the rusty factories. A Molotov cocktail flies her way, and the igniting flame burns her skin.

speaker: Phantom Crowd
content: Open the door, I need work! I'll go to the mines, I'm not scared of the contamination, and I'll mine Hypercubes for you! You can't go bankrupt, otherwise... what are we supposed to do?

speaker: Phantom Crowd
content: Give me back my job! Give it back! Don't move to Eastside, don't leave us behind...!!
She doesn't stay but keeps going. She walks to the shabby welfare center and as she reaches out to open the door, an iron hammer wrecks the wall and bricks fall on her body.

speaker: Phantom Crowd
content: They're closed! Starting today, there will be no more welfare centers!! The great explosion has lead to tens of thousands of orphans, and they can't afford to care for all of them. They'll abandon us sooner or later!

speaker: Phantom Crowd
content: Bah! Those old hypocrites. I'm killing them all before they sell me somewhere!! Hahahaha, hahahaha!!
Zoya gets up from the ground. Without a home to go back to, she turns and keeps walking, toward the burning street block.
A stray bullet hits the scrawny body, making her stumble. Indistinct and chaotic voices can be heard in the direction the bullet came from.

speaker: Phantom Crowd
content: Hand over the money! You haven't eaten in one f***ing day. Well, I haven't eaten in three days!

speaker: Phantom Crowd
content: Haha...ha... I-I didn't do it on purpose, it was you who... I was only defending myself... No, the gun went off by accident. I didn't kill anyone...

speaker: Phantom Crowd
content: We must find a way to make money... I have some connections. How about we smuggle some guns? In fact... we can even traffic people... and drugs... We can do it together...

speaker: Phantom Crowd
content: Hahahaha! I belong to a gang now and I have a gun! You all must listen to me!! Got a problem with that? How does the bullet taste? You still have a problem now? Hahahaha...

speaker: Indistinct Figures
content: This is our territory! Give me back my buddies! We can only control people with power... We need more weapons... Everyone's doing this anyway... I'll kill you, I'll kill you, I'll kill you!!
You can't stop these things from harming her, and you can't count how many times she's gotten hurt. She keeps walking forward without stopping, but ahead of her, there's nowhere she can be.

speaker: Child Zoya
content: ...Is it still not over...

speaker: Child Zoya
content: <size=30>Still not... over...?</size>
Amid the blasts of bullets and bombs, wails and laughter, Zoya's figure is slowly falling apart.
The phantoms have finally given up their disguises. They've transformed into ferocious thugs and are pointing their guns at Zoya...
No matter how many enemies she's destroyed, more and more raging monsters rush toward her, coming from collapsed walls, from shady alleys, and from every corner in Syndicate.

speaker: Indistinct Figures
content: Power! Power!! The strong prey on the weak! If you win, you'll be the king!!

speaker: Indistinct Figures
content: F*** justice. Syndicate is a free place! Violence doesn't discriminate!!
They are charging at the child who is staggering on alone. She can't advance anymore, her broken body unable to support her own weight any longer. She kneels down on the ground.
Your shackles emit a blinding light, shattering the violent phantoms and the broken streets. The two of you have returned to the desolate wilderness with the rusty towers.

speaker: Child Zoya
content: <size=30>Still not... over...?</size>

speaker: Child Zoya
content: <size=30>How much longer... do I have to go on...</size>

speaker: Choice
options: No one is going to hurt you anymore

content: Hurt her? No, all of this has made her stronger.
You hear a strange voice. A man in black is standing before you, holding up an umbrella.
Shh—I'm here to pick her up.
Something is wrong with Zoya. Her wounds are beginning to heal, her body is emitting purple smoke, and her voice is no longer shaking.

speaker: Child Zoya
content: ...It's not going to end. Everything is completely rotten, but no one is going to end it...
The suddenly emerged shackles pierce through you and hold you in place. Is this a backlash?

speaker: Man Holding Up Umbrella
content: No... It's a well-intended warning. It's warning you not to get close or be a hindrance. Your shackles are protecting you.

speaker: Man Holding Up Umbrella
content: Of course. That's the law of this world. This is her spiritual world.
Little Zoya stands up. Her eyes are no longer aimless, but are instead radiating frenzied determination.

speaker: Child Zoya
content: In that case... I will...

speaker: Zoya?
content: I'm putting an end to it all!!!

Her broken body bursts like a cocoon, and a pair of raw and bloody wings tears open her back, dragging a huge monster's body out of the cocoon—an enormous Corruptor, born at the same time as the Black Ring.
She flaps her wings and flies up high in the sky, vanishing in the luminous red ring at the apex of the sky. You're bound by the shackles and left on the slowly collapsing surface of the earth.

speaker: Man Holding Up Umbrella
content: Perfect power, perfect obsession. She's the perfect fruit nurtured by Syndicate. She deserves to be chosen.

speaker: Man Holding Up Umbrella
content: The <color=#fb9259>birth of the Corpseborne</color> is successful. The <color=#fb9259>Ring</color> has descended. Both she and the <color=#fb9259>Host</color> are free now.
Zoya is gone and the space she's left behind is beginning to crumble. The man in black is facing you, the edge of the umbrella covers half of his face, but you know you're being watched.

speaker: Choice
options: You're not a phantom. Who exactly are you?!

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: If I were you, I would stop asking so many questions and run away from this place at once.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Do you need me to tell you how?
He smiles at his own words, looking like a venomous snake.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Hmm... Forget it, it's too late.

The silt beneath his feet is spreading out. Countless crooked hands are emerging and groveling on the ground, reaching for you. At the moment of contact, you recognize the familiar nauseating feeling...
He's related to the inheritance. The secret power hidden in the dark. The mastermind. The culprit.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Haha... Given how immature these shackles are... you're pretty persistent...
The man disappears in the mist, but his voice still lingers in your ears. Your consciousness is gradually torn after being entangled in the dirt, and you lose your orientation.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: As a reward, let me share with you something interesting.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: This is Zoya's spiritual world. She's sacrificed herself to the Ring, so the Ring listens to her voice and responds to her wishes.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Isn't that incredible? She thirsts for destruction, and the Ring grants her power.

options: You've turned her into a monster.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Monster?

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Hehehe... From your point of view, that's indeed true. But that's her genuine wish.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: She was born a perfect monster.
She never wanted to become like this. She would never have chosen this kind of battle.
You're the one behind the inheritance, the manufacturer of Mania weapons! You've twisted everything, you've poisoned Syndicate, you've driven her to this!

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Yes. I'm honored to be involved in the refinement process of such a perfect piece.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: I must thank you too... Without the accident you brought about, we wouldn't have gained such a big pleasant surprise.

At this moment, the boiling emotions in your heart finally explode, washing away all your pain and weariness. Your senses suddenly become extremely sharp, and you're searching for the source of the voice...
You've found it. You swing your fist as you rush into the mist, hitting the target. You've never felt so much power within you. Clutching his collar, you drag the man out of the mist.
Half of his face is pulped now, transforming into flying dust. The other half is still smiling.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Hahaha, excellent. You're capable of controlling this world now. It has responded to you too.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Come on, you counterfeit. She and you are bound together by the shackles, and the Ring will respond to your wishes too.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Tell me, what do you want to do?
You can't help throwing a punch, eager to shut that smug mouth.
What happened to Zoya? How can I find her? How do I get out of here? How do I destroy the Black Ring?!

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Haha... No, these are not your wishes.
Another punch, then another. A feeble blue light clings onto you as if trying to confine your power, but you crush it along with everything else.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Hahaha... Haha... That's not what you really want... Listen to your heart...

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: You only want me to die...
Shut up!
The somewhat persistent noise is plaguing your ears, trying to slow you down, but still you move to strangle his throat.
Another firmer voice is urging you: This one before you is an enemy you must destroy. You must destroy him. No one can stop you.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: This is your mutual wish. The two of you are echoing each other. This is the power of the shackles, the power of the Ring...

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Destroy everything then... The Ring will respond to your wishes...
Then die!
Red spikes echo your anger and pierce through the man before you. At the same time, the blue light strikes your eyes. The whole world lurches, and then shatters completely like a glass dome.
Wake up!!
You hear a familiar voice. Someone is desperately holding you back from behind to stop your action. After a brief stunned moment, that unknown emotion controlling you suddenly disappears.
You begin to smell the familiar smoke and rust. The enemies before you are gradually blurring, turning into a cloud of vague mist.

speaker: Voice From Behind
content: Don't sink into the Ring, come back to reality! Come back!

You stumble and turn back in a daze. Hella is curled up and sitting on her heels not far away from you, holding a frantic Hecate in her arms. Both of their bodies are brimming with faint contamination.

Confused, you reach out to them and try to control their contamination with the shackles, but then you see even more viscous filth emerging from your hands. Hecate wails, and Hella drags her back, holding her tight and looking terrified.

speaker: Voice From Behind
content: The shackles are very dangerous now. Don't get close to them.

speaker: Voice From Behind
content: Calm down, calm down. You're only affected by the Black Ring and being controlled by the Mania. You must get back to yourself.

What is he talking about? Your consciousness is blurred and your body is being dragged away. The sky seems to be hanging low. Rust-like contamination floats in the air on the square and continues spreading.
High in the sky, an enormous reddish-purple luminous ring is shrouding everything, twisting everything, and separating everything.

speaker: Voice From Behind
content: This is not your fault.
Your gaze finally returns to the chaotic mist before your eyes. It's gradually dispersing, and you see the opponent you've been fighting all this time.
A man in white armor stands before you with his head bowed. Four or five spikes have impaled his body and pierced through his left chest, fixing him in the air.
He presses his left hand on your chest. His hand seems to be clutching something—a Hyperpyramid. He takes out his own contamination shield and hands it to you.

speaker: Voice From Behind
content: This... is not... your... fault... Calm... down... Listen... to me...
You shakily open your mouth to call for the person before you, but you realize you don't know his name.
036 trembles. You think he wants to say something, but he keeps silent. His hand slides quietly, dropping to the ground with that drained and dim Hyperpyramid.
You hear a crisp shattering sound. The last bit of blue light goes out, and with that, your consciousness falls into an abyss.

Outside the car window, huge clusters of rusty substances are floating in the air and constantly growing, looking like foreign subjects intruding from another space. The noise of metal twisting is echoing, sounding like someone's shouts and wails.
The purple light in the sky looks like Zoya's ever-crumbling spiritual world, yet the dwindling Statue of Keylan in the rear-view mirror reminds you this is the reality.

The top of the statue is shrouded by the purple light, electric arcs flashing around it occasionally. That's the last place Zoya went. Higher up, at the apex of the sky, an enormous and luminous red ring cloaks everything below.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: That's the Black Ring. Stop staring at it like that, or your consciousness will be dragged away again.
He grips the steering wheel. It looks like he's stolen one of the FAC's armored vehicles this time.
Stolen may not be the right word though... After all, there's probably no one else left alive around here.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: The two girls are at the back. Their minds were linked to you through the shackles, and they were affected by the Black Ring because you were linked to Zoya. They've suffered a lot.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: Good thing you woke up in time. If the two of them break down together too, I'm afraid I'll have to cancel the job and bounce.
You look toward the back seat. The two Sinners are leaning against each other and dozing. Even the slightest shake of the car makes them frown, as if they're having some kind of nightmare.
The FAC soldier who was with us... What happened to him?

speaker: Blond Driver
content: ...The contamination was too serious. I couldn't bring his body with us. I covered his body the best I could and left him there.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: If he had died outside the Black Ring, the FAC's cleanup unit could have retrieved his body and given him a proper burial. But he died in the Ring. Now they can only carve his name on the cenotaph.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: I only found this, he seemed to treasure it a lot. Take it, and when you're out, see if you can find his family or friends and hand it to them.
You take the photo from him. It's still wet with fresh bloodstains. You remember you've glimpsed a corner of this photo from the hole in his pierced armor.

In the photo, 036 is standing with many other FAC soldiers. Several heads are obviously cropped from other pictures and glued on. A list of names without faces is written on the back, completing this bizarre group photo.
Except for himself, a name and a date are noted for each person. The dates are all not far from now, and the names are all in full instead of just a number like 036.
You realize this is a group photo of the deceased. He'd always kept it in his left breastplate, closest to his heart.
Deaths are part of the game. If you can't accept this, you don't deserve to fight for the FAC.
Yes. I'm a member of an FAC combat unit. To fight Black Rings, I can discard all emotions.
You lower your head. Your hand grips the photo tightly unconsciously.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: The space within the Ring is distorted, so it'll take some time to find the way out. But I'll be sure to escort you out while someone is still able to hold Zoya back.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: You've done your best. Leave the rest to us.
You're done collecting yourself and have made the decision.

options: You seem unaffected by the Black Ring

speaker: Blond Driver
content: You can say that. We have some special protective measures. That's our trade secret, I can't reveal it to you.

options: Good. Turn back and take me back, please

speaker: Blond Driver
content: You gotta be kidding me.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: ...Cut it out. Given your current state, I'll be sending you there to die if I drive you back.
Before he finishes, you reach out to grab his ear.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: ...Is this workplace harassment? I'll sue you.
In fact, your first reaction was to grab his neck, but his scarf was in the way, so you lifted your hand a little higher. But anyway, you're in contact with him.

options: Please do me a favor, Sinner. Or else...

speaker: Blond Driver
content: How did you know...? Anyway, is this how you're gonna repay me for my kindness?
Take this as a new job. Please drive me to the statue, you can bill all the extra charges to the MBCC.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: So—rry, but I don't take suicide requests, no matter how much you're offering.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: This is the Ring born from Zoya. Every rule here, including the laws of physics and spacetime, is governed by her will. This is her realm, and she is no longer the Zoya you know.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: A Sinner's power comes entirely from their own manic spirit, and the power is bound to be no match for the black hole within themselves. Now that the Ring already has a grip on her darkness, everything is over.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: Because of the shackles, you're now the person closest to the contamination, followed by your Sinners. What are you trying to do by going back, besides getting both yourself and them killed?

options: To do something only I can do

content: Only she can destroy the Ring born from her. I'm going to wake Zoya. The shackles are still connected to her, only I can do this.
After taking me there, you'll get out of this place with them.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: Like playing the hero, don't you?

options: I don't have any other way out, anyway. I can't run away from this

content: The shackles are linked to Zoya. If I don't deal with her, I'll be swallowed too, sooner or later. That's why I must stay and fight.
If I die here, at least they can be free.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: ...Give me a break. That's really cringy.
You don't have time to waste either. The person holding Zoya back is your friend, right? Do you really think your friend can win on his own?
If someone can hold Zoya back, then our last hope should be to make it there in time and join forces with them.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: Don't be a fool. She's not like you. She'll run if she finds herself losing!

speaker: Blond Driver
content: Tsk! You better be useful if you're going.
He swings the steering wheel and the car does a 180. He slams his foot down on the gas pedal and shoots toward the statue.

Strangely enough, while it took you a long time to drive all the way here during your escape, it takes way shorter to drive back to the statue. As you push open the car door, you find the air filled with the smell of smoke and rust.

The statue is already covered in layers of the clustered substance that's leaking out, looking like an enormous tower of rust. The creaking noise it makes is mixed with the hisses and growls of monsters.

One after another, monsters are being formed in the contamination jungle like evil fruits growing on the huge tower. Although they don't seem aggressive toward you, they're blocking the statue's entrance thoroughly.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: We're here. What are you gonna do next? Are you sure you can go up on your own? How are you gonna fight these monsters?

speaker: Blond Driver
content: You're not thinking of kidnapping me as your Sinner, are you?
You steady your emotions, clear your mind, and reach out your hand to use your power.
As if sensing your power, a monster suddenly turns back and charges at you.
No!

speaker: Attacking Monster
content: Guahhh!!
A furious Nightmare jumps out behind you, howling and ripping the monsters into pieces.
Behind you, Hecate struggles to peek out while clutching onto the car door. Hella emerges as well, holding up her pipe and looking at you with an undecipherable look in her eyes.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Don't use it, the power's burden is too heavy on you. You don't need to fight like that. That's... my job.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, use me to fight. I can still fight for you.
She's still very weak, yet her eyes have never been more determined, mixed with a hint of anxiety.
The fight is over. The two of them seem mentally stable. You're relieved.

options: You didn't have to risk your lives to come

content: This is my own decision. No one knows how you guys will be affected if you follow me, I don't want you to take any more risks.

speaker: Hella
content: Cut the crap!

speaker: Hella
content: Ahem... These monsters don't scare me. It's not like I've never seen one before.

speaker: Hella
content: Just don't freak out like you did just now anymore. If you do that again, I'll... I'll knock you out and drag you back. If even that doesn't work, I'll run away on my own.
If something like that happens again, don't hesitate. Run, or kill me. This way, the shackles won't threaten you anymore.
Protect yourselves, and get your freedom. This is an order.

speaker: Hella
content: You...!
She's obviously holding her breath, but she can't get any words out for a long while. Eventually, she gives you a fierce glare and runs off to sulk on the side.

speaker: Hecate
content: Do you really have to go?
You look at Hecate. Her face is full of an expression you've never seen before. In the end, she can't seem to say what she means to say.

options: Are you trying to stop me too?

speaker: Hecate
content: I'll... follow Chief's orders.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: I'll pass. My protective measures are expiring soon, and I don't want your shackles. It's dangerous.
Accepting the shackles now is no different than tying a huge bomb to himself. You won't impose that on him.
I owe you a favor. When everything's over, I'll repay you.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: Oh, give me a break. I can't wait to be away from you jinxes.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: I thought you were the responsible grown man who watches over those two little freaks, but you turned out to be the craziest one.
female_content: I thought you were the responsible grown woman who watches over those two little freaks, but you turned out to be the craziest one.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: Don't forget to pay when you get out. Wire the money to this account.
Whitestone Industries... You take the business card and see him look up at the sky with a concerning face.
Around the top of the statue, blade-like white lights flash by from time to time, triggering a deafening roar every time. That's "Zoya"... The Ring Master's voice.

speaker: Blond Driver
content: If I come along, I'll only become a burden to that one... You must win.
You nod and bid farewell to the young man. You step inside the statue.

speaker: Hecate
content: I didn't expect this place to be so spacious.

speaker: Hella
content: No way. It looks at most half this size from the outside. Something's wrong here.
Since it's close to the Black Ring's center, the statue's internal space is further enlarged. Time probably doesn't flow normally here either. In this space, all known rules can be distorted.
Hella presses the elevator's button. As expected, nothing happens.

speaker: Hella
content: ****, gotta climb the stairs.

speaker: Hecate
content: The emergency staircase is over there, follow me.
You soon find the entrance to the emergency staircase. The spikes blocking the entrance have been crushed. It seems like someone passed through it not long ago.

speaker: Hella
content: Could it be the blondie's friend? She's gone up to hold Zoya back on her own, Zoya in this state, no less?

speaker: Hecate
content: That person is powerful enough. Look, the surrounding Corruptors are all ignoring us and moving upward...

speaker: Hecate
content: It makes sense if the minds of all the monsters in the Black Ring are controlled by the Ring Master. That person has all the attention of the enemies.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmm... Who'd have thought that blondie has such a powerful character behind him?
You must hurry up and climb the tower. Zoya is at the top of the statue. The fights will certainly get brutal later, so you must try your best to conserve your stamina.
Open up a path with as little effort as possible. If there's any danger, do not risk it. You can't die here.

speaker: Hella
content: You can't either!
Stomp, stomp, stomp—you're running at top speed, passing by constantly worsening contamination and lingering Corruptors, climbing up the metal staircase as fast as possible.

speaker: Hella
content: If I remember correctly, this bald statue is more than a hundred meters tall, which means we have to climb at least thirty to forty levels.

speaker: Hella
content: If we go on like this, by the time we reach Zoya, we won't have any strength left to fight her.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, are you alright? Your stamina...

options: Don't worry, I can go on

content: In fact, you don't feel tired at all. It's as if your determination to fight has really transformed into strength, granting you immunity against exhaustion.
This is not the first occurrence of this kind of bizarre phenomenon. The laws within the Black Ring are influenced by human will, so there are obviously slight deviations in the everyday rules.

speaker: Choice
options: We must believe we can get there sooner

content: Through the shackles connected to Zoya's mind, you can perhaps interfere in this realm too. You're not certain about it, but it's worth a try.
At the same time, your hunches, your sixth sense, and your clairvoyance have also been significantly amplified. It's as if a voice keeps nagging you:
Hurry up, you must hurry up, or you won't be able to make it...

speaker: Zoya?
content: Roarrrr!!

speaker: Hella and Hecate
content:
Oh...my goodness!!
Steady!
A deep howl shakes the whole statue from top to bottom, then shocks the entire Black Ring from the inside out.
Outside the statue.
At the top of the statue, the white light that's been resisting the limbo suddenly disappears.

speaker: Che
content: Bai Yi...!

The power suppressing the Black Ring has disappeared. Inside the statue, it feels like some kind of seal has been removed, or a spell has been lifted. All the dazed Corruptors suddenly snap out of their confusion and turn to look at you.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Oops. That chick above there drawing all the attention, she's collapsed?

speaker: Hecate
content: Careful, Chief... The Corruptors are coming at us now!

speaker: Hella
content: Are these... even Corruptors anymore? They don't die wherever you strike them, the parts just keep growing back.

speaker: Corruptor
content: Guahhh...!!

speaker: Hella
content: Haha... Haha, and they have solidarity too.

speaker: Hecate
content: Watch your step!

Rusty contamination is leaking out and expanding at a shocking rate, corrupting the physical space in which the statue stands. The entire place is soaked in the mental contamination of the Ring Master, and you who don't obey her will are the real intruders.

speaker: Hecate
content: Oh... Is this the power of the Black Ring? All is decided by the Ring's owner. She can control everything inside the Ring.

speaker: Hecate
content: A battle like this has no end. They don't know death.

speaker: Hella
content: Then how are we supposed to fight them?! Can we go back?

speaker: Hecate
content: The way back is blocked too. This statue has been completely derailed from reality.

options: Keep going up and break through. That's the only way!

content: You've won, but the contamination hasn't slowed down. More and more roars of Corruptors can be heard from all directions.
As if controlled by a certain voice, they are determined to either drive you out of here or tear you into pieces. This evil will is beginning to weigh on your nerves.
It's starting again... You two, get out of here and don't look back.
I can't let anything happen to you two!

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh—shut up! You refuse to leave; how can we run away without you!

speaker: Hecate
content: My mission is to follow you to the top of the tower and fight the final battle.

speaker: Hella
content: But the guy at the top of the tower is probably dead. Can we do it on our own?

options: We're not the only ones here

content: You grip the shackles tightly.
Zoya... Zo... ya...

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Who's there?

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Wake up, how much longer do you want to sleep...

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Who's calling for me?

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Your fight is not over yet...
Her fight has no end, as if she's stuck in a muddy swamp. Filth keeps emerging and blocking her way forward.

speaker: Zoya
content: My fight is not over yet... It'll never be over...

speaker: Zoya
content: No start, no end, just give me more enemies... I can handle it on my own...

speaker: Zoya
content: I'll keep on...
She raises her right hand and clenches her fist to fight, but then she sees the vague red mark branded on her wrist.

speaker: Zoya
content: What's... this mark?

speaker: Zoya
content: Someone has resisted me... Someone... is still fighting?

speaker: Hecate
content: What is this power...?

A great power surges from the other end of the shackles, and a light shoots out from your palm. Everywhere it shines, the purple rust begins dissolving and contorting, becoming a force that protects all of you.

speaker: Hella
content: Ouch, my head still hurts so badly. But... the hand that's been pulling at my brain seems to be gone.

speaker: Hecate
content: Has something happened to the shackles? Chief, you're able to affect the contamination?
Zoya's will has traveled here from the other end of the shackles.

speaker: Hella
content: She's still alive?

speaker: Hecate
content: Is she still conscious?
You don't know what Zoya has been through. But a power has been transmitted through the shackles, and you're feeling a determination and will to fight.

options: Zoya is still fighting, so we can't lose either

content: Be it the Black Ring or whatever this is, we must destroy it here!

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Wake... up...

speaker: Zoya
content: Who exactly are you?! Show yourself!
Running in a muddy world, she keeps warding off the filth blocking her way. The voice echoes in the empty world while the mist dissolves any response.

speaker: Faint Voice
content: Zoya... Zoya...

speaker: Zoya
content: Why do you want me to wake up? Where am I?!

speaker: Zoya
content: Where exactly do you want me to go?

speaker: Vague Voice
content: You're not going anywhere...
A twisted voice suddenly emerges. The mist is rising, completely swallowing everything.

speaker: Zoya
content: You are?

speaker: Vague Voice
content: You belong to the Ring, you belong to me. You... are me...

speaker: Vague Voice
content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>You can't go anywhere!</size></color>

speaker: Zoya
content: Get off!
It suddenly transforms into infinite black silt and strangles Zoya.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>Stay!!</size></color>

speaker: Zoya
content: Who the hell are you?!
The silt dissolves and gathers to form a figure. It turns out to be Zoya herself.

speaker: Zoya?
content: I am all of your fights, all of your power, all of your desires...

speaker: Zoya?
content: I am what the deepest part of your soul links to...

speaker: Zoya
content: You...?

speaker: Young Adult Zoya?
content: I am you. I was born from you. I am your wish.

speaker: Young Adult Zoya?
content: You were born to destroy.

speaker: Child Zoya?
content: You... only belong here!

speaker: Zoya
content: Shut up!
The red Illusory Moon rises behind her. It is an enormous eye, a scarlet gaze, firmly seizing the deepest part of her soul, seizing all her past, hatred, and desires.

She sees the blood on her hands, and the sins she has committed. She understands everything now, the power, the Black Ring, the roots... This is the abyss born from her, and this time, the enemy is invincible... it is herself.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: That's it... Fight, Zoya... Never stop fighting, never stop destroying...

speaker: Zoya
content: Never stop destroying...

speaker: Zoya
content: But... is this my fight?
Vaguely, she hears familiar rumbles. One after another, the explosions become tiny fireballs. They keep approaching the red moon, and slowly they all get swallowed.
On the other end of the shackles, the filth has once again blocked your connection to Zoya. It makes your head throb with severe pain.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: It's you again... you again!

speaker: Vague Voice
content: F*** off! Don't touch her, she's mine! The Ring is mine! Let go of her!
You don't want to let it win. You don't want to hand Zoya over to someone else. If you let go now, you'll lose her forever.
But you're not the only person here.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief! Ugh...!!

speaker: Hella
content: Let go... No more... Let go now!!

speaker: Vague Voice
content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>Let go!!</size></color>
What now?!
...Let go.
A low voice rings in your head. Although it comes from the other end of the shackles, it doesn't convey that kind of madness and violence. Rather, it sounds like a tempting persuasion.
It's not time yet... There's still a chance...
Come forward... I'll... guide the way... for you...
The voice is fading away, together with the light of the shackles. You can no longer feel Zoya's presence, but you also don't feel you've lost her.
Before you, the contamination and monsters blocking you look distracted and confused.

speaker: Hella
content: huh... phoo... What happened? That guy has woken up?

options: No clue, but I guess we'll be there soon

content: Can everyone still fight?

speaker: Hella
content: huh... phoo... Even if I wanna run, you're not gonna quit now, are you?

speaker: Hella
content: We're almost reaching the bald head. Let's climb to the top in one breath and end this once and for all!
The Nightmare smashes open the door at the top level. You barge out of the sealed tall tower and arrive at the spot closest to the sky.
Under the luminous red ring, an enormous body is half-kneeling and half-sitting, wings gathered together, looking contemplative or expecting someone.

speaker: Hella
content: Is that Zoya... or Earl?

speaker: Hecate
content: It's the Ring's owner —a Corpseborne.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: Zoya...
The voice sounds so familiar...

speaker: Vague Voice
content: Wake up... Zoya... Wake up...
Who's calling for me?

speaker: Vague Voice
content: Get up!
The jolt beneath her body startles the sleep out of her entirely. The familiar charm hangs from the rear-view mirror, swaying back and forth, left and right.
The desolate desert, the rusty iron towers, and the familiar passenger seat... everything in sight somehow makes her feel very nostalgic.

speaker: Leggett
content: What were you dreaming about? You were shouting and cursing, even throwing punches. You almost slapped my face. Did you do that on purpose?
Of course this is a dream. Leggett used to drive her around like this all the time, saying he was going on patrol. But that was so many years ago.

speaker: Zoya
content: Haha... I had a weird dream. I dreamed of you.

speaker: Leggett
content: Oh?

speaker: Zoya
content: I dreamed of you talking to me gently. It was kinda gross.
He knocks Zoya's head hard. It actually hurts as she remembers.

speaker: Leggett
content: Are you awake now? Hell, haven't I always been f***ing gentle with you? Aren't I always there every time you get yourself in trouble?
Is this not a dream? That's nice... But it's probably not real either.
Is this the afterworld? Or just a lingering vision?

In the rear-view mirror, a cloud of obscure mass is sitting in the back seat. It forms a human shape occasionally and disperses again, peeking forward with a twisted obsession while mumbling something unintelligible.
Further back, behind the rear window, the desolate road is being swallowed by a sandstorm and is constantly collapsing. The sandstorm is roaring, chasing the only vehicle in this world.

Someone refuses to spare her, so even this small world is going to be destroyed by that darkness sooner or later. But if this is the last moment of peace, then... she doesn't wish to be disturbed now.

speaker: Leggett
content: You're a grown-up now and you still let your old man drive. Every time I buy you a new car, you crash it right away.

speaker: Leggett
content: Hell, I was once the head of Nirvana's fleet back in the day. How have I raised such a vehicle butcher like you? What a shame.

speaker: Zoya
content: Quit nagging. I know all the guys in that fleet of yours very well. They dare not think I'm disgracing them.

speaker: Leggett
content: Huh? You've met them?

speaker: Zoya
content: I have. I'm their boss now. We've got a cool new name and dealt with all the other gangs. I've even heard many of the foolish deeds you did when you were young.

speaker: Zoya
content: You geezer were so patriotic back then, you became a sheriff in order to save Syndicate, huh?

speaker: Leggett
content: Ahem... ahem! You little punk! How dare you get my brothers into this shady business too?

speaker: Leggett
content: Haven't I told you before? Stop throwing punches every time you encounter a problem! Think of other ways, don't rely on violence like those stinky gangs!

speaker: Zoya
content: Haha, can't help it. I'm no better than a violent Syndican.

speaker: Zoya
content: Geezer, many things have happened since you left. They've made me realize this is who I am.

speaker: Zoya
content: I'm not as capable as you said I was gonna be. I can't imagine a good version of Syndicate, and I can't create any future. All I have in me is violence, and all I do is destroy.

speaker: Leggett
content: ...Is this your answer? That's the best way you can fight?

speaker: Zoya
content: Yeah. I can't do it, but there's someone who can.

speaker: Zoya
content: They have people they cherish and a future they look forward to. They see the good side of Syndicate which is imperceptible to me.

speaker: Zoya
content: Those people are Syndicate's true hope.

speaker: Zoya
content: What I have to do is open up a path for them using my violence. Defeat all the decadence blocking the way and clean up this place before handing it to them.

speaker: Leggett
content: ...Then what about yourself?

speaker: Zoya
content: I'm part of the decadence too, a thug raised in the darkest days of Syndicate. If there is a bright future, I shouldn't belong there.

speaker: Zoya
content: I've done everything I could. I've crushed the darkness before me, and I've opened up the path.

speaker: Zoya
content: Now, I've turned into one of their obstacles. This has to end.
The obscure mass behind lets out a murky and suppressed whisper, but Zoya doesn't look back.
She has understood that the only real enemy left now is herself. It's the darkness that her heart could not part with that led to the abyss.
And this darkness is her roots, her power, and where she truly belongs.

speaker: Zoya
content: Soon... I'll fight the last battle. I hope you can witness it. And take me with you afterwards.

speaker: Zoya
content: I'm glad you've come...
Leggett looks ahead and says nothing. After a long while, he begins again.

speaker: Leggett
content: You've found people you can count on... Seems like after I left, some good things have happened to you after all. You've met some decent people, haven't you?

speaker: It's not even a complicated case, yet it was handled like this...
content: ...Yeah. Quite a few, in fact.
A brainy one, a passionate one, and many others who've joined the Legion with their visions. They long for a future for Syndicate, and they're capable of creating one.

speaker: Leggett
content: I'm relieved to hear that...

speaker: Leggett
content: I didn't come... to take you away... Zoya. Your fight... is not finished yet...

speaker: Zoya
content: Leggett?
His figure is starting to blur. Is he leaving? Zoya grabs his hand urgently.
The driver is still there. But when his face becomes clear again, it belongs to another person.

speaker: Earl
content: Don't even put your hand within half a meter of the steering wheel. You wanna blow up this car too?

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Why are you here?

speaker: Earl
content: I need to get Commander out of here.

speaker: Zoya
content: What? Stop nagging! I told you, this is my own fight.

speaker: Earl
content: You're the Legion's commander. Your fight is the Legion's fight.
A brief silence. There's only suppressed murmur stirring somewhere in the car.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Do you still remember our promise when the Legion was first founded?

speaker: Zoya
content: I'll give you power, and you'll give me information. I need to wreck everything of the past, and you need a brand new future.

speaker: Zoya
content: The promise has been realized. That corrupt Syndicate is in ruins now, and my fight will soon be over. It'll be your turn next. Don't you want to build a Syndicate that can bring happiness to your sister?

speaker: Zoya
content: The Legion is no longer needed, Earl. Let everyone return to the fleet. Even if I'm not there, you guys can keep on fighting.

speaker: Earl
content: ...Don't be a fool. People like you, you know nothing at all.

speaker: Earl
content: The fights of ordinary people are forever accompanied by cowardice, regrets, and numbness. No matter what beautiful vision you have, no matter how much you want to persevere, those who are scared of failure and loss will still escape from the battleground again and again.

speaker: Earl
content: Only you can always be so asserted and fearless. Not everyone is as strong as you are.

speaker: Earl
content: It's exactly because you're here, we can get back on our feet time after time. After meeting you, I finally began to believe it was worth it to keep fighting in Syndicate.

speaker: Earl
content: There's no end to the darkness. Syndicate needs you, and the Legion needs you. If the only thing you can do is fight, then never stop fighting. I won't let you run away.

speaker: Zoya
content: Wow, you're jinxing me or something?

speaker: Earl
content: I am. You've sent so many people to battles, don't think you can get out of this so easily.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...Hmm, hahahaha! So this is still about Horo, isn't it?

speaker: Zoya
content: Get over it, you doting brother. I never provoked her. You know full well that Horo was born a warrior, and she went to battles only for you.

speaker: Earl
content: ...Humph.

speaker: Zoya
content: But you've indeed reminded me... If I'm gonna fight anyway, it's much more fun to do it with you guys than being stuck here.

speaker: Zoya
content: Drive, I'll go back with you. You know the way, don't you?
As if sensing the changes in her mood, the faraway sandstorm blasts out a deafening howl, whirling and chasing after them, crushing this world hysterically.
Inside the car, Earl only smiles.

speaker: Earl
content: I do. But I won't be the person bringing you back...
In the blink of an eye, Zoya suddenly finds herself gripping the steering wheel in the driver's seat.

Earl is gone. His voice is fading away, coming from behind. Zoya turns back instantly, but she sees that he's already outside the car, standing in the middle of the road, smiling and watching her. Behind him is the howling limbo, the world that's falling apart.

speaker: Earl
content: I'll stop it. Go, Zoya. You're the beacon. Go and lead all those who yearn to fight to the battleground.

speaker: Earl
content: If you still feel lost, then go and find... <color=#fb9259>the one who can guide you</color>...

The car doesn't stop and keeps shooting forward, leaving him dwindling behind. The black sandstorm is swarming near and roaring, but it's blocked by Earl. His figure is completely swallowed by the sandstorm.

speaker: Earl
content: Take care of... Horo...

speaker: Zoya
content: Earl?!
Don't stop!
The mist in the back seat wriggles and blocks her sight. A voice comes from the limbo.
That's his fight. Your battleground is ahead of you, keep going forward!

speaker: Zoya
content: Who are you really?!
The red brand emerges on Zoya's right hand, the burning pain stimulating her soul sharply.

speaker: Zoya
content: ...It's you?
It's an extraordinarily persistent will, dispelling the twisted mist, breaking free from the clingy shadows, and finally reaching her side.

options: Come back, Zoya, I need you

content: This is your Black Ring. Make it obey your will.
His words were firm and unquestionable, an absolute will to fight, pulling Zoya back to reality, back to her true self.
female_content: Her words were firm and unquestionable, an absolute will to fight, pulling Zoya back to reality, back to her true self.

speaker: Corpseborne
content: Aaahhh...!!

speaker: Hella
content: What happened? Why is the monster suddenly jumping?! And it looks like it's in pain too?

speaker: Hecate
content: This is not caused by external attacks. Someone has dissolved the Ring's will from the inside. The Black Ring's laws have been shaken!

speaker: Hecate
content: Could it be... Chief, did you do it?
The shackles on your hands are burning, but you don't feel any pain, only infinite power.

Someone is crying out and roaring inside the Corpseborne. She is breaking free from the swamp that entangles her, and crushing the darkness from within. All her anguish, her urge and her determination are unflinchingly conveyed to you.
She's defeated herself, and she's defeated the Black Ring.
Now, it's our turn.
This is the core of the contamination, the Ring's owner.

speaker: Corpseborne
content: ...Huff.

speaker: Hella
content: That's... Zoya then?

speaker: Hella
content: Doesn't look like her at all.

speaker: Hecate
content: This monster has swallowed two Sinners. Earl is inside too.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's probably more powerful than any other enemies we've encountered before. Be very careful.
You sense a familiar evil aura and hear its nauseating heartbeat —it's very similar to the inheritance, but it's not yet entirely active.
Perhaps the fresh wounds covering its body are buying you time, but the person who made those wounds is not here.

speaker: Hecate
content: It needs time to heal the wounds on its body. That driver's friend is likely also a powerful Sinner and possesses power we don't know of...

speaker: Hecate
content: If we'd arrived sooner and fought together...

speaker: Hella
content: Stop with the what-ifs. That person is most certainly dead, and if we don't act now, once the monster wakes, we'll be next!
She throws out her pipe to hit the Corpseborne —but it rebounds off something like a ward.

speaker: Hella
content: What the f***?!

speaker: Hecate
content: It's a ward! Could it be that under the Black Ring's veil, all attacks against the Corpseborne will be rejected?

speaker: Hecate
content: If we keep wasting time...

speaker: Hella
content: Those monsters again! Tell me I didn't wake them?
Around the Corpseborne, one after another... no, a huge crowd of furious Corruptors is emerging. Their aggressiveness obviously seems way more intense than in any other battles before.
No matter how many Corruptors you beat, new enemies keep being summoned endlessly.

speaker: Hecate
content: It's not working, all attacks against its body are useless. It definitely can control the laws in the Black Ring with its will.

speaker: Hecate
content: As long as we're in this Black Ring, we can't beat it.

speaker: Hella
content: We can't defeat it within the Ring, but we can't break the Ring if we don't defeat it. Aren't we trapped in a ******* dead end then?!
Perhaps it's the long fight, the light from the Ring, or perhaps you're really exhausted, your mind begins to drift, and you hear a voice you shouldn't be hearing.
Humans have no way of eliminating a Black Ring once it has appeared.
It's the worst timing to recall what he's said. You can't help but begin doubting yourself.
Does this kind of fight really make sense? Will the Sinners die here? Have you let your emotions get the better of you and made the wrong decision?
To resist Mania, you must have an extremely rational mind. Losing control of your emotions only brings contamination.
If he only followed rationality, then... why did he save you after the Ring appeared? Did that make any sense? What can you do in the face of a Black Ring that has appeared?
You see something that I can't. If what you see is hope... Then go and fight, and I'll protect you.
If that's what he believed... then you believe in yourself too. You are the one who's saving your Sinners...
With this thought, your shackles slowly begin burning, and you hear that voice guiding you again.
Come on, do it right now...
You clench your hands and try to grip the burning shackles in your palms, grasping your last connection to her. This is something only you can do.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: It's you again... It's you again...

speaker: Vague Voice
content: Die... Die! You can't defeat me!

options: It's not you whom I'm trying to defeat!

content: Wake up... Zoya... Wake up!!
The Corpseborne is kneeling on the ground. Its body is shooting out red flashes, breaking that invincible armor from within.

speaker: Corpseborne
content: Nooo...! No! No!! That's not possible, that's not possible! They must die too, they must all die!

speaker: Corpseborne
content: I've grasped her heart. I've given her what she wanted the most. It should be my victory, but why...!

options: You don't know her at all, and you can never give her what she truly wants

content: Even if there are dark corners and permanent scars in a person's heart, they are no food for a ravenous monster like you.
Sinners are not your sacrifices. They only fight for themselves. Don't even think about confining her!
You grip the shackles in your hands. As if echoing each other distantly, your palms and the monster's body shoot out a blinding red light simultaneously.
You know that this is Zoya fighting, destroying this corrupt and dark body.

speaker: Corpseborne
content: Noooo...!!

speaker: Hecate
content: The ward is broken! Now is the chance to attack!

speaker: Hella
content: But Zoya is still inside, and Earl too...

options: The two of them are fighting too, fighting together with us

content: Do it! Destroy this monster, get rid of the Black Ring completely, and take back our Sinners!

speaker: Corpseborne
content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>Aaahhh...!!</color></size>
The enormous body begins to crumble and contamination is spilling everywhere, finally exposing that ugly red lump of flesh. In a hysterical moment, it charges straight at you and clings onto you.

speaker: Corpseborne
content: I have descended! I must live eternally! Give me your blood and flesh! Give it all to me!!

speaker: Corpseborne
content: It's you, it's you!! Give yourself to me, give me your shackles and your everything! You cannot escape!!
You don't flinch. The shackles break up the filth and charge straight toward that lump of bloody flesh. But at the moment of contact, a massive shock grinds over both of you.

speaker: Corpseborne
content: Ahhh...!! That's impossible! That's impossible!! How can you...

speaker: Corpseborne
content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=44>Let go!!</color></size>

This has never happened before. The shouts are tearing at your nerves and the contamination is cutting through your consciousness. Countless filthy hands are sticking onto your body. The hands turn into mouths and devour your soul.

But you're doing the same. The shackles released from your hands have split into countless blood-red thorns, rushing into that enormous black hole in such an intense and eager manner never before seen.

speaker: Hella
content: Aaahhh..!! Stop it, stop it!! My head hurts, stop it now!!

speaker: Corpseborne
content: I see, you're... you're the same...

speaker: Corpseborne
content: But you are just a defective! You, you're mine!

You can't stop yourself at all. The pain and obsession intertwined in your body are roaring and overwhelming your will, rousing terrifying instinct. Something is fusing with your body and dissolving your consciousness...
The pain and obsession intertwined in your body are roaring, and your instinct has been roused. You begin to fuse into its body and dissolve its consciousness...
It's stopped answering. Laughing hysterically, it clings onto you, as if there's nothing else left in this world. It starts to drag you into the abyss.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief! Chief, let go! It's swallowing you! Let go...!!

You can't hear anymore. You can only see, in the center of the black hole —a human shape, a haggard human shape letting out a heart-wrenching wail and raising a hand at you. You've seen this hand before...

It feels so familiar and so dear. Devouring each other and yearning for each other, yearning for the bones, blood, and souls, yearning for a passionate awakening, yearning to return to the beginning...
That's enough!
Swoosh!

In that white-hot moment, a blade flashes before you but you can't even make out the shape of the weapon clearly. That malicious eyeball is pierced through and bursts open. The power gnawing at you disappears.
Next, all of its remains swarm into your body like a hurricane, smashing and piercing through your soul, drawing out all of your strength.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!!
Finally hearing her voice, you fall onto the ground. Hecate is holding you up and your vision is all blurry. Hella is watching all of this, her eyes filled with fear.
The Corpseborne's enormous body has finally burned down completely. Two human shapes detach from the wreckage.
Zoya has lost consciousness, but... she's still alive.
The other person has been burned to ashes, the body shattering into dust the moment it touches the ground.
He used himself as bait and tried his best to distract the Corpseborne from Zoya for a while, opening up a path for the shackles.
He bet everything on you.
A female stranger walks out of the flying ashes. She's covered in injuries and her breathing is slightly unstable.

options: What was that thing that entered my body just now?

content: Shh—I'm here to provide some after-sales service, and I don't have time to flirt. We'll get to know each other when we have another chance.

Before you finish, that unsteady figure suddenly appears right in front of you. Before you even make out her features, she's already leaning close to your ear. A hand is on your chest and you feel a slight press.
My business card... Keep it safe, alright?
Woah, woah, let's be more discreet now, Chief. There are kids here, that sounded a bit too explicit...

Before you finish, that unsteady figure suddenly appears right in front of you. Before you even make out her features, she's already leaning close to your ear. A hand is on your chest and you feel a slight press.
<size=30>It's not time yet... It's still too soon for you...</size>
You reach out to grab her, but she's suddenly gone again. Your hands are empty and there's nothing on your chest.
But at the moment of contact, something enters your body—you don't feel sick or strange at all. It comes, then it goes.
The woman leaves you and walks toward the figures detached from the Corpseborne. She carries Zoya on her shoulder and takes one last look at the man who's been burned to ashes.

speaker: Female Stranger
content: Good work, Second-in-command... You did your best...

speaker: Female Stranger
content: You're not a bad person. But it's safer for her to come with me now.

speaker: Female Stranger
content: No need to chase after me so eagerly now, take care of yourself first, our lovely Chief. Your path will not be easy from now on.

speaker: Female Stranger
content: ...I'll see you around.
She turns and leaves.
You want to catch them, but the manic substance that's rushed into your body is still boiling, and you don't even have enough strength to get up.
A helicopter's rumbling is nearing. You hear Nightingale's shouts, but you have no strength left to answer her.
Sometimes you dream of what happened back then.

speaker: Man under umbrella
content: Given how immature these shackles are... you're pretty persistent...

speaker: Corpseborne
content: I see, you're... you're the same...

speaker: Corpseborne
content: But you're just a defective!
In the dreams, the frenzied words buzz from afar, as if blocked out by frosted glass.
And right before your eyes, above the sea of flowers, the white box you've seen before is floating in the air.
The bane of the disasters, the root of the mysteries, the entrance to the abyss... It's right there before your eyes, yet it's unreachable.
...It only appears in your dreams, and you don't know why.

speaker: Screening Officer
content: Answer my questions, ${PlayerName}.
The knocks on the desk pull you back to reality. In the claustrophobic interrogation room, through the speaker, the interrogator's low voice hits the black walls.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The same interrogations have been going over and over again for too long. It's going to reach one's limit at some point.
After a brief silence, he speaks again, his voice even lower this time.

speaker: Interrogator
content: You're not the MBCC's chief now, you're a <color=#fb9259>suspect</color> who's been suspended and under investigation. If you don't want further and harsher interrogations, spill the beans now.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Tell me everything you saw about the Black Ring.
Just like that dream, these fruitless conversations have been repeated many times too.

speaker: Choice
options: I've said everything I ought to say.

speaker: Interrogator
content: But that's not everything.

speaker: Interrogator
content: While BR-004 was active, you lost contact with the outside world in the Black Ring. Meanwhile, all Sinners in the MBCC who were linked to you through the shackles went manic multiple times. All of them, at the same time.

speaker: Interrogator
content: What did you do?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You can ask the Black Ring what it did to me.
Through the speaker, you hear tapping sounds on a keyboard.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Your adjutant and Sinners all believe you destroyed BR-004. How did you do it?

speaker: Choice
options: ...I destroyed ground zero of the Black Ring.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Something like the inheritance in the crypt corrupted the Sinners and turned them into a monster named Corpseborne. That was the center of the Black Ring.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We defeated it, and the Black Ring subsided.

speaker: Interrogator
content: ...We only found the corpse of a male Sinner at the scene. Signs of deep corruption were identified on his body, but the thing that corrupted him had been forcibly stripped off him.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Where did Zoya go? And the whereabouts of the inheritance you just mentioned?

speaker: Choice
options: I don't know. I blacked out after defeating the Corpseborne.

content: In this interrogation room like a black iron box, you only hear the lifeless ticking sound of a second hand coming from the other end of the speaker, punching on your nerves with each tick.

speaker: Interrogator
content: ...You're still keeping your mouth zipped, aren't you? This kind of attitude won't do you any good.
But letting them know you've absorbed the inheritance will do you even less good. It's a dangerous secret even you yourself haven't been able to comprehend, a secret you can't share with anyone.

speaker: Interrogator
content: We know an <color=#fb9259>underground organization</color> is attempting to create Black Rings in the city. The DisCity's most merciless agents are watching them and making sure of their eventual deaths.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Now, think twice. The more you resist, the more suspicious you'll become. If someone thinks you're related to those people behind the Black Ring...

speaker: Interrogator
content: You should expect a different kind of interrogation by a different party.

speaker: Choice
options: Then on whose behalf are you interrogating me now?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The City Council's officials? The sheriff's hound? Or the FAC's enforcer? I've destroyed the Black Ring, and I've said enough about it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you're trying to get to those behind the Black Ring, why don't you first question the sheriffs? What did Burns have to do with them? And what did they do in Syndicate?

speaker: Interrogator
content: ...Don't try to use your tricks in the Bureau on me. I'm the one interrogating you now.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Now, FAC Special Operations Forces Against Black Rings, captain of team N7, service number <color=#fb9259>036</color>. Let's talk about him.
Your breath freezes the second you hear the name.

speaker: Interrogator
content: During the last round of interrogation, you admitted to accidentally killing 036 in a chaotic mental state under the Black Ring's influence. This is your most honest response during the entire interrogation process.

speaker: Interrogator
content: You've expressed your regrets and apologies to his family, let's start from there. Now, answer the questions we've encountered during further investigation.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Forensic examination reveals that the fatal wound on 036 was the one on his heart, pierced through by contamination crystal. Both on-site investigation and wound analysis show clearly that he did not plunge onto the spike himself.

speaker: Interrogator
content: It's evident that it happened very suddenly, 036 stood still and had his heart pierced through by the Ring's extremely aggressive contamination crystal. Something controlled the spike to kill him.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Explain this to me, ${PlayerName}. Under such circumstances, why did you admit <color=#fb9259>you</color> are the one who accidentally killed him?

speaker: Interrogator
content: From your response to his family, it doesn't look like you're harboring the real culprit. Tell me, did 036 take the bullet for you?

speaker: Interrogator
content: Or, were <color=#fb9259>you</color> the one who controlled the Ring's contamination and stabbed him?
You recall flashbacks of 036 before his death. The body pierced through by the spike, the bloodstained photo, and the hand reaching out to you at the last moment...

speaker: Interrogator
content: Tell me, why were you able to control the contamination inside the Black Ring? You've said that's the power belonging solely to the Corpseborne, the Black Ring's owner.

speaker: Choice
options: ...Because the shackles linked me and Zoya together.

speaker: Interrogator
content: That would only enable the Black Ring to destroy your mind one-sidedly. How were you able to turn it around and influence it?

speaker: Interrogator
content: Stop making excuses like this. Since the day the FAC launched this project, we've been monitoring you. We know you come with great risks, and this incident is only a small warning.

speaker: Interrogator
content: What exactly is the relation between you and the Black Ring? How are you related to the Corpseborne, that inheritance thing... and the power behind the Black Ring?!
To your surprise, you laugh under the immense pressure. Handling this matter with such seriousness, they must know even more than you do.
They dread and fear you, but they must get you to work with them. This reminds you of the Sinners. Facing this kind of scenario, they'd never bow down easily.

speaker: Interrogator
content: Answer my questions!

speaker: Choice
options: How can I give you the answers when I don't even know them?
You can look for the answers yourself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're wasting your time locking me up here. If you want the answers, why don't you just give it another try?

speaker: Interrogator
content: ...What are you trying to say?

Having been through that incident, you no longer care about these trivial things now. They can guard against you or try to torture answers out of you. But they are just a bunch of strangers overcome by cowardice who want things from you.
You have your own answers to look for, about the cause of that disaster, the mastermind behind it, and your own mysteries.
All these answers lie in the Black Ring.

speaker: Choice
options: I have a proposal for someone who has say over things.

speaker: Interrogator
content: ...You can say it here.
You snicker.

speaker: Choice
options: Let me out, take me to another Black Ring.

content: The Black Ring in the square is number 004, right? That means the other Black Rings before it must exist in this city and are being carefully watched. Take me to one of them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll try my best to get rid of it. And this time, look for its cause and the answers to your questions. You may even be able to spot the mastermind behind it, the one you've been trying hard to find.
...And everything you want to know.

speaker: Interrogator
content: ...You haven't even come clean about yourself, and you're dreaming of winning our trust?

speaker: Choice
options: If you have so many doubts about me, why don't you just kill me?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's exactly because you can't kill me, you must push me so hard and control everything about me. You need me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Because you can't do anything with the Black Rings. I'm the only one who can destroy them.

speaker: Interrogator
content: You...
His words are interrupted by chuckling sounds. You hear a few metallic knocks on the floor. The chair moves and someone stands up—a woman begins speaking.
What a waste, such a talent has fallen in your grip.
End this pointless interrogation now. From now on, he's mine.
female_content: End this pointless interrogation now. From now on, she's mine.

content: As she speaks, she cuts off the comms and blocks out the interrogator's angry shouts.
Soon, the interrogation room's door opens and a woman wearing a hat walks in.
Her cane knocks on the floor, the sound piercing through the entire room like a sharp blade.
Hello, newbie. My name is <color=#fb9259>Langley</color>. I'm in charge of the <color=#fb9259>9th Agency</color>. I'm an agent, and also someone...

speaker: Langley
content: who has say over things, as you've requested.
Langley walks toward you and lifts the brim of her hat gently, looking at you with a smile.

speaker: Langley
content: I know you're keeping quite a few secrets, but that's okay. I like your proposal. Very much, in fact...

speaker: Langley
content: No time to waste. Let's go.

speaker: Langley
content: Where you want to be, an existing Black Ring.
The helicopter's rumbling and buzzing nauseate you after your long period of confinement. Langley looks completely unbothered and is staring at you with amusement.

speaker: Langley
content: Have you read all the documents I gave you?

After leaving the confinement cell, you were immediately taken onto Langley's helicopter and headed off to the DisCity's center. An hour has passed at most. You've been fighting your airsickness while reading the documents, only able to get the gist of them.

speaker: Langley
content: Then put them aside. I'll summarize the main points for you. We've arrived.

Outside the window, under the rotor, you've reached the Rust. It's the meandering isolation belt separating the West District Syndicate and Eastside of the DisCity, a dumpster for waste, and an uninhabited area filled with contamination.
There's no water in the Rust, only a river of twisted red light beams gathering and spreading in all directions. Black contamination resembles infernal tentacles, extending outward endlessly.
In the center of the abandoned zone, at the source of the contamination stream, an enormous red luminous ring floats in the air like a gigantic eye, imposing a suffocating pressure around it.
That is the source of the Rust's contamination, the first Black Ring in the DisCity that's lasted for 23 years—BR-001, the <color=#fb9259>Endless Carnival</color>.
The helicopter lands steadily next to the defense zone over a hundred meters away from the luminous ring. Following Langley, you step onto the contaminated soil.

speaker: Langley
content: It's not exactly the first Black Ring. The great explosion of DisSea in N.F. 84 marked the true beginning of all Black Rings, <color=#fb9259>BR-000</color>.

speaker: Langley
content: But this one is indeed the first Black Ring that has erupted in a densely populated area and has not been under full control so far.

speaker: Langley
content: That's right. 23 years ago, the Rust was still the Grace River with a beautiful view, and the Carnival was a favorite amusement park for everyone in the city.

speaker: Langley
content: The day the Black Ring erupted was the third day of the reopening celebration of the DisCity Carnival. Everyone flocked to the park on that day. Guests of all ages came to seek for a paradise of dreams and pleasure.

You look toward the direction Langley is pointing at. Under the red luminous ring, invisible crooked curtains shroud the Carnival. Like a mirage, the vague shapes of several old amusement facilities can still be seen.
Yet the sounds that come from it are not pleasant melodies, but bone-chilling repressed echoes sounding like mad laughter mixed with wails.

At around thirty to fifty meters from the Black Ring, several FAC contamination shields and anti-Black-Ring stations form a ring corresponding to the Black Ring, the blue light striving to resist the red light in the sky.

speaker: Langley
content: After the great explosion of DisSea, the FAC spent five years to get BR-000 under control and slowly led the DisCity out of the trauma. The reopening of the Carnival also served to rebuild citizens' confidence. Those geezers did work hard back in the day.

speaker: Langley
content: Unfortunately, no one expected that there would be more than one Black Ring, and not only in DisSea. On the third day after the Carnival reopened, on that most bustling day, BR-001 broke out.

speaker: Langley
content: Shield technology was still immature at the time. After several eruptions, the FAC could only give up the Grace River altogether and utilize the valley terrain to block contamination. In time, this place has become what it is now.
Black thorns, floating debris, and heaps of filthy waste keep expanding outward. Between the remains of the badly decayed facilities, the once gleeful cartoon images can still be made out.

speaker: Langley
content: Alright, that's the end of my introduction. Be careful, even today, the Carnival is still a very popular destination.
From the depths of the Rust come strange noise, heavy panting, low cries, and screams... As if responding to them, the Black Ring begins shuddering, illuminating the crooked figures staggering near.

speaker: Corruptor
content: The... Carnival... Let me into... the Car...nival...

speaker: Corruptor
content: Let me...in!! Let me in...!!
Corruptors and soulless scavengers are swarming near from all directions. As if lured in by something, they're all rushing toward the Black Ring urgently, charging at you.

Before you can use your power, Langley presses down your hand with her gun. At the same moment, an enormous shadow suddenly appears before you. You hear a familiar voice that's been missing for days...

speaker: Hecate
content: Stay away from him!
female_content: Stay away from her!

content: Roaring, the Nightmare rips apart the Corruptor approaching you. Hecate dashes before you. Not far away, Hella knocks a scavenger out with her pipe.

speaker: Langley
content: Don't exhaust yourself so soon. If I could fish you out from that place, of course I could fish out your subordinates from wherever they were too.

speaker: Langley
