speaker: Woman in the Shadow
content: There's no use. A lot of people have told me about you already.

speaker: Rust
content: I'm not sure where the info is from, but it will be used against you. Remember, from now on, do not reveal your identity or the fact that you are still alive.
Looking at the woman who is quietly staring at you, you understand everything now.

speaker: Choice
options: Are you the source of information...?

speaker: Woman in the Shadow
content: …Come in, ${PlayerName}. I'm not used to talking outside.
The woman sidesteps back into the house, leaving only an open, dark door.
You step into darkness. The door seems to lead to a cold tunnel filled with the smell of dust and mold.
You hear a woman's slow footsteps in the distance. The echoes make it sound like you are not the only two here, but also make the place seem quite empty.
You can't help but shiver, instinctively reaching forward. You tremble as you feel the cold wall, then trip and stumble. But someone catches your hand.

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: Sorry, I'm used to the darkness and forgot to light the candles for you.
Swish...
She lights the candle. You finally see her face, beautiful and calm, both soft and cold in the lime green candlelight. She's right in front of you, but it also feels like she's in another world.

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: Your hands are cold, and your voice is trembling. Why didn't you put more clothes on? It's rare to see people or sunshine here.

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: Also, stop faking your death. It doesn't suit you.
She smiles, turns around, and heads forward, holding your hand. The gloves aren't thick, so you can feel her soft palm, but there's no warmth coming through.
The lit tunnel is not long. You soon arrive at the iron door at its end. The woman pushes the door open and leads you into a small room. This is the main hall of the funeral home.
When you're about to say something, an emaciated woman comes closer and, ignoring you, grabs the arm of the "white-haired woman" with withered hands.

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: Oh, good lady, you're back. My daughter...

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: She is ready.

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: Thank you, thank you so much...

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: Can I see her? Can you take me to her?
The white-haired woman glances at you, smiling. You nod back. The old lady seems so determined, and you can't find it in you to turn her down.

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: This way.
You follow behind them. The white-haired woman leads you to a smaller room.
The room is empty. There's only a single bed with wheels in the middle and a girl on it. Her eyes are closed, and she is covered with a white blanket and several white flowers.

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: Mia... My child...
The emaciated woman rushes to the girl, staggering, and bends over her. Her skin is flawless, her lips are red, and her eyebrows and sideburns are neatly trimmed. It's as if she was sleeping.
The old lady checks the girl's breath with a trembling hand, only to be disappointed. She bursts into tears.

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: She looks alive, even looks better than when she was really alive...

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: I put some makeup on her.

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: She's always wanted this. Now, her wish is fulfilled.

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: I know... She told me she really envied Eastsiders. She wanted a used lipstick, wanted to work to make money...

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: I should've done that for her. If I knew this would happen, I'd...! Ahhhh!
You are bewildered while the white-haired woman stays calm. She stands silently behind the old lady and watches her wailing without any expression.
The sorrow never ends. After a long time, the old lady turns around and tugs the sleeve of the white-haired woman again. She looks dazed and on the verge of a breakdown.

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: Lady, I know you can hear her... Please ask Mia...

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: Does she hate me for not realizing her dream? I couldn't give her a better life. She was born in Syndicate...

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: She doesn't have hate anymore. All her pain is gone.

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: Is that true...? Thank you... Thank you...

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: You're welcome.

speaker: Emaciated Woman
content: Can I stay with her? How much time do we have?

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: Mia is scheduled for cremation tomorrow morning. You are welcome to stay here until then.
The mother breaks down. She kneels down, hanging on the white-haired woman's dress, and eventually falls to the ground.

The white-haired woman stops talking. She looks up slightly, glances at the girl on the bed, turns around, and takes you out of the room. She closes the door and locks the woman's mournful cries behind her. Then she takes you away.
The backyard is windless with dispersing monuments. Without sunlight, this is the bottom of a deep patio of a large complex, while bridges, large and small, block the sky.

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: This is the Romanesque Hall, the bottom of Drifter Camp, a place of farewell and remembrance.

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: I'm the hall manager. I take the bodies of the deceased, make them look their best, cremate them, send them off, and inscribe the names on the memorial.

speaker: White-haired Woman
content: You can call me <color=#fb9259>Oak Casket</color>.
She looks at you with her arms folded in front of her and smiles.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: About six months ago, I started hearing about you from those Maniacs you "eliminated."

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Your shackles impressed them when their lives were coming to an end.

speaker: Choice
options: Are you saying their souls remain even after they die?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That mother earlier said that you could "hear" the deceased. Is that true?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Hehe. They assume this out of superstition or because they want it to be true. My power, however, is only an expression of Mania.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Yes. Many years ago, I looked death in the eyes and was sent back. Since then, I have gained the ability to "hear" the last words of some revenants.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Those infected with Mania will turn into a thin consciousness field after death, like an echo or a mirage.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: It's the last remnant of their consciousness, some kind of obsession. It's not as strong as the mental contamination, so people can't sense or understand it, except me.

speaker: Choice
options: Like that girl who wanted to wear makeup.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Exactly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So you learned about me by obtaining information inaccessible to the alive.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Exactly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
options: Then, can I ask you something?

content: Oak Casket smiles.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Will you use your shackles on me if I say no?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Maybe. It's quite important, concerning you and everyone's life here.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Hah... Everyone's life...

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Is life much of a precious thing in this world?
She reveals a strange smile but soon turns back to normal.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: But since it's you, I'm happy to answer.

speaker: Choice
options: Okay, you're in. This is the Eastside Museum of Humanities.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm tracking down... a monster. It's like an ugly, huge half, constantly oozing filth, leaving huge scorch marks everywhere it goes and awakening the contamination in slumber.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It has been to the square Black Ring with numerous deaths and injuries, and I don't know when it will come to Drifter Camp.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Have you seen it somewhere, or do you know what it wants to do?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Is this thing your enemy? If you could destroy them, maybe I can read them for you. But unfortunately, they are still alive.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Then it's out of my reach.

speaker: Choice
options: Are there any other victims, like, say, Mia?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The girl who just passed away. You said you could sense the mental contamination field left after the death of a Maniac. That means Mia was corrupted by Mania, right?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Yes, she could not bear the mental pain, was dragged into the abyss of chaos, and left this world. It was indeed the effect of Mania.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: But all I know is that she was not consumed by the pain or fear brought by the monster. Her last consciousness rested in a gray mirror, feeling profound sorrow for her bleak life.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Sorry if this disappoints you. I can't see everything the deceased went through. I can only listen to the "wishes" they left behind.
You nod your head in understanding.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did you reveal my information to Drifter Camp's forces? Do you consider me an enemy of Drifter Camp?
Oak Casket is still smiling, but now it's like the smile is frozen on her face. She seems to have become a lifeless statue.
After a long time, she speaks.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: I am not anyone's enemy, nor will I take anyone's side. Even if people expect or request something from me, they will soon understand that I cannot do anything for them.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: What I have seen and heard are the remnants of people who have died. They failed to change the world while they were alive, and they sure can't do anything after they die.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: All I can do is listen to their grievances, do small rituals that won't change anything, make up for their regrets, and let them leave in peace.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: It's the only reason for me to stay here.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: And that applies to you too.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Even if you put shackles and orders on me, I can't be of help.
You stand opposite each other. Her words are devoid of any emotion, but therefore devoid of any deception, and have an oddly convincing feel.
You open your mouth again when something suddenly slams into your back. A pair of arms wrap around your neck, and a girl's bright voice breaks the place's silence.

speaker: Dudu
content: Don't overstay your welcome! It's clearly written on Oak Casket's door that she only does business with the dead.

speaker: Dudu
content: Are you dead? Still alive? Then let's get out of here.

speaker: Dudu
content: Follow me! I'm the best tour guide in Drifter Camp. Let me show you around!
You put up with Dudu and look over to Oak Casket. She's put on a gentle smile again.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: I testify that Dudu is indeed the best tour guide here.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Are you leaving?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Please... give me a moment.
She takes the Bureau jacket from you and turns back inside. Shortly after, she returns to you with a cloak and drapes it over you.
It's a heavy cloak. You gently zip up the collar and recognize it as the style typical to Drifter Camp.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: It's a great fit.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Your identity is somewhat sensitive, so be careful. People up there may recognize you.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Not everyone will see you as an enemy, but they won't see you as a friend either. Don't expose yourself so easily.

speaker: Choice
options: Thanks, but didn't you say that you wouldn't help me?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: It's just a little reminder.
Oak Casket smiles. She takes out a pendant, hangs it around your neck, and gently places it on your chest.
At the bottom of the string hangs a small glass ball with a faint blue glow—It's the very Hypercube fragment you brought out of BR-004.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: ...You are carrying someone's trust. It's from someone noble, who spared nothing to send you back from the realm of the dead, and passed on the purest blessings and hopes to you.

speaker: Choice
options: And you want to fulfill his last wish too?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Oh, that would be too hard. After all, you are not someone who values your life.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: We are all entrusted by the dead to walk this side of the world. I wish you well, too.

speaker: Dudu
content: Hmph... You're really nice to him. What has he ever done to deserve this?
female_content: Hmph... You're really nice to her. What has she ever done to deserve this?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Go for it, but don't force yourself. Let go of what you can't change.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: They stepped into the land of the dead just to bring you back alive.
The voices in front of you become somewhat distant, and the woman's expression is hard to read. She stops in front of the memorial, along with the many names of the deceased.
Like she's going to disappear into another world, like she'll never leave.

speaker: Dudu
content: All right, now we start the Drifter Camp tour! The guide fee is only 30,000, and you can get a song, Drifter Camp Friendship, for an extra 5,000!
You have nothing to say about her ridiculous pricing. Whatever. Nightingale will take care of it.

speaker: K.K.
content: Hey, don't keep raising the price. My commission fee for tour guiding is only 600 DisCoins. You're asking for too much.

speaker: Dudu
content: Don't worry about it. You're not paying. Forget about your hard-working personality today, and enjoy the pleasure of being a consumer!

speaker: Dudu
content: The elevator is about to reach the upper level, so get ready for... Drifter Camp!
The elevator door opens, and a lively scene you never expected is presented in front of you.
There are cluttered but eye-catching homemade billboards, the indescribable taste of sweet and sour mixed with bitterness, and various sounds like a wonderful symphony...
You never imagined that the interior of this huge slum was so lively, let alone that the capes who attacked you only a short time ago lived here.

speaker: Dudu
content: Stunned? Hmph, this is only the surface of Drifter Camp. Don't touch anything. There will be trouble if you accidentally trigger any mechanism!

speaker: Dudu
content: That's right! DisCity looks down on Syndicate, and Syndicate looks down on Drifter Camp. But just look on both sides of the Rust, where else can you find a cooler castle?

speaker: Dudu
content: Behold!
She pulls a lever, and with a few clanks, a small railcar rolls over to you, hanging on the rail. Dudu pushes you into the car, and with another pull, the railcar keeps moving forward.
In the car, you feel a pair of eyes fixed on you. It's K.K.

speaker: K.K.
content: Um... I heard suspended animation takes a huge toll on your body, and the adjutant said that you have been in bad shape lately. So how are you feeling? Anything wrong?

speaker: K.K.
content: Please tell me. It's... part of the commission.

options: It hurts. Mommy, make it better.

content: You do feel a little rough, but it's nothing compared to what you've suffered before, and there's no time to waste. You nod to K.K. with a confident smile.
K.K. winces like you've triggered some horrible memory. She turns away and ignores you.
The car stops, the door opens automatically, and Dudu jumps down excitedly.

speaker: Dudu
content: Here we are!

speaker: Dudu
content: Central Plaza! Grand Stall!

options: ...Why are we in the most crowded place?

speaker: Dudu
content: Why? Are you scared that people will notice you? Or are you still thinking about work?

speaker: Dudu
content: Wake up! Look at you and the dark circles under your eyes! Do you not realize how horrible you look? You can't work like that.

speaker: Dudu
content: It's mealtime already! Can you really resist? Can you smell it? The sweet and sour taste, the sizzling oil, and the laughter of the diners who are chowing down gourmets...

speaker: Dudu
content: Besides, this is the most lively and best place to get info, and anything unsettling will spread immediately. You can just fill your stomach here!

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhhhh, I can't do this anymore! I want some too! There's nothing under there. I'm hungry and I want some good food!

speaker: Hella
content: ${PlayerName} went up with just a cloak. Why do I have to chew on bland buns down here?!

speaker: Hecate
content: The agent said that some people had already remembered our faces. Following Chief would cause trouble.

speaker: Hecate
content: There are two locals, Dudu and K.K., so they won't look too suspicious. But if we all went up together, three strangers would arouse suspicions.

speaker: Hella
content: But I want delicious food!

speaker: Hecate
content: Be quiet. You'll attract unwanted attention. Here, have a bun.
With that, Hella's whimpering sound comes from the other end of the communication, as if something is being stuffed in her mouth.

speaker: Hecate
content: K.K., protect Chief. I can't stay by his side right now, and I would be upset if anything happened.
female_content: K.K., protect Chief. I can't stay by her side right now, and I would be upset if anything happened.

speaker: K.K.
content: Okay... If this is a part of the commission as well.
As you're talking, a tall man suddenly wraps his arms around K.K.'s neck. You are taken aback.

speaker: Tally
content: Hey... Isn't this Whitestone's K.K.? Good to finally have one of you back... I heard an Outland bigwig is going to invest in you. Is that true?

speaker: Tally
content: ...So can you pay back the meat money you owe me?

speaker: Tally
content: Every time you guys have a hotpot, that scoundrel Bai Yi takes some meat from me and leaves an IOU. I have enough IOUs to make a book.

speaker: Greta
content: Your boss had too much to drink and made a scene in my clinic. She spilled a lot of drugs, and those were worth a lot...

speaker: Greta
content: And the one with blonde hair got me writing notes so he could pretend to be sick...
A granny suddenly grabs the corner of K.K.'s coat, and the crowd instantly falls silent.

speaker: K.K.
content: Auntie Margaret... What brings you here?

speaker: Margaret
content: ...You're finally back?

speaker: Margaret
content: Who are you?

speaker: test
content: It's K.K. I'm back.

speaker: Dudu
content: Oh, that granny has Alzheimer's. Everyone pretty much loves her.

speaker: Margaret
content: K.K.? K.K.

speaker: K.K.
content: Yeah, K.K.

speaker: Margaret
content: Pay back.
People burst into laughter and swarm her again.

speaker: Dudu
content: Go ahead. I'm too busy eating.
The suona starts to play and grabs everyone's attention.

speaker: Dudu
content: Okay, stop it. The boss here has given up his investment in Whitestone, and to thank everyone for helping him to see the reality, he decided to treat everyone to a grill!
female_content: Okay, stop it, the boss here has given up her investment in Whitestone, and to thank everyone for helping her to see the reality, she decided to treat everyone to a grill!

speaker: Dudu
content: Tally, let's go to your barbecue stand!
She points at the brawny man in the lead. It draws a cheer from the crowd.

speaker: Tally
content: All right! 100 Inner Bay grilled beancurd skewers! Thank you!

speaker: Tally
content: Here, boss, I put some meat in this one for you since you're paying for everything!
He respectfully stuffs you with a skewer of greasy beancurd, with two thin slices of meat tucked in.
This is outrageous. You take a bite... and it actually tastes great.

speaker: K.K.
content: ...Are you cutting corners again? You used to put in a lot more meat and a lot less beancurd.

speaker: Tally
content: It's all because of that scoundrel from your house! Ahem, we're running low on supplies these days, so let's make do.

speaker: Tally
content: Here, have this skewer. You haven't been back for a long time and must be missing this.
The scene feels lively, and there is no sign of any Mania contamination crisis. You want to slip away, but a child suddenly sneaks into your cloak.

speaker: Ica
content: Ah... Are you an outsider?

speaker: Choice
options: Do I look like one? I'm your neighbor from the 18th floor.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't believe me? Look at my cloak.

speaker: Ica
content: Your clothes inside... are different.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I picked it up from someone else.

speaker: Ica
content: Oh... Do you know where all the people the execs took are? Can you take me there?
The child's big eyes stare at you, and you find it hard to answer. You can only keep passing glances at Dudu, but she pretends to be wholeheartedly enjoying her food.
Hello, there!
Another strange man appears out of nowhere and approaches you.

speaker: Greta
content: Sir, I heard from Dudu that you are not feeling well. Do you want me to take a look for you?
female_content: Miss, I heard from Dudu that you are not feeling well. Do you want me to take a look for you?

speaker: Greta
content: I'm Greta, the wonderful back alley doctor in Drifter Camp. I'm especially experienced in muscle fatigue and relaxation.
With that, he twists himself into an incomprehensible shape.

speaker: Greta
content: Witness this, yooga! This is a treatment method unique to our camp. Are you interested?
You shake your head and glance at Dudu, who is gleefully nibbling on slices of fried bread. She mouths a few words when she sees you looking over.

speaker: Dudu
content: <color=#7683a2>60,000 DisCoins to get you out of this, plus free info and one extra song.</color>
You pretend not to see it and turn your head to look at the doctor.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do all people with poor health in the camp come to you?

speaker: Greta
content: That's right. Are you not feeling well? Or... are you trying to steal my customers?! Hey, that's not okay! This-This is my turf!
His eyes light up, and he strikes another pompous pose like he's meeting your challenge.

speaker: Choice
options: ...I was going to ask about Mania.

speaker: Greta
content: I would never dare to touch something so dangerous. I cure diseases in the human body, but with Mania, you need to fight invisible monsters. I can't understand any of it. No, no.

speaker: Greta
content: The gangsters are gone, and there aren't so many Mania weapons. I don't get why it's still around. It's so scary.

speaker: Choice
options: So you've met someone like that?

speaker: Greta
content: ...Yeah... Do you want to go see her?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes.

speaker: Greta
content: You're a good person... If you need help, I can go with you.

speaker: Greta
content: Yeah, but this is my home...

speaker: Greta
content: I certainly want to do what I can to help.

speaker: Choice
options: ...Thank you. Maybe we can go together sometime.

content: Just as you stand up to leave, noises come from around. It's the group of cloaked warriors who surrounded you earlier.

speaker: Tally
content: Hey, if it isn't the elites of Rustfire. You're later than usual today. Got into trouble?

speaker: Tally
content: Here, a bigwig K.K. and Dudu brought is buying everyone skewers. You should meet this one, so generous...

speaker: Tally
content: Huh, where is our bigwig?
Noticing the commotion, you have slipped into Greta's little tent.

speaker: Greta
content: Ohhhhhhhhhhhhhh, sir, have you finally decided to learn yooga?
female_content: Ohhhhhhhhhhhhhh, miss, have you finally decided to learn yooga?

speaker: Taran
content: Where is that person? How come I haven't heard about the new guest in the camp? We need to be careful now. Has anyone reported this to Julien?
He's coming towards the tent you're in!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll do it!
You turn on the strange-looking radio, and passionate music comes on. You hurry to follow the tune and twist yourself into a pose that Greta has done.
The man outside stops in his tracks.

speaker: Taran
content: ...Forget it.
The man leaves amidst a roar of laughter.
You breathe a sigh of relief, and Greta steps closer with a wicked grin.

speaker: Greta
content: ...I'm so glad... that you've come through... Let's keep going...

speaker: Greta
content: This exercise... is not so simple... So prepare to challenge yourself...

speaker: Greta
content: You are doing a great job! But you're not well, you need to find a way to get rid of the fire in your body, or you'll never recover! It will cause trouble sooner or later!
You're exhausted, but you've finally avoided the biggest trouble. It's already a mess outside.

speaker: Tally
content: Haha, well done! Should have dealt with those gangsters a long time ago! This feels so good.

speaker: Tally
content: If only that damned Reconstruction Executive Committee could actually do something...

speaker: Tally
content: Would our life get better? I want to work hard and go out there and do business.

speaker: Taran
content: Are you leaving?

speaker: Tally
content: Well... I'd like to make some money out there. I heard that big guy over at the Rust has been taken out as well. If we can really go to Eastside one day, we'll never have to worry about supplies again, right?

speaker: Taran
content: ...Hmph.

speaker: Tally
content: Haha, but... If I leave, who's gonna make skewers for our cutest Taran boy?
He grabs the leading child and starts rubbing his head. Taran tries to struggle but can't do anything to the beefy butcher.

speaker: Taran
content: Let go, you...

speaker: Tally
content: Are you going to miss me? Haha, you cute little brat!

speaker: Tally
content: Don't worry! I've lived here for so many years, and when the Syndicate was the most chaotic, Drifter Camp let me sell skewers. How can I leave? There is no better place than here!

speaker: Tally
content: I'll be able to buy quality meat when I get some money. And when I do, you'll be able to get some real Inner Bay skewers, brat!
Everyone starts laughing, but Greta next to you gets teary-eyed all of a sudden.

speaker: Greta
content: Sob... I love Drifter Camp... This is the only place that will take us in. I will always love Drifter Camp...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I think those people are in desperate need of your yooga instructions.

speaker: Greta
content: Oh hey, you're right!
He lifts the curtain and rushes out, and you soon hear Taran's curses. You immediately bolt in the opposite direction while Greta draws everyone's attention. And Dudu is waiting there.

speaker: Dudu
content: Nicely done this time. I see you didn't need my help.

speaker: Dudu
content: She saw someone she knew and went after them.

speaker: Dudu
content: Oh, I wonder who could get the model worker to leave her commission.

speaker: Dudu
content: What should we do? Should we go catch the runaway Sinner or investigate?

speaker: Choice
options: K.K. will be back. Let her do her thing.

speaker: Dudu
content: Well, we have the info, and we've shaken off the trouble, so let's go find the Maniac.
You take one last look back.
The young man who shot at you with a grim look in his eyes has broken free from Tally's embrace. He is still running away from Greta's invitation in a huff.
But instead of the hatred he had when facing your gun, he's wearing a smile that's more suitable for his age.
The dark alley of Drifter Camp is obviously much quieter than the square.

speaker: Dudu
content: After all, life is not easy, and everyone gives all the splendor to the square, but there will always be places where the sun does not shine in Drifter Camp.
She leads you around the corner to a small door and knocks. No one answers.

speaker: Dudu
content: I'm coming in...
Pushing the door open, she pauses in the small foyer and walks straight to a side door.
It's a small room of less than 4 square feet without a bed, and a woman is lying on a cushion made of rags. Unlike Mia, this is a healthy body, but has a similar aura of death.
...Through those cloudy eyes, you see that her spirit has been captured by some twisted will and is in a nightmare of madness and torment.
Seeing Dudu, she reluctantly opens her mouth.

speaker: Dudu
content: Oh, no. You're still alive. It's not like I only play tunes for dead people, and look, I didn't even bring my suona today!
She hangs the suona on her back and ambles over to the bed.

speaker: Dudu
content: What's your name?
The person lying there struggles to open her mouth.

speaker: Dudu
content: Furian... That's a great name. You should come to me next time you're celebrating something, and I'll play you a joyful tune.

speaker: Dudu
content: I've brought you an expert. He will help you.
female_content: I've brought you an expert. She will help you.

content: She gives her place to you. You nod and kneel beside the woman, and her faint voice crawls into your ears...

speaker: Furian
content: I... had a nightmare... of burning fingerprints... trailing flames... and...

speaker: Furian
content: A monster... A huge, burning one... It-It was howling... It grabbed me...

speaker: Furian
content: Help me...Pl-Please...

You take her hand in yours and close your eyes. The shackles ache vaguely. It's not a feeling a Sinner would bring, it's mental contamination, and you feel the tearing of some kind of evil consciousness.

speaker: Furian
content: Ahhh!!!

Her voice becomes distorted and manic, a familiar sensation comes over you, and you see the scorch marks all over the darkness as your head begins to ache. If this is the warning of the shackles, as Oak Casket said...
It's Mania, and you will enter the nightmare that captured Furian.
Hey, wake up.

speaker: Dudu
content: ...It's only been 10 minutes this time. You kept the grasp even if it was so painful. I underestimated you.
She wipes away the sweat on your forehead with her sleeve.

speaker: Dudu
content: So what's the conclusion?

speaker: Choice
options: It's the same thing I've seen. It's Mania.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I was wrong. It's not something from the past or a future revelation. It is happening, the mental contamination field has enveloped the whole Drifter Camp, but there won't be any warning of it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: <size=30>The anti-Mania monitoring system cannot capture it because there's no Mania contamination leaking from it. It directly captures a person's consciousness, consumes their spirit from within, and drains everything out of them before they turn into a Corruptor.</size>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That "thing" is different from all the Mania monsters. It's deliberately hiding itself. If it hadn't resonated and caused changes to 004, I'm afraid it could have dragged everyone into the abyss without anyone realizing it.
A contamination source that knows how to hide itself... This is too dangerous. Is it capable of this itself, or is someone guiding it?
Is it... them?

speaker: Dudu
content: ...Is this contamination source you mention still in Drifter Camp?
You can't answer and feel anxious about it. This concerns the safety of tens of thousands of people in Drifter Camp.

speaker: Choice
options: Right, we could ask Furian where she had contact...

speaker: Dudu
content: She's no longer with us.

speaker: Dudu
content: It's not your fault. She has been holding on for too long. Everyone in Drifter Camp is trying very hard to stay alive, but staying alive is not an easy thing to do in the first place.

speaker: Dudu
content: Do you want to ask her something? Sorry, I don't have Oak Casket's power, so I can't help you ask her questions.
She gently covers the eyes of the deceased with her hand, closing her weary eyes.

speaker: Dudu
content: You have no family... so let me send you off. Hopefully, the next time we meet, you will be smiling.
The girl stands up and blows her suona...
When the song ends, you are silent for a long time.

speaker: Dudu
content: What, moved to tears?

speaker: Dudu
content: You've never heard anything like this, have you? My suona is the best instrument in the world. It plays happiness and sorrow. Why are you acting so surprised about it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm just surprised you didn't ask for money this time.

speaker: Dudu
content: Haha! There's no hurry, and this is another form of service. Gives me a good name.

speaker: Dudu
content: One day, all the people who have parted will see each other again, and by then... everyone will still remember my suona and me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You really love Drifter Camp, and it's why you've been showing me around.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do you want me to see? And what would you like me to do?

speaker: Dudu
content: ...I don't know. You're the first big name who's come here, and you're the first... who would listen to us.

speaker: Dudu
content: I don't know if doing so will change anything.
She pauses, pats the dust on her butt and jumps up, and the witty look returns to her face.

speaker: Dudu
content: All right. I'll take her to Oak Casket now. What do you want to do?

speaker: Dudu
content: Come down with me and ask questions? Or do you want to continue chasing the big monster yourself?

speaker: Choice
options: Aren't you going to stay with me?

speaker: Dudu
content: I don't have to anymore.
She grins.

speaker: Dudu
content: I believe you.
Believe? What does she believe?

Just as you are about to ask, you hear a "bang." Dudu takes a blow to the back of her head, and there is something strange about the attack. She instantly loses focus and falls forward, and a person wearing grayish-yellow catches her from behind.
Before you can see what the attackers look like, several guns are pointed at you. A couple of execs follow closely and break into the room.

speaker: Donald
content: I knew it was you as soon as I heard the suona, cutie.
The lead attacker and executive officer picks up the unconscious girl and looks around, muttering to himself with some smugness in his voice.

speaker: Donald
content: Good, the evidence is all there.

speaker: Donald
content: Notify the headquarters. Drifter Camp is confirmed to be harboring evil forces. It's time to work, and tell them to bring the big guns.
He hangs up and looks at you, suddenly showing a huge grin.

speaker: Donald
content: Want to come with me? We could use a witness.

speaker: Donald
content: Rustfire's little brat, or... an intruder?
Grand Stall in Drifter Camp's Square
Dozens of execs have broken into Drifter Camp and are confronting the crowd.
The female executive at the head of the group proclaims in an icy voice.

speaker: Executive Officer
content: Mania mutation has been confirmed inside Drifter Camp. There is a confirmed Mania field and contaminations. We have captured an A-Class Sinner.

speaker: Executive Officer
content: <size=32>To sum up, the Reconstruction Executive Committee shall thoroughly investigate all dangerous phenomena, and once private possession of Hypercubes, Mania weapons, or any suspicious prohibited powers are found, they will be strictly dealt with!</size>

speaker: Executive Officer
content: Don't resist the orders, don't hinder the execution, or else...

speaker: Ica
content: Eastside bastards! We didn't do anything wrong. We never touched Mania contaminations. You're accusing the wrong people. Give me my parents back!
The doctor hurriedly pulls Ica back and covers the child's eyes, which are somewhat red from anger. His own hands are also trembling slightly.

speaker: Greta
content: What should we do...? Dudu is captured, and that person... and Granny Margaret...
Instead of confronting the crowd, the lead executive wanders over to his group, crouches down, takes Granny Margaret's hand, and speaks softly with a smile, ignoring the tension at the scene.

speaker: Margaret
content: ...Who... Who's back?

speaker: Donald
content: It's me, Margaret. It's Donald.

speaker: Margaret
content: ...Who are you?

speaker: Donald
content: Donald.

speaker: Margaret
content: Do-Donald?

speaker: Donald
content: Donald.

speaker: Margaret
content: Don...Don?

speaker: Donald
content: Donald.

speaker: Margaret
content: Don... Donny... Donna... Don... Don...

speaker: Donald
content: Yeah, Donald the duck. Don Don, Donny Aroman, it's all me. I'm back.

speaker: Margaret
content: How come you're still not back?...

speaker: Tally
content: Enough!!!
He rushes over, swats away the executive with a punch, picks up Granny Margaret, and runs back into the crowd.

speaker: Donald
content: Why? What's gotten you so riled up? I was just saying hello to dear Margaret. Why are you so angry?

speaker: Donald
content: You are the ones who have done bad things. Why are you acting like justice is on your side? Look at this woman, and look at you! An evil force is spreading!

speaker: Donald
content: Do you know how many people in the camp have been corrupted? Have you really not had any nightmares these past few nights? Guess who secretly introduced that monster into Drifter Camp, huh? And for what?
The crowd lets out shouts of alarm. They start to murmur with suppressed panic.

speaker: Taran
content: Drifter Camp doesn't have that kind of evil power. We have our own anti-Mania system. Furian didn't go crazy and turn into a Corruptor. She left this world because she was in too much pain.

speaker: Taran
content: And all her suffering was caused by you. You have taken away Syndicate's hope.
People in cloaks suddenly appear on the upper level, clutching their guns with anger in their eyes.
The young man in the lead speaks in a calm tone, and his face is back to icy cold.

speaker: Donald
content: "The gangs have caused all these. They have gone mad in their pursuit of violence, and they are the ones who have made you suffer."

speaker: Donald
content: But I heard that you guys have been very successful recently. You finally have the ability to fight back against them. You've won many times, even facing Mania weapons.

speaker: Donald
content: Isn't it because you're secretly using the same kind of power? Isn't that why there's now a Mania mutation in your backyard?

speaker: Taran
content: You're the ones who colluded with the gangsters, who let them use Mania power, and now you're blaming it on Drifter Camp? You are just looking for a reason to crack down on us!

speaker: Donald
content: There can be many reasons. That Mania specialist we got, that Chief, went missing on your turf. Can you explain what happened?

speaker: Taran
content: There was a gangster attack.

speaker: Donald
content: Haha, haha... You're still so naive. Whatever reason or evidence you have, as long as they don't want to hear it, it won't work. There are already suspicions about you using Mania weapons.

speaker: Donald
content: Leave Drifter Camp. Be smart about this, or they will think you want to use Mania and go on the same path as the Legion...

speaker: Donald
content: When my big guns arrive, it will be the end of this place!

speaker: Taran
content: ...How dare you mention that?!
He raises his gun at the executive named Donald, and almost simultaneously, all the armed individuals on both sides raise their weapons.

speaker: Donald
content: Hey, hey, drop the gun, kid. We can still talk about this.

speaker: Taran
content: Give those two back. I'm not buying your shit.

speaker: Taran
content: Isn't it what you want, me raising this gun? I know almost too well what you're trying to do. Inspecting without reason, interfering, harassing, and weaving charges every now and then to pick a fight...

speaker: Taran
content: Drifter Camp is a pain in the ass, and some people want us gone, but they can't deal with us the way they did with the gangs.

speaker: Taran
content: That's why you're forcing us into a corner, and when we light a fire, you'll be able to eradicate Drifter Camp as you did with the Legion!
The crowd erupts when they hear the Legion's name.

speaker: Crowd
content:
So the Legion was really set up? The Black Ring wasn't set off by them?
What about Zoya? Was she killed?!
Bastards, I knew none of you were any good!!!
Do you want to do it to us again?!

speaker: Taran
content: Come on, then. I've put up with it for a long time.
He slams a mechanism on the side, and the ground suddenly caves in. You, Dudu, and the guards on the side all fall straight down, and several armed personnel are there to catch you.
The sound of intense shooting comes from above, and at the same time, you hear a familiar voice.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief.
The two Sinners are right next to you!
But before you have a chance to greet them, a pistol is held against your temple.

speaker: Drifter Camp Force
content: Go help, or I'll shoot him.
female_content: Go help, or I'll shoot her.

speaker: Drifter Camp Force
content: Cut the crap. Do it now!
Her palm is sweaty, and you can force the Potestas to knock her out, but now... seems to be a "real chance."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They will need it.
The battle is over, and you are taken to the upper levels. Many execs are wounded or captured, and Taran is on the comm with someone.

speaker: Taran
content: Sorry, I screwed up again. I can never do this negotiation thing well.

speaker: Taran
content: Yeah, it's all done. The lapdogs are controlled. Some of them are hurt, but the non-combatants are fine. Dudu and that Chief have been brought back, and they're safe.
female_content: Yeah, it's all done. The lapdogs are controlled. Some of them are hurt, but the non-combatants are fine. Dudu and ${PlayerName} are brought back, and they're safe.

speaker: Taran
content: But that bastard got away. I should have been more careful and just killed him. Would he...

speaker: Taran
content: ...I see. How much time do we have? I'll deal with it now. If it comes to it, we still have him as a hostage.
female_content: ...I see. How much time do we have? I'll deal with it now. If it comes to it, we still have her as a hostage.

speaker: Taran
content: Okay, understood. This is my mess, and I will take care of it. No matter what happens, please don't leave or show up.

speaker: Taran
content: You can't be targeted.
He hangs up and sends the unconscious Dudu to Greta's side.

speaker: Taran
content: Doctor, if she wakes up, ask her if she could come and help.

speaker: Greta
content: But she's not...

speaker: Taran
content: Rustfire needs her power.
Greta is too terrified to say anything. He just nods, takes Dudu, and watches Taran walk to the armed forces.

speaker: Taran
content: The enemies will be here soon. Everyone, check your gear and take care of your injuries. We will gather and set out in 10 minutes.

speaker: Taran
content: We just finished analyzing the intercepted signal. Those bastards already gave instructions to attack earlier. Fight back or not, we are facing the same situation.

speaker: Taran
content: Now we need to protect Drifter Camp.

speaker: Choice
options: If you could calm down, there may be room for mediation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I could at least talk to them for you instead of being used as a hostage.

speaker: Taran
content: There is nothing to mediate with them. Sooner or later, it will always come to this. I will take responsibility.

speaker: Taran
content: Take ${PlayerName} away as well, and watch the Sinners so they don't get a chance to get them back.

speaker: Hella
content: You little...!
Before an argument could start, a roar comes from outside the camp, and the crowd stirs. An armed sentry stumbles back, her face pale.

speaker: Drifter Camp Force
content: Taran! It's here! It's...

speaker: Drifter Camp Force
content: A monster!!!
Even the sun can't shine through the rising smoke, and the rumbling of the tracks and the huge, muddy figure in the smoke has taken the breath away from everyone present.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...That's an FAC armor used to deal with Corruptors, and it's very lethal. What are they...

speaker: Donald
content: Enough about the FAC. The Reconstruction Executive Committee specifically asked the City Council's Speaker to deploy this big thing.

speaker: Donald
content: FAC-Propulsion Type 023, just decommissioned from DisSea Surveillance Zone, is exceptionally well maintained. Composite function, fully automatic attack, automatic repair, full ammunition reserve, and heavy firepower.

speaker: Donald
content: Think about it. Do you have skin as thick as the Corruptors?

speaker: Donald
content: Or do you think your pathetic little bullets can penetrate the armor of this beast?

speaker: Taran
content: ...You bastard. There are still so many people in the camp, and you're going to use that?

speaker: Donald
content: Didn't you ask for this, our righteous little hero?

speaker: Donald
content: I was just going to scare you off, but thanks to you, this is a big deal now, and the executive committee is really on the lookout for it.
He laughs and suddenly turns up the sound of the speaker to the maximum...

speaker: Donald
content: But there's still a chance for everyone...

speaker: Donald
content: If you don't want to be dragged down by these fools, run! Run far away, hand over Drifter Camp, and you'll be fine!

speaker: Taran
content: Don't look down on us! Rustfire will not give in, we can fight, we have our own power!

speaker: Donald
content: Power...? Do you mean this kind of power?
The barrel stretches out, rotates, and suddenly fires a high-speed energy projectile, hitting a corner of Drifter Camp and triggering a burst of alarm.

speaker: Donald
content: Phew... Incredible. But don't be afraid. It's just an abandoned warehouse, stocked with expired rations sent from Eastside. I know very well that there's no one there.

speaker: Donald
content: But it's hard to say what I will target... in half an hour.

speaker: Donald
content: All we want is this place to investigate the Mania, and nothing will happen if you leave in half an hour!

speaker: Donald
content: Run! Run now! There's only half an hour left!

speaker: Taran
content: ...You bastard!
You are suddenly grabbed over, and Taran points a gun at your temple.

speaker: Hecate & Hella
content:
Chief!
You little piece of...!!!

speaker: Taran
content: Stop! This is the expert you're looking for, the chief of Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, the hero that helped you take down the Legion.

speaker: Donald
content: Oh, a Sinner girl. Could it really... be him?
female_content: Oh, a Sinner girl. Could it really... be her?

speaker: Taran
content: Pull back now if you don't want to see his head blown off!
female_content: Pull back now if you don't want to see her head blown off!

speaker: Taran
content: Don't you want him to take care of Black Rings? You can't take responsibility for his death, can you, traitor?
female_content: Don't you want her to take care of Black Rings? You can't take responsibility for her death, can you, traitor?

speaker: Donald
content: Well... It will be difficult to explain. But... wasn't he killed by the gangsters, Taran? You testified.
female_content: Well... It will be difficult to explain. But... wasn't she killed by the gangsters, Taran? You testified.

speaker: Taran
content: You...

speaker: Donald
content: Even if he is important to the FAC, what does that have to do with me? I'm just a traitor who came to complete the mission given by my superiors. My superiors gave me the task of cleaning up Drifter Camp.
female_content: Even if she is important to the FAC, what does that have to do with me? I'm just a traitor who came to complete the mission given by my superiors. My superiors gave me the task of cleaning up Drifter Camp.

speaker: Donald
content: You're a little too naive, Taran. Didn't that man teach you anything?

speaker: Donald
content: Did he also teach you... to live and die for your pathetic ideals?

speaker: Taran
content: Shut it!!! You're not in a place to say anything about him!!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Calm down, kid. You've messed this up well enough.

speaker: Taran
content: What did you say?

speaker: Choice
options: You can't defeat him. Let me do this.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now I see it. It's you who want me dead, not your superiors.

speaker: Taran
content: What are you talking about? Why would I...

speaker: Communication
content: Buzz...
You notice that Taran's comm is on. You can't hear the other side clearly, but you know they can hear you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Want to see where I stand? Let go of me. I'll show you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There is no other way!

speaker: Communication
content: Buzz...

speaker: Taran
content: But!

speaker: Taran
content: ...Understood.
He shoves you forward, and with a twist of his blade, he cuts off the rope.
You rub your strangled arms and walk over to the Sinners, facing the huge armed robot.

speaker: Donald
content: Yo! I don't know you, but I bet you are a big shot. Shall I take you home?

speaker: Choice
options: The contamination here has nothing to do with the Drifter Camp.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop your so-called mission. I know what the Reconstruction Executive Committee is planning.

speaker: Donald
content: Hmm… You're making it very difficult for me... Should I call someone and make you go back?

speaker: Donald
content: But my superior would say...

speaker: Donald
content: Complete your mission first.

speaker: Choice
options: Then you can say goodbye to your robot!

content: In front of you lies a broken robot that has been shut down.

speaker: Hella
content: Whoopee! Done! I'm just too good!

speaker: Hella
content: How about that, you brat? Know your place! Understand who you're dealing with now? I'll let you off the hook this time!

speaker: Hella
content: Don't you dare challenge me again! Huh?
He remains silent and seems in great shock. People behind him start murmuring.

speaker: Drifter Camp Force
content: ...Those Sinners, taking down the beast without breaking a sweat...

speaker: Drifter Camp Force
content: Our forces are no match for that. Look at their power...

speaker: Choice
options: Hecate, get that person out here.

speaker: Hecate
content: Got it.
Nightmare slams, and the man bounces out of the operator's cabin with sparkles flying around.

speaker: Donald
content: ****. Why are you messing with me?!

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare, catch him.

speaker: Donald
content: W-w-wait. No, no, no. Please don't... Ouch! Don't, we are on the same side!

speaker: Donald
content: You think it's fair to trade me for their trust?! We came for the same mission, taking care of Drifter Camp, didn't we?
Another commotion comes from the crowd, and you realize something is wrong. Is this cunning man trying to drag you down?
Bang...
Bang, bang, bang...
He is about to continue when gunshots suddenly ring out from the crowd. The executive officer is shot several times, blood oozes out from his chest, and he falls down on the scrap metal.
...Should have done that a long time ago.
An old man in a wheelchair moves slowly toward you.

speaker: Taran
content: Julien, don't go over there!

speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
content: It's okay. They're not our enemies now.

speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
content: They are not with the executive officer but friends of the Legion. So they're our guests.

speaker: Hella
content: The broken cloak... You are... the old man from back then?
This voice doesn't belong to a senior, for it sounds too young, yet extremely persuasive to the unruly cloaked warriors. Even Taran bows his head and chooses to obey, though reluctantly.

speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
content: Thanks for your help. You have given us a chance to fight back.

speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
content: Now can I invite you for a conversation? I know you want something from me.
That man takes off his hood and looks right into your eyes.

speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
content: I'm Julien, the architect of Drifter Camp.

speaker: Man in a Wheelchair
content: ...I can see where you stand. Glad to meet you, ${PlayerName}.
A dark alley. Noises are kept far away from deep in Drifter Camp, where only the dripping water and a woman's furious roars echo between the cold walls.

speaker: K.K.
content: ****. Get your *** out here. I know you're around. I saw you!!

speaker: K.K.
content: Why are you hiding? Explain the utilities, the rent, and the seal! What happened while I was away?
She takes a step forward and inadvertently sees the blood on the ground. Stunned, she can't help but raises her voice.

speaker: K.K.
content: Come out, Che!!!

speaker: K.K.
content: Ah!!
Tripped over something, she stumbles and falls to the ground.

speaker: Che
content: Stop yelling... You're being too loud, and it might attract unwanted attention.
The young man talks casually, but his face is awfully pale.

speaker: Che
content: ...Yo. You've returned... at the worst timing.
Romanesque, at the bottom of Drifter Camp. Layers of overpasses block away the sunset and the hustle. Under the memorial lie darkness and silence.
A woman caresses names on the memorial for a long time, murmuring.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: ...Yes, I hear it, too... The sound of the abyss returning...

March 15, N.F. 113, 19:48
Senior Management Hidden Office, Drifter Camp

speaker: Hella
content: Wow... Is this your headquarters? It's old and shabby, but feels very Syndican. It actually looks pretty cool.

speaker: Hella
content: What's this? A model of the Drifter Camp? These look like buttons you can press.

speaker: Julien
content: This is a personal office. The model is the general operation panel for the Drifter Camp's major mechanisms.

speaker: Julien
content: Don't touch it. Save us some trouble.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph... So, architect... Did you build this whole Drifter Camp, including those mechanisms, secret passages, and that weird building?
He doesn't answer and turns to face you, with a weary expression and steady voice, but he speaks with indisputable certainty.

speaker: Julien
content: I'd like to have a few words with Minos' Chief. If everyone else could give us some privacy.

speaker: Hecate
content: I won't leave Chief.

speaker: Julien
content: You can summon your guard and let it stay here to protect ${PlayerName}. I can't see it, and I don't mind being watched.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph, your guys seem to mind though.
Someone tries to say something, but Julien lifts a hand to quiet him.

speaker: Julien
content: My guys will leave too. Only I'll stay. You can take me as your hostage.

He pulls out a gun with the barrel pointed at himself as he speaks, and hands the gun to you. The bony, gloomy face now has a tight frown on it. His eyes are deep-set, and there is neither hint of a smile nor vitality in his expression.

speaker: Julien
content: Look at me. What threat can a body like this pose? You came to stop Mania, didn't you? Then time is not on your side.
Grr...
Amid the tense atmosphere, someone's stomach suddenly growls.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What? Don't look at me like that! It wasn't me! I already had enough buns! I...

speaker: Hella
content: ...Hecate, you haven't eaten anything, have you? Since this morning?

speaker: Hecate
content: That's not important. It's Nightmare who fought in the battles. I didn't use too much energy.
Grr... Hecate's face is blank, but Nightmare, who's next to her, flinches.

speaker: Julien
content: ...Sigh.
The man's face loosens up. He sighs almost inaudibly and puts the gun on the desk. Turning the wheelchair, he makes his way to another corner swiftly and skillfully, then presses the button there.
A sketchy mechanical arm extends from the bookshelves, taking something from the top drawer and bringing it before Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh ****, what are you doing?
The arm loosens. Something drops. She catches it reflexively, looking like the thing scalds her hand, only to find it's a pack of... candies in some old-fashioned packaging.
Julien moves near a desktop receiver and leans in to whisper something into it.
Soon, a red-haired woman pushes open the door and comes in. She comprehends the situation almost instantly and flashes a knowing smile at Julien.

speaker: Red-haired Woman
content: Hehe, you've improved, Boss. You didn't pull a long face till the end and knew to send for me to serve our guests.

speaker: Julien
content: ...Just some starving kids. Get them out of here quickly.

speaker: Red-haired Woman
content: Alright, alright. You've seen it yourselves, he's a boring man. Don't waste time on him. Follow me, kiddos.

speaker: Red-haired Woman
content: There are some late-night snacks ready in the canteen. We've sent away those caped kids so they won't make a mess here.

speaker: Red-haired Woman
content: Don't worry about your friend. That boy may look like a twig, but I bet he can take out ten Juliens without breaking a sweat. Perhaps you can grab something for him too?
female_content: Don't worry about your friend. That girl may look like a twig, but I bet she can take out ten Juliens without breaking a sweat. Perhaps you can grab something for her too?

speaker: Red-haired Woman
content: You guys have some big fights waiting for you ahead. If you don't fuel up, how can you protect your loved ones?

speaker: Hecate
content: No, I...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If they're going to kill me, it won't happen here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eat well. Don't starve yourself again.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Okay, if this is your wish.

speaker: Hecate
content: But Nightmare will stay. No one can hurt you.
The two Sinners are pushed out of the office and the footsteps fade out. The door shuts, leaving only you, Julien, Nightmare who's invisible to him, and icy silence in the room.
Just now, his subordinate's jokes didn't anger or ease him. He watches you like he's waiting for something. You suddenly remember there is still an unoccupied gun between you two.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I understand your eager intention to team up, but I have no interest in taking hostages.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't need such a thing. I have my own power, and I'm not interested in taking you hostage.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I need an explanation for everything that's happened so far. This conversation could have happened sooner, and in a friendlier manner.

speaker: Julien
content: I hoped so too. But as you can see, I can't neglect the fact that you were with the Executive Committee. I must verify your stance.

speaker: Julien
content: You've seen how far they can go to eradicate the Drifter Camp. I'm sorry to have dragged you into this conflict, but you gotta do what you gotta do.

speaker: Options (Repeated Choice)
options: Why would the Executive Committee want to do that?
Including shooting that executive officer named Donald?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is an official operation. It must have a convincing motive.

speaker: Julien
content: Did Burns have any motives when he dealt with the Legion? I thought all they needed was a decision.

speaker: Julien
content: <size=32>One and a half months ago, when BR-004 precipitated Hypercubes for the first time, the Executive Committee decided to wipe out the Drifter Camp. Be it Mania or a riot, they'll either fabricate a crime for us or force us to commit it. The result will be the same.</size>

speaker: Julien
content: I've got a question for those big shots. Why have they chosen to pick on a bunch of refugees who's already lost everything, but not those lawless thugs out there?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I only wanted to take apart that weapon and settle the conflict, but you cut off all negotiations and didn't hesitate for a second when you killed him.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why? Because a corpse can't talk? Or did you spoil my stance on purpose to force me to go against the Executive Committee?

speaker: Julien
content: Bad blood. He was just a traitor.

speaker: Julien
content: Ask anyone in the camp for his back story. You may not believe it if I tell you, and I don't want to talk about it either.

speaker: Julien
content: And don't worry about your stance. Even in the committee, he was just a disposable pawn. A lapdog who resorted to betraying his home would never be significant.

speaker: Julien
content: When it's over, someone will forge a report to help you get away with this.

speaker: Options
options: It sounds like you have spies in the Executive Committee too?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You know about their internal decision one and a half months ago, and you can forge the executive officer's death investigation report.
His silence confirms your guess.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No wonder the moment I arrived at Keylan Square, you were already after me.

speaker: Julien
content: Yes. Information about you is too ambiguous and unreliable, but you've indeed influenced Syndicate greatly. Your existence is too important. We must approach you ourselves and find out whose side you're on.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then why did you assign such an important mission to a mindless kid?

speaker: Taran
content: Shoot me!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: He didn't try to kill me, but took my companions hostage and forced me to shoot him. Instead of testing my friendliness, he wanted me to start a fire. He wanted war.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As a leader, is this your usual way of dealing with issues? Is this how you manage your underlings?

speaker: Julien
content: You're right. He's naive and only wants to vent. He's far from an ideal candidate for the job. It was my mistake to have picked him.

speaker: Julien
content: But those who are mature and reliable enough to deal with things have already died doing that in many different ways. All we have left are a bunch of angry kids and an architect who's been chosen to be a makeshift leader.

speaker: Julien
content: It requires considerable capability to deal with things, but our opponent doesn't think we're qualified.
The man's mask-like stiff face finally displays emotions for the first time: frustration, exhaustion, sadness... and a stubborn insistence.

speaker: Julien
content: People didn't gather here to fight. They only wanted a shelter, probably their last one.

speaker: Julien
content: When the Drifter Camp is threatened, some pick up their weapons in rage, but more have already lost the will to fight in the hardships they've been through. They could easily fall into panic.

speaker: Julien
content: We're not the Legion. We don't have their strong fighters, let alone a leader like Zoya who can command a battle.

speaker: Julien
content: I wouldn't have brought conflicts into the Drifter Camp if I'd had a choice. I just never expected that Mania would creep in too.
He pauses as if to collect himself, and stares right at you as he speaks.

speaker: Julien
content: That's the only explanation I can give. You can send someone to confirm the results of the negotiations initiated by the Executive Committee three weeks ago. I can supply communication tools.

speaker: Julien
content: But don't alert the committee, and don't let anyone in the camp know. I don't want any panic.

speaker: Julien
content: You've helped us through the crisis and proven your distinct character. Now, back to the initial reason why I brought you here.

speaker: Julien
content: Please go inside the Drifter Camp, investigate the Mania contamination, and rid us of its threat. I'm willing to provide any information and assistance on this. I believe this is also what you need.
He turns to adjust the communication device, then moves to make way for you.

speaker: Options
options: When I leave here, I'll find time to contact the support staff

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's begin. This conversation happened too late, we must seize the time.

speaker: Options
options: It seems that you've had an understanding of Mania in the camp since early on.

content: He nods.

speaker: Julien
content: The earliest suspicion came from the undercover executive officers who infiltrated the Drifter Camp. At first, their main purpose was to spy for intel and scout the landscape. They were obviously preparing for a raid.

speaker: Julien
content: In response, we tightened up our entry control, and monitored and misled those spying executive officers.

speaker: Julien
content: But there was an anomaly ten days ago. The undercover officers suddenly mutated with Mania. Luckily, the person monitoring the officer reacted quickly, prevented a large-scale panic and the spreading of contamination.

speaker: Julien
content: <size=32>Rustfire members didn't reveal this to the inhabitants, but it caused quite a stir within the group. Many thought it was a vicious plot by the Executive Committee, that they had crossed the line and resorted to using Mania like those thugs did in the past.</size>
That's why they were extra sensitive to you, a Mania expert accompanied by executive officers.

speaker: Options
options: ...It would have been simpler had that been all.

content: The highly elusive corruption symptoms, the weird happenings at the Ring ruins in the square, the bizarre marks, the spreading evil contamination field, and Parma which you're investigating. You tell all of these to Julien.

speaker: Julien
content: ...We don't know much about the invisible Mania you mentioned. And the power that triggers Black Rings... Have they really come here?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's wrong?

speaker: Julien
content: Nothing... I just don't want that tragedy to repeat itself.

speaker: Julien
content: I kept the scene where the executive officers mutated. The remaining contamination is hard to remove, but that also helped to preserve the scene. You can start your investigation from there. I'll send some people to assist you.

speaker: Julien
content: Given my condition, I'll be wasting everyone's time if I'm there. I'll stay here to operate the mechanisms and back you up.
You nod and leave with the communications device, but stop and turn around after a second thought.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I have one more question.

speaker: Options
options: Is Dudu one of your guys too?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did she tell you about my suspended animation, or did you discover that first and send her to monitor me?

speaker: Julien
content: She's not one of us, only an occasional partner. Dudu goes to Romanesque often and is sensitive to death. She just happened to have discovered you.

speaker: Julien
content: That Sinner loves the Drifter Camp, and naturally she cares about your stance. Her conclusion matters greatly to me.
[Scene Change]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Aren't you going to stay with me?

speaker: Dudu
content: No need. I believe you now.

speaker: Julien
content: It's a life on thin ice here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I fail any of your trials, what will you do?

speaker: Julien
content: If you ever choose to harm the Drifter Camp, I'll do anything I can to end you.
He's so placidly honest.

speaker: Options
options: And now? Have I passed all my trials?

content: This time, Julien doesn't answer. With his face in the shade, you can't see his expression clearly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Haha, excuse me. I said one question. You've been generous enough already, thank you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've sent back the primary investigation report. The FAC has recalled military support to the Executive Committee at the last minute. Until I finish my investigation on Mania, there won't be any threat against you with that level of weaponry.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I can't make any promises further than that. Our mutual trust stops there, and I don't have that kind of power to help you fight against anything.

speaker: Julien
content: That will suffice. You don't need to trust or recognize me, and it doesn't matter if you choose not to forgive us.

speaker: Julien
content: No matter which side you're on, if you're an honorable and kind person, you'll do what you should. Rustfire will never harm you.

speaker: Julien
content: I wish you all the best.
You push open the door to leave. Two people stand behind the door on the left and right. Hecate and Taran. They seem to have guarded the door for a long time and the air between them is stiff.
The moment he sees you, Taran turns his head to look away. You ignore him too and say to Hecate...

speaker: Options
options: Why didn't you go and eat something?

content: Before she answers, the metal beneath your feet begins thumping. Someone is dashing this way from the other end of the bridge.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm back! Here, open your mouths!
Hella hops and bumps into both of you, ready to shove the wraps in her hands into your mouths.

speaker: Hella
content: Hehehe, these are offerings to the marvelous Hella. I'm kind enough to share them with you!

speaker: Hella
content: The way I defeated that huge armor and saved the Drifter Camp was too darn cool, the guys at the canteen were practically kneeling to me. I had my mouth full without paying a dime there.

speaker: Hella
content: Ah! I'd never enjoyed this kind of privilege before. I ******* love this place!

speaker: Hecate
content: Offerings are for the dead.

speaker: Hella
content: Mmph... Shut your big mouth!
You take the wrap and pass it to Hecate, then pat the grumpy Hella on her head.
You lead the two of them out of this stressful space that seems to suffocate you.
Only one staircase connects to Julien's office. You walk down it and exit the narrow path into the overhead passage sitting atop the square.

The broadcasting station is near, and the central square's food stalls are a few dozen meters below. Although the night market is open, the place is not as clamorous and crowded as yesterday. The entire space is drowned in an odd anxiety.
The Executive Committee's raid scared ordinary inhabitants, and in places they're not yet aware of, Mania is spreading unnoticeably.
No response. You try to sense the location of the contamination source, but in vain. It seems like you'll have to investigate by following one clue after another.

speaker: Hella
content: Lavina!
The shout interrupts your thoughts. Hella is waving at the red-haired woman waiting on the other end of the bridge. It's the woman who took her to the canteen not long ago.

speaker: Lavina
content: I haven't introduced myself. My name is Lavina, and I'm a logistics officer here. I'm only in charge of food and not the guns. I also dislike fights.

speaker: Lavina
content: Were the wraps good? If you haven't had enough, I can make you some more.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...You despise Mania but not the Sinners?
Hecate's vigilance doesn't offend the woman and only sends her into deep thoughts.

speaker: Lavina
content: Did Sinners do anything wrong?

speaker: Lavina
content: Oh, Dudu likes to scam people for money. Those three from Whitestone never pay their debts. There's also that con artist who only knows to bluff, and... alright, the Sinners we have here aren't very presentable.

speaker: Lavina
content: But look how cute little Hella is. People adore her energy and can't help coddling her.
You glimpse at Hella's expression. She seems to have already lowered her guard. Apparently, Lavina is good at easing others' nerves... Is this also his arrangement?

speaker: Lavina
content: Alright, I know you're already tired of my rambling. Come, the closest site for your investigation is not far, and it's been kept as it is since the incident happened.
She leads you across the bridge, onto the railcar, down the elevator, and finally you arrive at the other end of the commercial district. There are fences to seal this area.
The inhabitants are evacuated in time. Dressed in thick cloaks, a dozen armed personnel are pointing their guns at a dark alley and firing anti-Mania shots into it, triggering nauseating growls.

speaker: Armed Personnel
content: ...Inside.
There are no signs of monsters in there, but the pitch-dark alley indeed gives off an unpleasant yet familiar atmosphere.

speaker: Lavina
content: The Corruptors were already killed and the contamination has been mostly cleaned up, but I didn't expect to see a sign of resurgence today.

speaker: Lavina
content: I'll leave the rest to you, Mr. Expert.
female_content: I'll leave the rest to you, Miss Expert.

content: After cleaning up the overactive filth, you use Hella's pipe to lift a strange cloak lying in a corner.
...No, it's not a cloak. It's a raincoat. Its owner is nowhere to be found, and its inside is covered in highly developed Mania contamination, dripping down to the ground.

speaker: Man In Raincoat
content: Your wish... will be granted...

speaker: Man In Raincoat
content: <size=44>I... witness!</size>

speaker: Hella
content: I remember this! It's the raincoat guy from the carnival!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Was this kind of raincoat found near all the mutated executive officers?

speaker: Lavina
content: Just a moment, I've already contacted someone to check the belongings of the deceased. Besides...
She nods at an armed personnel next to her, who immediately walks toward you, holding a dark ziploc bag.

speaker: Lavina
content: Most people here haven't seen a real Corruptor. What you're holding may be too shocking to them. Keep it sealed.

Indeed, even in your experience, the contamination here looks very showy. It keeps morphing and making a twisting noise, as if emphasizing its existence constantly. Rather than destruction, it looks more like a revolting performance.
It's different from the Mania that took lives discreetly in your memories. Your head feels heavy, and you keep thinking as you pour the filth in your hands into the bag.
Just when your finish sealing the bag, the scar-faced man before you snickers suddenly and whispers to you in a hushed, weird voice.

speaker: Armed Personnel
content: Smarty-pants, Sinner, big shot... The monster who killed that monster... You're not one of us, but the so-called Chief...

speaker: Armed Personnel
content: Oh, you even know how to fake death... you deceived everyone... in plain sight... How brave...

speaker: Armed Personnel
content: I'm sure you've got an insider working for you...
Hecate freezes suddenly.

speaker: Armed Personnel
content: The person who shot you, who worked for you, runs fast and hides well. I couldn't see clearly... Sir, do you know... who he is?
female_content: The person who shot you, who worked for you, runs fast and hides well. I couldn't see clearly... Miss, do you know... who he is?

speaker: Options
options: Why don't you investigate it yourself?
Tell your boss Julien to come ask me directly.

content: You can't be bothered to respond to such blatant provocation. From these words, you can tell that "Rust" is being suspected, but not completely exposed. Considering his style, he wouldn't reveal himself while rescuing two Sinners.
Telling yourself that no pain no gain to ease the annoyed feelings, you turn to bypass the man and make your way back.
Outside the fences, you see through the window that many inhabitants have gathered in the building somehow.

speaker: Lavina
content: Everything is okay now. The threat has been completely removed. Once the clean-up force tidies the place, you can reopen your businesses again.
People are looking at you, their faces full of vigilance and distrust. You scan across the crowd and recognize Greta, that doctor who took you to yooga.
But he immediately evades your gaze, and his first reaction is to hide.

speaker: Lavina
content: I got their response. All the mutated guys had something like this raincoat around them.

speaker: Lavina
content: Now, what are you going to do next, expert?

speaker: Lavina
content: ...${PlayerName}? You don't look well, what's wrong?

speaker: Options
options: ...Nothing. Let's move on to the next place.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I just still have no clue. Let's hurry up with the investigation.
You're only cooperating with them. You barely know them, and neither do they know you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's go somewhere with fewer people. More people means higher risks.

speaker: Armed Personnel
content: Haha... Is it the risk of being hated... You're not hurt, are you? Here...
He smiles and points at his own heart, but a voice stops him abruptly.

speaker: Lavina
content: ...Shut up, Nakamura.
The gentle red-haired logistics officer's voice suddenly turns cold and stern. The man named Nakamura straightens up reflexively. His colleagues follow suit.
After a brief silence, Lavina begins slowly.

speaker: Lavina
content: I almost forgot. The girl took the two wraps for you. You've been working busily on an empty stomach. I reckon you haven't gotten much sleep either, have you?

speaker: Lavina
content: That's not good... This only means the logistics department hasn't done their job properly. ${PlayerName}, come with me.

speaker: Options
options: Time is running short. I have to go and investigate.

speaker: Lavina
content: How can you think when you're sleep-deprived and starving? You'll waste more time if you faint.

speaker: Lavina
content: <size=44>Come. With. Me.</size>
Are you really out of strength? As you hesitate, you feel yourself straighten up as well. Then, right in front of everyone, the logistics officer drags you away.
You're led into a duty room nearby. Soon, egg pancakes, minced meat, and hot bean soup appear before you. There seems to be coffee heating up on the stove as well.

speaker: Lavina
content: When was the last time you ate?
...Last night, I had some grilled chicken, bean curd, and a piece of meat from Tally.

speaker: Lavina
content: And the last time you slept?
...Yesterday afternoon, in the wooden box in Romanesque.
You didn't say that out loud, but she doesn't seem like she needs to hear it either. She just sighs.

speaker: Lavina
content: Here are some quick snacks, I know you're in a hurry. I don't think I can get you to lie down either. Try to take a nap on the railcar, and make up for the rest with coffee.

speaker: Lavina
content: This is what Julien drinks when he pulls several all-nighters in a row. He puts ten sugar cubes in a cup to replenish his brain energy.
Under her gaze, you begin chewing silently. In fact, you can't really taste anything, but you swallow mechanically. Like she said, your body is reaching its limit.

speaker: Lavina
content: People have some misunderstanding about you. News about the battle at noon has probably started spreading. Taran shouted so loudly that those words must have gotten out. Those who've heard it may think you're an infiltrated spy.

speaker: Taran
content: Stop! This is the expert you're looking for, the chief of Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, the hero that helped you take down the Legion.

speaker: Donald
content: You think it's fair to trade me for their trust?! We came for the same mission, taking care of Drifter Camp, didn't we?

speaker: Lavina
content: Don't be fooled by the brutal way they fight. Most of the people in the camp are ordinary folks who get scared easily. They didn't even dare to face gangsters in the past, let alone that huge thing today.

speaker: Lavina
content: They have nothing against you. It's just that they've been through too much. Fear has become a habit.
She smiles at you.

speaker: Lavina
content: Blame it on Julien, that sulky guy. He only knows to hide behind those mechanisms whenever something happens. He should at least say a few big words to lift the morale, being the leader and all.
The way his subordinate mocks him prompts you to rethink your preconception of Rustfire's leader.

speaker: Lavina
