The spokesperson angrily slaps the desk and interrupts Matilda. The hall falls to silence for a few seconds.

speaker: Matilda
content: You're right, sir.
She turns off the report screen and resumes her poised sitting posture, as if she has never said anything or exposed any scandals.

speaker: Somber Murmurs
content: ...What a gutsy thing to say. Of course, she's the daughter of the Cavendish family... We risk our lives every day while she's just here to polish her resume and kill time...

speaker: Somber Murmurs
content: Well, if her family had any hope in her, they wouldn't have thrown her to this hellhole and assigned her that figurehead loony superior. I say she's just an outcast in the Cavendish family, haha...
...Mind your own business.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: ...Ahem. I feel sorry for Donald, but your superior is notoriously prone to getting into trouble. If he had followed the Executive Committee's guidelines, he would never have ended up like this.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: Paradeisos has issued new instructions to all departments. Another large-scale joint operation concerning BR-002 will be launched within two weeks. The battle against the Underground's Mania forces has entered a critical stage, and the Executive Committee has also received important tasks.

speaker: Spokesperson
content: The remaining population in West District must complete the registration for systematic governance and resettlement. All who do not comply are suspected of rebellion. Find and destroy their organizations. If the operation is successful, you can all return to Eastside!

speaker: Spokesperson
content: Sergeant Matilda, you will perform field duties in your missing superior's place. You can do it, can't you?
A few sneers echo in the hall with brazen surprise and schadenfreude. After all, who would willingly undertake field duties during this time? As said in Matilda's report, it's a gamble on your life.

speaker: Matilda
content: Copy that, sir. I'll get right to it.
She gets up and leaves the meeting room, ignoring the hushed mockery along the way.

speaker: Somber Murmurs
content: Serves the nepo baby right...

<size=40><color=#fb9259>Matilda Cavendish</color> became a <size=40><color=#fb9259>clerk for the Executive Committee</color> in N.F. 112.

She is rigid, solitary, inflexible, and lacks political acumen.

The only reason she's still here is because people fear her family and her aunt who is expected to be elected the future Speaker of the Eastside City Council.</size>

<size=40>However, the Cavendish family has not taken her back to safety since the West District uprising six months ago.

People gradually realize that Matilda is more of an outcast than a promising Cavendish who's placed here to enrich her resume.</size>
<size=40>Perhaps even her family hopes she will die quietly on the battlefield in exchange for a glamorous medal of honor.</size>
Clang—
Worries always come true. On a Syndican street, a blue-haired Rustfire Sinner smashes off a robot guard with a club, looking down at the terrified Executive Officers smugly.

speaker: Panicking Officer
content: No, no... We didn't do anything. We were just doing our job. Please don't kill me, please!

speaker: Corso
content: Hey, I've warned you. Why are you still wandering around the streets? Are all Executive Officers so dedicated to their job? I'm ******* tearing up.

speaker: Corso
content: I've been quite bored recently. Line up and take turns to be my punching bag.

speaker: Corso
content: Aw! Don't run!
The armed Executive Officers flee in panic, leaving only Matilda in the patrol to protect the clerical officers behind her.

speaker: Matilda
content: That's a Rustfire Sinner, A-Class. With my gear, I can take her on alone and buy us some time. I'll hold her off, you guys go find reinforcements.

speaker: Panicking Officer
content: B-But... there's more than one Sinner!

In the middle of the dilapidated street, an incongruous figure emerges. Though frail and thin, she radiates a sinister aura. The shrieking Mania alarm and the black mist roaring under her cloak reveal the girl's identity.

Matilda clearly sees the twisted Nightmare rising behind the girl. The highly contaminated environment causes severe signal interference, so the real-time images cannot be transmitted. She calmly types the final telegram in the designated anti-Mania channel.

speaker: Matilda
content: To HQ, Matilda's patrol was attacked by an unknown Sinner. Enemy's highly aggressive. Please send reinforcements.

speaker: Matilda
content: Please send reinforcements.
The moment she finishes typing these words, the wall covering her is crushed by Nightmare's roar.
Everything stops. Corso looks around the ruin shrouded in smoke, and besides her so-called companion, there's no more living prey she can fiddle with.

speaker: Corso
content: You scared away my hard-won toys... What am I supposed to do now?
Her question is ignored. Nightmare struggles a bit as it lifts Matilda who has slumped to the ground. The battle wasn't tough, but the faint black spikes appearing on Hecate's body are burdening her.

Ever since ${PlayerName} disappeared in March, the shackles have been backfired by the Mania of Corpus 002. Every time she uses her power, it results in severe contamination. Hecate doesn't care though. She prefers to believe that the shackles' presence proves that Chief is still alive.
But that doesn't cheer her up at all. The girl now wears a gloomy face, turning around to leave with her captive.

speaker: Hecate
content: The mission's objective is achieved. Let's return immediately. Once the Executive Committee's reinforcements arrive, it'll waste more of our time.

speaker: Corso
content: Will they send reinforcements? If so, I'd rather stay. I haven't had a good fight in a while and I'm itching for one.

speaker: Corso
content: Why are you glaring at me? If you wanna take their place, that's fine too. It'll help me blow off some steam.

speaker: Corso
content: Hahaha, just joking. I have no interest in hassling someone who’s frail like you.

speaker: Corso
content: When the day comes that your Chief dies and the shackles break, you'll be able to fight with all your strength. I'll come looking for you then.
Corso reaches out to ruffle the young girl's hair, but Hecate swats her hand away. Her cloak loosens a bit, revealing her furious eyes.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I can kill you right now, you Rustfire scum.
As if seizing that brief moment, a metallic sphere suddenly shoots out of the rubble with a clamor. The camera flashes as it quickly flees the site.

speaker: Corso
content: Oh, it's the Executive Committee's security camera! Did it capture our heroic deeds just now?
Hecate anxiously tries to chase after it, but Nightmare hasn't recovered enough to make precise quick attacks. And at that very moment...
Bang! A gunshot, and the flitting security camera is immediately hit, exploding into a tiny firework.
The one firing the shot is Matilda. She was just thrown on the ground by Nightmare and has somehow grabbed a gun and fired that bullseye shot.

speaker: Corso
content: Whoosh... What a shot! Next time you should join me for some fun, ey? Miss Carabanda?

speaker: Matilda
content: My last name is Cavendish. When we get back to the base, I can train with you. But you must promise not to provoke your teammates or cause trouble during missions anymore.
She dusts herself off and stands up, then lifts her hand to help Hecate pull on her hood, covering the girl's too-pale face.

speaker: Matilda
content: You shouldn't have come, Hecate. I can handle Corso, and the MBCC can't know about your collaboration with Rustfire.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...If they found out, I'd just say I was attacking a traitor of the Executive Committee.

speaker: Hecate
content: This isn't a collaboration either.
Matilda's hand is also pushed away.

speaker: Hecate
content: Where is Chief? Any news?

speaker: Matilda
content: That's a question for a safer place.
Hecate glares at her. Corso whistles, and Matilda says nothing more. She sets up the scene, staging an attack against the patrol.

speaker: Matilda
content: All right, I've faked an attack scene here. This way, the Executive Committee won't suspect anything. They already have their hands full.

speaker: Matilda
content: Thanks for coming to get me. Now, let's return to the base.

The three pry open a manhole cover on the road and jump in. An elderly man has been waiting for a long time in the dried-up tunnel. He raises a blue lantern and leads the three deeper into the darkness.

After several hours of meandering, the three Sinners finally arrive at an underground hideout in the contaminated area. The old man nods and leaves. A red-haired middle-aged woman opens the secret door to welcome them.

speaker: Lavina
content: ...Good thing you've arrived safe and sound. Come on in.

<size=40>Matilda Cavendish became a Sinner in N.F. 112 due to an accident during her duty.

The Cavendish family is unable to stomach this kind of scandal, so she must keep it a secret.

She was therefore threatened by someone who knew her secret and became a Rustfire collaborator.</size>
At first, she was indeed forced to cooperate to protect the honor of the Cavendish family. But after the uprising broke out and Matilda decided to stay in West District, her thoughts have changed.
<size=40>Looking back, she might have been longing for an answer, one she couldn't find in the East.</size>

6:38 p.m., November 23, N.F. 113
Exiles - East 19 Underground Base

After the suppression of the rebellion, the Executive Committee has regained control of West District. As such, there exist a number of secret non-cooperative organization bases like this one. The so-called comprehensive census brings considerable pressure to these exiles. Many bases have already relocated multiple times since November.
Presently, Matilda, a clerical officer of the Executive Committee, is confirming the details of the relocation with Lavina who's in charge of the base.

speaker: Lavina
content: The food and medical supplies can still hold up. There used to be many Outlanders in the Drifter Camp, and they've established some channels for us. We can still hold on for a while.

speaker: Lavina
content: The biggest issue is still Hypercubes. Nirvana has completely cut off supply to civilians in the West District, and this affected trade with Outland as well. The only place to get Hypercubes is still Mine W-31.

speaker: Matilda
content: I remember it was that Chief who wiped out that half of the Corpus at the bottom of W-31. Coupled with the new BR-002 outbreak, the old Black Ring here was rendered completely inactive and became a small usable Hypercube mine.

speaker: Matilda
content: In a sense, the previous goal of Rustfire has indeed been achieved.

Only then does she notice that Lavina's face has turned gloomy. During the first Drifter Camp Mania crisis, Lavina was contaminated by Corpus 002, and it was ${PlayerName} who suppressed the Mania in her body with the shackles.
But now Chief is missing, and the life-saving shackles he left behind have become the source of contamination. This fact and chronic exhaustion have left the strong woman visibly weary.
female_content: But now Chief is missing, and the life-saving shackles she left behind have become the source of contamination. This fact and chronic exhaustion have left the strong woman visibly weary.

speaker: Lavina
content: ...Rustfire is no more. Those gathering here are all refugees.

speaker: Corso
content: Right, Rustfire is gone and Syndicate has no future. Miss Carbonara, how about packing up the people here and taking them to Eastside?

speaker: Corso
content: You care a lot about everyone, don't you? You must hate to see them suffer again.

speaker: Matilda
content: My last name is Cavendish. And yes, I do care. That's why I'm trying to find a way out.

speaker: Corso
content: A way out... Haha, not everyone believes there is one.

speaker: Corso
content: Or you can just send me away? You see, I've helped you a lot, haven't I?

Corso raises an eyebrow at Matilda with her completely insincere request. In fact, it's more of a taunt. It's not that this former Rustfire fighter bears any grudge against the Eastsider Executive Officer. Quite the contrary...
The natural fighter greatly enjoyed the violent games of Syndicate in the past. The current lifeless West District bores her silly, and not a minute goes by she doesn't wish she's fighting someone.

But most of her fellow enthusiasts have already died in the eight months following the reappearance of the Black Ring, or have simply been scared out of their wits that they're no longer able to play with her.

speaker: Matilda
content: I'll consider it. The relocation of the base will begin in a while. There may be danger along the path, could you scout it beforehand?
Corso waves her hand listlessly.

speaker: Corso
content: Boring Corruptors again. Fine, fine, I'll go.
Having sent Corso away, Matilda returns to Lavina's side, attempting to make up for her slip of the tongue.

speaker: Matilda
content: I'm deeply sorry for the loss of Rustfire, but besides the frontline fighters, Rustfire still has you and many non-combatants, as well as tens of thousands of Drifter Camp dwellers.

speaker: Matilda
content: During the March upheaval, you kept them safe from the riots while enduring the contamination. Since then, you've been gathering supplies under such dangerous circumstances, sustaining the operations of over a dozen bases, and protecting many people.

speaker: Matilda
content: You've safeguarded Rustfire as the one in charge of logistics. You've proven to be more reliable than many commissioners in Eastside.
Lavina stares blankly at Matilda. After a moment, she lowers her gaze.

speaker: Lavina
content: ...You're giving me too much credit.
Lavina doesn't find comfort in that, perhaps because it comes from an Eastsider Executive Officer, or her pain is just too immense to be alleviated by any words of consolation.
Perhaps to her, it seemed like Rustfire had weathered the toughest years only to fall in the most absurd manner.

March 22: The obituary of the MBCC's Chief and Rustfire's titular leader ${PlayerName} was issued. Rustfire, who shared the shackles' power, announced retaliation. March 23: Claimed the ruins of Inner Bay BR-002, the previous site of Mine W-31. March 26: Occupied the headquarters of the West District Reconstruction Executive Committee, seizing a large amount of classified information. March 29: Rustfire completed internal purges. With unified and determined conviction, they vowed to take revenge and reclaim everything that belonged to Syndicate. April 1: All major locations in West District had been taken over. With peaked morale, Rustfire planned to return to the Drifter Camp, breach the isolation belt of the Rust, and take back the East.

Influenced by public opinion from unknown sources, Rustfire received a massive batch of devoted new recruits. They gained Mania power similar to the shackles from the unconscious ${PlayerName} and became invincible for a time. In just ten days, they reclaimed what used to be theirs and struck back, achieving the unprecedented glory of Ten Days of Rustfire.

Also on the evening of April 1, architect Julien left Rustfire, quitting his long-time station Drifter Camp. On his way to Inner Bay, he detonated BR-002, bringing the Black Ring back to West District. Those Rustfire Sinners who gained the shackles-like power from the unconscious ${PlayerName} were the first to be swallowed by Mania. The Drifter Camp where they gathered instantly became a dead city overrun by Corruptors, the intense contamination reaching even the Rust. This marked the end of the ten glorious days.

What followed were endless suspicion, hatred, and ridicule. The Black Ring failed to awaken anyone. Syndicate fell deeper into chaos. BR-002 quickly developed into the largest and most powerful Secondary Black Ring in history. The Underground tried to approach it. Paradeisos returned to West District to seal it. The remaining Rustfire fanatics, targeted by both forces, claimed themselves as martyrs in delirium.

But that too quickly passed.

After venting their anger and sacrificing everything for their ideals, they found that their passion-driven struggle did not bring any honor, and nothing they did resulted in any change.

A rootless fire eventually goes out. No downpour or epiphany is needed. Time alone is the best extinguisher. With the outbreak of BR-002, Rustfire lost its soldiers, the Drifter Camp, and its leader. Those left behind were no fighters, but just a group of refugees, rendered homeless by the Black Ring and so-called governance, huddling together for warmth.
Time will ruthlessly prove that all vain fanaticism is fleeting and futile. It leaves behind nothing but a mess.
This is not a feeling that someone who has spent her whole life in Eastside can even begin to understand. Matilda won't force herself to. She has other tasks she must tend to.

speaker: Matilda
content: We're running out of time. Please gather everyone together. We need to move closer to the central base. At least the Executive Officers will never patrol that place. Converging the bases also lowers Hypercube consumption.

speaker: Matilda
content: There may be dangers during the transit. Most Sinners are burdened by the shackles now, so I should be of use.
Lavina nods. The shackles still inflict considerable contamination on her. She tightly grips a small piece of Hypercube on her chest to steady herself.

speaker: Lavina
content: Thank you. Before that, there's another favor I'd like to ask.

speaker: Lavina
content: I heard you're someone of influence in Eastside. Do you know of any safe ways to get in touch with the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control?

speaker: Lavina
content: I have a wounded person here, an MBCC Sinner. Her contamination is severe, and she's been unconscious since getting critically injured. I can't save her, she needs better treatment.

speaker: Lavina
content: I know it's dangerous to contact them, but if you have a way to send the child back without exposing us, if it can save her, I'll do anything you ask.

speaker: Matilda
content: I do have a way, but I wouldn't recommend it, even if it's for the sake of that child.

speaker: Matilda
content: As far as I know, the Sinners of the Bureau have also been contaminated by BR-002. The situation is bleak. The Ring Research Institute of Paradeisos has taken over the MBCC for now.

speaker: Matilda
content: They're not like that Chief. If a Sinner's condition is judged as too dangerous, they will only be subjected to more brutal treatment.

speaker: Matilda
content: If you do care about that child, keep her by your side. At least you would never give up on her, come what may.

speaker: Lavina
content: ...I see, thank you. I'm sorry.

speaker: Matilda
content: There's nothing you need to apologize to me for.
After seeing Lavina off, Matilda walks through the meandering secret passage and arrives at the isolation ward. She pushes the door open.
[Scene change] Green room (The place in Drifter Camp in Ch.9 where Dudu saves people)

In the narrow single ward, a girl with lilac hair lies there in deep sleep. Her body is covered in wounds, and black spikes emanate from within her ominously. The severity of her symptoms is visible. Matilda remembers the girl's name.

Hella. She was seriously injured by a delirious Mania-infected attacker during the riot. Her ability is rapid regeneration, but as she falls into a deep coma, her power becomes completely suppressed by the superior Mania consciousness on the other end of the shackles.

After ${PlayerName}'s death, the shackles' inhibitory effect on Mania has completely disappeared. The minds of all Sinners and Mania-infected people who have accepted the shackles are now connected to the resurged BR-002.

Those who desire power above all else are granted their wishes after sacrificing their sanity. Those who try to resist and preserve their own senses in vain are punished by the Black Ring, suffering both physically and mentally. Hella, Hecate, and Lavina are all perfect examples.

Matilda doesn't go closer. She sees a thin figure crouched in the shadows by the hospital bed. It's Hecate. She's guarding Hella by her bedside. Behind her, Nightmare is posed to attack anytime, highly alert.

speaker: Matilda
content: It's about time to leave. Lavina is really worried about you two.

speaker: Hecate
content: I don't need Rustfire's pity. They already stole Chief's shackles, what more do they want from me?

speaker: Matilda
content: Those who stole the shackles and hurt you have already become part of the Black Ring. No one here is your enemy, Hecate.

speaker: Hecate
content: And I want nothing to do with them. I'm only here for one reason.

speaker: Hecate
content: Where is Chief? You said you would keep me posted.

speaker: Matilda
content: There's no news right now.
Nightmare roars and charges at Matilda, slamming her against the wall of the ward. Hecate rushes over and grabs Matilda by the collar.

speaker: Hecate
content: You said the 9th Agency of Paradeisos was out looking for him! After all this time, how can there be no news?
female_content: You said the 9th Agency of Paradeisos was out looking for her! After all this time, how can there be no news?

speaker: Hecate
content: You're all lying to me. You're in league with Rustfire. <color=#dg1f1f>Where did you take Chief? What did you do to him?</color>
female_content: You're all lying to me. You're in league with Rustfire. <color=#dg1f1f>Where did you take Chief? What did you do to her?</color>

content: As the girl's mood flares up, the black spikes once again pierce through her body. Nightmare trembles with her, and Matilda seizes the chance to grab Hecate's wrist and easily pins her down.
Hecate tries to push her away, but, contamination-laden, there's no way she can win against Matilda.

speaker: Matilda
content: The Rustfire you despise has been wiped out. They coveted the shackles and abused their power, that's why they were corrupted by Mania and fell to the bottom. They let hatred burn down their sanity, so they became part of BR-002.

speaker: Matilda
content: Are you going to follow the same path? You will leave your friend here and turn into a Corruptor before your Chief returns?

speaker: Hecate
content: You... Let go of me... Let go...
Hecate is stung by her words, but an emotion that hurts more than anger gradually takes over. Her struggle becomes a helpless tremor, as if she's choking back sobs.

Matilda silently releases her restraint. She takes out her emergency anti-Mania shot and injects the girl with it to suppress her contamination. Matilda knows she's not good with words, so she begins simply and frankly.

speaker: Matilda
content: It was you who chose to stay, so you could obtain information you couldn't get elsewhere. You decided to stand on our side, then don't push away everything you might need.

speaker: Matilda
content: Lavina was infected with Mania in the Drifter Camp. It was ${PlayerName} who voluntarily curbed her contamination with the shackles, saving her life while turning her into a Sinner. You were there at the time. You know better than I do.

speaker: Matilda
content: She's never asked anything of you. All her efforts to protect you were to repay what that Chief did for her. People have brought you back from the riot. And people out there are still trying to look for your Chief.

speaker: Matilda
content: You don't need to trust me. But you should find someone you can trust. Don't isolate yourself. You've already pushed your mind to the breaking point.

speaker: Matilda
content: Hecate, if you still want to move forward, if you still want to fight for someone, you must first protect your own heart.
The girl finally shows a slight reaction to these words. She pries the Executive Officer's hand off, props herself up, and returns to the side of the bed, lost in thought.
Matilda has said everything that can be said. She's kept her promise and at least brought Hecate to a relatively safe environment. The rest is up to her.

speaker: Matilda
content: The Executive Committee will soon return to inspect this area. The refugees have to relocate their base. Do you want to come with us?

speaker: Matilda
content: Or I can also escort you back to the MBCC, then you can be rid of this place. The refugees can't be detected by the city-state authorities, and you won't see us again.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I'm going with you. I must get news of Chief firsthand. Don't think of getting rid of me.

speaker: Matilda
content: Alright, then just guard the patients in the infirmary. The shackles' contamination has worsened. You're not suited for battle in your current state.
Before leaving, Matilda sees Hecate curl up and grip Hella's hand on the bed, trembling. Matilda sighs and gently closes the door.
[Relocation]
Preparation of the East 19 base is complete. The procession moves through the tunnel quietly and slowly, the faces all dejected. Matilda continues to command with a blank expression.

speaker: Matilda
content: Interference and warning devices have been placed on the ground. To avoid detection by the Executive Committee, we must proceed carefully and cautiously and change paths upon the first signal.

speaker: Matilda
content: But it's just as dangerous underground. The area we're heading to is a deeply contaminated zone. Only there can we evade the Executive Committee's search, but it also means that we may encounter Corruptors during the transit.

speaker: Matilda
content: Those of you still capable of fighting, be prepared. This won't be a smooth journey.
Almost a whole day has passed. The closer to the destination, the worse the contamination and the more fights with Corruptors. The Hypercube reserves are being depleted quickly.
Hecate has been left with the injured. Not as a fighter protecting the wounded, but as someone who needs protecting.

speaker: Corso
content: Yo, don't force yourself to fight, our little burden. Leave it to your big sister Corso, got it?

speaker: Lavina
content: Don't go. Using Nightmare to fight is too demanding for you now. I'll protect you. I'll be using my gun only. I won't get contaminated.
She's already heard the same words too many times today. It makes her feel repressed and almost humiliated, and the shackles are making it even worse.

speaker: Hecate
content: I don't need your protection... I don't want...
With a loud boom, the ground shakes. Then it's all quiet outside. Hecate senses an extremely powerful force.

speaker: Corso
content: F*** me! What the h...

A scream rips the silence. Hecate leaps up and rushes out. The tunnel is a mess, but the battle has long ended. Corso is suspended in mid-air, wrapped in a black substance, whimpering through her muffled mouth.
The surrounding refugees are all clapping and cheering, looking at a petite girl in black with hero-worshipping eyes.

speaker: Refugee
content: It's the Shadow Guardian of West District! We're safe!
The tiny hero stares coldly at them, then turns to leave.

speaker: Matilda
content: You're Crache... right? Long time no see. Thanks, you're a lifesaver.

speaker: Matilda
content: It's hard to get messages out these days. I wasn't expecting any help, let alone from you. Thank you.

Crache, S-Class Sinner, nominal leader of the Homeless, a Syndican group. After the ten-day uprising, she contacted the Drifter Camp through Ica and joined the camp with all the kids from the Homeless. Since then, she has been secretly protecting the safety of the refugees.
Rumor has it that she's very hostile toward adults... That must have been exaggerated. Matilda thinks this kid simply doesn't like to talk.
But she indeed seems much more mature than her peers. Despite her immense power, she keeps a low profile and always looks quite broody.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Some fishy guy's been poking around the base. I noticed and followed him here.

speaker: Crache
content: He's blond, and also an Executive Officer. So I thought... you might know him.
Crache glances at Matilda, who understands her meaning.

speaker: Matilda
content: Got it. Can you tell me where he is?

speaker: Crache
content: He...
As she speaks, she catches sight of Hecate rushing out of the crowd.

speaker: Crache
content: ...What's that one doing here? I thought they sent her back last time?

speaker: Crache
content: Your name is Hecate, right? Hey, you...
Completely ignoring Crache's greeting, Hecate darts off in another direction. The squatting figure in the corner is startled by the approaching girl and smiles a little awkwardly.

speaker: Donald
content: Hey, if it isn't little Hecate?

speaker: Hecate
content: Donald!

speaker: Donald
content: Shh... Keep it down, I've got a few adversaries... I mean, admirers over there. If they spot me, I'll have a hard time getting away.

speaker: Donald
content: Look at these dark circles and bony arms. It's only been two months, or three? Did you get bullied? I'll give those suckers hell later, but first, give me your hand.

speaker: Donald
content: I brought you a gift. In return, could you do me a favor and deliver a message for me? It's for...
As the man reaches into his pocket with a grin, Hecate urgently grabs his sleeve, and the object in his hand falls to the ground.

speaker: Hecate
content: Is it news about Chief? Did you find Chief?

speaker: Donald
content: ...I'm sorry to disappoint you. It's just a piece of fruit candy.

With a smile, the man picks up the candy and places it in the disappointed girl's palm. Hecate wants to say something, but she notices a change in Donald's expression. Suddenly, a long stick lands on her shoulder, aiming at the man who is trying to escape.
It's a rifle. She hears Matilda's voice behind her.

speaker: Matilda
content: Alright, Hecate, this man is a spy sent by the Executive Officers to probe for intelligence. We'll take him. I'll personally interrogate him.

speaker: Matilda
content: He and I have a lot to catch up on.
The Base

Although it's called a base, it's really just a large underground space found in the abandoned Inner Bay. Once the contamination is cleaned up and some cover and basic setup are in place, it's habitable.

The first to move in were the non-combatants evacuated from the Drifter Camp by Julien during the W-31 reclaiming operation. With the rising number of refugees and relocation of the bases, the population here now fluctuates between six and seven thousand.
[Scene Change] Any Small Room
After sending Hecate away, Matilda closes the door again.

speaker: Matilda
content: Hecate is disheartened. All this time, she's been waiting for news of that person.

speaker: Donald
content: I can't exactly tell her we do have news, can I? Those behind her are up to no good. If anything happens to that Chief, that poor little girl will certainly never forgive herself.

speaker: Matilda
content: Then make sure that she doesn't find out.

speaker: Donald
content: One must get a closer look to understand what's the deal with the shackles, right? You know about the situation.

speaker: Donald
content: Before we get into that, can't you untie me first, my dear Adjutant? I risked my life to bring you information. Let's settle our personal scores another time.

The man calls himself Donald. He was placed in the Executive Committee in November, N.F. 112. Some higher-up vouched for his deep understanding of Rustfire and his ability to handle related matters. Despite that, Donald is not highly regarded internally. His eccentric behavior has even earned him some rumors that he was an escapee from the Banyan Psychiatric Hospital.

It was also this man who helped Matilda hide her Mania infection and brought someone to stop her mutation into a Corruptor. Eventually, Matilda survived and became a Sinner. But as the price of keeping her secret, she's also been forced to clean up many laughable messes.

Donald's past records have been destroyed and it's a mystery which side he's on. There are rumors within the Executive Committee that he has another backer and that he's a spy planted by some infamous Paradeisian big shot. But to Matilda, this man's relationship with Rustfire is even more ambiguous.

Matilda is very certain that from the day he put on the Executive Officer uniform, Donald has been secretly supporting the Drifter Camp. But until now, Donald refuses to contact Rustfire directly or explain anything.
The adjutant pulls over a chair and sits in front of Donald, organizing the documents.

speaker: Matilda
content: Since you're here, please give me some guidance. Rustfire's current situation is tricky.

speaker: Matilda
content: The number of refugees received at each location is increasing, and smuggling proves a less and less reliable way to gather materials. There have been several food shortages, not to mention other rare goods.

speaker: Matilda
content: The Underground is still secretly catalyzing Mania. W-31 doesn't produce enough Hypercubes to fulfill protection needs. They have no choice but to combine the bases to reduce consumption, but a concentrated base makes an easier target for the Executive Committee's patrols.

speaker: Matilda
content: Now, the Black Ring is no longer their biggest threat. The Underground and Paradeisos's policy are both squeezing the little survival space of West District.

speaker: Donald
content: Hmm... I see. Then I have only one suggestion: I strongly suggest everyone run away with me.

speaker: Donald
content: It's a big world out there. They can go somewhere even the Black Ring, Paradeisos, and the Underground can't reach and wait it out. Staying alive should come first.

speaker: Matilda
content: There's no such utopia. The whole world has long been tightly bound together by Mania and other disasters.

speaker: Matilda
content: Whether it's Eastside, satellite towns, or the Outlands, not a single place will accept refugees from West District. Infected or not, they are turned away by all as the source of Mania, just like what happened to Sinners in the past.

speaker: Donald
content: Then why not create a new world? I hear from many guys out there that things are changing every day, now there are plenty of good shelters outside.

speaker: Donald
content: Isn't Syndicate always so proud of its builders? Then go out and build history again! Stop clinging to past glory.

speaker: Matilda
content: To start from scratch and set up new settlements, the pioneers need to be stronger, firmer, and more proactive. The people of West District don't have it in them anymore.

speaker: Matilda
content: Rustfire's fall has taken a hefty toll. People have lost hope and motivation. The morale only keeps plummeting.
Matilda slightly lowers her gaze.

speaker: Matilda
content: I'm just an Executive Officer from Eastside. I can't truly understand what they're facing and feeling.

speaker: Matilda
content: So, do you really plan to not talk with the Rustfire executives? They've been looking for a new leader.

speaker: Donald
content: Cough cough! Are you serious?
Matilda looks up at Donald. She's changed the topic rather abruptly, but her expression is completely serious.

speaker: Donald
content: ...I've seen what happens to leaders. Not appealing at all. That's not what I'm after.

speaker: Donald
content: I want to be like... a catfish! Like what I'm doing now, playing at being a crazy Executive Officer who's good for nothing.

speaker: Donald
content: You know, every time I show up, everyone gets so worked up. Even the most unmotivated individual rushes over for a punch the second they see me! They're instantly energized! Not even a leader has this effect on people, right?

speaker: Matilda
content: I hate to break it to you, but the catfish effect is made up and has no scientific basis. But I understand your attitude now.

speaker: Matilda
content: You understand thoroughly what difficulties the refugees are facing. You won't just sit back and watch. I'm sure you have other plans.

speaker: Matilda
content: Why have you been frequenting the refugee camps recently? These injuries weren't caused by humans. Where were you just now and what did you do?

speaker: Matilda
content: Does this have to do with that Chief?
Donald scratches his head. His jests never seem to be able to distract an upright person like her. It's a good thing, in a way.
Later, when facing other difficult situations, the adjutant will surely remain as unwavering as ever.

speaker: Donald
content: You're quite perceptive, I must say. I knew you were a remarkable talent.

speaker: Donald
content: Yes... I just returned to the Drifter Camp, down to the monument at the very bottom, to meet with some old friends.

speaker: Donald
content: It's a problem brought by the Black Ring. We must consult a Black Ring Expert.
[Scene change] Inside the dilapidated Drifter Camp

6 hours ago.
The core of the Drifter Camp's contamination,
Romanesque Monument

During the Rustfire uprising, this was where the rioters welcomed back their deceased "leader", received the Mania disguised as the shackles, and spiraled into madness. When the Black Ring erupted, this was also where they degenerated into Corruptors, turning the Drifter Camp into a ghost town.
It takes a lot of effort to get to the heart of this place. For some, however, only the most dangerous places can provide cover.

speaker: Dudu
content: Look who's here, a respected Executive Officer! Did you get beaten up while patrolling around our turf? Told you, you should change your clothes next time. These people here won't spare this skin of yours even if they've turned into Corruptors.

speaker: Dudu
content: The person you're looking for is down there. I'm playing the suona every day at the door to keep him alive. If I keep this up, you won't be able to afford the performance fee even if you sell the whole DisCity. Hurry up and bring him back.
female_content: The person you're looking for is down there. I'm playing the suona every day at the door to keep her alive. If I keep this up, you won't be able to afford the performance fee even if you sell the whole DisCity. Hurry up and bring her back.

content: [Scene change] The contaminated Romanesque Monument

speaker: Oak Casket
content: There's no need to thank me. I'm not here to safeguard anyone's life. I'm simply attracted by the hundreds of souls here, and I want to hear their ravings. It's only a coincidence we ran into each other.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: If you really feel like you owe me, then I'd ask you to stop obsessing over saving him. Don't be so hard on yourself. Just let go. That way, everyone can find relief sooner.
female_content: If you really feel like you owe me, then I'd ask you to stop obsessing over saving her. Don't be so hard on yourself. Just let go. That way, everyone can find relief sooner.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: That one made a promise to come to me after death. Hehe... I've been looking forward to it.
[Scene change] Dark tunnel

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Stop shouting. I'm not dead, just not in the mood to see anyone... I'm not useless like you. I don't need to be glued to him to protect him. Even if I stay hidden, the spies from Paradeisos and the Underground can't get anywhere near him.
female_content: Stop shouting. I'm not dead, just not in the mood to see anyone... I'm not useless like you. I don't need to be glued to her to protect her. Even if I stay hidden, the spies from Paradeisos and the Underground can't get anywhere near her.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Tsk, that idiot Chief should have known better than to keep up the pretty talk and suicidal missions in these times. Now I gotta be the babysitter.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: Hurry with waking him up and get him out of here! I can't stand looking at that dumb face anymore!
female_content: Hurry with waking her up and get her out of here! I can't stand looking at that dumb face anymore!

content: After taking several turns and thanking several pals, Donald finally reaches the end of the passage and pushes the door open, then closes it behind him. He shivers.

speaker: Donald
content: These pretty ladies around you keep getting scarier. Coming to see you is like venturing into the gates of hell. It's taking years off my life.

speaker: Donald
content: We've only talked once before, and yet I've put myself through all this torture for you. I've worked too hard. I'd best get some payback in the future!
[Small CG1, Chief in fluid]

speaker: Donald
content: Wake up soon, Chief. If you don't, I'm gonna have to make you.
[Scene Change, Exit Flashback] Room in the Base
Back in that top-secret makeshift prison cell, Donald is now wearing a different expression.

speaker: Donald
content: That BR-002 is more powerful than we think. It'll be nine years old after December. It died once and came back to life, and can even hide itself. After getting hooked up with ${PlayerName}'s shackles, it turned the tables and corrupted the shackles instead, contaminating hundreds of Rustfire followers...

speaker: Donald
content: This is the largest and strongest Black Ring since the great explosion. If left unchecked, the entire West District will be devoured, as if DisSea expanded several times over, flooding half of the city-state... Even Eastside and Paradeisos can't turn a blind eye any longer.

speaker: Donald
content: But the strangest thing is that after its second outbreak, BR-002 has stopped expanding. Although contamination is still leaking, the boundary of the Black Ring remains stable. Corruptors rarely come out to harm people. Even the monsters outside have gradually returned to the Black Ring, never coming out again.

speaker: Donald
content: Although the FAC is working hard, their anti-Mania wall can only act as a cage. It can't turn the beast in the cage into a docile kitten. Compared to nine years ago, this Black Ring's personality has completely changed.
He leans back in his chair, squinting slightly at the ceiling.

speaker: Donald
content: It's as if it's in a chokehold, left completely immobile...

speaker: Matilda
content: Are you suggesting that... Mania and an anti-Mania force coexist in the Black Ring? Is it the shackles?

speaker: Donald
content: After all, that's Paradeisos's secret weapon. It wouldn't hurt to have some faith in him, would it?
female_content: After all, that's Paradeisos's secret weapon. It wouldn't hurt to have some faith in her, would it?

speaker: Donald
content: Over the past six months, our little Chief has likely been fighting tooth and nail with the Black Ring and that monster in some unseen place. Judging from Hella and Hecate's situation, it's clear that the shackles are also struggling. That's why I've thought of a way to lend him a hand.
female_content: Over the past six months, our little Chief has likely been fighting tooth and nail with the Black Ring and that monster in some unseen place. Judging from Hella and Hecate's situation, it's clear that the shackles are also struggling. That's why I've thought of a way to lend her a hand.

speaker: Donald
content: It's too complicated so I won't get into the specifics. To put it simply, it's like a tug of war. Give this side a bit of a boost, tickle that side a little, then you win. Easy-peasy. Sounds good? Isn't my strategy so imaginative?

speaker: Matilda
content: Are you going alone again? Even for such a dangerous operation, you're leaving on your own without telling anyone?

speaker: Donald
content: Hehe, can't let anyone overshadow me on such a cool and crazy operation, can I?

speaker: Donald
content: Alright, don't worry. I've already secured an assistant, an ally, and some strong backup too. It's foolproof.

speaker: Donald
content: If something really happens, don't I still have my great escape plan? Told ya, it's foolproof.

speaker: Matilda
content: Don't hesitate to let me know if you need my help. I can fight too.

speaker: Donald
content: Of course, when have I ever hesitated? I'm leaving the folks here and a bunch of cuties in your care.

He jumps off, stretches lazily, then waves his hand and leaves, the ropes on his body already cut off somehow. It's exactly due to this kind of behavior that both the Executive Committee and the refugee camp treat him like a madman.
Matilda doesn't deny his madness.

speaker: Matilda
content: I don't believe the man who has done so much to help the refugees is just a madman. In places they can't see, you must have done even more.

speaker: Matilda
content: And it's true sometimes madness is the only solution to a desperate situation. Many people have gathered here for this madness of yours, seeking shelter, a way out, and an answer.

speaker: Matilda
content: Regardless, everyone's fate is already tied together.
(Scene change)
The Shadow Guardian enters a study and turns on the light, letting it illuminate her petite figure.
In the dim light, she flips through the messy notes in the study. Most of them are just empty blank pages, with only faint colorless imprints pressed through the back of other sheets onto them.

This is a room filled with the works by the former Rustfire liaison, a self-proclaimed romantic poet and a showy teacher who hadn't yet received her qualification. There isn't much of her handwriting left in Syndicate today.
(Scene change)

Having just organized the relocation of the base, Lavina immediately takes over all of its logistics. She's pulled an all-nighter. Before going to sleep, she remembers that Hella's dressing needs to be changed and Hecate might not have eaten, so she gets ready and heads to the infirmary.
But when she arrives at the tightly closed door, she hesitates.
In the end, the woman simply leaves the supplies outside Hella's ward, gently knocks on the door, and silently turns to leave.
(Scene change)
Matilda looks at the either exhausted or frightened faces around her. The future is so uncertain. No one here can be unfazed by the unknown. No one can be above the confusion. Including herself.

She believes in the glimmer of hope that Executive Officer Donald mentioned, but she also sees that the plan is very risky. It's especially reckless and crazy to be proposing it at this juncture. Donald may seem mad, but deep down he is cautious with his actions.
Then why the sudden decision to act now?
(Scene change)

speaker: Donald
content: Because hope expires too, and the time window left for us is very narrow now.

Donald emerges from the underground tunnel, returning to the ruins of Syndicate. The resurrected Black Ring is right in front of him, inevitably visible to everyone's eyes from every corner of Syndicate above ground.

The red halo encircles a pitch-black high tower. It twists slightly like a mirage, seeming to grow continuously upward and tumbling down incessantly at the same time. It looks like it could collapse at any moment, destroying the long-crumbling half of the city-state.
Indeed, this war doesn't leave him much time.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: In your eyes, is the Black Ring effectively constrained and unable to expand? Hehe... That's different from what I hear.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Recently, the revenants who have come to me after dying of Mania are all agitated. They told me that the master of the Black Ring has been accumulating power and will soon regain freedom. Whatever it is that binds it, it can't hold on anymore.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: I'm not joking with you, take him away immediately. An Undergrounder came here a week ago and I made him bloom. That Undergrounder carried a special sorcery on his body to mark his own death, all for tracking ${PlayerName} down. I think the location's been exposed.
female_content: I'm not joking with you, take her away immediately. An Undergrounder came here a week ago and I made him bloom. That Undergrounder carried a special sorcery on his body to mark his own death, all for tracking ${PlayerName} down. I think the location's been exposed.

speaker: Figure in Shadow
content: But since then... the Underground hasn't sent anyone else. Something must be going on. You guys be careful.

speaker: Rust
content: Yes, things aren't looking good. If I'm not mistaken, those guys from the Underground and their Shepherd are all in action. You've seen what she's capable of. Don't think about taking her on yourself.

speaker: Rust
content: But on the other hand... this also opens up opportunities, a slight possibility to save the Chief. After all, those people know Mania best. Perhaps they hold the solution to it too.

speaker: Rust
content: Pulling the chestnuts out of the fire... What do you say? I can contact our ally for you.
[Small CG - Long shot of Chief]

speaker: Donald
content: Gotta hold on to the backup, meet up with the ally, stay alive, and hurry my ass up...

speaker: Donald
content: Sigh, my dear Chief, the stranger Donald is gonna risk his life for you this time. Just to put some pressure on you before I go.
[Small CG - Long Shot]

speaker: Donald
content: Whether it's to return my favor, save the world, or just to hug someone waiting for you... Come back soon. You'd best open your eyes now.
[Small CG - Close-up of Donald]

speaker: Donald
content: Any later... I'm afraid some things can't be undone.
[Return to the street]
Donald drapes the Executive Officer's coat over his shoulder, whistling and swinging his arm as he heads toward the high tower.
Not far behind him, a block away, a gloomy girl in a cloak keeps her eyes fixed on her prey, quietly following at a distance without being noticed.
It's been eight months. Hecate is tired of waiting. This time, she must look for news of that important person herself. This is for her own mission, and also for... Hella.

Hecate rarely gets to see Donald. Most of the time he's playing as an annoying Executive Officer. But she's always remembered how he acted during the riots, which makes her believe that everything about that man is just pretense.

Back then, attacked by the Mania of the shackles, Hecate almost lost her sanity. She recalls how this man single-handedly subdued the raging Nightmare and fought off over a dozen Rustfire Sinners. She still clearly remembers the words he said.

speaker: Donald
content: Is the mission all that matters? What about your own life? Then... What about her?

speaker: Donald
content: Is that Chief someone really important to you?

speaker: Donald
content: Then I'll go bring him back.
female_content: Then I'll go bring her back.

content: Whether he's an Executive Officer or a Rustfire member, whether he's a Sinner or not, this man saved Hella when Hecate couldn't, and even promised to rescue ${PlayerName}, whom Hecate failed to protect. It was he who brought back Raven and many more people.

Donald is powerful. If someone could break through the Black Ring of Rustfire and bring Chief back, it could only be him. Hecate is convinced of this, just like she believes that ${PlayerName} will definitely come back. She has no choice but to believe it.
But she doesn't want to keep waiting anymore.
[Scene change] Syndicate street in flames
Donald walks in the middle of the avenue, dressed in the uniform of an Executive Officer. Hecate follows two blocks behind with Nightmare slightly ahead of her. She tails him covertly.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...He's heading toward BR-002. There are no refugees there, only the FAC anti-Mania frontline and gangs stealing crystals of Mania contamination... Maybe even the Underground.

speaker: Hecate
content: He's stopped to observe something... Or is he waiting for someone?
Several gangster-like Syndicans come out of the street corner and surround Donald. Donald stops in his tracks and converses with them calmly.

speaker: Hecate
content: Are those his companions? Informants? Are they Rustfire or gangsters, or other undercover agents?

speaker: Hecate
content: What are they talking about? Information? Does it have anything to do with Chief?

She can't hear their conversation from this distance, and Nightmare can't get any closer. Hecate can't be sure if there are any Sinners among these people. She's extremely tense and agitated. The contaminated shackles begin to emerge on her body again.

speaker: Hecate
content: I must get a little closer... I can't let any possibility slip by...

speaker: Raging Gangster
content: Go to hell, you ******* Executive Officer!
Shouting, those people pick up their weapons and swing them at Donald. Hecate stops in her tracks.

speaker: Hecate
content: Are they enemies?

speaker: Hecate
content: Judging from their fighting style, the enemies are not Sinners, but they are using Mania weapons... It's fine. He is strong. He doesn't need my help, that might reveal me... and...
She wants to see that man fight again. She's eager to witness the technique of a truly powerful fighter.
A steel pipe is thrown at Donald, and with a twist of his body, it misses and lands on the ground. He goes on to dodge the subsequent attacks.

speaker: Hecate
content: He dodged them. His reflexes are impressive.
Meanwhile, another person hits Donald's butt hard from behind with a road sign. Donald only hops a small step forward, moves to a higher vantage point, and turns to look at his attacker.

speaker: Hecate
content: He withstood this attack... Amazing defense. Is he an Endura Sinner? Is he going to strike back with his power?
Looking back, Hecate has never seen Donald use his power. Perhaps he doesn't need to use his power to deal with these people?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I've become too reliant on my abilities. If my shackles are contaminated, I can't do anything without Nightmare.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm useless when Chief needs me the most. Even Hella is suffering because of me...
Luckily, Donald's fight distracts her from her self-blaming.

He starts to move, charging at the gangsters. An enemy attacks his head, but he dodges. Hecate watches intently. He's so agile. He seizes the chance to aim for the gangster's lower body, grabbing his legs to subdue him, then he...
...Wait a minute, why does this pose seem familiar?

speaker: Donald
content: Please... spare... me...!!
Donald's cry echoes throughout the street like a bell, shaking Hecate's heart. She finally remembers the shocking scene she witnessed when she first came to Syndicate.

speaker: EMP
content: Chief...!!!
Confusion gradually replaces her anxiety. Hecate stares stiffly at this farce, standing still for a long time. Eventually, amid different variations of Donald's cry, she sighs.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella... Is this a Syndican tradition?
Boom!!
The fight ended quickly. The fallen wall from the heights crashed to the ground, scaring off the gangsters. It's Nightmare who snuck over and helped from a blind spot on top of a ruined building.

Hecate can't make sense of Donald's behavior, and she doesn't want to waste any more time waiting. She wanted this powerful man to go and look for ${PlayerName} immediately, so she risked exposure and helped him clear the obstacles.
She isn't aware that this ridiculous and time-wasting farce has also helped release the tension within her.

speaker: Donald
content: Sob... Ouch...
Now the obstacles have been cleared, but the man she considers invincible is still lying on the ground. From its high vantage point, Nightmare can see him clutching his clothes and sobbing.

speaker: Donald
content: Sob... Those meanies scared me to death... Sob...

speaker: Hecate
content: He isn't that badly injured, is he...

speaker: Hecate
content: Isn't he supposed to save Chief? Isn't he supposed to go to BR-002? What on earth is he...
What's happening here?
Several white figures suddenly approach.

speaker: Hecate
content: An FAC patrol? Did they sense Nightmare's attack?

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: What was that explosion just now? Did another Sinner lose control?

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Be careful, they're now all connected to the Black Ring, the only active contamination that leaks out of the FAC's blockade. We must...
They turn around to search for suspicious Sinners.

speaker: Donald
content: <size=45>Please, FAC sirs, help!!</size>
A pair of arms grabs the FAC soldier around his waist. Donald springs up to cling to the leading FAC soldier and starts crying loudly. Caught off guard, the armored soldier is unable to move.

speaker: Donald
content: Look at me, I'm an Executive Officer, from the Executive Committee! Those damn gangsters are attacking us on the streets. Help me, please! Take me back!

speaker: Donald
content: I'm injured, I need medical attention. There's no time to go back to the Executive Committee. Take me to your base, please. I'll be forever in your debt!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: We will, but the matter of the Sinner is more pressing...

speaker: Donald
content: Awwwww! It's killing me! Stop talking about that Sinner now. Someone's about to die here. Arghhh, I'm dying!!

Distracted by this grown man throwing a tantrum, the FAC soldiers can't break away to search for the suspicious Sinner nearby. Their expressions shift from confused to helpless, then suddenly, they seem to realize something.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Could you be... Donald, that Executive Officer who was kidnapped a while ago?

speaker: Donald
content: You guys know me?

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Haha... You're well known for your unique character. We've been wanting to meet you for so long.
They smile knowingly and squat down to help Donald up, or rather, prop him up.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Before we take you back to the Executive Committee, please come with us to the FAC first.

speaker: Hecate
content: Oh No!

She turns to chase after those people, but when she looks back, she sees an unexpected figure already standing behind her. The person taps the young girl's shoulder and gestures for her to keep quiet.

speaker: Hecate
content: …It's you?
The old man's name is Samuel and he claims to be Donald's assistant. During the Ten Days of Rustfire, he saved Hella and Hecate with Donald and escorted the girls to a refugee camp.
His past is equally mysterious, with his age and affiliations unknown. Hecate can only confirm that he has no combat abilities, is not a Sinner, and is extremely low-key and reticent.
Hecate takes a step back, showing a resistant expression.

speaker: Hecate
content: I won't go back. Rustfire can't give me what I want, so this time I will find the information myself.

speaker: Samuel
content: I know, but you can't catch up to him.

speaker: Samuel
content: Follow me.

Indeed, she can't risk discovery by the FAC, or she will surely get locked back into the MBCC for her contamination. Hecate hesitates for a moment before she follows the old man, heading toward the red halo not far away and the stronghold glowing with a blue light beneath it which seems so small in comparison.

BR-002
FAC Black Ring Blockade Frontline - Stronghold S1

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Hello, Executive Officer Donald. Do you remember the <color=#fb9259>FAC-Propulsion Type 023 Bastion</color> you borrowed from us in March?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Although the Executive Committee claims you're only mentally unstable, we all know about your special background.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: An Executive Officer appointed by Paradeisos's Hush with experience dealing with BR-002 and a deep understanding of Rustfire. The 9th Agency has introduced you to us. Now, please come with me. The FAC requires your valuable assistance.

speaker: Donald
content: Hush who? I have no idea who you're talking about! I don't rely on connections! But sure, with pleasure, I miss you guys to pieces too.
He grins, his earlier craziness gone.
Hecate hides in the blind spot of the FAC outpost. Samuel is guarding a small communicator. After a while, a wave of radio noise comes out of it, followed by Donald's voice.

speaker: Donald
content: Phew... Now that's better! I was too busy running for my life just now to relieve myself.

speaker: Donald
content: It's my first time inside an FAC stronghold. It's impressive, but ever thought of upgrading the toilets? Compared to the Executive Committee, the facilities here are a bit rudimentary.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: I apologize for any inconvenience. You see, we've poured all our budget into equipping the anti-Black Ring system. We appreciate your constructive feedback on our work.

speaker: Donald
content: Oh, you flatter me. I'm the one here to learn, after all! Let's first take a look at the Black Ring's data, shall we?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Of course, this way please.
Compared to a regular FAC soldier, Donald does come off as an overly dramatic madman. But at least he manages to retrieve the communicator hidden in the restroom.
The old man snuck this communicator into the construction team of the stronghold as early as the campaign in August, allowing it to bypass the subsequent rigorous security checks by the FAC.
[Scene Change] Inside the Command (Flora - FAC Base Background)
In the dimly lit war room, the stronghold's representative is showing Donald various complex charts, explaining them painstakingly as if he fears Donald can't read them.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: It's highly consistent with the BR-002 that erupted in Inner Bay's Mine W-31 in N.F. 104. Based on the Drifter Camp Black Ring Operation Report sent by the MBCC's Chief in March, we can confirm it's the same Corpseborne. In other words, this is the revival of the same Black Ring.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: But the Corpseborne in N.F. 104 was activated by the collective consciousness within the mine. After its destruction, the core of the Black Ring that was revived in N.F. 113 changed. Corpus 002 has merged with Julien, the leader of Rustfire, and became a new Corpseborne that's more powerful and unified.

speaker: Donald
content: Hmm, I still recall how our great Paradeisos announced it...

speaker: Donald
content: "Julien is not a Sinner, but the Undergrounders did something to him and turned him into a Black Ring, or rather, the anchor point of Rustfire's collective consciousness nine years ago."

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Exactly. BR-002 was already highly hazardous at its first appearance. We thought it was successfully suppressed at the time, but it turns out that Corpseborne 002 survived and even gained a powerful camouflaging ability. No one, not even the Undergrounders or Paradeisos, can confirm its whereabouts.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: This year, after the Drifter Camp Mania crisis in mid-March, the Rustfire uprising in West District in late March, and the abnormal spread of the shackles during the uprising, BR-002 had already grown larger than any Secondary Black Ring when it erupted again.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: A large number of shackle bearers instantly turned into Corruptors, and Mania spread rapidly in West District. If it weren't for the timely reinforcement of the Rust isolation belt, it would have threatened the entire city-state. That's why the FAC spared no effort to advance the August blockade campaign and build this defense line.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: But following the construction of the defense line, the data confirmed that BR-002 was exhibiting many inexplicable anomalies. Most conspicuously, as the Black Ring with the highest recorded M-value, BR-002 itself has never expanded. It...

speaker: Donald
content: Alright, alright. Let's get straight to the point. I already know all about this bizarre Black Ring. Tell me, what exactly is holding it off, and who exactly is buying precious time for humanity?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...Yes. As you may know, we have the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} who went missing during the uprising to thank. He risked his life to win us this opportunity.
female_content: ...Yes. As you may know, we have the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} who went missing during the uprising to thank. She risked her life to win us this opportunity.

content: (Scene change)

speaker: FAC Officer
content: In the only preserved observation report from Paradeisos, it was mentioned that during his desperate battle with Corpus 002, he tried to link the shackles to the Corpus, possibly for location-tracking purpose.
female_content: In the only preserved observation report from Paradeisos, it was mentioned that during her desperate battle with Corpus 002, she tried to link the shackles to the Corpus, possibly for location-tracking purpose.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Afterward, ${PlayerName} was ambushed by the rioters and disappeared. The shackles were seized and became a tool for Corpus 002 to contaminate the rioters. But in turn, they're also desperately suppressing the expansion of the Black Ring.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We want to believe that ${PlayerName} is still fighting. As long as we can find him, or help him regain consciousness by suppressing the Corpseborne, then we have the possibility of defeating this Black Ring.
female_content: We want to believe that ${PlayerName} is still fighting. As long as we can find her, or help her regain consciousness by suppressing the Corpseborne, then we have the possibility of defeating this Black Ring.

content: Hecate's body starts to tremble slightly.

speaker: Hecate
content: Is it real? Chief hasn't given up...

She has heard countless rumors about ${PlayerName}'s whereabouts. Alive, dead, turned into a monster, escaped from Paradeisos... They all sound absurd, suspicious, and even fabricated with ulterior motives.
This is the first time she's got a credible update, and it's so reassuring to hear it from the FAC.
(Scene change)
Donald claps his hands with satisfaction. The message has been delivered as intended. Hopefully, this will bring that kid some relief.
Now, let's get down to business.

speaker: Donald
content: I assume you guys called for me because there's a change in the situation?
The officer nods.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: BR-002 is attempting to break through its restraints. Since November, the contamination radiation has been growing more rapidly. Despite being limited by its physical boundary, it emits a large amount of contamination which spills out to form a massive contamination belt. So far, it has expanded to less than 300 meters from the inner edge of the defense line.
Donald looks at the M-value chart. Indeed, a ring of concentrated contamination has formed around the Black Ring, with some coordinates showing noticeably abnormal values.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The Underground has made a new breakthrough. According to the intelligence the 9th Agency has retrieved from a fatal mission, someone within the Mania forces has mastered a new type of sorcery. It was activated in November and has been continuously injecting Mania contamination into BR-002.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Even more despicably, unable to break through the FAC's defense, the Underground has been using infected civilians to attack the base, trying to create a breach. They've likely already infiltrated the blockade circle, laying down sorcery inside to tear down the constraints on BR-002.

speaker: Donald
content: Well, well, I smell another showdown between you guys and your arch-enemy. Syndicate sure is the perfect battlefield.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: That's why our speedy victory is crucial to the safety of West District. This special operation aims to enter the blockade circle and locate the sorcerer, eliminating both him and all his Mania sorcery.

speaker: Donald
content: Then why not just go ahead? What do you need me for? You don't think I can fight them, do you?

speaker: Donald
content: Look, I'm really not a fighter. I don't even have any special abilities. I'm counting on you to protect me, buddy!
A clerk standing next to them glances at him with a strange look but doesn't say anything. The officer continues.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The FAC will certainly be at the forefront, eliminating all threats. But that's supposing we can locate the enemy quickly and get to the battlefield where we need to be.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Please take a look at this picture.
[Image] Maze outside the Ring

speaker: Donald
content: What's this? The interior of the Black Ring?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: No, the cost of entering the Black Ring is high, and we haven't received instructions to enter it yet. This was taken on the contamination belt outside the ring. A material product of the leaked Mania contamination.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Such contamination has formed unusually complex paths and structures, and even mechanisms. Corruptors also run rampant in it... Yes, it's like a gigantic maze that keeps growing, blocking all intruders and protecting BR-002.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: I remember you said that Julien, the leader of Rustfire, was an outstanding architect before becoming a Corpseborne. Mechanism and maze are his expertise, and the Drifter Camp was his creation.

speaker: Donald
content: That's right. I recognize these mechanisms. All the mazes and paths were his designs and signatures. They made up the fortress that Rustfire relied on for survival all along.

speaker: Donald
content: This is why you're looking for someone who knows Rustfire inside out and can guide you through the architect's maze.
He looks around, and everyone else in the room is staring back at him.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: That's right. The interior of BR-002 is expanding rapidly. Even the MBCC has sent a warning that the contamination inside the Sinners shackled by ${PlayerName} is surging abnormally.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The shackles are weakening while BR-002, or rather Julien the Corpseborne, is growing more powerful. As the maze expands, more and more Corruptors become active outside the ring, and they will inevitably cross the boundary. West District can't withstand another catastrophe like that.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The city-state is already taking action. The 9th Agency has made its sacrifices. The FAC will take over the intelligence they've retrieved and enter the maze to eliminate the enemies and contain the contamination. Paradeisos has also deployed a special force to find ${PlayerName}.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Regardless of Rustfire's original intentions, nine years later, both itself and its leader have become actual threats to West District. Please help us do the right thing.
Listening, Donald nods, and then shrugs.

speaker: Donald
content: Well, I don't feel guilty or anything. To tell you the truth, I'm a traitor of Rustfire. I mean, at the end of the day, everyone must act in their own best interest.

speaker: Donald
content: Ever since I came onboard, the Executive Committee has been relying on me whenever they need to tackle the Drifter Camp. The maze and the mechanisms are a piece of cake. I'm happy to serve you.

speaker: Donald
content: But there's one thing I don't understand... The 9th Agency is chasing the Underground, the FAC is guarding the Black Ring, and even Paradeisos is out looking for the shackles. It's looking like a big showdown against the evil.

speaker: Donald
content: Then what is our dear Executive Committee doing? The census, governance, and resettlement... It's all laborious work that doesn't matter.
He's staring at the stronghold's representative in front of him while surveying every person present in the room, capturing the subtle changes in their expressions.

speaker: Donald
content: I trust Paradeisos's decision. This arrangement must have a deeper meaning behind it... Do you know anything about it?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: I'm not sure I'm following. We don't know what's going on within the Executive Committee. The FAC's only goal is to subdue the Black Ring and protect the city-state. As for Paradeisos's decision, shouldn't you know better than we do?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Rumor has it that you were only able to transfer to the Executive Committee last year because an influential figure in Paradeisos vouched for you... Hush X, right?
Donald's face dims, but only for a split second. Abruptly, he throws his head back and bursts into hysterical laughter.

speaker: Donald
content: Hahaha, what Hush, Shush, X, Y, Z? Some Paradeisian bigwig is watching over me? That sure sounds reassuring! In that case, I'm ready to go, since you all should be risking your lives to protect me!
He straightens his collar and struts out of the war room, whistling a tune loudly.

speaker: Donald
content: Whistle~
Samuel listens attentively. This is a code.

speaker: Samuel
content: ...Path confirmed. Hecate, follow me.
Wendy
Hecate doesn't follow immediately.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm here to find Chief. Why would participating in the FAC's operation against the Underground help? Where is Chief?

speaker: Samuel
content: ...Wherever your Chief is, he's been heavily corrupted and is now unconscious. If you want to save him, you need to drain the Mania out of him.
female_content: ...Wherever your Chief is, she's been heavily corrupted and is now unconscious. If you want to save her, you need to drain the Mania out of her.

speaker: Samuel
content: Only the Underground owns this kind of Mania-controlling technology, and its owner is in this maze. Donald will lure the FAC into holding back the enemies and our ally will help steal what we need.

speaker: Samuel
content: Our job is to go to the rendezvous point to pick up the item and leave without alerting anyone or starting any fight. If successful, you can save your Chief. This is the only way.
He takes out several anti-Mania injections and hands them to Hecate.

speaker: Samuel
content: Take these. The maze is severely contaminated. If you want to save your Chief, first, protect yourself.
[Scene change] Inside the Maze

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Alright, once in the blockade circle, regular communication will be severely disrupted. Please stay close to us, Mr. Donald.

speaker: Donald
content: No worries, sir! Do what y'all are best at. I'll make sure I stay firmly behind you!
He squats in a corner of the maze and fires a few shots into the sky. He specifically changed his clothes before coming, saying he was itching for a good fight in a handsome outfit.

speaker: Donald
content: Charge, brave soldiers! I'll show you the way! Advance!
Turns out, it was still nothing but a bluff.

10:00, November 25, N.F. 113
The Exiles' Base
More and more people are coming to seek refuge. Amid the gloom and doom, there are still a few occasional delights to brighten up the atmosphere at the base.

speaker: Greta
content: New Yooga! Infuse yourself with the energy of the sun, brighter and healthier than ever!

speaker: Greta
content: Come on, practice with me!
Though it doesn't usually last very long.
(Scene change)

speaker: Greta
content: Phew... There are a lot of newcomers lately and they're all coming to me for health advice. My back is about to give out...

speaker: Matilda
content: The Executive Committee's recent moves are terrorizing people, so they are more inclined to join us.

speaker: Greta
content: Are you talking about the census and resettlement? Hmm... From my Outlander perspective, relocation is somewhat acceptable.

speaker: Greta
content: Compared to waiting for death under the Black Ring, obeying the orders and moving to the satellite towns with everyone else doesn't sound that bad.

The city-state relocates its population to the abandoned satellite towns, then cuts off the hypercube supply under the guise of a fake accident. This way, these burdens will sooner or later disappear in one of the Tides of Ashes. Population management or resettlement is just another name for the Purge Order.
A few small figures walk in, tightening their cloaks, followed by several newly joined refugees.
Similar rumors are heard everywhere lately, scaring many out of their wits. A few weeks ago, they were indifferent to us, but now they're desperately begging to come.

speaker: Matilda
content: Welcome back, Ica. None of those rumors has been confirmed. Don't repeat them, it'll only make people afraid.

speaker: Matilda
content: It's all thanks to the Homeless helping to spread the word that we've been able to recruit so many people. You guys have done a great job.
Ica glances at Matilda.

speaker: Ica
content: Save your flattery. You're already here, yet you still wear that Executive Officer uniform. You enjoy sticking out like a sore thumb?

speaker: Matilda
content: This outfit makes it easier for people to find me. Besides, not everyone thinks I'm an eyesore.

speaker: Ica
content: Tsk, like I trust you. Where's Crache?

speaker: Matilda
content: She's at the usual place.

speaker: Ica
content: I'll go find her.

speaker: Ica
content: Also, I brought back those eye drops. It's on your desk. You were complaining that you ran out last time, right?

speaker: Matilda
content: I completely forgot about it. It's not easy to find outside the Executive Committee. Did you actually get it for me? Thank you.

speaker: Ica
content: I just passed by SALVA and they insisted I take it! The Homeless are very busy, there won't be a next time!!
Before Matilda can respond, the kid runs off in a puff of smoke.

speaker: Matilda
content: ...So the SALVA doctors are back too. I must arrange a visit soon. We need their strength.

speaker: Greta
content: Pfft, that's not the point. That kid Ica actually cares about you now, huh? Does joining the Homeless turn these kids into big softies or what?

speaker: Matilda
content: Ica knows that information from Eastside is crucial, that's why he swallows his anger and tries to talk to me. He's very smart.

Matilda has looked into it. Ica's parents died in the Executive Committee's detention center last year and he joined Rustfire to avenge his parents. He's only tolerating the existence of an Eastsider Executive Officer for a greater goal.

Too many children here were forced to grow up prematurely. What was Matilda like when she was their age? What kind of life do the children of Eastside lead? Everything here is different from Eastside, then...

speaker: Matilda
content: Will I find the answers to the questions that the past me couldn't answer here?
[Scene Change] Raven's Office

Crache spends a lot of time out fighting that her dark circles are getting worse. The people of the refugee camp decided to give her a private room. When Crache first heard this suggestion, she was silent for a long time, and finally asked for the room where Raven's works are stored in.
These days, whenever she's free, she flips through her poems, diary, investigative report, or something like that. But there aren't many left.
Her shadow shudders, and Crache closes the notebook in her hands with a snap and shoves it into the drawer. The door opens.

speaker: Ica
content: Boss, I'm back. Reading Raye's notes again?
Crache's eyelid twitches. She says nothing, but Ica doesn't notice her unusual reaction and simply pulls out a flyer from his backpack excitedly.

speaker: Ica
content: Check this out! I've got a rousing poem by Raven. It's brilliantly written, full of strength.

speaker: Ica
content: We've copied stacks and stacks of it at night with kids at the base and distributed them everywhere during the day. It's effective publicity!

speaker: Crache
content: Don't...
Crache opens her mouth to stop him from reciting it, but it's too late. Ica clears his throat and begins...

speaker: Ica
content:
Ahem! In this darkest night, those who stay silent await the end, those who hesitate are doomed to fail, and those who cower live on with regrets.
