content: How can it not be? I got hotpot, good booze, a pushover I can borrow from without paying back, and these gullible employees I can mess with.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: On the Overground, everyone looks out for themselves, guarding their tiny slice of the world, maybe a few close pals... That's just more my style.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I'm just a small fry, not cut out for your lofty ambitions. This spot's good enough for me; I'm fine meeting my end right here.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: But if I'm going down, I'll take you with me.
The old lady lets out a knowing laugh. The woman who doggedly exposes the charade of the Underground Shepherd and pilfers the White Cube from her—she's anything but a "small fry."
Seems they've had their share of fun like this in the past, Bai being way lazier back then compared to the one standing before her now.

speaker: Old Woman
content: I've never heard you speak like this before. Looks like you've finally found something to live for, which I find comforting.

speaker: Old Woman
content: At heart, you're still one of our own from the Underground. I'll have your old mates see you through this part of the trip.
The old lady moves off without a second look back. And from the earth she has just walked upon, familiar, mud-soaked shapes begin to rise, creeping up slowly.
The man is long gone, his mind dissolved into the void. But his body is dedicated to Mania, becoming its vessel to rejoin the Black Ring, just as the initial contract stipulates.
(Scene change)

A flood of minds from the Black Ring infiltrates your thoughts, stirring turmoil and a profound heaviness. You're paralyzed, unable to open your eyes, but you dimly perceive someone bearing your body forward, whispering under their breath as they go.
This feels like déjà vu, like just before you nearly met your end last time.
I'll... take you away...
Silence answers you, while those deep, muddled murmurs persist, leading you somewhere unknown.
You try to open your eyes, to wrestle back control and understand what is happening. You fight hard to pierce through the engulfing darkness.
—Just then, you spot a speck of blue light, and with it comes a voice, strange yet somewhat recognizable.

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: ...Hmm? How did I end up here?

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: Hmm... Looks like things have only gone downhill in the months I've been gone.

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: But with you around, we'll find a solution, no doubt.

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: Alright, take a deep breath, focus on what's important to you.
A cocoon of white light gradually wraps around you. You spot a few indistinct figures and try to hold onto them, your awareness wavering and slowly taking shape.
Then, the apparitions merge into a thin, unknown woman.
As you come to, the woman offers a faint smile.

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: Nice to meet you, ${PlayerName}... or is it more apt to say... long time no see.
Her face is a mystery to you, but something about her feels oddly familiar.
It's a strange kind of familiarity, the kind where you know deep down, asking won't shed any light.

You actually don't recall her identity. The first time you see her, a sense of caution and alertness rises in you. But at the same time, there is a peculiar feeling of familiarity, prompting you to speak before your mind can process it.
...Long time no see.

speaker: Alarm
content: The Purge Order will commence in 22 hours. Attention all personnel, evacuate immediately, evacuate immediately.
Evacuation is a top priority; the Legion's convoy has been shuttling back and forth, taking other transport units with them along the route, seeking shelter from the storm within WhiteSands.
Ica is dashing around, distributing flyers, desperately trying to get the message out. The man spots him from afar and gets so furious that he gets up from the ground.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: ...Why the heck is he still running all over the place! What the heck, even at this hour—

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Ahhhhhhh...
His shadow beneath his feet twitched, lifting him and tossing him into the car.

speaker: Crache
content: Come on, get in the car. The Legion will ensure your safe passage out of here.

speaker: Crache
content: I'm all this place requires.

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: What? You cheeky brat, who do you think you are? I'm not a young whippersnapper; how dare you talk to me like that?

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: ...Hey, where do you think you're going? Mania's all over the place; where on earth are you headed?! Hey, are you out of your mind?!

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Tell me what you need, and I'll take care of it for you! Stay put!! Hey!!

Crache emerges from the underground tunnel and ascends to street level. Before her, the High Tower of the Second Black Ring reaches for the heavens, cutting the setting sun's glow in twain. A colossal shadow stretches over the tumultuous Syndicate district, obscuring her from view, while the wailing of the crowd fills the darkness.

This is the place where she spent her formative years. A land plunged into perpetual darkness, devoid of hope, a whirlpool of violence willingly embraced. Yet today, a cloak of shadows conceals all the past ugliness. Some remain silent, others panic, and a few simmer with hidden anger, but everyone stands impotent in the face of these forces.
The Corruptors surge forth from the maze, inundating the West District like an unstoppable tide. In the presence of the Black Ring, human strength amounts to nothing.

Only Crache, who dwells in the shadows for so long, is familiar with this sensation. She stands perfectly still in the darkness, and yet recalls the absurd words uttered by the person who insists there is a glimmer in her eyes.

speaker: Crache
content: Since then, I've thought a lot. I've read your poems, your teaching materials, and seen how much you praise Syndicate. But still, I just can't convince myself to fully believe in all of it.

speaker: Crache
content: I've always lived in the shadows, never seen the kind of light you talk about. I know even you don't believe some of the things you say.

speaker: Crache
content: I don't think I got it wrong. Syndicate has just chosen to go down a path that's beyond saving.

speaker: Crache
content: But now, I really regret it.

speaker: Crache
content: You're inciting a bunch of delusional fools to die!

speaker: Crache
content: Quit acting. If I had known your real motive, I never would have believed those lies.

She remembers that underground room filled with Raven's notebooks and the wrinkled investigation papers. That woman meticulously documented the backgrounds of every Homeless, dealt with numerous "grown-ups," and even compiled thick educational guides for each Homeless.

Dis language, math—wait, scratch that, math's been crossed out—science, history, home ec, gym, music, art, shop class, and even hands-on outside projects. Raye plays at being the teacher for all subjects.
No conflict, no animosity, no Rustfire beliefs. Each page bears only the word "future."

speaker: Raven
content: When this war is over, take the children back to class. After my mission ends, I won't need to travel anymore. I'll rebuild Syndicate Academy and teach you well.

speaker: Raven
content: Believe it or not, I didn't create the school to trick you into fighting. I want you to live and grow up in peace...

speaker: Raven
content: ...I want more people to see my adorable student.

speaker: Crache
content: I regret not taking action sooner, not talking to you earlier, not bringing more people together. Even if we ended up hurt and bleeding, if only I had done more—
[CG: A colossal bird explodes]

speaker: Crache
content: Even if things turned out the same, I wouldn't be this full of regret.

speaker: Crache
content: It's not the things I used to hate that I despise; it's myself, for doing nothing at all.

speaker: Crache
content: Let what's in the past rot. Syndicate is in such a dark place now, and I had no hope for anyone in the past to improve it. I'm still not counting on anyone.

speaker: Crache
content: You told a lot of lies, but at least one thing you said was true. Whether I like it or not, the future's going to hit me hard...

speaker: Crache
content: So, I am going to take action, and make it listen to me.

Crache remains motionless within the shadows, but beneath her feet, the immense shadow roars to life. Like waves cresting upon the sea, she is hoisted high, gazing down upon all that unfolds in the neighborhood, meticulously marking the positions of every Corruptor and refugee.
Subsequently, the colossal black shroud fragments into countless razor-edged blades, hurtling swiftly towards multiple battlegrounds, cutting down the Corruptors and shielding the civilians.
Before long, Crache's nose begins to bleed, and she, who has long avoided the world's gaze, has never before exerted herself so fiercely.
However, the sun is descending, and the shadows will soon be swallowed by the darkness once they reach their full extent. Time is running out, and this is the moment to take action.
—She doesn't have complete faith in her ability to turn the tide, but she has grown weary of regret.
Horo observes from a distance and lets out a murmur.

speaker: Horo
content: ...She's got some guts.

speaker: Horo
content: It should be safe from here on. You guys go ahead, I'll stay.

speaker: Legion Member
content: But, Horo...

speaker: Horo
content: Call me Commander!

speaker: Horo
content: The Legion Commander never flees from combat.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: I'm a uniquely altered Sinner, designed to combat disasters. Part of my consciousness is anchored in the Mania field of the Second Black Ring, constantly observing, constantly analyzing. Your shackles happened to be closely linked with the Second Black Ring as well...

speaker: Thin Woman
content: So, is this the reason I am able to meet you again? It's nothing short of a miracle. I'm glad to see everyone has taken such good care of you.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: But our link is fragile. There are plenty in the Second Black Ring who can't stand me. I might have to make an exit any time. Better to focus on the matter at hand and use our time wisely.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: You look like you're in a bind. Need a hand? I'm good at analyzing situations and solving difficult problems. I'm also... well, I used to be Paradeisos's proudest tool.

speaker: Bianca stealthily drags a woman in a suspicious gray coat into the studio.
content: It's out of order now, and might not be of much help, but I know you wouldn't mind, would you?
Instead of replying, you turn the question around.
...You're from Paradeisos?
So, what is this thing?
You points to the black triangle floating beside you.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: It's Paradeisos's watcher and spokesman, all in one, programmed to drill the Rules into you.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: It's a force of undeniable power and certainty, but it's also your ultimate shackles. You stem from the same roots as Mania, Paradeisos's arch-nemesis, which makes them distrustful of you.
He claims it's the power capable of wiping out the Corpsebornes.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Correct, but it's a double-edged sword, it'll wipe you out too.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Are you willing to sacrifice yourself for the greater good of humanity?
I'm just trying to figure out what cards I've still got to play.
They told me I'm cornered, with a mightier shackle-bearer lurking in the Black Ring. If I consume Corpus 002, she'll come to consume me, without any effort.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Did he say that? Hehehe... Rest assured, he wasn't lying to you. It's just that from Paradeisos's standpoint, this is the only plan they are willing to accept.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: But clearly, you still have a choice.
She lifts her hand, slips it into your coat's inner pocket, and draws out the White Cube.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: This... comes from the Underground, right?

speaker: Thin Woman
content: As the Square Black Ring erupted, the inheritance appeared silently in the conference hall, no one noticed. When the Black Ring enveloped the Tower, even the Underground Shepherd made a move against Julien, with the Observatorium oblivious to her.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: This stands as one of the Underground's most extraordinary feats, a secretive technique that continually perplexes Paradeisos.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Moreover, Paradeisos will never understand...
Her fingers gently press against your chest, right over your heart.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: ...Julien, Rustfire, and those in this Black Ring, the kind of feelings they harbor for you. They're too proud to bother understanding. Ha, I'm grateful for their haughtiness.
She retreats a step, straightens her stance, and then starts talking.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Looking at it from Paradeisos's view, championing "the greater good of humanity," you're left with only one path. However... from your personal standpoint, I can present you with three alternatives.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: <color=#fb9259>Option One</color>: Just like that little triangle proposed, you can embrace the "Rules" again, taking the reins to set off the Corpsebornes, supporting Paradeisos in wiping out everything at its source.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Hah, that person's calculations are always spot-on, and any strategy he devises is guaranteed to work perfectly.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: The price you pay as the trigger will be immense. You'll be sacrificed for the West District, for the good of humanity, following the "correct" course. You and a monster will meet your end together, celebrated posthumously as a hero. Alright, moving on to the next—

speaker: Thin Woman
content: <color=#fb9259>Option Two</color>: Get out of here, shed all the unrelated baggage. You don't have to fret over anyone coming after you. With the White Cube in hand, you can vanish off the grid, completely untraceable.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Go ahead, walk away without worry, and just leave this Black Ring to the Underground. Let them have their way. You shouldn't carry the weight of others' destinies. You're meant to be free, to live for yourself alone. No one has the right to judge you.
Her words are sincere, but her gaze is teasing, appraising you as if curious about how you'll react.
When met with only silence, the woman, who claims to be a pawn of Paradeisos, chuckles.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: I know you're not thrilled with either plan. Don't worry, there's another way—

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Trust your intuition and stay true to yourself, just like you've always fought bravely. You are capable of doing it.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: No need to fear the blue shackles, no need to be wary of the Rules. You've got the Corpseborne in your grasp. Defeat and devour it, turn this Black Ring into your strength—they're just like you, after all.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Those who once shone with freedom, clutching lofty passions and deep connections, found themselves cast aside, crushed underfoot. Their rebellion met with ridicule, their pleas falling on deaf ears. In the end, they were warped into these grotesque forms, branded as monsters.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Even in its monstrous form, it's the most persistent and resilient of all. The Underground shackles couldn't finish it off. For nine years, it's stayed hidden, and to this day, even the Shepherd hasn't managed to confront it.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: —In that case, it might not be able to take you down either, the inheritor of this power.
She steps closer, gazing into your eyes, looking beyond you as if seeing a multitude of others.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: This represents a magnificent will, one that shouldn't be manipulated by Paradeisos or undermined by the Underground, nor corrupted by Mania. Maybe it's better if you embraced it.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: The heroes will offer you complete freedom; if your desire is to burn down this world, they'll even help you make it happen.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: In exchange, their last wish is probably just one thing... to have you make everyone who trampled on Syndicate pay.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Only you are willing to confront this sorrowful wish. So, I think you can take a gamble, and you will gain their approval.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Plus... the ${PlayerName} I knew with would definitely favor this route, right?
She responds with a smile, noncommittal.
The wish they want me to realize...

speaker: Rustfire Combatant
content: Everyone who came here has the same faith and conviction. You are the hope of Syndicate. We will give you everything to help you succeed.

speaker: Vengeful Youth
content: Take all my Hypercubes. With you, we'll definitely win! Take back Syndicate!!

speaker: Julien
content: As long as you live, you can motivate everyone... You're a born leader.

speaker: Julien
content: You'll lead us to the battlefield.
(Scene change)

speaker: Donald
content: Don't worry, I'm not cut out for this. I can't even meet other people's expectations, so why would I do that to you?

speaker: Donald
content: It's not about Rustfire, nor is it about saving the world... It's about cherishing what matters most to you. You've come to discover the truth and put an end to it all, so you can return to their side, alive and well.
You let out a sigh.
I gave it a shot, but it didn't work out. Ended up like this, a victim of my own doing.
I'm just a regular person, not equipped or inclined to take on others' sad desires.
And of course, I can't live up to your expectations either.

speaker: Thin Woman
content: ...My expectations?
The one who wants me to choose this third option, to seize the power and rebel against it all... is you, right?

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Oh my, am I really wearing my heart on my sleeve these days?

speaker: Thin Woman
content: Hope you're not upset with me. I wasn't trying to probe.
I get it, no worries. I've got something to share with you too.
I've got my own goals, and I'm searching for the right solutions for me, but I know I can't do it on my own.
Will you lend me a hand?

speaker: Thin Woman
content: ...Heh, go on, I'm all ears. I'm really interested.
Only now, you finally open your eyes to see the one helping you along—a Corruptor, someone you know very well.

speaker: Taran
content: ...I will... bring you back...

speaker: Taran
content: For Rustfire... for... Syndicate...
It's too late for him now.
But you've got unfinished business, and finally, you address the persistent Corruptor.

options: Lead me to Rustfire's leader, Taran.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: I was curious about who'd cracked the maze that guy built, rushing into here to court death. It's you, after all...

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Makes sense, you've still got the shackles. It can help you cheat.
The moment it looks up, the Mania inside you explodes, almost knocking you to the ground. Farther away, the Corpseborne with Julien's face is perched on a throne, gazing down at you.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: You're so insignificant; I had almost forgot you existed... Had that architect not hidden you, you would've been my prey by now.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: What's with the silence? You were quite the talker last time. "It's not a hunting ground for a monster like you," you said, all high and mighty. Funny, you had so much to say then, but now, not a peep.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Died once and learned your lesson, huh?

options: The shackles are starving, time to devour a Black Ring.
Rumor has it, there's a scaredy-cat hiding.

content: Feels like there's someone more powerful on your trail; your time might be up.
I'm just here to watch and learn, curious about how the shackles handle a monster like you.
Looks like chopping you in half might be the way to go, want to test it out?
Building this huge maze just to hide from the shackles, I wonder what kind of scaredy-cat goes to such lengths.
He gets up from the throne, stands tall, and leisurely walks down the steps.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: What makes you think you can talk to me that way? Relying on those tattered shackles of yours?

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Do you really think you can do what she's done to me? Walking all over me, mocking me... believing you're better, seeing me as weak?

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: How dare you!?
Rusted steel rods surge from the earth, coming at you like a storm. "Taran" is knocked away, while the Corpseborne clutches your neck in his grasp.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: My domain is spreading, blanketing the whole Syndicate. Every soul, every person here is my prey. My power is now fully reclaimed.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: From now on, no pit is too deep, no tower too high to confine me. I'll go farther, gain more.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: But first, it's time to settle old scores! You're here first, so you'll be the first to go down!
A burst of blue light spears through its arm and torso, and that's when it spots a small black triangle next to you.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: ...What's this? Shackles? No... it's—
This is top-tier tech from Paradeisos, apparently works a treat on Mania Creation like us.
Got a job to do—use this to kill you. Perfect, it looks like it'll do the trick.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Kill me, you say? Let's see about that.
The blue spikes of light are devoured by flaming rust, while the Corpseborne watches you smugly.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: The best of human tech? Hah, too bad.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: The Black Ring is my realm, where your tech's just child's play. If I say no, you can't lay a finger on me, much less hurt me.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Enough, let's stop here. It's time for me to find her...

options: Is this all about revenge for you?

content: Why not let it go for once? You, who have gained consciousness so rarely, also possess the ability to hide yourself.
You have the chance to leave the Black Ring, to forge a path different from the rest.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: ...Hopelessly stupid, time to die.
He lifts his hand, intent on squashing the pest in front of him. Just then, Schorl hovers before you.
What a waste.
You had your chance.
[Release the shackles]

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: What's this?! Ugh! Aaargh!!
Along with the shackles, a dazzling blue light stabs at the Corpseborne. The blue triangle erupts, forming countless light spikes that impale its body.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Impossible, it shouldn't be able to harm me. This is my Black Ring; it shouldn't be able to reach me.
Like I told you, this is top-tier human tech, designed just to snuff out Mania Creation like you.
Sure, it's got its limits here, but... that's what I'm here for, right?
There's a deep connection between us. Whatever hits me, hits you too.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Is it... you? Did you really use yourself as bait, just to set it up to take me down?

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Are you insane! This will get you killed too, ripped apart just like that! Got a death wish?

options: Well, look at me, do I look dead to you?

content: Bowing its head, it gets a clear view of you: light spikes pass from behind, going through your body like it's made of air, targeting the Corpseborne. Yet, you don't have a scratch.
A thin veil of runes covers you, the very Mania sorcery that lets you stay hidden in plain sight of Paradeisos.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Is this... something that woman left? You've been using it to avoid attacks and stay hidden?!
Well, I had to. You're just too strong. The White Cube might not contain all your power, but it does a good job of tucking away someone "weak" like me.
Sure, I'm stuck too, but now, Paradeisos's tech can't touch me; it'll only zero in on you.
The supplier of that Paradeisos tech is grumbling in protest.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...What's your plan, ${PlayerName}? With that Underground sorcery wreaking havoc, the sync rate and accuracy are tanking, every attack is missing the mark, we can't take it down, and we're burning through our energy reserves fast. It's going to get loose and come after you, making all this for nothing.

speaker: Schorl
content: Whatever Underground sorcery you're messing with, wherever you got it, cut it out now!

speaker: Schorl
content: Weren't you here to destroy the Black Ring and save humanity? Are you really scared of dying now? Thinking of backing out here?!
What's all the fuss about? Thought you were keen to see my choice? Then step back and observe.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...No way, you can't know how to play by the Rules. Guessing the limits is also out of your league.

speaker: Schorl
content: Who's been spilling Paradeisos secrets? Who have you been in contact with while you were off the MBCC grid?!
You're not seeing the big picture here; rational minds often miss out on numerous possibilities.
Amidst the Mania field of the Second Black Ring, in a realm unseen by Schorl, a Paradeisos woman observes everything with a knowing smile.
Months have passed, and things have spiraled beyond her predictions, but she's thrilled by this unexpected turn.

options: I didn't come here with a death wish, and I'm not about to start backing down.

content: My goal was to get back home safely, not to be a puppet for someone else.
However, I'll see this through... all for my own dreams.

If Paradeisos has got what it takes to take it down, then no holding back. Keep the attack relentless, drain this Corpus of its strength to control BR-002. Time to get the Black Ring back to its <color=#fb9259>true owner</color>—
This thing's been sucking the life out of the so-called "weak," binding every soul it's drained right here through Mania. If the Black Ring can make even the strongest desires a reality—
then it's time we heard what these souls have to say.
It's the Black Ring of the West District—let them choose their own fate.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Ha... Hahaha... They get to choose? Who do you think threw you into my jaws, huh? Who picked you apart until you hit rock bottom? Ring any bells?

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: All these maggots, the faceless crowd... no backbone, no convictions, just going wherever the wind blows. Cocky when they're on top, but stick their heads in the sand like ostriches the moment they lose ground.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: I wouldn't bother giving them a second look if it wasn't for my goal to kill her. And you're telling me they can take me out?!

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: Are you kidding me?!

Yeah, think about it, in the West District, with 6.5 million people, it's just 200,000 or so chasing violence. The rest? Silenced, ignored, left in the shadows, wiped from memory. No one ever cares about what they want.
Thankfully, the Black Ring isn't like Syndicate—it's not all about who's got the most muscle.
The power-hungry ones flocked to your brand of Mania six months back, got absorbed into the Black Ring, and poof... gone, just like that.
The ones itching to run away, the ones who couldn't take it anymore, they've all cleared out with the Executive Committee's exodus.
Take a wild guess—who do you think is still sticking it out in the West District, hunkered down deep below, ready to face you head-on?
Ever wonder how they've lasted more than six months under your iron fist? How they've managed to stay alive, what's been driving them, what they're living for?
I bet you don't have a clue. You're too mighty, never bothering to look at the "insignificant bugs" you've squashed along your way.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: ...Ah, you... could it be...
It lunges towards the frail bearer of the shackles, crazed and screeching, but then, suddenly, several blue light spikes emerge, pinning it firmly in place.

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: You lowlife! Thinking you could outsmart me, plot against me like that!

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: So, you're after my power too, huh? Want to take it for yourself?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm nothing like you. I haven't fallen for Syndicate's "might makes right" mantra, and I sure don't need the kind of power you wield.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But here's what I need from you—to prove whether the strongest Black Ring can be shattered.
Are you brave enough to take that bet with me?

speaker: Black Ring Avatar
content: <size=56>You scum!!!</size>

speaker: Raven
content: Unrestrained Mania, twisting reality with humanity's darkest desires, making the world a more vicious place. The powerless struggle to survive, and in this cruel world, death is the only equalizer between the strong and the weak

speaker: Raven
content: You hit the nail on the head, and that's exactly what puzzles me.

speaker: Raven
content: How do ordinary humans make it through such massive calamities? How does a scientist, with no clue about guns or weapons, walk out of DisSea and save the world? Where on earth do they get the strength for all this? Beats me...

speaker: Raven
content: Beneath the vast shadow of the Black Ring, having suffered devastating losses, how have the countless Syndicate folks, despised for being "powerless," managed to hold on for so long?

speaker: Raven
content: Figuring out where to get food, how to steer clear of pollution, deciding who mines the Hypercube, plus evading Paradeisos and the Underground at the same time... With neither leaders nor hope, how do the weak survive here?

speaker: Raven
content: It's incredible... I've never witnessed their fiery determination, nor heard their battle cries. They're not heroes, but somehow, they've sparked so much inspiration in me, without even realizing it.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: No need to say them to me. I'm only captivated by the echoes of the dead. I've heard too much of your fancy words.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Now that you're back with us, leave this grim place and return to the world you love.

speaker: Raven
content: I'm already there. I've written so many great poems; my eager students must be waiting with bated breath.
(Scene change)

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Wake up!! Kidl!! Wake up!!

speaker: Dejected Refugee
content: Look! Your poetry, it's alive!!!

speaker: Crache
content: ...What's happening...
The flyer she holds is plain, without Raven's ornate lettering or boastful poems. Nothing on it at all.
But streams of ink lines burst out from the fluttering sheets, slipping through her fingers and zipping behind her. Suddenly, a powerful surge lifts Crache's plummeting body.

speaker: Ica
content: Check this out! I've got a rousing poem by Raven. It's brilliantly written, full of strength.
It's definitely not written by her, she's not even here, but why does it seem so familiar? Crache's mind blanks out as she turns to look behind—

speaker: Crache
content: ...Raye.
[CG-Crache's Ascent!]

speaker: Crache
content: You dumb bird, this whole scene is in such poor taste.

With a laugh, Raven twirls her pen, ink swirling at its tip, her power and poetry rejuvenated. Does it really matter if she didn't write it herself? The poet's ideas have long since passed to her students, soaring to greater heights and distances.

speaker: Raven
content: In Mania, it heralds the worst, yet brings forth the best of times. Violence isn't the only solution; power can also spring from thought. Therefore—

speaker: Raven
content: As long as desires still flicker in our hearts, how can we ever stand still and not move forward?

speaker: K.K.
content: Bai Yi!!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Oh my goodness!!

speaker: Che
content: Hold up, slow down a bit... We're not sure what kind of enemies are out there; let's not hurry—

speaker: K.K.
content: If we don't hurry, that guy will get away again!
She quickly slashes off the spikes on Bai Yi's body, then grabs and shakes her by the collar.

speaker: K.K.
content: Trying to skip town with all that debt, huh? Sneaking off after having hotpot without cleaning up, right?! Dressed to the nines, and doing some shady stuff here?

speaker: K.K.
content: Where are you heading off to after this mess?! Going to sneak away again without a word to me? You still think that's all for my sake?!

speaker: Che
content: Shhh— I've already been chewed out once; just don't say anything.

speaker: K.K.
content: ...It's fine if you keep it to yourself. Everyone in Syndicate has some history, right?

speaker: K.K.
content: I've loved every day with you guys, and I've tried so hard to keep up. You guys made my life interesting. Stop using "it's for my sake" as an excuse, and don't leave me out again.

speaker: K.K.
content: You hear me?!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I hear you, I hear you... But we need to focus on escaping first. What was Chief thinking, letting you loose? It's driving me crazy.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I was looking for a chance to sneak out of here, but now that you two have shown up, how can I slip away anymore?
Slip away?
Bang!

speaker: Langley
content: My men have sacrificed a lot; they deserve the best trophy as their medal. Just Parma's head won't cut it.

speaker: Langley
content: So... how about joining me back at base, Miss Bai? We've got a lot to talk about.

speaker: Whitestone Trio
content: Gasp—
(Scene change)

speaker: Rust
content: You flatter me. All we can do is buy them a little time.

speaker: Rust
content: After all, our most powerful one said she had to risk going to another place.
(Scene change)
While Horo is still locked in fierce combat, a sudden, mighty blast from behind sweeps away the surrounding enemies.

speaker: Horo
content: Legion...

speaker: Horo
content: No, this isn't coming from me...

speaker: Horo
content: This power is—?!
[Void Scene] Zoya's image darkens

speaker: Hella
content: ...I'm feeling weightless... My injuries are mending... What's going on, is this ${PlayerName}'s doing?

speaker: Hella
content: ...Hecate?

speaker: Hella
content: What are you doing here?! Is that thing a... dragon—?
Nightmare seems to grow in size, suddenly sprouting wings from its back.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What are you doing here? What about that dummy, shouldn't you be with him?
female_content: ...What are you doing here? What about that dummy, shouldn't you be with her?

speaker: Hella
content: Are you sure you can take this alone?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I'm fine now.

speaker: Hecate
content: I haven't been alone for a long time.

speaker: Hecate
content: The boy clutches the candy vending machine instinctively and flinches. He looks at Crache, then at you, and answers after a moment of hesitation.
female_content: Chief will be fine on her own, I believe in her. So—

speaker: Hecate
content: I'm here to protect Hella.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...The Black Ring is experiencing major disturbances, the Corruptors are lost in disarray, and some of the Mania Infected are coming to their senses... What's going on? Could it be... that Chief's back?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Anyways, this is an rare opportunity! Halt the retreat, all FAC units, gather up. It's time to take down the Corruptors. I'll take full responsibility for any disciplinary consequences, but try your best to keep the civilians safe! Move out!!
[CG: The Black Ring and the Tower Aflame]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's enough, the quiet masses of Syndicate.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've seen yourselves as the downtrodden, the weak, and the helpless. You've been numbed for far too long, escaping for far too long.
female_content: You've seen yourselves as the downtrodden, the weak, and the helpless. You've been numbed for far too long, escaping for far too long.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Waiting for leaders, heroes, or even fate to step in and right your wrongs.
female_content: Waiting for leaders, heroes, or even fate to step in and right your wrongs.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've only been watching them, the strong and the weak alike, turning themselves into beacons, forging the bloodstained path.
female_content: You've only been watching them, the strong and the weak alike, turning themselves into beacons, forging the bloodstained path.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now, it's your turn to step up.
female_content: Now, it's your turn to step up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Everyone gets a chance, and everyone faces a choice.
female_content: Everyone gets a chance, and everyone faces a choice.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop living in the shadows of self-pity. Stop waiting for someone else to save you. It's time to face the Black Ring head-on.
female_content: Stop living in the shadows of self-pity. Stop waiting for someone else to save you. It's time to face the Black Ring head-on.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This time, it's up to you to shape your destiny.
Please give me your answer.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: While I was out cold, I tried and failed to wake up, over and over again. That was a chaotic world.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There, in the depths of Mania were many unimaginable pains and inescapable traps.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I had good intentions. I tried my best. It shouldn't have ended up like this. The result shouldn't have been this ludicrous.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Was it because I didn't try hard enough? Was it because I'm too naive, too reckless, not wise enough, not strong enough? Was it because I'm weak?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Or was it because Syndicate didn't deserve me risking my life to change? Were the people simply too corrupted, and were my efforts pointless? Was that the reason why I ended up like this?
${PlayerName}'s gaze turns icy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I found myself trapped in darkness, the most terrifying kind. I couldn't break free on my own. It was then that I realized I knew nothing about human beings.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm weak too.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief?
Panic seizes Hecate for the first time. She takes ${PlayerName}'s hand.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, you're not weak. You always give it your all in battle, always go out of your way to protect us. I've seen this with my own eyes.

speaker: Hecate
content: When I feel helpless, it's the thought of you that always gives me strength.

speaker: Hecate
content: You are not weak, not one bit!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you, but I think it's okay to feel weak.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Because I'm not strong enough, I've received help from many people. Those who have passed away, those who are still struggling, those I remember, those I've forgotten...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hecate, you've met someone like that too, haven't you?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Yes.

speaker: Matilda
content: She's never asked anything of you. All her efforts to protect you were to repay what that Chief did for her. People have brought you back from the riot. And people out there are still trying to look for your Chief.

speaker: Samuel
content: Be extra careful when you are on your own. Make it out alive and return safely to the ones who matter the most to you.

speaker: Hella
content: Something very profound, indeed. Remember, we're Sinners. We have hearts of our own, and that's what gives us strength. No one can control our hearts.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your voice, Hecate, it stood out from the rest. You came to me by following the shackles. Someone pushed me out, and you were on the other end, pulling me toward you with the shackles.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You see, we are the same. This is our heart.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't want to call it "shackles" now. It's an emotional bond of the utmost importance for me, my anchor.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So I'm happy that you shared your feelings with me. I want to be closer to your heart. And I'm also happy to know that you need me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm sorry that I can't give you what you need right now. The shackles have been tainted, and I've lost my power. I must reclaim it first. Trust me; I can do it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But before I can do that, I need your help. Would you help me?
[Exit Memory]
Hecate opens her eyes, back to reality, back to the battlefield.

speaker: Greta
content: Yooga! Yooga! Here comes the medicine!

speaker: Samuel
content: The contamination here is still dangerously high. Quick! Get everyone out of here.
From above the battlefield comes the roar of a helicopter. They look up, greeted by a familiar face.

speaker: Hella
content: You are...?

speaker: Nightingale
content: It has been confirmed that those are the missing MBCC Sinners S-019 and S-098. Arrest Squad, come with me; let's proceed to the scene to provide protection.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Command Center, please contact Paradeisos. Wait, don't contact Paradeisos. Contact the FAC, the 9th Agency, all departments of the Executive Committee. Sync the live visuals. If the visuals are disrupted, sync the audio, detect M-values, and do whatever else that might help.

speaker: Nightingale
content: New developments! The Black Ring is collapsing. The Purge Order won't be of any help and should be terminated immediately. There are still people fighting out here. ${PlayerName} is still fighting!

speaker: Matilda
content: Corso, I'm going ask for your help once more. Please...

speaker: Corso
content: No problem, I'm more than happy to help.

speaker: Corso
content: I can't remember the last time I found Syndicate so endearing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Protect Hella and yourself. This isn't an order, nor is it an assignment.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I need you, just like you need me.

speaker: Hecate
content: I... won't be afraid anymore.

speaker: Hecate
content: I may be weak, but I've got people who help me, and they've got me. This is the source of my strength. This is what brings me closer to you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Thank you for telling me you need me, Chief. I'll protect Hella; she's very important to us. Now, please go fight with all your strength, and reclaim your shackles.

speaker: Hecate
content: I believe in you, just like you believe in me.
The blue light emitted by the shackles dims. The Corpus, torn apart by the Black Ring itself, finally has its true form revealed—a huge, ugly, and ferocious monster.

speaker: Corpus
content: You despicable □□□, lacking her strength, you resort to such a low trick...

speaker: Corpus
content: I will never be defeated by this... I've gained power, reclaimed what's mine... I will not go down here...

speaker: Corpus
content: Lowly insect! You'll never trample over me!

speaker: Corpus
content: Whoaaaa!
Hey, Chief... Finally caught up with you.

speaker: Donald
content: I've brought a new friend to you. This is gonna get much more exciting.

speaker: Donald
content: Hmm, you don't look so well.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That was some sterling acting from you just now.

speaker: Donald
content: Hahaha, all I did was do you a favor and give you some encouragement. Look how well it turned out.

speaker: Donald
content: I said I'd catch up with you and I just wanted to meet an old friend. Did I lie? Haven't I kept my promise?

speaker: Donald
content: What else did I say? Right, I also said we'd destroy the Black Ring together, the three of us.
The severely weakened monster is still struggling to escape.

speaker: Corpus
content: No... it can't end here... I must find that woman... I must kill her... I want revenge...

speaker: Corpus
content: If she couldn't kill me, nor can you... I'm stronger then ever... I won't die here...

speaker: Corpus
content: Right, all I need to do is abandon this vessel and find another one... go into hiding, slowly gather strength, just as I did last time... You won't be able to find me... No one will...

speaker: Corpus
content: I must survive... survive and then come back... and then...
(CG Scene: The Corpus sees an apparition of Julien, trapped.)

speaker: Corpus
content: ...It's you. Why are you still here? You...

speaker: Corpus
content: Ahhhhh!
The architect doesn't answer. Right at that moment, a thunderous roar issues from the Black Ring High Tower. The ground under your feet starts shaking, rising rapidly.
One minute, the High Tower was on the verge of collapse; the next, it is high in the sky, trapping the fleeing Corpseborne in an inescapable aerial cage.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yeah... The Paradeisos Rules are no longer in effect. The monster is still clinging to life. We suppress it, the three of us; don't let it run away.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And...

options: We let the Syndicans take care of the rest.

content: The light of the Black Ring gradually concentrates and eventually turns into a fire that burns the body of the Corpseborne and dissolves the existence of the former Ring Master. The once fast-expanding shell splits, shatters, and vanishes.
At some point, the feeling of restriction that has been plaguing your soul suddenly disappears.

speaker: X
content: I never would've thought that you'd hand over the decision-making to someone else... I've known you to be full of surprises, but I never expected this kind of surprise.

speaker: X
content: Forget about the success rate. Without the benefit of collective observation, the level of uncertainty surrounding this plan is almost infinite.

speaker: X
content: Was it a gamble? You surrendered yourself to fate by choice... Sigh, I wouldn't have had the courage to make that choice.

options: There was only so much I could do, after all.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I witnessed the great efforts of many people. Although some of them were not strong, they did their best.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Think about it, would a coward stay in the Black Ring for that long? By then all the frightened ones had already left. Those who stayed, who were still helping out... must have been most courageous.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I couldn't foresee the fate of the West District, but I trusted them to give me the answer.

speaker: X
content: ...I see. You can trust others because you have seen a bigger world and more genuine "people," because you are... not alone.

speaker: X
content: I'm envious of you. If I were more like you, I might have come up with a better solution, and everyone would have suffered less. I'm sorry.

options: ...I'm not that trusting, to be honest.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: At first, I didn't want to trust a "Paradeisian" like you. Your appearance threw the entire Black Ring into turmoil; I knew you must have done something unusual.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But all this way, I have received protection from many people I have never met before. And perhaps you're among these people.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You seemed convinced that they would keep me safe, until this day...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Plus...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When I was in mortal danger, someone risked her life to take hold of me and bring you to me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She didn't say a word, and I'm afraid she never will speak the truth about herself. But the sincerity she showed was impossible to miss. It's true that you've been treated as a tool by some people, but there are others who trust you deeply.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So I think there's no need for you to be envious of me.

speaker: X
content: ...I see... Is that how it is...

speaker: X
content: I thought they had all left, considering they each had their own path to follow...
A myriad of emotions flows freely in her eyes. You wish to savor the moment, but the Black Ring begins to collapse, and the realm of consciousness fades away.

speaker: X
content: Looks like time is running out.

speaker: X
content: Please take care of them for me. They are nothing like me, but they're a lot like you; sooner or later, they will come and rally around you.

options: What about you? You are not coming?

speaker: X
content: Me? I'm fine. Don't worry about me. And I hope you can forget this encounter of ours. You'll be safer if you do.

speaker: X
content: You always choose the path of most resistance. Neither running away nor causing havoc, you confront your challenges and look for new possibilities... Things are only going to get more overwhelming for you. Be careful.

speaker: X
content: Our destinies are linked. They've changed each other. There's nothing to regret.

options: ...Looks like the time hasn't come yet.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We'll meet again. And our friends will join us the next time we meet.
She is on the verge of saying something but thinks better of it. She only gives a smile.

speaker: X
content: I'm glad that you've gained your freedom. So... I wish you happiness.

speaker: X
content: By the way, if you guessed wrong and the people of the West District chose another path... What would you do?

speaker: X
content: Would you still think any of this was worthwhile?

speaker: X
content: Hmm... There's that interesting expression on your face again. It's a look that I'm familiar with.

speaker: X
content: Luckily, fate led them to this path.

speaker: X
content: Off you go. Someone's here to pick you up.

speaker: Donald
content: Got you! What were you just staring at?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Syndicate, I guess.

speaker: Donald
content: Oh, it truly is a splendid sight.
The red light of the Black Ring fades. Dust hangs above the entire Syndicate like smoke. Through the thin layer of rust-colored mist, you see many people, running, crying, laughing.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief is still in the Tower. Go find him!
female_content: Chief is still in the Tower. Go find her!

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We will go question the civilians, and that executive officer... Donald.
The Paradeisian knight lies on the ground. Schorl is nowhere in sight. Staring at the deranged Black Ring, she bursts into hearty laughter.
Hahaha... hahaha...
This is good... I'm... making progress too...

speaker: Christina
content: Ah! We've found an injured person here. Inform Adjutant Nightingale! Someone needs help!

speaker: Christina
content: Are you all right? let me...
No, thank you.
The warrior picks herself up from the floor.

speaker: Christina
content: Your voice... You are...
Take care.
She refastens her helmet. A new Schorl floats over, and she silently walks ahead.
(Scene change)
Thistle walks behind Mentor, sobbing uncontrollably and clutching a corner of Mentor's clothes as if her life depends on it.

speaker: Coquelic
content: All right, stop crying now. Did you really think anybody could hurt me? Look at me, not a scratch—good as new. It was not a big deal. I told you I'd be back. Have I ever lied to you?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Gee, with you being such a crybaby, how am I supposed to let go? <size=30>I just can't bring myself to...</size>

speaker: Donald
content: This is really great. I'd imagined many possible outcomes, and I'd been very positive and creative in my imagining.

speaker: Donald
content: But I never thought that Syndicate would end up with an outcome this good.

speaker: Donald
content: Thank you, Chief.
Donald's face takes on a surprised expression.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Everyone here is a hero.

speaker: Donald
content: Pfft, hahaha... Putting you back into Paradeisos's hands wouldn't sit right with me. Might as well...
As he speaks, he glances down and chuckles.

speaker: Donald
content: Too bad, the hook I brought today can't handle the weight of the two of us; otherwise, I'd whisk you away right now.

speaker: Donald
content: Maybe next time.
He unhooks you. Now the only thing that keeps you from falling is his hand holding yours.

speaker: Donald
content: Reluctant to part company with me? But I promised someone that I'd send you back.

speaker: Donald
content: When you find them to be a handful next time, just reach out to me. I'll come and return the favor. Until we meet again.

speaker: Donald
content: Now, she's coming to get you.
He lets go of your hand. The remaining Black Ring force field distorts spacetime, slowing your fall significantly.
You watch the High Tower fading away. Before it disappears into the clouds, you see the vague shape of what appears to be a long flight of steps.
On the steps are figures climbing slowly...

speaker: Julien
content: I am weak, always have been.

speaker: Julien
content: No sturdy legs to stand on, no formidable power to wield, nor a constantly soaring spirit to fight with.

speaker: Julien
content: But I have friends, ideals, and a hometown that once embraced me.

speaker: Julien
content: I want to become an architect, and restore Syndicate to its former glory.

speaker: Julien
content: To give everyone shelter and hope.

speaker: Julien
content: That is its true glory.
In a trance, you see the architect turn around, see countless people step onto the stairs one after another.
You see Lavina, Donald, the Sinners, and many other people, familiar and unfamiliar, and you see...
Yourself.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!

A girl's call brings you back to reality. The illusion vanishes. Nightmare is flying toward you, its wings spread wide. Hecate, seated on Nightmare's back, extends her hand to you, her eyes eager, intense, filled with so many emotions.
It's early morning. A girl stealthily slips out onto a dim street of Syndicate.
A voice from behind startles her.
Where are you going?

speaker: Hella
content: Y-you gave me a scare, Hecate...

speaker: Hella
content: I was going to the bathroom. Why were you following me?
She averts her eyes, looking guilty.

speaker: Hecate
content: The bathroom is over there, to the east.

speaker: Hella
content: Really? Ah, I remembered there are some convenience stores this way that I used to frequent. So, I thought I'd go and...

speaker: Hecate
content: All closed down during the riot.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Uh, I forgot that, I...

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, are you leaving?

speaker: Hella
content: No!

speaker: Hella
content: I just need some... some space... I've got a lot in my head. I just need to straighten it out...

speaker: Hecate
content: You were leaving without telling us? You haven't met Chief since we came back, have you?

speaker: Hella
content: <size=30>...I don't want to meet Chief.</size>

speaker: Hella
content: If I did, then I wouldn't be able leave. So... no, I guess....
female_content: If I did, then I wouldn' t be able leave. So... no, I guess....

speaker: Hella
content: Don't snitch on me... I'm not running away! I'll write to you guys, um, even if there are lots of spelling errors.

speaker: Hella
content: The MBCC is okay. There's training and stuff... But what I can see and do in the MBCC is still too limited. And if I stay, I'll always be under someone else's protection...

speaker: Hella
content: What I'm trying to say is, I want to be my own person and make something of myself. And then I'll come back to see you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Okay.

speaker: Hella
content: ...I want to be stronger, I want to be a protector, someone who can really protect others...

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate, you know what I'm getting at, right?

speaker: Hecate
content: Yes, I do.
(CG1)
Hecate takes a step forward, and before Hella can skedaddle like a little rat, hugs her.

speaker: Hella
content: What the... whaaat-t... Ahh...

speaker: Hella
content: What are you doing?! Who does that! Stop it. Let go, let go of me... Someone's got to be watching. This is embarrassing!
(CG2)

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't worry. No one is watching.

speaker: Hecate
content: I understand. I understand why you want to become stronger so that you can protect what is close to your heart.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is what you taught me. When I was lost, it was you who reached out to me, let me know I was not alone; you are the reason I'm back at Chief's side.

speaker: Hecate
content: So, it's only fair that I should give you my support when you need it. Go for it, Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: What about your mission?

speaker: Hecate
content: You mean the task of supervising you? It's okay, I don't want to fulfill it anymore. Chief will help me sort it out; you're more important than those tasks.
(CG3)

speaker: Hecate
content: Because Hella is my friend, the first friend I chose for myself.

speaker: Hecate
content: Don't forget to visit us often. I'll miss you.

speaker: Hella
content: Sob...

speaker: Hella
content: Waaaaaaaaaaaah! This is why I didn't want to see you before I leave. This is making it so much harder to leave. Idiot, idiot... Hecate, you big idiot!

speaker: Hella
content: ?! Why are you...
You bear-hug Hella and Hecate.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you know there's something called "release on bail pending trial"?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Out there, you better not indulge in your old habit. It's one thing to pick my pocket, but quite another to steal from others. So don't steal, or you'll be arrested and sent back here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All right, let me take a good look at your face before you go. I bet you'll look completely different the next time I see you.

speaker: Hella
content: Waaaah! Don't look at me! Go back now, you two big dummies!

speaker: Hella
content: I'll be back to visit you. But you need to visit me as well. Do you hear me?
(Scene change)

speaker: Nightingale
content: A lot has happened in the bureau during your long absence. Some outsiders have interfered in our affairs, and our Sinners have suffered greatly. The city has changed, so has the overall atmosphere; the MBCC has had to change as well.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But everyone knows how the MBCC is supposed to be. They remember the looks of the things they hold dear, hoping to restore them to the way they used to be upon your return.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We've been waiting for this day for so long.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Welcome back, Chief. You've been sorely missed.

About the provider of the White Cube and the numerous pieces of underground information, Donald is tight-lipped.

All he says on the subject is that Chief will soon meet those people Chief once met before.

As the MBCC investigates those involved in the incident, a prime suspect comes to the surface, but the lead soon comes to a dead end.

"Rust," a 9th Agency agent assigned to Syndicate, is reported dead in the incident.

Langley doesn't say much by way of explanation, but uncharacteristically, she doesn't show much sorrow for the death of her subordinate either.

speaker: Rust
content: I'm sorry. I've tried my best to keep them from meeting. Miss Bai stayed in the Black Ring. I didn't expect to see her fall into the hands of the 9th Agency...

speaker: Rust
content: My "boss" is quite intimidating.
Hehe, no matter how intimidating that place is, Miss Bai will never return to you. She has a place in mind.
Besides, the MBCC is a good place to be, with that little Chief at the helm.

speaker: Zoya
content: Calling you "little Chief" doesn't seem appropriate now. You've done a lot of great things. Quite impressive.

speaker: Rust
content: What, you are getting nostalgic and want to pay a visit?

speaker: Zoya
content: Maybe another time. Syndicate doesn't need a violent leader anymore. They can forge their own path now.

speaker: Zoya
content: Anyone who still tries to stand in their way or takes advantage of them... I'll take care of it.

speaker: Zoya
content: You can change your code name now. BR-002 is defeated, your life as "Rust" has come to an end. It's time to move on to the next fight.

speaker: Rust
content: You've got a point.

speaker: Rust
content: Now that the Black Ring in the West District has been destroyed, we "monsters" who have been residing inside the Ring can't stay here anymore. It's time to move.

speaker: Rust
content: See you wherever the next Black Ring crops up, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Rust
content: I hope to see the real you the next time around.

Out of the ruins of the BR-002, the largest Black Ring, rises the largest <color=#fb9259>stand-alone Hypercube mine</color> to date.

Nirvana mounts a bid for its ownership. However, since Paradeisos has closed the access to a certain technology based on the BR-002's Mania field, super-loop communication can no longer be maintained inside the ruins.
One thing is certain; in the coming years, Nirvana won't be able to carry out machine-based unmanned mining in the new mine.

Manual mining has to be applied to the huge wealth of BR-002 Hypercube. This seemingly forgotten technique is in the hands of Julien, the former leader of Rustfire.

This gives the new Inner Bay organization bargaining power against Nirvana.
With the support of logistics, trade, and mysterious funding, a new round of meetings will proceed as scheduled.

Surprisingly, Paradeisos is not fully on board with Nirvana's proposals this time.
They seem more interested in understanding the principles of how the BR-002 was destroyed.

speaker: Langley
content: Long time no see. I heard you've made great contributions in the battle. It wouldn't seem right to call you a "rookie" anymore.

speaker: Langley
content: Ready to meet those old geezers from Paradeisos? You've grown so much; surely you won't be nervous, right Chief?

speaker: Paradeisos 03
content: The Rules in SHP-13 are confirmed to be in effect once again. Tighten security; the request for contact is approved.

speaker: Paradeisos 03
content: Thank you for your cooperation, ${PlayerName}. I thought you would die in the BR-002. It surprised me when you came on board with the Paradeisos's proposal and accepted the restrictions of the Rules.

speaker: Paradeisos 03
content: Am I correct in assuming you represent a new possibility for humanity in the future?

speaker: Paradeisos 02
content: The unorthodox measures taken by the FAC and 9th Agency, they must have counted on you for the success of these measures, to a degree at least. You did exceed our expectations. We should have come and met you sooner... before X left.

speaker: Paradeisos 02
content: Fortunately, we still have plenty of time.

speaker: Paradeisos 02
content: Go ahead, someone has been waiting for you.

speaker: Paradeisos 01
content: While I was talking with you inside the Ring, I had a vague feeling that we might meet again.

speaker: Paradeisos 01
content: Hello, Chief ${PlayerName} of Minos. Reason told me to reject your radical plan, but... it did remind me of some interesting past events.

speaker: Paradeisos 01
content: Let's judge it by its outcome then.

speaker: Paradeisos 01
content: Thank you for buying us precious time. There's so much more we can talk about next.
The Corpus that hasn't been absorbed yet... the shattered, severely weakened BR-002...
At a certain point, you sensed the feeble existence of a breathing thing on the other end of the shackles, until...

speaker: Corpus 002
content: Hahaha... I survived, just like back then, I survived...
Back in the tower, just before it was reduced to nothingness, it latched onto a little something called "Rustfire." As luck would have it, it now has a new anchor point.

speaker: Corpus 002
content: You can't kill me... I refuse to accept that fate... I will reclaim what's rightfully mine, I have patience, and will regain my power... I will come back... no matter how many times it takes, I will come back for you...

speaker: Corpus 002
content: ...Wait and see. One of these days, I...
Its soliloquy comes to a sudden stop. It's just realized that it's back in DisSea, back to where everything started, to the most dangerous place.
Why is it back? It has been avoiding the place. Could it be...
This is a special gift from my lovely "little brother."
female_content: This is a special gift from my lovely "little sister."

content: You must have sensed me too, right? My dear...

20:57, November 26, N.F. 114
A Factory in the West District
In the stillness of the night, the factory stands quiet, save for the faint howls of ventilation systems breaking the silence.
With the impending election, the reconstruction project in the West District, delayed for long, has sprung back to life. This shiny new factory is just the tip of the iceberg.

Not far off, at the central square marked with graffiti and grime, several long-unemployed workers gather. They huddle together, eyeing this rare sight in the West District—a brand new factory—and chatting.

speaker: Syndican Worker A
content: Hey, y'all heard that? The bigwigs are gonna dish out cash to Syndicate!

speaker: Syndican Worker B
content: Nah, that's not it. See that new factory over there? They're lookin' to hire. Had some suits come down here the other day, preachin' about job opportunities.

speaker: Syndican Worker C
content: How's the pay?

speaker: Syndican Worker B
content: Heard they're throwin' good money, especially for us seasoned hands.

speaker: Syndican Worker C
content: For real? Since when did they become so generous?

speaker: Syndican Worker B
content: The election's 'round the corner, even Syndicate's gotta roll with the changes. Just look around—fewer gangs on the streets, new buildings poppin' up. My nephew even scored a spot on the Executive Committee last month!
As their chatter continues, a loud explosion suddenly sounded from inside the factory.

speaker: Syndican Worker A
content: What was that sound...?

Following the explosion, a tearing sound rips through the air. The workers scramble to higher ground, some pulling out their newly purchased terminals, zooming in to get a closer look of what's happening.

In the distance, a sight all too familiar to Syndicans unfolds—billowing smoke and serpentine flames lashing out in all directions, painting the night sky crimson. It seems that some incendiary bomb has been detonated inside the factory.
[Program Logo Intro]

speaker: Host
content: The juiciest election buzz, the freshest campaign scoops, and the most outlandish candidate tales! From breaking headlines to deep dives, we're here to sift through the truth and the tall tales! Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the special edition of Truth or Troll—the <color=#fb9259>[Election Focus]</color>!

speaker: Host
content: Last night, #WestDistrictExplosion topped DisPhantom's trending list in the early hours. How did an ordinary explosion capture the spotlight in the dead of night? What secrets lurk behind the smoke? Was it a mere mishap, or a darker scheme at play?

speaker: Host
content: Coming up next, we will be talking to <color=#fb9259>Pine</color>, the commentator of the popular independent channel <color=#fb9259>[The Hedgehog's Eye]</color>, ready to delve into the enigma surrounding this peculiar event with us.
[Standard Program Transition]

speaker: Host
content: Greetings, Miss Pine! Great to have you here on [Election Focus]. What's your take on the West District explosion? Do you suspect this could be a political hit job in the making?

speaker: Pine
content: A political hit job? An explosion without casualties hardly meets the assassination criteria. DisCity has witnessed its fair share of genuine hits—so why the fuss over this one?

speaker: Host
content: Are you implying... that some media channels are purposefully hyping up this event for drama's sake?

speaker: Pine
content: December's almost there, and with the election coming up, it's no surprise to see all sorts of dubious characters crawling out of the woodwork.

speaker: Host
content: Absolutely, this upcoming month is known for its <color=#fb9259>December Surprises</color>, where unexpected bombshells hit the headlines. Could this explosion be setting the stage for this year's shocking revelations?

speaker: Pine
content: This is hardly grand enough to kick off the show. It's just the Eastside bigwigs feeling threatened by the West District's growing clout, using petty tricks to smear Syndicate's name.

speaker: Pine
content: First, they use the explosion to grab everyone's attention, then the mainstream media jumps in, pushing their narrative: poor public security in the West District, Syndicans dissatisfied with policies, resistance against Eastside capital, blah blah blah...

speaker: Pine
content: That's all they know—the same old playbook.

speaker: Host
content: What a shocking revelation! So... who exactly are the puppet masters pulling the strings behind all this?

speaker: Pine
content: The Prime Minister, aka our distinguished Speaker of DisCity <color=#fb9259>Stewart</color> is definitely one of them. After all, he's been trying so hard to keep the West District in shambles—just imagine the humiliation for him if the district really were to thrive.

speaker: Pine
content: With such a hot story, not a peep from him? Guilty conscience, if you ask me.

speaker: Host
content: Is Stewart the only player in this game? The other two candidates both made public appearances today, promising thorough investigations. Surely they're not involved in this.

speaker: Pine
content: Hah, who's to say? One's a sly old ****, the other a total megalomaniac. What a show, what a spectacle! I'm betting all three candidates go down in flames. You care to join in?

speaker: Pine
content: We've still got the whole of December—just wait for the grand show, guys.

speaker: Host
content: We'll definitely be keeping an eye out for that. Thank you, Miss Pine, for your fascinating insights today. Now, let's dive into some other juicy tidbits.

speaker: Host
content: An anonymous tycoon throws their support behind Max King with a billion DisCoins poured into Max King's campaign!

speaker: Host
content: Prime Minister Stewart's secret "smurf" has been exposed, his private life shockingly blurring his public face.

speaker: Host
content: Thieves justify repeated break-ins at the Eastside Public Security Bureau, claiming it to be a protest against escalating crime rates.

speaker: Host
content: Online betting no longer seems enough as Eastside residents take their political rivalry to the streets.

speaker: Female News Anchor
content: Since N.F. 112, after humanity's initial triumph in containing BR-004, the 23-year-long BR-001, and the recurring BR-002 have also been successfully suppressed. Humanity has finally established viable protocols to address extreme Mania incidents.

speaker: Female News Anchor
content: The following year, DisCity finally found respite from the Black Ring crisis, ushering in a long-awaited era of peace and prosperity. At last, it might be time for humanity to dispel this prolonged darkness.

speaker: Female News Anchor
content: With these aspirations for the future, DisCity will soon witness the most significant political event in the lives of its citizens—

speaker: Female News Anchor
content:
<size=75>The 22nd <color=#fb9259>DisCity Election</color>
Coming on <color=#fb9259>December 26, N.F. 114</color></size>

November 27, N.F. 114
MBCC
Chief's Office

Malcolm Enoch, Vice President, Nirvana Regarding West District Development Dear Chief, the development of the West District is a matter of our mutual interest. I look forward to meeting with you to delve into its future growth. Jonathan Moy, Bureau of Energy and Industry Meeting Invitation from the Jacknal Family Dear Chief, I am honored to invite you to a meeting on behalf of the Jacknal family. This presents a remarkable opportunity, as you are well aware of their influence in Eastside. Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 27th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I am Max King, the primary candidate in this election. I have always held your reputation in high regard and would like to extend my heartfelt greetings and deep respect to you! Nightingale, MBCC Adjutant MBCC December Meeting Schedule Chief, we have received numerous meeting requests leading up to the election. I have tentatively organized the schedule, with pending requests attached to this email. Kindly review the Upcoming Visitor Request List.

Malcolm Enoch, Vice President, Nirvana Regarding West District Development Dear Chief, urgent attention is needed for the development of the West District. Kindly schedule a meeting at your earliest convenience to explore potential solutions. Jonathan Moy, Bureau of Energy and Industry Meeting Invitation from the Jacknal Family Dear Chief, Mr. Jacknal seems displeased by the absence of your response. A prompt reply from you would be greatly appreciated. Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 28th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I am Max King, the leading candidate in this election. I am eagerly anticipating having a discussion with you!

Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 29th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! Howdy, Chief! I have been closely following your remarkable career, and your achievements never fail to impress me! It's striking how our views align on matters concerning the West District, FAC, and even Paradeisos. We could...
Click! You shut the mail browser and rub your strained eyes—that last email not only employed ridiculously large font but also came with several photos of yourself attached.

Even with the strictest filter settings in place, these spam-like promotional mails still have managed to find their way into your work inbox... which means they must all be coming through official whitelist channels and legitimate special access.
What an Election this has been—seeing all these big shots humble themselves and practically shove their olive branches in the face of a nobody like you.

speaker: Matilda
content: As expected. During the election, every party will do whatever it takes to win support. At the very least, they don't want to see someone of your influence side with their opponents.

speaker: Choice
options: What kind of influence am I supposed to have?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm just an administrator of a secret agency, without much authority or resources. Plus, topics like Mania and Sinners aren't exactly crowd-pleasers around here.

speaker: Matilda
content: You're being far too modest. Let me show you something interesting.
The person on the other end of the call moves away from the frame, followed by some rustling sounds as she searches for something.

That is <color=#fb9259>Matilda Cavendish</color>. Though born into an established Eastside family, she has always empathized with the struggling Syndicate underclass. During the BR-002 operation in N.F. 113, she fought alongside you.

Afterwards, she registered as a Sinner at the MBCC and returned to Syndicate. She has helped reform the West District Reconstruction Committee, develop the new mine, and actively advocate for Syndican rights, all the while maintaining friendly contact with you.
—That is, when you both have the luxury of time.
—Which rarely happens.
Still, these moments are precious whenever they come.

speaker: Matilda
content: Found it.
A newspaper sheet featuring your photo emerges in the frame. The headline reads: "Black Ring Vanquisher! Hero of the West District! Vote for Chief of Minos!! Voice for Freedom and Justice!!!"

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cough cough cough!!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What the—what is that??

speaker: Matilda
content: A precious shot taken by Mr. Donald. Raven wasn't happy with the original copy and made a few tweaks. The plan is to produce hundreds of copies and have the Homeless spearhead a local promotion.

speaker: Matilda
content: We heard you're coming back to join the election on behalf of the West District.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is way too ridiculous. Are they really pulling this kind of prank?

speaker: Matilda
content: It's been a long time, Chief. Everyone's missing you dearly.
Everyone must be feeling swamped lately, especially with such a crucial state-wide election on the horizon.

Every four years, the citizens of DisCity elect their <color=#fb9259>Prime Minister of the City Council</color>, a prestigious Speaker that serves as the chief executive and unifying voice of all parties. This direct election allows every eligible citizen to cast their vote for one of the designated candidates, choosing who will guide their future.
For the people of the West District, who only regained their DisCitizenship last year, this election was supposed to be a pivotal chance to fight for their rights.

However, concerns linger about whether the "designated candidates" truly represent the interests of the West District. Moreover, the Syndicans face significant hurdles in merely securing their <color=#fb9259>right to vote</color>. Pondering the complexities, you look down at the documents in your hands...

DisCity Prime Minister Election Voter Eligibility Requirements 1. Eligibility is granted to any resident aged 18 or above, who has maintained continuous residence in DisCity for over five years and possesses DisCitizenship. 2. Active FAC members will have their voting rights temporarily suspended for the duration of their service. These rights will be reinstated upon completion of service and formal discharge from active duty.

N.F. 114 Special Act: Supplementary Provisions on Voter Eligibility To further clarify the definition of DisCity's jurisdiction regarding the residency period criterion for voter eligibility, this Act establishes the following supplementary rules for calculating residency periods in specific regions: For regions recently included within DisCity's jurisdiction, residents' duration of residency shall be calculated starting from the official date on which the region comes under City Council administration. For regions that were once temporarily separated from council administration, residents' duration of residency shall be calculated starting from the date of reintegration into administration. This Act shall take effect immediately upon passage, and voter eligibility for the election shall be verified and adjusted in accordance with these new provisions.

Shameless are these "supplementary provisions." It hasn't been six months since the West District's reintegration, yet the Eastside councilors have rushed through these regulations to block the Syndicans from participating in the election, all to repress their voice for integration and afford Eastside powers more time to tighten their grip on the West District.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I heard they pressured you during negotiations, demanding the West District pay five years' worth of administrative costs if you want to shorten the verification period? Just the nerve of these people.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Donald has been bombarded with lawsuits from Nirvana as well. At this rate, it seems like the West District might be years away from having its own representative.
You feel a surge of indignation, yet Matilda, who's been with the Executive Committee on the frontlines of negotiations the whole time, remains perfectly composed.

speaker: Matilda
content: Just some desperate moves from the opponent. Stewart's crushed his reputation by stomping on the West District these years. He stands no chance at re-election, and once he's out, all these radical policies will be scraps of paper.

speaker: Matilda
