content: The renowned MBCC Chief was also present during this attack, which further indicates the identity of the forces behind this incident.

speaker: Pine
content: The Underground poured too many resources into this bloodbath. It's not just some smokescreen.

speaker: Pine
content: The kidnapped daughter might actually be the main act in this series of attacks.

speaker: Pine
content: A supposedly minor character pushed into the spotlight... There are two possibilities here: either the little girl has a greater say in the Stewart family than we thought, or... she's just a trigger to pull out someone way more crucial.

speaker: Host
content: That's... quite a wild guess, Miss Pine?

speaker: Pine
content: Heh, just a logical deduction. She might even be a Sinner—and we're all aware of how capricious their powers can be. She may look like a young girl, but for all we know, she could possibly be older than any of us.

speaker: Host
content: Some said she might know some secrets from the late Prime Minister.

speaker: Pine
content: During the cabinet explosion, they took out Stewart without breaking a sweat. If they were after political intelligence, why not just grill him for answers?

speaker: Pine
content: You saw it yourself—both that blowhard and the MBCC Chief showed up there. It must've been something big going on.

speaker: Pine
content: Or even more, it's like last year, all these strikes just another round of smokescreens to keep the departments busy, while an even bigger bombshell is waiting to drop...

speaker: Pine
content: Or maybe the Underground isn't the only one pulling the strings... But who else in DisCity could pull off things like this?

speaker: Host
content: M... Miss Pine?
Pine mutters to herself incessantly, her usual detachment entirely absent. Her words come increasingly faster, the growing excitement within sending a chill down the host's spine.

speaker: Pine
content: What if... there's another mysterious force I don't know yet, stirring things up from the shadows?

speaker: Pine
content: Hehehe...
As Pine lets out an eerie chuckle, the screen floods with comments. It's as though her enthusiasm is contagious, prompting the viewers to frantically type out their own theories.

speaker: Pine
content: Whatever they want, this is far from the end... The election drama is just beginning. Finally! Something to get my blood pumpin' again!

speaker: Pine
content: Now then... which party will make the next move, and who will be the target?

speaker: Host
content: Uh... Thank you, Miss Pine, for another fascinating sharing. Now, let's move on to our usual dose of trendy gossip.

speaker: Host
content: A 20-meter-tall Max King skydancer recently lands downtown, rising as a new urban landmark.

speaker: Host
content: Ms. Cavendish's debate performance smashed viewer records, her verbal showdown rivaling blockbuster shows.

speaker: Host
content: As attacks across the city escalate, shopping centers are rolling out huge sales of civilian weapons.

speaker: Host
content: Max King stars as a superhero in what might be the most outrageous campaign ad ever aired.

speaker: Host
content: A mystery poll reveals that over 90% of residents are indifferent to the outcome of the upcoming election.

speaker: Host
content: Candidates attract what might be the "youngest supporters" ever, as parents begin naming their newborns after the election hopefuls.
(Scene change)

03:47, November 29, N.F. 114
An FAC Base
In the early hours, FAC soldiers still diligently continue their patrol of the base. Apart from their weighty footsteps, not even a whisper can be heard throughout the entire facility.
Within the monitoring room, rows of screens exhibit live footage from around the base. The images remain stagnant, depicting everything as seemingly ordinary.
Suddenly, a static crackle breaks the oppressive silence. A faint blue light flickers briefly in the corner of a monitor screen, only to vanish without a trace shortly after.

Directly beneath the security camera, a dozen military machines stand motionless, deprived of power. But with the flickering of the blue light, their mechanical arms rise slowly into the air, emitting soft creaks...

█ In the aftermath of the "Crimson Obsequies", the repercussions of the cabinet attack continue to escalate. Despite efforts to regulate the dissemination of information, the rise in independent media engagement has considerably complicated the management of public opinion.

█ Analysis of the Underground Puppets collected from the scene suggests the orchestrators of both incidents are likely one single Underground group. This marks the Underground's first large-scale overt attack against Eastside's elite in years, indicating their target scope extends beyond the Stewart family.
█ Evidently, this is just the beginning. With the FAC unusually facing numerous restrictions during the election season, the situation risks further deterioration...

November 30, N.F. 114
Election Season Assaults
Joint Investigation Team
In a secure conference room, three people sit with thick stacks of documents before them.
The first person to finish sets down the report and starts drumming her fingers on the table, tap after tap.

speaker: Langley
content: What a show. The Underground sure knows how to spice up the Election.

speaker: Langley
content: I heard some FAC folks were at the scene. Seems like a touchy subject. Those old foxes giving you trouble?
She looks up at the veteran soldier across the table.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Me? What for? It's just two retired soldiers who left the service over a decade ago, working for their new employers. That's what any investigation will show.

speaker: Langley
content: Better be careful. They've got their eyes on you more than they do on the Underground these days.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Doesn't matter. We're not here for small talk, are we? Let's get to business.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: You've been to EDGE, then why didn't you request to postpone the election?

speaker: FAC Commander
content: After what has happened, voters across the city are in an agitated state. With in-person voting, polling stations will be jam-packed on election day. If the Underground decides to make any move, the consequences would be catastrophic.

speaker: Langley
content: Consequences? They're more afraid of what a delay would bring. It's our beacon's big show that happens once every four years. The world's watching this. If DisCity displays even a hint of vulnerability, the vultures will start circling.

speaker: Langley
content: Looks like we'll have to put in some overtime and catch our enemy quickly. So, Chief, how's the investigation shaping up?

speaker: Langley
content: I heard you lucked out and got a front-row seat for the second assault. What did you see?
Both leaders of the FAC and the 9th Agency turn their gazes toward the third person in the room—you, who has remained silent since entering.

speaker: Langley
content: ...Feeling nervous about having your first meeting with your old boss?

options: Indeed, please be gentle with me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There are many factors at play in these cases. I'm still trying to piece things together.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Is it related to the Underground's dark web and the new Puppet model? Right, those investigations do tend to eat up time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, the investigation on those Mania-related cases is still in process, but there's more to it than that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'd also like to approach it from another way, to see who might have the motive to exterminate David Stewart and all his families.

speaker: Langley
content: You're saying, there's someone else.
You nod.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Underground has always been discreet, pulling strings behind the scenes. Both the dark web and the Garden served as their tools, and they've gone to great lengths to leave no trace when triggering the Black Rings. This time, however, they're acting with no scruples.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now, given that the Stewart cabinet was never interested in controlling Mania, they should've posed no apparent threat to the Underground. But even so, they were murdered in such a brutal way...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well, as the heads of three anti-Mania departments, if we're still alive and kicking here, we must be terrible at our jobs. Apparently, the Underground thinks we’re less of a concern than the little Stewart girl.
Langley lets out a laugh while the commander remains expressionless.

speaker: Langley
content: Go on.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've heard that Stewart was quite radical in city matters. He probably made some formidable enemies, stood in someone's way, or learned things over the years that weren't meant to be known.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The stress of running for re-election could be taking its toll on him, leading to some erratic behavior. It's possible that someone viewed him as a threat and wanted him dead, with his daughter being targeted for the same reason.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They might've gained damaging information on someone, or the assailant just believes they know something.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It could be the Underground, or people who have dealings with them.

speaker: Langley
content: So, you think the Underground has weaseled their way into the top brass, and now you're playing detective all on your own?
...Sensing a shift in the atmosphere, you collect yourself and carefully consider how to address her pointed question.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, you tasked me with uncovering the truth, so I've been investigating those I find suspicious and have obtained some intelligence—
[Flashback: Banquet Scene]
[MK's portrait]

Max King, a notable personality in Eastside, having worn many hats—judge, musician, writer, explorer, and businessman. However, he is most recognized as a leading social media influencer, with his account "MK" commanding a massive following across all platforms.

After the Square Black Ring incident, he decided to redirect his business endeavors towards the West District. His subsequent declaration to enter the election race has garnered even greater public interest.
[Vale]

Adrian Vale, serving in the FAC until N.F. 103, after which he roamed within Syndicate before dropping off the grid for a period. Rumor has it that he met Max King during his lowest point, eventually becoming his assistant and butler.

As per Vale's service record, he participated in numerous pivotal operations throughout his service, garnering considerable merits and earning high esteem from his superiors. Notably, S9 was also a former FAC soldier who was discharged in N.F. 103.
Unlike Adrian Vale, S9 chose to stay in Eastside afterwards, taking up covert security work for the city's upper class.
For veterans like them, working as private security for influential figures is indeed a decent career path.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: I know some candidates are in a desperate situation. They might try to use you for their own ends.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Be careful, Chief. Steer clear of those politicians.
These words remind you of a recent memory—

speaker: Max King
content: Hey, no sweat! Fighting alongside you totally made this scratch worthwhile! I definitely got the better end of the deal!

speaker: Max King
content: We might not have much time together today, but one day, you'll see who I really am. For now, just remember one thing—

speaker: Max King
content: Your actions have ignited a fire in many hearts. In the near future, they will all stand with you as allies.

speaker: Bernadette
content: You think I have ulterior motives? That I'm seizing this chance to approach you, rope you in, and earn your trust to vote for me? That would be undignified, and unnecessary.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Since you don't have a liking for politicians like me, I won't trouble you beyond today. This is just a one-time personal request—to protect a child who has recently lost her loved one.
Both of them have approached you. Whatever they say, you've probably already been used as their pawn—not that it matters.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All this information is provided directly by those in the incidents and can be easily verified.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But whenever I try to delve into the death records of the cabinet attack or the guest list from the memorial service...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I keep being told that these VIPs and Eastside bigshots have special privacy privileges, and that I have no authority to inquire into their affairs.
As you say this, you shift your gaze towards Langley, who returns it with a smile.

speaker: Langley
content: Because investigating them is the 9th Agency's turf.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: May I ask if you've found anything?

speaker: Langley
content: No one has been confirmed to be involved so far. They're all too caught up in the election frenzy.

speaker: Langley
content: Oh, totally slipped my mind. She's the one who gave you the invite, isn't she? Don't worry, she's well aware she's under a spotlight. She'll play nice.
Her deliberately vague response makes it hard to verify whether they are truly "old acquaintances," as Bernadette Cavendish claimed, and even harder to discern her true intentions in approaching you.

speaker: Langley
content: Look, the 9th Agency holds the reins when it comes to probing these VIPs because our agents know their boundaries—skilled enough to gather intel, and discreet enough to keep secrets.

speaker: Langley
content: So save your breath trying to squeeze info out of me. After all, don't you already have your own little inside track?

speaker: Langley
content: The Stewarts are still hounding me about finding his missing niece, but strangely, I don't see any mention of this in your report.
Clearly, this inquiry is not a casual one. She's waiting for your answer.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: DNA tests have verified that the girl is indeed David Stewart's daughter. But she has no public records, and her mental state has consistently been unstable.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She has experienced significant suffering both before and after the attack. The trauma has led to a high fever, making her unable to communicate for now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Jelena was hired by then-Councilor Stewart in N.F. 107 and has been Elvira's caretaker for seven years. Prior to this role, she held positions at several educational institutions. Mania testing has verified her as an A-Class Sinner with a Catalyst Tendency.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: At the time of the cabinet assault, both she and Elvira were at David Stewart's private residence and did not leave.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: According to FAC records, Sable wasn't regularly discharged but rather dismissed from the FAC due to inadequate performance during an operation. After that, she was immediately recruited by Councilor Stewart.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since N.F. 103, Sable has served as Elvira's personal bodyguard.

speaker: Langley
content: That's all they told you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. It seems the late Prime Minister didn't place as much trust in them as one might assume. These three were kept hidden away because he saw them as nothing but stains on his reputation.

speaker: Langley
content: That's just their side of the story. Chief, if you're too nice to grill them, how about bringing them over to the 9th Agency?

speaker: Langley
content: I could give you a crash course in interrogation tactics.

speaker: Jelena
content: Please, do not hand us over to any other forces—be it the Stewart family, the 9th Agency, or the FAC. Don't let any of them come at her again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...That won't be necessary. I have my own ways of getting to the truth.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's also a name list that might interest you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They agreed to stay under my care, with certain conditions. I'll take full responsibility for my Sinners.
Langley takes the document from you, quickly scans it, and breaks into a smile.

speaker: Langley
content: Alright, chill out, I was just pulling your leg. Let them stay with you. It suits me just fine—might even be more effective with you at the helm.

speaker: Langley
content: I'm out. Got a long queue outside my interrogation room waiting for me.

speaker: Langley
content: Keep your witnesses well-protected, Chief. Many folks seemed jittery about that secret daughter's existence during my interrogations. That speaks volumes about her value.

speaker: Langley
content: Don't let her fall into anyone else's hands, and make sure she stays breathing.
After delivering her final words, she leaves promptly, likely with a multitude of tasks awaiting her attention.
As the meeting draws to a close, the FAC Commander-in-Chief also rises from his seat.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: FAC's main forces will be deployed to the DisSea frontline during the upcoming election month. Urban security will be jointly managed by MBCC and the Public Security Bureau.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Your adjutant has received all relevant data and permissions. Contact me if anything comes up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Commander, a moment please.
The Commander halts in his tracks, turning around to face you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There are still many questions about the attackers, and I need more information on the crime scene. I've heard about an incident within the FAC base yesterday—does it have anything to do with the cases? May I request an investigation?
The Commander's expression remains unchanged, but you can't shake the feeling of his prosthetic eye scrutinizing you.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: ...It's just some malfunctioning old equipment. No cause for alarm. FAC will take care of this.
You find the response far from satisfactory. You carefully weigh your words before finally speaking up again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...These incidents aren't just the Underground's doing—there are multiple layers of mystery at play here. Moreover, with the FAC forces receiving an unusual deployment order... Commander, could someone higher up be trying to—

speaker: FAC Commander
content: FAC will handle it. There's no need for concern.
Perhaps realizing his response might sound too harsh, he pauses for a moment before speaking again.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: Chief, you do have sharp instincts, but be careful not to let them lead you astray—especially in the shadows, where you can easily lose your way.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: These are sensitive times. Focus on your duties, and stay true to yourself. This is the only advice I can give you—protect yourself.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: And the citizens—their safety is in your hands now.
[Scene Change] Inside a vehicle
As you head back to the Bureau, you reflect on those words.
The investigation team maintains neutrality, just like your three agencies do. It's precisely because none of you have direct obligations to any faction that you were entrusted with this task.
But there's no doubt about it—you've sensed an enormous shadow looming over you. And now, more so than during any previous Mania crisis, you're closer than ever to the root of this darkness.

The 9th Agency, safeguarding secrets for <color=#fb9259>certain people</color>; FAC, deeply feared by <color=#fb9259>certain people</color>; and then there's MBCC and yourself, their definition of your roles still veiled... This case resembles a key, guiding you further into DisCity's depths, towards yet another shrouded mystery.
Engrossed in these thoughts, you suddenly realize the car hasn't moved for quite some time.

speaker: Driver
content: No, Chief. We're... stuck here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What...? Agh!
Before you can react, multiple hands suddenly start slamming against the window beside your ear.

speaker: Reporter A
content: Chief! It's the MBCC Chief!!! Stop him—!!
female_content: Chief! It's the MBCC Chief!!! Stop her—!!

speaker: Reporter A
content: Is it true that you attended the Stewarts' memorial service? Why did they invite you? There's something fishy going on with Prime Minister's death, right?

speaker: Reporter B
content: You allied with Max King, does it mean that the West District is now backing the MK Group? What does your boss say about your decision? Has the West District turned its back on the Cavendish family? Has Miss Matilda Cavendish officially broken ties with her family?

speaker: Rowdy Crowd
content: Are you also joining the fray? As a West District rep or on your own? What are your campaign strategies, and do your supporters align with your stance?

speaker: Rowdy Crowd
content: Chief! Chief!! Over here! This way!!
The door is violently wrenched open, and the crowd surges towards you like a horde of Corruptors.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ugh... Please calm down!! This is classified information. I can't talk about it. I won't—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What is going on here?!
By the time Bureau personnel arrive to scatter the crowd and escort you back to your office, half an hour has already elapsed.
Only now do you finally find out what has happened.
[Television]

speaker: Max King
content: Yes, during the Viers Mansion attack, the MBCC Chief and I worked together to organize rescue efforts and quell the unrest. I can't disclose the specifics, but yes, I'm referring to the legendary Chief ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Max King
content: I've been tracking his endeavors for a long time. Our perspectives align remarkably on matters concerning Mania, FAC, and issues within the West District. This incident has forged a profound bond between us, as we both aspire to change this city!
female_content: I've been tracking her endeavors for a long time. Our perspectives align remarkably on matters concerning Mania, FAC, and issues within the West District. This incident has forged a profound bond between us, as we both aspire to change this city!

speaker: Max King
content: What? ${PlayerName} stated he wouldn't interfere with the election right from the start? Oh sure, sure, let's just roll with that. But remember—actions speak louder than words. And more importantly, what do WE think when we look at him?
female_content: What? ${PlayerName} stated she wouldn't interfere with the election right from the start? Oh sure, sure, let's just roll with that. But remember—actions speak louder than words. And more importantly, what do WE think when we look at her?

speaker: Max King
content: Look at him, look at all those who are fighting like him. Our city may have lost its way, reality may have left you disappointed, but as long as we have people like them, we can still believe in change for our city.
female_content: Look at her, look at all those who are fighting like her. Our city may have lost its way, reality may have left you disappointed, but as long as we have people like them, we can still believe in change for our city.

speaker: Max King
content: My friends, ask your hearts—if they still yearn for something better, then step out of your homes and make your votes count! This is our chance to seize our destiny. If we wish to change our city, let it start with ourselves!

speaker: Max King
content: Staying passive won't pave the way to a brighter tomorrow. We must take part in shaping our own future. Believe, take action, and cast your vote for me! I am Ma—
[Sound of TV being turned off]
...So, he's been using you for publicity. It seems that you truly can't place trust in anyone running for election.

speaker: Wynn
content: WHO ON EARTH is voting for him?!

speaker: Wynn
content: I'm soooo mad! It's all Chief's doing, but he's taking all the credit and even rubbing it in our faces! And then he's even got the nerve to send you that message, saying he's going to visit you! Ugh! What a politician—so shameless! All this for votes!

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief, don't meet with him! You're too soft-hearted, and you're too easily fooled by people like that!
While Wynn keeps chattering away, your thoughts drift entirely elsewhere.
Your association with the mansion incident has been exposed, and there's no telling what complications this might further cause. You must find the real culprit, fast.
Right now, you desperately need leads, intel—anything at all.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Has Jelena provided any new information?

speaker: Wynn
content: Umm... no, nothing new after that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then arrange another meeting. I'll ask her myself.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief... You've already done enough for today. I think it's best if you take a break now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No need for that. There's still a lot on the agenda, and time is running short...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hold on... What's that?
On one of the monitor screens, you catch a glimpse of an unexpected figure.

23:39, November 30, N.F. 114
MBCC Underground Training Ground
The training ground is eerily quiet at midnight, yet the only person "training" there remains exceptionally elusive.
She's too small and thin.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...Bam.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...Bam.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...Bam.
You like shooting?
Startled by your sudden presence, she hastily withdraws her raised hands back to her chest.
Though she seems to have forgotten there was no actual gun in her hands, only fingers mimicking one.

speaker: Elvira
content: I... I wasn't...

speaker: Elvira
content: ...Eek!
As she tries to run away, she trips over her own feet and tumbles to the ground. When you move closer to help her up, she flinches a few more inches in fear.

options: Alright, I'll step back. Don't be scared.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you're hurt. You need to visit the infirmary. Should I get Jelena?

speaker: Elvira
content: Wait!
She hurriedly grabs your arm.

speaker: Elvira
content: I... I sneaked out... Please don't tell Jelena...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Alright, I won't tell her. Would you let me take a look at it?
Sensing no objection from her, you bring over a chair, help her sit down, and examine her injury.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It'll heal in a few days, but you'll need to hide it well. Otherwise, Jelena might notice when you get back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know how you feel. When I was young and found myself in trouble, I was also afraid of my mom finding it out and giving me a long, long lecture.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...Hee.
She lets out a quiet chuckle, only to quickly catch herself.

speaker: Elvira
content: Mm... That's not how it is... Jelena never lectures me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
options: Then, you don't want to make her worry?

content: The girl remains silent.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When your foot gets better, you don't need to sneak out in the middle of the night. Just come over and have fun whenever you like.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There are kids your age at the Bureau, and they love coming here too. They always have lots of fun. Maybe you could all become friends.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: —And we'll all help you keep it a secret from Jelena.
The girl's effort to hold back her laughter is endearing. You wonder what else you could chat about with her.
Before you can think of anything else to say, the air suddenly grows colder, and a voice emanates from behind you.
Hmm? What's there to keep from me?
You recognize Jelena's voice, though it somewhat lacks its usual warmth.
Footsteps draw near slowly. Her figure glides past you and halts in front of Elvira, bending down to examine the girl's injured foot.

speaker: Jelena
content: You should have been more careful... Take ample rest for the next few days. Sable will be here shortly to carry you back to your room.

speaker: Elvira
content: Jelena, are you angry with me?

speaker: Jelena
content: Yes, I am angry.

speaker: Jelena
content: I'm angry because you sneaked out to play at this late hour. Now, go back to your room.

speaker: Elvira
content: Will you go with me?
Jelena shakes her head with a smile.

speaker: Jelena
content: Chief still has some words with me.
As she speaks, Jelena rises and gently places her hand on your shoulder. Grasping her signal, you offer Elvira a reassuring smile.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: See you tomorrow.
Elvira hesitates for a moment before finally returning your smile. A few minutes later, the bodyguard comes to escort her away.
Now, only you and Jelena remain at the training ground.
Silver threads cut through the dim underground expanse. Amidst the quiet, you can sense power coursing through them, all the while with her hand remaining on your shoulder.
With a sharp chill, one thin, taut silver thread brushes against your neck. A single notion from its wielder would suffice to draw blood.
[CG 1]

speaker: Jelena
content: I heard you were called to a meeting today. Did they say anything? You look rather tired.

speaker: Jelena
content: Please tell me if you need anything. You will have my full cooperation.
Quickly gathering your thoughts, you start explaining the situation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Elvira is not a Sinner after all. I wish to protect her, but I can't keep her here forever. Your enemy will eventually find out that she's under my care.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: To protect you all, I must uncover the truth, find the culprit of those attacks, and eliminate the threat—as soon as possible. For this, I need your help.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The investigation isn't going well, and time is ticking away. Many are counting on you to be the breakthrough, while others fear you will become that breakthrough.

speaker: Jelena
content: Right, I suspected it was time they would put pressure on you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The 9th Agency wanted you, but I managed to deflect their request.

speaker: Jelena
content: What else can we do... We are not the Prime Minister's confidants, merely employees hired to cover up his scandals. He divulged very little to us, and I have shared all the information I know.

speaker: Jelena
content: Sorry that we couldn't be the linchpin in solving this case. We lack that level of influence, only insignificant as feathers in the wind.

speaker: Jelena
content: If there is no alternative, Chief, hand me over to them.

speaker: Jelena
content: This way, those people—be it the agents seeking to interrogate a witness or those with something to hide—will refrain from troubling you for a while.

speaker: Jelena
content: I'll buy you time.

speaker: Jelena
content: Sable will protect her. And...

speaker: Jelena
content: Won't you protect her, too?

speaker: Jelena
content: As for me, I am but a butler, an employee—replaceable at any time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is that so? But you seemed quite upset when I got close to her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You used your power on me. Were you afraid I might do something rash?

speaker: Jelena
content: Did I? I must have done it subconsciously.

speaker: Jelena
content: Forgive me, but I don't believe my power is potent enough to threaten you. You also have your shackles prepared just in case, don't you?

speaker: Jelena
content: Though I may have emotional moments at times, I always regain my composure and do what needs to be done.
You look at her for a long time before speaking again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're always so guarded—not just with me, but with everyone who approached you at the memorial service.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So, you would never truly trust me with Elvira. Even staying at the MBCC was just a desperate compromise.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But when the time comes that you can’t protect her anymore, what will you do?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Run from here? Leave the MBCC? Get away from Eastside? Or escape DisCity altogether?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Or perhaps... something more drastic?

speaker: Jelena
content: Are you going to stop us?

speaker: Choice
options: Why can't we work things out together?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since we're both taking a gamble here, wouldn't it be better to have allies? I can certainly bring something helpful to the table.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We've made a deal—you help me investigate and catch the real culprit, and I protect you three. I'm serious about it. You?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Were those words you just said out of desperation? You don't trust me 'cause you think I'm no different from the others?

speaker: Jelena
content: ...How rare to find one with such candor. It's been far too long since I've met anyone like you.
You gaze at her intently, waiting for her true thoughts to emerge.

speaker: Jelena
content: My apologies. I don't intend to act rashly, nor do I doubt your integrity.

speaker: Jelena
content: You saved the West District and defeated Black Rings—a true hero indeed. Elvira is incredibly fortunate to be under your protection.

speaker: Jelena
content: So please, feel free to give me your instructions. As long as no harm comes to El, I will do it in any manner possible.

speaker: Jelena
content: However, Chief, what we need is not a hero who can save the world. My only wish is to protect this one person from the storm.

speaker: Jelena
content: And that, more often than not, is so much harder than saving the world.
(Scene change)
Through the surveillance monitor, you watch as Jelena returns to Elvira's room. She exchanges a courteous nod with S9, who is standing guard outside, before entering.
Elvira wakes up.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...I'm sorry, Jelena. I didn't mean to make you angry.

speaker: Jelena
content: It's all right, El. I understand you are frightened.

speaker: Jelena
content: Would you like a real little handgun of your own?
El shakes her head vigorously and buries herself in Jelena's arms.

speaker: Jelena
content: Maybe next time, then.

speaker: Jelena
content: Good night.
The night holds the two inside in its embrace, accompanied by the soft, soothing singing of a lullaby.
[Black Screen]
In your office, you listen quietly, only to turn off the surveillance monitor long after the singing stops.
You then pick up your communication device and make several calls.
[Black Screen]

speaker: Max King
content: Hey, Chief ${PlayerName}! Haha, so you saw that show? My bad, go ahead and let me have it! Feel free to ring me up anytime to give me a piece of your mind!

speaker: Max King
content: But at this late hour, you must've called me for something, right?
[Television]

speaker: Host
content: Breaking news again! Max King has just made an emergency announcement, and this-this is absolutely massive! His approval ratings are skyrocketing!

speaker: Pine
content: ...Breaking news, huh. What the heck is that guy doing?

speaker: Max King
content: Yes, my friends, I'm back! The Viers attack incident turned out to be quite the adventure—not only did I cross paths with Chief ${PlayerName}, but I also connected with a vital witness.

speaker: Max King
content: Her existence links together all the Election Surprises, exposing the true darkness that touches every corner of our city. So, I must also conceal her identity until the investigation is complete—for her good of course.

speaker: Max King
content: However, citizens, worry not—this witness will soon be relocated to the 9th Agency, where she will be granted the highest level of protection while her valuable insights can be put to optimal use.

speaker: Max King
content: Hmph... Did you hear that, you vermin lurking in the shadows? Your days of hiding are numbered. The tide is turning...
Meanwhile, in a secluded corner of the city, a stick of incense is lit.

Amidst the swirling incense smoke, several shadowy figures emerge, their eyes locked on the man on the television screen, hanging on his every word and meticulously noting every individual he mentions.
And...
...Well, then... time for a little chat with them...

November 30, N.F. 114
WhiteSands Channel

The WhiteSands channel, typically ravaged by violent sandstorms, is unusually tranquil today. A mild breeze ruffles small cacti, as fine grains of sand cascade endlessly over the dunes. Even the sun overhead appears less blistering.
After an extensive journey, the Nirvana sand ship caravan is nearly at their rest stop. Despite the favorable weather, the entire crew finds themselves unconsciously picking up their pace.

Along the channel where the sand ships pass, a subtle vibration swiftly approaches from behind, rippling through the sand. The monitoring equipment promptly identifies the anomaly and sounds an alarm.

speaker: Nirvana Caravan
content: What's that sound?

The buzzing noise grows louder as the vibration intensifies. Without a moment to spare, the sturdy mechanical hull abruptly detonates, hurling metal shards and sand in every direction. In an instant, the entire caravan is engulfed by the blast.

speaker: Nirvana Caravan
content: Ahhh...!
The battle ends shortly after, just another accident in WhiteSands—mundane, routine, and overlooked.
DisCity, consumed by the heat of the election, remains oblivious to this "minor incident." No one has noticed this unknown threat that has seized the opportunity to infiltrate.
Before the sands can bury all traces, several figures emerge beside the caravan's wreckage.
Oh... some uninvited guests, I see. Now that they've ventured so deep into our territory, it would be terribly rude of us not to offer them a warm welcome.
She lifts her head, gazing in the direction of DisCity.

December 1, N.F. 114
Live at Eastside Tonight

speaker: Host B
content: Ladies and gentlemen, after four long years of waiting, the stage is once again lit for the DisCity Election as we enter the official voting month!

speaker: Host B
content: The cabinet attack has ignited discussions across the town! With the mastermind still unidentified, theories are swirling in every direction. This real-life mystery has stirred up a buzz around voting, pushing election fever to unprecedented heights!

speaker: Host B
content: Have our citizens finally risen from their political slumber, prepared to cast their votes in the pursuit of justice?! Will they expel the wicked wrongdoer and elevate a soul of integrity to the council throne?!

speaker: Host B
content: What? Even some are voting for the murderer? Saying "Stupid Stewart had it all coming"? Oh, our poor dear Prime Minister, you've finally made it to do the city some good—with your death, though...

speaker: Host B
content: Now, this is our Acting Prime Minister! How about a quick sound bite for us?
The host makes a gesture, and the director cuts to the live feed on cue.

speaker: Acting Prime Minister
content: ...While exercising your invaluable right to vote, everyone must remain vigilant and safeguard yourselves. Should you observe any suspicious individuals, please reach out to the Joint Security Committee and—

speaker: Host B
content: Alright, thanks for that! If only your predecessor had kicked the bucket sooner, you might've had a shot at running for office. Too bad luck wasn't on your side—you'll be out of that seat in a month.

speaker: Host B
content: But hey! At least you'll earn the prestigious title of DisCity's shortest-serving Prime Minister! Do watch your back though; we wouldn't want you setting another record for the shortest-living one, now would we?

speaker: Host B
content: Moving onto our next story—Pine, the famous online political commentator and conspiracy expert, has gone missing! Last time we heard from her, she was busy criticizing the election superstar MK, aka Max King. Now, could this be a case of speaking truth to power gone wrong—
[Bureau]

speaker: Nightingale
content: As the FAC's hands are tied during the election period, much of the security work has been handed over to the Sheriffs and us at the MBCC.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But our past efforts have primarily focused on fighting Mania and tracking down Sinners, so we lack experience in civic security, even with the FAC's secret help.

speaker: Nightingale
content: On top of that, training can be time-consuming and it's hard to find good instructors. So, Chief...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't we already have a former FAC elite right here?
When you bring up the training request to S9, she hesitates at first, seemingly reluctant to leave Elvira's side.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry, Jelena will still be with her. I promised her I'd keep your young lady safe.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We need you. Think of it as another way to protect Elvira.
Eventually, she agrees to your proposal.
On the training ground, S9 immerses herself fully in her tasks. Such military training, long absent from her life, seems to evoke memories of her past.
Meanwhile, somewhere out of her sight, a car is quietly slipping away from the Bureau.
[Scene Change] Inside a vehicle

speaker: Nightingale
content: The handover to the 9th Agency has been arranged. The vehicle will follow the established route. Even if S9 notices, we've prepared decoys, so she won't be a problem.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Focus on your mission and keep it under wraps. Don't worry about anything else.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Understood.
You end the call and look up at the two ladies before you.
They sit across from you in the car, the atmosphere thick with tension.
After a brief moment of silence, you avert your gaze from them and address the driver.
(Black screen, sound of the engine starting)
(Scene change)

Eugene recalls that earlier this morning, Wynn said he would have bad luck today and advised against taking on any arrest missions. That's why he specifically chose what he thought would be a safe assignment.
But he never expected what would happen next.

speaker: Eugene
content: Ugh—Let me go! Who are you?!
The liason agents who were supposed to come didn't show up. Instead, a group of men in suits block the road, force Eugene out of the car, and pin him roughly to the ground.
As one of the enemies reaches for the back door, Eugene lets out a furious roar.

speaker: Eugene
content: Stay away from them!!
The door opens, followed by the emergence of a handgun. The Chief of Minos stands defensively before the vehicle, shielding the two people behind.
The leading figure raises his hands in a gesture of feigned surrender, offering you a smile.

speaker: Man in Suit
content: Greetings, Chief of Minos. We have received confidential intelligence regarding a possible kidnapping or death threat to you, so we rushed here to guarantee your safety. Our apologies for any inconvenience this may cause.

speaker: Man in Suit
content: For the safety of you and the ladies behind you, perhaps we should have a talk somewhere else. Come with us, Chief?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I can protect myself. We don't need your help. And who exactly are you people?

speaker: Man in Suit
content: I'm sorry, but we can't say anything here. Your safety remains at risk, and this place is far from secure.

speaker: Man in Suit
content: If you won't go... then I'm afraid the two behind you will have to come with us instead.
As the man converses with you with a smile, his companions fixate on the two in the vehicle with predatory gazes, akin to hyenas coveting their prey.
You pause for a moment.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief! Don't go with them! I've sent a signal, and help will be here soon! Don't—ugh!
A forceful blow silences him. Your fists tighten with anger, taking a long moment to slowly unclench.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't hurt him.
With evident satisfaction, the well-dressed man opens the door of the luxury car for you.

speaker: Eugene
content: (Cough cough)... Chief... Don't...
You shoot Eugene a cautionary glance, silently advising him against doing anything rash.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you are not to hurt anyone.

speaker: Man in Suit
content: As you wish, Chief. This way, please.
Jelena's face turns deathly pale as she holds Elvira tightly in her embrace, as if to shield her from the sight of such raw malice.
Navigating through the intimidating crowd, you position yourself protectively in front of the two as you enter their vehicle.
They escort you to an upscale private club with an open-air section that offers a panoramic view of the entire city. You recall seeing it from photographs; it's quite a renowned establishment.
On the way up, you notice that over a dozen floors below have been entirely cleared out. Evidently enough, they have meticulously prepared for this.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Welcome to the most exquisite vista in all of DisCity. It is only fitting that a venue of such distinction plays host to your presence.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Take it easy, Chief. Have a shot, maybe?
You leave the offered glass untouched.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: MBCC is a department with limited authority, but this? You're directly challenging the city's security laws and undermining the authority of both the FAC and the 9th Agency.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've got some nerve. Who are you?

speaker: Negotiator A
content: We're just some nobodies who follow orders. Rest assured, we would never dare to cause you any harm.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Should we cause you any distress, or should any esteemed individuals raise concerns in the future, we stand ready to extend our most heartfelt apologies and provide recompense until your contentment is restored.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So you're saying, no matter what you do to me now, you have ways to smooth things over afterward, is that it?
The man responds with a noncommittal smile.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: It won't be unpleasant, hopefully. We just want to have a little chat.
He turns on the TV.

speaker: Max King
content: ...Not only did I cross paths with Chief ${PlayerName}, but I also connected with a vital witness.

speaker: Max King
content: Her existence links together all the Election Surprises, exposing the true darkness that touches every corner of our city. So, I must also conceal her identity until the investigation is complete—for her good of course.

speaker: Max King
content: However, citizens, worry not—this witness will soon be relocated to the 9th Agency, where she will be granted the highest level of protection while her valuable insights can be put to optimal use.
Following a prolonged silence, you are the first to speak up.

speaker: Choice
options: I have nothing to do with that man.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This isn't the first time he used me for vote rigging. If you're sent by Cavendish, then this whole thing is pointless.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I have no interest in interfering with the election. I've never aligned with any side, nor will I in the future. Let us go.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Ms. Cavendish would certainly appreciate your stance, but that's none of our concern.
Several figures in black swiftly put Jelena and Elvira under control.

speaker: Jelena
content: El!

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Hey—Easy now, Chief. Using your power here would be dangerous—we can't guarantee who these facilities might target, you know.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Please put away that secret weapon of yours.
You slowly withdraw the shackles.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That was just instinct. Do not push me—I'm sure you wouldn't want to see me lose control... Let go of them. Now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you want them muted, or do you want them to talk? Afraid they'll leak information that could be used against you?

speaker: Negotiator A
content: That is not what we are thinking of, but for others it might be.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Normally, no one cares about such gossip matters. But you know, during election season, everyone's a bit sensitive. We'd rather not give anyone ammunition for baseless speculation.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Now that everyone knows you have these ladies, and that you plan to hand them over to the 9th Agency... Just imagine what Stewart's enemies might do with that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What exactly do you want?

speaker: Negotiator A
content: We want to protect you... in an appropriate manner.
Not protecting, but manipulating; not seeking your support, but treating you as a tool, a puppet.
They gaze down at you with feigned humility. Behind their masks, you see countless unseen eyes, forever self-righteous.
Who are they? Human or beast? How can you discern their true colors?
Perhaps it's the influence of the anti-Mania field—you feel dizzy when suddenly, a voice cuts through, interrupting your thoughts.
Are you going to betray us?

speaker: Jelena
content: We gave you everything we could, ${PlayerName}. You promised to protect us—that was our deal.
Jelena's voice pulls you back to reality. Gradually, you gather your thoughts, your mind starting to clear.
You turn to face those men in suits.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's be honest. I know that Stewart had leverage over you as well. If I were you, I wouldn't let them fall into other's hands, either.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I guess you won't harm them or coerce them into anything—that could backfire. By keeping them under watch, they might prove useful down the line, becoming leverage in future negotiations.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But, I won't simply hand them over to you. I made a deal with them, so I have to ensure their safety.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: ...A deal? You're willing to risk so much just because of a deal?

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Chief, in our business, the noble-minded never survive.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They've provided crucial leads about the cabinet attack. That's why I'm willing to risk getting involved.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Likewise with Max King—he has promised them refuge once he stands atop. That's why I've stomached working with a politician, helping him gain some momentum.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I may not know about surviving in politics, but after everything I've been through, I've long given up on being "noble." Now, deals are the only thing I know.
The negotiator's face lights up with a contented smile.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Hahahaha... I should have picked up your approach more quickly.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Name your terms, please. What would it take to make you satisfied?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: First and foremost, ensure their safety, and no more handing them off to anyone else. That's the price for my guilty conscience.
Jelena freezes in astonishment. When she attempts to step forth, the surrounding guards obstruct her path.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Haha, now I see what you meant by "leverage." You're right—they are valuable indeed.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: You said you don't like politics, yet I dare say, Chief, you are exceptionally well-equipped for this circle.
Jelena trembles as she holds Elvira tightly in her arms, yet no one present seems to take notice of them anymore. The rooftop scene carries on in perfect harmony.

He waves his hand, prompting another man with a perfectly rehearsed smile to stride forward. The man swiftly lays out a set of presentation materials before you, complete with elaborate text and illustrations.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: You have no interest in money, surely, but we know you care for the West District. Nirvana has been stifling the new mine there, even pressuring Stewart to strip out Syndicans with a decree.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: While the actions cannot be changed, we can push for favorable policies moving forward. This could include industrial licenses, employment, social security benefits, and even pathways to citizenship.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: Ah yes, we can guarantee they get their voter eligibility one year early, that is to say, they'll have the right to participate in the NEXT election.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: Also, we've also got some dirt on Nirvana. We can make it a bit trouble for them, if you want.
...So they're not with Nirvana, you think.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: David Stewart is dead. The remaining candidates are both supportive of the West District—your intervention isn't needed. Sooner or later, Syndicans will find their own way forward.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Besides, I'm not a spokesperson for the West District. I'm just doing my job; my goals lie elsewhere.
The man's smile grows more genuine.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: Absolutely, I understand. Your ambitions surely reach far beyond something as small as the West District.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: We understand the weight of your responsibilities, and you certainly deserve a higher position, free from anyone else's thumb. Take... the FAC, for instance! You shouldn't have to answer to them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you saying that you can handle the FAC?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Heh, don't take me for a fool. If you had that kind of power, you wouldn't need to come to me with such a roundabout talk.
The negotiators flash sly smiles.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: Even the most robust walls have their vulnerabilities. We once had a close relationship with the FAC, so we are well aware of their weak spots. If backstabbing's what you want, we can make you a myriad of knives for that.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: Or perhaps there are other enemies you'd like us to... take care of?
During your brief silence, another person joins the conversation.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Read the room, would ya? Our Chief isn't even remotely interested—your propositions are far from appealing.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Chief, I know what you are capable of, and I'm aware that Paradeisos is backing you. With all of that, anything we bring to the table, you'd secure on your own in due time.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Let's talk about something DisCity can't offer you, Chief... Ever heard the saying about not having all your eggs in one basket?

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Investment in the Outlands—if you're interested, we could set you up with a whole little city of your own there. Just as a backup plan, you know, in case anything goes awry in DisCity.

speaker: Choice
options: ...That would be high treason against DisCity.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The 9th Agency would have my head for this. Is that what you're after, something to level against me down the line?!
Your response seems to please him. Sensing that he has gained the upper hand, he reclines in his seat with fingers interlaced.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Well, of course we all hope that the great DisCity continues to prosper for another century.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: But if we look at the bigger picture, Chief, even the common folk can see times are changing. The economy, governance, military power—everything's changing. Where there's risk, there's opportunity.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Many of the elites are already hedging their bets, moving assets to the Outlands. With DisCity's strong presence abroad, setting this up wouldn't be too hard now.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: But for people like you, with your exceptional prowess, Paradeisos's watchful eye can be quite the hindrance. We know, and that's where we come in.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: And we can help kill two birds with one stone here—once we relocate the two ladies, they'll be out of harm's way.

speaker: Choice
options: Can you really pull this off?

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Absolutely. Our employers boast a century-long legacy of influence. Their reach extends far beyond what you can see. Chief, this partnership promises mutual gain. We extend a cordial invitation for you to join us.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...That's quite a generous offer. The last point has piqued my interest, in particular.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: That's right—whatever you want, we can make it happen.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Our esteemed employers have built up considerable influence over time, Chief. It is with the utmost admiration that they regard you, and they would love to have you in our exclusive inner circle.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: And now, anything you want to know? Shall we make a deal?

speaker: Choice
options: Were you the ones who schemed the Underground attack?

speaker: Crowd
content: Hahahahaha!

speaker: Negotiator A
content: My sincerest apologies. Your devotion to work is truly commendable, Chief. However, such moves are unnecessary in our case—I'm sorry, but we are not the culprits.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Stewart was doing quite a decent job. We were, in fact, eager for him to continue his service for another term. Now with his death, regrettably, all our investments in him have gone to waste.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: Does this explanation sufficiently prove our innocence?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That’s valuable information—hard to come by. Maybe we should consider an intel exchange.
You observe a shift in their demeanor upon your mention of an exchange—there's now an underlying hint of impatience and doubt beneath their thin veneer of respect.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: During the West District crisis, the Department of Labor pushed the Outland Affairs Bureau to ease immigration policies, taking in "inferior populations" to fill service sector gaps. But as things escalated, stricter measures were hastily imposed, leaving numerous immigrants to die outside the city.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: About the FAC you just mentioned—under the instruction of certain leaders, they resorted to extreme measures several times to secure their budget, and consequently, the entire FAC had to face disciplinary action.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: In N.F. 103, the same group embezzled pension funds, leaving grieving families destitute. A few FAC members protested, only to be fired soon after. The incident caused quite a stir but was kept quiet until a resolution finally came about last year.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We don't even have to discuss the media, given that all news is monitored. Whenever there's a scandal or crisis, they'd just incite unrest in the West District or exaggerate Outland threats. But Mania? Completely off-limits—too risky to even mention.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even now, the media continues to demonize the satellite towns and West District, all so their puppet masters can grab a bigger piece of the pie and manipulate the narrative.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And...

speaker: Jelena
content: That's enough, Chief. You may drop the act now.

speaker: Jelena
content: They've proved your guess.
She calls out to you softly, her voice deep and gentle.
With each secret you reveal, the negotiators' expressions grow darker. The moment Jelena interrupts you, they exchange a glance and draw their guns without hesitation.

speaker: Negotiator A
content: It is truly regrettable, Chief. We did intend for collaboration. However, you have stumbled upon some things that you're not supposed to know.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Get rid of them, all three. Dump the bodies at any of the Underground attack sites.
The bodyguard behind you steps forward, attempting to press a gun to your head. However, an invisible force knocks the weapon from his grasp just as ear-splitting alarms start blaring.
The silver wig atop the young girl's head suddenly flies off, unveiling her own steel-blue hair beneath.

speaker: Hecate
content: Leave the rest to me.
As planned, the moment Nightmare charges into the crowd, Jelena's silver chains smoothly pull you behind her.

BOOM! The roar of a hand cannon echoes through the air as muzzle flashes burst from multiple weapons, unleashing a barrage of fire in this direction. It's your allies, firing from the building across the street.
In the midst of exuberant shouts, machine gun fire pursues the panicked men in suits, the bullets snapping at their heels like whips.

speaker: Negotiator B
content: Aaaahhh—! Heeelp!!

speaker: Negotiator A
content: W-who else is there?

speaker: Max King
content: Chief!! Are you all good?!! We've rented out the building across the street to back you up!!

speaker: Max King
content: Careful with your shots, Adrian! Don't hit Chief. I'll go get the chopper!
Max King's concern proves unwarranted as each machine gun maintains flawless accuracy. Only the negotiators, caught in the crossfire, stand frozen in place, their faces drained of color with fear.

speaker: Vale
content: Chief, the Bureau's reinforcements have arrived as well. You have our full support. Please handle the threat before Master King arrives.

speaker: Vale
content: Mr. King's always impulsive. Any harm befalling him could impact the election.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: How—how did they know our location?! We've checked all the comms... You have a tracker on you?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, your examination was quite thorough. I couldn't have brought a tracker in. But I do have something else up my sleeve.
As you speak, you unleash your shackles, letting the sirens continue their wail.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They know I have shackles, but they seem unaware of the sensing ability. This will narrow down our list of suspects quite a bit.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thanks for your leads, Mr. Kidnappers. Now it's time to surrender. In return for your hospitality, let's have a nice, long chat back at the office.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The 9th Agency has been waiting for you eagerly.

speaker: Negotiator C
content: Th-they paid me to do this!! This has nothing to do with me!!

speaker: Eugene
content: Give me a heads-up about planned ops next time, will you, Chief...? I really thought you'd been captured! I was scared out of my mind!

speaker: Hecate
content: It was thanks to your convincing reaction that we managed to deceive them. Thank you, Captain Eugene.

speaker: Eugene
content: ...You're welcome, but let someone else do it next time maybe?

speaker: 9th
content: You did an excellent job too, Hecate. None of them suspected a thing.

speaker: Hecate
content: I've observed Elvira for a long time. I know how to do her.

speaker: Hecate
content: All I had to do was hide in Jelena's arms.

speaker: 9th
content: Alright, alright, would any of our brave ones be willing to drop by the 9th Agency and make a statement? The boss is waiting.
Everyone gets out of the car, the negotiators being escorted to the Bureau first. After a moment's thought, you walk toward the front seat.
The car window rolls down, and the man inside flashes you a bright smile.

speaker: Max King
content: This is our second time working together, always spot-on! Ever thought about becoming a permanent member of my team?

speaker: Max King
content: Whether you're out to uncover the truth, shake up the city, or simply protect someone—having a Prime Minister by your side could always smooth things out.
Your response escapes your lips almost reflexively.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As you've seen, I'm easily ticked off. Political games just aren't my thing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You want to know more about the West District, right? I've recommended some trustworthy friends from the Executive Committee to Adrian. Maybe you can sort something out with them. As for me...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm knee-deep in my cases now, all the while having a bunch of secrets to keep. You wouldn't want a partner who can't shoot for something wild, would you?

speaker: Max King
content: ...I could really use your help right now. But hey, what can I say... There's always next time!

speaker: Max King
content: Next time, when you've wrapped up your cases and I've won the election, we can talk about working together again. Great minds always find their way back to each other.
You smile.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Honestly, I know nothing about the election, nor do I want to. That position has never seemed to make any difference in the things I truly care about. If it really holds the value you say...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then please win and prove yourself by making real changes. Who knows? By then, I might be the one not letting you go.

Max King smiles. It could be just your imagination, but the typical self-importance in his expression appears to have softened slightly. His gaze shifts to the road ahead, fixed on something in the distance.

speaker: Max King
content: Chief, I've never doubted once that I would make my dreams come true and change this city. But it's only when I walk alongside you that this vision feels closer than ever before, almost within reach.

speaker: Max King
content: So, as long as I haven't thrown in the towel, I'll keep coming back to you.
You shrug and turn to his reliable right-hand man in the driver's seat.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Always such a bullhead, is he?

speaker: Vale
content: Hehe, don't worry. I've got his back.

speaker: Vale
content: This world needs Master King's vision, and I'll make sure to lift him to his rightful heights.

speaker: Max King
content: Until next time, Chief! Feel free to reach out if you need anything. We're friends now, after all.

speaker: Max King
content: And even if you don't jump on board with the campaign, you're still a DisCitizen. Just cast your vote! Your vote would mean a lot to me.

speaker: Choice
options: That depends on you, not me.

content: You exchange a final handshake before his limo glides away into the distance.
Now it's just you and one other person remaining. She has been silently observing you with a faint smile, perhaps since only moments ago, or possibly for a while now.
Jelena freezes in surprise, clearly caught off guard by your sudden display of pride.
But she swiftly regains her composure, her smile blossoming in the sunlight.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Yes, great progress indeed.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well, if only things could continue to go this way...
You gesture politely to invite her back to the Bureau, but someone has already come out to greet both of you.
Elvira rushes straight into Jelena's embrace. You step back, returning the butler to her young lady.

02:13, December 2, N.F. 114
MBCC Chief's Office
Happy moments are always fleeting. After victory comes the arduous task of sifting through intelligence reports.
Fortunately, you're not alone in working overtime.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They're not prioritizing the West District. We can probably rule out the chances of them being from Nirvana, or those looking to get a piece of Nirvana's pie.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They have ties to both the FAC and the Outlands. Hmm... not many clues here, but let's make a note of it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They were aware of shackles but not their sensing ability, which led to their defeat during the kidnapping. So it can't be any MBCC moles, or personnel from the 9th Agency and FAC.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Plus, there's that private club and the arrested negotiators. We might uncover something unexpected from these leads.

speaker: Jelena
content: What about the satellite towns? When you brought them up, two of them in particular looked conspicuous.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're right. Okay, now that's plenty of leads here to keep the 9th Agency occupied for a while. The agents were pretty happy, saying our operation was a great success.

speaker: Jelena
content: That's great. You've done very well, Chief.
Perhaps out of habit from her time with Elvira, Jelena reaches out as if to pat your head.
You instinctively draw back. Jelena realizes her gesture might be inappropriate, her hand frozen in mid-air. The moment lingers between you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It was all thanks to your help with the preparations the night before. The information you shared all proved effective in probing them, also putting me in the right mindset about how far they could go.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's just this one thing I've been curious about...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: During our previous sessions in the interrogation room, you never brought any of this up. Why the sudden change of mind?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You also mentioned that the Prime Minister never shared his work with you. So, where did all this information come from?

speaker: Jelena
content: Let's just say I wasn't entirely truthful before. After seeing how dependable and trustworthy you were that night, I decided to share all the intel I'd been withholding.

speaker: Jelena
content: See? I truly do trust you now.

You are eager to delve deeper, particularly about the origins of her intelligence, but just then, the office door creaks open slightly. A figure peeks through the doorframe, eyes fixed on both of you.
Elvira seems less timid now, her eyes carrying a hint of silent reproach.

speaker: Jelena
content: Yesterday, you whisked me away while Sable was in training. El has been quite unsettled by it.

speaker: Elvira
content: ...Jelena, it's bedtime.

speaker: Jelena
content: Mmm... Actually, I...
Found you.
Another figure peeks out from the doorframe—it's Hecate, whose sudden appearance startles Elvira.

speaker: Hecate
content: You agreed to the synchronization training. The first body double op only succeeded because no one there knew you. Information about you will spread, and our luck may not hold out then.

speaker: Hecate
content: Come with me, let's optimize the next operation plan.
Elvira appears clearly reluctant.

speaker: Elvira
content: I don't want to...

speaker: Hecate
content: This is scheduled. I asked and you agreed. And don't disturb Chief at work.
Despite their shared youth and delicate frames, it's evident that Elvira is no match for an A-Class Sinner. In the end, she's gently lifted away by Nightmare invisible to her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Hecate just isn't good with words. She's actually very gentle.

speaker: Jelena
content: Hehe, I think they’ll get along well. Hecate is so calm and quiet, which helps El feel less anxious around her. This way, she can gradually learn to cope with the outside world.

speaker: Jelena
content: She cannot remain by my side forever. Engaging with peers her age is a precious opportunity. I simply wish she could make some friends.
Jelena watches the lively departure of the two with a gentle smile playing across her face.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You hope Elvira can make friends, and live a happier life here?
She comes back to herself, considers what you said, and responds with nothing more than a gentle smile.
The situation is far from optimistic. Your brief moments of finding light in dark times must end now—it's time to get serious again.

Urban attacks persist despite a decrease, driven by Puppets inciting Mania among crowds. The 9th Agency has dismantled several hidden sorcery installations, but these were all pre-planted traps—the mastermind behind it all unknown to us.

At this point, they have finally begun exhibiting traces of the familiar Underground style. However, this development strikes you as too deliberate, almost as if the enemy is purposely toying with you all.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Do you intend to delve deeper?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nothing is certain until we catch the real culprit behind the cabinet attack.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Besides... While we've managed to lure out a group after Elvira, they're not exactly what I expected. Those who would ally with the Underground, assassinate the councilors so brutally, and attack the mansion—they'd never be willing to sit down for a talk.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Looks like the Prime Minister's position draws a lot of hate, and there's no shortage of people who want to get rid of you two all along with him. I'll have to check them one by one.

speaker: Jelena
content: The threat has diminished. No one's in jeopardy, and the culprit has been cautioned. They are unlikely to act again.

speaker: Jelena
content: But if you press on, they may think of it as a declaration of war. What do you think they would do then?

options: Even better if they dare to make a move.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That would save me the trouble of tracking them down. I'll be waiting.
Your words draw a bitter chuckle from her.

speaker: Jelena
content: You're still hiding your wound from your adjutant, aren't you? If she knew they dared to harm you, she would never endorse this plan.

speaker: Jelena
content: Next time, it won't be a mere trivial injury.
Having noticed genuine concern cross her face, you quickly drop your solemn demeanor and opt for a light-hearted tone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is this how a top-notch butler behaves professionally? Don't worry about me—just focus on Elvira. I'll manage just fine, Jelena.

speaker: Jelena
content: You made a promise to protect El. It wouldn't be responsible for you to walk away now, right?
Ah... That familiar sense of overprotection.

Your adjutant, colleagues, and even Hecate sometimes act this way—almost everyone who cares about you does. But eventually, they can only yield to your persistence. After all, you're the Chief, and there will always be times when you must step forward.

However, Jelena stands apart. Talk of duty is merely her method of convincing others. Your rank holds no significance to her—she only wants to keep you safe, as if you are still just a child in her eyes.
But in the end, you are not Elvira.

options: Thank you for trusting me as one of your own.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But if a few scratches could scare me off, I'd have no right to talk big about protecting you all. Look—
You roll up your sleeve to show the scars on your arm.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm not that fragile. I'm not just a chief; I'm also a fighter, trusted by my comrades in action. Experience has taught me that the more perilous the situation, the less space there is for hesitation, especially when you want to protect something.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm not sure what this new era of peace may look like, but from the past I know, anyone seeking something has to be ready to fight for it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Sure, most of the time you only see me taking cover behind Sinners. But I've also taken bullets in the West District, right here—
You point to a spot on your body with a grin.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm a tough one to kill, so don't worry. You can put more trust in me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even if things go south, I'll have contingency plans ready for all of you.
She remains silent for a long while, her bowed head veiling her emotions.
She raises her hand and gently touches your supposed "bullet wound," where you randomly pointed to, her fingers brushing against your shirt.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Here?
Well... actually... it's not.

Even though the scars remain, you haven't given them much thought in a long time, so much so that you've forgotten their precise locations. When questioned unexpectedly, your previous assurance wavers.
...Maybe it's the guilt of telling a little white lie catching up to you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Caught a bullet, spent half a year in recovery, then bounced right back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: During your time in Eastside, you might have seen many councilors living their pampered lives. But I'm different—I'm younger, and much more thick-skinned.

speaker: Jelena
content: You’ve suffered more injuries than the ones I can see, haven’t you?

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Where else?

...You find yourself at a loss for words. No one has ever asked about your scars with such genuine concern before. After all, you are the <color=#fb9259>Chief</color> everyone looks up to, always dependable and tough.
But in Jelena's eyes, you are something else entirely.
As if grasping your pretense, she refrains from further inquiries. Her gaze lowers as her fingertips trail across your shirt, softly skimming over scars that even you yourself had forgotten.

speaker: Jelena
content: Had these wounds taken a slightly different turn, Chief, you might not have been here today.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...But I pulled through. I don't regret stepping onto the battlefield. Without these scars, I wouldn't be who I am today.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We all run into obstacles that seem impossible to overcome. Believing you can evade them at all times is just wishful thinking of a child. When there's no way to retreat, you grit your teeth and press on... And maybe that's just what makes you grow up in the end.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's a young girl once told me that what doesn't kill her makes her stronger—guess that's what I'm getting at. She's also a tough one, even more so than I am.

Jelena listens in silence, her gaze fixed on you. A peculiar, unfamiliar sensation washes over you as those lake-blue eyes seem to melt away your barriers, leaving you frail and exposed, almost as if—
You quickly catch yourself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I mean, you can trust more in Elvira too. She is really something special.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I think she went to practice shooting alone in the training room so that you wouldn't have to worry anymore. Perhaps it was also her way of protecting you—back then, you were so visibly anxious that you couldn't even hide it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: From such a young age, she has already learned to cherish her loved ones, and she's willing to find her courage for all of you. One day, she'll grow up to be someone strong, strong enough to make you proud.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Have a little more faith in her, too.
Jelena remains silent. Instead, her fingers gravitate towards your recent wound. The injury still raw, your body instinctively tenses—a reaction that doesn't escape her notice.
She offers you a faint, strained smile and decides to follow your change of subject.

speaker: Jelena
content: I'm aware of how resilient she is.

speaker: Jelena
content: But even the strongest people still feel pain when they're hurt.

speaker: Jelena
content: Watching her endure all of that, seeing her tears of pain run dry... Even though I know she’ll make it and grow stronger, part of me still longs for a reality where none of this had to happen.

speaker: Jelena
content: If the journey to growth means walking such a painful path... I'd rather she stay an innocent child forever, never having to grow up.

Recognizing the naivety in her words, she shakes her head with a self-deprecating smile. After finishing bandaging your wound and adjusting your coat with a few gentle pats, she asks in a casual tone, as if attempting to change the subject.

speaker: Jelena
content: Wouldn't your parents feel the same way?
Your attempt to evade the question comes too late, and as you finally gather your thoughts to respond, the words catch in your throat.
Jelena takes in every detail of your reaction.
She fixates on you, her gaze unwavering, as the unfathomable haze in her eyes finally clears. What remains are depths of sorrow in her blue eyes, profound as deep waters.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...I see... You've been through a lot...
She extends her arms slowly, pulling you into her embrace.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
