content: ...I'm not a child anymore.

speaker: Jelena
content: Mm, I know...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Elvira will also grow up just fine. There's a bright life awaiting her ahead, because she is surrounded by people working hard to protect her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Both you and I will protect her.

speaker: Jelena
content: I know...

speaker: Jelena
content: Thank you...
[Dark Web - Shadow Protocol 2]
- The agents have already traced their way to me, all thanks to the failure last time. Being kind-hearted really doesn't pay off in the end.

- Looks like it's about time to teach them a lesson. That candidate is just a nobody; should be a breeze to handle. Just pave the path for Cavendish. - But the other one... He's backed by someone in Paradeisos.
female_content: - Looks like it's about time to teach them a lesson. That candidate is just a nobody; should be a breeze to handle. Just pave the path for Cavendish. - But the other one... She's backed by someone in Paradeisos.

content: - It's fine. There's no Black Ring anymore, he's not as crucial now. As long as someone takes the fall, Paradeisos won't make a fuss. They'll eventually come to terms with it, as they always do. - No need to go overboard, though. A simple warning will do. We act before the next gathering, agreed?

They'll eventually come to terms with it, as they always do. - No need to go overboard, though. A simple warning will do. We act before the next gathering, agreed?

speaker: News
content: The electoral landscape shifts again as December Surprises unfold, with a new revelation from the Judicial Inspection Bureau.

speaker: News
content: Max King, one of the election candidates, is embroiled in campaign finance irregularities. Compelling evidence and witness accounts point to questionable funding origins, with allegations of illegal fundraising from the Outlands.

speaker: News
content: The Prosecutor's Office has initiated legal action, with the Acting Chief of the Outland Affairs Bureau detained by the 9th Agency for further investigation.

speaker: News
content: The upcoming election holds critical significance for DisCity's security. With just over two decades of independence from Outland interference, the recent reintegration of the West District highlights the urgent need for heightened vigilance against potential Outland infiltration.

speaker: News
content: In response to these potential charges, Max King's campaign office is actively engaging in legal protocols, denouncing them as a targeted smear campaign orchestrated by their rival. Nevertheless, this legal battle is poised to significantly impact the election dynamics.

speaker: News
content: Meanwhile, Councilor Cavendish's approval ratings are on the upswing. The Stewart family has verified that the MBCC Chief gained access to their estate through an invitation from Cavendish, and their collaborative intelligence efforts effectively thwarted the second large-scale attack during this election season.

speaker: News
content: This news, combined with Max King's recent statements, has sparked further discussions online. Public trust in Councilor Cavendish has seen a general increase...
[Cavendish Residence]

speaker: Bernadette
content: Things must be quite dire on your end. What made you come here instead of focusing on your allies during this pivotal time?

speaker: Bernadette
content: Or, do you no longer have an ally, Mr. King?

10:00, December 3, N.F. 114
An FAC Base

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Excuse me. This is S9, Prime Minister Stewart's bodyguard and a distinguished former FAC soldier. She's been recruited by the MBCC to lead urban security training for contingencies during the election period.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: However, she's still using an implant model from a decade ago, which is rather outdated now. So I'm here to request a technical upgrade for her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ensuring citizens' safety during the election period is a crucial responsibility, and we really need her expertise for this task.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: No problem. This is our shared responsibility. I'll make the prep right away.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've heard about a recent attack on this base by unknown forces. I'd like to investigate the scene.
You brace yourself for a dismissive response, but the soldier falls silent for a moment. Then, to your surprise, he agrees to your request.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: This way, please.
Power hasn't been restored to the area yet. You advance through the darkness with only flashlights to guide you. An ominous current of air brushes past, carrying with it a faint metallic scent.

To your growing unease, as you venture deeper into the site, your flashlights and earpieces suddenly begin to malfunction. The power fluctuates erratically, causing the lights to flicker in and out of darkness.
Despite the malfunctioning equipment, you finally reach the origin point of the anomaly: an electronic door that has remained completely deadlocked to this day.

The electronic door fails to activate. Inspections reveal no internal or external damage, and no signs of forced entry are found at the site. The situation appears highly suspicious, suggesting potential involvement of Mania forces.
You shift your gaze toward the FAC soldier. He shakes his head and produces a Mania detector, clearly prepared for this very possibility.

You take readings at several locations, yet the indicators reveal no traces of Mania contamination. If a Sinner or any Mania-related forces were present, there would undoubtedly be residual Mania with significantly higher readings.
Unless the attacker has obtained purification technology far beyond the FAC's knowledge—though that notion is deemed impossible.

Therefore, the FAC's ultimate conclusion categorizes this event as a "mechanical malfunction." Just like this electronic door, they assert that the machinery was impacted by some inexplicable force, underwent minute alterations, and led to the berserk behavior of several combat units.
Although there are signs of combat among the mechanical units at the site, these marks are surprisingly subtle, almost as if someone intentionally tried to conceal them.
Who could be fighting here...?

During the investigation, you uncover some evidence. It appears that malfunctioning cyborgs or machine units were present here and clashed with the FAC's security system. Nonetheless, there is no indication of Mania or involvement of the Underground Puppets.
The FAC left some suspicious traces at the scene untouched, yet thoroughly erased the signs of combat. Why did they do that?
If it was just their own mechanical units going berserk, why would the FAC withhold information from you? Could this be related to the pressure they've been put under during the election period?

options: I'd like to check those malfunctioning units.

content: The FAC will conduct the investigation internally and share the report with the Bureau when it's complete. This is the Commander-in-Chief's order.

content: ...Chief, I believe the Commander has his reasons. I hope you can understand.

speaker: FAC Commander
content: ...It's just some malfunctioning old equipment. No cause for alarm. FAC will take care of this.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Though he never says it directly, the Commander holds you in high regard and always instructs us to fully support your work.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: He's been worried about you lately, telling us to bolster security for you and the MBCC within the limits of our authority. There's a lot he keeps unsaid, but I believe that, too, is his way of protecting you.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Chief, there might be foes even more perilous than Mania that lurk in the dark. We are in a troubled time, so please take good care of yourself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Take care of yourselves as well.

Her built-in communicator suddenly chimes. She opens the channel, projecting the text onto the visor of her mask.

<color=#fb9259>Jelena:</color> How are things going? I hope it's not dangerous.
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> Problem solved. But this won't be the end of it.
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> If you really want to ensure ${PlayerName}'s safety, get those who are targeting him and take them down.
<color=#fb9259>Jelena:</color> I know. I'm working on it, but it takes time. Until then, I still need your help.
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> I only wish to protect El. Besides, I still don't understand why you decided to entrust El to him.

speaker: Elvira
content: The bodyguard... will live with us too? That means she's family, right...?

speaker: Elvira
content: For my birthday... will you celebrate with me?

speaker: Elvira

speaker: S9
content:
<color=#fb9259>S9:</color> ...I see. Protecting that Chief means protecting El.

An outdated model from N.F. 103. Not even worth salvaging.

[Cavendish Residence]

The two candidates sit across from each other, with Councilor Cavendish letting the butler serve tea to the guest. Sunlight streams in through the windows, casting a warm glow over the room. She leisurely sips her tea, her gaze fixed on the man seated opposite her.
Then, a smile of sympathy graces her face.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I know you are up against a formidable enemy. This recent assault is particularly devastating—a coordinated strike almost from every corner. It seems they've timed this moment to break you entirely.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Quite overwhelming, isn't it? You may have been a seasoned businessman, but when it comes to politics, you're practically an amateur, still figuring out the playbook.
She delicately sets her teacup down and locks eyes with Max King, exuding perfect composure.

speaker: Bernadette
content: To be frank, I admire what you bring to the table. DisCity is approaching a critical turning point, and you could very well be an exceptional leader. This city needs someone like you—and if there's anything you need, I can help.
Her kind gesture, however, receives no friendly response. Max King leaves the teacup untouched, fixing his opponent with an icy stare.

speaker: Max King
content: Drop the act. Your attempts to undermine me are just stepping stones for your own power grab. Normally, I wouldn’t concern myself with your scheming. I'd just fight you to the bitter end.

speaker: Max King
content: But you've crossed the line this time. How could you stoop so low as to get Adrian involved and use him to threaten me?

speaker: Max King
content: I had respect for you. Your niece made a real impact in the West District, and you, yourself, also displayed integrity. You didn't hesitate to speak up when Stewart was knee-deep in his shady dealings.

speaker: Max King
content: For a person of your stature to side with special interests is one thing, but to stoop to those underhanded tricks? Do you have no shame, Councilor Cavendish?

speaker: Bernadette
content: You're insinuating that I orchestrated these schemes against you... Show me your evidence?
Her calm words instantly ignite his fury.

speaker: Max King
content: Evidence?! That evidence will find its way to court soon. I am here to appeal to whatever conscience you've got left!

speaker: Bernadette
content: Heh, you seem to have misunderstood. I'm just expressing my surprise.

speaker: Bernadette
content: It's quite astonishing that even with your life on the line, you still fail to identify your real enemy, instead wasting your precious time on me.

speaker: Max King
content: ...What do you mean?
[Mood shifts]

speaker: Bernadette
content: For now, I'm on the stage just the same as David Stewart was. We're both handpicked "representatives" pushed into the limelight.

speaker: Bernadette
content: He was the perfect choice. With no political allies of his own, he had to pledge absolute loyalty to the powers to secure his position. This explains his fervent dedication and radical stance—qualities that made him a far more fitting representative than I.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Had he lived, his backers would have ensured his re-election regardless of his waning popularity. Unfortunately, his untimely passing left them in a scramble to find a fitting replacement in time.

speaker: Bernadette
content: So, between you and I, they had to settle for the lesser evil. Your presence actually cast me in a more favorable light in their eyes. And well, here we are.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Getting rid of you is someone else's job. I'm just here to siphon away your votes. They don't need me to get my hands dirty—I have to maintain a clean image.

speaker: Max King
content: Save your excuses. You've all had your fill of backroom deals and power plays. This election is meant to change everything. It's not your private little game anymore. The next leader will be chosen by millions of DisCitizens.

speaker: Bernadette
content: That's hardly fair. If the common people have the right to choose, shouldn't the elite also be entitled to that same privilege?

speaker: Bernadette
content: Everyone simply votes for the one who aligns with their interests. You're a champion of the common folk, riding the waves of change with your band of idealists. You want to reshape the city, redistribute resources, and benefit the masses—that is indeed admirable.

speaker: Bernadette
content: "Unite all who desire change"—when you choose this slogan, you should've known what kind of allies you were seeking, and what kind of enemies you were making.
Though equally seated on the sofa, Bernadette's demeanor looms over her political rival as if she is gazing down upon him from a higher vantage point.

speaker: Bernadette
content: By siding with the powerless to take the pie from the powerful, you should have been ready, and you should have thought things through—what others are capable of, and how they will strike back.

speaker: Bernadette
content: That right-hand man of yours understands this far better than you do.

speaker: Bernadette
content: That's why while you keep picking fights and making enemies, he has no choice but to work tirelessly building your defenses—even if it means seeking help from the Outlands.

speaker: Max King
content: ...You mean Adrian?

speaker: Max King
content: Adrian would never collude with the Outlands. He has no reason to! I know him better than anyone. Don't you dare slander him to my face.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I am complimenting him. Mr. Vale seems to be the only clear-headed person in your naive little campaign team. Surely you didn't think your modest fortune alone could sustain an election campaign?
With a faint smile, Bernadette gestures for her butler to refill Max King's tea.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Running for election needs money, but all legitimate major fundraising channels have closed their doors to you. Your personal wealth? Please. Not even ten fortunes like yours could cover it. How else could he finance your grand crusade without finding alternative means?

speaker: Bernadette
content: Truly, against a retired veteran with ties to Syndicate like him, concocting an accusation would be child's play. They could pin anything on him—extortion, smuggling, bribery. The prosecutors opted for the Outlands part simply because it would sell better in the news.

speaker: Bernadette
content: And the public opinion you've built your triumph on? Even more susceptible to manipulation. A mere handful of media outlets, the reiteration of select narratives... and your standing could collapse in a single night.
Max King meets her words with palpable contempt.

speaker: Max King
content: Extortion, smuggling, bribery... Was that why you took Adrian away? For these charges?

speaker: Max King
content: No way. The Adrian I know is the most upright person, an FAC veteran with a rock-solid conviction like no other. He supports me because he believes in my vision to change this city for the better.

speaker: Max King
content: Sure, he has ties to Syndicate, so what? The suffering in the West District, the shadows over our city—it's all your doing. But Adrian, like me, sees a path to change. Change that's already happening. He's got more honor than any of you, so don't you dare play your usual dirty games with him.

His words ring with indignation, yet the uncertainty in his expression already betrays his true feelings, and Bernadette finds it almost amusing.
—He doesn't even understand his own right-hand man, let alone grasp the true reasons behind his rise to prominence.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Eastside isn't buzzing because your people believe your ideals. It's stirred up because this election makes for good headlines—and a handful of media channels are all it takes.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Mr. Vale is acutely aware of all this. If it were you in custody, he'd be here this very moment, pleading on his knees, willing to sacrifice anything and everything just to convince me to release you.

speaker: Bernadette
content: That's the difference between you two, Mr. King—experience. Now, what are you going to do?

speaker: Bernadette
content: Pin your hopes on your supposed new friend, that MBCC Chief? Indeed, he's someone who can be easily persuaded.
female_content: Pin your hopes on your supposed new friend, that MBCC Chief? Indeed, she's someone who can be easily persuaded.

speaker: Max King
content: ...So you admit it, huh? Finally owning up to your own doing?

speaker: Max King
content: That so-called "protection request" you made with Chief? I bet you couldn’t care less about that girl’s life or what Chief thinks. Your only aim is to manipulate him into stepping in, just so you can leverage his influence through the media.
female_content: That so-called "protection request" you made with Chief? I bet you couldn’t care less about that girl’s life or what Chief thinks. Your only aim is to manipulate her into stepping in, just so you can leverage her influence through the media.

speaker: Max King
content: But you're wrong. He's a man that can never be swayed easily—he's in this for his own principles, protecting those he believes worthy of protection. He will expose your schemes, and never stoop to your level.
female_content: But you're wrong. She's a woman that can never be swayed easily—she's in this for her own principles, protecting those she believes worthy of protection. She will expose your schemes, and never stoop to your level.

content: A meaningful smile graces Bernadette's face.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Will he really?
female_content: Will she really?

speaker: Bernadette
content: Or let me rephrase this... Do you really want him to do that?
female_content: Or let me rephrase this... Do you really want her to do that?

speaker: Max King
content: ...What do you mean?

speaker: Bernadette
content: At the moment, this so-called "protection request" is nothing more than hearsay and could still be considered part of his duties. People are eager to find out everyone's stance on the election, but nothing is certain yet. However, if he issues a formal denial, it would be seen as publicly supporting your candidacy.

speaker: Bernadette
content: As for the repercussions? Just look at the FAC now. See what happens to those with military power who dare to meddle in politics.

speaker: Bernadette
content: That Chief only has what little freedom he does, thanks to his excessive prudence. But, if you plead for his help, he might sacrifice his own interests for yours, given his nature.
female_content: That Chief only has what little freedom she does, thanks to her excessive prudence. But, if you plead for her help, she might sacrifice her own interests for yours, given her nature.

speaker: Bernadette
content: If you can really do that, Mr. Vale would be very proud.
That Minos Chief did say something similar before.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Honestly, I know nothing about the election, nor do I want to. That position has never seemed to make any difference in the things I truly care about. If it really holds the value you say...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then please win and prove yourself by making real changes. Who knows? By then, I might be the one not letting you go.

speaker: Max King
content: Hmph... I'm not that desperate.

speaker: Max King
content: I don't need anyone making sacrifices for me, especially not my friends.
After a moment of silence, he asks in a low voice.

speaker: Max King
content: ...Did you kill Stewart?

speaker: Bernadette
content: I have better means to get what I want.

speaker: Max King
content: To be honest, I'm not afraid of your means or whoever's behind you. But fine, you've won this round—I'm not sophisticated enough to throw my allies under the bus for my own victory.

speaker: Max King
content: Tell me straight. What's the deal to set Adrian free? Do you want me to quit the election?

speaker: Bernadette
content: I've already let him go.
Max King freezes in shock.

speaker: Max King
content: ...Wh... what are you really up to? Where is he?

speaker: Bernadette
content: As I've said, I'm not here to stand against you. I genuinely admire you, which means I could be an option for you.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I will speak with those behind me. When you return, you should also have a serious conversation with Mr. Vale.

speaker: Bernadette
content: After all, it's your internal problems that are truly fatal. Your ideals were what forced him down this path.
(Scene change)
After leaving the Cavendish residence, Max King does not get into his car; he just walks mechanically, his movements rigid and robotic, hardly preserving the impeccable state of his suit.
He loses track of time, only to suddenly realize he's standing at the door of his campaign office. And there, right before him, stands...

speaker: Max King
content: Adrian!!

speaker: Max King
content: Thank goodness... You really came back. I was even thinking about—
The elderly man stands in the doorway, his eyes sunken from what must be days without sleep. In a rare departure from his usual demeanor, he interrupts his young master.

speaker: Vale
content: ...Sir, the lawsuit has been settled. For the sake of your campaign, please cut connections with me. That way, I can make amends for the damage I've caused and make up for my mistakes.

speaker: Vale
content: I have faith in your victory, sir. Your growth and strength are evident, and you now have a more helpful hand by your side. As long as you persist without wavering, success will undoubtedly be yours.
Max King falters for a moment, his eyes filled with confusion.

speaker: Max King
content: "Cut connections with you... A more helpful hand?" What are you talking about?

speaker: Max King
content: You want me to beg for Chief ${PlayerName}'s help—just so you can make your exit?
After those words, Max King feels a pang of regret. His hands clench tightly, as if trying to hold onto something slipping away.

speaker: Max King
content: No, Adrian... Please don't go. You're my closest friend and most trusted ally. I will always trust you, no matter what comes our way.

speaker: Max King
content: So please, trust in me too. I won't lose to someone like that.

speaker: Max King
content: Cavendish thinks she has intimidated me, but she's also exposed her hand. Those high-and-mighty jerks think they can manipulate everyone as they please, and they dare use you to threaten me? To hell with them!

speaker: Max King
content: In three days, I'll clear our names of every false accusation they've thrown at us at the rally. You'll see...

speaker: Vale
content: Max...

speaker: Max King
content: Times have changed, and justice is now on my side...
[Scene Change] Cavendish Residence
Bernadette stands by the window, gazing into the distance. Earlier that day, she received her rival in this very room.
Now that he's gone, Bernadette finds herself dwelling on his words.

speaker: Max King
content: Thank you for your generous enlightenment. I'll definitely bear in mind those "unseen voters" behind you, now that I've learned what they're made of.

speaker: Max King
content: But I have no reason to back down, absolutely none. You're the ones who should fear.

speaker: Max King
content: The West District has become an undeniable force. The fact that your backers are resorting to every possible means of suppression only proves their own fear. You're all shaking in your boots at this new power, 'cause you know Syndicans will never vote for you.

speaker: Max King
content: A new era is coming, and all you old timers will be left in the dust. Just you wait.
To think an amateur like him has made it to the finals... Should I blame David for dying too early, or...
The times really ARE changing...

speaker: Bernadette
content: He's right. It's only a matter of time... If I were a Syndican, I would choose him too.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Now... what should I do to satisfy those who've chosen me?
She opens a box and takes out a stick of incense, contemplating it briefly before breaking into a smile and putting it away.
...That's enough for today. It's time to rest.

content: ${PlayerName} has fallen asleep at his desk. Jelena's coat lies draped over his shoulders, and the scattered documents on the desk have all been neatly arranged.
female_content: ${PlayerName} has fallen asleep at her desk. Jelena's coat lies draped over her shoulders, and the scattered documents on the desk have all been neatly arranged.

content: All the documents are the FAC operation reports during the election season, while the top two files mark the locations of bases that were recently attacked but never officially reported.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief, we've got an intruder in the east wing. A moderate level of Mania is detected there.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What?! There were no breach alerts at all. How did the enemy get in?

speaker: Eugene
content: Just... walked right in, bypassed all our security checkpoints. The intruder has access clearance.

speaker: Eugene
content: ...It's S9, that Stewart's bodyguard.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Sable, stop this, now.
[Scene Change]

speaker: Hecate
content: Jelena is there too, but why isn't she using her power? Is she unable to fight?
You grab your coat, signal the others to follow, and rush out.
[Detention Cell]

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Sable, stop this, now.
Despite Jelena's desperate pleas, her words fail to bring back the sanity of her longtime companion.

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare!
Nightmare lets out a roar, repelling the malfunctioning bodyguard. The MBCC guards quickly seize the chance to form a barrier between you and S9.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Chief.
You help Jelena to her feet and confirm that she has only sustained minor injuries. Elvira, on the other hand, appears shaken but unharmed, having been well protected during the incident.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She has managed to breach our security. Her previous clearance has turned into a huge vulnerability. We have to take actions now, or the whole Bureau could be in danger.

speaker: Jelena
content: No, Sable is not our enemy.

speaker: Jelena
content: She's being controlled. Someone is forcing her to attack the Bureau, but she's still fighting against it!
...Being controlled.
[Flashback: Cabinet Attack]
A shiver runs down your spine. Control... The attacks on the FAC and the cabinet were executed using the same method—controlling puppets to wreak havoc.

speaker: Jelena
content: Someone ordered her to attack us, but she recognized El and refused to harm her—there's still something we can do.

speaker: Jelena
content: Chief, let me—

speaker: Choice
options: Then who's going to protect Elvira?

content: Interrupting her abruptly but soon realizing the anxiety in your words, you catch yourself and soften your tone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This might be our closest chance to catch the culprit. It has to be me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry. I'll try not to harm S9, and do my best to... bring her back.

speaker: Jelena
content: Wait!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Initiate a full lockdown to intercept the intruder! The enemy is extremely dangerous. Non-combat personnel must evacuate immediately and avoid direct engagement! I will handle this with the Sinners!
Before Jelena can say anything else, you rush out with the combat team, your body taut with tension as you command orders.

It was careless of you to never anticipate the enemy's strike directly INSIDE the Bureau. However, if this is indeed the work of the perpetrator you've been pursuing, the one behind the brutal massacre of the cabinet, then such violent move doesn't come as a surprise.
By taking control of S9 and forcefully entering, they seem to have one clear objective in mind—the elimination of Stewart's surviving child. You dread to imagine what cruel fate awaits those two.

Why? Who could they possibly pose a threat to now? What drives this relentless urge to eliminate them? Could it be related to the upcoming election, Stewart's secrets, or perhaps something even darker...
[Scene Change] (Corridor)
You catch up to her. Being controlled, the cyborg soldier's mobility and decision-making abilities are significantly diminished compared to when she is fully conscious.

speaker: Eugene
content: Something's off with her condition. She's entirely unresponsive to communication, and her actions are purely mechanical, fixated on destruction.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief, what should we do?
Confronted with S9 in this manner, the MBCC troops, who have recently undergone her training, are visibly shaken.

You maintain a cautious distance as you observe her. Her mechanical body bears numerous battle scars, emanating strange noises and a burnt odor, and her entire form appears in an unnaturally distorted posture.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is there any way to break the control over her, or at least immobilize her?

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare can give it a try.

speaker: Hecate
content: S9's mobility is far below her usual level. It's likely due to the external control, which works to our advantage.

speaker: Hecate
content: She won't be as tough as she was that night at the mansion.
While speaking, Hecate summons her familiar and launches an assault under the cover of the combat personnel.
After an intense battle, the cyborg bodyguard finally ceases movement.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...The mental intervention worked.

speaker: Hecate
content: S9 is fully immobilized and can no longer engage in combat for now. We can proceed with the retrieval process.
You wait cautiously as the team conducts their initial examination of S9. Her neural activity and physical functions have both ceased, a state essentially equivalent to physiological shock.
Moving closer, you ascertain that she is not under the influence of any Mania creature nor subjected to mental manipulation. Then what could it be that controlls her...

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief!
In a split second, S9 springs up and, with movements impossible for any human, contorts her body to evade attacks before instantly taking down the nearest soldier.

speaker: Hecate
content: How's that possible? She's moving even faster than before!

speaker: Jelena
content: She's being controlled. Someone is forcing her to attack the Bureau, but she's still fighting against it!
Was her inflexible movement before because her own will was resisting control? Now that S9 is unconscious, who is fully controlling her?

As thoughts flood your mind, S9 dashes toward you in an instant, her metal arm striking your abdomen. Then, she carries you away at an astonishing speed, the abrupt acceleration almost causing you to black out. In that fleeting moment, one matter dawns upon you—
The enemy's target now, is YOU.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!!!
[Black Screen Transition] 2s
[Scene Change] (War's entrance small CG, background only with no character portrait)
It's when your body is slammed violently against the ground that you regain consciousness.

Though your vision and consciousness are blurry, you can still make out your immediate surroundings. S9, who was coerced into "kidnapping" you, lies collapsed nearby. Her body convulses, the strain of the sustained high-speed sprint having pushed her physical form beyond its limits.
You extend your arm towards her, yet she lies beyond your reach. Then, almost instinctively, you release the only thing you have that can touch her...
[Release the shackles]
[Shackle effect fades, followed by a blue flash]
Just as the shackles begin to glow red, bullets fire from another direction, striking the ground near you. Blue electrical arcs crackle as an unknown force swiftly pins you down.
Not far away, a figure emerges above your sight.
[Small CG - War single portrait]

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: Just as I thought... an unexpected gift.
Max King has expected some troublemakers at his campaign rally, but not this many.

speaker: Reporter A
content: You've talked a lot about your dreams and visions. How about shedding some light on that lawsuit?

speaker: Reporter B
content: Word is the lawsuit was suddenly dropped. Have you struck a deal with someone in power? Is this what your self-proclaimed "man of integrity" resorts to?

Accusations and disruptions saturate the air from every angle—they are here to disgrace him. Yet, Max King welcomes their presence; these are precisely the voices he seeks. He appreciates that his adversary took the bait. Now, it's his move.
He raises the microphone with determination.

speaker: Max King
content: Excellent question. No, I didn't make any deals. I fell flat on my face and paid the price for my naivete. However, it was a valuable lesson learned.

speaker: Max King
content: No, no, no, I can't just take! Shifu says we're not supposed to accept food from villagers without earning it...

speaker: Max King
content: Corporations, dynasties, oligarchs, media outlets, and bureaucracies—they have the ability to strip me of wealth, silence my voice, and manipulate even my closest allies to intimidate me. At this moment, I do stand defenseless against them.

speaker: Max King
content: In this sacred election that will determine the city's future, there's still such a group who can easily twist any citizen's will to their whim, even expecting my compliance as if it were their natural right.

speaker: Max King
content: I say—to hell with them!

speaker: Max King
content: I owe "thanks" to Cavendish and the puppet masters pulling her strings. It is through them that I gain a clear sight of the true malice corroding our city.

speaker: Max King
content: For nearly a century, the parasites in our city have grown ever more. They have fostered a will of their own—bloated, rotten, resistant to progress and change—becoming a tumor that drains our city.

speaker: Max King
content: I'm glad they're trying to crush me by any means necessary, forcing me to bow my head. But it only proves one thing—we can hurt them, and we can defeat them! With your support, together we can liberate DisCity from their control!

speaker: Max King
content: Today, I stand here, not for power, but for change; not for myself, but for "us." I will be the voice that speaks for the common folk, for Syndicate, and for everyone who yearns for change to DisCity!

speaker: Max King
content: This is a great city we have. Don't let it fall ill. Let's heal it! Let's work together to make it stand tall once again!

speaker: Max King
content: Let me fight for you! Fight for a brighter tomorrow!
The hall falls silent for a moment, only to erupt into feverish cheers as expected—but there's a discordant shrillness to the applause.

speaker: Overexcited Spectator
content: Holy ****, he's going all out! Gotta stream it! This is gonna be the hottest headline!

speaker: Overexcited Spectator
content: M-K! M-K! M-K!!

speaker: Host
content: Dang, he's on fire! Even after all the drama he's been through, he's still able to charm the crowd with just a few words.

speaker: Pine
content: ...Calm down. What else could those words be for other than manipulating the masses? He's either a clueless airhead or a sly crook saying that, but one thing never changes—he's a total megalomaniac.

speaker: Pine
content: The pampered little prince has coasted through life on easy street. So easy that he actually believes swagger alone can solve everything. Almost makes me feel sorry for him.
The audience continues to roar with excitement, their voices filling the hall—but upon closer listening, one will realize they're not actually cheering for MK as their ideal future leader.

Amidst the wild shouts and cheers, people throw out questions they don't truly care about, jostling over the microphone simply to vent their excitement. A frail, disheveled man barely manages to lay his hand on the mic, only to be almost shoved to the ground.

speaker: Disheveled Man
content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>...You said you'll speak for us—</size></color>

speaker: Max King
content: Sorry? Sir, could you repeat?

speaker: Max King
content: Hey, team! That man over there, in the cloak, he's got something to say! Please get him a mic. I want to hear his voice!

speaker: Max King
content: You've come all the way from the West District to attend my rally. You must have a lot to share. Please, go ahead!
The man gets back to his feet and takes hold of the microphone.

speaker: Disheveled Man
content: You come from money, no? Never had to run with gangs, never saw the Rustfire.

speaker: Vale
content: Thank you for your question, sir.
Adrian is the first to notice the situation taking a dangerous turn and promptly signals the control room to cut the microphone. However, the operator in charge holds a different opinion.
The young operator seems to perceive this as a perfect opportunity to showcase MK's influence in the West District. And so the speech continues for another half minute.

speaker: Disheveled Man
content: The West District was attacked again just last month. You say you care about us... but did you even ask about it? Did you look into it?

speaker: Disheveled Man
content: Your old dog was quite active during his time in Syndicate. Do you even know what he did?

speaker: Disheveled Man
content: You, Cavendish, Stewart—you're all the same.

speaker: Disheveled Man
content: You ain't speaking for us, you speak for YOU. So cut your fancy words.
Max King had never pondered these questions, or he would have formulated an appropriate response instead of just freezing up. Yet, the stage he's standing on right now allows no room for reflection.
As the crowd grows rowdy once more, MK's opponents, who had infiltrated the venue, seize upon his moment of weakness. They raise their voices of taunt, adding fuel to the fire.

speaker: Agitator
content: Quiet now, huh? With all that big talk, you just take Syndicans as a bunch of fools easy to control, don't you? You say Cavendish has a puppet master, so who's pulling your strings? The Outlands?

speaker: Max King
content: No! I—
But are his explanations really wanted? In the shadows, multiple gun barrels ominously rise.
With the instinct of a seasoned soldier, Adrian swiftly detects the impending danger. He makes the decisive call—instead of pursuing the gunmen, he lunges to shield the person he's sworn to protect.

speaker: Vale
content: Get down—!!

The gunfire persists. Some instinctively drop to the floor, pressing themselves against it, while the majority panic and scatter in all directions, their screams blending with the clamor of trampling feet.

speaker: Host
content: Ugh... help, somebody...

speaker: Pine
content: Over here!
Pine quickly pulls her companion away and shoves her into a secret passage she had already scouted out.

speaker: Pine
content: Take this way, then run as soon as you're out. Make it a quick one, move!

speaker: Host
content: What about you? Pine? Pine!! Where are you going??
Pine has already rushed out, running against the fleeing crowd toward the center of the turmoil.

speaker: Pine
content: Well, well, something did happen—no, this is a real black swan event! An election that claims two candidates' lives? So filthy, so despicable, absolutely... fascinating!

speaker: Pine
content: What will this hit lead to? Is MK dead? How will this change the election, and... who's really behind this? Cavendish?

speaker: Pine
content: No, no way. She's got the upper hand now—there's no way she plotted this. Did MK stage it himself? But those bullets were meant to kill... Or, he has a Sinner in his corner? Could it be that MBCC Chief?!

speaker: Pine
content: Haha... Hahaha! I was wrong. There could never be innocent airheads among those cunning politicians!! This is their true nature; all they do is plot upon plot! I'm not gonna fall for their tricks again!

Filled with wild imaginations of conspiracies and insider secrets, a wave of excitement floods Pine's mind. Completely ignoring the danger to her own life, she thinks only of retrieving all her hidden cameras to get her hands on the raw footage.
But just as Pine pushes through the crowd and reaches the second floor, she hears a heart-wrenching cry of anguish.

speaker: Max King
content: What... No—

speaker: Max King
content: NO!! NOOO!!! Adrian!! Adrian, stay with me!

speaker: Max King
content: Someone, anyone... Call an ambulance!!
Amid the tumultuous crowd, the old man rests in Max King's arms. Warm liquid slowly escapes from the old man's body, trickling through Max King's fingers and dying his suit in a dark hue.
Pine freezes in shock. For the first time beyond her camera lens, she witnesses real bloodshed and death, her previous thrill vanishing without a trace.
She immediately thinks of using her power, but the ability she usually takes such pride in proves utterly useless in this moment.

speaker: Pine
content: ...Damn it, not now. Come on!
She forcefully kicks aside the obstacles in her path, seizes a flag from the second floor, and charges directly towards Max King.

speaker: Pine
content: Let me help!! Where's that Chief?! Anyone?! Someone needs help here!!
With her calls unanswered, Pine grits her teeth and quickly creates a makeshift stretcher using the flag, trying to help Max King carry the elderly man out of the chaos-filled venue.
However, the elderly man musters a feeble shake of his head in response.

speaker: Vale
content: Don't... there's no need...

speaker: Vale
content: This isn't... anyone's fault... No one made me do this; it isn't a sacrifice, Max...

speaker: Vale
content: This is my own choice...

speaker: Vale
content: ...You've chosen a hard path, sir, and walking it is even harder... I'm sorry I took shortcuts... I did things that were not noble, but I don't regret them...

speaker: Vale
content: Because your vision shines so bright... It has guided me through the darkest nights, and I want you to go even farther...

speaker: Vale
content: Keep going... my young master... and stay gold.

Max King gazes blankly at the elderly man cradled in his arms, his usually inexhaustible passion completely drained as if he's suddenly found himself in a desolate wilderness. He can feel the once-warm liquid seeping from the body now growing cold.
An inexplicable surge of anger washes over Pine, yet the words of fury die in her throat. In the end, she can only lower her head and release a deep, heavy sigh.
[Black Screen]
Outside the ward, Max King and Pine take a brief break from managing the aftermath.

speaker: Max King
content: Back there... thank you.

speaker: Pine
content: ...It's nothing. I was already there anyway; guess that makes me one of your supporters.

speaker: Pine
content: Stay strong. You made quite a speech there. He also believed in who you really are.

speaker: Max King
content: I've seen your channel. I know... you came to dig up dirt on me.

speaker: Max King
content: You thought I was either a fool or a crook... just spouting around empty catchphrases for views, manipulating voters.
Pine remains silent, refraining from her usual mockery.

speaker: Max King
content: You're right.

speaker: Max King
content: Everything you said was right... I'm a complete fool.
He bows his head in exasperation. For a long while, Pine finds herself at a loss for words.
After another prolonged moment, Max King lifts his head slowly. Despite his weary face, his eyes appear...
He has only one path left now. The person closest to him is gone, leaving him with just this single path forward.

speaker: Max King
content: ...You're a capable person. You can see through to the truth of things.

speaker: Max King
content: Can I ask you to look into something for me?
Pine affects a professional demeanor.

speaker: Pine
content: ...Sure. Tell me about it.
You are pinned down by the blue light and lose the strength to raise your head. Meanwhile, footsteps echo across the ground, drawing closer.
The sound bears an unnatural weight, accompanied by the grinding of metal joints. You realize it must be a massive cyborg approaching.
A cold metallic hand grabs your collar and hoists you up. You come face-to-face with a metal mask, yet from beneath it, you hear steady, deep breathing.

It's a person. One that's bold enough to strike at the MBCC in broad daylight, utilizing a cyborg to seize you right in front of everyone. Quite the opposite of those sweet-talking councilors caught up in their political mind games.
There's no doubt about it—this must be the same perpetrator behind the FAC assault and possibly the cabinet attack. They exhibit the same merciless brutality and utter disregard for consequences.
You are lifted, feet off the ground, but you still force out a question through gritted teeth.

options: ...Are you the one who attacked the cabinet and killed Stewart?

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: Oh, investigating that case, are you? Bold, but naive, I must say.

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: No wonder someone resorts to us to take your life.
His voice is consumed by heavy mechanical distortion, yet miraculously, those words reverberate within your skull, allowing you to understand everything he says.

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: You've caught the attention of some pests. Need any help?

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: We've done our own verification. We can discuss a potential partnership.
You strain to make out the figure before you. It's probably a man. He towers over you, his massive frame extensively covered in metal.
The restraint binding you appears akin to anti-Mania technology, yet the method employed to control S9... undeniably emanated from an immensely potent Mania power.
Your gaze shifts to S9 on the ground. She has remained motionless for a while now, with electric sparks flickering amidst her mechanical joints where blood slowly seeps through.
Too weak to call out to her, you slowly raise your hand.

options: I don't work with those who harm my allies.

content: A red light spike hurtles towards the man's neck. Despite depleting your last ounces of strength, the spike barely skims the only exposed part of his skin, leaving behind a thin trail of blood.
Then, as if in response to an unseen force, the thin bloodline starts to widen, turning into a horizontal gash, and then... into some blazing red marks you know all too well.
The man offers you no answer. He simply wipes the blood from his neck, a smile playing across his face.

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: Heh... You’ve got some backbone. I suppose I’ll take you back—she favors people like you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I—Argh!
Without waiting for your response, he slams you violently against the ground. Your head rings from the impact, blood catching in your throat, leaving you unable to utter another word.
Shadowy figures materialize one by one from above, looming over you. Their leader approaches and raises their foot over your right hand—the very hand you just used to unleash the shackles.

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: Shackles of the Underground... even if we break your limbs, you can still use that power, right?

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: We'll have you fixed.
You have no strength left to resist. Just as his foot comes crashing down, a figure suddenly lunges over, pushing the man back a pace. Droplets of her blood splatter across your face.
With her battered body, S9 struggles to restrain the towering man. Just before she's completely vanquished, a faint light flickers across her body as if some program is activated.
In her last moments, she turns to gaze at you, and beneath her fractured mask, human eyes meet yours for the first time.

speaker: S9
content: Tell... Elvira... I...
[BOOM!!]
Thrown several meters back by the blast wave, you fade into complete unconsciousness.

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: Heh, a lackey of the powers... you do have some guts.
With his coat burnt away, the man removes the mechanical debris clinging to his body. S9's minor self-destruction has scarcely wounded him, yet...
Not far away, another figure slowly approaches.

speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
content: ...Oh right, I almost forgot. There's still you behind her...
You no longer remember what happened after that.
Only fragmented memories remain. On that battlefield, you seemed to hear Jelena's voice.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...${PlayerName}... Wake up, wake up...

speaker: Jelena
content: It's all right, I'm here to save you... I won't let you die...
You attempted to speak, yet no words could escape your lips. You only felt someone holding you in a grief-stricken embrace.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Who did this? Who hurt him... say it!
female_content: ...Who did this? Who hurt her... say it!

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Was it you?
(Flashback)

speaker: Jelena
content: Don't even think about taking him. Not a single step closer, I warn you.
female_content: Don't even think about taking her. Not a single step closer, I warn you.

content: (Flashback)
The final memory etched in your mind is of that slender woman, standing alone against a horde of formidable adversaries.

speaker: Jelena
content: The military...?

speaker: Jelena
content: Anyone who dares lay a finger on my children... is DEAD.
You wake up.
You find yourself already back at the Bureau, surrounded by familiar faces wearing expressions of deep concern. The recent happenings seem like nothing but a fading nightmare.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I'm fine. Thank you, everyone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where's S9... and Jelena...?
Their silence tells everything.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Jelena's in the infirmary, right? I'll go check on her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I have questions to ask her.
In the end, however, you can't bring yourself to ask any of them.
At the entrance to the ward, Elvira remains by the bedside. You've heard that she hasn't slept in two days. Her shoulders tremble as she tightly holds onto Jelena's hand.

speaker: Jelena
content: Please don't cry, El... Sable will come back. Chief went to find her... She will come back to us...

speaker: Elvira
content: Mmm...

speaker: Jelena
content: You still have me, and so many others to protect you... Everything will be alright...

speaker: Elvira
content: Mmm...!

speaker: Jelena
content: I will never leave you alone...

speaker: Jelena
content: That song... Would you like to hear it again? Your favorite one...
You remember this song.
The melody feels unfamiliar, the lyrics indistinct, reminding you of both a lullaby and a requiem.

speaker: Wynn
content: Jelena's power is spiraling out of control. The shackles within her body have become unstable and can no longer restrain her Mania.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief... What enemies were you up against? How did she end up like this?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: About those two... Give them some special care, just do what I said.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now... back to work.

These days, you have immersed yourself in scrutinizing every document and pursuing every lead, working through meals and late into the night. Despite the numerous instances of denied access, you persist by seeking alternative routes to probe into the cases.
Call it luck—an unexpected mail arrives just in time, providing the final crucial piece of the puzzle.

Max King—Your Future Speaker that Speaks for You! The Leading Contender Max King's 30th Cordial Greeting to the Esteemed MBCC Chief! I'm the investigator Max King hired. Found something interesting, figured I'd pass it along to you as well. Check the attached. Pine Attachment: [Internal Memo]

December 9, N.F. 114
16:30
MBCC Chief's Office
Your invited guest arrives right on schedule.

speaker: Schorl
content: It's rare you call to see me, Chief. Has there been any progress in the cabinet attack investigation?

speaker: Schorl
content: I heard you were attacked right after finishing your investigation at the FAC. Did you see who did it?

options: I thought you'd ask about my injuries first.

speaker: Schorl
content: Sure. How are you feeling? You've done so well. Wishing you a speedy recovery.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Alright, just kidding. I'll handle those attackers later. They're not our main concern right now, and this isn't my first injury, anyways.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I called you here because I've found something else... something interesting.
You slide the documents across the desk to Schorl.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Interesting, isn't it? The cabinet was massacred, with almost all senior officials killed. Despite such a significant event, looking at it now... it seems to have barely impacted the city's operations.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: New appointees were immediately put in place, stepping into the exact roles of their predecessors, backed by the same behind-the-scenes support, and continuing policies that align with the same interests.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Here's what's even more intriguing: the cabinet lineup is already set in stone before we've even elected the next leader. Even if they've sealed the deal of Bernadette Cavendish's win, this is still way too confident of them, don't you think?

speaker: Schorl
content: ...Who provided you with this information?

options: The source no longer matters, doesn't it?
That being asked, so it's true?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This supposed "most important civic event" turns out to be nothing but a facade, a circus act. These unseen voters are the real ones determining their next leader, while the public election is just there to rubber-stamp their decision.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Bernadette's image as an independent force standing against her predecessor was simply a show put on for the voters, intended only to attract more votes from those in opposition.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm finally starting to get it...

speaker: Jelena
content: The threat has diminished. No one's in jeopardy, and the culprit has been cautioned. They are unlikely to act again.

speaker: Jelena
content: But if you press on, they may think of it as a declaration of war. What do you think they would do then?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: In this election, in this city, there are influences that I can hardly make out. The council, even the whole cabinet, are nothing but their puppets, the citizens just an audience they've carefully crafted. It's all a recurring drama staged every four years, where real change is forever out of reach.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I guess I had it coming for poking my nose where it didn't belong and breaking the rules recklessly. Getting away with just these wounds... I should count myself lucky.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But what part does Paradeisos play in all of this? Is this truly the governance you envision for Eastside?

speaker: Schorl
content: ...All I can say is that things haven't spiraled out of control for now. This solution, while not ideal, still falls within acceptable boundaries.

speaker: Schorl
content: We understand the injustice you've endured. With the EDGE's computing power strained by fighting the calamity, we can't allocate resources to fully protect you, nor can we precisely control every variable in the city. Many wield power and violence, yet few possess the wisdom to master either.

speaker: Schorl
content: That's why we urged you to steer clear in caution and avoid delving too deeply. Under normal circumstances, we wouldn't task you with such responsibilities during an election season, but reality often presents complexities beyond our plans.

speaker: Schorl
content: Considering the unfolding events, we will set things right for you. All hostilities directed towards you will cease, and we hope you will regard this matter as closed.

speaker: Schorl
content: Paradeisos doesn't want to see any further harm come your way, nor do we want you to be under detrimental influences. You have a more important mission to fulfill.
There might be some sincerity in those words, but you can never truly discern the genuineness of emotions from a machine.
—And a discussion within Paradeisos is not your real purpose anyway.

options: I'll decide my next steps for myself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But there seems to be a misunderstanding. I didn't approach you today to file a complaint.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As I promised, my sole mission is to investigate, to uncover the truth behind a major Mania attack and murder case.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Whether this has anything to do with the election or not, the intricate power dynamics at play, or what hornets' nest I've stirred up, my only focus is the perpetrator—their motives, and what exactly are they playing along the way.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now, with these leaked insider details in hand, I finally see a possibility that may crack this case open.
Your finger points to a name on the list.

speaker: Schorl
content: This one is...

speaker: Schorl
content: ! Does it mean that...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Everyone keeps saying that I'm too obsessed with trivial investigations, unable to see the full picture of the election, while the true power players sit in elevated positions, pulling all the strings.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But now it seems those supposedly "inscrutable" figures, absorbed in their political games for decades, might be the ones with a limited perspective, unable to see beyond their own chessboard.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Perhaps... they've already been thoroughly fooled by the very people they deem worthless.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...So, you already have a suspect in mind.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Yes, I have my suspicions, but they still need to be verified.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I just want this to proceed according to my plan.

speaker: Schorl
content: Very well. You've managed this exceptionally well, after all. You can proceed as you wish.

speaker: Schorl
content: We have only one condition: your security detail must be enhanced, with Paradeisos overseeing the arrangements. We don't wish to see a recurrence of the past incident, and we don't trust your judgment when it comes to your own safety.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...There are others who need protection more than I do.

Jelena opens her eyes. Instead of her familiar ward, she finds herself in a room adorned with advanced medical apparatus, cozy furnishings, and thoughtful get-well presents and bouquets from the Bureau personnel...
She appears to be under a heightened level of care, yet Elvira, typically inseparable from her, is nowhere to be seen.

speaker: Nurse
content: Oh! You're finally awake! Everyone's been so worried about you. How are you feeling? Any discomfort anywhere?

speaker: Jelena
content: Thank you, I'm feeling fine... May I ask where Miss Stewart is?

speaker: Nurse
content: Oh, Chief said that sticking around you might pose a risk of Mania infection, so he had Hecate escort her back. For your own safety, he has stationed additional guards, saying he's worried about your health.
female_content: Oh, Chief said that sticking around you might pose a risk of Mania infection, so she had Hecate escort her back. For your own safety, she has stationed additional guards, saying she's worried about your health.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...I see. He's as reliable as ever.
female_content: ...I see. She's as reliable as ever.

content: Jelena casts a casual glance out the window.
As she notices several security personnel discreetly positioned outside, a wave of unexpected relief washes over her. A smile even unconsciously forms on her lips.
That Chief truly proves to be reliable.

speaker: Nurse
content: Now that you're awake, I'll notify Chief right away. He's been really concerned about you, checking in constantly.
female_content: Now that you're awake, I'll notify Chief right away. She's been really concerned about you, checking in constantly.

speaker: Jelena
content: Thank you. You truly are kind people.
And yet... can someone so seemingly kind really be trusted?

Elvira opens her eyes to find herself neither in the hospital ward nor in Jelena's room. Where she stays now is under heavy guard, with Hecate standing watch outside the door, appearing poised for any potential threat.
Where is Jelena? She has been by her side the whole time. How did she end up here?
Elvira's head spins with a familiar dizziness—the same kind she experienced during past kidnappings, causing the sharp noises around her to blend into an indistinct cacophony.

speaker: Alarm
content: Emergency alert! The Bureau's under attack! All non-combat personnel evacuate immediately!

speaker: Alarm
content: Repeat! The Bureau's under attack! All non-combat personnel MUST evacuate immediately! Attack location: Medical Wing!

speaker: Alarm
content: Warning! Sinner Jelena has broken containment!

speaker: Elvira
content: ...Jelena?

The Rust
An Abandoned Theater
Where WhiteSands meets the Rust stands a long-abandoned theater.

Several broken Puppet bodies lie scattered nearby. They bear the same traits as those found at the cabinet attack site—initially destroyed by someone, then completely dominated and enhanced by an even more formidable Mania power.
The 9th Agency stumbled upon this location during their pursuit of the Underground Puppets, and of course, it could very well be that someone was intentionally leading you here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It seems like... her mission is really completed.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll stay right here and wait for her. I know she will come, and it won't be long.
Your shackles have already sensed her approach, but before that...
Fine droplets of rain fall sparsely, emanating a soft cyan glow. This isn't the Blue Rain, but more like those silver threads that cascaded around her that night.
And with the rain comes more Underground Puppets, their bodies twitching as they approach.
The single-eye runes on their faces have long since faded, replaced by a trail of cyan tears.
In contrast to the ordinary Puppets that attacked the mansion, these exhibit unsettling, unnatural movements while exuding formidable power—potent enough to rival even HUSH's elite units.

speaker: Eugene
content: The Mania characteristics have changed. Her power is extremely dangerous now. Chief...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll stay here by myself. The more people around, the greater the danger. I'm afraid her power can manipulate weakened or dead creatures.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry... She won't attack me. She must have something to say.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Please activate the Blue Rain in the area to suppress the Mania, and... just let the FAC's auto units handle these Puppets.
The Blue Rain suppresses the frenzied Puppets while FAC's mechanical forces maintain constant fire, shattering their bodies to prevent any further movement.
From your position at the rear, you watch as the chaotic battlefield gradually calms. Amidst the fading howls and through the bloody mist, a figure slowly emerges.
—Just as you predicted.

speaker: Jelena
content: Yes. I couldn't find my child, so I had to come to you.

speaker: Jelena
content: Tell me, where did you hide El?
[Scene Change] MBCC

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief went to the scene? Can we reach him?
female_content: Chief went to the scene? Can we reach her?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I request to mobilize, immediately. No vehicle needed; I can go there on my own.

speaker: Hecate
content: Nightmare!
Nightmare materializes in the courtyard. Hecate clambers onto one of its arms, poised to depart, when another figure rushes out and seizes her.
I'll go too. Take me with you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Elvira?

speaker: Hecate
content: No, Chief ordered me to keep you safe. You...?!

speaker: Elvira
content: I have to go. Please.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I see.
In the fine rain, you stand facing each other, both of your "guards" nearly exhausted. Trailing behind her are several Corruptors from the Rust, likely tools she has captured along the way.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your power doesn't work on non-living beings, and it requires Mania infection to establish control, right?

speaker: Jelena
content: Is that so?
Silver chains glint as shuttle-like crystal shards slice through the air, expertly shattering the anti-Mania cores of the mechanical guards behind you.

speaker: Jelena
content: They’re from the FAC, just like the ones who wounded you so gravely back then.

speaker: Jelena
content: Did they send you here... to stand against me?

speaker: Jelena
content: They told you to make El a hostage?

speaker: Jelena
content: Where did they take her?
Her voice carries an icy chill, her eyes reflecting the same wariness and hostility as that night when she had you bound.
But you stand your ground, not stepping back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I was the one who took her. I hid her in a safe place—all on my own accord. I was the first to have doubts about you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've seen your true power—how you controlled and enhanced Mania-infected creatures to amass an army of Puppets.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You saved me with that power—the same one you used to capture Underground Puppets, break into the cabinet, and kill Elvira's father.
She freezes for a moment, then lowers her eyes.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...So you were conscious then, and I never noticed...

speaker: Jelena
content: Had I been more careful...

speaker: Jelena
content: No, how could I... You were so hurt, I couldn't possibly stay calm then.

speaker: Jelena
content: I can't bear to see you hurt again...
She truly is a gentle soul. Even now, her soft-spoken words carry genuine concern for you.
How deceiving appearances can be. You must hold onto every piece of evidence to avoid falling into this trap.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...That memory has been hazy. I kept wishing that I was mistaken about you, especially since you fought so hard to save me. I really wanted to believe in your innocence.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But then I found other evidence, and piece by piece, I uncovered the culprit's true intentions.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Every slain cabinet member was quickly replaced, with their successors carrying on with the same policies and protecting the same hidden interests. Stewart, as a mere pawn in the game, even his death meant nothing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Business continues, and nothing has changed. All that carefully orchestrated violence has achieved nothing, with one exception—

speaker: Choice
options: Chief Guillotin of the Outland Affairs Bureau.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: He's been extremely rigid against the Outlands—rejecting immigrants and investments, tightening restrictions even further during the election season. His successors will continue down the same path, same attitude toward outsiders like those in power in DisCity.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: On the flip side, the Outland Affairs Bureau ranks low in the cabinet's hierarchy with little opportunity for graft. Those people deem it insignificant, and as a result...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: During this power vacuum before the appointment of Guillotine's successor, Outland capital has made its way into DisCity, its sight set on both the successor candidates of OAB and Max King, a political layman susceptible to control.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Outlands are indeed aiming to meddle in the election, having also wormed their way into the Outland Affairs Bureau. If the 9th Agency hadn't been busy investigating those "Underground Puppets," they could have kept a closer eye on the Outland forces.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Using the Underground to assassinate the Prime Minister was merely a play. And you did it during the election, all to throw off our investigation and hide your actual goal. Is that right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now, it's about time we have an honest conversation. Tell me about your handlers, and your real purpose for getting close to me.
A weighty silence descends upon you both, even the sound of the rain growing fainter.

speaker: Jelena
content: I will, but don't use El against me. She's innocent.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've been using her all these years.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The 9th Agency screens all councilors' background, never allowing Outlanders to touch the city's core of power. But even so, you found your way in—the daughter that Stewart had kept hidden. By becoming her butler, you not only got close to her but also to your ultimate target.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And when Stewart's doomed for re-election, when he was no longer of any use to you, you killed him.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Elvira could never have imagined that you, of all people, were the one who murdered her family.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...Her family?

speaker: Jelena
content: El was never cared for. She was not allowed to go out, or talk to anyone. She lived at the mercy of others' hands, never knowing a moment's peace.

speaker: Jelena
content: Those vultures of the Stewarts, those bastards who treated her like a bargaining chip... are they truly her family?

speaker: Jelena
content: For over ten years, he never once came back to see El, no matter how she longed for his love. A man who treated her as nothing but a blemish on his reputation—can he truly be called a father?

speaker: Jelena
content: If people like that can be called her family, then... why can't I?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Playing "mother" does help you win trust, but for someone with blood-stained hands like you, do you really want family or just an excuse?

speaker: Jelena
content: Hah... I asked myself the same question.

speaker: Jelena
content: Beyond DisCity's sight, settlements struggle against calamities. We fight desperately to survive. Of course, we all yearn for family. I want to be a mother. In a world of death, only mothers can bring life.

speaker: Jelena
content: The disasters ravaged my body—I can never bear children of my own. Yet those orphaned children embraced me, making me whole. Some of them blossomed into strength and resilience, much like you have.

speaker: Jelena
content: ...But they forever lost their chance to grow up.

speaker: Jelena
content: The calamities grew more and more, corrosive rains eating away at everything, destroying my homeland. Our Hypercubes ran dry, and all our resources were taken away. DisCity's prosperity demands money, so they took it from us.

speaker: Jelena
content: Ironically, in his final days, Mr. Stewart sought to see his daughter, hoping to rekindle their bond. He was resolute in his desire to win the election, all for El's sake.

speaker: Jelena
content: He planned a birthday party for her, the same day he passed the Nirvana price bill—all because his campaign needed money.

speaker: Jelena
content: See, Chief? Even those with blood-stained hands can have a heart. They can love. They just choose carefully who deserves their love... That's what DisCity has taught me.
As she speaks, she raises her eyes to meet yours, a faint smile gracing her face.

Suddenly, the sheet of rain, glowing with an eerie cyan light, gusts past the FAC mechanical guards. Their metal armor, having survived years of front-line defense against Mania, dissolves rapidly. Also showered by the rain, you are engulfed by waves of dizziness that leave you momentarily paralyzed.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Change of plan, the enemy Sinner is out of control! Abandon defense, all units on the offensive! Get Chief back!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop, Jelena! Don't use your Mania power!
Red light from the shackles pierces out from her body, but only for a moment.

The rain hasn't stopped. Instead, the light piercing through Jelena begins to dissolve. You feel the connection between you two fading as her Mania power undergoes a transformation. Another more dominant force is gradually seizing control of this Sinner.
Meanwhile, in her palm, a blue crystal slowly rises, emanating an eerie glow.
A large-scale anomaly, a power distinct from human Mania... This sensation is not entirely foreign to you. You have encountered crystal energy like this before.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is... the Apostle of Ashes?! You are using an Ash Crystal to control its power?

speaker: Jelena
content: This very calamity once destroyed my homeland, but now I've made its power my own.

speaker: Jelena
content: Worry not, Chief. I've long since let go of my hatred. I care as little for your election as they have ever cared for us.

speaker: Jelena
content: Yet, I am deeply grateful to have found a child here who would hold me in her embrace.

speaker: Jelena
content: After my mission is complete, my only wish is to protect her.
The rain streams across your body, heightening your senses, alternating between scalding and freezing. Before you realize it, your body begins involuntarily walking towards her.

speaker: Jelena
content: I don't want to hurt you. Looking at you reminds me of the children who never had the chance to grow up... I wish you could come with me.

speaker: Jelena
content: However, as children grow up, they find their own path. You’ve already found yours, so I know you won’t come.

speaker: Jelena
content: But please... return El to me.

speaker: Jelena
content: There's no place for her here. I must take her away, and for that, I need your help.

speaker: Jelena
content: Please be my hostage, Chief. After all, I don't have any choice.
The bizarre power of the Ash Crystal is too overwhelming, exceeding the operational limits of the currently arranged anti-Sinner combat operation.
And likewise, it's beyond what Jelena can endure.
The ominous, twisted energy overflowing from the Ash Crystal travels back through the silver chains, corrupting Jelena's body.

options: Stop it, Jelena! It's turning against you!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This power is beyond what any Sinner can handle. I don't know who gave you this mission, but they never intended for you to live.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We can still talk this through. Stop it!
But Jelena pays no heed to your words. Raising her hand, she pierces and enhances another drawn-in Corruptor, turning it into a new Puppet that charges forth to disperse your approaching allies.

speaker: Jelena
content: Even now, you're still concerned about me, Chief... You must not waste your kindness on enemies anymore...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even if you were to take Elvira away with you, then what?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Run away with her? But where to? You're going to keep her in the dark for your whole life? Would you even use this power in front of her?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, you don't even dare to tell her who you are, what you did. If there really was a safe place to escape to, you'd have left long ago. You simply don't believe a child could grow up safely in the Outlands.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You know you can't protect her. The moment you decided to kill her father, you trapped yourself in an impossible dilemma. Look at what you've become! The Ash Mania is corrupting your body and your mind!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You can't even protect yourself—how could I possibly entrust Elvira to you? I won't let her leave the MBCC!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I made you a promise to protect her, and now, I'm going to honor that commitment.

speaker: Jelena
content: I'm so glad to hear those words from you...

speaker: Jelena
content: <size=30>Now, I can rest assured...</size>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...What?

Before you can get an answer, a laser beam slices through, obliterating the massive Puppets. The ensuing blast propels you forcefully against the shattered walls. Were it not for a Puppet holding you just in time, you could have passed out immediately with a few ribs broken.
Glancing behind, you catch sight of a slender passage etched through the dense contamination. Across the way, a black Schorl hovers in midair.

speaker: Schorl
content: Highest priority: reclaim <color=#fb9259>SHP-13</color> and eliminate all enemies.

As you attempt to speak, multiple Puppets surge towards you, not in aggression but to shield you with their bodies. They crowd around you, muffling your voice and obscuring your sight. Trapped among them, you are pushed away from the battlefield.
[Black screen + Jelena's portrait]

Jelena confronts the inhuman adversary, showing no trace of surprise or fear. The frenzied desperation she exhibited moments ago to take Elvira back has dissipated entirely, replaced by a serene composure as she studies her opponent.

Perhaps now is the time to test how her power measures up against the great DisCity. After all, somewhere far away, in the near future, someone will need these findings. Moreover, there's no way out for her at this point.
...After all, with ${PlayerName} around, she has nothing left to worry about.
[Crystal portrait] [Background dims]
The Ash Crystal returns to her palm, slowly gathering power.
Trapped within the wall of Puppets, you hear the rain grow louder, mixed with echoes of chaos. A bone-chilling sensation suddenly seeps through your entire body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This power is something beyond that of the Apostle of Ashes. It's...
It's her children.

speaker: Jelena
content: To be honest, I don't like fighting.

speaker: Jelena
content: I want to heal others, shield them, even. But this power of mine is always bound to death.

speaker: Jelena
content: This is where I belong, a battleground, cold to death.

speaker: Jelena
content: I'm sorry, Chief. This is not a fair deal, but I have to force your hand, just this once...
Mania flows forth from the crystal, a power born from lives dissolved by corrupting rain, from the children of Jelena's homeland who departed this world before her, years ago.
Now, those phantoms embrace her with laughter as Jelena gradually dissolves into the downpour of Mania...

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!
Bang—!!
(Transition)
The bullet strikes the growing crystal, sending shrapnel flying and grazing Jelena's forehead. Though the crystal falls to the ground unscathed, its glow dims a lot.
For the Sinner has spotted the one who fired the shot.
[CG] Elvira shoots at Jelena

speaker: Elvira
content: You're the one who should go...

speaker: Elvira
content: I don't need your protection... not anymore...
