The incredible inspector slams his fist on the table, scaring everyone around.
He blinks hard, then fumbles out a mobile phone from his pocket. He furiously wipes the vomit from the phone, dials a familiar number, then presses his face against the shattered screen...

speaker: Voice on the phone
content: Buzz... Buzz... The number you have... Buzz... Buzz... dialed... Buzz... Buzz... Cannot be reached... Buzz...
His headache and anxiety put him under a lot of distress. In a stroke of bad timing, another call comes in.

speaker: Secret Telegram
content: Hello, Inspector Doyle. This is the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. About the "Sleepwalkers" case, we'd like you...

speaker: Inspector
content: What **** bureau! I don't care what **** boss of Noms you are! Now listen up! The Sleepwalkers case is mine! Don't stick your ******* nose into this!
With that, he slams down the phone. His whole body spins around from the force of his action, slamming piteously into the edge of the table.
From the other end of the long table, a cold voice speaks up from the shadows.

speaker: Mysterious Woman
content: All right, calm down. You're startling everyone.

speaker: Mysterious Woman
content: It's such a lovely evening. Let's cheer up with something sweet. Here, my treat.

speaker: Mysterious Woman
content: Even though there's only a bit left, I promise you'll like it...
A blurred figure appeared in the shadows as she pushed an eerie glass from the other end of the long table. The tired Inspector snatched the glass of glowing drink, and drank it all down in one go.

speaker: Inspector
content: This ****... so sweet. It makes me retch...
His head falls back on the table. Amidst his stupor, he seems to have spotted a long-lost figure.

speaker: Inspector
content: Nasha... You came...

speaker: Inspector
content: Come back. It's all my fault...

speaker: Inspector
content: Nasha...

speaker: Mysterious Woman
content: ...Hehe. Perfect.

speaker: Mysterious Woman
content: Sweet dreams tonight...

The day before
September 29, 9:30 PM
MBCC - Chief's Office

speaker: Telephone
content: I don't care what **** boss of Noms you are! Now listen up! The Sleepwalkers case is mine! Don't stick your ******* nose into this!
With the sound of something smashing to the ground, the call cuts off.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Maybe it's not the best time for him right now. Don't worry. This contact already promised yesterday to meet you at the mission location.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Background check confirmed. His name is <color=#fb9259>Doyle</color>. He used to be a renowned inspector in Eastside, and an informant for the 9th Agency. An upright and hardworking man. Though he has temporarily left his post due to some <color=#fb9259>personal issues</color>, he is still quite reliable when he is sober.

speaker: Nightingale
content: He will assist us in this operation.
Operation... You pick up the letter from the table and tear open the ever-pompous sealing wax.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Hello, Chief ${PlayerName}. Regarding the rumors about the Sleepwalkers in Eastside's District 14, your trusty adjutant will surely tell you about them in detail.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Rumors are spreading like wildfire. Some say that Sinners created this crisis, while others claim that Mania broke through the West District's quarantine measures after the crisis at the Square.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: In any case, Eastside residents now feel that they're under threat, and the City Council is highly concerned as a result. They want you to investigate the matter. Of course, if it can be completely resolved, it's a happy ending for everyone.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: Commander <color=#fb9259>Langley</color> has approved. She said that a talented individual like you can easily resolve such a trivial matter.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: So, we have to rely on you once again.

speaker: Nightingale
content: At the moment, there is no evidence implicating Sinners in these incidents. Preliminary investigations can be carried out by the Bureau's city arrest team. You are still on vacation, so you don't need to go in person now.
You can indeed skip out on this operation, but there is something unusual about this case.
Ordinary Sinner cases don't grab the attention of that "superior," let alone requests from the City Council. You know Langley doesn't care about those.
This assignment is either an annoying test, or... There's something behind it she's interested in. You see this as a great opportunity to "get to know" your elusive new superior.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Understood. I will prepare a simple disguise for you immediately. The place you will be going to is...

September 30, 7:00 PM
Eastside District 14 - Midsummer Night's Club

This new upscale club is the talk of the town. Funded by Quinn, it aims to recreate a romantic midsummer night in the desert city... and now, it's hosting a cocktail party for the upcoming opening ceremony.

Clad in an expensive suit prepared by Nightingale and clutching the invitation letter from the 9th Agency in hand, you mingle among the glamorous socialites of Eastside and slip into the club to look for your contact.
female_content: Clad in an expensive gown prepared by Nightingale and clutching the invitation letter from the 9th Agency in hand, you mingle among the glamorous socialites of Eastside and slip into the club to look for your contact.

content: You feel a bit out of place. You're more used to the chaos of Syndicate.

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft, you look like a dummy! Your hands and feet are all out of place! Not used to wearing anything other than that ragged MBCC cloak, eh? Hahaha... Hey Hecate! Why are you poking me again?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Please don't worry, Chief. Your disguise is excellent. Your manners are impeccable, and those clothes are a perfect fit for you. Everything is perfect for this undercover operation.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Eastside residents are very sensitive to matters pertaining to Sinners, and the MBCC is also a highly confidential bureau. Concealing your identity is the optimal strategy, but you don't need to be too nervous.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Eastside isn't like the West District. There are no riots nor Mania outbreaks. Most of the time, it's quite safe here.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The Sinners are on standby nearby, and I'm also monitoring the situation from the MBCC. No matter what happens, you'll have backup to help you.
You look around, but fail to find the "Inspector." But since the 9th Agency chose the Midsummer Night's Club as the meeting location, it must be of value for other intelligence.
The club staff members weave through the crowds, serving drinks to the guests. You pick up a glass and swirl it slowly, mingling into the glamorous crowd.

speaker: Elegant Male Voice
content: ...You saw it?

speaker: Nervous Male Voice
content: ...Oh, yes. I saw a Sleepwalker spit out a pile of black goo with my own eyes. Do you think it was a Sinner?

speaker: Calm Female Voice
content: Impossible. There's no Mania in Eastside. Don't the infected get whisked away to the West District as soon as they're discovered? We've been fine for so many years, and things will surely remain fine...

speaker: Nervous Male Voice
content: I heard that back in August, there was another major Mania outbreak in West District... The FAC said they resolved it, but who knows? A depraved place like Syndicate...
You hear Hella's curses from your earpiece. You quietly lower the volume.

speaker: Elegant Male Voice
content: ...Don't worry. Isn't the quarantine belt by the Rust just fine? The Sleepwalkers are probably just a rumor made up by internet trolls to gain traffic. If something really happens in Eastside, the whole world will probably come to an end.

speaker: Elegant Male Voice
content: Enjoy the party. This is Quinn's latest investment. The venue is top-class. Maybe we'll get to see some <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color>!
As you listen intently, a light sound chimes from the glass in your hand.
A strange, gaudily dressed woman has slipped next to you without you noticing. The drink in her hand seems quite special.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Hey mister, you look a bit bored. Does this place bore you?
female_content: Hey miss, you look a bit bored. Does this place bore you?

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Or maybe... you're trying to find out something?

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Have you been waiting for a long time? Want to watch something entertaining to kill the time?

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: I'm great at entertaining people. That's why I was invited here.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: A performer. The boss of this place invited me here to create joy for everyone. I'm very good at it.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: The show is about to start. Want to come watch?
She smiles and raises her glass to you.

But just as you raise your glass and step closer, the liquid inside suddenly ignites. A blue flame surges out from the glass and rushes towards you. The sweet aroma makes you dizzy, and the stunned crowd gasps in amazement.
All of a sudden, the flame dissolves into transparent, bluish-violet bubbles, which scatter and disappear. After a brief silence, the hall bursts into applause.

speaker: Crowd
content: A magic show? How spectacular! This Midsummer Night's Club is truly a Quinn masterpiece!

speaker: Crowd
content: Encore! <size=40>Encore</size>!!

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Just a little trick from the circus. Hope everyone was entertained! Thank you all...
Giggling, she bows to the people around her. She seems quite satisfied with her performance.
You became a prop for her performance, exposed to the public eye. The glass in your hand is still smoldering slightly.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: And thank you, my dear friend! You're such a natural.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: This glass is on me. Dreamy Ambrosia, a special token of my thanks.
You see that the smoke has dissipated from your glass. The liquid inside has changed color, glimmering radiantly with a hint of sweetness.
Amidst the bright colors is the faintly swirling shadow of a snake.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: A toast to you, my dear guest. May you have sweet, happy dreams tonight.

You swirl the glass and take a sip. The taste is sweet, but otherwise unremarkable. Your "undercover" assignment has been interrupted, but the woman is still looking at you and smiling without a hint of concern.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you, but it's a bit too sweet for my liking.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Miss, please find someone else to help you with your performance.
You raise your glass to her. As she prepares to clink glasses with you, you pour the Ambrosia back into her glass.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Please tell your boss that not all guests enjoy taking part in these attention-seeking gimmicks.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: Are you unhappy? Hmm... my apologies. I didn't prepare well enough for this rehearsal. But how can I hold back when I see someone so adorable?

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: When the real show starts, I'll make it up to you properly.
She giggles, looks you up and down, and then disappears into the crowd.
A man dressed like a butler emerges from the direction she went and bows to you.

speaker: Butler
content: Good evening, Chief of Minos. Our apologies for putting you on the spot just now. Our performer just wanted to entertain you. Please don't be offended.
He smiles faintly.

speaker: Butler
content: Miss Eirene is thrilled that you're here. However, she's a bit caught up at the moment.

speaker: Butler
content: She hopes you can wait for a bit. Miss Eirene would like to see you.

<color=#fb9259>Eirene</color> is a rising star in Eastside's business world, the President of Quinn, and the owner of Midsummer Night's Club. Due to rumors of her connections with the Outlands, the authorities are very vigilant against her, and she is probably on one of the 9th Agency's lists.
It seems you've been keeping tabs on each other... But unfortunately, you have another assignment tonight.

speaker: Choice
options: I will find another chance to visit her.

speaker: Butler
content: Then we look forward to seeing you at the official opening ceremony of Midsummer Night's Club.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Excuse me. Is the district inspector here? His name is Doyle.

speaker: Butler
content: This gentleman's name was indeed on the invitation list, but he is currently not present. I will keep you informed if Inspector Doyle comes.
Did something happen? You thank the butler, and turn to leave the party.

speaker: Butler
content: Good night, sir. You're always welcome at the Midsummer Night's Club.
female_content: Good night, ma'am. You're always welcome at the Midsummer Night's Club.

content: After leaving through the back door of the club, you open your comms, and walk towards the alley leading to the contact point.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You didn't see Inspector Doyle? How strange... The District 14 Public Security Bureau said his coordinates are near the club. Did something happen...
Blegh... blegh...

The slurred sound of vomiting can be heard from a nearby garbage heap. Several people, with their heads buried in garbage bags, are vomiting and mumbling incessantly. You can't tell what smells worse, the garbage or the people.
You hear a familiar voice among them.

speaker: Drunk Middle-aged Man
content: Sleep... Sleepwalk... Club...

speaker: Drunk Middle-aged Man
content: What Noms... It's my case, assist your ***...
You pick up the Eastside public security ID on the ground. Logistics staff, Doyle...
He looks kind nice in his ID photo.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...Why are you touching my stuff? Who the **** are you?!
The man suddenly gets up and shoves you against the brick wall. The vomit on his hand splatters on the clothes Nightingale picked out for you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief?

speaker: Choice
options: There's a bit of issue here.

content: The delirious inspector tries to say something to you, but the "friend" at his feet is already pinching his ankles.

speaker: Doyle
content: What happened... How did you guys end up like this? What did you eat last night? Your vomit is disgusting...

speaker: Doyle
content: ! You are...?

The inspector suddenly regains his clarity. He lunges at you, knocking you out of the Sleepwalkers' attack range. At the same time, the sleepwalking man stoops over and spews a large pile of black goo from his mouth...

speaker: Doyle
content: Sleepwalker?!
The black goo splashed on the ground seems to be alive. After a few quick wriggles, it morphed into a new human shape. This certainly matches the description of the "sleepwalker" report.

speaker: Doyle
content: Why are you standing there?! Come behind me if you want to live!
The Inspector stands in front of you, eyes blazing, and grabs something off the ground to aim at the enemy and shoots. On closer inspection, it's only a crappy leather shoe in his hand.
The inspector fires his "pistol" with a shout. The body of the black goo monster forms a big hole. You are shocked. Is this Sinner power?

speaker: Doyle and Hecate
content:
Die!
Chief!
As Doyle roars energetically, the Nightmare arrives...

speaker: Hecate
content: Like Mania, the black goo is the materialization of spiritual contamination. But unlike Corruptors, they cannot be completely eliminated.

speaker: Hella
content: The black goo monsters are from the vomit of those two Sleepwalkers! To stop the goo, we have to deal with them first! Detective Hella is gonna take care of them now!

After two clean-cut blows to the head, the two Sleepwalkers fall to the ground, their mouths stuffed with garbage bags by Hella. They are in a half-conscious stupor, but at least they've finally stopped spewing black goo.
Yet the other muddle-headed guy is still wandering about vigorously.

speaker: Doyle
content: Look at me! Who says I've gotten rusty? I'm in great shape! I took care of those Sleepwalkers! I'm... the incredible... inspector!
He zigzags before you, spins the beat-up shoe in his hand, and stuffs it into his back pocket.

speaker: Hella
content: Tsk tsk... Cops are embarrassing the whole world over.

speaker: Doyle
content: You **** piece of...
He spins around, takes out the shoe from his pocket and points it at you.

speaker: Doyle
content: You're... That, um, Noms whatever?

speaker: Doyle
content: Hiding behind a little girl, how useless... But you didn't run away... So at least... you have a bit of guts.

speaker: Doyle
content: Keep up. I'll teach you how to crack a case—Ughhh!
The sluggish, hot-tempered man spins around and trips over the garbage bags. You rush over and try your best to keep him from falling.
You don't notice at all that someone has been watching you and your companions from the club's terrace.

You carry the inspector on your back, and relying on his incoherent, mumbling directions, you circle around the block three times before arriving at his residence... or maybe it's his office, or simply another garbage dump.

speaker: Hecate
content: Adjutant Nightingale has dispatched personnel to control and investigate those "Sleepwalkers," as well as clean up the traces of Sinner activity.

speaker: Hecate
content: I'll stand guard downstairs. Adjutant Nightingale said that Eastsiders hate Sinners. We must keep a low profile so as not to hinder your work...

speaker: Hella
content: Hecate! Come, quick! Toasted marshmallows, braised meatballs, and sweet buttermilk tea! Eastside really is a **** awesome place! Come thank me... argh!

speaker: Hecate
content: ...I won't let her run around again, Chief. Please keep a close watch on your belongings next time.

speaker: Hecate
content: If anything happens, call me and I will be there right away.
You change out of your vomit-covered "cocktail clothes" and back into your MBCC jacket. You feel much more at ease.

speaker: Voice in bathroom
content: Cough cough... Blegh...
You hear the toilet flush. The door opens and Doyle comes out. He looks more normal now, but is still a far cry from a "reliable inspector."

speaker: Doyle
content: Okay, let's get to know each other. I'm Doyle, inspector... I mean, former inspector. I will get my job back, soon.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm Noms, agent from the 9th Agency.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...You work for those old foxes, too? Tsk, you don't look like it. You look like a newbie at most.

speaker: Doyle
content: Thanks... for what you did just now. I'm not used to fighting those things.

speaker: Doyle
content: The bigwigs want you to take over this case? Ha... Fine. Whatever.

speaker: Doyle
content: Remember this place. Use it as a contact point, or a safe house, up to you. The 9th Agency checked for safety issues already, so it'll have to do. You'd be even less welcome elsewhere.

speaker: Doyle
content: Then there's this notebook. It's trash. I won't need it anymore. You can have it.
You take over Doyle's notebook, which looks like it holds a bunch of records. You can read them after you finish asking your questions.

speaker: Choice
options: Do you think Sinners caused the incidents?

speaker: Doyle
content: I don't know. This isn't Syndicate. There aren't any Sinners here in Eastside, so not that much trouble around here.
He throws himself onto the couch and looks away. No wonder he has "temporarily left his post due to personal reasons." He has simply stopped caring about everything.
But you've dealt with many more difficult characters back at the MBCC. You can handle him.

speaker: Choice
options: The bigwigs know you've been treated unfairly and sent me to assist you, Inspector.
I need your wisdom for the sake of the public's safety.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...Pfft. Why'd they send such a starry-eyed rookie.
He turns around and sits up.

speaker: Doyle
content: You do know how to handle the "black goo." You've been running errands in West District, haven't you? Then remember, this isn't West District. Eastsiders won't be so calm when they see things like Mania.

speaker: Doyle
content: There hasn't been a Mania outbreak east of the Rust in years. The detection station covers all of Eastside. Although it cannot pinpoint precise locations, it can still detect if a general area has anything unusual.

Indeed, before the start of the operation, Nightingale gave the two Sinners accompanying you special "escape configurations" to avoid detection. It's said that this intervention required special high-level access.

speaker: Doyle
content: We can only be sure that there is an intermittently active Sinner in District 14. As for whether or not he or she has anything to do with the Sleepwalkers... I'm no expert, so I can't say.

speaker: Doyle
content: If we do things my way, we should just be practical and focus on the Sleepwalkers themselves.
The doorbell interrupts your conversation.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...What good timing.

speaker: Doyle
content: This is a "witness" who has volunteered to come. I'll let you question him for practice in a bit. But don't say anything unnecessary.
The door opens, and a handsome, muscled man with black circles around his eyes walks in.

speaker: Man who Walked in
content: Oh, so the bigwigs really did send someone to check up on things. Doyle, you better be on your best behavior. Maybe this bureaucrat gentleman will help you get your job back.
female_content: Oh, so the bigwigs really did send someone to check up on things. Doyle, you better be on your best behavior. Maybe this bureaucrat lady will help you get your job back.

speaker: Doyle
content: Go **** yourself!

speaker: Doctor
content: That mouth of yours really doesn't know when to talk tough and when to do sweet-talking. No wonder your wife left you...
With that, the doctor tilts his head and dodges the ashtray that Doyle threw over, flicks the ashes from his shoulders, and closes the door. The two seem to be old acquaintances.
Hi there. I'm assisting the inspector in investigating the Sleepwalkers.

speaker: Doctor
content: Hi. I'm a physician from the neighborhood clinic. I used to work for the laboratory of the District 14 Public Security Bureau. The ex-inspector and I used to be colleagues.

speaker: Doctor
content: No need to know my name. I'm here to give you some clues. As half a <color=#fb9259>Sleepwalker</color> myself, I hope I can bring some progress to this stalled case.

speaker: Doctor
content: Yeah. Because of my work, I've come into contact with some Sleepwalkers and have a rough idea of their illness... If you can call it an "illness," that is.

speaker: Doctor
content: Plus, not long ago, I also started showing some of the symptoms.

speaker: Options (loop)
options: Did a Sinner do something to you?

speaker: Doctor
content: In addition to vomiting the infamous black goo, Sleepwalkers also suffer from uncontrollable lethargy, intermittent memory loss, dispiritedness, and a sharp drop in metabolism when sleeping.

speaker: Options -1
options: Guess I've experienced similar things too.

speaker: Doctor
content: Really? I had been sleeping for 57 hours straight. When I woke up, I wasn't dehydrated, hungry, or feeling anything out of the ordinary. Do you still think this is normal?

speaker: Doctor
content: Let me put it this way. When I was asleep, I had many sweet dreams. When I woke up, all my physical functions were fine, but... my memories became jumbled.

speaker: Right! No wonder it felt so familiar!
content: Some bad memories became blurred and jumbled together. It took me a while to figure out what's bothering me in the first place.

speaker: Doctor
content: It's as if my bad memories have been squeezed out. Maybe it's not the best metaphor, but it does feel like they've been "squeezed" out.

speaker: [New Clue]
content: These are typical Sleepwalker symptoms.

speaker: Yanyan and Greta keep on chatting. Yanyan even performs another part of the Sun Crow ritual dance in front of the crowd.
content: I'm not sure. The only change in my life during that time was switching sleep meds.

speaker: Doctor
content: I rely on sleep meds a lot. When I become resistant to one type of meds, I switch to another. Someone recommended me a new type a while back, so I tried it out. How do I put it... the effect was outstanding.

speaker: Doctor
content: I'm really ashamed that as a doctor, I developed drug dependence. If it hadn't been so hard to get those meds back then, I don't know how I would've turned out.

speaker: Options -1
options: Does it happen to all Sleepwalkers?

speaker: Doctor
content: I think so. Different people seem to have different levels of resistance to it. I'm one of the lucky ones. Those with weaker wills are more affected.

speaker: Doctor
content: Ha. If they really did something to me, I would have been sent to the detection station by now. This isn't Syndicate. It's harder to see a Sinner than to shake hands with the head of the Council.
If he had come up the stairs, he'd probably already seen the two downstairs.

speaker: Doctor
content: I know what you're thinking, but my situation has nothing to do with Mania.

speaker: Doctor
content: Even if you include my patients, my social circle is quite small. I haven't met any Sinners, and the alarms in District 14 haven't gone off for a long time.

speaker: Doctor
content: I haven't seen any black goo, let alone Sinners. My M-value has always been within normal range.

speaker: Doctor
content: You're very safe.
From his repeated emphasis, it does seem that Eastsiders are extremely wary of Mania.

speaker: Doctor
content: Do you guys have any more questions?
The bait has been thrown, but Inspector Doyle just buries his head in the cushion and acts like he doesn't care. You take over the conversation.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm quite interested in the sleeping meds you mentioned.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If they're really that powerful, there must be a lot of rumors about them in Eastside.

speaker: Doctor
content: You're right, there are a lot of rumors about it. Maybe you've heard of the name... <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color>. True to its name, it's a heavenly new drink.

speaker: Doctor
content: Very sweet.
It's indeed a familiar name.
Before you can recall all the details, Doyle sits up.

speaker: Doyle
content: Holy ****, Gandall! Why didn't you say this earlier?!

speaker: Gandall
content: I told you this last week, inspector. You didn't pay attention.
Doyle slaps his head hard, staggers onto his feet, and puts on an old coat.

speaker: Doyle
content: I heard this name recently. I know where to buy this stuff.

speaker: Gandall
content: So the incredible inspector finally found his groove again?
Doyle doesn't reply. Ignoring Gandall, he strides to the door and swings it open.
Clang!

October 1, 3:23 AM
Eastside District 14 - Street
Eastside is as busy as always. You follow Doyle down the road, with the two Sinners trailing not far behind.

speaker: Doyle
content: Ambrosia... Ambrosia... Why didn't that **** scoundrel Gandall mention it earlier...

speaker: Choice
options: Dr. Gandall really wants to help you get back on your feet.

speaker: Doyle
content: Yeah, right! He should mind his own business. He just wants to laugh at me!
Talking about his old friend will just trigger him further, so you change the subject.

speaker: Doyle
content: I don't know. The name sounds familiar. I must have heard it somewhere recently... But I just can't ******* remember!
You sigh.

speaker: Choice
options: Let's go back to where we met first.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's go back to the back door of Midsummer Night's Club. There were two Sleepwalkers next to you at the time. They must have taken Ambrosia to become like that.
Doyle shoots you a glare.

speaker: Doyle
content: Who's the inspector, you or me? Come!

Seeing that this guy is still being foolish, you sigh and consider contacting Nightingale to investigate the two "Sleepwalkers" who attacked you, or to ask the 9th Agency to get you the footage from nearby surveillance cameras.
At that moment, a thin, black scrap gets blown in front of you. The wind flips it 90 degrees in the air, and you see that it's a strange figure resembling a four-leaf clover.

speaker: Black Four-leaf Clover
content: Want to become a good luck charm?

speaker: Black Four-leaf Clover
content: Want my good luck?

speaker: Black Four-leaf Clover
content: Take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all!!!

speaker: Doyle
content: Black goo? There are Sleepwalkers nearby!

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, remain undercover, don't expose yourself...

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? Remain undercover?! We're already fighting in the middle of the **** street!

The black four-leaf clovers are no match against the Sinners, but they keep growing in number, making it hard for Hella and Hecate to escape. At the same time, more and more people are getting affected by them on the street.
Someone with a digital lottery ticket wins the biggest jackpot and hollers in excitement. Pedestrians cheer after finding money on the roadside.

The black four-leaf clovers stick to their faces and dissolve into countless fragments, seeping into their mouths and nostrils, but the victims don't notice. They are so overexcited that they completely ignore what the two Sinners are doing.

speaker: Black Four-leaf Clover
content: Hahahaha take all the good luck!!

speaker: Doyle
content: ******* it, should I just stop fighting? And what's with those people? Can't they see the black goo? Or have they fallen under its control?

speaker: Doyle
content: I'll hold down the fort here. Rookie, go and get help!
A four-leaf clover floats toward you. You quickly flick it away, but the moment you touch it, a familiar force triggers your shackles.
It feels like... a Sinner?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, the detection center is sounding alarm. M-value anomalies have been detected in District 14. Are you all right?

speaker: Choice
options: I'm OK. There's spiritual contamination around here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The "black goo" created by Sleepwalkers is attacking citizens. But unlike what we saw last night, these black four-leaf clovers clearly have Sinner powers.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You're right. Intense M-value fluctuations in District 14 have triggered the alarm. This is definitely caused by a Sinner.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Aside from Hella and Hecate, there's a <color=#fb9259>third active Sinner</color> near you.

speaker: Choice
options: Can you give me the coordinates?

speaker: Nightingale
content: The monitoring network can only detect M-value fluctuations within the specified range, and cannot determine the precise location. But that Sinner must be using their power right now.

speaker: Choice
options: Understood. A Sinner using their power won't be hard to find.

content: Amidst the chaos, you observe the direction the "four-leaf clovers" are coming from. The Sleepwalker who created them must be nearby...
Found it!

speaker: Doyle
content: Hey! Where are you going? Wrong direction!

You go against the direction the four-leaf clovers are coming from and turn a corner. The four-leaf clovers here are only half as tall. The smaller, thinner pieces are rushing out from the crack of a discreet door and expanding rapidly.
You ram open the door...
You ram open the door with all your might, and the world suddenly falls silent. The music trails off, and everyone stares at you blankly...
Then, a glass slips from the waiter's hand and shatters on the floor.

speaker: Waiter
content: Holy sh...!

speaker: Waiter
content: Cough cough... Don't worry, sir, the show won't start for another ten minutes. You're just in time. Please, take a seat, wherever you want.
female_content: Cough cough... Don't worry, ma'am, the show won't start for another ten minutes. You're just in time. Please, take a seat, wherever you want.

content: The patrons staring at you slowly turn away their gaze and continue on with their revelry.

There are no four-leaf clovers or crazed Sinners around here. No matter how you look at it, the place seems like an ordinary bar. On the contrary, you're the one who seems odd from the brash way you entered.

speaker: Waiter
content: Is this your first time here? What a coincidence! We're serving limited specials tonight. Anyone who's tasted it loves it. You see, everyone here is a repeat customer.

speaker: Waiter
content: The entry fee is only 100 DisCoins... It's a real bargain...
You rummage through your pockets and discover that Hella has taken away all your cards and cash.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm here to find someone. I'll leave in a minute.

content: You look around, scrutinizing every intoxicated person, trying to find the one spitting out black clovers. That person is both a Sleepwalker and the "Sinner" you're looking for.
You finally find her—a blue-haired girl sleeping in a corner by the window. Her face is red, and she is mumbling to herself.

speaker: Blue-Haired Maiden
content: Hehe... Daddy...

You catch her head before it slips and hits the windowsill. At the same time, a small black four-leaf clover flutters out from the corner of her mouth. You grab the clover, triggering a response from your shackles.
She's definitely a Sinner. She is passively releasing her Sinner power via the black goo clovers spewing from her mouth.

speaker: Nightingale
content: <color=#fb9259>Roulecca</color>, No. <color=#fb9259>S-666</color>, a Sinner roaming through West District. She has a violent temperament and is extremely unstable emotionally.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The contaminants that attacked you just now came from her. They are laced with S-666's power, <color=#fb9259>Unbeatable Luck</color>, which triggered the alarm for District 14.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, to stop the spread of the contaminants, you must first get her out of her sleepwalking condition.
You pat Roulecca lightly on the face and call out her name, but you get no response no matter how much you shake her.
You release your shackles while no one is looking, but you fail to wake up Roulecca. In fact, you don't even feel like you've successfully linked to her.
At that moment, a sweet and alluring fragrance drifts into your nostrils. You notice a glowing glass of familiar liquid on the table before Roulecca... That woman had offered you some, too!

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: This glass is on me. A glass of Ambrosia, as a token of my thanks.

speaker: Gaudy Woman
content: A toast to you, my dear guest. May you have sweet dreams tonight.
The girl's mirage appears faintly in the dreamy liquid. Stunned, you get a bad feeling about this.

speaker: Choice
options: Ambrosia? Is her consciousness trapped in here?

content: How can you call it "trapped"? Roulecca stays there because Ambrosia makes her happy...

A hand slowly pushes open the window, and a little head with purple hair pops out. The girl presses her chin against the window frame and smiles at you with her head tilted. A gaudy patched bear doll dangles from her shoulders.

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Like everyone else, she came here to seek joy. Joy comes from <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color>, and everyone's favorite Ambrosia...

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: ...Comes from me.

speaker: Choice
options: You were spreading Ambrosia? You created the Sleepwalkers?

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: I'm the supplier... The biggest supplier... You want to try some too, mister?
female_content: I'm the supplier. The biggest supplier... You want to try some too, miss?

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: But you came too late. This is the last glass of the night, and I already gave it to Roulecca.

With a grin, she climbs in through the window and overturns the table with her feet, sending the glass of Ambrosia flying into the air. Roulecca's mirage shudders and begins to disintegrate. It's her consciousness!

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Too slow!

She reaches out, snatches the flying glass, and catches all the liquid. She then turns around, kicks you to the ground, and pins you between the legs of a round stool. Finally, she puts one leg on the stool seat.
You are now on your back, firmly pinned by the stool under her foot.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief... Answer me, Chief! What's going on?!

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Risking your life for a glass of Ambrosia? How thirsty are you?

speaker: Choice
options: Roulecca's consciousness is in here, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You want to kill her?

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Oh? So you're risking your life for someone else? What a good Samaritan! A boring ol' goody two-shoes...

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Don't worry, Roulecca is my friend. Although we've only known each other for a little while, I won't hurt her. I just want her to be happy.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Sob... Daddy... Everyone... Come play again...
Roulecca spits out some more black four-leaf clovers. Several of them stick to your face, making you feel nauseous. The purple-haired girl grabs some of the ones floating in the air.

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Sniff... Hmph, you usually have so many funny ideas. How come the things you spit out are so bitter?

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Not pure enough, not good enough, I have to keep looking...
No one is trying to stop the commotion. Some guests around you even whistle and applaud. The only waiter backs away farther and farther, trembling as he looks in your direction.
You try to push the stool away, but the purple-haired girl is shockingly strong. Is she a Sinner? Your shackles show no response. Does this mean she hasn't even started using her powers yet?
The purple-haired girl notices your gaze. She turns, leans down, and looks at you through the stool.

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: You wanna try some Ambrosia, too? A little weakling, a good Samaritan, a big fool... Want a sweet dream of your own?

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Hahaha, all right, then! Take some!

Bellowing with laughter, she straightens herself and pours the Ambrosia in her hand on your face. You quickly shut your mouth and hold your breath, but the sweetness seems to seep into all your orifices.

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: Don't close your mouth, you'll choke! Don't try to dodge, either. Roulecca's consciousness is in it. If you want to save her, you shouldn't let it spill everywhere...

The sweet, nauseating liquid ultimately flows into your body through your nose and lips. You realize this isn't the first time you've experienced this feeling. Still, your consciousness begins to blur, float, levitate, and depart.

speaker: Purple-haired Girl
content: I really look forward to seeing what kind of malice you'll spit out!
You hear an angry shout, the exclamations of the crowd, and the laughter of the purple-haired girl... Then you completely lose consciousness.
It's you... A blank, dreamless canvas... What a strange soul... I can't touch your heart, yet you managed to break in here...
Oh... I get it. Your dreams are not your own... You disturbed someone else's paradise...
Hehe... What will you give me?

speaker: Female Voice
content: Hmm? Roulecca, he's awake.
female_content: Hmm? Roulecca, she's awake.

speaker: Girl's Voice
content: Really?

speaker: Girl's Voice
content: What a pity. I was hoping everyone would take turns doing CPR on him, like how a prince would wake up a sleeping princess.
female_content: What a pity. I was hoping everyone would take turns doing CPR on her, like how a prince would wake up a sleeping princess.

content: A huge four-leaf clover hovers over you... No, it's a woman whose head is a four-leaf clover. Terrified, you jolt wide awake.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hey, what kind of reaction is that? How rude! Lucy is really pretty, so many people line up to court her! It's your honor to get a kiss from her!
Roulecca pokes you with her cheeks puffed up, then breaks into a smile.
Contrary to the information given by Nightingale, she doesn't seem irritable or unstable. In fact, she seems like a happy, ordinary child.
People who use Ambrosia will enter and indulge in their own sweet dreams.
Since it's not your dream, it's hers...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hehe, I know you! You're the new Chief of Minos!

speaker: Roulecca
content: You've been running around chasing after Sinners for months now, but you still haven't caught everyone, have you? Hehe, you're really unlucky. Did you get lost? How did you end up here?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Since you're already here, then come and enjoy my family's summer party! Daddy bought me the most beautiful beach!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Daddy's a dummy. He's in his room because he got heatstroke. Roulecca'll have to play with the Chief instead!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Roulecca's family welcomes you too!
Family... Is she talking about the four-leaf clover heads?
The pink sky, the pink sea... Everything before your eyes reminds you that this is a dream. A young girl's dream. Yet the girl doesn't realize it at all.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ahhh... it hurts! What are you doing?
She didn't wake up. Instead, she covers her cheek with a pout. You've confirmed that in this mirage, your shackles don't work.

speaker: Choice
options: This is a dream. Come back with me, Roulecca.

content: She suddenly reaches out and pinches your cheeks in revenge, squeezing one side after another. The pain is quite real. This definitely doesn't feel like a dream.

speaker: Roulecca
content: It hurts, doesn't it? Still think this is a dream? Hehe, the Chief is a dummy, too.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hey... Come play! Didn't you come here for Roulecca's summer party too? The garden party is really fun!
You want to say something, but the atmosphere around you suddenly becomes tense. You feel like you are surrounded by cold glares from many...
"Play with Roulecca. Make her happy..." Even though the four-leaf clover people don't have eyes, you know they're staring at you. You haven't forgotten how aggressive they are in reality.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hehe, since we're at a beach, of course we should play... <color=#fb9259>beach volleyball</color>!

speaker: Roulecca
content: On one side is the Mister Chief of Minos... On the other are Roulecca and the four-leaf clover family!
female_content: On one side is the Miss Chief of Minos... On the other are Roulecca and the four-leaf clover family!

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Roulecca is just a kid. Surely our big strong Chief can handle things solo?
You think about it. This little girl can barely touch the edge of the net even when she jumps. As for the four-leaf clovers...

The incoming sea breeze spins the four-leaf clovers' heads like windmills. It doesn't take long before all the clovers are dizzy and spinning on the spot. You suddenly feel confident, and think of a new idea.

speaker: Choice
options: No problem. Let's start the game.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I win, what will you give me as a reward, Roulecca?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmph! Chief, how arrogant you are! No one has ever beaten Roulecca before, not even Daddy. What makes you so confident?

speaker: Roulecca
content: All right, then. Since you're so courageous, I hereby announce that the player who collects three Roulecca medals will receive the highest honor of the four-leaf clover family—<size=40>the Diamond Roulecca Medal</size>!

speaker: Four-leaf Clovers
content: <size=40>The Diamond Roulecca Medal</size>!

speaker: Choice
options: Forget about the diamond. I want something else from Roulecca.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I win, can you help me realize a wish?

speaker: Roulecca
content: How sly, hehe... Chief, you're as cunning as Daddy.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Sure. If you win the Diamond Roulecca Medal, Roulecca will grant you one wish, but only one.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Woosh! Let the game begin!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ahhh! How could Roulecca lose? I've never lost before, not to my daddy or sister or uncle or auntie or the four-leaf clovers!

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Chief, did you cheat?

speaker: Choice
options: Of course not. I want to win the reward fair and square.

content: Though you're low on stamina, it wasn't hard to win against a skinny little girl. The four-leaf clovers in the mirage aren't that smart, either.
She used to always win, either because of her lucky power, or...
You watch the little girl whine and lie down amidst the four-leaf clovers, who rush to comfort her... Clearly, this family spoils her rotten.

speaker: Choice
options: Roulecca, you didn't use your lucky power this time?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmm? What lucky power?
To your surprise, she looks at you in confusion. Did she lose her Sinner power?
No. Back in reality, you could feel the Sinner power from the black goo she vomited.
According to Dr. Gandall, sweet dreams squeeze out the bad memories... Did Roulecca view her lucky power as a curse?

speaker: Roulecca
content: I tried my best! Roulecca won't lose to you again next time!
She reluctantly puts a medal engraved with a four-leaf clover in your hand.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Sob... I'm tired... We'll continue tomorrow...
Whining and grumbling, she falls back into the arms of a man who gently picks her up.
He also has a four-leaf clover head, but his persona is clearly different from the other clover clones.

speaker: Roulecca's "Father
content: Hello, Chief of Minos. I'm <color=#fb9259>Roulecca's father</color>. Your arrival was unexpected, but it's just what I needed.

speaker: Roulecca's "Father
content: Please come with me. I can help you leave this mirage.
You walk across the pink beach as the sun sets. Roulecca's clover father leads you into a seaside villa.

speaker: Father
content: Please wait while I go tuck in Roulecca. You may do as you wish for the time being.
He carries the sleeping Roulecca upstairs, leaving you in the first floor lobby. The other four-leaf clovers around are doing chores in silence, as if they don't care about your presence.
Anything that interests you?
You turn around. The "father" with the four-leaf clover head is standing behind you. His voice is calm and gentle.

speaker: Father
content: Don't be nervous. I won't hurt you. You're investigating this room because you probably have questions about this world. I can answer them for you.

speaker: Father
content: This is Roulecca's dream. It's a world created by her subconscious mind. Ambrosia materialized the happiness she longed for, and cast all the painful memories out of this dream and into reality.

speaker: Choice
options: Is this why Sleepwalkers spit out black goo in the real world?
How did you find out that it's a dream?

speaker: Father
content: Really? Did my child spit out a lot of suffering in the real world?

speaker: Father
content: Sorry for giving you trouble. Roulecca has been mischievous since she was a toddler. She must've put you through a lot.

speaker: Options -1
options: I came here to stop her.

speaker: Father
content: I know. You want to break this dream. But do you know what to do?

speaker: Choice
options: How did you find out that it's a dream?

speaker: Father
content: Like you, I made observations and reasonable guesses. This world has too many loose ends. In Roulecca's eyes, Daddy is the smartest person in the world, and the one who understands her best.

speaker: Father
content: Even in a dream world created by Ambrosia, I can't let down my daughter's expectations of me.

speaker: Options -1
options: You want to guard your daughter's sweet dream?

speaker: Father
content: That's what I wanted to ask you. Do you want to destroy this dream?

speaker: Father
content: Like you, I made observations and reasonable guesses. This world has too many loose ends. In Roulecca's eyes, Daddy is the smartest person in the world, and the one who understands her best.

speaker: Father
content: Even in a dream world created by Ambrosia, I can't let down my daughter's expectations of me.

speaker: Options -1
options: You want to guard your daughter's sweet dream?

speaker: Father
content: That's what I wanted to ask you. Do you want to destroy this dream?

speaker: Choice
options: Is this why Sleepwalkers spit out black goo in the real world?

speaker: Father
content: Really? Did my child spit out a lot of suffering in the real world?

speaker: Father
content: Sorry for giving you trouble. Roulecca has been naughty since she was a toddler. She must've put you through a lot.

speaker: Options -1
options: I came here to stop her.

speaker: Father
content: I know. You want to break this dream. But do you know what to do?

speaker: Father
content: Here, Roulecca is the rule. You can't use your strange power. If you go too far, you will be rejected by Roulecca. The dream will obey her subconscious and expel you back to reality.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When I get back to the real world, I will find a way to wake her up and stop the black four-leaf clovers from spreading.

speaker: Father
content: It's too late. This world has already matured and taken deep roots. As long as Roulecca still yearns for the Ambrosia-made "happiness" in her heart, she will never wake up from this dream.

speaker: Father
content: Also, don't assume you can escape unharmed. Even if you are expelled from the dream, you will become part of the black goo. You will turn into a black four-leaf clover head, contaminating your "reality".
How terrible this is.

speaker: Choice
options: Are you here to stop me, or to threaten me?

speaker: Father
content: Neither. I want you to take her away from here.
Roulecca's "father" sits down on the sofa, resting his elbows on the armrests and locking his fingers together. The eyeless four-leaf clover looks toward you.

speaker: Father
content: I'm already dead. Ambrosia used Roulecca's longing for her family to create this doting hallucination to restrain and imprison her in a frozen past.

speaker: Father
content: You're the only outsider. You are not created by her. And only you can dismantle all this. I will help you destroy this dream so that you and my daughter can return to reality together.

speaker: Father
content: Awaken her. Make her understand that this is all fake, so that she can no longer get joy from it.

speaker: Father
content: When she no longer relies on Ambrosia, Ambrosia will stop attaining her happiness, and the dream will collapse. Roulecca will be able to escape the Sleepwalker's curse, and cease to cause trouble for your real world.
This doesn't sound like something a "doting hallucination" would say. It sounds like the words of a Syndicate casino boss.

speaker: Choice
options: Why don't you awaken her yourself?

speaker: Father
content: I can't do it. I am the father shaped by Roulecca's subconscious, an extremely doting father.

speaker: Father
content: If I'm forced to say anything that makes my dearest Roulecca cry... My mouth will rot away before the words come out.
...What strange things is this four-leaf clover head saying?

speaker: Father
content: ...I've tried many things, but none of them succeeded. I'm not able to destroy this world for her.

speaker: Father
content: You can choose to not believe me, but there's no harm in listening to me. You don't want to be stuck here forever either, do you?

speaker: Father
content: Roulecca likes you very much, and also made you a promise. As long as you win the Diamond Medal in the next games, you can make a wish for Roulecca and make her leave.

speaker: Father
content: This is your plan anyways, isn't it?

speaker: Choice
options: Will this world allow me to win?
Even if I win, will she keep her promise?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like you said, this place obeys her subconscious. If she doesn't want to lose, how can I win?

speaker: Father
content: Just join the game and win against her fair and square. Roulecca will never cheat.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If this mirage was born from her yearnings for you, would she be willing to leave just for a game?

speaker: Father
content: Don't worry. Roulecca's a bit stubborn sometimes, but she never breaks a promise.

speaker: Father
content: She's a daughter of the four-leaf clovers. <color=#fb9259>"Win fairly and lose graciously"</color> is a rule she lives by, and also your best chance of winning.
But there's still something you're confused about.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You are also part of this dream. You were also created to dote on her and satisfy her every whim. But you are not like the other hallucinations.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not only did you see through this dream, but you also want to go against your "daughter's" wishes and make her leave. Why is that?

speaker: Father
content: ...You don't need to worry about me, Chief. Don't overthink it. I'm not really human. I'm just here as the "father" from her memories.

speaker: Father
content: This is everything her "father" would do. That's all.

speaker: Father
content: Good luck to you on the game tomorrow.
The competition begins as scheduled the next day. Both of you arrive at the beach on time. Roulecca puts her hands on her hips as she confidently challenges you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmph! Before this game, I already tested things out with Lucy and Uncle John and Dummy and Gummy countless times. Whether it's chess, volleyball, darts, dice, or poker, Roulecca wins every time! Victory is mine!

speaker: Roulecca
content: It's Roulecca's lucky day! There's no way I'm losing to you again!

speaker: Four-leaf Clover Spectator
content: Go, Roulecca, go!

speaker: Four-leaf Clover Spectator
content: You're the best! You're not gonna lose to him!
female_content: You're the best! You're not gonna lose to her!

content: It must've been tough for the four-leaf clovers. They had to let Roulecca continuously "win" without her noticing anything wrong. This family must've expended a lot of effort each time.
Unfortunately, without her lucky power to protect her here, the skinny little girl is no match for you.

speaker: Choice
options: Yeah, yeah. Roulecca, please spare me.
Hmph! You don't know who you're up against.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Let the game begin! Bring it on!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Wahhhhh! Why?! This is insane! Roulecca has never lost a game before! A big bad adult is bullying a kid!
The almighty creator and rule maker of this world has lost, and is now throwing a tantrum on the ground.
Roulecca's "father" walks out from the villa, gently picks up the little girl, and pats away the sand from her body.

speaker: Father
content: Roulecca lost? Is this your first time losing?

speaker: Roulecca
content: The second time! Yesterday I also... I've never even lost to Daddy! Sob... He's obviously not as smart as Daddy... He's a big bully! H-he, he cheated!
female_content: The second time! Yesterday I also... I've never even lost to Daddy! Sob... She's obviously not as smart as Daddy... She's a big bully! S-she, she cheated!

speaker: Father
content: I don't care what he's the chief of. If he dares to cheat and bully Roulecca... There are plenty of guys Daddy can send to kill him...
female_content: I don't care what she's the chief of. If she dares to cheat and bully Roulecca... There are plenty of guys Daddy can send to kill her...

content: If that four-leaf clover face had eyes, he would've cut you to pieces with his glare. It seems this doting hallucination has completely forgotten that he's on your side.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Sob... No need to kill him... Sob... Actually, I don't remember too clearly. Maybe Roulecca was mistaken.
female_content: Sob... No need to kill her... Sob... Actually, I don't remember too clearly. Maybe Roulecca was mistaken.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...But if he wins one more round, Roulecca'll have to grant him his wish.
female_content: ...But if she wins one more round, Roulecca'll have to grant her her wish.

speaker: Father
content: Do you regret it, Roulecca? You don't want to keep this promise?

speaker: Roulecca
content: I regret it a bit... What a shame. I never even made such a promise to my own family. None of you have ever beaten me...

speaker: Father
content: You haven't lost yet, Roulecca. Besides, it's just a little wish. You'll grant him that wish, won't you, Roulecca?
female_content: You haven't lost yet, Roulecca. Besides, it's just a little wish. You'll grant her that wish, won't you, Roulecca?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Yeah... Roulecca is the daughter of the four-leaf clovers. Like Daddy said, our family lives by the rule "win fairly and lose graciously."
Whining and grumbling, the little girl hugs the four-leaf clover tightly. She buries her face into his neck, wiping her tears back and forth.

The scene is so natural and heartwarming that for a moment, you forget about the strangeness of the whole situation and view the four-leaf clover as Roulecca's real father... However, it's just an illusion. Roulecca's real father died a long time ago.
...Did she really not notice anything strange? For her, is this really just a dream from which she's waiting to be awakened from?

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Hmph! Bad Chief... I want to say first that Roulecca won't lose! I don't think I'll lose!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Roulecca just wants to ask, in the teensiest chance that you win... Or when you're daydreaming about winning... What are you planning to wish for?

Nervously clutching the hem of her skirt, she keeps her head lowered but still steals glances at you. Without her lucky power to back her up, the little girl can only bluff and timidly wait for your answer.

speaker: Choice
options: ...I wish you'll leave this dream and come back to reality.

content: The "father" freezes, but you ignore his shock. You stare into Roulecca's eyes, observing her.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...That's all you want?
She bats her eyes, then suddenly squirts you in the face with her water gun.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hahahaha! What a dummy you are, Chief! Roulecca woke up a long time ago! I've stopped dreaming already!

speaker: Roulecca
content: By the way, last night I dreamed that I won against Daddy for the 666th time, and that he finally bought me the cutest little revolver for my birthday.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Sigh, but that was just a dream. When I woke up, I didn't have anything. When can I get my own revolver?
She sighs exaggeratedly and winks at her "father." There's not a hint of gloom in her bright smile.

speaker: Father
content: When she no longer relies on Ambrosia, Ambrosia will stop attaining her happiness, and the dream will collapse. Roulecca will be able to escape the Sleepwalker's curse, and cease to cause trouble for your real world.

speaker: Roulecca
content: But it's fine. I'll have a chance to get it in the future. There's still a long time. Daddy will always be by my side, just like everyone else. The Four-Leaf Clover family will stay together forever and ever.

speaker: Roulecca
content: As for your little wish, Roulecca'll make sure to grant it. Good luck, Chief!
female_content: As for your little wish, Roulecca'll make sure to grant it. Good luck, Miss Chief!

content: She runs off laughing, leaving you frozen in place. Her "father" walks up and stands shoulder to shoulder with you.

speaker: Choice
options: This is why you can't wake her up...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even if I make a wish to force her to wake up, it's no use. Roulecca has chosen this sweet dream with all of you in it. She thinks this is reality.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even if she admits defeat, she can't escape her own perception to meet my request. Even if she were to wake up a thousand times, she'll only end up back here.

speaker: Father
content: You're right. We have to get her to accept that this place isn't real from the bottom of her heart.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How can I convince her that the world without you is the real one? How do I persuade her to leave you behind? By brainwashing her?

speaker: Father
content: ...All you have to do is make her recall.

speaker: Father
content: We four-leaf clover heads aren't her real family. Her memories with her real family go way back before us. She won't discard her deep love for them.

speaker: Father
content: Make her remember her real family, and that she has long lost them. That way, the mirage created by Ambrosia will no longer numb her. Our existence will become salt on her wound, forcing her to wake up.

speaker: Father
content: She will leave on her own.

speaker: Choice
options: Even if that brings her pain?
...What about you? Are you willing to let her go?

speaker: Father
content: ...Yes, even if that brings her pain.

speaker: Father
content: ...I was created here to act as her "father." This is what her father would have wanted.
In this moment, the surreal four-leaf clover is showing unwavering resolve. For a second, you see a human figure.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not just a hallucination created by Ambrosia to hold her captive. You're...

speaker: Father
content: Chief, my good sir, are you someone who is easily swayed by others?
female_content: Chief, my dear lady, are you someone who is easily swayed by others?

speaker: Father
content: Roulecca has a strong power that others don't. When she "sleepwalks," black goo laced with her power will continuously contaminate the real world and threaten your companions.

speaker: Father
content: This isn't your sweet dream. Don't forget why you came here, and what you're trying to accomplish.

speaker: Father
content: Act as soon as possible. The longer she stays here, the more pain she'll feel when she wakes up.
You recompose your wavering resolve. What you need to do now is find a way to awaken Roulecca, and the key to this lies in the self she discarded to create this beautiful dream.
...You have to get her to voluntarily reclaim what she has discarded.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmm? What is it, Chief? Are you done resting? Eager to start round three?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Roulecca, if I win, you'll keep your promise to me, right?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Of course. A daughter of the four-leaf clovers always keeps her word.
She flashes a carefree smile, the kind that only a well-loved child can make. You pause for a second, then force yourself to say...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I win, I'll take away everyone here except you. You will never see your family again.

speaker: Roulecca
content: You want... my family?
It doesn't take long for the girl's expression to change from innocent and carefree to shocked and perplexed, before finally molding into a frown of indescribable pain.
Not far away, the wind begins to rage, and the waves begin to roar.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Where are you going to take them? What... are you going to do to them?

speaker: Choice
options: You look really perplexed. Did you remember something?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you remember where your real family went? Do you remember what happened to them?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ahhh!

With a sudden shudder, Roulecca covers her head and slumps to the ground. Her "father" instinctively lunges forward to catch her in his arms, while the other four-leaf clovers rush over to pin you down.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Daddy... Lucy... Everyone is here... Everyone is fine... Everyone is by Roulecca's side... Daddy didn't leave Roulecca... Daddy has always been by my side...
The four-leaf clover doesn't reply. He just hugs her tightly and supports her as best he can. Small pieces of black four-leaf clovers begin to float out of Roulecca's mouth and dissolve into the air.
You know those are fragments of her pain being driven back to reality. Ambrosia always expels Roulecca's memories before she manages to remember anything. This must have happened many times already.
You have to take a gamble to break the cycle.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Hehe... You've got guts, mister... To want Roulecca's family...
female_content: ...Hehe... You've got guts, lady... To want Roulecca's family...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Who do you think you are?!
Your skin begins to crack and shed pieces of black four-leaf clovers, which float away and disappear. A tingling pain seeps through your body.
Roulecca is rejecting you. Her subconscious is trying to squeeze you out of the dream, but you can't back down.

speaker: Choice
options: No cheating. You don't have the confidence to beat me?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come beat me in the game. Lucky Roulecca, daughter of the four-leaf clovers, don't break your own rules!
She glances at her father, who looks back at her, as if silently reminding her of something.
Finally, the girl lowers her head, clenches her teeth, and glares at you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I'll win against you fair and square.
The resentment expelling you disappears. The girl staggers up to face you, surrounded by a black shroud of shredded four-leaf clovers.

speaker: Choice
options: You won't beat me by playing house.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm not like your "family." I won't coddle you, and you won't get any "good luck" from me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you want to win against me, then wake up from this dream and remember what you have discarded, Sinner Roulecca.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Hehe, hahahaha... A villain, what a villain you are...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Roulecca is not a Sinner. Roulecca is just the daughter of the four-leaf clovers. No one can split up the clovers. No one can take away Roulecca's family.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I hate you, but I won't lose to you.
She grabs onto the corner of her father's shirt.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Daddy... You're on Roulecca's side, aren't you? You won't leave me, will you, Daddy?

speaker: Father
content: ...Of course. Daddy will always be on Roulecca's side.
The four-leaf clover father hugs Roulecca. The pair walks to the other side of the net and turns to face you. You know he won't go easy on you.

speaker: And you... could you be my auspicious star?
content: Match... Match point... Winning side, ${PlayerName} serves...

speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
content: Roulecca... is six points short.
You can't tell if Roulecca is panting out of exhaustion or anxiety. She sweats profusely as she stares at you both nervously and stubbornly.

speaker: Choice
options: If you keep this up, you'll lose.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm really going to take away your family. You'll never see your daddy again.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Roulecca won't lose!

The moment you toss the ball into the air, a seagull sweeps across the sky beneath the dazzling sun, casting a flash of blinding light into your eyes. The ball falls, snaps your finger, and hits your forehead.

speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
content: Fweet! Service fault by ${PlayerName}! A point for the four-leaf clover family!

speaker: Roulecca
content: What are you waiting for? Keep the match going! It's my turn to serve. Roulecca's going to make a comeback!
Wobbling, she takes the ball and serves it with all her strength. The ball floats softly, hits the white boundary line and twists a few times—then jumps over the line and lands on your side!

speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
content: ...Good serve! Well-played, Roulecca! A point for the four-leaf clover family!
There has been a change in the situation.

speaker: Choice
options: Are you interfering with the rules here again?

speaker: Roulecca
content: How rude! Roulecca didn't cheat! That was luck!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Like I said, Roulecca is always the luckiest one! I won't lose to anyone! I won't let you take them away!
Her eyes flash with a frenzy and persistence that you are all too familiar with. Something is gradually awakening within her.
Things aren't going according to plan, but maybe... it's better this way.

speaker: Choice
options: Great. Keep enjoying the game, Roulecca.

content: All the way till you regain what you have lost.

speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
content: In! What a stunning arc! What a spectacular volley! A point for the four-leaf clover family!

speaker: Roulecca
content: ${PlayerName} clips the net... but fails! Tsk tsk tsk, what an unlucky guy. Another point for the four-leaf clover family!
female_content: ${PlayerName} clips the net... but fails! Tsk tsk tsk, what an unlucky lady. Another point for the four-leaf clover family!

speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
content: The serve clips the net! Roulecca scores twice! A point for the four-leaf clover family!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Wow! My serve went over the net! It's in! Daddy, I scored a point! My good luck is real! A point for the four-leaf clover family!

speaker: Four-leaf Clover Judge
content: Net fault for ${PlayerName}! A point for the four-leaf clover family! The four-leaf clover family is now in the lead!

You protest loudly, pointing at the strange hermit crab pinching your heels. When you were rushing towards the ball, it suddenly appeared and pinched you. You lost your balance and fell face first into the net.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Mm-hmm, nice excuse. Fine then. Roulecca'll let you off this time. Let's try again.
One minute later.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Wooo! Out again for ${PlayerName}! Match point for the four-leaf clover family! Roulecca is going to win!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Daddy, look! We're going to win!
Her little face is bright red from all the excitement. She takes her father's hand and skips around in happiness.

speaker: Roulecca
content: So, Chief Dumb-Dumb... Did you see the powers of the goddess of luck?

speaker: Choice
options: I did. You really are the goddess of luck.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hehehe... You don't know who you're messing with! I have the super duper invincible good luck from all the four-leaf clover family! There's no way I'd lose to you!
Around her, there are no more black four-leaf clovers dissipating.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As expected of a Sinner with the power of Unbeatable Luck. You've regained the power that you discarded.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Huh?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you remember why you discarded it? Did it bring you a lot of pain?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Shut up!
She stands up abruptly and points her water gun at you, which has somehow turned into a revolver.
Roulecca notices the transformation, and throws away the gun in shock.
Someone else picks it up silently.

speaker: Father
content: This is the birthday gift promised to you, Roulecca. Your father kept his promise and gave you this revolver.

speaker: Father
content: Do you recall what happened that day?

speaker: Roulecca
content: No, no... I don't want to! I don't want this kind of luck...

speaker: Roulecca
content: I don't want luck in exchange for Daddy and everyone else... I just want you guys... Don't leave me...

speaker: Father
content: Wake up, Roulecca. This isn't your world. Your real father is no longer with you.
The pink sea begins to distort, and cracks form in the sky. Once punctured, the beautiful dream can never go back to the way it was.
Your shackles react. Sinner S-666, the super lucky Roulecca, has woken up...

speaker: Four-leaf Clover People
content: Roulecca... Roulecca...

The four-leaf clovers around her wither away one by one. Their bodies thin out and finally disappear. Just like the "father" said, once the truth is known, these fake family members can no longer make her happy.
The child is at a loss. No longer happy and carefree, she shuts her eyes tightly, unwilling to see what is happening around her, while at the same time enduring the overwhelming pain of old memories.
You don't say anything. You just pick up the volleyball in silence, pat it twice, and serve it over the net. Then you flip the scoreboard and walk over to Roulecca.
The girl is kneeling on the rose-gold beach. The fine grains of sand are flowing to the edge of the world and disappearing into nothingness.

speaker: Roulecca
content: You villain, you devil, you big bad brute... You're just like those evil gangsters. You took everything Roulecca had...

speaker: Roulecca
content: I won't forgive you! I'll have my revenge... Just you wait, one day...

speaker: Choice
options: Grant me my wish before that then. Lose graciously.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Your wish already came true. You took away my family for the second time...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's not my wish. I was just tricking you. My real wish is...

speaker: Choice
options: Bid farewell to your daddy, Roulecca.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Huh?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: He loves you very much.
You take a step back, giving way to the four-leaf clover man behind you. You leave the last moments of the dream to this father and daughter.

speaker: Father
content: You realized another wish on your bucket list. We found the most beautiful beach and played volleyball together.

speaker: Father
content: Did you have fun, Roulecca?

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Why are you on his side?
female_content: ...Why are you on her side?

speaker: Father
content: Daddy is always on Roulecca's side.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Then why do you want Roulecca to wake up?!

speaker: Roulecca
content: You know I'd be heartbroken! You know I just want to stay and be with all of you! Yet you...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Damn it! It's just Ambrosia, isn't it... I'll find Mess! She has a lot of it! She'll give it to me. I'll be back. I'll be back no matter how many times it takes!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Next time, I'll create my real daddy! A daddy who will never betray Roulecca! I won't let you guys crush my dreams again!!

speaker: Father
content: It'll be the same, Roulecca. Ambrosia will never change "my" resolve.

speaker: Father
content: As long as you still miss your real father, the "father" you create will try to wake you up every time, no matter what it takes.

speaker: Roulecca
content: You're lying! My real daddy wouldn't push me away! My real daddy wouldn't make me cry!

speaker: Roulecca
content: You're a fake! You're just a four-leaf clover! You're not my real daddy...

speaker: Father
content: You're right. I'm just a hallucination... But I know his heart better than anyone else.
He lifts up the girl's tear-streaked face.

speaker: Father
content: Your real father would never allow anyone to toy with your feelings. He would break Ambrosia's curse and take you back every time.

speaker: Father
content: Wake up, Roulecca... Wake up, and grow up. You two made so many wishes that belong to the future. He wants you to see the world, and to meet more people who love you and are worthy of your love.

speaker: Father
content: The past cannot be changed, but both he and the four-leaf clovers are always watching over you. You're the luckiest little girl now, Roulecca, and in the future, you'll be the happiest too.

speaker: Father
content: Your father's greatest wish has always been for you to grow up happy. You know that better than anyone else, don't you, Roulecca?

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Sob... No, that's not right... No!
She strikes his chest over and over again with fists weakened by crying.

speaker: Roulecca
content: My real daddy wouldn't leave me all alone! He wants to see me grow up and find happiness with his own eyes! That's what he wants, right? Right?!

speaker: Father
content: ...Yes, he wants that.
The man leans down and hugs the sobbing girl tightly. Time is running out. As the funny-looking four-leaf clover fades away, the last thing you see is a father's tearful face.

speaker: Father
content: I'm sorry, Roulecca... I'm not your real father...

speaker: Father
content: I'm sorry... for not being able to watch you grow up...

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Sob... You liar... Let go... You're not my daddy, you...

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Ahhh!

The embrace supporting her suddenly shatters. The man dissolves into countless four-leaf clovers that scatter into the air. The girl tries to grab them in panic, but the leaves slip through her fingers, and she ends up with nothing.

speaker: Roulecca
content: No... No!!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Don't go! Don't leave me! Come back, I beg you!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Daddy!!!

The dream has been broken, but you can't bear to watch the final ending. You never did find out what happened on the birthday that Roulecca got her revolver and lucky power, or what exactly she is so desperate to forget.
You start to float as the ground slips away beneath your feet. Your consciousness gradually drifts away to the sound of the girl's whimpers.
Before completely merging into the darkness, you hear a voice.

speaker: Male Voice
content: Thank you...
The sea breeze has halted, and the waves have fallen silent. The girl's laughter and cries fade away, replaced by pain tightening around your brain and stomach, as well as a familiar rancid odor.

The sun is shining into Doyle's filthy home. You're nestled on the messy sofa, with tattered socks hanging above your head on the sofa's back. As you dodge them to get up, a note floats down before you.

speaker: Note
content: Rest properly and don't ******* go wandering around again before I come back. —Doyle

speaker: Nightingale
content: You can rest a bit more, Chief. Hecate already updated the Bureau about the situation.

The digital clock reads: <color=#fb9259>N.F. 112.10.03</color>, 07:16. A little more than a day has passed. You can't tell if that's a long or short time. The endless summer in the dream has blurred your perception of time.

speaker: Choice
options: What happened at the scene of the attack?

speaker: Nightingale
content: At the same time as you were attacked, Hecate arrived on the scene and saved you. She had a brief confrontation with the suspicious woman who attacked you, and confirmed that she was the fourth Sinner at the scene of the crisis. The Sinner's abilities are unknown.

speaker: Nightingale
content: That fourth Sinner took her away. The arrest team went to work right away, but not long ago, S-666's power anomalies suddenly stopped. The contamination from her Sleepwalking symptoms disappeared at the same time, and we lost track of her.

speaker: Nightingale
content: In the worst case scenario, your attacker forcibly ended S-666's Sleepwalking state by killing her, to shake off our pursuit.

speaker: Choice
options: I think... Roulecca woke up from her dream, that's all.

content: You tell Nightingale about the "dream" you experienced. You recount the imprisonment of Sleepwalkers' consciousness, the source of the contamination, the deepening of the Sleepwalking state and its termination method, and most importantly...
The root cause of everything, <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color>.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ... All this time, Sleepwalkers' M-values remained within the safe range, so the FAC did not officially classify this mutation as a form of Mania.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But if "Ambrosia" can alter human consciousness so deeply and with such precision that it can even change the reality... Then it can already be classified as a <color=#fb9259>new strain of Mania</color>. A strain that is even stealthier.

speaker: Nightingale
