Suddenly, colorful rays of light resembling oil film stream out of the club, flooding the entire block. The light fades, and darkness descends like night.

Now, only you and the two Sinners remain awake in the entire affected area. You walk through the corridors of the empty club, looking for possible clues while fighting off condensed contaminants from time to time.

speaker: Hecate
content: Using the map provided by the 9th Agency, the Nightmare has already investigated the club, but could not find anyone "sober." Everyone had fallen into a deep sleep.

speaker: Hella
content: Pwahaha... I can't do this. Don't talk while wearing that. I just can't hold it back, hahahaha... And I can't breathe when I laugh hahahaha.

speaker: Hecate
content: This is a necessary protective measure. This area is blanketed by gasified Ambrosia. It's another type of spiritual contamination, and is very dangerous.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, control yourself. The Hypercubes in your protective mask are starting to deplete faster.

speaker: Hella
content: Hahahaha... ${PlayerName}, you should stop talking, too... Ouch!
It always takes a thwack from Hecate for Hella to stop.

Doyle's disappearance rang the alarm bells for everyone. The FAC launched an emergency operation proposal overnight, and finally overcame obstruction from the City Council to dispatch counter-Mania troops into Eastside's District 14. You also make preparations in advance to fight against the Sinner.

Yet no one expected that the decisive battle would suddenly start like this. You've done all you could, yet still lost the upper hand to the new, unknown strain of Mania. All the frontline surveillance troops are trapped in the contaminated area, yourself included.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: That Sinner deliberately made it seem like Ambrosia was extremely rare, to hide the fact that she had enough to create a large-scale contamination to control the area swiftly. Judging from the M-value fluctuations, she's already an S-Class Sinner.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: All right, Chief. Go after her. Keep this protective mask on. If the Hypercubes inside get used up, remember to replenish them immediately. We've prepared for you an ample supply.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: We will contain the contaminants from the Sleepwalkers outside, and try to hold out until you get in. There are quite a few of them. Once our protective gear gets exhausted, we'll just get some good sleep.

speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
content: We're leaving the rest up to you. Don't let "Miss Serpent" give us more surprises.

You return to the banquet hall of the club again. The hall is unusually quiet. Unconscious people are sprawled out everywhere, curled up like babies dreaming sweet dreams. They puff out traces of contamination as they murmur happily in their sleep.
The faint and dreamy colors flow gently in the air. If you take off your mask, you'd definitely smell the familiar sweet and nauseous aroma of Ambrosia.

speaker: Hella
content: Is that circus Sinner really here? Even Nightmare can't find her. Where should we go look?
The faintly sparkling light all float toward the same direction. You stretch out your hand. Your shackles cannot be fully activated, but they can sense the faint flow.
You lead the team up the stairs into an elegant office.
Sinner Serpent isn't here. Behind the spacious desk is Eirene, President of Quinn. She is leaning back against her chair, brows relaxed and sleeping soundly.
Half a glass of Ambrosia sits on the desk. Beneath the glass is a note with a small snake symbol.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She used Ambrosia to hide in someone else's dream, just like she did with Mess.
You pick up the glass of Ambrosia. Faintly colored mist rises from the mouth of the glass. This is definitely the epicenter of the mist in the club, and Eirene's image flickers inside.
You take off your mask, hold your breath and gulp down all the Ambrosia. You're overwhelmed by the familiar dizziness. You close your eyes, and when you open them again...
You're in the center of a huge chessboard. The sound of chess pieces hitting the board echoes from one end of the chessboard.
The next second, you see a huge shadow looming toward you!
You ruin the chessboard because you can't win the game? What a philistine.
Come out. You ruined a good game of chess.
The light gradually brightens, and the first thing you see is a shrunken chessboard. The pieces on the chessboard are broken from smashing into each other, much like the board you just fought on.
As the area becomes brighter, you see a giant "tree" formed by a chessboard. Eirene sits at the foot of the "tree," gazing at you from across the chessboard.

speaker: Eirene
content: A few days ago, you declined my invitation. Now, you show up uninvited and trespass onto my chessboard.

speaker: Eirene
content: What do you want, Chief of Minos?

speaker: Eirene
content: What do you want, Chief of Minos?

speaker: Choice
options: I came to find the performer you hired.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ambrosia has taken too many people captive. The contamination from Sleepwalking is seriously threatening the real world. I must find Sinner Serpent and put an end to this mutation.

speaker: Eirene
content: At least you're being honest and upfront today. Not long ago, you had a bunch of spies from the 9th Agency test me...

speaker: Choice
options: We need to find out the truth about Ambrosia.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You and your Midsummer Night's Club are also victims. She trapped you in this dream. No matter how well you got along before, she has now betrayed you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I'm on your side. We share the same interests.

You speak as frankly as possible and observe Eirene's reaction. Her intelligence and rationality are obviously much higher than the average Sleepwalker. You must hurry up if you want to cooperate with her.
Eirene laughs.

speaker: Eirene
content: You think I'm a victim, and want to save me?
She glides her hand over the chessboard, instantly restoring the broken pieces to their original forms. On the opposite end of the chessboard, a vague illusory figure appears to play against Eirene.

speaker: Eirene
content: I know this is a dream. I can clearly recognize my own consciousness. Everything in this world obeys my will.

speaker: Eirene
content: Does this feel familiar?
...Very familiar. "To obey someone's will" is a disturbing description, and exactly the impression left on you by the <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color>.
She knows far more than you expected. The possible intentions behind this new strain of Mania make you shudder. Yet Eirene looks at you with a playful expression.

speaker: Eirene
content: Don't worry, Chief ${PlayerName}. This is just a <color=#fb9259>lucid dream</color>. Its limits and boundaries are very clear. I can't manipulate reality with my will like the Black Ring.

speaker: Choice
options: I thought you wouldn't need this kind of illusion.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why rely on these illusions? You can already conquer everything in real life. You're the President of Quinn. You can get whatever you want. No one can halt your desires or footsteps.

speaker: Eirene
content: You're right. That's why I feel bored sometimes.
On the chessboard, the illusory figure's white chess piece moves. Eirene thinks for a while, then moves her black piece.

speaker: Eirene
content: I have fulfilled too many wishes, but none of them have truly satisfied me.

speaker: Eirene
content: So I was curious what kind of joy this legendary Ambrosia can bring me, so that I'll never be bored...

speaker: Eirene
content: And the answer she gave me was very interesting and unique... At least, it's something reality can't give me.
You look at the figure across the board. It's blurry and illusory, but also calm and focused. Even if you can't read the board, you know that this figure is a "chessmaster."

speaker: Eirene
content: You're right.

speaker: Eirene
content: That woman knows very well she cannot hold me captive. So instead of becoming my enemy, she gave me this interesting gift...

speaker: Eirene
content: She's my friend already. She's an adorable, vulnerable and hardworking person. I like her very much. If you want me to hand her over...

speaker: Eirene
content: Chief ${PlayerName}, what can you give me in exchange for my friendship?
This woman isn't a victim, nor is she a potential partner. You know very well that here, she's in charge. Whether you or Serpent wins depends on which way this overlord sways.
And now, you have no shackles, no strength, and not even enough freedom. But you have something that can entertain her...

speaker: Choice
options: I can give you an opponent.

content: You walk over and dispel the chess-playing figure on the other side of the board, then sit down face-to-face with Eirene.

speaker: Eirene
content: Haha... At least you're quite courageous.
She flashes an elusive smile, then waves her hand gently. The chessboard resets, but this time, all the pieces on the board have turned into familiar faces.
On the white side, the chess pieces take on the appearances of Hecate, Hella, Zoya, Hamel, and other shackled Sinners.
On the black side, Eirene commands Serpent, Mess, and several blurry figures.
And at the center of the chess formation are you and Eirene, one white and one black.

speaker: Eirene
content: Just use the rules and pieces you are familiar with, and try your best to win.

speaker: Eirene
content: Come, my <color=#fb9259>opponent</color>. I look forward to your performance.

speaker: Eirene
content: Checkmate.
You've lost four games in a row already, yet Eirene still hasn't lost interest. She waits patiently for your move, and even begins to comfort you.

speaker: Eirene
content: You lack experience and technique, but I see some improvement in you, and some strategy.

speaker: Eirene
content: Checkmate. Do you want to start over? Try another round?
The disparity in prowess is too great. You don't want to waste any more time. Serpent won't wait for you. You try to nudge Eirene while she's still interested in you...

speaker: Choice
options: Do you only want an opponent in chess?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why don't you come back to reality and challenge me another way? Maybe I'll be able to satisfy you more that way.

speaker: Eirene
content: Hehe... If you can't even beat me in a game of chess, you'll have even less of a chance of winning in the real world.

speaker: Eirene
content: You should try to understand your chess pieces, then understand the game of Chess. Want my advice?
She reaches out and gently pushes the chess piece Hecate, who is standing in front of "you" on the chessboard.

speaker: Eirene
content: First of all, every chess piece's movements abide by their own rules, just like every person's destiny is determined by their own nature. Good chess players will familiarize themselves with the rules of each piece and make good use of them.
She points at Zoya.

speaker: Eirene
content: A powerful chess piece, obliterating everything in its path, forming an invincible army of one.

speaker: Eirene
content: But it can only ram forward blindly, without tact or restraint. Once caught in the enemy's trap, she will quickly collapse. If you don't discard the piece in time, you'll be in trouble too.
She then points at Hamel.

speaker: Eirene
content: A chess piece of void. She will not be attacked, even when deep in hostile territory. She heals and protects everyone without distinction.

speaker: Eirene
content: But she only follows her own rhythm and will not be controlled by you. Even if your life is on the line, she won't look back.
Then she points at Hecate.

speaker: Eirene
content: A stubborn chess piece who can unleash the ultimate strength by the king's side.

speaker: Eirene
content: But once out of her comfort zone, she becomes a useless pawn that can collapse and be discarded at any time.
She skips Hella without even looking at her and points to you.

speaker: Eirene
content: As the <color=#fb9259>king</color>, you must stick to your ground and deploy all the other pieces to protect yourself. Once you die, the existence of the other pieces becomes meaningless, and the whole game is lost.

speaker: Eirene
content: To win, you must observe, calculate, judge, and evaluate the situation. You need to use them to their greatest strengths, and discard them when necessary.

speaker: Eirene
content: I know you don't like it. You can't even view them as pawns on the chessboard. It'll be even harder for you to win in real life.

speaker: Eirene
content: Just like now. As the king, you leave your safe spot to break into the enemy's line alone. You never even thought about letting them take the risk for you... That's why you're trapped here in my place.
She smiles and looks at you with icy eyes.
Between the two of you is an unwinnable board of chess.

speaker: Choice
options: You trapped me here on purpose?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not looking for an opponent at all. You're just stalling time... for "Serpent."

speaker: Eirene
content: I do want you to give her some more time, but I also want to see you myself.

speaker: Eirene
content: I have high expectations for you. You're a special new recruit of the 9th Agency, Chief of the MBCC, and someone directly involved with BR-004.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since you're so interested in me, why don't we talk about why you're helping the mastermind of the Sleepwalking crisis?

speaker: Eirene
content: Why do you think?
Eirene continues to look at you with a smile. She's just having this roundabout conversation for fun. You look at the chessboard. Serpent is also in the black chess camp.

speaker: Choice
options: You never saw her as a friend. She's just one of your pawns.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You want to test out the power of Ambrosia, or rather, the power of the <color=#fb9259>new strain of Mania</color>. You're waiting to see how far Serpent can go. You won't allow me to obstruct her until she succeeds.
It seems that one can completely control and create a world in a lucid dream, while in reality, Sleepwalkers can also materialize their spiritual fluctuations by producing "contamination."
Eirene can already control the world of her dreams. If she can break through to the real world, she'd be able to use her consciousness to control reality through lucid dreaming.
Is this what she wants? The greedy capitalist, the careerist, the conqueror, or... the ruthless chessmaster?

speaker: Eirene
content: I know how far she can go.

speaker: Eirene
content: What I want to know now is actually... how far you can go.
She smiles as always.

speaker: Eirene
content: Let's have another round, Chief. As long as you beat me, I will grant you your wish and bring you to her.

speaker: Eirene
content: I've told you the rules of the chess pieces without any reservation. Please entertain me thoroughly this time.
Her unsmiling eyes seem to say that she knows you can never win. You're well aware of this fact yourself.
But you're not going to throw in the towel, either. There may be other ways to "entertain" someone who is bored from always winning like her. You stare into her eyes and say...

speaker: Choice
options: Then let me subvert your chessboard.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You say the rules of the pieces come from their nature. Let's discuss the "human nature" on this chessboard, then. After all, I disagree with your rules with all my heart.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like me, they're all living, breathing people, not pawns to be manipulated and discarded. Human nature cannot be summed up in a few words.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sure, Zoya uses violence to open the way. She harbors a lot of rage and paranoia, but in the end, she's still always fighting for others. It's only natural that she'd turn back for those she loves.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hamel sees the world differently from others, but that doesn't mean she's cold and indifferent. She just loves the world and those in it in her own way. The world is big enough to be her stage. She will find her audience.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hecate obeys orders well, but she's not a soulless robot. Despite her shortcomings, she's trying her best to understand this chaotic world. She has plenty of feelings, and will embrace many more possibilities in the future.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hella is not a weakling to be dismissed with contempt. You've never seen her fight with all her strength, so you can't imagine how strong she can be for those she cares about.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As for me... I'm not you. I'm neither a king nor a chessmaster. I'm one of them. I stand side by side with them on your chessboard. If I have to describe myself... then I'd say I'm their companion in this chess game of fate.
As you speak, your king moves forward on its own. The white chess pieces on your side vibrate gently, as if trying to break free from some kind of restraint and make an unexpected move.

speaker: Eirene
content: ...So what you're saying is, the chess pieces can break their own rules too?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. An arrogant person like you can't see through anyone at all. The chess pieces will one day overturn your so-called rules and shatter your fictitious destiny.

Eirene still won. On top of the disparity in technique and experience, she also strategized more meticulously than you. This chessmaster quickly familiarized herself with the rules you bent, and took advantage of the situation to counterattack.
Now, she gazes at her victory on the chessboard and the pieces who made "unexpected" moves, deep in thought.

speaker: Choice
options: Let's go again. I can do this all day.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I won't stop till I beat you. You will point the way for me.

speaker: Eirene
content: Ha... you're right. I don't know them well enough to surmise their nature. But your intentions are way too obvious, Chief ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Eirene
content: You made an impassioned speech to shake my subconscious and understanding of chess, so as to slowly rewrite the "rules" of this world.

speaker: Eirene
content: This is also why you lost every game but still keep on playing... To <color=#fb9259>subvert the chessboard</color>, as you put it.

speaker: Eirene
content: I'd love to keep playing with you, but you don't have that much time, do you?
She is truly the master of this lucid dream. Once this kind of psychological tactic has been uncovered, the ensuing challenge will be twice as hard.
But she has a happy smile on her face. You don't know when, but the black "king" has already moved forward one step.

speaker: Choice
options: Then have I entertained you enough?

speaker: Eirene
content: Hmm... no.

speaker: Eirene
content: If I could, I'd trap you to this chessboard till you struggle to your dying breath, until... I lose interest in you.

speaker: Eirene
content: But as you said, you can still provide more entertainment for me. This goes for both you and your chess pieces.

speaker: Eirene
content: Oh right, you call them <color=#fb9259>companions</color>...
A ray of light shines into the strange room. Then, a wooden door appears in the center of the room.

speaker: Eirene
content: Go, my opponent, my friend. Go resolve your troubles, so you can come back soon to challenge me without distractions.

speaker: Eirene
content: Let's set the next battle in your beloved reality.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When the time comes, you will pay for what you did today, Sinner Eirene.

speaker: Eirene
content: Haha, yes. You have a million reasons to take me to the Bureau. But you should know that you will face even more, graver crises in the future.

speaker: Eirene
content: When the time comes, will the President of Quinn be of more use to you confined or free?

speaker: Choice
options: I'll think about it. But same goes for you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know you have a million ways to clear your name and escape punishment. But think about it...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You yearn for challenges and worthy opponents. Would you rather be stuck in a boring CEO's office, or be in the heart of the coming storm? Which path will better quench your thirst for conquest?

speaker: Eirene
content: ...Haha, well played. I will think about it.
Her gaze returns to the chessboard. The initial illusory figure gradually reappears on the opponent's seat. You now see clearly that it resembles Eirene.

No amount of lucid dreaming can give her an opponent that surpasses her own cognition. Sooner or later, this chessmaster will get bored of always winning and leave this dream to find the next opponent, challenge, and conquest.
But that's not something you should be thinking about right now. You open the door, smell the sweet aroma, and step into the light...
You pass through the fragrance and light to see...
...A home.

The sound of tap water splashing onto pots and pans comes from the kitchen, blending with the soothing music of an old record player. The cozy afterglow of dusk illuminates the house with surreal warmth.
Does your head still hurt?
The woman's gentle visage comes into view. She hands you a hot drink. You take it, and find yourself on the sofa with a splitting headache.

speaker: Gentle Woman
content: Have some. This hangover drink is my family's secret recipe. Doyle often stumbles home drunk like this, too. I always make it for him. It's effective, and he likes the taste.
The miracle hangover drink from Doyle's home? You take a sip hesitantly. Unlike what you remember, this beverage tastes mellow and warm, dispelling your fatigue.
She smiles and nods.

speaker: Gentle Woman
content: That guy always needs someone to take care of him. You must've had to look out for him at work.

speaker: Gentle Woman
content: He went grocery shopping just now. He says we're going to cook a big meal for our guest, so he'll probably take a while. Please make yourself at home.
Smiling, the woman takes the empty cup and returns to the kitchen to prepare dinner. You get up and look around.
This is Doyle's dream. This is the home he once had.
You want to keep looking, but you hear a familiar man's voice humming out of tune from outside the door. He happily opens the door, his face beaming brightly.

speaker: Doyle
content: Oh hey, you're finally awake. Where'd you party last night to end up this wasted?

speaker: Doyle
content: Have some of the hangover drink to clear up your stomach. We're going to have a big meal in a bit. Not to brag, but my wife is the best cook in the world!

speaker: Nasha
content: Doyle, come help.

speaker: Doyle
content: Roger that, commander!
He quickly changes into his slippers and shuffles toward the kitchen, but you grab him.

speaker: Doyle
content: What is it?
You don't have time to beat around the bush. You get straight to the point.

speaker: Choice
options: Wake up, Inspector. Time is running out.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're trapped in a dream. You ingested Ambrosia in the real world and fell into this Sleepwalking state.

speaker: Doyle
content: What are you talking about? Are you still drunk or something? You're the one who was craving my wife's cooking all the time. You insisted on coming over to eat these past couple weeks.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I didn't even know you two weeks ago. You've been working on this case, and got attacked yesterday.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: District 14 is in grave danger. You have to wake up and help me find the Sinner hiding in your dreams, or else more people will become victims.

speaker: Doyle
content: What are you talking about? Did you lose your mind? Nasha and I have been preparing this meal for you all day.

speaker: Choice
options: You split up with her a long time ago.

speaker: Doyle
content: What the **** are you talking about?!

speaker: Choice
options: You know what I'm talking about.

content: You pick up the TV remote and turn up the volume. The looping news broadcast disturbs the peace in the house.

speaker: TV Newscast
content: ...The impact of the incident at the Midsummer Night's Club continues to worsen. Dozens have gone missing...

speaker: TV Newscast
content: ...The cause of the incident remains unclear... The FAC's counter-Mania defense line has been impacted. If it is damaged, the Sleepwalking phenomenon will quickly spread to cover all of District 14...

speaker: Choice
options: This is your subconscious warning you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Try to remember! This is your case!

speaker: Doyle
content: Enough!
Doyle grabs the remote control and throws it hard at the TV. With an earsplitting crack, the screen goes dark, leaving only a long spiderweb-like fissure.

speaker: Nasha
content: What's wrong?
"Nasha" walks out of the kitchen and looks at you two in worry. In this instant, a frightened look flashes on Doyle's face. A wisp of black smoke floats out from the TV screen, and the fissure heals.

speaker: Nasha
content: Do you have work... Or are you fighting?

speaker: Doyle
content: No, it's fine. ${PlayerName} suddenly realized he needs to leave to work on a case. I'll see him out.
female_content: No, it's fine. ${PlayerName} suddenly realized she needs to leave to work on a case. I'll see her out.

speaker: Nasha
content: Dinner's ready though. Aren't you going to eat something before leaving?

speaker: Doyle
content: A workaholic like him won't appreciate it. This case is urgent. He's not gonna stay.
female_content: A workaholic like her won't appreciate it. This case is urgent. She's not gonna stay.

speaker: Nasha
content: Then... what about you?
Behind her is a table full of delicious food, which must have taken a long time to prepare.

speaker: Doyle
content: I'll stay and eat, of course. I'm not him. I'm married to you, not my work.
female_content: I'll stay and eat, of course. I'm not her. I'm married to you, not my work.

speaker: Doyle
content: Wait for me.
You open your mouth to say something, but Doyle grabs you by the collar and drags you to the door.

speaker: Doyle
content: What the **** do you want to say?!

speaker: Choice
options: She's not real. None of this is.

speaker: Doyle
content: This is real. This is the most important thing in the world to me. I'll never let go!

speaker: Doyle
content: **** work, **** the case. They're nothing compared to her. I won't make the wrong choice again.
His eyes are full of fear. The man is deeply immersed in the dream already. You have no time to wake him up.

speaker: Doyle
content: Get lost!
Doyle pushes you out the door and slams the door shut. He has expelled you.
Outside the door is icy darkness, from which you hear a faint sneer.
Why bring this upon yourself? Why try to snatch others from their sweet dreams?
A hint of sweet aroma lingers in the darkness.

speaker: Choice
options: Show yourself. I know you're here.

content: Haha... It's just a little warm-up performance. Don't be mad...
Plus, aren't you the fool who disturbs others' dreams?
The dreamy performance is about to start. Welcome, dreamless one. I saved you a VIP seat.
According to legend, there's a mighty city...

It stands in the middle of the storm, illuminating the endless night. It is a beacon, a torch, it guards the rarest treasure in the world all alone. It embraces the most precious miracle in the darkness...
Do you know what it is?
It's happiness!

speaker: Serpent
content: Ta-da... I am Serpent, the circus performer of dreams. My greatest joy is bringing joy to everyone.

speaker: Serpent
content: You there! The frowning gentleman in the audience! Yes, you!
female_content: You there! The frowning lady in the audience! Yes, you!

speaker: Choice
options: I don't have time for this.

speaker: Serpent
content: That's right! Serpent invites you onstage!

speaker: Serpent
content: Aww, don't be such a killjoy! Serpent invites you onstage!
Your body somehow turns into a small wooden cutout, and is placed onstage.

speaker: Serpent
content: Ah, much better! Your previous look was much too heavy!
She jabs you between your brows, making your wooden body shudder violently.

speaker: Serpent
content: Relax, relax... Like I said, I want to bring joy to everyone. That includes you, of course.

speaker: Serpent
content: Poor little dear. You can't taste the sweet Ambrosia and enter a sweet dream of your own, so you rack your brain all day to try to ruin my performance. I really pity you.

speaker: Serpent
content: So I've decided to give you a custom package of joy! Tell me, what do you want? I'll satisfy you personally!
You can't feel your new strange and absurd body, but you do feel shock and fear. This is the first time that you, as an intruder from reality, have been completely transformed by dreams.
The blue-haired girl in front of you wields greater control in the Realm of Dreams than anyone else. She can turn you into a ridiculous wooden cutout or kill you at any time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know you use Ambrosia to filter consciousness, and expel all the darkness and misery. Your goal isn't to create a new strain of Mania, right? Those contaminants are just garbage you don't want.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You spread Ambrosia to attain high-purity <color=#fb9259>joy</color> from the Sleepwalkers, who are immersed in happiness. You are definitely involved with the <color=#fb9259>Marv case</color>.
Such a highly-concentrated, singularly strong emotion reminds you of that horrible phenomenon. It's a possibility you have to consider. No one can bear the consequences...

speaker: Choice
options: Are you trying to test the power of the <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color>?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And even use it to lure Quinn to work with you?
Serpent's wooden cutout rolls her eyes.

speaker: Serpent
content: You like Marv? You like the Black Ring?

speaker: Serpent
content: Then why are you talking about it? I was asking you about happy things, and you keep bringing up depressing things. You've always been like this!

speaker: Serpent
content: Stop being such a killjoy. You'll get beaten up sooner or later. Didn't you see the inspector's fists clenching angrily just now?
She still had the nerve to mention that.

speaker: Serpent
content: I was bringing him happiness. True happiness.

speaker: Choice
options: You took away his freedom with a false dream.

speaker: Serpent
content: Pffft... Here we go again. I know you are the "best" talker.

speaker: Serpent
content: "Roulecca, this place can only mimic your past, but it can't create your future. This isn't your life. Come back to reality, blah blah blah."

speaker: Serpent
content: "Mess, this isn't the enemy you want. It devalues   your fight's worth. You can't forge a truly powerful Sacred Sword here. Come back to reality, blah blah blah."

speaker: Serpent
content: "Eirene, this only gives you the illusion of a mighty foe. It can't produce anything other than your own reflection. Opponents who can truly surpass you are in the vaster, real world, blah blah blah."

speaker: Serpent
content: "Dreams are just cages for all your consciousness, trapping you guys in narrow fantasies and depriving you of greater possibilities. Come back to reality... Come back!"

speaker: Serpent
content: Ha. With just a few words, you lure people out of the beautiful dreams I crafted for them. You encourage them to discard their happiness and return to their worst miseries... Aren't you the most bewitching little trickster?
She gazes at you, somewhat displeased.

speaker: Serpent
content: I gave them freedom, and let them decide for themselves what dreams they want the most. I enabled them to grasp onto their own happiness.

speaker: Serpent
content: I gave them the truest, healthiest, and most long-lasting happiness. Hey, they don't even have to worry about pain or hunger in their dreams!

speaker: Serpent
content: If you hadn't come to ruin things, everyone would be dreaming forever. They wouldn't have to worry about their happiness coming to an end like in reality.

speaker: Choice
options: But Sleepwalkers keep releasing dangerous contamination.

speaker: Serpent
content: That can't be helped. How can people have true happiness without expelling their pain and suffering?

speaker: Serpent
content: At least everyone is happy in their dreams.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What about the people in the real world? You just let the contamination harm them?
Your wooden cutout body creaks as you blurt out these words. This body doesn't seem to hide your emotions very well.
But Serpent doesn't get angry. Instead, she starts clapping.

speaker: Serpent
content: Hahaha, I can finally see a bit of your heart. Even though it's just a bit, it's so adorable!
With a clap of her hands, the wooden cutout explodes into colorful smoke. The stage set dissolves into colorful ticker tape and disappears, revealing the huge empty stage behind.
The real Serpent is suspended mid-air on a hula hoop. Amidst the flying ribbons, the girl is all smiles. Strange picture frames float about beneath her dangling feet.

speaker: Serpent
content: You've been through a lot of pain too, and you still want to bring happiness to others. You strive hard for this goal, and want to protect their reality.

speaker: Serpent
content: I like you this way, but you're going in the wrong direction.
She points to the frames surrounding you.

You see that each frame holds the smiling face of someone who's dreaming. The staff of the Midsummer Night's Club, Eirene, the housekeeper, the secret agents of the 9th Agency, the investigation team, random citizens you've never met... and Doyle.

They are all murmuring quietly, black fluid flowing out of their mouths. You wonder what the contaminants will turn into once they reach the real world. What kind of damage will they cause? A chill goes down your spine.

speaker: Serpent
content: See? They spit out so much black goo because there's too much suffering in the real world. That's why I help them purge all misery, and create dreams filled with only happiness.

speaker: Serpent
content: Don't worry about the real world. I will invite everyone into dreams so that no one gets hurt ever again.

speaker: Serpent
content: By then, what does it matter what becomes of the real world? The real world created all the black goo of misery to begin with!

speaker: Serpent
content: I want to rescue everyone from the real world, and go to a joyous paradise together. That includes you, dreamless one. I want to give you happiness, too.

speaker: Serpent
content: The happiness of you all... is my happiness!

Serpent flips over, jumps off the hoop and lands on the ground, then bows to you. She looks at you with a smile, just like when you first met. Is that so-called happiness flowing from the depths of her serpentine eyes?
Is this girl tricking you again? Or is she stalling for time?

The Sinners may already be struggling in battle. As for those in the frames, the mental states of all the Sleepwalkers are under threat. You can't imagine how much the contamination in District 14 has spread during this dreamtime.

speaker: Choice
options: How are you connected to Marv's case?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know about the Marv case from years ago. People immersed themselves in beautiful dreams, but their spirits became absorbed and destroyed. Ultimately, they became Corruptors. This is the truth about Ambrosia.

speaker: Serpent
content: Pfff, that was so many years ago. Not important.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There weren't that many victims back then, but things are different now. Have you been hiding all this time just to pull off today's large-scale mutation? I will stop you.

You wield the wooden cutout body and try to throw yourself into the only picture frame not spewing black goo at the center of the stage. The wooden cutout spins quickly, making you dizzy, but you manage to achieve your goal before she can react...

The wooden cutout spins into the picture. In an instant, your body automatically recovers. You bear with the dizziness and grab the person in the picture. It turns out to be a little girl with blue hair.

speaker: Serpent
content: Hey! Not now! I'm not ready yet!
She struggles, trying to go back deeper. You hold onto her as tightly as you can, and you both fall into the depths of the picture.
Immediately, chaotic murmurs seep into the depths of your consciousness.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Coming coming coming coming...

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Joy, give me joy, give me all your joy!!
A burst of nauseatingly sweet scale dust seeps into your nose. Something has wrapped around your body!
You try your best to break free from the strange creature entangling you. You fall and land in the middle of an empty stage.
After a brief silence, you notice a pair of dim eyes slowly fixate on you. The creature gives off the aura of Mania, yet is unlike any monster you've ever fought.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: You're... the dreamless one...?

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: No... you're just someone... I cannot touch...

options: Who are you? Where do you come from?

content: The shadow doesn't respond as it wriggles up. You smell the familiar, chillingly sweet scent of Ambrosia.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: I feel... its fragments, its carcass... inside of you... The call of the Ring is inside you...

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: I can find happiness... I can seize happiness... I can... create dreams, open up a world...

Tentacles creep out from the shadows, prodding and wrapping around you. They turn into tiny mouths to kiss and gnaw at you. Something is seeping into your soul, slowly rotting away your consciousness. It is awakening your purest hatred and fear.
You've been careless. You thought you'd still be fighting against "humans," either Sinners or conspirators related to the Black Ring... You never thought you'd come across something like this.
Searing pain tears at your body and soul. You want to shake them off, but you can't cast your shackles.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Am I... qualified to awaken you...? Am I able... to awaken the Ring...?
The Ring... Is it also a creature from the Black Ring?!
A ray of blue light flashes before you, severing the goo entangling you. The girl lands gently in front of you. With her back toward you, she faces the monster with surprising fierceness.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: ...If you dare touch him, you shall die.
female_content: <color=#396fdc><i>...If you dare touch her, you shall die.</color>

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Grr... Corpus... Corpus... Come to me... Come...
Snap! Another sharp ray of blue light cuts off its outreached tentacles, carving a clear boundary on the ground. The gooey black monster lets out a mournful cry.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: If you cross this boundary, you shall die too.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Now... Go back!

The girl speaks icily, pushing back the monster with her intimidating presence. It finally gives up and writhes on the ground as if surrendering to her. Whimpering piteously, it finally retreats into the darkness.
The suffocating atmosphere disappears. The girl turns to you, pouting and complaining.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Audience members shouldn't barge onstage. It's common sense. Those who climbed into the circus cage all got eaten by lions and tigers in the end. Do you want to end up like that too?

speaker: Young Serpent
content: <color=#fb9259>Marv</color> is really bad. It'll really eat you when I'm not paying attention.
She pulls you up from the floor.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: I was speaking serpent tongue just now. I used to have a little snake about this long. It was my good friend.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Well, language doesn't really matter. It's just a little beast-taming trick from a circus performer.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Marv doesn't understand human language. You can't reason with it, either. I can only use serpent tongue to awaken its instinctive fear.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Don't try to go close to it when I'm not paying attention. You can't handle it. Marv is not like me. It'll really eat you up.
She says this with a casual wave of her hand, as if your struggle with the monster was just an illusory dream.

But your breathing has not returned to normal. Your body is cold, your vision is blurred, and your mind is a jumble. You still haven't shaken off the horrible feeling of being haunted by that "thing."
That was "Marv," the powerful Mania mutant who possesses the same mind control power as Catalyst Sinners. Under the FAC rating system, its threat level is at least A+ or above.

Now it's trapped in this confined space, tamed by a Sinner. Why did Serpent stop Marv from killing you? Was it out of the kindness of her heart? Or for deterrence? Or did she just want to toy with you, her prey?

speaker: Choice
options: Is Marv a monster you're raising?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It filtered people's consciousness, devouring only happiness, while the negative feelings left behind turned into spiritual contamination. After the victims were drained of happiness, they became Corruptors... That's the truth of the cases back then.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did you make it do this? Are you behind the Marv case, as well as the Sleepwalkers' case now?

speaker: Young Serpent
content: What are you talking about? Why would I let it devour others' happiness? I want to give everyone happiness!

speaker: Young Serpent
content: I've trained Marv well.
As if to reassure you, Serpent reaches out to pat your head, but you dodge her touch. This girl is powerful enough to crush you like an ant.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It devours others' happiness, yet you keep it in your Realm of Dreams. Don't you find that contradictory?
Serpent chuckles and pulls back her hand. With a flick of her wrist, a crystal bottle appears in her hand. It's the same one you saw in Mess's dream. She squeezes it with a bit of force...
The monster in the shadows wails, while radiant liquid fills up the empty bottle.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: This is the <color=#fb9259>Bottle of Dreams</color>, which is also Marv's heart. Marv loves to devour the joy in people's hearts, so its own heart can make Ambrosia and induce others' happiness...

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Marv keeps eating and eating non-stop. It also wants to find some "Corpus" to make a Black Ring appear. And it wants me. To trap me in a dream and drain my joy, to turn me into a walking dead.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Ha, but too bad it's so weak... Not only did it fail to eat me, but also got a good whipping from me. It never dared to challenge me again. Now, it's an obedient little servant of mine.
Serpent chuckles and casts a contemptuous look at the shadowy monster.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Don't worry. I won't let it hurt anyone. Marv is bad, but Ambrosia is good. It can peer into your heart and bring you true happiness.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: I use it to bring happiness to everyone...

options: So you captured Marv for the Ambrosia?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is a monster created for the "Black Ring." The Ambrosia it creates is dangerous spiritual contamination, and its so-called happiness is only a distortion of human consciousness.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've seen similar monsters before. It will only conjure up happiness to deceive and lure you into addiction. The human heart is just its nourishment. It can't give you true happiness.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Ha, no. It didn't deceive me.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: I knew from the first time I used it that it won't use happiness to trick me for its own purposes.

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Ambrosia is the most honest. It knows the human heart. See? It's the only thing that dares to tell me that I'm joyless, and that I've lost all happiness long ago.
The curtain falls with a raucous swoosh, revealing an empty stage devoid of laughter, sunshine, and warmth.
The girl opens up her arms gleefully and twirls around. Her laughter echoes across this empty "dreamscape."

speaker: Young Serpent
content: Even though I don't have my own happiness, everyone else does! I want to see everyone be happy on my behalf!
Just as you're pondering about how to respond with a lump in your throat, something grabs your ankle.
As if aware of your intentions, black goo has oozed out from the ground and begins to talk.

speaker: Hoarse Pleading
content: No... Don't take it away, don't destroy it...

speaker: Hoarse Pleading
content: Don't awaken me, don't leave me...

speaker: Serpent
content: See, everyone needs sweet dreams. Everyone needs happiness.

speaker: Serpent
content: I want to make everyone happy.
The wooden frames around you suddenly vibrate, and more black goo pours out of them. You get entangled and pulled into the chaotic mental vortex.

speaker: Clingy Black Goo
content: Do you want to ruin this? Do you want me to wake up? It wasn't easy for us to return... It wasn't easy for us to attain this...

speaker: Clingy Black Goo
content: Who made you the judge of good and evil, of truth and falsehood... Who are you to decide where we should stay... You know nothing... Who do you think you are...

speaker: Clingy Black Goo
content: Get out get out get out... Get out!!!

Is this the will of the Sleepwalkers? Or is it an illusion created by Serpent? She's able to use Ambrosia to connect all the Sleepwalkers through their dreams. This woman is as powerful as she is crazy.

As you get pulled and tugged, a wave of intense, chaotic feelings flood your mind. The aftereffects of Marv's attack have greatly damaged your sanity, rendering you unable to resist. Amidst the dizziness, you remember what that woman said.

speaker: Serpent
content:
O dreamless one... You've never tasted a sweet dream, so you assume that no one else wants it, either...
You only have reality in your grasp, so you assert that everyone needs reality...
Your consciousness gradually fades away. Your last thought is feeling thankful that you came here alone without Hella and Hecate...
The light suddenly shines bright. Serpent shields you, and the serpent shadow wriggles to disperse the black goo on your body. The shadows remain unscathed, but just slither away beneath the ground.

speaker: Serpent
content: Oops, looks like they're being cranky for being woken up...

speaker: Serpent
content: The ones you're trying to "rescue" seem to like their dreams more than I do.

She teased you and tortured you. She unleashed the monster she raised to filter your consciousness, and let the black goo shake your will. You are thoroughly exhausted from all her tricks. But in the end, she came to protect you.
...The expression on her face now is full of pity. What exactly does she want from you?

speaker: Serpent
content: ...Stop grappling what's right or wrong with me. Reality isn't that important. It's not worth risking your life for.

speaker: Serpent
content: You just haven't experienced it before... If you understand it, you wouldn't reject it... No one can reject it.
She stands up. A huge picture frame slowly appears on the empty stage. It's the same one you dove into to catch her. You reached the innermost depths of Serpent's realm through it.

Now, warm specks of light begin to shimmer in the pitch-black frame. Through it, you can see the world outside the dream, the center where the Sleepwalkers connect... The world made from dreams inside the picture.
Only from this side, you don't see any Sleepwalkers sleeping happily inside the frame. Instead, you see one joyous scene after another. Long-lost passions, faraway dreams, rekindled friendships...
There isn't a hint of gloom in the picture. All the people inside the picture are starry-eyed. They are all glowing.
Serpent stands in the center of the vast empty space, before the frame overflowing with others' happiness. Joyous light illuminates her face, tinging it with brilliant colors.

speaker: Serpent
content: There's too much suffering in this world. Happiness is the only miracle, the only ray of light.

speaker: Serpent
content: Isn't it great? I can still bring happiness to others. Seeing them happy brings a little bit of warmth to my heart.

speaker: Serpent
content: This picture is my last joy. I hope you can join this picture too, or at least don't ruin it.
Under the ethereal light, tiny cracks form on her skin. Other voices start echoing faintly from the dark void behind her.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Laugh. If you don't laugh, how will you make us laugh...

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Not enough, still not enough.... We want more... More thrills... More intensity...

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Joy... Give me joy... I only want joy... I want all the happiness there is...

options: ...What is the price of such happiness?

content: Serpent notices the creeping darkness and smiles contemptuously. She flicks away the darkness behind her and takes your hand.
The sly luster in her voice has been replaced by curt sincerity. And whether you like it or not, you don't have the strength to shake off her grasp.

speaker: Serpent
content: Don't force everyone to go back to reality. Don't ruin these joyful scenes.

speaker: Choice
options: ...If you can ensure not to harm those in the real world.

speaker: Serpent
content: If you're so worried about them, why don't I bring them in here right now?

options: Did you ever consider they might not want to?

speaker: Serpent
content: That's because they haven't experienced the sweet dreams I can give them.

speaker: Choice
options: Can illusory dreams really satisfy everyone?

speaker: Serpent
content: Yes. What Ambrosia brings to everyone is flawless joy. A true paradise.

speaker: Serpent
content: Too bad you can't experience it. But that's okay. What Ambrosia can't give you, I will.

speaker: Serpent
content: If you fear waking up to pain and suffering, I can give them never-ending dreams. If you worry about someone getting hurt in the real world, I can bring everyone here.

speaker: Serpent
content: Stay here and embrace me. I will give you happiness here.
Serpent hugs you. Her body is thin and her skin is cold. She's like a lonely night traveler longing for warmth and light, or a Sleepwalker in the picture clinging onto an illusory dream.
Behind her, the dreamy picture is emitting warm light. It's the only light in the darkness. Even you can't look away.
But through the light, you don't see the fabricated joy. What you see are those who aren't here.
Nightingale must be anxiously coordinating things right now. Has she come to the scene?
The FAC and the 9th Agency must also be trying their hardest to curb the spread of Mania. Have they used up all their Hypercubes? Did their wounds heal?
Are Hella and Hecate still awake? Are they still looking for you? Is everyone still fighting? Is the battle intense?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't know you well, so I have no right to negate your choice. Maybe one day I'll also be unable to bear the pain and seek the comfort of your sweet dreams.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But stop allowing Ambrosia to contaminate and destroy the world on the other side. Don't make us stand against you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The real world is tough, but not everyone hates it as much as you do. Maybe there are still people who cherish it and want to return. Don't block their way...
A faint roar echoes from outside the window. It seems to be far away, yet very close. Doyle freezes for a moment, then goes back to the delicious meal on the table.

speaker: Nasha
content: Is that an earthquake outside? It's not serious, is it...

speaker: Doyle
content: It's fine. It's probably some construction company doing illegal construction. Not my problem.

speaker: Doyle
content: Today's our day off. I'm staying with you, come hell or high water.

speaker: Nasha
content: Ha, how corny.
The TV suddenly turns on, blaring the news extra loudly.

speaker: Newscast
content: ...The incident at the Midsummer Night's Club is worsening... The FAC has urgently deployed counter-Mania troops to slow down the contamination, but Districts 13 and 15 still became affected...

speaker: Nasha
content: Ah! What's that wrapped around the club? Is it a... snake? How frightening.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...Pfft, it's just CGI. Don't look at it. I know you don't like horror movies.

speaker: Doyle
content: What's wrong with TV channels these days? They're always showing this kind of scary **** at dinnertime. They deserve to get ******* bankrupt.
Doyle walks up to the TV and presses the power button, but the TV continues to broadcast scenes from the Midsummer Night's Club.
He frowns and pulls the plug roughly, but it still doesn't turn off. In one corner of the TV, the crack from the fight with ${PlayerName} can still be seen.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...That bastard!
Irritated, Doyle turns around to snatch the remote control from the table, but someone else's hand got to it before him.

speaker: Doyle
content: Nasha?

speaker: Nasha
content: ...Is that really just CGI?

speaker: Nasha
content: The TV turns on by itself and you can't turn it off... It's because you're worried about the world on the other side, right?

Startled, he takes a deep breath, then takes the remote control from her with trembling hands and shuts off the TV. The screen turns pitch black, leaving behind only the cobweb-like cracks from his outburst, which remain no matter what.

speaker: Doyle
content: ...No. I'm not going there. This is where I care about.
<color=#7683a2>It wasn't easy for me to come back. I won't make the same mistake again.</color>

speaker: Doyle
content: Let's eat. You made so much food. We shouldn't let it get cold.
<color=#7683a2>If I leave, I won't ever be able to come back. I won't ever be able to find this warmth again.</color>

speaker: Doyle
content: ...Nasha, I just want to stay by your side.
I can't lose you again.

speaker: Nasha
content: ...You haven't spoken to me like this for a long time.

speaker: Newscast
content: The number of Sleepwalkers is increasing... Panic is spreading amongst the civilians, and there is a severe shortage of security personnel...

speaker: Newscast
content: There have been reports of casualties in many places...

speaker: Nasha
content: Look. That's 9th Avenue, isn't it?
She stares at the pitch-black screen as if it is still broadcasting scenes.
9th Avenue... Doyle begins to suffer from shortness of breath.

speaker: Nasha
content: 9th Avenue... What a familiar place. Do you remember it?
A vague memory of a woman leaving home alone and heading to 9th Avenue appears in his mind.
He remembered secretly going there many times, wanting to see if she is doing well, and wanting to apologize to her but lacking the courage.

speaker: Nasha
content: I wonder if people there are okay. Hope they're not injured.

speaker: Nasha
content: If had to face that kind of thing alone, I'd be really scared... Good thing I have you...

speaker: Nasha
content: Doyle?

speaker: Nasha
content: ...Are you leaving?
Doyle feels a skull-splitting pain in his head. He grasps Nasha's hands tightly, as if afraid she'll suddenly vanish.

speaker: Doyle
content: I... I don't know... I don't know... You're what I want and what matters most to me... I can't bear to lose this place again... I can't bear it...

speaker: Doyle
content: But...

speaker: Nasha
content: ...I know. You're a workaholic.

speaker: Nasha
content: You never turn your back on your duty. You're always protecting me and this city while enduring all the pain in silence. That's what attracted me to you in the first place.

speaker: Doyle
content: Nasha...?
Smiling, she hands him a cup of warm, sweet drink.

speaker: Nasha
content: Here, have this hangover drink. The incredible inspector must head off with a clear mind.

speaker: Nasha
content: Go and don't worry. I'll always be here, and... I'll always love you.
These words shake Doyle's whole body and mind like thunder. He wants to hug the woman in front of him and bawl his eyes out.
He didn't really want an apology, repentance, or a rational breakup. All he wanted were those words. All he wanted was to be with her forever.
Her disheartened departure made him realize this. Doyle recalled everything that happened that day...

speaker: Nasha
content: Doyle... I'm sorry...

speaker: Nasha
content: Let's break up. I can't take it anymore...

He remembered that he failed to catch the criminal that day. Once again, he missed dinner, and worked overtime till dawn. When he lost his temper and smashed the TV in front of Nasha, her eyes completely went dark.

There is no such thing as a perfect wife who will be tolerant and understanding forever. The real Nasha is an ordinary person just like him, who faces all sorts of pressure, gets hurt and scared, and feels pain and loneliness.
The real world doesn't have that much joy. To face it together, they must put trust in each other's love, but he hasn't professed it for a long time.

speaker: Nasha
content: Why are you crying? There, there. I'm here. I'll always be here...
Is Nasha okay? Is she safe? Is she scared? Someone took her phone away. Did she get hurt? Is she toughing out the nightmare as well?
The door opens, leading to boundless darkness, to a reality that Doyle cannot face, and to where she really lives.
Doyle once swore that her happiness mattered more than anything else.

speaker: Nasha
content: Go now. I'll make you something yummy again when you're back.

speaker: Doyle
content: All right... I'm leaving...

After this, life will probably become miserable again, but there's nothing to regret about. Doyle takes the hangover drink, gulps it down in one go, then leans over to hug his wife with all his strength.
The warm, soft, nostalgic taste is really like a sweet dream. There will be no more opportunities like this after going back. He can finally say what he needs to.

speaker: Doyle
content: I love you.
When the door shuts, the small world behind the door instantly melts into thin air.
Behind you, a wooden frame suddenly shatters. A coarse hand grasps the wooden frame, and a pitch-black figure struggles desperately to get out.
He roars and struggles with all his might to escape the dream. The squirming hand that broke free from the beautiful dream keeps oozing out the black goo of misery.

speaker: Serpent
content: It's you...?!
Serpent leaves you and rushes toward the frame, trying to stop him from leaving.

speaker: Serpent
content: Go back, don't force yourself! You're expelling pain! Leaving this sweet dream gives you pain, reality gives you so much pain!
Doyle doesn't answer. He roars mournfully and grabs tightly onto Serpent as he tries to break free from the frame. Half of his body is already out, and the whole frame begins to spew out black goo.
The black goo sears Serpent's body. She looks like she's in pain, but she doesn't let go, nor does she attack the out-of-control Sleepwalker.

speaker: Serpent
content: Sob... Why... Stop, go back... Don't come out...

speaker: Serpent
content: You'll only be happy if you stay... I tried so hard to give you happiness... Don't you want to see Nasha?!

The mention of this name triggers a hysterical roar from Doyle as he struggles feverishly to get out. A few more picture frames tremble as others also try to break the boundary between dream and reality to get out.

speaker: Serpent
content: I don't understand. What did I miss? What's missing from the dream?

speaker: Choice
options: The things that are not happy are missing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There are many things in the real world that people won't easily let go of. There will always be those who cherish things other than happiness.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You say that I have no right to force others to abandon their dreams and return to reality, but the same goes for you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You have no right to decide for them. You have no right to destroy reality and imprison everyone in their dreams.

speaker: Serpent
content: Haha... You're trying to sway ME this time? You sly fox. You're trying to repeat your old tricks and shake my will to change the rules of this realm?

speaker: Serpent
content: You can't fool me. You haven't experienced that kind of joy, nor have you experienced the darkest of nights... You have no idea how precious it is!

A ray of blue light flashes before you and slices off the hair in front of your forehead. Serpent is showing anger for the first time, but even so, she doesn't do anything to the people in her frames.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your opponent is Doyle, and everyone else to whom you force-fed happiness and robbed of freedom. Go fight against them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My opponent is over there!
You force yourself up and focus your mind to face the monster creeping in the dark—"Marv," the source of Ambrosia and all the mutations.

speaker: Serpent
content: Are you thinking of... No! Get out!!
She immediately realizes your intentions. The Realm of Dreams twists and pushes toward you as she shrieks. She wants to expel you from her realm.
Your innards start to burn, but you can't stop. You yell at the writhing monster...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't you want my power? Don't you want the Corpus inside my body? Then rebel against her and come get me!
You shout loudly at the monster in the dark, beckoning and provoking it. Even if it can't understand human words, you must attract its attention, so that it will target you as its prey...
Finally, it starts to squirm with a mad glimmer in its eyes. This monster is spliced   from all sorts of debris, and the radiant spiritual contamination gluing it together turns out to be Ambrosia!

speaker: Serpent
content: Marv! Stay away from him! Back down!
female_content: Marv! Stay away from her! Back down!

content: But the monster's desire for you overturns Serpent's commands. The two sets of willpower constructing this dream clash with each other, tearing the world apart. Your shackles are back.
Fight it, even though it frightens and disgusts you. People must always face some undesirable things to get what they want. Plus...
You won't lose.

speaker: Marv
content: Aaahhh...!!!
Marv utters a final shriek as its body withers away. The Ambrosia flowing about in the space quickly dries up, and the sweet aroma vanishes.
The FAC counter-Mania joint operation's temporary headquarters at the scene of the crisis in Eastside's District 14.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The peak of the M-value is falling rapidly. The scope of Mania contamination has shrunk, and some of the Sleepwalkers have regained consciousness!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Alert the whole task force to seize this opportunity and counterattack!
Crisis epicenter in the corridor of the Midsummer Night's Club.

speaker: Hecate
content: The shackles are reacting! Hella, Chief is back... He's in the banquet room!
female_content: The shackles are reacting! Hella, the Chief is back... She's in the banquet room!

speaker: Hella
content: What the **** took you so long? Go go go, I still need to... arghhh!
To her shock, she trips over a large figure that suddenly appeared.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Huh? Doyle? How come you're here?
The chessboard gradually melts away.

speaker: Eirene
content: ...I knew this is how it would end.

speaker: Eirene
content: You can't win against him, little snake...
female_content: You can't win against her, little snake...

content: The colors of the radiant stage fade slowly at the center of the dream.

Some resist sorrowfully, clutching the withered and broken wooden frames, reluctant to leave their dreams. Others break free from the wooden frames roaring, rushing through the cracks and disappearing into the light.
You've won. This epic battle has sapped you of all your energy. Your tightly wound nerves finally relax a bit, and you collapse to the ground, unable to move.
Even after being suppressed for so many years, the monster Marv is far stronger and stranger than you had imagined. He's different from other Corruptors, he's...

You've no time to ponder. The woman who once commanded Marv as her servant saunters to your side, clutching the empty Bottle of Dreams. She looks down at you, but you are unable to see her expression clearly.

speaker: Serpent
content: ...I didn't expect it to end like this.

speaker: Serpent
content: You crashed my performance, ruined the sweet dreams, and drove everyone back to the miserable real world.

speaker: Serpent
content: You used all your might to destroy my last shred of joy...
She kneels down, caressing your cheek with her cold hand. A dark little snake slithers from her arm onto you and chokes you. Now you can feel her power.
It's a powerful, icy force, manic and out of control.

I know you can't forgive me for destroying your world, but then you should also understand why I rejected you... It has nothing to do with whether your dreams are good or not. It's because you've been wantonly destroying our world.
She doesn't respond, nor does she move.
After a long time, icy droplets splash onto your face. One drop, two drops...
It's her tears.

speaker: Serpent
content: How could I hurt you all... I wanted to... give happiness to all of you...

speaker: Serpent
content: If I could heal your pain, make you happy, and bring you into a beautiful dream, even just once... You would definitely choose me...

speaker: Serpent
content: If only you would choose me...

speaker: Choice
options: Let us choose for ourselves, Serpent.
...Why on earth are you so persistent?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Happiness is not bestowed upon by others. Just like pain and misery, it's everyone's own experience. We came all this distance in our own way, so let us choose where we ought to go. Don't destroy our path.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Maybe someday you will also find something worth cherishing in the real world.

speaker: Serpent
content: ...Ha... You really think so?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: With your strength, Doyle's black goo is no match against you. You could've easily killed him, but you didn't... You just wanted him to be happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So why are you so stubbornly persistent? Did you... experience a lot of pain before?

speaker: Serpent
content: Ha... Is that important?

You hear the voices of Hella, Hecate, and Nightingale through the crack in the Realm of Dreams. The crack continues to expand, and light shines in, illuminating the fissures on her body. Her body is crumbling away, riddled with age-old injuries.

speaker: Serpent
content: ...There's no longer a stage for me here.
Her cold hand leaves your cheek. You try to catch her and shackle her, but your body doesn't respond.
Serpent stands up. Her expression is grim as she leans gently toward you.

speaker: Serpent
content: Next time, I'll bring you a "real" sweet dream.

speaker: Serpent
content: ...Goodbye.
You can only watch the show end as a spectator. You gradually lose consciousness, following everyone else and drifting through the crack back to reality.
Only the performer of dreams remains behind, disappearing alongside the bubble-like stage.

speaker: Doyle
content: Hello? You little brat! It took you this long to call me? I'm on vacation, so I'm not writing any reports or working overtime. Let's talk about something else!

speaker: Doyle
content: When are you coming to Eastside again? Whether you're here for work or for fun, stop by my house for dinner. I've actually learned how to make the hangover drink properly now.

speaker: Doyle
content: Well, I'm still a grouchy old man, but I'm very happy now.
<size=40>　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　The show has ended.</size>
<size=40>　　　　　　　　　　　　　Whether you stay or not, I wish you...</size>
<size=40>　　　　　　　　　　　　　Sweet, happy dreams tonight.</size>
The silence outside the museum is somewhat frightening.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: But before she can pedal away, a monster emerges from nowhere, shrieking as it kicks the mailbox away. Strong gusts of wind and flying debris shred the letter together with its envelope.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Calculating. It's 319 times better than the Syndicate. Judging. It has similar livability to the Bureau. And more interesting things are present.

speaker: Hecate
content: Labyrinth, can you feel the shackles?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Answering. No, but Labyrinth can use other ways to find Master.

speaker: Hecate
content: Let's confirm the surroundings first. The situation here... seems really eerie.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Understood, but I'm more interested in knowing the Mania level of this place.
There are no fleeing people nor operation units from the 9th Agency, only an art museum in front of them with its door closed.
Hecate takes out an M-value meter and shows the figure to Labyrinth.

speaker: Hecate
content: The Mania Density is currently stable at B+, but it is rising. According to Adjutant Nightingale, we need to act quickly.
Even her Nightmare nods in agreement.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Agree. The excellent maid is ready to share the environment analysis report.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Analyzing. The museum door is solid due to the mixed-in Hypercube. Also, the wall on our side is not a load-bearing wall.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: No others are watching us, but we have a precious companion here.

speaker: Hecate
content: Companion? The Bureau didn't send any...
Before Hecate can react, Labyrinth presses the switch of the navigator in her hand.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Dear friends, welcome to the Belphegor Art Museum, N.F. 112, the 18th annual Witching Hour themed art exhibition.

speaker: Hecate
content: These are...?
A familiar voice starts speaking again. It's the "guide" of the museum.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: I'm Enfer, the only exhibitor this year, and your guide on this art tour. It will be my pleasure to show you around and introduce you to my works.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Please be careful and keep your belongings safe, as there are a large flow of visitors here currently. Finally, I wish you a pleasant and meaningful trip to the exhibition.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...A large flow of visitors? Are all the missing people locked up here...?
The Belphegor Art Museum was heavily trafficked during its opening period, but the Sinners can't hear anything outside. This is obviously not due to the excellent sound insulation.

speaker: Hecate
content: There is no time to waste. We need to find the Chief as soon as possible.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Absolutely. It's mission queue priority one. I will find the Chief.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Question, Enfer. As the navigator, can you locate people inside the museum?

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: Checking. Please wait.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: During the checking process, I can introduce you to the various functional areas within the museum. The one in front of you is the oil painting section. Here...
Roarrrr! Aaahhh!
A screeching howl penetrates the walls and reaches their eardrums.
The M-value on the meter in Hecate's hand shoots up in an instant.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...It's Corruptors. We need to get in now, or the Chief...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Situation, still very complex. We need to analyze.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: We, are unable to locate the Chief...

speaker: Hecate
content: Open the door, please. We don't have time.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: One visitor is detected. They are moving slowly 37 meters away.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
content: To enter the oil painting section, please submit a valid ticket.

speaker: Hecate
content: Get ready, Labyrinth. This is urgent.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Question. To prepare the ticket?
A loud bang answers Labyrinth's question.
Boom—
The raging Nightmare hits the museum's outer wall with all its might, and the fragile wall crumbles instantly.
In the rolling smoke, Hecate and the Nightmare step first into Belphegor.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: So, looks like it meant to get ready for the housekeeping mode.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: See. As a great tool, the first step is learning to adapt.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Also, the Bureau will pay for the subsequent restoration costs and admission fees.
The two blast through the wall and charge into the oil painting section. Instead of the visitor mentioned by the navigator, they're welcomed by a large group of wandering Corruptors.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Notification. The threat has been completely erased. No sign of Master has been found.

speaker: Hecate
content: Maybe the Chief... is hiding?
The section is filled with masterpieces of the horror art exhibition.
But the duo isn't very interested in them.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Presuming. There may be more Corruptors ahead.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: And, a weak cell phone signal has been detected inside a nearby cabinet while trying to connect to the shackles.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...! Chief? Is that you?!
Just as Hecate approaches the cabinet, an eerie human voice comes out.
Bring it on, you monsters!
I'm not afraid! Not at all!
The cabinet door opens.
Stay... Stay away from me, ahhhh!!!
Wait... You're... not monsters...
Haha... Hahaha...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Snort.
As if to make it less awkward, the girl does her best to slowly move out of the cabinet without making a sound.
She holds her phone, looking embarrassed.
Of course, she's not the only one feeling embarrassed in the room.

speaker: Hecate
content: What do you want? Why were you hiding in the cabinet?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Question. Why are you in a dangerous place like this? Are you tired of living?

speaker: Sasha
content: Um... My name is Sasha, an outdoor live-streamer!

speaker: Sasha
content: I'm here because... my viewers voted for me to come. They said... it's really scary, and the show would be really great... something like that...

speaker: Sasha
content: I never thought I'd run into those monsters... and there's no signal here! All this big scene going on, and I can't even do streaming!

speaker: Sasha
content: Right, if you're able to defeat all these monsters... You must be one of those, Sinners, right? Am I right?

speaker: Hecate
content: You don't need to know.
Hecate has no interest in the livestreamer from the cabinet, but Labyrinth on the side doesn't feel the same way.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Woah, you got it right on the first guess. 100 out of 100, Miss Sasha.
Labyrinth puts her hand to her mouth somewhat pretentiously and looks in Hecate's direction.

speaker: Sasha
content: Oh! In that case, could you show me the thing?! The snake-like thing that was wrapped around Midsummer Night's Club last time!
The rescued girl is more interested in the duo than scared.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Shouldn't Eastsiders be afraid of Sinners?

speaker: Sasha
content: Yeah, I used to be. But you guys saved me, and... everything about Sinners has brought me followers! People would come to my stream and talk about <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> in the comments. Why would I be afraid of you?

speaker: Sasha
content: In Eastside, anything that gets people talking, big or small, is a good thing!

speaker: Sasha
content: Aaand! This museum right now is even scarier than that giant snake!

speaker: Sasha
content: Many monsters come out of paintings, and there are also moving statues... Including the ones you took down just now. There are other Sinners here, right?!

speaker: Sasha
content: To make sure I stay alive, I've decided to... stick with you guys!

speaker: Sasha
content: You will protect me, right? Right?!

speaker: Hecate
content: The Chief is still waiting for us, Labyrinth.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Agreed.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Judging. Completing the mission is the highest priority. Labyrinth will only protect Master.

speaker: Sasha
content: Hey, where are you going?! Hey, don't leave me here! I have to record videos! What should I do without you?!

speaker: Sasha
content: I just took a short clip the last time, and a lot of people noticed me. I want to shoot the whole thing this time! I want everyone in Eastside to know the rookie livestreamer, Sasha, who chases thrills and excitement!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Question. Why not start dislodging?

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Judging. There's a possibility of interfering with the operation.
Labyrinth mutters as she follows Hecate, leaving Sasha behind. She wants a reasonable answer, and an efficient one at that.

speaker: Hecate
content: If Chief were here, he would make the same choice.
female_content: If Chief were here, she would make the same choice.

content: Hecate clearly means that the Chief will make the mission the first priority...

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Hmmm. Hope you made the right decision.
The two both speed up, leaving Sasha behind without sympathy.

The always-calm Hecate is acting out of character on this mission. The howling of Corruptors, the clock ticking toward midnight, and even the wind blowing into the museum... The slightest sound would cause her to be alerted.
But the over-sensitivity instead makes them run into Corruptor crowds again and again.
But this time, they run into not only monsters...

speaker: Sasha
content: Ah! What is that?!

speaker: Sasha
content: I AM SOOOO DEAD!
Sasha runs wildly, followed by howling monsters.
She darts toward Labyrinth and tries to grab her, but Labyrinth gracefully dodges out of the way.
Sasha, who falls to the ground, staggers to her feet. But she then quickly picks up her phone and starts recording.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Enemies. Preparing to exterminate.
With a few swings of her blade, the monsters following Sasha go up in smoke.

speaker: Sasha
content: Hey, hey, aren't you afraid at all?!
After the short battle, Sasha follows the two deadpan. The screen in her hand is still blinking, indicating she's trying to get an interview.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: No. It's worse in the Bureau.

speaker: Sasha
content: But something's coming out of paintings!

speaker: Hecate
content: Stop following us. You'll die.

speaker: Sasha
content: Did you hear that, everyone? These are Sinners!

speaker: Sasha
content: Sinners who have the power to crush everything!

speaker: Sasha
content: If you ask me, they should add more people like this in the FAC. They are powerful, and it's something for people to talk about!
She ignores Hecate's words and starts recording again.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Repeat. I hope you made the right decision.
Labyrinth looks aside at Sasha.

speaker: Hecate
content: It doesn't matter. I won't protect her.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Agreed. But one other question.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Is she, having an impact, on your mind?
Hecate doesn't answer but clutches the album in her hands.

speaker: Hecate
content: Finding Chief is our first priority. My condition is not important.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Denied. This is not about saving that girl.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Instead, you are affected and leading us in the wrong direction.
This is the 11th time Hecate's over-sensitivity has led her to take the wrong route.
With every second that passes, Hecate falls into silence, gazing at the navigator in her hand.
She can't think of a way to find the Chief without the guidance of the shackles.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Question, Enfer.

speaker: Dahlia Guide
