speaker: Lisa
content: Hmph.
Times are precarious. Demons roam the Earth. Fear abounds the heart... And hope... ehh... is nowhere to be found!
Yet in DisCity, the city of chaos, there is a figure like no other...
It stands apart from everything else around it...
And it always catches the attention of all... It is...
All right! Perfect moves, perfect slogan, perfect expression, perfect entrance, and perfect lion's head!

Hi everyone! I'm the world's most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen's forgot-how-many-generations of heirs, OwO! Remember my name, because soon it'll be known all over the world!
That's right, OwO!
Ow... wooo...
Jeez... I'm not howling, it's just my name, and it sounds great! Hurry up and change it!

speaker: OwO
content: All right! Today's the big debut for the superstar of the future! I know my 20 million viewers are all eager to see me lion dance, but I've prepared a bigger surprise for this vlog debut...

speaker: OwO
content: Ahem, the DisCar Whatchamcallit Awards are happening soon, so all you little dummies competing to win, listen up. This year, the grand DisCars award will all go to OwO!

speaker: OwO
content: As the world's most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen's forgot-how-many-generations of heirs, I'll win over everyone with my awesome and unique lion dancing skills!

speaker: OwO
content: Do you want to join this amazing journey? Wanna bask in OwO's glory up close? Want to leave your mark on this great masterpiece?

speaker: OwO
content: Then scan the QR code right now and sign up to join my crew! It'll definitely be the biggest, grandest, quirkiest, jolliest, liveliest journey that DisCity has ever seen!

speaker: OwO
content: We've already recruited a dummy clapper! That's ${PlayerName} behind the camera right now!

speaker: OwO
content: Come, come, ${PlayerName}, say hi to everyone!

options: No no no, this is OwO's time to shine. You continue.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hi!

speaker: OwO
content: Hmph, so you're not even going to show your face. Though your work skills are meh, your face is still very good-looking. I like it!

speaker: OwO
content: What's there to be shy about? Though your work skills are meh, you're still someone I chose! Be confident!

speaker: OwO
content: Though he looks weak and inexperienced, not like someone you can count on, but that's okay! The most important quality for a person is to have vision!
female_content: Though she looks weak and inexperienced, not like someone you can count on, but that's okay! The most important quality for a person is to have vision!

content: ${PlayerName} recognized my genius as soon as we met! And that's how I found this one, who was so eager to submit this resume right after hearing my grand movie plan! Not only that, this person also prepared a moviemobile for us to shoot!

speaker: OwO
content: So that's the second member to join our crew!

speaker: Stella
content: Squeak...

content: Chief, it's me. The mission progress is...
After hanging up, you feel like apologizing a million times.

speaker: OwO
content: Huh? What is it?

speaker: Option
options: The alarm rang. Time is almost up.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmph, put your phone on silent next time. We can't always have it disrupting our work.

speaker: OwO
content: Ahem, anyways, I'll give you more details next time. All in all, I've already created my filming diary, which I'll be updating from time to time. It'll record the birth of a masterpiece, a wonderful journey, and joyous friendships!

speaker: OwO
content: Everything is ready, and now we're just missing you! Dear...

speaker: OwO
content: Um... I guess... the... the scriptwriter? And what else... the makeup artist? Actors? Promoters?

speaker: OwO
content: Right, right! We welcome everyone to join My Best Cool Car Studios!

speaker: OwO
content: Well, I'll have to go work on the film now. See you in our next update!

speaker: OwO
content: I won't make you wait for long! Toodles!

speaker: OwO
content: Is it over? Did you turn the recording off?
You put the camera aside.

speaker: OwO
content: Phew... I didn't expect to be so nervous. How was I just now, ${PlayerName}?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Absolutely splendiferous! That vlog alone is enough to win us a DisCar!

speaker: OwO
content: Hehehe, no way! I'm not even satisfied with it myself!

speaker: OwO
content: This is OwO's first film ever. It must be polished to perfection. It's gotta have the best plot, the best acting, and be full of passion! Hmm... and it needs a perfect lion dance!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But we still had a little flaw just now.
You point to the little blue critter. It had been curled up in OwO's arms, but now that you're staring at it, it arches its back and bares its teeth.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stella seemed a bit uncomfortable and didn't look good on camera. It detracted from your presentation. Why don't I take it to see the vet?

speaker: Starbeast
content: Bite...

speaker: OwO
content: Stella, don't be mean to others!

speaker: OwO
content: You too, ${PlayerName}. Stella's different from other little creatures. It's very smart. Don't take advantage of the fact that it can't talk!

speaker: OwO
content: Stella isn't as gentle and patient as I am. It'll fight back!
She picks up the little critter and starts to head back.

speaker: OwO
content: There, there. Until you two learn to get along, I'll keep Stella with me.

speaker: OwO
content: I've been busy recruiting crew members for the past couple of days. I didn't even have time to practice lion dancing. I really have to find time!

speaker: OwO
content: You still haven't seen me lion dance, have you, ${PlayerName}? I'll make sure to show you a good one after I practice for a few more days.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe, it's a unique art form that has been passed down for generations. No one in DisCity has seen it before. You'll love it!

speaker: OwO
content: I'll get a DisCar for sure. By then, not only me, but also ${PlayerName}, Stella, and our new friends... Our names and movie will be famous all over the world! It'll be watched in every city-state, no matter how far away.

speaker: Option
options: Of course. It's a DisCar, after all.

speaker: ${PlayerName} & OwO
content: The Walk of Fame where all wishes come true!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Sorry, Chief. Hope I didn't disturb your plans just now.

speaker: Option
options: No worries. OwO is very innocent. She trusts me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But that creature took an ordinary human child hostage, so it's a bit hard to handle.

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft, what's so hard about it? It's actually the girl you can't handle, right? I'm dying of laughter here, Dummy, what kind of play are you setting up with her? Hahaha...

speaker: Hecate
content: Weren't you upset and complaining just now? About how Chief didn't take you out to have fun this time?

speaker: Hella
content: ...Wahhhhhhh!
The two of them went aside to fight.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The Apostle from the last Tide of Ashes is confirmed to have entered DisCity. It is adept at creating clones to hide its tracks. The FAC has already destroyed many of its clones, but has yet to find the main body.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The one you found is the most hidden and unique. As of now, it is also the only one left.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Are you sure you don't want us to handle it? It's taking up your precious vacation days again.
You look at MBCC's disguised vehicle in the distance. The young Apostle of Ashes is sitting by the window, looking back at you.
A blue light flashes across its body, as if to taunt you.

speaker: Option
options: ...It's okay. It doesn't have any power to attack.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Plus, for me...

speaker: OwO
content: Hee-yah!

The vehicle shakes violently. OwO must have done some high-difficulty moves inside. She likes to boast, yet always insists on practicing lion dancing out of view. She'll only show you when she feels ready.

speaker: Option
options: For me, this is a nice vacation.

content: A vacation doesn't always mean going to a resort. Chasing one's dreams is also a beautiful journey.

Come to think of it, in this world, only a kid would believe that a movie can be made in 10 days and win a DisCar. Only a kid would believe that by winning a DisCar, one can overcome the Apocalypse and bridge all boundaries.
...To let the world hear a small wish.

My Best Cool Car temporary filming spot

speaker: OwO
content: All right! The most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen thowoo... ouch, I bit my tongue...

speaker: OwO
content: <color=#7683a2><size=28>How come my tongue is all tied? I've never encountered this before. Is it because I'm too tired...?</size></color>

speaker: OwO
content: <color=#7683a2><size=28>La la la la la... Okay, fixed now. </size></color>${PlayerName}, cut out that part. Let's start again. Ahem...

speaker: OwO
content: All right! After nine hours of grueling work, the most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen OwO is finally back on camera to talk to y'all!

speaker: OwO
content: You're all dying from missing me, aren't you? Let's hear some applause!
Silence...
You look at the followers' list for OwO's account. There's only one new follower, named "My Best Cool Car is Awesome!"

content: Oh I forgot! I can't hear anyone's applause because I'm talking to you through the screen.

speaker: OwO
content: All right, all right. No need to make your little hands red from clapping. I'll feel bad about it even if I can't see it.

speaker: OwO
content: Today was super tiring, but I know how much you guys miss me! I can't let my fans down, so I'm here to update y'all on our filming progress!

speaker: OwO
content: Remember the recruitment ad we issued this morning for My Best Cool Car Studios? Our main task today is to recruit crew members.

speaker: OwO
content: This has its own criteria, and requires a lot of professionalism, just like lion dancing. Now, let me test you guys a bit...

speaker: OwO
content: There's a job in the crew that requires carrying the camera, finding the best angle, and being ready to zoom in and out, or turn left and right at any moment.

speaker: OwO
content: This person is...
She winks at you, cueing you to give the answer.

speaker: OwO
content: Argh...! You dummy!

speaker: OwO
content: It's the cameraman, of course! You dummy clapper!

speaker: OwO
content: Ta-dah... That's right! It's the cameraman!

speaker: OwO
content: Our little clapper works hard to film this vlog, but for the actual movie, we need someone more... experienced.
female_content: Our little clapper works hard to film this vlog, but it's tough on her little body to carry a big camera. So for the actual movie, we need someone more... experienced.

speaker: OwO
content: That's right! This person is... the cameraman!

speaker: OwO
content: Every light and shadow, every little movement, and every dazzling effect you see in the final movie depends on this guy.

speaker: OwO
content: All right, next question...

speaker: OwO
content: There's a job called noise engine... ah no, I mean <color=#fb9259>sound engineer</color>. Can you guess what they do?

speaker: OwO
content: The answer is... <color=#fb9259>all of the above</color>! They're in charge of anything that has to do with sound! It really takes a genius to figure this one out!

speaker: OwO
content: Well, it's not like I know everything. No one's perfect, and it'd be boring if they were.

speaker: OwO
content: When I find the world's top sound engineer, I'll get them to explain the details to y'all...

speaker: OwO
content: Let me think, what else did I learn today... Oh! There's a magical job that even I've never heard of before.

speaker: OwO
content: <color=#fb9259>Editor</color>!

speaker: OwO
content: So, when the shooting is over, all the recorded clips and sounds and special effects will be given to this person, who'll cut and stitch them into the final film!

speaker: OwO
content: I heard that if this person wants to, they can use the same materials to create a completely different story by rearranging their order. It all sounds really impressive.

speaker: OwO
content: But since editors usually stay up all night long, they lose a lot of hair, so they should be easy to spot amongst the crew.

speaker: OwO
content: Out of humanistic care, I'll get some ginger tea, wigs and hats for our future editor!

speaker: OwO
content: In short, after a hard day's work, a lot of outstanding talents have joined My Best Cool Car Studios.

speaker: OwO
content: They don't just have a keen eye for potential. After all, there's no shortage of people who recognize OwO's brilliance. The most important thing is... they've all been chosen by the great OwO!

speaker: OwO
content: It was a flash of pizzazz in the crowd, like the moment the lion's head shines. When our eyes met, I just knew...

speaker: OwO
content: They stand out from the crowd not only in their professional skills, but also in their extraordinary powers, unique personalities, and... the passion burning in the depths of their souls!
To your alarm, the Apostle of Ashes named "Stella" suddenly lifts its head, a strange light flashing across its eyes.

speaker: OwO
content: That's right, all the talents I found are...

speaker: OwO
content: Potential disciples who'll carry on the art of lion dancing!

speaker: OwO
content: Huh? Did ${PlayerName} say something just now?

options: Sorry, I was being dumb. Please go on.

speaker: OwO
content: Don't be too disappointed, ${PlayerName}. You're dumb and clumsy now, but it's just because you lack experience.

speaker: OwO
content: But with Stella's lucky blessings, and me by your side, you're sure to get better with a bit of practice! Your future is bright, my dummy friend!

speaker: OwO
content: But today was really tiring. I'll let everyone go back and get some good rest, and also prepare for the official shooting.

speaker: OwO
content: After all, we're about to aim for the DisCars! We still have to... have to... (yawn)... so sleepy...

options: Feeling sleepy? Say good night to everyone, then.

content: Hmm... I feel like I'm forgetting something. Oh well... Good night, My Best Cool Car friends.

speaker: OwO
content: Everyone will get to see OwO's great movie soon...
She wobbles back to the vehicle. The Apostle jumps onto her head, wagging its tail arrogantly at you.
[Black Screen] [Vlog ends]

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Chief, it's Wynn from the Intelligence Department. Remember me? Today's vlog is really amusing. I wish all our surveillance targets are this cute. (¯¯-¯¯o)

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Back to the main topic. Adjutant Nightingale analyzed all the current combat data for the target Apostle, who is code-named S.T. I want to give you some information for reference. (￣^￣)

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Because its main body is wounded, S.T. has developed a strong tendency to approach and provoke crowds. It creates clones to distract the enemy, while at the same time collects human spiritual energy to repair its body. Σ(°□°)ǃ

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> This is the first Apostle of Ashes to have ventured deep into DisCity. What we can confirm is this: After recovering from its injuries, it will continue onwards to DisSea. This Apostle will get unprecedently close to DisSea. (。OωO。)

Stella? Since when did she start using that name so affectionately?

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> First off, it's not very strong or aggressive. Secondly, it absorbs very little energy, and we can't tell what its intentions are. All in all, it's quite strange that it chose <color=#fb9259>OwO</color>, a little girl who hasn't been infected by Mania. ('·ω·')

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> Should we do some extra research about OwO? Maybe there's something special about her. After all, wandering near the Rust at night like this is really... (,,・ω・,,)

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> (。OωO。) Ah! How could I forget? She grew up in Syndicate. Does that mean her parents are gone?

<color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Car is Awesome!:</color> That's so sad! For such a happy child to lose her family at such a young age (/TAT)/...

options: Calm down, it's not that bad...

<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> I asked already. OwO lives with some distant relatives in a refugee settlement. They call it the "Drifter Camp." I hear it's a harmonious place.

<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> I have met her relatives already. How should I put it... they're kind and trust me with OwO alone on this trip without a second thought. OwO is pretty popular. She was raised by the whole village. Her life's not that sad.

A huge, golden figure suddenly flashes into your line of vision. You're so startled that you almost toss away your phone.

speaker: OwO
content: I remember what I forgot to do! I forgot to practice! I've been so busy today that I haven't practiced lion dancing yet!

speaker: OwO
content: I want you to take a look and give some feedback! This is a great honor, so freshen up and get ready!

speaker: OwO
content: Ta ta ta tum! Good evening, everyone! It's been 24 hours since we last met! How much do y'all miss me?

speaker: OwO
content: I really... miss you guys!

speaker: OwO
content: After a hard day's work, OwO the Lion Dancing Queen is bringing over all the new recruits as promised!

speaker: OwO
content: The official shoot is about to start. We're now gonna have an important pre-shoot meeting. Come on, let's get pumped!

speaker: Everyone
content: Applause!
You smile dryly and clap your hands. Clap... clap... clap... Seeing all the faces on camera, grumbles of discontent start whirling in your head like a tornado.

How did this little girl manage to find so many people after just waltzing around for two days? What kind of devilry is this? This was supposed to be an easy, one-on-one mission. How come it suddenly feels like a lion's den?

Also, how come all three are Sinners? Add to that Apostle... is OwO really just an innocent little girl? Does she really have no powers to attract Mania? Forget about making movies. She should work for the MBCC City Arrest Team!
Plus... can this motley crew really be counted on to make a movie?

speaker: OwO
content: We officially have a crew now. The journey to the DisCars is about to begin. It's time to think about some more serious issues! Such as...

speaker: OwO
content: How do we stand out from the crowd and make a name for ourselves? What other preparations shall we make?
Guess we can only rely on dreaming. Get your pillows ready.

speaker: OwO
content: At the end of the day, it's the almighty DisCars we're talking about. Even though I'm putting my winning name in the lot, there'll be a lot of little monkeys elbowing each other to try their luck. So I've been thinking long and hard about it.

speaker: OwO
content: So far, I've created 3 masterpieces, dabbled in different genres, and reached the height of cinematic excellence.

speaker: OwO
content: But because of this, I realized I'm still missing something. Something really important...
So there's something that even the world's most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen's forgot-how-many-generations of heirs OwO doesn't have.

speaker: OwO
content: Yeah... I want people's eyes to pop, hearts to thump, and bodies to tremble all over... Something that catches everyone's...

speaker: Love
content: Catches everyone's eyes? Oh, I know how to do that! Pack the film with explosive scenes, then throw in a few of the hottest stars. That's how we do it at DeadLover Radio, but it works everywhere. The DisCars are no different.

speaker: Love
content: But right now, Love is the only celebrity we have onboard. We come off as a bit weak. It'd better if we had a star-studded cast and crew.

speaker: Daisy
content: Ignore that daydreamer. "Eye-catching" is a subjective term. To put it more scientifically, you want something that would do great at the box office?

speaker: Daisy
content: That seems to be a set criterion for the DisCars. Who can we get to distribute the film? Is there a publicity strategy? What about the cost?

speaker: Lynn
content: I... I also heard that if you want to win a DisCar, you have to win the judges' approval. But the judges will write off all the works produced by people they don't know...

speaker: Lynn
content: That is to say... um... we might need some... connections?
Well well well... Seems like the crew is a lot more thoughtful than OwO.

speaker: OwO
content: Mmm... what do you think, ${PlayerName}?

speaker: Option
options: Suggest using realism as a theme

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The DisCars award cinematic art, and art needs depth. Judges will favor films that reflect DisCity's reality. In other words, we need to have some <color=#fb9259>realism</color>.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: For example, scavenging along the Rust, street snap in Eastside, vigilante justice in Syndicate, or observing animals in WhiteSands. Cost-effective and fun to watch. I also have a special friend who can help with the shooting.

speaker: OwO
content: Realism... realism...

speaker: OwO
content: I know what's missing!

speaker: OwO
content: <color=#fb9259>Dazzling fantasy</color>!

speaker: OwO
content: Since we're making a movie, we need imagination! Something different! Something so cool you can't even think of or encounter!

speaker: Lynn
content: But... how can we film something that doesn't exist in real life?

speaker: Love
content: Oh! Ohohoh! What about special effects? CGI blockbusters are the biggest hits at the box office and nab prizes every year.

content: I just want to remind everyone that special effects are charged by the second. We don't have that much money. Are you going to do crowdfunding? Or look for that goofy Gonzales boy?

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... special effects... I've seen a lot of that stuff at the Drifter Camp's underground theater.

speaker: OwO
content: Films like The Hero's Fight Against Draco, Tennis Wars: Screw Versus Nut, The Shapeshifter's 73 Faces...

speaker: Daisy
content: Uhhh... yeah, we definitely won't encounter those.

speaker: Lynn
content: Do those weird imaginary things... also count as dazzling fantasy?

speaker: OwO
content: Of course not! Not even close. I forced myself to finish watching them even though I wanted to doze off. I felt nothing at all. If the DisCars were that level, then no one should watch it until I rescue it.

speaker: Option
options: So what kind of dazzling fantasy does OwO want to bring?

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... dreamy feelings... romantic feelings... Something you've never thought about, but have been yearning for a long time...

The girl tries her best to string her words together, her pudgy little hands waving about in the air. It seems like she's trying to explain something, but at the same time trying to grasp something beyond explanation.

speaker: OwO
content: Sigh... No, no, none of it feels right. It always feels a bit off.

speaker: Option
options: Why don't we call it a day and sleep on it?

content: You must be tired from running around these past couple of days. Go to bed early tonight. When your little noggin is too tired, it won't find any inspiration.
The personnel involved have changed. You'd better go back and reassess the mission.

speaker: OwO
content: Ugh... okay. Seems like I really do need some rest after filming three masterpieces in a row.

speaker: OwO
content: But don't worry! Just like I promised, My Best Cool Car Studios will definitely come up with the most amazing movie about courage, fun, and growth! And dazzling fantasy!

speaker: OwO
content: I'll be sure to get new ideas after sleeping on it tonight! I won't keep you guys waiting for long!

speaker: Option
options: Don't get too excited or you'll get insomnia.

speaker: OwO
content: I won't! I'm not some kid on a field trip!

speaker: OwO
content: Good night, my fans! Send me any fun ideas you get!

speaker: OwO
content: (Snores)...
At 3:23 a.m., you secretly start the vlog stream to contact the clerk from the Intelligence Department. Together, you observe the situation from a spot near the Rust.

speaker: Wynn
content: Wow... you're right. She got a carload of Sinners.

speaker: Wynn
content: This high-tech phone that Faye got is really cool. Its vlogging function lets us observe the situation in real time.

speaker: Wynn
content: But I feel a bit guilty about using it...

speaker: Option
options: This is all for the mission.
It's to protect the little girl.

speaker: Wynn
content: Sigh... I know. The MBCC has bigger things to deal with. Leave everything to me!

speaker: Wynn
content: Hehe, I knew you were the most caring and dashing person in the world! Chief, with you there, OwO will definitely be fine.

speaker: Wynn
content: <size=32>S.T. has released a new clone in the last four hours. Powers that used to be vague have become clearer and more precise. According to our preliminary analysis, it's a quasi-concretization power, which can project the crowd's mental activities into reality.</size>

speaker: Wynn
content: Most of the clones pop up in densely populated areas in Eastside, and their powers cause considerable chaos and destruction. The FAC must terminate them immediately. Stella is now the only one safe and stable enough to be observed.

speaker: Wynn
content: I don't know if the main body will also affect it and cause it to change...

speaker: Wynn
content: Ahhh!
The surveilled Apostle suddenly dashes in front of the camera. Its deep, round eyes staring straight at the image in the screen.

speaker: Wynn
content: ...What... What's going on? Are we busted?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's just an ordinary cellphone at the scene. At most, it'll think the phone hasn't been turned off, and that there are some electric currents or something.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We're hundreds of meters away in the other direction. If it had discovered us, it should've turned the other away instead of facing the camera.
You stare at the inhuman creature. Your eyes lock onto one another's.

No matter how small and harmless it looks, this is a creature that broke into the city-state from the Apocalypse of Ashes. Its eyes sparkle, yet no one knows what it sees, what it thinks, and what are the rules of its world...

speaker: Apostle of Ashes
content: Squeak...!

speaker: Wynn
content: Ahhh...!
The creature's body flashes a ray of blue light, and its horns stand on end. The screen trembles. The connection is obviously getting jammed.

This is aggressive behavior. It had realized someone is surveilling it, and is taking on a different form than usual! You quickly pull the camera away. The Apostle raises its front paw and swipes at the camera...
I... found... you...

speaker: Apostle of Ashes
content: ?!! Squeak?!!!
A huge figure suddenly leaps forth, enveloping the startled Apostle like a tiger pounces on a prey, then raises it up.

speaker: OwO
content: Are you glowing? Stella, you can glow? Dogs or cats can't do that! How did you do it? Amazing! I'm so lucky to have you as my mascot! My lucky baby!

speaker: OwO
content: I know! You're not from around here, either. You got separated from your family, too! You're a <color=#fb9259>visitor from outer space</color>!!!

speaker: OwO
content: I just got inspired. I know what kind of movie to make! You are my dazzling fantasy!

speaker: OwO
content: Let's start working on the script right away!

speaker: Apostle of Ashes
content: ?!! Squeak?? Squeak, squeak!! Squeak...!!
The girl lifts the creature up high in excitement and spins around, leaving your sight with a whoosh. Only the Starbeast's mournful cries remain.

speaker: Wynn
content: Is Stella... crying for help...?
You sigh. The ominous thoughts in your mind subside, but now you're worried about what the Lion Dancing Queen has planned for you tomorrow.

7:00 p.m., January 21, N.F. 113
My Best Cool Car temporary filming spot

speaker: Lynn
content: Um... um... For the sake of the movie, OwO is focused on the script right now... I-I'll take over... today's vlog...
She sneaks a nervous glance at the people behind the camera.

speaker: Love
content: Ugh, this is too hard on her! I'll do it...

speaker: Daisy
content: You come back here! Don't be an obnoxious attention-seeker like you were at the radio station.

speaker: Lynn
content: Ahhh... I'm sorry for being an attention-seeker... I shouldn't be stealing the spotlight... Well, th-that's all for today! Hope everything goes well with OwO's script. See you guys next time!
Lynn runs away from the camera in panic. Good thing you stopped filming, or else this girl was so shy that she would have started crying.

speaker: Lynn
content: Sob... I'm sorry, I'm so useless... I had promised to help OwO out... Sob...

speaker: Lynn
content: How is OwO? Is she in a better mood now?
The usually noisy girl is sitting motionlessly in the distance, hugging her lion's head. For the first time, calm and quiet falls over My Best Cool Car Studios.

speaker: Love
content: Why is OwO sad? The new Stella movie is great! It's loads of fun! I really like the duck that pops out of nowhere.

speaker: Love
content: Should we go comfort her together? It's so quiet without her. Not used to it.

speaker: Daisy
content: We should, but not you, Love. You're not suited for this.

speaker: Lynn
content: ...Is it because of the pressure...? Writer's block is really hard to overcome... How can we help her...

speaker: Option
options: Maybe that's not the only reason.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll go check up on her.

speaker: [Scene Change]
content: *Omitted as instructed by the client*
You lighten your footsteps as you approach her. OwO isn't crying, nor does she look back. She just stares blankly at the skyscrapers on the other side of the Rust.
The blue critter is resting next to her. It looks over swiftly when it hears you approaching, but this time, it doesn't grow agitated. It just looks at OwO, then at you, then lies down whimpering.
What should you say to her? Maybe just... encourage her?

speaker: OwO
content: I know you're there.

speaker: OwO
content: The plot... I haven't figured it out yet. If I go on camera like this, I'd let everyone down...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Everyone made it together. We're all friends from the same crew.
You walk over and sit down beside her.

speaker: Option
options: We can also figure out the plot together.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's figure out how to add dazzling fantasy to Stella's story.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do you think, OwO? You want it to be more dazzling? More dreamy? Or perhaps more romantic?

speaker: OwO
content: ...I really don't know... what's missing, exactly...

speaker: OwO
content: Maybe it's what ${PlayerName} said... Realism?

speaker: Option
options: Can dazzling fantasy and realism mix?

content: She doesn't answer the question, but just shifts her gaze from the distance to the lion head in her hands.

speaker: OwO
content: Did you know? I'm the only one in DisCity who knows how to perform a lion dance. This lion head is also totally unique.

speaker: OwO
content: These are all special treasures from Goldionville.

speaker: OwO
content: Have you heard of Goldionville, ${PlayerName}?
You shake your head.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe... Very few people know about it. But I learned of it when I was very little.

speaker: OwO
content: Goldionville is a tiny city-state far, far away from DisCity. The people there are completely different from the people here. They speak a different language, write a different script, wear different clothing, eat different food...

speaker: OwO
content: Oh, when they eat, they use two little bamboo sticks to pick up the food. It's really impressive. Even I had to practice a long time to get the hang of it!
She shows you a strange gesture.

speaker: OwO
content: They are completely different from the people of DisCity!

speaker: OwO
content: They're all so unique, just like OwO! Oh, but OwO is the best at lion dancing!

speaker: OwO
content: Goldionville is very far away. I haven't been there yet. I grew up here. DisCity is my home.

speaker: OwO
content: But I've heard of another term called "homeland." I think Goldionville is my homeland.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why do you say that? Did someone tell you?

speaker: OwO
content: I found out myself.

speaker: OwO
content: Do you remember? I was born a much-loved child and raised by the whole Drifter Camp. All my neighbors, from the 1st floor to the 100th, loved and doted on me.

speaker: OwO
content: A few of them looked like me. We had the same hair, eyes and skin color.

speaker: OwO
content: They came only once in a blue moon. They were very busy and low-key people, who came and went cautiously and quietly. But each time, they'd make sure to come and see me, and give me lots of fun and yummy things.

speaker: OwO
content: I got my precious lion head from them, hehe!

speaker: OwO
content: The people in the Drifter Camp told me they were merchants from Goldionville, who trekked a long way here for DisCity's precious stones. They had to brave huge sandstorms and desert bandits along the way.

speaker: OwO
content: They never stayed for long, but always came to see me when they had time. They would smile at me and beat up my bullies. I found that each time they were about to leave, they would hide and secretly shed tears.

speaker: OwO
content: I found that... they were different from the other neighbors who loved me. Though I'm the most adorable cutie pie in the world, these merchants loved me more than anyone else.

speaker: OwO
content: So, gradually, I started praying for them to come. I really liked them, and wanted them to tell me stories about Goldionville.

speaker: OwO
content: They refused to tell me, and forbade me from learning the way they talk. They insisted that I use the language of DisCity. They only gave me this lion head because I threw a tantrum. Hmph! They didn't teach me how to use it. I taught myself!
The girl shakes the lion head grumpily, her expression darkening again.

speaker: OwO
content: They stopped coming for a long, long time... Some said the catastrophe became stronger, and now there's something called the Tide of Ashes. Merchant fleets from small places can't make it here anymore...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There, there. Since they can't come, it's up to you to call out to them. It's just like the movie for Stella, calling out to its faraway family. They will hear it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Our goal is to win the DisCars. A DisCar-winning movie will be famous all over the world, and watched in every city-state, no matter how far away. Right?

Even if we don't win an award, as long as the movie gets made, there should be a way to get it out there. Your connections with the Outland Affairs Bureau, as well as the trade info you get, should be able to help.
Having been comforted by you, OwO breaks into a smile.

speaker: OwO
content: Stop! I'm the invincible Lion Dancing Queen, the star of tomorrow! Since when did a lowly clapper get to comfort me?

speaker: OwO
content: I'm super strong and confident! My lion dance became so awesome and unique precisely because the Goldionville folks didn't come often! Add in Stella's dazzling fantasy, and we'll win for sure!

speaker: OwO
content: As soon as we figure out the plotline, the DisCars are ours!

speaker: OwO
content: As long as we figure out how to send Stella home... As long as we figure out... Emmmm...
As she says this, she starts to rub her hair buns in worry again.

speaker: OwO
content: Sigh... It's weird no matter how I think about it! It just feels off that Stella's family would suddenly come back like that. So fake. Even I want to laugh at it...

speaker: Option
options: Maybe you don't need that much realism for dazzling fantasy?

speaker: OwO
content: See, this is the problem... Sigh...
Um...
A huge electronic helmet suddenly looms behind you in silence. You notice it, startling each other.

speaker: Lynn
content: I-I didn't mean to scare you guys! I just wanted to help, so I searched up "movie" and "dazzling fantasy" online...

speaker: Lynn
content: I found an interview with a famous director... I really agree with the points she gave. Maybe it can also inspire you...
Lynn hands you the phone timidly. The title of the article is "Indelible Mark: Lost Interview with the Legendary Director Deren."

Deren:
Movies are often described as dream-makers that weave beautiful fantasies with lights and shadows. But I think it's a lot more complicated than dreams.

The audience always walks into the theater "sober." It's up to the filmmaker to challenge them to a game of truth and deception amidst the lights and shadows.

Research, props, backdrops, lighting, acting skills... These are only technical issues. Beyond these, one must convey emotions that cannot be described with words...

We go to great lengths to convince the audience to believe a lie, which takes just one little audio-visual slip up or plot hole to expose. It truly is difficult...

Hehe... but also very fascinating.

People know it's fake, yet choose to believe that it's true. That's the interesting part.
After reading the article, everyone falls silent.

speaker: Lynn
content: Oh... She's a famous Dillywood director who nabbed all the DisCars one year. She's quite the legend...

speaker: Lynn
content: So I think... to win a DisCar... or to solve OwO's problem, we can use her opinion as a reference?

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... but I still have a question.

speaker: OwO
content: What does a director do again?

You almost choke. Seeing how confident she was ordering everyone around, you had assumed that she thought of herself as My Best Cool Car's director. Little did you know... Now, all you can do is try to explain as you scratch your head.

speaker: Option
options: It's the soul of a film.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: In reference to what had been said, it's the person who directs the entire crew to realize the movie by using various technical tools, so that the audience may believe and enjoy it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's kind of like what you're doing right now, OwO. But with more expertise and experience.
OwO goes deep into thought.

speaker: OwO
content: So... what I can't figure out now stems from not understanding "directing," and lacking "expertise" and "experience"?

speaker: Lynn
content: I... I didn't mean it that way. It's difficult, but with hard work, you should be able to do it...
Lynn tries frantically to comfort OwO, but OwO jumps up.

speaker: OwO
content: Oh, I get it now! Thanks, Lynn! I finally found the missing piece of the puzzle that stands between My Best Cool Car and the DisCars!

speaker: OwO
content: We need a director! Let's go to Dillywood to find Deren! We need her to join our crew!

2:00 p.m., January 22, N.F. 113
Eastside - Dillywood Walk of Fame

speaker: OwO
content: The Lion Dancing Queen is back! You didn't see me last night, so now you get an early update! Yup yup, I know, I know... y'all really miss me! I miss you guys, too!

speaker: OwO
content: I've come back to the camera, and today, the crew is taking a big step forward! We're warming up for the big battle for the DisCars!

speaker: OwO
content: That's right! Thanks to our little clapper ${PlayerName}, we've crossed the Rust and entered Eastside to prepare for the awards ceremony in advance. <size=28>Of course, that dummy asked for a day off and didn't come along...</size>
female_content: That's right! Thanks to our little clapper ${PlayerName}, we've crossed the Rust and entered Eastside to prepare for the awards ceremony in advance. <size=25>Of course, that dummy asked for a day off and didn't come along...</size>

speaker: OwO
content: This is the place where dreams are made... Dillywood's Walk of Fame! Ta-dah...

This narrow but brightly lit street is crammed with cinemas, studios, and offices. The walls are plastered with posters, while holograms of sultry stars beam everywhere. This dreamy area stands apart even in the wealthy Eastside.
Golden confetti soar across the sky like countless little dancing suns. The atmosphere here is beyond compare. Yet the crowning jewel of all this is the upcoming DisCars Film Festival.

A bigger-than-life Golden Duck Trophy flanks the street. Celebratory music blasts day and night, while talent scouts, actors and paparazzi mingle amongst the crowd. All eyes in the city are on this avenue these few days, making it dearly exuberant.

speaker: Love
content: Oh... Even though DeadLover Radio has been popular for quite a while, this is the first time I actually set foot in Eastside... Crossing the Rust was no small feat. This place is really beyond my imagination.

speaker: Love
content: It's the fragrance of flowers and makeup! It's the fragrance of dreams and joy!

speaker: Daisy
content: Ugh... It's the stink of money and camera flashes... It still gives me nausea after all this time...

speaker: Love
content: Are you unwell, Lil Daisy? I remember that you were in the Eastside entertainment industry for a while. I was hoping you could tell me about it.

speaker: Daisy
content: Stop talking about it... I'm gonna puke...

speaker: Daisy
content: Want to say something, Lynn? I remember the photographer you like also works in Dillywood...
The girl in the rabbit helmet, who had been patting Daisy on the back, freezes for a moment, then panics.

speaker: Lynn
content: No no, um, I...

speaker: OwO
content: What? Lynn's been to Dillywood before? Then...

speaker: Lynn
content: N-no, I haven't...
Five minutes later.

speaker: Lynn
content: I-it's because Dillywood is the heart of the film industry... It has a lot of talented people and opportunities, so w-we also came here...

speaker: Lynn
content: My Best Cool Car Studios... is looking for a director... If you have any friends to recommend, please leave their contact info in the comments.

speaker: OwO
content: That's right! You can recommend yourself, too! As long as you're a director... A directorrrrr...

speaker: OwO
content: Directorrrrrr... Do you hear me... The DisCars are waving to you ...

You listen to OwO's vlog from your headset. They've barely gained any followers these past few days, and the Intelligence Department is also monitoring them. Their livestream helps you keep tabs on them at all times.

The area is brimming with oddly dressed weirdos who goad tourists to take pictures and then demand money. They all excel at catching eyes and making trouble. OwO's lion head pales by comparison. You hope she doesn't get into a fight with anyone.

speaker: OwO
content: <size=30>You dare look down on the Lion Dancing Queen? You think I'd let my emotions get the better of me? I definitely won't reveal my moves here! My first public performance will be onstage at the DisCars, so everyone can be awed by the wonders of lion dancing!</size>
You try imagining again, and feel that this is the more likely scenario. You can't think of anything worse, so you look up at the man in front of you.

The Dean of DisCity Film Academy, head of the DisCars Awards Ceremony, and a shareholder of a major Dillywood studios. He reacted oddly when you asked to visit on behalf of the MBCC this morning, and kept insisting on receiving you himself.

But when you actually got here, he tried his best to keep you in the office alone. Whenever you'd ask something, he'd beat around the bush and talk in circles. You have no idea what he's trying to say.

speaker: Option
options: ...Sir, can I help you with anything?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've been sitting here for a long time. If something's troubling you, feel free to tell me.

speaker: Dean
content: Ah, no. No no no no no... you misunderstood. We are full of admiration for the FAC's contributions. Your presence here is an honor for Dillywood. There is nothing you should worry about.
His anxious expression says otherwise. You switch to a different channel on the covert comms system that he can't hear, and receive some updates from the MBCC Intelligence Department.

speaker: Wynn (Secret Message)
content: Have the Apostle's clones appeared in Dillywood, too?

speaker: Wynn (Secret Message)
content: Hmm... no reports on that, but it's very likely. After all, Dillywood is a dream factory with a ton of spiritual energy. They'd easily get lured to a place like that.
That's why the Dean is so scared. He thinks you're an FAC commissioner who came here to investigate.
But why would he try to hide it? You try to put him at ease.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry. If you encounter any incidents, I can report them on your behalf. Right now, everything is still under control. A short lockdown ought to solve the problem.

speaker: Dean
content: No!!! These are just some... uh... pranks! Yeah, pranks! It's not Mania! No need to bother the fine staff of the FAC!
The Dean finally can't hold out any longer. He slams his palms on the table and begins to speak in panic.

speaker: Dean
content: The film festival is about to begin. It's the most important event of the year! It must not get disrupted by Mania!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...The arts are important, but safety comes first. The sooner it gets found, the faster it can be dealt with. There shouldn't be too much disruption.

speaker: Dean
content: Mania is a disruption in itself!

speaker: Dean
content: We've invited so many celebrities, judges, guests, and media. All the contracts for sponsorships, ads and publicity have already been signed, and they're worth a fortune! Do you know how much we'd have to pay if we breach them?
Huh?
Before you have a chance to react, the man walks over the coffee table and grabs your wrist, pleading with a fawning look on his face.

speaker: Dean
content: The problem's not that bad, really. There's not that much damage. Please just wait out these few days. You can do whatever you want in a week, okay? I can give you whatever you want. Investments? Celebrity appearances?

speaker: Dean
content: Oh, and I heard that your friend is looking for Director Deren. I can help you...
You become high on alert.

speaker: Option
options: You sent people to follow them?

speaker: Dean
content: No, no! I just care about young people with filmmaking dreams. Don't worry, they went back already!
Sensing your anger, he quickly fumbles out a name card.

speaker: Dean
content: Here are the contact details for Deren Film Studios. The director is very busy, so I couldn't get in touch with her personally, but her team is quite good.

speaker: Dean
content: Her assistant has already accepted the invitation for this year's DisCars, and said that Deren has agreed to be a judge for this year's awards. So as long as the ceremony can be held as usual, you'll be sure to see her!
On the ostentatious card is a glamorous, black-haired woman in sunglasses and an evening gown, who is flashing an obviously fake smile.

speaker: Dean
content: I know you want to make a movie. I can find all sorts of resources for you. Money is not a problem, nor is ticket sales! Anyone can enter the industry. You can make a movie in 10 days and still win a DisCar!
These words are so familiar to you. When spoken by OwO, they feel like the innocent, romantic but troublesome fantasies of a child. But when uttered from the Dean's mouth, they just sound absurd.
The name card in your hand is an unexpected gain, but it makes you feel uneasy. All you want to do right now is to leave this place.

speaker: Option
options: Don't worry, I won't say anything.

content: The man thanks you a million times and accompanies you all the way to the street. He puts you in a VIP car and keeps waving until you can't see him anymore.
You won't say anything, but everything that had been said has already been heard by Wynn on the other end. The FAC can decide how to handle it.

speaker: [Scene Change]
content: Night at My Best Cool Car.

9:00 p.m., January 22, N.F. 113
West bank of the Rust - My Best Cool Car parking spot
You return, completely exhausted. Before you can sit down, OwO gives you a big bear hug.

speaker: OwO
content: Too slow! You're slacking off! You're losing points with me, little clapper!

speaker: Option
options: I'm trying hard to find Deren, too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Here is the contact information for her studio. Let me see, her name card is...
You reach for it, but then hesitate. You don't even want to bring in a whiff of her fans' adoration from Dillywood, let alone have this big director join My Best Cool Car herself.
You'd rather ask the MBCC for some reliable professionals to help out, or even learn the ropes yourself.

speaker: OwO
content: Name card?

speaker: OwO
content: What do I need a name card for? I've already brought the best director here!
She skips back to the vehicle, and pulls out a shabby woman you've never seen before.

speaker: OwO
content: Welcome to today's special vlog update! ${PlayerName} is back, so everyone is here. It's time to introduce our newest member... the famous Dillywood director, D!!!

speaker: Director" D
content: Hehe... Good evening...

speaker: Option
options: You randomly pulled someone from the street again?

speaker: OwO
content: Of course not. She joined on her own! We hit it off right away on the street. She also gave a lot of shopping tips, so the others went off shopping and had a lot of fun! D is the most perfect fit for our crew!

speaker: Option
options: She joined on her own? And sent away the others to talk to OwO alone?

content: You observe the director named D carefully, who looks very gloomy and sluggish. She squints so much you can't even see her eyes properly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did you read the script already? What did you like about it? What about OwO attracted you? Do you know what the lion's head is for?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where's your resume? What works have you produced?

speaker: Director" D
content: Ahhh... so many questions. Is this an interview?

speaker: Director" D
content: Sorry, I forgot the first few questions already. Can I just answer the last one? About my works...
She avoids your questions, but then responds again after a while.

speaker: Director" D
content: To tell the truth, I've been in Dillywood for many years, but I haven't produced anything worth showing... Hehe...
...Okay, at least she's honest. It's true that while Dillywood has many glamorous celebrities, there are also a lot of small potatoes who struggle to realize their dreams.

speaker: Director" D
content: But it's fine. There's a saying: Don't dwell on past glory... The true masterpiece is always the next one...

speaker: Director" D
content: That'd be the new movie I'm making with OwO, right? From the moment we met, there was dazzling fantasy all over.

speaker: OwO
content: That's right! It's because you're a great director!
The two of them tilt their heads and giggle, casting you aside. They've used shameless nonsense to avoid all the serious questions.
This is clearly a scam. This woman obviously belongs to another major demographic of Dillywood—con-artists who lie through their teeth every day.

speaker: Option
options: Why are you trying to get close to OwO?

speaker: Director" D
content: You still have questions? Can you ask me tomorrow? OwO said the little clapper would bring us some food... If you can do that, I'd be very thankful.

speaker: Director" D
content: Umm... I'm really hungry and sleepy. I haven't slept indoors for several days... Can you please help me out?
...Could the reason why she wants to join the crew be...

speaker: Option
options: OwO! Did you tell her that room and board will be provided for?!

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm? Yeah! When you got me into My Best Cool Car, didn't you say that I'd get room and board, too? Of course we should treat all crew members equally!
How can that be the same?!

speaker: Director" D
content: Haha... Better get some rest before work starts... Haha... Yawn...
She waves her hand, and lies down with a thud.

West bank of the Rust - My Best Cool Car parking spot

speaker: Love
content: Hi everyone! It's finally Love's turn to do the vlog. How about it? Doesn't it feel all fresh and new?

speaker: Love
content: Or maybe, the site is already chock full of my old fans?

speaker: Daisy
content: This is for an Eastside vlog site. Syndicans who don't use the Internet won't be visiting it. You should start over.

speaker: Daisy
content: Also, this isn't the radio station. Don't bring out your old habits. Be good and tell everyone about the crew's progress today.

speaker: Love
content: <size=28>Think you're cool just because you're holding the camera? You're bringing out your old habit of dissing me, too...</size>

speaker: Love
content: Ah, never mind, never mind... In any case, since Director D joined, recruitment has ended. The film crew has officially been established!

speaker: Love
content: OwO is getting special training from the director, and also working on the script. Us three production staff went around all the studios in Dillywood last night and learned a lot. We also bought almost everything we need.

speaker: Daisy
content: Actually, we didn't buy much, mainly because of limited funds. We emptied the little clapper's wallet.

speaker: Love
content: Ahaha, that's what investment is! Tomorrow we'll start shooting, so the workload will increase a lot. We'll get the real sense of filmmaking in no time!

speaker: Love
content: And tonight, the crew needs to do something very important! That is...

speaker: Love
content: That is...

speaker: Love
content: ...Why aren't you dissing me? The ratings are gonna drop.

speaker: Daisy
content: You weren't planning to say it tonight anyways. Weren't you saving it as a surprise for tomorrow?

speaker: Daisy

content: ...Stella? Oh, no! There's something wrong with Stella!
The blue cub is glowing all over, and begins to struggle frantically. Is the mutual influence growing stronger because the main body is getting closer?
Just as you're about to move it away from OwO, countless monsters crawl out from the movie posters all around you.

speaker: Love
content: Wow... Monsters crawling out of posters? That's so cool! Just amazing...

speaker: Love
content: But the ones leading the pack look so tough and scary. Can we really hold them off?

speaker: Daisy
content: Shhh! I hear the Otherworld. It's so noisy. Why are there so many voices? They're cheering... My head hurts...

speaker: Daisy
content: Wait, someone who seems powerful is trying to tell us something! He's shouting...
female_content: Wait, someone who seems powerful is trying to tell us something! She's shouting...

speaker: Daisy
content: <size=44>Break its Core!!</size>

speaker: Lynn
content: L-leave it to me!
D takes over the camera to free up Lynn's hands.

This time, the girl doesn't eat any candies of courage. She bends over slightly, grasps the clunky helmet with both hands, and yanks it off without hesitation, scattering her golden locks. OwO suddenly really wants to see Lynn's expression...

speaker: Lynn
content: <size=44>Don't look at me!</size>
Boom—
A violet jet of blazing light shoots out from her eyes, brushing past the lion's head like a gust of wind and piercing the phantom in front of her.

speaker: Love
content: Oh wow, great job! Seize this chance!
${PlayerName} and the Sinners charge forward. OwO stays frozen on the spot with a look of shock on her face. Stella, who had already been agitated, burrows into her arms, shivering with fright.
Director D comes next to OwO with the camera in her hands, recording the spectacular battle scene before them.

speaker: Director" D
content: Here, sweetie, stand back a little. Don't get hurt.

speaker: OwO
content: ...Everyone's so awesome. They seem more like the heroes of this movie than me.

speaker: OwO
content: Will I also be this cool and powerful when I grow up?

speaker: Director" D
content: This is the lead-up to the climax. It's to make sure the hero goes into the final battle in the best condition.

speaker: Director" D
content: So make sure you don't get yourself hurt.
Those pudgy little hands can't help but clench around the lion's head. She understands everything. Now's not the time to pull a move, but...

speaker: OwO
content: I'm also a member of My Best Cool Car. I can't hide behind everyone else. I want to be with them...

speaker: OwO
content: I'm the world's most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen's forgot-how-many-generations of heirs. My lion dance is our battle drum. Time to boost morale!

speaker: OwO
content: <size=44>Hee-yah, watch this... Star of Fortune!</size>
Holding up her lion's head, she jumps high into the air and spins, her ear-splitting shrieks echoing across the battlefield...

speaker: Daisy
content: ...What is this kid doing... Her voice will break if she shouts like that... She's not a Sinner...

speaker: Love
content: Isn't this a good thing? She scared them for a moment, giving me the chance to pummel them even harder! Watch this... microphone attack!

speaker: Lynn
content: OwO is helping our fight in her own way. I-I have to try harder, too!
OwO continues her performance in the background, posing no threat whatsoever to the opponents. Yet the camera has panned from the fight on the field to this little cheerleader.

speaker: Director" D
content: Mhmm... This isn't bad.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief, we've stalled it from the front! The good news is, this Apostle's attack power is a lot lower than expected. The bad news is, is that it's just too resilient! There is no end in sight for this battle!

speaker: Wynn
content: The battle time has already exceeded our original plan. You should take everyone and leave. After all, OwO is an ordinary girl. If she stays in the Mania field for too long...
An Apostle minion suddenly breaks through the line of defense and dashes toward OwO.

speaker: OwO
content: Hey! Stay back! OwO's lion head will bite! Watch this... ahh!
The director yanks her back from behind. At the same time, the little blue critter suddenly jumps in front of OwO and lets out a long, silent cry.

speaker: Lynn
content: Why is Stella acting like this... Something's also wrong with the enemies around us...
There's a brief silence, as if the battle had been paused. Then, the Apostle's minions suddenly start screaming, and the attacks become more frenzied.
Did the little critter make them go crazy?

speaker: Rabbo
content:
Quack quack! Quack quack quack quack quack quack!
(Its main body has left! It's been repelled!! Quick, after it! Don't let it get away!)

speaker: Timecop Duck
content:
Quack!
(Yes, sir!)
Before leaving, the strange ducks salute you, but you have no idea what they're saying.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief! The Apostle's main body suddenly left. It stopped attacking and vanished from the battlefield. The remaining minions are probably attacking harder to cover its retreat. Their strength has obviously weakened.

speaker: Wynn
content: Is Stella protecting OwO?
...You have something more important on your mind than this naive guess.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What distinguishes it from other clones is not just its strength. Its power is clearly not concretization. Then...
But now, you must end this battle as quickly as possible. There's too much chaos. Even with the Hyperpyramid's protection, an ordinary kid like OwO shouldn't stay any longer.
You decide to make the Sinners stay and clear the scene, and ask the director to...

speaker: Director" D
content: Bye! We non-combatants are leaving now! Carry on, everyone!
She had already put on her coat and started fleeing like the wind with OwO under her arm.
The corridor to the gate of the theater isn't long, but OwO's struggles slowed them down.

speaker: OwO
content: Ahhh... No, no, no! We're so close! Stella's still not back home, and we haven't filmed the climax yet! I don't want to go!

speaker: Director" D
content: There, there. Didn't we already get a lot from this trip? Let's go back and review what we have.

speaker: OwO
content: The DisCars are just an inch away! Let go of me!

speaker: Director" D
content: Ugh, those are worthless. If you really want one, ask ${PlayerName} to pay a bribe, and you'll...

speaker: Director" D
content: ...Uh-oh.
She doesn't stop in time and stumbles out the broken gate. They instantly get overwhelmed by blinding camera flashes and snapping camera shutters.

speaker: Cacophonous Crowd
content: They're out, they're out!

speaker: Cacophonous Crowd
content: I knew it was her! I recognized her right away! That reporter was talking about it earlier!

speaker: Cacophonous Crowd
content: That blue monster is gone... so it has been killed! Did she go up close to film it? What a thrilling topic! We expect nothing less from her!
The people blocking the gate aren't soldiers, but a blur of glamorous folks all surging forward with their cameras.
OwO suddenly remembers that this is the first image of the DisCars she's ever seen. The red carpet, the theater, the flashing lights, the screaming crowds... It's a dreamy, surreal sight to behold.

speaker: OwO
content: ...The DisCars? Am I at the DisCars already?

speaker: OwO
content: Are they all here to see me? Director, did our film get a lot of attention?
The crowd shrieks, and the white-clad guards in front fail to hold them back. All the spotlight is focused on the other person—the "director" who's concealing herself with a hat and heavy coat.

speaker: Excited Crowd
content:
It's Deren!!!
Deren is back in Dillywood!!

speaker: OwO
content: Huh?

speaker: Reporter A
content: <size=32>Director Deren! Your assistant said that you accepted the DisCars' invitation to be a judge. Is that true? Five years ago, there were rumors that you severed ties with the academy. Does this prove that those rumors were false? Or were they true, but you reconciled now?</size>

speaker: Reporter B
content: After hearing rumors of your comeback, many of the hottest stars have expressed their desire to be in your new work. xx, xxx, and xxxxx even hinted that they have an "intimate relationship" with you. What are your thoughts?

speaker: Seething Crowd
content:
What's your schedule like, Director Deren? What genre are you choosing this time?
Rom-com? Action? Fantasy?

speaker: Reporter C
content: Those aren't important! Over here, Director! I care about your cinematic art the most!

speaker: Reporter C
content: Why did you stop making films five years ago? Have you lost your inspiration? Did you retreat from the public eye to hide that fact? Please tell us! Are you all out of talent, Director Deren?
The crowd edges even closer. The pair who had just escaped from the chaos is besieged by microphones, cameras, phones and hands... But no one notices the conspicuous blue critter close by.

speaker: Director" D
content: Sigh... I didn't expect that to happen.

speaker: OwO
content: It's so noisy!!!
She scares back the crowd and steps in front of Deren.

speaker: OwO
content: Whether she's D or Deren, she's my director! What do you people want to do to her? Outta the way, outta the way! No one's allowed to bully a crew member of mine!

speaker: OwO
content: Our movie isn't finished yet! Don't get in the way of us winning the DisCars!!
The reporters freeze for a moment. They look around, then lower their heads. Only then do they notice the little girl who's only half of Deren's height.

speaker: Reporters
content: Your crew...

speaker: Reporters
content: Are you the new Deren Girl?!

speaker: OwO
content: Huh?
The crowd becomes even more ecstatic, their cheers instantly drowning out OwO's voice.

speaker: Seething Crowd
content:
So you are making a comeback!
Who's the male lead? Who are the investors?
<size=32>Which production studio are you working with? What about the distributor? We can...</size>

speaker: Hysterical Film Star
content: No...! The next Deren Girl ought to be me! Director Deren! I'll do anything you want! I'll be a big box office hit, I promise! You're my dream! Please choose me!!
A couple of hands that had been reaching out to Deren turn towards OwO, startling her.

speaker: Seething Crowd
content: This kid is way too young. Is she related to one of the investors? They hid her for five years, so she must have quite the background... Could she be from Paradeisos?!

speaker: OwO
content: L-let go of me!

speaker: Seething Crowd
content: No, no, her clothes look so cheap. She's an Outlander... Hehe, and that accent...

speaker: OwO
content: D... Director! Head back and find ${PlayerName}! I'll stop these oafs!
No response comes from behind.

speaker: Seething Crowd
content: And that weird thing on her head... I've never seen that in DisCity... It really is... Tsk tsk...

speaker: OwO
content: It's not a "weird thing"!

OwO hollers out and stomps on the toes of the reporter who had been groping the lion's head. As he kneels down in pain, she jumps up with the golden lion's head, does a somersault, and lands firmly on the reporter's back.
OwO is angry.

speaker: OwO
content: No touchy! This is a lion's head! It's a treasure from my hometown! It should've debuted onstage at the DisCars! It's all your fault, you rude trolls!

speaker: OwO
content: This is a lion dance costume from Goldionville! It took a long, long way to get here! You're not allowed to insult it!
The golden lion's head gleams majestically in the light, surveying the crowd in rage. The crowd shuts up and stares at the Outland girl.

Clad in not-so-glamorous clothes and with a strange prop on her head, she glares at everyone with uninhibited fury. At this moment, OwO couldn't be more out of place with the Walk of Fame, tearing at the seams of this opulent dream factory.
As if unable to digest her existence, Dillywood falls silent. A long time passes before someone speaks up again...

speaker: Passerby
content: Goldionville... I remember now... I saw that name on a Quinn trade list a few years back. It's a city-state on the continent across the sea. Even today, there are no direct routes to it. We don't even have pictures of it...

speaker: Passerby
content: Last year, an catastrophe broke out on that continent, and it sank to the bottom of the sea...

<size=30>The last ray of hope is gone. The lion's head dims, and OwO seems to have suddenly lost her body. She wants to loudly refute the claim, but can't open her mouth. She wants to cover her ears, but her hands are frozen mid-air. Her eyes are wide open, but she can't recognize a single face in front of her.</size>

How strange. Is the world so far away from her? She feels tremors underneath her feet. The city is collapsing. Someone drags her down. Voices fill her head again, and every word is like a roaring drum.

speaker: Blurry Voices
content: Did that continent sink? Oh, I guess it's normal that we didn't hear about it. It's such a small, faraway city-state after all... It's hard to get to and hard to trade with. This would've happened sooner or later...

speaker: Blurry Voices
content: That's why she picked her. How brilliant of Director Deren... Everything makes sense now! What a genius choice! A great tearjerker would be a box office legend and make for the perfect comeback piece. Director Deren! Let's talk about distribution!

speaker: Blurry Voices
content: Ahhh... Director Deren... What's wrong?

The buzzing crowd suddenly falls silent. The director's face turns ashen, as if she saw something terrifying. But OwO doesn't notice at all. She just wants to grab someone. She has so many questions to ask. Who can answer her...
Step aside! Step aside!

speaker: Woman who barges in
content: Director, I finally found you! After all these years... Quick, come back with me!
A glamorous woman pushes through the crowd, grabs Deren and tries to leave. OwO doesn't understand what's going on, but she subconsciously grabs onto the director's loose black coat.

speaker: Woman who barges in
content: Save your questions for the press conference. The director won't be taking any questions right now. You...

The fashionable woman looks down and sees the little girl. She looks at Deren, then notices the countless cameras around her. Experienced and savvy, she quickly suppresses her built-up rage and puts on a warm smile.

speaker: Woman who barges in
content: Oh... I hear you're the director's friend. I'm Director Deren's assistant. I help her handle all kinds of work at the studio. Come find me if you need anything.

speaker: Woman who barges in
content: What's your name, sweetie?

speaker: OwO
content: ...OwO... My name is OwO...

speaker: OwO
content: I grew up in DisCity... My homeland is Goldionville... I know how to perform lion dancing... I want to make a movie and win a DisCar... and then...

speaker: OwO
content: I want... people in my hometown to see me perform lion dancing on TV...

speaker: OwO
content: ...Did something happen... to my hometown?

speaker: Director's Assistant
content: Sigh... About your homeland, I have heard some news about it... I'm sorry.

speaker: Director's Assistant
content: But all your misfortunes are in the past. Now you're in DisCity, and you've met Director Deren. These are all blessings of fate.

speaker: Director's Assistant
content: We'll take care of you. Why don't you join Deren Film Studios? We'll help you win the DisCar you want. You'll become Dillywood's future star.
What is she saying? Before the countless cameras, the woman brims with compassion as she reaches out to wipe the dust from the girl's face.

speaker: Director's Assistant
content: What an adorable child. What you had to go through is heartbreaking. Your story will move everyone in DisCity.

speaker: Director's Assistant
content: Your homeland would be proud of you.
The woman reaches out to OwO, and the crowd applauds. "Go with her, child," the crowd chants. But OwO is frozen in place.

speaker: Director's Assistant
content: Come...
Slap!
Someone slaps away the hand reaching towards OwO, and pulls the girl into their arms. OwO recognizes the person.

speaker: OwO
content: ...${PlayerName}?
Footsteps rush over from behind.

speaker: Love
content: What the **** are they doing to OwO? Leave her alone!

speaker: Daisy
content: I'm sorry... Madam, OwO already has a film crew... She is the founder of My Best Cool Car Studios. Please don't... look down on her because she's a child.

speaker: Lynn
content: No, Stella, you can't come out... I know you're angry, but not now...
You glance at the last member to join the crew. Behind her are countless flashing cameras. Her anger has dissipated, but she now has a totally unfamiliar look on her face.

speaker: Option
options: ...This isn't the script you gave me.

speaker: Deren
content: Sigh... Get used to it. This is Dillywood. Practically anyone can change your script.

speaker: Deren
content: That's fate for ya. It never goes the way you want. Everyone who comes must understand that they need to choose... how to keep the show going.

speaker: Deren
content: Now's your turn, my little hero.
She bends down towards OwO. Her long shadow eclipsing the girl's vision. OwO can't help but shrink back.

speaker: Deren
content: This is the Walk of Fame that makes all wishes come true. Fame, fortune, dreams, and opportunity... You're lucky enough to have a ticket in.

speaker: Deren
content: Want to pre-order a DisCar? Which category do you want to win in? Who do you want to watch your movie?

speaker: Deren
content: I'm the legendary Director Deren. Come to Dillywood with me. I can make all this come true.

speaker: OwO
content: No, its not!
She reaches out and grabs Deren's clothes.

speaker: OwO
content: I'm not going! I don't want those things! Can you please stay?

speaker: OwO
content: You said you'd help me make my own film. You said everyone will see my story. It's not finished yet. My wish hasn't come true yet!

speaker: Deren
content: ...My dear OwO, some films have happy endings, and some have sad endings. But there's one kind of ending that's the cruelest...

speaker: Deren
content: It's when the filmmaker can't detach themselves from their film, and dissolves to dust alongside it the moment they leave the theater.

speaker: Deren
content: The length of a film is all that a person can "direct." If you want to keep directing the world after the film ends... Are you strong enough to do that? Do you really think it's possible?

OwO doesn't know how to answer. Her silence causes the crowd to stir. They don't understand what's happening. Why isn't this Outlander girl accepting the deal of a lifetime? How can she let this new masterpiece hang on the line?
You shield OwO as the microphones and cameras turn to her. Yet the legendary director just smiles and blocks them all. She puts on her hat and walks into the sea of flashing cameras.

speaker: Deren
content: Enough... This is my big comeback. Why are all the cameras pointing at someone else?

speaker: Deren
content: This is the Walk of Fame, where dreams are made and shattered. Come, my big comeback press conference is this way. Let's forge the next dream together!

speaker: Deren
content: Those who cannot be part of this dream should go sleep somewhere else...

speaker: Deren
content: Some movies don't belong to this place.

10:00 p.m., January 27, N.F. 113
The Rust - My Best Cool Car Studios temporary base

speaker: Lynn
content: OwO... You don't have to force yourself. If you really can't do it, I-I can do it for you...

speaker: Love
content: That's right! Um... why don't you get some sleep first? Maybe you'll get some new ideas after you wake up. You don't have to say goodbye when you're feeling your worst...

speaker: Daisy
content: All right Love, you've said enough...

speaker: OwO
content: It's fine. I'm OwO, founder of My Best Cool Car Studios. What haven't I been through?

speaker: OwO
content: Turn on the camera, ${PlayerName}. I can do it.

speaker: Option
content: ...Turn on the vlog

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe... Good evening. This is OwO the lion dancer. It feels like it's been a while. I really miss everyone.

speaker: OwO
content: These past few days, we ventured into Dillywood, walked the red carpet, and got swarmed by reporters. We also met Stella's family. Though we were really close, we weren't able to send Stella home. But we'll definitely succeed next time.

speaker: OwO
content: I want to thank all my followers. I know there aren't that many, but each and every one of you has given My Best Cool Car the strength it needs. Thank you so much.

speaker: OwO
content: I also want to thank all my buddies at My Best Cool Car. I'm sorry that I couldn't win a DisCar for y'all. But after going there, I really think My Best Cool Car is too good for the DisCars.

speaker: OwO
content: I'm not good at talking right now, so I might not be fully expressing the gratitude in my heart.

speaker: OwO
content: But I've prepared some gifts.

She rummages through her lion's head. The first thing she takes out is an envelope, which contains a smaller red envelope inside. It looks old, but its fine embossing and delicate gold patterns are quite exquisite.

speaker: OwO
content: This is called a "lai see." The lion dancing folks gave it to me. It contains DisCoins that I've saved.

speaker: Lynn
content: No no, I cannot accept this...

speaker: OwO
content: <size=32>It's not a salary, it's a blessing. Every year around this time, the kids in Goldionville get these blessings from the grownups. This is my blessing for Lynn. I hope you can become a photographer, go wherever you want and take pictures of whatever you like.</size>

speaker: OwO
content: If you ever feel like you're short on courage again, you can come to the Drifter Camp and use this money to buy candies of courage from the architect. The candy I gave you also came from him. You don't have to worry about lacking courage ever again.
She continues to rummage.

speaker: OwO
content: This is some herbal tea, for Love. This'll help you cool down every once in a while, so that you can keep burning with passion in a sustainable way.

speaker: OwO
content: This is a yellow paper talisman, with Goldionville calligraphy on it. I've seen them in some Outlander horror films before. I think Daisy will like it... No, don't put it on your forehead.

speaker: OwO
content: Next time you guys come to hang out, I'll make my favorite dim sum dishes for y'all... When I grow up a bit more, I'll try to get the flavor as authentic as possible.

speaker: OwO
content: My DisCars journey is about to end. Tonight, I will leave My Best Cool Car Studios, and stop updating this vlog.

speaker: OwO
content: Next, I have some secrets to tell ${PlayerName} and Stella. They're private, so I don't want anyone else to hear them. So it's time to turn off the camera...

speaker: OwO
content:
Goodbye, everyone...
Bye-bye! Thank you for staying with me all this time!

speaker: OwO
content: ...Didn't we agree to turn off the camera? Why are you still here... I don't have any secrets to tell. Sorry, I was lying... If I didn't say that, everyone would've tried to stay...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Could it be the lion's head? Is OwO going to teach me how to lion dance?

speaker: OwO
content: Pfft, why would I give that to you? The lion's head is my treasure! It's already a big privilege that I let you touch it.

speaker: OwO
content: ...I do have a gift for you, though. It's My Best Cool Car.

speaker: Option
options: Isn't that mine to begin with?

speaker: OwO
content: Also all the good memories, the little inspirations during filming, the tidbits and chance encounters, and my special secrets...

speaker: OwO
content: Disclaimer! These are all treasures to me, and I'm really reluctant to give them away. But OwO must keep going forward, so I leave them to you as souvenirs.

speaker: Stella
content: Squeak...

speaker: OwO
content: Sniff... Don't worry, I won't be defeated so easily. I'm the best Lion Dancing Queen in the whole wide world. I still have a lot to do, so I have no time to be sad.

speaker: OwO
content: Stella, tomorrow I'll take you to find your family. We were so close last time! We almost succeeded. Once you get back to them, they'll get better and won't be angry anymore. They'll be just as nice as you.

speaker: Stella
content: Squeak... Squeak!

speaker: OwO
content: You still have a homeland, Stella. I promise to send you home.

speaker: OwO
content: What are you talking about? Didn't you come to make movies? OwO's awesome, but don't get too clingy towards me. Don't forget about your own dreams.

speaker: OwO
content: From today onwards, you're no longer an intern. You're now a full-time employee and the pillar of My Best Cool Car Studios. You must carry forward our spirit!

speaker: OwO
content: I'll still be following your work after leaving the film industry! I'll continue to watch you, your films, and stories!
She waves her little fists indignantly, but soon runs out of steam.

speaker: OwO
content: ...I'll be watching you all the time. You won't be alone.
She falls into silence, and doesn't lift up her head again.

speaker: OwO
content: What... I'm not crying...

speaker: Option
options: Of course, OwO is the strongest.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let me stay with you. It doesn't matter if you don't make it into a movie. I just want to see how the story ends.
