options: It's okay. I'll go to dear Adela.

speaker: %u
content: She's the gentlest hairdresser in the world. She listens to me and understands me. She helps me think of solutions, and makes me soothing black tea.

speaker: %u
content: When I'm with her, all my worries fade away.

speaker: Adela
content: She can't make all your worries fade away. More often than not, she can only watch from the sidelines. But <color=#fb9259>Mad Shears</color> can.

speaker: Adela
content: Let her cut off everything. What you don't remember won't bother you.

speaker: Adela
content: Forget everything and stay here. This is a beautiful place. I'll safeguard your peaceful life forever.
It's not time yet. You can still try to convince her. Just bet on the chance that she really does "care".

options: So I should forget about you too?

speaker: %u
content: I came to catch you, but got pummeled by you. You then extended a helping hand to me at my weakest, and took care of me so tenderly. We went in a full circle, but everything is different now.

speaker: %u
content: If I really do have worrisome hair, then those worries aren't just burdens. They also include many things worth cherishing. I worry because I care. I can't bear to lose them, and I can't bear to lose you either.

speaker: %u
content: As long as you're still Mad Shears, as long as you're still Adela, I can't bear to let you go.

speaker: Adela
content: ...Worries worth cherishing...

speaker: Adela
content: I've never heard anyone say that before. So many people have confided in me, and they all said they wanted to escape from their worries... Once again, you stand apart from the crowd.

speaker: %u
content: Maybe they feel the same as I do, but say otherwise just to vent their frustrations. After all, people are often blind in their own cause. The world's not black and white, right?

speaker: Adela
content: ...Perhaps. That's beyond my comprehension.
She looks down slightly.

speaker: Adela
content: I don't have any worries, so I don't know... what worries are worth cherishing.

speaker: Adela
content: As you know, all I can see is crazily sprouting hair.
A low roar shakes the ground, and the thick fog begins to surge. The wind becomes a violent storm, lifting her short hair from behind.

Adela constrains your attempts at resistance, her eyes fixed on yours. She raises her hand slowly, dangling those cold, sharp shears above you. The cold gleam of the blades reflects in your eyes. You're ice-cold all over.

speaker: Adela
content: These hairs are heavy and burdensome. I've seen them suffocate and devour people countless times. I've seen and heard too much. I don't want to see you end up like that.

speaker: Adela
content: ...You're the only one who I don't want to see meeting the same fate.
You've failed to persuade her. She swings her wrist, and the shears strike towards you. But at that moment...
Zing!

A bullet whizzes past the shears. A dazzling searchlight shines in, illuminating the terrace like the sun. Breaking through the thick fog are several FAC-MBCC combat helicopters, accompanied by those you've parted with for too long.

speaker: Hecate
content: We found them! They are here. Chief!

speaker: Hella
content: Dummy, letting someone step on you like a doormat again?!! Get up!!
A uniformed woman stops the two Sinners from rushing to go down. The adjutant has her gun pointed at Adela as she calmly issues commands.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Coordinates confirmed. Turn the anti-Mania devices on to maximum. Stop the fog and prepare to rescue the Chief.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Mad Shears... No, <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color>! Leave the Chief alone and back off! This is an ultimatum!!!
With everything exposed, Adela's calm expression changes for the first time. In contrast to the huge MBCC search and rescue team behind you, she's all alone.

speaker: Adela
content: ...How did they penetrate the fog?
You did feel something earlier. Was it from the shackles? Or was it... You look at the little swaying lantern on the helicopter, think for a while, and decide to change the focus point.

speaker: %u
content: There is a special connection between us. It takes a bit of time, but as long as the shackles are still here, they're sure to find me.

speaker: %u
content: They are my cherished "troubles." I won't let you sever them from me.

speaker: Adela
content: ...I see... So you said all those things to stall time.

speaker: Adela
content: How clever of you, Mr. Inspector...
female_content: How clever of you, Ms. Inspector...

content: The constraint on you loosens. She seems to suddenly have lost all her strength. You finally claim the victory you deserve. However, after going through so much, you can no longer regard her simply as a hostile target.
On that first night, why did she fight you so fiercely? And after that, why didn't she take back her shears?

speaker: Adela
content: No need. Things are fine the way they are.

speaker: Adela
content: My life is as peaceful as always. I'm content. It should continue like this.

options: That wasn't just for stalling time.

speaker: %u
content: ...I really meant what I said.

speaker: %u
content: I don't know how "Mad Shears" came about, or what happened in the past to make you so obsessed with "worries." But I'm willing to trust the gentle Adela I know.

speaker: %u
content: I trust that you really want to help others, and that you want to cherish your stable and peaceful life in your own way.

speaker: %u
content: Put down the shears. So long as they control you, you'll never get what you truly want.

speaker: Adela
content: A stable and peaceful life... yes, I do cherish a life like that.
Adela gets up slowly, lowering her shears. Under the strong light, you can't see her expression clearly.

speaker: Adela
content: I like the neighbors here. I like the worry-free days I've spent here.

speaker: Adela
content: After wandering for so long, I finally found... such a peaceful place.
An ominous feeling appears. The voices of the townspeople ring out from the thinning fog.

speaker: Resident
content: The FAC! It's the FAC! We're saved! The fog is about to get dispersed! Mad Shears is at... the hair salon?

speaker: Resident
content: Isn't that Adela's shop? How is Miss Adela? Why are those people pointing their guns at her?

speaker: Resident
content: ...No, that's impossible... How can Adela be Mad Shears? Adela, she...
The thick fog is surging slowly, and more and more murmurs pass through it to reach your ears. Under the bright light, the notorious Mad Shears of Eastside has nowhere to hide, and looks a bit dazed.

speaker: Adela
content: Hair... So much hair... Everyone is worried again... and this time, it's because of me...

speaker: Adela
content: Hehe... This moment would come sooner or later...
Her figure is so frail that it looks like she's going to disappear into the light at any moment.
You're suddenly seized by panic. You have to grab her! Out of instinct, you ignore the danger and struggle up, trying to grab her.

speaker: %u
content: Things aren't hopeless yet! You're just a victim of circumstance who got controlled by Mania. Everyone will understand! I'll... try to bail you out and let you come back here.
You reach out to her, but grab her shears instead. In an instant, a head-splitting headache hits you again. Your vision quivers, blocked by long messy hair once more.
The hair belongs to Adela this time. It has grown to enormous lengths, tangled and heavy.

speaker: Adela
content: I haven't experienced this for so long that I almost forgot... this is what <color=#fb9259>worry</color> feels like...

speaker: Adela
content: I moved many times before finally finding this place—a little home where I can sleep peacefully, a job that I can excel at, and the opportunity to gain trust and give back. Every problem has its solution.

options: I don't want to take away what you cherish.

content: You want to pull her to your side, but the intense disorientation caused by the shears makes it impossible to do so.

speaker: Adela
content: It's fine. Don't worry about me, Mr. Inspector. No one will get hurt...
female_content: It's fine. Don't worry about me, Miss Inspector. No one will get hurt...

speaker: Adela
content: I'm a hairdresser who trims away worries. Dealing with this kind of thing is my forte.
To be the Mad Shears who goes around Eastside doing as she pleased without ever revealing her face, while at the same time being worry-free Adela...
How is that possible? It's not that she's never been discovered, or that she doesn't have any worries, it's just that she knows how to <color=#fb9259>deal with those things</color>.
Under the aim of countless guns, Adela lets go of your hand gently.

speaker: Adela
content: Farewell, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Adela
content: Whether it's Adela or Mad Shears... You don't have to worry about me any longer.
You've failed. The hair on the floor ensnares you. Adela takes a step back, clutching the shears in her hand. You hear the alarm go off nearby.

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: The M-value is rising! What the... Her power is growing rapidly! Be careful, everyone! It's an S-Class Sinner!!!

speaker: Nightingale
content: ?! Sniper, shoot!!! Stop her!!!
Bullets pierce her shadow, riddling the ground with holes. Dense fog gushes forth, blanketing the entire area once again.

speaker: %u
content: Stop, Adela! Stop...
With a cold flicker, the blade slashes you. Something flashes across your eyes. You're alive, but something in your consciousness has splintered off again.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief!! Argh!
Her shadow flashes by. The helicopters shudder violently, and some of them crash to the ground.
You struggle to crawl over and force yourself into the cabin. Nightingale, the combatants, and even the Sinners... They're all fine, but have lost consciousness.

speaker: %u
content: Adela...

You open your mouth, but forget what you wanted to shout. Your memory is shattered once more. You seem to hear the townspeople's screams in the distance, wave after wave. Soon after, everything falls into silence again. All that is left is the rolling fog.
But you manage to remember something. You reach into your pocket and feel a string of <color=#fb9259>keys</color>.

...To find her, you must go to <color=#fb9259>that place</color>. There's still a chance. She's not without worries. She knows what it's like to suffer from them, and what it's like to cherish them. She can't bear to part with them, either.
You must catch her... while you still can.
You stop at the center of the fog—before the door of a familiar house.
This is an illusory space. Thick fog permeates the room, and all her once neatly arranged items are floating in the air. You vaguely recall its original appearance.
The soft mattress, the clean clothing, the delicious breakfast—you still have all these memories, yet they're fading quickly to the soothing fragrance.
You have to find her quickly before you forget everything.
The suitcase is gone, perhaps taken away by its owner. That little suitcase can't hold much. Its owner left in a big hurry.
...Or perhaps, without anything to long for.
You hear a sound. Clinging on to the last bit of hope, you find the room where the sound came from.
The door is unlocked, and creaks open from your movements.
You see familiar long hair.

speaker: Blurry Shadow
content: I'm a hairdresser who trims away worries. Dealing with this kind of thing is my forte.
A shadow made of hair lies at the center, murmuring quietly. Its voice is hoarse, with a hint of sadness.

speaker: Hairy Shadow
content: Must I go... Must I go...

speaker: Hairy Shadow
content: But I...

speaker: Hairy Shadow
content: Want to stay...
This is the heart of the fog. The shadow is made of Mad Shears' worries, which she has abandoned.

Operation Sloane Street has ended.

None of the victims were physically harmed. All recovered after some rest and are in stable mental condition.

Failed to detain Sinner suspect.

All electronic equipment at the scene were destroyed, leaving no visual data of the suspect.

Conclusion from analyzing Mania field remnants: S-Class, extremely dangerous.

The power is speculated to be <color=#fb9259>consciousness manipulation</color>, which is quite rare. High degree of vigilance required.

Hallucinations and amnesia are merely symptoms. Underlying cognition interference cannot be ruled out. If left uncontrolled, serious aftereffects may ensue.

No traces were left at the hair salon in question. The investigator found a photo album full of happily smiling customers.

Upon interviewing each one, not a single person remembers the place or who took their smiling picture.
...Chief, Chief!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey dummy, you finally woke up! Remember who I am?
You remember them. You remember everything.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The medical team has arrived and will conduct thorough examinations for both the residents and you. We must not underestimate the enemy's power.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Defeated by you. You have destroyed the monster and saved the street.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The fog has lifted, Chief.
You're surrounded by your Sinners. Time, which had been frozen by the fog, starts to flow again. The sun shines upon this street once more. You can all leave now.
Yet a forlorn feeling lingers in your heart.
You're still clutching a key in your hand, which gives off a familiar soothing yet melancholy fragrance.

speaker: %u
content: Whose is it?

speaker: Kelvin
content: This building actually extends downwards...

speaker: Macchiato
content: An old colleague told me the owner of this place loves the sea, hence designed it to extend downwards to simulate the depths and romance of the sea.

speaker: Macchiato
content: The architecture is quite rare for Eastside, so it became very popular. A lot of exhibitions and parties are held here.

speaker: Kelvin
content: But... doesn't this make you feel like you're trapped in darkness? A bit scary, come to think of it...

speaker: Macchiato
content: You think that's scary? I once heard a legend about an Eastside gourmet who even ate people to fulfill her culinary pursuits!

speaker: Macchiato
content: I think that's what's really scary...

speaker: Kelvin
content: Ehhhh!
The manual only marks the different floor levels: the open-air pool and restaurant are on Level 1, the game and recreation area is on Level B1, and the banquet hall is on Level B2.
You originally thought you'd go to the dinner banquet right away. It should be on Level B2, but the location is all you know about the dinner right now.
You can only follow the higher-ups' instructions, mingle into the event as much as possible, gain intelligence without anyone noticing, then finally help Miss Cabernet recover her "treasures."
Yes, and bring back the Sinner in the Thaumas Society.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We have far too few clues right now. We haven't even seen the client yet.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They say it's a feast to "please all tastes." And the guests are randomly chosen from Eastside and even Syndicate. Now that I've seen it myself, it really is quite extraordinary.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Maybe this is their tactic—with everyone's spirits at their highest points, even if there are Sinners around, I can't detect them unless they use their powers.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Then... what should we do...

speaker: Kelvin
content: I really hope I won't mess this mission up...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's okay. Didn't you socialize with those girls quite well just now? Just keep that up.

speaker: Macchiato
content: I didn't expect to meet my customers from before...

speaker: Macchiato
content: Although it's a bit embarrassing... I think I might be able to get some clues from them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll leave it to you, then.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: By the way, Kelvin, I heard that you like Miss Cabernet as much as the other guests here. She's our client this time, so maybe you'll get the chance to get her autograph.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Miss Cabernet...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. She's our client.

speaker: Kelvin
content: No, no... what I mean is...

speaker: Kelvin
content: I see Miss Cabernet. Over there!
You follow Kelvin's gaze and spot a redhead approaching from not far away.
The crowd quiets down for a moment, then erupts like wine being poured into a sizzling steak pan.
They surge forward and surround the woman, trying to chat with her from all sides.

speaker: Guest A
content: Miss Cabernet! What are you planning to do next?

speaker: Guest B
content: I'm thrilled to be spending today with you, Miss Cabernet!

speaker: Guest C
content: Quick, say something to Miss Cabernet! That way, you can put on your resume that you had in-depth exchanges with her at a social event!
The target of all this commotion, Miss Cabernet Franc, faces the surging crowd with elegant poise and a graceful smile...
She doesn't show a hint of impatience on her face.

speaker: Kelvin
content: I-it's her! It's Miss Cabernet!

speaker: Kelvin
content: Ah... I never dreamed I'd be able to see Miss Cabernet up close!

speaker: Kelvin
content: I've only ever seen her in my courseware and on the news...

speaker: Kelvin
content: Beautiful... elegant... and with such impeccable knowledge on food...
I brought you back here so you could live well. Father favors beauties like you. You can live happily here, just like I do.
After a while, her voice goes low again, and she just gazes at Cabernet with adoring and expectant eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why would someone so popular need to secretly ask the MBCC to retrieve her treasures?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She could make her fans turn this place upside down with a flick of her wrist if she wanted to.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who wouldn't want to do such a big favor for a famous heiress?
You gaze in perplexity at Cabernet, who is swamped by the crowd.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Perhaps... those aren't normal "treasures"?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What?

speaker: Macchiato
content: Ah... I just...

speaker: Macchiato
content: I know a couple of customers who come from this strata of society. They often use words as euphemisms for something else... a word like "treasure" is probably symbolic.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Maybe that's why she wants a government organization that won't leak her secrets to help her?
For some strange reason, it seems as if Cabernet had overheard your conversation from the crowd. She looks over at you from the distance.
She smiles as she gazes at you, and gives you a faint, barely noticeable nod.

speaker: Guest C
content: My family owns a vineyard. The wine there is amazing!

speaker: Guest C
content: Whenever you're free, Miss Cabernet, do drop by to have a taste! I guarantee you'll love it!
Someone suddenly approaches Cabernet and coos at her flatteringly.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Sorry, what did you say...?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ah yes, about the wine, is it? It would be an honor.

speaker: Guest D
content: Miss Cabernet! Since you're also a guest at the party, does that mean we'll have the honor of hearing your critique of the food here?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I usually don't give reviews on these types of occasions, but I'm willing to share some humble opinions if that's what the host and everyone else wants.

speaker: Guest D
content: Marvelous! I must write down what Miss Cabernet likes. That'll be the hottest dish for the rest of the year...
For a chance to speak to Cabernet, people are throwing all types of topics in the air.
Some flaunt themselves, some give empty boasts, while others coo about how splendid this party has become thanks to Cabernet's presence.
Some are even trying to attract her attention with outlandish actions, such as diving into the pool from great heights and making huge splashes.

speaker: Guest E
content: Look, Miss Cabernet! This is the coolest thing to do at a pool party!

speaker: Guest E
content: Divebomb!!
He barely finished his sentence before tossing his friend into the pool.
After a loud splash, everyone hears his friend cursing from inside the pool.
This makes everyone burst into laughter. Even as they laugh, they don't forget to observe Cabernet from the corner of their eyes.
She's covering her mouth, seemingly giggling in amusement. Upon seeing this, everyone starts to join in on the frenzy.
Regardless one wants to or not.

speaker: Guest F
content: Don't be scared, my friend! The pool's only a meter deep! You won't drown!
female_content: Don't be scared! The pool's only a meter deep! You'll be fine!

speaker: Guest F
content: Hey bro! Don't you want to take a dip?! The water's quite refreshing!
female_content: Hey sis, don't you want to take a dip?! The water feels quite comfy!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We don't want to join, stay back please...

speaker: Guest F
content: Come on, you're here already! Who comes to a party and doesn't want to have fun?
You continue to refuse, but someone grabs your ankle and pulls you into the pool!
female_content: You continue to refuse, but someone grabs your wrist and pulls you into the pool!

content: You're drained of air instantly as ice-cold water overwhelms your senses.

speaker: Macchiato
content: ${PlayerName}!!! Hurry, quick, grab my hand!!
Familiar voices come faintly from the pool deck, anxious and scared. You want to swim to the surface and respond to them, but you can't make your way out.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Wh-why isn't he responding?! I'm going down there to get him out!!
female_content: Wh-why isn't she responding?! I'm going down there to get her out!!

content: No... don't jump into the pool! It's dangerous down here!
This is clearly a critical moment. You want to stop Kelvin from jumping in, but something wraps around your legs and tries to drag you to the bottom of the pool!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ah!!

speaker: Strange Voice
content: Want to keep enjoying the pool party with them?

speaker: Strange Voice
content: If so, you can leave everything behind and keep having fun!
You hear a strange voice in your ear, but you're in no mood to care about what it's saying.
The force under your feet seems to be conscious, trying to drag you down at all costs.
You try to lift up your feet and break free from the thing entangling you, but whenever you make a move, your body sinks down a bit further.
With no strength left, the blue water before your eyes begin to blur.
The last string of bubbles pass before your eyes. You faintly hear that voice again...

speaker: Strange Voice
content: All right, you guys are the first batch... Why is there someone uninvited among you...

speaker: Strange Voice
content: Forget it. Doesn't matter. Bid farewell together, indulgent souls.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Ch... ${PlayerName}! Are you all right?!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Don't worry, it's just a heat stroke. He'll be fine.
female_content: Don't worry, it's just a heat stroke. She'll be fine.

speaker: Kelvin
content: I... I brought him some cold drinks and fruit!
female_content: I... I brought her some cold drinks and fruit!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Good job. Here, give them to me.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Mmm, he'll like this one.
female_content: Mmm, she'll like this one.

content: Your lips get gently parted, and something cold enters your mouth.
The sweet juice flows from the tip of your tongue down your throat, calming your restless emotions.
You forcefully open your eyes, and find yourself resting on someone's lap.
Red, faintly grape-scented hair brush against the tip of your nose. The person asks softly:

speaker: Cabernet
content: Are you all right? Do you feel a bit better?
You quickly sit up and look at her...
The woman who had been the center of attention just moments ago is now looking at you with a smile, as if wondering if you feel better.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cabernet...

speaker: Cabernet
content: You had a heat stroke and fainted. Poor dear.

speaker: Cabernet
content: But don't worry, you're fine now.
Cabernet's words seem to have some sort of soothing power. Your throbbing temples and nerves calm down somewhat.

speaker: Guest A
content: Ohh, look! That person woke up!

speaker: Guest B
content: My goodness, Miss Cabernet is too kind... Look, her clothes are all wet...

speaker: Guest C
content: Who is that guy, anyways? He's dressed like a bumpkin... he's not from Syndicate, is he? Why does Miss Cabernet care so much about him...?
female_content: Who is that girl, anyways? She's dressed like a bumpkin... she's not from Syndicate, is she? Why does Miss Cabernet care so much about her...?

content: The onlookers chatter to each other, full of envy and curiosity.
That invisible feeling of dread hits you again. You suddenly remember the thing that wrapped around you underwater.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Am I the only one who got saved from the water?
Your clothes are still a bit damp. In this summery weather, they ought to dry very quickly. You quickly deduce that you haven't fainted for long.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The only one? Of course... You were the only one who got heat stroke in the pool.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I remember, I was...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Was what?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I was caught by something large and heavy that tried to drag me down. And this pool seemed... bottomless.
You look at the pool. It's still teeming with rowdy guests who are partying like nothing happened.
Of course, there's the possibility that something did happen, but it's no big deal to these guests.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Never mind. Thank you for saving me, Miss Cabernet.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're welcome. These two helped a lot, so you should thank them, too... They are very concerned about the well-being of their Chief.

<size=31>You freeze. You catch the smile in Cabernet's eyes, realizing that she already knew your true identities. You're a bit taken aback, but then you realize that if she's influential enough to get the MBCC to do her bidding, it's only natural that she knows who you are.</size>
You turn to the worried Sinners and comfort them softly with a smile and nod:

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry for worrying you guys. I'm fine.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Miss Cabernet, since you already know our real identities, can you...
Before you finish speaking, Cabernet pulls you over to sit by her side.
You see that behind her, a guest is waiting to strike up a conversation with her. Seeing that you've already sat down and started chatting, the guest waits there for you and the Sinners to leave.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Would you accompany me for the rest of the party?

speaker: Cabernet
content: With you by my side, I think I'd be able to avoid unnecessary interactions and focus on enjoying the party.
Cabernet flips open the manual and hands it to you. She points at the last scheduled event: the dinner banquet.
You understand what Cabernet wants. You salute her and respond loudly, imitating the tone of the other guests.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ah... of course! I'd be honored! You saved me, after all! I'll stay by your side for sure!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Hehe...
Cabernet chuckles softly, then lowers her head and moves close enough for you to smell the faint fragrance of tropical fruit on her body.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Happy working with you, MBCC Chief and his Sinners.
female_content: Happy working with you, MBCC Chief and her Sinners.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then Miss Cabernet, can you tell us what exactly are these treasures you've lost?
After the guest leaves, you guys remain in place and exchange the information you have as if having a leisurely chat.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Umm... Food ingredients.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Food ingredients? To my knowledge, the host of this party is one of the top chefs in Eastside. She should have many channels to procure ingredients, and shouldn't need to...

speaker: Macchiato
content: Before I came, I also asked my old colleagues to do a bit of checking. The chef didn't seem to have any financial transactions that were out of the ordinary...

speaker: Kelvin
content: Recently, there have been rumors going around Eastside about a "legendary ingredient"... How did they describe it? A type of mermaid meat that can fulfill wishes...

speaker: Kelvin
content: But those are just rumors, after all. They can't be true...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Who knows. But I think that my ingredients are not particularly noteworthy to other people.

speaker: Cabernet
content: If I tell them what it is, they might be surprised by my choice... But to me, they're treasures.
Cabernet seems a bit sad, looking down at the ground.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Don't worry, I understand.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You understand...?

speaker: Macchiato
content: I've met many people who can only bury their true thoughts in their hearts. They all need someone who understands them, and whom they can confide in.

speaker: Macchiato
content: A top gourmet can also enjoy so-called "common food" and regard it as a treasure. It's no big deal.

speaker: Macchiato
content: But if you feel pent-up stress about it...
Macchiato touches the whip on her waist, her smile becoming wider.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Perhaps I can help?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ahaha, no, no need... I do think Miss Cabernet needs someone who'll support her in using common ingredients, but...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Whipping won't be necessary...

speaker: Macchiato
content: Ah... I see.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Haha... Thank you. I must say... Those who work for the MBCC Chief really know their stuff!
You find this client a bit hard to read—She recognized your identities right away, and gave you information and support.
But those "unnecessary engagements" she spoke of didn't decrease at all. On the contrary, even you guys became the center of attention.
This exposes all your actions to everyone. Every little thing you do is magnified.
The only advantage to this is that it won't be so easy for the host of the party to harm you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Right now, we know too little about this dinner banquet, so we can only go along with the host's plans step by step.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But in any case, at least we can confirm that the dinner banquet is the most important part of this party. There may be information about the treasures there.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Before that, please try your best to collect as much information as possible...
My goodness! Miss Macchiato! It's really you!
Did you really hear the song I just sang?
A tanned, muscular man walks up to Macchiato, his voice full of surprise.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Ah... wh-what song... haha... Mr. Ryan, what are you talking about? I don't understand...

speaker: Ryan
content: It's fine, no worries! I'm just surprised you actually showed up! And you know Miss Cabernet so well, too!

speaker: Ryan
content: Come and catch up with us! There are a lot of people here who know you!
The muscular man shows off his muscles and strikes a pose before the crowd.
Macchiato looks over at where Ryan is pointing, then whispers in your ear.

speaker: Macchiato
content: A couple of the guests over there work in the food and beverage industry. I might be able to get some information about this dinner from them.

speaker: Macchiato
content: It's a good opportunity, Chief.

speaker: One second later, he would have died in my hands... Were you trying to stop me?
content: But...

speaker: Macchiato
content: Don't worry, I can protect myself...
Macchiato smiles at you. The smile is genuine, as if to tell you not to worry.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All right, then. I'll be here at all times. If anything happens...
You wave your hands, signaling the "shackles."
You let go after seeing Macchiato nod. She and Ryan turn to leave.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Thank you and the others for remembering me. I'll go with you, then...
You're still a bit worried as you watch them leave, so you leave a few words with Kelvin and go after them.
Those guys surround Macchiato and come to the side of an elevator in the northwest. After a while, you hear a bunch of raunchy noises.
You feel the shackles in your hands twitch slightly. Worried, you hide next to the elevator and take a peek...

speaker: Big Tall Man A
content: Again, Miss Macchiato! Just once more! Please! Let me have it!

speaker: Big Tall Man B
content: Me, too! Me, too! Look, Miss Macchiato, my pose is on point! Shouldn't I get it first?

speaker: Big Tall Man C
content: Miss Macchiato can choose whoever she wants! Who let you choose for her?!

speaker: Macchiato
content: Haha... you're right. Excellent! I'll start with... you!
To your bewilderment, the sound of leather striking against skin rings out repeatedly from the narrow space.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Huh? Chief... it's you?
Macchiato is a bit surprised to hear your voice, but she maintains the sharp look on her face, nor does her hand stop.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Sorry you had to see that, Chief...

speaker: Are you too weak after the suspended animation? Or is the wooden box nailed shut?
content: It's fine! Um...

speaker: Narration
content: You scratch your head, think for a while, then ask:

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are they... all right?

speaker: Macchiato
content: Don't worry. They're all my former customers. This is just a little reward for them.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Thus, they will answer all my questions without reservation. See you in a bit, Chief.
Macchiato waves to you, then cracks her whip again.
Fanning your flustered ears, you quietly walk back to Cabernet.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Chief, your face is bright red... are you feeling too hot?

speaker: Kelvin
content: Try some of this. Miss Macchiato's friend brought it over and said it's delicious.
As a token of thanks for letting him borrow Macchiato, Ryan had given each of you a cup of ice cream before he left.

speaker: Ryan
content: It tastes delicious! Plus, you can also press it against any part of your body that hurts! The cold stimulation is also quite refreshing!
Remembering how Ryan winked at you, you have a hard time taking a bite.

speaker: Kelvin
content: This is the ice cream those swimsuit girls were feeding... hehe, I mean, sharing with me just now. It really is quite tasty. Would you like some, Miss Cabernet?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Really? How tasty is it?

speaker: Kelvin
content: It tastes sweet and smooth, with traces of lemon and sea salt. It's not heavy at all! Quite refreshing, actually!

speaker: Kelvin
content: Though I've never been to the ocean, I feel like this is the taste of the sea!

speaker: Cabernet
content: What an apt description. Makes me feel as if I tasted it myself... Seems that even the ice cream here is made from exquisite ingredients...
Kelvin is a bit bashful from the praise. She smiles at you, then gobbles another spoonful of ice cream.

speaker: Kelvin
content: But this serving tastes a bit different.
Kelvin smacks her lips, then sticks out her tongue and gently licks the spoon.

speaker: Kelvin
content: It's more savory than the one I had earlier. It feels like the same recipe, but with some... meat added to the ingredients.

speaker: Kelvin
content: But I can't really taste the meat, just the texture... hmm... maybe...
Having finished the portion in her hand, Kelvin glances at yours and asks:

speaker: Kelvin
content: Chief, can I have some more?
You give the untouched ice cream to Kelvin.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Thank you, Chief!

speaker: Kelvin
content: Hmm... This ice cream is indeed different from the ones earlier, but... it's still quite yummy.
You watch Kelvin stuff the ice cream into her mouth. Things feel a bit strange.
Though Kelvin can only taste frozen things, she has never displayed such a voracious appetite for any other food.
Cabernet also stares at the ice cream in silence.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Ah... Finished another one...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Don't eat too much. There's going to be dinner soon.

speaker: Cabernet
content: If you eat too much ice cream now, you won't have room to eat more delicious things later.
Cabernet puts her ice cream on a table a bit further away, and sits between it and Kelvin.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Right! There's still the dinner banquet!

speaker: Kelvin
content: Though I do want to have another bite... since Miss Cabernet says so, I'll leave some room for dinner!
Ting-a-ling...
The jingling of bells interrupts your conversation.
A uniformed maid with a little bell comes out of the poolside restaurant, calling to everyone.

speaker: Maid
content: Sorry for disturbing everyone.

speaker: Maid
content: The head chef told me to inform everyone that the soup is ready.
Upon hearing that the appetizer is ready, the guests in the pool cheer and start heading towards the restaurant.
Some linger in the corner. They had started satiating their appetites a long time ago, and refuse to leave.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Let's go. It's disrespectful to the chef to be late for the meal.
The guests enter the restaurant one after another and sit down at the long dining tables.
Everyone lets Cabernet have the head seat in the middle. You sit down next to her right.

Exquisite creamy almond-colored soup dotted with dark blue parsley has already been set in the shallow white plates on the tables. The light fragrance wafts into the guests' nostrils, igniting everyone's appetites.
Many have started to sip the soup as soon as they sat down. After tasting it, the guests gush with admiration and praise.

speaker: Guest A
content: I can tell that this is broth from excellent meat! It blends perfectly with the cream.

speaker: Guest B
content: Ah, how smooth and silky it tastes! Its fragrance is permeating my whole mouth!

speaker: Guest C
content: The milky white color looks so beckoning, too! What a wonderful choice for an appetizer!

speaker: Guest D
content: If you savor it carefully, you can taste a hint of a special flavour. The chef must've used a very rare spice!

speaker: Guest A
content: Yes, Yes! I taste it too!

speaker: Guest B
content: A spice that gives you an exquisite aftertaste, right?

speaker: Guest D
content: After... oh yes, absolutely! The aftertaste is marvelous!
The guests babble away, all the while sneaking glances at Cabernet.
Cabernet fills a spoonful of soup, takes a gentle sniff, then empties it back into the plate.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The texture of the soup is quite delicate. The fat is well emulsified, blending perfectly with the cream.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The fragrance is rich, and the color is pure. You can feel the chef's mastery just by the look and smell of the soup.
Cabernet puts down her spoon and looks around at the guests staring back at her. Everyone is waiting for her final judgment...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Mmm, very good.
No one knows if she's referring to the soup or the guests' commentary.
But no matter. Upon hearing Cabernet utter the words "very good," everyone relaxes and continues to shove spoonfuls of soup into their mouths. The wild food commentary also continues.
The most audacious commenters will also bellow out "Right, Miss Cabernet?" every once in a while.
Everyone's praise goads Kelvin into sipping a big spoonful of soup herself.

speaker: Kelvin
content: How strange...

speaker: Kelvin
content: Though I can't taste food this hot... this soup feels familiar...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Familiar?
Kelvin drinks another few spoonfuls, then nods confidently.

speaker: Kelvin
content: I'm sure I've eaten this before...

speaker: Cabernet
content: If I'm not mistaken... you're referring to the ice cream you had just now?
Cabernet's words light up Kelvin's eyes.

speaker: Kelvin
content: That's right! It's the ice cream! You're amazing, Miss Cabernet!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Certain ingredients can indeed be used for both soup and dessert, yet the flavors of the two we just had remain quite distinct...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Seems like the chef really mastered her skills.
Ah... what a great honor it is to be praised by Miss Cabernet!
A familiar voice rings out from behind you, making you jump.
You look behind. A woman you've never seen before is standing behind you in a chef's outfit. She beams at Cabernet.
And thank you everyone, for enjoying and approving of my humble soup.
Out of the corner of your eye, you notice that most of the guests haven't given their spoons a rest. As they guzzle down one spoonful of soup after another, only their eyes are fixed on the speaker.
However... even if Miss Cabernet approves of this soup... this guest here doesn't seem to like it?
Is this soup not to your liking? If so, may I have your suggestions?
You are Miss Cabernet's chosen companion, so your opinion is of great importance to me.
Her slender fingers dig forcefully into your shoulders, making it impossible for you to resist.

speaker: McGrath
content: Oh right, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm the head chef of this banquet. You can call me McGrath.
You're at a bit of a loss for what to do. You pick up a spoonful of soup to try, but Cabernet reaches out and stops you.

speaker: Cabernet
content: He ate a lot of grapes just now, so he feels a bit full. He's not trying to avoid the soup on purpose.
female_content: She ate a lot of grapes just now, so she feels a bit full. She's not trying to avoid the soup on purpose.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I told him that he would ruin his dinner like that.
female_content: I told her that she would ruin her dinner like that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry...
McGrath shrugs at your apology, not seeming to care.

speaker: McGrath
content: No matter. I think you'll have more appetite when the main course is served. I hope by then, you can give me the answer I want.

speaker: McGrath
content: I hope the same goes for you too, Miss Cabernet.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Mmm. I'm sure you'll surprise me.

speaker: McGrath
content: Of course, Miss Cabernet!

speaker: McGrath
content: I worked so hard precisely for this moment. All I desire is your nod and your precious and invaluable approval.
As McGrath says this, she walks over quickly to a place where everyone can see her.

speaker: McGrath
content: That's why the most exciting part of this party will be the dinner banquet. I prepared it specially for Miss Cabernet!
McGrath's words make the entire restaurant buzz with excitement.

speaker: Guest A
content: Specially prepared for Miss Cabernet?! Then we're in for quite the treat, aren't we?!

speaker: Guest B
content: Ah... Wh-what a time to be alive!

speaker: McGrath
content: Yes, it's indeed a great time... you're in for the ultimate feast!

speaker: McGrath
content: As for the ingredients used for this dinner... to be honest, before today, I too had thought it was only to be found in legends.
McGrath stares at Cabernet intently as she says this, as if expecting some reaction from her face.
But indeed, Cabernet's smile fades somewhat at the mention of the word "ingredients."
The ultimate feast, legendary ingredients... these proclamations are really stirring the pot, and all the guests are eagerly chatting about them.

speaker: McGrath
content: Not only that... everyone must be curious about the "Ocean Messenger" mentioned in the invitation...

speaker: McGrath
content: Hehe, of course, since it's a feast to "please all tastes," how could we not invite the Thaumas Society's Ocean Messenger, who devotes herself to bringing happiness to humans?

speaker: McGrath
content: She's already at the banquet hall, waiting for everyone to arrive.
The sudden news makes you frown.
The "Ocean Messenger" is already here? You couldn't get any info about her at the pool party just now. How involved is she with this party? What is her goal?

speaker: McGrath
content: But...
McGrath draws out her voice, interrupting your train of thought. Everyone's eyes focus on her again.

speaker: McGrath
content: Though everyone here shares an equal opportunity to sit at the dinner table...

speaker: McGrath
content: The legendary ingredients are extremely rare and limited in quantity.

speaker: McGrath
content: So... I will wait for everyone on Level B1. There are a limited number of seats for the dinner banquet, and the spots are first-come-first-served.
McGrath ends her speech with a dramatic wave of her hand. Right on cue, the elevator doors next to her open with a ding.
Someone shrieks: The elevator's here!
Many people spring up from their seats and surge towards the elevators.
They all try to squeeze into the two elevators, elbowing each other out of the way.
Some guests, however, remain seated and keep drinking the soup, as if the pandemonium before their eyes has nothing to do with them.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Should we go, Chief? You heard the head chef... first-come-first-served... legendary ingredients...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's too crowded. Let's wait a bit before we go... We won't be able to try the legendary ingredients if we get trampled in the stampede.

speaker: Kelvin
content: But...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry. We have our spot-saver right here.
You point at Cabernet, who smiles gently at you two. Kelvin calms down and follows you to the tail end of the crowd.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This way, we can also pick up Macchiato along the way.
You come to the side of the elevator, but there's no one there.
There's only a pile of brown, half-melted ice cream on the ground giving off the scent of caramel.
At that moment, the elevator door opens again. The remaining guests rush in, leaving only enough space for three more.
Seeing as they hadn't get to go downstairs sooner, it was a bit of a consolation to share an elevator with Cabernet.
Cabernet smiles and walks in confidently. You and Kelvin follow closely behind.
As soon as you enter the elevator, the crowd separates you from Cabernet.
Like a bus at rush hour, you're totally enveloped by the crowd in this overloaded elevator.
Though it's just one floor down, the ride is quite nauseating. Inside the tiny space, the other guests breathe down your neck, and their sweaty skin sticks against yours.
You're squeezed face-first against the wall, and can faintly hear Cabernet and Kelvin behind you.
A girl in a similarly suffocating position as you is pleading quietly.

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: Stop... stop pushing... let me out...

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: It's dangerous here... quick... get out of here...
On the pool deck above, the scorching sun is still shining, and the empty swimming pool is eerily silent.
Melting ice cream, coffee, and milky white soup are spilled everywhere.
They emit piteous wails as they evaporate.

The elevator finally reaches the floor below. The crowd rushes out, eager to see if there are still seats available. Your back is continuously squeezed and prodded by others—quite the unpleasant experience.
You and the mysterious girl are the last two to exit the elevator. Kelvin and Cabernet come over to you and shake their heads.
You understand what they mean: they didn't find Macchiato amongst the crowd.
You look around. This floor isn't as bright and colorful as the one above, and the dim lighting is hardly appetizing.

The main hall is decorated with strange sculptures and recreational machines. As opposed to the "game and recreation area" described in the manual, this floor is more like an escape room that one wants to flee from as soon as possible.

speaker: Guest A
content: Where is she? All of us arrived at the same time. Who'll get a seat and who won't?

speaker: Guest B
content: What is this place? I thought we were coming down here to eat?

speaker: Guest A
content: What the... Is she playing a prank on us? ... Didn't even finish my soup!

speaker: Guest C
content: It's a prank all right! We just went up the stairs and saw that there was no one left upstairs!

speaker: Guest C
content: Is there some hidden camera rolling?! Do they want to see us make a fool of ourselves?!

speaker: Guest D
content: The stairs? I just checked the stairs, it's locked already...

speaker: Guest D
content: I just came down with the final batch. You guys were arguing too much, so I wanted to go back and finish my soup. But the elevator's not working anymore, so I figured maybe I can take the stairs...
The elevators stopped working?!
The mysterious girl reacts even faster than you and rushes to the elevator, but all the lights on the panel have been turned off. No matter how hard she presses the buttons, there's no response.

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: Ahhhh great. Now the elevators is out of use!

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: That's why I said it's dangerous down here! Not one ever listens to me and they all rush downstairs!

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: Putting your life at risk just to try some strange new food...? Stupid!
The girl suddenly stops as if she realizes something, then looks up at you.

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: Ah, it's you! The one who also got squeezed flat against the wall back there...!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What... what a coincidence.
The girl glances at you, then at Cabernet and Kelvin. She suddenly comes up to you and whispers with lowered eyes:

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: P-please keep this between you and me... Help me, I beg of you...

speaker: Mysterious Girl
content: It's extremely dangerous down here. There are things beyond your worst nightmares... It's truly terrible. You've got to believe me. We have to get back upstairs!
The girl repeats what she had been mumbling in the elevator. You look at the shut-off elevator and locked stairwell. You don't have a good feeling about this, either.
Just as you're about to ask the girl something, ear-piercing static grabs everyone's attention.

speaker: McGrath
content: Ahem, can everyone hear me?
The crowd looks around, but the head chef is nowhere to be seen. Only her voice echoes in the air. It's as if she's monitoring you all from above.

speaker: McGrath
content: Dear guests... please quiet down.

speaker: McGrath
content: I did say that the seats for the dinner banquet are first-come-first-served... but...

speaker: McGrath
content: One must meet certain standards to be eligible. You will encounter different challenges at random times and places. Whether or not you're honorable enough for a seat will be judged on your performance.

speaker: McGrath
content: After all, only honorable souls are worthy of dining with the noble, elegant and perfect Miss Cabernet.
McGrath's words cause an uproar among the crowd. Some of the guests begin to curse her angrily.

speaker: Guest C
content: You personally invited me here! What, am I not worthy enough now?!

speaker: Guest D
content: Honorable soul? Worthy? What are you talking about? What challenges? What if we fail?! Is this some kind of battle royale?!

speaker: McGrath
content: What if you fail? You'll be eliminated, of course. Haven't you noticed that some of you have already been "eliminated"?

speaker: McGrath
content: So, everyone here has already passed the first challenge. If you're not confident about being worthy enough to dine with Miss Cabernet, I can eliminate you right here. Is there anyone who doesn't want to participate?
The agitated crowd calms down somewhat. Everyone is whispering to each other about the situation at hand: Challenges? A judgment of worthiness?
In the end, no one steps out to say no. Everyone seems to think it's just a game.

speaker: McGrath
content: Then, let the new challenge commence! Please complete the game as soon as possible, my dear guests.
McGrath commences the game. Having accepted the rules, the guests quickly scatter. However, you suddenly see red and feel intense pain. A chill goes down your spine.
An ominous premonition suddenly strikes you. Weathering the pain, you activate your shackles... and sure enough, Macchiato's end feels incredibly weak.
Your face turns ashen... this party is way too creepy. It even took Macchiato away from you without a fight.
Just like on the top floor, Cabernet observes the farcical scene from afar, deep in thought. You get up and walk over to her.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You don't look well. What happened?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Something happened to Macchiato. This isn't a normal game, Miss Cabernet.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If what that guest says is true, there's no one left upstairs. Macchiato isn't on this level, either.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: According to my senses... the signal from Macchiato is very weak. Something must have happened to her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This game is surely dangerous, Miss Cabernet. Did you know this would happen? If you know anything else about this, please share it with me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Otherwise, I'll have to apologize and abort your mission. Finding my Sinner is a much bigger priority for me.
Cabernet looks at you in silence for a long time, as if trying to decide whether or not to tell you something.
There's no one left around you. Even that mysterious girl has left to search for clues after realizing you have no way of going back upstairs. It's incredibly quiet around you right now.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I don't know the chef named McGrath very well. If you want to learn about her from me, all I can share is only some rumors and faint impressions of mine.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I did hear rumors about the legendary ingredient she got, as well as the legendary powers, but I just assumed she made them up to win my approval...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Last time we met, McGrath didn't get the approval she wanted from me, but she didn't yell at me like the others, or vow to win me over next time...

speaker: Cabernet
content: She simply gave me an invitation to this feast a month later, saying that she got my favorite ingredients and will make cuisine that I'd love for sure.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This coincides with you losing your treasures... which is why you suspect your treasures may be in her hands?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Correct. I pretty much guessed that she had my treasures. I was worried that something might happen to them, so I pulled some strings to get a seasoned professional to help me... which is you, dear Chief.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I know I've caused trouble for you. I didn't expect things to come to this, either. She has become crazy, and even started harming innocent people...
You look deep into her eyes. You sense that she's not being completely honest with you, but this isn't the time to make a fuss.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's happened has happened. No need to apologize... There's no way back up. If we want to find Macchiato, we'll have to participate in this strange game, win a seat at the banquet, and negotiate with the chef.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm just curious, why didn't she bring you directly to Level B2 like she did with the Thaumas Society's Ocean Messenger? Why is she making you play this game with the other guests?

speaker: Cabernet
content: You'd have to ask Miss McGrath herself. But if you ask me, I do love watching the best ingredients be transformed into delicacies through the art of cooking.

speaker: Cabernet
content: This is probably... her way of seeking approval.
Cabernet shakes her head as she watches the guests run around, and lets out a quiet sigh.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I'll try my best to assist you, protect you from McGrath, and find your companion...

speaker: Cabernet
content: As well as find my precious... treasures.
Crunch, crunch, crunch.
Creepy chewing sounds can be heard from every corner of the room.
Everyone looks at the scene in front of them, the blood draining from their faces.
To complete McGrath's game, the three of you have joined the crowd looking for clues and "game rules." Yet no one expected to see something like this a mere half hour later.

speaker: Strange Voice
content: "The poor kitten is about to be eaten by a monster. You must pick something valuable to swap it out."

speaker: Strange Voice
content: "Please circle your chosen items in the picture below. Note that once selected, you will lose these items."
It's the voice you heard in the pool! Though you heard it just faintly, you can still remember! You stare at the door in shock, trying to figure out what's going on.
After a while, the door swings open. You see the twisted face of a guest who gets sucked into the weird contraption before getting the chance to scream.
On a picture next to the contraption, you see dried roses and paper on a table circled in red.
Finally, the chewing stops. The big mouth in the room opens with a snap.
Everyone can see that in the center of the mouth, there is a plate of fresh oranges—the same color as that man's hair.

speaker: Kelvin
content: D-d-d-did he really get eaten...?

speaker: Guests
content: Aaahhh...!!!!
The guests scream in terror, as if they were going to be devoured by the big mouth next.
Yet aside from the oranges, you also feel Mania emanating from the big mouth!
It's an unfamiliar type of Mania. You don't know if it's from the Ogygia Villa, which belongs to the Thaumas Society in the first place, or some mutation with that Chef McGrath.

speaker: Kelvin
content: S-so this is the head chef's game? Whoever loses gets turned into... food?!
Kelvin cowers, grabbing onto your sleeve instinctively.
The guests' faces contort hideously. Remembering what they had just eaten, they're overcome by disgust and nausea. Most can't help but vomit.
You pat Kelvin's hand. You ponder her words as you comfort her: Lose... Disappear... Turn into food?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Perhaps... the game already started before she announced the rules?
You remember the melted ice cream by the elevator and suddenly realize something.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've heard that voice before. It was when I got pushed into the pool. At that time, something was dragging me down, and that voice asked me if I wanted to leave everything behind to have fun...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That question was part of the game—the selection of the worthy had already started at the pool party!

speaker: McGrath
content: Hahahaha... My dear guests, so you finally realized it!

speaker: McGrath
content: That's right! The game started a long time ago!

speaker: McGrath
content: Those on the top floor disappeared because they gave in to their hedonism!

speaker: McGrath
content: And then we have those vain social climbers who brawled to get the first spot in the elevator. As for this gentleman... he wouldn't even care to save a little critter!

speaker: McGrath
content: Tell me, what honor do these people have?

speaker: McGrath
content: This is only what they deserve! Hahahaha...
McGrath's words are clear: these challenges are her way of selecting the worthy.
The top floor was a test of "temptation," while the second floor was a test of compassion.
McGrath's sharp laughs echo in the air, plunging everyone in rage and despair.

speaker: Guest A
content: You didn't tell us anything about that! How despicable!

speaker: Guest B
content: What's so dishonorable about eating an extra bit of food?

speaker: McGrath
content: It's quite dishonorable indeed. You don't even have this bit of self-control?

speaker: McGrath
content: Think about Miss Cabernet! She would never eat anything short of perfect!

speaker: McGrath
content: One must be like her to make it to the end. Got it?

speaker: McGrath
content: After all, how can I allow anyone tainted to dine with Miss Cabernet?

speaker: McGrath
content: This is my surprise gift for you, Miss Cabernet! To give you the best dining experience, I will ensure that you're neither lonely nor pestered!

speaker: McGrath
content: You will approve of me, right?!
After saying this, McGrath falls silent.
Yet because of this last sentence, all eyes focus on Cabernet.
All the previous fawning, idolization and flattery have vanished, replaced by fear and disgust.

speaker: Guests
content: What... this is all for Miss Cabernet?!
The crowd erupts in discussion, echoing like frogs croaking in unison.
They can't touch the dreaded gamemaster, but they can touch Cabernet. Gripped by fear and anger, they all turn against her.

speaker: Guests
content: Is Cabernet behind all this?

speaker: Guests
content: Then she's a wicked accomplice of that crazy chef! She's simply picking the ingredients she likes!

speaker: Panicked Guest
content: Wait a minute... wait a minute... I remember it now!

speaker: Panicked Guest
content: I've read a story about Cabernet on a blog!
A guest in green suddenly remembers something and grabs her friend anxiously.
You recognize her as the blogger girl who you bumped into before.

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: Cabernet was born into a prominent Eastside family... Day in day out, she ate the most magnificent delicacies...

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: Thus... This made Cabernet an extremely picky epicure. She never ate anything she considered short of perfect...

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: To satisfy their daughter's exquisite palate, her parents searched high and low for the rarest delicacies for Cabernet... But for a long time, they couldn't find anything to her standards...

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: Then... one day... a chef bravely volunteered to serve Cabernet a dish...

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: The chef lifted up the cloche, revealing a string of fragrant grapes on the plate...

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: The delectable grapes caught Cabernet's attention. She couldn't help but pop one into her mouth...

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: She suddenly realized that grape was the most delicious thing she had ever tasted... So she gobbled up the rest one by one!
The lady in green flails her hands dramatically, using wild gestures to tell the story about Cabernet.

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: But Cabernet was not gratified. So she asked the chef, "Are there any more of these delicious grapes?"

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: And do you know what the chef said?
The girl in green asks the crowd suspensefully, fully aware that all eyes are on her.

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: Let me tell you... that chef said...

speaker: Blogger Girl
content: "I only have this one child!"

speaker: Guests
content: Aaahhh...!!
The guest's low, grim words frighten the others. They huddle closer together, isolating the three of you, and point any sharp objects they can find at you.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Is this part of the surprise? Haha... You have the right to believe that story or not.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I know you won't believe anything I say at this point, and I am not in the mood for lecturing anyone...

speaker: Cabernet
content: People shouldn't be taking cues from misinformation... but to me, it doesn't matter.
Of course, no one is willing to believe her. They rush about looking for things that can be used as weapons, preparing to attack.
These developments shock you. It had been a simple case involving some weird games, yet now, people are under the threat of being literally turned into food if they lost.
The person who dragged you into the mire is standing next to you, but she is also trapped, facing the angry guests.
Such strong emotions are really an incubator for Mania.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's the point of doing this now?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like that woman said, if you can't "prove your honor," you'll become food!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you want to turn into food and get eaten?
Upon hearing your shouts, the crowd pauses to look at each other. Those at the very front hesitate a while, then scowl and put away their weapons.
You know it's not because their view of Cabernet has changed, but because they're afraid of getting eaten.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Finally... They finally stopped...
Seeing the crowd scatter... Kelvin lets out a trembling sigh.
She looks worriedly at Cabernet but doesn't dare go up to her, instead choosing to stay by your side.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Miss Cabernet...

speaker: Cabernet
content: What, you believe that story, too?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, I don't really believe ridiculous stories from some blog.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But... I do want to know about your lost treasures, and the truth about your ingredients.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You are McGrath's obsession. All her actions stem from you... So, something like turning people into ingredients...
Cabernet stands loftily a few steps from you. She doesn't look like a participant in this game, or even this party.
She looks as if she only belongs in the head chair of a magnificent banquet table.

speaker: Cabernet
content: First of all, I want to thank you for saving me just now... Though we're besieged on all sides right now, this makes me feel that at least I can trust you.

speaker: Cabernet
content: It's quite funny, actually. I don't have many people around me who I can trust.

speaker: Cabernet
content: So...

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're right. My treasures, my precious ingredients... are two people.
Though you had your suspicions before, you're still caught off guard, and have trouble linking the two words together.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I cherish them very much... They showed me what a truly honorable soul is like, transcending any social status or identities.

speaker: Cabernet
content: <size=30>I did become a picky epicure after I met them, but it's because they showed me what "a truly satisfying taste" is like... Later, however, many began regarding me as some sort of guide. There were even rumors that only chefs whose dishes I approved of are good. But I don't want my words to become the judging standards for a dish or even a person.</size>

speaker: Cabernet
content: Just like how I don't want McGrath to judge my treasures or preferences by her standards. Plus... she stole my treasures, which is unforgivable in the first place.

speaker: Cabernet
content: What I want right now is not some surprise or dinner. I only wish I could take back from her, the treasures that belong to me.
You and Kelvin fall silent. This game is so stupid, and Cabernet's words are so absurd, but you've already gotten this far.
Macchiato is waiting for you, and Kelvin is still by your side. You must retrieve and protect them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We will certainly fulfill our promise, but I also hope that you can be honest with us. You are McGrath's heart's desire, so I think the breakthrough will be with you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I still need to verify your story, but... it will have to wait after some more pressing matters.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Don't worry, I also promised you... that I will help and protect you.
The atmosphere on this floor has gradually changed, becoming illusory, suffocating, and full of despair...
Everyone is trying to act with "compassion" and "honor," but the "standards" are becoming more and more vague. Fewer and fewer people are left.
People realize there's no way to fully figure out the rules, yet they don't dare to break them.
With knives to their throat, they'd rather feign whatever compassion and honor they can think of, even if it kills them.
However, such an environment has spurred another crisis—some of the guests' mental states of extreme panic have caused them to get infected with Mania and mutate into Corruptors.
As much as you dislike the guests, you can't just let Corruptors run around. You try your best to fight them, and right now, a fully mutated Corruptor has trapped you inside a room.
You can only hide with Cabernet and Kelvin, waiting for the opportunity to counterattack.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Is this a deliberate part of her selection process? It's too dangerous...!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What an insane game...In any case, we can't let her have her way in the end. Macchiato's aura has weakened but not completely disappeared, so those who have been "eliminated" should at least still be alive.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We have to go to the next level down, which must be the source of all this.

speaker: Cabernet
content: But to do that, first, we have to leave this floor alive.

speaker: Kelvin
content: But how exactly do we win this game?
How to win the game? You don't know either.
There are fewer and fewer people left. Whenever someone gets eliminated, the distorted expression on their face spreads like a contagious virus, imprinting itself on everyone else's minds.
Even you're distracted by panicked thoughts: What if I'm eliminated next? Or maybe, I've already been eliminated?

speaker: Kelvin
content: Chief... Are you alright?
A tiny speck of ice lands on the tip of your nose, bringing you back to your senses. Kelvin is looking at you in worry.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry, I'm fine.

You smile at her, but can't calm down—the more you think about it, the more you feel that you're the target of elimination. So many dangers along the way seemed to have been targeting you, yet ended up hitting others.

speaker: Kelvin
content: O-of course I'm not worried. I know you'll be fine because you're quite special, Chief.

speaker: Kelvin
content: You and Miss Cabernet... and me, and Miss Macchiato! E-everyone will be fine!
Just as you're about to nod, a strange commotion appears by the door.
A guest who has fully mutated into a Corruptor is lurching towards the room you're in, clutching some unknown object in his hand.
The thing in his hand is a mysterious ball of some sort, though you can't tell what it is. Gooey liquid drips down from it with every step he takes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...He attacked someone else.
But for you, this is actually a good thing—it's a sign for you to finish him off.
But now, with only Kelvin by your side, you also have to protect Cabernet and the other uninfected guests.
At this point, you don't want anyone getting hurt.
It might sound ridiculous, but you don't want to play by McGrath's stupid rules. You want to take everyone... to the finish line.

speaker: Corruptor Guest
content: Ughh...!! Arghhh...!!
The Corruptor senses your presence in the room, but fails to find you. He had mutated into a Corruptor from fear and anger, and is now wantonly venting his rage, destroying everything he sees.
The danger is edging closer and closer. You grip onto a baseball bat that someone else dropped and gaze at Kelvin and Cabernet.

speaker: Kelvin
content: I... I got you, Chief.
Kelvin understands what you want: when your fingers count down to 0, you want the temperature in the room to drop below zero.
And just like that, the mucus-covered Corruptor gets frozen alive.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stand aside!!
Thwack...!!!!
You swing the bat, while Cabernet swings her cane. The double blow shatters the frozen Corruptor.
Icy slime sprays out from the shattered ice and entangles your feet like countless tentacles.

<size=31>Striking the Corruptor had already consumed much of your energy. Now with your feet entangled, you fall down on the ground. You try to move your feet, but the mucus is firmly constraining you, making every move extremely strenuous. You don't have the energy for it anymore.</size>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's going on?! Are they being controlled by Mania?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Kelvin, try freezing them!!
Kelvin casts her power, but the slime can't be frozen at all—they are obviously controlled by a type of Mania that's more powerful than Kelvin!
Click!
While everyone is focusing on the slime, you notice that the door to the room suddenly got locked!
For some reason, Kelvin cannot unfreeze the room, and the cold seems to be even worsening. Cabernet thinks that you guys probably violated the game rules in a stroke of bad luck.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Miss Kelvin, try turning your ice into a blade, then maybe you can cut them. That way, we'll be able to look for clues to help us escape this... icy chamber.

speaker: Kelvin
content: A-all right! I'll try!
Kelvin smashes a vase in a hurry, and freezes the watery glass into a sharp, icy blade.
Her hands are red and trembling from the cold. She cuts the mucus entangling you guys over and over again, but no matter how hard she tries, the slime just reappears to trap you again.

speaker: Kelvin
content: No... no... no. Chief, Miss Cabernet, don't worry. Hold on a bit longer. I will get you out of this!
Kelvin is on the verge of tears. She tears down the curtains and bedsheets, wrapping them around you and Cabernet. She goes on to search every corner of the room, sniffling all the way.
But time is ticking, and the temperature continues to drop. Though Kelvin is still fine, you and Cabernet are almost completely incapacitated by the cold.

speaker: Kelvin
content: I-it must be somewhere... There must be a way to solve this!
Kelvin is still scrambling around. She suddenly slips on the slime and falls backwards.
Before you and Cabernet can catch her, Kelvin lands hard on the Corruptor's body.
You hear an earsplitting crack. Weathering the pain, Kelvin stands up and looks. Her hands fly to her mouth...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She wants us to be eliminated on purpose...!

speaker: Cabernet
content: How disgusting...
The Corruptor's icy chest is shattered, revealing an empty chest cavity—where there is a small mass of rotten flesh.
Lodged inside the rotten flesh is a silver key.
You try to pull out the key, but it's stuck. You can only get it out by cutting the flesh.
Out of the three of you, the only one who can still pick up the knife is Kelvin.

speaker: Strange Voice
content: His heart is still beating. What will you choose to do?
The strange voice rings out again, tormenting you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Kelvin... L-let me do it.
You reach out a trembling hand, which has turned purple from the cold.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Kelvin?

speaker: Kelvin
content: No...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What?

speaker: Kelvin
content: No, Chief. I'll do it.
Kelvin looks up at you. Tears are brimming in her eyes, and her nose is red from crying.

speaker: Kelvin
content: I know.. that if Miss Cabernet hadn't stopped me from eating that third ice cream by the pool, or if Chief hadn't pulled me out of my seat and led me into the elevator...

speaker: Kelvin
content: I... I might have been "eliminated" back on the top floor...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't be stupid. If you had just relied on others and didn't put in any effort of your own, you would have been eliminated regardless...

speaker: Kelvin
content: Chief...
Kelvin tucks your hand back under the sheets and smiles at you.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Miss Cabernet is our client...

speaker: Kelvin
content: She's such a gentle, caring soul who listened to my food commentary and protected me...

speaker: Kelvin
content: Same with you, Chief. You know how scared I am of such people and events, and how anxious I am about screwing everything up...

speaker: Kelvin
content: You always protect me, carefully and kindly... and never blame me for not finding any important clues...

speaker: Kelvin
content: I really, really want to tell you guys how much I like you and appreciate all of you...

speaker: Kelvin
content: So... this time, let me protect you! I believe that the two of you... will win this game!
Kelvin suddenly casts her power, separating herself from you two with a small ice wall.
You no longer have the strength to climb over the wall, and can only watch as Kelvin cuts with the icy blade through the transparent ice.
It's as if she's cooking an exquisite meal.
She finally manages to take out the key. Miraculously, it's spotless, without a single stain.
Kelvin holds up the key and smiles at you. Her legs are still a bit weak as she gets up, but she bravely walks towards the door.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Chief, Miss Cabernet... If I were to turn into a bowl of shaved ice, what flavor would you want me to be?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I don't want you to...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Blueberry, vanilla, dotted with soft mochi...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Sweet and cold... almost too delicious to swallow.
Cabernet leans against her cane and stands up. The sheets slide off her body, revealing her red, frozen shoulders.
She's a bit unsteady on her feet, but still bows to Kelvin.
The key gets inserted into the lock, making a sweet clinking sound as it turns.
You can't see your surroundings clearly. You only sense bright white light flooding in, and the frost on your body melting into a sticky substance as the temperature rises.
And at the other end of your consciousness, on the other end of your shackles...
That Sinner's breath has also become as frail as the melted snow.
You cast your shackles over and over again, checking for Kelvin and Macchiato's presence.
The fact that they're still around gives you some comfort, but also depresses you.
You recall their nervous but excited expressions when you asked them to join this mission, but now, you don't even know where they are.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I know you're suffering right now. Perhaps nothing I say will ease your pain.

speaker: Cabernet
content: But you must know that... the fact that you're still here means we haven't lost.

speaker: Cabernet
content: There's only one way out, and that's forward.
Cabernet comes up to you, still as tall and graceful as the first time you saw her.
She reaches out her hand to you.

options: You grab her hand and stand up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes... no matter what, I must keep going forward.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The only way to bring back everyone... is to march on and confront that chef.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Mmm, that's the spirit. That's how you should be.
You brace yourself and walk out of the locked room.
You suddenly realize that the entire level is now empty.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Have they all been eliminated?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What happened here...

speaker: Cabernet
content: The rules are all at McGrath's discretion, so this development is unsurprising...
You've also considered this possibility before...
But... you take a glance at Cabernet.
To keep going forward, you must... eliminate Cabernet.

speaker: McGrath
content: Oh my, I don't believe it... You made it this far? Haven't given up yet?

speaker: McGrath
content: And... you're even here with Miss Cabernet!
You hear that infuriating voice again, but this time without any static. You look up and spot her standing by the elevator close by.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You have the audacity to show up...

speaker: McGrath
content: Of course! Why wouldn't I?

speaker: McGrath
content: You really think you made it here on your own?! You think you're still qualified to win?!
McGrath glares at you sullenly, her eyes full of discontent.

speaker: McGrath
content: Reflect upon your behavior and how you made this far!

speaker: McGrath
content: If Miss Cabernet hadn't been protecting you all the way, you would've died in the pool back on the top floor!
A loud noise accompanies McGrath's roar. The entire elevator lobby collapses, and seawater floods the surrounding area, turning it into a lone island.
The floor between you and the lone island cracks and collapses, turning into a "sea trench."

speaker: McGrath
