content: To crash this party with an invitation that doesn't belong to you, accompanied by hedonistic and cowardly companions... and now, to utter some nice-sounding nonsense only after the bad things have happened...

speaker: McGrath
content: I've been watching you. I've been wanting to eliminate you this whole time... You obviously don't fully trust Miss Cabernet. Why do you still keep sticking to her side?!
McGrath looks over at Cabernet, her eyes instantly softening and filling with yearning. She's clearly reluctant to shift away her longing gaze.

speaker: McGrath
content: She's so noble and kind and perfect... Her words have always steered my efforts! Yet why does she like you so much?! Why does she protect you even though you have never trusted her!?

speaker: McGrath
content: She's the best and most precious guest here! Only she deserves to be the sole winner of this game! Even if... even if she cheats on your behalf to make you "resurrect" again and again...
Gritting her teeth, McGrath presses the strange fish statue next to the elevator.

speaker: McGrath
content: But I know it's because Miss Cabernet is too kind... So out of respect for her kindness, we'd better get back to the game and let the rules decide who wins.

speaker: McGrath
content: Miss Cabernet, there are only two of you left. At this depth, I'm afraid your little grapes don't work anymore...
The churning roar gets closer and closer, accompanied by the smell of sea salt. Water starts to gather around your feet...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Oh no! She wants to flood the entire floor!

speaker: McGrath
content: This is Ogygia Villa, the legendary depths of the ocean! I hope you make up your mind before you drown...

speaker: McGrath
content: You know it. It's not a nice feeling...
You take Cabernet to higher ground, but know that it's just a temporary fix. The cold water is quickly rising.

speaker: McGrath
content: Hahaha, make your final decision!

speaker: McGrath
content: I know you want to win. But now, how exactly will you achieve that? Hahahaha!
You clench your fists, digging your nails into your palms as you think about what to do next.

speaker: McGrath
content: Sacrifice Miss Cabernet and let her turn into food? But she's been helping you all this time! Are you really going to do that?

options: How do you know I wouldn't do that?

speaker: McGrath
content: Sigh... Think about it a bit more, then.

speaker: McGrath
content: Good heavens! I don't believe any honorable person would do that, right?

speaker: McGrath
content: Or... you can obediently turn into food, and become the most delicious and honorable soul for the dinner banquet that Miss Cabernet and I will enjoy later.

speaker: McGrath
content: Of course, you can just simply do nothing and drown.

The ice-cold water is now ankle-deep. Your line of sight is dominated by the trench before you, yet no one can help you cross it. Biting your lip, you wrack your brain for ideas on how to foil McGrath's plot.

A shadow casts over you, interrupting your wild thoughts. You realize that you're in Cabernet's shadow as she wades into the water. She's telling you with her eyes that she wants to try to talk to McGrath.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wh-what are you going to do? Miss Cabernet...

speaker: McGrath
content: Miss Cabernet! Don't worry, tonight... I will present you the most unforgettable feast! You will definitely approve of me! I'm sure of it!

speaker: Cabernet
content: How can you be sure... that the souls you give me... I will eat and approve of as the most delicious?

speaker: McGrath
content: Huh...? Because they are the most honorable souls!

speaker: Cabernet
content: And what is "honorable" by your definition?

speaker: McGrath
content: A-an honorable soul... is of course compassionate and honest, noble and flawless, and can resist temptation...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ha... I don't think even I can meet those standards.

You have no idea what she's trying to get at. She's as composed and elegant as ever, but with an extra hint of mystery you can't figure out. She no longer looks in your direction, nor responds to your questions.

speaker: McGrath
content: No! Of course not! To me, you're the most honorable one of all! You're perfection itself, Miss Cabernet!
Cabernet glides forward, her dress floating behind her like a mermaid's tail.

speaker: Cabernet
content: <size=32>Those born in Syndicate can be selfless, to your surprise. What he chose to exchange with might have been his most precious possession—that flower might be from the girl he fancies, and the paper on the table might have contained a poem he spent a week composing.</size>

speaker: Cabernet
content: <size=32>People first and foremost have the will to survive. It's only natural for them to put their own life over others when they are on the verge of death themselves. Occasional fear is not shameful, and the pursuit of happiness is not some heinous crime.</size>

speaker: Cabernet
content: Whether it is beauty and ugliness, tears and laughter, tradition and innovation, yummy and yucky tastes...

speaker: Cabernet
content: These are all but subjectivities born out of human nature.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You stand in a place of arrogance, and use my name to evaluate others... Hmph. Who gave you that right?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Who are you to judge anyone else?

speaker: McGrath
content: But... but I...

speaker: McGrath
content: I just wanted to give you the best souls there are! Isn't that what suits your taste? I... I've read so much about you to find that out!

speaker: McGrath
content: Only the purest, kindest, and noblest souls in the world are worthy of your taste! I did this all for you...!

speaker: Cabernet
content: For me?
Cabernet laughs softly, as if having heard a huge joke.
She motions for you to come next to her and face McGrath together.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The "honorable souls" I seek are not something judged by your superficial and self-righteous criteria.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Countless thoughts brew in the heart of the soul. It is also home to the cowardice, poverty, doubt and ignorance you despise.

speaker: McGrath
content: Why are you saying these things... You never said anything bad about us. You're so decent and honorable... You've guided me... You've stood with me...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Because you don't understand. Amidst all the complex thoughts and emotions, every pure and authentic soul... is worthy of my heart. They all shine brightly and exude exquisite flavor.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Yet you...
Cabernet stands on the edge of the abyss, glaring at McGrath in disdain.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I once praised your skills... but I never thought...

speaker: Cabernet
content: That your soul is so disgusting. It makes me want to vomit. How truly unappetizing.
McGrath freezes—it seems as if she has even stopped breathing.
Her eyes widen, staring at the person she admires most looking back at her in disgust. Cabernet's words are echoing in her mind, stabbing her insides.

speaker: McGrath
content: I'm the one who knows her best! I won't be judged by a fake! You... you're dishonorable! You're not Miss Cabernet!

speaker: McGrath
content: You... you must have done something! Fess up! Give me the real Miss Cabernet! I'm going to eliminate you!
As soon as she blurts out those words, McGrath freezes on the spot. She reaches out a trembling hand towards Cabernet, saying over and over again that she didn't mean it.
But Cabernet doesn't care. She looks triumphantly at the piteous chef and flashes the smile of a victor.

speaker: Cabernet
content: There you go. Game over. You did well, McGrath.
The roar that had vanished reappears. A strong sense of unease overwhelms you.
Countless vines suddenly shoot out from the trench before you and wrap around Cabernet!
...The game is over! Because McGrath announced that she was eliminating Cabernet... you have become the final victor!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't move!! Take my hand!!
You rush forward and grab Cabernet's wrist, but the vine slaps your hand away, leaving behind a red mark.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You helped me cheat again! I don't want this kind of victory! I don't want you to sacrifice yourself!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There must be some other way! As long as you and I are both still here!

speaker: Cabernet
content: It's fine. I trust you.
Cabernet looks at you with mellow eyes, as if gazing at her favorite dish.

speaker: Cabernet
content: There has never been a standard to judge whether a soul is "honorable" or not. Such games and rules are a joke to begin with.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Neither you nor I want to play by such rules, so...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Go and "win" this stupid game...

speaker: Cabernet
content: I trust you. As long as you're still here... I know you'll save your treasure, as well as mine.
The vines devour Cabernet, and continue to grow rapidly!
They shoot out of the watery trench, intertwining to form a bridge to the lone island.
McGrath's voice is hoarse and filled with rage. She yells hysterically in the direction where Cabernet disappeared:

speaker: McGrath
content: No!!! You sacrificed yourself... for him?! You did this all for him?!
female_content: No!!! You sacrificed yourself... for her?! You did this all for her?!

speaker: McGrath
content: You're truly selfless... a real martyr! Miss Cabernet, I was wrong! You're the most honorable soul there is! You, and only you!
McGrath's shrieks echo throughout the villa. Her plans have been completely ruined.
But she can't violate the rules she personally set for herself and the game participants.
Amidst her angry curses and neurotic wails, you step on the black path to the final gate.
You're going to bring back everyone important who has been taken from you.
You step into the dim banquet hall and approach the huge water tank. You finally get a clear look at the creature inside.
It's a creature that can only appear in legends: an exquisitely beautiful face, curly locks as wonderous as the waves of the sea, and a radiant fish tail glimmering with water-colored scales...
Yet on the back of that beauty is a lump that looks like a human being.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is this... a mermaid?!
You're stunned that a legendary creature like this really exists. But what disturbs you even more is the high level of Mania exuding from the water tank before you.
It's the same kind of Mania you encountered in the gaming area of Level B1.
In your mind's eye, your shackles revolve around those two tiny flames, as well as Cabernet's last words.
You tell yourself over and over again that you must save them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I must save them!
Save what, O Lucky One?
Upon suddenly hearing her voice, you quickly dodge and snatch a fork from the dining table to point at her.
McGrath emerges from the shadows. Her body doesn't seem to have mutated, but strange gurgling sounds are coming from her throat, as if there's rotten flesh rubbing against each other.
She ignores your defensive posture, and just stands there and says quietly:

speaker: McGrath
content: All have failed. Miss Cabernet has rejected me... she won't taste the ultimate feast I prepared for her... nor will I get her approval...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then what are you still doing here... Miss Cabernet shouldn't be your sole standard of judgment. If you confess to everything you've done, you still have a chance of redemption.

speaker: McGrath
content: Everything I've done...? Who do you think you are? What on earth should I confess to you...?

speaker: McGrath
content: She did this because of you! But what are you worth to her?!

speaker: McGrath
content: You're just a random person Miss Cabernet decided to protect on a whim! And they are just random ingredients that she wanted to favor on the spur of the moment!

speaker: McGrath
content: As long... as long as I find something better, tastier...
McGrath turns around and gently strokes the water tank as she gazes lovingly at the mermaid inside...

speaker: McGrath
content: Why does Miss Cabernet like them so much... why does she like you... what is it about you... that Miss Cabernet finds so "delicious"?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Delicious...?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This mermaid is Cabernet's food ingredient?!

speaker: McGrath
content: Before, yes. But now, I have nothing to "feed" it! They should've been the best seasoning for my ultimate feast for Miss Cabernet!
McGrath roars, glaring at you in resentment.

speaker: McGrath
content: It's all over now... The mermaid meat will be a failure... The "fish food" I got is not the most honorable souls!! I have utterly failed... Why... why did Miss Cabernet choose you!!!
McGrath runs up to you, grabs you by the neck, and slams you against the water tank.
You're overcome by pain. The air drains from your lungs bit by bit as you sputter out choking guttural noises.

speaker: McGrath
content: That was my chance!! The legendary mermaid meat...!! The man with the umbrella gave me the ultimate ingredients! Oh, how I cherished them!! I just wanted to... make it a unique delicacy that I alone created for Miss Cabernet!

speaker: McGrath
content: But it's not enough... it's far from satisfactory... the ingredients aren't perfect enough!!
McGrath keeps babbling. You don't get what she's saying, but you can feel the Mania surging in her body. If you don't stop her soon... she will completely mutate into a Corruptor.

speaker: McGrath
content: I need more... more sacrifices like these ingredients...

speaker: McGrath
content: Honorable souls... only honorable souls are fit for Miss Cabernet's lips and approval!

speaker: McGrath
content: Why... why did things end up like this!
You can no longer hear McGrath's words clearly. You're on the verge of losing consciousness, with pain and suffocation interlocking in your brain.
With great difficulty, you lift up your arm and stab the fork into the back of her hand. You wouldn't have done this if you had a choice—a chef's hands shouldn't be hurt.
McGrath screams as she looks at her hand that's gushing slime.

speaker: McGrath
content: My hand... my precious hand... I won't be able to cook anymore...

speaker: McGrath
content: Ha... hahaha! Then... then let me become the "fish food"!

speaker: McGrath
content: Just like the ancient cooks who offer their own flesh and blood to the king...!
McGrath stumbles toward the water tank's ladder.

speaker: McGrath
content: I... I shall also become the ingredient you desire!!
Splash!
McGrath jumps inside, instantly dying the entire tank black!

speaker: Eerie Mermaid
content: Grrrrr...!
Awakened by the smell of blood, the mermaid inside the tank opens her glowing eyes in the darkness.
The filthy water slows down the mermaid's movements, but then you start to hear the crisp chewing sounds, making the hairs on your body stand on end.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: McGrath has already been highly corrupted by Mania... if the mermaid eats her, it'll probably mutate too...
With a thunderous rupture, the glass of the water tank shatters, and the foul-smelling water gushes out all over the place.
Sure enough, amidst the dark water and broken glass, the stunning mermaid is staring at you with bloodthirsty eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No wonder she called it "mermaid meat." Maybe she turned out this way after eating it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But no matter what you turn into... I've had enough of this game... Give everyone back to me!
The moment the mermaid falls, your mind also becomes a bit dazed.
Like a fairy tale, the mermaid's tail disappears, replaced by a pair of slender legs.
The lump on her back also falls off, turning into a man around her age.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ha... it's over... everything's over...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Macchiato... Kelvin... Miss Cabernet...
Thank you for all your effort, my dear guest...
Swish!
Several vines slither around the people on the ground, sweeping them aside. You fall to the ground, coughing continuously.
You look up to see someone sitting at the long banquet table.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who...?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Hmm? Weren't you... calling my name just now?
Thud! The person at the table props her cane on the ground and stands up gracefully.
Under the hazy aquarium lights, no one can ignore her elegant, fiery red hair.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: M..Miss Cabernet?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why are you here?!

speaker: Cabernet
content: To enjoy the feast, of course.

speaker: Cabernet
content: However... it seems that the feast isn't ready yet.
Cabernet walks up to you and sniffs your body scent intimately again.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ah... you're really... very much to my liking.
A vine rises from her feet and slowly wraps around you. The Mania on it is the same kind that's emanating from the person in front of you!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Miss Cabernet... you're... a Sinner.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I'm glad you said that affirmatively.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Sorry for keeping this from you for so long... I just thought your reaction would be more authentic this way.
You become highly vigilant—only extremely powerful Sinners can summon the power to manipulate vines like that.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Your eyes are scaring me... are you too tired?

speaker: Cabernet
content: No worries... no worries... It's all over now...
You're hit by the scent of grapes, and you black out.
Your consciousness slips away with the scent... Gradually, you lose all consciousness.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ah... my ingredients are back.

speaker: Cabernet
content: And my feast... is finally ready.
A vast expanse of white stretches out before her, as if she's lying in the snow.
Kelvin thinks this to herself.
After all, the temperature feels like lying in the snow, too.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Snow?!
Bright white light shines into her eyes. Kelvin suddenly comes back to her senses.
She pants and squints, adjusting to the light.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Something's wrong! What... What is this place?!
Kelvin looks around in panic, and spots Macchiato looking back at her from a similar transparent box!

speaker: Kelvin
content: M-Miss Macchiato! You're all right!!
Kelvin feels tears welling in her eyes. She quickly pulls out the tubes in her hands and feet, then pushes open the lid with all her might.
After finding her balance, she hugs Macchiato in a tight embrace.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Miss Macchiato... Ch-Chief! Quick, let's find Chief!
Holding onto one another, Kelvin and Macchiato look around, but there's no one else here except them.
This doesn't seem like the floor where Kelvin was eliminated. Though there's a big mess around them, the dining table at the center is exquisite and ornate.

speaker: Kelvin
content: This must be Level B2...! Did Chief make it down here successfully?!

speaker: Kelvin
content: I can sense Chief! Quick, let's go find him!
female_content: I can sense Chief! Quick, let's go find her!

content: The elevator is back in service. The pair walks in carefully and presses the button for the top floor.
When the elevator reaches Level B1, it grinds to a halt.
When the door opens, a lavishly dressed but exhausted-looking guest shuffles in, followed by several equally tired-looking guests.

speaker: Lavishly-dressed Guest
content: What are you looking at? Never seen a man dressed like this before?
His voice is hoarse, as if he had been crying.

speaker: Macchiato
content: S-sorry! It's just that... y-you look really good in that dress, so I couldn't help but look...

speaker: Lavishly-dressed Guest
content: Ah... I-I see...

speaker: Lavishly-dressed Guest
content: Thank you...

speaker: Guest with notebook
content: I'm too tired... I don't want to write anything right now. I just wanna go home and sleep to my heart's content.

speaker: Waiter
content: This place is so scary... I want to go back to my hometown... and hang out with my old friends...

speaker: Blonde Woman
content: Hey... Hubby... sob... You said I'm perfect the way I am, didn't you?

speaker: Blonde Woman
content: Sob... I know, I think I get it now... sob... I think so, too!
The elevator finally comes to the first floor. Everyone is relieved to see the long-lost sunshine.
Sheriffs from the Eastside Public Security Bureau have already arrived. They are maintaining order at the scene and helping the injured...
Though not many people are seriously hurt on this floor...

speaker: Tanned Boxer
content: Sob... Miss Macchiato...! That scared me to death...! Sob...

speaker: Sheriff
content: There, there. You're a big boy. Don't cry like that...

speaker: Tanned Boxer
content: So what if I'm a big boy? Can't boys cry?! Sob...

speaker: Stylish Girl
content: Why can't there be pineapples on pizza?

speaker: Stylish Girl
content: I can eat whatever I like! Who are you to tell me how should I eat?! It's not like you're the one eating it! I'll do as I please!

speaker: Sheriff
content: All right, all right, you do as you please. But miss, you've already eaten three big slices of pineapple pizza after you woke up... Don't you feel bloated?

speaker: Stylish Girl
content: I'll do as I please!

speaker: Sheriff
content: All right, all right...
Seeing that everyone seems safe and sound, Kelvin and Macchiato continue onwards, feeling relieved.
At the front gate, the person they've been worrying about finally appears.

speaker: Kelvin & Macchiato
content: Chief!!!
Upon hearing their call, Chief turns around and waves to them with a smile.
The two rush forward and hug Chief tightly, as if embracing a long-lost treasure.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There there, everything's fine now...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You guys did really, really well...

speaker: Kelvin
content: Thanks, Chief...

speaker: Macchiato
content: Mmm, thank you, Chief...

speaker: Macchiato
content: But why did that FAC vehicle leave already?

speaker: Kelvin
content: I think I saw someone familiar in there...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yeah... you did. You'll meet again soon.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Everything has been settled. Time to go home.
An hour ago...
The familiar feeling of suffocating dread hits you.
You feel as if someone has dragged you into the pool again. You're unable to move your hands and feet.
All you can do is watch the air escape from your mouth bit by bit, before vanishing completely...
You wake up with a start, panting heavily. Sweat soaks your hair and trickles down your forehead.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where... where am I...
You're... on my plate...
The hazy feeling soon dissipates. You come back to your senses and look around.
You're in a dark room lit by dim candlelight.
You're lying on an elegant white tablecloth, surrounded by circles of beautiful purple flowers and sliced-open pomegranates and figs.
A stream of rosy juice is spreading on the tablecloth. It seems to be flowing from your body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cabernet?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What... what are you doing?

speaker: Cabernet
content: So you noticed that it's me?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I recognize your voice... plus your Mania.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ah. No wonder you're the MBCC's Chief... How very clever.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're so very... kind, yet unconstrained by the "rules"...

speaker: Cabernet
content: I like you so much... So much so that I want to gobble you down in one bite... I held myself back from getting a taste of you until now...
Your hands and feet are bound. You can only look at Cabernet with your head tilted back.
You see her voracious mouth and gluttonous eyes.
Her knife and fork can barely wait to cut out a delicious grape from your consciousness.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So... you planned and controlled this feast the whole time?

speaker: Cabernet
content: No... it wasn't all me.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I simply went along with poor McGrath after she said she'll give me an unforgettable feast... and helped her a bit along the way.

speaker: Cabernet
content: After all... I've been hungry for too long...

speaker: Cabernet
content: It's just that she's too stubborn and stupid... She doesn't really know what a truly shining soul is like...
Cabernet puts down her knife and fork, leans over you and kisses your hair.
Her sweat-stained lips glisten in the candlelight.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Watching those caged by rules... either get crushed by labels, or break free from the cage...

speaker: Cabernet
content: You... all of you... shone so brightly in the most precarious moments!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ahh... How delicious you are!
Cabernet gently lifts up your head, letting you see the rows of transparent boxes under the light.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Kelvin?! And... Macchiato!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why are they here?!
You can see that Kelvin and Macchiato are still breathing. But the people in the boxes next to them sends a chill down your back...
It's the two you had defeated just now, that "mermaid" whom McGrath regards as a failure... they are, the treasured ingredients stolen from Cabernet.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you going to eat them?

speaker: Cabernet
content: She stood up for the weak despite being terrified herself... and used her exquisite culinary hands to cut up a corpse to protect us...

speaker: Cabernet
content: She really is a good girl... Like I said, she's like a tempting bowl of fruit-flavored shaved ice, refreshing and sweet...

speaker: Cabernet
content: And her...

speaker: Cabernet
content: She can easily perceive what others yearn for... Even if that means picking at her own scars, she's willing to do it to comfort others...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Just like her name, she adds a sweet, wonderous and unforgettable flavor to people's lives...
Cabernet speaks vividly, as if she can already taste the delicacies she's describing.

speaker: Cabernet
content: McGrath doesn't understand them at all. She thinks that one is a coward and the other is a hedonist...

speaker: Cabernet
content: That's why I kept them!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ah... The purest, most instinctive impulse...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know what you do to your ingredients... you make them into hollow shells.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm the winner of this game. I should be the one you want to "eat" most, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come at me if you must. Leave them alone.
Cabernet stares at you, a bit surprised at first, then full of glee and desire.
She lunges at you bluntly and feverishly.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Yes... yes! Exactly! This is what I want!

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're the most delicious!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Whether in the game or in the face of powerful enemies, you never fail to surprise me.

speaker: Cabernet
content: From the moment you appeared, I knew you'd be the final victor of this game! You're the tastiest of them all!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ah... I know I can't stop myself from seeking delicious food!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Those poor kids. They ended up like this because of my unbridled actions... Their flavors have become much weaker...

speaker: Cabernet
content: But I know... You are different...
Cabernet clasps your hand tightly and presses it to her cheek.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're really impressive. In fact, I only used my grapes on you in the swimming pool. Since then, you've been trudging forward, and now you're the final victor...

speaker: Cabernet
content: It's thanks to your own ideas, actions, and abilities...

speaker: Cabernet
content: And after overcoming all the hardships of the game... your soul is brighter, tastier, and more attractive to me than ever...! You're still growing, ${PlayerName}.
Her soft skin and warm touch, and the trembling of muscles as she speaks, all pass through your palm into your nerves.
You want to take your hand out of her grasp and flee, but she clutches on even tighter.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ha... Don't be afraid. Don't try to flee... I now know how to take care of a treasure like you. I'll protect you and help you, so that I can enjoy you slowly...
Cabernet is still holding onto your hand and gazing at you gently, but you feel the Mania strengthening. Things are getting out of your control!
The sound of her heartbeat grows louder and clearer. You fully understand that this is a powerful, insatiable Sinner before you.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Don't worry... I'm just going to take one bite. It'll be like a kiss.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Think of it as a kiss...
Cabernet takes your hand, puts it to her lips, and kisses the beating pulse of your wrist.
Her hot, humid breath sweeps by you. You feel a certain essence slowly leaving your body, and your vision begins to blur!
The next second, you see a crystal-clear grape in Cabernet's mouth. She bites it gently, and the rich juice flows down the corner of her mouth, trickling past her beauty mark.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your power incapacitates people... I... I have the obligation to...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...to restrain... and detain you...
Cabernet chuckles. She licks away the lingering juice on her lips and tongue, savoring the sweet taste.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Shackles are indeed powerful... my dear Chief...

speaker: Cabernet
content: But a Sinner's power comes from their heart...

speaker: Cabernet
content: My heart... is filled with the desire for delicious food and "souls."

speaker: Cabernet
content: I hope that the growth of your power can catch up with... the expansion of my desires.

speaker: Cabernet
content: When that time comes... I shall willingly be at your mercy... and follow you to the ends of the Earth.
You understand the meaning behind Cabernet's words. You want to cast your shackles to stop her from leaving—but you realize you can't!
The peeling away of your soul makes you mentally and physically unable to support yourself. You can only watch as Cabernet leaves with a satisfied look on her face...
"I look forward to your continued growth, my most precious 'treasure'."

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, your delivery has arrived, hopefully in good time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yeah... It has arrived, but do I really need to wear this? I feel like it doesn't suit me...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Sorry Chief, but the request is for both you and the Sinners to "fit in perfectly" at the party, so please hang in there.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nobody told me it's this kind of "party," though?
After hearing you promise that you'll complete the mission, Nightingale hung up the phone. You look at your outfit inside the locker room, still feeling a bit uncomfortable.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's a bit too revealing...
As soon as you open the door, you're bombarded by a summery cacophony of colorful swimsuits and pool toys, splashing pool water, and the sweet scent of watermelon and mango.

speaker: Guest A
content: Hey, what's up bro? why are you wearing so much at a pool party?
female_content: Hey there, missy, why are you wearing so much at a pool party?

speaker: Guest A
content: You should take off that shirt! You won't be able to party if you get heat stroke!

options: No thanks, I'm fine as I am.

speaker: Guest A
content: Sigh, how lame.
You pull the sides of your buttonless shirt closer together, weave around the person and keep heading forward.
Soon after, you hear a familiar voice among a group of stunning swimsuit-clad bombshells.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Th-thank you, but there's really no need...

speaker: Kelvin
content: ${PlayerName}, where are you...!

speaker: Swimsuit Bombshell A
content: Emm? ${PlayerName}? Who's that? Someone important?

speaker: Swimsuit Bombshell B
content: Or is it just the "person who brought you here"?

speaker: Swimsuit Bombshell C
content: Oh, who cares? Take another bite, sweetie... Can you guess how many flavors there are in this cup of ice cream?
A swamped Kelvin spots you through the crowd and quickly squeezes her way out.

speaker: Kelvin
content: Sorry, m-my friend is here! I have to go with him to... uh...
female_content: Sorry, m-my friend is here! I have to go with her to... uh...

speaker: Kelvin
content: To find another friend! Thanks for everything. See you later!
Kelvin fixes her disheveled ponytail and bows to the swimsuit bombshells. She then turns around and hurries to your side.

speaker: Swimsuit Bombshell A
content: Hey, if you're free later, bring your friend to hang out with us together!
You smile awkwardly and promise them that you will, before quickly pulling Kelvin away from the scene.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All right. Now we just need to find Macchiato to combine our information.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where did you two split off?

speaker: Kelvin
content: Next to the little stage... Miss Macchiato said she saw an acquaintance of hers who might have clues and left...

speaker: Kelvin
content: It's all my fault... I shouldn't have been so curious about that strange ice cream!

speaker: Kelvin
content: That way, I wouldn't have been bogged down by those girls. I failed to find any useful clues... and even lost Miss Macchiato in the end.
You comfort Kelvin as you look towards the stage by the swimming pool.
Partygoers spontaneously jump onto the stage one after another, twerking wildly or bellowing out indecipherable lyrics at the top of their lungs.
Yet the crowds in the pool scream and cheer no matter what the performance is.

speaker: Singing Man
content: I dedicate this song to the light of my life!!

speaker: Singing Man
content: Oh...! I don't know where you are right now, but... I hope I can see you in the very next second!

speaker: Singing Man
content: Miss Macchiato! Please keep cracking your whip!
The ecstatic partygoers throw up their hands and cheer on the guy who bravely professed his love on stage.
Like a pop star, the singing man turns his back to the audience and leaps into the pool with a scream.
The audience hollers and laughs, reaching out to caress the guy who just jumped in, as if touching him would bring the same fervent "emotions" to themselves.
Behind the partition of the little stage, you can see the "light of the singer's life" squatting there with her head buried between her knees, covering her ears and muttering to herself.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Ahhhh... Why did this have to happen... It's so embarrassing...

speaker: Macchiato
content: Why did he have to say that out loud!

speaker: Macchiato
content: I know he likes to be spanked, but... ahhh no no no, the Chief and Miss Kelvin must have heard it, what should I do...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's fine... Life is short...

speaker: Kelvin
content: Just sleep on it, Miss Macchiato.
Macchiato raises her head, spotting you and Kelvin. She blushes and shuts her eyes again with a soft cry.
You and Kelvin sit down next to Macchiato. You hear waves of screams from the other side of the partition, mixed with the sound of splashes and obscene words.
You can't help but sigh.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Good thing we didn't bring Hella and Hecate... We can't let them see things like that...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now it's time for us to mingle with the crowd. After all, you're an expert on gourmet cuisine, while you're a fixture in Eastside high society...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's try our best together!
Three days ago...
In the council hall, a few Eastside sheriffs stand before you, presenting a request letter without saying a word.
You take the request letter. You notice a lavish invitation peppered with gold sparkles attached to its back.

Dear invitee, 

You are cordially invited to our magnificent banquet at Ogygia Villa on ?? ??, N.F. ??.
It will be a feast to please all tastes, and we look forward to your arrival.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So this means... the host of this party stole Miss Franc's "treasures"?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And you want me to go there to help her find them...?
You ask them this after you finish reading the letter, clutching the invitation in your hands.

speaker: Eastside Sheriff
content: That's right. The Francs are a prominent family in Eastside, and Miss Cabernet Franc is a renowned food critic who greatly influences the city's culinary trends.

speaker: Eastside Sheriff
content: A lot of famous guests will be attending this party. Deploying special security forces may draw unnecessary attention from onlookers and cause mass panic.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But...
Just as you're about to retort, the officials hand you another piece of information.

speaker: Eastside Sheriff
content: You must be familiar with this, right?
The corrugated seal on the file catches your attention.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Thaumas Society?!

speaker: FAC Official
content: That's right. This party is being held at Ogygia Villa, one of the gathering places of the "Thaumas Society." The MBCC has been trying to track them down for a long time. It's the online group that we've always suspected had Sinners in it.

speaker: FAC Official
content: These past few days, we've detected abnormal M-value fluctuations over there. We suspect that it may be caused by the Sinners involved with the Thaumas Society.

speaker: FAC Official
content: So... When we were deciding who to dispatch, we thought it'd be best for the MBCC Chief to go personally.
You fall silent, tuck away the invitation, and bow to the sheriffs and officers.

speaker: FAC Official
content: I'll send the details to your comms device later. Thanks for taking on yet another mission... MBCC Chief.
In any case, you accepted the mission yourself, so you must complete it no matter how humiliating it is, not to mention that it involves tracking down Sinners.
The stage seems to have calmed down somewhat. You lead the two Sinners to settle in an inconspicuous corner.
Yet as soon as you sit down, a uniformed waiter comes over to give each of you a "manual."

speaker: Waiter
content: Please pardon my late service, dear guests. Allow me to give you our proper greeting: Welcome to Ogygia Villa!

speaker: Waiter
content: To ensure that you enjoy this party smoothly and to its fullest, please carefully read the manual in your hands.

speaker: Waiter
content: If you have any questions, please let me know at any time.

It has been more than a hundred days since the <color=#fb9259>reappearance of BR-002</color>. The Rustfire rebellion has died down, and Parma's plans have also been thwarted.

Just as the administrators had expected, the enemy retreated from Eastside. Major Mania incidents drastically reduced in the eastern part of the city, and active conflicts became further concentrated in West District, which minimizes the overall damage dealt to DisCity.

But at the same time, the sheriffs received urgent intelligence that several high Eastside officials have appeared on a <color=#fb9259>hit list</color>. 
This is no doubt the enemy's retaliatory tactic, designed to spread terror and shake the will of the main combatants in West District.

An urgent special escort and investigation mission has been launched to foil the enemy's plan. Their scheme must be nipped in the bud before the effects spread further.

July 19, N.F. 113 - Eastside District 01
Erica Villa - Security Zone

speaker: Security Chief
content: Warning! Security line breached! The protection target is under attack! The attacker is nearby!

speaker: Security Chief
content: All personnel, blockade the villa! If any other assassins dare to step in there, riddle them with bullets!

speaker: Sheriff
content: B-but... There were traces of supernatural power at the scene! There are likely Sinners among the assassins!

speaker: Security Chief
content: What did you say?!

speaker: Security Chief
content: ...These Mania monsters... these... monsters...

speaker: Security Chief
content: Call the MBCC!! Aren't they the ones who are supposed to be dealing with the Sinners? Where are they????

speaker: Sheriff
content: They won't come. Their <color=#fb9259>Chief</color> is dead, and they've lost control over all their Sinners. We can't count on the MBCC for any help!

speaker: Security Chief
content: Then ****** call someone else! The sheriffs, the FAC, the 9th Agency... Call everyone!

speaker: Security Chief
content: When are they gonna release the <color=#fb9259>Blue Rain</color>? Monsters are running all over the place already. What is the FAC waiting for?

speaker: Security Chief
content: Isn't that woman from Paradeisos?! No matter how low-ranked she is, she can't die in this villa!

speaker: Sheriff
content: Commander! The enemy has disappeared from our radar... I'm afraid...
Shhh... Relax, this won't hurt...

speaker: Sheriff
content: A Sinner?!! Ahh...!!

speaker: Security Chief
content: Who is it now?!
...Special unit of the FAC Anti-Mania Force, requesting to intervene.

speaker: Security Chief
content: FAC?

speaker: Security Chief
content: Thank goodness, you're finally here! How many of you are there? Hurry up, we can't hold out much longer!
Already at the scene. The number of personnel is...
One.

speaker: Security Chief
content: What?! One person? Do you have any idea how...
Clank...!!
The woman rams her heavy shields into the ground, frightening the Security Chief into silence. She leans on the shields and stands up slowly.
Tell your men to leave if they don't want to get hurt by friendly fire.
Sinner, <color=#fb9259>Rahu</color>. Here for reinforcement.
Dark clouds gather over the city, and a storm is brewing.
The story that's unfolding is but a joke with several tragic figures as its protagonists.
The attackers retreat from the scene, vanishing into the night. The battle is over, giving way to silence. The FAC soldier's shields are stained with bloody grime.
She shakes off the grimy contaminants before the cowering sheriffs, marking out an arc-shaped cordon.
The crowd is dead silent. No one dares to approach this demonic soldier who came as reinforcement.
The Sinner walks up to the villa's Security Chief, who stumbles backward in fright. She salutes him in standard FAC style, then stands there silently, as if awaiting instructions.

speaker: Security Chief
content: What... kind of strange power did you use just now?

speaker: Security Chief
content: When did an anti-Mania force like FAC recruit Sinners?

speaker: Rahu
content: The situation is dire. The enemy is using high-level Mania power on a massive scale. FAC must reassemble the special dispatch team to deal with the emergency.

speaker: Security Chief
content: What about restraining measures? Don't tell me that mask on your face can keep you from losing control.

speaker: Rahu
content: Ha, of course it can't.
Did she sneer behind her mask just now? The Security Chief can't tell for sure, but he instinctively takes a step back.

speaker: Rahu
content: When the MBCC gets back on their feet, perhaps someone will come to restrain me. But as of now, they can't even restrain their own Sinners.

speaker: Rahu
content: You don't have much time. You wouldn't want the guest from Paradeisos to die in your jurisdiction, right Security Chief?
She glances at the villa behind her, where panicked footsteps can be heard from time to time. It seems the attack had wreaked total havoc inside.

speaker: Security Chief
content: Tsk... I protect everyone in the jurisdiction. You're a Sinner. I cannot guarantee that you're safe to deploy.

speaker: Rahu
content: Don't worry, Mr. Security Chief. I'm an FAC soldier first, a Sinner second.

speaker: Rahu
content: My power poses no threat to you. You're facing ferocious enemies, and I can be of use.
She shows him her high-level FAC credentials, which does certify her skills and safety.

speaker: Security Chief
content: Then how can you be of use?

speaker: Rahu
content: Tonight's attack is but the beginning. There aren't just Sinners among the enemies, but also many Mania-infected creatures. They stem from evil forces you cannot deal with.

speaker: Rahu
content: Better evacuate the protection target back to Paradeisos. I'll escort you.

speaker: Security Chief
content: That won't work. She refused, and we can't convince her. The higher-ups haven't responded, either.

speaker: Rahu
content: Then let me go inside the villa. I'll give her the best protection.
The Security Chief's face twitches.

speaker: Security Chief
content: ...And who will vouch for you?

speaker: Rahu
content: You. The next attack is coming soon. Your existing defenses will be pummeled in one blow.

speaker: Security Chief
content: You're pushing it too far! The lady's from Paradeisos. How can we let a Sinner go near her? Their attitude towards Mania is crystal clear!

speaker: Security Chief
content: The problem this time is that reinforcements didn't arrive in time. The fault is on your side. You stand on guard outside and make sure no one approaches before the protection target is relocated. That's your only job right now!

speaker: Security Chief
content: Also, I don't care if you're from the FAC or anywhere else. Unless the higher-ups say otherwise, I'm the Security Chief around here, and you have to obey my orders. You got it? You...

speaker: Security Chief
content: <size=44>Are you laughing at me??</size>

speaker: Rahu
content: Ha, don't worry, you're not that funny. I will obey the orders.

speaker: Rahu
content: By the way...

speaker: Rahu
content: Does the code <color=#fb9259>05257885</color> ring a bell?

speaker: Security Chief
content: What?
Rahu carefully observes his expression. It's one of genuine confusion, so she picks up her shields and turns to leave, but not before having a last word.

speaker: Rahu
content: I suggest you stop calling for more reinforcements. No one aside from me is going to come. Besides...

speaker: Rahu
content: If the enemy and Mania were to hide among reinforcements, you wouldn't be able to tell with your level of expertise.

speaker: Rahu
content: If that happens, you'd be guilty of personally bringing the enemy to our distinguished Paradeisos guest.

speaker: Security Chief
content: You...!

speaker: Rahu
content: I'll be standing guard and waiting for orders at the nearest sentry post.
Rahu ends the conversation there, and quickly returns to the nearest sentry post. The night has gotten calmer as the contamination and danger fade away.
Another encrypted comms message comes in from the FAC team, but this one deliberately by-passed review controls. Rahu answers the comms. A familiar and anxious voice rings out from the other end.

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: Rahu? Where are you?! Why did you act on your own accord again?

speaker: Rahu
content: The FAC received an urgent call for help. Erica Villa was under attack. There were A-Class Sinners among the attackers. Eastside sheriffs can't deal with them alone.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm the best candidate to deal with something like that, right Captain?

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: Who are you trying to fool?! When have you ever asked for permission? You've stirred up enough trouble as it is. If any more violations come to light, even I can't help you smooth things over. You'll be labeled a high-risk Sinner and get arrested!

speaker: Rahu
content: Then let them arrest me. I won't stop.
The person on the other end shouts angrily. Rahu didn't respond. After a while, the caller finally calms down.

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: ...I just submitted a mission application on your behalf. If the higher-ups ask, I'm only smoothing things over for you for one week. But there's going to be the <color=#fb9259>Blue Rain Project</color> in two days, so be careful out there. Don't cause any trouble.

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: I know what you're doing, Rahu. But we won't get what we want by pursuing Paradeisos like this.

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: Don't end up sacrificing yourself.

speaker: Rahu
content: Thank you for your support, Commander. I will get the job done.
She hangs up the comms and looks toward the villa where the Paradeisos guest is staying. A floral scent wafts over. Rahu frowns and makes herself remember this maddening scent.
The first night is over, and her first step can only go so far.
But tomorrow, she will get more closer.
...Who is...

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: ...Rahu...

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: ...Rahu, where are you... What time is it already... are you still asleep?
...So annoying... I'm not asleep... Who the hell are you...

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: For god's sake, I'm your captain! Your boss! Your commander!

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: How many times do I have to tell you? You're part of the FAC now, so you have to obey orders! When will this get through your thick skull?

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: You're an FAC soldier, and our mission is to form the frontline of defense. Any weakness in that line will cause countless deaths in the city behind us.

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: Obey without questions. No doubts, no hesitations. Execute every order with utmost loyalty, just like a knight protects his lord. Is that clear?

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: I usually tolerate you slacking off, but you're not allowed to mess up this mission! If we do well, we'll get medals, as well as a pay raise and vacation days. Don't mess this up for me!

speaker: Rahu
content: ...And if we don't do well, we'll just die. You've got some nerve to call yourself a <i>loyal knight<i> when you're salivating over pay raises and vacation days.

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: Hey... how dare you talk back?!

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: Enough with that. Now take those blasted shields of yours and hurry!

speaker: Rahu
content: Where to?

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: DisSea, of course. Are you still sleeping? This is the biggest operation since the Carnival. Top secret campaign directly commanded by Paradeisos.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...DisSea... a huge campaign... N.F. 103?

speaker: Rahu
content: <size=42><color=#fb9259>N.F. 103?</color></size>
Her mind is finally clearing up, but the people in front of her begin to leave.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...No, don't go, that mission is...

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: Ha, I thought nothing scared you? What are you afraid of? Stay focused on the battlefield. Don't go rampaging alone. You just have to remember one thing...

speaker: Rahu
content: No, listen to me, wait!

speaker: Dazed Voice
content: Listen to my command, and listen to your superiors! Remember that, knights of the FAC! Let's head out!

speaker: Rahu
content: <size=42>Don't go!!<size=42>
It's a dream.
She puts on her mask, her throbbing veins gradually calming down.
There's no danger nearby. The sky is getting brighter as the cold morning approaches. It's time to wake up from this dream.
She quickly brings her breathing under control. After calming herself down, Rahu picks up her shields and walks out firmly into the quiet garden beset by malice.
This is a luxury Eastside villa, but there aren't enough guards. The enemy might flee at any moment. But judging from last night...
The assassin is very familiar with the security plan and guards' protocol around here. She must have monitored these useless idiots for quite some time and know them like the back of her hand.
Then there is the possibility that the enemy has already infiltrated the villa. If that's the case...
She pulls up the villa's surveillance screen, which shows faraway villas, sentry posts, a park in the distance, and the nearby shopping street...
Some shops on that street are closed, but haven't been emptied, so it's worth a visit. There aren't a lot of patrols right now, which works in my favor.
The only shop in business is a little florist with a welcome sign on it.
Rahu furrows her brows and lifts up her shields in vigilance. A strange smell wafts out from behind the door—the same as the floral scent last night, but stronger and more nauseating here.
She pushes the door gently. As soon as it opens a crack, she sees a thin thread behind it, and also hears a mechanical trigger.
Rahu immediately dodges away from the door, which gets riddled by bullets.
The sirens on the street starts blaring loudly.

speaker: Rahu
content: A temporary trap set no more than four hours ago. Is it designed for me...?
She fastens her mask, her eyes gleaming with excitement.

speaker: Rahu
content: Excellent... Come at me!
Swinging her shields, she severs all the spikes and destroys most of the traps. The siren still hasn't stopped. The enemy had obviously set off the alarm on purpose.
Rahu looks at the time. It's been less than two minutes. She turns around and rushes out of the florist. Clearly, incidents have unfolded in more than one place.

Coming out in full force, the sheriffs are immediately distracted by the sirens ringing everywhere. Many run around in confusion like headless chickens. On the other end of the comms, someone is anxiously asking about Rahu's condition.

speaker: Rahu
content: There are smoke bombs everywhere. The assassin is really trying hard...

speaker: Rahu
content: What a great decision it was to spare you last night.
She leaves the comms device on the spot. She quickly observes the sheriffs' movements, then picks a discreet path in the opposite direction to rush back to the villa.
The main gate of the villa.

speaker: Cowardly Guard
content: Are we under attack again? I heard many other places are under attack too. How did this wave come so fast?

speaker: Anxious Guard
content: Shhhh! Don't be distracted and keep quiet. Watch every corner closely. Assassins might break in at any time.

speaker: Cowardly Guard
content: Wh-what's the use? We're facing off a Sinner... a monster!

speaker: Cowardly Guard
content: What about the FAC? Didn't they say they'll send someone to keep this place safe? Where is our help?

Rahu is in no hurry to enter. She had already scouted out the structure of the building last night, and is hiding in the most discreet corner. She pays close attention to what's going on inside, patiently waiting for an opportunity.
What she's waiting for soon arrives.

speaker: Cowardly Guard
content: Ahhh...!!

speaker: Anxious Guard
content: Assassin! It's the assassin!!! The assassin has broken into the villa!!! Help!!
Now!
Rahu leaps out into the courtyard. The guards no longer look at her with disgust and contempt, and are now screaming for her help. No one questions her unruly intrusion or late arrival.

The villa's front gate hadn't been breached, Rahu immediately spots the assassin. The assassin had cleverly hidden the face, but the moment the assassin sees Rahu, the surprise and disgust are exposed for all to see.

speaker: Assassin in the Shadows
content: ...You again, the FAC!

speaker: Rahu
content: Wanted to trap me in that stupid flower shop? Then your traps were a bit too basic.

speaker: Rahu
content: But I must thank you... for giving me a reason to enter this door!
Rahu grins widely behind her mask, her eyes gleaming with Mania. The heavy shields unfurl into sharp swords, and she charges at the assassin, shattering the gate with one blow.
She pins down the assassin forcefully and speaks in a low voice.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm not going to kill you today, but don't try my patience by pestering me.

speaker: Rahu
content: Get lost! Don't let me see you again!

speaker: Assassin in the Shadows
content: Tsk...

The assassin twitches her little finger, pulling an invisible thread. A ray of cold light zips toward Rahu, who steps back effortlessly to dodge it. At the same time, she lets go of the assassin, who breaks through the barriers and vanishes behind the walls.
As the cries of the guards outside fade into the distance, the people inside finally snap back to their senses.

speaker: Cowardly Guard
content: ...W-we won?

speaker: Anxious Guard
content: What are you waiting for? Chase that assassin!
Rahu picks up the silver needle that had shot towards her. There's a silver thread attached to it, and on the other end is a Flowery Scroll. She looks at it for a while, then puts it in her pocket.

speaker: Rahu
content: The enemy had ventured too deep into the villa, and were experienced in using Mania power. The most urgent task at hand is to check the interior of the villa for contamination and ensure the safety of our target.

speaker: Rahu
content: Step aside. I need to go inside to check.
The guards realize what's happening and rush forward to halt Rahu.

speaker: Cowardly Guard
content: We can't let you! The lady is convalescing in this house. She mustn't be disturbed.

speaker: Rahu
content: She must've woken up already from all the commotion.

speaker: Cowardly Guard
content: But you're a Sinner. Paradeisos won't allow it. Paradeisos doesn't accept Sinners. You can't put her safety at risk!
Her goal is in sight, yet blocked by this group of idiots. Rahu is gradually losing her patience.

speaker: Rahu
content: You failed to stop that Mania Assassin, yet you waste my time here. Outta my way, you wuss!

speaker: Rahu
content: Tell that pretentious Paradeisos woman I just saved her life. If she wants to live, open the door and come out to see me!

speaker: Cowardly Guard
content: You...
Let her in.
A soft voice echoes out from the guard's comms device, stunning everyone. Then, a maid walks out of the corridor and motions for Rahu to follow her.
Rahu stares down the corridor, clenching and unclenching her shield-holding hands, her mask gently billowing. It takes her a long time to take the first step.
She walks down the corridor and pushes open the bedroom door. When she reaches the Paradeisos woman's bedside, Rahu has calmed down already. She glares at the reclining woman coldly.

speaker: Rahu
content: Pleased to meet you, my lady. I'm your temporary bodyguard, Rahu.
Hello, Rahu.
I'm Shalom. I've been wanting to meet you for a long time.

The bedroom is quite cluttered. Though spacious and lightly furnished, it's filled with flowers. Rahu has a keen sense of smell. The scent of the flowers had already made her frown outside, and is now utterly suffocating.
Surrounded by flowers, the wounded woman on the bed looks even softer and frailer. Compared to the blood-soaked chaos around her, she is pitifully fragile.

speaker: Shalom
content: I've been in a coma since yesterday's incident until now. A lot of things have been delayed. To be honest, I didn't expect your arrival.

speaker: Shalom
content: A special Sinner of the FAC...
She studies Rahu politely.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're more dashing than I thought. Like a knight.

speaker: Rahu
content: How generous of you to let a Sinner come in and talk to you. Aren't you afraid that I'll sully you?

speaker: Shalom
content: I think you're very strong, and that makes me feel at ease.

speaker: Shalom
content: Plus, you've carried out your duties impeccably and saved me so many times. You deserve my respect and gratitude.

speaker: Shalom
content: I hope I didn't bring you any unpleasant experiences during my coma. I will explain the situation to the Security Chief.
Rahu remains expressionless.

speaker: Rahu
content: No need to worry about that. Don't you want to leave this place?

speaker: Rahu
content: There are Sinners and monsters among the assassins. It's too dangerous for you to be here. You should go back to Paradeisos.

speaker: Shalom
content: I will consider your advice. But before I make a decision, I believe that you guys are able to protect me.

speaker: Rahu
content: You're gonna depend on those worthless sheriffs?
Shalom shakes her head.

speaker: Shalom
content: They are shouldering undue pressure and trying their best. Just look at all these flowers.

speaker: Shalom
content: After simply hearing that I like flowers, they sent me so many every day. They just want me to have some comfort.

speaker: Rahu
content: It's because you're from Paradeisos.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'm from Paradeisos, but that doesn't mean I am Paradeisos. If it weren't for the attack, I'd be your average Eastside neighbor.

speaker: Shalom
content: Paradeisos is very different from what the outside world imagines. It's so far removed from this world... In fact, you can pretend that it does not exist.
Rahu almost lets out a cold snort, but she restrains herself.

speaker: Rahu
content: My apologies. What I mean is, now that the enemy is at our doorstep, you need more protection.

speaker: Rahu
content: Please permit me to enter the villa so I can conduct a thorough check-up for safety hazards. The others aren't capable enough. I'll protect you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Will entering the villa be more convenient for your work?

speaker: Rahu
content: Of course.

speaker: Shalom
content: I see. I will file an application with the Paradeisos liaison. The Blue Rain will arrive in less than two days. I will try to get permission for you before then.

speaker: Shalom
content: But this way, you will also face more danger. The attacker was strong. She was determined to kill me.

speaker: Shalom
content: You really want to protect me?

speaker: Rahu
content: I swear in the name of the FAC.

speaker: Shalom
content: Really? Thank you, then. I will try my best, too.
She flashes a kind smile.

speaker: Shalom
content: Times are changing. I lack the ability to protect myself, so I am very glad that you're here.

speaker: Rahu
content: Don't mention it.
Rahu bows, then turns to leave. When she reaches the door, she turns back again.

speaker: Rahu
content: One more thing...

speaker: Rahu
content: Do you know what... 05257885 is?

speaker: Shalom
content: Is that a code? If needed, I can ask the liaison about it.

speaker: Rahu
content: No need, forget it. I will protect you well. It's my duty.

speaker: Rahu
content: Since you're a distinguished guest from <color=#fb9259>Paradeisos</color>, I will definitely give it my all.
With that, she shuts the door and walks into the shadows, leaving this flower-filled villa.

speaker: Dissolving Filth
content: Ahhh... glug glug glug...
The attackers utter their final cries, pulverized by the battle shield. Soon, a cleaning team arrives quickly with counter-Mania purifiers to carefully clean up the mess.
All the enemies have been wiped out. They were all monsters formed by Mania contaminants. Rahu noticed the Sinner who attacked Shalom earlier were not among them.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Is this bait? Or...
She walks up to the sheriff who was initially attacked. He's still unconscious. Just as Rahu raises her hand to "wake him up," she smells the strange fragrance again—this time, from the man's wound.
Frowning, she quickly peels off the man's clothes and finds something unexpected...
There is a rose under a bottle of <color=#fb9259>perfume</color>. Neither seems to belong to this man.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Cut to the chase.
These are probably the "signals" the assassins left her, the key lead to the rest of the information.
And the door sealing these secrets is most likely the <color=#fb9259>Flowery Scroll</color> left behind by the assassin earlier today.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...It's a <color=#fb9259>developer solution</color>.
After using the developer solution to remove the words on top, the hidden characters behind are revealed... The attacker is indeed trying to pass on some kind of message.

Rahu caresses the letter paper. The texture does feel different in several places. This thin piece of paper seems to hold more than one secret. More clues will arrive. To fully understand it, she must humor the sender and wait a bit longer.
But even at this stage, she can still figure out some additional information...
The letter is hidden in the villa, indicating that it's for someone in the villa, or maybe Shalom herself.
After I disrupted their plan, the enemy clearly had time to adjust their strategy, but they still chose to leave behind the clues here. They knew these would fall into my hands...
Do they think that I'm loyal so I will obediently hand over these clues to my superiors? Or...
She smiles and breaks the wreath.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Did they give me these on purpose?
But after a day of fighting, prolonged Mania contact finally affects her consciousness briefly deep in the night.
Once again, she starts dreaming of the past.

speaker: Calm Voice
content: She's the only one who came back from DisSea? The lone survivor... How impressive.
...Commander from...Paradeisos...?
The mission... failed... The defense line... and the people in the city... what happened to them...

speaker: Calm Voice
content: It didn't fail. The city-state is safe, do not worry.

speaker: Calm Voice
content: How much do you remember about the front line? Do you remember how you left?
I remember... I remember... There are people who didn't leave... Many stayed behind...
...Please, go save them... I beg of you... don't leave her there...

speaker: Calm Voice
content: It's too late. DisSea's tide has risen, and the combat zone is now completely submerged. If anyone goes there now, no amount of protective gear will help them survive for more than three hours.
...Completely submerged...?

speaker: Calm Voice
content: Don't worry. Paradeisos won't forget you. All the soldiers will receive medals of honor.
Her breathing quickens.
You knew this would happen... You knew the tide would rise in DisSea... You knew it would submerge the area...
You knew all along it would end like this...
Then why did you send us there?!!!
She lunges at the blurred-faced Paradeisos representative, roaring in fury. Several hands reach out to stop her as she lashes out.
There wasn't enough time to begin with! It was a suicide mission! You knew that all along! Why didn't you warn us?! Why did you cover this up?! Do all those lives mean nothing to you?!
The FAC trusted your calculations and arrangements, and carried out your orders without any doubt. They just wanted to fight for the city-state, and this is what they get in return?! To die in vain?!
What kind of a joke is this?!! Why was such a mission arranged?!
<size=40><color=#fb9259>Who</color> issued the order?!!</size>

speaker: Calm Voice
content: ...There's no cover-up, nor the need to explain anything. Discussion will only sow confusion. That's not what the FAC needs.

speaker: Calm Voice
content: You've all fulfilled your life's worth. People will naturally honor you for that.
...I'll kill you!!!!
The last bit of her sanity snaps. She lunges forward, but gets hammered to the ground, surrounded and hauled away.

speaker: Calm Voice
content: ...Don't worry. It's just mental trauma from the battlefield. It's a common occurrence in the FAC. Take her to recovery, poor her.

speaker: Calm Voice
content: Even a dog would become mentally unstable from losing its owner.
Stop, don't leave...!! Who assigned that mission? Who is 05257885? Tell me!
<color=#fb9259>Who</color> from Paradeisos sent us to die?!
Rahu wakes up to her phone vibrating in her hand, but she doesn't answer it. The vibration eventually stops, leaving behind the words FAC Encrypted Call in the missed call section.
She rises and puts her mask back on, attempting to cover her heavy panting.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...<color=#fb9259>An abandoned dog</color>, how fitting...

speaker: Rahu
content: I can smell the scent... It won't take long now... Just you wait...

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm coming to sink my fangs into your necks.

speaker: Maid
content: Sergeant Rahu, Miss Shalom invites you to come inside the villa. She says the application has been approved.

speaker: Maid
content: The Blue Rain is arriving soon. Miss Shalom is worried that it will affect you negatively.

speaker: Rahu
content: Got it. Thank your boss for me.

speaker: Maid
content: Please express this to her yourself. Miss Shalom is not as inapproachable as others assume. She looks forward to seeing you again.

speaker: Maid
content: Miss Rahu, you'll protect her, won't you?
Rahu gazes at the villa nearby. It's the place closest to her target.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Of course.

23:37, July 21, N.F. 113
Shalom's Home, Erica Villa, Eastside
The Blue Rain is falling across the whole city. Duration: 30 hours.
When the maid arrived, Rahu was looking out the windows, watching the blue rain pattering outside the villa.

speaker: Rahu
content: Where is Miss Shalom?

speaker: Maid
content: Still sleeping. Miss Shalom is recovering very slowly, so she can't stay awake for too long every day.

speaker: Maid
content: Miss Rahu, I'm here to tell you that your room has been cleaned and is ready for you.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'll go after finishing the risk assessment.

speaker: Rahu
content: This villa needs to be searched thoroughly. I will check every corner. Do I need a permit?

speaker: Maid
content: No, you have free access to every corner of this house. Here are the keys to all the rooms. Or do you prefer... that I go with you?
The maid hesitated for a moment before finally gathering the courage to speak.

speaker: Maid
content: ...Actually, it's just something I want to tell you.

speaker: Maid
content: Miss Shalom is a gentle person, and the best boss I've ever had. She's friendlier than all the other Eastside elites. If this hadn't happened, I would've never guessed that she's from Paradeisos.

speaker: Maid
content: She's getting such cruel treatment simply because she's from Paradeisos. She's such a gentle person and has clearly done nothing wrong, yet no one can take her away...

speaker: Maid
content: Miss Rahu, you'll protect her, won't you?
Rahu looks at the maid's concerned face, then shifts her gaze to the Blue Rain outside the window.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...The Blue Rain suppresses anything Mania-related, whether they are Sinners or Corruptors.

speaker: Rahu
content: It's unlikely that the enemy will launch any large-scale attacks in the next few days. A couple of routine checks will do. No need to be as tense as the past few days.

speaker: Rahu
content: Go and get some rest. Y'all must be tired. Leave the rest to me.

speaker: Rahu
content: Your boss will be fine.
The maid smiles somewhat bashfully, curtsies to Rahu and leaves.
After the maid left, the villa is all quiet. Rahu walks down the empty corridor, opening the doors one by one with the keys she got and carefully searching each room.

There are no hidden rooms or secret triggers, and all the surveillance cameras are temporary installations. This is an ordinary Eastside luxury villa. The bland and unlabeled food products in the kitchen don't seem to be from Eastside. There aren't many clothes, only a few pieces that are much plainer than what the other upper-class women wear around here.

The lady of the house leads a life quite different from that of both Eastside elites and West District residents. This is in line with some of the vague stereotypes about Paradeisos. But that's all there is to it.
There are no papers or personal items that reveal her background, occupation, relationships, or any other information.
Rahu checks every room before finally coming to the study. She finds an old-fashioned photo album among the annoying flowers and opens it hopefully.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Tsk.

Aside from the flowers, there are portraits of people from all walks of life—nearby residents, reporters, councilors, doctors, guards, vendors, tailors, and unknown children. But the photos were obviously all taken in the villa, and they are all of ordinary Eastsiders.
None of the photos were taken in Paradeisos or show any distinguished Paradeisos guests.
After the attack, the doctors and guards who came were all Eastsiders. Even some councilors came to kiss up. However, there hasn't been any contact from Paradeisos.

speaker: Security Chief
content: Ms. Shalom has been here for less than a year and has kept a low profile. We didn't know that she was from Paradeisos until she was attacked for the first time three days ago...

speaker: Security Chief
content: In the beginning, our superiors took the initiative to contact us, mentioning that Paradeisos was aware of our situation. They instructed us to protect the VIP and regularly update the safety data, assuring us that support would arrive soon.

speaker: Security Chief
content: But since then, there's been no word from them. It's just been us, sending data, always sending more data... We want to reach out to Paradeisos, but who even knows where or who they are?

speaker: Security Chief
content: I know, our efforts barely amount to actual protection. But I don't even understand the current situation; I constantly feel like someone's watching us...

speaker: Security Chief
content: Even if things are hard to organize in Syndicate, it's clear that other members of Paradeisos are all under heightened protection. I just don't get it!
Rahu is a bit frustrated. It took her so much effort to get close to this woman, yet she can't peek at Paradeisos through her. It's always been like that.
It doesn't matter if she gets more power or reaches a more important position. As long as she is a part of FAC, she still can't reach any truth outside the battlefield.
As if the giant curtain of the world has descended in front of her, she is unable to reach beyond it. She remains trapped in a past that she cannot change.
A scene slowly comes to her mind. A cemetery shrouded in rain and fog, sparse flowers in front of the headstone, remembering those who will never return...
Is it because of the Blue Rain? Rahu starts to remember more irrelevant things. It feels almost suffocating. She lets go of the mask and tries to ease her breath, attempting to calm herself down.
Sergeant Rahu?
Leaning against the door frame and draped in a thin blanket, the Paradeisos woman gazes at Rahu.
Rahu looks back at her. She closes the photo album in her hands and puts it back on the shelf. Shalom just gazes at her without saying a word.

speaker: Rahu
content: Why did you wake up at this hour? If you feel unwell, I'll call the doctor or the maid.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'm fine. I slept for a long time and dreamt of rain. When I opened my eyes again, it was quite late.

speaker: Shalom
content: What about you? Are you staying up all night to stand guard?

speaker: Rahu
content: That's my job.

speaker: Shalom
content: You should get some rest. The Blue Rain also affects Sinners.

speaker: Shalom
content: Judging from the way you look, you haven't slept well for a long time. You must be feeling tired, no? Don't force yourself.

speaker: Rahu
content: No need to worry. The most important thing is your safety. Let me take you back to your room to rest.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...You look really stressed. Can I help you with anything?
The Blue Rain is irritating enough as it is, and now she has to chat with this Paradeisos woman, too. Rahu's patience is wearing thin, and she has to actively control her emotions.

speaker: Rahu
content: When are you planning to go back to Paradeisos?

speaker: Shalom
content: Why do you ask that?

speaker: Rahu
content: You are in grave danger right now. They should take you back. The sheriffs' capabilities are totally not up to par for someone from Paradeisos.

speaker: Rahu
content: Do you have a reason for insisting on staying here?

speaker: Rahu
content: Or... is it because you can't go back?
The woman doesn't avert Rahu's gaze, and slowly flashes a sincere smile.

speaker: Shalom
content: Did you hear any interesting rumors about me? For example, that I'm a "disgraced and exiled Paradeisos noblewoman"?

speaker: Shalom
content: Those are just people's speculations about Paradeisos. It doesn't correspond to reality. I have my reasons for staying here...
Rahu remained silent for a while before speaking up.

speaker: Rahu
content: Let's cut to the chase.

speaker: Rahu
content: Your life is in grave danger, but the security force assigned to protect you is abysmal, and no one has come to escort you to safety. You've been cast here like a piece of meat thrown to a pack of wolves. It makes no sense.

speaker: Rahu
content: Let me just ask you straight up. Did Paradeisos <color=#fb9259>abandon</color> you, or you their <color=#fb9259>bait</color>?

speaker: Rahu
content: Are they sacrificing you just to catch the culprit of these attacks?

speaker: Shalom
content: ...If that's the case, will you give up your mission, Sergeant Rahu?
Rahu is taken aback by her question.

speaker: Rahu
content: I will keep you safe until the danger is gone.

speaker: Shalom
content: Is it out of sympathy?

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm an FAC soldier. Protecting you is my job. My work doesn't require sympathy.

speaker: Shalom
content: Then who assigned you this mission? It wouldn't make any sense to protect bait. So why are you here?

speaker: Rahu
content: ...The sheriffs here pleaded for help again and again. They were kept in the dark and caught up in this crisis.

speaker: Rahu
content: Those around you are innocent, and... so are you.

speaker: Rahu
content: The FAC can't just let all of you die like this.
Shalom looks at her for a long time before speaking again.

speaker: Shalom
content: I see. Thank you.

speaker: Shalom
content: The original plan will remain unchanged, but since you're here, I hope you'll protect me and catch the culprit at the same time. Also...

speaker: Shalom
content: I hope you don't get hurt from this dangerous mission.
After a brief silence, Rahu lowered her eyelids and put on her mask.

speaker: Rahu
content: Let me walk you back to your room to rest.
At last, she is the only one left. The sound of rain tap against the windows, casting shadows within. Rahu walks down the long corridor, heading towards the main door.
No power, no background, a frail body, and not even a family member to seek help from... That's why Paradeisos "chose" her. No one will care if she dies.
Even if I save her and gain her trust, it'll be impossible to get to Paradeisos through her. She can't even go back herself.
That woman is useless...
After a while, muffled cackles ring out from behind her mask.

speaker: Rahu
content: Hehe... but the fish she'll catch seems quite valuable...

speaker: Rahu
content: The enemy that Paradeisos wants to catch... a bunch of Mania killers... You old foxes, what do you want from her?

speaker: Rahu
content: If I catch 'em first, will you guys come to me...? Hehehe...

speaker: Rahu
content: Just you wait. I'll bring the meat right to your mouths.

speaker: Guard
content: You're... that FAC... wait, where are you going? Don't leave...

speaker: Rahu
content: Having you here is enough. I'm off to clear the real threat.
It's morning already, but the rain hasn't stopped.
She leaves the villa and rushes to her destination.

07:18, July 22, N.F. 113
Flowerdale High Street, near Erica Villa, Eastside
Since the attack, the shopping street has been eerily quiet in the morning. Most of the sheriffs are guarding Shalom's villa, leaving only a few unlucky stragglers to patrol the surrounding areas.

On the other side of the rainy street, a woman holding flowers is walking alone down the quiet pavement. She nods to the familiar sheriffs as she passes by them, not bothering to inquire about their worries.
She walks all the way to the tailor shop. Upon finding the door unlocked, she freezes for a moment, then closes her umbrella and walks inside with a smile.

speaker: Female Tailor
content: It's too early for business. I wasn't expecting anyone. You scared me a bit.

speaker: Female Tailor
