content: Hello, dear customer. This shop is closed right now. If you want a custom made dress, please come back in a few days.
Rahu doesn't respond. She watches as the shop owner puts her flowers in a vase—they're white carnations.

speaker: Rahu
content: Those flowers are very beautiful.

speaker: Female Tailor
content: ...Thank you. My husband loved carnations. He was fond of the color purple, and said it reminded him of me.

speaker: Female Tailor
content: He worked for the FAC. He retired for several years due to his injuries, but then got called to help out with the emergency in Syndicate. And that... led to his funeral.
The woman chokes up, turning her head to wipe her tears.

speaker: Female Tailor
content: Sorry. I just came back from the cemetery, so I'm still feeling quite emotional.

speaker: Rahu
content: I understand.

speaker: Female Tailor
content: Really? Did something similar happen to you, miss?

speaker: Female Tailor
content: Judging from your uniform, you're part of the FAC too, right...? Though I can't make you a dress right now, you're welcome to take any flowers you like.

speaker: Female Tailor
content: If there are people you'd like to mourn, too...

speaker: Rahu
content: ...There are.

speaker: Rahu
content: But it's not time to mourn them yet.
Rahu goes to the window and draws the curtains.

speaker: Rahu
content: Maybe you don't know, but the situation in West District is really bad. Many have died, and it's taking quite a while to deal with the contaminated corpses. Memorial services have been postponed for some time already. If your husband died there, he won't be buried until next month.

speaker: Rahu
content: Where exactly did you go mourn him, ma'am?
Before she finishes her sentence, a shield comes flying forth, smashing the floorboards under her feet. White carnation petals scatter everywhere, yet the tailor is no longer standing where she was.
A few streaks of silver light zip towards Rahu, who blocks them with her shield. She looks over at the attacker—the mourning widow now has a sinister yet teasing look on her face.

speaker: Female Tailor?
content: Sigh, how impatient you are. I could've explained a small discrepancy like that.

speaker: Rahu
content: No need. Your dodging skills have already explained everything.

speaker: Rahu
content: We've fought several times, Miss <color=#fb9259>Assassin</color>. Your silhouette is quite memorable.

speaker: Female Tailor?
content: Hehe, quite the sense of humor, eh? You're in good spirits, Miss Bodyguard. Take off your mask and let me see... are you smiling?

speaker: Female Tailor?
content: Then I hope you keep smiling for the rest of your life...

speaker: Female Tailor?
content: Sometimes, a lifetime passes in the blink of an eye.
The woman twirls the needle in her hand and jabs it into the back of a mannequin, activating a hidden trigger with a click. The mechanism starts to attack Rahu!

speaker: Assassin
content: Ouch, this hurts! Really! I thought the FAC was known for being polite and gentle? Why are you being so rough with me?

speaker: Assassin
content: I'm your colleague's widow. Can't you be a bit nicer to me?

speaker: Rahu
content: Ha, what an amateur. Not only full of lies, but full of nonsense, too.
With a thrust of her shield, she throws a round table at the shopkeeper. The woman dodges it and pulls out a few arrows to fight back, and the two back away from each other.

speaker: Assassin
content: I'm telling the truth. I was married to a loving husband and now he is dead. These are my real life experiences.

speaker: Rahu
content: You used him to collect intelligence on the FAC, and then you killed him?

speaker: Assassin
content: No. He was a great man, upright and doting. He respected my privacy and never pried into my <color=#fb9259>secrets</color>.

speaker: Assassin
content: If he had listened to me and didn't take on the West District mission... Maybe I would have truly fallen in love with him as time went on.

speaker: Assassin
content: Too bad that good men always want to be heroes and clean up other people's messes. He went out over and over again, so he was destined to not come back one day... You also work for the FAC. Surely you understand?

speaker: Assassin
content: A new Black Ring appeared in Syndicate. How many of your teammates died there? I know this is your glorious tradition—the FAC loves meaningless sacrifices.

speaker: Assassin
content: So, I didn't kill him. Instead, we're in the same boat, and should chat more about it... Ah!
She dodges a second attack as she yelp. It was a close call, but a missed one nonetheless. Rahu feels that her movements have slowed down, and that her body is spinning out of control.
She immediately realizes what happened.

speaker: Rahu
content: You used neurotoxins on me?

speaker: Assassin
content: Smart girl. I know your combat habits. You love to fight your opponents head-on without any hesitation, and always put your life on the line to shield others. This is the best way to deal with you.

speaker: Assassin
content: Oh, stop thrashing around. This poison contains a hint of Mania. If you have Hypercubes on you, just wait quietly for it to be purified. I don't want to hurt you just yet.

speaker: Assassin
content: Let's have a chat.
The assassin doesn't make any further moves. On the contrary, the frivolous smile on her face fades away.

speaker: Assassin
content: In the past four months, all the Black Rings across the city-state have become active. The bulk of FAC forces have gone to deal with them. You have no resources to deal with incidents in Eastside right now. Such matters have already been delegated to the 9th Agency.

speaker: Assassin
content: Rahu, no, Sinner of the <color=#fb9259>FAC-G47</color> squadron, you shouldn't even be here. Your superiors haven't issued any assistance orders at all.

speaker: Assassin
content: You returned to Eastside on your own and forcibly intervened in a case that has nothing to do with you. You kept all the clues you found for yourself and even came to see me, the assassin, alone... I bet even your Sinner power didn't come clean, did it?

speaker: Assassin
content: As an FAC soldier, obedience and loyalty are your sworn duties, but you have stepped on so many red lines. Any one of them is enough to send you to be court martialed.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Ha, you found out a lot in just a few hours.

speaker: Rahu
content: Are you threatening me?

speaker: Assassin
content: ...No, I understand you. More than you know.

speaker: Assassin
content: You're the only survivor of the <color=#fb9259>Eclipse Operation</color> to DisSea. You're here for revenge.

speaker: Assassin
content: In <color=#fb9259>N.F. 103</color>, the FAC received an emergency order and deployed 28 squadrons to secretly go to DisSea to break into BR-000. With little time and information, the mission reaped no results, and only you survived.

speaker: Assassin
content: It was an absurd mission. But afterwards, the commander who devised the tactics went into hiding, and the FAC got scapegoated for all the losses.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Did you also get this information from your "dead husbands"?

speaker: Assassin
content: No, they wouldn't know. Anyone who knows this won't be able to sit there and do nothing. Like you and I.

speaker: Assassin
content: My father was a transport worker in the FAC's logistics department. In N.F. 103, he was at the base and got infected by materials secretly recovered from the Eclipse Operation. He died before even knowing what it was.

speaker: Assassin
content: My father got infected with Mania. Amidst the chaos, he went home without going through the necessary checks, and turned into a Corruptor right in front of my siblings...

speaker: Assassin
content: Like you, I was the lone survivor that night. I understand your hate.

speaker: Assassin
content: All these years, you sacrificed so much to become a Sinner, suppressing all your hatred to be a dog for Paradeisos, yet you still can't get a grasp of the conspiracy.

speaker: Assassin
content: I know the cold, dark path under your feet. I've traveled along that same path.

speaker: Assassin
content: Our lives were completely destroyed in an instant. Nobody gave us justice, so we can only seek justice ourselves. There must be some fairness in this world, right?
She hands Rahu a purple carnation.

speaker: Assassin
content: My name is <color=#fb9259>Garofano</color>. I'm not your enemy. We are the <color=#fb9259>same kind</color>, and there are many more of us out there.

speaker: Garofano
content: There is a place in this world that accepts us, and someone there who understands us. <color=#fb9259>She</color> will guide and support you in exacting cold, sweet revenge.

speaker: Garofano
content: If it's what you desire, I can take you to her.

speaker: Rahu
content: Are you talking about your patron, or the leader of your organization?

speaker: Garofano
content: It's the new <color=#fb9259>family</color> I tried so hard to find.
She answers sincerely, and the emotion in her voice seems to move Rahu. The FAC soldier remains silent for a while.

speaker: Rahu
content: You say she'll help you seek revenge...

speaker: Rahu
content: Then the Mania you released and the Corruptor monsters you brought... She was behind all that? She gave you those to seek revenge?

speaker: Rahu
content: The woman you're trying to kill and the people around her... what crimes have they committed? Why are you treating them like this?
The assassin detects Rahu's hostility. A trace of disappointment flashes in her eyes. She feels up a few needles as she calculates the duration of the toxin and tries to make a final argument.

speaker: Garofano
content: She's from Paradeisos, Rahu. No one from Paradeisos is innocent. They are all enemies. The most powerful and terrible enemies.

speaker: Garofano
content: You hate her too, don't you?

speaker: Garofano
content: Just like you risked your life to become a Sinner, I must gain the strength to fight them. We all have to fight for what we want, and we all have to give up some things.

speaker: Garofano
content: Revenge is about giving your all. You know that best, don't you? Now is your chance. We can help you.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...If you're telling the truth, then I get it.

speaker: Rahu
content: There's no such thing as "we". Don't kid yourself, and don't confuse us as the same kind.
She throws the Hypercube on her body aside and smashes her shields, triggering the violent Mania in her body to neutralize the neurotoxins.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm an FAC soldier. I will protect my comrades-in-arms, the front line, and all those who must be protected in DisCity. I will give my all to fight against the villains who harm them.

speaker: Rahu
content: I will rebuild all the ruined morals the FAC way. Even if I'm the only one on that dark and lonesome path, I'll keep going till I die. That is my <color=#fb9259>revenge</color>.

speaker: Rahu
content: Yet you...

speaker: Rahu
content: Doing the bidding of shady gutter rats, abusing Mania to kill innocents, and using revenge as an excuse to do evil. We've never been the same kind. You're but a useful idiot exploited by others.

speaker: Rahu
content: You, your organization, and the scumbags behind you... shall always be the FAC's enemies!

speaker: Garofano
content: ...What a pity. I really wanted to take you home.
There's a huge gap in strength between the two. In just a split second, Garofano gets knocked down, and a heavy shield pins her to the ground, immobilizing her.

speaker: Garofano
content: Ahhh... cough cough, what brute force... Are you a monster? What evil have you done to gain such strength?

speaker: Garofano
content: Does your dear FAC know?

speaker: Rahu
content: Who is the person directing you?

speaker: Rahu
content: You call her family, so you must be very close. If I capture you, will she come looking for you?

speaker: Garofano
content: ...What do you want to do?
Her voice turns cold.

speaker: Rahu
content: I want to go to Paradeisos. To do that, I need an opportunity to present them with a gift. You and your master will make the perfect gift.

speaker: Rahu
content: There are those in Paradeisos who want you guys. Did you know about that?

speaker: Garofano
content: ...I see. So I'm not the only one you want...

speaker: Rahu
content: Come now. Either 'fess up on your own, or wait for your "family" to come rescue you. You choose.

speaker: Rahu
content: Didn't you say she's a savior for revenge-seekers? Then she will definitely come find you.

speaker: Garofano
content: Hehehe... In that case, you have quite the potential to be an evildoer... Stop fretting over your so-called justice. You're already unfit to work for the FAC.

speaker: Rahu
content: Answer my questions! I have no patience with my enemies.
The heavy shield slams down again with bone-cracking force. Garofano groans in pain, yet wears a weak and intoxicated smile. There is no more kindly enticement in her eyes, only hostility and malice.

speaker: Garofano
content: Hehehe, you've waited for ten years already. Why the rush now?

speaker: Garofano
content: I gave you that floral letter quite a while ago... Did you read it? Did you not understand it?

speaker: Rahu
content: Just straight-up tell me what's in it. I don't want to play more riddle games with you.
Rahu frowns and exerts more force, but the assassin's body is as soft as water, absorbing all the force like a sponge. Her smile widens, sending a chill down Rahu's spine.

speaker: Garofano
content: It's quite simple. Let me take you through it step by step.

speaker: Garofano
content: This is the <color=#fb9259>secret comms code</color>, the only code that penetrated the DisSea's Black Ring during the Eclipse Operation. It was used to send you orders inside the Ring. It came from the elusive Paradeisos.

As she babbles leisurely, she suddenly tugs on a faint silk thread on the ground nearby, triggering a mechanism on the wall. Several needles labeled with strange runes shoot out. Rahu refuses to let go of her shield, and the needles pierce deeply into her upper arm.

This time, the needles aren't covered with neurotoxins, but something... filthier and deadlier. It penetrates Rahu's consciousness like a living organism. Her vision gradually turns red, and the voice of the enemy becomes distant.

speaker: Garofano
content: Recognize it? The other end of this comms is the enemy you've failed to find in your ten-year search of DisCity.
Rahu can't feel the pain. That nightmarish string of numbers occupies her entire brain, igniting the boiling Mania in her body. At the same time, it awakens a dormant, painful memory.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: The DisSea tide is rising ahead of schedule! We can't hold out with this temporary line of defense! Requesting to retreat!! We must retreat!!

speaker: Vague Voice
content: No word from Paradeisos yet?! What about the comms? Didn't they say they have a way to contact us through the Black Ring?
<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: Obstructions cleared, <color=#fb9259>Super-loop Observation Anchor</color> established, Mania noise filtered out, connection stabilized.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: Greetings, FAC personnel of Eclipse Operation. I am your Paradeisos observer and liaison officer. We have completed data collection and battlefield analysis, and our decision is—<color=#fb9259>the mission shall continue</color>.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: There is only one goal: do your best to withstand DisSea's rising tide before the task is complete. I will assist you in redeployment. Calculated based on the relative time inside the Ring, the remaining forces can withstand for another 34 minutes.
...You again...

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: I understand that everyone's mental state has reached the breaking point, so I also bring some good news.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: Rescue forces have gone deep into DisSea. Hang on for a bit longer. As long as you withstand the tide and extend the window for 44 minutes, they will reach the temporary levee.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: All right, brace yourselves. You are in a place where determination can alter reality. You are the staunchest and bravest people in all of DisCity.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: You can do it.
...Lies... We held out for three hours... No help ever came...
You lied to us, and left us to die...
<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: This operation is of great significance, and we can only rely on the FAC. Paradeisos conveys to you our utmost respect.

speaker: Rahu
content: You let them die there for no reason!!

speaker: Garofano
content: All worked up? Who are you shouting at?
Tsss...!
A sharp object pierces Rahu's collarbone. Thanks to the excruciating pain, she finally struggles free from the hallucinations, forcing open her eyes and returning to reality.
She's in the tailor shop, not in the DisSea of ten years ago. The person in front of her is the assassin, not the blood-stained number she's pursuing.

Garofano had already slipped away from the heavy shield. She is still smiling, weakly but triumphantly, as she slowly spins the needle piercing Rahu, sending the poison and contamination deeper into her body.

speaker: Garofano
content: I didn't want to use this on you. You had an intense reaction. Did you see the enemy you've been thinking about all these years?

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Where did you get this code? How come you know so much?
This code is the only clue that Rahu has about that person. She memorized it and searched for ten years, but never saw anything outside of her nightmares.
Yet now this woman easily dishes out her deepest secret, and knows more about this number than the "sole survivor" herself.

speaker: Rahu
content: Could it be that... you were there, too? In DisSea? Or... Paradeisos?

speaker: Rahu
content: You've seen <color=#fb9259>that person</color>?

speaker: Rahu
content: Who is he? Where is he now?!

She wants to grab the assassin, who stabs her with another needle. Rahu's body goes numb. The poison spreads to every corner of her body, slowing down her movements and making it impossible for her to keep up with the enemy.

speaker: Garofano
content: What's the rush? Can't you see I'm about to tell you?

speaker: Garofano
content: I did some dirty work for Mania traffickers in exchange for information. I know they're bastards, but I don't care.

speaker: Garofano
content: Only the shadiest bastards can get to the shady truth. They can tear open the facade of Paradeisos and give those hot shots something to worry about.

speaker: Garofano
content: Can ordinary folks like you and me do that?
Tsss! Another needle pierces Rahu's other shoulder. The poison and Mania erode deeper, ferociously tormenting the soldier who is on the verge of going manic.

speaker: Garofano
content: I know my hands are dirty. I know that some of the Paradeisos people I attacked are innocent... but they've all been useful.
She fishes out a third needle, but doesn't rush to stab Rahu. She slowly traces Rahu's chest with the needle tip, as if probing the heart of the prey.

speaker: Garofano
content: Those Paradeisos f***** have always been secretive. Outsiders don't even know where Paradeisos is. But recently, several of their people have parachuted into Eastside.

speaker: Garofano
content: They visited Nirvana, the FAC, the City Council... lots of places. You and I both know they're here to fix the mess in West District. There's no question that they're important.

speaker: Garofano
content: So we're both here to seize upon this rare chance, to use them to learn about and infiltrate Paradeisos.

speaker: Garofano
content: You forced your way into this protective mission, trying to gain her trust. How "upright" of you, FAC soldier.

speaker: Garofano
content: But no matter how hard you try, those nobles won't take their dog back to Paradeisos. To get information from those bastards, this is what you have to do...
Garofano tears open the front of Rahu's coat with the needle tip, revealing the flowery scroll inside the pocket. She takes it out.

speaker: Garofano
content: This is a <color=#fb9259>notice letter</color>, sent to every Paradeisos person on my hunting list in advance. They're smart and know at first glance that it's not a death threat, but a <color=#fb9259>lifeline</color>.

speaker: Garofano
content: The puzzles aren't difficult. They all know what I want, and will tell me if they want to live. I've clearly laid out the deal: Give me the information, and I'll spare your life. Can you guess if they told me or not?

speaker: Rahu
content: There are bound to be those who don't know anything, and there are also many innocent people around them. But you didn't spare them either...

speaker: Garofano
content: That's right! Isn't this the <color=#fb9259>necessary sacrifice</color>? They will surely understand. It's the only way to fully appreciate the gravity of this <color=#fb9259>opportunity</color>. There are bound to be those who will spill the beans, and some already have.

speaker: Garofano
content: This is the right way to use this opportunity. This is true revenge. I'm willing to give up everything and burn in hell. What about you, the upright FAC?

speaker: Garofano
content: It's been ten years. What have you accomplished aside from acquiring your power and getting close to a useless Paradeisos woman?
The toxins magnify the shock and confusion in Rahu's heart. She pants heavily, both from pain and excitement, and starts laughing.

speaker: Rahu
content: Ha... hahaha... there's still you, isn't there?

speaker: Rahu
content: I don't need to betray the FAC. I can just rip open your mouth and get everything I want!

Her smoldering Mania suddenly erupts. Roaring, Rahu leaps up and sprints forth with the needles still protruding from her. She grabs Garofano by the neck and rams her into the wall with all her strength.
Almost simultaneously, the sheer force of her Mania triggers the alarm. The harsh sirens ring throughout the villa, and someone fires a shot.

speaker: Security Chief
content: Sinner!! Let go of that woman! You've lost control already! Stop right now!!!

speaker: Security Chief
content: If you don't surrender, we'll shoot!
The sniper bullet pierces through the window and whizzes towards Rahu's temple. She instinctively blocks it with her shield, loosening her grip on the enemy.

speaker: Garofano
content: Ha... Hahahaha... What amazing power... Your Mania even triggered the alarm. They'll treat you like a monster now.

speaker: Garofano
content: Will the FAC still want you the way you are now? Will they kill you? Hahaha...

With her last bit of strength, she reaches out to touch Rahu's cheek and peels off her mask. Bright red Mania burn marks sear the soldier's face in an instant. Rahu roars, lets go of her and stumbles backward, covering her face.

speaker: Garofano
content: I've long completed my revenge. Somebody put an end to my hatred, soothing the rage and emptiness in my heart. I have a new family, a new life. I've received salvation.

speaker: Garofano
content: I wanted to bring you back too, but it seems that not all exploited souls can become family... You make me cherish the only treasure I have even more...

speaker: Garofano
content: I won't let anyone hurt my possessions again. I won't spare you, or the people you want to use us to please.

speaker: Garofano
content: I gave up everything to seek revenge, and now, I will double down on defending my future. How can you, who have nothing, win against me? You're an abandoned dog that does nothing but bark blindly.

speaker: Rahu
content: Come out!!!
Rahu roars and tries to break through the invisible vortex of madness to find her enemy. But more bullets pelt the dilapidated house, and Mania sweeps through her body.
She can no longer find her way back. Only the woman's delicate voice lingers in her ears.

speaker: Garofano
content: Go ahead and wallow in the past with your stubbornness.
The frenzied Sinner smashes open the back door and rushes into the rain. She might've fought off some people along the way, but everything is a blur and she can't remember clearly.
A covert assassination spirals into chaos as an S-Class Sinner goes manic. Back-up is bound to arrive shortly, and this situation can't be sidelined any longer.
Time is running out. Rahu can't make any better decisions. Her consciousness is sucked into the abyss.

speaker: Solemn Voice
content: Mania follows no rules—it distorts all rules, and is beyond human understanding. Thus, it cannot be defeated with logic and rationality. It destroys not only the body, but also the mind. Everyone experiences doubt, fear and confusion, and everyone has their weak spots.

speaker: Solemn Voice
content: The FAC has few weapons to deal with Mania. The most effective one is <color=#fb9259>loyalty</color>. Cast aside your doubts, obey your orders, and trust your superiors and the city-state as much as you believe in victory.

speaker: Solemn Voice
content: The only thing that can stand against Mania is unwavering conviction, whether that be stubbornness or stupidity. Let us devote our lives to fighting it. Let us build DisCity's last barricade.
But in the end, they didn't die where they should have...

speaker: Nauseating Voice
content: A-are you sure you want these? This isn't a trick to bait me out and arrest us, is it?

speaker: Nauseating Voice
content: It-it did make a lot of people stronger, but it also turned some into monsters. I can't guarantee its safety...
Ha... If you want me to do nothing and endure this like a zombie... then I'd rather turn into a monster.

speaker: Aloof Voice
content: You have defended the loftiest values with your lives. You are loyal knights. You are the greatest barricade.

speaker: Aloof Voice
content: But it all ends here. Don't go on further. Don't doubt anything. Get ready to fulfill your next order.

speaker: Aloof Voice
content: That's the meaning of loyalty. That's the meaning of your existence. You've won your compliments. That's it. Don't cross the line.
Save your sophistry! You don't care about her loyalty. As long as you live, her soul will never know peace!

speaker: Nostalgic Voice
content: What is this about again? Your rebellious phase seems to have no end and everything is wrong in your eyes. Is the world really that doomed? Ah, perhaps a little.

speaker: Nostalgic Voice
content: ...A bright future is indeed not guaranteed. Humans haven't had the best luck since Nightfall. But Rahu, even on the darkest night, there are stars. I've found mine. One day, you'll find yours too.

speaker: Nostalgic Voice
content: When you look up at it, you'll find the strength to keep running. And keeping yourself running is the meaning of life.
But you died for nothing. They've taken away the meaning of your death.

speaker: Raven
content: Yes, she died for nothing, but did she really die for Paradeisos?

speaker: Rahu
content: Didn't she die for you?

speaker: Varna
content: A vehicle... Rahu, look, a vehicle over there! Get in and start it up, I'll hold off these monsters! Don't die here!

speaker: Rahu
content: Do you wanna die then? You're an officer, you should live! Move, I'll handle this!

speaker: Varna
content: Get in! This is an order!

speaker: Rahu
content: No!!!

She tries to resist but the brawny FAC captain grabs her armor and flings her into the cockpit. The captain slams on the switch and the door is locked. The tides of DisSea crash near and the Corruptors press her onto the glass window instantly, tearing up her armor.
Rahu's sanity was torn from her as she rushed up to the glass, but all she could see was Varna's face twisted in agony. The soldier's body gradually slipped down.

speaker: Rahu
content: Ahh... No!! Open the door!!!

speaker: Varna
content: I... recruited you... I ought to... protect you till the end...

speaker: Varna
content: Go... Go now...

speaker: Rahu
content: No, you're wrong, you should have... let me protect you... I...

speaker: Rahu
content: She pushes you into the lifeboat and dies alone in the mouths of the monsters.

speaker: Varna
content: Protect... yourself...

speaker: Rahu
content: She was the noble FAC warrior. She didn't die fighting for her own wish. She died for you. You stripped her death of meaning, so you're responsible for rectifying everything.

speaker: Rahu
content: Avenge her. Find out who put her on this path. Find the people behind 05257885 and make them pay with their own lives.

speaker: Rahu
content: You didn't fulfill your duty when she was still alive. Now she's dead, it's time to realize your promise.

speaker: Rahu
content: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!
Her consciousness burns with pain. Finally, she smashes against the thick glass, growling.
The glass shatters and the chaotic scene in Rahu's sight cracks up gradually. The rain spatters in and she hears a faint mechanical noise.
Beep... Beep beep...
Turn off attack mode. She's an ally.
A blurry figure gradually approaches, carrying a floral scent that repels Rahu.

speaker: Shalom
content: Such an intense Mania reaction. Where's your face mask? It would have lessened the pain.

speaker: Rahu
content: Get lost... You bastard... Don't you dare come near me...

speaker: Shalom
content: Your sanity barely remains. You took the most extreme route to obtain Sinner power, didn't you?

speaker: Shalom
content: Mania Crystal? Or intentional contact with contamination?
She picks up the floral letter on the ground and reads the decoded numbers aloud.

speaker: Shalom
content: 05257885... I see, that's why you've approached me. Are you looking for the people behind this number?

speaker: Shalom
content: Doesn't seem like it's working out. You're getting nowhere with only this.

speaker: Shalom
content: Come with me, Rahu. You're getting soaked in the rain.
Shalom moves closer to Rahu with an umbrella, meaning to keep her from the rain. But as soon as she takes a step forward, the massive shield is flung and with a smack...
The approaching umbrella almost springs off and the rain instantly shrouds both of them. Mania has long crept onto Rahu's cheeks and slithered into her eyes.

speaker: Rahu
content: Piss off... You scum from Paradeisos, it's all because of you... she...

speaker: Rahu
content: Who the hell are you? Get away from me... People like you, people from Paradeisos...

Shalom's forearm is lightly bruised and her shirt is spattered with mud and drenched in rain. But she doesn't hurry to hide from the rain, doesn't so much as shift her gaze, and keeps staring at Rahu silently.
After a moment, Rahu hears that soft voice again.
Rahu hears a barely audible snicker.

speaker: Shalom
content: I know.

speaker: Shalom
content: Protecting me isn't part of your FAC mission. You only approached me to get close to Paradeisos, for your revenge.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're a terrible actress.

speaker: Rahu
content: Hmm...
She tries hard to lift her head to take a good look at this "stranger", but the woman is towering over her, peering down at her.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're a failure of the FAC and a lost avenger. You've forgotten who you are. I'll tell you who you are.

speaker: Shalom
content: You were once the most loyal knight, but you lost your master and became an ownerless stray.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're utterly disoriented and simply rampaging blindly in the dark. All you do is growl and rage and that has gotten you nothing.
The woman from Paradeisos talks languidly. Her words are gentle like drizzle, but they fall chillingly on Rahu as icicles.

speaker: Rahu
content: Stop... Shut up...

speaker: Shalom
content: You act recklessly based on your naive imagination of Paradeisos. You think if you prove your strength and snatch all the achievements, you'll be needed and recognized. That's why you've ended up turning yourself into this.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're wrong. Paradeisos has never needed power, but <color=#fb9259>tools</color>. Reliable, handy tools they can use to resist Mania safely. What's the point of sneaking up behind us if you don't even know that?

speaker: Shalom
content: Power drives you to take the risks, and your remarkable achievements are a result of your rebellious streak. Your edges are too sharp, you're bound to be ill-fitted in any machine you don't approve of.

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't you see how pathetic you are? All you do is prove how unqualified you are to Paradeisos.

speaker: Rahu
content: Then just kill me! Like you did my comrades!

speaker: Shalom
content: Your comrades were much more outstanding and reliable than you. The FAC is deeply trusted, and they were the most loyal tools.

speaker: Rahu
content: You...!

speaker: Shalom
content: As for you... No one's gonna kill you. You've pushed yourself into a dead-end. In the end, you've avenged no one and achieved nothing. You've simply made yourself a living joke.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Ahhh!
Rage and Mania erupt simultaneously. Furious, Rahu gets up and charges at her, but she's lost control over her own body, just as the woman has said.

Shalom folds up the umbrella and points its tip on Rahu's shoulder, ever so lightly but enough to keep her down. The burning Blue Rain drips and scalds the freshly pierced wound on Rahu, but also wakes her slowly.

speaker: Shalom
content: Calm down. Tame the storm in your body and take a good look...

speaker: Shalom
content: Am I your enemy?

Pain sears her shoulder, but also clears the scarlet in her sight. Rahu's vision refocuses and she can gradually make out the woman before her. Her slender and frail figure looks as though it can be fractured by the drizzle any second.

On her bare skin, scarlet scorch marks emerge vividly among the abundant scars. Compared to Rahu's, the woman's scorch marks are evidently weaker. Ashen-faced, she seems to be on the edge of endurance.

speaker: Rahu
content: Just like mine... Are you also... a Sinner?

speaker: Security Chief
content: You're pushing it too far! The lady's from Paradeisos. How can we let a Sinner go near her? Their attitude towards Mania is crystal clear!

speaker: Shalom
content: Times are changing. I lack the ability to protect myself, so I am very glad that you're here.

speaker: Rahu
content: No power, no background, a frail body, and not even a family member to seek help from... That's why Paradeisos "chose" her. No one will care if she dies.

speaker: Rahu
content: That's why they banished you...

speaker: Shalom
content: Not banished. Used. In Paradeisos, to be used means to be trusted.

speaker: Shalom
content: My power is not as strong as yours, but I've accomplished every mission assigned to me. As a Sinner, I've won their trust.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...As bait?

speaker: Shalom
content: As a tool.

speaker: Shalom
content: As insignificant as me, I'm an excellent tool now... I can open up a genuine path into Paradeisos for you.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Be my tool, let them use you and trust you through me. I'll be your way into Paradeisos.

speaker: Rahu
content: What are you talking about... I want revenge, I... I can't take orders from you, I...
The woman from Paradeisos peers down at her, a faint glint of pity flickers in her eyes.

speaker: Shalom
content: You've done your best. You've resisted fearlessly and fought against the tide, pushing limits. Finally, you've made your way to me. Good job... From now on, just leave it to me.

speaker: Shalom
content: Be it revenge or relief, I can take you anywhere you want and grant your wish. On only one condition...

speaker: Shalom
content: Keep your head clear and protect me. You're a knight, protect me like you did those you once served.

speaker: Shalom
content: Never be lost again.

speaker: Rahu
content: I don't understand, why...
A brief silence. Amid the pitter-patter of the rain, Rahu catches a soft, low murmur.

speaker: Shalom
content: <size=30>Fate is ruthless. Lost one who treads against all... may you...</size>

speaker: Rahu
content: What are you saying...
Rahu tried to discern her expression, but her face remained impassive, almost like sculpted wax. The words, barely audible to begin with, were finally lost amidst the patter of rain.

speaker: Shalom
content: A tool doesn't ask questions. Just do as I say.
The Blue Rain falls on her hands. Her umbrella-gripping hand begins to lower, gradually reaching the level of Rahu's chest.

speaker: Shalom
content: Stand up and make your choice. This is your only chance.

The rain drenches her vibrant red hair and trickles down her eyelids. The Mania reaction it triggers keeps spreading and the scorch mark grows brighter and brighter, yet the woman doesn't bat an eye. She stares straight at Rahu, her gaze deep as a dark pool.

speaker: Shalom
content: The one you're to protect is hurting.

speaker: Shalom
content: What should you do?
Can I trust her? What does she want? Why is she helping me?

A storm of chaotic thoughts sweeps past Rahu's brain and she struggles to find a firm answer. But as if her body has its own mind, her hand reaches out to the umbrella. The Blue Rain hits her bare skin, but the pain wakes her up.
Finally, Rahu takes the umbrella, opens it, and takes a step toward the woman.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...I've only ever wanted to serve one person. And she's no longer alive.

speaker: Rahu
content: But I need you to realize your promise. I... forbid you from dying.

speaker: Shalom
content: With your protection, I'm not dying anytime soon. Rest assured.

speaker: Shalom
content: This time, you can do it.

speaker: Varna
content: Keep running, Rahu. Keeping running, that's the meaning of life.

10:30, July 23, N.F. 113
Shalom's Home, Erica Villa, Eastside
It was a dreamless night. A soft floral scent wakes Rahu from her sleep.
She opens her eyes and sees the woman close by, fiddling with the flowers beside the headboard. She removes some bandages and wraps the wound up again with new ones.

speaker: Shalom
content: Did I wake you?

speaker: Rahu
content: ...How are you feeling? You were drenched in rain last night, and... I can't recall, did I attack you last night?

speaker: Shalom
content: I'm fine. Your injuries are worse.

speaker: Shalom
content: You were unconscious the whole night after we came back. They're all worried something bad happened to the FAC elite.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm fine. I just slept hard.

speaker: Shalom
content: Get up then if you feel better.

speaker: Shalom
content: You came all guns blazing yesterday. Don't tell me you wanna slack off now?
Rahu doesn't get up right away. She slumps into the warm bed and spends a moment separating reality from dream.

speaker: Rahu
content: Nothing, I'm only a little surprised.

speaker: Rahu
content: I feel like I hadn't slept so soundly in a long time...
Shalom smiles. She draws the curtains open and sunlight instantly fills the bedroom.

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't sleep in. Time waits for no one. Come on, we've got important things to do.

13:00, July 23, N.F. 113
 Erica Villa, Eastside

speaker: Weather Forecast
content: The current Blue Rain decontamination is drawing to an end. The city's contamination index has stabilized. Rainfall is dwindling progressively and will terminate completely in two hours, after which all city services will resume.

speaker: Weather Forecast
content: Thank you for your support for the city. Have a happy weekend.
Drizzle refracts sunlight on the flower trail. There are few passersby, among which the two women walking one after another with their umbrellas are attracting all the gazes.

speaker: Rahu
content: This is the important matter you talked about?

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes. I haven't gone outside for a while. Did some research on Eastside fashion. I'd say I'm quite satisfied with these two outfits.

speaker: Shalom
content: I hope the shirt doesn't feel too formal? Undo a few buttons. I bet it'll look even better.

speaker: Shalom
content: Hey, quit looking so stiff. Relax, or someone may see through our disguises.

speaker: Rahu
content: You call this a disguise?

A passerby recognizes Shalom. He starts coming over cheerfully for a chat, but decides against it the second he sees Rahu's face behind her. In the end, he simply takes off his hat to return Shalom's greeting.
Seeing her smiley face, Rahu sighs.

speaker: Rahu
content: You said you'd take me to Paradeisos. I don't see how this is helping.

speaker: Shalom
content: And yet, you're here. Haste makes waste. We must wait for a chance.

speaker: Rahu
content: I don't have my usual weapon with me. If something goes wrong, I can't guarantee I can settle it with a gun.

speaker: Shalom
content: Nothing's gonna go wrong. Trust me.

speaker: Shalom
content: I've been to the scene. That woman was pretty badly injured too last night. Without a healing ability like yours, she can only act discreetly before the Blue Rain stops completely.

speaker: Shalom
content: Paradeisos is after her. I should have been the one to lure her out, but since you interrupted forcefully and injured her like that...

speaker: Shalom
content: I can only hope she didn't get too demoralized and run away.

speaker: Rahu
content: So it's my fault?

speaker: Shalom
content: Haha, of course not. You've brought back some useful intelligence. Now, we can finally take action.
Before blacking out last night, Rahu told Shalom everything she knew. Garofano's own words as well as everything unusual Rahu had noticed.
The assassin had been completely ignorant about Rahu the first two times they fought. But by the third time, she seemed to have grasped the entire history of the FAC warrior.

speaker: Rahu
content: The woman is highly dependent on external intelligence. My guess is that between the attack on the 21st and the morning of the 23rd, she must have touched base with her source.

speaker: Rahu
content: Could it be the boss of their group?

speaker: Shalom
content: If that reckless assassin group had that kind of intelligence power, it wouldn't have survived till now. They're merely somebody else's knives.

speaker: Shalom
content: There's a secret assassin group in Eastside founded by a Mania power from the Underground. It preys on pitiful Sinners, takes advantage of their hatred, and turns them into knives aiming at DisCity.
Rahu thinks of Garofano.

speaker: Shalom
content: The power behind these women is hard to tackle. Their discreetness grows with their influence. It's their habit to use hired knives, sharpened with Mania.

speaker: Shalom
content: The recent assassinations targeting those in Paradeisos were their doing too. The individual assassins are not Paradeisos's real enemy, these people are. And Paradeisos seeks to eradicate them at all costs.

speaker: Rahu
content: And are you part of the costs too?
Shalom laughs, and her face seems to say, Paradeisos is not as you imagine.

speaker: Shalom
content: The range you specified was precise. The 9th Agency's agents have begun tracking. I suppose we'll hear from them soon.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...What else?

speaker: Rahu
content: I saw a team of unfamiliar faces sneak into your villa, the MBCC's arrest team. Did you arrange that too?

speaker: Rahu
content: Where did you find these people? Are you setting up a trap in your own house to catch Garofano?

speaker: Shalom
content: Good observation.
She flicks the leaf of a flower growing on the side of the trail. The dew spatters onto her hand, leaving faint red marks.

speaker: Rahu
content: I hear that the organization is in turmoil now and is no longer capable of arresting Sinners.

speaker: Shalom
content: They've lost their director and several inmates are on the loose, so morale is at its bottom. Our operation is likely to succeed. It'll give a boost to their spirits if they can catch the target. They'll surely appreciate this cooperation.

speaker: Shalom
content: You can seize this chance to make some friends. They may just come in handy.

speaker: Rahu
content: Assuming that the operation is a success and that you can really catch her.

speaker: Shalom
content: We will. You've confirmed the assassin's identity for me. More importantly, we now know that Sinner named Garofano is highly attached to her group and the boss. This is good.

speaker: Shalom
content: I've prepared some good stuff that has to do with her boss. If she indeed loves her family, she'll show up. Now is the best time since you're away. She'll lower her guard and walk into the trap.

speaker: Rahu
content: She doesn't come across as that dumb to me.

speaker: Shalom
content: But she's the type to lose her cool once she starts caring. That's why she's accepted such an ambitious request and wants to rope you in. You, a fellow avenger. She's quite sentimental, probably even hiding the truth from her friends.

speaker: Shalom
content: Once we've got her, we'll grill her and decide what to do.

speaker: Shalom
content: If everything goes as planned, you're coming back to Paradeisos with me.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...A bona fide Paradeisos local, always scheming ten steps ahead.

speaker: Shalom
content: Be glad. All this scheming is helping you because I'm on your side. Now you don't have to do what you're poor at.

speaker: Rahu
content: And what are we doing here, according to your plan?

speaker: Shalom
content: Well, we still have a little free time before catching the assassin. Take a walk with me.

speaker: Shalom
content: You dream about going to Paradeisos, but for me, I cherish my time here more.

The two stroll into a small park. Seasonal flowers are in full bloom all over the park, especially vibrant and fresh having been cleansed by the drizzle. Sunlight pours down and glazes them with a pearlescent shine.
Shalom halts all her informative talks and walks into the flowering shrubs, never turning her gaze away from the flowers again. She's smiling and seems genuinely in a mellow mood.

speaker: Shalom
content: Once we get back in Paradeisos, I won't get to see flowers like these again.

speaker: Rahu
content: People send you bouquets all the time. Isn't your house piled with flowers already?

speaker: Shalom
content: Those are different. What I admire are lives like these. Lives that grow and die naturally, never at anyone's mercy.

speaker: Shalom
content: Firmly rooted in the soil and facing the sun and rain openly, they live arduously but eagerly on their own terms. Doomed to wither, they bloom fearlessly. Each has its unique color and embraces death with its immense beauty.

speaker: Rahu
content: You can grow your own.

speaker: Shalom
content: I don't have a gift for that. Any flower touched by these hands wilts soon.
Rahu falls silent for a moment.

speaker: Rahu
content: These flowers were only transplanted here temporarily. They'll be replaced once they're out of bloom to suit the taste of the rich in the villa. The rain is artificial too, a decontamination measure of the city. There's nothing natural or free about either of them.

speaker: Rahu
content: But I don't see how they're different from this thing you care so much about. You think that a picked flower becomes a mere decoration. But the way I see it, even if a flower is uprooted and cut, wherever it's brought to, it's still living its life on its own terms.

speaker: Rahu
content: A flower doesn't bloom to be looked at.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're right.
Shalom folds up the umbrella. She tilts her head back and lets the sheer Blue Rain tint her. Her face blushes faint red as it reacts with Mania.

speaker: Rahu
content: Hey!

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't worry, I'm not as vulnerable as you think.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're right. What matters most is that we get to see the rare sun shower, and...
She reaches out to catch the glistening, hazy rain. In her blurry vision, Rahu sees a faint gleam slip into her palm.

speaker: Shalom
content: Look, a rainbow.

speaker: Maid
content: Miss Shalom. Just as you said, the assassin came back. The new security guards have subdued her and we're all waiting for you to come back. There's just this one thing...

speaker: Maid
content: Just a moment ago, another strange visitor appeared. He demanded to see you as soon as possible, and he said...

speaker: Maid
content: He's brought news from Paradeisos.

17:10, July 23, N.F. 113
Shalom's Home, Erica Villa, Eastside

speaker: MBCC Arrest Team Captain
content: Sinner Garofano has been subdued. Rating: A-Class. Her condition is not good. She's unconscious and her M-value fluctuates significantly.

speaker: MBCC Arrest Team Captain
content: Given the special situation, with permission from the 9th Agency or the FAC, you will be granted provisional supervision and interrogation rights. But currently, there are no effective measures to control her Mania, so please beware.

speaker: Authoritative Man
content: I'll follow up the procedures with the 9th Agency. For now, this Sinner will be transferred to Paradeisos for management. Once she wakes up, I'll finish the interrogation.

speaker: Authoritative Man
content: You may leave.
The MBCC team nods and exits silently. As soon as no other outsiders remain in the room, the authoritative man turns to the two who've just returned.

speaker: Authoritative Man
content: You should have stayed here, Shalom.

speaker: Authoritative Man
content: What happened?

speaker: Shalom
content: The plan was to lure the attacker out. I have indeed accomplished it, though in a different way. When the situation changes, the plan follows, no?
She says as she placidly takes off her hat and sunglasses and places them on top of a chest on the side, diverting the man's gaze from Rahu.

speaker: Shalom
content: Your sudden appearance surprises me more, <color=#7683a2>Liaison Officer</color>. Is there a new order?

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: Paradeisos wants to confirm if you've completed your task. Things have changed over there. They have a new mission for you.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: Get ready and tend to your injuries. We leave tonight.

speaker: Shalom
content: I still have a few words for Miss Garofano. Is it urgent?

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: I'll finish the interrogation for you. It's a highly urgent assignment. Be prepared to go all out this time.
Shalom is silent for a second.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...I see. Meaning the possibility of death is high. When I die, who's gonna take over? Have you found my <color=#fb9259>replacement</color>?

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: We'll see to that soon. As I said, this is an urgent matter.
As he speaks, the Liaison Officer takes a step toward Shalom but is stopped by someone. It's Rahu.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...This damned familiar taste of rigidity, arrogance, indifference, and disregard. Good old Paradeisos.

Without the face mask's protection, the taste instantly recalls the distant nightmare. A tornado of emotions seizes her, hatred, anger, and pain gnawing at Rahu's sanity. If she had her shields, she would already be wielding them furiously.

speaker: Rahu
content: I've received an order to protect this woman.

speaker: Rahu
content: I can't just stand back and watch when her life's being threatened.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: ...FAC, Special Task Force, Sinner Rahu.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: She should be on the BR-002 mission in West District now. Why is she here?

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: Shalom, your mission is to be the bait. Bait shouldn't need protection. It contradicts the purpose of the plan. Why did you recruit her?
She shifts the side of her body and slots herself between the Liaison Officer and Rahu.

speaker: Shalom
content: You need not worry. It's all for the plan. I am fully aware of the importance of the new mission. Even if the chance of success is slim and I'll likely die, I'm all ready.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's a shame though. We've made huge progress on the other mission. Besides that Sinner assassin, we've also traced her source of intelligence. If we keep digging, I suppose... we may be able to locate the entrance of the Underground.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: What...!

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes, we're at a critical point and the same chance may not come again. If I die, the clue may be lost before my replacement takes over.

speaker: Shalom
content: What would be your decision, Liaison Officer?

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: Both matters require urgent attention. This is not a decision I can make, I should report it...

speaker: Shalom
content: No need. Time is scarce, and none of us here can afford to miss the chance. I have a proposal that can solve both problems.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'll accept the new mission and leave for West District immediately. After, you'll find a replacement if there's a need for one.

speaker: Shalom
content: As for the work here, you may delegate it fully to this FAC soldier.
Rahu's eyes widen, but Shalom pays no attention to her shock and simply smiles casually at the Paradeisos Liaison Officer.

speaker: Shalom
content: This FAC soldier has performed splendidly as my bodyguard. She is reliable and capable of serving Paradeisos in my stead. I won't say she outshines me in all aspects, but in some, she can certainly do a better job than I can.

speaker: Shalom
content: The 9th Agency's investigation will yield results soon, and you should let her follow it up. If we're lucky, we'll find the Underground's entrance in no time.

speaker: Shalom
content: The Shepherd's location is now unknown, but the Underground's threat is intensifying. Paradeisos could use more reliable Sinners.
It sounds like a tempting offer. The Liaison Officer has clearly taken the bait and is mulling it over.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: ...It's worth trying.

speaker: Shalom
content: In that case, I'll leave Garofano's interrogation to you.
The Liaison Officer nods and leaves, seeming to agree that time is not on their side. When Rahu and Shalom are left alone in the room, Shalom finally turns to smile at Rahu.

speaker: Shalom
content: See, thanks to me, you're only a step away from Paradeisos.

speaker: Rahu
content: And must I watch you die too?
Shalom smiled, a hint of resignation in her eyes.

speaker: Shalom
content: Only you'd care about a tool's death, which means you're not qualified to be a tool yet. Don't waste the chance I've given you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Didn't you swear to infiltrate Paradeisos and fulfill your mission? Know your priorities and focus on your duties. Paradeisos doesn't need weak minds.

speaker: Shalom
content: Or am I more important than your one and only master? You'd give up your revenge plan for me?

speaker: Rahu
content: Stop joking.

The mention of Varna only reminds Rahu of her dying face. She should have protected Varna, but Varna sacrificed her life to save Rahu instead. What a joke. And somehow she recalls that at this juncture.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Don't get the wrong idea. This is a test you must complete. You shouldn't waste more time here.

speaker: Shalom
content: Accomplish your mission. Find the patron and source of intelligence behind this series of attacks, follow the clues, and uncover everything about the Underground. Whatever happens, keep moving and don't look back.

speaker: Shalom
content: Only when you serve as a good tool, find them what they need, and enter Paradeisos, the plan I mapped out for you can be considered a success.

speaker: Rahu
content: But what about you...

speaker: Shalom
content: I did recruit you as my bodyguard to avoid getting hurt or killed. But in the long run, my fate is always held in the hands of my users. Whether you're there makes no difference.

speaker: Shalom
content: So don't worry about it. Walk your own path.

speaker: Shalom
content: You've got one now.
Rahu's fists clench and relax a few times. Finally, she collects herself.

Shalom is right. Everyone has their own path. After all these years, Rahu knew very well what she should do. Her realization weighed much heavier than the slight frustration she felt at the moment. But...

speaker: Rahu
content: ...You get me. My life was torn into pieces long ago. Vengeance is the only thing that got me here. I'd give up everything for it without a second thought.

speaker: Rahu
content: Along the way, you've helped me find myself and shown me where to go.

speaker: Rahu
content: Thank you for keeping your promise. I won't let you down. The test, the mission, whatever you ask of me, I'll get them done.

speaker: Rahu
content: But I don't want a chance exchanged with somebody's life. Don't make me a laughing stock again.
She took a half step back, her expression serious, and bowed to the woman before her, in her capacity as an FAC member.

speaker: Rahu
content: You asked for my protection. Then give me a chance to realize my promise.

speaker: Rahu
content: Don't die.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...You'll have it.

speaker: Weather Forecast
content: With the recent changes in West District, a new wave of Mania Flux is expanding and the FAC has launched another emergency Blue Rain decontamination program that is expected to last 3 days.

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: I got the transfer order. What is this about? You're getting transferred? Where? Paradeisos? Did you really approach them by yourself?!

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: You can't get back at them alone and so recklessly. You're gonna get yourself killed!

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: We'll work out something together. I'll help you this time. Come back! Instructor and everyone wants you to be alive and well, not dead!

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: Please, you're my last comrade, Rahu!

speaker: Shalom
content: Accomplish your mission. Find the patron and source of intelligence behind this series of attacks, follow the clues, and uncover everything about the Underground. Whatever happens, keep moving and don't look back.

speaker: Shalom
content: Walk your own path. You've got one now.

speaker: Rahu
content: Conrad.

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: ...Yes?

speaker: Rahu
content: Thanks. Without you, I'd have already died a thousand times. You gave a home to a mad stray like me.

speaker: Rahu
content: In the coming days, visit the graves of everyone on my behalf.

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: ...What do you mean? Are you going on some suicide mission?

speaker: Rahu
content: No, no suicide missions for me anymore. The path before me is no longer dark. I know clearly what I must do from now on.

speaker: Rahu
content: Take care of yourself, brother. When it's all over, I still wanna come home.

speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
content: Rahu?! Hey! Rahu!!
Rahu hung up the phone. Reflecting on her past self, she found it somewhat amusing. If Varna were here, she would undoubtedly tease her even more relentlessly.
Perhaps she should visit her later. Being preoccupied with thoughts of revenge, it has been a long time since she last went to the cemetery.
Rahu mounts her motorbike, and disappears into the Blue Rain.
This is a hidden basement in Eastside. The interior is installed with many invisible traps. They are not the usual physical mechanisms, but some kind of sinister, occult sorcery.
According to the 9th Agency, this is the evil means employed by the <color=#fb9259>Underground Mania power</color>.

speaker: 9th Agency Agent
content: Expect the worst contamination. It'll be too intense on a Sinner. You'd better wait for reinforcements.

speaker: Rahu
content: I can't wait any longer. The enemy may destroy the evidence anytime now.

speaker: Rahu
content: I fought against a similar force not long ago. That Sinner used the same power. I'm certain this is where she got her sorcery from.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'll be breaking through and cleaning things up. Please cover me.
Rahu confirms the location of the suspicious room where a glimmer still flickers. She readies her weapon, steadies her breathing and mood. This kind of battle isn't even worth mentioning in the FAC.
Charge!

The defenses were more stringent than expected, indicating that this place held significant importance to the enemy. Yet, Rahu succeeded. When she penetrated the target location, it was eerily silent inside.
A figure in black has collapsed on the floor. A woman in purple stands next to him, a long umbrella in her drooping hand. A viscous liquid drips off its tip, giving off the stench of death.
The collapsed man is clad in a black raincoat, seeming to have been impaled by the umbrella defenselessly. A familiar single-eyed rune is branded on his palm.
The woman stares down blankly at the man slumped next to her heels. She only turns slowly to Rahu a while after she's barged in.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: ...Such intense power. You're the FAC Sinner, the one who defeated Garofano.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Too bad, you came too late.
Rahu glances at the figure in black, and readies her sword-shield.

speaker: Rahu
content: That's Garofano's patron. Did you do that to shut him up?

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Patron? More like a swindler.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Garofano didn't care about bounties, she only wanted to stop Paradeisos from harming us. These scum targeted her impatience. She was baited by fake intelligence and went ahead to challenge Paradeisos on her own.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: We're merely wilting flowers that got lumped together, yet she treated us as family and even went that far for us. Ha...

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Garofano, we've gotten rid of the vermin that deceived and used you. We'll come and save you, until then, don't try anything stupid...
Bang! With a sharp blow, Rahu subdues the sorrowful assassin. When her shield collides with the umbrella, she realizes it's a hefty metal umbrella. Of course, this woman is a Sinner too.

speaker: Rahu
content: Stop talking in riddles. Explain what happened.

speaker: Rahu
content: Attacking Erica Villa, spreading Mania contamination, injuring many... She acted as the Mania merchant's knife. Her crimes cannot be pardoned simply because she was used.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Ha... Listen to your pretty talk, Paradeisos's lapdog.
With the flickering light from the monitor screen, Rahu finally makes out the woman's face. Her eyes are hollow as ashes, her face streaked with stubborn tear stains.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: You have eyes like ours. I bet you've had someone important in your life.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: After struggling in the dark for years, you met the only light in your life. You'd never dreamed that he would appear, but he did.
female_content: After struggling in the dark for years, you met the only light in your life. You'd never dreamed that she would appear, but she did.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: But you do, in your head.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Whose image are you seeing in your mind? Who do you get courage and strength from?

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: You thank him, cherish him, would give up everything for him, even your life. Whenever you think of him, you no longer feel lost. Do you have that person in mind?
female_content: You thank her, cherish her, would give up everything for her, even your life. Whenever you think of her, you no longer feel lost. Do you have that person in mind?

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: ...Now think about someone taking him away from you!
female_content: ...Now think about someone taking her away from you!

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Somewhere you don't know, your cherished one is being mercilessly used and ruined. You don't know whether he's dead or alive. Before you're aware, you've lost him forever, without even a chance to fight for him.
female_content: Somewhere you don't know, your cherished one is being mercilessly used and ruined. You don't know whether she's dead or alive. Before you're aware, you've lost her forever, without even a chance to fight for her.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Imagine it. Experience it once more. And you'll understand how I feel.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: Paradeisos is the reason why we're exploited and destroyed repeatedly, like we don't matter.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: You have eyes like ours. Then why are you still on their side?!
The woman shouts as she draws a compact weapon with one hand and throws it at Rahu. Rahu dodges narrowly and as she's about to strike back, she notices the enemy's body mutating.
The assassin's body is emitting faint red spikes of light. The luminous spikes are intertwined with filthy contamination. Mania. The sight is so ominous that even Rahu dares not get close.

The woman in purple is suffering in pain, yet she doesn't resist or loathe the luminous spikes. Instead, she lifts her hand to touch them. Soon, the spikes shatter and only sorrow remains on the woman's face.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: ...Fine, I don't have a reason to fight you. Just cut me some slack, don't make me wreck this place. The intelligence here is crucial to you. Take a close look, you won't wanna miss anything.

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: When you're back, tell your owner...

speaker: Shadow Assassin
content: "The bloom season's here. The Mentor is off to the banquet... just as you wish."

She disappears into the darkness, but the vehement words remain. Rahu tried to restrain those bad thoughts and focus on the current mission. While she waited for the contamination cleanup team to process the scene, she checked all the intel she could reach at hand.
The documents look like communication records, some encoded, others clear. Rahu mentally notes to be wary of traps as she dives into the details.

Many of the records focus on the tactics for the West District. Rahu isn't too invested in what's happening there, and she's not quite getting the bigger picture yet. She's only sure that the Underground has retreated to the West District to get a hold of BR-002, but the comeback of the Black Ring has thrown a wrench in their plans.

P: They're playing with the Rustfire again, stoking that Corpus, and are willing to give up their one "shackle" just to pull us back in. Feels just like 8 years ago; they're in a hurry.


H: That doesn't mean we're ahead. What's more intriguing than their endgame are the tricks up their sleeves.


H: Paradeisos's never been one for grand shows of manipulation. It doesn't fit their M.O. Cutting to the chase...

H: They're using Sinners, harnessing the strength of Mania in ways we didn't see coming.


P: You mean that knockoff?


S: Way before him. By N.F. 103 at the latest, they already rolled out this tech in the field. The "blossoms" I've raised are proof of that.


S: Back in N.F. 103, Paradeisos broke through the Primary Black Ring, sending orders to scores of folks in the DisSea. Their Hypercubes can't pull that off; it's got to be the deep Mania.
female_content:
H: They're using Sinners, harnessing the strength of Mania in ways we didn't see coming.


P: You mean that knockoff?


S: Way before her. By N.F. 103 at the latest, they already rolled out this tech in the field. The "blossoms" I've raised are proof of that.


S: Back in N.F. 103, Paradeisos broke through the Primary Black Ring, sending orders to scores of folks in the DisSea. Their Hypercubes can't pull that off; it's got to be the deep Mania.

content:
P: ****, huh... That should simplify things. Can your little **** find these folks? And take her out?


S: Hah. I get that we're short-staffed, but a little "help" on your end would be nice...

Rahu's breath quickens. The cryptic messages multiply, each with its unique meaning, and none boded well. She constantly tells herself that this might all be a setup, maybe even deceit. She has to keep her cool.
Right then, a new message pops up, clearing all her doubts.
S: Need backup, meet at this spot—

speaker: Rahu
content: ...This is!

23:04, July 23, N.F. 113
Shalom's Home, Erica Villa, Eastside
Inside the bedroom, Shalom opens her eyes and gets up slowly. The bandages on her have all been unwound, strewn across the bed. But all her wounds are gone as well.
Body repair always consumes a lot of stamina. Shalom feels exhausted. She rings the bell.

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes... Understood. I've just repaired my body. I've spent too much energy on it.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Yes, understood. I'll get going soon.
Outside the window wall, the Blue Rain shrouds the entire Erica Villa, falling incessantly. The person she's waiting for is not here yet.

speaker: I... I...
content: Ah—!!
With a woman's scream from downstairs, the door opens.

speaker: Maid
content: M-miss Shalom. Your clothes...

speaker: Shalom
content: Thank you.

The maid enters to help Shalom dress. She dares not close the door, but the voice keeps creeping in from downstairs, alternating among cries, curses, and hysterical laughs, reminding her of how that severe Liaison Officer from Paradeisos is interrogating the poor assassin.

Since that Liaison Officer entered the house, everything has felt different. The maid shivers uncontrollably, her fingers brushing against her employer's skin. Shalom can feel the fear underneath the icy cold.

speaker: Shalom
content: Are you scared of me? Because I'm from Paradeisos too?

speaker: Maid
content: No-no. That's your private matter. Whoever you are, whatever you do, it's not my place to judge...

speaker: Shalom
content: You seem to really need this job. Don't worry, I'm not going to fire you.

speaker: Shalom
content: I adore this mansion and your company. You've been doing an excellent job. You should stay. These frightening scenes, just pretend they're a nightmare. Take a few days off and come back to work when you feel better.

speaker: Shalom
content: Take care of my garden, Rosa. I hope the day I return, I'll find that nothing's changed here.

speaker: Maid
content: Miss Shalom... I...

speaker: Shalom
content: Alright, off you go. Or I'll be running late.
Shalom exits her room, goes downstairs, and enters the guarded basement.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: Set off if you're ready. The car is outside. I'll take over everything here.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Of course.
She glances at Garofano lying on the floor. The assassin is barely even breathing, but her eyes are still full of indignation and determination.
After brief consideration, Shalom begins.

speaker: Shalom
content: No need to coerce her further. Rahu will bring back the intelligence.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: That FAC soldier hasn't been officially recognized yet. Moreover, if she can do that, it's one more reason to kill this worthless assassin. She will be executed here.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...She's not worthless.

speaker: Shalom
content: The person behind this assassin, not her patron, but her leader, seems to value their members' lives. She'll make excellent bait.

speaker: Shalom
content: The questioning may be futile, but her boss is probably willing to meet you and exchange her with some intelligence Paradeisos could use.

speaker: Shalom
content: I got this piece of information from Rahu too, and it's yours now. Is this reason enough to keep Garofano alive?

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: ...That makes sense. I'll report...!!!
Somehow triggered by one of these sentences, Garofano opens her eyes and shoots an agonized and loathing glare at the two people peering down at her.

speaker: Garofano
content: I won't let you do that... I won't...
Garofano is clutching a single-eyed rune in her palm. She's gained immense power but also submitted completely to Mania. Filthy spikes protrude all over her body.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...So this is the last resort the Underground has granted you, tempting you to go down together with them. How stubborn.

speaker: Shalom
content: That's why they can manipulate you so thoroughly.

speaker: Garofano?
content: Keep your hands off them!

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: The Underground's sorcery?! Stand back!
But Shalom doesn't listen. She simply watches as the manic Sinner charges at her again...
A deafening crash draws the sheriffs near the house. As they check with the security chief if they should take a look inside, the front door flies open, and a silhouette bolts out.
With a heavy stench of blood and a chilling vibe, this person dashes into the downpour, vanishing into the pitch-black faster than any normal person could.
Everyone is frozen in shock. The Paradeisos Liaison Officer walks out of the mansion. He's suffered some light injuries but has returned to his usual calm self.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: A-Class Mania threat. Underground sorcery confirmed. Orders for all combatants on site: Intercept this Sinner. Do not kill her. Capture her alive!

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: Target Sinner is moving toward the northeast of the villa where her partners are. All sheriffs in the Villa, intercept her with all you've got.

speaker: Sheriff
content: But... But our job is just to protect that mansion and that woman.

speaker: Sheriff
content: The MBCC arrest team are still here, aren't they? I know they haven't gone far. They're standing by right outside the villa. You should let them handle this!

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: They're on another mission.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: Your job is to capture this frail Sinner in the villa. Don't let her escape and don't let her die.

speaker: Sheriff
content: Frail... You call that frail?
He's cut off. On the other end of the flower trail, that manic monster is charging at him. Immense fear wrecks the sheriff's sanity like a howling tempest.

speaker: Garofano?
content: Get out of my way!!
I've heard your little garden was attacked recently. Paradeisos is finally coming after you, isn't it?

speaker: Garofano
content: ...It's you, scum from the Underground...

speaker: Garofano
content: Don't drag us into your battle with Paradeisos. We're not your tools anymore.
Aha, think your hands are clean now? Paradeisos doesn't care. You'll always be an Underground rat in their eyes. They've been after you for a while now...
We founded this group. We saved you and helped you get your revenge... Your rebirth is a gift from us...

speaker: Garofano
content: No! Not you. Vengeance wasn't what saved me, my family was. I was saved by her and everyone...
And Paradeisos will wipe them out soon. Neither your boss nor your family can defend against that... One day, and you know that day is coming soon... Unless...
Let's make a deal... The administrator of Paradeisos, the one leading your eradication... He's exposed himself...
...Together, we'll find him. I'll grant you enough power to safeguard your new life.

The bullets are piercing into Garofano's body. The Mania within her lessens the impact, but can't cancel it out completely. Her senses are blurring, only the stubborn determination fueled by fear keeps her bolting.

speaker: Garofano
content: Can't... get caught again... Can't be used again...

speaker: Garofano
content: I... must not become bait and endanger them...
The Blue Rain keeps intensifying and sears the Sinner's body, but fails to slow her down.

The single-eyed rune is burning into her, feeding her power and madness. More and more contamination-packed single-eyed Corruptors are split and replicated from Garofano's body. And farther away, strange roaring sounds came from all over the villa, this place seems to become a petri dish for Mania.

speaker: Security Chief
content: And they said not to kill her... How do you even do that?! Why did they make us fight a monster like this? We're only human, it's impossible...

speaker: Security Chief
content: FAC!! Come back! Help me! Hel...
I once lost everything without warning.
My poor child, you have nothing left... Come with me, at least you'll meet others like you. You can even plan your revenge. I'll show you how...
Then I regained everything unexpectedly.

speaker: Vague Phantom
content: Are you sure I can have these beautiful clothes? Thank you! You're like my mom, Garofano! Oh... sorry, I mean sister!

speaker: Vague Phantom
content: I feel a bit embarrassed calling you big sis... You came here before I did and have taught me so much. To me, you'll always be a senior I respect from the bottom of my heart...

speaker: Vague Phantom
content: D-don't think I'd fall for your trick! Just wait, I'll be back!

speaker: Vague Phantom
content: Alright, now, no one can threaten us anymore. Severed, hushed, goodbye~

speaker: Vague Phantom
content: From today on, you can take whatever job you like, butcher whoever you need to at the price you ask for, go wherever you want. You may even leave if that suits you. You don't take orders from anyone anymore, except me.

speaker: Vague Phantom
content: Not even hatred restrains the Garden now. I give you freedom. It's your own life, squander it the way you want. As your Mentor, I permit it.
I've lived for myself... I've found my treasure...
I'd rather die than let anyone hurt them... You can dream of getting past me...

speaker: Garofano
content: Arghhhh!
A heavy blow strikes her left shoulder and sends her to the other end of the track.
It's a familiar figure. She had cleared the villa of the Mania sorcery, but the accumulated contamination had already exceeded tolerable limits.

speaker: Rahu
content: Garofano, it's you...

speaker: Rahu
content: What happened to you? Shouldn't you be in the villa? How did you escape?

speaker: Rahu
content: ...You carry the scent of her blood, what happened?

She asked, but such a question was now pointless. They were like two beasts deeply corrupted. The Mania rampaged within them, and even a greater amount of 'Blue Rain' would be just a drop in the bucket.
When everyone rushes to the park, the battle is already over.

Shattered plants lie across the park and the land is covered in Corruptor remains. A pair of heels is keeping Garofano down. Her single-eyed rune burns constantly in vain, eventually dims and dies out.

At last, only Rahu stands at the center of the battlefield. The contamination all gathers and huddles around her. Her sword-shields are hefty and sharp, and her battle uniform is covered in blood stains.

speaker: Security Chief
content: Is the assassin still alive?

speaker: Security Chief
content: Another... monster?

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Where's Shalom?
The liaison officer's brow furrowed, and quickly turned to leave. Yet, he was stopped by someone.

Shalom halts the liaison officer, not uttering a word, just gazing intently at the nearly uncontrollable beast in the midst of the Blue Rain. After a moment, she moved forward alone, stepping into the ravaged garden.

speaker: Shalom
content: Look what you did to this place... I liked this garden a lot.

speaker: Shalom
content: Why did you come back?

speaker: Shalom
content: Didn't I tell you to accomplish your mission and not look back no matter what?

The Blue Rain and contamination stir her senses alternately. They can't see Rahu's face. Her breathing sounds labored through the face mask. Though exhausted and repressed, she looks like a menacing ghost. Only one thought remains.

speaker: Rahu
content: Are you... the user of 05257885?

speaker: Shalom
content: Is this all you've come back for?
Shalom sighs.

speaker: Shalom
content: You've failed your test, Rahu. You've sabotaged your own path. I'm disappointed in you.

speaker: Liaison Officer
content: She's becoming more aggressive. Shalom, get ready to...

speaker: Rahu
content: Back off!
