Shalom sits by the hospital bed, slowly peeling an apple. She's not skilled with the knife, her movements are slow, but precise enough. Under the gaze of the Schorl, the thin apple skin extends bit by bit before falling, and she finally speaks.

speaker: Shalom
content: I heard that you frequently used your abilities during the investigation and almost lost control.

speaker: Christina
content: I... I was forced by circumstances...

speaker: Shalom
content: I think we agreed that the premise of giving you this task was not to rely on violence, to control your own Mania. Pursue truth and justice with wisdom. Right? We agreed, didn't we?

speaker: Christina
content: Yes, yes, of course I'll do it! I will do my best to complete the mission that you gave me.

speaker: Christina
content: Ah... ha... I-I remember, it's just that the enemies were too strong...
She had long forgotten.
Click.

With a soft sound, the apple skin in Shalom's hand peels away. She carves a crescent shape with the knife, skewers it with a toothpick, and offers a gentle smile as she feeds it to Christina. She waits anxiously, sweat pouring profusely.

speaker: Shalom
content: Here, open your mouth.

speaker: Shalom
content: It seems I'm pushing you too hard. Should we switch to a more suitable task?

speaker: Christina
content: Wahhh! N-no, Shalom. I made a mistake! I won't misuse my abilities again! Don't leave me—
The crying that had finally stopped once again echoes through the ward.
Five minutes later.

speaker: Christina
content: Have you finished your work?

speaker: Christina
content: Where's Rahu? I remember she saved me last night, from all those monsters... is she alright?

speaker: Shalom
content: Rahu said, "I didn't even need to use my abilities to deal with those things." You see?

speaker: Shalom
content: She's already searching for the Garden's base near the scene of the incident. Your near-death experience provided vital information, we will treasure it.

speaker: Shalom
content: As for work... we need a bit more time. FAC will soon face an important battle, they need me to weigh in.

speaker: Christina
content: Oh... then I shouldn't bother you anymore...
Shalom smiles, and hands over a piece of apple.

speaker: Shalom
content: Your task is also important. Tell me about your progress, I know you've made achievements.

speaker: Christina
content: Mmm!
She pulls up the investigation records, files, and reports all of her speculations.

speaker: Christina
content: The Garden took on the commissions of vengeance, but why select these assignments? And the final combination should have a deeper meaning. Now it seems that they so generously gave me clues to guide my investigation.

speaker: Christina
content: The first two cases are related to FAC's defeat in N.F. 103, without a doubt, that must be the reason.
When talking about ten years ago, Christina still feels a bit apprehensive.

speaker: Christina
content: Does the Garden think that what happened back then was unfair, and wants to attract attention through these cases, reveal the truth, and then make accusations?
Shalom picks up the second apple, still peeling it very slowly.

speaker: Shalom
content: They don't care about the public's opinion, after all, they are a group of people who want to keep vengeance firmly in their own hands.

speaker: Shalom
content: Rehashing the events of N.F. 103, can only mean it's useful "now."

speaker: Shalom
content: The Eclipse Operation was top secret, FAC made huge sacrifices for a greater cause, but this sacrifice was used and twisted by others.

speaker: Shalom
content: Information leaked, the public's criticism of FAC was constant. Other factions in Eastside also took the opportunity to suppress. FAC lost its original status, and from then on was controlled by others. People's trust in the city-state fell to the bottom.

speaker: Shalom
content: Like you, it was this very event that led you to believe there was a vast conspiracy behind the Nirvana incident in N.F. 104, prompting such a drastic assault.
Chris' head sinks.
It's true. In N.F. 103, Chris, who had lost her father and friends, also fell into paranoia. The next year when she heard about the Nirvana mine incident, she took drastic action.
The victim of that time is right in front of her.

speaker: Shalom
content: FAC will soon have a major battle in the West District. A very important Black Ring control operation, using a lot of manpower and funds, will cause the power structure to change. The most critical thing for the FAC Commander-in-Chief is to return to Eastside and push through the operation plan.

speaker: Shalom
content: So, rehashing the old events at this time, what do you think it's for?

speaker: Christina
content: Could it be that they want to stir up trouble again, trip up FAC's rear, and obstruct this operation?

speaker: Shalom
content: At least this is absolutely beneficial for the Underground. The Garden was originally an assassin group established by the Underground forces. Although they declared independence a few years ago, looking at the Erica Villa incident, they are still connected.
Thinking of the appearance of those people, Christina falls silent again.

speaker: Christina
content: Although her methods are outrageous, after actually meeting her, I don't think she's a complete lunatic.

speaker: Christina
content: They are... a group of people who have already given up on this world. They don't believe in justice anymore, but they won't admit defeat either. They want to seize everything with their own hands.

speaker: Christina
content: They're a lot like me in the past...

speaker: Shalom
content: That's not true.
Setting down the fruit in her hand, she looks at Christina.

speaker: Shalom
content: If I was killed one day, would you kill for me?

speaker: Christina
content: I won't let that happen!

speaker: Shalom
content: But if it does happen, what will you do?

speaker: Christina
content: I—I... I would find out the truth, capture the criminal, and prevent him from hurting anyone else. I won't let anyone end up like me...
Chris' head sinks more and more as she speaks, her words seeming less convincing even to herself.

speaker: Christina
content: ...I don't want that. If I had to choose, I'd rather die than have you killed, Shalom. You're the most important person to me.
Shalom looks at the ginger girl with her head lowered. After a long pause, she said, word by word...

speaker: Shalom
content: What if I committed crimes and evil deeds?

speaker: Christina
content: No way! You would never do such a thing!

speaker: Shalom
content: Wrong answer. You should still seek the truth, capture the criminal, and prevent her from hurting anyone else. You're a detective, after all.
As she speaks, she ruffles Chris' hair, her voice regaining its usual warmth.

speaker: Christina
content: I... I know... but you wouldn't do that.

speaker: Christina
content: Don't joke about that, it's too cruel...
Shalom looks at her, smiles, and pats her head.

speaker: Shalom
content: Alright, alright, it's my fault for teasing you. I will always cherish your feelings.
The phone rings. Shalom answers it on speaker in front of Chris, continuing to peel the last apple with both hands.

speaker: Rahu
content: It's me. We've searched a 10-kilometer radius around where Christina appeared, but we haven't found the entrance to the Garden.

speaker: Rahu
content: I suspect they deliberately moved Chris.

speaker: Shalom
content: They might have used some special technology, after all, they have the <color=#fb9259>Underground</color> backing them.

speaker: Shalom
content: According to Chris' investigation, there will soon be a response from the FAC. It's time to move.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'll come pick you up.
The call ends. Shalom has finished peeling the apple, displaying a mastery gained from practice. She quickly cuts a piece and offers it to Christina.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'll go first then. Contact me as soon as there's any progress with the case. Its nature has completely changed now, and I need you to provide more clues.

speaker: Christina
content: I will! I'm heading out too! Since it's related to the battle, we can't delay.

speaker: Christina
content: There must be clues in the third and fourth lines of the poem. Along with the events related to FAC in N.F. 103, at least I can issue a warning in advance and gather more information.
Christina jumps off the bed, grimacing but managing not to cry out in pain. She quickly changes her clothes.

speaker: Shalom
content: There's no need to rush, someone came to see you.

speaker: Christina
content: Huh?
The door opens, and a gloomy girl in a wheelchair stops at the entrance, eyeing the two people in the room warily.

speaker: Christina
content: Mireya?

speaker: Christina
content: Oh right, Shalom, Mireya is my sister. She's... a very smart kid!

speaker: Shalom
content: I know. She's a child from your foster family, you often mention her. You two must be very close.

speaker: Mireya
content: Tsk.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'll leave you two alone. Take your time.
Christina nods repeatedly, bidding farewell to Shalom. When she turns back to look at Mireya, there's a hint of awkwardness.

speaker: Mireya
content: They said you were going to die and asked me to sign. But you're still alive.

speaker: Mireya
content: When you're ready to die for your justice, let me know in advance. Don't cause me any trouble.

speaker: Christina
content: ...Don't say that. After I solve this case, can we sit down and talk?
Mireya doesn't respond, just watching Shalom leave.

speaker: Mireya
content: ...Is that the amazing person you mentioned?

speaker: Christina
content: Yes! She's really special, kind, just, and strong. She's also very smart, and her answers are always right!

speaker: Christina
content: Thanks to her, I've regained my energy.

speaker: Mireya
content: ...That woman never looked at me directly. In her eyes, I'm invisible.

speaker: Mireya
content: You better be careful, or you won't know how you died.
Nasha

Now that they know that the murderer is targeting the chain reaction caused by the failed Eclipse Operation in N.F. 103, the direction hinted from the third and fourth lines of the poem becomes more obvious.
On the same night, she and Detective Dole work all night to identify several related businesses and individuals, contacting and warning each one.

Some people on the list panic and seek protection, while others deny everything. The investigation team follows up on each one. As Shalom said, the importance of the case has escalated and preventive strategy is needed.
However, Christina has a hunch that what's supposed to happen will inevitably happen...
Christina feels like she is back in good shape.
She runs all the way to the crime scene, only to see a large number of detectives and FAC personnel have sealed off the area, and the guy leading them is a familiar face.

speaker: Dole
content: Wha...? Why are you here—

speaker: Dole
content: Sigh, never mind. I can't stop you anyway.

Finally, the inspector waves his hand and lets her in. Christina has also made up her mind that this time she will not <color=#fb9259>resort to violence</color>, nor will she damage anything at the scene.

Eastside Third Avenue
Crime scene at Future Charity Foundation Park
Although Christina had a feeling when she heard their frightened reactions, she still felt a headache when it actually happened.

The incident at the Future Charity Foundation perfectly matches all of Shalom's concerns. The foundation is influential and difficult to control due to the large number of staff. If a scandal breaks out, it will greatly affect FAC's future operations.

The park has now been sealed off by FAC and the Eastside Public Security Bureau. The Future Charity Foundation, where the incident occurred, was on yesterday's warning list, and is one of the few organizations that scoffed at the warning. After all, their job is to operate and distribute FAC's compensation.

There is only one body at the scene, which has been sent for examination by the Public Security Bureau. Christina only got a report. According to the description in the report, the victim's flowers were forcibly removed and put in the vases at the scene.
The things in the safe are gone. With no doubt, this disposable terminal was put in by the suspect.
Christina carefully checks this terminal. All the content inside is deleted. Did the suspect leave it here to communicate with her?

What does she want to do? To mock her for being late again, or argue about justice?
No, Chris, you need to stay calm and not be affected by the enemy's tricks.
Ding-a-ling.
The terminal rings, but it's not the one in her hand, it's Christina's own.

speaker: Dole
content: How are things, kid? Nothing happened at the scene, right?

speaker: Christina
content: I think I'm very certain about the killer's motive. The Charity Foundation is indeed related to the battle 10 years ago. And surprisingly, it has some relation to the previous two victims.

speaker: Christina
content: Because the Charity Foundation has tampered with the compensation, many families received unfair treatment.

speaker: Christina
content: They were either misled by Anania's report or threatened by Nathan. And the Charity Foundation has also put a lot of effort into suppressing FAC.

speaker: Christina
content: But there are some discrepancies at the scene that I haven't quite cleared up.

speaker: Dole
content: What is that?

speaker: Christina
content: There is only one victim at the scene, but 12 different Mania flowers are here, none of which match the victim .

speaker: Christina
content: Each person can only bloom one kind of flower, indicating that there are at least 12 other victims. And the victim's body was solidified by the effect of Coquelic's ability, but his flowers were not here at the scene.

speaker: Christina
content: That means, at least one person's flower and 12 people who have bloomed have disappeared from this scene.

The suspect is very attention-seeking, and she has a strong sense of ritual for these missing things. It's like she's "inviting" her to solve the case, to look for the truth, and what's more important is...

"In autumn's prime, wine and meat gleam. 
Gold and silver set the festive scene.
As year's end nears, vast and wide, 
over dried-up wells, I alone stride."
There is nothing "festive" here... only one victim "stride alone"...

speaker: Christina
content: The first two lines of the poem correspond to the location and time of the case and the victims. While the third line of the poem is right about the victim, there's a subtle mistake with the location, which is closer to the fourth line of the poem...

speaker: Christina
content: Inspector, I suspect that the fourth crime scene has already appeared but we haven't found it yet. The things missing here may all be in the fourth scene, or they can be retrieved from the place corresponding to the third line of the poem.
The place corresponding to "In autumn's prime, wine and meat gleam. Gold and silver set the festive scene"...
Recalling Shalom's speculation, Christina becomes increasingly uneasy.

speaker: Christina
content: Mr. Dole, can you find out the whereabouts of other core members of the Charity Foundation as soon as possible? Their financial flow... uh, where do they usually spend their money?

speaker: Christina
content: The victim this time is too special, I think we need to get the upper hand, otherwise...

speaker: Sheriff
content: Inspector, look at the TV!

speaker: News
content: We just received another anonymous document!

speaker: News
content: There are words on the cover that say: "Want to know where tens of millions of compensation went? Ask what they did in N.F. 104."

speaker: News
content: It seems the killer wants to tell us something... The missing compensation funds and the victim at the banquet, what's the connection between the two? Our reporters will continue to bring you updates.

speaker: News
content: Breaking news! The latest crime scene has been found at the Sunset Club on Eastside Third Avenue, marking it the fourth case in the recent series of incidents!

speaker: News
content: We're getting the latest updates! Live images are coming in from the scene... What kind of banquet is this?! The flowers on the dining table... Oh goodness, are these the devil's work?
The inspector sends over images, and Christina stares blankly. Among the mammoth objects on the dining table, she recognizes twelve familiar flowers...

speaker: Christina
content: Another twelve victims, a bouquet of flowers...

speaker: Christina
content: This is... "In autumn's prime, wine and meat gleam. Gold and silver set the festive scene."

Out of breath, Christina arrives at the Sunset Club. It's a major hotel in Eastside, usually bustling with people. Today, there are even more people gathered outside—all reporters and bystanders who were forced to leave the scene.
Of course, there's also a group of Eastside sheriffs and FAC soldiers who have come late to clear the scene.

speaker: Reporter A
content: Gossip TV Reporting! Why is the Public Security Bureau of Eastside still sealing off the scene? What secrets are they hiding?

speaker: Reporter B
content: Can you tell us what the FAC's compensation case has to do with this case? Were there any Sinners involved in the case?

speaker: Reporter A
content: Why does this public security case involve the FAC? Is this within their jurisdiction?! Is the killer seeking revenge because the FAC pocketed the funds?!

speaker: Passerby
content: Me! Interview me! This is definitely related to the FAC's recent agenda! They can't hide the truth forever!

speaker: Reporter B
content: Some say the FAC is not a shield protecting the city, but a dangerous organization secretly undermining its security. What's your comment on this?
The clamor and intermittent flashes make the scene increasingly chaotic.

Christina remains silent, trying her best to squeeze through the crowd. The shouting reporters are easily pushed aside by her, and the detectives guarding the scene let her through after glancing at her intern ID.
Inspector Dole stands at the hotel entrance, shaking his head when he sees her.

speaker: Dole
content: No need to look. The scene is no longer useful.

speaker: Christina
content: What do you mean by "no longer useful"?

Despite his words, she insists on going in. First, she's stunned by the astonishing scene, then immediately understands what the inspector meant—Even though the scene is now sealed off, the first people to enter were reporters who got wind of the news. Their curiosity is enough to destroy everything.
Before Christina began her investigation, Inspector Dole and his team had already examined every corner of the scene.

speaker: Dole
content: Yeah, we've checked. There are signs of damage everywhere, all the clues have been contaminated. Some things have been moved around, and maybe some have been taken away.

speaker: Dole
content: Heh... Those announcements sent to the media were timely, why didn't they send us one too?
Whether the criminal sent the letters to destroy the scene or to expose everything as Shalom suggested, it's hard to determine now. But in any case, they were indeed late.
As the operation approaches, FAC faces mounting public pressure. If this is the purpose of the Underground, they've achieved their goal.
For the first time, the "Mentor" didn't leave Christina a puzzle, but instead wreaked havoc on the scene.
Wait... Are there really no puzzles here? No place for her to explore?

speaker: Christina
content: Among all 13 elders of the Charity Foundation, why was only one of them moved to another scene?

speaker: Christina
content: Why go to the trouble of arranging two symmetrical scenes?

speaker: Christina
content: The reason for the retaliation against the Charity Foundation is clear. But even if she's doing this as a payback, this doesn't make sense. She could have just arranged this one extravagant scene. Why...
Christina vaguely realizes that, whether the Mentor intended it or not, both scenes hid some information.

speaker: Christina
content: Inspector, I have some ideas. I would like to head back to the third scene later. Before that, there's one more thing at the fourth scene I was hoping you could investigate.

speaker: Dole
content: But this scene has already been completely destroyed.

speaker: Christina
content: Isn't there still a clue? The one that even the most gossip-loving reporter didn't dare to touch...
Christina looks at the terrifyingly large bouquet on the dining table, intimidating and fully contaminated by Mania. No one dared to touch it.
Where there are puzzles, there's the possibility of uncovering the truth.
Looking at the determined Christina, Dole can only let out a long sigh. He really can't deal with this intern.
[Black screen, taking the report]

At Christina's strong insistence, the intelligence department tested the flower again.
And the result of this test is as Christina thought. The intelligence department detected the DNA of 12 people on this organism, corresponding exactly to the 12 broken flowers in the conference room.
This is what Coquelic wants to hide. All the feints, and the mystery of the third and fourth lines of the poem, were just to hide a secret, and...
That secret is hidden in the third scene, the conference room!
Christina is somewhat relieved that the two crime scenes aren't too far apart. They don't have much time left. If she is right, then...
There is something wrong with the case at the third scene. Perhaps, Eugean didn't die at the hands of the Mentor.

speaker: Christina
content: The Mentor meticulously planned this. She even violated her own principles and forcibly created a fourth scene, just to cover this up.

speaker: Christina
content: If the criminal has something to hide, we must uncover it!
She storms into the conference room. This time, she will unravel the lies beneath the lies.
Christina has cracked the Mentor's puzzle. She isn't afraid of any other consequences and directly hacks open this glowing red storage cabinet with an axe.
Inside, there is only a flowery scroll, which looks exactly the same as the one she received before.
"Little one, you need to speed up your puzzle-solving."
If this was her first time here, Christina might have been upset by her, but now... Christina just feels like it's unnecessary.
The blade marks Christina just discovered... clearly weren't caused by Coquelic's power, but by another ability.
And the fact that Eugean's flowers can't be found anywhere indicates one thing: when Coquelic showed up, he couldn't grow a "flower" anymore.
Someone had already killed him.

speaker: Christina
content: Eugean was killed by another assassin... Coquelic made all this fuss just to help her cover everything up. That person is also a Sinner from the Garden, and, a very weak one.
This is an opportunity.

speaker: Christina
content: Not only did she commit the crime against the Mentor's will and leave so many flaws at the scene, but she also forced the narcissistic Coquelic to give up her original perfect plan to help her cover up the scene... The criminal who attacked Eugean is definitely easier to deal with.

speaker: Christina
content: She will be the breakthrough, but... what should I do?
Just then, the phone rings.

speaker: Shalom
content: Well done, Chris, leave the rest to me.

<color=#7683a2>Netizen A</color>: Have you heard about the <color=#fb9259>Future Charity Foundation</color> case? It's about the FAC scandal from 10 years ago. It's a big deal.

<color=#7683a2>Netizen B</color>: I did! Wow, 1 billion DisCoins, that's huge. I'm not a family member and even I'm furious. Huh, pretending to be so innocent, there must be a whistleblower in FAC.

<color=#7683a2>Netizen A</color>: Speaking of which, the <color=#fb9259>Eastside Hotel Massacre</color>... It seems like someone silenced all the people involved, all the core members of the Charity Foundation were wiped out. Amazing, what a hero!

<color=#7683a2>Netizen B</color>: Heard it was a beautiful assassin from the Garden? Punishing evil and promoting good, brilliant!
<color=#fb9259>Anonymous</color>: No, didn't you hear? There's one more person who didn't die, the real mastermind behind the Foundation... Eugean!
<color=#fb9259>Anonymous</color>: He didn't go to the Eastside Hotel at all. His signature wasn't among the guests at that banquet.

<color=#fb9259>Insider Scoop</color>: Yes, I have a mole within the criminal investigation team who told me there was a murder at the hotel, at the Future Charity Foundation to be exact, even before all this. Only one victim—Eugean.

<color=#fb9259>Insider Scoop</color>: But do you know? <size=50>Eugean isn't dead!</size> He was saved!! 


<color=#fb9259>Insider Scoop</color>: I have <color=#fb9259>photos</color>, straight from the criminal investigation team's database!

<color=#7683a2>Netizen A</color>: Impossible! He was the source of all the scandals, he set up this entire charade, took the most money, and in the end, he's the only one left alive? Where's the justice in that??

<color=#7683a2>Netizen B</color>: How could the Garden have failed? Aren't they the most ruthless and brutal assassins?
<color=#fb9259>Insider Scoop</color>: Heh, a few assassins are no match for the bigwigs of the Charity Foundation. They were fooled...

21:25, August 14th, N.F. 113
Eastside Third Avenue, 
Future Charity Foundation Sanatorium

speaker: Reporter
content: Inspector!! We demand an explanation! Is it true that Eugean is still alive? What are you trying to achieve by keeping this a secret?

speaker: Reporter
content: Could it be that there were never any assassins from the Garden? This is all Eugean's own doing! When he heard someone was clearing up the scandal from back then, he faked his own death, didn't he!

speaker: Reporter
content: Give us an explanation! The attention is getting higher, you can't hide this! We saw him in person at the sanatorium!!

Reporters who caught wind of the story have completely blocked the front door of the Future Charity Foundation Sanatorium. They all hold so-called "reliable information" in their hands, clamoring for Eugean, the Charity Foundation head who's clinging to life, to come out and confess. The scene is abuzz with noise all at once.
On the other side of the crowd, a slender figure stands for a while before turning to leave.
She cleverly conceals her face, moving quietly without drawing attention, but her pace quickens, finally darting into a dark alley, running, filled with surging hatred.

speaker: Hidden Figure
content: ...It's my mistake, I need to clean up this mess. Even if I am driven out, I can't cause any more trouble for Mentor...

speaker: Hidden Figure
content: Bastard... Bastard!! I clearly stabbed him! I used my ability, I made sure!!

speaker: Hidden Figure
content: If that scumbag can live, why can't the people he killed!

She made sure that the man was in the top-secret ward in the northeast corner, who had just been urgently transferred there three days ago. She couldn't possibly mistake the man in the photo, it was the bastard who ruined her life.

speaker: Thistle
content: I'll kill you, I'll kill you over and over again! I'll kill you with my own hands!!
She turns into a side door hidden in the shadows where someone has been waiting for her.

speaker: Christina
content: ...You really did come. Has your confinement been lifted?

speaker: Thistle
content: Why are you here?

speaker: Christina
content: I didn't expect it to be you either... We sure are fated.

speaker: Christina
content: Shalom was right, a rookie assassin who is so stubborn that she would act without the permission of the Mentor, and a junior who needs her Mentor to clean up after her, would absolutely not tolerate failing a second time.

speaker: Christina
content: You're too eager to put someone to death, that's why you fell for this trap.
The assassin's voice begins to tremble, her eyes reddening.

speaker: Thistle
content: I should have killed you back then!

speaker: Christina
content: Stop committing atrocities in the name of vengeance! Now, I am arresting you for the attempted murder of Eugean. Surrender and confess! This is your last chance!
The ambush ends swiftly and decisively. The assassin is quickly transferred to a safe house for interrogation, and the 9th Agency also sends a hypnosis expert to assist in the investigation.
Christina was forbidden from attending the interrogation. She had completed her own work and was sitting in the break room, feeling a bit dazed.

speaker: Christina
content: The body that the Mentor "bloomed" would stop all normal physiological responses. But I think, the real time of Eugean's death was August 9th.

speaker: Christina
content: The night that the rookie from the Garden saved me.

speaker: Christina
content: She must have deeply hated Eugean, so she disregarded the Garden's rules and personally sought revenge... even if it meant angering her Mentor.

speaker: Thistle
content: I should have killed you back then!
Christina leans back, sinking into the couch, and looks up at the ceiling, exhausted.

speaker: Christina
content: ...On her way back from revenge, did she feel lost for the first time? That's why she saved me, even though I'm clearly her enemy...

speaker: Dole
content: Don't overthink. At least you caught her.

speaker: Dole
content: If she returned to the Garden after getting her revenge, she would truly become an assassin, only taking more lives, turning from confusion to numbness. It's good as it is now, at least she is fiercely hating you.

speaker: Dole
content: You can't make everyone happy or win everyone's approval, but you're doing what you think is right.

speaker: Dole
content: Your first big case, you did a great job, even exceeding expectations. You can take a good rest now.
Christina nods, utterly exhausted after all that's happened. She hopes everything is over now. She opens up the news on her phone and puts on her headphones.

On the screen, a stern and resolute old man is being bombarded by countless cameras and microphones. Christina recognizes him, he's the current Commander-in-Chief of FAC, who took office after the Eclipse Operation.

speaker: Reporter
content: Can you tell us what the FAC's compensation case has to do with this case? Were there any Sinners involved in the case? Is it related to the FAC Commander-in-Chief's return?

speaker: Reporter
content: Why is the FAC involved in this security case? Is this within their jurisdiction?! Is there something else going on about this operation plan?

speaker: Reporter
content: Give us an explanation! More people are paying attention, you can't hide this!

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: ...We have nothing to hide. All of FAC's plans and intentions are to protect the city-state, and our operations won't be hindered by such minor issues. I've returned solely to advance the operation proposal.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: But since you're here for an interview, I'll take this opportunity to say a few words to the criminals.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: Stop targeting ordinary people. If your target is FAC, come at us directly. I'll see you on the battlefield.
Leaving the Eastside Public Security Bureau building, Christina walks alone in the quiet alleyway.
The poem and her serial cases have been completed, so what will that woman do next?
If Thistle could sneak out of the Garden, it is most likely that the Mentor isn't at the base right now. So where would she go? To find her client? Or to bloom another flower?
Anyway, the Mentor has never taken her seriously from the beginning. Christina has completely understood this, and suddenly, she has a strong desire to see her.

She wants to ask Coquelic, what is all of this for? Is it necessary to hinder such an important operation? Is it necessary to side with the Underground? By sacrificing the chance to save the West District, does the vengeance obtained make the Garden happy?

speaker: Christina
content: ...Inspector, I'm inexperienced, careless, and I often mess things up...

speaker: Christina
content: But sometimes, my terrible intuition... is surprisingly accurate.

speaker: Christina
content: My intuition tells me that the assassination from the poem is not over yet.

speaker: Christina
content: Given that woman's flamboyant personality, it's impossible for her to end it... quietly.
As she is saying this, suddenly, something sharp pricks the back of her head. Before she could react in shock, Christina lost consciousness.
The results of the interrogation are handed over to the Hush.

Under hypnosis, the Garden Assassin spills everything she knows, limited information. The most important intel has been subjected to counter psychological suggestion and can't be currently extracted.

She worries that the Mentor has taken on a commission from evil forces, she has caught a glimpse of a long list. She knows the Mentor made a dangerous trade for some reason.

She deeply regrets sabotaging the Mentor's plan.
Shalom quietly flips through the report.

speaker: Shalom
content: In autumn's prime, wine and meat gleam. Gold and silver set the festive scene... As year's end nears, vast and wide, over dried-up wells, I alone stride.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...As year's end nears, vast and wide, over dried-up wells, I alone stride.
The writing is awkward but full of pride. The author must be very proud of this, she must want to execute her plan perfectly.
But the plan was ultimately disrupted. She had to split into two scenes to cover for another little assassin.
The two scenes essentially form a sentence of the poem, "set the festive scene." The real target of "As year's end nears... I alone stride" is...

She glances at the timetable, the agenda for the West District operation proposal is coming up soon. If the Underground wants to disrupt it, if she <color=#fb9259>herself</color> wants to disrupt it, then compared to this tickling performance, she would...
Shalom smiles.

speaker: Shalom
content: Since it's a grand blooming, I suppose it won't just end here. Right, Mentor...?

speaker: Internal Alert
content: <size=48><color=#dg1f1f>All personnel assemble!! The Commander-in-Chief has been attacked! The Commander-in-Chief has been attacked!</size></color>

speaker: Internal Alert
content: The criminal is a <color=#fb9259>Garden Assassin</color>!!

05:25, August 15, N.F. 113
Temporary Command of the FAC-HUSH Joint Task Force

speaker: Shalom
content: The criminal attacked the temporary command post, used a transport vehicle to kidnap the Commander-in-Chief, license no. DS-3864H. The vehicle just passed the Rust and is now heading towards Eastside.

speaker: Shalom
content: Judging from the life signs monitoring, the Commander is still alive, there is still time. The enemy getting such accurate information indicates that the Underground has infiltrated FAC.

speaker: Shalom
content: The core rescue operation will be carried out by the <color=#fb9259>Paradeisos HUSH unit</color>. The operation time is 2 hours and 13 minutes. Rescue the Commander before the designated meeting time. Prevent the spread of panic.

speaker: Shalom
content: FAC's main force should not act, do not disclose any information, inform them that the Commander will arrive on time. During this period, anyone who behaves abnormally, spreads panic, or investigates the Commander's whereabouts may be a spy from the Underground, and will be closely tracked by the 9th Agency.

speaker: Shalom
content: The Underground has sent an invitation for a skirmish, this is also our chance. The West District operation proposal will definitely be passed, we should clean ourselves up before the war begins, and eliminate all moles.

When Christina wakes up, her surroundings are pitch black. The space is vibrating, as if she's in a vehicle. Christina gropes around, besides the dark metal boxes, there are even many people piled up next to her.
Her phone is gone, Christina can't contact the outside world, so she takes out a small flashlight to shine around.
There are guards and bureaucrats around, as well as some high-ranking individuals whom she can't identify, but they are all unconscious, with small "flowers" blooming on their bodies.

speaker: Christina
content: Of course, it's her.
She hastily checks everyone she can see. Fortunately, the degree of blooming is not deep. It seems to be just a means for Coquelic to control people.

Among these people, Christina finds one who is different. He is old but robust, has grey hair and his body is full of injuries. Many parts of his body have been replaced with machinery, and he is under more severe restrictions than the average person, falling into a deep unconsciousness.
This face, Christina remembers seeing it on TV.

speaker: Christina
content: ...The FAC Commander-in-Chief...?

Christina immediately understands her situation—<color=#fb9259>"as year's end nears, vast and wide, over dried-up wells, I alone stride"</color>. This is the real <color=#fb9259>fourth scene</color> corresponding to the <color=#fb9259>fourth line of the poem</color>. And she, as one of the "victims," was attacked last night and brought here.
(Rustling...)
Perhaps sensing someone's awakening, a red light emerges from the corner of the shadows. Christina looks over to see the red light transform into muck, coalescing into filthy humanoid forms.
These are the puppets from the Underground that Shalom once told her about.

speaker: Christina
content: I was right, she really is in cahoots with the Underground scoundrels.
Even Christina is now a victim, which means the criminal no longer needs a detective. This is the <color=#fb9259>final case</color>.
Christina slaps her face hard, turning her cheeks bright red.

speaker: Christina
content: Great, there's still time. I won't let you get your way this time!

speaker: Christina
content: Cough, cough... Contamination device... I should've known.

speaker: Christina
content: Fortunately, the FAC armor still has some Anti-Mania devices, I need to get out before the Hypercube storage runs out.

speaker: Christina
content: I have no idea where this car is going, or how much time I've just wasted. I need to hurry...
She struggles to move the unconscious Commander-in-Chief, but quickly discovers a chilling device on the man.

speaker: Christina
content: Is this... a contamination bomb?
At this moment, the sound of electricity crackling comes from the other end of the darkness.

speaker: Christina
content: Inside the car... a walkie-talkie?
A familiar voice comes from the other end of the walkie-talkie.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hello there, little detective.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Alright, alright, stop banging on the door. This is the FAC's super armored car, not the safe you're used to smashing.

speaker: Coquelic
content: And stop throwing a tantrum, didn't you also use dirty tricks to kidnap my people?

speaker: Christina
content: Do whatever you want with me, just let the Commander go!

speaker: Christina
content: This operation in the West is very important. If we can block BR-002, the West can be saved. So many innocent people won't have to be abandoned by the city-state! Now is not the time for you to throw a tantrum!!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Sure, sure, you know I don't care.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Give me a contact, I want to call your favorite <color=#fb9259>Hush</color> sister.
A familiar ringtone sounds from the other end of the walkie-talkie.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Oh, how convenient. She's calling you.

speaker: Christina
content: You took my phone?!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Shush, adults are talking, children shouldn't interrupt. I'll mute you.
Coquelic ignores Chris' roar, she directly answers the incoming call on the phone and turns on the speaker.

Behind the driver's cabin, the young girl is clearly irritated. She bangs on the door with all her might, trying to get the caller's attention. Coquelic leisurely holds the phone between herself and the walkie-talkie. The car is going fast and noisy.

speaker: Shalom
content: Hello, Mentor.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hello, Hush. I have your people, but you don't seem surprised at all.

speaker: Shalom
content: After the first time you kidnapped her, Christina was implanted with a locator. I knew she was near the Rust. Naturally, she was kidnapped by you again.

speaker: Coquelic
content: That's strange, I've had her kidnapped for several hours. Why are you only calling now?
Coquelic notices the banging on the door stops abruptly, she lets out a cold laugh and continues to focus on the phone call.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Taking a living person as my tracker, how shameless. The little girl must be heartbroken.

speaker: Shalom
content: The Commander-in-Chief is there too, isn't he? We've already locked onto the vehicle's location. This time, it's not the sheriff or the FAC chasing you, it's the Paradeisos exclusive HUSH unit.

speaker: Shalom
content: We can still talk now, Mentor.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ha, your HUSH unit has been harassing me since June, don't act so distant.

speaker: Coquelic
content: And besides, I didn't pick up your call to take orders from you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Listen, Hush of Paradeisos. This car contains your Commander-in-Chief, a dozen important negotiators, and the Underground Mania bomb you hate the most. It's heading towards Eastside.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Right now, an Underground Puppet is driving the car, sniping won't affect it. If anything causes the car to slow down during the journey, the bomb will immediately detonate, and the M-value within a kilometer radius will exceed 2000.

speaker: Coquelic
content: The only way to defuse the bomb is to dismantle the detonator directly, it's on the old man. The old man is next to your puppy.

speaker: Coquelic
content: As for whether she has the ability to do this... heh, we both know the answer.

speaker: Coquelic
content: It's 11:32 in the morning now, in less than half an hour, this car will reach the first densely populated area of Eastside. I'm not like you, I don't negotiate.

speaker: Coquelic
content: This is what you asked for.

speaker: Shalom
content: Understood. This is indeed a choice you would make.

speaker: Shalom
content: The operation in the West District is necessary, so is the Commander-in-Chief. The demands of Paradeisos are clear, and I will eliminate the threat at the lowest cost.
The car is bumped a few times, something has clung to the roof. Quite a few... it's the HUSH elite squad.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...Hmph, don't be so sure.
Coquelic hangs up the phone and casually unmutes the walkie-talkie. The other end is silent.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Alright, kiddo, don't sulk. So you're being overlooked, that's nothing new.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Your dearest Shalom sent the Hush squad, but they're not here to save you. Of course, they can't stop me either.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I've told you how to play. Your detective game isn't over yet, want to continue?
After a moment of silence, a low but firm voice comes from the other end of the walkie-talkie.

speaker: Christina
content: I will win. I won't let you have your way.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hahahaha!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Good, then show me your justice.
The Underground Mania Puppet is driving the car, Coquelic reaches into its body, pulls out a jet-black sturdy floral sword. She breaks the car window, and vaults onto the roof of the car.
Facing the rushing wind, she raises her hand to impale three white-masked men who leap onto the roof, throwing them off the car. They tumble and bounce like trash, destroying several chasing cars.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Let's see how ridiculous it is.

speaker: Christina
content: Okay! It's dismantled!
This isn't a very complicated bomb, but Christina doesn't have time to think about that, she has more pressing matters.

The door to the driver's seat swings open with a clatter, allowing a gust of wind and shards of shattered glass to flood into the carriage where Christina is. She quickly rushes out, her first action being to grab the Mania Puppet.
She hurls the Puppet out of the window and quickly grabs hold of the steering wheel herself. Searching for the brakes, she realizes that they have been removed.

speaker: Christina
content: Coquelic!
Lifting her head again, she finds that Coquelic has already taken a seat on the hood of the car, her back to Christina. Her hair, streaming through the broken windshield, obscures Christina's view.

speaker: Coquelic
content: It's 11:56, almost time.

speaker: Christina
content: I've already defused the bomb, you—

speaker: Coquelic
content: Oh, is that so? Well done. Do you want me to praise you?

speaker: Christina
content: Stop messing with me! That was the simplest of traps, even an amateur like me could easily disarm it. You never intended to kill anyone with that!

speaker: Christina
content: If you weren't aiming to kill the Commander-in-Chief, then who is your real target? And why are you doing this?

speaker: Christina
content: What are you trying to tell us?
The wind makes her voice somewhat unclear.

speaker: Coquelic
content: The Hush squad has given up on forcibly attacking this vehicle. They can't do anything about me. They did leave a final ultimatum, though. They said that one minute before entering the danger zone, they would detonate the entire vehicle.

speaker: Christina
content: You bastard! Give me your phone, I'll tell them that the bomb has been defused, that it's safe now! All we need to do is stop the car, I can drive it until it runs out of fuel if necessary!

speaker: Coquelic
content: I already told them that.

speaker: Christina
content: Huh?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Five minutes before you disarmed the bomb, I knew you could do it. So I sent a message to the Hush.

speaker: Coquelic
content: She hasn't responded to me yet. Do you think it's because she hasn't seen it? Or because she doesn't believe it?

speaker: Christina
content: ...What did you say...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Or is it because...
Far ahead on the road, a blurry figure appears. Just by the silhouette, Christina recognizes who that is.
Shalom is standing in the middle of the road, with Rahu at her side.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Oh, isn't that your beacon of justice?
Christina can no longer hear Coquelic's taunts. She sees the black Grim Reaper, the Paradeisos weapon known as "Schorl," slowly opening.

speaker: Christina
content: ...Shalom...?
She has seen its power before. It was once a magnificent force for justice that she trusted immensely.
But now, it fills her with fear.

speaker: Christina
content: I did it... I've already stopped her, believe me... I beg you...

speaker: Christina
content: Don't use it... Please...
Schorl slowly unfurls, as if amassing energy. It analyzes the scene, as if calculating death toll. Waves of light flow over it, like a cruel countdown.

speaker: Coquelic
content: By the way, that old man won't die so easily, otherwise, the Underground guy wouldn't have asked me to do this.

speaker: Coquelic
content: But I can't say the same for the others in this vehicle.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Including you.
She looks ahead at the road, where the Hush is standing in the center, along with that black-clothed guardian.
Coquelic scoffs disdainfully, flips back onto the roof of the car and leaves, but not before uttering one last sentence.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Goodbye, envoy of justice.
Right now, the only person in Chris' eyes is Shalom. The broken car window allows them to recognize each other at this distance.
Shalom's expression is like a frozen statue until, at one moment, Christina sees her lips move.

speaker: Shalom
content: Position, force, timing...

speaker: Shalom
content: Go.

A blue light shoots vertically into the sky from the center of Schorl. Several rings of light are immediately projected onto the ground in front of the vehicle. The moment the uncontrolled vehicle drives into them, something descends from the sky.
White light covers everything in front of Chris' eyes, and a massive shockwave flips her over. The airbag deploys but is of little use as Chris' head slams hard onto the ground.
In the middle of the highway, amidst the fiery ruins, Shalom slowly walks over the scorched road surface to find the old man.

His uniform is torn, revealing more than half of his mechanical prosthetic limbs. Even his heart area has a faint light pulsing. At least half of this body has not been destroyed by the impact, it's as resilient as iron.
Several medical personnel rush over, administer CPR, and perform a series of procedures. The old man suddenly opens his eyes and takes a deep breath.

speaker: Shalom
content: Glad to see you're alright, Commander.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: Hush...
He gasps for breath, hard to speak, but his gaze remains fixed on Shalom.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: ...I'm... still alive... Did you use... Rebe...

speaker: Shalom
content: Rest assured. To use that kind of power on you, I would need to apply for permission, which would certainly not be granted.

speaker: Shalom
content: Besides, your body is very robust, there's no need for me to intervene.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: ...What about... the others, and...

He turns his head to look in the direction of the transport vehicle. The large vehicle has already toppled over. The contamination cleanup team inspects the remnants of the Mania bomb—no need for further action.
The attack from Schorl directly purified all the contamination, no... it destroyed everything with a power from higher up, a more lethal strike.

speaker: Shalom
content: The vehicle contained a large amount of level 5 Mania pollutants. You could withstand the impact, but you definitely couldn't withstand the contamination. Direct purification from Paradeisos is the most prudent solution, with the least cost.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: ...With the least cost? Heh...

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: Like what you did in the West District in March? BR-002, the second time, was that also what you call the "least cost"?

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes. The Underground is in motion, time is limited, and the mission I received was very clear: at <color=#fb9259>all costs</color>.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: ...Understood. If this is the result of Paradeisos's calculations, we can only trust it. Only you can do this.
The Commander-in-Chief murmurs, pushing away the helping hand offered by Hush and struggling to get up. His entire body of metal organs makes a dense noise as he finally stands.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: Killing an old man doesn't require such a grand scheme, it's a smokescreen, just like the serial cases they were involved in previously. They're trying to divert our attention to make their next move.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: That woman has an entire <color=#fb9259>assassination list</color>, all the backbone of this operation, the backbone of FAC. She's already got a handle on some of their whereabouts, not all, she's trying to pry my mouth open.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: Those scumbags know all too well, killing just me won't be enough, FAC has plenty of warriors. If they want to halt the operation, they'll have to kill everyone.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: Dream on!

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: Go back, don't waste time on me, round up all the spies and all the agents inside FAC who have turned against us.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: Their bold actions mean that our operation plan is already posing a real threat to them, which means we absolutely have to push through.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: An FAC is meant to die on the battlefield against Mania, not at the hands of these scoundrels. We'll continue our fight, you go and make them pay!

speaker: Shalom
content: Of course, the 9th Agency and HUSH have already taken action. If the enemy can't kill you, their plans will be completely exposed.
A few soldiers rush up to help the old man leave. Before getting into the car, he takes one last look back.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: There's an agent, a Sinner, who locked up the front seats before the explosion, blocking 20% of the firepower. I hope she's okay...

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: Is she one of yours?

speaker: Shalom
content: She is my subordinate.

speaker: Commander-in-Chief
content: ...Then you truly have no humanity.
The FAC special vehicle drives away. Shalom turns and heads towards the transport vehicle. Rahu is giving first aid to Christina.

The moment the attack was launched, Christina turned to close the door, Rahu left Shalom and rushed to the front of the car, shielding her with her shields. The detective was not directly torn apart by the shockwave from above, but the fused metal still pierced her waist.

She's stuck in place, unable to move, and the loss of blood makes her consciousness hazy. Through the bloody mist in front of her eyes, Christina can't see who's approaching, but she recognizes the familiar footsteps.

speaker: Shalom
content: Rahu, let me handle this.
She bends down and holds Chris' hand.

speaker: Christina
content: Where's the Commander... What about the others...

speaker: Christina
content: ...I've already dismantled the device... I did it, there was no need...

speaker: Shalom
content: Not everyone is as sincere as you. That woman has set up even more cruel traps, such a risk cannot be ignored.

speaker: Christina
content: Then... Can I go and check? I want to know... whether I managed...

speaker: Shalom
content: There's no need for that.
Her right eye reveals a faint triangle, and at the same time, Christina feels something touching her soul.

—It's a touch of white light, a vague giant shadow. Christina feels nauseous, as if she's been invaded and squeezed. The pain in her body is lessening, but the sickness cannot be eliminated. She wants to struggle, wants to shout questions, wants answers.

speaker: Christina
content: ...Tell me...

speaker: Christina
content: What the Commander just said, BR-002, the March uprising in the West District... Were you involved?

speaker: Christina
content: What do you mean by twice? What about BR-002 in N.F. 104? Is it related to this? Didn't you say... you're still investigating?

speaker: Christina
content: Shalom... what you’ve done, is it really... justice?
After a long silence, the nauseous feeling disappeared. Shalom let go of Christina's hand, clean and neat.

speaker: Shalom
content: Forget it.

Shalom gets up and returns to her Schorl. Christina opens her eyes wide, she finally sees the person in front of her clearly. That person is looking down from a high place, indifferent, looking down at her. Then, she turns her head indifferently.
All of Christina's courage and grievances were instantly shattered by this sudden indifference.

speaker: Christina
content: Ah... No, wait... I just...

speaker: Shalom
content: Basic first aid is enough, contact MBCC to take her away. I don't need her anymore.

speaker: Christina
content: No, I just want to know...

speaker: Christina
content: I'm sorry, Shalom, I just...

speaker: Shalom
content: Rahu.
Rahu gets up and leaves Christina once she confirms the arrival of the rescue team.

speaker: Schorl
content: The West District operation plan has been unanimously approved, the construction of the defense network confirmed: Funds, resources, and manpower will be in place immediately. Internal investigation and tactical meeting will begin immediately.

speaker: Schorl
content: The Underground won't sit idly by, be prepared, X, in this FAC operation, you have a more important, real task to complete.

speaker: Shalom
content: The requests have been received, and I will fulfill them all, as I always have.
In the distance, the Garden's Mentor who easily escaped is happily looking at the other side of the Rust, where the FAC temporary operation headquarters is emitting a sharp sound.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Oh dear, I failed the task and got made. What should I do next?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Trouble is coming. Dear client, what are you going to do...?

speaker: Christina
content: Don't... don't go...

The assassination attempt on the FAC Commander-in-Chief has shaken the entire city-state. The FAC, Public Security Bureau, 9th Agency, and Paradeisos's HUSH Unit are conducting a joint investigation with astonishing efficiency. The goal is to eliminate all obstacles before the Black Ring Blockade Operation begins in August.

Under the coordination of Paradeisos's special envoy <color=#fb9259>Hush X</color>, the joint investigation team is closely tracking all suspicious individuals during the intelligence blockade. A list of suspects has been quickly identified.

Plus, more enemies have exposed themselves in the intense attack against X.

The operation is being carried out discreetly and swiftly. Most of the culprits are intelligence agents who have been bought out or implanted by the enemy. Through them, we've obtained further information about their handlers, and captured many Underground members.

The threat is gradually being eliminated, and the official Black Ring Blockade Operation can be launched soon.

The West District shall never be abandoned. We cannot repeat the same mistakes.

content: <color=#7683a2>The preparation for battle is going smoothly. The important thing now is intelligence security. If the plan for the Anti-Mania Blockade Network's core base gets leaked, the Underground will definitely strike without mercy.</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>Your decoy strategy has been very effective. They are in a very vulnerable position right now.</color>

content: Understood. Since the HUSH system has already been compromised, my presence is the best bait for the Underground.

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>On top of that, we need you to ensure your own safety. Though the substitute is about to take over, our strategy must remain consistent after the battle starts.</color>

content: <color=#7683a2>At this stage, your </color><color=#fb9259>observations</color><color=#7683a2> are indispensable. Do not allow for any disruptions, or else our whole battle plan will be at risk.</color>

speaker: Shalom
content: Understood. I will hold out safely until the end of the battle and complete the handover. Plus, besides you, I also have Rahu protecting me. There won't be any problems.
Schorl spins around, scanning the black-clad guard nearby. She hears the conversation clearly, but shows no expression.

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>...That FAC has repeatedly overstepped our orders to her. Her behaviours in the recent kidnapping incident is an outrageous example.</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>Did something happen to the <color=#fb9259>mark</color> you gave her? Or was there a problem with the initial instructions?</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>She obviously overemphasizes her role as a "guard," which compromises her obedience as a result.</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>In her loyalty test, she even submitted a so-called "action statement," claiming that if there were obstacles for specific missions, there's a chance that she might disobey orders, and warned us to be careful when using her. With this attitude...</color>
Shalom can't help but chuckle, unintentionally interrupting Schorl.

speaker: Shalom
content: I think she's seriously creating her own user manual. That's exactly something Rahu would do. A tool that can actively provide a detailed "instruction manual" is more trustworthy, don't you think?

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>...Indeed, someone specifically requested her.</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>The threat from the Underground is growing day by day. The crisis that Hush faces will eventually fall on more people. There is a big shortage of capable guards... Do you agree with these statements?</color>

speaker: Shalom
content: She's very reliable and handy. After I leave, there will be many people who want her, so please help choose the most suitable position for her.
Schorl slowly opens its dark body as it stares at her, revealing the light blue core that once destroyed an FAC heavy armored vehicle in one hit and quietly scans the Sinner before it.
M-value fluctuation, safe. Emotional fluctuation, safe. Physiological indicators, stable. Mental activity level, high. Result: Hush is stable.
Shalom doesn't look up. She flips through the report in her hand with a smile and sips on warm water as she lets Schorl scan her inside out.

This is probably a Level 3 Scan. Teasing Schorl is pretty boring, but unfortunately, she can't tease anyone else now. As Schorl closes up again, Shalom shuts her eyes. The <color=#fb9259>channel</color> is open, and the <color=#fb9259>orders</color> have arrived.

2:23 p.m., August 17th, N.F. 113
Secret base of the Garden
No sunlight shines into the base. Coquelic leans against the doorpost, quietly contemplating something with her eyes closed. After a while, she opens her eyes and stretches dramatically.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Yawn... that trip was exhausting. My back hurts from sleeping...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Garofano, I want to take a bath... with roses this time. I want the tea to be rose too, as well as the snacks...

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...Oh, I forgot. She hasn't woken up yet.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Fine, Sumire can do it. Are you in a better mood now? If so, can you give me a massage?

speaker: Sumire
content: As you wish.
Warm spring water pours into the square bath. Fresh, bright red rose petals float on the surface. Coquelic soaks inside, happily enjoying Sumire's service.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ahhh... That feels much better...

speaker: Coquelic
content: How's Garofano?

speaker: Sumire
content: She's still deep asleep, but thanks to your help extracting the filth from her body, she is no longer producing any contamination.

speaker: Sumire
content: Some newbies are taking care of her. She should be waking up soon.

speaker: Coquelic
content: That's good then.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Add another rule to the Garden's manual: Don't blindly listen to the employer's orders to use weird powers. Always rely on yourself, or ask the Mentor for help.

speaker: Sumire
content: All right. I'll add it as rule number 73.

speaker: Sumire
content: As for Thistle...

speaker: Coquelic
content: She brought it upon herself.
Silence.

speaker: Coquelic
content: She repeatedly disobeyed my orders and acted on her own, and fell for such an obvious trap. If I hadn't taken precautions in advance, she might have leaked all kinds of information.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I won't go save her again. Let her suffer the consequences of her actions.
After another long silence, Coquelic reluctantly continues the conversation.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Okay, okay... She's probably with the psychologist at the 9th Agency right now. I set a reverse-psychology trap for her. They're going to be busy for a few days.

speaker: Coquelic
content: It's safer for her to be locked up in the 9th Agency than to be running around the Garden. That <color=#fb9259>Silver Spider</color> never saw eye-to-eye with Hush, and wouldn't hand her over.

speaker: Coquelic
content: She'll probably end up in your Bureau. That's quite suitable for her. She has completed her revenge. Before she figures out what she wants, she should just calm down for a bit.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I didn't say I despise her. Newbies don't know the rules and break them, but she beats all of you in at least one aspect.

speaker: Coquelic
content: She does everything for herself, and wouldn't sacrifice herself for others or let herself be taken advantage of. From this perspective, she's the most like me. She makes me less worried about her than the rest of you.

speaker: Sumire
content: As long as she's okay.
Silence.

speaker: She grips your wrist tightly, her eyes gleaming with wild excitement.
content: Mentor, you have never acted in such a high-profile way before. You've attracted so much attention this time. Is that okay?
Coquelic laughs. Only Sumire would ask something like this. She's usually soft and shy, but becomes very direct at critical times. She tilts her head up and playfully flicks Sumire's chin.

speaker: Coquelic
content: If you're afraid of being implicated, just hide well. I don't need your help anyway.

speaker: Sumire
content: No, I've been prepared to meet my fate since the day I joined the Garden. And you are the strongest one there is. I don't believe that anyone can defeat you.

speaker: Sumire
content: It's just you've always hated the conflict between the Underground and Paradeisos. You even chose this secluded place as a result.

speaker: Sumire
content: Is there a deeper reason for your involvement this time?

speaker: Coquelic
content: No. I was just feeling sluggish in spring, and didn't want to move or bother with them. Now that summer is here, it's time for the flowers to bloom and for me to take action.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Those guys from HUSH have been annoying me for a long time. I can't stand flies buzzing around my Garden. That's all there is to it.
As she speaks, she brushes aside Sumire's long black hair, hooks her neck to pull her in closer, then gazes into her eyes.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Why are you asking this? You usually don't care about these things. You've always wanted to leave the Garden. This is the first time you've come back to the Garden to find me. And those who come to the Garden to find me have only one reason...

speaker: Coquelic
content: How's your <color=#fb9259>vengeance</color> coming along? For your kind and gentle Chief who ended up killed? Need my help?
The sudden change of topic makes Sumire freeze.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You left the MBCC for this, right? You wouldn't possibly let those who hurt him off the hook.
female_content: You left the MBCC for this, right? You wouldn't possibly let those who hurt her off the hook.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Who did you go kill in West District? Rustfire, the Executive Committee... who else? Those high-ranking execs from Nirvana? Can you find the chance to strike?

speaker: Sumire
content: Yes. Thanks to you diverting their attention with your recent activity, I've had the opportunity to get close to them.

speaker: Sumire
content: To avoid interfering with your actions, I've been very discreet. No one will discover that this is the work of the Garden.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ha, well done. There's no news of this anywhere. You're truly my best student.

speaker: Coquelic
content: So, has your anger subsided? You feel better? You've avenged so many wrongs, and should feel happier by now. How about giving me a smile?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I haven't seen you smile in a long time. Seeing you so bitter puts me in a bad mood, too.

speaker: Trust them to do their job. There isn't much we can do.
content: I've eliminated many Rustfire thugs, Executive Officers, and Nirvana scum. I've killed so many enemies, yet I don't feel like I've completed my vengeance.

speaker: Sumire
content: ...There are simply too many of them to kill. There are too many bastards who are responsible for his pain. I can't kill them all. They don't even know what they've done!
female_content: ...There are simply too many of them to kill. There are too many bastards who are responsible for her pain. I can't kill them all. They don't even know what they've done!

content: She bends over in agony, burying her face in her hands.

speaker: Sumire
content: You once said that the joy from vengeance would liberate me from hatred, but this hatred is endless. It's blurring and wearing me down... I have no way of freeing myself.

speaker: Sumire
content: You've also been dealing with endless hatred. How do you cope? How do you stop your heart from becoming numb?

speaker: Sumire
content: Or is this just the price I have to pay for giving away my heart? Because after losing him, I can never find a replacement.
female_content: Or is this just the price I have to pay for giving away my heart? Because after losing her, I can never find a replacement.

speaker: Sumire
content: Is that why you told us to only love ourselves forever?

speaker: Sumire
content: I don't know what to do, I... need your guidance.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...You're living well and suddenly someone stabs you, but you can't find the culprit. You can only fumble blindly in the dark.

speaker: Coquelic
content: This is not vengeance. You're just being driven by pain. Fate has hurt you. You need to first find out who's the bastard that did it, then figure out how to deal with him.

speaker: Coquelic
content: If you can't find the culprit, just let it go for now. Maybe in a couple of days, he'll come to you head-on.

speaker: Coquelic
content: As for how to punish bad "fate"... There are other ways aside from an eye for an eye.

speaker: Sumire
content: You mean...?

speaker: Coquelic
content: If that idiot is still alive, find him and take him back. There's nothing wrong with liking someone. Instead of giving your heart away, why don't you get him to give his heart to you and hold on to it tightly?
female_content: If that idiot is still alive, find her and take her back. There's nothing wrong with liking someone. Instead of giving your heart away, why don't you get her to give her heart to you and hold on to it tightly?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I would like to go find him if I had the chance. I want to see how that silly boy is doing. But...
female_content: I would like to go find her if I had the chance. I want to see how that silly girl is doing. But...

content: She smooths Sumire's hair and flashes a rare, gentle smile.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Listen up. This is the last time I'm teaching you. I won't say it again.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You are all flowers that I've picked. You all more or less have some of my qualities to have been able to join my Garden. The more beautiful the flower, the more bugs it attracts, and you all know how much these self-righteous bugs love to trample on flowers.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Flowers are indeed fragile. The more beautiful they are, the likelier they are to bend and wither with a slight blow. Just like how pitiful all of you were when you first came to me.

speaker: Coquelic
content: But it's okay, let them come. You might appear weak, but you're stronger than you think.

speaker: Coquelic
content: If you're crushed, you'll bloom again next year. If you're burned, you'll sprout new buds from the ashes. Fate can break you, but it can never destroy you... as long as you keep your roots firmly in the ground.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Don't drift with the current. Don't let fate push you around. Don't let external things lead you astray.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Your lives are your own. Don't listen to anyone but me.
She lets go of her hands and gets up. The sound of splashing water echoes all around.

speaker: Sumire
content: I will, but Mentor, what did you mean just now? Why did you say it's "the last time"?

speaker: Sumire
content: You've been fighting alone for the past two months. Everyone is very worried about you.

speaker: Sumire
content: Do you have any other arrangements? Please tell me. Your health...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ah, I can't stand it. I feel bad all over. Call everyone over for a massage. Consider it my birthday celebration in advance.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Wishing for beauty, joy and wishes coming true today and every day.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Think about how to make your Mentor happy. Today's task is to give me the best day ever!
She had the best day ever indeed.
After that night, Coquelic leaves a stack of handwritten instructions, punishes each assassin with solitary confinement, and then disappears from her Garden.

The FAC will shift its focus back to the main battlefield, dealing with all possible obstacles.

The 9th Agency is keeping a close eye on the actions of suspicious elements from the Underground. The Black Ring Blockade Operation will inevitably be fiercely countered by the enemy. This is also an opportunity to tear off their disguise.

Paradeisos's HUSH Unit will withdraw from the main battlefield and continue to investigate the mastermind behind the attack from the Garden. This relates to the spatial mysteries of the hidden Underground entrance.

Paradeisos's special envoy Hush X will continue to assist in operations, providing observational data and strategies for reference.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: No matter how powerful the Underground's Shepherd is, as long as Paradeisos finds SHP-13 first, humanity will take the lead.

content:
<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: But is he still reliable? Previous observations have shown that SHP-13's <color=#fb9259>"shackles"</color> have swallowed too many Corpuses. That's his instinct, and his capacity is already close to historical limits.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: While contacting the BR-002 Corpus, the defensive <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> inside his body have activated twice to halt his swallowing process. This shows that the risk is already close to surpassing our limit.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Now that he's connected with the BR-002 Corpus, and further connected with the rapidly expanding mega-Black Ring, the immense Mania has dissolved all the safeguards we've set. In my opinion, he should not be trusted.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: I'm more worried about who stole him. Is it the Underground?

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Even if he's the weakest defective product, he's still way beyond our control. Plus, before...

content:
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: It's okay, <color=#fb9259>X</color> will find him.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: If our safety measures falter, just reinforce them. Eliminate any unexpected risky behavior on the spot.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Paradeisos's <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> are ironclad for them; we've verified this. The moment he regains control, Mania won't be able to dismantle the "Rules" we've established. He's a valuable asset.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: We'll just have to repurpose him then.

content:
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: There's a high chance SHP-13 is trapped in the Depths of Mania. Locate him but don't awaken him; keep him in that state.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Have the Underground Shepherd consume BR-002 Corpus, which will also result in the consumption of SHP-13. FAC's defense grid will pinpoint the moment when the three entities are ready to fuse, and then...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Take this chance to apply the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> to SHP-13. If we can't wipe out all three threats at once, we can at least severely cripple the Underground Shepherd. Marking it alone would be a win for us.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Isn't that right, <color=#fb9259>X</color>?
