content:
<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Apologies, a stray kitten wandered in. I've just shooed it away. I'll get right on reviewing the logs.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: You seem to be holding up well.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Yes, you know me well. The plan is going smoothly, and I find that gratifying.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: So, besides giving direct support to FAC, my real job is to recover <color=#fb9259>SHP-13</color>, correct?

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Exactly.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Excellent. I've already considered this scenario and have a plan in place. Coincidentally, it ties in with what I'm working on right now...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The Garden?

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Correct. They're targeting me, and since I can't evade them, I'll turn them into an asset.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Otherwise, once the Underground gets wind of it and sends them after ${PlayerName}, we may not outpace those assassins.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: You're always so dependable. This is a difficult task. Would you like to extend your service life?

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: No, risk management comes first.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: I've been <color=#fb9259>observing</color> for far too long; the corrosive risk is approaching the limit. The operation should be handed off when the time is right.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: The war is about to begin. We should let a more reliable backup take control of the HUSH system to ensure uninterrupted strategy.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Don't worry, all your needs will be taken care of, just like always.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Very well.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: You've always been our most efficient and dependable Hush; you've never let us down.

speaker: Shalom
content: Of course, it's already underway; it'll be very soon...

Once the communication is over, Shalom takes the damp cloth from Rahu and wipes away the grime that has splashed onto her. Another Mania assassin has just been dealt with, the monocular mark on its face slowly fading away.

As its body breaks apart, eerie fragments are revealed. Every puppet that has attacked her over the past half-month has carried similar objects. Shalom compiles the encoded messages; even though they're incomplete, it's enough to discern the sender's motives. She allows herself a subtle smile.

2:23 a.m., August 19, N.F. 113
The Rust, near the DisSea radiation zone.
Along the edge of the Rust, a woman dressed entirely in black moves with haste, vanishing from one part of the void only to reappear in another instantaneously.
At last, she finds a sanctuary where her soul can rest.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: Ha... I've finally lost them...

speaker: Woman in Black
content: The HUSH units from Paradeisos... from the West District to Eastside, they've been hindering us, as if they've got us figured out... The one pulling the strings is that Sinner, <color=#fb9259>Shalom</color>...

speaker: Woman in Black
content: I'm in deep trouble now...
The woman in black leans silently against the wall, her wounds severe and leaving her too drained to keep running.
Reinforcements aren't coming—that's just the way they operate. Field agents like her work alone on the Overground, each carrying the weight of their own life and death.
It's their only way to stand against Paradeisos.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: While we're cautiously mining power little by little from external sources, Paradeisos has already penetrated deep into the heart of Mania—reaching at least the 8th level of <color=#fb9259>Collective Observation</color>.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: No... they can't possibly harness such profound power yet. If they could, the game would already be over; we'd have no chance of winning.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: Right now, they're just observing and communicating. They were able to make such precise manipulations in March because they've noticed fluctuations in the collective will within the <color=#fb9259>world of Mania</color>. As for ten years ago, the mission across the DisSea was also directly overseen by Paradeisos.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: But even observation has its limits... No matter the technique used, an <color=#fb9259>Observer</color> is bound to be corroded over time. This means Paradeisos must have <color=#fb9259>backup</color> Observers on hand. Have they really advanced their technology to this extent?

If all this is part of the Hush's grand scheme, derived from her observations, and if she has indeed penetrated the depths of Mania... then what she might see or do is beyond any comprehension from the Underground.
What sort of technology does Paradeisos have to keep such a monster under control? And could this technology be effective on ****?
The thought sends a shiver down the woman in black. Fear and loathing well up inside her.

speaker: Woman in Black
content: At all costs... they must be stopped, must be eradicated... <color=#fb9259>Hush X</color>, Shalom... Otherwise, BR-002 will...
As she wrestles with her thoughts, a voice she knows all too well pierces the darkness.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Oh, my. Segal, is that you? Long time no see. You look like you've been through the wringer.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Don't die; my Garden still relies on your little tricks to stay hidden.

speaker: Segal
content: Heh... The power isn't mine; it's from the Underground, and now it's yours alone.

speaker: Segal
content: I honored your terms and paid you upfront, but as it stands... you've failed to fulfill your end of the bargain.

speaker: Segal
content: Worse yet... you've compromised us all.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Is that so? Well, I am... truly... sorry.
Coquelic steps forward, closing in on Segal. With a swift move, she plunges her hand into Segal's wound.

speaker: Segal
content: Cough!!

speaker: Coquelic
content: It was you who tricked Garofano, wasn't it... Fed her deadly misinformation, along with those vile runes.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You seek my aid instead of turning to your fellow beings from the Underground—clearly, you've been cast aside.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You've always been our sole point of contact. With your departure, the Garden stands to lose a significant client—a regrettable loss, indeed.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Thank you for your final patronage. From now on, my Garden will have no further ties with the Underground.

speaker: Segal
content: Cough... Hehe... Hehehehe...

speaker: Segal
content: You didn't have to betray me... Given your skills, defying the Underground would hardly put you in harm's way...

speaker: Segal
content: But it doesn't matter now... my mission is fulfilled...

speaker: Segal
content: I know why you did this... I know the sacrifices you made for this newfound power. I know why you betrayed me...

speaker: Segal
content: Ahhhhhhhh!!

Before she can utter another word, Coquelic swings her hand, extracting an enormous, dark, and eerily writhing alien flower from within her. As this happens, Segal is transformed beyond recognition, leaving only the sinister bloom displayed against her black attire.
Coquelic observes the woman's form dissolving before her eyes and witnesses the nightmarish entity she has unleashed. This should have been done much sooner.
The one who cast Coquelic into the abyss, who has ensnared her for countless years, this lowly rat who dares to covet her Garden—has finally been banished to where she rightfully belongs.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Of course, because I wanted to.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Next...
She gazes intently at the intelligence concealed in the woman's embrace. And on the other side... another individual who presents even more of a challenge.

speaker: Wriggling Flower Mud
content: It's fine, go... I know you'll help me...

7:00 a.m., August 23, N.F. 113
FAC Black Ring Blockade Operation Joint Command

The first set of critical strongholds has been successfully captured, and the anti-Mania core base is under rapid construction. As anticipated, we've met with resistance; hordes of Mania Mutants and incited remnants of rioters are relentlessly attacking our front lines.

But exactly as Observer X from Paradeisos predicted, we successfully deceived the enemy with intelligence operations before the battle. They received a falsified stronghold distribution map and walked right into our pre-laid trap.
This provided our spearhead forces with a crucial advantage. Bolstered by soaring morale, we're making steady progress in fortifying our frontlines.
Schorl has assumed communications duties, while Shalom attentively listens to incoming messages.

speaker: Shalom
content: Is that so... That's wonderful news.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're too kind. You are the true heroes, spilling blood and sweat on the front lines to face the enemy. My role, as assigned by Paradeisos, is to support you in every way possible.

speaker: Shalom
content: Well, the core base is now secure, and the entire defense grid has been successfully activated. It's time to focus on the front lines; there's limited scope for intel operations now.

speaker: Shalom
content: Going forward, the Underground forces will spring into action; that's where the real struggle begins. I have other crucial tasks to attend to as well.

speaker: Shalom
content: Good luck out there, heroes of Dis.
Communications have been closed. Schorl hovers silently beside her, emitting a flicker of blue light.

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>We're operating efficiently. All other departments are in place. Next up—</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: It's time to deal with SHP-13.

speaker: Shalom
content: Certainly, your assessment is spot-on. Locating <color=#fb9259>him</color> is our foremost priority at this moment.
female_content: Certainly, your assessment is spot-on. Locating <color=#fb9259>her</color> is our foremost priority at this moment.

speaker: Shalom
content: Either we capitalize on this moment to fully reform him into someone "trustworthy," or we eradicate this latent threat altogether. Paradeisos must locate him before the Underground becomes aware.
female_content: Either we capitalize on this moment to fully reform her into someone "trustworthy," or we eradicate this latent threat altogether. Paradeisos must locate her before the Underground becomes aware.

speaker: Shalom
content: Neither FAC, MBCC, the 9th Agency, nor even HUSH can directly intervene; the objective would be far too transparent, and the Underground would inevitably detect it. They should remain focused on the front lines—the August Offensive serves as our optimal subterfuge.

speaker: Shalom
content: As for the remainder, entrust it to me. I know precisely <color=#fb9259>whom</color> to engage for the task; plans have already been formulated for his retrieval. Consider this my ultimate, flawlessly executed mission.
female_content: As for the remainder, entrust it to me. I know precisely <color=#fb9259>whom</color> to engage for the task; plans have already been formulated for her retrieval. Consider this my ultimate, flawlessly executed mission.

content: ...Unless someone interferes.
Just as this thought crosses her mind, a visitor darkens her doorstep.
Ah, has the grand operation come to a successful close?

Emerging from the shadows behind her, the Garden's Mentor holds a floral sword marred with the remnants of her quarry. She breaches the most stringent security, silently evading all alarms, and now stands before the Hush.
Shalom doesn't turn around, but Schorl is already hovering behind her, entering a state of heightened alert.

speaker: Shalom
content: Welcome, Mentor. We've located the Undergrounder, adorned with unsettling blooms. Your handiwork, I presume?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Uh-huh, don't mention it—you all owe me more thanks than you could imagine. If it weren't for my <color=#fb9259>"gentle nudge,"</color> that FAC Commander-in-Chief and those junior commanders wouldn't have even made it to the battlefield.

speaker: Coquelic
content: So, shouldn't the highest honor for this West District Defense Operation go to me?

speaker: Shalom
content: Absolutely, you're nothing short of remarkable.

speaker: Shalom
content: Taking on the Underground's most crucial assignment, you've plunged headlong into the fiercest zones of conflict for both sides. After stirring the pot, you subtly redirected the chaos back towards your own client. Ultimately, you've broken the chains that have been choking you for so long.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's a delicate balancing act, but you've managed it well—no wonder you've been able to move so freely between Paradeisos and the Underground for years.
Shalom turns to Coquelic, her smile tinged with kindness.

speaker: Shalom
content: Seeing as you've severed all ties with the Underground... would you consider aligning with me?
Coquelic is taken aback, yet pleasantly surprised.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Really? Is it possible? Would you forgive me, accept us?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ah, I can't go on pretending any longer.

In the blink of an eye, the crimson floral sword and the obsidian shield clash and recoil. Shalom remains unmoving, while Rahu has already positioned herself before her, deflecting Coquelic's assault with her shield.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Heh, it's this pathetic guard again. You had some spirit last time I saw you; what happened, did my blade snuff out that spirit, turning you into her lapdog?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I still remember vividly what happened to her last lapdog. So what's the deal with that airhead? Dead, or just cried her eyes out?

speaker: Coquelic
content: And people still buy into your nonsense after seeing that? What, did you brainwash them or something?

speaker: Shalom
content: You sure live without a care, settling scores as if it's nothing. Most people wouldn't dare;

speaker: Shalom
content: They'd fear accumulating enemies, endangering those they care about... the steep price of revenge.

speaker: Shalom
content: What's your take? Does it not bother you? And what about your Garden?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hehe... You're talking about the unending chain of hatred, aren't you? When will this cycle of vengeance ever break? Is your point to value those who stand before us now?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I am the Master of the Garden, the head of Assassin Group. People seeking vengeance flock to me in droves, just as countless others beseech me to exact revenge on their behalf. And you're talking to me about hatred?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Would you spare me your harassment because I am just and kind? No, the only reason you'd hesitate is the knowledge that crossing my path means certain death.

speaker: Coquelic
content: This world has never been kind to us just because I tread carefully and abide by the rules. The only things that grant us the freedom to truly live are <color=#fb9259>raw power</color> and the principle of an eye for an eye.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Shall I teach you this lesson up close and personal?

speaker: Shalom
content: Hmm, my apologies. With your strength, you've certainly earned the right to act as you wish.

Reaching out, she catches petals falling amidst their fierce clash. These are the Mania flowers, crafted by Coquelic. Shalom appreciates their delicate beauty as she lightly rubs them between her fingers.

speaker: Shalom
content: Both Paradeisos and the Underground fear your might and madness, dreading the day you'll come to collect their dues. As long as you're alive, neither your Garden nor your Blooms need to worry about being trampled.

speaker: Shalom
content: If I were you, I'd be more at ease, more reassured—just as you <color=#fb9259>used to be</color>. You've always struck a fine balance between the two.

speaker: Shalom
content: If so, why this sudden impatience?

speaker: Shalom
content: Both sides are on the brink of war, and yet, you've not only chosen not to sidestep the conflict—you've thrown yourself into it. You accepted a contract from the Underground to challenge the Paradeisos, and now, you're turning their own blade back on them. It's as if you're determined to sever every tie that binds your Garden, come what may.
Her gaze settles on Coquelic, taking in her impossibly youthful face and her eerily pale skin. It's as if time has stood still for her, frozen in some distant past.
Shalom smiles, a knowing glint in her eyes.

speaker: Shalom
content: Your extraordinary strength has been traded for your <color=#fb9259>life</color>, hasn't it? Just how many days do you have left, Mentor?
The atmosphere grows suddenly tense.
Coquelic fixes her eyes on the Hush of Paradeisos. After a moment that feels like an eternity, she unsheathes her sword—this time, all levity has vanished.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...Are you wishing for my death? How uncouth. I'll have you know, my days are numbered higher than yours!

speaker: Shalom
content: Just a question—is it that I hit the nail on the head?
Shalom laughs. Before she can even finish speaking, that white figure surges forward, crashing forcefully into Rahu's shield.

speaker: Shalom
content: I remember <color=#fb9259>Segal</color>, the Undergrounder. She was the only one who managed to consistently evade HUSH during the whole chase. According to the reports, she's either mastered some kind of <color=#fb9259>spatial powers</color> or she's tapped into the Underground Mania magic.

speaker: Shalom
content: That's your reward for taking on this mission, right? Once the mission's complete, she'll show you how to perfectly conceal the Garden.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Feel free to guess, but even if you guessed it, you're incapable of deciphering the arcane arts of the Underground. Otherwise, you wouldn't have been groping in the dark for years, failing to even locate the entrance. Losers！

speaker: Shalom
content: You're right, Paradeisos doesn't have the same mastery over Mania as the Underground, making it impossible for them to locate the Garden. Besides, your Blooms have all become experts at concealment.

speaker: Shalom
content: Within the finite life you have, you've gone to great lengths to pave their path. Mentor, you possess a finesse and a softer side that's even greater than you realize—truly commendable.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Tsk, you make me sick. I only act in my own interest. I accepted this Garden because they're good at serving me—it pleases me.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're right, they do love you very much, even more profoundly than you realize.
Hearing those words, Coquelic gets goosebumps all over. In an instant, her crystalline weapon, forged from the essence of countless fallen foes, is shattered by a piercing beam of blue light.

The attack comes from Schorl, glowing ominously, adjacent to the Sinner Shalom. It unfurls its form and gracefully floats to the battlefield's core. Rahu has retreated, lifting her shields to protect Shalom.

Coquelic recalls the devastating potency of its assault against Mania. During the abduction episode, its unexpected celestial downpour obliterated an entire truck filled with Underground Mania Bombs. For the Sinners, this entity is nothing short of Paradeisos's man-made God of Death.

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>Your foresight was spot-on; the Underground has indeed nurtured a perilous Sinner. It's no wonder that Paradeisos has struggled to eradicate her for so long.</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>However, her vitality has been severely drained by Mania; her sluggish movements pose little threat.</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>Eliminate her, X. For the sake of your mission, you must remove any chance of Underground interference.</color>

Shalom looks beyond the God of Death, fixing her gaze on the targeted Coquelic. Unwavering before Schorl, she has already unsheathed a new floral sword. She must have amassed considerable power for this odyssey.
You're all underestimating her... She's not indecisive; her subconscious is actively seeking a way to cheat death. She aspires to meet her end elsewhere.
But that won't work, Coquelic... Unleash your full power, or your blossom will be crushed before it even blooms.
Shalom clenches the petals in her hand and starts to speak softly.

speaker: Shalom
content: In Erica Villa, merely mentioning you makes Garofano barge in without a second thought. Out of all the misinformation we've provided, she's most intrigued by the technology that enables control over Mania to help extend lifespan.

speaker: Shalom
content: Your flowers must be growing increasingly anxious. Did you fill them in on this details of this mission? When was the last time you went back and saw them?

speaker: Shalom
content: It's been long enough that the mere trickle of information I released about you sent eager young fools rushing to investigate...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Are these...?
Shalom pulls a few blue crystal flowers from her pocket: Violet, Carnation, Chrysanthemum, Lily.
As Coquelic catches sight of them, her eyes narrow instantly. Shalom smiles, savoring every nuance of Coquelic's reaction.

speaker: Shalom
content: You know, they want to protect you just as much.

speaker: Shalom
content: I have my regrets, but you've accumulated too many enemies on this path. Once the order reached me, there was no turning back.

speaker: Shalom
content: You can't shield them alone, not forever. Some things are simply fated.
What will the Garden's Master do next, and to what extent can she act...

5:20 p.m., August 23, N.F. 113
Eastside, Banyan Medical College First Affiliated Hospital
Special Ward
Inspector Dole stays behind to accompany Christina. He says he'll wait for her to recover in the hospital.

speaker: Dole
content: It's not a big deal, I'll prove it to you.
In front of Christina's hospital bed, Inspector Dole awkwardly cuts an apple. He's not good at taking care of people. He cuts pieces of different sizes, and almost cuts his hand.
The girl stares blankly without any reaction. In just a few days, she's lost a lot of weight, and her once sparkling eyes have dulled.

speaker: Dole
content: MBCC has agreed, no matter what, they will not detain you until you've recovered from your injuries. In the meantime, the investigation team will prepare explanatory materials for you to prove your stability. Your uncle at FAC is also making connections everywhere.

speaker: Dole
content: I don't know who exactly gave this order, but it's okay, we all know you're a good kid. You...
His words are cut off as his work phone vibrates. After Dole picks it up and whispers a few words, he frowns and stands up.

speaker: Dole
content: I got work to do, so I'll get going. Eat something, take care of yourself first.

speaker: Christina
content: Inspector.

speaker: Dole
content: Hmm? What's up? Do you need something?

speaker: Christina
content: ...Does justice really exist?

Dole's eyes turn red. He roughly cuts the apple into the plate, sticks a toothpick in it, and places it in Christina' hand. He turns around to leave the ward but stops at the doorway, slamming his fist against the door frame.

speaker: Dole
content: Don't give up, Chris. You've always been advocating justice for others, now when it's your turn to need it, we'll give it back to you.
He steps out of the ward, the door is immediately locked. Christina is now in a semi-house arrest state, she sits blankly in the ward, staring out the window.
The sun sets, and night falls.

She gets out of bed, pulls out the hidden roll of bandages, ties one end around her waist and the other to the head of the bed. She checks the length, then checks the eaves and pipes outside the window where she can land.

She then turns and walks into the bathroom, picks up the fruit knife left by Dole, wipes it with the stashed alcohol, and makes a shallow cut behind her ear to remove the tracker. When she comes out, she grabs the top of the infusion stand, breaks it to a convenient length, and tucks it into her waist.
Before leaving, she notices the unsightly cut, yellowed apple on the plate. She picks up a piece to eat but then puts it back down.

speaker: Christina
content: Does it exist...
She rubs her red eyes and rolls out.
Half an hour later, alarms ring throughout the hospital, quickly spreading to half of Eastside.

01:24, August 24th, N.F. 113
The house of Christina and Mireya

The Hush approaches Coquelic, the expression on her face becoming more ambiguous and unfathomable.

speaker: Shalom
content: This is the only place they can't touch, so they make so many rules to control the risks. Only I have been approved, granted permission to enter here, and you forced your way in by defeating me.

speaker: Shalom
content: I am glad. What I am about to say next, it is only between us.
She stops half a step in front of the Mentor. Before being disgustingly pierced by Coquelic, Shalom lifts both hands to hold the Mentor's cheeks, forcing her to look directly into her eyes.

speaker: Shalom
content: I have the ability to keep you alive, to protect your Garden. All you have to do is help me do one thing, to find <color=#fb9259>someone</color>.

speaker: Shalom
content: The Chief of Minos, the holder of the shackles, ${PlayerName}. He disappeared in the Rustfire uprising in the West District, the shackles were contaminated and spread by the Corpseborne. Under the intervention of the Black Ring, neither MBCC nor Paradeisos could find him through sensing.
female_content: The Chief of Minos, the holder of the shackles, ${PlayerName}. She disappeared in the Rustfire uprising in the West District, the shackles were contaminated and spread by the Corpseborne. Under the intervention of the Black Ring, neither MBCC nor Paradeisos could find her through sensing.

speaker: Shalom
content: Those hiding him are very capable, but soon more people will come looking, and no one will be able to hide him any longer.
female_content: Those hiding her are very capable, but soon more people will come looking, and no one will be able to hide her any longer.

speaker: Shalom
content: I want you to use your ability as the Master of the Garden, the ability to slip through the cracks, and find him before anyone else.
female_content: I want you to use your ability as the Master of the Garden, the ability to slip through the cracks, and find her before anyone else.

content: Shalom's face still remains as impassive as a wax figure, but the force in her hands gradually increases, carrying an undeniable will.
...This woman is serious. Realizing this, Coquelic bursts into dumbfounded laughter.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I see, it's that person who Sumire misses... But didn't you kill him? Isn't he also a casualty of your fight with the Underground?
female_content: I see, it's that person who Sumire misses... But didn't you kill her? Isn't she also a casualty of your fight with the Underground?

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes, it was carefully planned by me. I received the mission, pondered carefully, and cautiously led him to a dead end in the turbulent situation.
female_content: Yes, it was carefully planned by me. I received the mission, pondered carefully, and cautiously led her to a dead end in the turbulent situation.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Then why are you looking for him? To exterminate him, to make up for the failure at that time? Or now that the situation is out of control, you want to catch him back as a dog?
female_content: Then why are you looking for her? To exterminate her, to make up for the failure at that time? Or now that the situation is out of control, you want to catch her back as a dog?

speaker: Shalom
content: No, I want you to find him, and then, <color=#fb9259>kill anyone who comes looking for him</color>, stay in the dark until he wakes up. Apart from this, you don't have to do anything else.
female_content: No, I want you to find her, and then, <color=#fb9259>kill anyone who comes looking for her</color>, stay in the dark until she wakes up. Apart from this, you don't have to do anything else.

content: Coquelic is stunned.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Are you out of your mind?
Shalom tilts her head and actually starts laughing.

speaker: Shalom
content: No? I painstakingly made my way here, step by step, finally found a solution, I even wanted to be proud of it.

speaker: Shalom
content: Even if he lost his memory, he's a rare troublemaker who can really hurt both sides.
female_content: Even if she lost her memory, she's a rare troublemaker who can really hurt both sides.

content: Shalom's smile deepens, which somehow gives Coquelic the creeps.

speaker: Shalom
content: The <color=#fb9259>shackles</color> are carefully studied and used by Paradeisos. First, they suppressed the Sinner, then dealt with Mania, and then tried to suppress the Black Ring...

speaker: Shalom
content: For ten years, Paradeisos needed this power and strived to chase the truth behind it, but could never fully understand it, nor dare to let its guard down.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Because those were the craziest creations of <color=#fb9259>the Underground</color>. Born from the Lone Island in DisSea, fed by the Black Ring, and ultimately leading to the source. It's the <color=#fb9259>ultimate container</color> created by those madmen who wanted to steal Mania, and the revival of Mania is Paradeisos's greatest fear.

speaker: Shalom
content: After receiving this news, Paradeisos took action at all costs, broke into DisSea, made huge sacrifices to destroy the Lone Island, and severely damaged the Underground. It was a great victory that must be silenced, and what they brought back was such a fearful existence.

speaker: Shalom
content: You were in the Garden at that time, you should remember.
She remembers.

Ten years ago, the <color=#fb9259>defeat</color> that shook the whole city-state, the <color=#fb9259>meaningless</color> sacrifice. Coquelic recalls the things she had thrown behind her mind out of disgust back then.

N.F. 103,
Courtyard of the Garden

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...It's you, coming so suddenly, how annoying.

speaker: Coquelic
content: The Mentor isn't here, you can look for her tomorrow.

speaker: Segal
content: ...Urgent mission... Garden, eliminate our enemies...

speaker: Segal
content: Anyone will do, just send everyone. Those people on the list, find them and kill them all.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Tch, that woman is at your beck and call, but I'm not—

speaker: Segal
content: Kill them! Reckless fools! Dare to touch that place! Who do they think they are!

speaker: Segal
content: *** was destroyed, *** was taken away, and they even dared to hurt ***!! Kill them, kill them all!!

That was the only time she saw the pretentious woman from the Underground so angry and desperate. During those two years, the Underground's mad assassination commissions kept pressing on the Garden's doorstep. Her Mentor at that time kept asking her to do boring and despicable "work."

...So many innocent people have cried their eyes dry and are scarred all over, left with nowhere to go but to knock on the gates of the Garden. This is a covert and vicious war, with both sides intent on annihilating the enemy, and the brutal consequences are borne by those outside the war.
How ridiculous, how absurd, how shameless. Those memories she once sneered at and dismissed from her mind, she now recalls them all, understands them all.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ha, haha... I see... So that's how it is...
She brushes off the hand of the Paradeisos Hush.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You've stolen the enemy's knife, find it awkward to use, yet are reluctant to toss it away. When the real battle comes, you start fearing that the enemy's mysterious trick might backfire on you. So in the end, you break it, melt it, and use it as a mere prop, right?

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes. He gained too much power, gradually approaching his origin. Paradeisos got scared and enacted the strictest rules to prevent him from swallowing the Black Rings any further. Once, twice... by the third time, he was undoubtedly doomed.
female_content: Yes. She gained too much power, gradually approaching her origin. Paradeisos got scared and enacted the strictest rules to prevent her from swallowing the Black Rings any further. Once, twice... by the third time, she was undoubtedly doomed.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Talking big, but in the end, aren't you just a coward? Not just a coward, but also hypocritical, arrogant, delusional, and cruel. Who do you think you are?!

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes, this is <color=#fb9259>Paradeisos</color>... desperately seeking the truth, the correct answer, yet also fearing risks and the unknown, terrified of disaster striking again. They established so many rules and safeguards, protecting against everything but also driving themselves and everyone else to a dead end.

speaker: Shalom
content: As for what the <color=#fb9259>Underground</color> is like, you know better than I do, don't you?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I'm not like them, but I know that you two are just dogs fighting each other! Don't act like you're the hero just because you fought the bad guys!

speaker: Shalom
content: Exactly, one side can sacrifice everything to resist Mania, while the other side can sacrifice everything to obtain Mania. The disaster hasn't even awakened yet, and humans have already fallen into madness, fighting each other and burning everything to the ground.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You should all go to hell together, how dare you drag the others into this!!

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes, it will happen, but before that...
Shalom grabs Coquelic's wrist again. This time, the Mentor can't break free. Upon looking up, the woman's face is already close.

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't you want to see other possibilities? Don't you want to reject this foolish path? Just do as I say, go find him.
female_content: Don't you want to see other possibilities? Don't you want to reject this foolish path? Just do as I say, go find her.

speaker: Shalom
content: I've already destroyed the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> that bind him, sent him away from all surveillance, to a place even I can't reach. But this isn't enough.
female_content: I've already destroyed the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> that bind her, sent her away from all surveillance, to a place even I can't reach. But this isn't enough.

speaker: Shalom
content: <color=#fb9259>The Second Black Ring</color> carries everything of the West District, it is destined to revive and turn into a storm again. As the <color=#fb9259>Shepherd</color> connected to it, he will inevitably be fought over again. It's time to move to the next stage. Please, go to the place that I can't.
female_content: <color=#fb9259>The Second Black Ring</color> carries everything of the West District, it is destined to revive and turn into a storm again. As the <color=#fb9259>Shepherd</color> connected to it, she will inevitably be fought over again. It's time to move to the next stage. Please, go to the place that I can't.

speaker: Shalom
content: You are the strongest among the crossfire, only you have been able to navigate both sides over the years, capable of keeping him from falling into either side's hands. This time, you just need to protect one person, you can do it.
female_content: You are the strongest among the crossfire, only you have been able to navigate both sides over the years, capable of keeping her from falling into either side's hands. This time, you just need to protect one person, you can do it.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...Ha, what, are you only talking about betraying Paradeisos now?

speaker: Shalom
content: What are you talking about? During my term, I was always the most efficient Hush, I fulfilled every demand, no one could accuse me of betrayal.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's just that in this increasingly stagnant stalemate, I casually loosen the binds on a little monster.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Another tool of yours, huh? What are you planning for him this time?
female_content: Another tool of yours, huh? What are you planning for her this time?

speaker: Shalom
content: Why should I plan anything for him? That's the most troublesome, hardest to use, and most uncontrollable tool. For a guy like him, you should set him free and let him cause chaos.
female_content: Why should I plan anything for her? That's the most troublesome, hardest to use, and most uncontrollable tool. For a girl like her, you should set her free and let her cause chaos.

speaker: Shalom
content: Go set him free, Coquelic. Like you, he's also destined to belong to no one. Whether you want to take revenge on Paradeisos, the Underground, or fate, this is an opportunity. Let him cause a huge commotion, you'll enjoy it.
female_content: Go set her free, Coquelic. Like you, she's also destined to belong to no one. Whether you want to take revenge on Paradeisos, the Underground, or fate, this is an opportunity. Let her cause a huge commotion, you'll enjoy it.

speaker: Shalom
content: As payment for the commission, whether you want to use my power to survive and seek rebirth, or to destroy me and swing your sword towards greater heights, you can try both.

speaker: Shalom
content: No one else will give you a chance besides me.
She finishes speaking and waits for Coquelic's reply. The Mentor looks into Shalom's eyes, those hollow eyes now seem sincere because of their emptiness.
No lies, no disguises, no impurities. After all the meticulous planning, it's such a covert <color=#fb9259>commission</color> that takes so much effort to deliver into my hands... How stupid.
If she had come to me for help earlier, maybe I would have considered it. If she hadn't done those unnecessary things, maybe the Garden could have used this woman for something.
If only I had known there were other choices earlier...
Too bad. There won't be. She has long stopped thinking about "what ifs."

speaker: Coquelic
content: Heh... once I've rested, I might consider going. But I don't need to borrow his power to take revenge. When I do things, I don't need to rely on others.
female_content: Heh... once I've rested, I might consider going. But I don't need to borrow her power to take revenge. When I do things, I don't need to rely on others.

speaker: Coquelic
content: It's just to see what that heart-stealing thief is capable of, to make my little Garden fool cry so pitifully.
Coquelic breaks free from the Hush's hand once again, takes two steps back, and completely distances herself from Shalom.
She looks at Shalom and thinks of something funny.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Haha... I now know how that little blonde felt when she was scolding me...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Evil is evil. It doesn't matter what your stance or reasons are. Casually brushing over the debts we owe in the course of your self-serving talk. In this respect, we are both filled with evil.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're right. Cutting costs is just my personal interest, fulfilling demands is the absolute goal, and "necessary sacrifices" are a common means. This is their will. Witness how it's carried out through <color=#fb9259>me</color>, and you will have no room for wishful thinking.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Sacrifice this today, sacrifice that tomorrow, how much to sacrifice is all up to you. Haha... who do you think you are?!
Shalom quietly looks at her, after a long while, she responds with a smile.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Just a tool that broke secretly during its use period.

Coquelic bursts into laughter. Behind her, the pale blue rift suddenly expands, emitting an eerie light that keeps inching closer. It seems to be attracted to Coquelic, its dazzling glow nearly swallowing her whole.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...I won't live long enough to see that day. I don't want the life you're offering, nor do I want to wait that long to take revenge. No matter whose orders you're following, or how many people are involved... you're the one who disturbed my Garden. So that's that, life is short.

speaker: Coquelic
content: If compared to the <color=#fb9259>righteousness</color> of Paradeisos and the <color=#fb9259>long-standing wishes</color> of the Underground, we're insignificant... If we can be sacrificed at any time, then it doesn't matter if I'm a bit stubborn, a bit rebellious, right?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Now that I'm as light as a feather, it wouldn't matter if I act recklessly, right?

speaker: Coquelic
content: You and this place are both important to Paradeisos?
She slowly approaches the rift. She can hear the strange noises coming from behind it.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Since this rift is something you can't touch...
Coquelic thrusts her hand into the rift. The blue light surges into her body, but she pays no mind, only pushing deeper into it.

The space suddenly shakes violently, a blinding white light tearing through the calm like a sword. From the bottom of the rift, ice-blue crystallized flowers spread, bringing with them the stirring aura of Mania.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You've always pretended to understand me. Then you should know, I wouldn't possibly listen to you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I can't stand your so-called "righteousness." I'm nothing but a tiny assassin caught in the crossfire. My prey, those who hunt me, those who seek my help, none of them are good people. I've strayed from the path, and I will not accept your "righteousness."

speaker: Coquelic
content: The hell with your "right answer"... Letting me in was your mistake, destroying my Garden was your mistake! Whatever I do from now on has nothing to do with you. Now, pay with your life!

An insane power poured in, Coquelic hadn't felt so full of life in a long time. From the rift, she pulls out a strange long sword, emitting a deafening roar. Following this, Mania gushes out from the other side.

The Hush didn't stop it. From the collapsed rift, glowing tendrils writhed out, casting wild light that hit Shalom's face, reflecting a frozen smile with a hint of eerie cracks, as if her long-standing wish had been fulfilled.

speaker: Shalom
content: This is fine... This time, I'm not holding back either.
The empty courtyard shakes violently, mechanical cries and roars echo from the void. From the ominously expanding rift, countless light tendrils slowly emerged.
The tendrils move as if alive, illuminating everything. They touch Coquelic. She feels everything returning.

Surrounded by the tendrils of light, the entire space is filled with intense emotion. She breathes freely, as if all the rebellious power enters her body, all the vitality returns to her hands. It is the exhilarating feeling of regaining control of her life.

speaker: Coquelic
content: How refreshing... I'm back.

speaker: Coquelic
content: No one can control me, life is only so long, I'll squander it as I please. Love or hate, it's all up to me.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I won't sacrifice for anyone. I won't serve anyone. I'll take pleasure in my revenge. Every minute, every second, I will live freely.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I bloom for myself, I live for myself, I die for myself, the one I love most must only be myself. I must hold my fate in my own hands! This is the <color=#fb9259>Garden</color>! I've said it countless times!
She spreads her arms and looks up at the light, laughing and finally shedding tears.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...You guys should also live for yourselves... A bunch of fools...
Familiar smiling faces appear in the light, her flowers. She wants to hug them, protect them, she wants to sleep peacefully in her own Garden.
...The only one left with her in the end is this ice cold woman.

Shalom stands before the rift, among the light tendrils. All tendrils are drawn to Coquelic, giving her life and power, and conveying an inexplicable emotion—it is the first time she feels emotion from that doll.
She looks at Coquelic, with a hint of pity and sorrow, but more so, a cold anticipation.
All conditions to activate the power have been met, Shalom murmurs to herself.

speaker: Shalom
content: I know you won't accept it. Your emotions are too intense, as naked as they are brilliant.

speaker: Shalom
content: If your life wasn't coming to an end, I would have chosen a milder method. But neither of us has time anymore.

speaker: Shalom
content: So resist all you want... I understand, I accept it all.

speaker: Shalom
content: Even if the flowers I've touched are destined to wither, I must keep you alive.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...To hell with you.
She swings her sword and leaps into the light, merging with countless light tendrils. Now, only Shalom remains in her eyes and mind.

...That woman, whom she could never forgive, whom she refuses to submit to, has unknowingly occupied all of Coquelic's consciousness. She raises her sword to strike her enemy, but the woman opens her arms as if to completely embrace her.
Coquelic's life is being restored, but her consciousness is gradually dissolving...
Just as she is about to be swallowed by the light tendrils, the space suddenly fractured.
An unexpected person forcefully breaks through the invisible boundary, barging into the stormy space. At that moment, Coquelic clearly sees a flicker of surprise in the wax-like woman's eyes.

speaker: Christina
content: <size=50>Stop it—!</size>
The ginger girl suddenly breaks through a crack above them, crashing into the ground. She is quickly engulfed by the turbulent Mania of this space.
She stands in front of Coquelic, blocking Shalom, panting heavily, seemingly still recovering from the collision.

speaker: Christina
content: Stop, Coquelic! This isn't a fight, she's about to swallow you whole!

speaker: Coquelic
content: You're still alive... Are you here to get in my way?

speaker: Christina
content: I... I snuck in while you were causing chaos, watching you guys fight, but I couldn't intervene. Until you suddenly... pierced her, made her bloom. Then everything went wrong.

speaker: Christina
content: This isn't reality. In reality, the flowers she bloomed have already blocked the entire space. Just now, they suddenly started backfiring on you. And when I came in, I understood.

speaker: Christina
content: You're being controlled. These white lights have entangled you. The more you attack her, the more the white light will swallow you. You'll be brainwashed. Stop now!

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...So you recklessly dove into the flower that swallows people and followed me in here... all to save me? Hahaha!
Coquelic bursts into laughter, her disgust palpable.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Save me? Who are you trying to fool?! I'm feeling great right now, never felt better! I'll kill her soon, and you're here to save her! Even though she's blown you up with her own hands!

speaker: Coquelic
content: You're the one being brainwashed!
Her words are merciless, like a knife piercing the already trembling young detective. She struggles to keep her footing, teeth gritted as she holds on amidst the rampaging Mania.
This is terrifying, beyond anything she's ever faced before. It takes all her strength just to stay on this horrifying battlefield that far exceeds her capacity.

speaker: Christina
content: No... I... I'm here for myself... for my own...

speaker: Coquelic
content: You don't even have the courage to look back at her!

The ginger fool in front of her is already covered in wounds, her heart shattered. For some reason, decades of memories flood back, looking at her feels like seeing every broken person who first entered the Garden, like seeing her old self.
This girl didn't shed a single tear while being tortured. What is she doing now?

Does she think she'll be treated gently if she makes a sad face? Does she think she can escape by begging for mercy? It's because she can't do anything herself that she blindly believes in other people's kindness! And then she gets trampled on!
Coquelic's head throbs as strange images flash through her mind.

speaker: Christina
content: No, don't be blinded by vengeance, she loves it when you're like this... she wants to fan other people's hatred.
So what are you trying to say? That I should let go? That I should forgive her, embrace love and peace?
Talk about love and peace with her and this damn world?! Does the fate expect us to hope for justice after pushing us into the abyss?
Now that things have come to this, I'll handle it myself... even if it means death, I...

speaker: Christina
content: I know what you've lost is irreplaceable, you're capable of making everyone pay, you don't believe in any justice, only revenge can heal you.

speaker: Christina
content: But none of this should be taken for granted, because from the beginning, you shouldn't have been subjected to this deprivation. There's no reason for you to endure such suffering.
Christina bites her lip, holding back tears as she looks up at Coquelic. She can't run away, a step back would mean falling into an abyss.

speaker: Christina
content: Coquelic, wake up. The Garden is still alive.

speaker: Christina
content: Only you can save them.

speaker: Christina
content: Things didn't add up at the scene, but you were too hurt to see the truth. I brought it to you.

speaker: Thistle
content: The scene was fabricated? The people in the Garden weren't killed? Where's the evidence?

That large pool of blood, it would have taken at least 20 minutes to clot, but the petals that fell on it didn't have a single drop of blood on them. This proves that a lot of time passed after the bleeding before the vase was shattered.

Not just there, all the damaged scenes had the same unnatural feeling to some extent. The bleeding should have occurred with the battle's destruction, but there are too many places where the traces don't match.

Although it could be explained by coincidence, but... isn't there another possibility? The high-intensity attack by HUSH was real, and the Garden was destroyed. But the death and brutality were faked.
It's also possible that the so-called "slaughter" never happened.
The mastermind was her. The wisest, the most efficient. She never wastes energy on useless work. There must be a reason...

The entire ordeal was designed to provoke Coquelic who was at the scene. She cherished the Garden so much; faced with such a shocking sight, she couldn't muster the strength to look closely at such a brutal scene. She would immediately find her enemy and fight to the death.

speaker: Thistle
content: But why would she do this?
Why... Christina has some guesses, but right now she needs to prove...

speaker: Christina
content: Thistle, you work for the Garden, so you must have a lot of connections. I need you to do something for me. Get the real evidence, prove my hypothesis!
Christina reaches determinedly into her pocket, intending to take out her phone and play Thistle's recorded call. Unfortunately, this spiritual space seems to have forgotten to bring her phone in.
She pretends to be calm as she withdraws her hand and wipes it. Coquelic's gaze is fixed on her, giving Christina confidence.

speaker: Christina
content: The evidence is with Thistle. We collected the coagulated blood from the scene and had it verified at a clinic. It's definitely mixed with a large amount of <color=#fb9259>artificial blood</color>.

speaker: Christina
content: My hypothesis is correct. HUSH faked the scene, making you believe that the Garden was dead. She always pursues efficiency and economy, such a roundabout way can only be to satisfy two goals: <color=#fb9259>she needs the Garden alive, and at the same time, to drive you mad.</color>
Coquelic tries to follow this line of thought, but the white light still surrounds her, warning her not to be gullible, and to think clearly about her true purpose.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...I don't believe what you're saying. I won't let you lead me on, don't think you can fool me!

speaker: Coquelic
content: You, a person who's been blinded by her, a waste who gets weak-kneed at the sight of death, what could you find in a place like that?

speaker: Coquelic
content: If they're still alive, why didn't that woman from Paradeisos say so earlier? Wouldn't that have been a better way to trick me into helping her?!
Christina opens her mouth to tell her something, but the words suddenly get stuck in her throat. She feels a pang of pain.

speaker: Mireya
content: Is facing the truth that hard for you, detective?!
It's very hard... Mireya... very hard...
But... we must face it. Because justice can only come from truth.
Even if the truth is painful.

speaker: Christina
content: I've looked into Rahu's transfer records. She was affiliated with the FAC before July, N.F. 103, participating in the Eclipse Operation. Around the time of the Erica Villa incident, her demeanor drastically changed. I contacted her previous commander in the FAC, Captain Conrad, and learned a lot of things.

speaker: Christina
content: From the medical records at that time, Rahu suffered a fatal injury in the early morning of July 24, similar to what I encountered... It was the Hush's Schorl. It can be inferred that they may have fought, the Hush killed Rahu, then saved her and changed her.

speaker: Christina
content: I've seen this situation before.
Christina stops, aware of the gaze behind her. In the silence, she can even imagine that smile, the one she used to love so much.
She clenches her teeth and, word by word, musters all her strength to say what needs to be said.

speaker: Christina
content: In <color=#fb9259>N.F. 104</color>, I attacked Nirvana, attacked Shalom, the Hush on the scene at the time, with the utmost hatred. I was also severely injured then, I wanted to kill her, and then... I was changed too.

speaker: Christina
content: I always thought... always thought it was because she redeemed me. But, but, maybe that's not the case. Seeing what you look like now, I'm even more certain, the truth is not like that.

speaker: Christina
content: The Hush can control the Sinner under <color=#fb9259>certain conditions</color>, making them completely serve herself. This is a more economical, efficient, and stable method than killing them. This is the tactic I know the smartest and most powerful <color=#fb9259>Shalom</color> would use.

speaker: Christina
content: This is the true intention of destroying the Garden. She wants to incite your anger for revenge, and then, like now, use her abilities to completely control you. As for the lives of others... she can "economize," even make them serve her, can't she?

speaker: Christina
content: I have some clues about the whereabouts of the Garden. Once we reach a safe place, I'll tell you. But first, you have to wake up. You also have to see the truth. The truth is—
Christina stammers, her mouth opening and closing several times without being able to utter a word. The tears come first.

speaker: Christina
content: The people I loved most, the things I believed in most, are all gone... It hurts me too! But I can't just stand still, can I?

speaker: Christina
content: Unlike you, revenge doesn't heal me. Even if I exterminate all my enemies, it's just forcing me to admit that the world is rotten, forcing me to stab myself, and then turning me into the person I hate the most.

speaker: Christina
content: Laugh at me if you want, but I choose to believe in justice forever. No matter what happens, I refuse to accept that the world is inherently bad. I cannot stand by while people are stripped of their rights as if it's the norm, or while wrongdoers behave as if their actions are normal.

speaker: Christina
content: I only agree with one thing you said, that I should get up on my own, only I can save myself... I will prove that justice exists, and then bring it to those who need it. Only in this way, can my heart heal.
She lifts her head again, her eyes still tearful, but her gaze is no longer wavering. It's so sharp that it makes Coquelic shiver.

speaker: Christina
content: I found the truth, and brought it to you. I don't have the ability to execute justice, so you do it.

speaker: Christina
content: Don't you want to be free from fate and hold it in your hand? Then stop it before it destroys you, don't give it the chance to trample on you, don't let it take away what's important to you.

speaker: Christina
content: Even if you don't believe others and don't listen to big words, you should at least look at your own heart.

speaker: Christina
content: Don't you want them to come back?
...Of course I do.
The moment she realizes this, the intense desire that she can no longer suppress breaks through all the resentment in her heart.
To hell with the enemy, to hell with revenge, who cares about those dirty bugs? Coquelic just wants to return to her Garden immediately, wants to see her flowers in their vibrant state and hug them.

At this moment, the light that has been entangling her is repelled, and the vitality and resentment that had been instilled in her body are abruptly cut off. And Coquelic fully recovers herself, her consciousness gradually clearing, and the feeling of languor in her body completely disappears.
It isn't until this moment that she sees the exit to leave this place is not far away.
She looks at Shalom. From beginning to end, this woman hasn't said a word, neither refuting nor admitting. At some point, her powerless body had been pierced by blue light spikes, unable to move.
But she doesn't have a trace of a painful expression, she just looks at Christina, as if pondering something. After a long time, realizing Coquelic's gaze, she smiles.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...What's all this about? Are you playing me? Does it mean anything to provoke me like this?

speaker: Shalom
content: Using my ability is quite troublesome. Without adequate preparation, I dare not face a strong adversary like you directly. I didn't know how far I should go, I'm sorry.

speaker: Shalom
content: They are all good flowers, rather than being broken, it's better to fall into my hands, as an alternative... Heh, I'm just kidding, of course, you are still the best.

speaker: Coquelic
content: What, you want to control me again? What method will you use this time?

speaker: Shalom
content: No need, I've done what I needed to do, I don't need to push you around anymore. You've broken this <color=#fb9259>Rule</color>, escaped my <color=#fb9259>emotions</color>, and became free.
The space on this side vibrates as if it's trembling in terror, Shalom watches the blue light spikes condense. There's not much time, but it's enough.

speaker: Shalom
content: Now, run for your life.

She says calmly. As her voice fades, a startling roar erupts from the rift torn open by Coquelic herself. A monstrous giant claw crashes through the crack. Then, a massive demon squeezes out of the rift, roaring.

Giant blue light pierces through its body, triangular patterns of light are imprinted all over it, producing waves of white smoke. It's not a physical entity, but the embodiment of intense emotions. Like a violent storm, it roars and screams. Pierced by countless sharp nails, choking its throat, it still struggles to tear everything apart.
Christina is nearly nauseated by the sudden onslaught of Mania. But beneath the distorted, monstrous, and terrifying appearance of this creature, she recognizes a familiar feeling.

speaker: Christina
content: You are... Shalom?

With each roar it emits, it triggers violent vibrations within Coquelic. Not out of fear, but because all the Mania within her is ignited, fueling an uncontrollable urge to cry out in harmony; to resist, to shatter everything that binds her.
Is it that she's being "controlled" by it? Or has a part of her soul "resonated" with it? Has she become one with it?

speaker: Shalom
content: Paradeisos separated my emotions and sent them to the other side of the rift. This way, the purely rational me can stay on the front line, while the emotional side dives into Mania, observing the changes in the world and human hearts for them.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I see... so these are the feelings you were exiled with by Paradeisos... this is your heart...

speaker: Coquelic
content: You can't control all of Mania, you can only control one side of human hearts through "this," only control the emotions that are the same as yours... This is your true ability.

speaker: Coquelic
content: And to provoke me, you even manipulated Paradeisos's orders. What you did to me...
She wants to continue, but sees Shalom raise her hand in a smile, her index finger lightly touching her lips.
Shhh... she silently says to Coquelic.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's not hatred, it's the power we were born with... Saying it out loud would make it ineffective.

speaker: Shalom
content: Your life has only been partially restored. Use it sparingly, Coquelic.
Coquelic understands. She looks at Shalom, then at the "monster" behind her, shackled layer upon layer, and for the first time, she smiles at ease.

speaker: Coquelic
content: It screams so miserably, don't you feel sorry for it?

speaker: Shalom
content: No. The separation technique is perfect, it's been long since I've felt anything.
She looks up at the crumbling space. Countless blue light spikes coalesce from the void and pierce the giant beast's body, also piercing Shalom. She's used to it, not bothered in the slightest.

speaker: Shalom
content: I can only go this far now. After you go out, remember, that matter is very important to me.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Heh... forget it. I can't manage what you really think, thanks to you I can't even take care of myself.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I won't accept your request, you go ahead and do your best, Shalom.

What answers Coquelic is the roar of the beast. Its claws tear through all the shackles in the void, facing the countless blue lights piercing it, demolishing the prison that has confined it for many years.

Shalom watches as the grand hall gradually collapses, as the Mania on the other side swarm in, as the holy Rules finally decay. This is her power, not imprisoned, not distorted, not deprived, her true heart. She took it back with "rationality".
Everything is arranged and everything is going as planned. Whatever follows is her own: her first or the last battlefield.

Coquelic shuts her eyes, emotionally distancing herself. "This isn't my concern," she thinks, "Time to move on." With a swift motion, she yanks Christina—who is on the verge of being consumed by Mania—to her side. She forcefully draws a new floral sword from within herself, its blade blooming with radiant crystal flowers.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Kid, I'm getting you out of here. Once we're out, lead me straight to them! Hesitate for even a second, and I'll dismember you. Dare to lie to me, and I'll make sure the entire world goes down with you. Mark my words.

Rays of light plummet like frantic executioners struggling to contain a furious madman. The leviathan is pinned to the ground, unable to break free, but it still lets out a roar so loud it could burst eardrums. Light erupts from within its body, wildly shattering the very fabric of space itself.

The rift leading to Mania keeps widening. Christina is gripped by an agonizing headache as a torrent of emotional sensations floods her mind, engulfing her before violently ejecting her. She's in a realm of pure mental chaos, where her sense of self is continuously breaking apart, relentlessly eroded.

Amidst the chaos, she instinctively releases Coquelic's hand and rushes back to find Shalom. But in this moment and place, humans are insignificant—a forceful streak of light swings her way, casting her aside like a solitary leaf.
As she distances herself, she finally sees that soft figure.

Shalom is consumed by Mania, impaled by lances of light. She lifts her gaze to Christina, witnessing the young girl's struggle as she shouts her name, only to be relentlessly pushed back by berserk beams of light. She takes no action, seemingly numb, as if in a state of waiting.

At last, a shadowy figure catches Christina from behind, the luminescent edge of a familiar blade severing all the menacing beams of light that imperiled her. Observing this from a distance, Shalom smiles, her lips quivering subtly; Christina can't quite make out what she's saying.
She senses a momentary hesitation from the person holding her from behind, and then she decisively leads Christina away from the surrounding chaos.
As everything goes white, a massive triangle materializes within the space. Blue spikes of light rain down from it like a torrent, wholly consuming both the roaring leviathan and the silent Hush.

As Christina's consciousness fragments while regaining awareness, she can't make out her surroundings. What she does see are vivid red and icy blue spikes piercing her body. This is the disruption that broke out in the real world when the two forces clashed. She too was affected when she intruded upon the scene.
From the indistinct distance, the clamor of a fierce battle resonates.

speaker: HUSH Combat Force
content: X is encountering anomalies, draining ahead of schedule. Activate emergency eradication protocol—Eliminate all! Eliminate all!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Christina, where are they? Tell me! Where are they?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Are you dead, kiddo?!

Another burst of intense gunfire erupts, only to be abruptly silenced by the crash of heavy metal. Multiple grunts from Hush elites suggest they've been thrown off balance. Christina hears a familiar voice.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Mission update. Paradeisos's proxy will arrive to retrieve the worn-out Hush. In the meantime, I'll take care of the pollution here.

speaker: HUSH Combat Force
content: You're a Sinner who's been adjusted by X, equally untrustworthy. Eliminate all, eliminate—?!

speaker: HUSH Combat Force
content: A new Schorl? Why is it with you?

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>Conditions in the Observatorium are abnormal. Update instructions:  Emergency recover X and preserve her life.</color>

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>Central pollution levels are critical. HUSH unit, assemble to neutralize another S-Class Sinner. Rahu, recover X and eradicate all originating contaminants. Report any anomalies.</color>

speaker: Rahu
content: Understood.

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>Another Sinner...</color>

speaker: Rahu
content: The MBCC tracking team has reached the outskirts. Taking her out now would be too risky. I recommend relocating and, if needed, employing memory alteration via the 9th Agency.

speaker: Rahu
content: Although very subtle, she too bears X's <color=#fb9259>Mark</color>.

speaker: Schorl
content: <color=#7683a2>...An unnecessary move. Then hand her over to the MBCC. This accident has cost too much. It's time to stop the losses. All our forces should be reserved for the Underground. Now, move.</color>
Footsteps draw near.
Is it... Rahu?
Christina strains to open her eyes, struggling to discern her surroundings.
Before seeing Rahu, Christina is first struck by a scene that floods her with nostalgia, rendering her mind a blank slate.

speaker: Christina
content: You... saved me?

As she speaks, she sees a radiant white light enveloping her. She senses something deep within being stirred, as her wounds miraculously start to mend. An unsettling awareness seeps into her thoughts, leaving Christina overwhelmed with dread.

speaker: Christina
content: No, no! You're wielding your powers on me—you're trying to control me. Release me! I don't want your salvation; I won't be shackled by you again—

Christina forcefully shoves the woman before her, who stumbles backward like a hollow shell, terrifying the young girl who immediately clings to her in sheer terror. The light around them fades; the eyes of Hush grow increasingly vacant, until nothing remains but a chilling triangular insignia in her pupils.
Christina's mind is in chaos. Is she being manipulated? Despite her best efforts, she finds herself helplessly pulled back into the past—into memories deeply etched in the recesses of her soul.

speaker: Shalom
content: Justice exists, without a doubt. I've seen it with my own eyes.

speaker: Shalom
content: In another pure, real world... where every facet of the human heart is laid bare... there, I saw justice... and it exists forever...

speaker: Young Christina
content: Its exists forever... Does it mean it's very strong? Is it strong enough to defeat evil?
The woman's laughter fills the air as her captivating smile takes form. Shalom leans in toward Christina, her head gently finding rest on the young girl's shoulder.

speaker: Shalom
content: Occasionally, it is strong, but it's often frail. We live in a far-from-perfect era where many tend to believe the harsher side of things; chaos, in its own unsettling way, provides some certainty and comfort.

speaker: Shalom
content: But there will always be those who need it: the downtrodden, the brave, those unwilling to submit. I don't think it's naive...
Words momentarily wrap around Christina in a gentle embrace before departing.
The white light that had filled her with dread finally vanishes, and yet Christina finds herself irresistibly pulling the woman leaning against her into a tight embrace.

speaker: Shalom
content: This isn't naive... it's your defiance against this world of chaos...
She suddenly hugs the woman in her arms tightly, gripping her hard. In her mind, she realizes, "As a detective, there's still something I need to take care of." Right then, Christina cries out.

speaker: Christina
content: Coquelic, I'll keep my word. So listen up, remember every word I say!

speaker: Christina
content: My father, Marshall Collins, served as an instructor for FAC-G42. He gave his life in the Eclipse Operation, back in N.F. 103. For his sacrifice, he earned the FAC's Second-Tier Heroic Medal. I pay my respects to him every year, and I'm always proud of him!

speaker: Christina
content: Survive, and save them from whatever hell they're in. If you can't find them, come looking for me. Rest assured, I will never give up. Got it?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Get out of my way!

Coquelic grasps the situation, and a sudden surge of strength flows through her grievously wounded body. With a swift swing of her floral sword, she repels the elite HUSH forces before her and breaks through their lines, never once looking back. She is not driven by revenge; no one could now stand in the way of the Garden's Mentor.
Rahu watches as Coquelic departs, shaking off the grime from her shield. With Mania now quelled, Rahu turns and heads toward Christina.

speaker: Rahu
content: She heard and she left. She's not the kind of woman who can be held back.

speaker: Rahu
content: Let her go, Chris. Paradeisos needs Shalom; entrust her to me, everything will be fine.

speaker: Rahu
content: Even if you feel powerless to change anything right now, you're not alone; there's still a long road ahead.
The guard in black extends her hand to take Shalom's limp body, and Christina holds onto her tightly until the very last moment.
Under the watchful eye of the new Schorl and encircled by the stoic HUSH squad, Christina has never loathed her own intuition more.
Her detective instincts tell her that Shalom won't be coming back; some things must be said now.
Up to this point, I still can't tell if you've been truthful or deceptive, nor can I come to terms with what you've done to me.
Yet I still have feelings for you, still don't want to leave... Could this, too, be a manipulated emotion? Can something controlled feel so genuine?

If I could return to that day and speak to my past self, I'd still convince her to trust you, to believe in the justice you spoke of... Even if it were a lie, you returned that belief to me when I needed it most, allowing me to get to where I am now.
I really, really like you, Shalom.

speaker: Christina
content: Hush Shalom, I know I can't catch you, nor do I have the power to stop your evil acts. But...

speaker: Christina
content: I will relentlessly pursue you, scrutinize your every action, and expose your hidden schemes. One day, I'll unveil the truth you've been covering up.

speaker: Christina
content: I'm not yet strong enough to mete out justice, but... someday, someone will be.
I will bring you back...

Shalom has lost her sense of hearing. Her body, weak and fragile, can no longer sustain her. A glowing blue triangle plunges her consciousness into an abyss, pulling her away from Christina and leaving even the chill of her body behind.
In the end, what lingers is her enigmatic, forever inscrutable smile.

August 26, N.F. 113
The West District's Black Ring defense line
is now fully operational.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: The August War is over. FAC has successfully built the BR-002 anti-Mania barrier, thereby halting its corruptive spread. We will not forsake the West District, and we shouldn't.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: As long as we purge the existing corruption within the city, there will come a day when order is restored in the West District, and both sides of the Rust will be reconciled. Until that day arrives, FAC will hold the line against Mania.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: This is the shared hope of all heroes who have fallen in this mission.

speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
content: May our city-state be free from suffering, may our fellow citizens be forever safe.
Blue Rain falls, enveloping the cemetery in silence. Coquelic trudges toward the direction she remembers.
Her body somewhat recovers. Uncertain if it's an aftereffect of having been controlled, her mind faintly echoes Shalom's words.

speaker: Shalom
content: Set him free, Coquelic.
female_content: Set her free, Coquelic.

content: "Annoying Hush, still holding something back even now..." Coquelic forcefully shakes her head, banishing the noise from her thoughts.
There are more pressing matters, things she truly cares about, as she desperately heads toward the hazy location imprinted in her memory.

speaker: Coquelic
content: N.F. 103... the 79th... it's at... <color=#fb9259>the Fifth Cemetery</color>...
She stumbles in clumsily, heading for the Hero Monument to search for the name Christina pointed out, in hopes of finding the clue they had talked about.
No need to search any further.

A figure suddenly lunges forward to embrace Coquelic, spilling the evidence, map, and intelligence papers she is holding onto the ground. She bursts into unrestrained tears. Those are the records of the Paradeisos approved "assignments" that the Garden assassins marked by X may have taken on.

speaker: Thistle
content: You don't have to do this. I know where they are. I'll go find them, I swear!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Really... You found them...?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Why are you crying... Trying so hard... You're such a fool...

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: The HUSH system is compromised. The Rules have shattered, Mania has extensively breached our <color=#fb9259>Second Observatorium</color>. The area is now impenetrable and beyond repair, demanding urgent containment measures. We've lost all monitoring of the BR-002 field.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Based on the final logs from Schorl, the enemy S-Class Sinner obliterated our on-site HUSH forces. She sabotaged Schorl before it could neutralize X, damaging <color=#fb9259>X's</color> physical form as a result and making a forced entry into her mental realm.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: With just a month left in her service period, X was set to be safely decommissioned and destroyed, and a replacement was already lined up. She was intended to be the most impeccable Hush, but she was sabotaged by the enemy in the eleventh hour, compromising even the entire Observatorium.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: It's <color=#fb9259>the Underground</color>! In July, they discovered the HUSH system and recognized its significance. They immediately dispatched assassins to sabotage our operations. The attacker was none other than the notorious Mentor from the Garden, who alone has the power to defeat Schorl, dismantle X, and infiltrate the Observatorium.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: I'm familiar with the Mentor from the Garden. She's powerful, but not to this extent.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: X couldn't have possibly interacted with the Rift herself. In theory, even those S-Class Sinners can't breach the Rules sealing off X, much less rupture the Rift in the <color=#fb9259>Observatorium</color>. Unless...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The Mentor experienced some form of <color=#fb9259>trigger</color>, inducing a Mania outbreak.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Pull up all the data on X since her activation, every record for each piece of Schorl, and any data synchronized while she was monitoring. Then run a comprehensive analysis.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Analysis complete.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: For the past 9 years, X has excelled in every assignment, with all deviations staying within safe limits. Her crisis responses have been spot-on, and every optimized plan has proven to be sound and justifiable upon further validation. There's been no sign of self-awareness, and no Level 5 or higher alerts have ever been triggered by Schorl during its operation.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: She's more than reliable—losing her would be a major setback. This definitely works in favor of the Underground; they've managed to turn the tables.
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: But indeed, there's an inconsistency that's hard to justify.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: X has twice used her <color=#fb9259>Mark</color> ability on the same low-tier Sinner, yet hasn't fully assimilated her.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The first instance could be chalked up to X's initial field test, where she observed the development of a young Sinner. The second use of her Mark ability, however, lacks any logical reasoning.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The marked individual doesn't warrant such attention from X—be it skill, qualifications, potential, or obedience. It simply defies rational justification.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Are you implying that the <color=#fb9259>Mark</color> ability we developed has inadvertently contaminated the Hush, leading her to manifest an unneeded emotional crack?

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The odds are low, but we can't entirely dismiss the possibility. The Mark technology is, after all, a mere mimicry of the Underground <color=#fb9259>Shackles</color>, an object tainted with Manic Entity forcibly integrated into X. We can't overlook the chance that this coerced Mania resonance might negatively impact the Hush.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: I recommend halting the Mark system's usage until we can verify these claims.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: But, if she's truly betraying us, she's likely trying to deceive us intentionally! She aims to discredit the <color=#fb9259>Mark</color> system, a notion I can't accept.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: ...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Well, anything you do seems to make sense, given who you are, and your Manic Entity...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: <color=#fb9259>X</color>, you have a good understanding of us, too.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: You're aware that your opinions don't concern me.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Excessive skepticism about others' intentions carries its own emotional pitfalls. Rationality looks only at the facts.
