It is known that prior to the intrusion, all X's actions result in the fulfillment of the demand with no additional risk exposure. As for perceptual concepts like motivation...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Whether X is showing cracks due to Marking the Sinner, strategically creating distractions to halt the Mark technology research, or even scheming to disrupt the HUSH system transition... Given that so many systems have failed around her, we now have a unique case study to help locate vulnerabilities and enhance out future developments.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: She has become the ideal subject for advancing the HUSH system.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Seal the backup and X until the Second Observatorium is reconstructed. Afterward, proceed with the transfer and decommissioning. This should be a quick process.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Both the HUSH system and Mark technology come with their own set of risks. Until we've pinpointed the exact cause of X's anomaly, exercise extreme caution when utilizing either.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Conveniently, she has recently completed the rigorous vetting of an S-Class Sinner, and her performance has been exceptionally stable. Retain the Marked subject, position her accordingly. By closely monitoring her stability, we can approximate the current status of X.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Use the waiting time to prioritize rooting out the spies. The breach of HUSH intelligence to the Underground is the gravest situation we're facing.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The impending cataclysm at the Second Black Ring is unavoidable. Our defense grid is useless against it, and the Underground is gearing up for action. A struggle for control is inevitable. SHP-13 isn't just necessary, it's crucial—and the Underground will soon get the message.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Collect all of X's observational data from the past six months; it'll give us the edge we need. Find SHP-13, stick to the original plan, and wipe out the Underground Shepherd.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Paradeisos has already lost a "valuable tool"; let's wring every last drop of worth from what she left behind.
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Take the HUSH-X channel offline until the day it comes back on.
...You know nothing about tools.

The guard in black places the dormant woman into the Restoration Chamber, observing her submerge into the cerulean regeneration liquid. This healing elixir gradually mends the severe cracks across her form, forever sealing away her perilous awareness.
Then, HUSH-X sinks to the bottom, vanishing into obscurity much like her unspoken, authentic self.
You've succeeded; no one will take your place, nor will anyone seek to destroy you. From now on...
Hm, forget it. Even if I were to ask, you'd simply tell me to go alone, without a backward glance.
I won't let you die, nor do I need you to serve as my tool. But thank you for bringing me to this point, for setting the stage.

Turning away, she leaves the room. Behind her, the door closes with a thud. Alone, Rahu wanders the vacant halls of Paradeisos, encountering one vaguely unfamiliar face after another. She moves through them with a quiet calm, committing each to memory just as peacefully.
Indifferent, arrogant, uneasy, dissatisfied... Rahu takes note of each face in her heart.
This is the reality behind the curtain. Who's pulling the strings, what they're doing, what they're after... I'm watching, and I'll see the truth.

speaker: Blurry Figure
content: Keep running, Rahu. Keeping running, that's the meaning of life.
Then, one day...
I like flowers.
Unyielding to the mire, untrapped by the narrow gaps, they yearn for the sun, blossoming in a grand spectacle that occurs but once in their lives.
I admire them, for being destined for futility, yet they still swim against the tide; for being destined to wither, yet they live marching towards death.
Even if they are plucked by someone, they can still freely...
At the FAC Memorial Cemetery before dawn, Christina encounters an unexpected figure after sending a lengthy letter of gratitude to Inspector Dole.

speaker: Thistle
content: Ah, so you're still alive.

speaker: Christina
content: How dare you show your face here? Where's Coquelic? Shouldn't she be the one thanking me?

speaker: Thistle
content: ...You really haven't changed, still as audacious as ever.

speaker: Thistle
content: The Mentor's swamped, so I'm relaying a message for her: "Any promotions yet? Proven yourself reliable? What's your case clearance rate? How many perps have you nabbed? You still dragging down your mentor?"

speaker: Christina
content: Ahem!! Enough, enough... I'm off duty today; so... no solving cases!

speaker: Christina
content: My little sister is returning to school. She's been away for too long, and I'm concerned she'll get picked on when she's back. I have to take her.

speaker: Christina
content: Then... people from MBCC will come for me. My knowledge is still limited, my power inadequate. To grasp what I truly desire, there's still a long way to go...

speaker: Thistle
content: You got nabbed, didn't you? Washed out before you could even make the cut as a full-fledged detective?

speaker: Christina
content: It's a reassignment! Not a demotion! I'm being sent to train and lend a hand! They need a formidable detective like me to help track people down!

speaker: Thistle
content: Ah, later on, I'll be heading to the <color=#fb9259>West District</color> with the Mentor. It seems that's where our companions from the Garden have all ended up. So, you won't have a chance to catch us or even locate us again. I thought you should know before I go.

speaker: Thistle
content: My quest for vengeance has come to an end. I no longer need to live as an assassin. From now on, I'll remain in the Garden that brings me the most peace, guarding it for all eternity.
She smiles, radiant as a blossom, before gracefully vanishing into the closing embrace of the night.
Christina remains solitary in the tranquil cemetery, as the rain prepares to cease.
Amidst a crowd adorned with the mantle of "heroes," the young girl greets the day's first break of light.

speaker: Answer Machine
content: Hi there. I'm currently unable to answer the phone. Please leave a message after the tone.
Beep...
Ahh... Hi there.
I'm starting to miss you. Will you come to me? I want to hear your voice.
...Okay, then. I'll see you tonight.
In the night, the stationary object screams in inaudible vibrations.
This continues until the notification light on the phone goes out, and everything returns to silence.
You look at the comms device in your hand. The bright red "low battery" icon flashes for a few seconds before the screen completely falls into black.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who's been using my comms to make random calls again...? It can't really be a ghost, can it...
Recently, an urban legend wave about "Ghost Calls" is sweeping across Eastside, reaching even the Bureau. Day or night, every corner of the Bureau is filled with startling phone rings and busy tones.
Whispers buzz around your ears. Sometimes, you really feel like someone is whispering secrets into your ear and trying to lure you into an abyss.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When I get back, I will find the instigator... and then... give them a good...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sigh... Can't I take a break without any trouble?
You sigh and put away the comms device.

Originally, you were going to enjoy a rare day off after attending the "Forum on Strengthening the Management and Efficiency of Hypercubes in the Response to Mania Crisis Incidents" with the Public Security Bureau in Eastside.

But now your comms device is completely out of power, and you can't contact the hotel you booked. You plan to go to the grocery store next door and get some coins to call your adjutant for help from a phone booth.

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Hello, welcome to Call at 3 AM. I'm your host... Eleven."

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "I'm glad to share some thoughts with you all about recent events..."

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Woah, she's certainly keeping her cool in this crisis. Still hosting the show as if nothing happened...

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Oh, excuse me. I was too distracted listening to the program. Sorry, I didn't see you there.
The owner, who was sitting casually behind the counter, quickly stands up straight when he sees you.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Still out so late, young man? What would you like?
female_content: Still out so late, young lady? What would you like?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: A bottle of water, please. Can you give me some change in cash?

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Let me see, I might only have some coins left... I'm not sure if it's enough...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's okay. I'll take a few of these, too.
You pick out a few brightly wrapped candies from the glass bowl on the counter and put them in your pocket along with the coins.

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Next, we'll open up the phone lines, and invite everyone to call in..."

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Well, let's see how many "Ghost Calls" we get tonight...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ghost Calls?
You take the water from the owner's hand and glance at the small radio on the other side of the counter.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: You haven't heard about this?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've only heard a little about it.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: This show, Call at 3 AM...

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: It ain't clean!

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: They say this host has the same voice as the legendary female ghost who will call you at 3 a.m. and claim your life through the phone! After this went viral, her show's phone lines have blown up!

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: At first, everyone thought it was just a publicity stunt by the radio station, but...
The grocery store owner beckons you to lean closer.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Since then, several people who had called the radio station disappeared!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Disappeared? They went missing? Or...

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: If they went missing, they would at least leave some traces, right? These people... simply evaporated from the face of the earth! See?
The grocery store owner nods towards the shop's door. You see several posters on it, all of them missing person notices.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: But... I reckon those people might not necessarily have anything to do with this radio station.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: <size=30>I think so, too. How could a radio station have such power? It feels like just a silly rumor...</size>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cough cough. What's your take on this?

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Well look, she works at a radio station. She's a popular radio host. With popularity comes controversy. It's probably just a silly rumor.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: We're just looking for something to keep us entertained. Look at me, keeping the shop open so late into the night. It's so tedious. It's nice to listen to some idiot messing around on the radio to pass the time.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Those who vanished, most of them are idle people who threw money around all day and night on radio shows and hosts. It's not surprising that they attracted attention.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Rumor has it that these people all received a call before they disappeared. But the Public Security Bureau insists there are no records of these calls.
You walk out of the grocery store, and the owner behind you turns up the volume of the radio a bit more.
The voice of the host echoes faintly, causing a tingling sensation on your back.

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Thank you for your call. Thank you for sharing your experiences and insights with us."

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "People often feel anxious, becoming frustrated and wanting to vent."

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "You are welcome to call us at any time."
After leaving the grocery store, you walk down the street. There should be a phone booth around here.
It looks a bit old, but because it's transparent and covered with graffiti, it doesn't seem so dreary.
You think about the story the store owner mentioned earlier, and start to wonder if there might be Mania powers at work.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I'm on vacation. I shouldn't think about work.
As you try to dispel the thoughts of work in your mind, you're jolted by a sudden ring of the phone.
You jump in surprise. When you look up, you realize that you're trapped inside the small phone booth!
The small space is filled with echoing rings and deathly silence. The public telephone appears before you, like a phone book abandoned by the world.

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Let's look forward to the next call~"
The voice isn't loud, but to you, it's like a thunderclap.
You're already a distance away from the grocery store, and the booth's door is tightly shut. There's no way you should still be able to hear the radio station from here.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Pick it up~ Don't be scared, it's not a big deal~"
The old public phone suddenly rings. Your mind flashes back to those strange calls at the Bureau.
The ones known as "Ghost Calls."
Your first reaction is to leave the phone booth, but it's as if someone is holding the door shut from outside. You can't make it budge at all.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Damn it!
You grit your teeth. A faint red light emanates from your palm as you prepare to use the power of the shackles.

options: Pick up and hang up immediately

content: You don't want to answer the phone and stare at it as it continues to ring, letting the shrill sound echo inside the phone booth.
But the ringing shows no sign of abating. Your ears are starting to hurt, and your consciousness is gradually becoming blurred.
At this moment, a soft laugh echoes in your ear.
Aren't you going to answer?
Cold sweat breaks out on the back of your neck. You grit your teeth and reach out to pick up the phone.
The piercing ring grows louder. You can't bear it any longer.
Gritting your teeth, you reach out and pick up the phone.
Amidst the piercing ringing, you pick up the receiver without hesitation and immediately hang up.
The echo of the phone ringing still reverberates in the small booth. You can sense the vibrations and hear your own racing heartbeat.
Hehe... So naughty...
A strange female voice suddenly rings out from behind you, causing cold sweat to break out on the back of your neck.
You have to answer~
The relentless ringing starts again, growing louder, making your eardrums and heart tremble.
You grit your teeth and reach out to pick up the phone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hello...
You finally decided to answer my call?
Hearing your voice... makes me happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who are you? Do you know me? And why are you... calling me?
You look at the public phone, really wanting to hang up.
Don't hang up, darling... I'm here to help you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Help me? If you want to help me, let me call my adjutant or the MBCC instead of hogging the line.
You should talk more, I like your voice...
Take good care of it... Take good care of yourself...
Let this voice echo in your mind... in your heart... in the whole wide world...
Beep... Beep... Beep...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hello?! Hello...?!
The call is terminated, and a dial tone emits from the receiver. You're still in shock, and your ears are still ringing.
You hang up the phone, remaining in the phone booth to calm down for a while. After observing your surroundings and finding nothing strange, you slowly retract your shackles.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Was it a prank...?
The door of the phone booth clicks and unlocks.
You quickly push the door open, intending to rush back to the Bureau to find out who's playing tricks on you. But as you step out, you realize something is wrong.
A strong sense of discomfort hits you head-on. The streetlights cast a strange purple glow. The occasional flickering signal fault distorts the buildings and lights before returning to normal.
But for you, what's even more disturbing is the strong Mania enveloping the area.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This place... is a world constructed entirely by Mania!!
In front of you are the same streets, the same shops, and the same neon lights. At the center of Eastside's Fifth Avenue, three streets intersect.
At 3 a.m., you're standing at the intersection, right in the center.
Eastside is a city that never sleeps. Even at this hour, you can see many groups of people milling about.
You see them here too... but you're not sure if what you're seeing... are people.

speaker: Passerby A
content: Haha, another one!

speaker: Passerby A
content: We've had quite a few newcomers lately, haven't we? That weird one we saw last time has probably transformed, right?

speaker: Passerby B
content: Absolutely! It's tough being an oddball, and no one likes hanging around those weirdos, either. Isn't it much better to just be like us?
They clearly have normal human bodies and you can understand every word they say.
But unlike normal humans, they all have strange items in the place of their heads.

As for the two "people" in front of you, one has a dull monitor as his head, while the other has an old tape recorder. The blood-red eyes on the machine body are staring at you lifelessly, as if they're about to dissect you the next second.

speaker: Passerby B
content: Look at this weirdo with gawking eyes and such a dumb expression! Here, let's help you transform right now, so you won't feel bad.
The two chatty pedestrians slowly approach you. Seeing their strange heads, you instinctively hunch over in a defensive posture.

speaker: Passerby A
content: Are you scared?

speaker: Passerby B
content: Don't be afraid. It won't hurt at all.
A strange sound rings out, and you see several worm-like black wires extending from the back of their heads. Each one is connected to a sharp, golden plug, dripping an unknown liquid.

speaker: Passerby A
content: If you become like us, you won't be so... weird. You'll fit in, think the same as us, and even talk the same...
The sticky liquid drips to the ground, eroding the road in front of you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I appreciate that, but I certainly, definitely, absolutely don't need this...
You slowly back away, scanning the area with your peripheral vision for any handy weapons or escape routes.

speaker: Passerby B
content: I've noticed that the newcomers lately aren't very willing to "transform"... Why is that?

speaker: Passerby B
content: This is clearly safe and convenient...
More electric wires with plugs appear from the back of their heads, looking like they could wrap around you and pierce right through you any second.
Thankfully, there's a narrow alley behind you. You start thinking about how to shake off these two eerie fellows with machines as heads.

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Hi everyone, welcome to Call at 3 AM~"

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "The most loving radio show is by your side... Tell me about all the troubles and worries in your life. I'm all ears."

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "First, let's welcome our new listeners..."
Suddenly, a radio broadcast rings out from the residential building behind you.
To your surprise, these people stop approaching you, take out their comms devices, and start listening to the program.
Taking advantage of their pause, you quickly duck into the alley next to you, only to realize that you've underestimated how active the Eastsiders are at night.
You are like a mouse who ran into an alley full of cats. The moment you slip into the alley, three or four "people" with equally bizarre items as heads look up at you.

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Is this world a mystery to you? Does it seem inexplicable? That's all right. You're just unfamiliar with it, and haven't learned to adapt. I will listen and answer your questions."

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Please join us, step by step. Come, repeat after me..."
There's no radio around, but for some reason, you can clearly hear the voice from the radio.
It's exactly the same as the voice you heard in the grocery store...

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Why are you being reprimanded? Because you did a bad job, of course. Why would anyone scold you otherwise?"

speaker: Passersby
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Why are you being reprimanded? Because you did a bad job, of course. Why would anyone scold you otherwise?</color>

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Shouldn't you reflect after offending others? So you're wrong~"

speaker: Passersby
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Shouldn't you reflect after offending others? You're wrong~</color>

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Don't you understand? You didn't even realize you did something wrong. That's why you're wrong~"

speaker: Passersby
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Don't you understand? You didn't even realize you did something wrong. That's why you're wrong~</color>

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "That's what you're meant to be... without me, you're nothing..."

speaker: Passersby
content: <color=#dg1f1f>That's what you're meant to be... without me, you're nothing...</color>
The strange figures who blocked you just now are closing in from both sides, chanting along with the radio and converging on you.

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Why obey? The majority is always right. The loudest voice is always right. The highest rank is always right. My voice is always right."

speaker: Passersby
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Why obey? The majority is always right. The loudest voice is always right. The highest rank is always right. My voice is always right.</color>

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "Inferior, clumsy, ugly, awful..."

speaker: Passersby
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Inferior, clumsy, ugly, awful...</color>

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "That's what you all are. Don't question anything, don't doubt anything. If it exists, then it's justified. The loudest voice is always correct."

speaker: Passersby
content: <color=#dg1f1f>That's what you all are. Don't question anything, don't doubt anything. If it exists, then it's justified. The loudest voice is always correct.</color>

speaker: Radio Voice
content: "If you can't speak, your voice is useless. The redundant, ugly, clumsy... should not exist in this world. Just give it to me!"
The passersby repeat the words from the radio, faster and faster, louder and louder.
You are being watched, guided by their strange consciousness.
You feel your brain starting to spin. The oxygen seems to thin out as they gather, making it hard to breathe.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No... no, why... why should I chant...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why should I... admit that I'm...
The moment you fall backwards, a pair of hands reaches out to hold you steady. A pain in your waist clears your mind.
If you want to live, chant with them!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "My voice is always right. You should listen to me. What I tell you is good."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Inferior, clumsy, ugly, awful..."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "That's what you all are. Don't question anything, don't doubt anything. If it exists, then it's justified. The loudest voice is always correct."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Discard the wrong ideas. Repeat the most beautiful words, just like me..."
Yes, don't stop. Keep walking and talking!
You chant along with them to the radio without stopping. Seeing this, the strange figures finally stop staring at you and leave you alone.
Just like that, a petite girl leads you hand in hand to a place where the lights aren't so bright.
Phew... That was terrifying!
I thought we were both going to die back there!
The petite girl lets go of you and pats her chest dramatically.
Hey, say something. Say, how much wood could a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why would I say that... are... you really a normal person?
Of course I'm normal!! Look at my head!
See? I'm a human, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well... you seem to be.
Uh... wait, how did you adapt so quickly?!
I broke down for an hour before I finally got it...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Maybe it's because of my job...
You quietly shift your gaze away with a somewhat awkward look on your face. The sweet mirages, the terrifying art museum, the world of movies... you're indeed used to situations like this.
Though if it were up to you, you'd rather not be.
The petite girl seems triggered by your calmness. She starts running around, mumbling nonstop.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Um... calm down. What's going on?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I need your... assistance in my investigation. Please answer me truthfully.

You stop the pacing girl and pull out your work badge from your pocket. It's the pass the Public Security Bureau gave you when you went to the meeting in the morning. It has a picture of you taken when you registered at the entrance.
You were yawning the moment the picture was taken. Who knew the shutter would click at that exact moment!
Fortunately, the back of the pass has a large seal from the Public Security Bureau that's enough to intimidate anyone.
The girl is startled after seeing your credentials. After looking around and seeing that there is no way out, she obediently goes to your side.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Name?

speaker: Nino
content: Nino...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Age?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What landed you here?

speaker: Nino
content: No!! I didn't do anything! I'm not here because I did something wrong!!
Nino stomps her foot, puffing up like an angry guinea pig.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry, sorry... I misspoke...
You put away your work ID and take a longer look at Nino. Her reaction is normal. Even though she's likely a handful, she's still a "normal person" who got dragged into this like you did.

speaker: Nino
content: You're a cop, aren't you?! Then hurry up and help me get out of this hellhole! Isn't it your job to help people in need?

speaker: Nino
content: If I don't get out of here soon, I'm gonna turn into one of those... those freaks!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Calm down. Tell me everything, and we'll find a solution together.
Nino pulls you to sit on a flower bed by the street, facing away from the strange people.

speaker: Nino
content: I was live streaming when I suddenly got summoned... Or should I say transported... Anyway, that's the gist of it!

speaker: Nino
content: Have you heard of Ghost Calls? All Eastsiders should know, right?! Call at 3 AM! That dirty show!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, I just found out about it today.

speaker: Nino
content: Actually, that radio station has been popular for a while. It's a well-known late-night station in Eastside. The hostess is gentle and has a pleasant voice, like a soothing night breeze...

speaker: Nino
content: But it really blew up after they started talking about those Ghost Calls!

speaker: Nino
content: I'm a virtual host. When I was live streaming today, I really got a ******* call at 3 a.m.!

speaker: Nino
content: My audience had been egging me on to call the radio station. They were being really generous with their donations. How could I not make a call for my fans?

speaker: Nino
content: Who would've thought, just two days later, the Ghost Call from 3 a.m. actually called me back!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So you took a call and then... ended up here?

speaker: Nino
content: Yes! How... How did you know?

speaker: Nino
content: Hmm, this is a serious matter!

speaker: Nino
content: ...Hey, do you know what the voice said on the phone?
Nino suddenly lowers her voice, whispering into your ear.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What did the voice say?
You recall the call you received in the phone booth. Your memory is a bit fuzzy, but you vaguely remember a gentle yet eerie voice telling you that she likes your voice and wants you to protect it.

speaker: Nino
content: It was a female ghost on the phone... She said she loves my voice and wants to keep it forever...!
Nino's words are shaky and her voice is faint. Her breath tickles your ear.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Take away your voice...? How would she do that?

speaker: Nino
content: You were surrounded by that group of people just now, right? When I first arrived, I also got surrounded.

speaker: Nino
content: How could I let her take my voice? But I was so scared that I chanted along with them. As I chanted, I felt my consciousness becoming hazy, and my throat felt blocked. It felt like I wanted to say something but couldn't.
Nino touches her neck with her hand. Her dramatic face suddenly becomes tightly wound up.

speaker: Nino
content: Afterwards, I really didn't want to chant with them anymore. I wanted to stop, but found that I couldn't...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Your voice was taken away?

speaker: Nino
content: Yeah. I found that I couldn't say "no" at all.

speaker: Nino
content: I was terrified, so I ran away, chanting those phrases as I ran...

speaker: Nino
content: Perhaps because I kept chanting, those guys with weird heads didn't chase after me... I ran all the way here, and when I took a break, I saw... I saw...
Nino's voice trails off, but you still hear the tremor in her voice.

speaker: Nino
content: I saw... My reflection in a window on the street...
Nino takes a deep breath and looks at you.

speaker: Nino
content: In the reflection... My head was a computer with a red switch... The switch was my eye, glowing red, looking back at me.

speaker: Nino
content: I had turned into one of those... those people who only have one voice...
Nino covers her face, showing a terrified expression.

speaker: Nino
content: That reflection scared me. I instinctively shouted no... I didn't want to be like this.

speaker: Nino
content: I don't know if it was the scream that woke me up, but it seemed like... I changed back again. I found that I could say "no" again!
The people on the street begin to thin out. The streetlights shine on you, reflecting off the shop windows.

speaker: Nino
content: Mister, do you think... she will call us again?
female_content: Miss, do you think... she will call us again?

speaker: Nino
content: Does she... really want to take and keep our voices? To turn us into... those people?
You can't help but look up. In the reflection, you and Nino are standing side by side, both very real... Does the word "no" and the act of refusal have something to do with this world?
But the next second, a sudden ring in your ears breaks the silence!!
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
Nino grabs your sleeve. Her grip tightens around your wrist, and your pulse becomes noticeably faster.
You look around. There are no phone booths, but the harsh ringing continues.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...

speaker: Nino
content: Look... look over there...
Nino tightens her grip and points at the shop window ahead of you.
A lonely table with a phone had suddenly appeared in the middle of the empty shop.
Your reflections and the phone form a perfect picture in the window... the phone appears right between you two.

speaker: Nino
content: It... it just keeps ringing. What should we do? Should we answer it? How would we answer it? What if we don't answer? Ahhh?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't panic. Let me try.
Staring at the phone's reflection, you reach out to the space between you two and make a motion of picking up the receiver.
The moment you "pick up the receiver", the ringing stops.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Hello?

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Hello there, my darlings~

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What exactly are you trying to do? Steal people's voices?

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Hehehe, I was just joking with you. You don't like this strange world, do you? You hate the voices here, right? Me too. I wish it could return to normal~

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: But it can't be helped. The world has lost its most important and precious voice, its one true voice. Terrible noises have taken over everything. That's why it's like this...

options: That's why you need my help?
Enough with this nonsense. What are you really trying to do?

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Help me out! If you find that voice, I'll let you leave this place. How does that sound?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't believe a word you're saying.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Hahaha, you will help me. You want to leave this place. You hate it here, too.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Go find that lost voice. It's close to you. You'll definitely find it... I'll be counting on you.
Before you can voice your doubts, the "Call at 3 AM" has already hung up.
The table in the display window gets covered in dust the moment the call ends. That's when you realize that the phone didn't even have a telephone line.
This sort of thing is beyond what you can handle, and it is making you a bit irritated. You force yourself to calm down and focus on analyzing the situation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...She can already control objects and sounds in the world, and even influence ordinary people who enter...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: These are already S-Class powers. No matter what... I have to take the culprit away...

speaker: Nino
content: Though I don't know what you're talking about, I support you taking the culprit away...

speaker: Nino
content: So what should we do now... uhh...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Call me ${PlayerName}, or if you prefer, you can call me Chief.

speaker: Nino
content: Huh? Chief? You're a bigwig with a proper title?!
You look at Nino, somewhat speechless. Just a few minutes ago, she was scared and surprised about how you could adapt to this world so quickly. But in reality, she is an eccentric one herself.
You suddenly understand why that female ghost wants her voice: she always speaks her mind freely. Controlling someone like her must bring a sense of achievement.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No time to think about that now. Better think about how to deal with these "voice thefts." She just said that she won't take all the voices at once.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And the way she takes them is by using those strange creatures, who guide and trick us into saying those weird words...
You recall those strange words. They were all negative comments. Who were they meant for?
For us? For the fellows with the weird heads? Or... for the female ghost?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Anyway, we need to come up with a plan so that every time this radio station broadcasts, we can survive without saying a word...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Otherwise, if we really lose our voices, we won't be able to speak up and refuse the "demands" of those strange people.

speaker: Nino
content: Why do we have to assume that we will lose our voices... And isn't that a bit hard to accomplish?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm just used to preparing for the worst-case scenarios.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's always better to have several plans... My adjutant always says that.
You take out your comms device, which hasn't mutated to suit this world since you've arrived. It's still out of power, becoming a burden on you.

options: Did you bring a comms device with you?

speaker: Nino
content: A comms device?

speaker: Nino
content: Yeah, I did. But I can't turn it on. Maybe it's because I fell on it.
Nino takes out her comms device, which is adorned by a string of clinking charms that looks almost heavier than the device itself.
She tries to turn it on, but the screen remains dark, showing no response.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then... recording a voice message to loop playback probably won't work...
In this world, anything related to sound seems to carry a hint of eeriness.
A series of strange, intermittent sounds attracts your attention and interrupts your thoughts.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That voice... sounds a bit like the "Call at 3 AM"?
"Hel...Hello... Welcome to Call... at 3 AM... Eh..."
It's a record store. The strange voice you hear is coming intermittently from inside. It sounds like the opening lines of that radio show.
But you notice that all the lines containing words like "no", "refuse", "resist", have all been censored, unable to be spoken.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That record store is a bit strange. Let's go check it out. If all else fails, we might be able to get some words from the lyrics to get by.
Customers who come to a record store at 3 a.m. are usually crazy, but the owner doesn't seem to care.
The record store owner, who has a phonograph for her head, seems much friendlier than the passersby you encountered earlier. You decide to go in and try your luck.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hello, would it be possible to listen to the records here before buying?

speaker: Record Store Owner
content: You...
You try to make casual conversation, while Nino hides behind your coat, watching nervously.
The owner is startled by you striking up a conversation. When she notices your uniform, she can't help but quiver.

speaker: Record Store Owner
content: Ah... ah yes, you can listen to the ones that are unsealed...

speaker: Record Store Owner
content: There are headphones over there by the listening area... You can ask the staff over there to help, but...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hmm? But what?
The owner's voice is a bit shaky, but for some reason, that gives you a sense of relief. You can't help but lower your voice a bit more.

speaker: Record Store Owner
content: That staff member is a bit special. If you encounter any difficulties, please don't give her a hard time. You can just come find me.
You nod to the owner and head to the back.
When you reach the listening area, you find several unsealed sample records on the shelf. You pick one at random, put it in the player, and start listening to it through the headphones.
Haunting music echoes in your ears. It sounds like the dreams of a restless sleeper. You know it's an illusion, yet you can't help but believe it's real.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It... shouldn't be this one.
You try a second, then a third... Soon, you've listened to almost all the records on the rack, but still haven't found the one with the eerie voice.
Like the garbled music, your mood once again turns incredibly sour. Without lyrics, you can't defend against the resonance of the radio show, which means... you'll lose your voice.
The words that slip out of your own mouth surprise you. You instinctively tighten your hands over the headphones.
You have some speculation about these anomalies... The Mania here is constantly affecting and assimilating you.
Although those strange people initially wanted to directly "transform" you into the shape of alien heads, they also said that you would eventually transform.
This might mean that, whether or not you're plugged into those electric wires, Mania will eventually assimilate you into a part of this city, just like them.

options: Take a deep breath to calm down.

content: You tilt your head back, close your eyes and breathe deeply, trying to calm yourself down.
But before you can gather your thoughts, the muffled sound of a toppled cargo enters your ears.
You quickly look back to see a human foot sticking out from beside a shelf not far behind you. Someone had fallen there.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll go check it out.
You cautiously approach, gripping the pen in your pocket and gently unscrewing the cap.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Excuse me... What happened?
You glance back. The owner is still sitting in front of the counter, propping up her head, listening to the music from the player, nodding along to the beat.
Turning back, you inch towards that unusual shelf.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't move, put down your weapon...
You hold the pen, pointing its sharp tip outwards, only to see... something unexpected. It's not a trap, nor a crime scene.
A woman, a "normal person" like you, is lying on the ground. The scattered records around her make her look like a pale blue stylus.

speaker: Nino
content: Wow! Another normal person!!

speaker: Nino
content: But is she... all right?
You pick up the records on the ground and examine the woman on the floor. Her shoulders are gently rising and falling. She seems to be asleep.
There's small dark circles under her eyes, and her eyebrows are slightly furrowed. She looks like someone who had just finished a shift and dozed off.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is she an employee here?
You hand the record to Nino, observing as you gently tap the woman's shoulder.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you're tired, go get some proper rest. Don't sleep on the ground, okay?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Miss, do you need my help?
Mmm...
Your calls only elicit a faint murmur from the woman. She doesn't move at all.

speaker: Nino
content: Is she... really that tired?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She must've been working non-stop for several days and then suddenly ended up in a place like this. Her body must've instinctively fallen into a deep sleep to escape reality after the double blow from psychological and physical stress.

speaker: Nino
content: You sound as if you've experienced the same thing...

speaker: Nino
content: But... if what the owner says is true, and she's an employee here, she should be working, right?
Nino squats down to look at the pretty girl.

speaker: Nino
content: Sleeping at work... she'd get her wages deducted...
Mmm... Emm...

speaker: Nino
content: Huh? She woke up?
As if triggered by some key word, the slumbering lady slowly wakes up. After seeing the situation in front of her, she jumps up in fright.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are... are you okay?
The woman looks at you in surprise, her mouth slightly ajar. She looks at you, then at Nino, then back at you, then back at Nino again.

speaker: Startled Woman
content: Emm!
The woman rushes over to pat your face and pinch your hand, as if to confirm if you're real.
After she's done pinching you, she turns to Nino and pinches her all over, too. Then, as if relieved, she pulls Nino into her embrace.

speaker: Nino
content: Mmph...! Miss... I can't... can't breathe...
The woman quickly lets go of Nino and bows apologetically.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You are...?
The woman searches her pockets for a while, then pulls out a comms device and starts typing in front of you.
You and Nino look at each other, not knowing what she wants.
After a bit, she hands the comms device to you. There are two short lines of words on the screen.

speaker: Eleven
content: "Hello, my name is Eleven, silent E at the top. Sorry, I got a bit excited when I finally saw people like me..."

speaker: Eleven
content: "But for some reason, I can't speak. I can only communicate with you in this way."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Just now, I think I heard... the opening line of a radio show around here...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's your relationship with that radio show?
The woman seems at a loss to your question. She runs to the shelf, rummages around, then pulls out a pure white record with only a few numbers marked on it.
She runs to the listening area, puts the record into the player, and hands you the headphones.
"Hel...Hello... Welcome to Call... at 3 AM... Eh..."
When you listen, you realize it's indeed the opening line of "Call at 3 AM"! But some of the words have been cut, making it sound quite disjointed.
It's the same strange voice you heard outside the record store.

You look at the timid woman in front of you. Your eyebrows furrow slightly. No matter who she is, as someone who has already lost her voice and is linked to the radio station, she might be the key to leaving this world.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you really have something to do with the radio station... then...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you know about the urban legends about "Ghost Calls" and this radio station?
You seemed to have frightened Eleven. Her shoulders hunch up and her head slowly lowers...

speaker: Eleven
content: "I... I don't know... After I arrived in this world, I lost my voice..."

speaker: Eleven
content: "If... the owner of this record store hadn't remembered me... I..."
Eleven glances towards the store entrance. The store owner is dozing off in her chair, her phonograph head bobbing up and down, her stylus flicking.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We were drawn into this by the legend of the "Ghost Calls" and a radio show called "Call at 3 AM" The record you played for us is a recording of that show, which makes me suspicious of you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Can you tell me why you lost your voice? Nino and I have faced similar dangers, but we didn't lose our voices.
Eleven picks up her comms device, seemingly wanting to type something, but in the end, she stops. Other than shaking her head, she makes no other movements.

options: You are inextricably linked to the "radio station" that controls this world.
Does your phone have anything to do with you losing your voice?

content: Your voice becomes a little high-pitched from urgency, which makes Eleven lower her head even more. She bites her lip, unable to utter even simple syllables, only shaking her head.

speaker: Nino
content: You're so scary... Even if it's for work, can't you be a bit gentler with ladies?

speaker: Nino
content: ...What are you staring at me for?
The store owner, who had been sitting at the doorway, also comes over after hearing the commotion. She gently squeezes Eleven's shoulder and speaks to you in a somewhat humble tone.

speaker: Record Store Owner
content: Oh officer, she loves those pleasant sounds, so she mimicked the radio show host and recorded quite a few opening lines. But now that she can't speak anymore, she's more anxious than anyone else.

speaker: Record Store Owner
content: Whenever that radio show at 3 a.m. starts, Eleven can't sleep... Look at the dark circles under her eyes. They're practically all the way down to her chin...
Eleven hurriedly nods. She sneaks a glance at you, then lowers her eyes, not daring to meet your gaze.
Seeing this situation, you sigh softly, then squat down to look directly into Eleven's eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to scare you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is a serious issue with a big impact. I'm guessing that many people in the real world have also been implicated. So... if you know the "Radio Ghost" who's causing the trouble, you should try to give me some clues.
Eleven lowers her eyes and bites her lips. Her low spirits are almost palpable.
She lightly taps her comms device, typing rapidly.

speaker: Eleven
content: "If I did something wrong, please just tell me. If my performance is poor, or if I made you uncomfortable, it's all my fault..."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm not blaming you. I just want... to find a solution as soon as possible.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You also want to get your voice back, right?
Eleven thinks for a moment, then starts typing slowly.

speaker: Eleven
content: "I've always loved radio shows. After graduating from college, with the encouragement of the owner of this record store, I got an offer from a radio station and was about to have my own program."

speaker: Eleven
content: "But... because I was inexperienced and new, they kept pushing back the time slot they gave me, until finally I got a 3 a.m. program..."

Eleven didn't finish typing, but you both could guess what happened next. Entering the workplace as someone with no experience or background, she'd have to endure all the bullying and unfair treatment.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I'm sorry. It was my fault just now. I was stressed from overworking.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Next time I do something rude, please stop me immediately.
You calm down, sigh, and apologize to Eleven.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How terrible. Why not try to fight back? It's infuriating just hearing about it!
Eleven shakes her head vigorously, and quickly types a few lines on the comms device.

speaker: Eleven
content: "No, no... that won't do. I... I don't know anything, and I can't do anything right. How can I question others' arrangements? They... they must have their reasons for doing this..."
The words on the device are a bit glaring. You remember hearing it somewhere.
The radio station here, and those... strange people on the streets.
Ha. I was wondering why a record store would have such terrible noises...
So it's a bunch of untransformed freaks, eh?
Hey, stop making those awful sounds. Either shut up or become a normal person!
A few customers with strange heads walk in. They casually pick up some records from the shelf, then toss them on the floor after looking at them.

speaker: Customer A
content: What is this garbage? There are even radio shows.

speaker: Customer A
content: Can these even be considered records?

speaker: Nino
content: Hey, if you wanna buy something, then do it without all that blabbing. You break it, you pay for it. The one you threw on the floor is an antique worth eight million DisCoins. Pay up.

speaker: Customer B
content: You little brat, how dare you talk to us like that?! Who the hell are you to tell us what to do??

speaker: Nino
content: Who's the one who butted in first? Our conversation doesn't have anything to do with you!
Seeing the tall man about to lash out at the young girl, you quickly pull Nino behind you and make a zipping motion over your mouth.

speaker: Customer A
content: Ha, you're a freak yourself, yet you want to stand up for her?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You misunderstood. I'm just taller than her and don't have to look up. I didn't want her to get tired.

speaker: Nino
content: Hmph.

speaker: Customer A
content: Are you a pig? Can't you understand what I'm saying?

speaker: Customer A
content: This world! Doesn't allow people like you to make sounds! Especially those strange, forbidden sounds!!

speaker: Eleven
content: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry! I won't say anything again, please don't..."
The tall, strange man turns his face slightly, his shadow completely enveloping Eleven. Eleven cowers, shaking all over.

speaker: Customer A
content: If you violate the rules of this world, you don't deserve to be here!

speaker: Customer A
content: Get out now!

speaker: Nino
content: Are you stupid?! The world has its own rules, and since the world didn't expel us just now, it proves we can stay.

speaker: Customer A
content: Ha, we "normal people" are part of this world's rules. If I say you gotta go, then you gotta go! People like you have no say in this world!

speaker: Nino
content: Don't think you're in the right just because there's more of you. I've lived all my life without following a single rule, and I'm still alive and kicking!

You weren't the only ones attracted by Eleven's practice recordings. A huge group of people, all with strange heads, came to check things out as well, crowding by the door. Nino is standing up to them at the very front, but if a fight really breaks out, you guys won't stand a chance.

options: Things must be changed from the source.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eleven, don't be scared.
Eleven lifts her head. The sight before her clearly terrifies her, leaving her even more confused than before.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Can I hear what's in your heart? Do you really think... what they're saying is right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't you think that what Nino is saying makes more sense?
You step next to Eleven and gently speak to her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Their words are causing you pain. They're making you unhappy, aren't they?

speaker: Nino
content: Do you really think that what they're saying is right? That it's for your own good?

speaker: Nino
content: Then why are you in so much pain?
Eleven's eyes widen slightly as she looks at you. Her lips move as if she wants to say something.
But in the end, she types a few lines on her comms device, and hands it to you with a bitter smile.

speaker: Eleven
content: "I... I'm in pain, but... I've been enduring that for too long, apologizing for too long..."

speaker: Eleven
content: "I no longer know... what it means to say no."
The dim yellow light shines on Eleven's face. You can see and understand her sadness.
You sigh, looking at the thick, dark aura of Mania outside. Inside your head, you question why you have to work overtime everywhere you go.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The power of the "female ghost" has grown to the point of affecting the outside world, even those who have nothing to do with the radio station.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As long as they hear the voice from the radio station, they get pulled into this world... like me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I had planned to take a vacation after the meeting. Who knew I would end up working overtime here.

speaker: Eleven
content: "I'm really sorry..."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is not entirely your fault, although I do believe that someone who really wants to stir things up would get themselves involved too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So, is this part of your plan?
Eleven seems to be frightened. She starts typing frantically on the comms device.

speaker: Eleven
content: "No, no, it's not like that...!"

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I understand. After all, all these opposing and negative voices can make someone feel very uncomfortable.

speaker: Eleven
content: "Yeah... I... I'm used to it."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't get used to such things. You have to... speak up.

speaker: Eleven
content: "Speak... up?"

speaker: Eleven
content: "But right now... I can't say anything."
You shake your head and look at Eleven seriously.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As long as you feel pain, you must speak up. You must say "no."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All the things that make you angry, sad, and miserable... if you don't say "no" to them, they will always stay by your side.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sometimes, they even hurt the people around you.
It seems like Eleven really took in the last sentence. She opens her mouth, trying to make a sound.

speaker: Eleven
content: Ah... ah...

speaker: Eleven
content: Um... ah...
Fragmented ahhs gurgle from Eleven's throat.
Eleven opens her mouth. You can tell that she wants to agree. She looks at Nino with a glimmer of desire in her eyes, yearning to be like her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Say it. Say what you want to say.
Eleven seems anxious. Her breathing quickens, and she bites her lip, still hesitating.

speaker: Eleven
content: "I... I'm not... I'm just scared... I just feel that..."

speaker: Eleven
content: "Even... if I speak up... it won't help..."
Eleven types the same sentence over and over again on her comms device. She's still scared.

speaker: Customer A
content: Enough with this weird drama. She's the one who spoke just now, right? Take her out first!
A few burly customers stride towards Eleven, but someone stops them.

speaker: Record Store Owner
content: Wait! She... she's my employee. If you want to take her away, you must get my permission!
The owner's hands quiver a little. Next to those big guys, she's like a tiny music box trying to stop a line of junk trucks.

speaker: Customer A
content: Huh? Why are you meddling in this? This has nothing to do with you in the first place, but you keep butting in.

speaker: Customer A
content: You want me to throw you out, too?
The owner is trembling with fear, but she still remains in front of Eleven. Though she doesn't say a word, she stands her ground.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you want the people by your side... the people who love you... to get hurt?
Under your gaze, Eleven musters the courage to step forward and take the owner's hand.
She bites her lip so hard that she almost draws blood.
The owner tightly grips her hand, as if trying to share her own strength and courage.

speaker: Eleven
content: I... won't... let you do this!!

speaker: Eleven
content: You're... not welcome here!! Get out!
The act of refusal roars out like thunder. You can almost see sound waves emitting from under Eleven's feet.
Shelves, records, even people, are affected by Eleven's power and fall to the ground one after another. Suddenly, the entire record store is filled with cries of pain.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Is this the power to change the world?

speaker: Customer A
content: How... how can this be?! What... what did you do?!!
The ringleaders see things spiraling out of control and run out one after another.
The owner keeps holding Eleven's hand. For some reason, you feel a sense of relief from her.
However, cracking the world means that this world... is about to collapse.
The entire space seems to have frozen.
The customers who ran out and the owner in the store are frozen in place like statues, unable to move.
Eleven shook everything up after uttering that refusal in her own voice, and everything, in the end, fell back into silence.
But you know that something is on the brink of derangement. You must...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Get out of here right now!!!
You feel the force that had been restraining you suddenly vanish. You quickly pull Nino and Eleven towards the exit.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eleven was indeed the key to cracking this world! But now the world is collapsing. We must find a place to escape or hide from this wave of derangement!

speaker: Nino
content: Huh?! How... how can we find such a place so quickly?!
As you speak, you see the wall behind the record store beginning to display eerie signal failures, accompanied by crackling static. These anomalies gradually cover the entire wall.

speaker: Nino
content: Holy ****! It's really starting!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We're running out of time...
Hahaha...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who's there?!
A shrill laugh suddenly rings out around you. The familiar tone makes Eleven instinctively grip your sleeve tightly.
You look towards the source of the sound... it's the owner's radio.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: It's very close. I can hear the voice I've been seeking for a long time. It's my favorite sound!

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: You finally found your own voice. Are you happy? But... do you really know how to use it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She has spoken already, so surely she will remember. Don't think about controlling her.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Don't jump to conclusions... Allow me to congratulate you first for successfully leaving this world~

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: But... it's not enough... Can you find more?

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: You will help me find them. You're different from the rest...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: More? You never intended to let us go back, did you?!

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Come... Remember where you started your journey?

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: I will personally... come to see you...
The familiar voice disappears, and the record player's indicator light goes out. The outage spreads instantly before your eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Get out first! Hurry!

speaker: Eleven
content: "Can't we take the owner with us?"

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's part of this world... I don't know if taking her is the right thing for either us or her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: In my opinion, we should prioritize the safety of us three.
Eleven glances at you, then at the owner who's still in the store, and types rapidly on her device.

speaker: Eleven
content: "Thank you!!! When this is all over, I will definitely come see you. This time, I'll keep my word!!"

speaker: Eleven
content: Hmm... ah!!
After Eleven utters the only sound she can make, she turns around to catch up to you.
Zigzagging sound waves appear from under her feet the moment she speaks again. They wrap around the record store owner and vanish into thin air.

speaker: Record Store Owner
content: "Thank you, and also... I'm sorry. But I'll always remember why you chose this path... Please don't forget what you've loved in the first place... the sound of Call at 3 AM..."
Eleven looks back again, but she can no longer find the source of the voice.

speaker: Nino
content: Wait, where are we going? Are we just running out randomly?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: To the phone booth on Fifth Avenue!
The three of you squeeze into the tiny phone booth. You face the corner and try your best to wiggle in further.
female_content: The three of you squeeze into the tiny phone booth, your breaths falling on each other, and the sound of your heartbeats clearly audible.

content: The breaths, the heartbeats, and the howling outside intertwine to make you uneasy.
female_content: Accompanied by the howling outside, it makes you uneasy.

content: Eleven still seems overcome by emotion. She shrinks in the corner, burying her face between her knees and clutching her device.
The words of gratitude are still on the screen. She simply stares at them, and stares at them more.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry, as long as we solve this situation here and prevent it from affecting the real world...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The record store, the owner, and your job will all be fine.
Eleven nods, but in a matter of a second, the world in front of you suddenly turns pitch black.
The sounds in your ears, even the subtlest ones, become clearer and clearer.
None of you dare to speak. You all wait for this collapse to pass.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
The phone suddenly rings in the booth, gripping everyone by the heart. And your hearts begin pounding again.
You fumble to pick up the receiver and bring it to your ear.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Standing by the window, you look out.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: The passerby returns the gaze.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: You're the ornament of his dream.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Do you like this poem? If you do... next time, I'll read you the rest.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Do you feel lucky? Take it as an honor~

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Think of it as my encouragement for you. In this world... what kind of wonderful voice will you find for me?

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Also... I'm eager to see how you will use... the voice you already have.
The darkness surges in, eventually submerging the tiny phone booth. This is when your consciousness goes out completely.
When you open your eyes drowsily, you find yourself sitting in the phone booth. Outside are the familiar street, familiar crowd, and familiar darkness.
And the familiar Mania...
As you think, you find that the notebook and fountain pen you carry with you have been taken out of your pocket and placed next to you. It's also at this time that you realize that Nino is gone.
You open the notebook to the page holding the fountain pen. There's a small paragraph written crookedly on it, but the signature at the bottom is mature and fluid.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nino Sama... How long did you practice that...
When you wake up and find that I'm gone, don't worry! I'm doing great!
I've already checked for you. This world is much safer than the last one! The weird guys here won't try to transform us into them!

<i>But I suddenly thought of something I must deal with, 
so I gotta go now!

Don't worry, I'll make sure to be careful. 
You see, I was the one who saved you in the last world, right? 
I'm sure you can solve the problem and find the voice this world
really needs!<i>
When you finish reading the note, Eleven beside you also wakes up. She stares blankly at the identical world in front of her, eyes full of surprise.
You show her the note and reassure her. Nino is a bright girl, and just like she said, it was her who saved you in the first place.

You push the door open and walk out of the phone booth with Eleven, entering this city that is both familiar and strange to you. You look back at the phone booth which stands there alone, waiting for people to go in and out or pass by it.

speaker: Eleven
content: "I get a strange feeling about this world... It makes me want to escape immediately, but my feet feel stuck."

speaker: Eleven
content: "Even though it looks so much more peaceful and quiet than the last world..."
Eleven typed two lines on the communication device and showed them to you.
Your feeling is the same as hers. Everything here is just like the last world you've left behind, but somehow everything feels more unpleasant.

On the nighttime street, the strange people with alien heads don't instantly pounce at you wanting to transform you like in the last world. They lurk in sparse groups, all hunching as if crushed by something.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They look so haggard... Their expression is blank, but you can tell they're about to snap...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's as if their souls have been drained.
Their walking speed and the way they get on the bus are almost identical, as if they are all puppets worn out from being fiddled with for too long.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...It feels somewhat familiar.
You think of the meeting this morning. The whole conference room was gloomy, not particularly different from the scene in your sight.
You shake your head and throw the work-related anxiety out of your mind. You mull over the hint the ghost lady gave you in the phone booth.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What kind of voice... does this world need?

Based on the experience in the last world, Eleven hid in the record store because she couldn't find the key to crack it. When you arrived, she remembered the voice she'd lost. So... what would she think this time?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you have any ideas, Eleven?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: About this world, and about... what you want to say.
Eleven shakes her head and looks toward a building not far away. After staring at it for a while, she lowers her head to type for you.

speaker: Eleven
content: "I... don't have any clues, but I feel there must be something here..."
Eleven opens her mouth. The slight strain of veins on her neck shows that she is trying hard to speak.
Unfortunately, she still can't say anything except words of refusal.

speaker: Eleven
content: "Because over there..."
Eleven points to the building she's been staring at.

speaker: Eleven
content: "That's the TV station... where I work."

speaker: Eleven
content: "I heard the poem in the phone booth... I once recited it in my show..."

speaker: Eleven
content: "Perhaps... her hint might be related to this?"
You look up and see that under the night sky past midnight, several floors of the building are still lit, and some windows are flickering with lights.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Still working at this ungodly hour... They're insane...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Insanely professional, I mean...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But what you said makes sense. She seems to be delivering clues in each call, and since this has appeared in your show, we should go check it out.
Along the way, Eleven keeps looking at her device. You glimpse her lips moving, silently reciting that poem.

You know that such Mania-related incidents always have something to do with the obsession of the person at its core. The girl in front of you and the mysterious Call at 3 AM host must have a significant connection.
But she can't speak now, and it's hard to recount the details in text.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sigh...
It seems that you still need to think of a way to ease this plight and resolve this Mania crisis.
Your sigh seems to startle Eleven. She looks at you timidly, and starts typing on her device.

speaker: Eleven
content: "I'm sorry, did I... cause you trouble again..."

speaker: Eleven
content: "If I've done something wrong, please don't hesitate to tell me!"
Eleven comes up to you with her device, her eyes flitting around, still not daring to look at you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hey, you've done nothing wrong. I just feel a bit frustrated having to work overtime.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I'm quite envious of you.
Hearing that, Eleven looks at you with a puzzled expression.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even your fear doesn't change your passion and anticipation for your job...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When you have to work overtime every day while risking your life and dealing with superiors with big titles that are basically strangers to you, it's only natural you get burned out regardless of how much you loved it in the beginning...

speaker: Eleven
content: "Is... is it really that terrible?!"

speaker: Eleven
content: "I remember they used to say that... rookies can't leave the office before the seniors, can't start eating before the seniors, and must open the taxi door for the seniors... Could these all be true?!"
Eleven is suddenly typing really fast, leaving you stumped by the questions.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pfff...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well... that's a bit exaggerated.
You take a deep breath and start walking slowly toward the TV station with Eleven.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've got some excellent, warm, and reliable companions. Even when I'm out of strength, with them around, I become full of courage and fearless.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And I speak up and say no when something truly unreasonable happens. Be sure to remember this.
When the topic suddenly turns to herself, Eleven nods with a shy smile, and starts typing on her device while biting her lip.

speaker: Eleven
content: "Thank you, I will."

speaker: Eleven
content: "I know what it feels like to receive encouragement in the workplace~"
As Eleven walks and types, she starts to tell her story.

speaker: Eleven
content: "I don't know what the real Call at 3 AM podcast heard in my voice... but becoming a radio host was indeed my aspiration."

speaker: Eleven
content: "At that time, I had just graduated and was very confused about my future... I originally planned to listen to my family and become a clerk. You know, don't stand out too much but don't be too useless..."

speaker: Eleven
content: "But the voice in my heart was telling me... that wasn't what I wanted."

speaker: Eleven
content: "So, I made a call to the radio program I'd always listened to..."
Eleven gazes at the TV station in the distance, the gentleness in her eyes stirring like the night breeze.

speaker: Eleven
content: "Actually... I don't really remember what exactly the radio host said... All I remember is that she said she became a host so that she could hear the voices she wanted to hear."

speaker: Eleven
content: "Her words inspired me at the time, so I followed my inner voice and became a radio host too~"
Eleven taps away on her device and shows you the text with the same shy smile on her face.
You somehow sense her anticipation, and indeed, based on what she told you, she's worth the compliment.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well, it's impressive that you've followed your own voice. That show... must be quite excellent.
Eleven shyly waves her hand and answers you with the only voice she can muster.

speaker: Eleven
content: No... I'm not that great of a host... This... is just... just my dream...

speaker: Male Voice
content: You're really not quite there yet. Although you're well dressed today, your makeup isn't perfect. As a consumer, I prefer a more innocent look...

speaker: Female Voice
content: A good radio host wouldn't make these mistakes. Your voice isn't sweet enough, and you stutter. You can't satisfy the listeners like this...

speaker: Male Voice
content: You can't finish your sentences and your voice isn't up to par. Your interactions with the audience are a tad disappointing...

speaker: Female Voice
content: Go to the TV station and learn from the excellent hosts there. That's how you'll realize your dream! The audience and listeners didn't spend real money just to get this. You can't daydream your way to success.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...What? Who are you to judge her...

speaker: Male Voice
content: Who are we? We are the most perfect workers, the most perfect products...

speaker: Female Voice
content: Only ones like us are perfect...
Those passing men and women continue to slouch away. Their tone is calm, but those words make you frown.
The smile on Eleven's face has faded. You feel a pang of sympathy and carefully begin, wanting to offer some comfort.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't listen to them. Your dream will come true.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Believe in yourself, just like how you've followed your inner voice. We will definitely restore everything to normal and find your lost voice.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're going to realize your dream.
This world has been gleaming with an eerie glow, but now you see the light gradually returning to Eleven's eyes.
Noticing your gaze, for the first time, Eleven does not lower her head.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well, they suggested we go to the TV station to learn something. So, let's go.

speaker: Eleven
content: Emm!
It's only when you reach the bottom of the TV station and look up at it that you realize it stands there like the Tower of Babel, its top out of sight.
Despite the bright white lights, you feel as if you are facing an abyss.
Your already glum mood suddenly becomes overwhelming. You understand this feeling too well. Like being called back to work just before bed, with no means to vent your grievances.
"Hello, welcome to this building."
"Pleased to meet you in this place, at this moment."

As you open the doors of the building, you are immediately plunged into darkness. Then a dazzling light suddenly lights up, blinding you. A pleasant female voice rings in your ears, forcing you to squint and look up...
The walls of the gloomy interior are lined with countless LCD screens of various sizes.
Perched on the walls, they peer at you like prisoners.
And in those eyes, you see many duplicates of... Eleven.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: Whatever you need, just name it.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: I will provide you with a service beyond your imagination.
On the big TV screen, Eleven is greeting and briefing you with a smile. Her voice is sweet, her smile bright, and her outfit impeccable. But it makes your scalp tingle.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your voice... Is this "Call at 3 AM"?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But why Eleven?! Why is she here?

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: Didn't you ask me to be here?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I asked you to be here...?!
You remember that poem and that you told Eleven there might be clues at the TV station. Could this unsettling scene be your own request?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What we're looking for is the key to get out of here!

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: Whether you want to leave or stay...

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: I, we... will always be with you.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: Wherever you are, you can call me.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: My eyes serve you.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: My hands serve you.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: My voice serves you.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: I, we, will always serve you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What... what does this all mean??

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: We, are the perfect products.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Perfect products?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You are people... or maybe not...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But calling yourself a product never sounds like a good idea.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: Don't you remember? Don't you think so?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course I don't think so!
Hold on... Suddenly, you realize that her question isn't directed at you!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eleven! Don't listen to her, it's not like that...!
You turn around wanting to grab Eleven, but you find her staring intently at those versions of herself, unmoving.
Her lips move slightly and a faint voice oozes out of her throat. Bit by bit, phrase by phrase, it's becoming clear...

speaker: Eleven
content: Yes... You're right... I am the Call at 3 AM... I am the host of the program.

speaker: Eleven
content: I... I've always remembered... I remember now... From when I first started working, until now, how I speak, why I speak...

speaker: Eleven
content: Wherever you are... you can... call me.

speaker: Eleven
content: My eyes... serve you...

speaker: Eleven
content: My hands... serve you...

speaker: Eleven
content: My voice... serves you...

speaker: Eleven
content: Everything that makes me... will be at your service... Your needs are above all...
The cold white light from the screen is cast on her face, revealing a horrifying green hue. The light in her eyes fades away again.
You're taken aback. The girl you know is a greenhorn who left campus not long ago. How did that innocent girl suddenly become...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You... You're the person behind "Call at 3 AM"? No, this must be...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What have you done?! Are you controlling her?!
The person on the screen smiles, lifting the corners of her mouth without showing her teeth.

speaker: Eleven on TV
content: Control her? Haha~ Can one control oneself? I've always been her... And she's always been me... She may just have forgotten it, along with her voice.
Eleven's voice merges with the voice from the screen. Getting a premonition, you instinctively turn around only to see Eleven fading right in front of you!
She melts and floats away like the silhouette of a sound wave, entering the endless screens. All the Elevens are smiling down at you.
Her eyes, her mouth, her hands, and her heart. They're all watching you.
You look around and find that the entrance you came in through has disappeared, blending into the dark walls. All you can do now is to cross these screens and enter this unknown building.

speaker: Intercom
content: Zzt, zzt...
On the check-in counter next to you, a black walkie-talkie flashes a few times, apparently receiving an incoming message.
You shoot it a glance. Suppressing your anger, you walk to the counter and pick up the walkie-talkie.
You press the button on its side. After a few crackles of radio signal, you hear a familiar voice.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Congratulations! You've helped Eleven... to find her own voice~

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, the truth of this world has not been revealed. That's not her voice... Or rather, it's not the voice she wants, am I right?

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Hehe... How can that be? This is her dream...
You slam the walkie-talkie on the counter. The signal pauses for a moment, then comes back sharper with a cacophony of noise.

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: She wants to be better, to be perfect, just like the person in her dreams...

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: But that's a product, the perfect product in the boss's eyes...
