speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Thank you for making her... the perfect product!
The black walkie-talkie finally goes dead, having been smashed into scrap metal by you. You drop it and return to the countless screens, staring hard at them and trying to spot Eleven.
But every Eleven on these screens repeats the same words and turns her face at the same angle, as if... it's all been programmed.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eleven! Where are you? Tell me, just give me a direction, and I'll find you!
Eleven on the screen smiles at you, showing herself off at all angles.

speaker: Eleven
content: For directions, please proceed to the information desk on the second floor. I will provide you with multiple answers.
Then, a door with an On Air sign lit up on it opens, seemingly inviting you in.
You take another look at Eleven on the screen. She's still smiling, the record player software beside her on the right stubbornly spinning.
The offices in the building are all lit up, but there's no one around.
The map hanging at the entrance of the floor, like a broken channel guide, flickers with noise and error signals.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So, where exactly is the information desk...
As if hearing your question, the malfunctioning map suddenly displays an image.
Though her clothes and hairstyle are different, you can still recognize the woman on the map. It's Eleven.

speaker: Eleven on Map
content: The information desk is on your left. Just keep going straight and you'll find it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Eleven? I can recognize you, even if you've changed your clothes.

speaker: Eleven on Map
content: Thank you for your compliment. My attire, hairstyle, and makeup all serve to suit your taste. I hope you like them.
And with that, Eleven on the map smiles at you and disappears into the noise.
Under the yellowish lights in the corridor, the passage on the left extends forward, interrupted by the doors of several rooms.
You step forward, and suddenly hear the noise of radio waves, a sound you've been hearing since arriving in this world, in this very corridor.

speaker: Eleven
content: Thank you for tuning in to Today's News, where I'll be bringing you the latest news happening every minute.

A room on the side of the corridor lights up. Inside, in a light-colored uniform and with her hair tied up neatly, a host who looks exactly like Eleven sits in front of a green screen recording a news program.

speaker: Eleven
content: You don't like my hairstyle and makeup today? No problem, if it's your request, I'll change them immediately.
Then, Eleven grabs her hair to pull off the whole thing above her neck, and swaps it for another one under the green screen. This time, she has shoulder-length hair, looking sweet and innocent.

speaker: Eleven
content: Thanks for pointing out my mistakes. I'm still unable to satisfy everyone's needs all at once. I'm not a qualified host, a qualified product.
Through the small window in the door, you can barely see Eleven sitting in front of the green screen with a stiff smile, responding to nonexistent voices.

speaker: Eleven
content: What you see is the most beautiful on-screen personality here.

speaker: Eleven
content: As requested by the audience, she's been made to appear in all existing programs.

speaker: Eleven
content: As for you, please don't feel embarrassed. Your needs are my orders, and I'll always deliver them.

The sound from the room on the other side drowns out the ending of the news. Through the small window, you see a row of Elevens standing in there, still smiling as always, camera flash going off in their eyes.
The feel total different but looks identical as the Eleven you know at the same time.

speaker: Eleven
content: Hello, welcome back to the Call at 3 AM, I'm your host... Eleven.

speaker: Eleven
content: About that legend...

speaker: Eleven
content: Yes, your understanding... is perfect. I am indeed the ghost lady, it's me. Every word and sentence I say and all my feelings exist just for you.

speaker: Eleven
content: I will follow your perception and try to become her... Your happiness is what I desire. It's the reason this voice exists, and the purpose of Eleven's existence.
In the last room, sitting in front of the microphone, Eleven lifts her head and looks straight at you by the door.

speaker: Eleven
content: I will become... the most perfect... product.
It's suffocating. The further you go, the harder it becomes to breathe.
As you pass by more rooms and more Elevens, their mechanical, rigid forms make the invisible chains weigh you down more.
At the end of the corridor is a simple information desk. As you expected, the person sitting at the desk is also Eleven.
Everyone here is Eleven. The ones being watched, displayed, and toyed with are all her.
But it's not just her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eleven, where are you? Answer me!

speaker: Receptionist Eleven
content: Hello, I'm right here.
You almost have to drag your body through those last few steps.
You slam on the counter and utter each word through gritted teeth.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You are not her! Bring her back!

speaker: Receptionist Eleven
content: This is her wish too. She wants to be the best radio host, and the best radio host is the best product. She's achieved her dream. Let's clap for her, shall we?

speaker: Receptionist Eleven
content: Don't you want to cheer her on?

speaker: Receptionist Eleven
content: Oh, right, now you're a listener too. We can also fulfill your wishes.
You clench your fist and slam it hard on the counter. Receptionist Eleven doesn't look at all displeased and looks at you with a smile.

speaker: Receptionist Eleven
content: Do you want me to become that girl? That girl who knows nothing. Who's timid and docile and does whatever she is told.

speaker: Receptionist Eleven
content: I can be her if you want. After all, I am the best radio host, the perfect product.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't need you to become anyone or anything!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And you should never listen to anyone who tells you to do that!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We came here to find your voice and what you want to say with it!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do you want to hear? What do you want to say? What is the voice you desire?!
The perfect product before you keeps her smile, but you spot a tiny crack spreading from the corner of her mouth.
Suddenly, one, two, three, and even more voices echo in this space, bouncing back and forth.
They repeat the words of that Eleven, assaulting you constantly.
The shackles in your consciousness tighten instantly. They sense an extremely powerful Mania power, filling the space from bottom to top.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No one else should decide who you want to become! Say it! Who you truly want to become!
With that last sentence, the red signal light disappears and the shackles flash. You unleash the power, slice through the Mania, and then escape.
But when you come out, what you see is not the corridor, but an emergency exit.
Behind the door is only a staircase spiraling upward endlessly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come on, you gotta snap out of this soon... or I don't know how else to help you...
Inwardly cursing this interminable shift, you step onto that endless staircase.
You don't know how long you've been climbing, but you don't feel tired.
In this world, physical labor is no longer the cause of fatigue.
Psychological and emotional exhaustion and pain can stop this heart from beating at any time.
You push open the door. The sky feels so close here on the open rooftop, so close that it seems like you could jump and grab the stars.
But now is not the time for stargazing. And those who ever came probably didn't come for the stars either.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come on, don't stand me up like this...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Does this not count as a rebellious act?
You walk toward the center of the rooftop where there is a table, and on the table is a phone that looks familiar.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Isn't this... the Bureau's phone?
You pull the chair and sit down, looking at the familiar phone.
Sure enough, after a moment, it rings.

speaker: Eleven
content: Hello... this is Call at 3 AM, and I'm your host, Eleven.

speaker: Eleven
content: If there's anything you want to share, or if you want to ask me anything, feel free.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I have a question: How can I rebel against this world?

speaker: Eleven
content: Why do you want to rebel against it? Or would you like me to do it? If this is your wish, I will make it come true.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You have found your voice of resistance, haven't you?

speaker: Eleven
content: Yes, thanks to your assistance.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then why don't you continue to fulfill your dream instead of letting others shape you?

speaker: Eleven
content: I exist to serve you. I want to become what you want me to become.

options: Are their voices what you want to hear?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you still remember what first inspired you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The dream you once told me about, is it true?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The dream of becoming a radio host, hearing the voices you want to hear, and saying what you want to say... Do you still remember all these?
On the other end of the phone, the sweet, contrived voice has gone silent, leaving only her breaths and the hiss of the signal.
As the night sky darkens and thickens, the surrounding Mania seems to be piling up all the emotions, threatening to drown you at the slightest sign of change.
But you are not afraid. You have faith in the person on the other end of the phone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What kind of radio host do you want to become? What is your dream voice?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But no matter what, know that you already have the best voice, and I like every word you say.
You already have the best voice, and I like every word you say!

speaker: Eleven
content: I don't like... being made into a story or an image just for others' amusement...

speaker: Eleven
content: I... I want to hear more harmonious... wonderful... praises... not this kind of...
You hear Eleven's voice. At this very moment, the stars begin falling down on you from the sky!
As sparks of silver light flash by, the table, chair, and phone on the rooftop all vanish. By the railing at the end stands a familiar figure.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eleven!
You rush over to grab her, but in that same moment, a star falls toward you and the massive impact throws you off the rooftop!!

speaker: Eleven
content: Thank you, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Eleven
content: This is not the kind of host I want to be. These are not the voices I want to hear.

speaker: Eleven
content: What I really want are gentler, kinder words... a more beautiful language. I want to hear words like that, not this kind of...
The tumbling wind envelops you with a screeching howl, yet your voices carry into each others' ears clearly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your voice... It's different from usual.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, perhaps it's the same, but... it carries a different meaning now.

speaker: Eleven
content: Yes, and for that, I want to thank you...

speaker: Eleven
content: Thank you for making me realize that I should voice what I truly want...
The last star falls, and the entire building is destroyed in an instant. This world also begins to slowly collapse.
This world has regained her voice. The eerie purple begins to peel off, gradually revealing a red glow like a sunrise.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's over, Eleven, let's return to reality... I know you've found what you want to say and do the most, right?

speaker: Eleven
content: Yes... I like it, and I look forward to it...

speaker: Eleven
content: This world is full of love, full of kindness, full of... good voices.

speaker: Eleven
content: Everywhere.
Eleven looks at you with an anticipating smile.
Suddenly, intense pain pierces your consciousness. A warning from the shackles.
At the last moment before this world crumbles entirely.

speaker: Female Voice on Radio
content: Hmm, you've got a nice voice too, one that makes your listeners happy.

speaker: Female Voice on Radio
content: If you want, you can do it too.
Ah... I remember now. I think she said that...
But my voice, the one she's praised, can only be lost in the voices of those people, in their demands...
It's okay, we've found it... the voice I want most...
It's him. I've always known it, from the first time I called him~
female_content: It's her. I've always known it, from the first time I called her~

content: The most important, authentic voice that I've lost and long to retrieve... is a gentle and beautiful voice... It's the one you've always used with me...
Ding-a-ling...
In the darkness, the ringing of the phone pinches your nerves.
Reflexively, you open your eyes wide and breathe shallowly.
The violent heartbeats in your chest almost drown out the ringtone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hello.

speaker: Eleven
content: My dear...

speaker: Eleven
content: Finally... we get to meet... you...
A cold voice from the receiver tickles your eardrum. Shivering all over, you immediately drop the receiver and walk out of the phone booth.

The sky is covered in a hue red as the shackles, completely shrouding the streets of Eastside. The atmosphere is even more unsettling than the previous two worlds combined. Strange noises whisper in your ears ceaselessly, echoing in your mind.
You're clearly on your own, but you hear Eleven's voice.

speaker: Eleven
content: Why so nervous... I am right behind you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Behind me?
You turn to the phone booth. In that space that was empty just a moment ago, a woman stands.
She raises her head and stares straight at you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you Eleven?

speaker: Eleven
content: Why do you call me that? I don't like it.

speaker: Eleven
content: The program, its content, my look, and even my voice... Everything must be done in their way. I must always listen to the audience or I'll get no listenership, or so they say...

speaker: Eleven
content: Then, out of nowhere, came the urban legend about Ghost Calls...

speaker: Eleven
content: At first, I didn't pay attention to it, thinking that maybe... it would cool off...

speaker: Eleven
content: But everyone became more and more invested in it and my show gained a lot of traction... This was not my intention... and I hated it...

speaker: Eleven
content: Ah, right, you taught me this... to know when to say "no"...

speaker: Eleven
content: Call me by my name, please. Call me... Eleven.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not Eleven.

speaker: Eleven
content: Of course I am! But... indeed, not entirely...

Eleven in the phone booth picks up the receiver. You notice that all the speakers on the street seem to be connected to that receiver. Countless overlapping breathing sounds close in on you, rendering you almost breathless.

speaker: Eleven
content: Thank you... If you hadn't been... so nice to me... and said so many kind words along the way, I wouldn't have remembered why I chose this job...

speaker: Eleven
content: Once... the voices I heard at 3 a.m... were really kind...

speaker: Eleven
content: Just like yours~

speaker: Eleven
content: The words all of you utter are complimentary, admiring, kind, and full of love...

speaker: Eleven
content: That's what I pursue ultimately...!
Something seems to stir the power of Mania. It starts to churn and compress, rushing straight toward you!
You realize that in Eleven's mind, the words you've said to help her retrieve her voice have now all become what motivates and fuels her!
This is even more twisted than Call at 3 AM!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Shouldn't you return to the real world after finding your voice?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What are you doing now?!

speaker: Eleven
content: Can't you tell...? This is the power you've given me. You've granted me the voice I desired most!

speaker: Eleven
content: Thank you for showing me what a wonderful world it is when it's full of such voices!!!

speaker: Eleven
content: The voices I received before were still not good enough... not enough to please me and bring me joy...

speaker: Eleven
content: What I want is a world like this!

speaker: Eleven
content: A world constructed of your voice.
Your vision seems to freeze abruptly. The phone booth and Eleven have gone still before your eyes.
Unnervingly, you hear the sound of something being ripped, and a crack immediately emerges over your sight!

speaker: Eleven
content: Come... Come on...

speaker: Eleven
content: All the worlds have merged. We've gathered enough power now...

speaker: Eleven
content: You will stay here forever, and a new world will be born from your voice. I will create a world filled only with your beautiful voice...! This is... the voice I long for, the voice I want to hear and own in my dreams!
The waves of her voice envelop you like depressing thoughts, obscuring your surroundings.
Eleven's voice cuts through everything, echoing alternately in each of your ears.

speaker: Eleven
content: I've lost many voices... and forgotten many voices...

speaker: Eleven
content: I miss the gentle voice of that radio host. I've tried to recall it many times, but each time I've failed...

speaker: Eleven
content: From then on, the world has become cruel, filled with only order, demand, petulance, compromise, stereotype, and cliché...

speaker: Eleven
content: I want to find them back. Only you can help me retrieve them.
The face before you gradually becomes recognizable. Smiling as usual, Eleven slowly reaches out to you.
Her slightly cool palms cup the sides of your face, gentle and affectionate as if holding something precious.

speaker: Eleven
content: I like your voice... I long to hear your voice...
Her hands slowly slide down, fingertips touching your throat. You can't help but swallow, and the cartilage in your throat glides, choking you briefly.

speaker: Eleven
content: Speak... I only want to hear the words from your heart... the best voice different from all others...

Palms shaking, Eleven looks at you with a thrill of expectation, her thumb encouragingly pressing against the part of you that vibrates when you speak, as if wanting to remember the frequency as well.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I really didn't think it would turn out like this.
Eleven's expression freezes. She never expected that from you.

speaker: Male Voice
content: I'm sick of training that rookie! Can't even follow a template, can't think for a second! Just quit for god's sake!

speaker: Female Voice
content: Huh? What does your voice have to do with winning the project? All you have to do is butter them up a bit! It's not a darn singing competition!

speaker: Male Voice
content: Every day I put on this clown-like makeup and get side-eyed on the street... I'm becoming a meme at this point... Why do I do this to myself...

speaker: Eleven
content: Why... These voices... No, not these voices...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry, I'm not as great as you think.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When I first came, I only wanted to be done with this damn work ASAP...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I didn't come here just to save you...
You touch Eleven's wrists and gently push them away.
As you move, the voices around you break one by one, releasing countless low moans and shouts.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: To be honest, I understand how you feel. When we're exhausted, we simply don't have the energy to discern whether a voice is good or bad. I blame overtime work, it's the worst invention ever.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's especially true for you, since most of the people you deal with have been influenced by such voices.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Under these circumstances, cruel words sure cut like knives, but even kind words can add fuel to the fire.

speaker: Eleven
content: No, enough of these unkind words. I've heard enough!

speaker: Eleven
content: Shhh... Calm down... We still have a chance! We can still find new voices. We'll keep looking. Hide yourself for now, until I find the next person...
You want to step forward to grab Eleven, but you're blocked by another figure that's gradually becoming clear.

speaker: Eleven
content: I won't let you touch her. Listeners can't harass the host! Your voice is no longer useful. Your work here is done. Can you just go home?

options: I'll have to come back if the case isn't solved.
I'm overworked too, I can understand you.

content: You take Eleven's hand and try to make your voice sound gentle enough.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There are words other than slander and flattery in this world. I just want to speak what's close to my heart. Listen to me, Eleven.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've said that we can only break this world by finding the truly important voices. Well, surely they are not like the pretentious preaching that just came out of me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do you really want? We'll figure it out and find it together!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've told you my honest thoughts. Now, can you tell me yours?
But you don't wait any longer. After all, you're a cunning adult who's been hardened by work.
Your palm releases the red thorns which quickly wrap around the three of you.

speaker: Eleven
content: What... what is this!

speaker: Eleven
content: No... I really don't remember... I don't remember!
Eleven's sad cry stirs up a massive wave of sounds. Your consciousness is shaken into a trance, submerged in a sea of white.
Ring, ring, ring...
In a daze, you hear the phone ringing. A speck of white light is trembling, and from it comes a familiar timid voice...
...Hello, is this the radio program at 3 a.m.?
Oh wow, sorry, I didn't expect someone would actually answer. I, I need a second.
My name is Eleven. I'm about to graduate, and I'm a bit lost about work, the future, and myself...

speaker: Eleven
content: Everyone says you're the kindest host. I also... would love to hear your opinion. Can I?
That white dot flits about, timidly waiting for an answer. The answer is vague and you can't make out what's being said. You see a blurry figure next to you.
After a while, the figure gradually becomes solid. You recognize her, it's Eleven. She looks gloomy at the moment.

speaker: Eleven
content: ...I don't remember.

speaker: Eleven
content: All I can recall is her being understanding and making me feel that the future wasn't so scary, and that there were things to look forward to. For the first time, I had aspirations.

speaker: Eleven
content: I wanted to join the radio like her. I wanted to help everyone solve their problems and listen to people share happy things and beautiful moods. I aspired to listen to warm and wonderful voices and pass them on.

speaker: Eleven
content: But as soon as I entered her radio station, I realized things were not as they seemed. Behind the glitz, the voices I heard were chaos...

speaker: Listener A
content: Once you pick up my call, you're as good as dead! You'll never have a good time, not even in your next life! Hahaha, scared you, didn't I? Serves you right!

speaker: Listener B
content: Hey, why don't you pose as that calls from 3 a.m. thing? You might get even more popular than you are now!

speaker: Eleven
content: Ah... I realized that a voice was not only used for conveying affection and messages. It can become a knife that stabs into the hearts of strangers.

speaker: Eleven
content: So, words are not used to express oneself. No one cares what you think. They're just waiting for you to say what they want to hear.

speaker: Eleven
content: The world is so big... I'm just a voice behind the screen. I am a radio station, an emotional trash can at everyone's disposal, a jukebox that should never make mistakes.

speaker: Eleven
content: It cuts way deeper than feeling lost when I knew nothing. Is this what I wanted? Should I keep going? What was that initial dream I had?

speaker: Eleven
content: If possible, I want to find that radio host. I want her to clear my confusion again. I want to hear what she said to me once more. I need her to give me strength.

speaker: Eleven
content: But my memory is fading. I'm a radio station always on air, and I've long been overwhelmed by malice. I've completely forgotten what a beautiful voice should sound like.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's not talk about work now. Take your time to search, I'll wait for you.
The glow of the shackles reemerges, like the first light of dawn in this world.
Ring, ring, ring...
...Hello, is this the radio program at 3 a.m.?
Oh wow, sorry, I didn't expect someone would actually answer. I, I need a second.
My name is Eleven. I'm about to graduate, and I'm a bit lost about work, the future, and myself...

speaker: Eleven
content: Everyone says you're the kindest host. I also... would love to hear your opinion. Can I?

You've lost count of how many times it's been replayed, but you still can't make out the host's answer. The memories you've painstakingly recollected are only of Eleven's own voice in her student days.

speaker: Eleven
content: My parents keep pushing me. They don't believe in me and want me to follow their plan. Become a clerk and work a 9 to 5 job.

speaker: Eleven
content: My teachers advised that I continue my studies, or find a career in a big company. They told me to stay on the right path and never stray...

speaker: Eleven
content: A-and my friends said I should become an influencer, and that I hit all the criteria...

speaker: Eleven
content: Even the owner at my part-time job at the record store grew worried about my indecision.

speaker: Eleven
content: But I'm really not sure. I don't know what's right and what I can and want to do. There are so many voices around me. I don't know which one to follow. I know everyone means well, but I still feel irritated and want to escape...

speaker: Eleven
content: Um... Can you help me? Tell me whose advice I should follow, and what I should do?
The response becomes even more distant and almost inaudible. Silence ensues.

speaker: Eleven
content: ...Even you're not talking to me anymore. Have I been complaining too much? Have I bored you?

speaker: Eleven
content: ...I'm sorry, I can't think of a solution, and I'm not a good talker. I don't dare to talk about these things with others. I only dare... to tell you.

speaker: Eleven
content: I've been your listener for a long time. You always listen to everyone's troubles and your voice is ever so encouraging, so I...
The faint voice on the phone isn't heard again, as if its identity is insignificant, yet it seems ever present, in this place where every radio host lingers.
Meanwhile, after revealing her true feelings, the girl's anxiety is increasingly palpable. Even the sounds of her nervous breathing and her fumbling with her clothes are clearly audible.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Believe in yourself, just like how you've followed your inner voice. We will definitely restore everything to normal and find your lost voice.
Suddenly, you realize something and look at Eleven, whom you've asked to stay. The anxiety on her face is long gone, replaced by a quiet gaze at the faint white dot.

options: Should you say something to her?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're also the host of Call at 3 AM, and she's your listener too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Do you detest her emotions and expectations of you?
Eleven doesn't answer you or turn around, but simply stares blankly ahead. She begins with that perfect voice of the Call at 3 AM host.

speaker: Eleven
content: I'm sorry, I'm not that amazing. In the radio station, I'm nothing more than a jaded employee beneath the mask of a famous host. Work is exhausting and complicated. Adulting is hard, and the future... isn't that bright either.

speaker: Eleven
content: I understand your troubles, and maybe I can offer you some advice, but I don't have the answers to all your problems. I'm just a useless adult.

speaker: Eleven
content: But I'm glad you're willing to talk to me about these things. Your words might not be pleasant, perhaps a bit negative even, but they're your precious, honest thoughts, a true reflection of your struggles in life.

speaker: Eleven
content: Thank you for listening to my radio station, for choosing to confide in me, and for sharing your life with me. I really appreciate it.

speaker: Eleven
content: This is the voice I've been looking for and the reason why this radio station exists.
She begins sobbing silently. The white dot seems a little stunned, hovering around Eleven helplessly.

speaker: Eleven
content: Although I don't understand everything... you seem to really love this job and these voices. I also like it when people share their true feelings.

speaker: Eleven
content: I may be overreaching, but...

speaker: Eleven
content: I think I want to become a radio host like you. Do you think I can do it...?
You hear a faint voice buzzing in your ears like before, but this time it no longer makes you anxious, painful, or aggrieved.

speaker: Female Voice
content: Hello, Eleven. I hope my message didn't disturb your rest.

speaker: Female Voice
content: I just want to say that every night I spend staying up working, your voice cheers me up so much.

speaker: Female Voice
content: You're definitely not some ghost. You're my favorite record that gets me through the longest night.

speaker: Male Voice
content: Hi, this is my first time leaving a voicemail, I'm a bit unsure of what to say, haha...

speaker: Male Voice
content: The other day I was in the shop, I was quite surprised when I heard customers talking about Ghost Calls.

speaker: Male Voice
content: Because this is the program I listen to every night. If those are Ghost Calls, how am I still here?

speaker: Male Voice
content: Your voice is a rare prize, and you're putting it to good use. I believe in you and I'll keep supporting you.

speaker: Female Voice
content: I adore your voice, but the content of the program is a bit dry. Can't you talk about something exciting?

speaker: Female Voice
content: Oh, I don't mean to insinuate anything about those Ghost Calls. What a childish story. You don't think I'll fall for that, do you?

speaker: Female Voice
content: But to be frank, your program's content and sound effects lack surprises. That being said, I'll definitely continue to support you.
Amid the voices, beside Eleven, another voice quickly solidifies and transforms into another Eleven.

speaker: Eleven
content: ...Of course.
She replies, cradling the tiny speck of light and her trembling self in her arms.

speaker: Eleven
content: Oh, the timid Eleven, who's always struggling, and easily overwhelmed by malice...

speaker: Eleven
content: You still have to go on in this world.

speaker: Eleven
content: But... the good news is, I've found my initial strength, and I will never lose you again.

speaker: Eleven
content: Listen to different voices and pick out the sincere ones. Bring them to those in need and soften their hardened souls.

speaker: Eleven
content: You've got a nice voice too, one that makes your listeners happy.

speaker: Eleven
content: If you want, you can do it too.
Tears streaming down her face, Eleven glances at you and shows you a relieved, sincere smile.

speaker: Eleven
content: I guess you're done with your shift now. Thanks for your help.
Ding-a-ling...
The phone rings again, but this time it doesn't seem to wake anyone up.
You rub your eyes and pick up the phone. It's your device that was completely out of power earlier.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Huh? Wasn't it out of battery?
The screen displays an unknown number. For some reason, you seem to know who's calling because you're not at all surprised to receive this call.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hello.

speaker: Eleven
content: Hello... ${PlayerName}.
The white void fades away as the noise grows louder in your ears. Slowly, you open your eyes widely.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Am... I back?
This is the center of Fifth Avenue in Eastside, where three streets intersect.
And you're standing in the middle of the street, watching the passersby. It's almost dawn.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm back, Eleven.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You should be back too, right?

speaker: Eleven
content: Yes, right now, I'm basking under the same sunlight as you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's great.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: By the way, I forgot to tell you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I work as the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, specifically in charge of detaining Sinners...

speaker: Eleven
content: Hehe...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Why do you laugh?

speaker: Eleven
content: Thank you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I will find you.

speaker: Eleven
content: This will be the last Call at 3 AM.

speaker: Eleven
content: If you miss me, please just say...

speaker: Eleven
content: Goodbye.

speaker: Curious Man
content: Hey, have you heard? Those missing people have suddenly all reappeared!

speaker: Curious Woman
content: What? They're back? How come there's no news about this?

speaker: Curious Man
content: I only heard about it from others too. One of the missing people is the son of a family in our neighborhood. It's like he became a different person after coming back! He insisted on throwing away his computer, phone, and radio!

speaker: Curious Woman
content: That sounds scary...

speaker: Curious Man
content: I know... But to be honest, this might not be a bad thing. Everyone knows that those who went missing are either jobless or some sketchy characters. I heard that family spent quite a few DisCoins on that virtual thingy...

speaker: Curious Woman
content: I mean, that's their business, who are we to judge? I'm glad he came back safe and sound... Did he say where he went?

speaker: Curious Man
content: No. And on the day they came back, several figures in Public Security Bureau uniform surrounded their house... I hope they weren't sold to the private mines north of the city to dig for Hypercubes...

speaker: Curious Woman
content: Hypercubes? I heard they were tricked into doing telemarketing?

speaker: Curious Woman
content: Didn't they make a phone call before they disappeared? I think it's a call to a radio station...

speaker: Curious Woman
content: That radio station... What's it called again...?
In the gazebo of the neighborhood, a woman sits down on the stone bench next to the two passersby and chimes in.

speaker: White-Haired Woman
content: Is it... Call at 3 AM?

speaker: Curious Man
content: I think I've heard that name...

speaker: Curious Woman
content: Yes, that's it!
The white-haired woman takes out her personal device and puts it next to her ear. She begins softly, as if making a phone call.

speaker: White-Haired Woman
content: No, you don't remember anything. Call at 3 AM, and everything about it... You don't need to remember any of that.
At the entrance of a shop, a middle-aged man is tearing off the notice on the door.
Hello, sir.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Hey! I remember you! The fella who came to buy water and get change in the middle of the night!
female_content: Hey! I remember you! The girl who came to buy water and get change in the middle of the night!

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: What's up? Need some change again?
Ah, no, I just... I saw you tearing the notice off and I was wondering, have all these people come back?

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Yes, and these have been up for too long. Look, the words on them are all smudged. Even if they haven't been found, I need to replace them.
The shopkeeper shakes the torn notice at you. You look at the words and find that all information related to Call at 3 AM is now illegible, as if it's been soaked in water.
Indeed... Um, do you remember why they disappeared? I can't read anything on this.

speaker: Grocery Store Owner
content: Hmm... I really don't remember... They all look pretty young. I hope they weren't sold as Hypercube miners to the private mines.
You help the shopkeeper remove all the notices, for which he insists on giving you a piece of candy. Unable to refuse, you follow him into the grocery store to get one.

There's a trace of Mania scent in the shop, so faint that it can only indicate that someone has activated their Mania ability here before. But no one was hurt here and no property was damaged. Only the memories related to Call at 3 AM have been completely erased.
Finally, you come to that phone booth again, where you got dragged into this entire crisis and eventually terminated it.
This place was once the center of Mania as well as a peaceful eye of the storm where people could take refuge.
Once again, you push the door open and walk into the phone booth, and the three worlds seem to overlap anew in that instant.
You pick up the phone. The receiver is only silent in your hand for a moment before a cacophony of voices pours into your mind again.

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#005aff>I'm starting to miss you. Will you come to me? I'd like to hear your voice.</color>

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#12edcb>Pleased to meet you in this place, at this moment.</color>

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#ff0093>It's okay, we've found it... the voice I want most...</color>

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#005aff>People often feel anxious, becoming irritable and wanting to vent.</color>

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#12edcb>But the voice in my heart was telling me... that wasn't what I wanted.</color>

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#ff0093>Call me by my name, please. Call me... Eleven.</color>

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#005aff>Hearing your voice... makes me happy.</color>

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#12edcb>I, we... will always be with you.</color>

speaker: Voice on the Phone
content: <color=#ff0093>You've got a nice voice too, one that makes your listeners happy.</color>
But in the end, you hear something shatter crisply. Just like those shattered worlds, only the busy tone remains afterward, snapping you out of the absurdity and bringing you back to reality.
You place your hand on the phone, but end up not picking it up after hesitating briefly.
You may have a thousand things to say now, but you want to express your heartfelt feelings to that person face-to-face.

speaker: Nino
content: That should've got rid of him...
The girl takes a cautious peek, glancing back at the street outside the alley.
Seeing the computer-headed guy in the big coat runs straight into the next alley, the girl finally breathes a sigh of relief.

speaker: Nino
content: Gone finally. How did he manage to follow me in here... He'd scared me enough outside already.
Nino frowns and thinks for a while in vain. Finally, she gives up.

speaker: Nino
content: Ahhhh... Forget it! I only had time to leave a message before running out of the phone booth when that guy popped up.

speaker: Nino
content: I need to find a way to get to Chief and Eleven quickly!
But how do I sneak into the TV station in the middle of the night? And what if I'm stuck at the entrance and run into that computer head again?!

speaker: Nino
content: Ah... If only I'd had ground-drilling or wall-climbing superpowers in this strange world... Or perhaps I could squeeze myself into the TV and wriggle my way into the TV station through the cables!

speaker: Nino
content: Sigh, in my dreams. I must think of something feasible...
What if... it is feasible?

speaker: Nino
content: Who is it?!
Not far away, in a half-closed internet cafe, one of the computers has lit up faintly. A shadow hovers above the screen, speaking in an eerie voice.

speaker: Shadow
content: Like you've said... this is a strange world... Why not give it a try?

speaker: Nino
content: Give it a try...?

speaker: Nino
content: But... there's nothing here?

speaker: Nino
content: All you've got here are several hundred old computers. I'd be better off streaming myself digging up some antiques from the Rust.

speaker: Nino
content: Ah, what a letdown, I'm off... I still have to stream the game I didn't finish yesterday.
With that, the girl puts her hands behind her head and makes for the exit. But before leaving, she glimpses surreptitiously at the computer screen where the shadow is.

speaker: Shadow
content: "If the world could be changed by dreaming..."

speaker: Nino
content: Huh? What are you saying?

speaker: Shadow
content: "Then I would sleep in this dream and never wake up, until the joyous world of my imagination has been created."
As if murmuring to itself, the shadow moves from one computer to another. Every time it touches a screen, the computer miraculously turns on and displays an image.
Images of all kinds of video games crop up one after another on the computer screens. Some the girl can name, and many more she's only heard of on DisMyth.

speaker: Shadow
content: So, now... do you want to give it a try?

speaker: Shadow
content: You just do what you do all the time, only in a different environment~ Want to... give it a shot? Maybe you can catch up with your companions as you said?

speaker: Nino
content: Al-alright... I get to experience everything here right?

speaker: Nino
content: Hold on... Can I take a picture?
Acting calm, the girl swallows and takes out her phone. She turns around and asks the shadow.

speaker: Shadow
content: Certainly.

speaker: Nino
content: Haha, great! I've finally got a chance to play with these antiques. I'm so gonna show off to my fans when I get back...
But she notices something.

speaker: Nino
content: Eh? There's no game controller or disc drive, so how am I supposed to...

speaker: Shadow
content: Of course, not here.
As the shadow turns on the last computer, the entire space is enveloped in dazzling white light. The girl's figure gradually blurs, as if she is about to fuse with this space.

speaker: Shadow
content: What kind of voice will you find me...? Or rather... what kind of voice do you want to hear?
Nino opens her eyes to find herself in a closed space.
The space is entirely white, with only essential facilities including a bed and a bathroom.
Apart from that, there's an enormous game room filled with heaps of games and live streaming equipment.

speaker: Nino
content: That shadowy thing didn't lie to me...
Like admiring antiques, Nino carefully picks out a disc from one of the shelves in the game room.
The cover image seems to be a father and his son standing side by side on an icy plain, about to embark on an epic adventure.
She tries hard to recognize the words on the cover, but this is a product from before Nightfall after all, so she can barely make out a few words like Lord of War.
Nino sighs, wishing she had spent more time in the Retro Games section of DisMyth. She blames her obsession with flaming as she lets the clue slip away reluctantly.

speaker: Nino
content: Right, I have my phone!
She slaps her thigh and fumbles for her phone. Just as she's debating whether to take a photo or start a potential viral post on DisMyth first...
Live stream begins in one minute. Please turn on the computer and get ready.
A voice comes out from somewhere in the room.
She hurriedly drops her phone to investigate the source of the audio in the room.
Live stream begins in 30 seconds. Please get ready.
The voice keeps echoing in the room, but she can't find its source anywhere.
Live stream has begun. Please prepare to start streaming, otherwise extreme measures will be taken.
She looks at the computer in front of her and it's surprisingly identical to the one she has at home.

speaker: Nino
content: Why is that thing forcing me to stream? What does it mean by extreme measures?

speaker: Nino
content: Too bad for you, Nino Sama is fearless. Show me what you can do then.
Resistance detected. Live stream has not started. Extreme measures will be taken.
Every object in the room except the computer starts belching out smoke. A few discs have caught fire. Nino quickly jumps forward to put out the flames.

speaker: Nino
content: Okay, okay! You want me to start streaming, right? I'll do it... I'll stream these games for the sake of playing them!

speaker: Nino
content: But mind you... You, the voice in the room, you'd better not let me catch you... or else... I'll be streaming myself hammering you into the ground!
She takes a deep breath and indignantly clicks the Start Streaming button.

speaker: Nino
content: Hi there, this is Nino Sama's live stream channel! It's not my usual streaming time now, so consider yourselves lucky to catch me at this hour!

speaker: Nino
content: In fact... This is a surprise live stream! Surprise! This is Nino Sama's mercy to you!
Nino searches for words nervously, trying her best to get in character.

speaker: Nino
content: Ahem, although it's a bit rushed, I've decided to stream this ancient game called Lord of War... or something like that.
After her usual introduction, she starts running the game while checking the reactions in the live chat.
As always, comments keep popping up non-stop. But looking at those words, Nino feels that something is off.
Nino frowns. People are always looking for entertainment from her live streams and most audience are here for a show. Very few comments focus on Nino herself these days.

speaker: Nino
content: What the hell is going on... I have barely started, and these comments are all over the place...
Or is it... all that woman's doing? How did she get these ancient games, and how did she sneak my computer in here?
Negative emotions detected. Please continue the live stream, otherwise extreme measures will be taken.

speaker: Nino
content: What the **** is this detection system? Stop bothering me or I'll give you a punch...
Suddenly, a barrage of comments appears before her eyes. "Girls shouldn't swear." "Just cut the crap and play the game!" "Love it, keep talking!" Nino feels dizzy.

speaker: Nino
content: Huh... What's this about... This is the way I've always been. You guys have never said anything!
Anger detected. Do not argue with the audience. Please continue the live stream, otherwise extreme measures will be taken.

speaker: Nino
content: Shut the **** up! Who the hell are you to tell me how to host my live stream?!
Anger detected. Do not argue with the audience. Please continue the live stream, otherwise extreme measures will be taken.

speaker: Nino
content: Now you've really pissed me off. Bite me!
Nino punches the screen in front of her. For a moment, the entire live chat system seems to glitch, flickering several times.
Then, the interface goes blank completely, like the system's rebooting.
Live stream countdown, three, two, one...

speaker: Nino
content: Nasty system... Ahem! Took me a while to load the game just now. Let me tell you, this is a game I worked so hard to get from the DisCity Prehistory Museum. You should be grateful I'm streaming it for free!

speaker: Nino
content: I've heard that the production level of games back then was quite something. You guys better watch closely!
The legendary classic game has no cutscenes, no CG, and no fancy effects.
In the final stage, only a pixelated monster named Dreadlord stands in the center of her screen.
And it keeps repeating the most idiotic lines.

speaker: Monster
content: Meet your end!

speaker: Nino
content: Who's playing now, you or me?! Stop telling me what to do!!!
Warning, defiance detected. Please do not ignore the audience's opinions.

speaker: Nino
content: Who the hell are they? Why must I obey them?! If you don't like what I do, get lost! And maybe settle your own freaking debate before you talk to Nino Sama!

Nino stares at the monster on the screen and decides to ignore the warning and the audience. She withdraws the disc and swaps it for another, but nothing changes. The same monster reappears in the center of the screen. She tries another disc, and another, but the result is the same.
Clearly, she's been tricked. She should have realized this earlier when she saw her computer here or when she noticed the weird comments.
That woman wants to fool her in this strange place! She wants her to blindly follow the viewers' voices and erase her own opposing voice!
Wait a minute... Nino suddenly freezes.
Outside of the game world, if she didn't listen to others' voices, she would die! She would turn into those monsters with strange heads!
Then... what about here? Nino looks at the game world that is beginning to distort, the discs and comments merging and transforming into countless small windows.
In each window, one or many people are staring at Nino. They are muttering something, scrutinizing her, judging her every move.
Their voices and judging words turn into attacks in the game and are fired straight at Nino...

speaker: Nino
content: You... You'll pay for this...!!!

speaker: Nino
content: You've been warned!! The last time I did this...

speaker: Nino
content: I blew up all the computers...!!!
She smashes the screen in front of her with a punch, and her power explodes to fill the entire space.
Nino's explosive power destroyed everything. The space returns to its initial state, white and spotless.

speaker: Shadow
content: Your power is truly astonishing.

speaker: Nino
content: Of course! I was a survivor in your world!

speaker: Nino
content: Don't think I won't recognize your voice just because you've turned into a shadow!!
Nino launches an attack on the shadow in the white space, but her opponent doesn't dodge or flinch. It takes the hit and breaks into dust in the air.

speaker: Shadow
content: You ignored the audience's voice, acted so egotistically, and even tried to pit the viewers against each other...

speaker: Shadow
content: You really are terrifying. Locking you in here away from them is the right decision.

speaker: Shadow
content: You will stay, and when this world attains its ideal form like in my dreams... you will change along with it...
As it speaks, the shadow slowly fades away, leaving only its giggles echoing throughout this space.

speaker: Nino
content: ******* bastard!

speaker: Shadow

In the heart of winter, marking the end of an old year and the beginning of a new one.

The Bureau spruced up the rest zones with quaint decorations, and carefully designated a few safe spots for cozy campfires. Right beside these, they set up stands offering marshmallows and roasted chestnuts.

Next to the crackling hearth, Luvia Ray and Ignis are busy roasting marshmallows on skewers, their soft popping sounds filling the air.

speaker: Lady Pearl

content: Perhaps, you guys will be able to find your destined roles here, embark on a unique life journey, and stage an unprecedented drama just for me.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Here in Fortuna, that's more than possible. I'm thrilled to welcome you all to join in this one-of-a-kind musical extravaganza!
Suddenly, the lights go out, thrusting everyone back into darkness. The audience can't help but buzz with conversation, uneasily pondering the theater owner's speech.
In their preoccupation, they all fail to notice the subtle rustling noise starting to echo around them.

speaker: Chief
content: Hmm?!
Once your eyes adapt to the lighting, you see that the splendid stage in front of you has changed. Right now, it's enveloped by black bars that came out of nowhere, becoming a massive cage.

Inside the massive cage, there are separate smaller cages, each with a performer—some are caught in heated arguments, others burst into crazed, silly laughter. You notice that all the audience members, yourself included, are also enclosed by the bars.
Furthermore, the Sinners who were right next to you a moment ago have been dispersed. It's unclear which of these numerous cages they've ended up in.
Looking at this scene, you can't help but have mixed feelings.

speaker: Chief
content: Are we... really a part of this play?

options: Intriguing, I'm usually the one locking people up.

content: Wait, that's not 100% true. You suddenly remember—you've been locked up before too.
No... this isn't making sense. What's going on here...
How did everyone disappear all of a sudden?
Luvia was just here by my side, and suddenly, she's disappeared, and so has ${PlayerName}... where could they have gone...
Nearby, a panicked but familiar voice cuts through your thoughts, offering a brief respite of calm.
Glancing up, you notice the red-haired Sinner biting her lip, anxiously clinging to the bars, looking all around—obviously distressed about being a "part of this play."

speaker: Prisoner A
content: Hey, looks like the newcomer can't handle the pressure, huh?

content: What does that mean...?

content: Regarding them...

speaker: Prisoner B
content: Those devils, they're the kind who'd swallow a person whole without a second thought...

speaker: Prisoner B
content: If you're skeptical... just wait and see! Hahahaha!
The prisoner's laughter is quickly drowned out by the darkness, then a startling blue light flares up. Right then, you hear a shrill whistle—
Black Screen
With the last drumbeat echoing, three guards eye you down disdainfully, making a slow, deliberate descent.

In their cages, the performers let out piercing screams, sneering and snapping at the three figures approaching them. Their hands reach out, almost with a desperate craving to grab and consume them entirely.

speaker: Guard
content: Alright, you despicable lot, cut the smug faces around here.

speaker: Guard
content: One wrong move, and my baton will make sure your tongues remember it.

The baton's clash against the prison bars resonates with a thunderous "thud," reverberating intensely. The crowd instinctively recoils, with many in the audience visibly shaken, a clear sign of their intimidation.

speaker: Chief
content: Quite the opener... it almost had me going for a second.
You spontaneously burst into applause. There's something about seeing a performance like this up close—it's more impactful, filled with a tangible sense of strength and belief.
Seems like this trip was a good call after all.

speaker: Prisoner A
content: See that? Scared stiff, aren't you? So here's a tip: don't go around saying things that'll tick them off. Watch out, or you'll get a taste of their baton!

speaker: Prisoner B
content: Honestly, just forget about them for now. Why don't you tell us what mischief got you thrown into this mess?

Shortly after, you see the "prisoners" around Ignis casually striking up conversations again. They appear to be quite familiar with the "prison guard" role by now, engaging Ignis in a bit of light-hearted banter.
Luckily, the performers seem to have caught on that Ignis isn't exactly a natural at this acting thing. They tone down their voices, making it easier for her.

content: What, no! That's not why I'm here... Hold on, I'm not even a performer...

content: Hey, it's typical for newcomers, still clinging to the hope of going back to Eastside... Ah, I meant, back to the outside world. Give it a bit, you'll adjust.
You spot someone in the cell opposite Ignis, craning her neck to get a better look at you.
Her clothes suggest she's just another spectator like you, but she boldly steers the conversation, winking at Ignis.

speaker: Ignis
content: ...No, it's not what you... think...

speaker: Ignis
content: If any of you... know anything about them... please, let me know...

content: Guts or not, you're already in this. There's only one way outta here.

But she doesn't seem used to being the center of attention so suddenly. After a series of ums and ahs, she finally manages to blurt out something.

speaker: Prisoner C
content: Cough, hey, isn't it just... you know, a jailbreak? This is a cell, so that's the only way... you know, to escape...

content: Hey, look at the brains on the new kid! So if you want a way out, the only option left is a jailbreak~

content: Hey, new girl, stick with us when we make a run for it later!

speaker: Ignis
content: Will that way lead me to my friends?

speaker: Guard
content: Attention—!!

content: Yard time! Don't just stand there like idiots, get out here, all of you!!

content: Do whatever you want, just don't do anything stupid! Whether to trust others and who to trust, it's your life on the line!

The memory of her earnest look just moments ago brings a warmth to your heart, and a smile naturally crosses your face.

Your curiosity getting the better of you, after checking behind several doors, you find yourself back in the corridor, now nearly empty of people.

Some spectators are tailing the main squad, while others have already slipped behind these doors, embracing roles meant just for them. It's quite astonishing to see how many have already started to "play their roles."
As you look along the extended hallway, you can't help but wonder with growing excitement what the final act of this play will be.
Caught up in your reflections, you suddenly become aware of a strange sound behind you.

speaker: Chief
content: What? Just because you're at a loss, you resort to dragging others down into the show with you...?

speaker: Chief
content: If you try to assault me here, I'll make sure you serve a real sentence after you've served your fake one here at the theater.

You grip the fountain pen you habitually carry in your pocket, seizing the moment the footsteps behind halt, and whirl around!

speaker: Ignis
content: Chief?!

speaker: Chief
content: Ignis?!

content: I even started to suspect... that Chief was just a performer they'd roped in...

content: Don't worry, I'm the real deal, your actual Chief.

content: The shackles clued me in! I trust you! Come on, let's get moving!

content: I ran into Luvia just now! She wants us at the stage down the hall when the bell rings three times. Says she's got a surprise for us!

content: A surprise? Luvia's an actress after all. She must be in her element here.

content: Hurry up and keep up!! If you wander off and get lost again, I'm not coming after you!

speaker: Chief
content: The lady running this theater is something else, managing so many performers in such a massive space... all to make sure the audience in every corner gets fully drawn in...

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, I'll go ask around elsewhere, my apologies.
You move on from the elder, pressing ahead.

Sweat trickles down your forehead as you take a deep breath, steadying your restless mind. You intend to find a young person to ask again, but your attention is suddenly caught by a figure slipping out from behind a curtain.
It's the same chef you encountered before.
But where he just came out of wasn't his bakery, nor a setting.
Your heart races suddenly, a flash of recognition—you think you know where that place is.
...Is it backstage?!
You make a beeline for the chef, itching to get offstage and get a crew member on the line to reach your friends. But suddenly, you're stopped in your tracks!

speaker: Chief
content: Move aside, please! I've got to get offstage, there's an urgent situation.

speaker: Chief
content: Let go of me, now!
Grinding your teeth, you hang onto the last bit of your composure. But the chef? He appears totally blind to your rage—it's hard to tell if he's just unaware or deliberately ignoring it.

speaker: Chef
content: What?! You got the nerve to come back here?
The chef ignored your question and asked you in surprise.

speaker: Chef
content: Hey, over here! I'm certain of it! His face wasn't in any of the press conference photos! He's no innocent bystander! He's a troublemaker who bolted in the confusion!!
female_content: Hey, over here! I'm certain of it! Her face wasn't in any of the press conference photos! She's no innocent bystander! She's a troublemaker who bolted in the confusion!!

content: The streets are swarming with people now, glaring menacingly, trying to force you out.
The more you move away from the curtain that could be your exit, the more your mind fills with irritation and rage. It's almost like you can hear a voice whispering in your ear:
Turn into the person you've always wanted to be... Live the life you've always dreamed of...

You fight to keep your wits about you, noting that Mania is swaying everyone onstage. It's futile to talk to those absorbed into the script by its influence; try discussing anything off-script, and they'll forcefully drag you into their narrative.
Or in another case, they'll treat you as an anomaly, a villain to be chased away.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't even try... Don't try to hold me back!

You forcefully push through the crowd, but they keep closing in, cornering you at the edge of the "stage." Staring into the pitch-black expanse of the upper seating area, you look for an escape and notice a single lit box shining amidst the darkness.

speaker: Chief
content: Spectator... There are other spectators here?
You yell towards the area, seeking assistance, but instead of a spectator, the person who steps out of the box is none other than the theater's owner—Lady Pearl.

speaker: Chief
content: Lady Pearl?! Please, tell them to stop!
You plead loudly. However, the woman perched above merely cracks a small smile, observing your frantic efforts for a moment before nonchalantly returning to her box.
It dawns on you immediately—this chaos, it must be Lady Pearl's handiwork.
Once this sinks in, you recognize there's no one else to turn to; you have to handle this on your own.
Once you've somewhat settled your scrambled thoughts and emotions, you spot an opening in the furious mob and slip away.
They're hot on your heels. In a rush, you notice a cluttered spot close by and swiftly duck behind it for cover.
Sigh, this world... is in table... oh, it's truly... Uh... no, it's a world in turmoil...
In a world mired in turmoil, everything's a mess, filled with uproar. Better to turn our ears to the bard who sings tales of history!
A strange sound suddenly comes from the jumble of items behind you.
You can't tell if the person has been touched by Mania, so you keep quiet, watching and waiting to see what happens next.
Ah, kindred spirits of life!
The music sounded, and next to a tiny fire in the corner, the flames dance lightly in response to the music's vibrations.
Behold, the world's sole surviving bard, the illustrious Echo, here to spin you a yarn!

speaker: Echo
content: A hearty thanks to you all for gifting me such an exhilarating tale of pursuit to recount!

speaker: Echo
content: Come on! Witness history and compose legends with me!!

speaker: Echo
content: "Our ragged tent leaves no trace."

speaker: Echo
content: Sally

speaker: Echo
content: "Ruby wine goes with that steak."

speaker: Echo
content: "The blonde lady hears our pray."

speaker: Echo
content: "She might be poison or a snake."

speaker: Echo
content: "She has our hearts anyway."

speaker: Echo
content: "Brand new cloak and crown of gold."

speaker: Echo
content: "She crowned our King as she spoke."

speaker: Echo
content: "Trust her folks. Trust her folks."

speaker: Echo
content: "But what is our quid pro quo?"

speaker: Echo
content: "Trust her folks. Trust her, folks?"

speaker: Echo
content: "Fortuna is doomed down the road."
With the song's finale, the bard bows gracefully to everyone. They acknowledge her, then, as if forgetting you ever existed, slip back into their respective "roles."
The bard's song isn't harsh to the ears, but it leaves you puzzled—the words sung clash with the present narrative! The character in the song... it's Lady Pearl!
You quickly emerge from behind the jumble of items and intercept the departing bard.

speaker: Chief
content: Excuse me, could you hold on a second? I need to ask you something!

speaker: Echo
content: What?! Wh-wh-what?

speaker: Echo
content: What do you think you're doing?!

speaker: Echo
content: Better be careful—if I blow into this sax, I'll have a whole van of toughs here to sort you out in no time!

speaker: Chief
content: Sorry about that, I didn't mean to come off strong. I just have some questions for you.
You nod with a hint of regret and release your hold.

speaker: Choice
options: Guess I got a bit carried away.

speaker: Chief
content: My friends have vanished, and I'm really worried... This theater, it's eerie, like it's hiding something sinister.

speaker: Chief
content: I've got to get to the bottom of what's really going on here, in this play... Your music, it tells a different story than what's unfolded here. I'm sure it's got the clues I need.

speaker: Echo
content: You think my songs hold clues? Well, of course! They're songs of historical tales, after all! Wouldn't be surprised if they did have some hints!

speaker: Echo
content: Feel free to fire away with your questions! As a bearer of stories and a witness to history, I've got lots to share!
Tucked in a corner piled with odds and ends, the bard with a bird's nest hairdo, legs crossed, ready for your queries.

speaker: Chief
content: Ever since I split from my crew, I figured we've all become characters in Fortuna's play.

speaker: Chief
content: However, in this play, "Fortuna" refers to a prison, but in your lyrics...

speaker: Chief
content: It's the name of a theater.

speaker: Chief
content: So, can you tell me... are you a part of the script, or beyond it?

speaker: Chief
content: Maybe, your song is the script itself?
Echo, the bard, gazes at you with a furrowed brow, making you feel oddly uneasy.

speaker: Echo
content: I'm not sure I get this whole "script" thing you're talking about. Are you... into my songs or something?

speaker: Chief
content: Sure, let's go with that. I want to know, is there more to your songs? What comes next?

speaker: Echo
content: Ah, you're curious about the tales in my songs, huh? Those are stories I've gathered from all over, trading tale for tale!

speaker: Echo
content: If you're eager to hear them, then it's only fair you swap some of your stories for mine!
Echo fishes out a bunch of papers from her bag and flicks them in your direction.

speaker: Chief
content: Stories, you say? Well, I've got stories galore. What kind would you like to hear?

speaker: Choice
options: A tale of a toy factory
A story of a game world

speaker: Echo
content: Aww... Sob...

speaker: Echo
content: I'd love to give that little bear a cuddle as well.

speaker: Echo
content: Whoa, a place that amazing? I've got to see it for myself!

speaker: Echo
content: Really? I can come with you? You're not pulling my leg, are you?

speaker: Echo
content: Zzzz...

speaker: Echo
content: What?! No, no, I wasn't snoozing! Wide awake here!

speaker: Echo
content: Well, you've told quite a bit, but honestly, not many were all that intriguing...

speaker: Chief
content: My friends are everything to me; I can't stress how much I need your clue.
You move forward, a bit impatient. The sax-cradling girl quivers slightly and puckers her lips.

speaker: Echo
content: Okay, okay, I'm not unkind or anything...

speaker: Echo
content: I don't get why you're so rushed, but since you seem to have a flair for music and really enjoy my songs, I'll make an exception and sing for you!

speaker: Echo
content: "Grand palace stands to fall."

speaker: Echo
content: "The future's bleak for us all."

content: "I want steaks soft and raw."

speaker: Echo
content: "Not some bread like drywall."

content: "I need my crown gold and tall."

content: "Nothing else will fit my skull."

speaker: Echo
content: "Please dear Lady help us out."

speaker: Echo
content: "Fortuna needs her savior now."

speaker: Echo
content: "The blonde lady takes her part."

speaker: Echo
content: "She has your interest at her heart."

speaker: Echo
content: "Fortuna, Fortuna."

speaker: Echo
content: "Be tempted and evil's not so far."

speaker: Echo
content: "Fortuna, Fortuna."

speaker: Echo
content: "Set a flame, get a new start."

speaker: Echo
content: "Blonde lady takes the crown."

speaker: Echo
content: "In the box she settles down."

speaker: Echo
content: "A perfect way to end the show."

speaker: Echo
content: "Welcome to Fortuna. I'll be around."
Echo, in a tucked-away corner, wraps up her song with a stylish bow and walks away, her hum of a tuneless ditty trailing behind her.
As you ponder over the lyrics, it dawns on you that the Fortuna in them is truly a theater, and intriguingly, it isn't owned by Lady Pearl.
Plunged back into poverty, the theater's former owner reluctantly agreed to a change in ownership, handing over Fortuna to a "savior" lady.

speaker: Chief
content: "Savior" lady... It really is her...!
It becomes clear, the lyrics hint at none other than the current owner of Fortuna, Lady Pearl.

speaker: Chief
content: In light of this, it seems I must engage in a "discussion" with you.
A slender piece of paper, drifting in on an unseen wind, lands at your feet. It's the type of manuscript paper Echo uses.

speaker: Choice
options: Bend down to retrieve the paper.

speaker: Chief
content: Hmm? There's more writing on the back?
The paper is inscribed with the ballad the bard just performed. But it appears the careless bard overlooked something—a hidden verse on the back detailing the finale.

"Tents fallen, homes forgotten, we've all lost our way back."
"Our quest leads to a far-off castle, just down that slender path."
"In that haven, struggles vanish, swept up in the communal dance."
"A magnificent dance, erasing every hardship!"
"Join the dance, let joy mend every wound."
"Time marches on, but the dance goes ever on, grand and timeless."

speaker: Chief
content: So, this is the next part of our script?
A sudden creak echoes. To the right, on the bard's escape route, a door now stands mysteriously at the path's end, with a sliver of an opening.
A frown creases your brow. Now the "slender path" has appeared, your "quest leads to a far-off castle" should also begin. This signifies the script is in play, everything coming to fruition.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm sorry... but I must shatter this unnatural theater to save my friends.
In this expansive space, the music is the only sound, aside from your own breath.

speaker: Chief
content: I can still feel them around, for now. But harm them, I won't spare you.
Folding the paper away into your pocket, you begin your journey down the path to the castle.

speaker: Choice
options: Reach the end and push open the door.

speaker: Chief
content: Time to find out what sort of drama awaits.
The glaring lights continue to spin around you, casting a sea of twirling performers.
Lost in a whirlwind of Mania, they laugh and shout, playfully yet sinisterly taunting you.
In the distance, familiar shadows are etched against the backdrop; you stretch out your hand, desperate to hold onto them.

speaker: Chief
content: Ignis... Luvia...!
Yet, as they twirl and dance, they slip away, growing ever more distant from your reach.
You're nudged and shoved by other performers, who use their choreography or props to hinder your advance.

speaker: Chief
content: Stop... don't block me...
You feel the Mania around you intensifying, as you fight to release your hands that are being grasped, eager to press on.

speaker: Chief
content: Luvia... Ignis! Wake up, snap out of it!
The harder you fight, the more your vision clouds. The music has lost its tune, with only a ringing in your ears. Still, you're reluctant to join the stage... unable to identify your part.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't... stand in my way!!
You try to release the shackles, but a wave of vertigo sweeps over you, knocking you out cold.
By the time you come to, you've been pushed off the stage by the ensemble of performers.
Behind you, the audience is shrouded in darkness, while before you, there's a frenzied stage you can't seem to join.

speaker: Chief
content: Darn it!!
You're still battling a wave of nausea and vertigo when, unexpectedly, someone's hands reach down to help you up.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Oh, you poor thing, the stage has turned its back on you...
In the sparse light, a noble lady emerges in front of you.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Are you longing to be part of that stage?

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: If you're up for it... I could show you the way in?

speaker: Chief
content: You... you're the one behind all this.

speaker: Chief
content: You've been pulling the strings.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: ...Huh, is that what you really think?

speaker: Chief
content: Even if it's not true, you're still a part of this... inextricably.

speaker: Chief
content: I won't... let you get away.
Struggling to your feet, you turn the situation on its head, grabbing her wrist.

speaker: Chief
content: Enough with the charade... Spit out the truth!

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Easy there, darling, I understand... you need to do this to unleash your power, don't you?
She guides your left hand to rest on her lower back.
The black satin dress clings enticingly, its bold back cut extending to just above her lower spine.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Come on, you can do... whatever you want.

speaker: Chief
content: ...I won't go easy on you.
Thorny shackles rapidly wrap around your and Lady Pearl's minds. After a wave of familiar dizziness, you're both transported to an isolated, pristine white space, away from the outside world.

speaker: Chief
content: What have you done!?

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I haven't really done anything; it's just my power at work.

speaker: Chief
content: If it's your power, I'd be on the stage at this very moment!

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Sorry things didn't work out the way you expected, but capturing me won't halt the play.
With a gesture from Lady Pearl, a window materializes in the stark white void, much like those in private viewing boxes.
The show on stage continues, with not a soul breaking free from its enthrallment.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: You're so smart... you ought to have put it together by now.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Yes, I am indeed the owner of Fortuna... but you should know better than anyone what truly nurtures Mania.
You get what she's implying: those desires unmet by reality, the regrets that can't be fixed in real world, all fueling a wish for an alternate life, to transform into another self...
Such potent feelings and thoughts have built an ideal hotbed for Mania.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I just gave them a choice.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: This whole play is a creation of their own making, a result of the roles they chose for themselves.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: They desire it, they long for it, for roles, for lives like these.
Lady Pearl moves to stand by your side, observing the performers with you.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Just capturing me won't change anything.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: If you want to halt this performance, you'll have to rewrite the script.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: But, to rewrite it... you'll have to take on a role within the play.
Lady Pearl tugs at her hat, a playful glint in her eyes.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I understand you're reluctant to get into character, to act out a part in the script.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: But it's exactly for this reason that there's a role that's perfect for you.
The white void fades away like fog, bringing you back to the forefront of the stage.
Lady Pearl reaches out, presenting a gleaming silver-white sword.
It's a longsword fit for the brave, for the hero.
You accept the sword, meeting Lady Pearl's increasingly fervent look.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm just here to save my friends; I won't... be drawn into your storyline.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Now that all the performers are set, the stage is ready for the spectacular final act.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: With his longsword in hand, he embarks on a journey tailor-made for him.
female_content: With her longsword in hand, she embarks on a journey tailor-made for her.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: All eyes are fixed in anticipation, eager to see his take on the unfolding drama, curious about the choices he will make...
female_content: All eyes are fixed in anticipation, eager to see her take on the unfolding drama, curious about the choices she will make...

content: Amidst the deserted audience seats, a solitary figure with a broad hat sits, seemingly in a dialogue with an invisible companion.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: If this performance lives up to my expectations, I may want to put on this show again by the same time next year.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: This could be Fortuna's biggest blockbuster, the jewel in my crown.
The sword's razor edge slices through the curtain, its tearing sound jarringly halting all movement.
The "performers" whirl around, curious to catch a glimpse of the newcomer invading their realm.

speaker: Chief
content: Wake up! Break free from the script!

speaker: Chief
content: Don't get trapped in the act forever.
The people around didn't keep moving; they're like clockwork toys with stuck gears, subtly stuck in a loop of the same motion.
They line up on both sides, creating an unseen path just for you.
With your silver sword in tow, you advance.
Never before has the stage seemed so endless; you stride on, relentlessly seeking the presence of Ignis and Luvia Ray.
It's not until you arrive under the hovering dancer that you finally spot those two dear companions.

speaker: Chief
content: Ignis, Luvia, so glad you're safe.

speaker: Chief
content: Let's bring this to a close, and draw the curtain on this drama.
You step forward to them, extending your hand to take them with you.

speaker: Luvia
content: The curtain falls...

speaker: Luvia
content: Yet our lives, they've barely started...

speaker: Chief
content: Are those your lines?

speaker: Chief
content: Or...
