content: In this place, my acting is as seamless as life itself.

speaker: Ray
content: My spoken words are my own script.
Luvia Ray steps closer, looking at you intently, unlike her usual demeanor.

speaker: Chief
content: Ray? Wait, that's not it... You...
Sophisticated, dignified, with head held high, reminiscent of a proud swan on the stage.

speaker: Luvia
content: Not that deep, but indeed closer to the source than the usual Black Ring. That's why there are stricter defense rules here, including controlling our impulsive behaviors. All to prevent Mania from the other side from seeping in.

speaker: Luvia
content: I dream of being a triumphant actress!
Luvia Ray grasps your hand, spinning you around once.

speaker: Luvia
content: And then... and then...
A faint change crosses Luvia Ray's face, and she stops speaking.

speaker: Chief
content: I understand that in the script, anything the author wishes can come to life.

speaker: Chief
content: But, all of this is...

speaker: Ignis
content: What exactly is all this?
The spotlight flickers off, shifting its focus.
White light bathes her red hair, its glare nearly dazzling.

speaker: Ignis
content: I... yearn for a different life... to have an...

speaker: Ignis
content: An authentic, everyday life of an ordinary person.

speaker: Ignis
content: I can stroll down the streets freely, without attracting curious stares; awakening to the morning sun, working butter into dough, gazing as the bread gently swells in the oven...

speaker: Ignis
content: All will be calm and in order, nothing will go awry, nothing will be ruined.

speaker: Ignis
content: I'll manage to make the perfect apple pie, to let him try... he...
female_content: I'll manage to make the perfect apple pie, to let her try... she...

content: Ignis's voice fades into silence, motionless.

speaker: Chief
content: I understand your longing for an everyday life, to be just like any other girl, preparing dishes by hand, living normally...

speaker: Chief
content: But the person you hope to savor these dishes with... do they exist in this life, in this story?
You attempt to pull your hand back, but Ignis holds on firmly, lifting it to her chest in a gesture akin to a prayer.

speaker: Ignis
content: Right... Our story's just one role short... If you stay, it'll all fall into place.

speaker: Ignis
content: The story could come alive, turn into a play, become reality.

speaker: Luvia
content: Your talents make you a natural star, you can decide your own script!
Before you've had the chance to process it, Luvia Ray, quiet for so long at your side, takes your other hand in the same way Ignis did.

speaker: Luvia
content: Step into the spotlight, be the star of the show, the brightest of all!

speaker: Ignis
content: Take the lead, be our guide and guardian!
You escape their hold, and yet immediately feel a stinging pain in your wrist.

speaker: Ignis
content: This is what I desire... ${PlayerName}. To be no burden to my loved ones, to cause them no pain... To live each day without the dread of being overwhelmed by fear.

speaker: Ignis
content: I don't need to fear being out of control and no one will ever control me...

speaker: Luvia
content: Come, you've already discovered the character you're meant to be, right? Or else you wouldn't have taken up the sword, would you?

Ignis and Luvia Ray close in slowly, with the spotlight intensifying on them. The blazing light clearly reveals the swirling dust. Narrowing your eyes for a better look, you quickly grasp the situation.
Numerous fine strings, attached to the performers' joints on stage, puppeteer their every move and word.
Beyond them, in the shadowy realm above the stage, a massive dress shrouds all.

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Act... Dance...
As she spins, the delicate strings move with her, leading all the performers in a uniform dance around you.

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Face the desires in your heart, and set them free...

speaker: Crowd
content: Face the desires in your heart, and set them free...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Choose the life you yearn for, and pen it into the script...

speaker: Crowd
content: Choose the life you yearn for, and pen it into the script...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: I will... The script will... make all your wishes come true...
Once more, everyone begins to move, twirling around you incessantly, as they did before.
With each step, you're driven inexorably to the brink of the stage. However, there's a twist—in your grip lies the silver sword Lady Pearl had just entrusted to you.
Looking over your shoulder, you spot Lady Pearl sitting in her seat, watching the stage's spectacle with a serene detachment.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Let us see... what you would choose.
The steady throb in your wrist serves as a grounding force amidst the whirl of the stage.

speaker: Chief
content: Hmph... so you want me to make choices?

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, I've made my mind!

speaker: Choice
options: Sword in hand, aimed at the dancer
Standing tall, gaze at the dancer

content: Your eyes lock onto the magnificent aerial dancer. You feel a release in your hand and the crowd stepping back as you declare your choice.
Still, they cluster around the stage, awaiting your next move with bated breath.

speaker: Chief
content: Now, I'm destined to be... the one who cuts all ties of control.
Gripping your sword in a backhanded style, you dash towards the dancer, facing down her extravagantly massive skirt that's almost eerie in its grandeur.
The red lips adorning the skirt's edge show the sharp fangs within, emitting a relentless, jarring chewing noise, as if gnawing away at everyone's fantasies.
You give a measured bow, lifting your sword again to stand ready before you.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm taking back my friends and shattering every illusion!

speaker: Chief
content: I'll be the one to rewrite this cowardly and false narrative!
Your eyes lock onto the magnificent aerial dancer. You feel a release in your hand and the crowd stepping back as you declare your choice.
A wave of lethal intent and hostility hits you in an instant, as the performers, under the aerial dancer's sway, all turn their aggression towards you.

speaker: Chief
content: Isn't it a bit unsporting for all these people to come at me alone?

speaker: Chief
content: I'm just not interested in being your idea of a hero—the Sword of the Brave and Hero, that's the script you've written for me, right?
Sensing the watchful eyes of the audience behind you, you smile and go on.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm following my own script... The part I play in the real world, that's the character I'm embodying at this moment.

speaker: Chief
content: It's time to grasp that some people won't let go of their actual lives for some phony dream.

speaker: Chief
content: Even without following your storyline, without playing your parts... I'm determined to save my friends.

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: You, you're not one of the cast... you don't belong on this stage...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: You're wrecking this performance... you're not meant to... be here...
With the silver sword in hand, you valiantly resist the performers' attacks.
Their sheer number, however, soon puts you on the back foot, struggling to keep up.

speaker: Chief
content: Tsk... looks like... I really should listen to Nightingale more...

speaker: Chief
content: I've got to up my training...
With a resounding crash, your silver sword is sent flying from your grasp, landing forcefully in the steps beside you.

speaker: Chief
content: Hah... Ruining the show shouldn't be a death wish, right?
You back away slowly, but the crowd is merciless, lashing out at you with full force.

speaker: Ignis
content: ...No one touches Chief!!

speaker: Luvia
content: S-stop... Stop it!
The assault from the crowd comes to a sudden stop, thanks to your two allies stepping in front of you.
They're still a bit wobbly, like they've just snapped out of a coma.

speaker: Ignis
content: I've got to... let Chief try out the dish I made by myself...

speaker: Luvia Ray
content: Chief promised... to be there for my debut when I'm the star of the show...

speaker: Chief
content: That means we can't just fall here and now.
Grasping their offered hands, you swiftly stand up.
The cutting of two silken threads leaves the aerialist hanging in a frozen moment—she's slow to react, and the spectators below are just as puzzled.
All three of you turn to the audience, finding Lady Pearl there, observing you closely.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Fascinating, it's the first time I've witnessed... someone willingly stepping out of my script.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: What, are you regretting the life you've chosen for yourselves?

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Or does this life no longer satisfy your desire?

speaker: Luvia Ray
content: I'm not regretting it, it's just...

speaker: Ignis
content: If that life doesn't include Chief, it's not the one I really want.
The two speak their mind almost without thinking.

speaker: Ignis
content: I do crave a normal, mundane life, however appealing that may seem...

speaker: Ignis
content: The person I'm longing for isn't actually with me; I can't feel real love, nor can I truly love them back.
Ignis checks her pocket, finding it empty as she thought.
The apple given to her by the girl is gone.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Sigh, I understand...
Lady Pearl lifts her hand, signaling you to turn back and observe the frozen performers.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I'm truly impressed that you made that choice.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: But, have you really thought it through?

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Do you really... not want to be the hero who ends all this?

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I know you've got the skill and the gift for it.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Plus... you're definitely capable of waking up from that dream, aren't you?
Lady Pearl's eyes gleam with a touch of madness as she offers another choice.

speaker: Choice
options: Might as well give it a shot.

speaker: Chief
content: But you'll never be able to script my ideal life.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm not meant to be a hero, nor will I let others pull my strings. But now that everyone's here... I guess a little performance wouldn't hurt, especially with these amazing stage effects of yours.
You approach the staircase, effortlessly drawing your silver sword.
Heading back to the stage, your attire gains clarity and detail with every step you take.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But after this, I'm set on bringing everyone back to the Bureau.
Only when you make it to the heart of the stage do you notice you're already in your grand costume, gripping the sword, side by side with your allies.
Together, you face the dancer in the sky.
Silver light descends, cutting through every thread.
The dancer in the sky cries out, drifting down and sprawling on the ground.
Losing control, the actors collapsed limply into a heap, their eyes devoid of light and seemingly no longer capable of sparking hope.

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Yes... this is your doing... your decision...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Embrace the script, be one with it...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: This is... this is... your stage!
You approach the dancer with measured steps, your strength overwhelming it. Yet, in the face of overpowering suppression, it slowly lifts its hand.
Rising up, it seeks to reach your heart with a mere touch of its fingertips.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Goodbye, you'll never have control over me.
The blade's silvery light pierces the flower's core.
Crimson petals take flight, creating a breathtaking scene like a wind gust moving through a sea of flowers.

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Ah... I adore... the look in your eyes...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: It's... the pure desire, so pure it's as though there's nothing inside your heart...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've always been this way.

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: No... true greed... is having nothing at all...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You can't control me.

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: I've lost my control over everyone... you've bested me... you're everyone's hero.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm... a hero?

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Yes... It's your time to shine...
Suddenly, the lights flash, and a wave of cheers engulfs the scene.
Everyone's praising you, complimenting your magnificent outfit, idolizing your expert swordplay, longing for your power which you never realized you possessed.
And in this noisy gloom, Lady Pearl's voice, clear and soft, reaches your ears.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Amazing... absolutely fantastic...

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: You are the performer I've always longed for... ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Stay with me, and I'll turn you into a star.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: You have endless choices, each leading to a different life... any life you wish for...

speaker: Choice
options: I'll go on with the act.

content: The dancer on the ground begins to fracture and reassemble, morphing into your image.
It's as if gazing into a mirror.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since I've become the hero of this place... I'll keep going.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll be the one to shield everyone, freeing them from control.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My silver sword will cut through all unease, severing...
Severing what?
In the blur, something warm is steadily approaching.
Your hand holding up the sword begins to go out of control, sinking downward bit by bit.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's going on... why is this sword getting so heavy...
Ignis... maybe Chief needs a jolt, don't you think?

speaker: Ignis
content: I don't think it's a good idea...
In the blink of an eye, all the echoes in your head are gone. With your sword dropping to the ground, you suddenly come to your senses.
In front of you, Ignis and Luvia Ray are frowning, gazing at you.

speaker: Choice
options: What... what's going on with me?

speaker: Ignis
content: That's my question to you. We found ourselves on this stage as soon as we woke up.

speaker: Luvia Ray
content: Right, then we saw you dressed in these clothes, alone on stage, lost in a solo performance.

speaker: Ignis
content: You were swinging this sword around, delivering some really melodramatic lines...

speaker: Chief
content: Let's just forget about this part, please.
Those who were sprawled out on the stage are slowly waking up, looking as if they've just snapped out of a dream.
As they came to, the crowd burst into rounds of applause.

speaker: Spectator A
content: Wow, it's crazy! The quality of this show is unbelievable!

speaker: Spectator B
content: That was incredibly realistic!!! And I remember all the details!!!
They're chatting and leaving the stage, still making fun of you.

speaker: Spectator A
content: Hey dude, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!
female_content: Hey missy, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!

content: While you're chatting, a smooth saxophone melody begins to fill the air.
That iconic saxophone melody plays, like a homeward path for wanderers, guiding you, your team, and the audience, towards the rear exit of Fortuna Theater.
However, in the crowd, some audience members linger, reluctant to leave, kneeling beside the gown of the dancer who fell on the stage.
Crying and shouting, they reach out to grasp the lives they picked in the play.

speaker: Audience
content: No... I don't want to go!!

speaker: Audience
content: That's the life I want... that's my dream!!
The red lips on the gown's edge seem to respond, slowly opening, mercilessly devouring all those people.

speaker: Chief
content: What?!

The dazzling dancer gracefully gets back on her feet, her eyes locking with yours. She stands there, elegant as ever, a spitting image of the noble lady in the crowd, who is watching you with keen interest.
Caught in the thick of the crowd, there's no going back now.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll be back, you won't get away.
As though she caught your words, the noble lady, owner of the theater, gives you a smiling wave.
The doors grind shut, sealed for good.
The Fortuna Theater, bustling with shows, again falls into quietude, anticipating the next visitor to lose themselves in its plays.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Fortuna Theater appreciates your visit, and we look forward to our next encounter, perhaps in a more profound realm of desires.
You set aside your silver sword and face the audience, giving a respectful nod to the person in the central seat.
Out of nowhere, a round of applause breaks out, celebrating your stunning performance.
As the clapping continues, the ghostly images on stage slowly dissolve, bringing everything into sharper focus.
Light filters in from somewhere, soft like the first hints of dawn.

speaker: Ignis
content: Huh...? It feels like... I had an incredibly long dream...

speaker: Luvia Ray
content: I feel the same... That dream... it was incredibly vivid...
As Ignis and Luvia Ray come to, they recognize you and dash over, their faces lighting up with joy and astonishment.

speaker: Luvia Ray
content: Hey Chief, guess what? I had this dream! I was the star of a musical!

speaker: Luvia Ray
content: But you vanished, and I was running around looking for you. I really wanted you to be the first one to see me shine in the lead role...

speaker: Luvia Ray
content: I looked everywhere but just couldn't find you. When I woke up... what a relief, you were the first person I saw!
Ignis, fiddling with her hair, murmurs in agreement.

speaker: Ignis
content: Me too... And I baked an apple pie and was hoping you'd try it in my dream...
Ignis suddenly turned her head away, eyes looking elsewhere.

speaker: Ignis
content: When we get back to the Bureau, I want to take a crack at making it.

speaker: Ignis
content: But you've got to watch me by my side, that way you'll be the first to know how it turns out.

speaker: Chief
content: I promise, I'll be there for your debut as the leading lady and be the first to try the dish you whip up.
You breathe a sigh of relief and give them both a reassuring pat on the shoulder.

speaker: Spectator A
content: Wait, why am I lying down here?
Not only you two, but those who were sprawled out on stage are also coming to, looking as bewildered as if they've just woken from a dream.
When reality sets back in, they break into waves of applause.

speaker: Spectator A
content: Wow, it's crazy! The quality of this show is unbelievable!

speaker: Spectator B
content: That was incredibly realistic!!! And I remember all the details!!!
They're chatting and leaving the stage, still making fun of you.

speaker: Spectator A
content: Hey dude, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!
female_content: Hey missy, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!

content: You give an awkward wave, planning to slip backstage and get out of this outfit. But then, you see the aerial dancer slowly vanishing into thin air.
And there, in the place it faded away, is someone you've never laid eyes on before.

speaker: Chief
content: You are...?
The outfit she has on isn't for show; it's the same kind of everyday wear you guys have on.
Digging into her pocket, you pull out a promotional flyer.

speaker: Flyer
content: Fortuna: A Winter's Welcome in the Year N.F. 113.

speaker: Chief
content: She was in the audience last year?!
It hits you out of the blue. As you're about to dig further, the air fills with the soothing strains of a saxophone melody.
That iconic saxophone melody plays, like a homeward path for wanderers, guiding you, your team, and the audience, towards the rear exit of Fortuna Theater.
But in the throng, some audience members linger, sprawled out on the stage.
Crying and shouting, they reach out to grasp the lives they picked in the play.

speaker: Audience
content: No... I don't want to go!!

speaker: Audience
content: That's the life I want... that's my dream!!
Caught in the moment, with no time to scrutinize or think deeply, you're swept along by the crowd. Unable to turn back, your only option is a fleeting look back at the dimly lit seats.
There, in the heart of the seats, stands the lady with charming curls, the theater's owner, beaming as she waves to you.
The doors grind shut, sealed for good.
The Fortuna Theater, bustling with shows, again falls into quietude, anticipating the next visitor to lose themselves in its plays.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Fortuna Theater appreciates your visit, and we look forward to our next encounter, perhaps in a more profound realm of desires.

The sky's dancer cries out, drifting down and sprawling on the ground.
Losing control, the actors collapsed limply into a heap, their eyes devoid of light and seemingly no longer capable of sparking hope.

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: In the end, you... you still chose to be...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Embrace the script, be one with it...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: This is... this is... your stage.

content: I've always been this way.

content: Like I said, you can't control me.

content: I've lost my control over everyone... you've bested me... you're everyone's hero.
Disregarding the dancer's last words, you step up and slam your silver sword in front of them, then turn, leaving them to vanish in your wake.
You grab Ignis and Luvia Ray and head to the stage's edge, offering a courteous bow to Lady Pearl in the audience.
The end has come, and with it, the closing of the show.
Lady Pearl sits, her laughter ringing out as she begins clapping.

speaker: Spectator A
content: Wait, why am I lying down here?
As the play concludes, those sprawled on the stage slowly awaken, disoriented as though waking from a dream.
When reality sets back in, they break into waves of applause.

female_content: Hey missy, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!

content: You give an awkward wave, relieved at the thought of finally getting backstage to change. But your attention is caught by the dancer in mid-air, gradually vanishing.
Beneath the glitzy performance outfit, a stranger now lies quietly in their place.
With a puzzled frown, you step closer.

speaker: Chief
content: Who is this...?
She's not dressed like a performer; her clothes are just regular, similar to what you're wearing.
Digging into her pocket, you pull out a promotional flyer.

speaker: Flyer
content: Fortuna: A Winter's Welcome in the Year N.F. 113.

speaker: Chief
content: Is it possible... you were in the audience last year?
The realization hits you—she was a spectator at Fortuna last year, and when faced with Lady Pearl's decision, she opted to remain!
Those who are selected and choose to lose themselves in the script of the play turn into dancers!
They're the challenge for the following year!

speaker: Chief
content: Lady Pearl, this isn't something you should do.
You rise to your feet and head towards the seating area.
There sits Lady Pearl, right in the middle, smiling at you. Her expression suggests she's quite content with how you've reacted.

speaker: Chief
content: Is this your ritual every year? Luring even the most steadfast heroes with the choices you offer as a "temptation."

speaker: Chief
content: Leading them to be consumed by their own performance, becoming the next "Choice of Destiny"!

speaker: Chief
content: I can't let you continue like this.
You reach out to her, gearing up to deploy the shackles again.
However, at that very moment, a haunting saxophone melody fills the air.
That iconic saxophone melody plays, like a homeward path for wanderers, guiding you, your team, and the audience, towards the rear exit of Fortuna Theater.
Trapped in the crowd's flow, you can't move back, left only to look back at the dimly lit seats.
There, in the heart of the seats, stands the lady with golden curls, the theater's owner, beaming as she waves to you.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: It's been ages... since I've seen a play that excited me like this.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: The last time I saw a performance that I truly appreciated... was in "Fortuna".

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I find it fascinating to watch your struggle with choices, and even more so to see where life takes you after you've made them...

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: But you've been a real surprise, in the most unexpected ways...

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Next year, same time, return to my theater...

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I'll present you with another unparalleled show...

speaker: Chief
content: But that's it.

speaker: Chief
content: I've closed this stage for good, and no one else will be the next "Choice of Destiny."
Lady Pearl answers you with that same enchanting smile.
The doors grind shut, sealed for good.
At these moments, the Fortuna Theater, bustling with shows, again falls into quietude, anticipating the next visitor to lose themselves in its plays.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Fortuna Theater appreciates your visit, and we look forward to our next encounter, perhaps in a more profound realm of desires.
Getting through the incited crowd was hard enough. To make matters worse, Ignis finds she's lost track of her Chief.
Relieved to feel the shackles are still active, she figures Chief is okay, easing her worried mind.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Oh? Aren't you the young lady with the red hair?

speaker: Young Girl
content: How come you're here? I thought you already found your delicate-looking friend?
Ignis jumps at the sound, turning to see the "culprit" she's briefly crossed paths with in Fortuna.
She had said she hadn't closed her eyes for three days just to take care of her little brother, but right now, the exhaustion that once marked her features has disappeared.

speaker: Ignis
content: Ah, right... but I kinda... lost track of Chie... I mean, ${PlayerName}... I figured, maybe if I wait here, he might come back to find me...
female_content: Ah, right... but I kinda... lost track of Chie... I mean, ${PlayerName}... I figured, maybe if I wait here, she might come back to find me...

speaker: Young Girl
content: Oh, I see. Why don't you come and take a break over here? I can make you some tea. You seem pretty worn out.
Without thinking, Ignis takes a step back and scans her surroundings.
That's when she notices she's unknowingly made her way back to the street she had escaped to after the jailbreak.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Come over, relax. My window has a view of this spot, so if your friend shows up, you'll see him.
female_content: Come over, relax. My window has a view of this spot, so if your friend shows up, you'll see her.

content: Perhaps it's her comforting smile, Ignis can't help but nod in agreement.
It's a charming little room. The clean, neat table is draped with a white tablecloth, and there's a vase with a red flower on it.

speaker: Young Girl
content: It's the same color as your hair! It looks beautiful!

speaker: Ignis
content: Th-Thanks...

speaker: Young Girl
content: Would you like something to drink? But I'm afraid all I have to offer right now is some water.

speaker: Young Girl
content: However, for dinner, how about we make an apple pie together? The chef next door gave me three lovely apples~

speaker: Ignis
content: Cook? Me? Oh no, no way, I'm a disaster in the kitchen, really, don't make me cook!
Ignis reacts as if she's heard the wildest story, suddenly standing up and pacing towards the window in disbelief.

speaker: Ignis
content: A-and, are you really planning to use the stove and cook a meal here so grandly?!

speaker: Ignis
content: Weren't you, like, just fleeing from your prison cell?

speaker: Ignis
content: Your story's still all over the news, you know! Maybe it's best to head back and fill in the prison guard lady...

speaker: Young Girl
content: Why should I do that?
The girl, brow furrowed, places her basket beside the chopping board, in a kitchen brimming with cooking utensils, just like the one Ignis has always imagined.

speaker: Young Girl
content: jojo

speaker: Young Girl
content: We just need to live our lives and not worry about it.
Ignis looks down, her face hidden from view.

speaker: Ignis
content: But... this might spell trouble, you know.

speaker: Young Girl
content: No, it's fine, I have faith in them.

speaker: Ignis
content: We can't just count on luck! Don't get lost in wishful thinking!!
Ignis looks up, tears welling in her eyes, her lips quivering as she struggles to keep her composure.

speaker: Ignis
content: You just don't get it... the abilities you have, the things that have happened... you just can't wipe them away or hide them...

speaker: Ignis
content: The moment you let your guard down, that's when... they'll steal your happiness all over again.
There is a brief, awkward pause. The girl twirls a strand of her hair, looking here and there.

speaker: Young Girl
content: But... we've still got to eat dinner, right? We will think about the problems after the meal, okay?
The girl invites Ignis over to the kitchen, saying she is free to use it in any way she wants.

speaker: Ignis
content: No, you don't understand. I'm really terrible at cooking... I just can't do it...

speaker: Young Girl
content: But... you did take a good look at my kitchenware as soon as you came in, didn't you?
The girl gives a small smile, approaches Ignis, and gently grasps her hand.
Ignis isn't used to such contact and tries to withdraw her hand, but the girl grips it firmly.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Don't be scared, here... you can be whoever you want to be, just follow your heart!

speaker: Young Girl
content: It's fine if you don't cook well; it doesn't even matter if you don't know how to cook. As long as you make the choice, "They" will handle everything...

speaker: Ignis
content: They... Will they really... be able... to help me cook?
Ignis locks eyes with the girl, seeing in them a vision of someone gently holding her face, murmuring something close to her ear.
Slowly, a shadow creeps into Ignis's eyes, stealing away their light.

speaker: Ignis
content: I... I just want to be able to cook with fire... and have nothing go wrong...

speaker: Ignis
content: I long... to cook, to live a life... just like anyone else...

speaker: Young Girl
content: That's right! Just figure out who you want to be in this place, and you can become that person!

speaker: Ignis
content: Really... Can it really be like that?
The girl picks an apple and extends it towards Ignis.

speaker: Young Girl
content: How about trying it out?
With the apple in hand, Ignis moves to the chopping board and grabs a paring knife.

speaker: Ignis
content: I... I just want to cook with fire normally, to lead a regular life...

speaker: Ignis
content: I... I want to be someone like that... I desire to... bake an apple pie... for Chief...
Delicately dicing the apples, Ignis tiptoes to the stove with great care.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Trust in yourself, trust that you've already become who you're meant to be!
Pop.
The stove's blue flame suddenly leaps up, just right in size, neatly covering the base of the frying pan.
It didn't swell in size, nor did it set the whole kitchen ablaze.
Gradually, bit by bit, in Ignis's gaze, the modest flame of the stove is mirrored.
On stage, the lighting subtly shifts from a stark, cold white to a cozy, warm yellow, breathing life into the streets that were quiet just moments ago.
The streets come alive with constant motion again. The bakery chef, in a familiar rhythm, emerges yet again from the adjoining kitchen, carrying a large tray of bread, golden and freshly baked.
But this time, something is different. Instead of the girl who had fled her cage, the buildings alongside the road reveal a new face—a redhead girl with charmingly tied twin ponytails.

speaker: Chef
content: Hey Ignis, the bread's freshly baked. Care for a few?

speaker: Ignis
content: Absolutely!
Ignis lingers at the roadside briefly. Seizing a quick break in the traffic, she scurries across in dainty steps to the opposite side of the road.

speaker: Ignis
content: Chef, why does your bread taste so much better than mine? What's the secret?

speaker: Ignis
content: We're using the exact same ingredients and techniques!

speaker: Chef
content: Hehe, if making bread like mine was that easy, everyone would be opening their own bakeries!

speaker: Ignis
content: Psh. Just wait till I get the hang of it, I'll bake something even tastier than yours.
The chef chuckles warmly, bagging three buttery rolls for Ignis.
The delightful scent is so tempting. It could make anyone unwrap and devour one right there on the sidewalk.

speaker: Ignis
content: Hmm?
An odd voice resonates in Ignis's thoughts while she gazes at the alley's door numbers. She faintly remembers she was supposed to do something here, but it just wouldn't come back to her.
This is the life you want to choose for yourself, right?

speaker: Ignis
content: Yeah, living a normal life, being a normal girl...

speaker: Ignis
content: No one to criticize me, no one on my heels... I can joyfully cook up tasty meals...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Of course... you can live this life forever...

speaker: Ignis
content: I've always dreamed... of living like this forever, cooking up mouth-watering dishes... My desire... is to share them with my family, my friends, and... with Chief...

speaker: The Choice of Destiny
content: Yes... Yes... I hear your choice.

speaker: Anxious Mother
content: No...! My child is still inside...
A disheveled woman falls to her knees in tears. Flora, ready to take action, takes her hand and promises her in a reassuring tone.

speaker: Flora
content: Don't worry, ma'am, I will save your child!

speaker: Anxious Mother
content: It's you... I saw you in the news about the firefighter's commendation! Please, save my daughter!!
The mother pleads as if she's found her savior. Flora, seeing you next to her, hands the helpless woman's hand into yours.

speaker: Flora
content: Take care of her for me, alright Chief?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sure, and you must be careful.
Flora nods firmly and then turns to enter the "fire scene" simulated with lights and projections.

speaker: Passerby
content: The fire is so intense. The firefighter has been gone for so long. Could it be...

speaker: Anxious Mother
content: No, it can't be! Please, be safe...!
A heavy thud interrupts her prayers as the prop house collapses. The woman screams and nearly faints, and it was then she hears the cries of surprise from others.

speaker: Passerby
content: Look, they're coming out!
In the midst of the flames, you see Flora, carrying a little girl, lifting huge "ruins" out of the way single-handedly like a savior with divine strength, rescuing those in need.
At last, Flora emerges from the fire and returns the girl to her mother carefully. The mother and daughter embrace each other and cry in relief, and the woman looks up and thanks Flora profusely.

speaker: Anxious Mother
content: I really can't thank you enough...!

speaker: Flora
content: It is my duty. Saving lives is what a firefighter should do! The scene is dangerous. Everyone, please, move to a safer place!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Isn't it... a little... too windy here...
You wrap your coat tightly around you. The wind machine is powerful, and you have no idea how all these sand made their way here. It's as if the entire WhiteSands has been moved here.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Hey, are you okay? Don't be afraid, I'll take you to a safe place... Ah, it's you, Chief!
It's Kawa-kawa. Seeing you, his eyes widen in surprise. Suddenly, a gaudy decorative painting crashes near your feet, clearly not a product of the WhiteSands.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Look, it's really dangerous here, come with me quickly!

Kawa-kawa erects a small shelter with his beacons, and you both huddle inside to wait out the storm. In the meantime, he pulls out a bunch of maps, excitedly sharing with you the results of his recent expedition to the WhiteSands.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I am now a fully-fledged surveyor! Once I complete the mapping of the entire WhiteSands, I can open up a safe route that everyone can freely traverse!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The entire WhiteSands... that's a lot of area to cover... that's not an easy task.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: It's okay, I'm almost done! My dad brought back a lot of valuable survey data from deep within the WhiteSands, made my work so much easier!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Your dad has returned home? Please give him my regards.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: No problem! After the sandstorm ends, I'll take you home as a guest!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Okay, but let's do it another time. I have other things to do.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: In that case... since you still have to travel through the WhiteSands, I'll give you this, should come in handy!
He hands you something made of metal wires, which you accept solemnly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you, I will make good use of it.

speaker: Lynn
content: Welcome... welcome to my personal photo exhibition!

speaker: Spectator A
content: You truly live up to your reputation as a famous travel photographer. You've traveled to so many places and captured so many beautiful sceneries!

speaker: Spectator B
content: The photographs are so powerful... vibrant... and lively...

speaker: Lynn
content: Re-really? Thank you... I'm glad you like them!

This part of theater has been transformed into a bright exhibition hall. You carefully examine the photos; Syndicate, WhiteSands, Outlands... Photos taken from all kinds of places, the photographer sure is a free traveler.
Ugh, this is so boring... Travel photographer, huh... These pictures are far from exciting!
A discordant voice interrupts your thoughts. A man rudely critiques the photos, causing other viewers to frown and avoid him. Lynn, however, walks straight towards him.

speaker: Lynn
content: I'm sorry, but you're severely affecting others' viewing experience. Please leave immediately!

speaker: Spectator C
content: Why should I? I am just providing criticism for poor photography, kiddo.
The man is about to shove Lynn. Just as you're about to intervene, Lynn grabs his arm and stops him.

speaker: Lynn
content: I... I can travel through Syndicate and WhiteSands by myself. Even... even gangs and desert bandits dare not provoke me in my journey! You... you're no match for me!
Lynn stammers out her powerful lines, occasionally glancing your way. She swings lightly, and the man immediately falls to the ground dramatically, making a scene out of it.

speaker: Spectator C
content: Arghhhh... you...!
His fake groan is drowned out by the applause of the crowd. Eventually, he gets up as he holds his stomach in embarrassment, and slowly walks out of sight.
Joan is surrounded by theater staff, looking very impatient.

speaker: Joan
content: This script is terrible... "I am a talented musician. My friends are jealous of my talent and are trying to suppress me in the market?"

speaker: Joan
content: This is against the spirit of rock and roll, what kind of performance is this?
With the theater staff's earnest reassurances, Joan reluctantly stays on the stage.

speaker: Joan
content: Fine, fine...! I'll play along. Where were we with the script... "Heartbroken and devastated by a friend's slander, I was crushed"...

speaker: Joan
content: Okay, I'll lie down on the bed over there for a bit. That's sad enough, right?
Joan lies on the bed for a while, her hand itching to reach for the guitar in the corner. A visitor knocks on the door.

speaker: Musician
content: It's me... My friend... You don't need to open the door for me, I don't deserve to stand before you... just listen to my confession...

speaker: Musician
content: I was surely bewitched by the devil for the wrongs I've done to you... No, don't blame the devil... It's me... It's my soul that was consumed by jealousy.

speaker: Musician
content: But you, my friend... You have the purest soul in the world, you have the talent I admire most in this world... If you can ever forgive me...

speaker: Musician
content: I will spend the rest of my life to support your art. I want to play music with you until my bitter end.
The door is yanked open.

speaker: Joan
content: Get your sheets.

speaker: Joan
content: What are you waiting for? I thought you said you're playing music with me til' your bitter end?

Music plays, and the two sing a duet. Guilt over the past, joy of reunion, admiration for each other's talents... All blended into one song, the musician's mood gradually relaxes, until... Joan breaks a string from strumming too hard.
The musician looks at Joan in slight fear, but Joan just starts laughing.

speaker: Joan
content: Okay, all these crap from the past, just let them go like this broken string.
She looks around the stage, and walks up to you and stuffs the old string into your hand.

speaker: Joan
content: Keep this for me.
She quickly replaces it with a new string from her guitar case.

speaker: Joan
content: New string, new start...

speaker: Joan
content: Rock on!
MBCC Barriers... You know it's just props, but you couldn't help but feel on edge.

speaker: Soldier A
content: Chief, an event of Mania is in place, please advise!
You're startled and about to respond intuitively, but someone else has spoken first.

speaker: MBCC Chief
content: Such a scene, just send a few Sinners in, set up a few more lines of defense, and keep them away from me.

speaker: Soldier A
content: That's our Chief! Straight to the point!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What?

Seems like someone else is the Chief here. Though this person seems to have a huge misunderstanding about what it takes to be an MBCC Chief... What kind of Chief hides behind lines of defenses instead of facing Corruptors in the frontlines?
The "MBCC Chief" takes a look at you, and flicks his hair smoothly, while you stand dumbfounded.

speaker: MBCC Chief
content: Sinners, such powerful and easy pawns to command! What's your problem? Envious of my schedule?
You don't remember Sinners being "easy" to command.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Black Rings, Mania in Eastside, Syndicate conflicts, The Rust pollution... All the issues related to Mania and Sinners are within MBCC's jurisdiction, so I heard.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We can't leave Sinners risking their lives for us alone.

speaker: MBCC Chief
content: Woah... is this what the job is like? Although it's very prestigious...

speaker: MBCC Chief
content: Cough, it seems that I can't fully utilize my talents here at MBCC, I've decided to transfer! To the city council!
The subordinates gathered around and applauded enthusiastically. You think about it, if you want to be a relaxed, happy, powerful and superior person, um, the city council is quite suitable.
He didn't forget to appreciate your suggestion.

speaker: MBCC Chief
content: You're quite clever. If there's a chance in the future, I'll give you a leg up.
The wind is blowing so gusty on the stage, almost making you unstable. Fortunately, there's a small firewood room not far away, with a warm light on.
You walk into the room and find a girl crying.

speaker: Sad Girl
content: My wicked stepmother broke my right hand, and so did my dream of becoming a court painter.

speaker: Sad Girl
content: From today on, my hand can only be used to hold a rag, or to carry a broom... Ah!!
As the girl sings, her right hand can't help but tremble, accidentally knocking over the bucket of dirty water.
The girl cries in the dirty water.
Dreamy music starts to play, and ribbons of magical light, acting like a pair of hands, lift the girl from the dirty water.
If you have time to cry here and waste your time, you might as well do something meaningful.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This voice is... Lisa?
The magical light ribbons continue to float. The dirty water turns into a palette, the pile of firewood turns into a drawing board... The firewood room disappears, replaced by a painting studio.
With the light dots, Lisa appears on the stage, her expression haughty.

speaker: Lisa
content: Pick up your paintbrush and make art of your own.

speaker: Sad Girl
content: But... My right hand...

speaker: Lisa
content: Don't you still have your left hand?

speaker: Lisa
content: Or are you saying that the knowledge you learned, the experience you accumulated, all turned into water in your brain, washed away with your useless tears?

speaker: Lisa
content: Starting today, I will teach you how to paint with your left hand. However, if you can only paint garbage in the end... On the day of the court painter's exam, I won't provide you with a pumpkin carriage to the palace.
Lisa waves her magic wand. Several pieces of paper flutter from the sky and fall in front of the girl, one of them falls into your hand.

speaker: Lisa
content: Start practicing. Don't expect an easy life as my student.

You look at the paper in your hand. It's more like a small note than a sketch paper. You can't make out any words or images on it. It seems like a small piece has been cut out from a complete pattern.

After the press conference ends, a group of satisfied reporters exit the venue, seemingly having obtained the materials for tomorrow's headlines. In their conversations, they mention Fortuna and a certain lawyer.

speaker: Reporter A
content: I didn't expect the lawyer that Fortuna wanted to hire for their defense to be so upright and inflexible. He flatly refused to accept Fortuna's defense materials. Seeing the furious expressions of the staff talking to him, even I feel scared.

speaker: Reporter B
content: This lawyer seems to be quite a tough character... although he's not very well-known.
You hear sounds of smashing and shouting from the back alley of the building. There's a vaguely familiar voice, a male voice.

speaker: Staff Member
content: Tsk! You lowly lawyer! We even prepared the evidence for you, how are those reporters not taken care of?!
These "evidences," are clearly forged, don't embarrass yourself.
As you approach, you realize it's Mr. Fox. He's cornered in the alley by Fortuna's staff, unable to escape.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: Evil begets evil. False testimonies will not be forgiven. Justice never discriminates.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: Rather than resorting to such despicable tactics, my advice is to prove the legality of the trial process back then, and let Fortuna stand firm...

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: Anyways, that's all I got to say... I did accept your press conference entrustment but I will not be the defense lawyer for your case. If you want to continue this conversation, you'll need to pay me more.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: The press conference has ended, and this is the current situation. Accept this failure.

speaker: Staff Member
content: If we don't end well, neither will you!
The staff member raises his fist menacingly, it looks like he's about to take a swing at Mr. Fox. You quickly pull out a small notebook from your pocket.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mr. Fox, could I interview you again? I have more questions.
The staff member thinks you're a reporter. Afraid of their actions being discovered by the press, they hurriedly leave with an awkward expression.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: You... you're not a reporter, are you? Whoever you are, please take my business card. Thank you very much for helping me just now.
Mr. Fox hands you a piece of paper that seems to have been cut by someone.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: If you ever need a lawyer in the future, please contact me... I may not always win, but I will do my best to serve justice.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: I have another important defense entrustment to prepare for. Miss Luvia's case is one that needs justice, I must prepare thoroughly. Goodbye for now.
Mr. Fox turns around and leaves energetically, rushing off to his next battlefield.
As you walk towards the stage, you step on something. You bend over to pick it up and find it's a newspaper.
The year is before Nightfall, the headline talks about a play being performed, which has attracted a huge crowd.
Just as you're about to take a closer look, you hear a rush of footsteps on the stage.
The door to the set is pushed open and someone bursts in with a newspaper. The playwright sitting by the window looks up.

speaker: Assistant
content: Sir! Sir! You've made the headlines!

speaker: Assistant
content: Listen to this review... "The play 'After Nightfall' showcases extraordinary imagination and creativity. The protagonist, known as Chief, is groundbreakingly..."

speaker: Assistant
content: "...Indeed, 'After Nightfall' signifies the maturity of the theatre industry! In the future, it will undoubtedly become a gem in theatrical history!"

speaker: Playwright
content: Let me see!
The playwright snatches the newspaper, his lips and eyebrows trembling.

speaker: Playwright
content: I've made it... I've finally made it!!

speaker: Playwright
content: I made a masterpiece... I'm a great playwright...
The playwright wipes away tears, bouncing around the room like an immature student.

speaker: Assistant
content: You're truly amazing... "Mania" "MBCC" "Chief"... It's all so interesting... How did you come up with such a world...
The playwright modestly touches his head.

speaker: Playwright
content: Cough, I just had a dream like this one day...

speaker: Playwright
content: I also dreamed... I was a student in the future world, no matter how I tried, I couldn't get into the art school... In the end, I had no choice but to set up an array in the theatre to pray to the ancestors.

speaker: Assistant
content: Oh my, how could you possibly be such a nobody!
On stage, the assistant continues to flatter the playwright. Off stage, Ignis tries to keep a straight face, but her shoulders can't stop shaking... She waves the newspaper, signaling you to look.
"Interpretation of the role of Chief..." "Exclusive Interview! Why did █ █ design the Chief role?" "MBCC's Chief kindles theatre passion!"
You look at the newspaper, then at the stage, turn your head to look at Ignis, point at yourself...
You open the door, a gust of cold wind hits your face, making you shiver. On closer inspection, you find yourself in a snow-covered wilderness.
The snow-covered wilderness is pure and devoid of debris. Only a frail figure sits in the middle of the wilderness—it's Victoria.

Victoria sits on the snow, with her nose all red from the coldness. She touches the snow and mud without worry, even her bandages have been removed... It seems she no longer needs extra sterile protection.
A group of people in white scrubs surround her, softly singing to her.

speaker: White Scrub A
content: Misery, disease, jealousy, are all products of happiness...

speaker: White Scrub B
content: Happiness, freedom, dreams, are always hard to satisfy...
Suddenly, a deep male voice breaks the tranquility of the snowfield. He wears a mask, hiding his true face, and heads straight for Victoria.

speaker: Masked Man
content: I'm back, Victoria... This is my promise to you, and it's also our bond of blood.

speaker: Masked Man
content: Dear Victoria, come with me. I have so many sceneries for you to behold.

speaker: Victoria
content: Daddy! You came back from that world!

speaker: Victoria
content: Sure, I'll follow you wherever you take me.
Victoria happily grabs the hand of the masked man. She grips it tightly, until blood flows out from her hand, turning into red sharp crystals that pierce the man's chest.

speaker: Victoria
content: ...As long as we never part. Anywhere you go, I'll be with you.
Victoria, with a face full of happiness, walks into the distance with the masked man whose body is covered in red crystals.
Suddenly, Victoria turns around, she notices your presence.

speaker: Victoria
content: You look... like you want to come with us too? Do you also want love and blessings?
She reaches out her hand to you, and the sharp crystals fly from her pale palm in your direction!
You quickly turn around and hide outside the door. You are not ready for these love and blessings by yourself.

speaker: Judge
content: The champion has been decided! Let's congratulate the most dazzling player on the field, the deserving winner—Nike!
You remember this man. You've seen him hobbling to the theater on crutches before, getting into disputes over minor issues.
And now, he stands on the podium holding the trophy, full of vigor, his posture upright no different from the average person, a stark contrast to his initial shabbiness and irritability.

speaker: Nike
content: Thank you all for your support!

speaker: Reporter
content: Mr. Nike, first of all, congratulations on your victory! In the previous few seasons, you were unexpectedly injured on the field, and it was rumored that the injury almost forced you to retire, which was a great pity for everyone.

speaker: Reporter
content: Fortunately, now you've proven yourself with your performance, telling us that true strength won't bow down to difficulties!

speaker: Nike
content: Yes... I've completely overcome the impact of the injury. I'm no longer... the helpless person lying in some hospital bed...

speaker: Nike
content: Is this... really true...?
For a moment, there's a glaze over Nike's eyes, but when he grips the trophy in his hand, his expression instantly becomes firm, not wavering for a moment.

speaker: Nike
content: ...That's right! Now, the person standing on the podium is me. I am the champion!

speaker: Nike
content: In that difficult period, I never thought of giving up. I persisted in rehabilitation every day, finally overcoming my slump, and that's how I gained this victory!

speaker: Reporter
content: Your spirit is truly admirable, an your experience will definitely motivate many people!

Under the bright lights and fluttering ribbons, Nike shows a proud smile. He brushes off the momentary confusion in his mind and continues to immerse himself in this honor and glory that he will forever miss.
You find yourself in a wasteland, a withered rose in the distance, singing faintly.

speaker: Rose Flower
content: Ahead, it might be an abyss, or it could be a hair-raising nightmare...

speaker: Rose Flower
content: Keep going, hero, this is the last hope.
Looking into the distance, you see a familiar figure—Mess.
Mess is clad in armor, her hand holding the giant sword trembling slightly, it's unclear whether she's excited or nervous. In front of her, is a dragon with black scales and blood-red eyes.

speaker: Rose Flower
content: The hero is exhausted, she's finally found the embodiment of fear—the evil dragon that brings calamity and suffering!

speaker: Mess
content: This is really interesting... Die, evil dragon! I swear on my sword, today I will cut off the source of all evil!
Mess exerts all her strength, slaying the dragon with her sword. The dragon lets out a mournful cry, its body turns into black smoke and scatters with the wind.

speaker: Mess
content: The horrifying black thing is gone... It's all over now.

speaker: Mess
content: Now, it's my new era! Hahahaha!
A huge shadow appears on Mess's back, it seems to be... a pair of dragon wings!
The rose timidly lowers its head.

speaker: Rose Flower
content: The one who defeated fear, has become a greater fear for all...

speaker: Rose Flower
content: A storm is coming, a new evil dragon has been born! The world is trembling. We are about to enter an even more terrifying dark age!

speaker: Mess
content: Ahahaha! The one who's peeking over there, yes, I'm calling you!

speaker: Mess
content: You wanna be the next dragon slayer? Are you a hero?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry, I'm busy right now. But when you're done, find us at the exit.
You enter a somewhat strange room.
Blue sky, white clouds, sun. Childish lines, highly saturated colors, it's like a child's sketch.
There's one tree standing on the ground painted as a meadow, just one tree.
You walk forward, wanting to take a closer look.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Ah!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Huh?! Ma... Macchiato?

speaker: Macchiato
content: I'm not Macchiato, I'm a tree.
You call her name again, but this time Macchiato doesn't respond.

speaker: Macchiato
content: ...The sunlight today is very comfortable.
Macchiato shakes her branches.

options: Stand with her for a while

content: You stand quietly beside Macchiato, the artificial sunlight enveloping you, soothing your spirit.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Becoming a tree, always basking in the sun, doesn't seem too bad.
The branches sway a bit, seemingly pleased to hear you say that.

speaker: Macchiato
content: Yes, escaping work, society, and the identity of being a "human"... the feeling of absolute freedom... it's quite nice.
A breeze blows through, the leaves moving freely with the wind.

speaker: Macchiato
content: ...However, I will still return home. In the end, I can't bear to leave my friends and family.

speaker: Macchiato
content: But before that... please let me enjoy this a bit longer.
You leave the room, while Macchiato still stands leisurely on the open field, occasionally shaking her branches.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Heh... That toy factory you are talking about...

speaker: Aged Voice
content: ...I know that place. All the scavengers around here know... the Buonanotte Factory.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: It was just an obscure little workshop manufacturing plushies, plastic dolls, and stuff like that.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Its business was getting worse by the day, with only a handful of employees hanging on.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Then one day, out of the blue, the last few employees were gone overnight too... as if they vanished.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: From then on, the factory has stayed abandoned.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: And after a while, it became part of the Rust and home to those man-eating creatures too...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Man-eating creatures?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sounds like it might indeed be related to Mania.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Hehehe, want to know the truth about the factory? No one can answer your question.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Reporters, exorcists, and intruders who cross the Rust wanting to spend the night in the factory... Too many people have been there.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: No one who came to the factory at night managed to come out the second day.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: The more mysterious it is, the more people are curious about it! The more people investigate, the more people go missing!

speaker: Aged Voice
content: What's really inside that factory? The rumor has too many versions.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Some say the toys in the factory have come to life.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: But more mention metal wheels and a ghost in white...

speaker: Aged Voice
content: A pale wheelchair-bound girl appearing in various corners of the factory.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Without exception, those who lay eyes on her will all...

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Turn! Into! Toys!

speaker: Aged Voice
content: With both body and mind trapped in a small toy, never able to escape from this factory again.

speaker: Aged Voice
content: They can only lie on the factory floor, day after day, until they are forgotten by the world...

speaker: Aged Voice
content: Spending their last days in that ruin as a toy...

speaker: Scavenger
content: Be careful. That blonde girl you're looking for... might have turned into a toy too.

speaker: Scavenger
content: Toys, toys! Three, two, one... Freeze! Hahahaha...
Flicking the DisCoins he just got from you, the old scavenger burps loudly and staggers away, mumbling something under his breath...

speaker: Scavenger
content: Burp... Big... Big toy? Small toy? Good toy... Bad toy! Hahaha...

speaker: Nightingale
content: You're saying that Pepper's also gotten involved in this strange toy factory?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, it's my fault for not paying enough attention. She did send me a message before she set out on an assignment.

speaker: Pepper
content: Chief, Chief! I've found a super duper interesting place! Just right for a wicked villain like me!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did you find new soil to plant in?

speaker: Pepper
content: Uh-uh! It's a factory full of evil power!

speaker: Pepper
content: Come on, let's go together! Pepper will show you some real fun!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I was tied up with other tasks, so I turned her down. I didn't expect Pepper to go missing in the Rust for a full 24 hours after that...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I am to blame for my negligence. Fortunately, the shackles are still linked to Pepper, and I'm not too unfamiliar with the Rust anymore.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But as for this Buonanotte Factory, the information we can get is still limited. We must quickly find out more about it and send people to search for Pepper...
The night is getting darker, and the Rust's miasma of Mania has begun to interfere with communication. The red light on your device is flickering unstably.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief... Where are you... Why... the signal...
The stench of garbage mixed with the cold night air fills your lungs. You tighten your grey coat and look up as if responding to a call.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm already near the factory.
The device emits a screeching noise. The signal is now completely blocked by the invisible miasma.
You look at the dirty old map in your hands and the familiar Underground emblem on it. Considering the risk of this operation, you shouldn't drag more people into this.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All this hassle just to invite a single person here. I should feel honored.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As you wish, I'm here. What will it be this time? Come on, show me.

A dried-up dead rat lies awkwardly in the middle of the path, still in a fleeing posture. The scraps of remaining flesh are covered in little holes eaten away by maggots, revealing the yellowish bones inside.
Gooey clots of old industrial fluids are spreading all the way out of the base of the building not far away.
You step over the rat, follow the source of the fluid, and stop in front of a dilapidated building.
Above your head is a wobbling door sign eaten away by rust. You can barely make out the words on it: <color=#fb9259>Buonanotte Toy Factory</color>.
You still feel a steady connection to your shackles in your palm. Pepper should be nearby. You push open the rusty door.
Creak... The screech of the opening door pierces the dead silence of the Rust at night.
The door stirs up a flow of rusty air. Behind the door, out of your sight, a notice with blurred writing falls...
Eve's home. Only Eve and her family can enter.
After midnight, it's time for Eve and her family.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pepper?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pepper——
The interior is spacious and you can hear the echoes of your own voice. The level of decay exceeds your imagination. Any small movement stirs up an astonishing amount of dust.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cough...
You cover your mouth and nose, fan away the dust in front of you, and fumble in the dark with the faint flashlight.
Finally, you find a switch-like button on the peeling wall.

The circuit emits a dull electrical noise. After a long time, the bulbs in the factory start flickering one after another. The dim lighting is barely enough to illuminate the machines in the workshop.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: According to the old scavenger, this factory should have only been abandoned for a few years.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is it because of the harsh environment of the Rust? The condition is much worse than expected.

The interior of the factory is even quieter than the Rust, making the unstable communication signal from the device somewhat jarring. You decide to turn it off completely and focus on observing your surroundings.
Dust and cobwebs are visible everywhere. The machines are of an old make, and their surfaces are mostly corroded and rusty.
You cast a cursory glance around the room. Apart from a few toys scattered on the floor, nothing seems out of the ordinary, except for the fact that nobody is here.
It's not just that there's no one in sight, there are also no signs or traces of recent human activity.
The deep, silent darkness seems to swallow your attention. You find yourself unconsciously staring into its unfocused depths, as if something is also staring back at you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pepper? Are you here?
Zzt, zzt...
What responds to you is the flickering of the unsteady light.
In the next instant, the red lights of all the instruments in the factory start blinking almost simultaneously, like well-hidden blood-red eyes, flickering on and off...
An uneasiness begins to spread.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The contamination is pungent in the air. There's definitely something wrong with this place.
Making sure that the door is still open, you make to leave the workshop and think of something else when suddenly, you hear a familiar voice next to you...
Emm... Chief...
Am I dreaming? I thought I heard Chief speaking...
It's indeed Pepper's voice! You follow the sound and begin searching, but apart from the toys strewn all over the floor, you see nothing.

speaker: Pepper
content: Hmm, what... time is it now?
23:59:42
Bang! A gust of chilly wind blows by and the factory's door suddenly closes in your face!

speaker: Pepper
content: Oh no! Get out, get out! Leave this place, don't come in!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pepper? Where are you?! How come I don't see you?
Your gaze sweeps across the entire workshop. All you see are machines, toys, and more toys...
No way...
You look down for clues but suddenly feel dizzy.

speaker: Pepper
content: Chief! Don't worry about me! You must go now!
23:59:55
Your vision begins to spin and twist, tearing at your mind and spirit.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm afraid... it's too late.

Is it taking you to another dimension? Or is this some kind of illusion... The jumbled factory ceiling is dividing your perception into pieces, making it impossible to think. Right now, all you can count on is your past experience of being caught in similar predicaments.
23:59:58

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The shackles are still connected... but... I can't muster the strength...
23:59:59

speaker: Pepper
content: Chief!!!
00:00:00
This is... Buonanotte, right?
This place used to be so severely contaminated. Who'd have guessed it can produce such amazing toys?
Please, please, Molewagon... Just take me in for a peek! Just a peek.
What shall we do today...
Let's pretend to celebrate Bone's birthday, shall we?
Happy birthday to you, happy...

speaker: Chelsea
content: Eve, another bothersome visitor's here.

speaker: Eve
content: Too bad, I've already made it clear that guests are not welcome here.

speaker: Oliver
content: Oliver can help Eve catch them all!

speaker: Eve
content: No need, there are more important things to do... Bone is celebrating its birthday.

speaker: Eve
content: It's time to play house.

speaker: Familiar Voice
content: Baa, Chief... Wake up...

speaker: Familiar Voice
content: Wakey-wakey!

Before your eyes, an old light bulb hangs precariously from the ceiling, its cool light flickering, making you a bit dazed. You try to sit up, but your limbs feel weird. A tingling, soft, and light feeling spreads throughout your body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is...
You're still a bit dizzy, but falling unconscious is nothing new to you anymore. You quickly calm down and manage to figure out how to apply strength, turning your head tentatively.
What you see is a huge blackface sheep sticking its muzzle to your nose. Its dull pupils are staring intently at you. You start at the sight.
You instinctively release the spikes and quickly distance yourself from it. But to your surprise, you feel a familiar sensation at the end of the shackles. A connection unique to that with a Sinner.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're... Pepper?

speaker: Pepper
content: Yes, it's me! Sob... Thank goodness you're not hurt, Chief!

speaker: Pepper
content: ...If you came here for me, I will feel guilty for the rest of my life!

speaker: Pepper
content: I've become a guilty little wooden sheep! I will never be happy again!

speaker: Pepper
content: Wahhh... Pepper doesn't want to be a sad villain!

speaker: Pepper
content: If I'd known, I would have just stayed home and tended to my crops... Sob...
The familiar voice makes you sigh in relief, but it's indeed also noisy enough to start another headache.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Easy there, I'm fine, and I'll take you back. What turned you into that?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Into... a giant sheep?
The little sheep looks you up and down, then hangs her head guiltily as if she's done something wrong.

speaker: Pepper
content: Chief, it's not that I've grown in size, it's that we've both shrunk...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do you mean?
An ominous feeling makes you anxious suddenly.

You quickly struggle to regain control of your limbs and lift your head slightly clumsily. The rusty door you could easily push open is now towering and unreachable, seeming even more massive than the skyscrapers of Eastside... Are you hallucinating due to the blackout?
Pepper notices your gaze toward the exit.

speaker: Pepper
content: You can't open it. I've been trying to push it with all my farming strength for the whole day. But the strength of a <color=#fb9259>toy</color> is just too little... Baa.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: A toy?

speaker: Pepper
content: Yes, Chief.

speaker: Pepper
content: Once past midnight, anyone who steps into this factory will turn into a toy.

speaker: Pepper
content: We... have become toys.
You look down at yourself somewhat belatedly. Your cotton palms are fraying a bit, and your legs are stout and short. With that realization, your cotton brain seems to become a blank too.
Before you can fully process that, the eerie scene before your eyes shocks you anew.

speaker: Blue Soldiers
content: Heave-ho, heave-ho, keep it up!
The toys scattered on the ground get up one by one to stand by the conveyor belt, waving their arms stiffly at nothing.

speaker: Blue Soldier A
content: I'll take care of the assembly!

speaker: Blue Soldier B
content: I'll handle the painting!

speaker: Blue Soldier C
content: I'll do the final check and packaging!

In the workshop, dusty instruments turn on its red lights. The old machines struggle to operate, trembling incessantly, the sound of rusty metal colliding unsettling. Your surroundings are filled with the smell of motor oil and an uncanny atmosphere.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: These are...

speaker: Pepper
content: People who came to this factory before me. Like us, they were turned into toys too.

speaker: Pepper
content: They work at night here. You're about to see the factory in its element.

speaker: Blue Soldier A
content: Work hard!

speaker: Blue Soldier B
content: To give to the kids!

speaker: Blue Soldier C
content: A sweet dream!
Plastic limbs collide with each other, echoing the well-coordinated yet eerie chant.

speaker: Pepper
content: This place will gradually transform everyone into toys.

speaker: Pepper
content: Your body will become stiffer day by day until it is completely out of your control and you lose your rational mind! Then, you'll be motionless during the day and turn into dumdums like them at night.

speaker: Blue Soldier A
content: Screws!

speaker: Blue Soldier B
content: Wrench!

speaker: Blue Soldier C
content: Drill!
The plastic dolls repeat their tasks mechanically, already a part of this factory.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So... we will also become a part of the factory and completely lose our self-awareness and control over our bodies. I'm afraid it'll be impossible for us to escape if we just sit and wait until then.

speaker: Pepper
content: In fact, you don't even need to wait that long... I've been here for a whole day now...

speaker: Pepper
content: Toyification is a faster process than you can imagine... Baa.
Pepper stands up and smiles a bit ruefully. You see that her movements are already going out of control, stiff like her body is wearing out and breaking down. Just like a real wooden toy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why didn't you tell me earlier?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Can you still walk? Do you feel discomfort in your body, your head, or your legs?

speaker: Pepper
content: Oh, chill out! I'm the most wicked villain DisCity has ever seen, nothing bad can happen to me! I just... can't help bleating occasionally.
She acts all excited and wags her sheep tail, but her body still makes a wooden creak. This is not a good sign...

speaker: Pepper
content: Hey, hey, it's all good! It's not every day I get to see you with such cute, beady eyes. Don't you make that face, Chief! Anyway, you came inside the factory to find me, I swear I won't let anything happen to you!

speaker: Pepper
content: If entering this place turns you into a toy, perhaps all we need to do is just get out? I'm sure you'll figure something out once we escape from here!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Didn't you say you can't push this door open?

speaker: Pepper
content: Yeah! So I've been looking for another exit!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's another exit? Where?

speaker: Pepper
content: Hehe... haven't found it yet! But I believe in you, Chief!
Pepper twists her head somewhat proudly, again making that noise of a worn-out toy.
Seeing her struggle to move, you can't bring yourself to tell her off.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There must be more than one way out of here. If that old scavenger wasn't lying, then this place used to be just an ordinary toy factory. There must be other exits.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Manufacturing, production, sales...
Trying your best to calm down, you set your eyes on the most conspicuous conveyor belt in the middle of the workshop.

speaker: Pepper
content: What is it? Do you want to help these plastic dolls out with their work?

speaker: Pepper
content: Well, guess I have no other choice! Pepper will join you too!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The products made by the factory definitely wouldn't stay in the factory forever.

speaker: Pepper
content: They'd go to shops! The big malls in Eastside!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, the main entrance might be used only by humans, but there must be a passage used only by toys. So, how do they get out of this factory...?

speaker: Pepper
content: Transported out with a large truck!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And how do the toys in the factory get to the truck?

speaker: Pepper
content: Well... by manual handling!
Looking at Pepper in front of you, self-satisfied with her own "smartness", you suddenly miss Hella and Hecate.

speaker: Pepper
content: Oh, oh, I know! The conveyor belt! You're too smart, Chief!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You finally caught on... Keep your voice down, don't disturb those working plastic dolls.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Though we're not sure if they can hear with those plastic ears, startling them is definitely not a good idea.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Follow me, go around them, and climb onto the conveyor belt. How's your body feeling?
The little wooden tries to stand at attention, making little clicks and clacks.

speaker: Pepper
content: As good as new!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's go.
You take the lead and move. The cotton soles of your feet step on the concrete floor almost soundlessly.
You advance, sticking to the shadows of the machines while carefully observing the toys on the assembly line.
Fortunately, they don't notice anything unusual.
The little wooden sheep nods, carefully lifting her wooden feet to move closer to you with wobbly steps.
Pepper's body is obviously not as easy to operate as yours. She tries her best to hide behind the piles of toy blocks around her, moving inch by inch unsteadily.
Clack! The wood hits the cement floor, inevitably making a slight knocking sound. Startled, Pepper gasps.

speaker: Blue Soldier A
content: We are workers of the factory!

speaker: Blue Soldier B
content: We belong here!

speaker: Blue Soldier C
content: Be diligent and serious. No slacking off!
The chant doesn't stop, and they haven't noticed you yet. If Pepper just hangs in there for a bit more, you can both slip into their blind spot.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: <size=30>It's okay, Pepper, keep going.</size>
Clack, clack, clack. The wooden sheep speeds up on her tiptoes. Just one more step, one more step...

speaker: Blue Soldier A
content: Oi!
The worst-case scenario ends up coming true. The plastic dolls stopped their work, and their three pairs of hollow blue eyes without whites or pupils...
...Turn to look at you!

speaker: Blue Soldier A
content: You are different!

speaker: Blue Soldier B
content: You are not workers yet!

speaker: Blue Soldier C
content: No slacking off! Punish them! Punish them!

speaker: Eve
content: I almost forgot, I need to prepare a birthday gift for Bone.

speaker: Eve
content: I wonder... what's a puppy's favorite...

speaker: Eve
content: Looks like I need to make a trip to the warehouse.

The girl places a tinplate puppy, a doll, and a nesting doll from her arms onto the desk in order, then turns her wheelchair to leave with no need for assistance from the person next to her. She keeps muttering the words "Bone", "gift", and "birthday"...

speaker: Oliver
content: The workshop seems to be bustling. Should we do something?

speaker: Oliver
content: It looks like the new toys have caused some trouble!
Not replying, the girl approaches the door and gently wipes the dust off the doorknob.

speaker: Oliver
content: E... Eve?

speaker: Eve
content: The birthday party is about to start. Where are Bass and Benna?

speaker: Eve
content: I've told them many times. They don't have to work every day from now on. It's enough to stay by my side.

speaker: Eve
content: Oliver, could you help me get Bass and Benna?

speaker: Pepper
content: Chief! They're catching up! Ahhh!

speaker: Pepper
content: So... so many people... No, so many toys! Ahhh!
You're running frantically on the conveyor belt as Pepper's body gets heavier and heavier.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't panic. See the entrance of the conveyor belt up ahead? We're getting really close to victory.

speaker: Pepper
content: But I... I feel like... I can't run anymore...

speaker: Pepper
content: The brilliant Pepper has a new idea! How about I distract the plastic dolls behind us, and then you can...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't even think about it!
It's true, the toyification is getting worse over time. Your movements are noticeably clumsier, and you can even feel the cotton lurching inside your body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We're almost there! We can both get out, and there must be a way once we're out!
