The pursuers behind you are getting closer and closer, and finally... just before they reach you, you and Pepper jump into the pitch-black entrance of the conveyor belt.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pepper? Are you okay?
No response?
It's a musty darkness inside, and you don't sense any sign of Pepper.
Given her character, whether she managed to escape or not, she wouldn't remain silent. Something's off.
You continue to take two steps forward, but bump your head into an unexpected plastic column.
Are you looking for that sheep?
The speaker sounds coherent, unlike the plastic people outside who have completely lost their self-awareness.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you also a human who's trapped here and got turned into a toy?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Have you seen a blackface sheep?

speaker: Bass
content: Yes, she didn't want to play with Bass, so she's out! I threw her out! Bass, strong!

speaker: Bass
content: Are you also ditching Bass to play with other friends?
Communication seems difficult. The cold and rough plastic toy pats the back of your cotton head in a half-threatening, half-curious fashion.
The speaker seems to be acting strange. When you can't tell someone's intention, there's only ever one right choice...

Without looking back, you run desperately into the depths of the darkness, your cotton body almost rolling on the conveyor belt. As you roll, you still catch a glimpse of the real face of the shadow behind you. A yellow screaming chicken swinging its flexible neck and chasing after you relentlessly.

speaker: Bass
content: Another person who despises Bass! You meanie!

speaker: Bass
content: Bass is smart and strong! Bass protects everyone! Makes everyone happy!

speaker: Bass
content: Why don't you want to be friends with Bass?

speaker: Bass
content: <color=#fb9259><size=50>Why!!!</size></color>

Fighting with this body is not easy. The shackles are much less responsive than usual. The cotton in your head has slid to your belly, and the frantic running has severely worn out the fabric under your feet.

The toy before you looks even more miserable though. The screaming chicken, who calls itself Bass, is now contorted and deformed after the fight. Its neck is almost folded and drooping, but its protruding eyes are still glaring at you indignantly.

speaker: Bass
content: Haha, dummy, you'll be outta here if you keep going that way! Just like that sheep! Dummy! Only dummies want to get out!

speaker: Bass
content: Hahahaha! That's why you two are friends! Meanie friends!

speaker: Bass
content: Never! Disturb! <color=#fb9259>Eve</color>!

speaker: Bass
content: Bass will get rid of the meanies!
Bass the screaming chicken lets out its final scream, as twisted and sharp as blackboard-scratching nails. Fortunately, it finally faints.

The dull and high-pitched voice makes you instinctively anxious. How is Pepper now? Who exactly is this "Eve" mentioned by the screaming chicken... But you don't have time for that now. A faint glow is coming from the depths of the darkness, where the exit and your companion lie ahead.
Just as you continue moving forward, you hear an unfamiliar childish voice above you.
I'd advise against that.
What kind of expression is that? Don't get me wrong, I've already passed the stage of wanting to be a human being. I don't need your pity.
Before you can decide whether to turn around, a hand reaches down from above, the shadow of the arm almost blocking the dim overhead light. A human arm!

speaker: Bass
content: Cluck——!
All of a sudden, that hand snatched away the screaming chicken before you almost violently.
Here to look for Bass? Before you let out a sigh of relief, the child speaks again.
If you run away like that like your friend did, all you'll find is death! Oliver will be sad to see that.

speaker: Oliver
content: About the factory, the rumors, and my "kind sister" <color=#fb9259>Eve</color>... I can tell you everything you want to know!

speaker: Oliver
content: Let's help each other out, you and Oliver!
Not given a chance to think or defend yourself, someone yanks you in the pitch darkness!
The dim overhead light illuminates the face of the person in front of you, the seemingly innocent smile covered by an ominous shadow.

speaker: Oliver
content: Oh, why are you ignoring me? Haven't you noticed yet?

speaker: Oliver
content: Your friend has already turned into a real, motionless toy!
You hold your breath in the darkness, the shackles probing in the sea of your consciousness...
The shackles' link between you and Pepper... is broken?!
Pepper's whereabouts are unknown and even your connection is lost. This child must know something...
You continue feeling the unresponsive shackles inside your body, while collapsing into Oliver's palm as a sightless doll, buying yourself some time to think.

speaker: Oliver
content: Why won't you answer me? That's not right, the toys in Eve's factory are supposed to be alive~

speaker: Oliver
content: Could I have made a mistake? Ah, what a pity... I guess I'll have to throw you into the shredder~
The kid named Oliver ravages the silenced screaming chicken in hand, and with a sense of superiority, Oliver picks you up and heads toward the shredder.
You suddenly move and grab Oliver's hand, but Oliver doesn't seem surprised.

speaker: Oliver
content: Ah, you're finally talking to Oliver! I thought you didn't like me...

Oliver's clearly provoking you on purpose, but is now acting all innocent... You too put on your best naive expression, tilting your rag doll head and forcing a cute voice that Hella would surely mock...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What did you mean by all I'll find is death if I run away?

speaker: Oliver
content: I meant that, literally. Who says getting out will change you back? It'll only turn you into a motionless, lifeless toy.

speaker: Oliver
content: If you want to find a solution, of course, you have to find the root of everything...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You mean Eve, the name you and Bass have mentioned?

speaker: Oliver
content: That's right! A round of applause!

speaker: Oliver
content: She's the one you're most curious about, the evil villain who turned the factory into this!
Oliver gives your cotton belly a gentle squeeze.

speaker: Oliver
content: You, sir, are just a pitiful passerby who got turned into a toy by accident.
female_content: You, ma'am, are just a pitiful passerby who got turned into a toy by accident.

speaker: Oliver
content: As for this one...
Oliver shakes the screaming chicken in the other hand.

speaker: Oliver
content: He had always been part of the factory. Besides, he's also Eve's most important non-blood-related family member!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's why he was screaming "protect Eve"...

speaker: Oliver
content: And you got it right again! Isn't it very touching? He still thinks about Eve even after being turned into a toy!

speaker: Oliver
content: Even though she's a bad kid who aspires to turn the whole world into toys, not sparing even her own family! Yet she receives so much love!

speaker: Oliver
content: Oliver is so envious of such unyielding familial love that it makes me sick!
Oliver says this with a disdainful and mocking expression.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If everyone here gets turned into a toy by Eve, then why has nothing happened to you, Oliver? And just now you did call her... your sister?

speaker: Oliver
content: Hey, Oliver is being so nice and answering all your questions, but you're still doubting me. You must have mistaken Oliver for a little liar, haven't you?

speaker: Oliver
content: What if I told you that just like you, I was a poor innocent passerby? Would you believe Oliver?

speaker: Oliver
content: That ghost in white named Eve, she somehow just floated in front of me in her wheelchair. Oliver was petrified!

speaker: Oliver
content: She said that only family were allowed in her home, and that her family could only be toys.

speaker: Oliver
content: Oliver was desperate, so I told her I could be her best family member even without turning into a toy... It was a close call.

speaker: Oliver
content: But Oliver only managed to keep a flexible body, I still can't escape from this place... Oliver is so useless...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: White clothes, wheelchair, young girl...

speaker: Scavenger
content: A pale wheelchair-bound girl appearing in various corners of the factory.

speaker: Scavenger
content: Without exception, those who lay eyes on her will all...

speaker: Scavenger
content: Turn! Into! Toys!
At least this kid didn't lie about one thing. Eve. She's the crux of this place, and finding her could mean saving Pepper!
Staying in character as an innocent rag doll, you glance at Bass who's been tormented by Oliver and ask vigilantly...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not telling me so much for nothing, are you? What do you want me to do for you?

speaker: Oliver
content: Hehe, have you seen through Oliver's little plan?

speaker: Oliver
content: Then come on, if you want to save your friend, show me how you defeated Bass just now.

speaker: Oliver
content: It's time to prove your worth as my partner in crime! I can't wait!
Oliver puts you on the ground and steps back while holding Bass.

speaker: Oliver
content: I've seen him with Eve before, but he's even more disgusting in person...

speaker: Oliver
content: They loved and cared about Eve more than anyone else did in the world.

speaker: Oliver
content: But still, they were turned into these things by their closest family... How pitiful...

speaker: Oliver
content: I'm sure you can end this revolting farce quickly, Mr. Rag Doll. I believe in you!
female_content: I'm sure you can end this revolting farce quickly, Miss Rag Doll. I believe in you!

content: Oliver holds Bass up, looking into the darkness with a face full of excitement and anticipation.

speaker: Oliver
content: Come on, Bass, say hello to your family from the past!

speaker: Oliver
content: Let him out, make him tell us how it felt to be turned into a toy by his beloved Eve.
From the darkness, a round object about half an arm in diameter quietly rolls out.
There's a realistic yet lifeless smile on the ball.
Just like Bass, the worn-out ball sits there motionlessly, repeating the same incomprehensible conversation over and over.
Underneath its childish, innocuous appearance, it speaks with a very old and kind voice.

speaker: Ball
content: There... are so many people... Let me see, oh, how come... I don't recognize anyone...

speaker: Ball
content: My memory is getting worse... Are you all here to keep Eve company?

speaker: Ball
content: Good, our little Eve has made some friends out there too, hasn't she...

speaker: Ball
content: She's still young... She should have someone with her...

speaker: Ball
content: Shanna is still young... still so young... I should go back and be with her...
As the ball speaks, its tone is full of warm affection. When it finishes, it closes its eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is this also one of Eve's family members?

speaker: Oliver
content: Yes, you're really lucky! I knew I chose the right person!
Oliver playfully picks up the ball from the ground, knocking it against the screaming chicken.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've proven that I can beat these toys. Can you tell me now? How are we going to work together?
After another battle, your physical condition is getting worse, but you try hard to endure it, determined not to lose your bravado in front of this kid.

speaker: Oliver
content: It's simple, wreak the biggest havoc you can! Destroy everything Eve values the most!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So that Eve can focus on dealing with me, and you'll have a chance to escape?

speaker: Oliver
content: Exactly. Oliver will get out and find some powerful adults to rescue you and your friend. Sounds like a perfect plan?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What if you simply leave and forget about me?

speaker: Oliver
content: Oh well, in that case, you'll just have to... fend for yourself.
Of course you can't trust this little brat!
And you noticed there's an obvious contradiction in this...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're saying destroying Eve's family will enrage her, but it was also you who said that Eve is a freak who'd turn even her own family into toys...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Aren't these two things contradictory?

speaker: Oliver
content: Are you doubting Oliver? But... everything Oliver said is true... Is it because Oliver has been alone and without family since childhood that I can't understand their twisted pleasure?

Tears well up in Oliver's eyes and those hands tighten around you, choking your questions in your throat. This kid can't give you any more clues. You shift your gaze back to Bass and this ball in front of you...

Oliver does indeed want to escape, and you want to find Pepper and make her human again... But strangely enough, you don't feel any resentment from the screaming chicken and the ball for having been turned into toys, only utter kindness and good wishes toward Eve.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Were these toy family members truly forced to be part of this twisted game of house against their will?
Or is there a set of goals and rules in this factory that neither you nor Oliver understands? Why exactly is Eve doing this...

speaker: Oliver
content: Oh, don't get hung up on family and whatnot. Oliver doesn't understand these things. All I know is that you've run into two special toys in a row, and Eve must be very, very angry right now!

speaker: Oliver
content: Our plan is about to succeed... Argh!!!
Before you can see what happened, Oliver has been suddenly struck by an inexplicable force, crashing into a steel pipe in the distance, making a huge noise.
From the depths of the endless corridor, a faint, bone-chilling murmur creeps into your ears.
Guests are not welcome here...
As if out of a toy's instinctive fear of its owner, you feel the fabric all over your body tense involuntarily.
If you can quietly fit into this place, I can pretend you don't exist.
But today is Bone's birthday, it'll be complicated if Bass and Benna are absent.
As the dust gradually settles, the sound of metal wheels rolling over rough concrete nears. Finally, those doll-like ball-jointed legs come into view.
You look up and see a pale girl in a wheelchair. Her gaze is downcast, staring at the screaming chicken and ball defeated by you on the ground.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eve.

speaker: Eve
content: I can't bend over. Do you mind picking up these two toys? They're my very important family.
She is indeed talking to you, but she doesn't look at you once.
The corridor is exceptionally quiet, all sounds seemingly swallowed by the darkness behind Eve.
Even the noise of Oliver scrambling up from the ground behind you is amplified infinitely in this silence.
You pat your recently squashed body, take two steps forward, and pick up the two toys with your cotton palms.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They're important to you? What a coincidence, you also hold something very important to me.
There's no response, but thankfully she doesn't seem infuriated either. You don't sense any obvious hostility. She simply waits for you to bring her the two toys silently.
Holding up a screaming chicken and a ball at the same time is no easy task for a rag doll like you, but you still take the risk and begin negotiating while dragging them behind you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My body, and my friend's body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll give you back your family, and in exchange, you'll give those back to me.
Eve doesn't respond for a long time. The light in the corridor is too dim, or are you imagining it? Her gaze seems to linger on you for a moment at last.

speaker: Eve
content: You and your friend entered my factory and then became toys.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: To be precise, my friend got turned into a toy by you first. I only came to bring her back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We tried leaving through other exits, but Oliver said it wouldn't work. Only you can change us back.

speaker: Eve
content: I can't.
She responds coldly without looking at you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How can that be? You transformed us, you must be able to undo it.

speaker: Eve
content: I... can't.
She repeats stiffly.

speaker: Eve
content: I've warned everyone to stay away. This is my home, I own it.

speaker: Eve
content: How is it my fault when they insisted on barging in...
She lowers her head, her voice a bit muffled, like she's just murmuring to herself.

speaker: Eve
content: I don't know how to change you back. I'm just a useless child who's seen as a burden.

speaker: Eve
content: It took me a long time to come this far, to make this factory feel like home.

speaker: Eve
content: But outsiders like you insist on barging in. And now you even want to take my family away from me, and you even dare to...

speaker: Eve
content: Threaten me?
A familiar power gathers all of a sudden, powerful, overwhelming Mania filling every bit of air in the factory...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I apologize. I didn't mean any harm. Calm down, we can talk it out.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm not trying to threaten you or snoop around. I only came to save my frie... Cough, cough!
The abrupt pressure triggers an involuntary resistance in you. But attacked by the defensive urge and the terrifying force from within and without, you begin coughing and dry heaving.

speaker: Oliver
content: She's speeding up the toyification of everything in Buonanotte! ...Get out of here now, you stupid doll!

speaker: Oliver
content: Stop wasting your time. If she could be persuaded, I wouldn't need your help!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is the toyification... Pepper has told me about... Cough, cough!
Covering your mouth and nose, you catch what you cough up from your body. A clump of blood-stained cotton!

speaker: Eve
content: Are you shocked? But that friend of yours has been going through this all along.

speaker: Eve
content: If she really means that much to you, how could you lose her?

speaker: Eve
content: Shouldn't you cherish your important ones and keep them by your side?
The girl in the wheelchair looks confusedly in an unknown direction, propping up her body feebly.

speaker: Eve
content: He's right... You're all foolish, indifferent, and arrogant intruders.

speaker: Scavenger
content: Do the lives of intruders matter?

speaker: Scavenger
content: As you're going through all of this, does anyone else care? They'll just keep tearing up your wounds to satisfy themselves. But then, who's going to fulfill your tiny wish?
It's only natural that a toy factory is filled with toys...
Then you'll all turn into toys, even if it'll cost you your life!

speaker: Eve
content: All of you will... turn into toys!
Suddenly, Eve turns to you, her pupils seemed to glow with a faintly frightening light. A single glance makes you feel like you're tumbling into an icy cellar.

speaker: Oliver
content: Watch out!!
As Oliver cries out, the visible Mania miasma gathers around Eve.
Out of combative instinct, you reach and grasp the closest and biggest weakness of the enemy.

speaker: Oliver
content: Hey... Don't touch Eve's prosthetic. She'll get mad!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I've already touched it.

speaker: Eve
content: Just die...
Eve's fingers have almost etched into the wheelchair. As her breathing quickens, the force pressing on you also intensifies.

As if falling into deep water, you can't breathe or make a sound for almost a whole minute. You seem to sense in that filthy power a determination to obliterate everything at the cost of self-destruction!
Eve's face is getting paler, her body weaker, but you can't take advantage of it at all. The cotton inside your body starts churning violently, ready to explode if you so much as breathe.
Pepper is nowhere to be found. You can't just give up here like this... There's no other way...
In an instant, crimson light collides with the surging black fume, exploding with a massive blast of energy.
Your senses are overwhelmed by the white light and the ringing in your ears...
Benna, do you think he can get Eve out?
female_content: Benna, do you think she can get Eve out?

content: I don't know... but he's a good kid. Eve was too hard on him.
female_content: I don't know... but she's a good kid. Eve was too hard on her.

content: Poor Eve! She's straining herself! Bass don't want Eve suffer anymore!
It was so hard to take him away under Eve's watch. Let him see that!
female_content: It was so hard to take her away under Eve's watch. Let her see that!

content: See... what?
How could you forget again, Benna, you dummy! Our story with Eve, of course!
Oh, that's right. My memory does worsen day by day...
Right, right, show him. He will surely understand.
female_content: Right, right, show her. She will surely understand.

content: This person can surely... get Eve out.

speaker: EMP
content: But will Eve be upset if she finds out?
She won't blame us.
Eve is a good girl, just like my granddaughter Shanna. This... I will never forget.
Outside the factory, the wooden sheep lies on its back. All of its perceptions stopped the moment before she left the factory.
She has been lying there for god knows how long, until the ground beneath her begins to loosen. A crudely constructed mechanical claw emerges from the ground, pulling the little sheep down.
Hey, is this a toy from the factory? How did it run out on its own?
There seems to have been a significant tremor just now. I found an opening. Let's go in together...
The location of the opening is roughly... let me see... here!
You don't know how long you've been unconscious, but for now, your body no longer feels the tearing pain. The cotton stays peacefully inside your body.
Amidst the dizziness, a lot of information floods into your cotton head. About the screaming chicken, the rubber ball, Eve, and Buonanotte Factory.
What's even stranger is that you feel a peculiar throbbing again from the other end of the shackles. The wooden sheep, which should have been disconnected, has re-entered your perception.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Pepper?

speaker: Oliver
content: You finally woke up? Oliver has been by your side all along, yet you were calling out someone else's name? Oliver is so sad...
There's no sign of Pepper. The unfamiliar room is warm and tidy, a stark contrast to the rundown factory outside.
Oliver, slightly injured, is sitting on the floor, fiddling with the screaming chicken and rubber ball while mumbling complaints.

speaker: Oliver
content: I told you, Eve is an unreasonable monster. But you insisted on getting close to her.

speaker: Oliver
content: "We can talk it out..." blah, blah, blah...

speaker: Oliver
content: Look at yourself now. So badly injured, and ending up in this weird place. Oliver's plan is going to fall apart...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why are you here, too?

speaker: Oliver
content: Huh? I thought you pulled me in?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No...
Though you are unsure where this is, you can feel through the neat furnishings, soft lights, and comfortable temperature that this is a different dimension from the factory you've been in.
Your attention falls on the two toys in Oliver's hand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They also showed me some memories between them and Eve. The Eve in those memories seems different from the one we met... Something must have happened in between.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You were also brought here. Didn't you see those?

speaker: Oliver
content: Hmm?... No, Oliver didn't see anything.

speaker: Oliver
content: All I see is that the hope of escaping is gone. Oliver will have to be locked up here forever with you, and turned into a toy...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You really didn't see anything? Those seemed to be the memories these toys had with Eve.

speaker: Oliver
content: What good are memories? Oliver is dumb and doesn't understand. Oliver only knows that you are now ragged and can't do anything.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No... those memories are important.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They are warm, happy, and joyful, completely different from the atmosphere of this factory.
You cover the overflowing cotton from your wound, endure the pain, and stand up to look around this unfamiliar space.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You have always assumed that Eve created this place with malicious intent. At first, I thought so too, considering the atmosphere of the factory is far from "beautiful."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But maybe we are both wrong. The factory looks weird and scary, but this may not be Eve's intention.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There must be many truths we haven't discovered yet.
Dreams, statues, illusions, games, the space-time constructed by Mania... You've experienced a lot. Undoubtedly, the creator's greatest wish must be the key to unravel all the predicaments.
The cotton inside your body is still restless, and the toyification continues. But thankfully, you feel Pepper's vitality again, and everything about this place is gradually becoming clear.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Oliver, it's not over yet. Before I completely turn into a toy, there's still a lot we can do.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I have decided to work with you, but with a slightly different plan.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now, listen to me.

speaker: Oliver
content: So you're saying, if we find more toy family members like these ones, we can find a way to restore this place faster?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. Not to attract Eve's attention, but to get more information. After piecing together these bits and pieces of info, we will surely get closer to the truth of this factory.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The reason why Eve doesn't want to stop the toyification is not clear yet, but she's right about one thing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pepper is my friend, it's up to me to figure out how to save her.

speaker: Oliver
content: So we still have to watch their warm and beautiful memories?
Oliver's tone is clearly full of disgust and resistance.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Didn't you just say you didn't see anything?

speaker: Oliver
content: Ah... I, I just worry, worry that if you see too many warm memories, you will sympathize and can't bear to deal with them...

speaker: Oliver
content: By then, if you turn against us, Oliver will really be alone... Eve is so scary. I don't want to meet her on my own!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry, she won't come here anytime soon. Though the blow of the shackles didn't directly hurt her just now, it should have caused a great impact.
Oliver seems to want to argue, but upon looking in your direction, turns pale with fright.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's wrong? Did I speak of the devil? Eve isn't here, is she?

speaker: Oliver
content: No... it's not Eve...

speaker: Oliver
content: Don't turn around, doll. Whatever you do, don't turn around.

speaker: Oliver
content: Some toys are not suitable for kids.
Seeing that you still don't understand, Oliver points behind you.
Before you can turn around, a big bloody mouth suddenly zooms out from behind. A row of sharp teeth fiercely pierces into your arm and tears it back forcefully.
Amidst the numbing sting, you clearly hear the sound of seams breaking at your arm!

speaker: Eve
content: No, don't... don't take them away...
Eve, trembling with pain all over, curls up in her wheelchair. The sharp spikes of the shackles did not directly harm her, but the burden of another force made her fall into a coma.
A sinister black aura surrounds Eve, whispering chaotic murmurs that outsiders can't understand. It repeatedly tempts the girl in the wheelchair, dragging her deeper into the nightmare.

speaker: Eve
content: Bone, Bone... we haven't... lit the birthday candles yet...

speaker: Eve
content: Why did you all leave again... You all left...

speaker: Eve
content: It's the grey rag doll that snatched you away!

speaker: Eve
content: I won't lose to him... I won't let him destroy our home again... Hurry up and turn into a quiet toy.
female_content: I won't lose to her... I won't let her destroy our home again... Hurry up and turn into a quiet toy.

speaker: Eve
content: No one will disturb us. We'll be just like before...
Eve opens her eyes, but there's no light in her pupils. Her consciousness is still wandering in nothingness, unaware of the long shadows cast by the two toys beside her.
I've brought Eve back. She's tired.
Yes... let's... do something for her...
The two toys look at the half-asleep Eve, sigh softly, and retreat outside the door.
With a "clack," they lock Eve inside the room.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cough, cough, cough!
You've managed to save your arm, but more and more cotton is spewing out from your body. You try to stuff it back in vain. The toyification is still going.
This is what one has to go through to become a toy. Pepper spent more than a day here alone, enduring all this... Fortunately, your link with her is still there. There's still a chance.

speaker: Bone
content: Woof, woof...

speaker: Bone
content: Woof...
Before your eyes, the defeated puppy lies in the dust, repeating its monotonous barks.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is it really a puppy? Why does it keep repeating...

speaker: Oliver
content: It was the same with the screaming chicken and that ball.

speaker: Oliver
content: Is this also Eve's personal hobby?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Or perhaps it's some kind of obsession, an emotion so strong that it can't be let go, even when turned into a toy...
You tentatively move closer to the tinplate dog on the ground. Seeing that it truly lost consciousness and is no longer resisting, you place your hand on it.
The red spikes penetrate the tinplate, spreading inside this shell to explore.
But where the shackles pass... you don't feel anything.
Under the tinplate, there's a hollow void.

speaker: Oliver
content: Did you discover anything?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No... it's just a toy dog. There are no signs of life inside its body.

But you clearly remember, when you used the shackles to probe the wooden sheep that Pepper turned into, you could clearly feel Pepper's presence inside the wooden body. Are they different from Pepper? Different...
You want to lean in again to feel the puppy, but Oliver pulls you back.

speaker: Oliver
content: You'd rather touch the puppy again than care about Oliver?

speaker: Oliver
content: Listen, there's a terrifying noise and it's getting closer, right behind Oliver...

Your senses are becoming more numb. You withdraw the hand reaching out to the tinplate puppy. With Oliver's guidance, you hear the approaching frail and unfamiliar female voice, accompanied by blurred, echoing sighs.
Found you.
Go. Go. Go.
Help Eve.

speaker: Oliver
content: Ahhhh, it's coming...
You and Oliver squeeze into a small tinplate cabinet, so nervous that you can hear each other's heartbeat and breaths.

You're getting weaker and weaker, and gradually losing control of your cotton body. You can only leave the task of detecting enemies to Oliver, and lean against the cold inner wall of the cabinet to support your body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is it a new toy? ...Or is it Eve?

speaker: Oliver
content: Not sure. I can't see what it looks like from above. But Oliver thinks she's probably not something that would be happy to see us.
Tiptoeing, Oliver peeps out from the crack of the storage cabinet. All that can be seen is an empty corridor.
Clang, clang, clang!
Suddenly there's a banging noise outside the tinplate cabinet, and you both immediately hold your breaths.
You see a tuft of blue-green hair sliding through the crack of the cabinet door. The hair rustles as it gropes on the cabinet door, gradually wrapping around the handle.
The space to move inside the cabinet is very limited. You have no place to hide. All you can do is watch as the hair grabs the edge of the cabinet door.
"Screech..." The rusty friction makes a hair-raising noise.
The door opens. You see a long-haired doll facing away from you.

speaker: Oliver
content: A doll just like you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Shh... Let me try something.
You look at the doll before you, who is about your size. You avoid her eerie strands of hair, ready your shackles, and reach out...

speaker: Oliver
content: Do you need help? You're already in tatters. You might fall apart if you're not careful.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No need. There's something I want to confirm. The puppy just now seemed a bit strange...
——!!! The doll's head suddenly turns around.
Found you.
I want to help Eve. I found you. I want you to leave.

speaker: Doll
content: Ahhhhhh——!!!
Bone-shattering pain makes the doll let out a heart-wrenching scream...

speaker: Doll
content: Eve! Has gone through a lot!

speaker: Doll
content: You... leave! Take her with you! Take her away! Please!

speaker: Doll
content: Run! Jump! Stand up! Get out!

speaker: Doll
content: A new life!

speaker: Doll
content: A bigger, better world!
This battle has exhausted almost all your strength. Your body is weak and fuzzy, and you can no longer stand up. You can only lie on the ground with the doll, staring at each other.
She seems to have a lot to say to you, but in the end, everything stops at this moment.
As Oliver guessed, if you use your strength again, you will really fall apart. All the cotton in your body has worn out, but an important fragment is right in front of you.
You still decide to crawl towards the doll and reach out...
The spikes of shackles penetrate her plastic body, with the same result as before.
Apart from the intense energy of Mania, there's nothing inside this body. This is just an ordinary doll that has been given personality and will by someone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Oliver, I remember you said that Eve's family members are the most special toys here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now I get it. If Pepper and I are humans who got turned into toys, then they are toys who got turned into "humans."

speaker: Oliver
content: Huh? Has your head gone bad, too? Why are you speaking in tongue twisters?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eve's goal has never been to turn people into toys.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: From the very beginning, all she wanted was to make the toys in this factory come alive.

speaker: Oliver
content: Come alive to act in a corny family soap opera with Eve?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Perhaps you're right this time... These weird toys pretending to have identities... It's all just make-believe. A game of playing house.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Her original goal is indeed to "get the toys to play house with her." As for what others will become when they come here, she doesn't care... Cough, cough, cough.

speaker: Oliver
content: Oh... I get it now. So, you're saying they're not like you? That these toy family members are actually dead? That they don't exist?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The horror, the scares, the macabre... These were never Eve's intention. It's just that this is the best she could do.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is reality, not a mirage. The effects of her powers are ultimately limited. It's impossible to restore the real happiness and warmth.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: After all, these toy family members no longer have life.
After listening to your wise and calm analysis, Oliver does not try to be flattering like before, but leans by your ear and whispers...

speaker: Oliver
content: You know, you're going to be just like them soon...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What... cough, cough, cough!
More and more blood-red cotton gushes from your throat. Along with your last bit of strength, they are spewed out of your body.
Your vision starts to blur. In the dim light, you squint and look up to see an indifferent "I-told-you-so" sneer on Oliver's face.

speaker: Eve
content: Open the door! Let me out! Polly! Maresa! Are you outside?
The girl at the door irritably twists the door lock, her wheelchair hitting the door panel again and again.

speaker: Eve
content: Another one has been taken away... That new doll wants to destroy everything! I must not let him succeed!
female_content: Another one has been taken away... That new doll wants to destroy everything! I must not let her succeed!

content: The eerie dark mist spreads around Eve and thickens in the room.
The girl suddenly stops and weakly looks back.
Her listless gaze crosses the contaminated dark mist. She looks at the photos and toy designs on the wall, smiles, grits her teeth, musters all her strength, and...
...blasts open the door.
Oliver coldly watches as you attempt to get up a few times without any intention of helping.

speaker: Oliver
content: What did you say your plan was just now?

speaker: Oliver
content: Collect all the toys to make everything normal again? Save your friend with your own power? Hahahahahaha...

speaker: Oliver
content: How can a tattered rag doll brag so shamelessly?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Oliver?

The little tyke before you feels like a stranger now. Even though Oliver had been using and deceiving you from the start, your goals had always been the same. This is the first time you see such blatant rebellion from the kid.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you leaving?
Your muffled voice leaks from your cotton lips, eliciting a predictable sneer in response.

speaker: Oliver
content: I thought so highly of you, yet you ended up like this... Ah, adults really can't be relied on!

speaker: Oliver
content: In the end, it all depends on Oliver!
Special threads made of Mania power shoot out from Oliver's palm and mockingly poke your ragged body. Oliver then stands up and stretches lazily.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're... a Sinner?

speaker: Oliver
content: Yup. Even though I look like a cute kid, I do have special powers. I just don't want to get hurt, so I prefer to use other ways.
Pleased by the successful cover-up, Oliver eagerly awaits your flattery and pleas for mercy. Unfortunately, you just don't know how to be "spineless"...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mania powers stem from emotional and mental strength. Eve and her family are always there for each other. Even if they've become toys, they still want to protect Eve. But you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You want to abandon me the moment you think I'm of no use to you. You think you have the willpower to win against them?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You saw the memories in that room, didn't you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you refuse to admit... that your selfishness and cunning can't defeat the power of this family bond... Ugh!!
Threads of Mania tightly bind your mouth. Oliver leans in, forcing an impatient smile.

speaker: Oliver
content: You must be tired from all that talking. Let Oliver help you save your energy to deal with the upcoming enemy. Isn't Oliver thoughtful?

speaker: Oliver
content: No need to thank me. This is what I should do as a good kid...
The kid casually pokes your cotton body again in revenge, then skips off and disappears into the shadows at the end of the corridor.
Only you, with your mouth bound, and a doll that has lost consciousness, are left in place.

Oliver's footsteps echo further and further into the distance until they can't be heard anymore. Dead silence blankets the empty space. Apart from the occasional breath leaking from your cotton mouth, there is nothing to break the silence.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm, mmm mmm mmm mmm... (Kids these days... they really have no patience...)

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm, mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm... (Once everything is over, I'll bring Oliver back to the MBCC for some proper education...)

Your consciousness is somewhat blurred. The scene in front of you is twisting and spinning, but lying here won't solve anything. Your willpower helps you regain a bit of control over your limbs. You drag the doll and crawl along the dusty floor.
Things aren't as bad as they seem. You can still move, and still sense your shackles... Even if Oliver has run off, you are not far off from gathering all the toy family members.
"Thud, thud."
You hear the sound of wood hitting the ground, and start to head in that direction.
"Thud, thud, thud."
Finally, a red nesting doll appears close by.
"Have you seen a wooden sheep with a black face?" "What other stories does this factory have?" You want to ask loudly but can't open your mouth.
"Thud thud thud thud thud thud."
The sound gets more and more intense. You even feel the floor trembling.
Though your physical condition is terrible, you are sure that what you hear and see in front of you is not an illusion. Hundreds of nesting dolls are rushing towards you.

As they approach you, they continue to crack open, spitting out other nesting dolls from their bodies. The dense sea of red nesting dolls spread and reproduce infinitely, covering your entire vision like a locust tide...
Oliver didn't actually get far before stopped in place, and the celebratory grin on the kid's face after shaking off the tiredness was nowhere to be seen.
Where to go next? Go straight to find Eve? She must be very weak now... Or wait for the rag doll to create a miracle? Then escape amidst the chaos?
Good.
It's not out of guilt or regret. That doll is too desperate to save his companion. Following him will not end well.
female_content: It's not out of guilt or regret. That doll is too desperate to save her companion. Following her will not end well.

content: But the doll's last words almost threw Oliver off balance... If it weren't for the speedy escape, Oliver would have been caught out.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Eve and her family are always there for each other. Even if they've become toys, they still want to protect Eve. But you..."
Is Oliver... just a selfish and cunning bad egg?
Oliver didn't have a chance to figure it out. The warning of "you can't defeat Eve" was fulfilled too quickly.
In the darkness, several toy hoses fly out. They tie Oliver's limbs and suspend the kid in mid-air, leaving dozens of marks on the kid's wrists and ankles.
Oliver's good sis Eve, enveloped in an unfamiliar black aura, slowly emerges from the dark corridor...

speaker: Eve
content: Are you alone? Where's the doll that was with you?

At night, it's colder inside the factory than outside by the Rust. The kid's voice is trembling instinctively. The Eve before Oliver almost seems like a stranger, appearing more like a doll than a person. It takes Oliver a long time to regain composure and put on the usual air of arrogance.

speaker: Oliver
content: That doll, he's unreliable. He's not obedient at all. Oliver doesn't want him anymore.
female_content: That doll, she's unreliable. She's not obedient at all. Oliver doesn't want her anymore.

content: A hose tightens around Oliver's throat. The contaminated miasma swirls around Eve's ear, seemingly whispering something to her. Eve shakes her head and sighs.

speaker: Eve
content: Oliver... do you remember why you were kept here in the first place?

speaker: Oliver
content: Because these toys could no longer satisfy your twisted tastes? Ugh!!!

speaker: Eve
content: No, no... because you and I are the same.
Eve shows no emotional fluctuations. She still sits in her wheelchair, watching coldly, unscathed.

speaker: Oliver
content: How so? Because we're both Sinners?

speaker: Eve
content: Sinners? I don't care about that...
Her frail fingers easily snap the Mania thread in her hand.

speaker: Eve
content: Haven't you realized it yet, Oliver... we're the same because we were both abandoned.

speaker: Eve
content: No one to depend on. Nowhere to belong.

speaker: Eve
content: I made a home and kindly shared it with you, but you don't seem to need it.

speaker: Eve
content: Indeed, you don't know how lovely it is to have a home, how wonderful it is to have a family.

speaker: Eve
content: Because you've never had them... You only have yourself. It was like that before and it's the same now.

speaker: Oliver
content: Bah!!!
Oliver spits out a mouthful of bloody saliva.

speaker: Oliver
content: Keep those good things for yourself, then! Everything will disappear in the end anyways! Ugh!!!
The plastic hose suddenly tightens. Oliver hears the crisp sound of a wrist bone breaking.
Oliver gave a retort instinctively, but all that occupies the kid's mind right now are the rag doll's words: "You can't win against Eve".
A black aura of grief and numbness swirls around Eve. This Eve is nothing like the one Oliver knew.

speaker: Eve
content: You know... when you passed by here saying you wanted to be taken in, I thought, Maresa would definitely be happy.

speaker: Eve
content: She lost her own child, so she always gave her love to children your age.

speaker: Eve
content: If she were still here, maybe you really could have joined this family. She would have treated you like her own child.

speaker: Oliver
content: But she's not here... Eve is just sleep talking...

speaker: Eve
content: I know... so I can't let anyone destroy this dream. Once we wake up, there will be nothing left...

speaker: Eve
content: Tell me, where is the doll in the grey clothes?
Oliver gathers the courage to look directly into Eve's cold eyes, and with the last bit of strength, the kid tells a final lie.

speaker: Oliver
content: I... don't... know...
Thud! There's no sign of Oliver in the corridor anymore. What lands on the ground with a thud is a unicorn doll.

speaker: Eve
content: Is that so... then you're of no use to me.
The wheelchair rolls over the doll.

speaker: Eve
content: Poor thing... a child who has never had a home, won't understand this place.
The wheelchair leaves the doll and heads towards the warehouse.

speaker: Oliver
content: Haha... home, huh...
Oliver still seems to have a sliver of consciousness. The unicorn doll seems to be sobbing in the dust. Or perhaps it's twitching in the direction of Chief, seeking help.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mmm...
You can't speak, and everything in front of you is pitch black. It seems you've passed out again. You're almost out of strength...
The clatter of nesting dolls hitting the ground seems to have stopped. Have you won?
In your daze, you feel a human hand picking you up, fiddling with some strange tool on your body, and even untying the thread that binds your mouth.
Is this person helping you? The wounds on your body seem to have been patched up, greatly relieving your pain.
It doesn't seem to be a dream. You've regained some strength, and try to open your eyes...

speaker: Pepper
content: Chief, you're awake!

speaker: Pepper
content: Sob... I've missed you so much!!!
The big face of a blonde girl zooms into view, rubbing against you several times.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pe... Pepper?
Her eyes are filled with tears as she nods and hands you over to a stranger.

speaker: Pepper
content: By the way, I brought a new friend for you! This is Eureka! She's an inventor!
Unlike Oliver, Eureka doesn't try to hide her Sinner identity. You see various strange devices on her, all made with the help of her power.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Was it you who fixed me just now?

speaker: Pepper
content: And helped Pepper change back, too!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Amazing! We've been wandering around here for half a day and couldn't find a solution. Gotta leave it to an inventor!
Eureka is a bit taken off guard by the sudden praise.

speaker: Eureka
content: No, no... I didn't do much... This place is actually already very fragile, like a wafer biscuit.

speaker: Pepper
content: Huh? Fragile?
Eureka nods. She finds a simple way to explain and continues.

speaker: Eureka
content: Do you remember how you got your human body back?

speaker: Pepper
content: I remember! This factory seemed to break down for a moment!

speaker: Eureka
content: Yes. The person who turns everyone into toys... her power is very unstable. I don't know if Chief did something, but that person is very tired right now.

speaker: Pepper
content: Wow! Even without Pepper, Chief caused such a big impact. As expected of Chief!

speaker: Eureka
content: I squeezed you in with me when that temporary breakdown happened, and exploited the loophole to turn human.

speaker: Eureka
content: So it should be easy to turn rag doll Chief back into human form as well.

speaker: Pepper
content: I get it! We just need another momentary breakdown!

speaker: Eureka
content: But... how do we do that?
Two pairs of eyes gaze at you earnestly. Your small rag doll body bears heavy expectations.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Perhaps, on your way here, you've encountered some very special toys?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They aren't like Pepper or myself, who got turned into toys unexpectedly. They were toys from the start, who got bestowed personalities, memories, and abilities by Eve, the owner of this factory...
Before you finish your sentence, your attention is drawn to the nesting doll in the dark corner. Isn't this the one you just knocked over?
She has been lying alone at the bottom of the bed where no one cared, chanting something over and over again.
You signal Pepper and Eureka to keep it down, and quietly approach the nesting doll.

speaker: Nesting Doll
content: Child... child...

speaker: Nesting Doll
content: Where's Eve? Did she go out? Did she help me find my child?
The nesting doll has lost her instinct to attack, and is mechanically expressing the identity and memories that Eve bestowed upon her...

speaker: Nesting Doll
content: I turned around to buy some candy, and he was gone the next second!

speaker: Nesting Doll
content: He was so young... so little... where could he have gone?

speaker: Nesting Doll
content: Should I have not gone... to buy him candy?

speaker: Nesting Doll
content: He should be twelve or thirteen by now, right? Was he sold to a gang... Will he resent me?

speaker: Pepper
content: What is this doll talking about?

speaker: Eureka
content: I don't know, but it must be something very important.

speaker: Eureka
content: Pepper held out till now thanks to her strong desire of finding the Chief.

speaker: Eureka
content: This nesting doll must also be supported by some strong wish.

speaker: Eureka
content: The Chief you mentioned is the same. I just did a simple repair on him, and I could feel it.
female_content: The Chief you mentioned is the same. I just did a simple repair on her, and I could feel it.

content: Pepper seems to realize something interesting and looks at you, who is still holding out.

speaker: Pepper
content: Does Chief also have a strong wish? What is it?

options: Finding a way to save you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You jumped into the conveyor belt exit and completely lost connection the next second. I almost thought you got made into Pepper lamb kebabs...
Pepper lets out a muffled laugh and scratches her head bashfully...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eureka, you just mentioned that what spurs the toys to move is the power of their wishes. This power is getting weaker and weaker, and we could try to trigger a breakdown again, right?

speaker: Eureka
content: Right. Is there a problem?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like I just said, the toy family members are special. They are toys that were originally lifeless. How can they have wishes of their own?

speaker: Eureka
content: Is that so? Perhaps I'm mistaken...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, your conjecture is correct. But what supports them is the wish of their maker, Eve.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But... if that's the case, what I've done to Eve shouldn't be able to shake her wish. There must be another reason as to why her power is unstable...
As you instinctively remember the symbol from the Underground, Eureka suddenly shouts out loud...

speaker: Eureka
content: Eureka! I got it!

speaker: Pepper
content: Huh? What did you realize?

speaker: Eureka
content: The secret behind the unstable power!

speaker: Eureka
content: Sometimes this happens when I'm inventing little gadgets.

speaker: Eureka
content: When I really, really want to make it... When my will is strong enough... it's like there's a force helping me.

speaker: Eureka
content: Those seemingly impossible experiments all succeeded in the end.
Eureka puts on her homemade roller shoes and runs around the factory with you in her arms, telling you about her discoveries. Pepper trails behind mindlessly.

speaker: Eureka
content: Many times, the successes couldn't be explained scientifically... I later chalked them up to... hmm, there's a saying... what was it...

speaker: Pepper
content: Where there's a will, there's a way!

speaker: Eureka
content: Oh? That sounds about right!

speaker: Eureka
content: Mind over matter, to put it simply.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Especially for Sinners, a strong willpower can directly beget special powers...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Makes sense. Please continue.

speaker: Eureka
content: Yep. I've met all kinds of toys along the way. But when I met that nesting doll, I realized, she is the most meticulously designed toy of all.

speaker: Eureka
content: Being "meticulous" is kind of a "power" in itself.

speaker: Pepper
content: The more meticulous, the stronger?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eve was most meticulous about the toy family members, so they carry her deepest wish...

speaker: Eureka
content: That's not all!

speaker: Pepper
content: Huh, there's more to it?

speaker: Eureka
content: Compared to that, those little toys might not count for much.
She gasps for breath, pushing open a half-closed door at the end of the hallway...

speaker: Eureka
content: What Eve is most meticulous about, and what carries her deepest wish, is much more dramatic than this!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What is this place?

speaker: Pepper
content: Oh, we stumbled upon this place by accident before!

speaker: Eureka
content: The factory boss's office.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then the power she used to blanket this place and create the toy world is...
You quickly understand what Eureka means. The power that consumes even herself to bring toys to life...

speaker: Eureka
content: It's an ultra sincere and passionate wish that I don't even dare to think about.

speaker: Eureka
content: We've actually always been inside her creation!

speaker: Eureka
content: This entire factory is her creation!
The tranquil moonlight illuminates the humdrum office and the factory blueprint on the desk.

speaker: Pepper
content: Has she been relying on her intense wish to support the toyification of the entire factory?! This place is huge! No wonder she's exhausted.

speaker: Eureka
content: Right, so she must be extremely weak right now! The way to make this place normal again is simple.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Have another fight and drain her of her power. If she doesn't have the energy to keep transforming this place, the toyification will stop. Then we can all...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Cough, cough, cough, cough!

speaker: Pepper
content: Chief!

speaker: Eureka
content: Why is Chief coming apart again? I clearly just patched things up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Good news...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We don't need to act. Eve might not be able to hold on much longer.
You watch as the cotton on your body rots and splits. Your body is recovering and reorganizing in a strange way.
Your consciousness becomes hazy, but only for a moment. You quickly come back to your senses.
You find that you have turned back to normal.

speaker: Pepper
content: Chief, you're really impressive! You've beaten the enemy even without Pepper!
Pepper runs excitedly around your now normal body, gasping in awe.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Weren't you listening just now? It's not that I've defeated her, it's just that the factory is too much for Eve to handle.
Is this really the whole story? Was your guess really wrong? Does Eve's weakness really have nothing to do with the Underground?
You pat your firm, human-sized body, somewhat disbelieving at how smoothly everything is going.
Before you have time to think or celebrate your return to normalcy, a sudden commotion interrupts your thoughts.

speaker: Chaotic Crowd
content: I've turned back! I've turned back to normal!

speaker: Chaotic Crowd
content: Where am I? What year is it now?

speaker: Eureka
content: The commotion is coming from the workshop.

speaker: Pepper
content: What does this mean? We can leave now?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The factory's toyification stopped and reversed just like that? But we haven't done anything... Something's not right.
Based on the information you have now, Eve can't possibly have given up her wish... Oliver? No, that kid couldn't have done it either.
The power won't disappear for no reason... it will simply reappear in another form. Your ominous guess is immediately confirmed. A new type of commotion is erupting from all corners of the factory...

speaker: Chaotic Crowd
content: The door won't open! We're trapped!

speaker: Chaotic Crowd
content: Monster! There's some monster in the depot! Let us out!
Eve is mechanically moving between the shelves of the warehouse, numb and cold, like a real doll.

speaker: Eve
content: This is my home, my family, all that I cherish... It can't be destroyed again...
<color=#dg1f1f>You're right! No one is allowed to do that!</color>
The black Mania mist whips up all the fallen toys and spirals upward around Eve. But she seems to have lost consciousness, and is repeating coldly over and over again...

speaker: Eve
content: You'll help me, won't you...
<color=#dg1f1f>Of course! Give me your sorrow... and I'll give you power! Power that no one can stop! Give me... give me...</color>

The contamination spreads along her ankles, hair, and limbs. The toys infused with contamination gradually lose control as the black mist surges and spreads. More and more toys in the warehouse are moving towards Eve, devouring her bit by bit.
More and more toys are getting their bodies back. Their panicked cries for help rise from all corners of the factory. The once silent factory has turned into a boiling furnace of catastrophe.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I finally turned back to normal, and there's new trouble already... Can't you let me recover a bit first...
The screams are only a door away from you. Eureka and Pepper also didn't expect the situation to develop like this. They nervously stand by the door, waiting for your instructions.
Fortunately, having gotten rid of the cotton head, your thoughts are much clearer. You manage to not panic.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: A Mania monster... Your previous guess was not wrong. As expected, the Underground wouldn't randomly target a toy factory. This might be what they're really after.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Pepper, Eureka, you guys protect the people outside.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They are all innocent civilians who had been turned into toys. Don't let any danger come to them.

speaker: Pepper
content: Then where will you go, Chief?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...A new monster is being born. I can't just stand by. I need to go check the warehouse.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: A powerful "wish" that can control a whole factory might bring greater calamity than toyification if used by someone with ulterior motives on a single "monster."
Eureka looks at you, then at Pepper, hesitant to speak.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eureka, you must have thought of something. What is it?

speaker: Eureka
content: ...Getting outsiders to destroy such a powerful "wish"... It's easy to say, but almost impossible to do, right?

speaker: Eureka
content: But actually, there's an opposite choice that's harder to say but easier to do.

speaker: Eureka
content: If the Creator is gone, her wish and creations will all disappear.
She obviously regrets saying such words. She tremblingly pulls out her threaded sword, but her voice is still shaking.

speaker: Eureka
content: At this point, she should almost be at her limit.
The air quiets down. In the closed office, only the trembling threaded sword is making a faint clanging sound.
You understand what Eureka is getting at. Even Pepper understood. If Eve is gone, all the problems will be solved.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There must be another way. Eve... just wants to be with her family.
Family... Family?

speaker: Oliver
content: So you're saying, if we find more toy family members like these ones, we can find a way to restore this place faster?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. Not to attract Eve's attention, but to get more information. After piecing together these bits and pieces of info, we will surely get closer to the truth of this factory.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eureka, Pepper, go protect the people outside. I believe Nightingale will bring reinforcements. You guys keep an eye out for her.

speaker: Eureka
content: You're not really going to destroy the creator of the toy factory, are you?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course not. I have another place to go to.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There, I will find the real answer.
Black Ring, illusions, mirages... You've also been through many opportunities that could be paused at a certain moment.
Now, the story is only missing the last fragment. The dawn is approaching. It's time to wake up from both the sweet dream and the nightmare.

speaker: Eureka
content: Then... Chief, can you help me pass a message to Eve?

speaker: Eureka
content: I saw many toys she designed in the factory that are both exquisite and meticulously crafted! Thanks to her, I now have many inspirations in my head that I want to realize!

speaker: Eureka
content: She must've created such passionate creations to commemorate an important person or event.

speaker: Eureka
content: Please tell her for me that she's amazing!

speaker: Eve
content: Bass has a catchphrase. Do you know what it is?
Half of Eve's body has been devoured by toys and Mania. Yet she lets the contamination surge, and is calmly chatting with the toys all over her.
<color=#dg1f1f>What is it? Something that makes you sad just thinking about it, right?</color>

speaker: Eve
content: "Run, Bass. Run, Bass." ...He always yells like this in emergencies.

speaker: Eve
content: It seems like he learned it from some cartoon. He says that the louder he yells, the faster he can run!
She shakes her head in amusement.

speaker: Eve
content: The day of the explosion, his voice must have gone hoarse from yelling. He kept repeating, "Run, Eve! Run, Eve!"

speaker: Eve
content: I can't run with these legs... I'm just a burden that everyone is forced to protect.
<color=#dg1f1f>It's okay! I will give you strength! Bass will always be with you as a toy! He now has the loudest voice! He can surely run fast, faster than the explosion!</color>
The pile of toys slowly surges towards Eve, knocking over several shelves along the way. But Eve is unfazed in her storytelling.
It seems like all the toys in the warehouse are rushing over to listen to Eve's story.

speaker: Eve
content: Benna never forgot that I have prosthetics for half of my body. He just often mistakes me for Shanna.

speaker: Eve
content: He's forgotten a lot of things, but that just makes him more like a child.
<color=#dg1f1f>Maybe the elderly are just a type of child?</color>
<color=#dg1f1f>Your sorrow will be turned into power that can make him into a baby. As a baby, Benna would surely be treated well...</color>
The toys have flooded up to Eve's chest, and she's starting to feel short of breath. But upon seeing a toy puppy fall while climbing, she remembers something and chuckles.

speaker: Eve
content: Bone is the strongest, smartest, and bravest puppy I know.

speaker: Eve
content: Hard to believe, right? He has such a small body, but always rushes to the front to protect me.
<color=#dg1f1f>This time, you can give him the sharpest teeth! No one can kick him away ever again!</color>
The pace at which the toys are piling up has completely sped out of control. Eve is now choking at the throat, making it increasingly difficult to tell her story.

speaker: Eve
content: Polly... Huff...

speaker: Eve
content: Only the most perfect and beautiful doll in the world is worthy of Polly...
<color=#dg1f1f>Yes, yes! Give me more sorrow, more longing! I promise you, she will always be the most beautiful doll!</color>

speaker: Eve
content: Cough cough cough... Maresa...
Mania has started to gnaw at Eve's will. She is now squeezing her words out from between her teeth.

speaker: Eve
content: I'm sorry, I couldn't find your child...

speaker: Eve
content: You will have many, many children...

speaker: Eve
content: The mama nesting doll is a lot like you...
The toys are no longer satisfied with devouring her. They pile up higher and higher, almost reaching the roof.
Eve can no longer feel the pain of suffocation. Her limbs are numb and cold. She's now just one of the many components of this behemoth.

speaker: Eve
content: Ah, it's...
In the increasingly narrow rift, she catches a glimpse of a strange figure rushing towards her.
The grey trench coat seems familiar, carrying the scent of her most familiar family members.
<color=#dg1f1f>He's a villain, a bad egg who's trying to stop you! The toy factory can only have toys! Give me your all, and I'll turn him into a toy!</color>
female_content: <color=#dg1f1f>She's a villain, a bad egg who's trying to stop you! The toy factory can only have toys! Give me your all, and I'll turn her into a toy!</color>

speaker: Eve
content: Is that so? All right, I'll listen to you. Don't let anyone stop... stop me... Huh? Stop me... from what?

speaker: Eve
content: Why am I here? What did I want to do in the first place?
The light in her eyes dims. Darkness, accompanied by evil sludge, is completely robbing her of her vision and perception.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eve! Wake up!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eve! Stop! Don't let the contamination control you!

Your shouts, of course, don't work. The one controlling these toys is no longer Eve, but Mania itself. The toys are trying to trip you one after another, and you can only keep stepping over them or kicking them away.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop! This is the Rust, and the contamination level here is already high. If Mania continues to accumulate, it may attract wandering Corruptors from nearby. If the crisis spreads, it will be beyond my control!
The disturbance caused by the toys is growing bigger by the second, and even the floor is starting to tremble. Your voice is drowned out by the cacophonous noise.
There's no way that Eve can hear your shouts. You're almost deafened by the noise yourself.

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Hahahaha, so many tears, so much longing! How pitiful...</color>

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Even though you know that the toys are fake, and that everything about the factory is fake, you still want to stay with these illusions!</color>

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Silly child! I'll help you, then! I'll help you stay with these toys forever and ever!</color>

The giant toy bear is still only in its premature form. Judging by the scale of the toys rushing towards the center, it will take some time to fully form. But even so, it is already terrifying, and you have to raise your head to see its head.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Looks like you've had a hand in the creation of this terrifying toy factory, huh?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You'd devour anything... even the grief and longing for one's family. You're really shameless.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then I'll make you spit out everything you've devoured.
You've regained the confidence of your human form, and focus on the last bit of silver hair peeking out from the pile of toys. Kicking aside the toys in your way, you stride towards Eve.
She's still there! There's still time!

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Yes! Just like that! Feed me! Give everything to me!</color>

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>You only have me! Only I understand you! I will fulfill your wish for you!</color>
The monster is "growing" non-stop. It makes no difference whether you're a doll or human... it simply looks down on everything. And right now, it wants to steal more power.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eve, wake up! Don't be fooled by it!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It can't fulfill any of your wishes! It just forces you to stay in the past, brings forth your sorrows, and exploits your emotions!

The monster is furious at you, and the ground trembles again. You almost lose your balance, but you seize the moment to dive into the mountain of toys. As the last bit of Eve is about to be swallowed up by the toys, you finally reach your target.

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Don't come over here! Stay back! What are you trying to do?!</color>

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Eve! I need more power! Give me more power! Stop him!</color>
female_content: <color=#dg1f1f>Eve! I need more power! Give me more power! Stop her!</color>

content: Paying no heed, you cling tightly to the monster and shove the photo in your hand into the center of the toy pile. You know that Eve must be there.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I brought you the real voices of your family.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eve, don't you want to listen to them?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Finally, you let me in.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Judging from the storm outside, I thought your inner world would be more turbulent.

speaker: Eve
content: Lies... lies... liar.
Deep inside her consciousness, Eve is still immersed in chaos.
First, she needs to sober up to continue the conversation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've seen a lot of things about you here. But this is the first time we're face-to-face for a good chat.
Eve stares blankly at the ground, and you continue to patiently communicate.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I remember correctly, you helped Bass and Benna fix the machine, right?

speaker: Eve
content: Bass, Benna... fake...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, they are just toys that you designated as your family members. But I believe the memories you shared are real, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: In those memories, they trusted you and believed that you could fix the machine.

speaker: Eve
content: ...Trusted...
You seem to elicit some reaction. You continue with the next topic.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And, the scene where you found Bone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: To that little puppy, you were probably a savior, right?

speaker: Eve
content: Take a walk...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yeah... unfortunately, the promise to take a walk could not be fulfilled...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Polly's a nice girl, isn't she?

speaker: Eve
content: Yes, kind, brave...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As you said, she deserves the most beautiful doll.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Maresa... Although she didn't find her own child, she actually has a lot of children here.

speaker: Eve
content: You saw... a lot...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, I saw everything, including the explosion.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Somebody told me that you were able to build this factory where toys come alive thanks to a powerful wish.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I'm not mistaken, your wish is...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: <color=#fb9259>To stay here forever with your family</color>... right?
Eve's eyelashes flutter.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But is this really what they want?
You hold Eve's hand, pressing her palm tightly against the photo.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Listen carefully. All the personalities, identities and memories you painstakingly created with the toys... What wishes have sprung forth from them?

speaker: Polly
content: I wish that in my next life, I'll meet Eve again! By then, we will be complete, healthy and well.

speaker: Benna
content: All right. Then I wish that in this life, Eve can leave the factory, and live a long, happy and peaceful life.

speaker: Bass
content: Bass hope Eve can make new friends! Friends smarter than Bass, so Eve won't be troubled! If Eve is happy, Bass is happy!

speaker: Bone
content: Woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!

speaker: Maresa
content: Then let me make the last wish. I hope, all our wishes can come true.

speaker: Bass & Benna
content: Eve?

speaker: Polly & Maresa
content: Eve!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eve.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Their wish is for you to experience tomorrow outside the factory.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's a tomorrow that belongs to you, and one that you'll witness on their behalf.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Because of you, this family without blood ties exists.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you move forward, the family members in your memory will also move forward.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. You were never a burden. You are their hope and continuity for the future.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's go. I'll take you away from here.
Her eyes regain their sparkle. At the same time, a sea of emotions is awakened in an instant, amplified infinitely across her consciousness.

Her monochrome consciousness suddenly becomes a kaleidoscope of colors. You feel an intense emotion... partially guilt, and partially the exhaustion of repeating memories in a false paradise day after day. She lifts her head, looking somewhat bewildered through the mist in her eyes.

speaker: Eve
content: Are you that cotton doll? You look better than when you were a toy.

speaker: Eve
content: I remember... I was celebrating Bone's birthday.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And then I came in and caused a mess, and you caught me.

speaker: Eve
content: I hurt you... I hurt many others too, didn't I? I... I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know. You just wanted to recreate a place where you're accompanied by your toy family.

speaker: Eve
content: As long as I leave here, everything will get better?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course. The Buonanotte Factory was created from your wish. Things will get better as long as you are willing to let go of your wish.

speaker: Eve
content: I see, I see... As long as I leave here, everything will get better...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. Things haven't gotten too bad yet. It's just that you unintentionally trapped some people in this factory, and they had a long nap. There is still room to recalibrate your Mania risk level.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I will find someone to heal your legs, so that you may carry on the existence of your family members in this world. As long as you remember, they are not gone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Keep moving forward along with your memories. I believe you will make new friends at the MBCC.

speaker: Eve
content: Friends?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Someone asked me to give you a message.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's an inventor. She discovered the intricacies of some old toys from the Buonanotte Factory and specially came here to get inspiration.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She said that she saw many toys that you designed in the factory that are both exquisite and meticulously crafted. Thanks to you, she has many new inventions in her head that she wants to realize.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She wants me to tell you that you're amazing!
Perhaps because she's been with the toys for too long, she seems surprised and flustered at such sincere and frank compliments. You seize the opportunity to offer her your hand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll take you out of here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is also their wish.

She looks at the hand in front of her, staring for a long time before she carefully holds up your fingertips. She sees the wounds from your journey to her, and also feels the real warmth that reminds her of her family.

speaker: Eve
content: "What will happen tomorrow?" Only after you said all this do I realize that I haven't thought about this question for a long time.

speaker: Eve
content: The world you promised sounds wonderful. I like it.

speaker: Eve
content: After going out, I can start a new life, meet new friends. I can also make a lot of toys... It'll be great.

speaker: Eve
content: Thank you for bringing their voices to me, for letting me hear their wishes. Now, let me do something for you, too.
She releases your hand, and conjures up a match in the sea of consciousness.

speaker: Eve
content: I remember... Bone's birthday isn't over yet. It's time to light a birthday candle... I'll leave the outside world to you.
With a crackle, the warm dancing flame pulls you back to reality.
The tyrannical giant toy bear is rampaging amidst a sea of flames, destroying everything in its path. Fire is rapidly spreading over its body, burning it from the inside out.

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Ah!!! It's so hot! Eve! What are you doing inside there?!</color>

speaker: Toy Bear
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Stop it! Stop it right now!</color>

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Don't go... don't leave...</color>
The toy bear has been defeated, but its contamination residues still stand in your way, moaning eerily.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's over. Time to go out and face reality.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: <color=#dg1f1f>But the mirage is clearly so much better...</color>

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Reality always leads to pain!</color>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You're using the same trick again. Aren't you tired of it?
You wave away the dark mist in front of you, but it gathers again into another shadow.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Why can't everything just remain in this moment forever?

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Isn't it wonderful to stay in a world without any worries?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's fake will always be fake. They cannot bring about genuine feelings.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: <color=#dg1f1f>But those people you brought back to reality... did they really... find happiness?</color>

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: At least we should give Eve the right to see the truth and make her own choice.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Ha, how do you know that Eve...</color>

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: <color=#dg1f1f>...hasn't made a choice?</color>

The black smoke laughs menacingly as it pounces on you. You block it instinctively. The sharp spikes of your shackles tear open the last bit of contamination, revealing a memory you've never seen before.
In this memory, Eve is carefully hugging a pile of rags, her face clearly tear-streaked.

speaker: Eve
content: These are the things left by Mr. Benna before he passed away. I'm sorry. There was a severe Mania incident. These were all I could find.

speaker: Middle-Aged Male
content: Mania? My God, is there any contamination on these?!

speaker: Middle-Aged Male
