speaker: Angell
content: So, thank you, ${PlayerName}, for letting me feel the warmth I haven't felt in a long time.
She draws out her blade, but aims the handle at your abdomen first, causing you a burst of pain. Before losing consciousness, you hear her last few words in a daze.

speaker: Angell
content: Thank you for sharing the sunlight with me, ${PlayerName}. But you see, those who're used to the sunlight can't see the shadows at their feet.

speaker: Angell
content: You won't get to take me away. You're the one who's in trouble. Take care of yourself.
That's right... you were panicking not because you feared her betrayal.
But because you realize she has already made a decision you can't change.
Days are passing by, living this lie, Not knowing what we're looking for. Gray, these walls are gray and there's no sky. There is no hope, there is no soar. I know somewhere there must be more.

The Blue Rain pours down once a month, and it has been drizzling today. The soaked clothes stick to the body, and the icy water seeps into the wounds. Before the pain sets in, Mania is already reacting.

Angell leans against a lamp post in the narrow alley. Despite the surrounding silence, the intense stimulation to her senses completely overwhelms the music in her headphones. She looks down to pause the player, then turns her gaze to the dark alley.
From the darkness, a man emerges, followed by an attendant holding an umbrella for him. Several more pairs of eyes lurk in the shadows behind him.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: You're punctual, Angell, as expected of the top hitman on the dark web.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: But it seems you didn't bring what I wanted.
Angell knows him well—he's a middleman hidden within Syndicate. She has taken several big orders from him. Not too bad as a client.

speaker: Angell
content: There are loads after him, just having my pick here.
female_content: There are loads after her, just having my pick here.

speaker: Angell
content: You know, see who they are, what they can offer, and just how much they want his life.
female_content: You know, see who they are, what they can offer, and just how much they want her life.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: Heh, silent killer is more your style, Angell. Cut the crap.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: Those who came to you asking for that person all got killed, right? Sounds like the Top Hitman's been baiting her clients... Are you trying to pull that same trick on me?

The man's expression darkens, and heavy footsteps echo behind him. Thugs step out from the darkness, some of them blocking her escape route, while countless guns from the surrounding buildings take aim at their only target—Angell is surrounded.
The first to step out of the crowd are two heavily modified thugs. Blue Rain ignites their marks of Mania; they are Sinners.

speaker: Miguel
content: Hehehe, is this the one? I can kill her in any way I want as long as she's dead?

speaker: Melanie
content: Shut up, Miguel. Show some respect to the Top Hitman. She'll do us a huge favor soon.

speaker: Melanie
content: Sorry, ”Angel”. The newbies here need some achievements to prove themselves. I'm just trying to beef up my resume here.

speaker: Melanie
content: The worth of a hitman is measured by the heads they collect, and yours is the top prize. As the number one hitman on the dark web, you know how it is, right?
Angell recognizes them—they're all hitmen on the dark web. With them securing more and more gigs lately, they are on the brink of overtaking Angell in the system rankings.

Chasing after the "number one" title is nothing weird. It's actually no different from how she enjoys red bean soup and keeping goldfish. People living on the edge of the world tend to have their own quirks.
But their client pays no mind to these matters, his cunning, vulture-like gaze is fixed on Angell.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: Letting the target escape, then coming back to point your blade at your old clients...

speaker: Gang Leader
content: Is it for the money? How much did the Bureau offer you? Or were you charmed by that Chief? Heh... None of these sounds like it.
The man laughed, his expression a mix of anger and mockery. Angell likes this familiar look; she even had to thank everyone here.
It's been a long time since she felt this shaken. Thanks to them, Angell finally sees her place and makes peace with her choices.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: You've always wanted to break free from the dark web, always fantasizing about returning to the "normal" side of the world. Do you think he can help you, or did he promise you?
female_content: You've always wanted to break free from the dark web, always fantasizing about returning to the "normal" side of the world. Do you think she can help you, or did she promise you?

speaker: Gang Leader
content: Forget it. He can't even protect himself, let alone you. There are plenty out there who want him dead, hired or not. He's crossed lines he shouldn't have. It's only a matter of time before he's killed.
female_content: Forget it. She can't even protect herself, let alone you. There are plenty out there who want her dead, hired or not. She's crossed lines she shouldn't have. It's only a matter of time before she's killed.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: And you have no idea what you're up against.

speaker: Angell
content: That's not true. I chose this side of the world, so of course, I'll do my job.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: Doing your job means betraying your client?

speaker: Angell
content: No. I don't take on many gigs, but I make sure to complete the ones I do.

speaker: Angell
content: Out of all the assassination jobs, only the one I took wasn't about killing the Chief of MBCC. It was to "kidnap and hold" until delivery.

speaker: Angell
content: I followed those exact orders, and you can check the records. Now that the job has expired, as compensation for the lost payment, I can do whatever I want with the "goods." Everything is by the book, even the system has given me a good review.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: ...Kidnap? That's not possible. I know Carnivore was your client. They've been holding a grudge after what happened in Syndicate, and they only want the Chief dead.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: Did you hack the dark web and alter the job details?!

speaker: Angell
content: I know nothing about that. I'm just a regular hitman who follows orders; tech is not my thing.

speaker: Angell
content: But I wouldn't mind if someone managed to hack the dark web and mess with that job.

speaker: Angell
content: There are others on the dark web trying to keep him alive. That's good.
female_content: There are others on the dark web trying to keep her alive. That's good.

content: The man's expression darkens, while Angell's lips slowly curl into a smile, her mood visibly brightening.
The sadness from parting slowly eases. She's always been the type to make a choice and never look back. For someone accustomed to farewells, being sentimental is pointless.

speaker: Angell
content: Since I've chosen to live on the dark web, I will respect the rules here.

speaker: Angell
content: But you do surprise me, though. Why are you so angry? You know this world far better than I do.

speaker: Angell
content: On this side of the world, what's the point of morals and credibility?
Her smile widens as she turns and walks towards the man. The rain washes over her, clearing the accumulated blood from several rounds of killing and leaving a red puddle under her feet.

speaker: Angell
content: I kinda have some principles, but none of you show respect to that.

speaker: Angell
content: ...You want me to kill those you can't kill. You just need this blade.
She slowly draws her blade, murderous malice awakening her senses. A few people around her recoil. That's right, this is the kind of distance she is familiar with.
There's nothing scary about malice. Under the night sky, she has always been the one who instills fear in everyone.

speaker: Angell
content: Well, I don't mind proving how sharp my blade is once again. Let's see how many gangsters and Sinners it can take down in one day. After today, only more would want to use it.

speaker: Angell
content: I'm a hitman on the dark web, after all. I know the drill.
She's overexerted herself. Blue Rain has arrived as expected. I made sure to bring enough people—I've hired hitmen and modified Sinners, all stronger than her. I'm well-prepared!
The man thinks to himself, but overwhelmed by the intense malice emanating from Angell, he involuntarily steps back.

speaker: Gang Leader
content: Move it! What are you waiting for?!

speaker: Miguel
content: It's my turn! My turn!
With a flash, one of his ears flies off. Angell gives her blade a shake and resumes the music.
The gentle, soothing music begins again. There's too much stimulation during work, a tune gives her just enough time to calm the restlessness in her heart.

speaker: Angell
content: Don't let the dead do the talking. I just want to speak with you.

speaker: Angell
content: After this song, answer my questions: Who gave you the gig? Who asked you to kill Chief?
When you open your eyes again, you hear some familiar voices.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, are you alright? Are you hurt?
They are all familiar faces.

speaker: Wynn
content: Sob, Chief, we finally found you! You seem even thinner than before... Chief, I've really missed you. I always complained about the endless tasks you assigned, but things just weren't the same without you...

speaker: Eugene
content: I'm glad you're alright, Chief! Now that you're back safely, we can finally get some good sleep... Tracking Sinners is one thing, but tracking you is way scarier...
The adjutant looks slightly hesitant and apologetic as she takes your hand, nodding solemnly at you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Welcome back, Chief.
The sunlight shines on you, and for some reason, you find it a bit glaring. It seems you've become too used to the dark in just a few days, after all, no sunlight ever seeps into her house.
You don't want to give up on her; you want to look for her. But before that...

options: The attack case isn't over yet.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We thought we understood the dark web, but we were wrong... There are still more people lurking behind the scenes...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know their target. Go after them. Hurry, it's not over yet...

As the joint operation unfolds, a new round of assassination attacks occurs. However, the attackers are not fully prepared and have left many flaws this time. The joint investigation team seizes the opportunity to track down more hidden backers, including a Hypercube company supported by a former Nirvana director.

He might be the mastermind, or just an abandoned pawn. With the diligent efforts of the MBCC Chief, the suspect is finally punished, and the forces attempting to disrupt the West District's new mine suffer a significant setback.

Following these events, on DisMyth, the number of assassination jobs targeting the MBCC Chief plummets, and the undercurrents lurking on the internet also temporarily subsides.
As for the whereabouts of that hitman he insisted on tracking down…
female_content: As for the whereabouts of that hitman she insisted on tracking down…

content: The intel shows that she was last seen on a bloody battlefield in March.
Some say this is the most fitting end for a legend on the dark web.

speaker: Angell
content: Hello, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Angell
content: I've never written a... letter like this before. But I remember when you write emails, you always start with a greeting. So let's do that.

speaker: Angell
content: You've always wanted to ask why I trust you, why I let you change my life.

speaker: Angell
content: First, I haven't really had a life for a long time.

speaker: Angell
content: And second, you should change the question, or rather, I should ask myself...

speaker: Angell
content: Why did I take that kidnapping job when there were so many assassination ones that paid well?

speaker: Angell
content: Maybe it's because I thought there are too many people who want you dead, and if I don't kill you, someone else will, so I figured I might as well take the job. I needed the money to pay the electricity bill, after all.

speaker: Angell
content: Or maybe it's because I thought, you were going to die anyway, at least you wouldn't suffer if it was me, I'd make it quick for you.

speaker: Angell
content: Yes, I did my research before. I knew what you've done, and that you're a good person... the kind of person that reminds me of sunshine—a scent that I miss.

speaker: Angell
content: In the end, I couldn't stand the thought of a good person being destroyed by this side of the world.

speaker: Gangster
content: You know full well we want his life, and yet you took him away and let him live...
female_content: You know full well we want her life, and yet you took her away and let her live...

speaker: Gangster
content: And you have the gall to say you're not their lapdog?!

speaker: Gangster
content: Go to hell!

speaker: Angell
content:
Sometimes I find myself missing, the scent of you all. Like gazing into an aquarium,
and how it reminds me of the ocean.

speaker: Angell
content: But the ocean I think of isn't one with a sunny, golden beach that you talked about. My ocean is dark, wild and boundless—an abyss untouched by sunlight; it's this side of the world.

speaker: Angell
content: Remember that young lad who used to work for a gang? If it wasn't for me, he probably would have died there. He just wanted a decent job, but there were so few options and he only knew the dark web, then he fell into a trap.

speaker: Angell
content: And that restaurant owner... If you hadn't accepted that job, another hitman might have shown up at her door with a weapon, forcing her to pay a debt that she could never pay off. It doesn't matter whether it was luck or sheer desperation. She got close to the cliff, and surely someone would have taken the chance to drag her down.

speaker: Passerby
content: Out of cash? Should we "borrow" some from the convenience store ahead?

speaker: Passerby
content: Ha, you think that still works?! Now our boss is gone, and those lowlifes dare to turn against us because of that damn Executive Committee!

speaker: Passerby
content: Just ******* kill them all. That will show them!!

speaker: Angell
content: Living is like traveling on the sea. In the great storms, I was tossed off the boat, and fell into the water... but luckily, I turned into a shark and got used to the darkness.

speaker: Angell
content: Only when I see someone like you, do I remember I also once lived under the sun.

speaker: Angell
content: When I'm not in a fight, my senses are always dull. I can't distinguish smells, or taste whether the food is burnt or spoiled. But I tasted something different in your red bean soup.

speaker: Angell
content: The fragrant soup and the soft, mushy red beans... I might not be a child anymore, but I always miss that taste... that sweetness.

speaker: Angell
content: I don't even remember what pain feels like, but I saw you wince when you looked at my wounds. People only ever talk to me about killing, hatred, and their needs, but with you, I feel appreciated and cared for.

speaker: Angell
content: I feel like those moments belong in the wonderful dreams that I have every night but that are forgotten upon waking.

speaker: Angell
content: The time we spent together wasn't long enough to reclaim what I lost, but enough for me to remember what I once had.

speaker: Angell
content: Maybe, over time, even a shark can see through the darkness; maybe I'll get used to having daytime and nighttime, get used to kindness, to feeling alive, and to embracing life.

speaker: Angell
content: Then again, I thought, let's leave them as maybes.
Have you ever thought about, if you weren't a hitman...

speaker: Angell
content: Not a hitman? I'd probably have starved to death by now.
I mean, is there anything else you want to do?

speaker: Angell
content: No, I don't usually think about things like this.
Noticing your silence, Angell struggles to lift her head from the bed to glance at you, then buries her head back into the soft pillow, muffling her voice.

speaker: Angell
content: Those are things I can't have. If I give them too much thought, they will shatter the life I have now.

speaker: Angell
content: It's colder today. The porridge cools down so quickly.
Yes, the temperature dropped last night. You had kicked off the blanket while sleeping, so I covered you up again. You could have caught a cold.

speaker: Angell
content: I had no idea...

speaker: Angell
content: Thank you, it's been a long time since I last slept through the whole night like that.

speaker: Angell
content: The sea won't dry up just because one shark has gone. The brighter the light shines in this city, the darker the shadow it casts. There's always got to be a place for all that malice with nowhere else to go.

speaker: Angell
content: You've changed too many things. The malice you drove away flocked to the dark web, seeking revenge on you. You're not really the sun, you're just like us... a traveler on the sea.

speaker: Angell
content: Taking on more malice will only make your journey harder. If that's the case, you don't have to pull me out from the sea.

speaker: Angell
content: I do miss the sunlight, but I've also gotten used to the darkness. If I have to choose...

speaker: Angell
content: I'll stay. A shark is more powerful underwater. If anyone else tries to pull you down, I'll cut off their limbs and escort you back to where you belong.
Clack!
The door, which hadn't been opened in a long time, swings open, bringing in a gust of wind that gently lifts the letter on the table.
I'll take your job, but I'll protect you in my own way. As payment...
Take care of the goldfish for me. I can't go back there, to that home. I hope you'll think of me every now and then.
Just like how I'll... I'll reminisce about the fleeting sunshine you brought into my life.
The kitchen light is switched on, and the rustling sound of plastic bags fills the room, followed by the sound of running water and washing.
After starting the rice cooker, you turn around and look at the dining table.
Ding-a-ling...
A sudden ringtone cuts through the air when you're lost in your thoughts, and by the time you come back to your senses, Angell is no longer there.
The rice cooker is making bubbling noises, and in the empty and quiet room, only you remain.
Ding-a-ling...
The terminal keeps ringing in your pocket.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, you didn't send us the signal after you went in, is something wrong?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...No, it's safe in the house. Don't worry.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But there are things I need to handle, just wait for me outside.
You walk to the window, hesitating for a moment before pulling open the curtains.
The brilliant sunlight pours through the window. The curtain flutters, stirring up the dust in the golden light.

The room is bathed in sunlight, just as tidy as it was when you left it. The fish tank's filter and oxygen system are still operating smoothly. However, you notice a thin layer of dust has collected on the desk and floor.
The sun is setting down outside, its gentle rays shine over your head, landing on the bowl of sweet red bean soup on the table and the empty chair behind it, casting a warm and cozy glow.

You dust off your hands and stand up by supporting yourself on your knees. You discover a generator in the storage cabinet located in the corner of the living room. It's working well and looks like it can last a few more days.
Didn't expect she even has a generator at home, probably not the first time she forgot to pay the bill.
But judging by the thick layer of the dust, she must have forgotten about this thing.
Don't know how much power is left, but it'll have to do for now...
Must make sure Angell earns enough money to pay the bill before this generator runs out of power as well.
You gather the cardboard boxes that tripped you and stash them in the cabinet. Then, you pick up the clothes knotted together and try your best to untangle them.
Where did these clothes come from? They weren't here when I cleaned the living room a couple of days ago...
Never mind, might as well wash them later...
Right, she mentioned that the gig she took on today turned out to be a fake again. Now that there's power, you should look into that...
Beep... Beep...
Just as you're about to log on to the dark web, the comms device rings suddenly.

speaker: Angell
content: Found the generator?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. It'll last for a while, but we still need to pay the bill.

speaker: Angell
content: I know. Just take a few gigs from my regulars. They're all lined up waiting, and they pay well.
You look at the DisMyth site on the screen, unsure which accounts are her "regulars," but scrolling through the countless orders on the commission board...

The ones offering generous payments are almost always assassination gigs, either targeting a prey or a hunter. These are not uncommon on DisMyth, and sometimes the job details are so horrendous that they make you sick just by reading them.

If possible, you don't want to be reminded of those bloody businesses every time you see your roommate. You're already walking a tightrope here, pushing it any further might just push you over the edge.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not that in need of money, right? I'd rather pick some gigs that are safer and more acceptable, even if they pay less. We'll make enough to cover the bill eventually.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We better keep a low profile to avoid trouble for now.

speaker: Angell
content: Alright then. I'll wait for your update.

The fridge is almost empty. There's just a pack of red beans, half a pack of rock sugar, and an egg. Outside the fridge, there are a few bottles of condiments and several packs of instant noodles. That's all the food in this house.

On your first day, she told you that you could use anything here. You remember when you cleaned out the fridge, you found quite a bit of meat and vegetables that had gone bad. All the edible food has already been consumed over the past few days.

speaker: Angell
content: Well, I really can't buy anything right now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Huh? But everything in your fridge has gone bad already, we really have to get some groceries.

speaker: Angell
content: I still haven't gotten paid for that order on you, so I'm out of cash for now.
She explains calmly, and shows you her account balance.

It's actually more than enough to buy some groceries from the local market. But according to Angell, in her line of work, enemies are everywhere. For safety reasons, hitmen don't go out unless necessary, and they order everything they need on <color=#fb9259>DisMyth</color>.
Shopping there is safe and secure, you can find everything you need, but the prices are simply outrageous.
Not convinced, you press on.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But aren't you a top-tier hitman who always takes on big jobs? You have no savings at all?

speaker: Angell
content: Saving money is useless; I could die at any time. I only take jobs when I'm almost out of money.

speaker: Angell
content: They're all lined up waiting to hire me because I always get the job done quickly anyway. I can earn enough to last me half a year from one job.

If this were said by someone else, you might think they were fishing for sympathy and bragging about their wealth at the same time, but her expression tells you she's likely just thinking about sleep.

speaker: Angell
content: Don't worry, there's some instant noodles. Bought them on sale just in case. If you're hungry, just eat those.
Looking at the direction she's pointing, you walk to the dusty old cardboard box in the corner and reach inside.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry? These noodles have been expired for months.

speaker: Angell
content: Do instant noodles expire?
She asks the shocking question calmly.
Forget it, if the noodles aren't moldy, they should still be edible. Better than meat and vegetables that have started to smell and liquefy.
Perhaps a hundred years from now, your stomach will shock the DisCity's archaeologists.
You sigh, taking the red beans and rock sugar out of the fridge, and, after thinking for a moment, also take the instant noodles and the egg.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's running errands all day and deserves a treat. Thank goodness she only wants <color=#fb9259>red bean soup</color>, not a full banquet.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The money left in the account is probably just enough to buy some <color=#fb9259>discounted rice</color>, and a <color=#fb9259>cutting board</color>... Before the money comes in, we'll make do with porridge.

speaker: Angell
content: I don't want to monitor you, and it's easy to keep you from running away.

options: But you seem to be on guard for something.

content: Angell narrows her eyes slightly, staring at the window covered by heavy curtains, as if someone could break in from there at any moment.

speaker: Angell
content: I'm very sensitive to malice. I can detect hostility within one kilometer and react instantly.
That's her special ability? Can't believe a hitman's ability is sensing malice from others.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who was that?

speaker: Angell
content: No idea. If he could find this place, he was probably also a hitman on the dark web.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: He mentioned your name. Is he your enemy?

speaker: Angell
content: Too many people want me dead, I can't remember every face.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So people often come looking for trouble like this?

speaker: Angell
content: This is the first time someone has found my hideout. Probably because I brought you here. It was quite a mess that day.

speaker: Angell
content: It's not so safe here anymore. Don't wander around when I'm not here, be careful on your own.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There might be danger in the future. Do you need to move? Do you have other hideouts?

speaker: Angell
content: This is the only one for now, but finding a new one is easy as long as you have money. There are people on the dark web who specialize in this.

speaker: Angell
content: Every time my cover is blown, I just ask him to find me a new place. Sometimes I move every few days, but I've stayed here for over half a year now, so it's about time to move.

speaker: Angell
content: If you're really scared, I can take on a few big orders right now and we can pack and leave.
You know what she means by "big orders" and immediately stop her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, don't do that. It's fine. Moving now is actually more dangerous.
She looks at you for quite a while before answering.

speaker: Angell
content: Okay.
The night has fallen, and the weary people drag their heavy bodies back to their homes.
They don't want to think about anything, emptying their minds and bodies as they collapse on the sofa, numbly scrolling their phones for anything fun.
Until suddenly, a cyan light imprints itself on their eyeballs.
Black English letters paired with numbers and symbols, a small cute manta ray swims around them. It's just an ordinary webpage, but it inexplicably makes people want to tap into it.
When hesitating, a voice comes from the webpage.

speaker: Guests
content: Welcome to... Elysiland?
Ah, a sallow face, a numb body, dead eyes... you look like a dried salted fish. It's really heartbreaking, you weren't like this before.
How long has it been since something caught your eye? How long has it been since your heart raced?
When was the last time you felt truly satisfied?
Can't remember? Sigh... I know, life has let you down. Stagnant days and rigid rules, we're all trapped in this concrete jungle of reality, with our passion stolen away.
Have you ever thought about escaping? Even just a little, relaxing just a bit, kicking off the shackles, and taking a deep breath of fresh air.
If I told you there's a sea out there, a place of true freedom, would you want to come? Do you want to meet the real self... within you?
Just for a while, do you want to meet the real self in your heart that's been suppressed for so long?
Although it looks like a flashy and boring ad, those who know the true nature behind this immediately jump out of bed, rush to their computer desk, and log onto the forum.

speaker: Dark Web User 1
content: !!! Holy ****!! I got the Elysiland invitation link people keep talking about!!!

speaker: Dark Web User 5
content: "For real? I'll give you 50,000,000 DisCoins, let me have it!"

speaker: Dark Web User 2
content: "Can confirm, I am his psychiatrist, I sent the link to him."

speaker: Dark Web User 3
content: "Elysiland? Isn't it just a forum? Why so excited?"

speaker: Dark Web User 2
content: "Type 1 and I'll send it to you."

speaker: Dark Web User 3
content: "Really? So exciting, 11111."

speaker: Dark Web User 2
content: "LOL the posts in Elysiland are all wild and surreal, some are even extremely graphic, it is indeed quite thrilling."

speaker: Dark Web User 4
content: "Which version are you still on? The forum admin created a virtual platform a long time ago and has been randomly inviting people to join."
Yes, I can see it, a grand banquet is being held in your heart, yearning to expose everything!
What do you want to eat? What do you want to play? What kind of beauties or handsome guys do you want, what hero do you want to be, and what bad things do you want to do?
What gives you the adrenaline rush? What makes you think of... the charming scent of dopamine?
Do you have the image in your mind? Yes, that's the real you! The passion you have now is real, life is all about desire!

speaker: Dark Web User 3
content: "That's all fake, right? It's just an online post, you can write whatever you want. No matter how exaggerated, it's just online boasting, isn't it? What's the difference from those bragging brats?"

speaker: Dark Web User 3
content: "...Wait, I remember seeing many posts on the Elysiland forum, all about unspeakable secret desires... Could it be that the admin recreated the graphic scenarios from the posts...?"

speaker: Dark Web User 4
content: "Hahaha, why else would Elysiland have its name? It's the dark web, nothing is strange here."

People recall the posts from back then, describing how thrilling the "cannibal feast" was, with the aroma of food mingling with the sweet scent of roses and the stench of flesh. Instantly, their hearts race, and their eyes get closer to the screen, as if hoping to penetrate into a scene more joyful than that feast.

speaker: Dark Web User 5
content: "...Man, I kinda want to go."

speaker: Dark Web User 6
content: "Same."

speaker: Dark Web User 7
content: "Indeed, good luck, get ready to say goodbye to this world."

speaker: Dark Web User 4
content: "Hmm?! Bro, any juicy details? Tell us more. I'm all ears!"
Their hands are gently held, like being surrounded by sun-bathed seawater, warm, with a bit of humidity.
No matter how hard they blink, they can't see the face of the person holding their hand.
They can only vaguely see the corners of her smiling mouth, repeating these words—
Don't care about what others say, or whether these things are achievable, don't trap yourself, and trust your heart.
Only those with a beast in their heart can hear my voice. And I, invite you to a new world, to be your own king.
Even if just for a day, break through the cage, embrace the entire sea. Come on, right here—

speaker: Dark Web User 7
content: "I heard some people who entered Elysiland never came out again... why else do you think there are only 'legends' of Elysiland now?"

speaker: Dark Web User 3
content: "Isn't it just a forum? Is it that dangerous?"

speaker: Dark Web User 7
content: "What's there to worry about? The worst is just death, which is just the same end for all of us anyway lol. Moreover, those who went and never came back, they all..."

speaker: Dark Web User 4
content: "They all what? Don't keep me in suspense!"

speaker: Dark Web User 7
content: "They all died happily, haha! RIP!!"
We accommodate all desires here. And we will filter out everything you don't like. All you can see here will be the things you want the most, so... Click to agree and enter your own sea!

In rooms filled with wants and desires, people collapse on the table and fall into the sweetest dream. With a mouse in their hand, a computer in front of them, and the webpage they just clicked on, loading for a moment, and then disappears.
The computer screen only leaves a seemingly calm sea and a small fish swimming quietly.

The moment their consciousnesses reconnect, colors explode like fireworks before their eyes. No more concrete jungles, now they are surrounded by vibrant islands, and the unfamiliar scenery impacts them directly. Everyone is left speechless.
Blue waves crash against the rocks with a splash, and the staff in tight swimsuits on the beach wave at everyone. Only then do they come back to their senses.

speaker: Guests
content:
Look! It's the sea!
Ahoy! It's really the sea!
Am I really at the beach?
That's right! The blue skies and seas are all yours! I knew you would come!
The waves around the beach roar, and in the next instant, a tidal wave rises, exploding at its peak and sprinkling like raindrops on people's faces.
A young girl appears within the wall of waves, looking down at everyone through the clear seawater.

speaker: Blue-Haired Girl
content: Hello hello! Friends who are chasing pleasure, you have taken the brave first step, breaking free from restraints and embracing freedom. Now, it's time for your reward!

speaker: Blue-Haired Girl
content: Enjoy to your heart's content! Your passion is my passion, your joy is my joy!

speaker: Blue-Haired Girl
content: This is created just for you by the adorable and omnipotent <color=#fb9259>+\L.L/+</color>—

speaker: L.L.
content: <color=#fb9259>Welcome to Elysiland</color>!!!
The shock takes time to sink. After a few seconds of silence, some instantly accept the invitation to the paradise's revelry, while others remain cautious, shy, and dare not step forward.
The blue-haired girl looks at those who dare not join in, her eyes darting around before she approaches a guest.

speaker: Skinny Office Worker
content: Ahhh...

With a gentle push from the blue-haired girl, a slender office worker in a suit falls into the water. His exclamation attracts the attention of many on the beach, who crane their necks to see what the island owner will do to him.

The fallen guest's clothes are soaked by the waves, his face turning red as he nervously covers his chest through the wet suit shirt. L.L. doesn't force him, cheerfully takes his tie, slowly pulls it off, and throws it into the waves.

speaker: Skinny Office Worker
content: W-wait, I'm afraid this is too...

speaker: L.L.
content: Too what? You love this, your favorites folder is full of this kind of "material." You've imagined this scene many times, right?

speaker: L.L.
content: Because you're not honest and didn't follow the island rules, I'm here to guide you... personally...
The unabashed conversation makes people cheer, and almost all the guests gather here, staring at the island owner and the guest she is "teaching."

speaker: L.L.
content: Don't be shy, your heartbeat doesn't lie. You're clearly happy. Now that your passion is ignited, you must enjoy every bit of it.

speaker: L.L.
content: Now, I'll help you remove the last restraint...

L.L. waves her hand, and a rustling sound comes from the water. Something come to him through the water, gently wrapping its soft limbs around his body, probing into his clothes. The mucus it secretes dissolves the buttons one by one, revealing his wet, sticky, and red-marked naked chest, amid the crowd's increasingly loud cheers.

More and more people gather, those in the back stand on tiptoe or have taller staff lift them up. Some take out binoculars, some cover their eyes but peek through their fingers. Everyone stretches their necks, afraid of missing any part of the scene.

speaker: Skinny Office Worker
content: Ah... not there!

speaker: L.L.
content: Nuh-uh! Just a little more... shame is not something you need here.

speaker: L.L.
content: Hmm... almost there, it's almost done... Let me see what you truly desire...

A cute manta ray swims through the air, leaving behind white light and blue sparkling particles. As his clothes dissolve almost completely, the man suddenly turns muscular, his upper body forming a perfect V-shape, even showing signs of further development, making his head look smaller in comparison.
The soft creature slides its limbs down his body, as if reluctant to leave. People's gazes follow its movement, admiring the perfect physique.

speaker: Muscular Hunk (New)
content: This, this is?!

speaker: L.L.
content: Your computer desktop is always filled with such photos. You've always wanted a body like this, right?
The guest was left shocked, repeatedly feeling his body, looking at L.L. in disbelief.

speaker: L.L.
content: These past few years, you've been working out every day, torturing yourself with tasteless chicken breasts, vegetable salads, and those yucky protein powders. Now that you're in Elysiland, you don't have to work so hard!

speaker: L.L.
content: And of course, there's more!
With a clap of her hands, the electronic pet named Manty swims past everyone again, and several voluptuous beauties and handsome men suddenly appear among the crowd.
Seeing these instantly realized wishes, the guests scream and cheer excitedly, touching their bodies with admiration, praises filling the air.

speaker: Muscular Hunk (New)
content: Sob, it's... it's so wonderful, so incredible! Yes, I could never admit it, but... this is what I've always wanted.

speaker: L.L.
content: Why feel ashamed? Who told you this is shameful?
L.L. looks at the muscular man's aggrieved expression, then turns to the onlookers. She flashes a knowing smile before bending down to gently pat the man's face.

speaker: L.L.
content: If you care about what others say to you that much... well, then listen close to what I am about to say...

speaker: L.L.
content: Here and now, in Elysiland, stop caring about everything else except yourself.

speaker: L.L.s
content: The same goes for all of you!

In an instant, countless L.L.s appear among the crowd, some lifting guests' chins, some gently hooking their pinkies, enticing them to reveal their innermost desires. Suddenly, the island is filled with exclamations, as all the spectators are pulled into their own "dreams come true."

speaker: L.L.s
content: I know... in reality, you're used to caring about others' opinions, used to following the rules. You have to be cautious and avoid traps; you fear losing yourself, and the consequences of acting on your desires.

speaker: L.L.s
content: But here in Elysiland, you are truly free. Anything you want can come true, anything you want to do is allowed.

speaker: L.L.s
content: The things you dare not say or think about, the bad, shameful, misunderstood ideas in your head! Elysiland will make them all come true for you.

speaker: L.L.s
content: ...Only here, only for today. Everyone has only one chance, so think carefully.

speaker: L.L.s
content: Don't worry about anything beyond the here and now. Is such precious time meant to be wasted on others? Do you have to worry about things that haven't happened yet? Why not look at your own heart first?

speaker: L.L.s
content: Ask yourself what you are looking forward to, what makes your heart race and blood boil?

speaker: L.L.s
content: Think about it! Since you've all accepted my invitation and come to Elysiland, be honest! Everyone can and should realize those wonderful wishes!

speaker: Muscular Hunk (New)
content: I... I want a beautiful body... I want to show my beautiful body... I...

speaker: Excited Female Guest
content: Bring on the handsome guys! I want a guy like Liam from "My Dear Coroner"! I want him here with me now! Eeeeeeeei!
Before she finishes, a more urgent shout comes from the crowd.

speaker: Excited Male Guest
content: Then I want a beauty to play games with me!

speaker: Excited Male Guest
content: Or a catgirl maid! One who can cook, warm the bed, and play online games with me!!! If you really have such great ability, give her to me, satisfy me first!!!

speaker: L.L.
content: Hahaha, no problem! That's the spirit! I'll satisfy you all!
Colorful ribbons rain down with L.L.'s voice as exciting music begins to play.

Restaurants, docks, bizarre decorations... buildings and amusement facilities rise from the ground. Pretty girls, handsome guys, magical animals suddenly appear. And many more "desires" are fulfilled.
In an instant, the island transforms into its true form, becoming Elysiland.

speaker: L.L.
content: This is not reality. Those hurt, exhausting, and embarrassing feelings don't belong here. Elysiland only wants your happiness!

speaker: L.L.
content: Forget sadness, forget pain, forget shame! Face your desires! Grow your desires!

speaker: L.L.
content: Be honest with yourself, indulge in yourself! Squeeze every second of today here and now, make it unforgettable for a lifetime!

speaker: L.L.
content: This is the only rule of Elysiland, my only command to you!
Her words kindle Elysiland, the crowd boils, and the carnival begins.
The girl who makes all this happen leaps into the air, dispersing into the azure sky, while at the other end of the island—

speaker: L.L.
content: ...My only command to you! ...Ahh!
A huge splash erupts from the enormous luxury pool, as a figure crashes heavily into the water.

At the other end of the island, a giant boat that contains a pool anchors in a concealed corner of the beach. The one who just fell in is L.L., who got too excited during her welcome speech and accidentally leaped out of the water.
Being out of the water for so long overstimulates her body, she can't hold on and falls straight down. Manty quickly swims to the poolside, looking for its master underwater.
After a while, ripples appear on the pool's surface, and L.L. emerges with half her head, blowing bubbles and complaining, her expression somewhat embarrassed.

speaker: L.L.
content: Blub blub blub? (Are you laughing at me?)

speaker: L.L.
content: Blub blub blub blub blub blub? (I tried so hard that I got exhausted. How could you?)
Manty shakes its head vigorously, trying to explain, but gets drenched by the water the girl splashes.
L.L.'s face no longer shows any anger, she giggles and laughs heartily.

speaker: L.L.
content: Oh come on, laugh if you want to. Why worry about making me unhappy? Be yourself on the island.
She floats leisurely in the water to the other side, leaning against the window, watching the joyful figures on the beach not far away, her eyes gleaming.

speaker: L.L.
content: Ah... such pure and lovely newcomers. It's a pity I can only stay here now, I can't join them in there yet, it's not time...

speaker: L.L.
content: So Manty, you go, transform into me. Every strand of hair must be perfectly replicated. I need you to find the lonely guests who aren't quite prepared for this place yet. Oh! Make sure you pay a visit to those who are having a lot of fun too!

Manty receives the order, circles in front of the girl, and projects a hologram identical to her. This hologram replicates into countless girls, giggling as they fall backward, passing through the huge floor-to-ceiling windows, floating toward everyone on the beach.

speaker: L.L.
content: With so many people here, let me have some fun too!
Under the sunlight, in the seawater, in every building, the sounds of joy are never-ending.
Ordinary desires, strange desires, everything is here. In every corner, there are people satisfying their desires.

Some guests have become so rich that they'd purposely spend a fortune on a toothpick; some are soaking happily in a bathtub filled with gold coins, casually burning banknotes; and some crave recognition, wanting to be seen by everyone, now every news outlet are going crazy over even the smallest thing they do.
And there are those unspeakable, indescribable feasts. Desires that make every cell sigh with satisfaction, making the body continuously secrete exciting and joyful hormones and compounds.
L.L.'s avatars hum little tunes, bouncing slightly as they walk on this Elysiland.

As soon as they see her, the guests stand up, wave and raise their glasses to L.L. The amber liquid inside crashes against the glass walls like waves, overflowing with foam, as they offer their sincerest thanks to L.L., the owner of the island.

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: This is amazing! I've never eaten so much, and had so many pretty girls around me. Elysiland is just awesome!

speaker: L.L.
content: Yup, yup! That's right! There's nothing you can't have here, whatever you want to eat, I got it all! So delicious it makes your soul tremble!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Oh, thank you! The manga here is so complete! I never thought I'd see my favorite in my lifetime! It's such a highly restricted and rare piece of work!

speaker: L.L.
content: On this island, no manga or anime is restricted. If you want to watch, you can watch to your heart's content! You can even have the author tied up in front of you to watch them draw!

speaker: Elysiland Guest C
content: I'm so happy, so many friends... This place is heaven!
L.L. watches, listens, and smells the accumulating happiness of people, her projections swim like little fish in the sea, wandering among the joyful crowd.

speaker: L.L.'s Avatar
content: You want to be respected, become a superstar, or spread happiness? Or maybe you just want to spend the whole day gaming and eating junk food? No problem!

speaker: L.L.'s Avatar
content: Whether it's big dreams or small thoughts, as long as everyone is happy!

speaker: L.L.'s Avatar
content: Don't hold back, enjoy to your heart's content!

speaker: L.L.
content: Enjoy! Your happiness is my happiness!
She floats alone in the vast swimming pool, letting the water push her body to wander around.

speaker: L.L.
content: Everyone should have let go of their burdens, right? Yes, that's it, free yourself, enjoy freedom.

speaker: L.L.
content: Let me feel your joy too! Let's see how you all enjoy yourselves.
Dazzling arrays of digits and variables gradually float to the surface of the water, and tiny electric particles seep into every corner of the island through the pool water.
She closes her eyes, links to everyone, digitizes and copies everyone's emotions, incorporating them into her body. As time passes, L.L. slowly sinks into the water.

speaker: L.L.
content: ...It's so nice, it must be fun to play with them...

speaker: L.L.
content: But time is almost up... Now, I should do the final check to see who isn't happy enough and which guests haven't been attended to.
Unexpectedly, she notices a small flaw—a strange figure. That person seems to have noticed L.L.'s electric particles and disappears swiftly.
L.L. tries to chase after that figure, but only catch a vague outline. She opens her eyes wide, whispering in surprise at this data.

speaker: L.L.
content: ...No invitation, not authenticated... It's an illegal login, 30 minutes ago... now hidden...

speaker: Shawn hangs up abruptly before the girl can finish.
content: The intruder is... someone in a gray trench coat...

speaker: L.L.
content: Interesting... not satisfied by anything on this Elysiland after arriving for 30 whole minutes?

speaker: L.L.
content: And even have done something bad? Hehe, it's okay, it's okay...

speaker: L.L.
content: Time is up.
It happens so abruptly.
The money covering them vanishes instantly. The last bite of steak disappears. The once sturdy body abruptly deflates. The warmth in their embrace dissipates, turning into cold desolation.
People gather displeasingly and anxiously in the central square of the island, starting to complain.

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: Huh? Where's my A5 Wagyu? Where's my truffle rice with caviar? I haven't had enough yet!!!!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Honey! Where did you go, honey? How can I live without you, honey!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Is there a thief? Did a thief come here?! Or is it a malfunction?! I was having so much fun, what's going on!

speaker: Elysiland Guest C
content: Where is the island owner? Help us, something's wrong in Elysiland!
Shhh... Calm down, calm down. There's no thief, and it's not a malfunction, it's just that time is up.
Flickering particles gather, L.L. with her usual smile, floats above the crowd, tilts her head, and speaks.

speaker: L.L.
content: Although the sun of Elysiland always shines, a wonderful day has to come to an end as time passes. Did everyone have fun? Are you satisfied?

speaker: Elysiland Guest D
content: Huh... what?

speaker: L.L.
content: Be honest with yourself, indulge in yourself! Squeeze every second of today here and now, make it unforgettable for a lifetime!
As people come to their senses, they remember the initial agreement. They open their mouths wide, their expressions changing from ecstasy to surprise, and now to a sense of loss. L.L. sees it all.
She gracefully lands, stands in the middle of the crowd, opens her arms, bows like an actor taking a curtain call, and then points to the nearby dock.
Sure enough, a large ship is already docked there, and Captain Meow, who took everyone out to sea fishing, stands on top of the ship, waving its tail at everyone.

speaker: L.L.
content: Don't worry, I've prepared the ship. It will take everyone home safely.

speaker: L.L.
content: Return to reality. Go back to your lives. Those important people and things are still waiting for you.
L.L. wipes her moist eyes, reluctantly bids everyone farewell. After waving her hand, countless avatars appear once again in the crowd, holding the guests' hands, leading them to the ship.

speaker: L.L. Avatar
content: Although all of this is an illusion, a well-made fabrication of mine, I hope you had enough fun and will remember this sense of freedom and joy.

speaker: L.L. Avatar
content: Ah... also, remember me too.
Many people have already boarded the ship, but they still crowd at the stern, showing reluctance and helplessness.
...Until someone refuses to let go of L.L.'s hand.

speaker: Elysiland Guest D
content: ...I had a great time today, it was so satisfying. So... can I stay a little longer?

speaker: Elysiland Guests
content: Elysiland is such a wonderful place... Is a day really all we can have?
A gentle question, yet it resonates loudly. Almost everyone raises their heads, looking at L.L., their eyes showing the same desire, hoping for L.L.'s affirmative answer.

speaker: L.L.
content: But... but this is all fake.
L.L. covers her mouth, deliberately widens her eyes, looking at all the guests.

speaker: Elysiland Guest F
content: Hmm...

speaker: L.L.
content: ...No matter how realistic Elysiland is, it's all an illusion created by dark web codes... Although it can infinitely satisfy everyone's desires, it can also bring strange side effects.

speaker: L.L.
content: One day, 24 hours, is the longest safe limit I've carefully calculated. If you stay longer, the people at the Public Security Bureau will come to catch you...!

speaker: L.L.
content: So, for your own good, you must leave when it's time. You know this in your hearts, don't you?
She swims like a beautiful little fish to the guest's side, gently lifts the guest's chin, and caresses her hair.

speaker: L.L.
content: After all, what I can give you is only momentary pleasure and excitement. Shallow. Nothing more.

speaker: L.L.
content: Those deeper bonds, ideals, and real growth and comfort... Elysiland can't give you that. Go back to your important reality and look for them.

speaker: L.L.
content: So, don't act spoiled with me. You should go back. I wish you all a safe journey!

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: But I don't want to go home! It's exhausting to deal with my parents, and online part-time jobs are boring. I'll just play with my phone if I go back anyway, might as well stay here!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Exactly! Work is stressful, and nothing tastes good. But here, it's finally peaceful, I can eat freely without worrying about getting fat!

speaker: Elysiland Guest C
content: ...You're right... My family, my job, they're still waiting for me. But...

speaker: Elysiland Guest C
content: We understand what you're saying, but one day is really too short. Can we have one more day? We can handle it, our bodies are fine!

speaker: Elysiland Guest C
content: Or... half a day? An hour?
Guests reach out to her, some even trying to grab her feet; everyone is using their own methods to try to keep L.L. from leaving.

speaker: L.L.
content: But...
Facing the guests who are pleading with her, L.L. lowers her head, showing a troubled expression, but there seems to be a hint of a smile.
The crowd gradually becomes restless, more and more people descend the gangway, trying to discern some room for negotiation from L.L.'s reaction.
They beg, reaching out to touch L.L. or even just the hem of her clothes.

speaker: L.L.
content: Why...? Do you not want to go back?

speaker: Elysiland Male Guest
content: It's so great here, let us stay a little longer, even if it's just for a while.

speaker: L.L.
content: Even if there are more important things and people waiting for you on the other side?

speaker: Excited Female Guest
content: It's okay. We'll just stay a bit longer. You said that passion and desire are equally important.

speaker: L.L.
content: Do... do you really think so?
L.L.'s hand slightly clenches into a fist, covering her lips, looking as if moved by everyone's sincerity, but no one notices the trembling smile behind her palm.

speaker: Elysiland Guests
content: Yes! You said you would satisfy us, so satisfy us to the end of it!

speaker: Elysiland Female Guest
content: We'll leave when we're satisfied. We won't trouble you!
Everyone is overwhelmed by their desire for pleasure, their need for satisfaction is like withdrawal symptoms, gnawing at them. L.L. looks at the people with a different gleam in her eyes.

speaker: L.L.
content: B-but as the owner of this island, I have a responsibility...
Noticing the wavering in L.L.'s tone, a gray figure in the crowd suddenly pushes forward, shouting loudly as he reaches out to stop the people who are continuously surging towards L.L.
female_content: Noticing the wavering in L.L.'s tone, a gray figure in the crowd suddenly pushes forward, shouting loudly as she reaches out to stop the people who are continuously surging towards L.L.

content: No, don't hesitate! Didn't you say you were happy with us? Then we'll stay with you!

content: As long as we can stay, anything is fine, we promise to make you happy!

content: ...Oh my, oh my, look at them, look at these enthusiastic guests!

speaker: L.L.
content: You know it's shallow, and it's wrong; you know there are more important things, and you should learn to endure and mature... Yet there are just things that you want to indulge in, even if it means corruption.

speaker: L.L.

speaker: L.L.
content: You're right! In this Elysiland, the happiest person is me, and the one most reluctant to leave is also me!

speaker: L.L.
content: I'm so happy! So many people are like me, I understand your joy, now you understand me too! We are friends now!

Her eyes sparkle with excitement as she looks at her guests, her face flushed and her body trembling. After being away from the sea for so long, she can't help but gasp continuously, and uses all her strength to utter every word.

speaker: L.L.
content: Since everyone has the best and most intense desires, let's indulge a little longer!

speaker: L.L.
content: Because I can't help it either! Come on, let's indulge together, let's sink together, let's fall together!!!
She opens her arms to embrace everyone, as a nearly sky-covering tidal wave instantly surrounds the entire island.

speaker: L.L.
content: Those willing to stay! You deserve even more supreme pleasure!
Behind her, within the giant wave, a monster almost the size of the entire island flaps its fins, continuously emitting terrifying sound waves.
The crowd is ablaze with excitement, cheering and rushing towards L.L., all infected by her fervor.
The only out-of-place person wears a gray trench coat, trying hard to stop them but fails, blocked outside the crowd, gritting his teeth, looking in L.L.'s direction.

female_content: Someone is causing trouble on my island, I won't let her get away with it.

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: Hey, or we could invite him to join us, and he'll be so happy he'll cry, bowing and thanking us for letting him enjoy with us!
female_content: Hey, or we could invite her to join us, and she'll be so happy she'll cry, bowing and thanking us for letting her enjoy with us!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Inviting such tasteless people, tsk, don't bring them here, or they'll dirty my place!
L.L. shakes her head, stopping the crowd's discussion.

speaker: L.L.
content: I can probably guess who it is—It's that person in the gray trench coat.
L.L. shrugs, floating up, overlooking her guests, stirring the now-calm seawater, guiding them to continue satisfying themselves.

speaker: L.L.
content: It's okay, you have me, and I will always stand by your side.
Following the guidance of Elysiland's creator, the guests are once again caught up in a whirlpool of frenzy and chaos.
Occasionally, a hand reaches out, trying to touch L.L.'s hem, asking her to quickly address the issue and join their play, so they can be happy forever.

speaker: Elysiland Guests
content: Let's get rid of him! Drive him away!!
female_content: Let's get rid of her! Drive her away!!

speaker: Elysiland Guests
content: Such a person must be a cancer! A terrible disease! We can't have such a person here!

speaker: L.L.
content: Ah... don't worry, I'll handle it.

speaker: L.L.
content: You guys just continue your revelry. Leave the killjoy to me.
L.L. floats beside the fish, gently calming its agitation, her eyes gradually becoming playful.

speaker: L.L.
content: Besides... now that he's on Elysiland, why not look forward to him becoming one of us?
female_content: Besides... now that she's on Elysiland, why not look forward to her becoming one of us?

content: On the game room screen, pixelated characters lose control and fall off cliffs, the black "game over" flashing continuously. Ice cream on the dining table melts into a white puddle, and even the colorful comic books gradually turn into line sketches until they become blank pages.
Seeing these changes, L.L. can't continue to trace the unknown intruder. She runs to the beach, trying to save these changing scenes.
But the sound of crystal shattering is heard, and the rose garden beside her turns from swaying roses to dark red crystals, then rapidly fades and shatters into powder.

L.L. collapses, her fingers touch a white conch buried in the sand. She picks it up like a treasure, clutching it in her hand. However, the next second, the conch also weathers into white sand, falling from L.L.'s fingers with the sea current.
The seabed storm stirs up white powder formed by death, bringing a blizzard to Elysiland.
She stares blankly at her hands, weakly tightening them for a moment.

speaker: L.L.
content: This is... the conch that the radio host likes the most... The conch allows her to hear her favorite sound.

speaker: L.L.
content: And that rose garden, without the roses, will that girl never see her father again?
L.L. stands up, slowly walks to the center of Elysiland, her footprints getting lost in all kinds of chaotic marks.

speaker: L.L.
content: This house is made of gold, and the owner can experience the joy of endless wealth.

speaker: L.L.
content: Turning those who once bullied him into his furniture, that person loves this feeling of power the most.

speaker: L.L.
content: And these... the joy of sports and fitness, the joy of lying down and eating, the joy of daily parties and gambling, the joy of indulgence and wantonness...

speaker: L.L.
content: They brought me all those things I had never seen or experienced before!

speaker: L.L.
content: They can't find satisfaction in the outside world, so I help them achieve everything here. I said as long as they don't want to leave, no one can take away their right to enjoy.
She looks at the empty island.

speaker: L.L.
content: But they still left...

speaker: L.L.
content: They clearly liked it here, they couldn't enjoy this kind of happiness anywhere else, so joyous, so free... but in the end, they left just like that...
L.L. props herself up under the huge billboard, looking at the now desolate island.
The tiny digital particles slowly gather into a small electronic pet, appearing beside L.L. with a sad face. It gently pats the girl with its fin, expressing its comfort.

speaker: L.L.
content: I don't blame you, Manty.

speaker: L.L.
content: That man in the grey coat is really cunning, it's not your fault you couldn't find him.
female_content: That woman in the grey coat is really cunning, it's not your fault you couldn't find her.

speaker: L.L.
content: Well... after all, it's just shallow pleasure and illusory experiences. Staying too long is harmful to the body. It was supposed to be a one-day tour, it was already overtime, they were almost addicted.

speaker: L.L.
content: They have to wake up... that's what normal people do.

The billboard in the center of the island is exactly where the sunlight from the sea surface illuminates. The photo on it once had many people surrounding L.L., like the group photos girls often take at parties, close together, everyone smiling happily.
But now it looks a bit different, once smiles become the past, they only make people feel lonely.

speaker: L.L.
content: Ah... but I really don't want them to go!
She covers her face, finally letting it all out.

speaker: L.L.
content: What did he do? How can he make people let go of their happiness and return to such a boring reality?
female_content: What did she do? How can she make people let go of their happiness and return to such a boring reality?

speaker: L.L.
content: Just by calling their names? By saying everything is fake, and staying longer is dangerous? By telling them to wake up?

speaker: L.L.
content: Tell me, what exactly did you do?
L.L. lowers her hand and looks back. Not far away, a gray figure quietly walks towards her.
He walks along the footprints left by L.L., letting the seabed storm lift his trench coat.
female_content: She walks along the footprints left by L.L., letting the seabed storm lift her trench coat.

content: His expression is the same as the first time L.L. saw him on the sea surface, serious and earnest, completely different from the atmosphere of this island.
female_content: Her expression is the same as the first time L.L. saw her on the sea surface, serious and earnest, completely different from the atmosphere of this island.

speaker: L.L.
content: There's no one else on the island, just you and me. Now, tell me the answer.

speaker: L.L.
content: How did you manage to pull so many pleasure addicts out of the water, making them leave my island?

speaker: L.L.
content: Answer me, Chief of MBCC.
L.L. reaches out her hand, demanding an answer, as if it's only natural that this person will satisfy her desire.

speaker: Choice
options: I don't need to do anything.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What is provided here is just pure pleasure, the most superficial delight. No matter how much you increase the stimulation, indulgence can't fulfill all of a person's needs.
No one likes hardship, but in life, many people are willing to endure hard work to maintain and strive for some people and things. Those are their most precious things.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I just made them remember. The decision to leave was their own.
She listens intently, lowering her head in some dejection.

speaker: L.L.
content: ...The precious things they want to maintain even if it's hard...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So that's it, that's the kind of happiness I didn't know existed in the outside world...
She lifts her head, suddenly enlightened.

speaker: L.L.
content: Then you should've just told me that!

speaker: L.L.
content: No matter what you want, Elysiland will provide it. I'll do it for you. Then you can easily hold onto these treasures without having to endure any hardship, isn't that amazing?

speaker: L.L.
content: Why didn't you say so?
At this moment, her somewhat confused and strange realization seems very sincere.
Indeed, if she could understand, she wouldn't have created such a dangerous place on her own.
The ocean currents surrounding you have subtle changes, it's the familiar feeling of a Mania storm. There's not much time, you still have important things to do.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've got your answer, now it's my turn to ask.

speaker: Choice
options: Who helped you build this Mania forum?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Elysiland links countless people's mental networks through the dark web. Once a Mania outbreak occurs...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You say you want to make people happy, but you know that indulging in these fake pleasures will only completely destroy a person.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Our tech experts have tracked all your traces on the dark web. You don't have enough dark web skills to create such a large forum like Elysiland.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Someone is helping you, no... they're using you. They help you build this stage and promote it, just to use your power to trap people like this.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I'm not mistaken, this isn't the first, nor will it be the last Elysiland, right? You and those behind you plan to create more traps to spread Mania through the dark web in Eastside.

speaker: Choice
options: Is the Underground behind the dark web?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where are they now? What do you and those Mania followers really want to do?

speaker: L.L.
content: ...I don't know what the Underground is, nor what they think.

speaker: L.L.
content: I just want to invite people here, to see them enjoy themselves, and be happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Mania on the island has long exceeded the limit. Keeping them here will only create Corruptors that are addicted to happiness!
A dead silence. Her ocean-like eyes stare straight at you, as if a whirlpool is forming between you and her.
After an unknown amount of time, she finally looks away.

speaker: L.L.
content: You're right... I know this is bad, the dark web has problems. The happiness it creates is fake, superficial, and harmful.

speaker: L.L.
content: No matter how addicted the guests are, they will never feel like they belong in Elysiland. They all have lives outside and things they cherish there. I understand this, and I told them so from the beginning.

speaker: L.L.
content: But everyone can't help themselves. They know they should leave but still look back; they know they should stop but still take another bite. Even the shallowest pleasure is still pleasure, and even the most clearheaded person will succumb. Who hasn't been addicted at some point?

speaker: L.L.
content: I'm simply the same!
L.L. chuckles, her voice still soft but the innocence in her eyes long faded, replaced by growing madness.

speaker: L.L.
content: I know one day is the limit, so I set the rule, prepared the ship for departure, and told them they should leave. I knew what you were trying to do the moment I saw you, and I didn't deal with you because I knew you were right.

speaker: L.L.
content: But you saw it that day. So many people found their passion, and begged to stay and share their joy with me. How could I let go? This is what I've always dreamed of!

speaker: L.L.
content: I'm different from you all; I'm not sensible at all. Once I'm addicted, I can't stop or control myself, so I sank the island. I'm the one who can't leave this happiness the most!

Your clothes rustle, and the buildings on the island shatter in pieces under L.L.'s frantic shouts. They turn into surging data, sweeping around all desires, surrounding the island, and even blocking the fake sunlight.
Unknown objects surge in the dark, eagerly awaiting a command to tear apart you who is trying to awaken happiness, to drag you into their game, and to melt you into this frenzied joy.
The shackles start to thrash wildly, warning you about the surging Mania that's ready to erupt at any moment.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Mania here is reaching the critical point, and it will threaten you too. Leave, there's not one guest here, nothing left to feed your addiction.

speaker: L.L.
content: Heh, you say there's no more guests on my island? That's not true...
With a wave of her hand, everything on Elysiland stops surging and starts to reassemble. In the deep sea, it looks like a cursed paradise.
The swirling data swallows the creatures in the dark, rapidly expanding before your eyes, turning into countless places, people, things you've seen, imagined, or even your imagined self.
She suddenly gets close to you, her eyes shining with fanaticism.

speaker: L.L.
content: ...You're still here, my last and most interesting guest.
The black swamp around recedes, and the girl you "woke up" stands before you, not daring to resist, muttering the information she knows.

speaker: Shrooma
content: According to L.L., her power seems to come from the bottom of the sea or some place like that. She's like a fish and needs to live in water. That's why she keeps taking us to the seabed.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Those people from under the sea... Or is it under... ground? They said that as long as Elysiland created by L.L. can gather enough emotional energy, then L.L. herself can enjoy many experiences she has never had before.

speaker: Shrooma
content: She likes to see everyone has their desires fulfilled, to see everyone indulge in pleasure, as if that would also bring her joy...

speaker: Shrooma
content: She also said... everyone would always stay with her, because... once people find out how easy it is to satisfy a desire on Elysiland, no one can resist the temptation to stay.
Shrooma curls up, poking the soft sand with her fingers, creating pits and holes in the white beach.

speaker: Shrooma
content: That's why I don't want to leave! A poisonous mushroom is only safe when buried in the mud... But there's no place for filthy mud or poisonous mushrooms in this world.

speaker: Shrooma
content: I just hope to live happily in this world.
Shrooma wipes her eyes, a bit sulky, and turns her head away.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Now you've woken people like us up, cutting off the joy and the energy. That's why my swamp is gone.

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...Was that useful? Can I leave now?
Before looking for L.L., you encountered a little girl who was trying her best to protect L.L. And that child was right, Elysiland seems to be fulfilling everyone's desires, making everyone indulge.

But what you finally arrive at is this chaotic scene. Monsters howl and rise, and the island and ocean tremble continuously under L.L.'s agitation. Every piece of land underfoot becomes sticky and soft, like an inescapable spider web, soon to be swallowed by Mania.
And the culprit, the owner of Elysiland, this beautiful girl in front of you, stands alone in the open square, smiling at you.
In the end, the so-called Elysium has left her alone in it.

speaker: L.L.
content: You're my last guest. You stay on this island for so long, knowing full well of its illusory and dangerous nature, without giving in to its influence... You're the most clearheaded person I've ever seen.

speaker: L.L.
content: I really want to know, have you ever succumbed to anything?

speaker: L.L.
content: Is there anything you want, something you long for, something that spurs you to keep going? Is there a desire you just can't resist?

speaker: L.L.
content: Tell me, I'll make it happen for you, Elysiland will fulfill all your desires! It must take an unparalleled thrill to make someone as sensible as you lose your mind. Whatever it is, I want to try it!

Her expression and words are full of joy. Her frenzied words melt into the water like seaweed entangling a diver's body, wrapping around your limbs and torso, flooding your mouth and nose, muddying your consciousness, trying to make you sink with her.
But you refuse. The shackles disperse the power entangling you, and fly straight towards L.L.

speaker: Choice
options: I don't need the happiness you create.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Shut down Elysiland, leave the dark web and come back with me. I can't let you and those behind you run loose anymore!
L.L. dodges your shackles, swims up in the water, and laughs even more cheerfully.

speaker: L.L.
content: Hahaha! You don't want to tell me? That's okay, I'll get to know you, and so will this island. Let's take it slow!

speaker: L.L.
content: It's just you and me now. The next part is custom-made for you! I will satisfy you in the most perfect way!

speaker: L.L.
content: Please enjoy yourself to the fullest, and satisfy me with your joy!
The underwater scene rapidly changes, everything starts to twist and dissolve, even you feel yourself being deconstructed, rearranged, and reassembled.
Countless pieces of information surge up. Every guest's past flashes before your eyes. Your brain receives too much information, making you feel sick, but you can't back down.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There are indeed times when I have desires, but that will not be happening here.
You take a step closer to her, determined.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know you won't stop here, even if this island is destroyed, you will find a way to gain the Mania you need to create another one.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I won't let this happen again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I will stop you from creating Elysiland once and for all.

speaker: L.L.
content: But, if this really happens again, you can come to my Elysiland once more like a piece of cake, can't you?
L.L. also takes a step closer to you, with one hand behind her back, looking at you obediently, with an "I knew it all along" expression.

speaker: L.L.
content: You must have someone very proficient in computers or networks on your side, who can get you to Elysiland even without my invitation, right? And they hide your traces very well too.

speaker: L.L.
content: I tacitly allowed your entry and permitted you to do anything you wanted on the island.

speaker: L.L.
content: So why are you stopping me now?

speaker: L.L.
content: Or... do you just like being a hero?
L.L. taps her chin with her finger, frowning with her eyes closed, thinking for a while, then suddenly seems to think of something and smiles at you again.
You have seen her with this expression before...
...when she dragged everyone to the bottom of the sea.
The little manta ray beside L.L. suddenly appears, and swims towards your head, wagging its tail.
Eerie data sound effects explode above your head, and the cute little pet instantly scatters into countless signal data, wrapping around you!
Your vision gradually blurs, tiny pixel particles refract colorful light, overlaying in front of your eyes. In the constantly flowing and changing data, you see flashbacks from your past.

speaker: L.L.
content: Let me see... what kind of different life would you like?
The seawater slowly rises, submerging your throat. When it reaches your eyes, all your senses vanish, and it feels like you're falling into a slumber in the dark.
Help! Help! Someone fell into the water!
Oh no, the wind and waves are too strong, we need a rescue boat!
The surroundings gradually become clear, and you find yourself on the shore of Elysiland, with Luvia Ray and Eleven looking at you anxiously.

The strong wind stirs the waves, and not far away, a small figure is struggling in the waves. You don't have time to think; you jump into the sea instinctively, swimming towards the figure with all your strength.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't be afraid! Stay still! Grab onto me!
You swim to the person who fell into the water, letting her grab onto your arm.
Fortunately, the person listens and stops struggling. You support her and swim to the shore, quickly laying her down on the beach to check for water inhalation or other injuries.
Sob... I was so scared, I thought I was going to die.
I was just playing on the beach, but suddenly a wave swept me into the sea.
My hero, thank you so, so much!
A familiar voice rings. You look at the person who fell into the water... It's the owner of the island! The L.L. who was just confronting you!
But your body seems out of control. You want to run away, yet an invisible force stops you.

speaker: L.L.
content: How should I repay you?

speaker: L.L.
content: Just say it! You are my hero. I will fulfill any request you make!

speaker: Eleven
content: Yes, Chief, you are a hero. Whatever you want, just tell her!

speaker: Luvia Ray
content: You are amazing, Chief! Everyone is proud of you! In the future, I will definitely make a movie based on you!

speaker: Eleven
content: I will also spread your story on the radio!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, I didn't do this to gain anything.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't need these.

A flash of light passes by, and everything in front of you stutters like a program error. The figures of Eleven and Luvia Ray gradually disappear, and the sunny beach of Elysiland slowly reverts to its original state.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Is this your "vision" of everything I want?
Obviously, your question and emotions do not satisfy L.L.even the slightest. She lowers her head, as if thinking about something.

speaker: L.L.
content: ...Don't you like this story? Or do you want a more thrilling battle?

speaker: L.L.
content: You need a grander version, right?

speaker: L.L.
content: Yes, it must be like this, I have seen your data, the life you experienced before was far more thrilling than this!

speaker: L.L.
content: Saving just one person is not enough, saving a few is not enough either, you can save a city! An entire sea! Even an entire planet!

A powerful awe suddenly hits, L.L. stirs up a tidal wave from the seabed, surrounding the entire island. The roar of monsters presses near with the waves, and you can palpably feel her control over the Mania on this island.
And as L.L. waves her hand, the particle-like waves gradually form a ruined city, a pitch-black sea of Mania, and even a precarious planet.

speaker: L.L.
content: What about this? Does this interest you? Does this satisfy your desire?

speaker: L.L.
content: Come on, every scene, every planet, they all need you! Your ability can help them escape these disasters!
The waves surge over, and you are swept in again, with the familiar darkness looming. Unable to tell the direction, you can only choose by instinct.
You advance towards the faint commotion not far away. Suddenly, the darkness surrounding you disperses, and a strange world appears before you.
Ruins, red moon, and constantly emerging black monsters have almost turned this place into a dead city.
