A team of masked squad members walks against the crowd towards you. The leading petite girl takes out a gun and solemnly places it in your hand.

speaker: Summer
content: You finally arrived.

speaker: Summer
content: The task of saving the world is now yours.
Summer's voice is somewhat tired. On closer look, her protective suit is already tattered, and her body is covered in wounds.

speaker: I see, you already have an idea. What kind of plan do you want to make?
content: Go, partner, our power will become your bullets and armor!
One by one, the squad members push you towards the deep sea under the giant red moon.
Step by step, then turning into a jog, and finally, you give it your all, strafing the surrounding monsters and jumping towards the center of the deep sea...
White light flashes, and your voice echoes through the sky!
Soon after, lyrical music starts to play. The once ruined and shattered world vanishes, replaced by green fields and shady trees.
And the people around you applaud.
Everyone smiles, including the blue-haired girl in the crowd, who smiles and shouts with the others towards you.
"Great Hero!" "Thank you for saving us!" "Congratulations" "Savior!" "The monsters are gone!" "Wonderful..." "I'm so happy." "Finally, peace..." "The sun is out!"

speaker: Whispers
content: Become one with me...

speaker: Whispers
content: You and I, we make the world... and the world becomes us.
The darkness in front of you quickly fades. You find yourself in the DisSea illusion, holding a pulsating, warm object in your hand.
Whispers in your ear provoke you, urging you to place the object in your heart.
You know that the object in your hand holds immense power.

speaker: Uni
content: Your eyes are beautiful. I really like them.

speaker: Victoria
content: Chief, Daddy will come back, right?

speaker: Cassia
content: Ah... The flowers in the garden are blooming. How fragrant.

speaker: Serpent
content: Why the sad face, look at me, give me a smile!
You feel your hands tightly gripping the object, your fingers deeply embedded into it.

speaker: Whispers
content: Ahhhhh!
The whispers in your ear turn into heart-wrenching screams, enveloping you. The overwhelming force that almost suffocates you vanishes the moment you crush the object!
The buzzing in your ears lasts a long time before fading. The long-unseen sun finally rises slowly, dispersing the thick fog.
The surrounding scenery becomes clear. No one is injured, no one has lost anything. There is no trace of apocalyptic events or battles in this world.
Not even anyone cheering for you.
It's okay, history will remember your greatness.
A familiar voice comes from the sky, but when you look back, there is no one under the sunny sky.
Wherever you go, the perfect savior is there.
Countless worlds and scenarios flash before your eyes. And in each of them, you always play the role of the savior.
Abandoned cities, worlds plunged into Mania, even entire planets are saved by a mere gesture of yours.
Once again, you support an injured person away from the war zone. She keeps thanking you in your ear.
Thank you, thank you! I thought I was really going to die there...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't thank me, I'm just...
Yes?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...doing what I should do.
You gaze at the world before you, feeling the ongoing and receding episodes of your history in your peripheral vision, scenes of heroic deeds.
The cheering crowd, the kneeling crowd, the gratitude towards you still rings in your ears, fanatical like the followers of this island chasing joy.
Your mind becomes increasingly chaotic, and you can only bite your tongue, using the pain to stay sober.
You wave off the tightening hand clutching your arm, summoning the shackles with all your might...
A red light flashes, and the illusions created by data disperse before you. You and the blue-haired girl beside you are back on Elysiland.
The Mania mixed with massive data becomes unstable due to your shackles, attacking you along with the twisted creatures from the sea!

speaker: L.L.
content: Ahhh...!!

You fight with all your might. The red light from the shackles bursts, shattering the splendid scene before you. They dissipate into foam. The annoying, bewitching voices finally quiet down, giving you a chance to catch your breath.
In front of you, L.L. gasps for air, clutching her throat like a fish thrown ashore.

speaker: L.L.
content: Huff... huff... Heh... Hehehe... hahahaha...

speaker: L.L.
content: Amazing, you easily broke the battlefield I worked so hard to prepare.

speaker: L.L.
content: What else do you want to do? You don't seem satisfied yet... The great hero is really hard to please.
L.L. laughs while struggling to straighten up. Her lips are pale, and her voice trembles. You realize that the girl is far more fragile than most people, she looks very distressed.
If this was a deliberately designed performance for you to see, she indeed succeeded. You feel a tinge of pity.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop creating these illusions. It's time to end.

speaker: L.L.
content: Stop? Why? Shouldn't you grow more strength as you fight?

speaker: L.L.
content: Countless traps and temptations couldn't shake your fighting spirit. You kept moving forward, determined to stop Mania and defeat the enemy. Why are you retreating now?

speaker: L.L.
content: ...Is it because I'm not a good enough villain? I can't ignite your fighting spirit? Is it because the scene isn't grand or epic enough, and the fight isn't exciting to you?

speaker: L.L.
content: Then I'll try harder. It can't end like this, it's not heroic enough for you, and I am not satisfied yet.

L.L.'s voice trembles, perhaps from weakness, or excitement. She seems unable to continue speaking, suddenly raising her hand, and the people you awakened earlier are copied onto Elysiland by her in data form.

They endlessly compound their joy on Elysiland, causing the data to multiply. They show eerie expressions, greedily looking at you, surrounding you and L.L., constantly laughing, shouting, and urging you on.

speaker: Elysiland Guests
content: With your invincible shackles, no enemy can stand against you! Fight, and then win!

speaker: Elysiland Guests
content: Save us, save the dark web, save DisCity! We've been waiting for you, and finally, the dawn has arrived!

speaker: Elysiland Guests
content: You are the great hero who defeated Mania!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No matter how stubborn you are, there must be a limit. No pleasure is worth harming yourself like this.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You know you can't continue, what exactly are you holding on to? Why?
Blinding red light brushes against her cold hands, and in an instant, a strange image flashes by.
A dim room, humid walls, water, and... in the middle is...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What is that...?

speaker: L.L.
content: Nothing...
L.L. suddenly leans in, placing her hand on your shoulder, forcibly pulling your consciousness back.
Her face is as white as paper, and she stares directly at you, demanding all your attention.

speaker: L.L.
content: I'm here, I will always live in a place full of passion.

speaker: L.L.
content: Since you are on Elysiland, just focus on yourself and satisfy yourself.

speaker: L.L.
content: The people you need to face are here; the enemies you need to defeat are here. Focus on me. I will prepare the ultimate showdown for you.

speaker: L.L.
content: Enjoy yourself, great hero!
The giant fish circling above roars, parting the sea water of Elysiland.
Its giant pectoral fins embrace L.L., enveloping her in a dazzling, colorful light.
Her smile seems to unveil a grand celebration exclusive to you, yet it also appears to be pleading for you to play with her.
The fish leaps into the air, charging straight at you, as if the omnipotent owner of Elysiland is offering you a hug.
The giant fish struggles, eventually landing on the last piece of land on Elysiland.
After the dazzling colors fade, L.L. is left alone, sitting with her back to you.
This was the most spectacular battle created by L.L. She used herself as the power source to summon the most imposing boss, full of challenges and sparkling special effects.
You gave it your all, used your wits, and won beautifully. The moment the monster is defeated, L.L. sets off a massive amount of fireworks just for you, covering the sky.
Watching you walk out of the light, approaching the defeated as the victor, L.L. smiles happily.
Isn't this victory glorious enough? It should have satisfied his hero complex. He must be very happy, right?
female_content: Isn't this victory glorious enough? It should have satisfied her hero complex. She must be very happy, right?

speaker: L.L.
content: Yes, I just love seeing people being satisfied.

speaker: L.L.
content: I can't see the big world outside, but you guys can. You always bring the most interesting experiences from the outside to me, and it makes me happy too.

speaker: L.L.
content: Come, let me see your face... I've enjoyed the joy of so many people, but I've never empathized with a real hero.
But when that person approaches and looks straight at her, she's stunned.
His face shows no pleasure. The anger, seriousness, and even that unwavering determination he had is gone.
female_content: Her face shows no pleasure, the anger, seriousness, and even that unwavering determination she had is gone.

content: What remains is an expression L.L. has never seen before. A sad, restrained expression, he looks straight at L.L. as if he has many things to say.
female_content: What remains is an expression L.L. has never seen before. A sad, restrained expression, she looks straight at L.L. as if she has many things to say.

speaker: L.L.
content: ...Why this face?

speaker: L.L.
content: Wasn't it satisfying enough? Wasn't your victory glorious enough?

speaker: L.L.
content: Tell me everything. I will try my best to make you happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This battle was already very satisfying, thank you. I am very satisfied.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So now I want to make you happy as well.

speaker: L.L.
content: Make me happy?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Elysiland is done for. Mania has corrupted it, and it's now hurting you. You need to say goodbye to it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There are other joyful places in this world. If you trust me, I can take you to see them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Aren't you curious why the guests left Elysiland? You can see such a place with your own eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Beyond Elysiland and the dark web, there is a bigger world. You can go there yourself. You can find joy yourself without borrowing others' dreams, and then share it with others.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Just like you find ways to make us happy, I will find a way to make you happy, okay?

speaker: Choice
options: No matter what, you are not alone anymore.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I promise you.
As you speak, you reach out to L.L.
But the girl looks at you blankly until the sunset, which is no longer controlled by the island owner, illuminates both of you.

speaker: L.L.
content: Hehe... there won't be a better place than here, I know it...

speaker: L.L.
content: It's...
L.L. remains kneeling, the sunlight falls in your palm, and she just stares blankly.

speaker: L.L.
content: ...so warm...

speaker: L.L.
content: The place you mentioned... does it have sunlight like this?
Her expression softens, and she slowly raises her hand.
Her voice abruptly stops, and the distance between you is suddenly widened! A force is pulling you up, dragging you out of the underwater world.
The island starts to sink, but the blue-haired girl has disappeared.
Under the sunlight, countless bubbles reflect dazzling colorful lights, pushing you out of the deep sea.

speaker: News Report
content: Recently, there have been cases of unexplained comas. After investigation, it has been confirmed that they are caused by shock symptoms from internet stimulations...

speaker: News Report
content: Currently, all patients have regained consciousness, and no obvious aftereffects have been found. Their mental states are being closely monitored by the hospital...
In the hospital, patients in the psychiatric ward groan one after another, talking about daily complaint and fantasies.
"I want lots and lots of money," "I want beauties," "I want handsome guys!" "I want to skip work," "I want to eat without getting fat!"
But after shouting, no one speaks again. They look at the white clouds and blue sky outside the window, pinching themselves a bit fearfully to prove they are still in reality world.

speaker: Strange Man
content: It's time to wake up, Lore-Ley.
In the run-down bathroom, two computer screens alternate between pink and blue light, reflecting on the clear water in the bathtub.
A girl lies on her back in the bathtub, slowly opening her eyes.

speaker: L.L.
content: …It's you?

speaker: Strange Man
content: Yes, it's me.

speaker: Strange Man
content: It was very dangerous just now. They sent me to get you. Luckily, I found you in time.

speaker: Strange Man
content: You're pushing yourself too hard. The dark web's power is strong and can easily harm you. You need to be discreet with it.

speaker: Strange Man
content: Look, you've been unconscious for so long, you were almost caught by that man and lost your freedom forever. Your value is much more than that. Be careful next time.
female_content: Look, you've been unconscious for so long, you were almost caught by that woman and lost your freedom forever. Your value is much more than that. Be careful next time.

speaker: L.L.
content: Next time...

speaker: Strange Man
content: Yes, your desired paradise isn't complete yet, right? Don't let such boring people stop you.

speaker: Strange Man
content: Go and build the next Elysiland.

speaker: L.L.
content: Really, he almost got me... hehe...
female_content: Really, she almost got me... hehe...

speaker: L.L.
content: That's... quite unfortunate...
A flash of white light wakes you up. You almost spring up from the bed. Gasping for air, like someone who has been holding their breath underwater for a long time and finally breathes.
You rush to the terminal, open your email, and find the message from the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center.
[Elysiland cracked, tracked "Island Owner" IP to 146.2.1.■■■, excluding proxy factors, possible geographic location—]
Moore sent a link, which is the offline address of the Elysiland owner's IP.
You click on the link, it's an very old building with almost no residents in Eastside.
You rush out.
The sun has fully risen, making people sweat lightly, which immediately evaporates.
You lead a team, following the coordinates Moore gave you, acting as fast as possible.
The stairwell is cold and humid, with inconspicuous water stains that haven't been evaporated by the sun.
You sense something is wrong and immediately run upstairs.
The run-down room you saw in L.L.'s consciousness appears before you, with no extra furniture, just an old bathtub by the window.
The two computers set on the bathtub are still on, displaying the forum page you are very familiar with.
Welcome to Elysiland!
This restaurant, with its lively and cute manta ray sign, is bustling with business and chatter. The busy orders are like sizzling oil in a pan, heating up the atmosphere to a fever pitch.

speaker: Customer A
content: Pudding! I want pudding!!! A mountain of pudding!!! Triple the cream!!!

speaker: Customer B
content: Is this what caviar tastes like? I'd say a store-brand salad dressing is better! But this foie gras is alright. I'll have five more. No, fifteen!

speaker: Customer C
content: Pizza, milkshake, burger, fried chicken, fries, cake! Everything is zero calories here! Zero calories!
The air is filled with moisture and a savory aroma, but the customers still sound ravenous. The comfort from food is fleeting, and waves of desire come and go endlessly like tides.
Luckily, this small, charming restaurant seems to have an inexhaustible supply of ingredients and countless recipes, effortlessly accommodating the diners' picky and greedy demands.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Is this <color=#fb9259>Elysiland, where all wishes come true</color>? It does seem more convincing than those fake ads with cheap gimmicks.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Impeccably cooked, well-seasoned, made with fresh ingredients, and beautifully presented...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Hehe, it's been long since I last found a dish I was willing to put in my mouth.
L.L., who's decided to play server for fun today, is delighted by her compliments. She bounces over to Cabernet, her wavy dress making her look like a beautiful little fish.

speaker: L.L.
content: It's such an honor to be approved by Cabernet the gourmet!

speaker: L.L.
content: These are the chef's specials, creamy salmon and beef bourguignon. Hope you'll enjoy, Miss Cabernet.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The aroma alone warrants a pass. I'm looking forward to the surprise it will bring me.
The noblewoman nods to L.L. and picks up the knife and fork. L.L. watches her intently, as if admiring the intoxicated, closed-eyed expression she shows while savoring the food.
But the next moment, L.L. suddenly closes the distance to Cabernet. She stares straight at her, her light-colored eyes reflecting every detail of that aristocratic face.

speaker: L.L.
content: But... Miss Cabernet, why do I feel like you aren't genuinely satisfied?
L.L. tilts her head. Though she's asking a question, her tone is strangely assertive.

speaker: L.L.
content: We've served you so many delicacies, and although you've been praising them, you've only taken a bite of each or even just a dab of the sauce...

speaker: L.L.
content: You aren't really satisfied with these dishes at all, are you?

speaker: Cabernet
content: How could that be? I never lie about food.

speaker: L.L.
content: Then... I suppose you're only expecting more from me and this island, right? You hope to taste the flavors here that you can't find in reality.

speaker: Cabernet
content: As expected of Elysiland's owner, you can tell right away if a person's joy is genuine.
The red-haired woman dips her index finger in the sauce on the plate and brings it to her tongue. Then, she waves it elegantly, as if showcasing the texture or denying something.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The food here is indeed of excellent quality. It's decent enough. I can taste that they all contain the same ingredient, which is desire.

speaker: Cabernet
content: It is a wonderful ingredient, requiring neither technique nor creativity to provide a satisfying texture and aroma.

speaker: Cabernet
content: But desire can only quell hunger or soothe restlessness deceptively. No matter how much you eat, in the end, your stomach remains empty.
Cabernet cuts a small piece of meat, holds it at the tip of her fork, and gazes at it tenderly, as if looking at someone through the food.

speaker: Cabernet
content: And of course, above all... it can't replicate the taste of soul I was expecting. That rich, delectable, layered flavor that drew me here in the first place!

speaker: L.L.
content: Ah... I see.
L.L. gobbles up that piece of meat, licks off the sauce, and then falls into thoughtful silence for a while.

speaker: L.L.
content: If I understand you correctly... Is your wish "to meet the most interesting person on the island"?

speaker: L.L.
content: The central kitchen's products are all the same, but an interesting soul would make the most unique seasoning, right?

speaker: Cabernet
content: That's right. The dishes your restaurant currently offers are like the colorful ice cream at a party. The difference is only in the colorant of the syrup, not the flavor itself.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Such artificial food can't bring joy. It only makes people miss the fresh and wonderful stimulation from the soul all the more...

speaker: Cabernet
content: That is the genuine, ultimate joy! The kind of joy promised by this island is what I was expecting!
She seems to be getting heady at her own words, and her intoxicated look thrills L.L. too, who can't help but cup Cabernet's blushing face.

speaker: L.L.
content: Yes, yes, that's it. Chase the joy, get drunk over it, never let it go...

speaker: L.L.
content: Miss Cabernet, it's like you're made for Elysiland... Will you stay and coach my restaurant? With your advice, it can only get better...
The voice stops abruptly. The girl stares down blankly at the fair-complexioned hand sinking into her chest.
Before the surprised sigh fades, Cabernet has already withdrawn her hand swiftly!

speaker: Cabernet
content: As the island owner, it's your duty to satisfy everyone's desire, isn't it? Even if... it means sacrificing yourself.

speaker: Cabernet
content: My wish isn't that complicated... I only want to have a taste of <color=#fb9259>you</color>.

speaker: Cabernet
content: But how sad, it seems like Elysiland isn't a place where <color=#fb9259>all</color> wishes come true, after all.
She shakes her right hand regretfully. Her fingers remain as immaculate as ever, tinged by neither fresh ingredients nor bloody liquid.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The food is made with desire, and the owner is a projection. Even if it does pique my curiosity, in the end, it's nothing but an empty illusion.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I guess there's no need for me to stay any longer.
Cabernet glances at L.L. standing unscathed behind the table before flicking her long hair with a smile.

speaker: Cabernet
content: But if you can come to me in person... I'll be looking forward to it.

speaker: Cabernet
content: After all, you should suit my taste.
Swish... Swish...
The sound of the waves crashing on the beach is gentle and rhythmic, as if lulling the heart exhausted from work into relaxation.

speaker: Eleven
content: Sigh... I can hardly keep my eyes open...

speaker: Eleven
content: It must be all those back-to-back night and day shifts these days... I'm so tired I'm hallucinating... I can actually hear the sound of waves...

speaker: Eleven
content: ...Huh?! Why am I hearing waves?
The woman jolts up on the beach chair, looking around. To her surprise, she finds herself on a beach with fine white sand by the clear blue sea.
The warm air makes her skin sweat, and the light sea breeze instantly cools her down, wiping off her drowsiness.
Around her, people in beachwear are playing and laughing. Splashing water at each other, the drenched figures run past Eleven, almost bumping into her.

speaker: Eleven
content: This feels so good... Anyway, there's still time. I suppose a little break won't hurt.

speaker: Eleven
content: Come to think of it, I've never seen the ocean in real life. This can be a nice research opportunity for my show. My listeners would like this sound.
Convincing herself, Eleven wanders on the beach timidly. Soon, her attention is caught by some white conches washed up by the waves.
Curious, she picks one up and places it to her ear, listening to its echoes.

speaker: Eleven
content: I hear something inside! Are these little things the ocean's phones? Pick one up and it may connect you to the sea...

speaker: Eleven
content: Hello? Can you hear me, listeners in the sea? I bet life in such a relaxed environment shouldn't be too stressful, right?

speaker: Eleven
content: Ah... Then, would you guys need my voice?

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: Your voice is so lovely. All my stress would be gone the moment I hear you speak!

speaker: Eleven
content: ...?! Who... who are you...?
Eleven suddenly hears a lively voice. Startled, she moves the conch away at once and searches around.
But the voice is indeed coming from the conch.

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: It doesn't matter who I am. What matters is that you've arrived at Elysiland, where any wish can come true!

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: Be bold and greedy. Just indulge yourself! You can make everyone fall in love with your voice and go crazy for it. You can even make them do as you command!

speaker: Eleven
content: Fall in love with my voice, and even... do as command? Me? Really?

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: Of course!

speaker: Eleven
content: You're saying, these people on the beach will listen to whatever I say?

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: They will all listen to you!

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: Every word you say, they'll listen to it attentively and do as they're told, turning it into reality!

Noticing Eleven's hesitation, L.L.'s voice grows more angelic. She waves her hand, and a few colorful sparkles flash by, giving Eleven a new outfit. She goes to sit on the small "throne" on the beach.

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: Come on. Try wielding your authority over the beach! You'll like it.

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: Wow, it's been an hour! You're pretty tough, huh. Let's see how much longer you can stay buried!

speaker: Eleven
content: Wait... wait a minute. It's too sunny now. Don't bury him in the sand for too long. He might get heatstroke... Help him get out.

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: Oh, oh, sure. I'll dig him out right away!
Eleven made a try to advise a guest who gets too excited on his first visit to the beach, expecting him to be like her stubborn listeners who ignore her words.
But to her surprise, he didn't brush her off but instead became sensible immediately as if on command, following Eleven's advice to dig out his friend.

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: See, you did great! Your voice has power!

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: Everyone will do as you say! They should listen to you, or else there will be danger!

speaker: Eleven
content: Be sure to warm up before going into the water. The seawater is quite cold, you may get a cramp...

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Got it! Miss Eleven, I'll warm up now!

speaker: Eleven
content: Hey, you! Don't swim to the dangerous area! And you! Don't overeat before going into the water. Stay alert!
Eleven's voice echoes on the beach, gradually becoming different and filled with authority. The guests are also intimidated by her and all follow her instructions.
For a moment, the chaotic beach becomes orderly and safe, as if the previous uninhibited revelry was just an illusion.

speaker: Eleven
content: It's true... Here, everything I say gets a response...

speaker: Eleven
content: No one pretends not to hear or understand me anymore. This is wonderful, hehe...

speaker: Voice in the Conch
content: Yes, that's right. Everything you say is right... As long as you're here, no one can ignore your voice... Keep going, Eleven, keep going!
Eleven clenches her hands, watching everything with excitement and a satisfied, thrilled smile. To maintain safety on the beach, her scolding and instructions echo along the shore.

speaker: Summer
content: ...In conclusion, the strongest unit in all the Gandam series is No. 135! I'll always be a fan of the Four Heavenly Lords!

speaker: L.L.
content: Eh? But No. 135 is only a backup of the Three Heavenly Lords! When it became famous, two of the original Three Lords had already been destroyed!

speaker: L.L.
content: And the greatest achievement you mentioned is from the TV anime! As a manga reader, I don't think it's fair to use this to prove its strength!

speaker: Summer
content: Wow, you even know that?! Didn't you say you'd never watched Gandam before?!

speaker: Summer
content: Did you lie to me? You're in fact not Elysiland's owner, but an angel sent to make up for the regrets of my high school years!

speaker: Summer
content: A higher-dimensional being must have erased you—my best friend in high school in another timeline, and put you here now!

speaker: Summer
content: That's why I meet you here! My destined BFF...?!

speaker: L.L.
content: Hehe, maybe that's true! Something must be driving you to seek happiness and joy, which is why you came here...
The blue-haired girl waves her hand behind her back surreptitiously, and the little manta ray flailing on the pile of blu-ray discs and manga e-books vanishes instantly.

speaker: L.L.
content: Now you believe me, right? Whether you want to chat with a fellow enthusiast or binge-watch anime alone, this place can grant all your wishes!

speaker: L.L.
content: Forget those ridiculous restrictions. Who wouldn't want to snuggle cozily in the couch and just eat chocolate and watch anime all day? Enjoy yourself here and indulge in pure joy!
The girl spins around before Summer can pounce on her for a big hug, transforming into glowing particles like water droplets and vanishing in the air.
But where she disappears, a huge building rises. A dreamland specially tailored for Summer!

speaker: Summer
content: An out-of-print manga library... The Sweet Treat Wonderland... A New Dis-2 studio for anime and tokusatsu films, complete with all the post-production services...

speaker: Summer
content: It's all real! I can't even decide what to do first! But how can a hero be so easily stopped by indecision?

speaker: Summer
content: Let me pick a random number to guide my future! Hmm, the first stop is decided, the Sweet Treat Wonderland!
Anime, manga, unlimited chocolate and ice cream, inexhaustible filming sets... All of these deeply fascinate and captivate Summer.
She even takes a moment to feel smug for having clicked the URL and not missing all of this.

speaker: Summer
content: Ah... Feels so good! Shooting The Age of Youth Remake while enjoying an ice cream is like having a massage for the soul!

speaker: Summer
content: And when I get tired, I can just lie on the beach and flip through the original edition of GoGo's Daily Adventure. Talk about living it up!
The girl lies on the beach chair and covers her face with an open manga, breathing out a sweet, satisfied sigh.
But just as the warm darkness covers her eyes, Summer catches a strange sound coming from the beach.

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: Wow! What was that just now?!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Huh? What?

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: No, didn't you see it? Something seemed to flash by just now...

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: It looked a bit like... a big fish!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: I get it, you just haven't had enough to drink. What big fish? The big fish is with the island owner!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: I mean, hic, only the island owner can control the big fish! Come on, have another drink, and then we'll go see the big fish! No, let's go dancing!

speaker: Summer
content: Island... Big fish?
She gets up and walks to the edge of the beach, pinching the fine white sand.
The touch feels real. Perhaps too real... Summer notices something's slightly off.

speaker: Summer
content: Maybe this island... is more interesting than I thought.

speaker: Summer
content: But it'll be a shame if I don't enjoy every byte of it before taking it apart!
Like the other guests, the girl lets her instincts take over and chooses to continue luxuriating in this paradise. She hums an anime theme song and picks up the priceless out-of-print manga again.
The dim room is so quiet that breaths of the only person inside are audible. The only light source is her phone screen with its brightness set to the lowest.

The girl looks extremely young, but she has already mastered the technique of touching the screen with only her fingertips, making no tapping sound with her nails at all, as if she's a well-trained secret agent.
She is like a quiet, inconspicuous mushroom growing in a dark corner. An otherwise cramped environment makes her feel safe and at ease.

<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> Has this happened to anyone else? I was just checking a DM on a forum, and the moment I opened it I was gone! One second and I ended up in a place I'd never seen before!
<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> What's happening? Is this some new type of scam? Or has my crazy classmate finally decided to abduct me?

<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> I thought since I'm here, I might as well think of it as a free vacation. But the other people in the group are all so weird. It's like they're on some kind of drug. They're all acting a bit crazy and frankly just despicable.
<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> They keep shoving things they think I'd like at me. It's so annoying! Who'd like those fluffy things anyway!
<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> We were all taken to this place against our will anyway, why do they keep lecturing me like they think they're better than me? GET LOST!

On the gray forum page, glowing characters stream down like a waterfall. One after another, approving replies refresh at the bottom of the screen, and the red notification for likes flashes frequently.
Shrooma seems encouraged, typing more and more excitedly. Her fingers tapping away turn into a blur above the black smartphone, the emotions in her text almost dripping off the screen.
But just as everything appears to be going well, someone pushes open the window from the outside, interrupting this revelry in the two-dimensional world.

speaker: Unknown Guest A
content: Whoa, look, they even allow little kids like this on Elysiland.

speaker: Unknown Guest A
content: No way, are you doing your homework on Elysiland? Hey, kiddo, put that away! Come out and play!

speaker: Unknown Guest B
content: Hahaha! Exactly, forget all about your homework or studies here. Can't you see we're right next to the real sea here? Don't you want to play?

With her back turned to them, Shrooma rolls her eyes at the two, but when she turns around, she has already put on an innocent and adorable look, responding to the adults' "kind advice" softly with her head bowed.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Mom and Dad say no matter where I am, I must stick to my routine: homework, lesson preparation, and memorizing stuff I've learned. Once I finish, I can go play. Thank you for inviting me!

The sea breeze lifts the curtain covering the window. The light pouring in reveals the room's dreamy true appearance. Colorful veils, cute plush toys, and expensive anime and game merch. Not to mention the bright, attractive beach facilities outside the window. But Shrooma remains completely unmoved.
The disappointed guests leave without noticing that Shrooma is still typing her post rapidly in the dark corner.

speaker: L.L.
content: I thought a kid her age loved these kinds of things? But she doesn't seem interested at all... Hmm, intriguing.

speaker: L.L.
content: Hmm? A new post on the forum at this hour?

<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> Argh, here we go again. Another busybody! Why do you care if I've eaten or if I'm gonna go out? I'm not some naive kid who'll believe that this place can grant all your wishes just because you tell me so!
<color=#fb9259>DoomSwamp:</color> This isn't some weird education camp my helicopter relatives have signed me up for, is this?! I'm seriously at my wit's end!
The loading bar fills up and the post is successfully sent. Shrooma stares at the updated post and sighs.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Sigh, the internet speed here is pretty good though. But it's almost been an hour, it's almost time for my internet curfew... I really don't want to go offline yet...

speaker: Shrooma
content: It's almost meal time too. It's probably going to be those healthy veggies they think are good for me. Just thinking about it kills my appetite...

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...Huh? How do I still have access to the internet? Is something wrong with the parental control software...?
She tests it by liking a forum post she's been following. The number updates immediately, and the homepage content continues to refresh smoothly.
The girl seems to realize something and dashes to the pink microwave used for ordering food. Sure enough, there she finds a kid's meal overloaded with sugar and fat.

speaker: Shrooma
content: There's nothing I don't want! What's going on? Have I been bugged?

speaker: Shrooma
content: Or is this place really just as that suspicious tagline says... A place where <color=#fb9259>all wishes come true</color>?

speaker: Shrooma
content: Then would it be okay if I asked for... hmm, a soft doll that won't hurt when I punch it?

speaker: Gentle Voice
content: Of course! You don't need to hold back here on Elysiland. Everything you want, we have it!

speaker: Gentle Voice
content: And you can rest assured! The only rule here is joy. You don't have to worry about anyone criticizing you. Everything here happens only to meet your expectations!

With that unknown voice, the revolving wardrobe spins open, from which a giant doll falls out. Shrooma grips her black smartphone and cautiously takes two steps back, only to find that the voice is coming from a small speaker.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Who are you? Are you the owner of this place? Can-can you hear me?

speaker: Shrooma
content: So I guess no one's monitoring me... I just hope in the end no one's gonna jump out and announce that I've lost all my credits or something...
Though her tone still remains cautious, having had her wishes granted a few times already, Shrooma visibly relaxes her guard.

She takes one last look around to confirm no one is watching her, and that the internet is still connected. She picks up her phone, sits on the bed, curls up like a little mushroom, and starts typing away.
She takes a deep breath and steps onto the long-spread red carpet.
Behind the door are clamoring people and countless camera flashes. The girl inhales deeply and pushes open the door...

speaker: Luvia
content: Wow! Look at the beautiful sea and beach! I've only seen something like that on a set in the studio, never the real thing!

speaker: Luvia
content: Oh! Could this really be the place where all my wishes come true? Did it hear my wish in the studio?!

speaker: L.L.
content: You're exactly right!
As Luvia Ray checks out the surroundings, a blue-haired girl walks out of the sea and takes her hands very friendly. Her wet skin and cool palms make Luvia shiver slightly.

speaker: L.L.
content: I know you! How gorgeous you are! I've watched every show you've performed in!

speaker: L.L.
content: That's why I arranged a red carpet show for you specifically and brought you to my island. I wanted you to experience the joy of being a superstar...
Luvia's eyes light up instantly.

speaker: Luvia
content: So everything just now... It was all prepared by you!
Luvia holds L.L.'s hand and takes her onto the red carpet.
Sure enough, the cheering and shutter noise she heard earlier stir again. Not only that, Luvia Ray can also clearly hear what people are cheering about.

speaker: Cheers
content: The Best Actress! Luvia Ray! A well-deserved academy award winner!

speaker: Cheers
content: I know all of your movies by heart down to each frame! They're so perfect!

speaker: Cheers
content: You're really the best out there!
The crowd's shouts are fervent and insistent. They all stretch out their arms, desperately wanting to touch the dazzling legendary movie star.

speaker: Luvia
content: Ahh... This is truly a scene right out of my dreams!
Surprisingly, upon hearing the praise, Luvia stumbles back a little amid the rising waves of cheers, taking L.L. with her.

speaker: Luvia
content: I'm not as good as you guys say... I'm, I'm so nervous I'm getting all sweaty...
L.L. props her chin and frowns at Luvia.

speaker: L.L.
content: But haven't you always wanted to be recognized by the audience... Why aren't you happy now that they're all praising you? Hmm...
Looking at Luvia's genuinely confused expression, an idea crosses L.L.'s mind.

speaker: L.L.
content: I got it. Think carefully, when you say you want to be "recognized," is there a specific person in your mind?

speaker: L.L.
content: This person is the one from whom you most want the approval. You don't care what others think!
Hearing L.L.'s words, the girl falls into pensive silence. After a while, she snaps back to reality and grabs L.L.'s hands firmly.

speaker: Luvia
content: Exactly! You're absolutely right!

speaker: Luvia
content: When the audience praise my acting, of course, I'm really glad, but... there is indeed this one person who I would love to hear compliments from. It'd be more than a dream come true!

speaker: Luvia
content: Sigh, but I know my acting skills aren't at that level yet... How should I hone my craft? Preferably a normal method, not Mania...

speaker: L.L.
content: Hmm, I got you. Let me see...
Luvia's bright eyes and those tense, whitened fingertips demonstrate to L.L. certain sides of her, which are not captured by the red carpet shows or filming studios.
Intrigued, she licks her lips and looks pensive for a moment. After a while, L.L. claps her hands excitedly.

speaker: L.L.
content: I know! Maybe you can try the mirror method!

speaker: Luvia
content: Mirror... method?

speaker: L.L.
content: Yes, I hear that a very talented actress used to always practice in front of a mirror and achieved great success. Everyone admired her!

speaker: L.L.
content: According to her, once you've practiced enough, you'd feel like the person in the mirror is your other half, like a sister. You can feel her approval through the mirror.

speaker: Luvia
content: A reflection of a sister... Are you saying that the mirror can show me Ray?!
Luvia gets all excited and looks longingly at L.L., who grants her wish by conjuring up a luxurious framed mirror with a snap of her fingers.

speaker: L.L.
content: We're on Elysiland, where all wishes come true. What you see depends on what you desire! So, act to your heart's content, and you will be rewarded.
She emphasizes the word rewarded with a knowing smile, then leans back and plunges back into the seawater, disappearing.

speaker: Luvia
content: "Go away, this damned red mark! Go away! It's so dark here!"

speaker: Luvia
content: "They're laughing at me! I'm sure they're laughing at me!"

The sky gradually darkens, with only the mirror reflecting a dying light. It illuminates the girl making various hysterical and exaggerated movements in front of the mirror, like a spotlight from the abyss.
Even more strangely, the reflection in the mirror behaves completely out of sync with her. "She" simply keeps clapping and smiling, and urges the girl outside the mirror to get closer and closer.

speaker: Luvia
content: "How do I look? Am I beautiful? Mirror, answer me!"

Finally, the girl gradually stops moving like a toy running out of battery. Luvia stands in front of the mirror, her breathing unusually shallow. After a moment, she suddenly lunges toward the mirror...
But the expected collision doesn't happen. Her entire head is swallowed by the glass surface, which has turned into water!

speaker: Ray
content: Get out! Run!! Leave this cursed place!!!
At the critical moment, the reflection's movement is twisted by an unknown force, turning from a dramatic, unsettling embrace into a desperate push!
The encouraging smile also disappears. The reflection in the mirror, identical to Luvia, seems to break free from its restraints, overcoming the mirror's tension and pushing Luvia out.

With a crisp shattering sound, the strange suction stops all of a sudden. The unknown force also pulls Ray through the mirror, the powerful recoil causing her to fall on top of Luvia, their identical faces pressed together.

speaker: Luvia
content: Ray! It's you... It's really you...!

speaker: Luvia
content: You saved me again. I can finally touch you. Your hands are so warm!

speaker: Ray
content: ...Yours are warm too.

speaker: Ray
content: No, now is not the time for this! If I hadn't pushed you away just now, you would have completely fallen into the trap! You...

speaker: L.L.
content: Hey, this isn't a trap! It's just a little performance to grant both of your wishes!

speaker: L.L.
content: Luvia's wish is to gain Ray's approval, and Ray's wish is to protect Luvia... I've just killed two birds with one stone. Pretty impressive, right?
The girl with a body made of vapor appears smugly next to them, seeming to be waiting for her well-deserved compliments with her flushed cheeks.
But what she gets is only Ray's cold response.

speaker: Ray
content: This idiot may believe you, but I won't.

speaker: Ray
content: Let's go, Luvia. We can't stay here any longer. With your tiny brain, you'll get eaten alive by this island owner.

speaker: L.L.
content: Hey, are you leaving already? Here, you can touch her and you don't have to fight over the same body and consciousness. Isn't it nice to be free?!

speaker: Ray
content: ...I couldn't care less. I just want Luvia to be safe. This place is far too dangerous for her.
Watching Ray take Luvia away without a second of hesitation, L.L. deactivates the mechanism sustaining Ray's form in frustration. Ray fades gradually, but there's not a hint of regret on her face.

speaker: L.L.
content: Sigh... You've just got here... You're going to regret leaving so soon!

speaker: L.L.
content: But... it is indeed enviable that someone is willing to go to such lengths to protect her... Hmph, I've got Manty with me too. Yes, I do. I definitely don't envy them.

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: Hey, you're in my way, you know? Look where you're going, idiot!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Why must you park your car next to mine when there are so many spaces left? If you dare scratch my car, I'll ruin yours!

speaker: Elysiland Guest C
content: Are you done taking pictures yet? Is nothing else going on in your brain? Just swap it out for a camera in that case!

A scene of utmost chaos is unfolding. Someone's suddenly pushing a pedestrian, and another person's smashing a car with a crowbar. Someone has even grabbed another person's camera, shoving it into the owner's mouth.
Quarrels and brawls echo throughout the street. Everyone in sight is venting their anger freely. Shocked, Shrooma grips her black smartphone tightly, standing dumbfounded.

speaker: Shrooma
content: What is this place...?
Shrooma is struck by everything she sees, but the girl beside her is evidently proud of the scene before them. This is her creation, based on Shrooma's wish.

speaker: L.L.
content: Isn't this the place you've always dreamed of?

speaker: L.L.
content: I've told you before. The only rule here is joy. Everything here happens only to meet your expectations!

speaker: Shrooma
content: You're not joking with me, right?

speaker: Shrooma
content: This isn't some reality show where they put you in a huge glass box, is it? Is this the moment of the big revelation?
L.L. observes Shrooma, whose little face has stiffened, and pinches her cheek sympathetically. She then brushes her hand over the smartphone in Shrooma's hand like she's implying something.

speaker: L.L.
content: You worry too much for a kid your age. Rest assured, I can guarantee you that no one is monitoring you here. No one is going to judge you or stop you from doing anything!

speaker: L.L.
content: Haven't you always talked about the life you want on the forum? Now I've created such a place for you. Here, you can do whatever pleases you!

speaker: L.L.
content: No more suppressing yourself. Let it all out and get your rebellion!

speaker: Shrooma
content: Let it all out? Rebellion? No way... you know I'm on the forum...?!

speaker: L.L.
content: You don't need to be afraid. You can post whatever you want. I will support all your ideas!
The girl hides her smartphone behind her back, looking panicked. But L.L.'s smile calms her down, prompting her to think and process the current situation.

speaker: Shrooma
content: These people are indeed acting according to the fantasies I posted on the forums... You've turned my posts into reality!

speaker: Shrooma
content: But don't they say no one can crack the anonymity of that forum on the dark web? How did you do it?! No... I can feel that your power is much stronger than mine... Are you not only the creator of this island, but also related to the dark web?!

speaker: L.L.
content: What a bright kid, you guessed it right! But don't worry. Only I, the master of the forum and the owner of this island, can link you to your account. Your anonymity is intact.

speaker: L.L.
content: My intention isn't to uncover your true identity. I just thought it was a shame having to hide and not fully enjoy yourself. I don't want your interesting ideas to go to waste!

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...You think my ideas are interesting? Even on the dark web, people think I go too far. You don't think this is just some disgusting filth that deserves only to be shoved to the corner or a swamp, out of everyone's sight?
L.L. chuckles as if she has just heard a nonsensical joke.

speaker: L.L.
content: Filth? Disgusting? Why? Your little ideas are cute and creative!

speaker: L.L.
content: I don't think they're any different from, say, wishing to binge eat without gaining weight! Elysiland is a place to satisfy everyone's desires. No one should be excluded!

speaker: L.L.
content: So go ahead and let out everything you've been hiding! If someone says you only deserve to live in a swamp, then turn the whole world into a swamp! Show them!

speaker: Shrooma
content: Yes! That's exactly what I think! I can't believe you agree with me!
The girl has never had such a pleasant surprise. Her gaze toward L.L. turns friendly. And after L.L. gestures at the thick swamp around the pool, the friendliness turns into reverence.

speaker: L.L.
content: Of course! I've already told you, your wish is just as worthy as anyone else's!

speaker: L.L.
content: Besides, you're not alone! Look over there, see those people getting drawn in? They're just as happy about the swamp as you are!

speaker: L.L.
content: The more content and satisfied you guys are, the more energy this island gains, and the stronger I become! That way, the world you desire will grow even larger too!

More and more people discover the spreading swamp. They gather around to shout angrily and jostle at each other, wreaking havoc. After venting thoroughly, they leave feeling relieved, resuming their gluttonous feasting.
The malice they leave behind slowly settles into the murky swamp, stirring up numerous sticky, filthy muddy bubbles. The swamp expands and engulfs, replacing the beach and coral reefs.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Amazing... The swamp has grown... My habitat is expanding...
Shrooma's smartphone screen lights up at some point, illuminating her ecstatic face. But just then, the island suddenly shakes violently.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Wh-what just happened? My swamp... Did I do something wrong? My swamp just got...!

speaker: L.L.
content: Easy, it has nothing to do with you. It's just some bad guys trying to take you away!

speaker: L.L.
content: A peculiar wish, isn't it? But also a sincere one. So the island will make his wish come true!
female_content: A peculiar wish, isn't it? But also a sincere one. So the island will make her wish come true!

content: L.L. pats Shrooma's head in a comforting manner, still smiling brightly.

speaker: Shrooma
content: But... if the island is destroyed, what will happen to me and my swamp? I don't want to hide anymore!

speaker: Shrooma
content: No, I must protect this place, the place where my wishes can come true... I must protect the island owner!

L.L. has clearly won the girl's loyalty, so much so that she's even worrying about losing Elysiland. She clenches her fists, her tone full of unusual energy despite the unsettling darkness underlying her words.

speaker: Shrooma
content: I will turn the entire island into a swamp, and let it sink to the bottom of the sea where no one can reach! That way, I can protect everyone and my swamp!

speaker: Sadistic Female Voice
content: Did I tell you to move your legs? Stupid dog!

speaker: Elysiland Guest A
content: I, I'm sorry! Punish me, please punish me! Ahhh!
The sound of a whip slashing through the air and an uncontrollable cry of pleasure come from the beach.

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Ahhh!!!

speaker: Elysiland Guest B
content: Wait, I'm not dead? I'm not dead! I'm still alive!!! Oh my god, that near-death rush of adrenaline feels so good!!!

From further out in the sea come screams of dying victims and cheers of relieved survivors. Everyone is intoxicated by this dangerous pleasure, even craving more, not bothering to hide this bizarre addiction.

speaker: Serpent
content: Oh? Do these happenings really please them so much?

speaker: Serpent
content: A paradise "full of laughter where everyone enjoys themselves." The eternally blissful Elysiland... It really is something.
That colorful website looked suspicious, but the tagline claiming everyone can find happiness still piqued Serpent's curiosity enough that she clicked it open.
Next thing she knew, she found herself standing on an unknown island. Although there is constant laughter around, it almost all comes first from painful screams.

speaker: Serpent
content: Are people truly into these things that hurt them and cause them pain?

speaker: Serpent
content: And here I am thinking that only when they watch others despair and flirt with danger from a safe spot, they're thrilled enough to spare a tip... Am I wrong?
Joy comes in many forms!
Serpent's surprise draws the island owner to her. She emerges beside her effortlessly, like a pretty little fish.

speaker: L.L.
content: And Elysiland is exactly the place where they can all exist freely! There are no restrictions here, so everything is possible!

speaker: L.L.
content: You should try something that interests you too! With so many choices available, there's bound to be something that brings you joy!
L.L. twirls in the water proudly. Countless bubbles rise and drift to different corners of the island, as if showing off to Serpent the variety of entertainment abundant here.

speaker: Serpent
content: Something that brings me joy? That might be difficult. Just like it's probably hard to please you too. That's why you go to such lengths to devise these strange ways of entertainment, right?

speaker: Serpent
content: I can only feel joy when I see others find it. So, according to you, how should I seek my own joy here?
Serpent smiles, but there's an edge to her words, just like the faintly visible fangs between her pink lips.

speaker: Serpent
content: Oh, I forgot, you're the owner of Elysiland! This question shouldn't be too hard for you, right?

speaker: Serpent
content: You're not gonna tell me you can't grant my wish and bring me joy, are you?
L.L. and Serpent stand face to face, like two pretty reflections in a mirror of water.

speaker: L.L.
content: Of course not! Don't worry, I understand the pain everyone faces and know how to replace it with true joy!

speaker: L.L.
content: Including yours! You've found that beyond your performance, there are many other things that can please people, a kind of joy you can't comprehend or provide...

speaker: L.L.
content: That's why you're upset and annoyed. Am I right?

speaker: Serpent
content: I like the way you talk. You sound just like me. So tell me, your little trick, what's it gonna be?
L.L. wants to touch Serpent's fang but withdraws her hand smilingly when she receives a glare.

speaker: L.L.
content: There's none! I simply want you to know that the fun provided here doesn't contradict your belief. They even complement each other!

speaker: L.L.
content: Just go and experience all the joyful activities on the island yourself. Understand them, digest them, and integrate them into your own performance!

speaker: L.L.
content: Maybe then, you'll be able to bring joy to everyone on the island!

speaker: L.L.
content: You might just create the most unique kind of joy, making Elysiland burst into unprecedented satisfaction and pleasure because of you!
Her words flow out like honey, the sweet temptation hooking Serpent's most greedy desires.

speaker: Serpent
content: Wow bingo! This is indeed an opportunity! A chance to experience the most diverse, unrestrained, and personal joys!

speaker: Serpent
content: It'll allow me to please even more people and enrich my dreams with even more unique forms of joy!
Her desire awakened, Serpent immediately embarks on a tour of Elysiland, leaving L.L. who cheers her on contentedly.

speaker: L.L.
content: That's right! Elysiland will surely suit your needs! No place can offer more unique and comprehensive joy!
She cups her face in excitement, watching Serpent's back as she enters one facility after another. Her words tremble, her face flushes, and her voice rises higher!

speaker: L.L.
content: The joy of binge eating, of exercising, of being controlled, of trampling on others... Stack it up! This joy has no end! Experience it all!

speaker: Serpent
content: So this is... the accumulation of joy? Numbers keep growing, money keeps rolling in... Another zero, the sense of achievement of breaking yet another record...

speaker: Serpent
content: So this is how it feels for those addicted to someone else's control... The relief of surrendering all thoughts, obligations, and burdens...

speaker: Serpent
content: Aside from the taste buds' rapture, swallowing alone can bring such pleasure... Turning everything into a part of you, from opening the mouth, savoring, chewing, to swallowing, every step is so joyful...
Serpent traverses the island, moving through spaces built by the guests' various desires, observing their expressions and behaviors, tasting and sharing their rapture.

speaker: Serpent
content: Where else haven't I been... Where's more joy to be had...
Her consciousness gorged with overstimulation, Serpent feels dazed with satiation. As she exits the building, something falls out of her pocket.
The hard object hits the ground, and the cover automatically opens.

speaker: Serpent
content: I want to know... more, more forms of joy...
At that moment, a crisp and bright music box melody suddenly plays. The tinkling tune stands out starkly in the rich, decadent atmosphere.

speaker: Serpent
content: What is... this sound? It sounds familiar...
She turns around and picks up the small box. Inside the circus tent, the carousel keeps spinning and spinning. The thin metal plates vibrate, gradually syncing the music with Serpent's heartbeat.

speaker: Serpent
content: It sounds... so familiar...

speaker: Serpent
content: Am I... dreaming again?
The gray figure in the dream is growing clearer. He breaks through the fog and walks forward, the slowly rising hand exuding a calming strength. Serpent stares at the warm palm and smiles.
female_content: The gray figure in the dream is growing clearer. She breaks through the fog and walks forward, the slowly rising hand exuding a calming strength. Serpent stares at the warm palm and smiles.

speaker: Serpent
content: I know, as long as I'm by your side, I won't feel pain.

speaker: Serpent
content: Even if I wake from the dream, it's okay.
The moment she grabs the person's hand, the music stutters, and Serpent's body turns into white powder, disappearing from Elysiland.

speaker: L.L.
content: Hmm? Little Coral, who gave you such beautiful eyes?

speaker: L.L.
content: Wow, Mr. Clam, you've got a pair too?
The coral, the sculptures, the TV... Every object has gained a pair of beautiful eyes, with long eyelashes and bright irises, all blinking uniformly and affectionately in all directions.

speaker: L.L.
content: These eyes... look kind of familiar...

speaker: L.L.
content: Such a unique hobby. How interesting. Is it the work of that plastic surgeon from Eastside?

speaker: L.L.
content: Manty, let's go! We should join her in this cosmetic wonderland!

speaker: Restless Voice
content: This candy looks hideous! It should have eyes that are second to none!

speaker: Restless Voice
content: Not the vulgar, cookie-cutter kind, but eyes with longer lashes, better translucency, and definitely no redness... They should be clear and warm eyes!

speaker: Uni
content: No, no, these are not the eyes I want. Something's missing... Need a little more tweaking...

Restless Mania swirls around Uni, occasionally spilling out crystallized particles, some landing on her and slowly melting into a sticky syrup, leaving winding traces. Unaware of all this, she has clearly lost control.
Forensica

speaker: Uni
content: Alright, now you have eyes... Tsk, but they're still not quite right. They're not up to that standard!

speaker: L.L.
content: Hey, don't throw it away! Don't those eyes look pretty good?
L.L. appears just in time, interrupting Uni before her irritation reaches the breaking point, calming her down from her burgeoning anger.

speaker: L.L.
content: Or, have you just come up with another wish that my island hasn't yet fulfilled?

speaker: Uni
content: ...This island? I don't see any major issues. It's passable, at least in terms of looks.

speaker: Uni
content: The only problem is that too many things are missing a pair of beautiful eyes. Once I fix that, I'd say I'm generally satisfied.

speaker: L.L.
content: A positive review from Uni! What a surprise! People on the internet say you're stingy with your compliments!

speaker: Uni
content: It's just that...

speaker: L.L.
content: It's just that?
The brewing frustration surrounding her returns, casting a shadow over Uni's brow as she slams the candy heavily on the desk in front of her.

speaker: Uni
content: It's just that I can't create those eyes I want even here! The perfect pair of eyes!

speaker: Uni
content: I'm getting closer each time, but never close enough! There's always something off!
The shattering of the hard candy seems to unleash Uni's emotions. Her long-unfulfilled desire, magnified by Elysiland, has pushed her to the brink!

speaker: L.L.
content: I understand that feeling. It can indeed be very frustrating! But this is Elysiland, where your wish will definitely come true! Just think harder. Desire it more intensely!

speaker: L.L.
content: Maybe what you want is already on the island, or on its way here?
Her enticing, dream-like tone does not succeed in soothing her, instead only eliciting a firm rebuttal.

speaker: Uni
content: That's never gonna happen.

speaker: L.L.
content: Huh? Why?

speaker: Uni
content: Because I know where those perfect eyes are. They have long been shattered and lost, but I'm still searching for them.
Her fingers curl slightly as she stares into the distance reminiscently.

speaker: Uni
content: They are my eternal wish.

speaker: L.L.
content: Oh? What kind of eyes are they? Are they really worth pursuing with all your effort?
The Mania surrounding Uni keeps crystallizing into shattered mirror shards, stacking together and reflecting countless faces mixed with longing and disdain.

speaker: Uni
content: Heh, I guess it's impossible for those who haven't seen them to relate...

speaker: Uni
content: Those sincere, intense eyes, radiant as the sun, illuminating and embracing everything...
Her increasingly fervent words infect L.L., who now also wears a longing expression.

speaker: L.L.
content: Wow... I sure can feel how intense your desire is... I can almost see those enchanting eyes!
Mania has undoubtedly maximized Uni's desire for those eyes, but all the surrounding empty stares calm her down again in an instant.
She looks toward a whole mirror that has appeared in the corner at some point. It is murky, but a gray figure gradually becomes clear in it.

speaker: Uni
content: I know those eyes are irretrievable, but they're linked to my flesh and blood. The mere thought of them gnaws away at me... Nevertheless, there's someone else who keeps my hope alive, I guess that counts as luck.
In the surrounding mirror shards, a pair of ordinary but distinctly different eyes appear. They meet Uni's gaze, as if communicating with her.

speaker: Uni
content: Don't worry, I won't stay. I know, you... aren't really here, are you?
The crystallized mirrors and fragments formed by Mania turn into dust rapidly, but L.L. still catches a glimpse of the final image reflected on them. Those ordinary eyes stare at Uni brightly.

speaker: L.L.
content: ...Is it her desire? Or...?

speaker: L.L.
content: What do those eyes have to do with Uni's flesh and blood... Didn't she say they were irretrievable? Then why were they able to take Uni away?

speaker: L.L.
content: I don't get it! Such a complex desire! How can one obtain this connection carved in flesh and blood? I want it too!
L.L. waves her hand, and the schedule projected by the manta ray changes color. Crimson liquid drips down everywhere, forming clear patterns.

speaker: L.L.
content: But in the end, between carved in flesh and blood and written in the schedule, is there really a difference?

speaker: Summer
content: "But the hero's journey continues! The End!"

speaker: Summer
content: Robot anime marathon, done! Yay, another fifteen worlds have been saved!
The girl looks at the automatically ejected disc and stretches her back lazily. The blue standby screen on the huge monitor is reflected on her glasses, casting a deep, dark shade.

speaker: Summer
content: So it's true. As long as I wish for it, I can get a happy ending from the anime.

speaker: Summer
content: Then...
The girl pushes her glasses, staring at the flickering noise on the screen.

speaker: Summer
content: What if I want to know the truth about this island?

speaker: Summer
content: What is the actual material composition of this island? Why did it end up forming an island rather than a continent or a city? What does the form of a sunken island represent in the spiritual domain?

speaker: Summer
content: I just can't wait... I really want to find out! This island must have some deeper hidden connection with Mania and spiritual power!
She mutters to herself somewhat neurotically while pulling out the huge toolbox that has been there in the corner of the lounge since the start.

The seemingly ordinary metal box opens, reassembles, and expands, eventually forming an array of research instruments several times its original size, along with the dozen or so drones Summer usually has with her.

speaker: Summer
content: A1 to A3, collect samples. A4 to A6, prepare the solutions. A7 to A9, use the loaded weapons to bomb the samples. A10, observe, record, and analyze the different reactions to provide a preliminary hypothesis.

speaker: Drone
content: Tasks received. Scanning island. Planning routes...
Under Summer's instructions, the machines operate in an orderly manner.

Despite the chocolate crumbs still on her lips, the eyes behind her glasses are no longer those of the girl marveling at the monitor minutes ago. No doubt, she is now an almost inhumanly meticulous scientist.

speaker: Drone
content: Building deconstruction complete. Detected material type: 1.

speaker: Drone
content: Soil and plant sampling complete. Detected material type: 1...

speaker: Summer
content: The metal, soil, and plants are all composed of the same substance? No, they are showing metallic properties... What determines the different manifestations of this substance?
Summer rubs it gently, and the sample in her hand suddenly turns into a wisp of blue electronic particles, dispersing in the air.
Oh no, you almost dismantled this island... I've invited a rather dangerous guest.
But it's okay, if taking things apart pleases you so much, do it to your heart's content! Elysiland never neglects its guests' wishes!

speaker: Summer
content: ...One more time, one more time! This should produce the phenotypic differentiation. Hmm, the result is good, but the efficiency is too low. This island's builder couldn't have used such a clumsy method...

speaker: Summer
content: That's right, if that's the case, once I gather enough materials, I could even deconstruct and rebuild this island...

Soon, she's completely dismantled this lounge she had carefully modified, even the beach and library she once adored have become unrecognizable. The plants have turned to ash and the pages are scattered everywhere.
But in her research mode, Summer couldn't care less. Calmly, she continues her experiments with these now-deformed "samples", approaching the "truth".

speaker: Summer
content: Suspected power source... up above me? Hmm? Is that... the island owner's big fish those people were talking about?

speaker: Summer
content: No way. The band and composition feel almost identical to the power I felt when trying to hack into the dark web before... Is the island owner, my friend L, related to the dark web somehow?

speaker: L.L.
content: I thought you were doing something fun and exciting. Turns out you're just fiddling with this metal stuff?

speaker: L.L.
content: Should I bring you some more manga? Or should we continue shooting the next tokusatsu film? There's a new chocolate dessert at the restaurant. Let's go try it together!
L.L., who's been Summer's playmate here, emerges behind her stealthily, sounding caring as she speaks.
But Summer doesn't even lift her head now, ignoring her completely.

speaker: L.L.
content: Why are you ignoring me? The rule of Elysiland is to have fun. If you can't find joy here...

speaker: L.L.
content: You will be expelled from Elysiland...

speaker: Summer
content: You measure everything with joy, but I don't.

speaker: Summer
content: In my world, coolness is above everything. If something's both cool and can save the world, that's even better.

speaker: Summer
content: Everything else doesn't matter.
Summer pushes her glasses, her eyes behind the lenses incredibly bright.

speaker: Summer
content: I want to study that big fish, and you. Did you construct this island and that fish with your power? Why is it able to represent and use the collective consciousness of the dark web to some extent?

speaker: Summer
content: And you. You appeared before me just as I was about to uncover the truth. That's how I know I'm onto something, but you won't let me go any further.
Summer stands up, walks straight through L.L.'s body, and reaches the edge of the island.

speaker: Summer
content: I can sense that everything here is virtual data. That includes myself, and you. And the virtuality is meant to cover up the truth.
She turns her head determinedly, leaving the girl and the ruins under her feet behind.

speaker: Summer
content: You don't need to expel me. I mean, how boring would that be? That's not cool at all. I still treasure the time we've spent together.

speaker: Summer
content: So, I've decided to leave on my own. The sight of my leaving must look so cool in the waves under the sun. Just like an iconic scene in an anime!

speaker: Summer
content: But we will definitely meet up again, little fish. Next time, I hope we can chat about anime again. Remember to catch up on the episodes!
The pink-haired girl disappears at the edge of the island. The residual data fragments turn into white powder before they touch anything.

speaker: L.L.
content: How interesting... You've barely left behind any data.

speaker: L.L.
content: Then let's hope we can indeed meet again in the future!

speaker: Cassia
content: No, no. That's not it...
In the garden full of blooming flowers, the perfumer pushes away the various ingredients in front of her, an unusual look of irritation appearing on her usually indifferent face.

speaker: L.L.
content: What a strange smell... Isn't this the most fascinating perfume corner on the island? Did something happen to the perfume master?
Ever since the island sank to the bottom of the sea, L.L.'s movements have become noticeably livelier. She bounces in small steps toward Cassia's garden.

Cassia is sitting in the flower garden tailored for her, surrounded by overturned perfume bottles. Incredibly fragrant when smelled on their own, the perfumes now give off an indescribably decadent scent all mixed together.

speaker: L.L.
content: What's going on? How come the perfumes have all been knocked over...

speaker: Cassia
content: Not nearly good enough. I need them to be more vibrant, more imperishable!

speaker: Cassia
content: The scents have all changed here at the bottom of the sea. Some have become purer and madder, while others have grown sweeter, more decayed...

speaker: Cassia
content: But that scent I've been searching for is nowhere to be found. Oh, dear me. Is that death I see drawing near...
Cassia's hand trembles slightly. Seeing this, L.L. immediately holds it in her palm, comforting her.

speaker: L.L.
content: No, that's not real. This place... will only fulfill all your desires. There won't be any death.

speaker: L.L.
content: If you wish for it sincerly, that imperishable scent you pursue will surely come to you.

speaker: L.L.
content: Forget those things that trouble you. Just remember what makes you happy!
Cassia looks at the girl in front of her, and for some reason, part of the anxiety looming over her heart seems to have faded.

speaker: Cassia
content: ...Are you the master of this place? The one who promises everyone pleasure and desire?

speaker: Cassia
content: But you don't carry any scents. No enchanting aroma of beauty or decadent stench of one consumed in desire...

speaker: Cassia
content: You are insipid, just like water... That's curious. A "perfume ingredient" like you really is a first for me... Perhaps your body is worth studying after all...
Cassia strokes a strand of L.L.'s hair absentmindedly, leaning in to sniff its scent, muttering to herself as if not hearing L.L.'s question at all.

speaker: L.L.
content: My body? Oh right, I hear that your perfume ingredients are hard to come by. They are both unique and frightening...

speaker: Cassia
content: Are you interested? Hehe, looks like you're bolder and have better taste than most others...

speaker: Cassia
content: Each part of the human body exudes a distinct smell... Here it is mild but dissipates easily, and here it is more vibrant...
The perfumer's hand brushes through L.L.'s long hair, caresses her cheek, and slides down her body. The movement is so gentle that it's almost tender, yet so assertive that it brooks no resistance.

speaker: Cassia
content: And here is the toughest part to extract for use, but it produces the most enduring scents which serve as the best materials for the Immortal Fragrance.

speaker: L.L.
content: Immortal Fragrance? Is that what you desire?

speaker: L.L.
content: If I provide you with the ingredients to make this perfume, you'll be glad, right?

Cassia's gaze laps over L.L.'s shoulder fervently. She looks as if she's going to agree immediately and then take apart the girl in front of her to turn her into an ingredient. However, her answer comes as a surprise.

speaker: Cassia
content: Yes. But what I want is beyond your reach. Even if you give yourself up for my formula, it is impossible to concoct the Immortal Fragrance down here...

speaker: Cassia
content: The salty sea water has compromised the scents of usable parts, so the amounts have to be recalculated...

speaker: Cassia
content: And the worst part is: the beauty, the most crucial ingredient is also gone...

speaker: L.L.
content: The most crucial ingredient is gone?

speaker: Cassia
content: Yes, yes, gone. I tracked down that scent on the island, but have been unable to find it after sinking beneath the sea.

speaker: L.L.
content: I see...

L.L. closes her eyes, immediately picturing a gray-clad demon who has been causing trouble on the island. That person's destructive actions have caused her incalculable losses. But that's fine, she and Elysiland are strong enough.

speaker: L.L.
content: I understand. Miss Cassia, you can rest assured. This is Elysiland, where no wish goes unfulfilled, no desire unsatisfied!

speaker: L.L.
content: I will make sure to bring him to you! As for you, you just have fun making perfumes here and wait for my good news!
female_content: I will make sure to bring her to you! As for you, you just have fun making perfumes here and wait for my good news!

content: She waves her hand, summoning a crowd of colorful marine creatures, which decorate the flowers and emit various sweet scents.

speaker: L.L.
content: Keep filling the void of your desires and pushing beyond the limits of your cravings! Turn all the creatures you fancy into perfumes!

speaker: L.L.
content: By then, he will surely come to you and be at your disposal! Consider this a promise from Elysiland's owner!
female_content: By then, she will surely come to you and be at your disposal! Consider this a promise from Elysiland's owner!

speaker: Cassia
content: What you are saying is but an empty promise to me. I've been on this island for quite some time now, but the necessary ingredients are nowhere to be seen, let alone the Immortal Fragrance...
Cassia tightens her grip, breaking off a few strands of L.L.'s hair. She puts the blue strands into the ingredient box, then looks up at L.L.

speaker: Cassia
content: Can you really deliver on your promise?

speaker: L.L.
content: Can I deliver? Ever since you came to Elysiland, I've delivered on countless promises and granted more wishes for you than I can count, haven't I?

speaker: L.L.
content: Everyone! Everyone who comes here has their wishes granted! Any wish that seems hopeless and impossible in reality! And of course yours too, why not?

speaker: L.L.
content: And what's the harm in doing as I say, Miss Cassia?

speaker: L.L.
content: When your most fervent wish can't be gratified, lesser ones need be prioritized to ease your anxiety and quench your yearnings... That's how things are meant to be, right?

speaker: Cassia
content: Mmm, meant to be...
The perfumer looks down at the abundant ingredients before her. The thick crimson liquid, the delicate milky white chunks, and the smooth colorful threads, all at her disposal.

speaker: Cassia
content: True. I've always comforted myself with the possession of these fragrances, until I can finally create the Immortal Fragrance...

speaker: Cassia
content: That's my desire too, one that deserves to be fulfilled...

She murmurs, completely convinced by L.L. Following her advice, the perfumer immerses herself in her perfume-making again, indulging in a new wave of satisfaction in the midst of the marine creatures.

speaker: L.L.
content: Yes, that's right... Indulge yourself, enjoy yourself!

speaker: L.L.
content: Even if the pleasure is fleeting and bound to fade, we can create the illusion of eternity with abundance and continuity!
The young island owner nods in contentment and transforms into foam in the seawater.
Shortly after she disappears, a figure in a gray trench coat steps over the illusory flowers and branches, arriving before Cassia.
Cassia's eyes light up in that moment, as if a long-suppressed desire deep within her soul is instantly kindled.

speaker: Cassia
content: This scent... a mere whiff is enough to calm you down.

speaker: Cassia
content: It's, you. You're here, at long last.
Before the gray figure speaks, the perfumer absorbed in her perfume-making looks up immediately. The immense joy dispels the mist of desire, making her eyes glow with a different kind of clarity.
...A fall induced by irresistible desire can only be interrupted by an even stronger desire... I understand it now.
The gray figure smiles wryly and waves at Cassia.
I've never been so grateful for your obsession with me as an "ingredient", Cassia.
Come on, it's time to go back.

speaker: Eleven
content: Hey, you guys over there! Don't all gather in one spot, swim further away so you're not all crammed together!
The man she points at immediately swims in the direction Eleven shows him, the floating figures of the guests on the blue sea forming a carefully crafted painting.

speaker: Eleven
