content: Good, very good, just like that. Next... Hmm, there should be enough shells and starfish on the beach for people to gather. You guys, follow my orders and go fetch some!

speaker: Elysiland Guest A & B
content: On it!

The beach has become Eleven's kingdom. Initially, her voice could only influence the guests' actions when stopping dangerous behaviors, but she quickly discovers that its range of function is growing.
As she gains better control of her voice, Eleven can now freely manipulate others' will with it, using it to create her ideal beach. A stress-free, soothing, and relaxing place.

speaker: Eleven
content: But why do they... obey my voice so readily?

speaker: Eleven
content: Obey? Can't you see? Some people just need a guiding voice, need to be controlled, so they don't do things that harm themselves or others...
"There are words other than slander and flattery in this world."

speaker: Eleven
content: Uh... Who's that...

speaker: Eleven
content: Never doubt yourself! They need your voice!

speaker: Eleven
content: Uh... My voice... My voice can be heard by anyone! My voice is worthy! Everyone... must listen to me properly!
Eleven clutches her head in pain, crouching down instinctively, fumbling in the sand. Soon, she finds another white conch and holds it to her ear like a lifeline.
The anticipated compliments soon come from the conch, soothing Eleven's strained nerves.

speaker: Gentle Female Voice
content: Eleven, you've done well... That's how you should use your voice. This is the best way...

speaker: Gentle Male Voice
content: Look how wonderful the beach is now... All thanks to your voice...

speaker: Gentle Female Voice
content: Yes, your voice deserves to be heard and valued... It's far more precious than those trivial noises...

speaker: Gentle Male & Female Voice
content: You should use it to make everything better...

speaker: Eleven
content: Make everything better... Yes, my voice can make this place better! As long as you all listen to me, it surely can!

speaker: Eleven
content: Find more conches! Tidy the messy beach chairs! Don't leave wrappers and trash here. Clean them all up!
Eleven's voice spreads far and wide in waves, motivating everyone on the beach to act strictly according to her instructions.

speaker: L.L.
content: Wow, look at you, Eleven. You sure have turned the beach into a fun place!

speaker: L.L.
content: Now you've made all of them your voice-controlled toys, haven't you? They'll do whatever you tell them to do!

The blue-haired girl suddenly emerges behind Eleven, who is gripping the conch. 
L.L. grabs her shoulders amiably and helps her supervise the guests as they bustle around like worker ants.

speaker: L.L.
content: Don't you feel like a queen overseeing her subjects? This beach has truly become your kingdom. Are you glad? Isn't it delightful?!
L.L. waves her hand and leads Eleven up the well-built sandcastle, overlooking the people whose minds and actions are controlled by her voice.

speaker: L.L.
content: You two... dance with each other! You three! Roll from this side of the beach to the other!
Following Eleven, L.L. also keeps ordering the people on the beach to do this and that, watching them get dragged here and there like puppets.
But suddenly, Eleven hears a ringtone from the conch in her hand.
A faint red light glows around the conch, and Eleven can't help but bring it to her ear.
Eleven? Can you hear me?

speaker: Eleven
content: Yes. Your voice... sounds familiar...
Eleven wants to hear more clearly, but the familiar voice disappears with a buzz. She shakes the conch twice, but the voice does not return.
She immediately jumps off the sandcastle and starts searching for other conches on the beach. Sure enough, another conch in the sand is glowing and ringing.

speaker: L.L.
content: Eleven, where are you going? Aren't you going to keep ordering them around?

speaker: Eleven
content: Hello, please say a few more words. I feel that... I really need your voice.
Ignoring L.L., Eleven glances up and begins searching for the next glowing, ringing conch.
I just want to speak the truth. Listen carefully, Eleven.

speaker: Eleven
content: The truth...
Just like when you listened to your own inner voice. Believe in yourself.

speaker: Eleven
content: ...Wait, Chief? Is that you? Are you looking for me?
Don't worry. We will find your true voice. The voice in your heart.

speaker: Eleven
content: The voice... in my heart...

speaker: Eleven
content: I... What I once forgot and lost is the voice in my heart!

speaker: Eleven
content: Chief, is it you?

speaker: Eleven
content: Is it you who's once again... woken me up?
The last conch turns into white sand by Eleven's ear, flowing down through her fingers.

To L.L.'s surprise, Eleven who was previously indulging in control seems to have found an anchor point, breaking free from the temptations from the beach and the conches, now going determinedly in another direction.

speaker: L.L.
content: The person who called her... must be very important to her. Otherwise, how could just a few words have taken her away?

speaker: L.L.
content: She was so happy here...

speaker: Victoria
content: Come on, hang in there... We need to make even more roses, enough to fill this garden...

speaker: Victoria
content: Cough, cough! But... but it seems like, there's not enough to make more roses...
In the empty garden, scattered roses sway in the wind.
The rich crimson seems to flow, the petals brushing against the plaster arch, leaving mottled red marks. The strokes look like the lonely marks made by a girl waiting for her parents to return.
But no one stays for this beautiful rose garden.
What beautiful roses you have in your garden! Did you grow them all by yourself?
The blue-haired girl suddenly emerges in the garden, her turquoise hair highlighting the blood-red hue of the roses.

speaker: Victoria
content: Yes... I've nurtured these roses with love. They're reserved for the most important person.

speaker: Victoria
content: But I... I've run out of love... Can you help me? I want to fill the entire garden with roses. Do you have enough love inside you?

speaker: Victoria
content: I wanted to ask those little fish for help, but they don't understand love and can't become roses. What about you... Can you?
Victoria grabs L.L.'s wrist eagerly, her tear-filled eyes as transparent and endearing as the crystal roses blooming in the garden.
Just like a child's gaze.

speaker: L.L.
content: Hmm, I know what you want. Elysiland can certainly satisfy you. Let's give it a try!
The blue-haired girl snaps her fingers, conjuring up a few buckets of bright red liquid before Victoria. She gropes in the liquid for a moment only to stain her hands red.

speaker: Victoria
content: No... This won't work... Why?

speaker: Victoria
content: Why hasn't my wish come true? Can't Elysiland grant all wishes?
Confused and disappointed, the girl withdraws her hands and resumes straining herself. Soon, another rose blooms out of her wrist, but its color is dull and its stem is fragile.
Red particles detach from Victoria's body, and L.L. is keenly aware of her weakening mental strength. She can no longer support the growth of another blood-red rose, yet she keeps trying stubbornly.

speaker: L.L.
content: Hey, don't lose faith in Elysiland yet!

speaker: L.L.
content: I think... maybe we haven't gotten the correct material. The most important material should be the "love" you've mentioned, right?
Victoria's doubtful attitude makes L.L. feel indignant.
She cuts her own wrist swiftly, and after the spattering particles fade, the blood beads drip onto the garden lawn like a broken string of pearls.

speaker: L.L.
content: Of course, the most intense form of love here is mine!

speaker: L.L.
content: I love this island and everyone here. I hope you can all be bathed in happiness, joy, and satisfaction all the time!
Thick liquid keeps falling next to Victoria, turning into beautiful flowers upon contact.
L.L. forces herself to stand, her face growing paler as her excitement intensifies.

speaker: L.L.
content: Go ahead, use this to build the world you desire and fulfill your wishes!
L.L. embraces Victoria, supporting herself with Victoria's body while murmuring into her ear.

speaker: Victoria
content: Roses... Great. I can use it to make roses...!

speaker: Victoria
content: My rose garden can finally be filled with roses... My wish will come true...
Victoria reaches out in astonishment to touch the flower bed. Under her red-stained palms, roses twist and grow vibrantly, filling the gaps in the rose garden.

speaker: Victoria
content: Bloom, bloom, little rose. Your petals will make a road. The departed one awaits, when the roses bloom, 'tis the return day...
As the rose garden gradually takes shape, L.L.'s face slowly turns pale. But she doesn't care, and even watches the beautiful yet morbid scene before her excitedly.

speaker: L.L.
content: What a wonderful wish. What a wonderful view.

speaker: L.L.
content: Who is this person worth risking your life for to create such a garden?

speaker: Victoria
content: Well, because by the time the world's largest rose garden is filled with roses of love, Daddy will come back!

speaker: L.L.
content: Daddy?

speaker: L.L.
content: You're creating this rose garden to bring your father back?
L.L. widens her eyes at Victoria's response, but her expression turns cold.

speaker: L.L.
content: What a little fool! You don't even know you've been lied to! Let me tell you...

speaker: L.L.
content: As soon as they realize you're a burden, they'll disappear from your life and never come back.

speaker: L.L.
content: What you believe in is just a lie to distract you, so you won't act up...

speaker: Victoria
content: But Daddy's made a promise. He's never lied to me.
The girl's innocent eyes, pure expression, and complete trust ignite a burst of anger in L.L.'s heart. She leaves a hesitant sentence before turning away.

speaker: L.L.
content: Well... maybe... what you have is a different kind of love? Then let me see if this miracle will really happen...
Victoria stands dazedly, looking lost, as she watches L.L. leave.

speaker: Victoria
content: Do you also have matters to tend to in the other world?

speaker: Victoria
content: Then... where can I find the remaining roses? Will Daddy... still come back?
The rose in her hand slowly melts and returns to its original form of blood, dripping through her fingers onto the stone slab, like tears accumulating in the heart.
The roses in the entire garden wither and melt. The girl watches the garden fall back into desolation, her expression blank.
Suddenly, she notices the crimson liquid flowing in one direction, as if forming a petal-paved path. At the end of the path stands a familiar figure.
Is that her father? No... it's not.
That gray figure's mere presence seems to soothe her emotions, making her feel at ease.

speaker: Victoria
content: Chief?
The rose in Victoria's hand blooms again. She reaches out to the figure, welcoming the red thorns growing and spreading toward her.
These are the thorns that can tightly connect the two and will bloom with gorgeous roses.

speaker: Victoria
content: Are you here to pick me up?
She stands up and walks out of the rose garden.
The roses behind her wilt and turn to dust rapidly, but in her right hand, a blood-red rose still blooms amid the shackles glowing with crimson light.
The Mania on the beach is suppressed by the shackles you released. The once madly expanding man-eating swamp has begun to recede, revealing the original beach and coral reefs.

This is obviously a good thing, but the girl you woke up and saved has no time to be grateful. She's squatting on the beach and futilely scooping up sand, in the middle of a breakdown. She purses her lips tightly, as if about to cry.

speaker: Shrooma
content: How did this happen... How!

speaker: Shrooma
content: How could my swamp be fake... This is different from what the island owner told me!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Fake or not, this is no place for a child to spend days in.
She bows her head and her shoulders are convulsing, as if she's still overwhelmed by the shattering of her dream. You feel sorry and try to comfort her.
You instinctively reach into your pocket, but soon remember this is not the real world. You won't find that candy you put in your pocket before coming.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Hmph, save it. I've always known this day would come.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Someone like me can't escape the so-called punishment. I'll tell you whatever you want to know...

speaker: Shrooma
content: As long as... you say nothing to my family.
The little girl still appears prickly. You sigh and notice not far from her, a black smartphone lies there alone on the beach, its screen flashing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Elysiland... Forum... General chat section?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And foodie section, gaming section, cosmetic surgery section...!

You pick up her phone, and glimpse at the constantly refreshing posts in all these sections on the screen. They remind you of many guests you've seen since arriving on Elysiland, not to mention that the island and the manta ray on the logo also look strikingly familiar.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course... Elysiland and this Elysiland Forum on the dark web are mirror images of each other. A desire on the forum corresponds to a fulfillment on the island.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All of this is probably controlled by L.L., the island owner? But just how does she do it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Her Sinner ability should be S-Class, but even so, can she really sustain a whole island...?
You look at the constantly refreshing forum on the phone, then at the people indulging in ecstasy in every corner of this island. You feel that there must be a connection between them.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Of course, she can!
You hear the sob-tinged voice again. You look up and find Shrooma staring at you, as if ready to take you down.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You know about it? Can you tell me?

speaker: Shrooma
content: According to L.L., her power seems to come from the bottom of the sea or some place like that. She's like a fish and needs to live in water. That's why she keeps taking us to the seabed.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Those people from under the sea... Or is it under... ground? They said that as long as Elysiland created by L.L. can gather enough emotional energy, then L.L. herself can enjoy many experiences she has never had before.
Shrooma wants to go on, but seems to suddenly remember you haven't yet agreed to her terms. She bites her lip and falls silent.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, yes, I promise you. I won't make things difficult for you, nor will I tell your family about this. You're still young. Once you leave, I'll help you erase the data left on the island.

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...Alright. As long as you keep your word. Don't forget, lying is wrong, even for adults!
After giving you a proper warning, Shrooma continues her explanation.

speaker: Shrooma
content: That forum... Elysiland. At first, it was just a gathering place for people with niche hobbies, as in, hobbies not tolerated by the mainstream.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Filth is only safe in a pit of filth... But there's no place in this world for filth. So we can only hide.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Only when the world is completely covered in swamps and filth, people like us can finally live without shame.
The girl fiddles with the cute watch on her wrist nervously. The accessory is much more appropriate for her age, creating a sharp contrast with her phone.

speaker: Shrooma
content: This is my wish. This is how I can exist happily.

speaker: Shrooma
content: I came here because the island owner said that Elysiland could offer me this kind of life.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But what benefit does it bring her? And what do you mean by "her source of power"?

speaker: Shrooma
content: Joy and satisfaction are the benefits. Although she is the island owner, she is also one of us. She has said many times that she likes having fun with us.

speaker: Shrooma
content: She likes to see everyone have their desires fulfilled, to see everyone indulge in pleasure, as if that would also bring her joy...

speaker: Shrooma
content: She also said... everyone would always stay with her, because... once people find out how easy it is to satisfy a desire on Elysiland, no one can resist the temptation to stay.

speaker: L.L.
content: The more content and satisfied you guys are, the more energy this island gains, and the stronger I become! That way, the world you desire will grow even larger too!
The girl glances at you, both grateful and wary.

speaker: Shrooma
content: That's why I don't want to leave! A poisonous mushroom is only safe when buried in the mud... But there's no place for filthy mud or poisonous mushrooms in this world.

speaker: Shrooma
content: My joy will transform into energy for her, maintaining my swamp and strengthening her power...

speaker: Shrooma
content: Now you've woken people like us up, cutting off the joy and the energy. That's why my swamp is gone.

speaker: Shrooma
content: I just hope to live happily in this world.
Although her account is filled with subjective speculation, her logic is clear and supposedly accurate. It also provides you with enough information.
You can't help but wonder, is this accuracy a result of her deep understanding of L.L. and the forum, or her analytical ability far superior to people her age?

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...Was that useful? Can I leave now?

speaker: Shrooma
content: I, I've still got homework to finish. No one told me I'd be kept here for so long...
Your silence makes the girl anxious. Afraid you will break your promise, she starts mumbling things she thinks may move an adult.
After some thought, you keep your promise, hand her back the smartphone, and send a message to the MBCC staff, asking them to have the network specialist release the data of Shrooma's consciousness.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You may go. Don't worry, I'm not an adult who lies to kids. If you really can't find an excuse, maybe I can help you make one up.
Hearing your words, she stumbles a little while dashing toward the pier. You can't help but shake your head with a laugh.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Kids sure are fickle. Suddenly, all she can think of is the possibility of getting caught and the urge to rush back home.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If only the owner of this place... also had such deep ties to the real world.

July 25, N.F. 114
DisCity
[Background: Command HQ]

It has been over four months since the dark web threat first surfaced. After being initially caught off guard, the authorities have struck back, effectively controlling the situation and swiftly dealing with all types of emergencies.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We have established comprehensive technical cooperation with the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center. The overall situation is under control, with various emergencies promptly addressed by a team of experts. Additionally, research on the new type of Mania is progressing in an orderly manner.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, you've been rushing about on this case for so long. Now you can finally relax and take a break.

speaker: EMP
content: Chief! Over here! I found a great anime series, collector's edition!

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Please forget about it. The recent snack order has already used up all the budget.

speaker: EMP
content: Hella isn't here. Plus, Chief is loaded. We rarely take vacations, so let's splurge a little.

speaker: Hecate
content: We also have patrol duties. Chief is still vigilant, so we shouldn't...
Strolling down the broad avenue with the Sinners, you feel no threat of danger or conspiracy. The girls' laughter is bright and carefree. Such long-awaited ease is indeed precious.
In retrospect, though the dark web had been a pain in the neck, it was nothing compared to the frenzied Black Ring battles. DisCity has indeed returned to peace.
The crowd bustles around you, basking in the summer sun. Everything is so peaceful, but you suddenly stop in your tracks.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Chief? Is anything wrong?
[Insert CG - glitch concept art]

A series of incomprehensible characters tear through your vision, inverting the colors before your eyes. Everything trembles and collides with each other, before breaking down into massive color blocks.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief?! Chief, what's wrong?

speaker: EMP
content: Huh? An attack? What attack?!!
Rifts tear through the sky. Rays of light surge from the depths of the darkness, writhing to converge into some kind of monster.

speaker: Labyrinth
content: Command received. Anomaly detection initiated...

You see waves of image noise forming into Corruptors, who quiver and distort upon closer scrutiny. A tidal wave of magnetic noise hits your brain. Your senses become blurred, yet your thoughts grow clearer. You make a decisive judgment...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's the dark web... A huge scale Mania attack. Contact the Cybersecurity Center immediately...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is a huge scale anomaly...
[Shackles Effect]
You release the shackles with your last bit of strength, pointing in the direction of the attack. Hecate understands and looks in the same direction.

speaker: Hecate
content: But Chief, where are the enemies?
The streets are still bustling, and the crowd teems without any hint of disturbance. The confused Sinners try anxiously to protect their dizzy Chief.
Above all the chaos, you see the sky vertically divided by a massive web of light, like an impenetrable ceiling formed by countless searching eyes.

<size=72>This chaotic, manic storm
has no impact on true fate.</size>

August 1, N.F. 114
Banyan Medical College Hospital
Department of Mental Contamination
Six days have passed since the incident in Eastside. Various investigative reports are beginning to come back.

<color=#fb9259>[Eastside Public Security Bureau Investigation Report]</color>
Apart from the MBCC Chief, no one else witnessed the Mania apparition, including the Sinners with him.
After reviewing all footage taken by security cameras and citizens at the scene, as well as the testimonies of those present, we have concluded that Chief ${PlayerName} suddenly lost control without any external stimuli and suffered mental trauma. He has been sent to Banyan Medical College for emergency treatment.

<color=#fb9259>[Personal Medical Report]</color>

speaker: Rise
content: That's all for now. The full reports from various departments amount to 546 pages and have been sent to your inbox.

<color=#fb9259>Rise</color>, an intern from the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center, took part in various support missions in the wake of the dark web threat. She is mainly responsible for liaising with the MBCC. Known for being diligent and responsible, she is well-regarded among partner departments.

speaker: Rise
content: In summary: there was no large-scale Mania crisis. The apparition you saw was likely a hallucination caused by sensory cognitive disorder, Chief.

speaker: Rise
content: It's <color=#fb9259>cognitive disorder</color>. People who are in long-term contact with the dark web may experience this kind of Mania reaction.

speaker: Rise
content: <color=#fb9259>Digitalized Mania</color> is essentially a form of information pollution. In the unregulated depths of DisCity's dark web, there are copious amounts of dangerous info of unknown origin, including mental horrors like the Black Ring. Prolonged exposure can affect a person's cognition.

speaker: Rise
content: Mild cases may cause emotional fluctuations and dispirit, leading to paranoia. More severe cases can result in mental breakdowns and Mania infection. The <color=#fb9259>Gray Mirror</color> and <color=#fb9259>Elysiland</color> incidents are extreme examples.

speaker: Rise
content: Even technical specialists back at the Cybersecurity Center have to take shifts and breaks. It's not surprising at all for someone like you to sustain work injuries from continuous frontline exposure to contamination. Also...
Rise hands over a mask and sunglasses.

speaker: Rise
content: Please wear these when going out. Footage of you from the Eastside incident is now circulating the dark web. You need to be more vigilant when going out; being recognized could jeopardize your safety.

You try to recall what happened that day: the strange grid weaving across the sky, the mottled image noise, and the distorted projections of Corruptors. Even casting your shackles felt strange. It does indeed resemble a "cognitive disorder caused by the dark web exposure" like Rise described.

Yet for a "Mania reaction," your Mania tests showed no abnormalities. Plus, with the protection of your shackles, you've never been affected by such common Mania infections, and your M-value rarely fluctuates.

If it's powerful Mania like Black Rings that can overpower your shackles, it would certainly affect all the Sinners connected to you, but none of the Sinners showed any abnormalities on that day. The only one who collapsed was you, making it a veritable conundrum.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Please go home and get some rest. The colleagues at the Cybersecurity Center must have all been working around the clock because of my incident, and now you're here with me even on the weekend. I really appreciate all your efforts.

speaker: Rise
content: No worries. We applied for overtime, so it's our working hours right now. We are just doing our job.

speaker: Rise
content: If you really want to cause less trouble, then please take better care of yourself, both mentally and physically, to prevent work injuries. In my opinion, the energy you put into the dark web is way more than what your job requires. It's sapping your health needlessly.
She is not being too harsh, but it still makes you instinctively sit up.

speaker: Choice
options: But the mastermind behind the dark web might be...

speaker: Rise
content: Whatever it may be, it is not your current mission. We are not in a time of turmoil right now. You've completed all your tasks with flying colors, and need to unwind now.

speaker: Rise
content: You've worked hard to bring six months of peace to this city. You should treat yourself well, too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is there anything else you wish to tell me?
You ask respectfully.

speaker: Rise
content: Folks from the Bureau will arrive in 15 minutes to fetch you. I will start my vacation this afternoon and won't be answering calls. Another colleague has already taken over. You may contact him if you need anything.

speaker: Rise
content: Goodbye then, Chief. Remember to send me proof of my overtime; I need it to apply for compensatory leave from Nirvana.
Rise adjusts her glasses, nods to you formally, then straightens up and strides out of the hospital.

True to the elite nature of Nirvana, even the interns are meticulous. In just two weeks, Rise's discipline has become well-known in the Bureau; her clear boundaries have earned her both trust and awe.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Clear boundaries...
You watch her walking away, think for a moment, then put on the mask and sunglasses she gave you and leave the hospital.
It is a bright summer day, boasting blue skies and sunshine. A warm breeze blows through the streets teeming with crowds and traffic.
As for the web of light you saw the other day... if no one else on the streets saw it, it might really be a sign of "cognitive disorder caused by the dark web and overwork."

The dark web Mania is rather a minor issue compared to the Black Ring operation and West District chaos ended six months ago, and DisCity is now finally basking in peace. For the first time since your awakening, a long period of peace.

But the more this continues, the more anxious you feel inside. Time passes, yet the calm doesn’t bring relief—instead, it leaves you even more on edge. When you close your eyes, it’s as if you can sense the dark currents of fate surging wildly in the shadows.
And what you fear most is that you cannot sense it.

speaker: Boss
content: You think the Underground might be behind the dark web? Haha, good. That's the kind of intuition we need. Let's play along with them, shall we? A warmup before the big battle.

speaker: Friend
content: The new mine has successfully yielded Hypercubes. West District's economic lifeline is coming back. With that in mind, the internal disputes of the Reconstruction Committee don't constitute a major problem. Thanks for your concern.

speaker: Subordinate
content: Paradeisos has expressed gratitude for your support in the DisSea operation. Chief, you have won their trust. That's really great...

speaker: Companion
content: ...Please get some rest, Chief. You look really tired.
[Fade to black, 1 second]
This is a special gift from my lovely "little brother."
female_content: This is a special gift from my lovely "little sister."

content: [White out back to the street]

Snapping back to your senses, you still see sunny blue skies and teeming traffic before your eyes. The rising heat blurs your senses. The peaceful daily life is just in front of you, yet you are trying desperately to pull yourself away from those persistent nightmares.
Not being able to enjoy peace is probably an illness. You try to refocus your attention on the present, on the here and now.
The traffic light changes, and the cars ebb away. Your view is no longer obstructed.
You see a person standing on the other side of the road.
She looks back at you. Your eyes lock for a few seconds, and the girl walks towards you through the sunlight, stopping just an arm's length away.

speaker: Maiden
content: ...Were you... looking at me?

speaker: Rise
content: You need to be more vigilant when going out; being recognized could jeopardize your safety.
The girl stares at you, then smiles gently.

She reaches out to your nose, and before you can stop her, she hooks her finger around your mask and pulls it down. Taking advantage of your surprise, she stuffs her popsicle into your mouth with her other hand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ??? Ptui, what are you doing?!
The girl responds to your reproach with a bright smile.

speaker: Maiden
content: A souvenir.

speaker: Maiden
content: To commemorate the fact that I found you <size=40>first</size>.
She talks in chunks, and combined with her sudden appearance, strange approach, and odd actions towards you...
You have a sudden epiphany.
She looks at you with a grin. Just as she is about to answer...

Time seems to stop for a moment. Out of nowhere, a flash of light bursts between you two, piercing the girl’s body. Her smile falters and distorts, as the web crisscrossing the sky rips through the space where you stand.

Several rifts surround you, sawing through your vision. Image noise overflows, condensing into strange shapes that lunge towards you... and the girl. You summon the shackles, trying to pull her towards you.
...But the girl's hand disintegrates in your grip the moment you reach out to her!

speaker: Distant Voice
content: It's a dark web attack!

speaker: Distant Voice
content: Chief! Chief, please answer me!!
You collapse to the ground, faintly hearing the voices of your MBCC companions.

The glowing web divides the world, distorting and twisting everything within. You are the only exception, as if locked in a heavy cage. The only reality in your grasp is the strange girl in your arms.
But her body has almost disintegrated into nothing.

speaker: Maiden
content: ...I found you... first...

speaker: Maiden
content: ...Now... it's your turn...
A white light pierces through both of you, cutting off your words. The person in your arms trembles and vanishes. You are left alone to make sense of it all.
The gaping hole in your chest quickly heals. Chaotic noise floods your mind, forcing something into you while ripping something else away, as if it's tearing you apart.
Before completely losing consciousness, you spot the popsicle on the ground.
It has melted completely, revealing a shriveled wooden stick.
On the wooden stick, a stream of light gleams. Strange characters flash before your eyes, then quickly disappear, as if they never existed.

speaker: Rise
content: Mom, I won't be coming back tomorrow. Emergency overtime.

speaker: Rise
content: Hmm... Yeah, don't worry, it's not dangerous. I applied for it myself... No, no one picked on me. They wouldn't dare. Plus, they'll pay me quadruple. I'll buy gifts for you and dad.
She hangs up, throws on her coat, and rushes out. They need someone experienced with liaising to handle the upcoming operation.
[Scene Change] Chief's Office
You sit in the office with the dark web portal open, repeatedly entering similar strings in the address bar. Your eyes are dry and sore, but you have no time to worry about that now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...That address... the one she left on the popsicle stick...
You open the URL and arrive at a blank white page.
You open the URL and get a long string of gibberish. Classic DisMyth spam.
A form of color blindness in which only yellow and blue can be perceived... according to the dictionary. But there's no corresponding site.
These are all you remember from the flashing characters...
After being brought back, the wooden stick underwent multiple inspections. No one found anything abnormal. It has no writing or markings, making your persistence seem almost laughable.

But this attack is not your imagination. You won't give up easily or dismiss it as a hallucination. You are determined to get to the bottom of it and find the strange girl who was torn apart in front of you.
[Amnesia CG] followed by intense white flash

Ridiculous. Now you can't even remember how she looked. Just like the information she hid in the popsicle stick, your memories about her are rapidly fading, even though you're not someone who forgets easily.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...It's not a hallucination. I must remember. The clues can't be lost.
You choose from many possible types of passwords, finally pinpointing three words that seem most suspicious...
The well-known slogan on the dark web is welcometodismyth, which appears in various places... Could it correspond to a website? No, you need to remove "dis"...
[Click, website opens]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Found it!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...What is this?!

content: Chaotic information keeps rolling out rapidly. These words flashing among the incomprehensible symbols leave you stunned.
You quickly realize that, regardless of its authenticity, this is crucial information that must be preserved.
[Glitch]
---Error--- ---Error--- ---Error---
Your computer suddenly goes out of control, with countless garbled symbols devouring the information on the screen.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's a cyber attack!
It's too late. Within seconds, all the characters dissolve into gibberish before your eyes, and there is nothing you can do about it.
As you watch, all the facts come together in your mind.

...The initial apparition that only you could see, the girl killed by the apparition right after contacting you, the intelligence she secretly hid deep within the dark web, and the rapidly destroyed "last words."
You leave a message for Nightingale as quickly as possible.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Immediately contact the Cybersecurity Center to investigate the address 'welcometomyth' and its owner.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The murdered girl must be identified. Who is she? What did she want to tell me? Who killed her and why? I need to know all the truth.
After leaving the message, you throw on your coat and rush to the door, swinging it open, only to bump into an unexpected person.

speaker: Maiden
content: Hi.
The sudden appearance of someone at the door startles you. When you see her face, you immediately recall every detail, including how she had been pierced and torn apart. Your heart almost stops.
You grab her tightly as soon as you remember everything.
At this moment, your actions and tone are far from gentle, but the person in front of you does not flinch.
As if she doesn't understand, she grabs your sleeve in return, trying to slink behind you.

speaker: Maiden
content: Help me.

speaker: Maiden
content: They're coming.
...They?
The space behind her suddenly flickers, and dozens of chaotic rifts tear open the space, emitting a familiar, ear-piercing roar.
The girl shrinks closer to you. For a moment, the image of her being pierced by the apparition flashes again, and you instinctively grab her arm, disregarding your suspicions.
You pull her back into the room, hoping to rely on the office's defense system can hold off the monsters for a while. But as you step inside, the ground beneath you feels anything but solid.
...Looking up, you see the floor, walls, and ceiling of the room already covered in illusory patterns, with filthy signals leaking out ceaselessly. You are stepping right on a trace of light.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Oh no...
Before you can finish your words, you fall instantly, along with the girl tightly held in your arms, into a digital noise-filled abyss.

speaker: Technician A
content: An emergency has occurred at the MBCC! There is a massive contamination leakage near Chief's office. The data type is consistent with the daytime Eastside attack, and it is extremely invasive!

speaker: Technician B
content: MBCC, take the lead for now. Send your Sinners to rescue your Chief. Cybersecurity will arrive soon.

speaker: Technician A
content: But that Chief... That Chief is gone! He has vanished into thin air!!
female_content: But that Chief... That Chief is gone! She has vanished into thin air!!

content: The Cybersecurity Center falls into chaos. While people rush about, a small break room on the edge of the office area lights up.

speaker: Soft Female Voice
content: Vanished into thin air...?
The woman props herself up from the bed and puts on her glasses. Her mechanical assistant floats over to light up the computer screen. Data flashes rapidly across her lenses.
After reading for a long time, a smile curls on her face.

speaker: Soft Female Voice
content: Oh dear, it's only been a little while and there's trouble again... Wonderful.

speaker: Soft Female Voice
content: This is a never-before-seen abnormal state.
What happens next is too chaotic to recount.
With the girl in your arms, the two of you are swallowed up and spat out by the rift repeatedly, until you are finally flung into the sky over DisCity, free-falling.
You do feel pain when the dust in the air cuts your skin like sharp blades. But strangely, when the web's virtual lines slice through your body, you feel no pain at all.
Yet every time you get sliced by them, your consciousness feels abruptly interrupted. When you regain your senses, the scene around you instantly changes.

From the clouds to the High Tower, to the sandstorm and to the square, and then to the giant rift splitting open in mid-air... Amidst the dizzying array of scenes, you are losing your grip on reality. The only thing you can hold tightly is the girl falling with you, who is shouting as if on your behalf.

speaker: Maiden
content: Hahahahahahahaha...
How can anyone laugh at a time like this?

You want to shout, but as soon as you open your mouth, the wind rushes in, making it hard to even keep your expression. She, on the other hand, seems to adapt effortlessly, looking around with excitement.

speaker: Maiden
content: A plane! A bird! Look, a bald head!!

speaker: Maiden
content: A Ferris wheel!
A Ferris wheel? You squint against the wind and look down. Sure enough, it's the ruins of the Carnival. You two are about to hit the ground. But the lake is nearby, maybe that's your chance to live.
You shield her head, and she immediately shuts her mouth and covers it with her hand. In the blink of an eye, the two of you crash into the lake in the Carnival ruins. The impact makes you dizzy.
In a daze, someone wraps their arms around your waist and drags you towards the surface. The water wards off the chaos, giving you a brief sense of peace.
What you just experienced was too insane and surreal. But it should be over now. The FAC contamination cleanup unit stationed near the BR-001 ruins is close by. You are safe.
[Splash...] Water sound effect
As you emerge from the water, the strong light blinds you, but your ears catch the sound of lively music that shouldn't be in the ruins.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Where are... we?

When you come to, you're no longer amidst the Carnival ruins. Now, you see the rooftops of skyscrapers in the center of Eastside. Because of your sudden appearance, the people in the luxurious pool scream and scatter.
Several rifts stretch out before you. Image noise spill out, coalescing into blurry Corruptors advancing step by step.
They are not here for you.

Their target is the girl, who takes a step back and futilely hides behind you. These strange Corruptors are here to kill her, to erase a girl who can barely speak, along with the secrets and information she holds.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Who are they? Why are they after you? What are you trying to tell me? Who are you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Can you explain? Can you talk normally?
She clutches your sleeve tightly, shaking her head desperately, tears welling up in her eyes as she looks at you like a drowning person grasping at a lifeline.
[Release the shackles]
You gently grasp her hand, then let go, and rise from the pool.

This might not be a battle you're familiar with, and many unexpected things may happen that are out of your control. Yet you are not backing down. Maybe it's because you don't want to see a person die in front of you the second time.
Or perhaps you don't need a reason at all; this is just a choice you are bound to make.
More and more monsters appear. They are not very strong, but there is an indescribable oddness about them.
Unlike conventional Corruptors, these new types emerging from DisMyth have digitalized apparitions. Simply being near them clouds your mind.

All the Corruptors you've encountered in the past, regardless of their form, show Mania-induced insanity, a strong desire for violence and destruction, and are particularly aggressive towards humans. But these...

These "Corruptors" before you, despite the shape and form you know all too well, are remarkably quiet in their actions. Swift, subdued, and precisely pinpointing their target, they show no hostility towards you, and only aim to kill the girl behind you in the quickest way possible. Their rationality makes them harder to deal with.

You're accustomed to facing hostility head-on to protect yourself. But when it comes to protecting someone else, your instincts and self-defense reflexes fall short. The enemy takes advantage of them, overwhelming you with feints and deceptive moves.
There must be a more formidable force behind you all... To hunt down one person like this... is she that much of a threat? Or does she know too much?
I won't let you succeed.
[Release the shackles]

In front of the shackles, a giant rift breaks through space, tearing at your vision. The web of light threads drowns out the familiar urban landscape, rendering everything surreal. You feel your stamina and mental energy rapidly depleting.
At this moment, someone tugs at your clothes, and you hear her disjointed voice from behind.

speaker: Maiden
content: ...That's enough.

speaker: Maiden
content: No one... can... do it alone.

speaker: Maiden
content: Let me... do it... with you.

The person behind you moves closer, one hand supporting your waist, the other gently holding your weakening arm. You feel something flowing from her palm, seeping into your body, gathering in your hand, and infusing into the shackles.
Then...
[Glitch effect]

A halo rapidly expands from your hand and cuts through all the Corruptors around you. They halt abruptly, their dark bodies flickering with specks of light. Then, they shake and swell, flashing countless familiar faces in the blink of an eye, unable to move forward.

A second halo follows closely, this time cutting through each rift around you, dispersing the web threads that divide your world. Countless specks of light fall and transform into characters, then quickly dissolve. A deep, resonant rumble echoes in your mind. Then, a third ring...
When the third halo explodes, there are no more threats around you. It just flies across the sky, kindling brilliant fireworks wherever it goes.
(Transition)
You fail to utter this question.
She steps in front of you, gently presses a fingertip to your lips, silencing your words, and closes her eyes.
A bizarre feeling slowly flows through your body, like countless tiny electric currents rolling into you and converging at where her finger rests, before flowing into her fingertip.
This lasts until she opens her eyes again and smiles at you.

speaker: Maiden
content: ...See, now I can speak properly.

speaker: Maiden
content: Hello, dear Chief. My name is 000. It was no easy task to see you in person, but I had a lot of fun. Can you stay with me... a little longer?
Your companions haven't arrived yet, and the next battle hasn't started either. Besides, fireworks must be a rare sight so high up here...
She turns and walks towards the grand, illuminated city.
The wind stops, and the noise fades for the moment. You can clearly hear her voice.
Can you stay with me to watch it all?
Flickering fireworks illuminates her profile, outlining her features in lights and shadows. Beneath the spectacular display, she seems like an illusion.
000 sits on the rooftop, gazing over DisCity, happily chatting about all she has seen.
So this is the wonderful air of DisCity... It's my first time in the outside world. How fascinating.
I never thought that a small speck on the map could be so big when you run through it on your own legs.
Going to Eastside with you during the day, skydiving in Syndicate at night, then swimming in the Rust. Lastly, topping it off with DisSea. Ah, the ice cream was so delicious!
Next time, I want to try milk tea, ride a Harley, maybe even fly a plane! Also, surfing and shooting... Can people farm in Paradeisos? Also, I want to try...
Hmm? Is there something on my face?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I just didn't expect you to be so talkative.
I'm just learning. It's my first time chatting face-to-face with someone like this. I can't help but want to share with you all the interesting things I saw.
I've been looking forward to meeting you for a long time. I'm really happy. Aren't you happy?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not really, especially after being fed a popsicle you’ve already taken a bite of.
Hmm... it was so hot. I couldn't resist when I saw it.
I only took a nibble. I left most of it for you. Don't be such a grinch.
She talks so excitedly, never mentioning the miserable state she was in after being attacked. You remember that scene vividly, filled with unanswered questions.
But it's hard to bring up seeing how joyful she is right now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You said it's your first time outside, first time chatting face-to-face with someone. What were you doing before this? Were you hiding in the dark web?
Yeah, it's a great invention. You can see the whole world without leaving home. Oh, and a lot of info you can't even imagine is in that sea of data.
After connecting with Mania, you can see even more. There are people specifically lurking to gather information about the otherworld.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yeah, crime, malice... it's replete with things that can't see the light of day.
Yeah, just like me. I can't see the light of day...
Before coming to see you, I always hid deep in the dark web. There, I could do many things without being discovered.
You stay silent for a while before finally asking the question you've wondered for so long.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So who exactly is after you?
Every time the girl appears, she gets attacked, and she deliberately reveals a lot of top-secret information to you. She is a huge mystery herself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've hidden a lot of information deep in the dark web. You know about my companions, about me, and a lot of information that even I don't know.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you being hunted because you know too much? Who wants to kill you? Do you pose a threat to someone?
Her smile fades a bit. She looks into your eyes for a long, long time before answering.
Sigh... there are so many happy things to talk about, yet you have to turn to such heavy topics.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If we can eliminate the danger around you, we will have a lot of time together in the future. But right now...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You took such a big risk to see me, and left so much info on that DisMyth website. Isn't it all to meet me and talk to me?
Her smile slowly disappears, and she looks into the distance forlornly.
...Perhaps.
I hoped you would come find me, and I knew what information would catch your attention.
But I also felt that it was pointless for you to run after those things.
Those things were preordained long ago. The harder you try down that path, the more it hurts when you fall. If you really want to know, I'll tell you...
She turns her head to look at you.
There are gods in this world, who dictate everything, including fate, rules, and values.
The first god created light, so the world had colors and shapes.
The second god wove sound, enabling language and communication.
The third and fourth gods set down power and rules. The fifth wrote souls and fate.
Everything is predestined. The world has boundaries. The future is certain. All possible paths you can take are exhausted, and there may not be the ending you expect among them.
But you are worried about me, right? Thank you.
Your topics are much heavier than mine, though. I haven't thought about faraway things like fate, boundaries, or endings yet. It's hard enough to keep going right now.
Can you help me? Just something simple will do. Even it's only about the next step I should take. Tell me what I can try.
Did you understand what I said? The gods dictate everything in this world.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I still want to move forward. Is this desire also dictated?
You smile and take her hand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then the gods are pretty nice, encouraging us to move forward. If such gods exist, I would like to meet them.
Do you really think so?
Pfft, I knew you'd say that. I've seen everything, so I know you inside-out. This is the personality I love.
Don't worry, I'll be with you all the way.
She stands up and pats the dust off her clothes.
Phew... I made things sound too heavy. The truth isn't that impressive. This world is just a game created by the gods.
As it's just a game, we can simply play to our heart's content if we feel like it. If not... we can seek them out and settle the score. Perhaps they're not that great after all.
Since you said you want to seize your fate. Let's set off now.
Oh right, let me ask before we go.
As the last bit of fireworks fade, the girl in white is shrouded in shadows. Her figure flickers like a ghost, but her eyes emit an eerie light.
...Chief, you do know what a "game" is, don't you?
[Transition] 2s
[Glitch]
Light specks of data appear around you, drifting in the air, as a large group of new-type Corruptors slowly takes shape, howling.
Ah, so quick about a simple slip-up.
Sorry, Chief, I just inadvertently told you a huge secret. This time, they're livid.
Do protect me, please.
Though she says this, she doesn't back down. There's no trace of fear on her face.
The Corruptors charge at you—10 meters, 7, 3, now just 1 meter away. 000 simply smiles and watches you as she draws closer.

speaker: Hecate
content: Stay away from him!
female_content: Stay away from her!

content: Nightmare howls as your adjutant and your MBCC companions follow closely behind.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Sinners, break through the Corruptors from the center. Support unit, max out the Hypercube Shield. Send a message to the Cybersecurity Center for full intervention to block the digitalized Mania attack!

speaker: Rise
content: Blocking completed in advance. Currently accelerating the analysis of anomalies at the scene. Awaiting the next command.
Nightingale nods and turns to you right away, confirming your safety.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, thank goodness you were not harmed. The situation will soon be brought under control.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Do you mean the girl from earlier? We will surely find and protect her.
After saying this, Nightingale gets up, loads her weapon, and runs towards the battlefield... While 000 is standing right in front of her.
Really? Hehehe! I'm so happy! Thank you! It's so nice to meet you all!
Laughing, she spreads her arms and strikes a hugging pose, letting Nightingale pass through her body.
Your eyes widen in surprise and your mind races.
Is this a hallucination caused by dark web exposure? Are you contaminated by digitalized Mania? Then the source of contamination is...
You immediately turn off and throw away the comms device in your hand, trying to stay away from the dark web's Mania contamination.
But 000 just watches, not caring and completely unaffected. She turns her gaze back to you. Your head aches, and your consciousness becomes blurry.
Fear not. Although I'm not exactly a good person, I shall always be standing by your side.
Because I am your Sinner, after all.

<size=72>This chaotic, manic storm
has no impact on true fate.</size>
Temporary background and other resources
[Transition] [Looping moving background, or looping blur effect, to make the background move slightly] [Rich sound effects]
You cannot move.
Everything before you feels both real and unreal. Whether it was the intense fight just now or the current eerie  calm, it all feels like a dream.
It feels like an invisible sheet of glass is pressing you flat. You can’t move your hands or feet, and you're forced to stare into the blinding white light.
[Transition] The screen blurs upon being tapped, making it feel uncomfortable.
You still cannot make any movements.
No one responds. In the distance, you hear bizarre sounds that resemble human voices, but are not quite human. You cannot understand their language.

speaker: Distant Voice
content: Avocados on sale! Avocados on sale! Half off only for now! Don't miss out on this great deal! Avocados on sale!
[Information overload] Slight distortion. Everything is shaking and changing. Your eyes are dazzled in an uncomfortable way.
The sounds overwhelm your ears, making you feel suffocated as if you are in a Black Ring. You remember the only weapon at your disposal...
[Screen shakes violently and goes to black]

The shaking vision finally stabilizes. The lights and shadows no longer flicker, and the ringing in your ears fade away. The world before you looks slightly different, but everything else returns to normal.
Even the culprit returns to her rightful place, smiling at you.
Feeling better? The gods' world is of higher dimensions. The information overload is too much for your paper-thin body to handle.
So, I put you into this little phone and adjusted it to a lower dimension mode. This way, you'll feel much better.
She giggles, and the view wobbles slightly... she probably just took a spin.
How do you like my new look? There's still room for improvement, though. Any suggestions?
How about my voice? Do you like it? Should I sing a song for you?
She looks extremely cheerful, like a bird out of a cage, which makes you feel that what she said to you on that rooftop was all an act.
There are no familiar figures around. Dimension change or not, this place is definitely not DisCity. Although the noise has been suppressed, you can still vaguely hear some sounds.
This place is not an illusion, nor a Black Ring, but another world beyond your comprehension.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do you mean by "the gods' world"? Where exactly are we? How did you get me here? What do you want?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's happening in DisCity? Where are my companions?
Homesick already?
Look, the entrance to the game is now in your phone. You can check it anytime if you miss home.
[A glitchy performance] [The screen is murky, emitting wailing sounds]

speaker: Blurry Voices
content: Help... tsss... Chief... tsss... error... Somebody please help me! tsss... Chief, where are you? ...expanding... tsss... Is this the dark web or... tsss...
Unprecedented chaotic information floods the crevice you're in, making you instantly sober. You feel unprecedented panic, wanting to rush into the chaos to return to everyone.
But you are forcibly pulled back.
Alright, alright. There's a glitch over there, so we can't go back right now.
Once we finish our business, the problem will be solved.

speaker: Choice
options: What happened over there? What did you do?

content: Haha, what could I have done? Didn't I tell you? Only the gods can change the world.
You feel absurd asking her this. But the crazed glimmer in her eyes makes it impossible for you to dismiss all this as a joke.
Yeah. You were unconscious for too long after coming here. Before you woke up, I went to meet some of the gods.

speaker: Choice
options: What did you make them do?

content: Make them do? Hahaha, I wasn't there to pray to them.
I killed them all.
She extends her hand, and two strings of strange symbols float in her palm.
Look, this is the power of the gods. I might have accidentally messed up the game while transferring it. Sorry about that. Would you forgive me, please?
There are only two right now. Once we collect them all, everything will return to normal.
Actually no. By then we will dominate the entire game, and you will become the god of the new world.
Alright then, let's go!
She turns to leave with the phone. You feel a sudden weightlessness. The acceleration makes you nauseous and even more nervous.
Ugh, what now, Your Majesty?
What the...?!
Another violent shock hits you, and your vision blurs. It feels as if your body has shattered into countless tiny cubes, pulled out of a small cell phone and hurled into a bizarre tunnel.
Countless specks of light and numbers wash over you, then...
<color=#dg1f1f><size=44>- Message from 5732 -</color></size>

speaker: Interference Noise
content: Chief? Chief ${PlayerName}??

speaker: Interference Noise
content: The comms must have connected. If you hear this, please respond. Lots of people are looking for you.
This voice belongs to...

speaker: Rise
content: It's me. Thank goodness you're alive.

speaker: Rise
content: It's been 16 hours since you were swallowed by that rift. Even the Sinners' shackles can't sense your presence. What is going on...

speaker: EMP
content: Chief... come back now! Everything's messed up back home...

speaker: EMP
content: There are so many monsters in the Bureau! I see doubles of everything, and I can't even aim my arrows... I even saw a freaking Godzilla in the sky!!

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief, are you okay? Are you hurt? Where are you? Are you in danger?

speaker: Hecate
content: You were swallowed by that rift. If we pass through it, can we reach you to help?
The familiar voices warm your heart, but you have to resist the urge to ask for help. Right now, you need to stay calm for their sake.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stay calm. That rift is unnatural. We don't know what might happen if you come over here. I'm relatively safe for now. Don't act on impulse.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: By the way, how did you manage to contact me? Can you brief me on the situation?

speaker: Hecate
content: The one who contacted you is...
(Sound of footsteps, someone falling down)

speaker: Moore
content: Ah! Hot, hot, hot...

speaker: Who's calling this late?
content: Ugh... my coffee, and my report...
It sounds like someone fell, followed by a flurry of confused voices from the other side.

speaker: Moore
content: Huh? Chief, are you there? Oh right, you can't see the situation here. Should I put you on video call? Hmm... okay, it's done. Let's do a video call, Chief.

speaker: Moore
content: Oh no, I look too...
Another flurry of chaos ensues. A new stream of data converges beside you, forming a screen. With a flash of white light...
[Falling CG. Skip the blurry description and move on quickly]
The video connects, but what you see catches you off guard.

speaker: Moore
content: Ahaha... Hello Chief, sorry about that. I've been staying up for my tracking mission and got a bit dazed.

speaker: Moore
content: I'm Moore, Rise's colleague. I'm a technician at the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center. I handle most of the network security work and have recently been dealing with DisCity's dark web.

speaker: Moore
content: By the way, I also worked on the Elysiland incident. Do you remember?

Moore is the head of the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center. She provided key support to the MBCC during the Gray Mirror and Elysiland incidents, but you haven't talked to her in person before. You only recently checked out her profile.
You vaguely remember that an expert helped crack the security system on Elysiland, installing a backdoor for your free access.

speaker: Moore
content: Haha, I'm glad I could help. We've worked well together before. I look forward to working with you again this time.

speaker: Moore
content: When you get back, let's have a coffee? I've heard a lot about you, and have always wanted to meet you.

speaker: Rise
content: Let's save the chit-chat for later. Miss Moore, now that we've found who we were looking for, can you bring Chief back?

speaker: Rise
content: The situation out there is terrible. We really need him.
female_content: The situation out there is terrible. We really need her.

speaker: Moore
content: Oh, sorry. I've been up all night, so I'm a bit over-excited.

speaker: Moore
content: It would be a challenge to bring you back right now. I need time to decode the barriers between the two worlds.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But right now I'm more concerned about what that Sinner meant by "killing the gods." Can you take me to the scene?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You tripped and fell, yet still managed to make a video call between two dimensions in seconds. I’m sure you can pull this off.

speaker: Moore
content: Haha, no problem. I've made preparations already. I knew you would make such a request.

speaker: Moore
content: We all had a hunch that to solve DisCity's problems, you would need to pull a few strings over there.
The woman on the other end of the call smiles gently. She will become your beacon to explore the new world.
Your body has been transformed into something unknown and is trapped in an otherworld device. Sending you to the murder scene of "the gods" would be no easy task.
But this technical expert clearly managed to do it.
With just a few simple commands, you feel a strange fluctuation, and your body becomes lighter.

speaker: Moore
content: You are now successfully digitalized. I can transfer you to the last place she lingered. There happens to be a suitable device there.
While you were still brainstorming what you need her to do, Moore already realized them.

speaker: Rise
content: Be careful at the scene. We don't even know what "the gods" are, let alone what that Sinner means by "killing them."
[Arrival]
The speed of traveling through the data channel is as fast as Moore fulfilling the request, but when you reach the terminal, you realize that perhaps your sense of time is distorted.
"You" have been casually placed in a dim room. It's already night outside, and directly in front of you is a huge whiteboard covered in otherworldly language.
Before you can make out the text, your vision gets blocked by something. You instinctively reach out, but quickly realize it's no use.
Drip-drip...
They're blood drops. The killing has already happened.
You hear Rise gasp.

speaker: Moore
content: The scene must be terrifying. How awful.

speaker: Choice
options: Rise, connect with the sheriff for investigation.

speaker: Rise
content: ...I'll be right back.
The intern's footsteps fade away.

speaker: Moore
content: Did you deliberately send her away? How kind of you, Chief.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: After all, she's just a young intern. No matter how reliable she is, a murder scene is too much for her to stomach.

speaker: Moore
content: Huh? Should I be feeling something?

speaker: Moore
content: Hehe, it's fine, I'm still half asleep. Don't worry. Investigate to your heart's content, Chief. I'll decode and analyze the data from the scene.
A halo appears before your eyes. It appears to be some kind of decoding process. Following Moore's instructions, you try to touch it with your hand.
Investigation 1
Moore sends back the images with translations added and bloodstains removed. Now you can see more clearly.
Investigation 2
The content on the left looks like some regular art design workflows, though some parts are hard to translate.
It seems to include some self-encouraging phrases.
Investigation 3
The content on the right is meant to categorize music tracks, which is easier to understand. There seems to be a rough hand-drawn doodle in the lower right corner.
Investigation 4
Curious, you zoom in. The content on the screen is somewhat puzzling. It seems to be the death scene of some kind of bird, which stands out from the rest of the content.
It just looks like the work of ordinary people.
Nothing indicative of the powerful world-commanding gods that 000 had mentioned.
[Investigation Ends]
A buzzing sound suddenly rings out. You see a message transmitted to this device.
"What time will you be back? Should I leave the door open for you?"
You feel a sense of suffocation.
This place is rather ordinary, much like a meeting room in a small company in Eastside.
So much so that it feels like the one who died here was not a "god" but merely a common person that you would encounter in the streets.
She doesn't appear but lets you hear her voice.
Hehe, I was wondering when you'd notice me.
Why do you look so unhappy? Angry that I peeked at your investigation?
Or mad that I committed a crime here?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I make it a habit to stay alert around dangerous people, especially someone as ruthless as you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You killed a person here, didn't you?
Not a "person," Chief. They're not from your world, not your kind, and they have no feelings for you.
They never care about what you care about, so why should you worry about their lives? Do you cry for the Corruptors you kill?

speaker: Choice
options: Do you think I would still believe anything you say?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: After kidnapping, deceiving, and using me?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Confining me here won't stop me from finding out the truth. I'm not alone.

speaker: Moore
content: No problem. I've hacked into the surveillance cameras at the scene. The data is connected, Chief. The surveillance footage is now streaming to you in real-time.
[Switch to static]
Wait!
The surveillance camera doesn't follow 000's command but instead points to the ground on the other side.
[Duck death scene]
Sigh... At least let me clean up the scene first. The blood and gore will make you hate me even more.
A god. To be precise, it's the corpse of a god I killed. Sorry, I'm a bad, ruthless woman.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Isn't this just a duck? And a goofy-looking one at that.
Are you questioning my intelligence? How dare you. Don't use your low-dimensional mind to imagine the true form of a god.
What's wrong with looking like this? It's cute. Don't judge a god by its appearance.
What a fuss! This is the god who created your game. Don't believe me? Look!
Hehe.
You're stunned and completely at a loss on how to take in the situation before you.
Is she telling the truth? Setting aside the whole "god" thing, do the creatures of this world really look like this?
You sigh. This farce is so absurd that you want to pinch your face to see if you can wake up from it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So it's just killing ducks. Do whatever makes you happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I don't have time to spare. Send me back.
No, no... they just look cute, but they're not actually goofy. Don't think any less of them.
No, you can't fall for her trick. You immediately steady your mind.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This bit of footage proves nothing. It could also be faked. You have no credibility with me anymore.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is a completely staged murder scene. You're wasting my time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Tell me the truth. What did you do to our world?
Ah, what a stubborn log you are. You used to be more fun and relaxed. Why are you so...

speaker: Choice
options: I don't believe a word you say.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Moore, what do you make of this?

speaker: Moore
content: Chief, I've thoroughly searched all the data available at the scene. The surveillance footage and recordings have not been tampered with. But there is indeed the possibility of other alterations, perhaps done hastily, leaving some traces of anomalies.

speaker: Moore
content: I suspect there are deeper secrets at this murder scene that have been altered, but I've yet to confirm the specifics.
You see 000 raise an eyebrow with interest.

speaker: Choice
options: So it's a trick after all.

speaker: Moore
content: Additionally, I've retrieved and decoded a large amount of audio-visual data from the deceased's phone currently accessed by you. Some data is locked and inaccessible, but the available content indeed matches the situation in DisCity.

speaker: Moore
content: It is worth noting that some of the content has been abnormally modified recently. These modifications perfectly correspond to the recent apparitions in DisCity.

speaker: Moore
content: In other words, whether it's ducks or gods, there is indeed a certain kind of being at this scene with the power to alter our world, whose might is beyond our imagination.
...No wonder you were snatched away from me. Turns out it's an expert who can grasp the key points right away.
Moore, right?

speaker: Moore
content: Thanks for the compliment. Helping Chief is my job.
Is that so... Then please help him. Our Chief still seems confused.
female_content: Is that so... Then please help her. Our Chief still seems confused.

content: She turns back to you.
It doesn't matter what the gods look like. I turned them into these funny creatures for your sake.
If you saw the real death scene, you'd flare up immediately.

speaker: Choice
options: ...What does the real scene look like?

content: Disturbing images flash through your mind. What's really behind those two toys...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who really got killed here? What are these ducks really...
Who do you think they are? Gods? Ducks? Or <color=#fb9259>people</color> like you?
Hehe, doesn't matter anymore. No matter what they once were, this is what they are now. Their existence has changed.
Since I killed two gods and took the power to control their form and voice, I've already replaced them.
And these are just the first two. Once I get them all...

speaker: Choice
options: I won't let you do that.

content: Then come over to my side? Be my companion, and we can usurp the gods together. The power will be yours by then.
If you don't trust me to play with the world, then you do it. You have my earnest invitation.
Why? I know you're a flexible person who's ready to try new things. Why not give me a chance?
Think of it like this: this is a one-stop solution to resolve all problems and realize all wishes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm no stranger to this kind of bait and I won't fall for it.
Are you really going to refuse? Aren't you tempted, even a little? You've never been curious about my proposal? Don't you want to try the second option?
...You won't stand with me no matter what?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Say no more. I will do everything I can to stop you.
Hahaha, of course, I know. I was just teasing you!
You would never choose or be tempted by me. You are the unwavering Chief who would never betray your true self.
But is this really your true self? Or is it designed by someone else for you?
A smile shows on her face.
I won't make it hard for you. I know you are not in a position to make any choice right now. You can only go down the path dictated for you. That's fine.
Just think of it as a game. The ones who died are just toy ducks. You came here for a silly adventure. Your only enemy is a shallow, daydreaming oddball of a Sinner.
If I can't be your teammate, being your opponent would be fun too. It's a game, after all, which is meant to be enjoyed.
Once everything settles, you will be liberated too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I am already free and under no one's control. I don't need your liberation.
Alright, alright, time's almost up. I'm off.
As much as I want to stay with you, the next god is already waiting for me to deliver the killing blow. I can't delay any longer.
Game on! Whether you join me, try to stop me, or just travel around for fun in this otherworld, it's up to you.
Since you believe so much in your own free will.

speaker: Moore
content: Chief, should we go after her?

speaker: Choice
options: ...Do you believe the absurd things she said?

speaker: Moore
content: Hmm... I don't see anything wrong with them?

speaker: Moore
content: "The world is a huge game, and the gods set all the rules." Haha, this concept has also been brought up in old movies. As a programmer, I quite like this way of understanding the world.

speaker: Moore
content: Except for the gods' appearance... They're really too cute, completely different from what I imagined.

speaker: Moore
content: So, Chief, do you believe what she said?
No matter how ridiculous her words are, it's very likely that there is some strong link between the two worlds.
You slowly understand the things written on that whiteboard, which bear uncanny resemblance to your world. If she can really seize all the gods' authority...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We must stop her, but...
With your paper-thin body trapped in the device... what can you do... the next target...

speaker: Moore
content: Don't worry, I've already pinpointed the most likely target she's after next.

speaker: Moore
content: According to her game world theory, the world where DisCity is located is numbered as 5732. This is the developer's world.

speaker: Moore
content: On the computers of the two murdered ducks, I found an online space which serves as a kind of group chat for developers. Many IDs are having real-time discussions, and indeed, they are all related to our world.
As she speaks, she shows you some group chat texts.

speaker: Moore
content: Interesting. Just as that Sinner was about to leave, a new discussion started in the developers' group:

speaker: Choice
options: Is the next target this "Code Duck"?

speaker: Moore
content: Very likely. If I were her, I would also target this duck first.

speaker: Moore
content: After all, "programming" authority is very important.
You break into a sweat.

speaker: Choice
options: Are we able to catch up to her?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: At the very least, we can't let her gain more power.

speaker: Moore
content: Rise has already pinpointed her destination. I'll find a transferable target device for you.
Everyone is doing their best to assist you, you must find 000 and stop her plan.
At least, find her before she succeeds again.
Half an hour passes, and you are still waiting in the data stream, completely unaware of how the god-slaying is unfolding.

speaker: Choice
options: So right now we know that the target is on the road.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then... would monitoring the traffic in this world help? For example, can you track the cars heading toward 000's location and identify the people in them?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Maybe tap a line or something?

speaker: Moore
content: Line tapped. That Sinner had the same idea. We can simply follow her path to the destination. I'm looking for that little duck.

speaker: Choice
options: But we can't check every car.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There must be hundreds of cars heading that way, and she could act at any moment. We can’t afford to find the wrong person. Can we get ahead of her?

speaker: Moore
content: Don't worry, the target has been located. I'll send you over right away.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Although it's late at night, the traffic here is still bustling. I can tell this is a big city, just like Eastside. How did you manage to find the target so quickly?

speaker: Moore
content: Haha, because we are very lucky. In this world, Game 5732 is not very popular, and very few people have it installed.
You recall the two ducks you just met. Their devices had this game installed, and in that moment, everything clicks.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So you're saying that although few people play this game, the gods who created it must have Game 5732 on their phone.

speaker: Moore
content: That's right. Guess how many phones in the cars possibly heading to your location have this game installed?
You smile.

speaker: Moore
content: Correct. The transmission link is generated. Chief, are you ready?
[Jump to murder scene]
You look outside the screen. The traffic has started to thin out, with only the traffic light blinking ahead.
Moore sends you a link, trying to connect the device you are in to the surveillance cameras outside.
You see the car still driving. Code Duck is clearly struggling to keep its drowsy eyes open to head for work.

speaker: Code Duck
content:
Quack... quack... Quack quack...
(Error, error... check the pointer...)
000 hasn't appeared yet, but the target is already a mess.

speaker: Code Duck
content:
Quack... Quack quack quack...
(Where is the bug...)
You couldn't wake it up. That's not surprising; your paper-thin body can't even break the glass, and people in this world might not understand your language.

speaker: Moore
content: How's it going?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It is already half asleep even though it's still driving...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Rust

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It wouldn't take much effort on her part, and everyone would believe that Code Duck died in a car crash from fatigue driving late at night.
In any case, you must alert this duck somehow before 000 arrives.
Suddenly, you feel a jolt, like an earthquake, or a bomb went off!

speaker: Moore
content: Don't worry. It has already been intercepted.

speaker: Moore
content: But be careful, Chief, she's also here.
Everything around you is now covered in a thick layer of white gauze and slows down a thousand times. You see a stream of light slowly shooting toward the target!
The duck is unaware and is still struggling to keep its eyes open.
You're here! I knew you'd choose me of your own free will. I'm not being sarcastic, I'm genuinely happy...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Cut it out. I'm here to stop you.
Alright, alright. The assassination game starts now!
In this special force field, I'm the assassin, you're the guard, and we both have special combat techniques. Let's have some fun.
