Just let them pour out all their hatred on her. After all, no one's better than a Sinner to suffer all the Mania, to bear the burden of their pain. That is the very reason her power exists—to save these shattered dreams.

speaker: Zindy
content: It was all a lie, wasn't it? We're never going to DisCity, aren't we?

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Oh, you naive child. Are you only figuring it out now? What took you so long?

speaker: Zindy
content: You promised to clear our records and said we could start a new life in DisCity...

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Has it never crossed your mind that this might be too good to be true? Or, perhaps you've been overestimating me—or underestimating DisCity's border police?
Vautour Bleu's expression remains unflappable as she faces the barrage of accusations, her voice calm. Her gaze, steady and indifferent, falls on Zindy, who crumples to the ground devastated.
[Dark alley]
Meanwhile, around you, new monsters begin spawning in the corners uncovered by datura flowers, croaking their resentment for the lie of Désir.
Vautour Bleu's words echoes in your mind, in an inaptly casual tone: "We'll purge them all in the end anyway. Just let the monsters come to me."

speaker: Chief
content: The more monsters there are, it means the more they hate you and the heavier the damage you'll have to bear. How can you still be smiling...

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: I just can't help feeling pleased to entrust them to you.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Before you arrived, I had my doubts about you. I thought you were an Outland Affairs Bureau agent coming to investigate the immigration and shut down this town. But then I saw how you got along with the people here, and how you showed more concern about Mania. Also, you tried to protect the townsfolk from the monsters.

speaker: Chief
content: So you've been testing me from the moment we met?

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: And haven't you been doing the same, my little neighbor?
The Outland Affairs Bureau hasn't responded to your request. Nightingale's support will also take a while to arrive.
You can't let her bear all this new wave of Mania alone. The battle for Désir has only just begun.
[Town center]

speaker: Alba
content: You... you made us work here... kept telling me to wait, that my turn would come...

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: I needed cheap labor. How else do you think my merchant caravan could've made my fortune?

speaker: Primrose
content: What about those who already made it to DisCity?

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: No one's ever made it. Not a single one. Your dear friend Sheila has turned into one of these monsters too.

speaker: Juan
content: So it's all just about the money, eh? Damn you, Vautour Bleu—I trusted you...!
[Dark alley]
All the surviving townsfolk are now within the safe zone. Outside, monsters continue gathering, their hungry eyes fixed on the town center, yet they're repelled by the final barrier of datura.
You can feel your strength ebbing away with overexertion, not knowing how much longer you can hold out.
If you survive this blast of resentment, come with us. I'll help clear up the misunderstanding, the hatred they have against you.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Come with you? Hehe, I've always been alone.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Alone on my balcony, whiling away the afternoons with my tea. I would watch those silly kids come by, clinging to scraps of hope. I made them promises, then watched them go.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Now, gladly someone can take over my job, so...

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: No worries. A poor reputation won't be much of a burden. I'm used to being alone.
Another newly spawned monster collapses under your shackles, cursing Vautour Bleu with its last agonizing cries.
[Town center]

speaker: Primrose
content: So, from the moment you took us in... Was it all just a lie...?

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Took you in? Wasn't it your own stubborn choice to follow me here and stay in Désir?

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: The gates were always open. As long as you pay off your bills here, you're free to leave anytime. But no, you all clung to your laughable pipe dreams, that a better life is awaiting you.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: You call me a liar? You might as well point your finger at DisCity. Did you really think they'd let you in with the scraps you saved up? DisCity isn't some charity center for refugees.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: In fact, you'd be better off handing your money to me. After all, life in Désir wasn't so bad, was it?
Vautour Bleu's cavalier attitude has already pushed the near-hysterical townsfolk to the brink. Yet, she continues to fan the flames.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Oh, and where's Dove? You might ask her about those letters—about how she forged each one, feeding you lies of hope.

speaker: Liam
content: The letters... Even those letters were fake...?

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Correct. Désir is nothing but a woven lie, nothing more than a wasteland discarded by DisCity. I had my people remove the dead plants and planting new ones every day to maintain this so-called oasis. You all owe me.
The monsters' growls draw ever closer to the safe zone. The townsfolk watch in horror as the once-lush datura flowers die before their eyes.

speaker: Juan
content: Shameless! I shoulda never trusted you! Now it makes sense—that's why you kept raising the bar for my trip. Listen up, Vautour Bleu! If I'm gonna die for those monsters, I'm gonna take you down with me, you hear that?!
The riot spreads like wildfire. Scattered shouts of anger turn into deafening roars. The tools used to fend off monsters are now all aimed at Vautour Bleu.
[Dark alley]

You can't clear the Corruptors fast enough to catch up with the mounting waves of malice. These specters, consumed with resentment, seem to be drawn by the charged atmosphere in the town center. Growling, they brush past you, converging toward one direction.
Vautour Bleu's proposal is surely awful, yet it's the most pragmatic decision she could make as a merchant.
I can play along with you, but I can't promise DisCity will be on board.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: That's because they don't know what we're bringing to the table yet.

speaker: Chief
content: What do you mean... What's in it for DisCity?

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: The assurance that the Outland Sinner Vautour Bleu is no longer a threat to their borders.
Beep, beep. Your communicator finally chimes. Backup is en route.
[Town center]
The enraged townsfolk are hurling clubs and stones. Spit, broken bottles, and rotten bread rain down on Vautour Bleu, accompanied by shrill screams and curses.
Yet she stands unmoved, enduring it all calmly, her gaze steady and fixed beyond the safe zone. At last, she spots the frail figure arriving with a support crew clad in white.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: The deal is done... Now, go be their beacon of hope. This is all I can do.

Standing on the ravaged street, Vautour Bleu raises her smoking pipe high above her head. Indigo power erupts from its tip, and in an instant, the last datura flowers in the safe zone wither and die. With the barrier gone, the monsters surge toward her in a frenzied wave.
People flee in terror, yet their bodies grow heavier with each step. The approaching creatures feed on their fear and despair, siphoning the last bit of strength from their agony.
As you arrive with the FAC reinforcements, the twisted, shadowy monsters have fused into a colossal entity. Its towering presence looms above, leaving you and the FAC soldiers frozen in shock.
It's the agglomeration of their obsessive dreams, shaped just like DisCity itself...

In the distance you spot her—the figure you've gazed at so many times from your window. But now she's no longer surrounded by her carefully tended plants, only a monstrous entity where she stands beneath, weary yet resolute. As you both agreed, she steps alone into the swirling vortex of Mania.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Don't let me down, little Chief.
The luminous spikes of the shackles pierce through the creature's core, and in an instant, the colossal monster falls apart. Yet the air still reeks of its stench and an oppressive aura of despair.
You scan the surrounding chaos, in search of any sign of Vautour Bleu, when a small hand grabs the hem of your clothes.
Liam grips your clothes tightly, staring at Désir with a blank expression. The once peaceful, vibrant town now lies charred in ruins.
The streets are littered with debris, and the alleys once adorned with colorful flower pots are now scorched and lifeless.
The town square's fountain stands bone-dry, its basin now a reservoir of viscous monster slime.
The townsfolk, unable to process the sudden catastrophe, stagger in the wreckage. Emotionally drained, they can only stare at the rubble around them.

speaker: Townie C
content: You're... the one from DisCity...
A local you've rescued recognizes you. Those dull, lifeless eyes brighten briefly before going out again.

speaker: Townie C
content: Mess
Though the immediate threat has passed, the townsfolk do not seem to rejoice, but instead look weary and lost.
Alba, who always wore a bright smile, has now lost all her lively colors. Her pallid face bears only streaks of dried tears.

speaker: Alba
content: DisCity... it's impossible now... It was all a lie...

speaker: Alba
content: All the dieting... all the starving... it was for nothing...
She murmurs, clutching her stomach as a dry heave racks her. But nothing comes from her retching, her body too depleted to even respond.

speaker: Zindy
content: Who can we trust now? If we can't go to DisCity, where do we go?

speaker: Zindy
content: Désir... it's in ruins. It's over. Everything is over.
As their gaze falls upon you and the soldiers, no one speaks. They simply stare, as if you were apparitions from another realm, alien and intangible.

speaker: Liam
content: Is it over now? Is Désir gonna be destroyed? I... I have no home to go to...
No, DisCity isn't here to destroy. We've come to take you to the Drifter Camp, where you can start a new life.

speaker: Liam
content: Drifter Camp? What's that?
Liam looks up, his eyes meeting yours with confusion, as if slowly waking from a long nightmare.
It's a settlement in DisCity's West District. Not long ago, they survived a Mania disaster even worse than yours. The Black Ring nearly took their entire home.

speaker: Liam
content: That doesn't sound good.
You're right. To be honest, DisCity is far from good.
Life in the Drifter Camp might not be as comfortable as here in Désir. It's a noisy place, railcars constantly zipping between buildings, and the vendors don't even give you what you pay for...
But they survived the disaster. They're rebuilding it, their home, bit by bit.
The food at the Grand Stall is actually pretty good. Sure, you'll run into some hotheads or greedy sellers, but most of the people there are friendly.
They're all just folks who'd run out of options and had nowhere to go—just like you.
But they've transformed the Drifter Camp with their own hands. Not relying on anyone, they fight off contamination and turn the rusty shacks into a fortress, a living community.
Liam's eyes light up, and then he sees the group behind you.
Reinforcements from the Outland Affairs Bureau and the MBCC have arrived, along with a massive sand ship, large enough for evacuating the entire population of the town.

speaker: That way it would match my hair and clothes, don't you think?
content: You're from DisCity. Can we really trust you?
That I can't decide for you. But I can tell you one thing though: The bread you make, Primrose, it'll be love wherever you go.

speaker: Alba
content: ...Can we really go there? That Drifter Camp place?

speaker: Juan
content: If this DisCity pal says we can go, then we're good to go!
A spark of life returns to their dull eyes. The dying embers of their old dreams reignite, kindling a new flame of hope that spreads among the townsfolk.

speaker: Liam
content: Will there be other friends my age there?

speaker: Zindy
content: Is it far away? I'm running low on cash...

Excitement sweeps across the townsfolk. They're like castaways at sea spotting a ship on the horizon. Where this ship is headed doesn't matter—any destination is better than the vast, frigid ocean of sands.
The questions from townsfolk pour in about the Drifter Camp. People crowd around you, like they once did with Vautour Bleu.
Through the shifting sea of people, you finally catch a glimpse of the familiar silhouette...
[Small CG Farewell 1]
She appears unscathed, her posture as proud as ever. Tucked away in an inconspicuous corner, she seems content, looking genuinely happy that everyone has found a new glimmer of hope.
Vautour Bleu watches the townsfolk from afar, eyes brimming with gentle warmth and unspoken blessings.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Go easy on the booze when you get to DisCity, Juan, or you'll soon go broke before you know it.
If he pawns his dagger for a drink again, she won't be able to buy it back for him any more.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Alba, you're such a sweet girl with a sweet tooth.
In her eyes, Alba has always been the prettiest girl in Désir.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Primrose, you can make your way in the world with your skills, no matter where you go.
It's a shame she'll likely never taste it again.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Liam, one day you'll grow into a promising young man.
Take your time, take your time... until one day he's ready to face the truth that Mom is long gone.
As she reminisces her time with everyone, Vautour Bleu takes a step back, then another. She turns around and walks alone into the shadow of the town.
If dreams are destined to fade, then just keep having more.
[Small CG Farewell 2]

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Carry on what I couldn't. Keep their unfulfilled dreams safe in the oasis for me.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Next time you open your window, I won't be there anymore.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Au revoir, my little neighbor.
Her steps falter, but her demeanor remains serene. The remaining monsters still linger in the dark, their grotesque forms faintly visible in the shadows.
She's heading back to her chamber, but this time, her neighbor won't be joining her.
You both walk away, paths diverging, a final parting in silence.
I have one last question, about our deal.
Why are you doing all this?

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Do you know how I decide who should stay in Désir?
Vautour Bleu taps her smoking pipe as if trying to tap off the ash of her past. As the embers fade, only wisps of smoke linger in the air.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: I can tell with just a single glance. No one knows better than I do what kind of person can survive on the strength of dreams.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Preserving dreams before they fall apart... that's my own sweet fantasy.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Just so you know. This place... is my oasis, too.

Rumors about the disappearance of Désir circulate among the bazaars of WhiteSands. Some say a disaster devoured the oasis; others believe that DisCity's patience ran thin, leading the FAC to purge the town's shady trafficking business.
A woman leans against the cargo ship, staying away from the bustling market gossip. In her hands is a letter bearing a familiar postmark.
It is the same mark from that confidential recording from DisCity.

speaker: Letter
content: Désir's Mania crisis resolved. The "deal" is over.

She's never interested in dealing with the big families of the Outlands. With the deal concluded, there's no need to keep any proof. She lights the envelope with her pipe, watching that emblem of the northwestern noble family blacken into ash.
Her caravan crew stands ready with several refugees waiting to board. She gives them a nod.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Kids heading to DisCity again? Let them tag along. We're merchants, after all. No reason to turn down good business.
As long as there's a need, Désir will always exist.
It might be known by other names—the Chief from DisCity or the Drifter Camp, or simply, hope, which will always live on.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Allons-y. Time to move on to our next Désir.
The caravan sets off from the rest station, fading into the boundless WhiteSands.
[Switch Scene]

They say, in Eastia, there was a cursed painting known as the "Jade Fox." Though the fox was rendered with uncanny realism, it was a malevolent artifact that brought misfortune, claiming the lives of many nobles. Only when a wandering Daoist sealed it away did the tragedies finally cease.

The Daoist devoted his days to exorcising spirits deep in the mountains. On the eve of his ascension to immortality, the painted fox suddenly stirred, transforming into a maiden of ethereal beauty. She fell right into his arms, her silk dress rustling as her sweet fragrance enveloped him. In her eyes lingered an unmistakable affection.

The mortal and the spirit locked gazes, their souls entwined in a wordless connection.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 At long last, the Daoist drew a deep breath and held the fox spirit close. Perhaps, in this fleeting joy, his long years of solitude had finally found purpose.

With it, a duet of intertwined spirits unfolded, a delicate dance of shared sweat and soft whispers. Her waist swayed like a willow wavering in the breeze, her scent as intoxicating as dew-kissed petals. The two lovebirds nestled together, their flesh charging as one...
You quickly cover OwO's ears.

speaker: OwO
content: Hey! What are you doing, little clapper? I can't hear anything!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well, that's... not right, not in THIS WAY. I'll make some changes before we continue.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And we'll have <color=#fb9259>someone else</color> tell you the story.
As you finish speaking, you turn to face <color=#fb9259>Yugu</color> with an irritated glare, peeved about her inappropriate words.
The "wayward" storyteller sits gracefully straight, slowly raising her eyes to meet yours. Her gaze appears distant and wandering, as if her spirit hasn't quite returned from the world of her tale.

speaker: Storyteller
content: It's been so long since anyone has interrupted me like that...

speaker: Storyteller
content: Chief, do you find my tale lacking in captivation? Or perhaps, you'd like to take the taleteller's seat yourself?
The Eastian woman gently folds her fan and taps it against the table's edge, the crisp sound breaking the story's spell as if waking one from a dream.

N.F. 115, An Unspecified Day
Between Winter and Spring
MBCC Reception Room

Ever since the Eastian delegation's visit last year, DisCity has been gripped by "Eastia Fever." The populace is fascinated by this distant land that has been long isolated by calamities. Everything Eastian—from its immigrants to its cuisine, from its customs to its exotic tales—has taken the city by storm.
Thus, this Eastian Sinner who claims herself a <color=#fb9259>taleteller</color> has become Eastside's most sought-after guest.

Yugu journeys across distant lands, collecting folk tales, peculiar anecdotes, and ancient myths. She recently arrived in DisCity along the newly established trade routes. Rumor has it that she possesses a mysterious power to weave narratives so compelling that they transport her listeners into the very heart of the story, rendering her taletelling salon tickets perpetually sold out.
While Yugu was at MBCC registering as an Outland Sinner, you took the opportunity to request a small performance from her.
Though no one was prepared for what her performance would reveal.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I invited you here because I heard of your extensive knowledge, especially regarding Eastian customs and culture. This wasn't the kind of story I had in mind...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Fabricated supernatural spirits, and... that... inappropriate content.

speaker: Yugu
content: Fabricated supernatural spirits... inappropriate content...

speaker: Yugu
content: Chief, I travel far and wide seeking tales of the most exquisite beauty to share with others. Naturally, they need a touch of embellishment to truly captivate. And in these few days, "The Jade Fox" has become quite the sensation among DisCity's elite.

speaker: Yugu
content: It has all the eccentric oddities that satiate the exotic fantasies the locals harbor about Eastia, alongside the allure of a beautiful maiden—after all, who doesn't enjoy a touch of sensual romance?

speaker: Yugu
content: It is my modest desire to entertain all with this tale, yet it appears I may have unintentionally provoked your ire, Chief...

speaker: Yugu
content: My inadequate craftsmanship has clearly dampened your spirits. I shall speak no more. Whatever registration procedures you require, I am at your disposal.
With it, she puts on her veil and assumes a statuesque pose with downcast eyes, upholding her vow of silence. Her display of compliance has left you, the host, in quite an awkward position.

speaker: Option
options: Well, maybe it's just cultural nuances...
When in DisCity, do as we do.

content: The Eastians I know aren't quite so... free-spirited. I apologize if I seem shocked, but I'd appreciate it if you could adjust your storytelling style.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't know what your regular audience prefers, but things are different here. Not everyone in DisCity seeks such... liberal entertainment.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your presence here isn't just for entertainment. Paradeisos... I mean, the Bureau is interested in establishing closer relations with Eastia.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We invited you for your extensive experience and engaging narrative style. We'd love for you to share stories about daily life and customs in Eastia. This would help deepen mutual understanding between our peoples, and...
You glance at OwO, who's blinking expectantly beside you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: OwO has been feeling homesick, and she's eager to hear your perspective on stories from Eastia.
As Yugu still offers no response, OwO glances between the two of you, adorning a crafty smile that seems far too shrewd for a child her age.

speaker: OwO
content: You're so bad at reading the room, little clapper! Yugu is just a bit tired and needs a break. Let me take over the storytelling!
With that, she hops off your lap with a thump and bounces over to Yugu, the lion's head swaying as she moves.

speaker: OwO
content: Legend has it in my hometown Goldionville, there dwells a big golden lion skilled at dancing.

speaker: OwO
content: The lion is incredibly powerful—one ROAR, and all evil runs away; one RAWR, and good fortune comes to stay! Every spring in Eastia, Goldionville holds a grand fest where they invite the golden lion to descend from the heavens for a dance performance.
As she speaks, she performs a full spin with the lion's head, vividly demonstrating the dance.

speaker: OwO
content: But when I went back to Goldionville, it was already fall. I've never seen the real golden lion or joined the New Year celebrations in Eastia they always talk about.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmm... How do they really celebrate the New Year over there? What do people do? I'm so curious... Has anyone heard any stories about it before, I wonder...
She bounces over to Yugu with her lion's head bobbing playfully, making the prop blink its eyes with exaggerated flutters.

speaker: Yugu
content: Hehe, this golden lion is truly a busy one. In Eastia, every household celebrates the New Year, and the legends that come with it are as boundless as the ocean itself.

speaker: Yugu
content: For instance... I happen to know of another tale, a legend of a <color=#fb9259>Hazy Fete in a Daze</color>, unfolding in a time when flowers bloom and their scents enchant the breeze.

speaker: OwO
content: I've heard about fetes! Will there be lion dances, too? What about yummy food? Are there also lai see and all sorts of Eastians there?
The taleteller shifts her glance between OwO and you, her eyes narrowing ever so slightly.

speaker: Yugu
content: Certainly. Every essence of life is there—joy and sorrow, warmth and wisdom. This should satisfy what you desire, Chief.

speaker: Yugu
content: Would my dear listeners care to delve into this tale with me?

A subtle smile seems to grace her face as the taleteller slowly removes her veil. The moment she utters the first words, you feel your consciousness being pulled away by a strange force, drawn into a faraway realm...

speaker: Yugu
content: They say, in times long past, within Phonidale Town of Kingdom Fauxia, there existed this Bloomfete Street where a millennium-old wisteria tree stood. Through the ages, the tree gained mystical powers—those who whispered wishes beneath its blossoms would find their answers in the coming year.
[Screen fades to black, lip animation]

speaker: Yugu
content: And thus, with the blossoming of flowers each year, the denizens of Bloomfete Street would gather around the wisteria tree, erecting altars in reverence and celebrating this godly manifestation, where all participants found their wishes answered.

speaker: Yugu
content: Word of this marvel spread far and wide, beckoning numerous seekers to the fete. Yet only a precious few—those blessed by fate—could enter and find a single bloom among thousands, bestowed with lifelong happiness.

speaker: Yugu
content: Now... do you two perceive the scent in the air?

speaker: Yugu
content: Ah yes, the fragrance of flowers. The millennium-old wisteria tree blooms once more, and now begins the celebration.

speaker: Yugu
content: O destined ones, welcome to the Hazy Fete in a Daze.
[Switch Scene]
The scenery before you suddenly shifts in a dreamlike haze, while the taleteller's tender voice still lingers in your ears.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: And so our outlander roams the festival grounds, hour after hour, losing all track of time in joy before dawn.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Perhaps from all the merrymaking, a deep weariness now begins to wash over him.
female_content: And so our outlander roams the festival grounds, hour after hour, losing all track of time in joy before dawn.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Perhaps from all the merrymaking, a deep weariness now begins to wash over her.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: While the young lion dancer still frolics energetically by the street, the outlander's gaze is captivated by a small, ink-dark building.　　　　 Looking up, the outlander beholds three striking words etched on the signboard—

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Truly, it is the House of Tales, its name inscribed in dignified strokes. From within drifts a familiar voice—a woman weaving some tale...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That must be Yugu telling one of her stories.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Who can say? The outlander takes a step ahead, pushes open the door, and crosses over the wooden threshold.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 With the door closing behind, all the world's clamor fades into silence beyond those walls.
[Scene Change] Inside the House

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Inside the silent small building, only the whisper of rustling bamboo is heard, accompanied by the aroma of ink permeating the air. Save for the familiar figure in white standing at the railing of the stage, the hall remains void of any presence.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: As the outlander nears the stage, the woman elegantly folds her fan and pivots to greet her guest.

You begin sharing your experiences with her—tales of strange spirits, fascinating customs, and mystical legends. When you come to realize it, you find yourself fully engrossed in the exchange for quite some time, perhaps even neglecting your official duties.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come to think of it, I've been here quite a while, and it's getting late. Would you mind showing me the way back?

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: A smile graces the woman's lips.

speaker: Yugu
content: How amusing. It is your first visit to my House of Tales, and instead of staying for a story, you request guidance to leave.

speaker: Yugu
content: Such treatment truly casts a shadow upon a storyteller's pride, does it not?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It seems I failed to appreciate the spirit of this place. My apologies.

speaker: Option
options: Then let's continue with this tale.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: From what you're implying, this fete holds more secrets than meets the eye, and you don't want me to miss them.

speaker: Yugu
content: Indeed, it is so.

speaker: Yugu
content: They say the Fete lasts for four days. The first day is for welcoming guests to explore freely—just as you are doing now.

speaker: Yugu
content: The second day is dedicated to offerings for the Wisteria Fairy. Those favored by destiny offer their tributes, and as spring brings warmth and bloom, the Wisteria Fairy will regain her celestial powers.

speaker: Yugu
content: On the third day, people write their wishes on paper tags and tie them beneath the wisteria branches. With heartfelt sincerity, they pray for the Wisteria Fairy to heed their desires.

speaker: Yugu
content: By the fourth day, once the Wisteria Fairy has perused all the wishes, she transforms them into flower lanterns that ascend towards the heavens, reaching the abode of the deities.

speaker: Yugu
content: Thus the fete reaches its perfect completion, the prayers drawing to a close. With the Wisteria Fairy's blessing, the deities shall surely grant the wishes of every soul.

speaker: Option
options: You really do have a thing for mystical tales, don't you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And those locals all look... um, quite peculiar.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Someone else might have found them pretty scary.

speaker: Yugu
content: Hehe, I find myself drawn to such things. They're quite fascinating to me.

speaker: Yugu
content: Quaint and mysterious, these tales hold their own enchanting allure. However, upon profound contemplation, a whisper of truth emerges beneath the facade of fantasy... This is the true splendor of myths and tales.

speaker: Yugu
content: And with a touch of sensuality, they would be truly exquisite.

speaker: Option
options: Come now, there are kids around.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's perfect as it is—full of vigor and warmth, genuine and heartfelt.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You mentioned that people in DisCity are captivated by the exotic tales from Eastia, but the demon-like spirits within these stories, despite their frightening appearance, have hearts just as warm as those of humans.

speaker: Yugu
content: Humans wearing masks are no different from spirits donning human guises, after all. Emotions and desires flow from the same source—it's always the heart that holds the most precious truth.
The tap of her pipe against the table snaps you back to reality—you've once again found yourself completely entranced by her vivid storytelling.

speaker: Yugu
content: Well then, dear guest, our idle chat shall end here. My latest tale has merely unfurled its first pages, and it beckons us to journey further—we wouldn't want to miss out on all the wonders this fete has to offer.

speaker: Yugu
content: Why don't you explore the streets some more? Should you stumble upon something intriguing, do return and regale me with your findings. It may just spark the next chapter of my tale.

speaker: Yugu
content: If you're truly interested in a performance, feel free to join me when I begin. I assure you, a captivating tale awaits. But remember, here, I am but a humble taleteller.
You catch a hint of playful meaning in her final words, and look up to find the taleteller's eyes narrowed in a knowing smile.

speaker: Yugu
content: You haven't met the heroine of my story yet—go find her. Between truth and fiction, what matters are always the people and the hearts that beat within. Go and see for yourself.

speaker: Yugu
content: The fete is afoot. It would be a shame to have it stop here. Let it persist.

speaker: Yugu
content: After all, I journeyed all this way just to tell you this story...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...What?
You turn back in confusion, only to find the stage empty—both the taleteller and her final words have vanished without a trace.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: The outlander returns once more to the gate of the Wisteria Pavilion.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: The vermillion gate stands sealed shut, its surface stained with mottled shadows, wilted vines hanging limp in the deathly silence. Amid the bustling fete, this place seems eerily out of place.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: A gentle tap of the gate ring yields no response. Moving closer, the outlander presses an ear against the gate, and, amidst the silence, discerns a faint sound of merriment and laughter, accompanied by hints of an ethereal fragrance.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Filled with a mysterious courage, the outlander pushes open the door, only to be engulfed by a blinding flood of white light...
[White Light Transition]
The white light fades, and you find yourself standing in a courtyard.
Unlike the impression from outside, you see no signs of merriment or revelry.
All that meets the eye is an overgrown field, scattered rocks, and a withered wisteria tree with its truck cut split.

The space appears desolate and devoid of life, completely cut off from the bustle of the festive street outside. Amidst this emptiness, the bare wisteria tree stands alone, leafless and flowerless, yet mysteriously adorned with strange, faded ribbons.
The only reply is silence.
The taleteller, too, offers no response.
You step forward. The withered wisteria tree is the only thing of note in this desolate place.

Respecting the sanctity of the wish tags, you cautiously observe them from a distance. The ink inscriptions on them are either so faded that they are indecipherable or scripted in a language unfamiliar to you.

Perhaps due to the wandering in the festivities, as you gaze at the tree, your thoughts grow heavy with an invisible weight. A mysterious fatigue overtakes you, compelling you to sit against the trunk. Your eyes slowly drift shut.
Time becomes meaningless—perhaps an eternity has passed, or maybe just a fleeting moment. Suddenly, a sweet floral fragrance tickles your nose, gently stirring your drowsy consciousness.
Then something soft brushes against your lips—a touch so fleeting that it vanishes just as quickly as it came.
Finally, you manage to pry your eyes open, only to be greeted with an extraordinary sight—

The withered wisteria has miraculously sprung to life, its branches now laden with cascading purple blooms that sway like ethereal wind chimes. Amidst this lavender sea of flowers reclines a woman, her beguiling smile displaying evident amusement as she observes you.
Oh, my, you were in such a deep slumber. It took a kiss to wake you up.
The memory of that touch on your lips suddenly becomes crystal clear. You instinctively wipe your mouth, which only makes her burst into laughter.
A shy one, aren't you? Getting all flustered over just a little kiss.
Alright, I'll stop teasing you now. It was just a flower petal that kissed your lips.
My health isn't the best, you see. I'm not nimble enough for a kiss-and-run-away.
...She certainly had you fooled there. You compose yourself, dusting off the lingering flower petals before raising your gaze. At last, her face comes into focus—undoubtedly hailing from Eastia.
<size=22>Not nimble, yet a tree climber?</size>
She seems not to catch your muttering. Instead, she stretches lazily and looks down at you, somehow leaning even closer than before.
It's been so long since the flowers last bloomed... Meeting you at just this moment—perhaps it's fate.
May I ask your name, sweetheart?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Just call me ${PlayerName}. And you are?
I am the guardian of this millennium-old wisteria. You may call me <color=#fb9259>Yingying</color>.

speaker: Yingying
content: It means a lingering dream that haunts your heart... Keep that in mind, would ya?
You nod, and she responds with a melodious giggle—that same sweet laughter that seems to never leave her lips. Then, she slightly shifts her position, settling into an even more comfortable pose.

speaker: Yingying
content: Come to think of it, I've never seen anyone dressed quite like you before. That drab gray outfit of yours... Is this some new trend these days?

speaker: Yingying
content: Or... have I been brought to some strange place?

speaker: %u
content: Ever heard of it?
She shakes her head.

speaker: %u
content: Mmm... It's pretty far from Eastia.

speaker: Yingying
content: Eastia? Where's that?

It appears she doesn't know Eastia. You can't help but study her more closely. Her features undeniably bear the mark of Eastian heritage, yet her attire diverges from any Eastians you've encountered—and it hardly looks warm enough...
Could she be one of Yugu's "story characters"? Is this "Yingying," like those peculiar "locals" outside, just another part of this bizarre realm?
As these thoughts cross your mind, she waves her hand with graceful nonchalance, as if accustomed to such scrutiny.

speaker: Yingying
content: Hehe, don't bother. We get all sorts of visitors here, both from near and far lands. I'm quite used to it.

speaker: Yingying
content: But what about you? Our fete is all about local traditions, and some of them have been around for ages. Being your first time here, I hope it's not too overwhelming?

speaker: %u
content: I've met others like you before, and I've heard quite a few tales.

speaker: %u
content: But I must say, I was pretty surprised at first... Didn't expect the fete to be run by Eastian "spirits."

speaker: Yingying
content: ...Spirits?

speaker: %u
content: Well, they're nice and all. It's just that they look... different from us, in a fascinating way.

speaker: %u
content: Other than that, everything here is amazing. It's fresh and lively. A unique take on the coziness of local living, I guess.

speaker: Yingying
content: Hehe, glad to hear you say that.

speaker: Yingying
content: Everyone here is just lovely and so welcoming. They're all keen to show their hospitality to our guests... Oh, you should check out the underground arena!

speaker: Yingying
content: Don't get me wrong—I'm not asking you to fight with that delicate frame of yours! Just spectating from the sidelines can be quite thrilling!
You notice her eyes light up as she speaks, her genuine joy evident when talking about the local community.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...I wish I could at least offer you a proper cup of tea. Please forgive my lack of hospitality.

speaker: Option
options: No need to be so formal.

speaker: %u
content: I'm not one for fancy treatment, so don't worry about me. Though... I know a kid who would love to meet you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: OwO, the girl from Eastia who came with me, would love to hear stories about her homeland. Maybe you could share some with her? You might even get to see her lion dance.

speaker: Yingying
content: Lion dance?
You notice her eyes light up with interest, but Yingying eventually offers a gentle smile and shakes her head.

speaker: Yingying
content: I've been sleeping for far too long now, and I can barely move. I wouldn't want to worry the little lady.

speaker: Yingying
content: Since you're here, might as well make the most of it. Dive into the food, savor the drinks, celebrate the beginning of a new year. That's what this fete is all about.

speaker: Yingying
content: Just be careful not to wander too far—people tend to lose their way around here. Especially when you have a little one with you. Make sure you don't lose sight of her.

speaker: %u
content: It's alright, the locals here are good people, I can tell.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...Yup.

speaker: Yingying
content: Here, I have something for you.
She reaches up to pluck a strand of wisteria flowers, and with a magical sleight of hand, produces a pale purple wish tag from her fingertips.

speaker: Yingying
content: The millennium-old wisteria is what makes our fete famous. The flowers are known for their mystical powers—they never fail to grant the wishes of those who pray to them.

speaker: Yingying
content: Think about what you hope for in the coming year, write it down on the tag, and after burning some incense, tie it to a blooming wisteria branch. It's as simple as that.

speaker: Yingying
content: Though it's still early, the Wisteria Fairy has already taken notice of you. She will remember to read your wish.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...My wish...

speaker: Yingying
content: Don't worry, take your time. It's just for good luck and fun, after all.
As she speaks, she lets out a gentle yawn.

speaker: Yingying
content: Yaaa—wn... Oh dear, I've finally met a new friend, and here I am getting sleepy again... I must rest now...

speaker: Yingying
content: I'm sorry, sweetheart, but I won't be able to see you out. Can you find your way to the gate yourself? Or shall I have someone escort you?

speaker: Option
options: I can manage on my own.

speaker: %u
content: Oh, right—someone told me that I should talk with you more. Would it be alright if I visit you again?
She gazes at you for a long moment before a smile finally appears on her face.

speaker: Yingying
content: If you wish, my dear. If... that's your wish.
She points to your chest, exactly where you've placed the wish tag.

speaker: Yingying
content: Have a good new year. Bye-bye!

speaker: %u
content: Bye.
...Wait, do Eastians say "bye-bye" too?
[Scene Change]

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: When consciousness reawakens, the wisteria tree has vanished from sight, and the outlander is once again outside the building.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 The gate now stands locked tight, unmovable, as though all that transpired earlier was but a mere dream.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Yet beneath the eaves, withered vines have turned verdant, and flower petals drift through the air, an entirely different sight from what it once was. The intoxicating fragrance lingers, leaving you in a momentary daze.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Could it be that you're still savoring that mystical encounter, dwelling on thoughts of the enchanting wisteria fairy?

speaker: %u
content: I'm just a bit surprised...

speaker: %u
content: Is that all I get to see of your story's heroine?

speaker: %u
content: But... is that all I get to see of your story's heroine?

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Heh heh, let destiny unfold as it will. When the right moment arises, what is destined for you will naturally find its way.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: It is not yet time to revisit her. Let her rest for now.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 In the meantime, you may venture forth and gather intriguing tales from the fete to share with her when your paths cross once more.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Rest assured, she too eagerly awaits your next encounter.
A peculiar fragrance catches your attention—the subtle, refreshing aroma of bitter herbs.
As you unconsciously try to trace the source of the scent, a whisper-thin voice cuts through the clamor and reaches your ears.
...Dark forces plague this place, and malevolent energies run wild. You would do well not to linger here, friend.
A chill runs down your spine as you whirl around to find the source of the voice... but all you catch is a lone figure melting away into the crowd.

She appears to be a young girl in strange attire, carrying herself with an eerily composed demeanor. Her appearance, undoubtedly human, makes her stand out distinctly among the revelrous "crowd"—a grotesque gathering of fiend-like creatures.

speaker: Chief
content: Could she be... another spirit from Yugu's story? Just part of the "atmosphere" she's creating?

speaker: Passerby?
content: Hey, you! Yeah, I'm talking to you! Watch where you're going! Looking for trouble, huh? Fine by me—me and my boys are happy to oblige!
Your attention is so fixed on the mysterious girl that you fail to notice the menacing figures surrounding you until it is too late.

When you come to realize it, the pedestrians nearby have all vanished without a trace. You're now trapped in the center of a monster-filled circle, with blood-red eyes gleaming all around you. Their gazes are filled with cruelty and hunger, watching you like predators eyeing their prey—there's nothing human about them at all.

speaker: Chief
content: Just what's the deal with this place...

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Several more hours slip away. The outlander grows wearier with each passing minute, losing all sense of direction, forgetting where to turn or whom to seek.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: He stumbles upon a shadowy figure, dispersing it into nothingness. Gazing up in a daze, the world blurs at its edges—obscured by flickering purple lights in the darkness.
female_content: She stumbles upon a shadowy figure, dispersing it into nothingness. Gazing up in a daze, the world blurs at its edges—obscured by flickering purple lights in the darkness.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Unbeknownst to him, wisteria vines have mysteriously taken hold of every eave along the street, their blossoms abundant. The rich fragrance intertwines with the laughter of a stranger, enticing him forward in a dreamlike trance.
female_content: Unbeknownst to her, wisteria vines have mysteriously taken hold of every eave along the street, their blossoms abundant. The rich fragrance intertwines with the laughter of a stranger, enticing her forward in a dreamlike trance.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Heh... Where else but to the heart of the blooms?
[BAM—]

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Awakening from the daze, the vermilion gate swings open wide. The outlander lurches forward, as though inebriated, catching just a glimpse of the "Wisteria Pavilion" plaque above before stumbling inside. Falling flat on the back, the outlander looks up, only to behold...
[Switch Scene]

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: The shattered walls and desolate ruins are nowhere to be seen. The building now blazes with countless lanterns, every seat occupied by revelers. The dazzling lights overwhelm you, the uproar of voices so tumultuous that it sends your mind reeling.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What happened...? What's going on with me...? Where am I...?

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: You recall the one you met here—the woman who called herself the wisteria fairy.
Coming—

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Before long, you find yourself greeted not by a single figure but by a gathering of beauties, each as diverse in allure as a garden in its prime. The whisper of silk dresses fills the air as they encircle you, their gazes cast downward upon you.

speaker: Elegant Woman
content: Oh my, we have an esteemed guest here... What delights do you seek today?

speaker: Vigorous Woman
content: Well, well, let me see. Those clothes of yours... You must come from a foreign land. Shall we...

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: However, your protest falls on deaf ears. The beauties help you up, their silk garments rustling, gazes tender and misty. Amid their joyful laughter, numerous hands reach out to you—

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Another wave of playful laughter ripples through the air. Then, a woman with an indistinct face emerges from the crowd, her ethereal lavender dress billowing like clouds, veiling her form in ambiguity.

speaker: Yingying?
content: My dear sir, were you looking for me?
female_content: My dear lady, were you looking for me?

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: She takes your hand—her fingers cool and silken to the touch, yet wherever they graze your skin, they ignite trails of fire in their wake. Though you try to pull away, she gently yet firmly entwines her fingers with yours, the touch searing with an almost unbearable heat.

speaker: Yingying?
content: My dear, to visit me in such a vulnerable state... What a devoted admirer you are.

speaker: Yingying?
content: I'll ensure you savor every pleasure you desire. Tonight, you shall be my first—and only—guest, hehehe...

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Your hand remains ensnared in her grasp as she leads you onward. Bewildered and dazed, you stagger through a seemingly endless corridor with her.
[Scene Transition to CG]

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: You pass doorway after doorway on both sides, each revealing the same kaleidoscope of enigmatic illusions. The woman pulling you forward chuckles, and your heart trembles at her laughter.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: In the first room, "Yingying" offers you a smile.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: In the second room, she coils her arms around your waist.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: In the third room, an ethereal nectar seeps through your clothes.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: In the fourth room, rosy lips press against your cheek.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Those shadows, the voices—they are yours yet not yours, hers yet not hers.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yingying... no, Yugu... make her stop, let me out of here!

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Hehehe... still trying to resist?

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Visitor, listener, or perhaps... Chief. You're already part of this narrative, and the story is far from its end. Embrace fate's orchestration and relish each fleeting moment...

speaker: Yingying?
content: Oh well, as you wish.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: True to her word, the woman releases her grip, watching as you stumble forward into the dimmest chamber, barely managing to stay on your feet.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: As you try to turn around, she gives your chest a gentle push. You tumble backwards onto the exquisite silk bedding, causing flower petals to flutter around. Her touch, though tender, leaves your mind in a whirl.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: In your daze, her sweet laughter reaches your ears, and she calls out to you in an unfamiliar, intimate manner—

speaker: Yingying?
content: My lord? Sweetheart? How would you like me to address you?
female_content: My lady? Sweetheart? How would you like me to address you?

speaker: Yingying?
content: Or should I just say your name? Hmm?

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: She leans down and plants a gentle kiss on your cheek. Her dark hair cascades like silk around your face, carrying with it an intoxicating aroma.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Has the scent of wisteria always been this cloyingly sweet? Your stomach churns upon the overwhelming fragrance.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Everything seems so peculiar, yet you can't muster even the slightest strength to resist.

speaker: Yingying?
content: Oh, I've been asking around about you. You're the Chief of... what was it, Nomis? They say you're the one who rounds up the villains and drags them to your little courthouse for interrogation.

speaker: Yingying?
content: Do you hunt down spirits like me too?

speaker: Yingying?
content: Will you tie me up with your sacred lasso? Preach about how humans and spirits must remain separate? Even torture me while claiming it's all for the greater good?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Stay... away... from me...

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: As you helplessly reach into the void with what little strength remains, she breaks into gleeful laughter, her form swaying like wind-swept blossoms.

speaker: Yingying?
content: My, what an adorably naive soul you are.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Who are you...? What... are you? What have you done to me...?!

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Has your vision deserted you already? What a pity. I shall paint the scene for you, then.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: In the darkness, a tender and moist touch boldly caresses your throat. A body, sinuous like a serpent, coils ever tighter around yours. As your strength and sanity are drained away, a burning sensation courses through your veins, clouding your consciousness.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: The floral aroma infiltrates every fiber of your being—through your breath, your organs, your blood, your mind—swirling and churning without end. It erodes and siphons your vigor, leaving you breathless like a drowning fish.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: As your body sinks further into the depths, your vision blurs into emptiness. Your consciousness dissolves, merging with the bustling festival throng, diluting into the endless river of time.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: This pleasure, lasting till the very end, is relished with spiritual allure and exhilarating sensualities—a fitting end to this bizarre narrative, isn't it?　　　　　　　　 Now then, dear guest, you shall—
[Fade to White]
...Just as I thought.

From the corner of your eye, you catch sight of wisteria vines by the window. They writhe as they slither into the room, silently snaking their way toward you. The woman on top of you seems to sense the intrusion, and as she turns around to look, the vines are already within your arm's reach.
Come now, hold on tight!
[Release the shackles]
With your last ounce of strength, you push the woman away and reach out with a trembling hand. The wisteria vines immediately coil around your fingers, climbing up your arm.
Upon the touch, the wisteria flowers burst into full bloom. The air, once thick with cloying sweetness, is instantly cleansed by their pure, refreshing fragrance.
A sudden weightlessness washes over you, but you're too weak to keep your eyes open. Your vision dims to black as consciousness slips away into oblivion.
(DisCity Scene: Infirmary)

As if surfacing from a long, weighty dream, you fight to open your eyes. The sterile white walls and the sharp, biting scent of disinfectant greet you, unmistakable signs that you're lying in a medical ward.

speaker: Nurse
content: ...Chief? Chief is awake!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What was that just now...
You turn your head in a daze to ask, only to see OwO lying unconscious in another bed, her face deathly pale. The sight instantly snaps you to full alertness.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: OwO!

You try to rush to her side, but the moment you sit up, the world spins violently around you. Your consciousness trembles and, with no strength left to fight it, you collapse helplessly back onto the bed.
Fortunately, someone is there to catch you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Please don't push yourself, Chief. You've only just gotten out of danger, and your body is still very weak. You can't handle any sudden movements.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How is OwO? How long was I out? What's going on? That taleteller... what did she do?

speaker: Nightingale
content: According to the surveillance, you and OwO were in the reception room during the storytelling performance when you both suddenly fell asleep and couldn't be awakened. Your vitals began dropping rapidly, and with all the physical indicators declining, we had no choice but to move you both to the ICU for emergency treatment.

You quickly review the surveillance footage. The recording shows Yugu watching as you both falls asleep. After a long while, she seems to notice something outside, then casually strolls out of the reception room. Shortly after, Nightingale comes looking for you for an urgent matter—only to find you lying unconscious on the floor.

options: ...So this is her power as a Sinner. Damn it.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I apologize for failing to keep her in custody. There was an emergency at the Bureau, and Sinner Yugu seized the opportunity to escape in the chaos.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, something's happened in the city.
Your adjutant's expression fills you with dread as you suddenly notice the strange light outside. Ignoring your own condition, you struggle to roll off the bed and stumble to the window—
[Fullscreen Background, CG]

—Outside the window, a massive tree-like monstrosity looms, its grotesque form coiled tightly around all of DisCity. Mania pours from it in an unending flood, twisting into a distorted form that stretches as far as the eye can see.
At the same time, you sense that familiar unsettling floral scent.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's not just you and OwO—thirty-eight individuals near the Rust have fallen into comas, all showing severely weakened conditions. Many of them had no prior contact with Yugu, yet they were all affected to varying degrees by this unknown Mania entity. As of now, you are the only one who has regained consciousness.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, the situation is critical. I know you're in a weakened state, but... we need you.
(Hotel)
Meanwhile, the taleteller has returned to her quarters, holding Hazy Fete in a Daze: Volume I in her hands. The book lies open, its pages turned to the very end.

speaker: Yugu
content: They say, in times long past, within Phonidale Town of Kingdom Fauxia, there existed this Bloomfete Street where a millennium-old wisteria tree stood. On the wisteria tree resides a flower fairy. Through the ages, the fairy gained mystical powers, granting every wish made beneath the blossoms.

speaker: Yugu
content: And thus once every year, the denizens of Bloomfete Street would gather for a grand fete, welcoming guests from far and wide to join in the shared celebrations. As they ushered in the new year, the people would make their wishes beneath the wisteria tree, praying that the flower fairy would grant them peace and happiness in the year to come.

speaker: Yugu
content: Hehe... but is that really how it was?

speaker: Yugu
content: How could prayers be answered amidst the storm of disaster? How could paradise take root in a world unraveled by chaos? The grand fete was but a fabricated legend. Those seemingly kind-hearted locals were all demons and evil spirits in disguise, luring travelers from afar only to trap them in the celebrations.

speaker: Yugu
content: And that so-called "flower fairy"... The millennium-old wisteria did not blossom into a fairy but twisted into a malevolent spirit. Whether seeking immortality or cultivating dark powers, she delighted in luring travelers to her Wisteria Pavilion. With honeyed words and feigned affection, she drained their life force in moments of intimate deceit...

speaker: Yugu
content: —And so unfolds my new tale. The Fete has only just dawned, and its path...

speaker: Yugu
content: My dear listener, since you alone have broken free from the fete's clutches and emerged awake from this woven dream... perhaps you shall take the mantle of this tale's protagonist.

speaker: Yugu
content: What will you do? Hehe... That is a chapter for another time...

speaker: Nightingale
content: The number of citizens affected by the arboreal Mania entity has risen to 87. All victims are showing symptoms of weakness, including varying degrees of anemia and malnutrition. So far, only Chief has managed to regain consciousness, and the reason remains unknown.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Based on the information Chief provided, this new Mania entity primarily employs mental attacks. The victims' consciousness becomes trapped in the same illusion, where their "life force" is drained.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: FAC frontline units have been deployed to all districts for defensive operations. That thing isn't particularly aggressive and doesn't catalyze any Corruptors. But it's expanding way too fast—just getting close is enough to be affected. We've already lost three soldiers to unconsciousness.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: With its massive size and sprawling branches, pinpointing the contamination source will take considerable time. We're working as fast as we can.
You frown as you study the complex analysis reports, filled with uncertainties and troubling possibilities.

speaker: %u
content: If close-quarter combat isn't an option, are we planning to strike the contamination source from a distance?

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...We haven't made a decision yet. All those citizens have their consciousness trapped inside—we don't know if an attack would harm them, and the number of hostages is still growing.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We can only focus on strengthening our defenses to contain its expansion until we either find a way to wake everyone up or ensure we can eliminate the contamination source in one strike—we need more intel, and more time.
MBCC has already contacted Eastia, who denied any connection to Yugu or the wisteria entity. However, they have offered to provide intelligence to help trace this unique Mania power to its source.
The investigation will take time, and perhaps a stroke of luck. Meanwhile, through the monitors, you can see OwO and many other victims still lost in their unnatural slumber.
You struggle to restrain yourself from imagining—now is not the time to dwell on what torments they might be enduring.

speaker: %u
content: Has the mastermind woken up yet?
Nightingale shakes her head, her expression grave. Your surge of anger finds its only outlet in a bitter sneer.
Yes, you brought her in. Thanks to the taleteller's law-abiding registration with MBCC, your shackles led you straight to Yugu.
Or rather, she never intended to escape.
(Switch Scene: Hotel)

According to the tracking team, after leaving her audience unconscious, she walked out of MBCC as if nothing had happened. She returned to town, pausing for a meal and tea along the way—just as she might after any ordinary performance. When she arrived back at her hotel, she even offered a polite nod to the receptionist.

Then, like everyone else in the hotel, she succumbed to the spreading Mania fragrance and fell into a deep slumber. When you arrived, you found Yugu draped in gauze with wisteria vines coiled around her body, a pen in hand—as if she had been earnestly "crafting" some story before sleep took her.
In your hands lies her unfinished tale, titled—Hazy Fete in a Daze: Volume I.
[Special Portrait]
The grand fete was but a fabricated legend. Those seemingly kind-hearted locals were all demons and evil spirits in disguise, luring travelers from afar only to trap them in the celebrations.

And that millennium-old wisteria did not blossom into a fairy but twisted into a malevolent spirit. Whether seeking immortality or cultivating dark powers, she delighted in luring travelers to her Wisteria Pavilion. With honeyed words and feigned affection, she drained their life force in moments of intimate deceit...

speaker: %u
content: Heh... What an "exquisite" tale.
Though written on Eastian paper and with Eastian ink, she was "thoughtful" enough to outline the entire scheme in Disian.
The story remains unfinished, but at the end, she left you a special "thoughtful" message—

speaker: Yugu
content: Since you alone have broken free from the fete's clutches and emerged awake from this woven dream... perhaps you shall take the mantle of this tale's protagonist.

You can imagine the expression on her face as she wrote these words. Even when being transferred to MBCC's special quarantine cell, Yugu maintained that same smile—whether lost in pleasant dreams or simply amused at having led you into her intricate trap.
You grind your teeth.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...So this is how it feels to be treated as a fool.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Here's all the data we have on Yugu. While her power is potent, she's never shown such an extensive range of influence before. A Banyan team has arrived to conduct a thorough examination on her.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We've also reached out to Eastia for assistance, but the intelligence about the Fete is still too limited. We can't verify what exactly Yugu did to cause the current situation, nor can we predict how it might develop.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, what do you plan to do now?
(Switch Scene: Wisteria Tree)

You gaze at the dark silhouette not far away. The shadow of the wisteria looms like a tentacled behemoth from mythology, its branches writhing slowly across DisCity as they devour the sky piece by piece.
You step away from the crowd and move closer to the peculiar tree of Mania. A ghostly floral scent drifts toward you, triggering fragments of memory that send chills down your spine...
[Flashback (small CG): Three moms and Chief getting dragged]
Though only fragments linger in your memory, that sickeningly sweet yet ice-cold fear awakens once more, growing more vivid with each passing moment.

The suffocation tightens its grip again as your entire body freezes. Within you, blood, air, and sanity are slowly stirred together, dissolving into a sweet syrup that seeps through your skin. Something coils around you, delicately sipping with a small, soft noise.
Every cell in your body screams at you to fall back, to run away—but you must press on.
You step forward, letting your senses become completely enveloped, until the eerie floral scent transforms into a soft chuckle that coils around you.
Heehee...
Then, your consciousness is completely dissolved and absorbed.

As written in the previous volume, with the auspicious day drawing near, the festival street is veiled in wisteria blooms. Their enchanting scent captivates all who pass, ensnaring numerous guests within their spell. These visitors linger, surrendering to ecstasy, lost in the embrace of this perpetual spring night.

The outlander willingly ventures into the realm, returning once more to the fete. There, familiar faces are found drifting through the crowds, their expressions eerily vacant—akin to puppets pulled by unseen strings, their features etched with weariness, unable to break free.

speaker: Dudu
content: Hey there, since you pass by my humble—well... just keep going, I'll catch you next time with my performance.

speaker: Dudu
content: You caught me at a bad time. I'm...*yawn* not in the best shape to play today. Come back another time—I'll play as long as you want, from sunrise to sunset without a break.

speaker: Dudu
content: Hmm? Oh, a regular, aren't you... I'll give you a special discount then, but it'll still have to wait until next time... next time...

speaker: %u
content: Don't fall asleep, Dudu. You can't sleep here—something's wrong with this fete...

speaker: Dudu
content: Don't pull me! I'm not sleeping... Who would sleep in a great place like this... surely not me...

speaker: Dudu
content: The fete is... wonderful... Folks from Eastia, and so many spirit friends coming to hear my music, all... so generous with their tips...

speaker: Dudu
content: Strange though... I get exhausted after just a few songs... I'm usually not... like this...

The young street performer yawns once more, and even the suona—her most cherished possession—is carelessly left in her coin box. The outlander surveys the surroundings, noticing the gathered crowd also falls victim to the same weariness: their eyes dulled, their energy sapped away.
At that moment, an eerie rustling noise emerges from beside the box. The outlander glances over, catching sight of a wisp of green mist winding itself around the suona's shaft.

Suddenly, a shrill screech erupts from the box, startling the outlander. In the blink of an eye, something rams into the box, toppling it over—the outlander barely manages to grasp the suona before it tumbles to the ground. Amidst the chaos, a large green mass darts away from behind the box.

Despite the commotion, the street performer remains eerily motionless, as if trapped in a deep slumber. Unable to awaken the friend, the outlander hesitates briefly before deciding to pursue the mysterious green wisp that fled moments ago.

speaker: %u
content: (Pant) ...Wh-where did it go?

speaker: %u
content: It's you...?!

speaker: OwO
content: Mmm... Little clapper? Where've you been? I've been looking everywhere for you, so tired I can barely—yawn—keep my eyes open...
■■■!
The elusive green wisp unexpectedly peeks out from the lion's head prop. The outlander hurries to separate them, but the drowsy lion dancer stumbles away.

speaker: OwO
content: ...Mmm? What are you doing? Don't hurt my friend... my new friend...

speaker: %u
content: I'm not trying to hurt it. OwO, you're feeling exhausted right now, and this thing might be the cause. Will you let me take it from you?

speaker: OwO
content: Mmm... it's been... keeping me company while I wait for you... Don't hurt the little wisp... Zzzz...

Mid-sentence, slumber overtakes the child, causing her to collapse abruptly. While the outlander scrambles to catch her, the luminous ball seizes its chance, darting into the crowd and vanishing without a trace.

Within the throng, more and more faces of DisCity people emerge.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 A sign that the calamity outside is growing worse by the minute, his heart burning with helpless anxiety. Friends, fellow citizens, victims—none heed his warning, and none can even rise, let alone be led to safety.

content: <i><size=36><u><color=#c9af79>I eagerly await your performance.</u></color>

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Returning once again to the Wisteria Pavilion, the wisteria appears more luxuriant than ever—its flowering branches unfurled, coiling up the walls with an otherworldly splendor that surpasses its former glory.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Undoubtedly, this is the craft of the flower spirit, draining the life force of those she ensnares. Without a moment to spare, the outlander bursts through the gate, desperately calling out the flower spirit's name.

speaker: %u
content: The wisteria... no, where is "Yingying"?

content: Right this way, esteemed guest. Would you like a cup of tea, or maybe a delightful musical interlude?

content: Here I am, Yinyin in the flesh. My dear sir, this is our first meeting—what brings you to call upon me?
