speaker: %u
content: Let's go.

speaker: Yingying
content: Come now, we're not so different! How about I tell you a story?
She links her arm with yours, wearing a sweet smile.

speaker: Yingying
content: Once upon a time, there was a little girl, born beneath the wisteria vines and raised among the blooming flowers. Everyone at the Wisteria Pavilion was like a mother to her, and everyone on Bloomfete Street—they were all her fathers, uncles, aunts, brothers, and sisters.

speaker: Yingying
content: Everyone said she was a child of the millennium-old wisteria, born to be the guardian of these streets. And when she grew up, she would become a flower fairy and grant the wishes of all who came to pray at the fete.

speaker: Yingying
content: And so, day after day, the little girl practiced her magic skills, and year after year, carefully noted down every wish made by every visitor. She vowed that once her powers were strong enough, she would grant them all, one by one.

speaker: Yingying
content: Later, she found her old baby swaddling clothes. Tucked away inside were her birth record and a faded wish tag.

<i><color=#7683a2><size=27>There's a war outside. I can't keep her with me anymore, and I likely won't return.
I've left all my savings here. I'm sorry. Please take care of her.</color><i></size>

<i><color=#7683a2><size=27>This street is the best I've ever walked on, and you're the kindest people I've ever known. Please, look after her.
May the sacred wisteria watch over her. Let her grow up in a place full of hope, where she can always look forward to a brighter year.</color><i></size>
<i><color=#7683a2><size=27>Don't let her end up like me.</color><i></size>

speaker: Yingying
content: In this story, there is no wish-granting flower fairy—only people powerless to change their fate.

speaker: Yingying
content: Does a story like this feel a little closer to home?
You freeze in your tracks, words catching in your throat.
Yingying turns to look at you, offering a gentle smile.

speaker: Yingying
content: Their times were just as troubled. War raged everywhere, visitors dwindled, and fetes became harder to uphold. Even the weather grew erratic—winters lost their chill, and wisteria bloomed when New Year should have brought snow.

speaker: Yingying
content: Life was a constant struggle—exhausting and painful. Hard work went unrewarded, and misfortunes struck without warning.

speaker: Yingying
content: And when things got even worse, they'd somehow survive until the new year, only to find themselves unable to wish for anything—they couldn't even imagine what better days would look like anymore.

speaker: Yingying
content: Or perhaps, as you said, they simply didn't dare to hope. Afraid to wish for the unattainable, terrified that another shattered dream would only make the fall more painful.
As she speaks softly, her hand traces the red silk ribbons hanging among the flowering vines along the eaves.

speaker: Yingying
content: Yet even in the darkest times, the people of this street never thought of canceling the fete. Visitors still came to celebrate the New Year, waiting to see the wisteria bloom as it did every year.

speaker: Yingying
content: Because celebrating the New Year wasn't just about welcoming another year...

speaker: Yingying
content: It was also to bid farewell to the past.
With one arm linked with yours, Yingying walks forward. Her free hand brushes against the dormant vines, and at her touch, they spring to life—new buds emerging and blossoming into flowers.
Her eyes remain fixed ahead, yet seem to gaze into something beyond sight.

speaker: Yingying
content: A new year has begun. The past is behind us, no longer holding sway. It's time to remember to release those that weigh too heavily on your heart.

speaker: Yingying
content: Time is always fair and powerful. All those weighty burdens—regret, confusion, anger, remorse, and sorrow... you can entrust them all to time's keeping. Step forward unburdened, leaving the past year behind and embracing the new.

speaker: Yingying
content: Your time may not be the best of times, but it's certainly not the worst. Because you're there, doing your best, and you're not alone.

speaker: Yingying
content: Since the New Year has arrived, and you have to look ahead regardless, why not find something to look forward to?
As she speaks, Yingying turns to face you, gently tightening her grip on your hand. Between your clasped hands, a wish tag has mysteriously appeared.
She gives you another smile.

speaker: Yingying
content: Even if you can't count on things getting better, you don't have to persuade yourself they'll only get worse, right?

speaker: Yingying
content: Besides, I think you could afford to be a little more optimistic.

speaker: Yingying
content: You may feel quite weary, but all your friends are looking forward to the New Year. Isn't that a reward for all your efforts this year?

speaker: Yingying
content: I believe you can make your wishes come true, even without the flower spirit's help.
Leaving the past year behind and embracing the new...
[Vibe a bit]
Before you can speak, the crowd suddenly erupts in excitement, their hands shooting up to point at the sky.

speaker: Crowd
content: Look, a shooting star!
A brilliant shooting star streaks past, its crimson tail stretching across half the night sky. The trail lingers, refusing to fade, rivaling even the brightest fireworks in the distance.

speaker: Resident
content: Make a wish! Make a wish!! It's now or never! Quick!

speaker: Resident
content: Hold on, isn't this the Wisteria Fairy's territory? Talk about being unfaithful, haha!

speaker: Visitor
content: Hey, this shooting star must be the Wisteria Fairy showing her divine powers! This year's wishes are bound to come true! Let me go first—I wish to win back all the money I've lost!
A swift kick sends him flying out.

speaker: Gold Toad
content: Gamblers losers. No matter how many times I tell them, they never listen. If only fewer fools would keep throwing their money at me... maybe then I could finally retire.

speaker: Pixiu Dragon
content: Since you've got cash to spare, boss, how about lending some to yours truly? It's been ages since I last visited the Dragon Palace, and I do miss it.

speaker: Lady Rakshasa
content: Then I wish for an easier year, with less drama and fewer troublemakers messing around. I don't really want to play the tough girl all the time—
The little wisp spins around excitedly, sending sparks flying everywhere. It urges Wuhuanzi to look up at the sky.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: Make a wish...?

The ghostly street, once veiled in Yugu's "refinements," finally shows its true essence as all traces of the sinister and mysterious fade away. Humans and spirits alike flood the streets, marveling at the auspicious shooting star overhead. Some rack their brains for wishes yet unmade, while others, having already decided, eagerly scramble to make even more.

speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
content: Wisteria Fairy, hear my prayer! May Yingying live a blessed life and find herself a handsome one. Let them visit us during festivals so we can feast our eyes upon such a lovely sight!
female_content: Wisteria Fairy, hear my prayer! May Yingying live a blessed life and find herself a pretty one. Let them visit us during festivals so we can feast our eyes upon such a lovely sight!

speaker: You've succeeded; no one will take your place, nor will anyone seek to destroy you. From now on...
content: Wisteria Fairy, hear my prayer! May Yingying live a blessed life and find herself a wealthy one. Let her be well-fed and healthy, never again having to worry about her life!

speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
content: Wisteria Fairy, hear my prayer! May Yingying live a blessed life and find her true love. Wherever they may go, let them be blessed with happiness for all their days!

Wishes pour forth in both Eastian and Disian—refined and vulgar, aristocratic and plebeian, proper and indecorous—all interweaving until distinct voices meld into a singular chorus. What lingers is nothing but the sincerest wishes of many souls.

The past seems to fade in importance as the new year takes physical form, materializing as dancing dragons and lions. It prances over firecrackers and rides waves of cheers, its radiant joy flowing from the main streets down to the smallest alleyways.
Just as it reaches the very end of your sight, a bright clash of gongs and drums rings out—

speaker: Mad Gourd
content: A bright future awaits! A bright future awaits!
Before you realize it, you find yourself looking up—at the sky, at the horizon ahead, at the crowds welcoming the New Year.

Perhaps it's the infectious mood of celebration, or maybe it's the realization that not every wish must carry the weight of the world. Now, the notion of having something to look forward to doesn't seem so bad after all.
With that, you glance at the blank wish tag in your hand, then at the flower fairy beside you who has been eagerly encouraging you to make a wish.
—Only then do you notice that she has fallen into an unusual silence, a departure from her usual vibrant self.

She offers no jests or words of encouragement—she doesn't even look your way. Instead, she remains motionless with a profound gaze upon the sky, standing out amidst the jubilant uproar. It's as if all the lights and merriment flow through her toward the future, while she alone remains rooted in place.
Only the dazzling shooting star falls into her eyes, eternally glistening.
Sensing your gaze, she finally stirs from her trance and turns to you, the starlight in her eyes fading away.
Her familiar smile returns to her face, but for the first time, you sense an inexplicable distance between you.

speaker: Yingying
content: See? I didn't lie about the best part of the fete. Isn't it wonderful?

speaker: Yingying
content: A fete should be vibrant and full of life. Even if just for a moment, as long as it helps people forget their worries and find joy, it's accomplished its purpose.

speaker: Yingying
content: Me? I'm having a great time, just a little tired, that's all.

speaker: Yingying
content: I've had so much fun that I'm completely worn out. Time for me to get some sleep. You go on and enjoy yourself.

speaker: Yingying
content: Look, the little lion dancer is looking for you, and your friends from DisCity too. There's still a couple of hours before the end—make the most of it with them.

speaker: Yingying
content: And, do remember all the happiness you witness, and all the lovely locals you meet here. It will make the perfect ending for this Fete. I'd really appreciate it. Now, off you go.

Have you had a good time? You want to tell her your answer, but your friends have already arrived. They pull you along in their laughing, bustling crowd, leaving you only a fleeting moment to glance back.
You catch a glimpse of Yingying standing among the fading lanterns, their dim light revealing a fragility you hadn't noticed before.

speaker: Yingying
content: Goodbye.
A rain of flower petals falls, and she vanishes without a trace.
The crowds have mostly dispersed now. You bid farewell to the residents of Bloomfete Street and see off the visitors from DisCity.
Finally, following the trail of flower fragrance, you return to the Wisteria Pavilion.
The ladies open the gate for you, teasing you playfully before patting your shoulder and ushering you into the courtyard. Then, their figures fade away like shadows in the night.
The wisteria tree stands as usual before you, its flowers in full bloom, yet no one sits among its branches.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've said goodbye to everyone else. You're the only one left.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's still some time left. I can let you borrow some of my Qi. Come out to see me, will you?
The only response is the whisper of flower petals falling in the wind.

You walk to the wisteria tree and sit by its roots. Drowsiness washes over you gradually—perhaps it's her secretly draining your Qi, or maybe you're simply exhausted after completing your mission and spending the whole night at the fete. Your eyelids grow heavy.
You recall your first visit to this courtyard—just like now, you sat beneath this tree, quickly fell asleep, and then you met her.
The thought brings an inexplicable sense of ease. You gaze at the wisteria blossoms and begin to speak, as if talking to yourself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This place is truly remarkable. It's different from what I imagined, and different from what Yugu wrote about too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You and the locals here are all pretty interesting—like spirits but also so human. You've shown me so much of what everyday life is like in Eastia.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Yugu couldn't have made all this up, could she? She'd never appreciate such simple joys. I still can't figure out how the two of you ended up together.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You said this was your fete. I'm wondering... are you a Sinner too?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No response? Then I'll take that as a yes.

Outside, the faint chatter of the Eastian spirits reaches your ears. The wisteria vines sway gently—they must be following their traditions, collecting the wish tags visitors had tied to the branches. Quite the undertaking, you imagine.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Were you all in DisCity? Inside that giant Mania tree?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: After the farewell on the fourth day, are you returning to Eastia? Where exactly? Even the scholars there can't seem to locate you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How about letting my shackles connect to you? Then I could go visit you.
Gradually, even the voices of the locals fade away. The night deepens, and a light purple mist settles around you.
She hasn't come, but the wisteria tree keeps you company, silently listening as you drift between sleep and waking, murmuring in your half-dreams.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I have to admit, I had a great time. It was a joyous fete, and I could see the people of DisCity enjoying themselves too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Will you come back next year?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you promise not to harm anyone anymore, I think people would love to come visit again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're right. Maybe we're not so different after all...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Perhaps by next year, I'll find a wish of my own...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Wish you a good new year...
The rich floral fragrance envelops you like a warm blanket, finally lulling you into a peaceful slumber.
...A good new year...
In your last moments of consciousness, something soft brushes against your cheek, or perhaps the tip of your nose, or maybe even the corner of your lips.
Like a kiss as light as a flower petal.
(Fade to white)

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: The outlander extends a hand, yearning to seize the hazy silhouette, craving words unspoken, longing for a final glimpse of her face—　　　　　 And so the dream finally ends.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: In a daze, you catch sight of a familiar face, just as she appeared when you first met.
[Scene Change]

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: However, it is not Yingying.

speaker: Wynn
content: ...Chief? Thank goodness you woke up too! Are you feeling any discomfort?

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Those at your bedside are your trusted companions—you have returned to your real world. You may now find ease.

speaker: %u
content: ...I'm fine, everything's good. I just didn't expect to return at this time...

speaker: %u
content: Did my Qi get drained up again?

speaker: Nurse
content: Don't be silly! You're in perfect shape—you just got plenty of rest! Why don't you head to the command center?

speaker: Nurse
content: The FAC officers have been waiting for you for a while.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: Indeed, they have been awaiting your arrival. The team stands ready, their spirits high as they present you with a thick stack of operation plans.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The arboreal Mania entity continues to expand, with internal contamination reaching critical levels—it's on the verge of going berserk. However, we've successfully quarantined the contaminated zone and found our opening!

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We've pinpointed the contamination center's coordinates, and our frontline units are assembled and ready for deployment. We're only waiting for your orders now, Chief!

speaker: Eugene
content: Yes! We got duped, but we still managed to find a clue in that illusion. Those vines crawling over the streets—they spread just like Mania in the real world. Turns out, the wisteria trees are the very source of the contamination.

speaker: Eugene
content: We've also confirmed another major pollution hub at the coordinates where the Rust sits. High frequency spectrum of Mania detected. Looks like a highly-contaminated Sinner is holed up there, and she's likely the root of all this pollution.

speaker: %u
content: The contamination source... are we going to eliminate it?

speaker: %u
content: What about the hostages? All those affected civilians?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Don't worry, Chief. Everyone has regained consciousness. Before you woke up, all the trapped victims had already been freed from the "fete," and they are now recovering quickly, both physically and mentally. The civilians in the contaminated area have been fully evacuated—we can now act without restraint.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We've heard back from Eastia as well. Based on our encounters at the fete, they've verified the complete story behind the "fete" and offered plenty of recommendations. We can now attempt to tackle that monster.

speaker: Taleteller's Narration
content: An urgent letter from Eastia is delivered into your hands.
[Display an image of the fete]

speaker: Du Ruo
content: In Eastia, stories of New Year fetes and millennium-old wisteria trees are quite common, though only a few were ever documented. With countless adaptations and revisions over time... it's difficult to trace the original legend.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: However, this wish-making ceremony you mentioned is quite interesting.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: In ancient traditions, shooting stars were commonly seen as omens of misfortune. The practice of wishing upon them came later, influenced by foreign cultures. This suggests that the "fete" you experienced is relatively recent—likely within the past two centuries.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Based on details provided such as dietary customs, we can trace it to a certain frontier region. Combined with the economic impact of distant wars and the early-blooming wisteria due to climate change, we can estimate this occurred during the chaotic times around the Nightfall.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Following these clues, we investigated several ruins where no descendants remained, and examined fragmentary written records. Among them, we stumbled upon a local chronicle about an unnamed fete where, on its third day, people witnessed a rare auspicious shooting star.
[Small CG - Shooting Star at the Fete]

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The records of that fete end there, leaving us in the dark about what followed. However, by translating between the old and new calendars, we can determine that the fete's third day fell on an unspecified date in the first year of the Nightfall.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: That celebrated shooting star, recorded as an auspicious omen...
[Small CG - Perishing Star]

speaker: Du Ruo
content: It was the <color=#fb9259>Perishing Star</color>.

speaker: Yugu
content: ...And so it was.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 They say, the millennium-old wisteria fete, revered for centuries, was ravaged overnight by the calamity the ominous star brought forth. How many dreams turned to dust, how many hopes lay entombed in its wake.

speaker: Yugu
content: However, perhaps this was destined.

speaker: Yugu
content: When the storm comes, never a single nest survives unscathed. In a world ever so cruel, how can any paradise endure?　　　　　　　　　　　　 These moments of joy are mere fortune's accidents, illusions in the void. Everything shall return to its fated end, and that... is the ultimate truth I seek.

speaker: Yugu
content: Still, I must thank you all. Your contributions to the third volume have truly breathed new life into these pages.　　　　　　　　　　 Those distant souls I could never quite reach now shine with such vibrant charm.

speaker: Yugu
content: Therefore, when devastation arrives, it shall be all the more heart-swaying. That... is the ultimate beauty I seek.

speaker: Yugu
content: Through my tales, they shall transcend into eternity.

speaker: Yugu
content: And so, dear audience, the tale of the Hazy Fete draws its last stroke.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 As the mist disperses, the threads of destiny woven through centuries finally culminate. And you shall bear witness to its final chapter.

speaker: Yugu
content: Together... let us behold what fate unfolds.
(Scene: The Rust)

A massive withered tree looms over the Rust, its desiccated black branches spreading chaotically in every direction. Waves of thick contamination relentlessly batter against the isolation belt, held back by the FAC forces and Anti-Mania devices surrounding the area.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The barrier was working! Deploy the drones and get all personnel behind the safety line. This Mania tree is hunting for living targets—it's trying to use us as nutrients!
Just then, a piercing alarm blares as a contaminated vine violently lashes out, slamming against the blue energy barrier.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: No way, it's become way more hostile than before. What's going on?

speaker: %u
content: Because all the trapped hostages have returned.

speaker: %u
content: I think this "wisteria" needs fresh nutrients to maintain its massive form...

speaker: FAC Officer
content: What?! That'd be a disaster! We can't let it enter the city—we need to end this now. Chief! Give us the order! We must eliminate the contamination source immediately!

speaker: Nightingale
content: MBCC forces are also in position, Chief. We await your orders.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief?!
A Mania vine lashes out toward you, but instead of dodging instinctively, you reach out your hand, and the vine strikes your palm with crushing force.
[Release the shackles]
You grip tighter, desperately trying to push deeper, squeezing your back way into that illusion—but an abyss of chaos blocks your path.
The red glow of the shackles vanishes into nothingness, followed by a violent backlash as Mania tears through your every nerve. After a brief struggle, an overwhelming force knocks you backwards.
Your body slams into an FAC soldier who catches you—he's clearly terrified by what just happened.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Chief, are you all right? What were you trying to—
That was an experiment you decided to make on a whim.

The rampaging Mania craves for prey, driving these wisteria vines to expand and attack humans. But deep within the contamination lies another will—one that surpasses Mania's insatiable hunger, steadfastly refusing all who try to enter.
After expelling all its captured "visitors," the entrance that once led to the fete has sealed itself completely.

speaker: %u
content: All combat units, prepare to counterattack. Suppress the target's expansion with everything you've got—we cannot allow the contamination to spread beyond the Rust.

speaker: %u
content: And... concentrate your fire on breaching the contaminated shell. We need to expose the Mania core inside.

speaker: %u
content: ...If a Sinner is really in there, then dealing with them is my responsibility.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: It's no use—the shell's too tough! We can't break through!

The FAC forces' persistent long-range assaults have reached a deadlock with the expanding Mania wisteria. Although the contamination's expansion has slowed, human efforts prove incapable of eradicating it entirely.
Back and forth the vines sway in an endless cycle, akin to a frenzied creature desperately clutching at survival. The situation has regressed into yet another impasse.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Is it because it's rooted in the Rust? The monster's growing even faster now—don't tell me it's feeding on the nearby Corruptors too?

speaker: Nightingale
content: It could also be that DisCity's standard equipment isn't fully compatible with Eastian Mania. Not to mention this contamination has been festering for over a century.

As it continues to stretch skyward, its shadow engulfs more and more of the city districts. Under this looming unknown threat, civilians are forced to evacuate in growing numbers—and those who have been fighting it for so long are beginning to lose their patience.

speaker: Nightingale
content: HQ is rushing to recalibrate our equipment based on Eastia's intel. It should be fully operational in about four hours. In the meantime, all we need to do is hold the line. We must ensure complete containment and prevent any contamination from seeping out.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Once the weapons are in place, we can inflict maximum damage on the Mania entity. Now that it has no hostages, we won't need to hold back anymore.
But before then, we still have four hours to wait.
There's still time for another operation plan, isn't it?

speaker: %u
content: An unknown threat from Eastia is no trivial matter, even for DisCity. With Paradeisos seeking to establish relations with Eastia, any friction between the two sides at this point would be diplomatically disastrous.
Give me more time. I'll get to the bottom of this.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: But that's far too dangerous! What if something happens to you?

speaker: %u
content: I'll find another way—a safe way. Trust me...
You also want to trust that person... This can't be left unresolved.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Chief, you only have four hours.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Please, make sure you come back safely.

speaker: %u
content: I understand. Thank you, everyone.
With only four hours remaining, you can neither approach the wisteria nor use the shackles to re-enter the illusion.
But you still have one last option—
[Scene transition: Taleteller's cell]

speaker: %u
content: Let's talk, Yugu. I know you've returned from the fete.

speaker: %u
content: That fete wasn't yours to begin with. Its true host drove out all the "visitors"—including you, who were seeking refuge there.
The Eastian woman, who had been lounging in repose, finally shows a smile as she slowly opens her eyes.

speaker: Yugu
content: I suppose you have already uncovered the truth about the fete, rescued the hostages, and broken free from the illusion. With such feats accomplished, you should be ready to take decisive action... Why come looking for me, of all things?

speaker: Yugu
content: Do not tell me you have come for a story now...

speaker: Yugu
content: Tired of Yingying's happy endings? Have you at last thought of seeking me out for something more... thrilling?

speaker: %u
content: I don't want stories. I want the truth.
She rises—hair loose and feet bare—and draws uncomfortably close. A cold, unsettling breeze brushes against your cheek as she fixes her gaze on your eyes.

speaker: Yugu
content: The truth... Whether it is facts or truth you are after, has the Eastian scholar not given you that already? All encapsulated in such neat words.

speaker: Yugu
content: Cruel, heartless, insignificant—and eventually, forgotten by all. With your experience, I believe you can envision such a fate? I doubt it would bring you joy. After all, such narratives are seldom favored... Oh, except for me.

speaker: Yugu
content: I pity them, hold a fondness for them. I spice up those tales with passion and romance, only to draw in a few sensation-seeking listeners. But at least in doing so, they would be known by others—and those poor souls wouldn't die entirely in vain. Though I suppose my approach is not quite to your taste.
Even through her veil, you can see her smile growing increasingly unhinged.

speaker: Yugu
content: It seems that you, like many others, favor stories where goodness prevails and all ends well, unable to stomach the cruel indifference of fate and its bitter partings. Perhaps you'd like me to embellish things? To paint you a blissful ending like that adorable flower spirit did, just to offer solace to your conscience?

speaker: Yugu
content: Heh, I suppose I could do that. Just like I indulge those sensation-seeking patrons of mine, I can satisfy your desires as well.
You feel a compelling urge to refute her.

You know that whether it's her tales supposedly born out of compassion or the audience she claims to humbly serve—the taleteller holds no regard for either. To her, everyone, both within and beyond her narratives, is merely prey for her twisted entertainment.
Now she lifts her veil, ready to speak, her gaze gleaming with delight as she prepares to tear you apart—like a butcher towering over their next sacrifice.
But in the end, you decide to change the subject.
...There's no need. I'm not here to hear stories. I only want to know... about the people there. About what really happened to those who lived and breathed through it all.
I need your power.
Yingying may be the host of the fete, but it was you who brought her to DisCity. Before the Mania outbreak, you were the one sending us all into the fete.
You captured both Yingying and the fete within your book, didn't you? That's how you can make people experience it all again, reopening the path to the fete.

speaker: Yugu
content: All right, I will stop making fun of you. I know you want to return to that street, to see that person again. Very well, I will help you.

speaker: Yugu
content: This is precisely the story I was hoping for.

speaker: Yugu
content: However, out of concern for your well-being, allow me to offer one word of caution.

speaker: Yugu
content: Remember, don't chase after impossible desires. Don't make the same mistake... that she did.
But the look in her eyes tells a different story—she evidently anticipates that you'll make the same exact mistake. You've seen through her game since long ago.
The taleteller removes her veil, her rosy lips parting softly. The pages of the book flutter in her hands, characters floating free, coiling around you and drawing you into their depths.

You traverse the crumbling streets. The once cheerful festive lanterns have now turned into raging flames, devouring crops and emitting acrid smoke so dense that it forces your eyes shut. Wails of anguish echo like cursed mantras, reverberating through your skull and tearing at your mind.

Inferno and miasma corrode flesh and brick alike, while screams of terror blend with manic shrieks. Humans transform into monsters—the same monsters you know all too well. Reality warps under contamination as Mania spawns Corruptors. This scene, in all its horror, is painfully familiar to you.
These streets, where people celebrated joyously at the fete mere hours ago, are now a living hell.
You force yourself to take deep breaths, constantly reminding yourself to stay focused on your mission.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I must find Yingying...

Though your mind is clouded, your direction remains clear. Amid the ruins, a path of purple emerges—wisteria blossoms strewn across the earth. Their vibrant hue cuts through the chaos, forming veins of purple that lead to the core.

You struggle forward, steadying yourself against broken walls as shadowy figures sweep past you. Their voices seep into your mind. Although the language is foreign to you, a strange intuition allows you to grasp the meaning behind their words.

speaker: Resident C
content: Monsters... so many monsters... argh... help us... Wisteria Fairy, save us...

speaker: Resident A
content: It's okay, it's okay... the flowers are still blooming... the Fairy is still there. May the Wisteria Fairy watch over us...

speaker: Resident B
content: Protect us, protect us... *sob*...
Prayers, resembling a rhythmic chant, echo outward from the ruins of the Wisteria Pavilion.
Though they pray, their words lack the conviction of true believers. Each syllable drips with fear and despair, as both survival and prayer have been reduced to mere bodily responses.
Inside you, the shackles writhe restlessly, sending sharp jolts of pain through your body, as if trying to deliver a warning—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Something's wrong...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is no natural disaster. Taking shelter like this won't save anyone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is Mania... If all these affected people gather together like this—
You break into a sprint, racing desperately to the Wisteria Pavilion. At the entrance, the "moms" are anxiously ushering people inside.
[Wisteria Mom's portrait]

speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
content: Sh-she's not here. She went out to help—there‘s still people trapped outside. She went to save them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll go find her.
Before leaving, you grab the woman's shoulders and call out:

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Corruptors have already shown up! The Mania contamination is spreading—the Wisteria Fairy can't protect you anymore!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Tell everyone to stop gathering here and run!
Your urgent shouts startle her.

speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
content: ...Corruptors? Mania? Have you lost your mind, young one? This is the sacred fete of the Wisteria Fairy—our divine tree has protected us for a millennium. Everyone here came to receive its blessings.
female_content: ...Corruptors? Mania? Have you lost your mind, young lady? This is the sacred fete of the Wisteria Fairy—our divine tree has protected us for a millennium. Everyone here came to receive its blessings.

speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
content: Even if the legends aren't real, how dare you claim it means us harm! And telling us to leave... Well then, you tell me...

speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
content: After everything that's happened, where else can we possibly go?

speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
content: If our divine tree can't save us, who even will?!
The woman's face suddenly turns pitch-black, and the void where her features once were lunges straight at you.
At that moment, your shackles glow crimson, swiftly cutting through the murky vines coiling around you. During the struggle, you stumble backward, and then—
—BOOM!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hey!

A thunderous crash erupts from within the courtyard as contamination tears through walls and gates, coalescing into wildly thrashing vines. Before you can make out the screams of anguish from inside, a dark shape strikes you in the forehead, sending you flying backward.

When your vision returns, you witness the courtyard, once blessed by the Wisteria Fairy, crumble into ruins in an instant. All its vitality transforms into roaring Mania tendrils, while the wisteria tree burns amidst flames and contamination—whether being destroyed or undergoing a twisted rebirth into a new monster, you cannot tell.
You remain frozen in place for what feels like an eternity before slowly rising to your feet. The flames sear your eyes, forcing you to look away from the devastating scene before you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...This... it's just an illusion... I can't change anything... it's in the past...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Find Yingying, resolve the crisis outside... resolve... now...
You get to your feet, turn around, and try to force yourself to move forward.
But as you turn around, you find her standing right before you.
[Past Yingying's portrait]
Yingying shields several children, the fiery flames reflected her eyes. Her lips tremble, her face deathly pale, yet she appears completely numb to the burning embers falling on her skin.
She approaches you with slow steps, gently placing the child from her arms into yours before proceeding on her path. You hear her words, barely a whisper:

speaker: Yingying
content: ...O Wisteria Fairy above, O Wisteria Fairy... above...
As she passes by you, murmuring those words, your shackles begin to tremble, signaling the awakening of a sinister power within Yingying. You instinctively move to stop her.

Yet, suddenly, the child in your arms transforms into a heavy stone, from which black-purple vines burst forth and coil around your limbs. Unable to break free, you can only watch helplessly as she walks into the crumbling ruins.
Even your shackles can't pierce through the layers of vines binding you. Immobilized and unable to cry out, you can do nothing but watch.

Another failing beam snaps and crashes to the ground with a dull thud, quickly devoured by the raging flames. Forced to watch from afar, you can only witness the contamination spread while the air fills with the shrieks of the maddened and the dying's desperate wails.
Yingying rushes back and forth between the ruins and the entrance, carrying out the "people" trapped within, one after another, laying them by the roadside.
Despite the distance between you, her labored breathing and sobs travel clearly to your ears through the vines that bind you.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...Save us... Please...

She repeats these words over and over—like a mantra, a prayer, comfort for others, solace for herself. The Mania gathers around her as power awakens within, and the Corruptors now cower before her presence, keeping their distance, no longer daring to harm her.

But no one calls out to her anymore—the screams and wails have given way to an even more terrifying silence. Time seems to stretch endlessly as she stumbles, struggles to her feet, and limps on, each step slower than the last. Eventually, she collapses, unable to muster the strength to rise once more. Yet, she still crawls on, with nowhere to go.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...Please...
As her consciousness fades, her plea finally receives an answer.

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: ...Are you... afraid... Do you... resent this... Are you... angry... ...Are you... in despair...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: ...These were supposed to be... the happiest days... Why did it turn out like this... Why did it have to be us...
The chaotic voice rises from the void, slowly engulfing the entire street.
And she can no longer tell who is speaking.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...I don't understand... I don't want this...

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: ...You... also want us to survive...
Her eyes can no longer see anything else but the wisteria in the center of the courtyard—

Her beginning, her childhood dreams, the roots she had relied on for years—all have grown monstrously large. The lives it absorbed are now intertwined, burning with a manic intensity, casting shadows of nothing but despair.
At this moment, the advent of their deity has finally come.

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: Speak... tell us your wish...
Countless familiar voices ring in a chorus—the voices of those she couldn't save. They come to comfort her, accompany her, beseech her, threaten her, tempt her, corrupt her.

speaker: Yingying
content: O Wisteria Fairy above... I beg you...

Before Yingying can finish her words, the massive darkness seizes upon her daze and completely devours her. A tempest of Mania erupts ferociously, ensnaring you as well in an ever-tightening embrace of vines, cocooning you away from the outside world.
You catch a final utterance, not just from her voice but from an obsessive chorus of countless souls merged into one—

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: From this moment on, you are the Wisteria Fairy... Now go, continue our fete...
[Transition]
[Black Screen]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I won't try to run away...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know what's happened, and I know nothing can change it anymore...
The vines wrapped around you slowly begin to loosen.
Before your eyes, the withered vines twist and weave themselves into a human shape, gradually taking the form of a figure you know all too well.
If you knew all this, then why did you come back?
She studies you for a moment, wearing that usual smile of hers.

speaker: Yingying
content: Oh... so Yugu sent you in here. I almost forgot, you have quite a few "caring ladies" helping you out there.

speaker: Yingying
content: Silly, becoming a character in her stories isn't something to celebrate. She always keeps tabs on her favors. You may get yourself into trouble without even knowing.

speaker: Yingying
content: Come now, don't look so sad. The fete should be a place of joy.

speaker: Yingying
content: Since she's the one who sent you here, you should know this is just another story she wrote. She has a thing for tearjerkers—crafting tales of tragic love between the living and the dead, all to steal your tears. Don't let yourself fall for it.
She reaches out to rub your face, but inadvertently reveals the spreading corruption marks on her arm. Instantly, she pulls her hand back and takes half a step away.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...This isn't my true self, just a projection. Don't worry about it.

speaker: Option
options: Then where is the real you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Can you leave this place?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The fete was over long ago—a hundred years ago. Let's go for a walk outside instead. I'll show you the way.
She watches you in silence.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...Are you trying to save me, sweetheart?

speaker: Yingying
content: Can't bear to let me go? Have I captured your heart? Or do you just pity me? You've always been so kind-hearted, unable to watch others suffer, always trying to help everyone you meet.

speaker: Yingying & All
content: But I'm not the only one here. Who do you want to save? Who will you save? Who will you save?
A massive surge of resentment suddenly erupts from within her, howling with desire for your life force. You instinctively take a step back, but in that same instant, it all vanishes without a trace.
Then, just like how she used to tease you, she bursts into laughter at your reaction.

speaker: Yingying
content: Scared, aren't you? This is exactly why I didn't want you to come back. I can't keep up my old charming self anymore.

speaker: %u
content: Even beneath a spirit's guise beats a human heart. I know who you really are, and I believe in the kindness you've shown us.

speaker: Yingying
content: A single thought can make a saint or demon. And me? I harbor quite a bit of resentment, you know.

A withered vine rises from below, lifting your chin to make you look into her eyes. Only then do you realize that those eyes, which once reflected the warm lights of countless homes, now harbor an unfathomable darkness in their depths.
That darkness looms ominously, a stagnant void akin to something long deceased, decaying over the ages, sealing away any decipherable hint of her true intentions.

speaker: Yingying
content: You enjoyed the fete, did you, sweetheart? With all the fun... was there a moment when all your burdens slipped away? Was there a fleeting second when you wished such happiness could last forever?

speaker: Yingying
content: ...That's what we thought too, on the day the shooting star fell.

speaker: Yingying
content: No matter how tough life gets, people keep on moving forward. They've faced the darkest times, always finding something to hope for... After trying so hard just to stay alive, why must they still be let down?
As she speaks, she narrows her eyes in another smile.

speaker: Yingying
content: I'm just a simple soul who loves happy endings. I hope those who made wishes here will come back next year with hearts full of joy. If heaven won't watch over them... then I will.

speaker: Yingying
content: Everyone has entrusted their wishes to me. As long as the fete continues, there's nothing I won't do—nothing I haven't already done... Would you like to hear about another fete? The story is even more fascinating than Yugu's tales.

speaker: Yingying
content: No? Well, that's fine. You're too kind-hearted—risking your life to come back for even a wicked spirit like me, trying to save me.

speaker: Yingying
content: So, if I do a few more things in your homeland, you'll forgive me, right? After all, you feel so sorry for us... You just can't bring yourself to leave us behind.
The vine caresses your chin with deceptive gentleness, all the while draining away your strength, depleting your energy bit by bit.

She is still chuckling, yet now more "human" voices begin to emerge within her laughter—twisted, covetous voices that pour directly into your mind. This signals the impending collapse of the collective consciousness, more terrifying than any fiend in Yugu's tales.
But...

speaker: Option
options: You're pretty bad at making up stories, Yingying.

speaker: %u
content: You wanted to cover for the evil, even play evil yourself, yet you couldn't bring yourself to crush your listeners' hearts, always leaving a glimmer of hope. Why don't you let me take over the story instead...

speaker: %u
content: I've already heard the original story of the fete from the taleteller...
[Cutaway]

speaker: Yugu
content: Unable to bear the endless torment, the maiden succumbed to madness. To sustain everyone's obsession, she first offered her own Qi, then began luring travelers to steal theirs. Again and again, year after year, she perpetuated this fete that existed only in her illusory dream.

speaker: Yugu
content: But the fete never truly revived as she wished. Every single time, on the third day, the ominous star of death would fall without fail, bringing devastation upon Bloomfete Street, leaving her as the sole survivor—everyone else perished, all their wishes shattering the very moment they were made... It took her a long time to understand the reason.
[Cutaway]

speaker: %u
content: You made wish after wish to restore the fete, to save everyone. But Yingying... when the fete began anew each time, when the locals appeared before you—did you truly feel at peace? Did you really believe your wish had come true?

speaker: %u
content: Or maybe witnessing them only reminded you of your repeated failures—of how powerless you were to stop that falling star?

speaker: %u
content: Mania has never granted any wishes. It's born from corrupted hearts, only reflecting the deepest truths within a heart into reality.

speaker: %u
content: It can do nothing but repeat the nightmare you can't escape, endlessly churning that hatred and despair into an eternal curse, growing and spreading—until it spirals beyond your control and devours you whole.

speaker: %u
content: ...You've known it all along, have you? That's why you keep telling me to let go of my past.
[Cutaway]

speaker: Yugu
content: The maiden, consumed by dark powers, wandered the world in her madness, leaving chaos in her wake. Years passed until one day, she attacked a taleteller in search of ancient lore. From this taleteller, she heard a new story about her cherished fete...

speaker: Yugu
content: In that one, there was no divine wisteria standing guard over the people—only an undying demonic tree. No warm-hearted locals—only bloodthirsty fiends. Gone was the memory of that jubilant fete where visitors from far and wide celebrated the New Year together. All that remained was a notorious street of haunting ghosts.

speaker: Yugu
content: The past she desperately sought to revive was already dead and gone, and what killed it was her own obsession. Only this truth was painful enough to wake her from her delusion.

speaker: Yugu
content: The anguish weighed heavily upon her, filling her with remorse, but what worth was the repentance of a single soul? She could no longer control the malevolence she had stirred. This accursed festival would roam as it pleases, beyond her sway.
[Cutaway]
In the original ending of the tale, the flower spirit was sealed away in eternal slumber, and with her, the rampaging fete would never awaken again.

—This was the ending she asked Yugu to write. The flower spirit allowed Yugu to seal her into the story. Sacrificing her own fate, she sought to borrow the taleteller's power to reshape the story, break the twisted curse, and grant everyone their final peace.
But of all people, she had to encounter such a cruel soul... and of all places, the taleteller had to bring her to DisCity...
[Cutaway]

speaker: Yugu
content: Come to think of it... the one who awakened her, the one destined to find her... wouldn't that be you, after all?

speaker: Yugu
content: Heheh... I should be the one thanking you...

speaker: Yugu
content: Such a tragic, such a lovely tale. I simply cannot bear to let it end here.
[Scene Change]
Yingying gazes at you. After a long while, she lets out a deep sigh.

speaker: Yingying
content: You're too kind-hearted... No wonder you're always so tired...

speaker: Yingying
content: Don't overthink it, sweetheart. These are just stories, no matter which version you hear... Stories belong to the past, to other people.

speaker: Yingying
content: Truth or lies, reality or illusion—none of that matters anymore. It's all in the past. Once a story ends, we must keep moving forward... What matters is the here and now.
Her smile, though no longer as bright as before, carries a gentle warmth.
—Tinged with weariness.

speaker: Yingying
content: There's Eastia, standing strong through the calamities, myths freshly woven by scholars, the little lion dancer journeying from Goldionville across the ocean, and... the city and people you can't bear to leave behind regardless of the burdens you shoulder.

speaker: Yingying
content: Don't let the sorrows of the past weigh you down. The path ahead will only grow rougher. You must learn to ease your load, so why not start by letting go of those stories that belong to the past, to others?

speaker: Yingying
content: The New Year has come. I have my street to watch over, and you... should go back to protect your city.
She raises her hand slightly, and you immediately know what she's about to do.

speaker: Yingying
content: Nope.

A tremendous force strikes you—and at the same time, her smile grows ever more radiant, devoid of all traces of sorrow as if they had never been there. For the guardian of the fete forever resides in joy and anticipation.

speaker: Yingying
content: Before you stands the wisteria flower spirit—the bearer of a millennium-old faith and the obsessions of countless souls, wandering the world for centuries! I am every unfulfilled wish, the very source of all corruption.

speaker: Yingying
content: Be decisive, great hero of DisCity—there's no time for doubt when vanquishing evil spirits. The wisteria did not fulfill my wish, but you, sweetheart, you can.
At last, the Mania flames are unleashed, lapping at her body until she becomes one with the blazing wisteria behind her.
Upon the impact, the vines release their grip. The ground beneath your feet crumbles away, and you plummet rapidly into the story's rift.

speaker: Yingying
content: Thank you for accompanying me to the fete... for helping me relive what I truly missed... It's been so long...

speaker: Yingying
content: Let it go back to the best days, and show me a happy ending.
The last thing you see is the massive tree crashing down with a thunderous rumble.
[Transition] Infirmary or Taleteller's Blue Hall

speaker: Yugu
content: Birth, aging, sickness, and death are but norms of life, not to mention the pains of facing what we despise, parting from what we cherish, and yearning for what we cannot have. If one fails to find beauty within cruelty and suffering, how are they to navigate this harsh world? Just like her...

speaker: Yugu
content: However, what must end shall end, just as every tale must reach its final chapter.

speaker: Yugu
content: That look in your eyes tells me you are prepared to take on the role of protagonist and bring this tragedy to its end in my stead, are you not?

speaker: Yugu
content: Welcome back, Chief.

speaker: Yugu
content: Have you attained your desire? Or perhaps...

speaker: Yugu
content: Have you realized that what you seek lies beyond your grasp?
Her expression reflects sympathy, yet her eyes gleam with satisfaction—everything unfolds precisely as she planned.
You no longer can bring yourself to argue against her words.

speaker: Option
options: ...You said you wanted me to be your protagonist.

speaker: %u
content: If your goal was to rewrite Yingying's ending... then you've succeeded.

speaker: %u
content: But you didn't approach me just for this old story that's coming to an end, did you?

speaker: %u
content: For your next tale, do you already have something in mind?
She gazes at you, a smile gradually forming on her lips. Rising to her feet, she moves closer, then lifts your chin with the edge of her fan to peer deep into your eyes.

speaker: Yugu
content: Well then... that certainly calls for a proper discussion...

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Equipment parameters calibrated, all combat personnel assembled, operation plan confirmed—

speaker: FAC Officer
content: The operation consists of three phases: defensive containment, systematic weakening, and precise breakthrough. Our ultimate goal is to break through the arboreal Mania's contamination shell and completely expose the source of contamination hidden inside.
White-armored soldiers stand ready at the Rust's isolation belt, as red targeting dots dance across the mutated wisteria's surface.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Commence the first wave of attack!
A barrage of projectiles rains down, pounding the marked points along the contaminated vines, causing the massive Mania tree to violently convulse.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The Mania entity is still growing upward! Contamination source is moving up! Update target coordinates and maintain sustained fire!

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's trying to evade, which means our attacks are working! Eastia's strategy is proving effective. Maintain the pressure!
The tactical deployment proceeds with precision and clarity, every move executed with practiced efficiency. These veterans of countless crises lack neither strategy, strength, nor courage.
Wuhuanzi stands beside you.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: ...Are you sure you want to do this?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And here I am, asking for your help again. You have my gratitude.
Wuhuanzi shakes her head.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: The real challenge lies in what you must face ahead... Stay strong.
Helicopters draw near and weapons lock on to their target: the massive Mania wisteria by The Rust. At its epicenter, where the anomalous power readings peak, is the Sinner known as Yingying.

speaker: Yingying
content: My, what magnificent weapons are these? How brave these young ones are, standing up to such a colossal monster without a trace of fear, and with such vigor! The world has certainly come far in a hundred years.

speaker: Yingying
content: Speaking of which, this is exactly where that big jinx star crashed down. Heh... It seemed so terribly mighty back then, but look at it now. People are living their lives just fine, right under its nose.

speaker: Yingying
content: Hey, just imagine—if we held a fete here, think of all the crowds and gold it would bring in!
The only answer comes from the corrupted mire that coils around her, steadily consuming her being.

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: ■■■■—■■■■—!!! Kill them, kill them!!

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: I don't want to die... don't want to die... Wisteria Fairy... Wisteria Fairy—

speaker: Chaotic Voice
content: Protect us!!
A purple-black miasma gathers in the air as shadows loom over the bustling metropolis. Mania tendrils descend from above, reaching down to drain the life from every living soul they crave.
Yingying watches them in silence, and after a long moment, she lowers her eyes.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...I'm sorry, for keeping you stuck in this nightmare for so long... but it will all be over soon.

speaker: Yingying
content: The fete from that year will finally be over.

As the Mania reaches downward, the wisteria tree defies its nature and stretches upward, lifting the contamination toward the sky. Fortune favors her—she still has enough strength left to lend a helping hand.

In the heart of the crowd beneath the shadows, the grey-clad commander has everything in place. He hesitates for a moment, lifting his gaze to the towering contaminated tree with a conflicted expression.
female_content: In the heart of the crowd beneath the shadows, the grey-clad commander has everything in place. She hesitates for a moment, lifting her gaze to the towering contaminated tree with a conflicted expression.

content: Yingying spots him instantly. She manages a smile and, with what little strength she has left, waves to that person from afar.
female_content: Yingying spots her instantly. She manages a smile and, with what little strength she has left, waves to that person from afar.

speaker: Yingying
content: Don't frown like that... Compared to the foes you've faced before and those yet to come, I'm hardly a challenge. You'll win...

speaker: Yingying
content: ...It'd be nice if we could be remembered.
Thank you, Yugu, for keeping our memory alive in people's hearts. And thank you, ${PlayerName}, for helping revise that morbid writing of hers, letting everyone remember us... as we truly were.
The Mania breaches the last line of defense, swiftly engulfing her, devouring her, making her one with itself. Yet in those final seconds, a tiny flower blooms from her fingertips.

speaker: Yingying
content: Welcome to the final fete.

speaker: Yingying
content: What's past cannot be changed—let time take care of that. Come to us to find solace, to bid farewell to the old and welcome the new. Don't dwell on sorrow for too long. You have a new year ahead of you.

speaker: Yingying
content: This is your era now, and it will be just fine under your watch...
The Mania mass ceases to grow and begins to crumble. Though it yearns to survive, a conflicting will within prevents it from withstanding the unified assault from outside.

The massive wisteria tree that once reached for the sky now topples down. It crumbles with firecracker-like pops and crackles, its fragments dissipating akin to withered leaves falling from dead branches.
The living have a future to embrace, while it's time for them to bid farewell to the past.

speaker: Yingying
content: Darkness scatters and moonlight breaks through the clouds... The tale of the fete... comes to a close at last.

speaker: Yingying
content: The valiant hero from afar vanquished the life-draining evil spirit and protected his streets. The tormented souls that wandered this world have finally found peace.
female_content: The valiant hero from afar vanquished the life-draining evil spirit and protected her streets. The tormented souls that wandered this world have finally found peace.

speaker: Yingying
content: One by one, they break free from the evil wisteria's grasp. As their obsessions fade away with the shadows, they transform into bright, warm figures—ones that stir fond memories.

speaker: Yingying
content: After more than a hundred years, they finally remember who they truly were, finding back their uncorrupted souls at long last...

speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirits
content:
Yingying said she'd wait for us over there. Let's go, we shouldn't keep the little one waiting too long.
Heh...
Mm, let's go.

speaker: Gold Toad
content: That's right. Let go, just let it go... Only by letting go of your obsession can you truly win at life...

speaker: Lady Rakshasa
content: No more troublemakers around? Then... I'll go ask the wisteria ladies to help me dress up.

speaker: Pixiu Dragon
content: My debt is paid at last! This noble soul is heading home! Home, sweet home—

speaker: Mad Gourd
content: A bright future awaits! A bright future awaits!

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Hehe, mommy—mommy—

speaker: Yingying
content: Goodbye, twisted fiends; farewell... endless nightmare. The past can never return, but now, more people will remember them.

speaker: Yingying
content: No longer a haunt of evil spirits, no longer a fiends' lair, but once again... a bustling, joyous fete of a new year.

speaker: Yingying
content: That's wonderful, truly wonderful...

speaker: Yingying
content: Now... you, too, can finally find peace...
She returns to her own realm, back to the devastated street, where beneath the wisteria—now nearly burnt to ashes—lies a fallen figure.
That is herself from a hundred years ago.

Her nails shattered, her voice too hoarse for tears. While this hellscape gradually fades away, and even the devastating fires that destroyed them crumble into void, "Yingying" still stays rooted in the ruins, like a withered vine clinging to a solitary grave.
The flower spirit bends down, her tattered vines trailing as she tries to hold that scarred maiden in her arms.

speaker: Yingying
content: Don't cry... This isn't the end of the world, and you're not alone...

speaker: Yingying
content: The hurdles that once seemed impossible... will one day be behind you...

speaker: Yingying
content: What we couldn't do... someone else will figure it out...
As she speaks, the sound of footsteps reaches her ears. She looks up, yet her vision is too blurred to see clearly. However...
A gentle smile graces her lips, almost instinctively.
[Chief's default portrait]

speaker: Yingying
content: You did wonderfully, sweetheart. I knew you had it in you.

speaker: Yingying
content: Come, it's time to write the ending.

speaker: Yingying
content: Help me end it all...
The new protagonist of the story has arrived. What unfolds before ${PlayerName} is a scene of devastation.

The tree has fallen, its broken branches splayed out like bones protruding from wounds. Countless trapped souls have finally found release, leaving behind only a single, barely recognizable... person.
Somehow, ${PlayerName} knows she must be smiling.
The corruption that lasted a century, the grief and resentment of countless souls—it's finally over. The curse that consumed her entire being has been lifted at last.
FAC Commander-in-Chief

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wake up, Yingying. You're still alive.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The illusion of the fete is not gone yet, that jinx star you hate still hangs in the sky, and Yugu can still send me in... This means there's still time to make things right.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The Mania might have thrown everything off balance within you, but it has also slowed down time—your body is still rescuable. The medical team is doing their best. We can cleanse the contamination from you and suppress the Mania. I'll give you all the Qi you need—whatever it takes.
A century has passed, but now we can save you. Please, wake up.
The New Year has come. Let's look to the future together, alright?
The figure in your arms remains silent.

content: Hey, hold on. Our meeting wasn't that conspiratorial. I just wanted to protect you. Not just you, I keep track of everyone listed on Gray Mirror, and I know many are innocent.

speaker: Bianca
content: You've seen that, um... Gray Mirror Space, right? All of those purged by monsters end up there. I can't change the rules, but I can draw a line to protect the truly innocent. This is a game of justice, after all. I can't let you guys be harmed, can I?

speaker: Chief
content: But that line only protects those you deem innocent, right? What about those you don't approve of? They're thrown into that Mania space without any protection. Is it because you can't protect everyone, or is this your way of punishing those you consider guilty?
She smiles wordlessly.

speaker: Chief
content: Did the Underground ask you to do this? To spread Mania through Gray Mirror?

speaker: Bianca
content: So they're called the Underground, huh? It looks like some kind of powerful secret society. But I found them, hehe! I'm excellent at my job as a journalist, after all.

speaker: Chief
content: You told me you barely escaped from them, and you hoped I could stop them. At that time, I believed you. I believed that we were partners in justice.

speaker: Chief
content: Even now, I still hope that wasn't a lie.
Bianca looks at you with a surprised expression, then reveals a brilliant smile.
It seems your words really please her.

speaker: Bianca
content: Of course it wasn't a lie. How could I lie to you? You are my only partner in justice! I simply withheld a few details about the climax and ending of the hero's tale.

speaker: Bianca
content: Now! The truth about Bianca's investigation into Gray Mirror! A thrilling adventure between life and death! Unexpected clues leading to the ultimate truth! No fees or subscriptions needed! The generous Bianca will tell you everything now!
[Try using chibi character from here]

speaker: Bianca
content: As you already know, the brave journalist ventured deep into enemy territory and found the suspicious server, but she got subdued by the men in black raincoats! However, the story was far from over!

speaker: Bianca
content: With her strong will and robust physique, the great journalist Bianca grasped something even as she was barely conscious! She opened her eyes to find in her arms a black box emitting a tempting faint light in the darkness!

speaker: Bianca
content: Oh my god! That was Gray Mirror's administrator rights! One second the enemy seemed to have prevailed, but the next they handed everything over to the protagonist... This kind of dramatic twist only belongs in a superhero movie!

speaker: Chief
content: Stand your ground as a truth-seeking journalist and find a chance to escape?

speaker: Chief
content: Or make the necessary sacrifices and hold out until a "partner in justice" appears, whom you will then pass the truth onto?

content: You chose the third way... You accepted Gray Mirror, seeing it as a rare opportunity to cooperate with the Underground. Everything that happened afterward was exactly as you expected.

content: Hahaha, oh, Ashy, Ashy! No one knows me better than you do!

content: Hahahahhaha... Yes, no one ever threatened me. The monsters let go and left, leaving only a magic box waiting to be opened. They set me free. So the clever Apple Juice understood immediately.

speaker: Bianca
content: I didn't get a chance to play the hero. What lay before Apple Juice was not a choice between life and death, but the red and blue pills, a fair multiple-choice question, an unbiased transaction, and a silent message...

speaker: Bianca
content: "I know why you've come, our honorable Apple Juice. You despise Gray Mirror and its atrocities. You hate all those who hide in the shadows and do evils as they please. Risking your life to come here must be your last resort, right? Well, let us show you another way."

speaker: Bianca
content: "Choose the blue pill, you may be able to destroy Gray Mirror, but you'll have to keep on fighting the countless invisible enemies on Red Mirror, White Mirror, and Blue Mirror? Or choose the red pill, you'll open the magic box, release the malice within, and see how it would end for it and its owners?"

speaker: Bianca
content: I know you'd choose the blue pill, Ashy. Hehe, too bad I'm not you. I have neither magical powers nor strong connections. My legs go weak at the sight of monsters and I always fail in obtaining information. But there are things even I can't tolerate. So, my answer is quite obvious, isn't it?

speaker: Bianca
content: I must become the new administrator of Gray Mirror and write a scandalous story to get everyone to download the app. I must make all the evildoers suffer from Mania and let them reap what they have sown! A world where kindness is rewarded and evil is punished, that is what Bianca the justice defender dreams of!

speaker: Bianca
content: As long as I can rid the city of its rotten roots, I don't mind sinking into the black sludge myself! Let the brave Apple rot and be purged too! As long as Eastside remains perfect and immaculate, I don't care!
[Back to regular proportion?]

She is enraptured by her own speech, wrapping her arms around herself emotionally. Those blue eyes with vertical pupils gleam with a malevolent light. Her gaze follows the ants beneath her feet contentedly and finally reaches your face. She smiles.

speaker: Bianca
content: You've said malice exists naturally in people's hearts and that they should learn to restrain it, that it's all Gray Mirror's fault for unleashing people's hatred and arming them with the killing knife.

speaker: Bianca
content: But I think quite the opposite. Gray Mirror is just a tool. What has the tool done wrong? Without Gray Mirror, there will still be another battlefield. Evils will find the next outlet, and it won't be hard.

speaker: Bianca
content: The evildoers will never restrain themselves. They want to act on their malice, which they hold above everything. To hell with empathy! To hell with guilt! They've even adorned this malice with the crown of justice so that the world can always revolve around them!

speaker: Bianca
content: But they know too well how ugly and shady they are, so they hide their sharp teeth and claws in the shadows of Gray Mirror. They're too self-aware and smart! I can only lure them out with the most tempting bait!

speaker: Bianca
content: Ashy, you are the most delicious golden apple I've custom-made for them. The golden apple that can lure out the bad guys hiding in the shadows!

Her voice grows increasingly impassioned as she spreads her arms as if to embrace the city. Standing proudly on the edge of the rooftop, just a mere inch from falling, she seems to be declaring her victory in advance with her passionate speech.
The wind howls past her, tugging at her hair, but she doesn't care. Instead, she spreads her arms to enjoy the new chaos brought by this gust of wind, competing with it for the city's airspace.

Meanwhile, every Gray Mirror user feels a buzz from the app. Unbeknownst to them, their smartphones connected to their palms are extracting new power from them. With each tap, each vibration, the spiritual energy named malice multiplies and accumulates at the source.

speaker: Bianca
content: Come on! All of you who wish to do evil, I offer you the knife and cover. I'll even hand you the most delectable prey. You can't refuse that, can you? Then come out and let's party together!

speaker: Bianca
content: Expose yourselves under the sun and take a good look at your sins. It's time you receive the punishment you deserve!

speaker: Bianca
content: I will make everyone who has ever tapped on Inferior on Gray Mirror suffer the consequences!

Vote Target: All Gray Mirror Users</color>
Nominated by user <color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>.

Reason for nomination: You're an Inferior. They are an Inferior. We're all Inferiors. Come on, all of us inferior beings, let's destroy ourselves and create a perfect world!

Bianca takes out her phone and throws it into the air with full force! Strange sorcery rips the sky open to form a rift between virtuality and reality, from which numerous Corruptors emerge. The malice nurtured by the users has been further processed and put under a hideous mask by Gray Mirror, now roaring and charging into reality to commence the final Purge.
[Public Security Bureau]

speaker: Roxanne
content: Highly concentrated Mania has been detected in the air above the television station. It's the new variant, but at this intensity... Call the FAC!

speaker: Roxanne

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Desire, hatred... Give me... the most disgusting malice...
[Newsroom]

speaker: Morghan
