She watches the floor below, where the smoky haze and amorous light catch on the expensive velvet of the guests' garb. Hands slink from beneath satin robes, brazenly plundering the dancers' crimson lips. Eyes leer through slits in the masks, filled with nauseating, carnal greed.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...True love? Happiness? In <color=#fb9259>a place like this</color>?

speaker: Sallie
content: Hehehe...

Honey is still dripping from her body, sticking bank notes to her like filthy labels. A few are shoved into her lingerie, others tucked into her stockings. Sallie can't stop laughing, as if the sound itself could restrain the flood of tears.
She laughs and laughs, fighting back tears. She will not cry in this place. This hellhole deserves only her curse.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...Go to hell. Go to hell, all of you...
As the indulgent feast draws to a close, cleaners and dancers trade places on the stage.

The show now over, the performers collapse in exhaustion, removing makeup and changing clothes in a heavy, oppressive silence. No one notices that Sallie, the newcomer who made a fool of herself on stage, has returned. She says nothing as she drags herself to a corner and crouches against the wall.

speaker: Sallie
content: Hnngg...
Pain and soreness hit her all at once. She rubs her swollen knees and ankles, eyes filled with nothing but hatred.
To survive, she has to adapt. Mustering her strength, Sallie drags her body toward the huddle of performers and pricks up her ears.
[Event]

After some time, the atmosphere in the dressing room loosens up. The stuffy air, thick with perfume and sweat, is mingled with laughter and gossip that assault Sallie's senses. Since she's spotted anyway, she gets up to leave.
But the magician sitting nearby has other plans.

speaker: Magician
content: Well, well, if it isn't the newbie who stole the show. You made it here, stop acting like a prude.
Sallie frowns. This really is a place full of vipers. Even though they're all fellow dancers on the bottom rung, these people still need someone weaker to take their frustrations out on.

speaker: Magician
content: Hey, I'm talking to you. You deaf?
A sharp jab in her shoulder. Sallie wants to ignore the petty taunt, but she can feel the eyes of onlookers fixed on her.

speaker: Sallie
content: It's not like I wanted to come to this goddamned place.
Her voice isn't loud, but it's clear enough for everyone in the cramped dressing room to hear. A brief silence follows.
Then, someone bursts out laughing. The magician dramatically clutches her stomach and pounds the table, doubling over like a shrimp and laughing until her face is flushed and tears stream down.

speaker: Magician
content: That's... that's the funniest thing I've heard all month! You think any of us wanted to be here?

speaker: Magician
content: Has Mr. E been too busy lately? Pulling in fresh meat with no time to break them in?
Not mincing her words, the magician drapes a casual hand over Sallie's shoulder.

speaker: Sallie
content: Don't touch me!
Sallie twists away, shaking the hand off her shoulder. She doesn't understand what's so funny, but she hates being the butt of the joke.
She's had enough humiliation. When the magician blocks her path again, Sallie snaps. She grabs an eyebrow razor from the table and holds it out in front of her, her body tensed.
But this doesn't earn her any respect. The others notice the commotion, shoot her a glance, and sneer.

speaker: Male Performer
content: Well, well, what do we have here? Now this is a show! I knew tonight wouldn't be boring.

speaker: Female Performer
content: This new girl's got some fire... Interesting. Wanna bet? Who throws the first punch?

No one steps in. Some clap, others whistle. One even pulls up a chair to watch the drama unfold. It all makes Sallie sick. The nerves in her head scream, the pressure that has been building for so long threatening to burst, when—
Knock, knock, knock. The sudden rap cuts through the tension.
A pale hand turns the handle, the metal chains adorning each finger gleaming coldly in the light. A sullen-looking man emerges from the shadows.
A single glance is all it takes for the man to grasp the situation. His eyes pass over the magician and land on Sallie, who stands rigid, clutching her makeshift weapon.
Mr. E wants to see you.
The onlookers scatter like birds, their mouths wisely shut. Sallie struggles to steady her breathing. After a long moment, she puts down the razor and follows him out.

Once outside the dressing room, they walk in silence down the corridor, one behind the other. The man is the ship's bartender, <color=#fb9259>Cassian</color>. They've never spoken before, but his voice sounds familiar... like the one who reminded her to watch for the signal before the show.
Cassian's face is expressionless. It's impossible to tell if he's dejected, melancholic, or just plain cold.
Did he just help me? Should I thank him?

Sallie can't figure out his motives for stepping in. Is it a sense of justice? Or does he have ulterior motives? The stress makes it hard to think. Before she can work it out, they reach a fork in the corridor.

Cassian stops. He gives a slight bow, as if to say goodbye, then turns back toward the bar without another word. Sallie stands there alone, feeling like an idiot. The words of gratitude die on her lips.
...Tch. He was just running an errand. Do I have to grovel for that? Stop acting so cheap, Sallie. That's why they walk all over you.
She looks down the other end of the hallway. Mr. E's office is not far away.
She's heard that he's the true owner of Euphoria. All the staff answer to him, and VIP guests need his invitation to board. Yet since arriving, Sallie has never once met her boss.
She takes a deep breath and knocks.

The dim ambient lighting barely penetrates the darkness. Only a massive, floor-to-ceiling window reveals the contents of the room: a desk nearly two meters long, a leather swivel chair positioned to overlook the bar and dance floor.

A projection on the desk displays surveillance feeds from the entire ship. The faint glow illuminates a row of small figurines on the desk, about a dozen of them, their features indistinct. On the wall nearby, the light from the window traces the outline of a relief model of Euphoria.
Sallie's eyes haven't adjusted to the darkness. It's only when one of the small figurines topples with a clatter that she sees the hand that pushed it and hears a low voice from the shadows.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Who is it?

speaker: Sallie
content: ...Sallie, the new dancer. Cassian told me to come see you.
Her introduction is met first with a low chuckle, then the sound of the leather chair turning.

speaker: Mr. E
content: A new face... What's your M-value? Your ability?

speaker: Sallie
content: ...What? M... value?

speaker: Sallie
content: I'm a dancer. Dancing is obviously what I do best. Isn't that what you hired me for?
She pulls her shoulders back, though she can't keep the tremor out of her voice.

After a short silence, she sees the hand swipe across the screen, switching the surveillance feed to text records. Sallie can't make out what it says, but for the first time, she catches a glimpse of his face in the glow.
Refined, delicate, cold, and pale, like wax rather than flesh. He glances down for only a second, the cold glow touching his eyes fleetingly before dying out.

speaker: Mr. E
content: ...That works, I suppose. Cheap, and lacks the ability to cause trouble.
He doesn't look at Sallie again. He picks up one of the figurines, toying with it out of boredom, or perhaps contemplation. A long silence ensues.
No questions, no reproach, not even another glance her way, as if she weren't there at all. The silence and the darkness grow suffocating.

speaker: Sallie
content: So why did you... send for me?

speaker: Mr. E
content: ...Send for you? Who did?
Sallie freezes, then her face flushes red.
That bartender... he was messing with me?!

Her hands tremble with rage. The relief she'd felt at being pulled away from the mob backstage is long gone, replaced by the shame and fury of being tricked. Sallie spins around, ready to storm out, grab that gloomy hypocrite, and punch him in his deadpan face.
Everyone thinks they can screw with me, everyone looks down on me. What gives you the right?! I'm not one of your—
Bang!
The door is flung open, the light from the corridor spilling into the dark room. A brilliant flash of gold darts in as a sugary voice cuts through the silence.

speaker: Milly
content: Oh my God! Mr. E, you have to hear this!
The little golden doll comes clicking in on high heels. It's... Milly? She flits over to the desk, deftly spinning Mr. E's chair around and throwing her arms around his neck.

speaker: Milly
content: I had the most wonderful chat with Mr. Lucian today! And did you know? He's such a sweetheart! He was so shy when he talked about his first love, even his ears turned red!

speaker: Milly
content: And! Most importantly, that kind, devoted gentleman... he told me something about him! Awww!
female_content: And! Most importantly, that kind, devoted gentleman... he told me something about her! Awww!

content: Milly squeals, cupping her face and bouncing in excitement. Sallie can almost see ditzy bubbles popping over her head.
Mr. E smiles. Light falls on his face, and Sallie can see clearly that his previous coldness is gone. He gently takes Milly's hand and pats it a couple times, his eyes filled with doting affection.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Because you're Euphoria's renowned jewel. They all adore you. Of course they're eager to talk to you.

speaker: Milly
content: Does that mean I'm famous? Has everyone in DisCity heard my name? Am I a big star now?

speaker: Milly
content: Has my love heard about me too?
Mr. E's smile deepens.

speaker: Mr. E
content: If he'd heard, don't you think he'd come running to see you? So, not quite yet. Keep up the good work. Spend more time with our honored guests. Make yourself unforgettable, so they'll carry your name back to DisCity. Sooner or later, your love is bound to hear of you.
female_content: If she'd heard, don't you think she'd come running to see you? So, not quite yet. Keep up the good work. Spend more time with our honored guests. Make yourself unforgettable, so they'll carry your name back to DisCity. Sooner or later, your love is bound to hear of you.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Such a moving legend, such sincere devotion... How could he possibly resist the urge to come and see you? So when that day comes, you must make yourself beautiful and charming enough, for him.
female_content: Such a moving legend, such sincere devotion... How could she possibly resist the urge to come and see you? So when that day comes, you must make yourself beautiful and charming enough, for her.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Go get a spa treatment, Milly. Pamper yourself, especially that gorgeous blonde hair. He'll crave you, like a bee attracted to nectar.
female_content: Go get a spa treatment, Milly. Pamper yourself, especially that gorgeous blonde hair. She'll crave you, like a bee attracted to nectar.

speaker: Milly
content: Really? When? In a day? A week... a month? Oh my, there's no time!

The man speaks in honeyed tones while the woman listens with ecstatic joy. The only outsider stands in the shadows, feeling so disgusted she could almost vomit. Good thing Sallie hasn't eaten all day, so she's spared that humiliation.
What a load of crap. You don't even have an audience. Who are you trying to fool? I'm so sick of this...
She turns to leave, but just as she steps into the light, she hears a soft cry from behind her.

speaker: Milly
content: Oh, you have another guest? Hmm, you're...
Milly hurries toward Sallie, her curious gaze lingering on her.

speaker: Milly
content: I know you! You're the one who fell on stage today!

speaker: Milly
content: Oh my goodness, your knees are scraped! And your foot, does it hurt? Are you hurt anywhere else?

speaker: Milly
content: Wait... you're not a Sinner?

Of course she has to bring up the one thing Sallie wants to forget. Her face flushes a deeper red, and she jerks her hand away from Milly's grasp. She opens her mouth to speak, but the man cuts her off.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Not a Sinner, but quite charming nonetheless, don't you think? With the recent departures leaving us short-staffed, we've recruited some exceptional ordinary people to bring a little novelty to the show.
He looks at Sallie again, smiling for the first time.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Now I remember. It was you... A very interesting debut. That creative little tumble was quite eye-catching. Some guests have already requested you by name. Congratulations.

speaker: Sallie
content: Requested me?!

speaker: Mr. E
content: Yes, by name. Don't worry. For someone in your position, this is a very good job. A little dancing on stage, a little chatting off stage... All you have to do is keep the guests happy.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Keep them satisfied, win their affection, and those distinguished patrons will reward you handsomely—with clothes, fine food, tips, and all the love you could want... Oh, you have the perfect example right here.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Go on, Milly. Show the rookie the ropes, as the Jewel of Euphoria. Teach her how to work, help her love the life here. We can't have her being so anxious all the time. It spoils the fun for the guests.

speaker: Milly
content: Oh, of course! Poor thing, she looks absolutely terrified. Leave it to me.
Milly's smile, radiant and sincere, only fills Sallie with dread. She takes two steps back.
Can't she understand what he's really saying? Doesn't she know what kind of place this is? Why is this idiot grinning like a fool? What does she want to teach me?!

speaker: Sallie
content: No... If you want me to... do those things with them... I'd rather die!
Sensing Sallie's distress, Milly gives her a consoling smile, gently taking her arm and trying to calm her down.

speaker: Milly
content: It's not that bad! We're all human. As long as you love them the right way, everyone can be happy. I'll show you how.

speaker: Sallie
content: Do you have any idea what you're saying?!

speaker: Milly
content: Well, what I mean is...
Mr. E is no longer looking at the two dancers. He idly fiddles with the projection, watching every corner of Euphoria in the surveillance feeds. He speaks with a casual smile.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Take your time, Milly. You can do it. There's only one reason Sallie resists our guests so much...

speaker: Mr. E
content: Perhaps she already has someone special. A lover she's pining for on the outside.

speaker: Milly
content: Huh?
Milly gasps, forgetting she'd just been shoved away. Her eyes shine even brighter, her face glowing with surprise and joy.

speaker: Milly
content: You... have someone special, too?

speaker: Sallie
content: NO I DON'T!
Sallie can't stand it anymore. Her voice is almost a shriek.

speaker: Sallie
content: What the hell?! I don't give a damn about your crap or your fake-ass high society! Leave me alone!

speaker: Sallie
content: Get those agents to take me back! So what if it's a loan shark? I'll go and pay it off! I'll pay millions, even billions! I'll sell whatever I have on the dark web and pay up! I'm done working here!

speaker: Sallie
content: You're all bastards... The guests, the Jewel, everything on this damn ship is filthy as hell! Stay away from me!
Before Milly can answer, Sallie turns and storms out of the door. She runs straight into someone...
It's Cassian, carrying a bottle of red wine. He seems surprised to see Sallie burst out of the office, but gets cut off before he can speak.

speaker: Sallie
content: This is all your fault! You lying bastard! Don't let me see you again! Get out of my way!
The bristling stray cat hisses and stomps away, leaving Cassian standing in the hallway. The office door cracks open, and a small, golden head peeks out.

speaker: Milly
content: Hmm, sounds like a rough relationship.
She cocks her head, gives Cassian an apologetic look, and adds:

speaker: Milly
content: Don't mind her, Cassian. It's not your fault. When people get mad, they'll kick any dog that crosses their path.
The bartender shrugs. He doesn't seem to care, but he uses the opportunity to glance past Milly...

In the shadows of the long desk, Mr. E is smiling as he sweeps his hand across the projection. The surveillance switches to a different feed. It's somewhere in the WhiteSands, the coordinates unclear. But something unusual in the blurry image has captured his full attention...

speaker: Mr. E
content: You want to leave? Hehe...
Mr. E looks up, and Cassian quickly averts his gaze. He hands the tray to Milly, bows lightly, and turns to walk away.
At the same moment, the new dancer is stomping down the other end of the corridor, the floorboards shuddering with her barely contained rage.

speaker: Sallie
content: Bastards... all of them...

speaker: Sallie
content: I'm getting out of this goddamned place! Just you wait... I will...

WhiteSands has been restless of late. With erratic weather and frequent Tides of Ashes, very few vessels dare to pass through. Near DisCity, a patrol ship veers from its regular course and heads deeper into the WhiteSands.
Aboard the vessel, a soldier moves between the cabins. He stops before a teak door marked "VIP" and raises a hand, tapping three times in a crisp rhythm.

The cabin door opens, and a woman in a black uniform strides out, taking a deep breath of the fresh air outside. She has a sharp, no-nonsense air about her, with a faint smile playing at her lips. In one hand, she carries an elongated, dangerous-looking medkit; in the other, she holds a phone to her ear.

speaker: Doctor
content: Phew... it's finally over.

speaker: Iron Mask
content: How's the situation?

speaker: Doctor
content: Very bad. Shouldn't have taken him out of the ICU. The contamination is stubborn, his body is failing, and it's taking a toll on his mind... He threw up several times again and passed out.
female_content: Very bad. Shouldn't have taken her out of the ICU. The contamination is stubborn, her body is failing, and it's taking a toll on her mind... She threw up several times again and passed out.

speaker: Doctor
content: What's a doctor supposed to do...?

speaker: Iron Mask
content: I wasn't asking about him.
female_content: I wasn't asking about her.

content: The man's blunt dismissal doesn't seem to faze her. She fires a question in return.

speaker: Doctor
content: Oh? But he's one of Catherine's favorites. If something were to happen to him... your commander wouldn't be pleased, would she?
female_content: Oh? But she's one of Catherine's favorites. If something were to happen to her... your commander wouldn't be pleased, would she?

content: The woman chuckles.

speaker: Doctor
content: Alright, whatever history you two have, we're on the same side now. Our objective is the same. Don't forget the 9th Agency credentials. Could be an expert at hunting down spies.

speaker: Doctor
content: After all, our target is proving quite elusive.
Her smile fades, her voice turning serious.

speaker: Doctor
content: Are you sure we're in the right area?

speaker: Iron Mask
content: Not sure. We intercepted suspicious chatter on the emergency frequencies a few days ago. Communications traced it to this sector, but that's all we have.

speaker: Doctor
content: That's fine. Understandable. The patrol has plenty of time. We'll just have to be patient.

speaker: Doctor
content: ...If that really is one of Farland's assets, it would be suspicious for it to be exposed too quickly.

After the Great Expo, tensions between DisCity and Farland have reached a breaking point. According to a confidential tip from a high-ranking source, the high-profile Nirvana-Aurum Secretum partnership is embroiled in serious corruption. The higher-ups suspect Farland has found a way to infiltrate and corrupt DisCity's high society, entangling them in vested interests.

During the 9th Agency's interrogations, several exposed corrupt officials only revealed a club called "Euphoria" hidden deep in the high seas. But where exactly? Who runs the place? How do you get in? They claimed to know nothing. Any further pressing sent them spiraling into terrified fits of mental breakdown.

Clearly, the enemy is skilled at hiding their tracks—and at controlling their corrupted pawns. Cunning foes, sparse intel, and frequent sandstorms have made the search mission exceptionally difficult. The only breakthrough came from a garbled message intercepted during a patrol:
HELP!! &*$I'm...^#Euphori*#! All devils onboar&*...#&don't want to die... I DON'T WANT TO DIE!!!

speaker: Doctor
content: It could be bait, but one worth biting. I'm sure Catherine's excellent patrol will catch them slipping up, don't you think?

speaker: Iron Mask
content: Hmph. Any unusual terrain, traps, ambushes... could be a clue to their secret base. Best case scenario...
As the ship lurches violently, inhuman roars fill the air.

speaker: Iron Mask
content: We run into monsters they've stationed in the sandstorm.
[Insert Gameplay Stage]
The white sands are littered with the grotesque remains of monsters. The DisCorps move from one mangled corpse to another, confirming each is neutralized before stacking them in one pile.
The doctor packs her weapon back into its case. The air still reeks of blood, a smell she is all too familiar with. She licks her lips, as if savoring the lingering taste of a feast.

speaker: Doctor
content: Any interesting finds?
The soldier straightens up and shakes his head in disappointment.

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: Nothing. No comms, no identification, not even a chip we could analyze.

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: But... they're different from the sand beasts and Corruptors we've encountered before. We'll take these back to R&D. They might find something.

speaker: Doctor
content: Covering their tracks this well... Must be some unusual prey.
A deep voice speaks from her comms line.

speaker: Iron Mask
content: They know they can't afford to be found.

speaker: Doctor
content: What a shame. The trail's gone cold. Don't tell me... we'll have to comb through the entire high seas?
The line goes silent again. Looking out over the endless WhiteSands, the doctor stretches languidly.

speaker: Doctor
content: If only we had more intel. This business trip might take quite a while.
Having vented her feelings, Sallie manages to calm down somewhat.
Security on this ship is airtight. Every gate requires a keycard with the right clearance. A dancer like her can't even leave this deck, let alone the ship.
Sallie can't find a way to escape, and there's no one she can ask. She doesn't trust a soul on this vessel.

The ship is a prison of steel and iron. She wants to search for another way, but time is running out. Before the next performance, whether she likes it or not, the dancers will be brought out to entertain the distinguished guests.
[Event]
The man in the golden mask who'd harassed her earlier is closing in again. Sallie tries to dodge, but he seizes her hand with a cold, disgruntled snort.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: You should be grateful I even glanced your way. You've no curves to speak of, no manners. Heh! Know your place.

speaker: Young Guest
content: Haha, exactly! Mr. Owl, what do you even see in her?

speaker: Short Guest
content: The chick isn't the prettiest girl here, nor the most entertaining. She's... <color=#fb9259>not even a Sinner</color>.
The short guest peers at Sallie through the curve of his wine glass.

speaker: Short Guest
content: Ahhh... Haha, I get it now! She's the dimwit, isn't she? The one who tripped on stage!
He bursts into laughter, slapping Mr. Owl on the shoulder. The young guest on the other side joins in, smirking with a suggestive look.

speaker: Young Guest
content: Well, congratulations, newbie. Starting things off with a bang! I wish you both... a lovely evening, hahaha.

The man in the golden mask lets out a cold sneer. He tugs at the collar of his suit with both hands, straightening it. It's hard to tell whether he's pleased or offended. He rises to his feet and turns his gaze on Sallie, deliberately looking down on her.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: This isn't an invitation. It's an opportunity for you to serve me. Do you understand?
The other guests, well aware of what he means, wolf whistle and look on.
The young guest picks up a glass of wine and tries to shove it into Sallie's hand. She forces a smile and pushes it back.

speaker: Young Guest
content: Heh, putting on airs before you've even made it big?

speaker: Young Guest
content: Think about it. Once you're with Mr. Owl, you'll have anything you could ever dream of. Besides, you're a dancer... isn't this what you do for a living?
His voice hardens as he pushes the glass toward her again. Wine spills over Sallie's hand in the back-and-forth. She flinches, and in that instant, the taut string inside her snaps.

speaker: Sallie
content: I... don't want to.
Her voice is quiet, but the air freezes. The dancers nestled in the other guests' arms gasp, hands covering their mouths, shocked that she would refuse.
The guests in their animal masks seem to have united in purpose. They set down their drinks, their eyes turning cold behind the masks, piercing Sallie like frozen daggers.

speaker: Short Guest
content: Mr. Owl, seems like the chick doesn't understand the rules here.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Hmph... I figured as much. But I like her fighting spirit. The look in her eyes... I like that.

Sallie feels uncomfortable under their gaze, her skin crawling as every hair stands on end. She had imagined the consequences of refusal, but reality proves more ruthless than anything she could imagine.
Cassian watches the scene. His eyes meet Sallie's across the room before he looks down, continuing to polish a glass. He seems to give a faint shake of his head.

speaker: Cassian
content: The guests here get whatever they want. As long as they want it.

speaker: Cassian
content: Farewell. May you find peace in hell.
She's too far away to hear him, but just by reading his lips, she can feel the chill behind the words.

Back as a dancer in Eastside, she thought she'd learned how to handle lecherous guests. But a suffocating dread, something beyond her experience, now seizes her, making her blood run cold. Like a fledgling bird with its head held high, she plummets into a lawless abyss.
All the masks turn to her, their dark eyeholes boring into her soul. She hears snickering. She wants to run, to scream. And at that moment...

speaker: Milly
content: Oh my, if it isn't Mr. Merlot!
A familiar sweet fragrance fills Sallie's nose as a flash of gold bobs into her view.
Milly bounds into the space between Sallie and Merlot, a delighted look on her face. She cheerfully loops her arm through the man's, while pressing down the hand he was reaching toward Sallie.

speaker: Milly
content: You've been here so many times but never requested me or any of the other girls. And now you're suddenly taken with Sallie... don't tell me it's love at first sight? Oh my, that's so romantic!
While Mr. Merlot is still confused, another figure slides in from the other side.

speaker: Magician
content: Mr. Merlot, didn't you say just last night how fascinating my magic tricks were? Now you're picking the new girl! What happened to first-come, first-served? You're making me jealous.
The magician nudges the stunned Sallie aside, playfully taking the man's other arm and pulling it toward herself.

The man tries to look back, but he can't resist the two beautiful women fawning over him, or the wolf whistles from the other guests. Feeling quite flattered, he's coaxed away within moments, leaving Sallie standing there, her face ashen.
Not daring to dwell on what happened, Sallie flees amid the chaos.
Sallie races back to the dressing room and locks the door. She slumps against the cold wall, gasping for breath, her chest heaving, a violent pounding in her ears.

She thought she'd seen the worst of human nature, that she'd grown used to armoring herself with anger. But just now, a long-forgotten instinct awakened inside her. In the black hollows of those masks, in that twisted moment of silence, she felt a terror, as if a dark scythe had pressed against her throat.
Who are these masked patrons? They could get anything they want in DisCity, so why go through all the trouble to come to the isolated WhiteSands? What are they coming here to buy?
And the other dancers... Are they glamorous? Are they happy? Why are they so wild on stage, but look like lifeless shells below it? Will she... end up the same way?
The more Sallie thinks about it, the more frightened she becomes. This dressing room, which had seemed so ordinary, now hides disturbing secrets in every corner...
[Event]

Seeing that no one has entered, Sallie pulls out the communicator. The screen flickers, displaying fragmented text... Her hand shakes in terror as she reads it, and the device slips from her grasp. It clatters to the floor with a sharp crack that chills her to the bone.
HELP!! &*$I'm...^#Euphori*#! All devils onboar&*...#&don't want to die... I DON'T WANT TO DIE!!!

speaker: Sallie
content: What... is this?

speaker: Mr. E
content: A new face... What's your M-value? Your ability?

Sallie thinks of what she's seen on stage. Milly, who could conjure honey out of thin air. Snow, who can control snowflakes. The centaur acrobat, the levitating Selene, and other bizarre figures she couldn't even name.
Their strange abilities and appearances aren't the product of costumes or makeup... They are <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> with special powers!

speaker: Sallie
content: ...Why are there so many of them here?

In the past, Sinners in DisCity were monsters that even gangs feared. They used their abilities to cause trouble, answering to no one. But now, so many of them are penned up here on this ship... Are they here by choice?
And the guests... are they even human? Why the masks? Those distinguished patrons... who are they? Are they like the rich brats and socialites who used to humiliate her at the clubs in Eastside?
What are they doing here? And who is Mr. E? What kind of place is Euphoria, really? Where is the owner of this communicator? Are they alive? Or... dead?!
What about herself? How much longer does she have?

speaker: Mr. E
content: Not a Sinner, but quite charming nonetheless, don't you think? With the recent <color=#dg1f1f>departures</color> leaving us short-staffed, we've recruited some exceptional ordinary people to bring a little novelty to the show.
Sallie panics, her mind going numb with fear.

The resentment of being humiliated day after day just to make a living, the shock of discovering her boss was racking up debt in her name, the terror of being cornered by loan sharks, the despair of having no one to help her, no one who saw her plight... She remembers the twisted smiles on their faces when they "introduced" her to this job, the words they used:
She should be grateful for her "good fortune," for "having a pretty face." That they "respected her enough to give her another chance."

speaker: Sallie
content: I never should've come here. I'm better off dead than stuck here... I should've fought to escape, even if they broke my legs!

speaker: Sallie
content: No... I don't want to die! I have to think of something...
In her panic, Sallie instinctively grabs the communicator from the floor.
Will it even work? Can she call for help? No. It has to work. She has to call for help. She can't escape this hellhole on her own!

BANG! The dressing room door is thrown open. Sallie jumps in fright, slamming her injured knee into the table and tumbling to the floor. But fear overwhelms the pain as she snatches the communicator and shoves it down her stockings.
She barely has time to do that when a familiar, sweet voice speaks behind her.
Why are you hiding here?
It's Milly. Sallie freezes, her throat too dry to speak.

speaker: Milly
content: Are you okay? You're so pale. Did that guest scare you? It's alright, we took care of that for you, so don't be afraid!

speaker: Milly
content: Hmm, or are you up to something you don't want the rest of us to know about...? Oh, I know!
She suddenly grabs Sallie's hand, nearly giving her a heart attack.

speaker: Milly
content: You were secretly writing to your sweetheart, weren't you?!
Milly spins in excitement, her skirt blooming like a champagne rose. The cloying sweetness of romance fills the cramped space.

speaker: Milly
content: You reacted so strongly just now, you must have someone you love, right? That's why you refused the guest's affection...

speaker: Milly
content: It must be so scary, having that happen right after you arrived. You must miss him terribly. Tell me all about it! When you're scared, thinking about the one you love always gives you comfort and courage, right?
Sallie is speechless, unsure if Milly is fishing for information or if she's genuinely this simple-minded. Worried the communicator might be discovered, she forces herself to play along.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...Yes. I was... writing my feelings to him...

speaker: Milly
content: I knew it! You're just like me!
Milly leans in breathlessly, her big eyes sparkling as she clasps Sallie's hands.

speaker: Milly
content: I have someone I love, too! But none of my coworkers like to talk about it. They always make fun of me... You have no idea how happy I am that you're here! I finally have an ally!

speaker: Milly
content: Can you tell me your story? I want to hear a real love story! Or should I tell you mine first? My love is amazing. I'm sure you've heard his name.
female_content: Can you tell me your story? I want to hear a real love story! Or should I tell you mine first? My love is amazing. I'm sure you've heard her name.

speaker: Milly
content: Oh, look! Here's his picture! Do you recognize him?
female_content: Oh, look! Here's her picture! Do you recognize her?

content: It's a face as weary as her own after pulling back-to-back night shifts.
...Who is it?

speaker: Milly
content: Mr. E says he's a celebrity, and it would cause trouble if the guests found out. I don't want to cause any trouble for him, so I'm only showing you. You have to keep it a secret, okay?
female_content: Mr. E says she's a celebrity, and it would cause trouble if the guests found out. I don't want to cause any trouble for her, so I'm only showing you. You have to keep it a secret, okay?

speaker: Milly
content: Oh, so gorgeous! No matter how many times I look, I still feel my cheeks blushing!
What's wrong with her? Is she here to mock me? Or is this... just how she is?
What was she talking about? Love? My love story? I don't have...

But an image of a man flashes in her mind, a face that ignites her fury. Milly's incessant chatter is making her feel embarrassed and angry. For a moment, it eclipses her fear. All Sallie wants is for her to shut up.

speaker: Sallie
content: If you have someone you love, why do you still entertain the guests?
Milly blinks.

speaker: Milly
content: There's nothing wrong with that. They're all kind guests who request me because they like me.

speaker: Sallie
content: Nothing wrong with that? Then tell me, what do those kind guests do to you every night?

speaker: Milly
content: Do to me? Hehe...
Milly crinkles her eyes, completely unaffected by the sarcasm in Sallie's words. Instead, she gives a sly, mysterious smile.

speaker: Milly
content: They do what you and I are doing right now, of course... sharing their <color=#fb9259>love stories</color> with me!
Sallie's confusion can no longer keep up with Milly's romantic fancy.

speaker: Milly
content: Every guest who requests me comes with a sincere heart. They tell me all about their feelings for their love far away, about loves they've lost, their happiness, regrets, so many things.

speaker: Milly
content: People captured by love are always so fragile. I just sit and listen. Sometimes I pass them tissues, sometimes I give them water...

speaker: Sallie
content: ...They don't touch you?
Now it's Milly's turn to be confused.

speaker: Milly
content: Why would they? I'm not the one they love.

speaker: Milly
content: Everyone knows I'm just here to sing and dance and make the guests happy. No one would really fall in love with a pretty flower decorating the stage. Besides, I've already told them that my heart belongs to someone else.

speaker: Milly
content: It's because my love is so brave and honest that everyone is willing to share things with me that they wouldn't tell anyone else.

Milly's face is gentle, but Sallie finds it ridiculous. So this is "the Jewel of Euphoria." She overestimated this woman. A Sinner, maybe, but she's just a love-addled fool. How comical. Pathetic, really. And she's beginning to understand the boss's methods.

For these patrons, beauty that is so readily attained becomes cheap and disposable. Perhaps what these cold-blooded guests really crave is the true affection that they so lack, something they can use to tout their own virtue.

After all, this place offers a feast where they can gorge themselves to their heart's content, or play at some charade of pure love. Finding a genuinely foolish romantic like Milly must not have been easy. Mr. E must have invested considerable effort in shaping her.
...How absurd. Those bastards come to a place like this to seek thrills. How dare they pretend to care about love or affection?!

speaker: Sallie
content: The ones who go on and on about how deeply they love or how wounded they are—they're either wallowing in self-pity or trying to get in your pants. Those scumbags know exactly what they're doing. The second you start to feel sorry for them, you're finished. You'll get played, sooner or later.

speaker: Milly
content: No. No one has ever tried anything with me.

speaker: Sallie
content: They've never laid a hand on you?
Milly shakes her head.

speaker: Sallie
content: Never forced themselves on you?
Milly shakes her head again. Then, as if realizing something, she reaches out and grasps Sallie's hand with concern. Startled, Sallie tries to pull away.

speaker: Milly
content: Sallie, you really are scared. Do you think everyone out there is going to hurt you? Did someone hurt you?
Milly looks at her with a pity that only fuels Sallie's growing irritation.

speaker: Milly
content: I know that feeling. Don't worry, it'll be okay. You're stronger than you think. Think about the person you love. That will give you the courage to keep going.

speaker: Milly
content: And until your love comes to find you, I'll be by your side to help you. Trust me. No matter how hopeless things seem, love will protect your heart from harm.
She speaks with genuine sincerity, but Sallie can't bear to hear it anymore. There are certain things that will always set a cornered cat on edge.

speaker: Sallie
content: Someone I love? I don't have anyone like that! And I can't take this for another second! I'm leaving this wretched place!

speaker: Milly
content: Leaving...

speaker: Milly
content: You said... you want to leave here...
Milly's face darkens. Sallie realizes, too late, what she's done. Her stomach tightens. She's said too much.

Damn it... she's tricked by this love-addled girl into forgetting one most important thing: this sweetheart is Mr. E's favorite. After everything she's said, will Milly betray her? Is she going to be killed now?

speaker: Milly
content: Are you going to elope?! Oh my god, that's so brave! So romantic! The power of love!

speaker: Sallie
content: Do you even use your damn brain?!
Sallie explodes. Grabbing Milly by the shoulders, she tries to shake some sense into her.

speaker: Sallie
content: I'm trying to escape! Do you get it? ES-CAPE!!

speaker: Milly
content: I get it, I get it! That's why I want to help, otherwise you—

speaker: Sallie
content: I don't need it! I don't want anything to do with any of you! I'll get out on my own! I—
What are you talking about?
There was no sound from the door, no footsteps. Mr. E is standing in the doorway, watching them with a smile. Sallie's burning rage turns to ice.
The communicator in her stocking digs uncomfortably into her leg. She remembers the text on the screen, and with it, a deep, primal fear.
HELP!! &*$I'm...^#Euphori*#! All devils onboar&*...#&don't want to die... I DON'T WANT TO DIE!!!

speaker: Mr. E
content: Please, go on. Is it something I'm not supposed to hear?
The man's smile is venomous as a serpent's, its tongue about to coil around its prey...

speaker: Milly
content: Of course not! We were talking about Sallie's love letter!
The blonde girl steps between them, giggling like she's oblivious to the icy tension in the air.

speaker: Milly
content: Why did you have to barge in, Mr. E? Sallie's so shy, and I finally got her to open up a little. Then you came in, and look, she's clammed up again.
She puffs out her cheeks in mock indignation, but it comes across as nothing more than sweet, playful pouting. The trick works wonders. Mr. E's expression softens back into a warm smile.

speaker: Mr. E
content: My apologies. I thought you were arguing, but it turns out you're already friends...
Sallie looks down, rubbing her arms nervously and avoiding Mr. E's gaze. But he's already dismissed her.
He simply smiles, reaching out to stroke Milly's golden hair.

speaker: Mr. E
content: The show's about to start, so go get ready. Give them another perfect performance. Make them remember you. It'll bring you one step closer to your lover.

speaker: Milly
content: I will. And so will Sallie. We both have someone to think about. At least, she won't trip again.
Mr. E nods, but as he turns to leave, he pauses in the doorway.
The light throws his cold, slender silhouette into sharp relief, his delicate features lost in shadow.

speaker: Mr. E
content: By the way, Sallie. Do try your best. You have fans now.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Should another guest request you, be sure to cherish the opportunity.
Sallie stands frozen to the spot. She remembers the gold mask, the man's hands, his eyes, his words. She shakes her head violently, trying to dispel the creeping fear.
The night's performance begins on schedule. Sallie manages to get through the first show, her nerves taut.

During the intermission, she doesn't follow the others backstage. Instead, she slips into a bathroom stall and retrieves the communicator, which she'd wrapped in plastic and hidden in the toilet tank.
After a quick check to ensure it's dry, she tucks it into her costume and walks out of the bathroom, trying to look composed.

speaker: Sallie
content: There has to be a way. First, I need to contact the outside world...
A large hand clamps around Sallie's waist, trapping her. A cloth, soaked in some strange chemical, is pressed against her mouth and nose.
No chance to scream, no time to struggle. Sallie's head spins, and the world goes black.
Heavy. So heavy. Her eyelids are heavy. They won't open. Her body feels heavy. It presses on her stomach, making her want to retch.
A dense fog fills her mind. It refuses to clear. Is the show still going on? Did she get away? Sallie can't remember.
Something presses against her neck. It's coarse. Cold. The sensation slowly wakes her up. She moves her fingers, struggling to focus her thoughts...
You're awake. Wonderful. I was worried you wouldn't open your eyes again... like Emily.

Sallie opens her eyes to heavy shadows cast by dim yellow light. The air is thick with perfume, alcohol, and... the smell of dog food. Her wrists are raw under the rope. A collar is clasped around her neck. She's been arranged on the sofa in the center of the room, like a piece for display.

Across from her, on a rose-colored velvet couch, a man in a golden owl mask is watching her. His gaze is gentle in a way that makes her sick. Seeing her stir, he rises and walks to her with the bearing of a master. He crouches down and strokes her hair.
But your hair is too long. Emily's was always neat and trim... Here, let me cut it for you. It'll look much better short.
Sallie thrashes frantically, but he clamps one hand around the back of her neck, holding her down. She remembers the mask. After his advances failed, the bastard decided to kidnap her.

speaker: Sallie
content: What Emily? What are you talking about...? Who... who are you?!

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Why, I'm the kind-hearted gentleman who bought you. Your new master.
Rage overwhelms fear. Sallie snaps fully awake. She wants to scream curses at him...

speaker: Sallie
content: Master?! What kind of sick joke is this? You think you can do whatever you want with your filthy money? We're dancers, not your playthings. We work hard. We have dignity. We—
She thinks of the communicator, filled with desperate cries for help, the dancer who sent it probably long gone... She thinks of the loan sharks, the gangsters dragging her away...

speaker: Golden Mask
content: ...We what?
The enormous golden mask fills her vision, looming over her, pressing down. Sallie has fought back against many men, but this time, she feels like yelling at ice and stone.
Then she remembers where she is, and her voice dies in her throat. The laughter from behind the golden mask grows louder, rabid.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Yes, yes, a dancer has dignity. And even you deserve to be loved. I will love you. From now on, you're my Emily... My darling little dog.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Come on, pant for me. See? Like this—hah... hah... hahahaha. A good dog wags her tail for her master, pants, shakes hands... Do it. Do it for me.
As he speaks, he fastens a tail accessory to her hips, his tone revoltingly gentle.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: The best thing about Emily... was how she'd wag her tail like crazy whenever I came home. I'm sure you can do it too, Sallie. No... Emily.
He retrieves a curling iron from a shelf and plugs it in.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Emily had a special birthmark... right here. So cute. You need one just like it to become my Emily.
Sallie's heart pounds wildly as she feels the searing heat draw closer. Her screams nearly shatter her own eardrums.

speaker: Sallie
content: What are you doing?! Let me go! LET ME GO!

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Don't move, my hand might slip... You don't want me to miss, do you? Emily never fought back. She knew I loved her.
Sallie thrashes her head desperately, knocking over a glass on the side table. The man pauses and stares at the shards on the floor, as if he's discovered something fascinating.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Oh, you clumsy thing. Emily was just like you. So clumsy. Can't walk straight, even with four legs. Always bumping into things.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Once... she broke a glass just like you did. Later... she got on her knees and picked up every piece with her teeth. Even cut her tongue doing it. Would you do the same for me, Emily?

He grabs a fistful of Sallie's hair and forces her head down toward the broken glass. Sallie's face is deathly pale, her body shaking violently. The man's laughter closes in from behind, leaving her nowhere to run.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: After Emily died, I thought I'd never find another dog as obedient as her... but you're different. You're so much like her. You even have the same defiant eyes. I adore those eyes. The moment I saw you, I knew. I had to tame you.

speaker: Sallie
content: I'm not your damn dog... You psycho! Freak!! Get away from me! Help! Help me!!
Unable to break free from his grip, she twists her head and spots the room's only window, a small square veiled by a gauze curtain. A faint light filters in, outlining a person's silhouette.

speaker: Sallie
content: Help!! HELP ME!!!
The figure outside remains motionless. The more Sallie struggles, the wilder the masked man's laughter.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Haha, you're my dog, my darling, my long-lost Emily. I have a feeling you'll be even better behaved than she was... I'm going to love you. I'm going to love you so, so much...

The man pins her down with one hand while the other gropes for something behind him, some other torture device for his madness. Fear, revulsion, and survival instinct all peak at once, and Sallie lets out a piercing scream.

speaker: Sallie
content: NO!!! Don't touch me!
(Clanging and clattering sound)

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Mmph...!
Clang!
Her desperate kick connects with his head. The golden mask flies off and hits the wall, before dropping into the bath and sinking with a gurgle.
His grip loosens. Sallie scrambles backward, gasping for air, but there's no time to feel relieved.

The guest stumbles back a few steps, hunched over and muttering. Her kick wasn't that strong, but his reaction is so extreme that Sallie is confused. He covers his face with his hands, shields himself with his robes, refusing to step into the light.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: My face... Don't look... don't look at me...

speaker: Golden Mask
content: The mask, where's the mask...? You... what are you staring at?!

Sensing her gaze, the man explodes with rage. Without the mask, his face is vaguely familiar. One of the "important people" her previous employer used to grovel to? Someone from a shadowed corner? Or... a face from the news, at some important event?

She has no time to place him. The man's face contorts into a snarl. He grabs a side table and brings it down on her with savage force. Sallie's vision goes black as she collapses to the floor, blood splattering across the velvet carpet.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: What kind of look is that?! What do you think you are?! How dare you look at me like that?!
He seizes her by the ankle and drags her like a corpse, then stomps on her stomach.

speaker: Sallie
content: Ugh!
Fists rain down on Sallie like a hailstorm. She can only curl up instinctively, shielding her head with her arms. But every organ is shrieking with pain, every breath an unbearable agony.

The physical pain drowns out the insults pouring into her ears. For the first time in her life, she's lost the strength to feel angry. Fear has consumed everything. That's right. She's not seen as a human, not even as a commodity to be maintained.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Do you have any idea who I am?! Even the Speaker bows his head to me!! How dare you treat me this way? HOW DARE YOU DO THIS TO ME?!

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Dignity?! Work?! Your job is to make me happy!! Go ask your boss how much I paid for you. He said I could do whatever I wanted! Doesn't matter if you live or die. It was out of MY kindness that you get to be my Emily, you ungrateful ****!

speaker: Golden Mask
content: You think dancing in some Eastside dump makes you somebody? That you're a big shot, because a few rich brats chase after you? You lowly bastard, I could crush you without blinking!

speaker: Golden Mask
content: You're not even a Sinner. They only picked you to fill a slot because too many died on this ship. Who else would be kind enough to even look at you? I gave you love, and this is how you repay me... you stupid moron!!

speaker: Golden Mask
content: I'm giving you one more chance. Say thank you. T-H-A-N-K-Y-O-U. Thank-you-for-loving-me. SAY IT!!!

Sallie can no longer move. She can no longer fight back. Can't even close her eyes. The world spins and shakes with every blow. The extravagant patterns on the plush carpet are soaked red with her blood. She lies there like a broken ragdoll, not a single part of her intact, no longer able to feel any pain.
Her vision blurs. Sounds fade into the distance. Her senses grow numb. Only one word scrapes at her nerves.

speaker: Sallie
content: Love...?
In the hazy white light, she sees a blurred figure.

speaker: Blurred Figure
content: Sallie...

speaker: Sallie
content: It's you...
He's a slender man, dressed in a fine suit, but his expression is shy, youthful. In the sensual lighting of the bar, he seems so out of place on her stage.

speaker: Theodore
content: H-hello, Miss Sallie. My name is Th-Theodore. May I come and see you again? I... I don't mean anything outrageous... I won't do anything, I promise!

speaker: Theodore
content: I just want to watch you... Your dancing has so much power. It's like you're shining...

speaker: Theodore
content: But if I'd dodged, that bottle would have hit you instead. Hehe, it's nothing, doesn't hurt. Ouch...

speaker: Theodore
content: I apologize for my family's rudeness. I won't let them near you again. What they said... that's not how I see you. I would never look down on you like that.

speaker: Theodore
content: Perhaps, in your eyes... I'm just like all the other rich people who've hurt you. Your past, the pain you've been through, the efforts and sacrifices you've made just to survive... I've never experienced any of it, and I have no right to pretend I understand. But please, believe one thing...

speaker: Theodore
content: You're the bravest, proudest person I've ever met. You never back down, never give in. You shine brighter than any of the wealthy and noble people I've known.

speaker: Theodore
content: I want to stay by your side. I just want to be with you...
Those words, his face... they still make her heart flutter. She remembers the happiness. She had fallen for him. She had believed in him. But now...
The dream shatters, and reality bleeds through the cracks. Another fist throw at her, another jolt of pain.

speaker: Sallie
content: Hehe... But where... are you now...
Something wet falls on her cheek. Sweet, golden honey—signature of Euphoria—is seeping from the ceiling, dripping onto Sallie's broken body. Just like her first night on stage.
The honey of a decadent hell. The drool of predators in power. The blood of trampled flesh... and her own powerless tears.

speaker: Sallie
content: Enough... Make it stop... let it end...
Drip... drip... Finally, in the haze, she hears a dull sound...
Schlick...!
A faint light tears through the dark, slashing across her tormentor. The fists stop. Something splatters across Sallie's face. The metallic smell brings back what little's left of her clarity.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: You... cough... blegh...
The bloated, savage body convulses twice before collapsing with a thunderous thud, no longer blocking her view.
In the blur, she sees gold... gold stained with blood.
Milly stands in the pale light, blood smearing the dagger in her hand and spattering her still-sweet smile.

speaker: Milly
content: Don't squirm. Does it really hurt that bad? You had plenty of energy when you were beating her. I thought you wouldn't feel a thing.

speaker: Milly
content: Look what you did to her pretty face. How's Sallie supposed to meet her sweetheart now? Leave her alone. The poor girl can't even move.

speaker: Milly
content: Now it's my turn, honored guest. Let me give you something sweet...
She raises a hand, and a golden liquid begins to seep from her palm, the same honey that drips from above. Slowly, Milly smears it on the twitching guest.
[Insert special effect: blood splashing] [Insert looping effect: golden honey dripping effect]

speaker: Milly
content: This is my ability: <color=#fb9259>Sweet Love</color>. Anyone who touches my honey will think of the person they love most. They become filled with that love, purified by it, willing to devote everything to that one love...

speaker: Milly
content: So, Mr. Merlot, who are you thinking of now? Sallie? Or your precious Emily? Why are you so quiet? Are you not seeing anything at all?

speaker: Milly
content: Oh my, that won't do. How can someone have no love in their heart?
The man's mouth hangs open, choked with blood from his ruptured organs. He can't form a word, only coughs weakly, struggling in terror with his last strength.

speaker: Milly
content: Hm? Oh, so you do see someone. You see Sallie? You're not treating her as a replacement for your dog, you truly love her?

speaker: Milly
content: Then that makes it even worse! Only thinking of yourself, satisfying your own needs, consuming the one you claim to love... Your love is rotten!
Milly drives the blade in again, her movement deft and unhesitating.
Merlot collapses against the wall. He turns his head toward the door and reaches out a trembling hand.

speaker: Milly
content: Don't bother looking. I sent them away. You know, everyone feels helpless sometimes. Now, it's your turn to feel that.
She smiles happily, toying with a long, elaborate dagger. A groove is cut into the blade to ensure maximum blood loss.

speaker: Milly
content: Hehe, I'm good at this. I know how to make it quick and clean, to make it easier for you. But then you wouldn't learn your lesson. That won't do. You need to remember the pain Sallie went through.
The brighter her smile, the paler Merlot's face. He wants to struggle, to beg on his knees, but his body is weak from spasms.

In the city, his prestigious titles and positions never gave him the freedom he craved. But at least he'd never been this powerless, crushed under the heel of a lowly dancer. Gripped by a colossal terror, he trembles and, for the first time in his life, learns to beg...

speaker: Golden Mask
content: No... I understand now, I won't do it again, cough... How much money do you want? I'll give you anything... I...

speaker: Milly
content: Looks like you still haven't learned...
[Insert special effect: blood splashing]

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Argh...!! It hurts, it hurts so much!!
He crawls desperately for the door, but Milly gives him no chance to escape. She follows him step by step, plunging the dagger into his arm again.

speaker: Golden Mask
content: Argh...!

speaker: Milly
content: Really, I haven't hurt anyone in such a long time, so I can become someone worthy of him. It's all your fault. I'll have to make sure you learn your lesson.
female_content: Really, I haven't hurt anyone in such a long time, so I can become someone worthy of her. It's all your fault. I'll have to make sure you learn your lesson.

content: [Insert looping effect: blood splashing across screen]
Wailing, struggling, fingernails clawing into the carpet. Only when her prey's breathing stops does Milly exhale in relief and slowly pull the dagger free.
She lowers her gaze to the motionless body, and a look of pity passes over her face. Gently, she reaches out and closes Merlot's eyes.

speaker: Milly
content: Love is a treasure that brings happiness. It's the most precious thing in life. Your love had rotted... so your life became worthless.

speaker: Milly
content: Remember this pain, and start over. In your next life... learn to love someone the right way, okay?
Now, Sallie can only hear one heartbeat: her own. Her breath, thick with the taste of blood, is choking her.

She watches the blood-drenched Sinner rise, turn, and walk toward her. Sallie's nearly numb body jolts back to life. Survival instinct screams at her to run, to cry for help, but every nerve is torn, paralyzed. Before she can move, Milly stops in front of her, and Sallie squeezes her eyes shut in terror.
...Then, she feels something soft and warm draped over her. A hand gently touches her forehead.

speaker: Milly
content: Why are you crying so hard? You didn't give in when he beat you up like that...

speaker: Milly
content: Did you think of someone? Was it my ability? Or were you just missing them?

speaker: Milly
content: And you told me you didn't love anyone. I didn't know you were the shy type, Sallie.
She wipes the honey and blood from Sallie's face, then brushes a tear from the corner of her eye.

speaker: Milly
content: It's okay to cry. This is a terrifying place. Awful, and dangerous. I know. And I know you're strong, Sallie.

speaker: Milly
content: You and I are alike. We both have someone we love. And as long as there's love, you can find light even in the darkest places.

speaker: Milly
content: So don't give up. Hold on. It's not time to despair yet. I'll stay by your side, until your love comes to save you.

speaker: Milly
content: But... I'll need to hold onto this.
Milly has somehow taken the communicator Sallie had hidden. She glances at the screen. Sallie panics, reflexively reaching to grab it, but Milly gently presses her hand down.
Milly stares at the screen, its faint light reflecting in her eyes but revealing nothing of her thoughts. She gazes, stroking what must be someone's final keepsake.

The sound of faint footsteps makes Milly look up at the tiny window in the sealed iron door, then back at the terrified Sallie. A small smile touches her lips as she slips the communicator into her palm and offers Sallie one golden smile.

speaker: Milly
content: Trust me, I won't let you die.

speaker: Milly
content: We're friends now.
The words have barely left her mouth when the door opens. Two familiar figures walk in.
Mr. E glances at the body on the floor and sighs. He speaks to the man behind him.

speaker: Mr. E
content: ...Clean this up. Don't disturb the other guests.

Cassian nods, skillfully stuffs the body into a bag, zips it shut, and begins cleaning the scene. The boss makes a call, speaking in hushed tones about "departure documentation," "alibis," and "informing political rivals"—things Sallie doesn't understand—and ending with a final, "there won't be any trouble."
Mr. E hangs up and turns to the two of them. Milly springs to her feet, places herself in front of Sallie, and begins fussing with her dress, a pout on her face.

speaker: Milly
content: Look, my dress is all dirty, and so is Sallie's... It's all that man's fault. How are we supposed to perform like this?

speaker: Mr. E
content: You're unharmed. Good. Then none of this matters. His death is easy to handle. Change your clothes, and you'll be the jewel of the stage once more. No one will ever know.

speaker: Mr. E
content: I've told you before, nothing that happens here will ever reach the outside world. Right?

speaker: Milly
content: ...Yes, you said—
Bam—
A sharp, ringing slap sends Milly's head to the side, an angry red handprint blooming on her pale cheek. Sallie flinches at the sound, her hands clutching the blanket tighter.
Mr. E is still wearing that same smile as he reaches over and plucks the communicator from Milly. He glances at the screen, then back at Milly, his expression unreadable.

speaker: Mr. E
content: What is this?
Milly pushes herself up, turning her reddened cheek back toward him. She wipes her face and gives him a blithe smile.

speaker: Milly
content: It's my toy.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Is that so?
Mr. E glances at Sallie, who is trembling too hard to speak, then back at Milly. He smiles too.
Then, another slap.

Some dark shadow Sallie can't comprehend bursts forth, slamming Milly against the wall. She crumples to the floor, unable to get up. Blood smears the wall and spills from her mouth, spattering the ground.

Mr. E walks over to her. He grips her face, caressing the spot he just struck. With a casual flick, he wipes away her honey—her power, according to her. The superhuman strength of a Sinner that she had used to kill Merlot and save Sallie.

speaker: Mr. E
content: A B-Class Sinner. Not a threat at all.
He pulls out a silk handkerchief, wipes the honey from his fingers, and tosses it into the sink like trash. Then he picks up Milly's dagger and begins tracing elegant lines on its owner's body.

speaker: Mr. E
content: You can toy with the guests. Play your little games of love. I indulge you. On one condition: we both know the <color=#fb9259>boundary</color>.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Euphoria must not be disturbed. This is vital for our guests' privacy. And for yours. So many guests adore you, trust you, confide in you their deepest secrets...

speaker: Mr. E
content: So don't even think about leaving. No one leaves here without my permission. Unless they're dead.

The golden fabric of her dress splits open, embroidered with the crimson of her blood. Milly bites down hard, not making a single sound. No one speaks, and all the screams she should be making are stuck in Sallie's throat.
She can only hold them in, not daring to let loose a single tear.
Finally, the man is satisfied. He drops the blade and caresses Milly's swollen face.

speaker: Mr. E
content: Cherish your life, my dear. Don't you have someone you're waiting for? Don't you miss him?
female_content: Cherish your life, my dear. Don't you have someone you're waiting for? Don't you miss her?

speaker: Milly
content: ...Of course... of course, I do...

speaker: Mr. E
content: Then stay here and wait for him to come for you, alright? Be a good girl, just as we agreed.
female_content: Then stay here and wait for her to come for you, alright? Be a good girl, just as we agreed.

content: Mr. E smiles, pleased. He leans close, whispering gently in her ear as his other hand closes around her throat, slowly pressing down.
Milly's body trembles. She chokes, unable to speak. She stares at Mr. E and, after a long moment, manages to force a smile.

speaker: Milly
content: Yes... I'll wait for him...
female_content: Yes... I'll wait for her...

speaker: Mr. E
content: ...Excellent. Take her away. Help her refresh her memory. It wouldn't do for her to forget again.
He stands up. Milly slumps to the floor. Two men in half-masks enter, grab her by the arms, and drag her across the floor, past Sallie, toward the open door.
Sallie reaches out a hand, but her vision is blurring again. She can't reach Milly, can't see how badly she's hurt.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...What are you doing... Stop, don't... Milly...
But she hears a weak voice.

speaker: Milly
content: It's okay...

speaker: Milly
content: Hold on. Remember, you're not alone anymore...

Is she smiling? Sallie can't tell anymore. All she can see is the gold being dragged away, disappearing into the light of the corridor. The bartender is the last to leave. The door closes softly, and everything fades into darkness.

speaker: Doctor
content: Ugh... How many of these things have we met today?
The doctor pulls her weapon from the monster's corpse, twirling it gracefully to keep the blood off her fresh uniform.

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: That's the third wave.

speaker: Doctor
content: Is that good news or bad news?
She kicks the corpse over with her foot, then idly drags her blade across its carcass. Suddenly, the blade hits something hard deep inside.

speaker: Doctor
content: Hm? A little surprise, maybe?
Without being asked, the soldier crouches down and carefully peels back the rough hide. He digs a strangely shaped object out of the mess of gore, slowly turning it over in his hand.

speaker: Doctor
content: What is this?

speaker: DisCorps Soldier
content: Can't say for sure. But one thing's for certain. These monsters weren't born this way. Like the ones we encountered before, they were mutated or modified by this thing.

speaker: Doctor
content: Hardly pets you'd leave running in the wild... Heh, what did your master send you here for?

speaker: Doctor
content: Get rid of careless intruders, maybe?
Her comm crackles to life.

speaker: Doctor
content: You're awake. How are you feeling today? Hehe, I was gonna let you rest longer, but your timing is perfect. We've found something.

speaker: Doctor
content: You called it. We might be in the right place.
The doctor gives a quick rundown of their discovery. The line goes silent for a few seconds. Thinking? Or flatlined?
Just as she's about to ask, a weak voice comes through the speaker.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Keep going. This is... a rare chance.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Before they relocate, we must...
Euphoria's detention cell. There's nothing in the darkness but dust, mildew, and the coppery tang of blood.
And the sound of faint breathing.

speaker: Milly
content: Oh well. I'm locked up again. At least they went easier on me today. It'll heal fast. Mr. E gave me the meds. He says I have more performing to do, with everything going on...
There's a small, round porthole above the frail woman. She hopes to catch a glimpse of the world outside. But no.

speaker: Milly
content: Where's the moon? Why won't it come out? It's so dark in here, I can't see a thing... I hope my candle is still where I hid it...

speaker: Milly
content: There it is! Looks like this is still my private hideout.
She clears a small space and carefully lights the candle. The matches are damp, and it takes many tries before a weak flame flickers to life, pushing back the shadows.
She wipes her dusty, blood-caked hands on her dress before pulling a small metal box from her bodice with reverent care. Twisting open the lid, she gazes at the photograph resting inside.
Milly gently traces the image with her fingertips, and a smile returns to her eyes.

speaker: Milly
content: ${PlayerName}, my dear, I've come to see you again. So much has happened these last two days, I haven't had time to really talk to you. You aren't mad with me, are you?

speaker: Milly
content: Hehe, don't be mad. I can't wait to tell you everything. I had three performances, learned two new songs and a dance, and heard sixteen new stories. Oh... and I made a new friend.

speaker: Milly
content: Her name is Sallie. She's a wonderful dancer, and she's so smart and strong. Even when they push her around, she never bows her head. She even tried to escape. Isn't that brave? She's amazing.

speaker: Milly
content: And what's more, she loves someone with all her heart, just like I do. When I look at her, I feel... a connection. It's love that makes her so brave, so strong, isn't it? I like her so much.

speaker: Milly
content: But courage alone isn't enough. If she keeps charging ahead like that, she's going to get into real trouble. She hasn't been through this before. She won't survive it. I know too well...

speaker: Milly
content: Even Sinners who try to escape... get killed by Mr. E. She's putting herself in danger.

speaker: Milly
content: So... I told him I was the one who took the communicator. Hehe. He's used to beating me up. I'm used to it, too... *cough*
Her voice grows a little louder, and blood catches in her throat. The feeble flame gutters with her coughs, nearly going out.

speaker: Milly
content: ... I promised I'd make myself pretty for when you come, and here I am, making a mess of myself again... But my friend was in danger. I couldn't just sit back and watch...

speaker: Milly
content: But don't worry, I'll be fine. Hehe. I'm tough, I can take a beating... I'm waiting for you, after all.
The tiny flame steadies itself again, its gentle light illuminating the corner where Milly sits, casting her face in a warm, tranquil glow.

speaker: Milly
content: As long as I have you, I'm not afraid of anything... So please, come to my side. I miss you so much...

speaker: Milly
content: I want to see you so much, ${PlayerName}...

The moon finally rises, its light streaming through the porthole and blanketing her in a pale sheen. If she looked up now, she might see the stars twinkling in the sky, the moonlight dancing on the white sand like waves shimmering in the ocean.
But the girl's eyes are already closed. Beside her only treasure, she slips into unconsciousness.
Euphoria, Backstage
The next show is about to begin. Three days have passed since that terrible night. With Milly gone, there seem to be fewer guests—or maybe not. The show goes on regardless.

Seeing Milly's empty seat, Sallie can't help but think of the frenzied look in her eyes that night. Fear and worry twist in her gut. Even though she didn't like her much before, Sallie knows the Jewel took the blame for her, which is why she's now missing.
She did it to save me...

After Milly was taken away, the ship's doctor came to check on Sallie. He declared that she wasn't going to die and applied some strange medicine to her wounds. The bruises and cuts healed quickly. After a few days' rest, Sallie was back on stage.
But there has been no news of Milly. She hasn't returned.
Thinking of the strange marks and the distress message she'd found, Sallie furrows her brow.
I haven't heard a thing for days. Is she alright? What can I do...?
Anxiety gnaws at Sallie. She hates this feeling of helplessness. She wants to ask the other dancers, but they fall silent the moment she walks in. Things feel awkward.
[Event]
The endless shows have left Sallie almost numb. As long as she can stand and walk, she has to dance—even when she's distracted by her worry for Milly.

The eyes below the stage only care about flesh; no one is really watching the dance. When the lights dim, the guests grow restless. Many climb directly onto the stage, grabbing any dancer that catches their eye, man and woman alike.

Out of the corner of her eye, Sallie sees a guest heading toward her. The gleaming black metal mask overlaps with the golden owl mask in her memory. Her stomach lurches, and she almost throws up. But fear roots her to the spot. She can only stand, paralyzed, in the dispersing crowd.
Spacing out when you should be leaving? You got a death wish?!
The sharp rebuke yanks her out of those terrifying, chaotic memories. Snow strides over and grabs her arm.

speaker: Snow
content: If you don't want guests, just get out of here! Don't stand around, are you begging to be picked?! Dense as you are, you'll be dead in this place before you even know it!
She doesn't stop chiding as she yanks Sallie back a few quick steps.

But this time, Sallie doesn't push her away. Perhaps the fight had been worn out of her. Or perhaps... after these few days, she can finally sense the subtle kindness between the wooden, humble dancers.

speaker: Sallie
content: Thank you...

speaker: Snow
content: Pull yourself together! Milly will come back.
Snow gives Sallie a hard shove, pushing her off the stage.

Sallie's body is still numb. She glances back and sees the magician—who had bullied her, but also helped her—shoot her an exasperated look from the shadows of the stage, before walking with Snow toward that guest.
Sallie returns to the dressing room, physically and mentally drained, her senses dulled.
It isn't until she's changing clothes that she notices something hidden in the shadows behind her—and it just twitched. Sallie's nerves go taut, and she slaps the light switch.

speaker: Sallie
content: Who's there?... Milly?!
With a soft thunk, Milly scrambles out from under the vanity, rubbing her head where she bumped it before nervously raising a finger to her lips.

speaker: Milly
content: Shh... shh... keep your voice down!

speaker: Sallie
content: That man... he didn't hurt you, did he? About what happened that night... and... the communicator...

speaker: Milly
content: Hm? What are you talking about? I'm fine! See? All healed! It doesn't hurt at all.

Milly waves her hands, and sure enough, her pale arms show no trace of injury. But Sallie knows how the ship "maintains its merchandise." Her own insides still hurt, and she's more worried about Milly. After all, Milly was the one punished that day, and there's no telling what they did to her after she was dragged off.
But Euphoria's star cheerfully changes the subject, easily deflecting any more questions.

speaker: Milly
content: But what about you? Were you scared? Did you have nightmares?
Memories of that night flash through Sallie's mind. The luxurious room, blood-stained carpet, fists raining down on her body... and herself, completely powerless to fight back.

This was different from the humiliations she had endured before. At least in the past, no one had seriously wanted to destroy a beautiful "commodity." But that night... that night... she wasn't even treated as a human. The mere thought of those memories makes Sallie's body go cold and rigid, and she begins to tremble.

Someone grasps her hand. Sallie shudders, looking up to see Milly watching her. There's no question or doubt in her eyes, only a quiet calm, like the surface of a mirror. Slowly, Sallie calms down, and feels the warmth spread from Milly's palm into hers.

speaker: Sallie
content: ...I'm okay. Thank you.

speaker: Milly
content: Don't mention it. I know what it's like. When you're most scared, you really need someone to support you. I've been through it too. Now, it's finally my turn to help someone else.

speaker: Sallie
content: That person... is the one you've been waiting for? ${PlayerName}, right?

speaker: Sallie
content: Who is he?
female_content: Who is she?

speaker: Milly
content: ...Want to hear about it?
Milly stares shyly at her fingertips, tapping them together and pulling them apart. She draws little circles on the floor with her foot. The air seems to thicken with the sweet scent of honey.

speaker: Sallie
content: He must be a really good person, right?
female_content: She must be a really good person, right?

content: She's just a little curious... Milly said that person gave her the strength to go on... Sallie wants to know what kind of person could inspire that in a place like this...
[Insert story item: Chief doll]

Something soft is suddenly shoved in Sallie's face, and she recoils in surprise. Looking closer, she sees it's a small cotton doll in a gray trench coat. It's clearly handmade, but with exquisite detail.

The fabric is a bit old, but it's been lovingly cared for. Every detail is clean and neat, the corners of its clothes perfectly straight. It's obviously someone's treasured possession, cherished for a long time.

speaker: Milly
content: This is wonderful! I finally have a friend to talk to about love!

speaker: Milly
content: He's the most amazing person in the whole world! So kind and dependable! The line of people he's helped would stretch all the way from Syndicate to Eastside! And it'd have to wrap around the block three times!
female_content: She's the most amazing person in the whole world! So kind and dependable! The line of people she's helped would stretch all the way from Syndicate to Eastside! And it'd have to wrap around the block three times!

speaker: Milly
content: Look! These are the newspaper clippings I've collected! And look! This is his doll and outfit set! And this is the legendary underground film he starred in, Beyond DisCars! I heard it was made by a famous director. He looks so dashing in the film, so gorgeous!
female_content: Look! These are the newspaper clippings I've collected! And look! This is her doll and outfit set! And this is the legendary underground film she starred in, Beyond DisCars! I heard it was made by a famous director. She looks so dashing in the film, so gorgeous!

speaker: Milly
content: If you're interested, I can tell you stories about him for three days and nights. Every one of them is a legend! But... if you hear them all, you'll probably fall in love with him, so...
female_content: If you're interested, I can tell you stories about her for three days and nights. Every one of them is a legend! But... if you hear them all, you'll probably fall in love with her, so...

speaker: Milly
content: No, no, that won't do! You already have someone you love, and besides, I'm not sharing him with anyone!
female_content: No, no, that won't do! You already have someone you love, and besides, I'm not sharing her with anyone!

content: Milly practically glows as she talks about her beloved. Her eyes are shining with stars, and the air seems to shimmer with pink bubbles. Sallie finds herself drowning in a sea of rosy fluff, and wishes more than anything for Milly to stop.
...Oh, whatever. Listening for a little longer won't hurt. As long as it makes her happy.
