content: Calm down, Wynn. Have faith in Chief. I've already led a team into the Mania zone. We should have news soon.

speaker: Eugene
content: How are things on your end? Have you detected any Mania spikes?

speaker: Wynn
content: Okay, I'm calm... I'm calm... Phew... There are intense Mania fluctuations 200 meters southeast of your coordinates. Wait...! Eugene, look! Chief's signal! It's back!
[Black Screen Transition]

You make it out of the hourglass, gasping for air as the illusion collapses. The sand and hourglass are all gone. You're now standing on an Eastside street. Static crackles in your ear as the signal comes back on, Eugene and Wynn's anxious voices coming through your device.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eugene, Wynn, I'm safe for now. Don't worry.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief! Thank goodness you're okay! Oh, I would've died from guilt had anything happened to you. I never should have persuaded you to try this game...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This isn't the time to feel guilty yet. This Sinner's ability is extremely dangerous. Even I couldn't easily see through the illusions she created. Without the shackles, I wouldn't have been able to even sense the abnormal Mania. Eugene, continue searching for any victims in this area. Don't let anyone fall into another illusion.

speaker: Eugene
content: Yes, Chief!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This isn't enough. Even if I escaped one illusion, there's no guarantee I won't be pulled into another. Most importantly, we need to capture her in her true form in the real world.
After a moment's consideration, you contact Faye.

speaker: Faye
content: Chief? Oh, you went to try the game today, didn't you? How was it? Calling to share your thoughts with me?
...Why were both Faye's and Wynn's first reactions to ask about your thoughts? Their similar responses strike you as an odd coincidence, but you don't have time to dig deeper right now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Faye, you never fail to bring me surprises. Though you reassured me many times about this one, I'm afraid you just have a knack for stirring up hornets' nests. This time, we've barged into a Sinner's lair. An S-Class, no less.

speaker: Faye
content: Wow, Chief... What a coincidence, hahaha... I swear I had no idea there was a Sinner involved when I bought the ticket! Please don't punish me, Chief!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Want to make up for this? Then figure out how to reduce next quarter's Supply Office expenditures.

speaker: Faye
content: ...Is that all? That's a piece of cake. Leave it to me!
After debriefing Eugene and Wynn, you return to the entrance of Nightwrought.
(Scene change)

Mania has thoroughly wrecked the establishment. Compared to when you first came, it's nothing but ruins now. The place is entirely deserted, but where the lobby once stood, a pitch-black void has appeared out of nowhere. The void looks endless, leading to some unknown destination. Around it, pages swirl in the air, covered with elegant cursive writing.
And deep inside that dark passage, a silhouette stands in the distance.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...You look like you've been waiting for me. Isn't this bait a bit obvious, Irrheia? Or did you actually think hiding here would keep you from being discovered?

Under the MBCC's offensive, the Witch has nowhere left to run. Even though she can manipulate the rules in the illusions within a certain range, fighting against a team of pros has proven taxing even for her.

At the center of the chaotic void is Irrheia, surrounded by Mania. You've seen this situation many times before. Her infection is severe and the Mania inside her has gone out of control, contaminating the entire district.

Moreover... you know that Aurum Secretum weapons cause side effects of various degrees in their users. Even if her claim is true that she obtained this Aurum Secretum hourglass from an Outland Sinner, to <color=#fb9259>resonate</color> with it would still drain the user's own power.

Irrheia's breathing seems to weaken by the second, and surprisingly, you barely sense any Mania on her person. It seems the Aurum Secretum hourglass and the notebook have been the true sources of Mania all along. Did you... make a wrong guess? Could the Mania be controlling this Sinner instead of the other way round?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is the Mania controlling you instead of the other way round?
Moreover, even weakened by the recoil from the damaged hourglass, the Witch's aura still permeates the space, restraining the hourglass's power.
Her fragile silhouette is engulfed by the Mania storm, swirling pages cutting into her skin. In that moment, you realize she might be the one truly trapped.
You reach out your hand, but Irrheia is instantly swept away by the Mania storm and vanishes, leaving you alone facing the void.
Is this cunning witch truly in peril, or... could this be part of her script as well?

options: No choice but to face it

content: You step onto the pitch-black path, just like when you first entered this game. After an endless darkness, you find yourself back in the place where you were once imprisoned by Prima and the Clergyman.

Everything has been torn apart in this space. Gravity no longer exists, and the room's furnishings float randomly. In the spatio-temporal fissures, you revisit scenes of all of your "deaths." In the endless loop, you and the others enact different scenarios, yet the ending is always the same.
[Flash scenes of various NPCs going mad]
[Insert CG - Got You]

Staring at the storm, you step closer toward the source of the Mania, your stride steady and resolute. With your thoughts, your face appears in every spatio-temporal fissure, determined, unwavering, clear-eyed, and uncompromising. You stretch out your hand to confront the Mania permeating the air.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Humans are bundles of desire. We suffer when we don't get what we want, but we tire of it the moment we do." Everyone goes through this same cycle endlessly. The present pain always hurts the most, so we place our hope in the future.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Someone as smart as you must know that our wishes can never be satisfied by mere illusions.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why push the darkest impulses of those oppressed by life to their extremes? Why make yourself the biggest villain in the story?
[Insert CG - Got You]-Hand Close-up
The false images shatter one by one. Your hand reaches into each of the fissures, all aiming at one single target!
It's the symbol of this world's rules, floating above you all along, yet always so elusive. The Aurum Secretum hourglass. You've finally discovered its location!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We've cornered you, a result of your own guidance. What outcome are you hoping for?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is it merely for entertainment? Are you trying to create a worthy opponent who can break your routine as the mastermind...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Or is it redemption? A way to free yourself from Mania?
[Release Shackles] Glass shattering effect with dreamlike elements

This time, the shackles crush the Aurum Secretum hourglass. As the sand scatters, you see the Witch. She raises her head slowly, and surprisingly, countless faces flash over her own, all people you've encountered in Cirrenfold.

The flash of images finally stops, revealing an innocent-looking Prima clutching a notebook in her arms... No, the notebook is oozing with ominous Mania. Or rather, the Mania is trapping her in a tight embrace.

speaker: Prima
content: Help me...
Without the slightest hesitation, you raise your hand again.

options: Attack the Mania script manipulating Prima
Attack Prima, who is the Witch and the culprit

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: End this game of manipulation.
In the light of the shackles, you think you see Prima smile.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even now, you're still trying to deceive me!
In the light of the shackles, the Witch, who was feigning tears, reveals a smile.
[Option 1] Ending
Through the connection of the shackles, you touch a memory buried deeply under Mania.

speaker: Irrheia
content: What does... my true self look like?

speaker: Irrheia
content: I knew exactly what my boss would say to me each day, what to do at what time... My life was like a pre-written agenda, repeating endlessly. Work numbed me. Writing numbed me. Even the scenery outside my window seemed like a frozen photograph, completely unchanging.

speaker: Irrheia
content: Yes, unchanging. Even war couldn't create a single ripple in such a bland existence. Until... one evening on my way home from work, I encountered a severely wounded Sinner from the Outlands.

speaker: Irrheia
content: Her expression was unfamiliar to me. An agonized, yet determined smile. She looked at me, raised her hand with her last bit of strength, then died before she could even speak. She dispersed like ash, leaving behind only a humble hourglass, as if she had never existed in this world at all.

speaker: Irrheia
content: And me? The next day, I went to work punctually as usual, as if nothing had changed.

speaker: Irrheia
content:
No, something did change.
Every night when I came home and faced that hourglass, I would remember that woman, someone completely different from me, with an expression I could never possibly make. I kept thinking about her final moments, wondering what she was trying to do when she raised her hand, what she wanted to tell me.
The golden hourglass was simply dispensing time slowly.
Then one day, as she stared at this anomaly that had barged into her life, she finally spoke.

speaker: Irrheia
content: What... did you want to tell me?
[Slow, Magical Scene Transition]

The moment she said that, the environment around her began to change. In an instant, she was transported from her desk at home to the vast expanse of WhiteSands. The desk, the windows, everything had vanished. Only the golden hourglass remained before her, slowly recording.
She was too shocked to speak.
Taking two bewildered steps forward, she felt the scorching heat of the sand beneath her feet, undeniably real.
Then she saw her. That Outlander woman, whom she had met only once, was now running swiftly across the sand, about to vanish from view.
She ran after her.

She watched as the Outlander struggled to survive in WhiteSands, trudging forward relentlessly toward the distant DisCity that shone like hope itself. The woman's lingering will had been preserved by the hourglass, continuously manifesting in this strange landscape.
But Irrheia soon discovered that this illusion had an end. The Outlander's fate mirrored reality. She died in silence, alone, without uttering a single word.
She couldn't accept this.
The moment this thought formed, her work notebook, something that had always bored and annoyed her, appeared before her eyes, as if saying to her...
Write. Write something. Craft a new story for her.

speaker: Irrheia
content: ...What made her so strong? What kind of life had she lived before this?

speaker: Irrheia
content: Perhaps she was a warrior who traversed WhiteSands...

speaker: Irrheia
content: Or perhaps simply a free-spirited Outlander who even yearned for a life like mine.
(Scene change)

speaker: Irrheia
content: Beside this hourglass I picked up, I imagined her story and constructed her world. The more I thought, the more it grew... reaching beyond unchanging paths, beyond daily routines, into worlds I'd never seen before, lives I'd never experienced.

speaker: Irrheia
content: By the time I realized it, that <color=#fb9259>notebook</color> I once utterly despised was already stuffed with my own writing, filled with her stories and the stories of everyone I'd met... Those words had never shone so brightly before.
Her story was unknown, but it could be reimagined. Maybe she had survived war. Maybe she was plotting revenge. Maybe she would even go on to become the ruler of the Outlands...
The notebook filled with writing as golden sand gradually enveloped the writer, as if merging with her, weaving her imagination and blessings into something greater.

speaker: Irrheia
content: If I indeed got infected with Mania, it must have happened at this moment, I suppose.
The power of Mania fades, and the vision dissipates like evaporated teardrops.
Before the scene vanishes, you catch a glimpse of her setting down her pen. The final page of the notebook depicts a simple scene of her and the Outlander sharing ice cream on a street corner.
This is the happiest ending I could imagine for her.
[Insert CG]
The link of the shackles breaks as Irrheia looks at you with perfect composure.

speaker: Irrheia
content: How unfair, Chief... I've always been the one peering into others' hearts, using the voids in their souls to craft my stories. This time, you gave me a taste of my own medicine.
The three people who were pulled into the hourglass with you earlier now appear on the Eastside street again. They seem fully lucid, indicating they've been freed from the Mania's influence.
It seems what she told you before wasn't all lies meant to provoke you. She just omitted the full context.

speaker: Irrheia
content: Now you've seen everything. This is my whole story.
The Butcher is the first to finish processing the Witch's story. He steps forward and cleaves through the notebook in the Witch's hand with his ax.

speaker: Irrheia
content: Congratulations, the evil script that imprisoned the Witch has been destroyed. Perhaps I should thank you all...
In the blink of an eye, her figure vanishes like popped bubbles.

The Mania subsides, and the streets of Eastside return to their usual bustling prosperity. Only your group, standing in the middle of the street with murder mystery props, looks completely out of place.

speaker: Butcher
content: I-it's over...? I did it? The Witch has been defeated?

speaker: Butcher
content: I did it!! I really did it!!!
The man's strong, large hands keep thumping against your back. Already exhausted, you nearly get knocked over.
Fortunately, Ezra quickly grabs your hand to steady you.

speaker: Clergyman
content: The game has ended. I'm glad I could fulfill your wish, Chief.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you. I couldn't have broken out of the Witch's hourglass without your help. Though the way you tossed me out earlier was a bit rough.
The Butcher chuckles shyly, then raises his massive palm above your back once again...

The tattered script catches a breeze, its fragments dissolving into shimmering light. While you and the other two gaze silently at the sky, Eleanor bounces excitedly, trying to catch the glowing motes.

speaker: Eleanor
content: Oh no, it's disappearing! But isn't it an important prop?!

speaker: Eleanor
content: Can we get a more action-packed ending after this sappy one? I'm not done playing! Let me be the Witch next time!
Amid Eleanor's disappointed grumbles, Eastside returns to normal. All traces of the Witch vanish completely, and everything you experienced feels like a dream. But you know... she is still alive.

In the last trace of her presence, you detected a faint ripple of Mania as a spatio-temporal fissure opened somewhere in Eastside. You didn't stop it, partly because you couldn't, with no strength left, and partly... because she had probably already found her own satisfying ending.

And just like that, the story reaches its perfect conclusion. Everyone got what they wanted and fulfilled their wishes...


<color=#fb9259>Or did they?</color>

Hmm... did you notice it too?

You don't seem satisfied. Perhaps, you'd like to see how differently things would have turned out if you had chosen the other ending?

options: Attack Prima, who is the Witch and the culprit

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Enough! Your story ends here!
A blinding light erupts from your hand, tearing through the false illusion. The world returns to its original form as "Prima" vanishes before your eyes, revealing the true face of Irrheia the Witch.
[Insert Special Illustration - Magic Book] + Shackles Effect

speaker: Irrheia
content: Mmph!

Boom! The illusion shatters under the shackles, and you find yourself back at the storefront. The dark void still looms before you, but this time, your companions from that room in the beginning stand by your side.
[Small CG - Walking Forward]
The Witch stands before the void, gusts of air blowing up her long hair. You can only see her side profile, adorned with an emotionless smile. She seems unsurprised by your choice.

speaker: Irrheia

She was too shocked to speak.
Taking two bewildered steps forward, she felt the scorching heat of the sand beneath her feet, undeniably real.
Then she saw her. That Outlander woman, whom she had met only once, was now running swiftly across the sand, about to vanish from view.
She ran after her.

She watched as the Outlander struggled to survive in WhiteSands, trudging forward relentlessly toward the distant DisCity that shone like hope itself. The woman's lingering will had been preserved by the hourglass, continuously manifesting in this strange landscape.
But Irrheia soon discovered that this illusion had an end. The Outlander's fate mirrored reality. She died in silence, alone, without uttering a single word.
She couldn't accept this.
The moment this thought formed, her work notebook, something that had always bored and annoyed her, appeared before her eyes, as if saying to her...
Write. Write something. Craft a new story for her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where's the owner? I'm here to talk business. Regarding that Witch...

speaker: Boss

speaker: Faye

speaker: Wynn
content: No way... I think people are arguing about something. Someone looks really agitated. If a fight breaks out, we'd need to call the Public Security Bureau right away... Wait... did you see that person being blocked by the staff...? Oh my gosh, Chief?!
(Scene change)

speaker: Faye
content: Chief! What's going on?! Need backup? Your loyal colleagues are always here for you!
The carefree Faye waves at you from beyond the crowd. Behind her stands a worried-looking Wynn and a stiffened Eugene.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Perfect timing. I need to go in and apprehend a Sinner. Come with me...

speaker: Boss
content: Oh my, dear guest, aren't you taking the role play a bit too seriously? There aren't any Sinners in our humble establishment! Please, you can't damage our reputation like this.
As the crowd of onlookers continues to grow, the three push their way through the gathering spectators.

Eugene stands guard by your side, scaring off the staff blocking you. The owner explains to your subordinates anxiously, almost on the verge of tears. Wynn begins comforting the owner a little guiltily. Realization dawns on Faye, and she tries to handle this tactfully.

speaker: Faye
content: There, there, Chief, you probably need to get out of character! The three-hour experience is over now, and we need to let the poor lady go home. Let's get going.

speaker: Faye
content: Let's discuss this once we get back? Even if a Sinner is indeed involved, we need evidence before making an arrest, right? Nothing to see here, folks! Make way, please!
Fearing a public scene, the three have no choice but to escort you away while you're still fuming. They only let go once you're far from the crowded commercial district.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief, are you alright? You're so mad your face is red. Are you feeling unwell? Here, have some ice water.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief, we've been keeping an eye on it the entire time. Since you entered, there haven't been any abnormal Mania readings in this area. Nothing dangerous.
Wynn watches you with concern, patting your back to help you calm down. Eugene takes the water bottle from Wynn, unscrews the cap, and holds it out to you. You take it and gulp it down.

speaker: Faye
content: Chief, still thinking about the game? Glad you enjoyed the script I recommended so much.

speaker: Faye
content: If you want to meet any particular character again, just get another ticket! I'll help you grab one! Just remember to approve my expense report, okay?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Cough!!

Faye's words make you choke on your water and start a coughing fit. In their panic, Wynn and Eugene accidentally knock the bottle from your hand, splashing water over everyone. For a moment, all you can hear is Wynn's shriek and Faye's mocking laughter.
How could you possibly explain to them that you've been deceived by a Sinner twice? Nevertheless, seeing their normal interactions finally convinces you that you've returned to reality.
Next time... I will definitely drag her out in reality.
With a sigh of relief, you casually open a review website and hover your finger over the rating button.
You tap without any hesitation.

speaker: Tall Figure

speaker: Tall Figure

speaker: Short Figure

speaker: Short Figure
content: Changed the script at the last minute and added an extra DLC for a few new customers... and then had to do the acting yourself in the end...

speaker: Short Figure
content: You must be exhausted, right? That customer had such an extreme reaction. That red thing... "shackles"? Looked difficult to deal with.
The girl raises her hand and makes a gesture that causes the woman to laugh.

speaker: Tall Figure
content: Haha, it only shows that he got into his character and was really enjoying himself. We should be glad.
female_content: Haha, it only shows that she got into her character and was really enjoying herself. We should be glad.

speaker: Short Figure
content: I hope he remembers to leave a good review. The boss keeps saying it counts toward our KPIs...
female_content: I hope she remembers to leave a good review. The boss keeps saying it counts toward our KPIs...

speaker: Tall Figure
content: You quite like him, don't you?
female_content: You quite like her, don't you?

content: The short figure looks down, examining the small wax figurine in her hand that vaguely resembles Chief.

speaker: Short Figure
content: I just... really like his wax figurine. It smells like sunlight, blood, and the shackles... all mixed together. It's complex, but it smells good.
female_content: I just... really like her wax figurine. It smells like sunlight, blood, and the shackles... all mixed together. It's complex, but it smells good.

speaker: Short Figure
content: Can I keep it? Rumina... wants to remember this scent.

speaker: Tall Figure
content: Of course. The little joys we find in our work are rare. Treasure them well.
Rumina cradles the wax figurine contentedly, but after a moment, another thought crosses her mind.

speaker: Short Figure
content: What if he suddenly realizes the truth one day? Won't he feel tricked and come back to give us trouble?
female_content: What if she suddenly realizes the truth one day? Won't she feel tricked and come back to give us trouble?

speaker: Short Figure
content: Will he ever come back?
female_content: Will she ever come back?

content: The woman catches that hint of anticipation in Rumina's voice and smiles. Her gaze sweeps across the crowd, as if watching countless overlapping stages, before finally settling on that familiar silhouette.
In the bustling crowd ahead, a familiar figure is being carried away by his rowdy companions.
female_content: In the bustling crowd ahead, a familiar figure is being carried away by her rowdy companions.

speaker: Tall Figure
content: ...He will. Because... he's already found his role in this game.
female_content: ...She will. Because... she's already found her role in this game.

content: [Insert Chief ID Card - "Anomaly"] Need to add a special character illustration, might not be able to get it

speaker: Tall Figure
content: Once it's become clear that the villainess is still at large, of course the "hero who shreds the evil script and defends reality" will return to "expose our plot" and "bring us to justice."

speaker: Tall Figure
content: And when that happens, it will only boost our KPIs, right?

speaker: Short Figure
content: Aren't you afraid?

speaker: Tall Figure
content: No.
The woman lowers her gaze, her long eyelashes casting faint shadows beneath her eyes. She fiddles with the hourglass in her hand, its golden glow flowing back and forth within it.

speaker: Tall Figure
content: No matter what happens, time always takes on the same appearance in my hands. Yesterday, today, tomorrow, every day... nothing ever changes.

speaker: Tall Figure
content: After all, I'm not like him. My story doesn't have so many exciting twists.
female_content: After all, I'm not like her. My story doesn't have so many exciting twists.

content: As she speaks, she stretches her arms to relax her exhausted body.

speaker: Tall Figure
content: The overtime is tiring me out a little... Time to treat ourselves. Come on, let's go get something nice to eat.

speaker: Short Figure
content: Yeah...
The two turn around, their silhouettes blending into the streets of Eastside like the countless hurried pedestrians in this city, leaving no trace behind.
[Background: Large Floral Pattern]

Her story briefly becomes real in that one captivating moment, and then ends abruptly when the guests depart. Dreams cannot change reality, but those fictional thrills and emotions can somehow lend you strength to break free from the monotonous cycle.
The "ordinary" made up of countless miracles is the greatest reward after the curtain falls.
Is the Witch of Cirrenfold good or evil? It doesn't matter anymore.
The real Witch simply clocks out and heads for a late-night snack. No one can disrupt this true cycle of hers.

<size=45>Northwild gales ring sharp on steel,

a thousand frozen peaks lie hushed and still.

Behold the divine arts that quell the snow,

granting the mortals a springtime glow.</size>

All the world admires Eastia, a land with no wants for mines and war, a realm untainted by the worldly chaos. It relies solely on its people's steadfast resolve and unwavering will. Seers channel the living's collective wishes to ward off disasters and preserve peace. Yet little does the world know, in Eastia, there exists such a place...

This territory has neither deity-channeling seers nor land-nourishing blessed energy. Only endless disasters and raging snowstorms year after year, leaving its soil lifeless and desolate. This place is the frozen earth beneath your very feet—Northwild.
[Small CG: Folk, Children]

speaker: Child A
content: Ah—choo! I, I know! My ma makes me say it every day: "The third thatched hut of Wu Lane, Ping'an Town, right under Mount Fuyun, Northwild, Eastia!"

speaker: Child B
content: That's 'cause you can't read and your ma's worried you'll get buried in the snow and can't find your way home! This way, the town patrol can dig you out and bring you back. Stop interrupting! I heard today's story is the best one they save only for special times!

speaker: Child A
content: What could be so amazing about this backwater mountain valley of ours... Oh! I know what it is!

speaker: Child B
content: That's right! The ones you can't stop babbling about even in your dreams, the coolest people from our hometown, who you can find nowhere else but in Northwild...

speaker: Child A & Child B
content: The martial heroes!

speaker: Storyteller
content: You're not entirely wrong. But even I've grown sick of the clichéd hero's moral awakening and journey into martial arts. Why don't we try something different today? Have you ever heard of Northsnow Manor?

speaker: Storyteller
content: Look up and behold: Deep within the clouds, atop Mount Fuyun, this mysterious manor has been hidden in the snow for years. Legend tells that it was once a place of ethereal peace and beauty, but alas, its fame has faded after years of snowstorms, and no one has so much as glimpsed its true form since.

speaker: Storyteller
content: But recently, rumors have begun to spread throughout Northwild's martial world. They say the manor's current master is none other than a frail, sickly maiden. What's more, this young manor master is said to possess a legendary codex called the Snowquell Arts...

speaker: Storyteller
content: Once word spreads, those usually elusive martial heroes all begin to stir. Some worry this may break the decades-old equilibrium of Northwild's martial world, while others are simply curious to catch a glimpse of the suddenly resurfaced Northsnow Manor.

speaker: Storyteller
content: By now, all these martial heroes should have already gathered at the foot of the mountain...

speaker: Martial Artist
content: Damn this weather! If I'd known how bad the snow would be, I would never have come!

speaker: Martial Artist
content: Bring me some liquor, lad!

speaker: Attendant
content: My apologies, sir, but our humble establishment is so busy today that I'm afraid we don't have any empty seats left for...

speaker: Martial Artist
content: Then tell those sightless bastards to make room for me! And if any of them refuse, tell them who I am and make them think twice!

speaker: Attendant
content: And... sir, may I ask who you are?
[Small CG: Folk, Broken Bowl]

speaker: Storyteller
content: A reckless monk who dines on wine and meat, whose iron fists crush all evil, merciless and unforgiving! It is none other than the "Delightful Forest Master," Jiewubei.

speaker: Child A
content: I know him! Ma has told me about him! They say he's so strong that he can send someone from one end of an alley to the other with a punch!

speaker: Child B
content: He's that powerful? Then why should anyone fear that dangerous manor and mysterious master with him around?

speaker: Storyteller
content: But courage alone is not enough. None of those who have gathered at the foot of Mount Fuyun with their various ambitions are ordinary folk!
[Small CG: Inn, Weapons]

speaker: Storyteller
content: Turning wealth in his palm like clouds and rain, he exhausts his fortune to aid the common folk. Here we have Young Master Shen Wanchou, also known as "Golden Brocade," a magnanimous merchant who delights in righteous deeds and helping those in a bind.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Well, easy there! What's the big fuss? Now, anyone willing to give up their seat for the Master gets a silver ingot! Tonight, all the food and drink in this inn is on me! Just do me this favor, how about it?

speaker: Jiewubei
content: Hmph! Are you mocking me...? Don't think that I don't know what you're scheming, lad!

speaker: Child A
content: Oh, he doesn't sound too glad about the offer! They're not gonna fight, are they?

speaker: Storyteller
content: Not so fast. As long as the Phoenix Princess Ji Guining is present, peace is always guaranteed. Listening in silence, the lady of imperial blood continues the story with her elegance and eloquence...

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Young Master Brocade's kind intentions are truly admirable, but the martial heroes value their dignity above all, and particularly despise anything that smacks of charity. Master Wubei, if it pleases you, you're more than welcome to join me at my table.

speaker: Martial Artist
content: Haha... Who would have thought that the Snowquell Arts would draw out even the renowned Lady Ji, who rarely leaves her pipa pavilion. Forgive an old man for speaking out of turn, but these bitter mountain snows are hardly good for your leg condition.

speaker: Child A
content: And who is this now?

speaker: Storyteller
content: Yin Yansheng the "Immortal Healer"! He diagnoses and treats sickness with his mad words and skillful hands, bargaining with ghosts and gods for mortal life!

speaker: Martial Artist
content: The legendary Doctor Yin! I have long admired your reputation. To be able to accompany the Immortal Healer to Northsnow Manor... This is truly an honor for someone with my humble medical skills.

speaker: Storyteller
content: "Silver Needle Gentleman" Xu Shen! For ten years he sharpened his rusted needles, only to one day aim them at the dragon's gate. With scaled armor hidden under scholar robes, he is a clap of thunder lurking beneath the calm surface!

speaker: Martial Artist
content: Tsk, I didn't bring you here to watch you keep up this scholarly act. You've stumbled into the martial world now, and you must understand that here we care less about seniority than strength and character. Everyone here is of great talent. I, Ma Ling, shall raise the first toast to you all!

speaker: Storyteller
content: "General Invincible" Ma Ling! A hero of humble origins, she rallies elite fighters with her loyal heart and righteous spirit. Steady as a ceaseless river, she holds her halberd high, but her spirits higher, even across mountain passes!
[Small CG: Folk Group Portrait]

speaker: Child A
content: One hero, two heroes, three... Wow, this Northsnow Manor sure is something else, to be able to summon all these legendary figures from the storybooks!

speaker: Child B
content: That "codex"... Um... cold eggs? Can they actually taste so good? Better than the eggs from Auntie Wang's hens?

speaker: Storyteller
content: Well, one can only find out by going there and seeing for oneself, right?

speaker: Child A
content: Shuang'er is going too? To that manor? To Northsnow Manor?!

The children listening to the story all crowd around at once, chattering excitedly. Among them, only one person stands out. A twentysomething who stands far off with arms crossed, having listened to the entire tale in silence.

Fitted clothes, tied-up hair, a sheathed sword. Definitely not a familiar face from Ping'an Town. Shuang'er glimpses the person thoughtfully but doesn't let her expression reveal anything, continuing to respond.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Of course! After all, I am a registered disciple of Ping'an Town's Beggar Clan, as well as the unofficial chief storyteller for the Martial World Gazette. I must attend such a rare martial world event to bring back the freshest, first-hand stories for everyone!

With that, she taps her wooden stick against the edge of her broken bowl with a sharp clink, bringing today's tale to a close. When she looks up again, the unfamiliar figure is already dwindling, heading toward Mount Fuyun.
[Inn]

speaker: Attendant
content: Oh, honored guest, I'm afraid you've come at a bad time. Our humble establishment is truly full today...
No problem. I just need a place to shelter from the snow. I hope that won't be too much trouble for you?
The young traveler has trudged through snow all the way up to the mountainside, finally finding the inn the storyteller described, where the martial heroes have gathered.
The attendant doesn't turn the polite guest away and simply pours a pot of hot tea. Just as he is about to turn and attend to other guests, he gets called back.
Excuse me, I'd like to ask about something. How much longer does it take to get to <color=#fb9259>Northsnow Manor</color> from here?
The moment Northsnow Manor is mentioned, the inn falls completely silent.
All eyes fall upon the young traveler.
Several days ago, the Bureau

Dear Chief:

　　It has been far too long since we last spoke, and you have been much in my thoughts.
　　However, I write today not to reminisce, but to inform you of an urgent matter.
　　Ever since Nightfall, Northwild has remained a persistent concern for Eastia. The region has been without a seer for thirty years, leaving disasters unchecked in this mountainous, isolated terrain. <color=#fb9259>In recent years, we frequently detect signs of Sinner activity in the area</color>—on a scale rarely seen elsewhere in Eastia. Yet even envoys from the alliance cannot intervene rashly without proper cause, lest we provoke local resistance or further strain the already fragile relationships between Eastian cities in these post-Nightfall times. Thus, we have been limited to observation alone.
　　Fortunately, thanks to the trust we have built through our previous collaborations, DisCity has offered to deploy operatives for covert investigation upon learning of Eastia's predicament. Details are attached in this letter, and Schorl can provide additional clarification.
　　This matter is of utmost importance, so please handle it with caution. This brief letter cannot contain my deepest thoughts about you, so I can only wish you success and safety in all your endeavors.

Warmest regards,
Du Ruo

speaker: Chief
content: "DisCity has offered to deploy operatives for covert investigation..."
You click your tongue and glance sideways at Schorl, who's waiting for you to finish reading.

options: What have you guys discovered about Northwild?

speaker: Schorl
content: I'm pleased you've identified the key issue. The matter requiring your attention isn't actually the letter itself. Something that's currently both closely tied to Sinners and under heavy scrutiny—I'm sure you've already guessed what that might be, Chief.

speaker: Chief
content: My guess isn't proof. Give me something concrete.

speaker: Schorl
content: As you suspect, we initially paid little attention when we received the letter from Envoy Du Ruo. That changed when DisCity's contacts in the farlands reported back: <color=#fb9259>Fraser is involved in Aurum Secretum smuggling, and Eastia's Northwild is one of the buyers</color>. Moreover, these transactions have been going on for several years.

speaker: Schorl
content: We attempted to trace the activity, but the Aurum Secretum trail vanished once it entered Northwild. Combined with the region's isolationist governance and underdeveloped infrastructure, our operatives couldn't function effectively.

speaker: Chief
content: Something that required such elaborate effort to transport couldn't simply disappear. Most likely it's been converted into another form and put to use.

speaker: Schorl
content: This actually provides a breakthrough for our investigation, because the key difference between Aurum Secretum Tech and Hypercubes is that only Sinners with the compatible type of Mania can harness it. That group of Sinners who have suddenly emerged in Northwild are obviously prime suspects.

speaker: Chief
content: Eastia is probably only interested in those Sinners because they are looking for new seers. Why should we be investigating this?

speaker: Schorl
content: That's not something you need to concern yourself with, Chief. All you need to focus on is <color=#fb9259>tracking the Aurum Secretum trade</color>.

speaker: Chief
content: Judging by how insistent Du Ruo sounds in that letter, I'm guessing you're sending me on this investigation? Finally another field assignment to the Outlands, and you're not giving me the full briefing?

speaker: Schorl
content: We chose you because Eastia trusts you. No other agents can act with the degree of freedom you have in Eastia, making it easier for DisCity to look for the answers it's after under the guise of this joint investigation.

speaker: Schorl
content: If you must know more, then know that an isolated valley chronically dependent on Aurum Secretum naturally raises suspicions for DisCity. Aurum Secretum isn't just an inferior substitute for Hypercubes. It's a critical link between <color=#fb9259>the Underground and the farlands</color>.

speaker: Schorl
content: We trust the Eastian Alliance more than the farlands, but that doesn't mean we can lower our guard against potential threats under the current circumstances.

speaker: Schorl
content: I appreciate your sense of humor.

speaker: Schorl
content: A recent rumor in Northwild is drawing many Sinners toward Northsnow Manor. This provides us with an excellent opportunity for our investigation. The convoy is standing by outside the Bureau, but there's some information you need to know before we depart.

speaker: Schorl
content: In Northwild, Sinners are commonly referred to as <color=#fb9259>"martial heroes"</color>, a term rooted in the martial arts culture that has flourished in Eastia since ancient times. To help you blend in during this operation, we've arranged a corresponding identity for you as well.
"Sandsnow Wanderer" ${PlayerName}, a lone rider wandering the world covered in Eastian snow and DisCity sand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you planning to stay bundled up the entire time we're in Northwild?

speaker: Schorl
content: Unstable... signals... This Sinner gathering in Northwild... happened too suddenly... Didn't have time to adapt equipment... for low temperature environment...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Um, why do you keep cutting out?

speaker: Schorl
content: Underdeveloped infrastructure... Eastia has signal bases... outside Northwild... but clearly... coverage is poor...

speaker: Schorl
content: Don't worry... I'll keep communications brief... if you need backup... support is standing by... outside Northwild...
You whisper cautiously to Schorl while casually leaning against the inn's counter. Whenever someone passes by, you whistle a tune and pretend to mutter to yourself.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Please don't tell me you're running low on battery. I don't think I can find a way to charge you here.

speaker: Schorl
content: Rest easy... I'm on power saving mode... Besides... even without me... you're handling things well... When everyone was staring earlier... you quickly changed the subject... distracting them...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How was I supposed to know this place would be so cut off that you don't even have map data?
Seeing the attendant approaching the counter with hot water, you quickly press Schorl down to hide it.

Fortunately, the attendant only refills your tea before hurrying off to other tables, completely oblivious to anything unusual. The inn hasn't seen this much activity in ages, and he's already run off his feet trying to keep up.

speaker: Attendant
content: Here's your "Snow Soul," sir. A potent brew unique to Northwild, distilled from water of three-year-old snow from Mount Fuyun. Only one jar is made each year. I hope you enjoy it.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Mm... what a fierce flavor. Indeed a priceless treasure. My silver was well spent. I've heard that drinking this while circulating one's inner energy can even calm restless Qi. Mount Fuyun really is an excellent place for cultivating one's spiritual essence.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Young master, those claims about "enhancing one's cultivation" were proven to be mere merchant tales long ago. The heroes of Northwild are valued for their benevolent hearts and moral conduct, for earning the common people's trust and respect. No expensive liquor can get you those things, though "Snow Soul" is indeed a fine brew. You do have excellent taste.

Based on your limited pre-mission intel and what you've learned from the town's storyteller, you've pieced together the context. The "martial heroes" and "seers" here indeed share the same origin, both drawing power from the collective will of the people. But while seers rely on divine oracles, martial heroes focus on doing good deeds.
But this "cultivation" they speak of... You continue listening.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: I didn't expect you to be such a connoisseur of fine spirits as well, Lady Ji. Martial principles can indeed be found in cups of wine. I see we're like-minded in this aspect. Perhaps you and I could exchange a few moves when we're free? I'd gladly wager a bottle of my finest western Crimson Flame.

speaker: Ma Ling
content: Ha! Already itching for action before we even reach the mountain? Perfect! This inn's got plenty of space. Hey, egghead! I've long heard about those silver needles of yours, how they can save lives and take down enemies. After we've eaten our fill, how about you and I have a little sparring match? I'd love to see what you can do!

speaker: Xu Shen
content: You flatter me, General. Your halberd swept away all the bandits in the northern mountains. Now that's true martial skill. I'd be pleased to receive guidance from you.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Ah, how wonderful... You younglings have such composed auras, and I can see a glow of vitality in your eyes. Seeing such vigor in you all makes this old man feel rejuvenated.

speaker: Jiewubei
content: Old Yin! Quit showing off with all that fancy talk! Why don't you take a look at me too? Lately my body's been stuck going in circles at the third stage of "Vajra Exorcism," and it's driving me crazy!

speaker: Chief
content: Stagnant cultivation... Has his special power reached its limit?
The Immortal Healer's brow furrows with concern.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Wubei... Why is your Qi and blood surging like boiling water? Your yang energy is overflowing and seems to be clashing with this mountain's coldness... You must be extremely careful these days. Don't force yourself too much!

speaker: Jiewubei
content: Bah, nonsense! Tonight I'm going to devour every last bit of this coldness. Let's see what's tougher, this blizzard or my bones!
Without any warning, Jiewubei slams the table and shoots to his feet, launching a palm strike directly at the Immortal Healer sitting beside him.
Surprisingly, the Healer shows no anger and begins sparring with him in earnest.
As you quietly marvel at the wild customs of this place, the eager general also spins around and throws herself into the fray.

Hands swish through sizzling breath while blades tear through the frigid air. Their figures crisscross in wide, sweeping movements, the shockwaves from their techniques shaking dust from the rafters above. Their physiques and speed have indeed far exceeded the bounds of ordinary humans.
You duck behind the counter for cover and gently tap Schorl in your arms.

speaker: Chief
content: Their speed, strength, resilience, and weapon proficiency all match the enhancement patterns of Mania corruption on humans. They all appear to be at least A-Class Sinners. Looks like we've already run into our targets before we even reach Northsnow Manor.

speaker: Chief
content: Their power is somewhat different from DisCity Sinners... I can't quite put my finger on it, but it feels purer and more unified. Perhaps this is the "internal force" mentioned in the materials you gave me? My shackles aren't picking up any corruption fluctuations for now. Have you noticed anything special?
Schorl is completely unresponsive.
This time it clearly makes an effort, but after struggling against your chest and emitting some electrical crackling noise, it gives out completely.

speaker: Chief
content: Tch... Thanks for nothing, I guess.
Everyone in the inn has their eyes glued to this rare confrontation, making your hunched figure whispering by the counter all the more conspicuous.
Just as you're about to discreetly give that metallic bump in your arms a proper shake, a gentle yet clear voice drifts near unhurriedly.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: You carry yourself with such composure, young friend... You don't seem like an ordinary spectator. Could it be that... you're one of us?
She's asking whether you're also a "martial hero" who possesses the special powers unique to Northwild. You immediately become alert.
But the more you turn your head away, the more the Princess pushes her wheelchair closer out of curiosity.

If these people are indeed your targets for this mission, you'll inevitably have to deal with them once you reach the manor. No point in being evasive now. You offer a slight smile and nod in acknowledgment.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: I don't think I recognize you, young hero. Where do you hail from? Under which renowned peak did you train?
She's asking about your background and territorial affiliations.

speaker: Chief
content: The world is my home, and I come from wherever I came.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: I do hear a foreign accent.

speaker: Chief
content: I've lost my hometown accent after wandering for so long.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: That's a fine sword. You must be quite accomplished in the way of the blade?

speaker: Chief
content: I only know the basics. Compared to all of you, my skills are nothing.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: The people sitting in this room would send ordinary wanderers of the martial world fleeing in terror. Yet you remain completely unperturbed... Such composure is rarely seen in a novice.

speaker: Chief
content: But I am indeed a novice, and that's why I don't recognize any of you by name. I can only tell that you are all extraordinary individuals. I'm used to traveling alone and am not bound by these formalities. Please excuse my discourtesy.

You maintain your composure and handle the situation smoothly, though you can't help but grumble internally about the Eastians' roundabout ways of speaking and their many rules... Thank goodness you had Yugu give you a crash course before departure.
Of course, I did. If the Paradeisian official wasn't there, why should I care if they were dead or alive?

speaker: Xu Shen
content: If I remember correctly, when you first entered, didn't you say... you were heading to Northsnow Manor?

speaker: Xu Shen
content: That's exactly our destination as well. This meeting must be fate. May I ask your epithet?

speaker: Chief
content: ...Ahem, Sandsnow Wanderer, ${PlayerName}.
Saying it out loud makes you feel inexplicably embarrassed, but to your surprise, two of them actually applaud and cheer.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Anyone who can make it on their own in the martial world must have exceptional abilities. I love befriending young talents! I'm curious, how did someone so young manage to reach the martial arts threshold? Do tell, my new friend!

speaker: Chief
content: I'm just a small fry who happens to have picked up some skills while helping others on the road. I'm no expert, so there's not much to tell...

speaker: Ma Ling
content: It's my passion to cross blades with every swordsman I meet! It is a common weapon, so true mastery is rare. If you've chosen this sword yourself, you oughtn't conceal it. Show me what you can do!

Before you can refuse, the General has already seized her halberd and vaulted over the table's edge with one hand, swooping toward you like a sparrowhawk. The red tassel on her weapon flutters as she strikes directly at the sword sheath in your hand.
While your answers have been flawless, actual combat will inevitably expose you. If you activate your shackles here, everything—the manor gathering, the covert investigation—will be for nothing.

You dodge desperately but are still driven toward the main hall by the halberd's sweeping force. Fortunately, you've observed earlier that while the inn is large, the cluttered furnishings will limit the General's long weapon. Before you can think further, another swift strike whistles past your ear.

After dodging three consecutive strikes, you finally manage to create some distance from the General. Just as you're about to offer some praise and slip away, a scorching hot hand suddenly presses against your back.
A domineering surge of energy lands on your back, probing your internal circulation.

speaker: Jiewubei
content: I thought you were some hidden master, but you don't even know where your Qihai point is! Which clan are you from? They think they can just send a lamb into a wolf den?!

This man clearly isn't one to listen to explanations. You desperately want to escape, but just as you start to move, the Immortal Healer, who has been silently observing, strikes his walking stick against the ground. The soft tap somehow sounds thunderous, perfectly blocking your path.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Your Qihai is weak, your foundation shaky... This old man can see you're no true martial hero. Heroes and ordinary folk are two different species. Young friend, you've risked great danger posing as one of us. What are you plotting... Would you care to enlighten this old man?
The moment these words leave his lips, Jiewubei's palm crashes down like raging torrents, giving you no time to defend yourself.

You've barely set foot in Northwild and already find yourself in such a sorry state. You practically tumble your way out of the inn, the gazes of those martial heroes behind you piercing like needles. In their eyes, you've become a deceitful fiend who infiltrated their pack.

...Though they're not entirely mistaken. They pursue you relentlessly as you flee breathlessly through the streets and alleys, hoping to use the complex terrain to shake them off, but instead you become completely lost.
Just when you're becoming trapped, a very soft voice urges you from behind.
This way! Quick, turn left!

speaker: Chief
content: Who's talking?
The footsteps of the crowd are already close. No time to think.
Oh no, wrong way! Duck down, watch out for the darts!
You instinctively duck down as a black iron dart grazes your hair and drills into the mud wall behind you.
That's right! See the haystack by the wall? Come here, no one will find you!

You rush toward the wall corner following the voice, but miss your footing and tumble into the fluffy haystack. Just as you're about to struggle to your feet, a scrawny, dirt-covered hand presses down on your shoulder.

speaker: Dirt-Covered Girl
content: Don't move. Stay hidden. I'll handle them for you.
[Mountain Path]

speaker: Jiewubei
content: That little scoundrel runs faster than a damn mountain rat!

Radiating with internal energy, Jiewubei's every step shakes the ground, causing the muddy snow to splatter everywhere. The flying ice nearly hits the Scholar's face behind them, but General Ma Ling arrives just in time to sweep it off before resuming the pursuit.

speaker: Ma Ling
content: The snow's too deep. The tracks are all messy. That young man seems to have some decent skills. Perhaps we are being overly suspicious. If he really is heading to the manor, I'll have to apologize to him when we meet—and then I'll spar with him.
female_content: The snow's too deep. The tracks are all messy. That young woman seems to have some decent skills. Perhaps we are being overly suspicious. If she really is heading to the manor, I'll have to apologize to her when we meet—and then I'll spar with her.

speaker: Jiewubei
content: I don't give a damn who he is! I'm here to stop those who don't know the rules from disturbing Northsnow Manor's peace and ruining my plans!
female_content: I don't give a damn who she is! I'm here to stop those who don't know the rules from disturbing Northsnow Manor's peace and ruining my plans!

content: Jiewubei doesn't give further chase, turning back while cursing under his breath. Suddenly, a grimy figure darts out from the side, appearing almost right in front of his face.

speaker: Dirt-Covered Girl
content: Wow! It's Master Wubei! And... oh my, all the famous heroes from the martial world! Am I dreaming?
The martial heroes are all taken aback.

speaker: Xu Shen
content: Young friend, have you seen a gray-robed swordsman pass by?

speaker: Dirt-Covered Girl
content: I... I tell your stories in town every day! Especially General Ma's legendary conquest of the mountain bandits, and Young Master Shen's generous aid to the woodcutters... Could... could I have your autographs? Just sign on my back with charcoal!

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Quite the sweet talker, aren't you? Here, take these coins, but you'd better tell the truth. Have you seen a foreigner carrying a sword?

speaker: Dirt-Covered Girl
content: Oh, I can't believe Young Master Shen is talking to me... Ah, right! There was someone just now... I think they went into the woods over there? They ran so fast they just vanished in a puff of smoke!
The girl has finally said something useful. Everyone looks in the direction she points to. That winding, secluded path clearly leads away from the manor.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Everyone, please calm down. We came here today to visit the manor and discuss martial arts, not to patrol the mountains and catch people for the manor master. Causing such a commotion over some young stranger... that would hardly look dignified.

speaker: Xu Shen
content: You speak wisely, Doctor Yin. We are all part of the Northwild martial world, and we should stand together. We're already so close to the manor, so let us wait here for a moment. When Lady Ji arrives, we can pay our respects together to show our sincerity.

You stay crouched in the haystack, holding your breath as you watch the group of martial heroes calm down with their discussion. Before long, they are chatting and laughing, and eventually they leave.
Only when their figures completely disappear beyond the veil of snow does the girl who helped you out of trouble pull you out.
That smiling face beneath the conical hat is looking more familiar now...

options: Are you the storyteller at the foot of the mountain?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Since you recognize me, I'll tell you my name! I'm Shuang'er, the local expert who knows all the goings-on in Northwild!

With a flick of her wrist, the conical hat spins up into the air, and she catches it. Then she bends down, scoops up some snow, and wipes it across her face, washing off all the soot. It's none other than the amateur storyteller from town who tells tales to children.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: You! Do you want to go to Northsnow Manor too?
She takes out a roll of rough paper.
She gives you a "quit pretending" look and takes out a roll of rough paper.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Look what I have here!
It's a hand-drawn sketch of the manor's terrain. The lines are crude but detailed, and there's a crooked doodle of a chick in the corner with a line of small text beside it:
"Shuang'er's Secret Passage—No Idiots or Bad Guys Allowed!"
[Inn]

speaker: Attendant
content: Esteemed heroes, please be careful with the tables... Thank you for your patronage...

Hearing no response, the attendant crawls out from under the table warily, hands pressed together like he's praying, as he slowly opens his eyes. Seeing the chaos and the empty inn, he realizes the martial heroes are gone and breathes a sigh of relief and resignation.

speaker: Attendant
content: Tables and chairs, twenty coins... broken bowls and dishes, eighty coins... Sigh... The boss just lost a whole year's hard work.
Innkeeper!

speaker: Attendant
content: Innkeeper?
Check, please!
[Small CG: Drunk Tiger]

This place is not bad! You get to drink and watch the show... Burp! Good wine, and you kept me entertained. Northsnow Inn is such a lousy name though... You should call it... Great Tiger Tavern instead!

speaker: Attendant
content: Wh-what, who's talking?! Is... is the inn haunted?!

Ohh... Did I scare you? Hey, have you got anything to write with? It's not every day you run into the White Tiger Mountain Lord. I shall give you a proper five-star review. Write down what I say, okay...
Winds howl through Northwild snow, come enjoy a brawling show. Should you dare to pick a fight? Ask your aching butt, it should know!

After the bewildered attendant has scribbled down her words, he finds a ladder and climbs up to the ceiling beams for a look, only to discover that the figure has long since vanished, leaving behind two ingots of finest silver.
The inn's doors have somehow been thrown wide open, and through the wind and snow, a carefree silhouette can be seen fading into the distance.
Alright, let's go, Meowy! We'll head to that manor and have ourselves some fun. Time to catch the next show!
With a tiger's roar, the silhouette races toward the snowy mountain peak.
[Mountain Path]

speaker: Chief
content: You know a way into the manor?
You look the plainly dressed girl up and down, your gaze finally settling on the crude map in her hands.
But sensing your attention, she quickly hides it behind her back while extending her other hand toward you, palm up.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Well, hand it over!

speaker: Chief
content: ...What?
Your expression grows stern, while she stares wide-eyed at you, like you're not getting something obvious.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: My pay! I just helped you slip away from all those martial heroes, didn't I? Don't you know the rule? Aren't you supposed to show a little appreciation?

speaker: Chief
content: You helped me... just for this?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Oh... You wanna know why I helped you?
She leans in closer with a smile, pushing her outstretched hand forward again, rubbing her fingertips together.
You pull out some spare change that Schorl gave you and place it in her palm. She weighs it in her hand, then frowns and pouts.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Oh, young hero! I just rubbed dirt onto my face to cover for you, abandoning my dignity as a member of the Beggar Clan! I'm afraid... this here is not quite enough to soothe my wounded pride.
You sigh and pull out some more coins for her.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: To tell you the truth, I've always been a sickly girl, and there's a bunch of little kids constantly chasing after me for candy at the foot of the mountain... Winter's coming, and charcoal gets more expensive every day. If I can't save enough money, I might actually freeze to death in some alley...

speaker: Chief
content: Enough. Just tell me already.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Hehe, in fact, I helped you for one simple reason. Because... I know who you are.
Your heart skips a beat.

speaker: Chief
content: What do you know?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I know... You're a huge martial arts fan, aren't you?

speaker: Chief
content: Huh?!

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Stop pretending! I could tell when I was telling those stories back at the tea stall. Your eyes lit up when I mentioned the legendary heroes and the secret codex! I know that look all too well!

speaker: Chief
content: How could you tell I'm a martial arts fan?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Oh, I just can! After all, we're kindred spirits.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Everyone says that if you live virtuously and do good deeds, you will one day have your martial enlightenment and step into that dangerous but exciting world... How enchanting that sounds! But what about unlucky souls like us?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I've tried countless ways, yet I'm still shut out from that world. And the longer I wait, the more obsessed I become! Even in my dreams, I see myself as part of the martial world. That's why you pretended to be a hero, isn't it? I heard how you got exposed at the inn. Trust me, I understand.
Her voice grows quieter, sounding genuinely melancholic.
If not for the way she's deftly stuffing the money she just collected into her pouch, you would have almost been fooled by her.
You catch a glimpse of her bag stuffed full of bottles and jars, and she notices your gaze.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: These? They're medicines I have to take every day. I wasn't lying when I said I'm sickly. I can't become a hero because of my poor constitution. Everyone in Ping'an Town knows.

speaker: Chief
content: You didn't come to Northsnow Manor just to get inspiration for new stories to tell the children, did you? I remember you mentioning that the manor master was also once sickly. Do you believe that...

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Yes! I want to see with my own eyes whether that codex can truly change fate and transform someone like me into a genuine hero!

speaker: Chief
content: The codex...
If there really exists a special item that can transform an ordinary person into a Sinner, could it be exactly what you're looking for?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: What about you? What brought you here?

speaker: Chief
options: I want to dominate the martial world!

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Alright, alright, I won't press you! A true hero always keeps a secret or two. At least tell me what I should call you?

speaker: Chief
content: Just call me ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Wait, is that your real name? Hmm... Well, if we're venturing into the manor, we must take our roles seriously. I'll call you ${PlayerName} the young hero! And you can call me Master Shuang'er!

speaker: Chief
content: ...I'm not sure I follow, but sure.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Are you ready to begin our martial world adventure, young hero?
Following the crude map, she leads you to one side of the manor's entrance and steps aside to reveal a hole only big enough for a dog to pass through.
Martial heroes, Sinners, the manor, the codex, and the illicit trade in the Outlands during these tense times... What lies beyond this opening may satisfy the world's curiosity.
Against your chest, Schorl remains silent. You'll likely have to face whatever comes next on your own.

The entrance is narrow, barely wide enough for one person to crawl through. Snow mixed with ice shards scrapes against your clothes, sending a chill through your bones. Just as your breathing grows labored, a cold wind suddenly blows from ahead, and white light spreads around you...
[Manor and BGM] Manor environment rendering, heavy snow rendering

Dark blue stone rises into towering walls, while curved eaves and ornate brackets stretch through the curtain of snow. In the open courtyard with clean stone paths, old plum trees thrust their branches toward the gray sky like firm brushstrokes. Even the dense snow cannot conceal the manor's serene, imposing presence.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: I've always heard that Northsnow Manor is like a fairyland... So the stories are true.

So she wasn't lying when she claimed to be a Northwild know-it-all. You listen as Shuang'er recounts the tale of the manor's previous masters. The Medical Sage couple had a daughter late, and the girl was cursed with frail health. Later, the manor fell into seclusion as they devoted themselves to caring for her.

The martial world had almost forgotten about Northsnow Manor, yet these sudden rumors of a secret codex have drawn minds back to that chaotic era when Northwild had no heroes. The Medical Sage couple were true champions of those troubled times, so it's hardly surprising the manor could achieve such grandeur.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: See that? Everyone's heading to that building in the center. That must be the meeting hall... Follow me! I've already scouted the route. We'll circle around behind the covered bridge. I guarantee no one will spot us!
You two walk in single file, hugging close to the corridor pillars as you creep forward. From Shuang'er's practiced movements, she's clearly no stranger to this kind of sneaking around.

speaker: Chief
content: Aren't there any guards or servants in this place?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: What if... they're all hiding in the shadows, watching us?

speaker: Chief
content: We wouldn't be able to creep around with our butts sticking out like this in that case, would we?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Maybe this manor master is an unusual character who doesn't trust people. Maybe she has set up a bunch of hidden traps instead... Ow!
She suddenly lets out a yelp, and you instinctively tense up.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Don't, don't move! Something's... poking me! Something sharp... on my butt!

Is there really a hidden trap? You turn around cautiously, only to meet two pairs of round, beady black eyes. Two chubby little birds are tilting their heads at you, and one is even tugging at Shuang'er's clothes with its beak.

speaker: Cheepy
content: Cheep? Cheep cheep, cheep!!

speaker: Chirpy
content: Chirp chirp!!

speaker: Shuang'er
content: They're yelling at us! They're scolding us for not using the front door, calling us sneaky thieves!

speaker: Shuang'er
content: It was an educated guess.
You don't speak bird, but you do notice that each bird has a thin bamboo tube tied to its leg. You reach out to remove them and find two plain memos rolled up inside.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Moore
Northsnow Manor has no gates. The winds escort the willing guests in, who choose their own fate.
Skinny, elegant handwriting in tranquil black ink. You lift your head to see snow blanketing the courtyard and the quiet buildings. The entire manor seems to have anticipated your arrival.
The two chubby birds lead you to the stone steps before the meeting hall, then vanish into the shadows beneath the eaves.

speaker: Chief
content: Were those birds sent by the manor master to deliver us the message? To welcome us inside?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: But why would she do that? Has she grown tired of guests who are real martial heroes, so she's summoning us for a change?

speaker: Chief
content: Anyway, isn't that a good thing? At least we won't have to hide anymore. But... someone who willingly lives in isolation in this harsh, cold place to convalesce doesn't seem like the type who enjoys company.
You're finding this manor master increasingly mysterious and incomprehensible. For now, you have no choice but to play your roles as honored guests.
The meeting hall's entrance is spacious and decorated with cold, austere stone pillars. Flanking the doorway is a couplet carved into dark wood:

<color=#bc1517><size=45>A decade the hero bones lie beneath the snow alone,
cloud-shrouded manor in the deathly cold</color></size>

speaker: Chief
content: Doesn't this couplet seem... a bit strange?

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Certainly doesn't sound cheerful... Hero bones and lone manor... It gives me the creeps.
Cold wind sweeps across the steps, stirring up fine snow against the grand entrance of the meeting hall, sounding like someone weeping.
You two exchange a glance, then push open the doors and step inside.
[Meeting Hall]

A warm fire crackles inside the hall, while the fragrant steam of tea fills the air. Several martial heroes are casually discussing recent events when they suddenly feel a cold draft sweep in through the door cracks.
Everyone in the hall turns their gaze toward the entrance in unison.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: Wh-Why is everyone staring at us...

speaker: Chief
content: Probably because... we kind of tricked these martial heroes at the foot of the mountain.
The atmosphere is tense. Fortunately, Ji Guining speaks up in a gentle voice, breaking the silence.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Oh, our brave guests have traveled from afar despite the snowstorm to honor the manor master's invitation. Why don't we all share a drink together and welcome our new friends?

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: Whatever methods you used, it's a feat to have made it here. You have my acknowledgment.

Afterward, the martial heroes you encountered at the inn gradually take their seats. Shuang'er is behaving, simply staying close by your side and gorging herself with snacks without causing any trouble.
Half an incense stick's time passes as the sun sinks in the west. Shuang'er has already eaten her fill, yet one seat remains empty.

speaker: Ma Ling
content: Where's Jiewubei?

speaker: Xu Shen
content: The Master said he's not used to sitting around waiting like this, so he's already returned to his room to rest.
The hall falls momentarily silent except for the faint chewing sound from Shuang'er.

Another moment passes. A gentle breeze seeps in from outside, gliding across the floor with drifting snowflakes and the fragrance of plum blossoms, softly lifting the gauze curtains beneath the light.

speaker: Yin Yansheng
content: Hmm, this wind feels unusual... It rises from the southeast and flows through the hall without fading or lingering.

speaker: Xu Shen
content: Are you saying someone is controlling the wind? But, but who could do such a thing so surreptitiously in a hall full of respected martial heroes?
Bang! Before the Scholar can finish his sentence, a gust suddenly erupts, and the two heavy wooden doors slam shut with a thunderous crash.
The wind howls and swirls through the hall like the low growl of a trapped beast. Everyone holds their breath, muscles tense, exchanging wary glances.
A lurking master? Or is this a trap to force the heroes' hand? To accomplish all this in an instant... this is no ordinary feat.

speaker: Shuang'er
content: What's that?
Everyone follows where she points, and there above the central incense burner stands a slanted plum branch, its snow-dusted buds radiating a striking, ethereal beauty.
Just moments ago, everyone's attention was completely absorbed by the strange movements of the doors and windows, so no one noticed when this was placed here, or by whom.

speaker: Ma Ling
content: Someone is here!

The General instinctively reaches for her weapon, but it's already too late. A rapid succession of loud bangs rings out like a sudden downpour. It's the powerful wind, slamming shut the high windows on all four sides, sealing off the hall.
[Dramatic entrance BGM]

The plums in the garden are blooming so beautifully despite the frost. I was quite taken with them and went to pick one to admire, which delayed me for a moment. My apologies for keeping you all waiting.
I haven't had the chance to introduce myself yet. I am the master of Northsnow Manor, a descendant of the Jiang family.
Please accept the sincerest greetings from Jichuan, distinguished heroes.
[Small CG: Silhouette]

Every guest at this banquet is a figure of renown in their own right. The manor master's entrance was clearly meant to intimidate them. And it proves effective. The heroes all understand that they could never replicate the sheer presence displayed in her arrival.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Why the silence, my guests?
Several furtive glances are exchanged, as if the guests are deciding who should step forward first. But the manor master has already chosen her target.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Princess, with your leg condition, the journey up the mountain in the snow must have been arduous, wasn't it?
Suddenly singled out, Ji Guining feels every gaze in the hall piercing her like needles. But being several years older than Jichuan, she is able to remain composed.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: It is most kind of you to ask, but no harm has come to me.

speaker: Jichuan
content: As a musical expert, you must also be an admirer of art and refined beauty. I wonder... can my humble manor's scenery catch your discerning eye?

speaker: Ji Guining
content: It is certainly exquisite... Such beauty is rarely seen in this world. Being able to witness such scenery makes my arduous journey up the mountain worthwhile...
The figure behind the curtains smiles, covering her face.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Is that so... I thought you only climbed the mountain to seek ways to clear your blocked internal force and revive the stagnant development of your martial arts, Princess.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: You...
Ji Guining's expression shifts several times, momentarily speechless. But the manor master behind the curtains seems unbothered, already chuckling softly as she turns to her next target.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Oh, so Young Master Xu has come as well. Few know of the remarkable literary talents of the "Silver Needle Gentleman." The mid-lake pavilion in my courtyard still lacks an inscription. Might I trouble you to improvise a poem?

speaker: Xu Shen
content: You flatter me... But I shall endeavor for my gentle host.

The Scholar's gaze darts across the seated guests. After a moment's contemplation, he recites four lines. It's a well-structured poem that lacks real inspiration, passable but unremarkable. A subtle tension settles over the hall. Only the figure behind the curtains seems amused.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Wonderful! I shall display it outside the pavilion to commemorate today's gathering. What a curious coincidence that Young Master Xu's martial techniques seem remarkably similar to this poem. Steady, smooth, but never too bold. I am truly impressed.

speaker: Ma Ling
content: Miss Jiang!
Xu Shen's face immediately pales, but he endures the humiliation in silence, not daring to speak. Instead, it's his travel companion, the General, who loses her composure first.

speaker: Ma Ling
content: I'm not one with refined etiquette, so forgive me if I sound harsh. But I can't stand watching my friend be subjected to such unfair criticism and humiliation. Everyone present today has earned their reputation in the martial world. Your way of treating guests... isn't exactly hospitable, is it?

speaker: Jichuan
content: General Ma, your "Mountain-Splitting Halberd" can advance no further since it reached its "City Destroyer" form. Every time you channel your energy to your sternum, you feel a prickling and burning sensation, don't you?

speaker: Ma Ling
content: How did you know...

speaker: Jichuan
content: How did I know?

speaker: Jichuan
content: You've all braved the harsh snowstorm and traveled here from afar, claiming you're here to discuss martial arts and meet your fellow heroes... But I can see clearly what occupies your minds—the obstacles hindering your martial arts advancement.

speaker: Jichuan
content: Young Master Shen's "Golden Peacock Fan" may be dazzling, but it lacks the power to penetrate solid defenses. Master Yin has saved countless lives, yet the chronic blockages in his own Three Yin meridians worsen each year. And there are two guests here who haven't even grasped the fundamentals of their arts...

speaker: Jichuan
content: So when you heard there was a sickly woman on this desolate mountain who possessed divine techniques that could enhance your martial prowess, you all came rushing to my humble dwelling uninvited. And yet you have the audacity to demand proper hospitality?
The hall falls silent, with only the soft crackling of the fire breaking the stillness.
Everyone, including you, may have underestimated this frail, reclusive young manor master and this gathering of martial heroes. You fear it might be harder to leave Mount Fuyun than it was to come.

speaker: Ji Guining
content: Please do not mistake our curiosity for rudeness. After all, those in the martial world have always known only one path: live virtuously and learn the heavenly way. So when we suddenly heard talk of a "secret codex," it was only natural that we wanted to explore it...

speaker: Jichuan
content: Behold the divine arts that quell the snow, granting the mortals a springtime glow. You are only curious whether this rumor is true, aren't you?

speaker: Jichuan
content: It is true. These techniques can indeed clear internal blockages and mental obstacles, helping you overcome the bottlenecks that have plagued you for years. I believe the fact that I am still well and conversing with you is proof enough. However...

speaker: Jichuan
content: They do not exist to satisfy your insatiable greed.

speaker: Shen Wanchou
content: ...What do you mean by this?

speaker: Jichuan
content: What I mean is, the breakthrough you've all spent your lives pursuing is, in my eyes... nothing more than a speck of dust on my fingertip. And I have no intention of flicking it your way.

speaker: Ma Ling
content: Enough! All you've done is humiliate us with your every sentence. Do you take us for some foolish cowards?

From the start, the manor master hasn't wanted to receive these uninvited guests. She's been evading the topic, wearing down everyone's patience. This very moment of heightened tension is probably what she's waiting for.
As you expect, the figure behind the curtains remains perfectly still, watching the growing unrest among the guests. She speaks increasingly slowly.
[Small CG: Eyes Closed]

speaker: Jichuan
content: I'm only making you see...

speaker: Jichuan
content: Just how insignificant the opportunity you've yearned for truly is when faced by someone who actually possesses it. And how pitiful and laughable your struggles are.
The figure behind the curtains raises a fingertip, pointing toward the seated guests.

speaker: Jichuan
content: If you want to obtain the codex and reach the pinnacle in one leap, then let's trade. All I require is...
[Small CG: Eyes Opening]

speaker: Jichuan
content: Your lives.
