[Dark alley]

You use the trip to the convenience store as an excuse to contact Nightingale. When you step back out, Phanuel is still quietly waiting at the alley entrance. She's idly tapping her foot against the ground, with no apparent intention of running.

Her gaze drifts along the walls of the alley. The sea of flyers, the dust-covered scooters parked along the curb, the faded signs of the shops... All something she'd never get to see in her chauffeured van.
You open the small container you grabbed from the convenience store freezer and pass it to her.

speaker: Phanuel
content: What's this?

speaker: Chief
content: The same thing those two girls you were staring at had.
She takes the spoon and cautiously scoops a bite. Then, she inspects it closely before carefully placing it in her mouth.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Ahh, it's so cold!
She scrunches her nose. Still, she can't help but look down at the little container in her hands again, like she's just found some rare treasure.

speaker: Phanuel
content: What is this? I've never learned about this. Can you tell me?

speaker: Chief
content: Neapolitan ice cream. One of the few budget ice creams in the freezer that won't rob you blind. Pure artificial flavor.

speaker: Phanuel
content: That's a pretty long name... but Phanuel's got it memorized!
Phanuel solemnly lifts the container above her head to read the ingredient list on the bottom.

speaker: Phanuel
content: White sugar... non-dairy creamer... artificial flavoring...

speaker: Phanuel
content: Oh my... this one cup is several days' worth of calories for Phanuel!

speaker: Phanuel
content: So... is the strawberry parfait just as terrifying as this? Eliza decided that's Phanuel's favorite food.
She scoops up another bite as she marvels at the dessert, holding it in her mouth for a long while before finally swallowing.

speaker: Phanuel
content: I wonder if my Cherubs actually believe that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Well... cute-looking desserts do suit your image.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Cute... People say that about Phanuel all the time. I don't really understand what being "cute" means, but as long as I smile the right way and strike the right pose, everyone seems happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's "cute" is different for everyone. Clumsy, gentle, the kind of person you just want to be close to...

speaker: Phanuel
content: So there are questions you can't answer too, Esteemed Reporter.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Oh... right, I still don't know your name. But everyone around me always includes some kind of title like that when they chat.
You say nothing to correct her assumption. She seems to be opening up now that you're on a familiar topic.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Eliza says everything that makes Phanuel cute is calculated. The kind of face people like, personality, songs... there's a database for all of it. Everything I do has to match that data.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Oh, I get it now! The things Phanuel normally eats are just too un-cute! That's why strawberry parfait has to exist.

speaker: Phanuel
content: One boiled egg in the morning, two cucumbers for lunch, and a small slice of whole wheat bread with an apple for dinner.

options: That can't be enough. Don't you get hungry?

content: But Phanuel can only maintain the perfect weight that way.

speaker: Phanuel
content: If the number on the scale goes over, that means Phanuel wouldn't be perfect in everyone's eyes. It would shatter so many people's illusions.

content: What does weight have to do with illusions?

speaker: Phanuel
content: They probably come in many, many varieties, just like "cute." I think so at least.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Some people want to become Phanuel, to shine on stage like me. So I always have to be the most dazzling version of that wish. Because when they look at Phanuel, they're looking at another possible version of "themselves."

speaker: Phanuel
content: Some people fantasize about becoming Phanuel's partner. That's why I can't date, have any rumors, and I need to be warm and caring towards everyone. For them, Phanuel got them through some of their hardest days. Phanuel is a symbol of that time.

speaker: Phanuel
content: And for some others... when they don't know what to do with themselves, they discover that there's still one thing they can do—to love Phanuel! Something certain, something they can control and hold on to.

speaker: Phanuel
content: The point is... as long as Phanuel stays perfect, they can keep believing that there's still something beautiful in this world.
It's the most you've ever heard her say in one breath. Maybe the ice cream actually managed to coax some rare honesty out of Phanuel—is what you think until she swallows a spoonful and says:

speaker: Phanuel
content: That's what Eliza says, at least.
She remains as calm as ever, her trust in and reliance on Eliza unshaken.
We need to create an unfamiliar situation and draw out a reaction that's outside the script from her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Phanuel, if Eliza is behind the Hollow Syndrome, that'd mean she used you to hurt your fans. Would you still go back to her, keep working with her, and do everything she says then?
A long silence settles over the alley. Phanuel stares blankly at the ground.

speaker: Phanuel
content: I don't know... There's so, so much I don't know...

speaker: Phanuel
content: Something must have happened to me before, something terrible. When I came to, I couldn't remember anything. I was all alone in the world.

speaker: Phanuel
content: I didn't know who I was, what I was good at, what I liked, how to make sense of the world, or what I could do.

speaker: Phanuel
content: But Eliza gave me all of that... including the name Phanuel, including the concert, a goal that means everything to both of us.
The Hollow Syndrome is still too foreign a concept for her, and so is a future without Eliza. She tilts her head, visibly at a loss.

speaker: Phanuel
content: This is a tough one, Esteemed Reporter. Can I have some time to think about it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Alright, how about you give me your answer before the concert?

speaker: Phanuel
content: Okay, it's a promise!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And before you do, there's one more favor I'd like to ask of you.

speaker: Passerby A
content: Huh, that person looks really familiar. Isn't she... that idol who's been blowing up lately—
Phanuel's cover is blown.

speaker: Passerby B
content: Phanuel! It's Phanuel!!
A figure in a grey trench coat races through the busy streets of Eastside, pulling the city's biggest star along by the hand.
The screams draw attention. An excited crowd closes in, phones raised.

speaker: Chief
content: Ready to join this reporter's exclusive class? We're about to scape to a world beyond the spotlight!
The blaring horns below fade into the distance as you lead her up the overpass, passersby watching as you go.
[Small CG: Eloping]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Lesson one: In this situation, a normal person would ask, "So, where are we going?"

content: Wh-where are we going—

content: Honestly, I have no clue either. You feeling hot?

speaker: Phanuel

content: You know what that is.

content: You don't like the sun?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Anything else?

content: Yes! Reporters might photograph me. Eliza doesn't want me to be seen too often. She says I need to stay mysterious, otherwise people will lose interest.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So, which do you prefer? The umbrella, or the sky?

speaker: Phanuel
content: ...I prefer now!
She isn't wearing the wings from her stage costume, yet right now, she's closer to the sky than she ever was.
You run and run, all the way to the end of the road, all the way past the city sprawl, and through the thick, humid midsummer haze.
And finally, at the mouth of an alley beneath an overpass, she lets go of your hand.

speaker: Chief
content: What's wrong? Can't keep up?
You turn around. Her smile is brilliant under the sunlight, her golden hair radiant, reflecting the sun's rays. In this moment, Phanuel is more alive than any poster of her could ever capture.

speaker: Chief
content: Then... let's stop here...

A wave of dizziness suddenly washes over you. Your fingertips go numb. Your eyes won't leave Phanuel's face. Something seems to be gently scratching at your chest, but the feeling isn't unpleasant. If anything, it's almost... comfortable.
The corners of your mouth curl up on their own, and your eyelids grow heavier and heavier...

speaker: Chief
content: Phanuel... Phanuel...

speaker: Phanuel
content: Then I said I was scared of the big white thing in the distance, and he sent those people who were following us away.

speaker: Phanuel
content: He didn't know Phanuel is a Sinner. I used my ability, and he went down.

content: Well done. This is what will happen to anyone who tries to get in our way.

speaker: Eliza
content: What's wrong? You're completely behind schedule as is. Get a move on.

speaker: Eliza
content: Phanuel?

content: Eliza... have I ever done things I don't know about?

content: What's "everything else" though?

content: We're together every single day. What could I possibly be hiding? It's all related to your work, of course. What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

speaker: Phanuel
content: Eliza...

speaker: Phanuel
content: Phanuel believes you.

speaker: Chief
content: The root cause of the Hollow Syndrome is Phanuel's power...

speaker: Evie

speaker: Evie
content: Um... did you say Hollow Syndrome...? Was it one of our coworkers?

speaker: Colleague B
content: You know, the one covered in... what was it again...? Oh right, Phanuel's merch.

speaker: Evie
content: ...Tracy?!

speaker: Colleague B

speaker: Evie
content: Tracy! Are you okay...?!

content: S-Sorry, I didn't mean to barge in... I mean, I meant to barge in... Tracy, um, the owner of this workstation is, uh, she's my friend. I heard she might be in trouble and I just... acted without thinking...

speaker: Evie
content: She poured almost all of her savings, time, and energy into Phanuel, finally being chosen as a Special Cherub. That meant she earned the privilege to attend a fan-exclusive pilgrimage gathering.

content: A few of the more dedicated fans mentioned this too. None of them seemed to have qualified, though. We haven't been able to identify the organizers or pin down the physical location either.

content: Chances are... Tracy had the closest ties to the organizers out of them all, then.

content: Found it. Here. A selfie she posted when she was taken to get a preview of the venue, plus a few countdown posts. Will these help?

content: Sorry... Can I come along too?

content: Evie, are you aware of what could happen if you disclose your identity as a Sinner?

speaker: Evie
content: I know. The Bureau sounds fine, honestly. It's okay. I never really liked my current job anyway... Tracy's the only coworker I can really talk to. There's not much holding me back.

speaker: Wynn
content: Well, we could always use someone as genuine and brave as you as well. Not many would take on this much risk for a friend.

speaker: Wynn
content: I'll notify Chief up through my terminal. Remember to get the shackles paperwork sorted out afterward, okay?

speaker: Evie
content: Do you mean...?

speaker: Wynn
content: Come on, let's go save your friend!

Outside the Eastside Concert Venue
13:12
Jane peers through the café window. Outside, the entire street has been overtaken by pink bows and white wings.
Phanuel's face reaches as far as the eye can see—banners, flower walls, fan signs, and, of course, her fans' T-shirts.

speaker: Fan
content: Let's go through the chant one more time! Phanuel will definitely hear us from inside! Let all of Eastside witness the power of her Cherubs!

speaker: Crowd
content: Yay!
Jane glances at the dense crowd outside, then back at the empty café. Looks like she's not getting any bonuses today.
With nothing else to do, she scrolls through her terminal, only to realize today's the deadline for paying her credit bill.
And then she sees her single-digit balance, along with the mission payout that still hasn't come through. She lets out a long sigh.

speaker: Jane
content: Come on, chin up. At least my debt could beat most people's. One, two, three, four, five, six... seven zeros...
She falls silent for a moment. As she's about to change back into her regular clothes and call Adjutant Nightingale for an update, her terminal lights up first.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Jane, you're close to Phanuel's concert venue according to the terminal. There's an emergency, and we need your help.
The call forcibly connects. Nightingale stares at the screen, taking in the sight of Jane in a maid outfit, and goes quiet for a moment.

speaker: Jane
content: Oh, um... this is for fieldwork.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...The Bureau has a strict non-interference policy regarding Sinners' personal hobbies, so long as public order is not affected.

speaker: Jane
content: In that case, Miss Nightingale, I'd like to ask one thing. Why hasn't my pay for yesterday's mission come through yet?
Nightingale sighs and pulls up the surveillance feed of Joan's confinement cell on her terminal. The lock has been pried open, and Joan is nowhere to be seen.

speaker: Jane
content: I swear I didn't let her go.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I know. But the result wasn't maintained, so yesterday's mission can't be counted as completed.

speaker: Nightingale
content: She also broke the cell's security lock. Said to the camera, and I quote, "I'll make those people with no taste hear my music in person!"
Looking at the feed again, Joan has left an angry message scrawled in red paint:
Plagiarists don't deserve a stage! I'll be taking it now!

speaker: Jane
content: The emergency you mentioned... Is it about her escape?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Yes. The crowd around the venue is massive. If she causes a scene at the concert, it could seriously endanger Eastside's public safety. All things considered, you're the best fit for this mission.

speaker: Jane
content: You are aware that Joan is my closest friend and sworn sister, right, Miss Nightingale?

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I'm not sure I follow. Didn't you just drag her to the Bureau for a reward?

speaker: Jane
content: Bump up the pay.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I'll have the Bureau's finance department recalculate the allowance.
After the call ends, Nightingale sends over a full set of emergency assistance documents.

Jane flips through it, leaning against the counter. The first few pages cover the security layout, venue entrances, and crowd control routes of Phanuel's concert. The last page is Joan's war-declaration graffiti.
Jane recalls the remark she casually made the night before.

speaker: Jane
content: Keep playing, and keep singing, until everyone has no choice but to listen. You're bound to be remembered that way.
Jane looks outside the café window again. A massive Phanuel poster hangs on the outer wall, and fans below are holding up their light boards, as if they're waiting for a miracle to descend.
No one knows who started it, but somewhere in the crowd, a Cherub begins humming the plagiarized melody. Others join in, one by one, until the tune echoes all the way till the venue entrance.
Jane puts away her terminal and unties the apron over her maid outfit.

speaker: Jane
content: ...Joan.

speaker: Jane
content: I hope you don't end up like me...
With that, Jane climbs through the café window, scales up toward the rooftop, and scans the crowd below for any sign of Joan.
(Scene change)

The entire apartment building has completely fallen under FAC's control. They've claimed access to all security systems, and armed personnel have secured every entrance and exit. A squad fans out silently along the outer walls and fire exits, sealing the building from ground floor to rooftop.

speaker: Eugene
content: Team A, secure the east balcony. Team B, come with me. Be ready to breach the front at any moment. The rest of you, take the west fire exit and lock down all remaining exits.
Following Eugene's signal, the team of MBCC guards and FAC operatives behind him files in. Yet, not a single footstep can be heard in the hallway of the apartment.
The moment Chief went dark, Eugene contacted the FAC squad assigned as support, and used the tracking terminal to pinpoint Phanuel's apartment.
Eugene crouches by the front door of the target unit, staring at the tablet screen. On it, he sees three human heat signatures: two in the living area, one near the master bedroom.
According to Wynn's latest report, the fan-organized rally is still growing, and the situation is spiraling out of control.

speaker: Eugene
content: We're running out of time. Remember, Chief's safety is our top priority. Avoid engaging ordinary civilians if possible.

speaker: Eugene
content: Everyone, on my mark. Three—
Eugene holds the keycard provided by management up to the reader.

speaker: Eugene
content: Two...
At the same time, Team A stands close to the edge of the balcony's window wall.

speaker: Eugene
content: One!
In one seamless motion, the keycard goes in, the handle turns, and the security door swings open. The team pours in like a torrent, seizing control of every corner in seconds.

speaker: Eugene
content: Bureau, open up! Drop your weapons and put your hands up—
Eugene has barely barged in when he spots a familiar figure hard at work, a small black triangle bobbing cheerfully nearby, and two suited men flat on the floor.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief? What... are you doing?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Oh, you're late. The little AI took these two guards down with neural shocks.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nothing like good ol' machines for this kind of dirty work. You all best watch out, or you might just get replaced by AI.
You grab the two suited men by the ankles as you speak, and drag them toward the open area. Everyone else just stands there, guns in hand, watching you huff and puff through the whole thing alone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Hello? Some help over here?
(Scene change)
Only then do they all snap out of it. They quickly take over the cleanup and begin sweeping the rest of the apartment.
You look at the guards on the floor, then at your own people tearing through every cabinet and drawer. It's ironic, but you look more like criminals right now.

speaker: Eugene
content: Found it. As we suspected, Chief, Mirrormoon Entertainment is just a shell company. Their real backer only entered the picture last year.

Eugene hands over the company's financial records. The statements show a fixed sum wired monthly from an import-export trading company over the past several years, with the memo field reading "advertising fee."

speaker: Schorl
content: I've already traced the trading company. It also has a fixed monthly expense to Harbour Culture, supposedly as "project service fees." Meanwhile, the only label under Harbour Culture is Startrack Productions, which is the primary organizer of Phanuel's concert.

speaker: Schorl
content: It's curious as is that a concert of this scale would be handed to a company that has only organized two events since its founding, but... Care to guess who's connected to the first one, Chief?

speaker: ${PlayerName} & Schorl
content: Phantom Entertainment.

speaker: Schorl
content: Additionally, Harbour Culture and the trading company are registered under the same address, building, and floor. Though I suspect that doesn't really come as a surprise at this point.

speaker: Chief
content: A shell company network, all registered by the same group, funneling money to Eliza and two secondary channels at the same time. This concert has been in the works far longer than we thought...

speaker: Chief
content: Schorl, mobilize every resource you can and shut down this concert immediately, on grounds of threatening public safety.

speaker: Eugene
content: About that, I'm afraid... we're too late.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't we still have two hours before it starts?

speaker: Eugene
content: But this afternoon, a pilgrimage movement spread through the fanbase, and they've spontaneously gathered for a march near the venue ahead of schedule. The number of people there far exceeds the venue's capacity, in fact.

speaker: Schorl
content: Based on the current situation, we cannot rule out the possibility that the march was organized and planned in advance—
Schorl switches on the television in the apartment remotely.

speaker: Host
content: Phantom Entertainment has just released a public statement, which reads as follows:

speaker: Host
content: Phantom Entertainment acknowledges having previously provided financial support to Mirrormoon Entertainment, the agency to which artist Phanuel belongs. However, the statement emphasizes—

speaker: Host
content: Phantom Entertainment has never been involved in any creative, operational, or business decisions pertaining to Phanuel. All of Phanuel's statements, works, and stage performances are entirely unrelated to Phantom Entertainment.

speaker: Host
content: The statement also addresses recent claims online that Phanuel is being manipulated by financial backers behind the scenes, dismissing them as baseless conspiracy theories.

speaker: Host
content: Phanuel comes from an ordinary background, with no powerful connections or backing. Everything she has achieved today was earned through her own hard work on stage and the unwavering support of her fans. Perhaps that is precisely why she has become the target of so much unwarranted speculation and criticism.

speaker: Host
content: Phantom Entertainment trusts the Cherubs' judgment, and calls on everyone to stand together in support of Eastside's brightest star, to prevent those with ulterior motives from disrupting this hard-won concert.

speaker: Host
content: That concludes the statement. We will continue to keep you updated on further developments.

speaker: Schorl
content: They've already made their move and distanced themselves from the narrative, in turn removing themselves from this incident. They've likely anticipated that you'd see through Mirrormoon Entertainment, that it's only a matter of time until you trace it back to Phantom and Quinn...

speaker: Chief
content: But time's also all they need. Their winning condition is successfully holding this concert, where tens of thousands of Eastside citizens will gather as their hostages.

speaker: Schorl
content: If the Bureau's research data on the light sticks is accurate, and if the hypothesis about Hollow Syndrome spreading in sync holds... Given the current crowd density and emotional intensity around the venue, the probability of the situation remaining manageable is estimated at below thirty percent.

speaker: Chief
content: Thirty percent... Let's not be too pessimistic just yet. After all, we still have one major wildcard.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't forget, I was already free before you found me.
[Flashback: In the Alley with Phanuel]

speaker: Chief
content: And before you do, there's one more favor I'd like to ask of you.

speaker: Chief
content: That room Eliza keeps off-limits... is there any way you could get me close to it?
Phanuel sets down her ice cream and gives a small nod, casting a wary glance at the FAC guards keeping watch nearby.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't worry. I'll draw them away.
[Flashback: Bound in the Depot]

speaker: Phanuel
content: Do you remember? The ice cream... the taste of summer, the taste of... freedom?
Phanuel unties the rope around your wrists.

speaker: Phanuel
content: I can't walk away from all of this. The stage, the lights, all the people waiting for Phanuel... I don't know what I am without Eliza.

speaker: Phanuel
content: But... maybe there really is another way? Maybe there's a part of me I've never even let myself hear?

speaker: Phanuel
content: Eliza gave me a reason to exist. But I want to know your answer too. I want to know what I could be... under that open sky.
With the guards still gone, she slips a key into your hand.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Eliza will be preoccupied with concert preparations all day. She shouldn't notice the key is missing. This is about all I can do.

speaker: Phanuel
content: If the world beyond the stage really is as wonderful as you say... please, let Phanuel see it someday.
[Exit flashback]

The team gears up quickly and heads for the concert venue to rendezvous with Wynn's unit. Before leaving, Schorl conducts a final scan of the penthouse, a place that feels more like a showroom than a home.

speaker: Schorl
content: So, aside from confirming that Phanuel could potentially be turned, what information did you obtain here that was worth the risk?
You pull out a few fragments from your pocket, something you found around the living room, where Eliza had been influencing Phanuel mentally.

speaker: Chief
content: Incense of the Death.
[Dressing Room]

Mirrormoon Entertainment had spread word across Cherub fan communities, telling the fans that the check-in time was moved forward. They've also planted a rumor that Phanuel might greet the fans personally before the show.

And it all works. A sea of pink glow has now flooded every street in the surrounding area. The crowd presses against the barriers, waving Phanuel's posters and light boards, chanting the same name over and over—
"Phanuel! Phanuel! Phanuel!"
The roar of the crowd pierces through the venue and into the backstage. Even the bottles and jars on the dressing table are trembling.
Stylists bustle around Phanuel, who's in front of the mirror. They're weaving white feathers, the symbol of the angel that is her, into her golden hair, pinning each strand into place.

speaker: Phanuel
content: It sounds so lively out there. How many people showed up today?

speaker: Eliza
content: Every single one of the thirty thousand seats is filled. We did set the record for the fastest sell-out on the ticketing platform, after all. This is now the largest event DisCity has seen after Nightfall, second only to the Great Expo, just as planned.

speaker: Eliza
content: And that's not all. Countless fans have gathered outside the venue on their own, ready to give their all to cheer you on. It was worth planting all those people across fan communities. They really helped drum up momentum after Phantom Entertainment's statement.

speaker: Phanuel
content: I knew it... This concert means a lot to you, doesn't it, Eliza? You wouldn't have put in so much effort otherwise. Will you really not tell me still? Even though the concert's about to start?

speaker: Eliza
content: Do you really need to know?

speaker: Phanuel
content: Of course! This was never just Phanuel's goal alone, but something that we would accomplish together! That's been the case ever since Eliza took me in, trained me, and gave me the name Phanuel!

speaker: Phanuel
content: I still remember the first time we met. You asked me if I wanted to make a big splash in Eastside together. Back then, I never could have imagined we'd come this far.

speaker: Phanuel
content: You never told me, but I know you have ambitions. You have your own agenda. And now, I want to carry Eliza's true wish with me as I step onto this stage we built together.

speaker: Eliza
content: Our stage? I like the sound of that. But you don't need to worry about my problems. As long as you can leave your mark in this pathetic little city, that's all the vindication I need.

speaker: Eliza
content: Every bit of fame and recognition I never got as a young model—you will reclaim it all for me, one by one.

speaker: Eliza
content: Those same tactics made me despised by countless people and forced me out of the industry. Yet now, they have become the perfect weapon to keep you in the spotlight — to turn you into someone your fans can’t live without. You should be grateful that I found you at the right time.

Eliza fusses over Phanuel's outfit, straightening clothes that are already perfectly in order. In the mirror, Phanuel catches something genuine flickering across Eliza's usually cold face. Something like... the thrill of exacting vengeance.

speaker: Eliza
content: There. Beautiful, as expected of the angel I handpicked. Don't second-guess yourself. We're one step away from the finish line. I'll be right there in the crowd, watching us succeed.

speaker: Phanuel
content: I see. So that's what Eliza has always wanted.
As Phanuel stares at her own reflection, she can't help but feel how different she and Eliza look. Yet she can't put her finger on why.

speaker: Eliza
content: Stop daydreaming. Just five minutes left. Go stand by in the wings.
Phanuel takes a deep breath and puts that perfect smile of hers back on.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Okay. I'm ready.
Eliza is already waiting in the hallway outside the dressing room.
At the far end of the corridor, the stage lift's lights glow like a giant eye, waiting to swallow her whole.
[Outside the Concert Hall - Service Corridor]

Every major entrance to the venue has been filled to the brim with fans, all hoping to catch a glimpse of Phanuel. Luckily, the equipment cases around the back door serve as good cover, so you and your team manage to slip in without issue.

As soon as you step into the fire corridor leading backstage, you find Wynn and the rest of the support team. They moved inside the moment the fan gathering spiraled out of control, and have been waiting for you since.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief! I tried negotiating like you asked, but management refused to cooperate. They don't recognize our authority and are demanding a higher-level administrative order before they'll let us intervene.

speaker: Chief
content: Too many civilians are involved, after all. I wouldn't want to be held responsible for the fallout either, much less risk a stampede with thirty thousand people. The council's been playing hot potato with it too. By the time they reach a verdict, this whole ordeal would be long over.

speaker: Schorl
content: If you wish to seek assistance from Paradeisos, I can help you contact them.

options: Thanks, that's very thoughtful of you.

content: The thought of the people behind certain numbers makes you roll your eyes.

speaker: Chief
content: We're short on time. I'm not about to spend an hour in a meeting debating the value of human lives. I'm plenty grateful that FAC is willing to step in and help.

speaker: Eugene
content: Most of the people here are ordinary civilians though. FAC can't afford to be too heavy-handed, or they'll risk triggering a Mania panic in Eastside. There's a limit to how much they can help.

speaker: Chief
content: That's why we need to shut the concert down before Phanuel takes the stage. It all comes down to how well we work together now.

speaker: Wynn
content: The fact that we managed to meet up with you here, Chief, proves the teamwork is already there.

speaker: Schorl
content: Sorry to interrupt again... I am aware this is not the ideal moment to dampen morale, but based on field reconnaissance data from the advance team, the current window of opportunity is not generous.
Schorl's projection interface lights up on the wall. Several venue schematics flash into view in quick succession, revealing the pipeline routing, power nodes, and a heat map of personnel movement.

speaker: Schorl
content: The venue has a large number of staff, with Mirrormoon's core personnel concentrated in two main areas: the master control room behind the stage, and the equipment server room on the east side of the venue.

speaker: Schorl
content: Based on equipment labels and personnel access levels, we'll most likely find the central signal hub for the glow sticks in the latter.

The two areas are kept separate for emergency isolation purposes. Should either end experience an anomaly, the other can continue operating independently. Accordingly, this also makes coordinating your next moves far more difficult.

speaker: Schorl
content: Based on current M-values, the Mania concentration among Phanuel's fans has reached the critical threshold for the Hollow Syndrome, driven by the emotional climate. We also know that the glow sticks can directly interact with the Mania energy field within range. The moment the signal is severed, all that Mania energy will undergo unpredictable fluctuations.

Right. The spread of Hollow Syndrome has always been relatively contained, leaving you with insufficient data to work from. Once the synchronization of the light sticks is broken, whether the excess psychic energy mutates or coalesces into something unknown, you can't say for sure.

speaker: Chief
content: Then moving into parallel would be our best option right now. We need to seize control of the stage and the glow stick hub at the same time. We'll also need another way to stabilize the M-values across the venue and keep the fans occupied.

speaker: Chief
content: Phanuel should be waiting in the wings by now... Since Eliza's noticed that something's off, she'll definitely be in the control room to make sure nothing goes wrong. In that case, I'll take the control center. Wynn, Eugene, I'll leave the equipment room to you.

speaker: Chief
content: Schorl, keep our communications channel clear throughout. As for what happens after the glow stick hub goes down...
Your gaze shifts to the unfamiliar face that's been hiding behind Wynn this whole time.

speaker: Evie
content: I'll do whatever you need! Just say the word!

speaker: Chief
content: Take it easy. Even if the Mania contamination does go out of control, we always have the shackles as a safety net. Just do what you can. That'll be enough.

speaker: Chief
content: Your friend will hear your voice. I promise.
[Venue Plaza]

speaker: FAC
content:
Emergency alert! Due to severe overcrowding of attendees, a crowd crush or stampede might occur at any moment!
All individuals without tickets must evacuate the premises immediately! Please follow security personnel's instructions and exit the venue!
FAC's loudspeakers repeat the evacuation notice over and over, but the chants and screams of the crowd devour every word.

speaker: Fan A
content: We just want to hear Phanuel's voice! We've done nothing wrong! Why are you driving us away?! I don't see you pointing your weapons at the elites when they throw galas mid-war!

speaker: Fan B
content: Danger?! More like you want to silence Phanuel! Is bullying a girl who loves the stage all you people are good for?!

Phantom Entertainment's perfectly timed inflammatory announcement had done its job, casting Phanuel as the victim in the eyes of an unsuspecting crowd. What began as raw emotion had escalated into a full-blown protest.

speaker: Fan C
content: I came all the way from the West District just for a chance to see Phanuel! What gives you the right to throw me out?! You just wait till I put you online!

A rock flies out from the crowd and strikes the helmet of an officer in the front lines. The FAC officer staggers back, in turn opening a gap, and the crowd instantly surges forward like sharks drawn to blood.

speaker: Fan A
content: Protect Phanuel! Down with the corruption!

speaker: Fan B
content: Don't be afraid, Phanuel! We've got your back! Your Cherubs will always be here for you!
Every voice converges into a single name. Wave after wave of pink light crashes against the FAC's defensive line.

speaker: FAC
content: This is for everyone's safety. Please comply with our instructions—
But the words fall on deaf ears. The tide of people continues to push against the very armor that exists to protect them.

speaker: FAC
content: Stand back! Stop pushing! This is your final warning!

speaker: Fan A
content: Keep going, everyone! They won't actually do anything! Push!
Bang!!!
A deafening shot rings out as smoke grenades detonate in the crowd. The rioting fans freeze in their tracks. The plaza grows silent in an instant.

speaker: FAC
content: The area is now under lockdown. All individuals are to remain in place and evacuate in an orderly fashion. Anyone who fails to comply will be charged with endangering public safety.
The FAC has regained control of the situation. Before the smoke clears, a lone figure slips into the gaps between the crowd.
[Stage]
Phanuel stands beneath the lifting platform. The crew members are running final checks on her microphone and equipment.

Looking up from where she stands, the opening above looks just like a little skylight. The edges are lined with metal frames and track grooves, the lights scattered across the dark arched ceiling appearing just like glittering stars.
She cannot see the audience. Even after countless rehearsals, she still cannot picture what it looks like to have a stadium filled with people who came just for her.
Phanuel's earpiece is live. Through it, she can hear every department hard at work. Sound, ready. Wardrobe and makeup, standing by. Lighting, calibrated.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Looks like everyone has something they want to do for themselves...
One by one, the crew members step back, clearing the space around the platform for Phanuel.
She stares at the pitch-black ceiling, yet what appears before her is an entirely different sky.

It is vast and blue. Beneath it are streams of traffic and swaying tree shadows. The melting ice cream slowly drips down the sides of its box, carrying that cheap artificial sweetness she'd never tasted before. The corner of her mouth curves up, ever so slightly.

speaker: Phanuel
content: ...Ice cream.
She murmurs it softly, as if savoring that unfamiliar word for the first time.
[Flashback: Unbinding Chief at the Depot]
She hesitates for a long moment before handing over Eliza's key.

speaker: Phanuel
content: You've asked me so many questions. Can I ask you one?

speaker: Phanuel
content: You came looking for me because of the Hollow Syndrome from the very start, right?

speaker: Phanuel
content: Can I know why you're so determined to see this through? Why do you want to help those victims so much? To the point where you'd let yourself be dragged all the way here?

speaker: Phanuel
content: And... how do you know why you're doing all this?
Freedom. The taste of summer. The open sky. The humid, scorched streets. These things have branded themselves into her skin, impossible to ignore, impossible to heal from.
The person before her takes some time to ponder the question, then answers with the same steadiness as always.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I never really think about these things before I act. But if I had to say... I do it for the people I have to protect, the truth I have to uncover, and the responsibility that comes with my power.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where the meaning comes from matters less than you think. But that's not something I can teach you in a moment. It takes a lot of living outside the spotlight to understand.

speaker: Phanuel
content: I see. Looks like this question's a bit too hard for you too...
[Exit flashback]
Bang! The lights above suddenly blaze to life. Pulsing pink beams cut through the narrow opening of the lifting platform.
The restless crowd outside ignites in an instant. What follows is a deafening roar. Phanuel knows. It's time.
The big screens begin rolling footage of her past performances. From Love & Chocolate, her song that went viral the moment she debuted, to her most recent and controversial concert premiere...

speaker: Phanuel
content: Come on, Phanuel, you need to get those wicked thoughts out now. What if he doesn't even show up?
female_content: Come on, Phanuel, you need to get those wicked thoughts out now. What if she doesn't even show up?

speaker: Fans (in unison)
content: "Ten!" "Nine!" "Eight!"

The countless voices crash in from every direction, pouring through panels and steel frames, flooding that small pocket of space beneath the platform. Those are the frenzy and devotion of fans from every corner of DisCity.

speaker: Fans (in unison)
content: "Seven!" "Six!"
Phanuel can hear her own heartbeat. She closes her eyes, adjusts her earpiece, and takes a deep breath.

speaker: Fans (in unison)
content: "Five!" "Four!"
Tracy is sitting in the front row of Section A, all dressed up. Her face is carefully done, light stick held to her chest, counting down with reverence like everyone else.

speaker: Fans (in unison)
content: "Three!"

speaker: Fans (in unison)
content: "Two!"

speaker: Fans (in unison)
content: "One!"
[Design a grand entrance for Joan, keep playing Joan's guitar]
Good evening, Eastside. I'm your special guest for tonight—
A piercing guitar riff tears through the air.

speaker: Joan
content: Not that I was invited. Guess that means I'm just here to crash the party!
Her voice reaches all the way backstage. The Bureau team, who were getting ready for their operation there, freeze in place.
The venue's security team is the first to react. They lunge forward to intercept, only to find a silver gun barrel leveled at their faces.
The gun's owner doesn't spare them so much as a glance, eyes locked on the uninvited guest up on stage.

speaker: Jane
content: Found you.
At the center of the stage, Joan is strumming her guitar furiously, the wild and surging melody sending tremors through every seat.
A storm of jeers and insults rises from the crowd below, but Joan doesn't care. Compared to hate comments in a livestream chat, this is practically a standing ovation.

Hurried footsteps echo from the shadows as wave after wave of security personnel pour out to catch her. But she simply tears across the stage, guitar clutched to her chest, weaving through every attempt to corner her.
Audio cables lie tangled across the floor in every direction, snagging at her ankles more than once. Still, that's not enough to slow her charge toward the front of the stage.

speaker: Joan
content: Wow, you can't even dodge a guitar? So much for an angel's bodyguard.
The music continues to build up, surging into its most electrifying passage yet.

The fans' verbal attacks don't let up for a second either, yet all that seething hostility does nothing to derail the performance. If anything, it's fuel to the fire, driving the chaotic, feverish show step by step toward its climax.

speaker: Schorl
content: An unplanned variable has emerged. While it works in our favor, from an organizational discipline standpoint... It seems you'll need to tighten management, Chief.

speaker: Chief
content: A tamed Joan couldn't write music like this. Take the win and shut it.
Using the chaotic performance as cover, you and Schorl lead the elite team to quietly close in on the target location, neutralizing every staff member you cross along the way.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief... we've successfully infiltrated backstage! We've located the glow stick hub as well. Moving in as we speak!

speaker: Chief
content: Good work, we're almost at the control room. But why's your voice shaking?

speaker: Wynn
content: I'm just... excited! I've never been a part of an operation this big, after all!
The driving rock beat perfectly masks the team's movements. The strike team alongside Wynn has already surrounded and secured the entire equipment area.
Eugene is standing guard at the sole entrance, running a final magazine check. Cole follows close behind, eyes drifting to a large Phanuel promotional poster on the wall.

speaker: Eugene
content: We're about to sabotage your idol's concert. Try not to get so worked up that you mess up.

speaker: Cole
content: Relax, I've done plenty of distraction resistance training. Even if Phanuel herself showed up right in front of me, I could hold myself back from asking for a handshake!
The first chorus ends, its restless melody still lingering. Joan brings her worn pick to her lips, gives it a light kiss, then flings it with a flourish into the angry crowd below.

She has made this stage entirely her own, lost in her music and the release it brings. She coolly produces another pick, readying herself for the next passage, completely oblivious to the predatory eyes below.

speaker: Wynn
content: Jane, stand down! Joan's one of us.

speaker: Jane
content: She trespassed, disrupted order, resisted with violence, and... the adjutant paid me a lot.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief just passed down new orders. This chaos is exactly what we need right now. We need it to continue.
After a full three or four seconds of silence, Jane lowers her weapon and turns her back to the stage.

speaker: Jane
content: ...Copy that. Protecting the target, Joan.

The words are barely out of her mouth when two security guards charge up the stairs and toward the stage. Jane steps into position, drives her rifle stock straight into the first man's chest, and shoves them both back in a single motion. As she does, she catches more guards creeping in from the stage's blind spots in the corner of her eye.

Jane immediately pulls back and raises her weapon, placing her shots precisely at the guard's feet to drive him off. The two muffled gunshots vanish into the music, unnoticed by the crowd below. Only Joan, up on stage, catches every beat of the skirmish unfolding in the shadows.

speaker: Jane
content: Keep playing. I'll handle the floor.
Joan raises an eyebrow, grins, and immediately turns to the crowd and flips them off.

speaker: Joan
content: This next one goes out to the megastar who treats other people's original work like it doesn't exist, and her almighty team that makes it all happen!
A few brief, muffled sounds of a scuffle crack through the comms before quickly settling. Schorl's calm, electronic voice cuts through.

speaker: Schorl
content: Our team has safely reached the control room. To prevent the situation from spiraling out of control prematurely, Chief intends to conduct one final negotiation with Eliza. All units are to stand by and await further orders.
The threats in the equipment room have been largely neutralized. The tech team is running final checks on the explosive device set to destroy the signal hub.

speaker: Eugene
content: All units, report in.

speaker: Guard A
content: All non-essential personnel have been cleared from the entrances and exits. The east audience corridor has been evacuated, and all fire exits are open.

speaker: Cole
content: We've completed a sweep of all other areas as well. Stands, restrooms, storage rooms, server room. No secondary Mania source found anywhere.

speaker: Eugene
content: Good work. Everybody, stand by.
[Below the Stage]
Phanuel is still waiting alone below the stage. Just then, an unfamiliar blonde woman with a guitar on her back swings past overhead.
So cool! Is that a guitar? Eliza once thought about having me learn an instrument, but there wasn't anything I particularly liked... or disliked, really...
The guitar's sound filters through her earpiece, and Phanuel begins to hum along.
It sounds a lot like my song, but... something's different? What, though...?
She recalls her reflection in the mirror, and Eliza's. Recalls herself under the blazing sun, and Chief.
I'm different from all of them, I think...?
[Control Room]

speaker: Eliza
content: Where's the stage manager? Why's that person still up there? Get someone to remove her immediately. By whatever means necessary.

speaker: Eliza
content: Cut the lights and sound too. Use any excuse you can—a warm-up act, whatever. Just skip past this part and redirect the crowd's attention.

speaker: Eliza
content: And get Phanuel in position now. You have three minutes to get her on stage!
But no matter how hard she hammers the intercom, nothing but static and corrupted noise answers her.
If you're waiting for Phantom Entertainment to come to your rescue, that's not happening. Just so you know.

speaker: Chief
content: The Bureau verified this in advance. They've submitted the documents already, formally withdrawing all investment and cutting all ties with you and Mirrormoon.

speaker: Eliza
content: I knew you wouldn't give up so easily. Guards—
The moment Eliza raises the intercom, Schorl's laser finds its mark and blasts it to pieces.

speaker: Chief
content: You're the one who should give up. The Bureau has taken control of this whole place.

speaker: Eliza
content: ...I should've dealt with you on the street when I had the chance.

She still stands her ground, even positioning herself in front of the control panel. You've already looked into Eliza. She's just an ordinary person with no powers. In a Mania case like this, she's nothing more than an operative who's being used.

speaker: Chief
content: What exactly did Phantom Entertainment offer to make you go this far? Well, the Bureau will get to the bottom of this whether you answer or not, of course. It only determines your fate here.

speaker: Eliza
content: Hahaha... I've worked as a talent manager for years now, and I've dealt with all kinds of people in the industry. So, I'd like to think I'm a decent judge of character. And from what you just said, I can already tell—

speaker: Eliza
content: You have a fulfilling life, don't you? Every day has meaning, a purpose. Your efforts are recognized. I've done my research. People like you were never my target.

speaker: Schorl
content: I don't detect any signs of willingness to cooperate with the investigation. Immediate disposal recommended—
You step in front of Schorl.

speaker: Eliza
content: See? You want to spare me. Just like how you tried to get through to Phanuel. You managed to get all that evidence, fought your way here... She's helped you quite a bit, I'd assume? Bet you think your efforts paid off, huh? You must be real proud of yourself right now.

speaker: Eliza
content: You urged her to find her own voice, urged the crowd to wake up, and now you're urging me to turn over a new leaf and cooperate with your investigation. Then what? Can you take responsibility for every single one of those thirty thousand people?

speaker: Eliza
content: You can't. Be honest, Chief. You don't care one bit about what kind of lives those nobodies lead after the show ends, about the things happening in every corner of this city...

speaker: Eliza
content: But I do. I know what they like to watch, what they need, what troubles them, what time of day they pick up their phones and which platforms they check. I know them even better than they know themselves.
She lists her methods of lining her pockets one by one, as though tallying up her trophies.

speaker: Eliza
content: Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to take something that costs next to nothing and sell it to them at dozens of times the price. Crazy? Absurd? Oh, believe me, they know. But look at them. They love every second of it, no? Can you make them smile with pure bliss like that, Chief?

speaker: Chief
content: You make it sound so romantic, but they're really just drowning in a delusion. A scam.

speaker: Eliza
content: And do you honestly think they wouldn't have lost themselves in delusions if Phanuel weren't around? They'll only start looking at other stars, at other forms of entertainment.

speaker: Eliza
content: Phanuel's power is no different from the kind of brainwashing those people do. It's just a faster, easier method. You can't understand it simply because this particular trap was never meant for you.

speaker: Chief
content: I would never deny people the right to seek comfort. But that's no excuse for using special powers to influence, poison minds, and make a profit off of manipulating them! Since you've made up your mind to take the fall for all of this... you'll bear the consequences of your failure too.

speaker: Eliza
content: Failure? Hahaha... I told you, I'm a good judge of character. There were so many young, pretty girls in Eastside. Phanuel can't even sing or dance that well. Did you really think I chose her solely for her powers?

As soon as she finishes speaking, Eliza slowly loosens her grip on the documents she had been using as cover. Tendrils of deep violet mist rise from her palm, spreading rapidly until they fill every corner of the room.

speaker: Schorl
content: A psychoactive smoke. She was stalling!

Schorl moves instantly, stepping in front of you and deploying a shield. The sudden mental trap throws your team's formation into disarray. The mist spreads at terrifying speed in the sealed space, cutting off sight lines and dulling all senses.
The external comms channel crackles restlessly. Everyone's waiting for the next order from the control room.

speaker: Jane
content: I'm running low on ammo. This isn't good...

Even with your hands clamped over your mouth and nose, you couldn't avoid breathing in traces of the mist. Your vision fractures, the afterimages of the equipment beginning to overlap. Fragments of sounds that shouldn't be there pierce your ears, overwhelming them. Your reason and senses are being corrupted, pulled apart at the seams.

speaker: Chief
content: So this is how you controlled Phanuel... How long have you been doing this to her...?

An intense wave of dizziness and numbness crashes through your body. You reach out for the wall, pressing against it to keep yourself upright, jaw clenched. You do what you can to force your mind back together.

speaker: Chief
content: Ha. A good judge of character, was it? All you can see are people's weaknesses. Yes, people can be frail, avoidant, dependent... but you're blind to everything that actually makes them worth something.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm standing before you precisely because there are those who choose to fight against an unjust hand, who choose to shoulder responsibility and face danger head-on, who choose to fight for a real connection... And these are the very same things that will bring your downfall.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief. Awaiting your orders.

speaker: Chief
content: Game over, Eliza.

The moment the words leave your lips, your fractured senses snap back into focus. The shackles lash out, sweeping the toxic mist away in one clean motion. Your vision clears completely, and only then does Eliza realize that someone had already silently slipped behind her, using the mist as cover.
Still, she tries to fight back. Only this time, Schorl gives her no such opening. A laser finds her left shoulder with pinpoint precision.
Meanwhile, Evie has already switched on the venue-wide microphone.

speaker: Evie
content: Hello everyone, I'm Evie, an employee at Otriana... I know that none of you really care, but... I've got to say this anyway. I'm here for a friend of mine.
[Stage]

speaker: Tracy
content: Evie...

speaker: Evie
content: She's the most incredible person I've ever met. She always jokes about not having the best education or the best background, yet she got herself to the same place as everyone who had a head start, all on her own!

speaker: Evie
content: She scrimps and saves every day, hits every impossible target they throw at her, and pushes herself to the limit just to earn a shot at a permanent position.

Joan perceptively slows down, pulling the melody back for the person speaking. Elsewhere, Jane, worn down by the prolonged battle, yet holds on. Despite her ammunition being spent, and despite her body having long gone past its limits.

speaker: Evie
content: What makes her truly incredible is that she'd still look up at the sky, even in that lifeless office! She could see the hope beyond her little desk, the vibrant world on the other side of the glass, and she saw... me, an exhausted, worn-down soul.

speaker: Evie
content: It's tiring, isn't it? Living up to your family's expectations, chasing goals endlessly in a city that still feels foreign to you. That's why Phanuel drew you in. That's why you felt like you belonged here. Right, Tracy?
With every word Evie says, the mental synchronization that has gripped the venue begins to quietly loosen. The comms go silent as each unit holds its position, waiting for the right moment to move.

speaker: Evie
content: I'm not here to stop you! I won't turn you away like I did last time!

speaker: Evie
content: Starting today, I want to cheer for Phanuel right alongside you!

speaker: Evie
content: Because, Tracy, you're the toughest, most incredible person I know! I believe in your choices! Tracy, and everyone, please believe in yourselves! Stay true to yourself, and love what you love!

speaker: Evie
content: Tracy, can you hear me? I'm not cheering for a Cherub, or anyone's fan. I'm cheering for "you"!

speaker: Evie
content: Please, find your own voices again! I'd love to meet more of you. The real you!
[Stage Shakes]

The moment Evie's speech ends, her sincerity takes shape as tiny, warm orange dots of light, riding the waves of sound and spreading through the venue. The tiny sparks weave through the crowd and the equipment, dispersing the hardened synchronization waves and shattering the mental grip that has held the entire stadium captive.

speaker: Wynn
content: Data's within range. Eugene!
Bang! The final note of Joan's song lands at the same moment as the explosion.

speaker: Eugene
content: Energy device destroyed!

speaker: Guard A
content: All clear on my end! The audience hasn't caught on to us!

speaker: Cole
content: The glow sticks of the fans outside are going out too!

speaker: Joan
content: Thought you were actually gonna throw me under the bus. Didn't think you'd actually pull it off—

speaker: Jane
content: All guards near the main stage cleared. Joan is safe. Mission complete.
[Below the Lifting Platform]
Is it over? It's completely quiet out there...
Struggle, clashes, a battle for supremacy... Phanuel listens to it all through her earpiece from below the stage. So close, yet worlds away.
I heard his voice! I knew he'd come!
female_content: I heard her voice! I knew she'd come!

content: Phanuel's channel connects to the control room.
What are they talking about? Does it have something to do with Phanuel?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: All you can see are people's weaknesses. Yes, people can be frail, avoidant, dependent... but you're blind to everything that actually makes them worth something.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm standing before you precisely because there are those who choose to fight against an unjust hand, who choose to shoulder responsibility and face danger head-on, who choose to fight for a real connection... And these are the very same things that will bring your downfall.
There he goes again, saying things that Phanuel has never seen on a script...
female_content: There she goes again, saying things that Phanuel has never seen on a script...

content: <color=#FFC9F3><i>What actually makes us worth something, huh... does Phanuel have that too?
<color=#FFC9F3><i>I have a pretty face! Wait, no, that probably doesn't count...
<color=#FFC9F3><i>I'm obedient and do everything Eliza says? No, that person said that's not a good thing...

<color=#FFC9F3><i>I have all of my Cherubs! They all love Phanuel, they think I'm adorable, they love the way I sing and dance, the way I look on variety shows, in commercials... every single bit of it... the look that Eliza designed...
<color=#FFC9F3><i>I... I...
She looks up in a daze as a warm orange light pours in like sunlight.

speaker: Evie
content: Please, find your own voices again! I'd love to meet more of you. The real you!
<color=#FFC9F3><i>The real me...
The sound of Eliza's defeat comes through the earpiece. As she is dragged away, she sends one last whisper Phanuel's way.

speaker: Eliza
content: Do you hear me, child...? The person you believe in cannot truly save you. Only you can make that choice... Face it. You know what you really want. You've always known!
What is it... that I want?

speaker: Phanuel
content: But Phanuel doesn't know what an idol doesn't need! I was born for this!

speaker: Phanuel
content: I can't walk away from all of this. The stage, the lights, all the people waiting for Phanuel... I don't know what I am without Eliza.
The smoke clears from the stage. In the front row of the stands, one girl seems to have come back to her senses before the rest.

speaker: Tracy
content: I... why am I here?
Tracy stares at the light stick and ticket in her hands, dazed.

speaker: Tracy
content: Wait, am I at Phanuel's concert? Is this... my ticket? Front row, Section A!!! Holy ****, it's so expensive! When did I even buy this...
Now I know what makes me different from everyone else... I have nothing of my own. I was born to be an idol. I was born to bring happiness to others. I was born to keep everyone's eyes on me...
Stay here. Stay where you are.
We promised we'd be together forever. Without that... Phanuel is nothing...
<color=#FFC9F3><i>Phanuel has no wings. There is no place for me beneath that open sky.
[Flashback: D2 Eloping]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Lesson one: In this situation, a normal person would ask, "So, where are we going?"
I-I want to be on the stage. I want everyone looking at my face. At my perfect face.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Lesson two: don't think, don't recall. Just tell me how you feel.
My palms are warm. My whole body is warm. My breathing keeps getting faster... like when the sun is shining down on me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why? What makes you feel that way?
Because... I was born to be seen by all. I was born to be a star...
[Exit flashback]
Phanuel walks toward the front of the stage, one step at a time, as if pulled by an invisible force.

speaker: Fan C
content: Phanuel...? I-I see her! She's down there, off the stage!

speaker: Fan C
content: <size=44>An angel... she's really an angel...</size>

speaker: Fans (in unison)
content: <size=50>Phanuel! Angel! Phanuel! Angel!</size>
Between an umbrella and the open sky... I'd choose the sky...
But between being an angel and being ordinary... I choose who I am now!
Just as Tracy gets to her feet, apologizing as she tries to make her way through the crowd, a faint whisper reaches her ear.
What's this? You cried out for salvation, but you won't even heed the divine word of an angel?

Tracy spins around, but Phanuel is nowhere to be seen. A heartbeat later, a strange, draining sensation washes over her entire body, and her soul and consciousness tear free from the confines of her flesh, slipping away uncontrollably.
[Control Room]
The muffled groans of pain and a series of crashing sounds come through the comms channel.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Jane. What's going on?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Joan? Joan!
Neither Jane nor Joan responds. Then, the frenzied roar of the crowd bleeds through the receiver.
[Stage]

speaker: Phanuel
content: Everyone! Sorry to keep you waiting.
That familiar intro begins to play. A single feather drifts through the blinding spotlight, spiraling slowly downward. Then, in an instant, the angel descends from above.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Welcome to Phanuel's concert!

speaker: Fans (in unison)
content: <size=50>Phanuel! Angel! Phanuel! Angel!</size>

When you reach the floor, the scene you witness is suffocating. Tens of thousands of faces, blank and blissful in a sickening sort of way. Their shrill, frenzied screams rise in layers upon layers, their light sticks sweeping in perfect unison, ultimately forming one terrifying wave of collective rapture.

speaker: Schorl
content: Anomaly detected! The glow stick signal hub has been completely destroyed, yet the crowd's Mania resonance remains uninterrupted. They are synchronizing autonomously. Contamination continues to accumulate.
On stage, Jane has been blasted into a corner and lies unconscious. Joan attempts to fight back, but her sonic resistance means nothing before thirty thousand devotees.
With a single wink from Phanuel, the crowd erupts in screams. An overwhelming surge of awe sweeps across the stage in an instant, snapping every last string on Joan's guitar.

speaker: Joan
content: Darn it...
MBCC guards and the full FAC team hold the front rows with everything they have, fighting to shield the audience inside from Phanuel's influence.
But the waves of mental corruption are unrelenting. All they can do is grit their teeth and endure. The defensive line is on the verge of collapse, every second draining beyond imagination.

speaker: Wynn
content: The Mania contamination is materializing. If even Jane and Joan can't hold out against it, then we probably...
Wynn looks up. Phanuel stands at the center of the stage. She's blinding, radiant beyond measure—the only light in the abyss, and the very thing that will devour everything.
That dazzling smile draws in the whole world's gaze. It almost feels like that void can take away everything real. The Bureau, work, the Mania crisis...
Just as Wynn's is about to lose her grip on reality, a solid barrier rises up before her.
[Shackles Effect]

speaker: Chief
content: Don't look. Don't listen. Phanuel's power forcibly drags people into a delusional state of elevated M-value. Keep your mind anchored. The happiness she offers is a lie. Don't let yourself be assimilated.
The shackles extend, weaving together a shield. But it's almost like every cheer from the crowd below is striking the barrier, physically.

speaker: Schorl
content: Bad news—your attempt to counsel Phanuel and turn her against her manager has failed. Continuing this standoff will drain your strength as well. The good news, though, is that given the current scale of contamination, I can secure a higher level of backup authorization for you.
Seeing no response from you, the bipyramid waves in front of your face.

speaker: Schorl
content: Are you thinking of another plan of attack?

speaker: Chief
content: I'm thinking... maybe deliberately pushing her to resist was a mistake from the very beginning. Maybe I shouldn't have tried to drag a blank slate out of her comfort zone...

speaker: Eliza
content: You urged her to find her own voice, urged the crowd to wake up, and now you're urging me to turn over a new leaf and cooperate with your investigation. Then what? Can you take responsibility for every single one of those thirty thousand people?
At the far end of your vision is Phanuel, standing at center stage. She's radiant and jubilant, her arms raised high, openly embracing the overwhelming adoration that has flooded the entire venue.

speaker: Phanuel
content: My Cherubs! We finally get to meet again! Were you all wondering where your angel had gone earlier? And why there was a stranger up on stage?

speaker: Phanuel
content: Actually, Phanuel realized I'd lost something very, very important before coming on stage. Will everyone help Phanuel find it?
The moment the words leave her lips, a thunderous roar once more.

speaker: Phanuel
content: It all started because I met a strange person recently. He told me that I need to listen to my own true voice, that I need to find my own answer, and that I can't keep living inside someone else's script.
female_content: It all started because I recently met a strange person. She told me that I need to listen to my own true voice, that I need to find my own answer, and that I can't keep living inside someone else's script.

speaker: Phanuel
content: And then he suddenly asked me: what kind of life did I actually want to live?
female_content: And then she suddenly asked me: what kind of life did I actually want to live?

content: As she speaks, Phanuel's gaze sweeps through the crowd, as if searching for someone. Then, she tilts her head, like one would when they're confused.

speaker: Phanuel
content: What a deep, complicated question. Phanuel gave it so much thought, but still couldn't come up with an answer. But then, Phanuel thought of her Cherubs.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Phanuel is always the one listening to everyone's worries, but maybe this time, you could be the ones to help Phanuel out? So—

speaker: Phanuel
content: I opened up the chat app's message board. And I heard your voices!
[Outside the Venue]

Eliza has been taken into custody and is being escorted into a Public Security Bureau investigation vehicle on suspicion of spreading Mania. Just as the car door is about to close, the familiar melodies of Phanuel's new song ring out from inside the venue.
She struggles against the officers, straining to crane her neck toward the venue. At the sight of the pink beam of light illuminating the sky, a satisfied smile crosses her face.

speaker: Eliza
content: Yes, that's it. That's my Phanuel! Everything she sees and hears every day has been carefully crafted by me! That includes her desires.

She recalls Chief's confident expression. Even now, it brings her nothing but satisfaction. Because that person never understood—the glow stick hub had always been the least important piece of this concert.

speaker: Eliza
content: I should thank you for making her curious about freedom and self-discovery... She's now chosen, of her own free will, to be everyone's angel. It's <color=#FFC9F3>Phanuel</color> who held the biggest concert Eastside has ever seen. It is I who gave her that name... and it will finally be remembered by history.
She looks out the car window at the fans parading across the plaza and the posters plastered everywhere. Then her eyes trace the outline of Phanuel's image.

speaker: Eliza
content: Congratulations. The attention you so desperately craved... is yours at last.
[Stage]

The stage has become a vast altar. The angel stands at the center of the spotlight, flawlessly performing the sweetness and warmth she has rehearsed a thousand times over, drinking in the devotion and adulation of the thirty thousand heads bowed before her.

speaker: Phanuel
content: One voice said, "Phanuel, I'm graduating this year. Everyone's telling me to find a good job. But I don't know what I like. I don't know what I want to do, Phanuel. All I want is to be with you forever, but my parents won't allow it."
It's okay. Forget all of that, and just stay with me.

speaker: Phanuel
content: And another said, "Phanuel, I wanted to learn to paint when I was little, but my family said I couldn't make any money from painting. So I gave up. But watching you up on the stage, smiling despite all the criticism, I regret not being as brave as you."
That's right, come. Be just like Phanuel. Smile forever.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Then there were those who couldn't find meaning in marriage, those who couldn't find meaning in improving, in repeating the same routine every single day... in chasing dreams, in living, and so, so much more hahahaha!
So many lost, worthless, hollow lives!

speaker: Schorl
content: Chief, the crowds in the plaza are also being influenced by the Mania. They've blocked our reinforcements' routes, so it'll take some time for the main unit to arrive.
You look through the shifting layers of protective light, and at Phanuel on stage. Radiant, and yet a complete stranger.

speaker: Chief
content: What do you think she's saying?

speaker: Schorl
content: Referencing her established patterns. She's adopting the angel persona to strike at the audience's vulnerabilities, leveraging their emptiness and confusion to reinforce psychic synchronization and intensify Mania bonding.

speaker: Chief
content: No... She's saying, help me.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm the one who taught her how to choose. I brought her doubt and change, so I must see it through myself. Hold the line here for now, Triangle Face... Cover me. I'm going up on stage.
Phanuel spreads her arms wide at the center of the stage. Behind her, phantom angel wings slowly unfurl. Countless invisible wires extend from the wingbones, lifting her gently into the air...

speaker: Phanuel
content: I see, so everyone's just like Phanuel after all. None of us know what kind of life we want to choose.

speaker: Phanuel
content: There are tens of thousands of people here right now. But it turns out that we were never the strange ones—it has always been those who want to protect their dreams, to stop disasters, to fulfill a mission, and to keep their friends safe!
She walks along the edge of the stage. And where she treads, the light follows.

speaker: Phanuel
content: It looks like what Phanuel lost was my <color=#FFC9F3>true self</color>. But that's alright. I've made my choice—

speaker: Phanuel
content: You wanted a perfect idol, so I became perfect. So, if what you want is a vast, hollow vessel, filled to the brim with your voices, then I'll become just that!

speaker: Phanuel
content: Look at me... Love me. Your eyes, your time and energy, your "self" that never quite belonged... Offer it all to Phanuel...
Let our worthless lives give rise to a star that the world will adore...
Phanuel reproduces the smiles and tears she knows by heart, performing the exact gestures her data says will move anyone—

speaker: Phanuel
content: Phanuel doesn't know if this is right. But this is Phanuel's... the only answer I could find that truly belongs to me.

speaker: Tracy
content: Yes... I want to be with Phanuel...
One, two, three... The murmurs spread like seeds taking root.
The crowd offers a hymn to the angel in unison. They abandon all thought, surrender their minds, and willingly step into the pink illusion.
The myriad wills dissolve into one, converging into a new gospel.

speaker: Schorl
content: Hollow individuals are beginning to appear within the security forces and FAC as well... The protective barrier's coverage is shrinking...
[Small CG: Phanuel lowers her head, energy converging onto her, wings gradually spreading open]

Phanuel has risen into the air. An invisible psychic tide slowly sweeps through the crowd, gently peeling away and absorbing those wandering emotions. Every last shred of confusion and uncertainty is being drawn into her, becoming one with her.

speaker: Phanuel
content: Let those strange people with their precious sense of direction march on ahead. Let them continue sitting high in their thrones, telling others what they should and shouldn't do.
The Angel spreads her wings, the idol opens her arms, and a false vision engulfs the entire venue—

speaker: Phanuel
content: My Cherubs, stay here with Phanuel. In this void that's begging to be filled. Lose yourself in the bliss completely, utterly, and...
[Big CG: Stage, Spread Wings]

speaker: Phanuel
content: Enter Elysium!

speaker: Fans
content: <size=50><color=#FFC9F3>Phanuel... Angel... Phanuel... Angel...</size></color>
The sea of pink light breaks free from the physical cage of the light sticks. The seats turn pink. The barriers turn pink. Where Phanuel reigns, even the speakers turn pink.
Schorl's defenses are riddled with holes by now, and even the Hypercubes on the FAC's chests are slowly losing their color.
At the center of this pink ocean lies a sanctuary of pure, unadulterated white. That is where the angel dwells.

The never-ending hymn of devotion lifts her wings and carries her higher and higher. She looks down upon the hollow shells drowning alongside her in the void, as they bear witness to the birth of an angel.

This is the stage Eliza built for her. This is the gate to paradise she was always meant to open. She has purified this place, she has stripped away everything, leaving but a single obsessive murmur, echoing for eternity: purify, ascend, bliss—

<color=#FFC9F3></color>
Yet within this pristine illusion where all have fallen, the angel's lowered gaze catches a single gray speck moving against the tide.
Try as it might, the pink cannot taint you.
Red spikes tear through the blissful gospel, piercing layer after layer of the illusion. You press forward step by step into the heart of the sanctum.
A warped haze of light floods your vision, forcing you to squint. It takes a moment before the scene at the center comes into focus.
Not far ahead, a long, crumbling staircase of the void is flaking away, inch by inch. At the top of the stairs stands a familiar silhouette.
You rush forward, but the silhouette retreats into the mist, leaving nothing but a trail of feathers behind.
You look toward where Phanuel vanished. The crumbling steps stretch upward in broken fragments, reaching into the sky.
[Water Dripping Sound Effect] [Scene Change: Home]
The scene before you shatters into pixels, fractures, and reassembles into an unfamiliar living room. It's lavishly decorated, clearly worth a fortune. Yet, there's no sign of Phanuel anywhere.
Daddy, look! My teacher said I did a really good job today and gave me this little red flower sticker!
female_content: Mommy, look! My teacher said I did a really good job today and gave me this little red flower sticker!

content: You follow the sound and look down to find a doll at your feet.
"Daddy?" Is it talking... to you?
female_content: "Mommy?" Is it talking... to you?

options: Ignore the doll and keep looking for Phanuel

content: But the doll grabs the hem of your pants just like a child would.
Its eyeless face tilts up toward you, desperate for your praise.

speaker: Unfamiliar Voice
content: Good job. My child deserves nothing but the finest honors. Do you know why your teacher praised you?
Your voice comes out cold, the voice of a middle-aged man.
female_content: Your voice comes out cold, the voice of a middle-aged woman.

speaker: Doll
content: Because I made the best work in the class! I'm more amazing than all of the other kids!

speaker: Unfamiliar Voice
content: Wrong!
Your tone suddenly turns stern, your grip on the doll tightening.

speaker: Unfamiliar Voice
content: Your teacher praised you because you are my child. Everything you wear is custom-made designer wear. You ride to kindergarten in a luxury car. When your teacher came for a home visit, she saw that you live in the most prestigious neighborhood in all of Eastside.

speaker: Doll
content: Designer wear? What's that? Is it something really, really good? Does that mean Daddy and Mommy love me a lot?
The little cotton head sways proudly from side to side. Your hand, which was reaching out to pat her head, stops.

speaker: Unfamiliar Voice
content: Love? That's for people without money. What we give you is worth far more than that. Designer brands are status and prestige. They make everyone look up to you.

speaker: Unfamiliar Voice
content: You are our child. You represent our name, so you cannot let anyone look down on you.
The little cotton head nods solemnly and earnestly. You try to end this conversation to no avail.

speaker: Unfamiliar Voice
content: What you want doesn't matter. Instead, observe what others have. Then, you take it. Once all the money, power, dignity, and security in the world are yours, all of those cheap things you've ever wanted will also be well within reach.

speaker: Doll
content: Okay! I understand now! ███ is Daddy and Mommy's pride! Higher, lift me higher!
You cannot make out her original name.
The doll laughs cheerfully as it's tossed up into the air—

You wrench free from the body that was controlling you. But just as your fingers are about to close around it, the doll grazes your fingertips and crashes to the ground, twisting into a warped plastic figure.
[Water droplet sound effect] [Scene Change: Hospital, Barbie Doll]

speaker: Doll
content: Are these people in the photo my parents? Did they lie to a lot of people and take their money?

speaker: Doll
content: No. Everything's all fuzzy. I just know there were a lot of people in uniforms, and some yellow tape. Then I got scared and fell from somewhere—

speaker: Doll
content: When I woke up, I saw more and more people holding microphones and cameras. They kept asking me questions.

speaker: Doll
content: Hmm? You don't know what you asked me, sir?
female_content: Hmm? You don't know what you asked me, ma'am?

content: The doll's warped head snaps toward you with a click, and with that, you lose control of your voice once more.
