content: But these are the memories we've truly lived in this city. If the Almighty Bow allows it, I won't mind recounting them personally.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Congratulations, you gave the right answer.
She comes to your side and takes your hand, helping you lift the Almighty Bow light as a feather yet heavy as a stele.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Don't rush. This is Eastia's special archery ritual. Xu never taught you this in your dreams, did she?

speaker: Du Ruo
content: No worries, I'm here. I'll teach you.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: You are very smart. I'm sure you'll get the hang of it right away.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Lower your shoulders. Open up your chest. Use your back muscles and keep your arms level, just like this...
She lifts your arms and surrounds you with her smoke, helping you suppress the sinister fire spilling out of the bow and the chaotic whispers from all over DisCity.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Next, listen carefully...
In the darkness, the world suddenly quiets down. The noise of the border's sandstorm and those inexplicable whispers all fade away.
The bowstring suppresses the Mania and the bow trembles as familiar figures emerge in your mind.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: The equipment has fused again. We can't mend the gap now. The Apostles will soon...
A soldier cries out as his Hypercube shield shatters. Just as a monster is about to pounce on him, a large shield lands before him firmly.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Sir?!

speaker: FAC Officer
content: I got this. Go fix the equipment or find a backup. Hurry!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: But...
The officer dawdles no more and turns to charge at the next monster. In the flurry of the battlefield, he doesn't notice a new threat approaching from the side.
The patterned green light shining down from above clears the threat beside him. The soldier instantly recognizes who has helped him.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: It's the Eastian sorcery!

speaker: FAC Officer
content: ...Heh, like I need their help.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Yanyan, leave this to us. Don't overexert yourself!

speaker: Yanyan
content: It's okay, I can hold on. It's my turn to support everyone now...
Syndicans gather in squares everywhere, looking up at the sky with anxious hearts filled with unfounded hope.
At the Rust, scavengers sit together and pray softly. Even in Eastside, hurried passersby halt their steps. They all hear it.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: What do you hear?
The echoes continue as more and more people flash past your memory. Gradually, you begin to hear vague shouts, the sparse voices drawing closer and growing more unified.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I hear... what you hear. People are afraid and panicking, but they also want to survive the calamity. The simplest wish becomes the unbreakable myth that crosses mountains and seas.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: For someone who doesn't believe in the myth, you're quite enthusiastic about drawing the bow each time.
She chuckles.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Beneath the lies, what I believe has never changed.
Under the joint attack of Eastia and the FAC, the enraged Sun Crow spreads its wings, assuming an offensive posture. At that moment, you feel the arrow on the bow trembles slightly.
A flame not belonging to the Sun Crow flows like an invisible hand brushing over the arrow. Suddenly, the bowstring feels less taut and no longer hurts your hand.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Perfect. It's all ready now. Come on, hero.

The moment you let go, this arrow mixed with flames, your shackles, and the healing smoke soars as if alive. The fletching draws a long rainbow in the air, instantly leaving your sight, but you are certain it will hit its mark.
The arrow is propelled by undying fire in the gaze of every soldier and every citizen holding their small hope... and it hits the chest of the Sun Crow precisely.

speaker: Sun Crow Apostle
content: Roarrr!!!!

The Sun Crow lets out a painful roar, attempting once more to swallow the arrow with its body as it did once before. However, the moment the arrow sinks into its chest, flames burst forth from the wound, burning and tearing its disguise from the inside out.
The burning feathers peel away from its body layer by layer, merging with the countless suns in the sky before splitting off again, finally settling in the form prophesied by the mural...
Everyone sees it. A blurry figure flashing across the ten suns...

It's the small figure of a mere human, but it may well be an everlasting simple prayer. The lie left behind seven years ago has now crossed thousands of miles, once again transforming into a sword that pierces the chest of the calamity.
You know that now is the moment.

Be it the myths from Eastia or the technology DisCity takes pride in, these are all stories of repeated victories over calamities, or miracles of humanity's ability to flourish again in the apocalypse.
It's the history of all the humans who overcome the impossible. Everything is set in stone now.
Sinners who were affected by the shackles and suffering from the Mania fever all recover. The aftermath of the Tide of Ashes in the city is quickly cleaned up.

speaker: OwO
content: Urgh... The fever these past few days felt like a dream. Ah! The shackles were burning hot... Did something happen to little clapper?

speaker: OwO
content: I heard from the folks at Drifter Camp that I missed out on a lot of exciting things.

speaker: Deren
content: Yes, My Best Cool Car's little clapper got a job behind our backs. Went to shoot some exotic epic fantasy film.

speaker: Deren
content: Despite some hitches, it probably wrapped up smoothly in the end.

speaker: OwO
content: What? He went behind OwO's back and shot an epic film?! No way! He can't possibly make anything good without My Best Cool Car's great director!
female_content: What? She went behind OwO's back and shot an epic film?! No way! She can't possibly make anything good without My Best Cool Car's great director!

speaker: Deren
content: Haha, he'll have plenty of help from the rest of the crew.
female_content: Haha, she'll have plenty of help from the rest of the crew.

speaker: OwO
content: Hmph... Fine, congratulations, I guess...

speaker: OwO
content: Hmph! But it surely can't beat OwO's amazing film! I'll catch him next time and show him what a true masterpiece looks like!
female_content: Hmph! But it surely can't beat OwO's amazing film! I'll catch her next time and show her what a true masterpiece looks like!

content: With the Sun Crow's fall, the Three Calamities ended, and the bow's materials soon fell apart with the last Sun Shot Bow. However, the data collected in the process has been well preserved and remains invaluable research material.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I did it... Although it wasn't Yanyan who performed the Sun Shot, the ten suns didn't return, and the Sun Crow was defeated!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Great Seer! Grandma! Yanyan did it! We didn't let everyone down, I, ah, achoo!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Did you catch a cold after the temperature fell back down? If you require medical care...

speaker: Yanyan
content: No, no. Don't worry about me, Adjutant Nightingale. I'm fine, really.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Is everything okay in the city? Uncle Greta at the Drifter Camp and the old men at the Rust, are they all safe now? It was such a huge disaster. I'm really worried about them.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Damage assessment is still ongoing. But for now, everything is fine.

speaker: Nightingale
content: If you're so worried, why not head back to the Bureau and give them a call?

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: ...Thank you for your assistance these past few days.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Don't mention it. You helped save DisCity. And given your physique, I imagine it was indeed not easy for you to travel all the way here.

The Eastian Alliance and DisCity have resumed discussions to evaluate various details in the Sun Crow Apostle operation. Their relations remain tense, with both sides sticking to their guns on technical intelligence security issues.

Despite that, communication channels have been established. Trade and shipping are gradually resuming, and exchanges between Eastians and DisCitizens are thriving. The public is optimistic about the future development between the two states.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: Alright. The Eastian sorcery is indeed powerful. Thanks to you, the FAC saved not just Hypercubes, but also many precious lives of our soldiers. I owe you my thanks.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: No, it's me who should be grateful. Thank you for fighting hard to defeat the Sun Crow and fulfilling our long-held wish.
The leader in white armor extends his hand.

speaker: FAC Officer
content: We're all victims of Mania. When you get a chance, come to DisCity again so we can exchange our experiences.

speaker: Eastian Envoy
content: Certainly.

speaker: DisCity Representative
content: They're too lenient with those Outland spies... Why would Paradeisos allow that Chief to act so recklessly? This will only complicate things.

speaker: 9th Agency Operative
content: Because the one assessing the risks isn't you, it's the 9th Agency.

speaker: 9th Agency Operative
content: Rest assured, representative. We are the pros of monitoring suspicious individuals and eliminating threats to the city. If needed, we'll be watching you too...
He smiles and tips his hat to the representative before taking a step back into the darkness.
On the screen, you and Du Ruo are still being monitored.
The flames near the battlefield have died out, leaving only the lingering acrid smoke.
You and Du Ruo support each other, making your way through the rubble of the ruins.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Can... you still feel it?
On the other end of the shackles, the heat and madness have vanished. Finally, the long-missed peace is back.
But it makes you feel a bit melancholic.
She served as a container for the sealed Sun Crow for so long... but not a sliver of her consciousness was left behind...

The fierce battle also temporarily cleared the threats that used to roam the DisSea. Dragging your weary bodies, you trudge over the rubble, searching every piece of debris burnt by the Sun Crow with a faint hope. Finally, you reach the center of the battlefield.
It's a vast expanse of empty, scorched earth.
The Sun Crow didn't leave behind a single feather or any trace of remains.
Du Ruo bends down to feel the residual warmth of the earth left by the fire.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: You're gone. Well, it's for the best... I don't even know how else to express my gratitude to you.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Look, the sun is about to set.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The Great Seer's lie has come to the perfect end...
Brave champion sang, sunward quest began; the best bow carved, from the blessed trunk.
Berries and fruits, mere mortal woods; in divine breeds, born divine seeds.

speaker: Yanyan
content: To defeat the Sun Crow, we must craft a peerless Almighty Bow. And the first step is to find the branch of the sky-reaching Fusang tree!
Yanyan lectures you while reciting the poem animatedly.

speaker: Chief
content: There is no sky-reaching Fusang tree in DisCity.

speaker: Yanyan
content: What are you talking about? I'm already looking at it. Right over there...

The Eastian girl points toward the ruins of the High Tower Black Ring. The towering afterimage is so high it almost touches the sky, looking somewhat different than before. Somehow, it does look slightly like a sky-reaching blessed tree.

You recall the FAC mentioning that after the Sun Crow approached the DisSea, the Apostle of Ashes resonated with BR-000 and stirred up widespread Mania within the city, causing the three Black Ring ruins to behave slightly abnormally.
You withdraw your gaze. Regardless of whether the myth is true or not, it's necessary to investigate any unusual phenomenon at the Black Ring ruins.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Wait! ${PlayerName}, before we go, there's one more important thing...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yanyan has brought you a <color=#fb9259>little gift</color>...
She looks you up and down, sizing you up with both hands and giggling. You have a bad feeling about this.
Excitedly, she pulls out a set of clothes from her bag and puts them on you. She even brings out a small mirror for you to check how you look.

speaker: Yanyan
content: This is a gift from the Eastian delegation! It's imbued with the Divine Lord's blessing. It can ward off all disasters and unholy spirits!!
You sigh, figuring that the Eastians are all about these ritualistic traditions.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's go.

speaker: Yanyan
content: What are those tall blue things by the road? Are they Fusang trees?

speaker: Chief
content: Those are anti-Mania bases designed to resist disasters.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Entymaniabysses... Sounds like a powerful artifact! We have artifacts with similar effects back home too, but... none of them has such a unique shape.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ah! Could this be the fabled Celestial Pillar?!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hmm? Haven't you all heard of the story of the Fall of Peril and the Azure Mender?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Oh, so it goes like this... A century ago, the Three-Eyed God fell from heaven to the mortal realm, intending to enlighten all living beings. But he slipped and landed headfirst and knocked himself unconscious.

speaker: Yanyan
content: The Three-Eyed God fell into a deep slumber, but the hole in the sky remained. The essence of the ether poured through it like a waterfall, landing on earth as fires, deluges, droughts, thunder, vermin, and plagues.

speaker: Yanyan
content: The hero of that era ventured into the forbidden land of the fallen god, took the iridescent crystals, and turned them into blue light pillars to support the collapsing sky. That's the tale of the Azure Mender!
She grabs the air in front of her vehemently as if about to reveal something incredible, but then draws back her hand to scratch her head after a moment's thought.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ehehe... Sorry, I don't remember the rest. There are too many scriptures, and maybe the ending of this myth isn't known to us yet...

speaker: Yanyan
content: But I'll keep working on my studies! Let me tell you some other stories, like the Ode to Sun or the Skymender Saga. They're really interesting!

speaker: %u
content: Yanyan, I'd love to hear all that when we finish our mission. As for now...

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: The power of the Sun Crow Apostle is formidable. Data shows that after it came into contact with BR-000, its influence spread rapidly and the previously suppressed Black Rings have also shown signs of revival.
An FAC soldier hands you the freshly prepared report and begins his briefing.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Currently, BR-002 is being suppressed by the Eastian envoys and is stabilizing. However, its contamination still spreads up to a certain range, and approaching it is still risky.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: But if that's our target, the FAC will unconditionally take your orders and protect you... and this seer next to you too.
Trying his best to look professional, the FAC soldier's gaze sweeps over Yanyan and then on your clothes before darting away. Meanwhile, you feel uncomfortable in your new outfit.
An ear-piercing roar interrupts the awkward atmosphere in the car. A group of monsters you've never seen before appears in front of you.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Wow! Look ahead, and up in the sky... It's just like the myth!

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Chief, a new type of Corruptor has been detected! We believe it's a mutation caused by the High Tower Black Ring. They need to be eliminated immediately!
The FAC soldiers are ready for battle, but you're feeling a bit uncertain.
After the first encounter with the Sun Crow, you've been suffering the backlash from the shackles caused by the Sun Crow Apostle's Mania, and since then you've been feverish.
The Sinners in the Bureau have also been affected, running low fevers non-stop, as if you've passed it on to them through the shackles.
But Yanyan isn't showing any fear. In fact, she's watching the Corruptors emerging in front of her rather excitedly.

This is a type of Corruptor you've never seen before. Can you even call them Corruptors? They look grotesque, out of place just like that Draco that appeared once in your dreams, as if they don't belong in this world.

Could that really be some kind of mythical creature from Eastia?
...For a brief moment, this absurd thought crosses your mind.

speaker: Yanyan
content: That's the Wraith Ape, imp bird, imp birdling, and little monkey. They are the Sun Crow's kin! Yanyan knows how to drive them away! Listen to me!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Phew, the apotropaic ritual is done! But why are there monsters lurking near the Fusang tree...
Because this isn't some auspicious blessed tree, but the afterimage of a Black Ring. These are all creatures of Mania... You murmur inwardly.

The Corruptors turn out to be more numerous than you imagined, but fortunately, the FAC team cooperates flawlessly with you and Yanyan can fight too. Soon, you've wiped out all the incoming Corruptors.
After getting rid of all the Corruptors nearby, you realize you've almost made it to the Drifter Camp unknowingly. You can even catch a glimpse of that dark gate.
So the influence of the Black Ring has reached here too... You have to check on the situation inside the Drifter Camp.
Outside the Drifter Camp, a large pile of rubble has yet to be cleared. You can hear the crunching footsteps over the debris.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Umm, I didn't expect to see such a place in DisCity besides those glittering skyscrapers.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Were these stones and houses smashed by some monster? Ah! Some were even burned to ashes.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Did something bad happen here?
Yanyan carefully examines her surroundings, her eyebrows slightly furrowed.

speaker: Chief
content: A battle happened here. A fierce one.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Was it also because... the gods were angry?

speaker: Chief
content: There are no gods in DisCity. The people just keep fighting among themselves.

speaker: Chief
content: But this fight was not for nothing. It was a battle of survival where ordinary people united for their dreams and hopes.
Flashbacks

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hmm... Yanyan likes this kind of story! Back home, Grandma always tells Yanyan the story about the hero who shot down the Sun Crow too.

speaker: Yanyan
content: The hero protects everyone, and the people get together to help the hero. Yanyan can never get tired of such legends!
You ruffle the girl's hair, and an FAC guard comes over in time to report the scouting results.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Of course, there's another thing. We didn't find anything resembling the sky-reaching Fusang tree, but we did find some special contaminants that are still multiplying.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: And these contaminants have already affected the residents of the Drifter Camp. People often experience ringing in their ears or hear bird calls...
The girl gets pumped upon hearing this.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ah... No good! If they keep hearing these sounds, how can they sleep at night!

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}, can we help the people there while we're on the way to look for the branch? You know, the fabled heroes never hesitated to lend a helping hand!
Yanyan stands with her arms akimbo, striking a heroic pose.
You're reassured by what you see once you've entered the Drifter Camp. The place is still bustling like before. After all, things can't possibly get worse than how they once were at that time.

speaker: Stall Owner
content: Inner Bay roasted tofu! Authentic Inner Bay roasted tofu! The best you can have!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Wow... It's so good... Just like Grandma's cooking...

speaker: Yanyan
content: According to Sunsink City's sorcery texts, you are what you eat. I think eating some local food will help me get acclimated to DisCity sooner.
Yanyan stuffs the tofu into her mouth while opening her little purse, taking out a few copper coins and placing them on the stall.
The stall owner seems confused by the coins in front of her, unsure of what kind of currency she's looking at. But upon spotting you behind Yanyan, she seems to understand something.

speaker: Stall Owner
content: Darling, you're too skinny! Here, have a few more skewers. They're on the house!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Thank you, ma'am! Mm... No, we're here for serious business!
The girl seems to recall something after nodding, so she quickly shakes her head again and wipes her mouth, catching up with you quickly.
She's pretty determined. The girl's got more self-control than a certain grey mouse who can't move a step the moment she sees food.
As you weave through the crowd in the Drifter Camp, you suddenly hear a familiar voice.
...You don't look quite well. Want a check-up?
Of course, of course. Here we provide a unique traditional therapy that can relieve fatigue and relax the body.
The man speaks while twisting himself into a bizarre posture.

It's Greta, the barefoot doctor of the Drifter Camp. He's even given you a bottle of essence oil, but you've since stowed that funky-smelling stuff away in the deepest part of your office cabinet and never used it once.
You step forward to greet him and ask for information, but Yanyan beats you to him.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ah? Were you performing the ritual dance just now, sir? You didn't do one pose correctly. It might anger the deities and weaken the blessings.

speaker: Greta
content: Huh...? What are you talking about?
Greta stares at Yanyan in shock as the girl suddenly emerges before him, striking similar dramatic poses.

speaker: Yanyan
content: See? That's how you should do it! I learned this move when I first became a novice seer.
Yanyan pulls out a book from her pocket and flips through a few pages quickly.

speaker: Greta
content: What... what's this novisia you're talking about? I only know how to treat nausea...

speaker: Greta
content: And I was doing yoo...
Yanyan keeps babbling on about the ritual dance with unseen vehemence. This seems a very important subject to her, and even the surrounding crowd is listening intently.
You try to pull Yanyan away, but her enthusiasm is unstoppable and she's already begun posing, so you have no choice but to watch her perform the entire ritual dance.
A crowd has gradually gathered around you. People applaud from time to time, and some even toss a few coins at your feet.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Oops! What time is it now?! Oh no... Thank you, everyone.
Yanyan pulls you away hurriedly, muttering non-stop.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hmm... Gotta tend to the serious matters first.
You traverse the Drifter Camp, clearing the monsters near the ruins. According to Yanyan, this should count as helping clean up around the blessed tree.
Yanyan points at the ruins of the High Tower, flipping open a book to read aloud the myth written in it.

speaker: Yanyan
content: The hero guarded the Fusang tree until it grew its hardest branch. To thank the hero for chasing off the monsters, the Fusang tree decided to gift the branch to the hero...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Look, that's the thank-you gift from the Fusang tree!
Thrilled, Yanyan grabs your hand and jogs toward the top of the High Tower. The FAC soldiers behind you shake their heads but quickly follow you.
(Scene change)

speaker: Yanyan
content: That's the one!
The girl points at the dark crystalline branch at the top of the High Tower and runs right under it enthusiastically.
Instead of a branch, it appears more like a crystal with a fiery hue running within, emitting an ominous aura constantly.
Roarrrr—
Awakened by the Black Ring, the Corruptors start to stir. Startled, Yanyan drops her precious myth book to the ground.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yeeeee! Nonononono... This isn't how it's supposed to go! Something must have gone wrong. This is when the Fusang tree gives its branch to the hero...

speaker: Yanyan
content: I, I'm terribly sorry! I apologize! Please, calm down!
Seeing Yanyan panicking, the myth and the Fusang tree don't matter to you anymore. The most important thing now is to deal with these Corruptors in front of you.

speaker: Choice
options: So I just need to get the branch for you, right?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Eh?

speaker: Chief
content: Leave it to me. I know this tree well enough. It's right next door to where I live, after all.
You turn around to face the group of Corruptors and the blessed tree.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't think that just because you sound powerful in some myth you can do whatever you want. You're nothing more than an afterimage of the Black Ring.

speaker: Yanyan
content: The blessed tree... was defeated?
Following the annihilation of the furious Corruptors, the contamination of the High Tower Black Ring gradually disappears. Yanyan thanks you hastily before rushing to that branch.
That crystalline object previously hanging at the top of the High Tower now lies quietly on the ground.

speaker: Yanyan
content: A dazzling blessed branch full of power... Is this the material for the bow described in the Ode to Sun? Great! Now that we have it, we can make the bow.
Examining the ominous dark crystal, the girl doesn't seem scared at all and even reaches out to touch it.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Stop. That's a contaminant. Don't touch it directly!
The FAC soldiers nearby run over to stop Yanyan.
Yanyan looks at the FAC soldiers and tilts her head cluelessly, then with skillful hands produces a piece of cloth and wraps up the crystal.
The FAC soldiers breathe a sigh of relief at Yanyan's response, but still hope you can take her to an M-value test.
This crystal exudes a familiar aura. It's a distant memory. That Ash Crystal you found in WhiteSands.
Yanyan's actions have been rather naive and reckless this whole time, but you can indeed see the links to the myth. The tall Fusang tree, the magical branch...

You're not sure if the myth from the East is true, but after picking up this crystal, the people at the Drifter Camp do seem to be doing better. Inexplicably, you feel this proves the Sun Crow Apostle is disrupting DisCity in some way.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Thank you for helping me get the blessed branch, ${PlayerName}. Although it's not quite like what's described in the myth... Ugh, we ended up giving the Fusang tree a beating…
female_content: Thank you for helping me get the blessed branch, ${PlayerName}. Although it's not quite like what's described in the myth... Ugh, we ended up giving the Fusang tree a beating...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Is it really okay... We didn't do as the myth said, I'm afraid...
Yanyan frowns, seeming both glad and worried.
You pick up the myth book Yanyan accidentally dropped and return it to the girl.

speaker: %u
content: Myths can have different interpretations. Maybe the hero made up that story to save face for the Fusang tree? Maybe our version is closer to what actually happened.

speaker: %u
content: The most important thing is, the people nearby are no longer suffering. Everyone's headache is gone.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...That's right! How did Yanyan not think of that! What matters is that everyone's doing better now!

speaker: Yanyan
content: If the Fusang tree was indeed in league with the monsters to bully everyone, then it deserves to be taught a lesson by the hero! You're exactly right, ${PlayerName}!
Yanyan takes the book from your hand and smiles like a blooming flower.

speaker: Yanyan
content: What a great victory! The material we found this time seems even bigger than what Yanyan got back home. We'll definitely make the best bow ever!
Scene change to Drifter Camp

speaker: Greta
content: Hey! You're back? You look like you've just been in a fight. Are you exhausted?
Hearing the familiar voice, Yanyan stops in her tracks.
It's Greta, and he's followed by quite a few people. It seems that after getting rid of their headaches, everyone has come here to get some essence oil from the doctor to help relax their muscles.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Emmm? Even though you do the wrong ritual dance, you can still cure everyone's headaches?

speaker: Greta
content: Hehe. This is new to you, isn't it? This is <size=50>yooga</size>!
Greta finally seizes the chance to clear up the confusion.

speaker: Chief
content: He's right. It's not a ritual dance.

speaker: Chief
content: Though it's not the Eastian ritual dance, it still helps everyone stay strong and healthy and even inspired many people in West District during the great disaster.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...It inspired many people in West District?
You look at Greta. Just like back then, he's putting those people who just got rid of their headaches in funny poses.

speaker: Chief
content: West District has gone through some tough times before, during which everyone was cooped up underground. Not only did their bodies become sluggish, but their mood also worsened.

speaker: Chief
content: But Greta didn't give up. When many were in despair, he was the one who led everyone to do yooga every day.

speaker: Chief
content: He wanted to help everyone get in shape, and also to cheer them up by fooling around.

speaker: Greta
content: Oh my. You flatter me too much, Chief.
Greta flashes you a big smile. It seems he quite enjoys the compliments.
Yanyan looks toward the rubble they passed by earlier, then to the bustling crowd on the street, and lowers her head slightly.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I... I didn't mean to criticize his dance...
She lifts her head, her eyes sparkling.

speaker: Yanyan
content: We perform the ritual dance... to pray for blessings...

speaker: Yanyan
content: So that everyone can still keep a smile in the face of disaster...
Though a bit shy, Yanyan still gives Greta a proper bow.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Although... your Sun Crow ritual dance was not up to standard, anyone who can bring a smile to people's faces has the gift to become a great seer!

speaker: Greta
content: Oh~~~ my, and I'm sure you've got that gift as well, Yanyan. Hehe. Wanna come and practice yooga together? There aren't many diligent girls like you in the whole Drifter Camp.
Greta scratches the back of his head and grins.
Yanyan and Greta keep on chatting. Yanyan even performs another part of the Sun Crow ritual dance in front of the crowd.

speaker: Crowd
content: Yes! Bravo!
The crowd keeps on applauding, cheering even louder than before.

speaker: Pedestrian A
content: Wasn't there a little girl named OwO who kept talking about the East? Too bad she went off to make a movie.

speaker: Pedestrian B
content: Right! No wonder it felt so familiar!

speaker: Pedestrian C
content: Exactly! It's a bit confusing at first, but it becomes fascinating once you get used to the style! Look, doesn't that move just now look like OwO's lion dance?

speaker: Pedestrian B
content: Yes, I can see it!

speaker: Pedestrian C
content: Check this out, hey!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Wow! These moves are pretty awesome too. Why don't you join Yanyan? We could use a few more companions. Let's explore the Sun Crow's myth together!
The crowd disperses all of a sudden. The folks at the Drifter Camp have been traumatized by the force of Mania. They flee the moment they hear about this kind of mission.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hey! Wait! I won't force you to learn everything all at once! You can take your time!
It seems a long myth-exploring journey still lies ahead of Yanyan.
Floods and downpour, from dragon's claws. Grand scales clanking, vast bones rumbling.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Alrighty! The hero obtained a fine bow body. The next task was to find the legendary bowstring! To the east!

speaker: Yanyan
content: But when the hero arrived at the shore of East Sea, there was a huge, huge flood happening there! And the culprit was a Wraith Dragon!
Yanyan puts away the divination wheel and grabs your hand excitedly.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Let's get moving, ${PlayerName}! The next target is right over there!
Yanyan points to the Rust on the map.
(Scene change)

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: So something is indeed wrong at the Rust...
You arrive at the periphery of the Rust and find that the once-stabilized contamination in the Rust is rising rapidly. It's even beginning to flow.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Chief, due to the influence of Mania, the contamination at the bottom of the Rust is forming a current and gushing out constantly. If we don't stop it promptly, the contamination will spread rapidly toward West District.

speaker: Yanyan
content: It seems much shallower than the floods in Eastia. But a toxic flood is no good sign nonetheless! Many monsters will come following this! Like the prawn soldiers, the crab generals, and the turtle minister. They're all underlings of that evil dragon!

speaker: Yanyan
content: To calm the floods and eliminate the aquatic monsters, we must first defeat the dragon causing all this trouble!
As you're discussing strategies, you suddenly hear a cry for help.

speaker: Scavenger A
content: Help! Can anybody give us a hand! Someone's getting trapped by contamination! Help...
It's the scavengers at the Rust. They are also affected by the rising current of the Rust and seem to have run into trouble.
He clings desperately to an arm in the pool of contamination, looking like he's about to give out.
The FAC soldiers react instantly, and within two minutes, they are helping the two elderly people to the shore.
Next to them, Yanyan is patting the back of the saved scavenger rather skillfully, then hands him a water bottle.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Here's some water, sir. Drink slowly and be careful not to choke on it!

speaker: Scavenger B
content: Thank you... Thank you so much...
The feeble scavenger tries to express his gratitude with what little consciousness he has left. You only nod to signal him to conserve his strength and not to make any unnecessary movements.
Following the scavengers' guidance, you advance through the carnival ruins in search of the dragon, when suddenly you feel your clothes being tugged.

speaker: Yanyan
content: There's danger ahead... Something very dangerous.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}, maybe we should... take a detour?
Uncharacteristically, Yanyan looks frightened.
You scan the surroundings. Aside from the wind making the amusement rides creak, there doesn't seem to be anything out of the ordinary.
The FAC soldiers nearby launch their scanning devices. Moments later, they still detect nothing unusual.
You take Yanyan's hand and continue walking forward.
But you've barely taken one step when Yanyan screams and clings to your waist like a sloth, then continues to mutter something.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Arghhh! Celestial soldiers from the heavens! I beg your protection…
You think Yanyan has seen something spooky. During a casual chat with Du Ruo, she mentioned that some Easterners with strong psychic power can see things other people cannot.
If they can see things that exist beyond the physical world, then maybe Yanyan too...

speaker: Yanyan
content: There's... there's Kaiming Beasts ahead!
That's not what you were expecting. Another term you don't know. You can only exchange confused looks with the FAC soldiers next to you.

speaker: Yanyan
content: That thing is about the size of a tiger, and... it has many heads and always stands facing east... It's the scariest calamitous creature!

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Those things up on the platform. Look! They're turning in a circle! Sob...

speaker: Choice
options: You really are terrified of them, are you?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yan... Yanyan is not scared! A great seer wouldn't be scared of these monsters!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Just that this... this is an exception...

speaker: Yanyan
content: That cursed dragon must have looked into my background. It knows I was scared to tears by stories of the Kaiming Beast when I was little... That's why it's targeting me like this!
Yanyan trembles uncontrollably behind you while babbling incoherently, like a child scared by the first ghost story she's heard.

speaker: Scavenger A
content: Hey, isn't that a carousel? This is the first time I've seen a child spooked out by a carousel.
The scavenger says behind you. You gaze at the so-called calamitous creature according to Yanyan, but it turns out to be only a carousel, the horses spinning in a circle in the wind.
As for the many heads... It's probably just the overlapped image of several abandoned horse rides.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Carousel?
Yanyan articulates the word carefully.

speaker: Scavenger A
content: Little girl, have you never been on a carousel before? Oh dear... A child your age should be playing in the amusement park all day!

speaker: Yanyan
content: I have always been moving homes since my earliest memories, because of droughts or floods... Today is the first time I've heard of carousels and amusement parks.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Did Yanyan say something wrong? Why are you so quiet?
Yanyan looks at the scavenger curiously. Not expecting such a response, he doesn't know what to say for a moment.

speaker: Scavenger A
content: Sorry, kiddo, I shouldn't have said that. You see, it happens at my age. This amusement park has been abandoned for many years due to the Black Ring. Somehow, I thought everyone remembered it...

speaker: Scavenger A
content: But the Black Ring was eliminated two years ago, so maybe it can be rebuilt.
The elderly scavenger looks toward the dilapidated amusement park, sighing.
Amusement parks and carousels are things found only in DisCity, in the center of the world. It's impossible for those caught in the disasters in Sunsink City a few years ago to have experienced them.
Children from Sunsink City have probably never even heard of an amusement park.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I'm sure they can rebuild it!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Seven years ago, Sunset Town was completely destroyed by the Sun Crow Apostle. But no one gave up, and a few years later, we built Sunsink City, which was brand new and even bigger.

speaker: Yanyan
content: So I'm sure you guys can do it too!

speaker: Scavenger A
content: Haha... Well said, kiddo! If it gets rebuilt, you must come to play again!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Sure, Yanyan will be here! I'll make sure to have a great time!
While the old man and the young girl are chatting exuberantly, Corruptors begin charging toward you again.
You examine the monsters before you carefully. They are massive and extremely menacing. You've never encountered such species in DisCity over the past two years.
For some reason, every time after a few attacks, they'll emit a faint golden glow and freeze for a moment before shaking their heads and charging again.
It's as if they're fighting against something for control of their bodies. With no time to dwell on this, you quickly tell the scavengers to leave, then hurriedly command the FAC soldiers to fight.
After dealing with these dragon-like Corruptors, you still haven't found the whereabouts of the bowstring.

speaker: Yanyan
content: How strange... But the poem literally says "rushed from the east, peered to the west."

speaker: Yanyan
content: Go east... check. Look west... check.
Standing next to the dead Corruptors, Yanyan flips through the myth book from start to end several times.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Mmmm... Maybe I should try divining again? This time we will definitely find it!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Drops from heaven, pray be hastened... Oops, that's not what I'm asking.
(Weird sounds...)

speaker: Yanyan
content: When peril hit, in hills all hid... Eh, that doesn't seem right either?
Yanyan concentrates on spinning the divination wheel in her hands, completely unaware of the changes happening around her.
The dead Corruptor suddenly comes back to life. Lifting its head, it makes to devour the human before it.
It all happens too suddenly. The monster's gaping maw is already wide open, yet you and the FAC soldiers can't reach Yanyan in time.
A burst of golden light suddenly appears on the monster's body. It begins struggling in pain and collapses to the ground.
You run over to scoop up the petrified Yanyan and signal the FAC to quickly contain the situation.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Eh? Eh! What happened...
Yanyan seems to have calmed down when the Corruptor stops moving after being blasted by the FAC's bullets. Only then does she notice what happened around her just now.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Is this...
In the lifeless dragon's body, you see a wriggling thread with a reddish-gold glow slip into the carcass like a parasite.
Did that thing interrupt the monster's revival? You look at the red worm, pondering.

It feels different from the Apostles of Ashes you've encountered before. After the Corruptor disappears, you don't feel any aggression. Instead, there's a strange sense of familiarity, as if you've seen this red flame somewhere.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Is this... the dragon's vein?
Yanyan examines the worm curiously with the magnifying glass in her hand.
Reciting some incomprehensible poetry, she approaches it with a glass jar she picked up from the banks of the Rust.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Great dragon slain, bright glory claimed... Heh!
Yanyan grabs the long worm from the carcass of the Corruptor and puts it into the glass jar.
Having seen Yanyan touch the contamination at the High Tower Black Ring, the FAC soldiers are no longer surprised by her actions. But this is definitely against every rule they've been accustomed to.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}, look, isn't it kinda cute?
The object in the bottle emits a faint golden glow. Yanyan lifts it to your face excitedly, eager to show you the bowstring.
You quickly wave your hands to refuse, but as soon as you stretch out your hand, a series of visions appear before your eyes.
(Scene change)

speaker: Schorl
content: Analysis shows that this substance does not belong to DisCity and has the power to suppress the Black Ring Apostle's kin.

speaker: Schorl
content: Continue the mission and move up the security priority of the Sunsink City's seer.
After conducting a detailed analysis on the dragon's vein acquired and consolidating the intelligence, Schorl assigns you the next phase of the mission.
Both the Sunsink City's seer and its myths still present contradictions and questionable points.
But her unique psychic abilities have repeatedly suggested that perhaps she really can create the Almighty Bow and end the disaster.
The persistent low fever is still ravaging your body. The omens brought by the Sun Crow Apostle are becoming more apparent, and the time left for you seems to be running out.

speaker: Yanyan
content: In the great hall, the divine lay; all spells ordered, elements reigned.

speaker: Chief
content: Where are we going next?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Over there.
Yanyan closes the book in her hands and gazes reverently toward the Statue of Keylan not far away, her previous vivacity gone. The usually fearless, curious girl even swallows hard nervously.
The little seer nods.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Only by passing the Divine Lord's trial can one obtain the arrow capable of shooting down the Sun Crow.

speaker: Yanyan
content: But even back in Sunsink City, few seers have actually seen the Divine Lord. We only hear legends about the Divine Lord, so... Yanyan is a bit scared.

speaker: Choice
options: Hey, don't worry. Everyone will be cheering for you, Yanyan.

content: You smile at the two soldiers behind you.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: You people from Eastia are all about that superstitious stuff... I mean, as long as it works.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Yeah, just go and be confident. We'll wait here for you. We'll do what you say.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Well, at least we can still hear birds chirping here. Could have been worse.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: I know, right? We've seen way worse in Keylan Square before. You just do your best, kiddo!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Okay! Yanyan won't let you down!
Hearing everyone's encouragement, a smile finally emerges on her tense little face.
As you step into the Square Black Ring ruins, the scenery around you starts to change rapidly.
A red apparition materializes out of nowhere before you, speaking in an incomprehensible language.
You look around to find the FAC soldiers unbothered by the apparition. It seems that only you and Yanyan can see the unusual scene. A slight tingling sensation is pricking the top of your head.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Revered Divine Lord, Sunsink City's novice seer Yanyan is at your service.
Yanyan devoutly kneels in the direction of the apparition, which is flickering and emitting a red light continuously. Uncertain of what it wants, you can only stay alert and get your shackles ready.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}, the Divine Lord is about to tell me about the trials.
After saying that, Yanyan sits up straight and closes her eyes. Soon after, her body emits bursts of red light as she speaks in the same mysterious language as the red apparition does.

speaker: Yanyan
content: S■e■s■c■a■t■d■d■m■n■s■r■v■l■d;

speaker: Yanyan
content: t■e■e■d■w■s■ne■r■t■e■wa■■ba■k■lo■g.
Yanyan struggles to repeat the words uttered by the apparition, her body trembling uncontrollably, sweat already soaking her clothes.
Like Yanyan, you too can feel that immense mental pressure as the screeches and wails never cease. You think of interrupting Yanyan's channeling, but can't bring yourself to do it.
After what feels like an eternity, the apparition vanishes and the ritual is complete. Yanyan struggles to her feet and takes your hand.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...I, I understood the Divine Lord's decree! The trials will be difficult. We must work hard together to complete them! For the first trial...
Everyone waits quietly to hear the Divine Lord's trial. There's no other sound than their breathing.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Fetch two basins of bathing water for the Sun Crow from the Spring Valley!
After completing all of the Divine Lord's tasks with great effort, you continue your journey following Yanyan's divination results. Apparently, the Divine Lord will be waiting there.
Some FAC soldiers are clearly reaching the limit of their patience with these seemingly meaningless puzzles.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: ...Is this for real? Did she really translate that correctly?

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Do these Eastian gods have a screw loose somewhere?

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Shh... Keep it down!

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: I knew something was off from the start. Fetching bathing water for the Sun Crow from the Spring Valley... You can't be serious?

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: For another trial, we need to make scrambled eggs with... Pollia japonica flowers or something. I've practically turned the flower shops in Eastside upside down...

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: She was muttering to herself just now. Has she been corrupted by Mania?

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Right... And she keeps murmuring Divine Lord or something to herself too. Is she mental...?
The FAC soldiers keep whispering about this and that. You shake your head and ask them to give the two of you some space.
Are you okay, Yanyan?

speaker: %u
content: Channeling must be exhausting for you. Don't push yourself too hard.

Yanyan doesn't respond immediately. She looks in the direction where the Divine Lord was, sighing and shaking her head. She then takes out her divination cards and fiddles with them for a while before putting them away hurriedly.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}... Do you find the trials Yanyan interpreted bizarre too?

speaker: Choice
options: Not really. Does it bother you?

speaker: Yanyan
content: No, I'm just worried... that I'm not qualified enough to interpret the Divine Lord's words correctly...

speaker: Yanyan
content: In the legends, the Divine Lord has always been a supremely awe-inspiring entity... They would never pose strange tasks or be ridiculed.

speaker: Yanyan
content: It's me... who's strange and deserves to be laughed at.
The girl lowers her head in dejection.
Yanyan isn't making things up or deceiving anyone. You've seen the Divine Lord yourself. That's the best proof.
But this proof means nothing to the FAC soldiers. If channeling doesn't work, you're left with only the last resort.

options: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

content: You've read Yanyan's myth book before, and besides some ritual dance moves, it didn't contain the stories she mentioned, just a few lines of obscure poetry.

speaker: Chief
content: Behold omens, from souls summoned; irised scene, with cold arrow gleam.
The Divine Lord indeed exists, but Their condition is unstable. The strange tasks might not be Yanyan's misinterpretation but an issue with the Divine Lord Themselves.

You've been holding back from using the shackles, fearing that the backlash might sabotage the current mission. But you can feel a lingering resonance pointing to the Sun Crow Apostle... as well as to the fragmented clues here.

speaker: %u
content: Even if your channeling did go wrong, as long as you keep trying to get closer to the Divine Lord and accept Their trials, the connection between the seer and the Divine Lord will only grow stronger, right?

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Yes, that's what the book says.

speaker: Choice
options: Then there's no problem. Let's go on.

speaker: %u
content: We'll take on the Divine Lord's trials together. Even if we mess up, as long as we don't give up, we'll definitely be able to communicate with the Divine Lord and reach where They are.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I see. I'll do my best!

The small hand holding yours is a bit tense. You squeeze it tightly, hoping to give her some strength. You're confident in completing those trials, which might just point the way forward. Behold omens, from souls summoned.

Standing at the top of the Statue of Keylan, both of you can see those flickering lights and shadows. They seem like the Divine Lord's memories. But just like the oracles, they're too fragmented to understand.
Every time you see these memories, both of you feel pressured. You're still fine, but Yanyan has been overusing her Eastian sorcery these past few days and is looking sickly.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Is this... the Divine Lord...?
As if responding to Yanyan's words, red light engulfs the top of the tower as powerful awe looms over everyone present. Even you begin to have a headache.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Divine Lord, can you hear my voice?
Upon seeing the golden light, Yanyan forces herself to stagger forward, trying to approach the glowing Divine Lord.
It's too dangerous. If the myth is true, the Divine Lord shouldn't be so irritable. If you let her go on, Yanyan will definitely be in danger!
Chirp, chirp!

You make to stop Yanyan when suddenly a chubby bird flies through the light and knocks Yanyan over. The red light fades, and the scene changes once more. This time, it seems everyone can see the strange spectacle.
Chirp... Chirp, chirp?
The chubby bird flutters up to a tree branch. It's hard to guess what it's trying to do.
People exchange looks of confusion. One of the braver soldiers stomps near the bird. Startled, it scurries down from the top of the tower, leaving behind only a few feathers.
...Chirp, chirp!
Before it flees, it doesn't forget to strut its stuff.
After the chubby bird runs away, Yanyan, who's been knocked over, seems to regain consciousness. You quickly help her up, but she can barely stand after overexerting her power.
You tell the diligent seer what happened just now. She seems a bit disheartened.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ah, I see...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Did the Divine Lord reject Yanyan? If not... Why would it send a big fat bird to bump into Yanyan...
The girl becomes more and more aggrieved, tears already swirling in her eyes.

speaker: jojo
content: Yanyan isn't good enough... I've let everyone down...

speaker: Chief
content: That's the Divine Lord. Look.
You pull out two golden feathers from your pocket and place them in Yanyan's palm.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Is this...?
Yanyan looks at the feathers in her hand, clearly feeling the power harbored within them.
But she still can't believe that the big chubby bird is the formidable Divine Lord.

speaker: Chief
content: Maybe both you and the Divine Lord are not that good at channeling?
You look at the array of items Yanyan has set up on the altar for channeling, then think of the Divine Lord who was scared off by the stomping feet of the FAC team soldiers.
You reach out and pat Yanyan's head.

speaker: Chief
content: Perhaps when you meet again, Yanyan will see the most majestic and powerful Divine Lord.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hmm... I hope so. Thank you, everyone, for accompanying Yanyan all the way here...
With that, Yanyan closes her eyes and falls asleep. Just as you're about to carry her away, someone steps forward to take the girl.

speaker: FAC Soldier A
content: Chief, let me do it.
You hesitate for a moment.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: Don't worry, Chief, he'll protect her well. You must be exhausted too. You can trust him, he's actually a pretty nice guy. He just likes to run his mouth.

speaker: FAC Soldier B
content: She collapsed because she tried so hard to protect DisCity. Whether or not she was talking childish nonsense, she's still a good kid.
The story has come to an end, and the hero has found the treasure. Whether the myth is true, what the Divine Lord really is... Let's leave that to the future Yanyan.

Are you ready?
Absolutely! I'm so ready to show them what I've got!
Just remember, caution is key. Stay sharp out there.
Let's move!
Eastside, the sleepless eastern reaches of DisCity, glitters under its usual blanket of artificial light, beneath the guise of another quiet night.
As if.

speaker: Chief
content: Eugene, watch the left flank of the building. Deploy a squad to establish a perimeter in front of the venue.

speaker: Chief
content: We can't afford to slip up tonight. Our opponents... they're not the easiest to deal with.

speaker: Eugene
content: Understood!
You step to the window, brow tense, surveying the towering buildings as the arrest squad's heavy footfalls recede down the block.
Moonlight threads between the surrounding towers, spilling through the gallery to rest upon the lower half of a painting sealed in glass.
Silence settles around you, yet your nerves refuse to unwind.
This stillness isn't peace; it's the lull before the strike... the breath before the Marauders' next vicious play.
Suddenly, the moonlight at your feet shivers. You snap your gaze upward.
There, clinging to the gallery's mid-level rooftop, are several tall, slender silhouettes.
Then, in a blink, they're gone.
Amidst the frantic wail of sirens, you bark into the mic hidden at your collar.

speaker: Chief
content: Target spotted! All units, move in!
RIIIINNNGG—

speaker: Guard
content: Infrared weapons live!

speaker: Guard
content: Thermal snipers online!

speaker: Guard
content: All access points secured and standing by!
The quiet of the gallery shatters. Guards scramble to their posts, rushing to intercept the three figures descending from the rafters and shield the priceless exhibits.

But in the frantic lockdown that follows, a faint mechanical whir goes unnoticed overhead. A miniature aircraft glides past the distracted guards, slips between the sweeping infrared beams, and slips into the heart of the exhibition hall.

speaker: Chief
content: Take that drone down! Now!
You spot the drone first, but even you are a beat too slow.
Above, one of the figures gives a mocking wave. Instantly, the drone swerves into a chaotic, unpredictable path, scattering the guards below.
BOOM—!
Smoke erupts through the hall, thick and choking. The acrid fumes seep into every crevice, stinging eyes and twisting faces into masks of tears.

But the real disruption comes as the drone falls. A shower of tiny sparks rains down, and suddenly, the once-proud array of surveillance cameras and automated weapons begins to twitch and spin wildly. A sharp whine pierces the air as their systems overheat, then one by one, they shudder and go dark.

speaker: Chief
content: Tear gas and... magnetic powder? They really did their homework.
The simple particulate mask that Pricilla insisted you carry rests in your pocket, a precaution you never truly thought you'd need. Now, as the choking fog spreads, you slip it on.
Around you, guards are doubling over, coughing violently, staggering into each other as they scramble blindly for the exits.
Then, through the veil of smoke, a slender figure breaks clear, moving with lethal grace. They're headed straight toward you— No. Not toward you, but the painting at the center of the hall.
The figure weaves through the guards' disoriented blind spots, tracing the shortest possible path to the prize.
Thanks for letting me have the first piece of the Otherland Angels!
The magnetic powder has silenced not just the cameras and weapons, but the entire security grid. As the protective glass is sliced away, the gallery holds its breath without any alarm sounding.
The intruder's hand is inches from the canvas when you move. You lunge from the haze, fingers closing around their wrist.

speaker: Chief
content: Not on my watch!
The intruder reacts instantly, slipping from your grip with fluid ease.
With a flicker of movement, they twist free by a hair's breadth and leap lightly onto a nearby display platform.
Moonlight catches only their silhouette from the shins down; their face remains shrouded in shadow, just beyond your sight.

speaker: Chief
content: You're cornered. So... what's your escape plan this time?

speaker: Chief
content: Are you going to cut your way through everyone... just like before?

speaker: Chief
content: I'm sorry, but I can't let that happen again.
You slowly raise your hand. A glint of silver catches the moonlight as the dark barrel of your gun levels at the figure above.
The smoke is thinning now. A low report crackles in your earpiece: affected guards have been evacuated, and a fresh tactical team is in position, closing in silently, awaiting your signal.

speaker: Chief
content: You've left me no choice.
Your radiating presence burns the intruder's skin, forcing them into a lower stance as every cell in their body screams danger.
Tension coils through the room like steel wire, pulled so taut that the slightest tremor is impossible.
Then, you see the intruder slowly lean forward, preparing to set down the painting.
Giving up already?
No, no way. They must be—
SWISH!!!
An unexpected blast rips the silence to shreds.

The windows along the wall don't merely break; they vaporize into a storm of lethal glitter, blasted inward with terrifying force. Your attention is instantly caught by the sheer violence of their destruction.
What follows is a violation of motion, a teleport across the room. Physics abandons the figure streaking toward the window.
The intruder lands on the window frame with perfect precision, and for a brief moment, a barely perceptible expression of shock betrays them.
As that shock transmutes into pure focus, every movement around them seems to solidify, frozen in place.
The intruder gains the rooftop, their labored breathing paced like a steady, forging beat. Their focus never wavers, already shifting to the next point in their path.
Their eyes in this instant are pure, honed intent. A cold, mechanical focus where no warmth survives.
Before the panorama of night-drenched streets, the intruder steps back into open air, a leap of effortless poise.
Hundreds of meters in the void, that dark shape sails as if on unseen wings, consumed by the greater dark.
Then, the night is torn by the sound of engines. Headlights stab once through the blackness before being swallowed by the woods.
After them!!
At your command, the guards exit the gallery at once, charging in the direction the intruder disappeared.
You start to follow, but a faint sound from inside the gallery stops you cold.
There, on the exhibition platform the intruder used, a small and sinister rift is quietly forming. It spews a continuous stream of contaminants, all laced with the power of Mania.
A dimensional rift...? Could this be connected to the recent incidents?!
But thought is a luxury at the moment. You must destroy it before the rift's spawn spreads further.

After swiftly dealing with the rift, you burst outside. The advance team is already converging on the motorcycle, leaving only the small arrest squad you brought from the Bureau, standing at the ready and awaiting your command.
You hold the order. Instead, you narrow your eyes at the shattered window.
The paintings are displayed on the gallery's second floor. It's not a deadly drop, but no ordinary person—no matter how athletic—could descend from that height and leave not a single trace behind.

speaker: Chief
content: Unless...

Crimson light gathers in your palm, then pulses outward in a silent wave, washing over the scene. And there, etched in the aftermath of the energy, you see them. Several faint, lingering trails of a familiar power, tracing from the windowsill down to the ground, then vanishing toward the nearby park and the woods beyond.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Unless you are Sinners.

speaker: Chief
content: Eugene, with me. We're going after them.
Guided by the shackles, you track the fading traces of Mania. You soon realize: multiple intruders are on the move and they're all Sinners.
At one point, the trails abruptly scatter, forking into multiple divergent paths, only to merge again into one.
But five kilometers from the gallery, the trail vanishes entirely.

To release such concentrated Mania in such a short time—enough to trigger resonance with a rift—these individuals must be A-Class, if not S-Class. Yet for such a potent signature to vanish so completely... What exactly is going on here?

speaker: Chief
content: For now, there's no sign of Mania overflow or a resonance rift forming.

speaker: Chief
content:
But this is no victory. All we did today was chase them off.
All this scattered wreckage... It's not a sign of their retreat. It's a warning. They will come back. And next time, they'll be more ruthless. More meticulous.
We can't afford to be careless.

After the chaos of the night, dawn breaks fully over the city. Around you, civilians begin to trickle onto the streets—curious, but cautious. They linger at café tables, pretending to read newspapers or sip drinks, all while stealing furtive glances in your direction.
Proceeding like this would only risk alerting the targets. With a wave of your hand, you dismiss the arrest squad, sending them home to rest except for Eugene.
After everyone leaves, you nod toward an elegant café nearby and offer to buy him a cup.

speaker: Chief
content: You've earned this coffee. The whole Bureau's been burning the midnight oil on this investigation. Sorry you've had to chase so many dead ends because of all that misinformation.

speaker: Eugene
content: Don't mention it, Chief. And as for those vicious criminals terrorizing the city, we finally have hard evidence from the scene. They're not just some phantom thieves. They're Sinners.

speaker: Eugene
content: So it's all part of the job. Maybe once this is all wrapped up...

speaker: Chief
content: Hm? Once it's wrapped up?
Eugene suddenly falls silent, his gaze shifting away. You instinctively follow his line of sight into the distance.
HEEEY! CHIIIIEF!!
Chief! What a coincidence! Didn't expect to see you here!
From the intersection up ahead, a young girl came skipping toward you, calling out a bright greeting.

speaker: Chief
content: What brings you out here?

speaker: Wynn
content: You know, the whole bureau's been working overtime for the recent Marauders cases.

speaker: Wynn
content: Then I got a field assignment, and it just happened to be around here.

speaker: Wynn
content: Didn't expect to run into you two wrapping up! So, how'd it go? Any leads?
Wynn rattles on without pause, her gaze blinking from you to the speechless Eugene at your side.

speaker: Wynn
content: Ah... Well, these things happen, right? No luck this time, but there's always next!
In a deliberate attempt to lighten the mood, Wynn scratches her cheek and exaggerates her tone before nudging Eugene with her elbow.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Yeah. We'll catch them.

speaker: Chief
content: Since we've run into each other, why don't you join us for coffee, Wynn?

speaker: Wynn
content: Oh?! You're treating, Chief? Count me in!

speaker: Chief
content: So you won't say no this time, right?
Eugene's ears flush red the moment he catches your teasing look. He nods, nonetheless, and falls into step.
Oh? Customers this early?
Welcome!
Good morning! Welcome to Cat's Eye!
As the door opens, the soft aroma of coffee wafts through the air. Behind a stylish yet cozy counter, three stunning women welcome you with warm smiles.
Come, have a seat!
We've got lots of coffees to choose from. Take your time!
If you have a preferred bean or flavor, just let me know. We'll do our best to match it.
If you're interested, our signature pancakes pair wonderfully with coffee.

speaker: Chief
content: O-okay, thank you for having us...

After a long and tense night of pursuit, stepping into the café feels like entering another world. The sweet, rich aroma of coffee wraps around you. As the three enthusiastic staff members welcome you warmly, the knots of tension in your shoulders begin to loosen.
Wynn and Eugene are ushered into seats beside you, their gazes immediately lifting to the menu board, scanning its slightly crooked handwriting with open curiosity.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm not picky about beans. Something with a strong roast, please. And an extra shot.

speaker: Wynn
content: Hmm... I'll have a latte! Mornings call for something milky!

speaker: Eugene
content: Ahem, I'll... I'll have the same as Chief.

speaker: Wynn
content: The same as Chief?
With a furrowed brow aimed at Eugene, Wynn leans in close to whisper.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief's coffee is so bitter, you'd have to have been eating candy since the DisSea Explosion to balance it out. You really sure about this?

speaker: Chief
content: I can hear you, you know.

speaker: Wynn
content: Wow, the coffee here smells AMAZING!

speaker: Wynn
content: Miss Shop Owner—er, Founder? Is it the new trendy word now? Anyway, you're all so impressive!
In the nearly empty space, Wynn's endearingly clumsy subject change earns a round of quiet chuckles. The easy atmosphere draws two of the staff members over to join your conversation.
Hehe, my sister's coffee really is the best!

speaker: Wynn
content: Oh, you're sisters? Now that you mention it, you do look alike!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: That's right! This is my big sister, Kisugi Rui, and my second sister, Kisugi Hitomi!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: And I'm Kisugi Ai!
As Wynn and the other girl—near in age—gather close, their presence feels like little rays of sunshine, instantly easing the fatigue from your sleepless night.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Please don't mind our little sister. She can be quite the chatterbox.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: She's just very curious and loves talking to people.
Kisugi Rui sets a cup of aromatic coffee before you, offering an apologetic smile. Yet her gaze softens with clear affection as it finds her little sister.

speaker: Chief
content: Not at all. It's refreshing to see such liveliness.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: So much energy every day can be a handful sometimes!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Hitomi!
Kisugi Ai's cheeks puff out in a show of feigned indignation, and she shoots her sister a glare.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: You two look rather tired for so early in the morning...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: ...Must have been working all night...
Kisugi Rui gazes out the window, her chin resting in her hands, a hint of worry gracing her features.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: I've noticed more uniformed personnel like you guys coming and going lately.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Has something... happened recently?

speaker: Wynn
content: Gulp... Haven't you seen the news, Miss Rui?
At her words, Wynn swallows her mouthful of pancake in a hurry, waving a hand.

speaker: Wynn
content: Lately, there's been a group of strange thieves targeting famous artworks in Eastside!

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Oh my... that sounds quite serious...

speaker: Wynn
content: They're incredibly skilled, in and out without a trace. I heard that...
Leaning forward herself, Wynn lowers her voice to a confidential murmur and gestures the others closer.

speaker: Wynn
content: That... they might be Sinners, like that dangerous group from before who committed murder!

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: M-murder?!

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: What...? Sinners...
Seeing the three sisters' frightened expressions, Eugene interjects hurriedly, his tone a blend of intimidation and reassurance.

speaker: Eugene
content: That's right. Those types will stop at nothing. The people we're after... they might be the same. But I promise you this: we will catch them. And when we do, they'll face the full weight of justice!

speaker: Wynn
content: Yeah! So you all...

speaker: Chief
content: Ahem. Let's finish up. We still have work to do.
Something feels off, an intangible shift in the air you can't quite name. Heeding your instincts, you decide to drop the subject.
With a final sip of coffee, you offer the sisters a conciliatory smile.

speaker: Chief
content: This really was excellent coffee. I'll be sure to return.
Eugene never does finish his coffee. Seeing you near the door, he and Wynn have no choice but to rise and follow.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief, wait for me!

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi, are you certain now?

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Yes, that's him. Without a doubt.
female_content: Yes, that's her. Without a doubt.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: We've been fast enough, but they still showed up here.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: That officer in charge... is sharper than we expected.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Rui! Hitomi! I found it!
On the wall, a projection resolves into the portrait of a gray-haired man. To its side, text runs in dense lines, cataloging his achievements.
female_content: On the wall, a projection resolves into the portrait of a gray-haired woman. To its side, text runs in dense lines, cataloging her achievements.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, hero of the West District liberation, overseer of Sinners... Quite the impressive record.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: And here, I also pulled the case they mentioned.
As Kisugi Ai clicks the next file, a Sinner's art heist pops up on the screen. The record is chilling: the culprit stole the masterpiece at the cost of the owner's life.
According to the latest intel, the culprit has been identified as a Sinner, but remains at large.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: So... they think we're like that? Vicious criminals?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: ...It makes sense, I guess.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: It's all right.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We'll be seeing them often. I'm sure this misunderstanding will clear up in time.
Having cleared the remaining statues from the previous gallery incident, you open your terminal to check the latest notifications.

"Shocking! Three phantom thieves infiltrated the city's most secure gallery without a trace!" "Original or forgery? The fierce debate over the breathtaking masterpiece Otherland Angels rages on!" "Despite a joint security operation by the Public Security Bureau and the MBCC, the notorious 'Marauders' still pulled off the heist, reports confirm."

"Why did they target only the Otherland Angels despite the formidable security? Now, that's the real question!" Trending #1: Who exactly are these artwork phantom thieves? Trending #5: Hey Fox and Rabbit, you still around? Care to make a comeback?

speaker: Police Officer
content: Move!! They're getting away!!!

speaker: Police Officer
content: Team One, left flank! Team Two, right! Cut them off! Do not let them escape with that painting!

Late at night on the city's outskirts, near a factory exhibition hall, the red and blue lights of two police squadrons flashed urgently. Sirens pierced the darkness while the vehicles gave desperate chase to three figures racing ahead.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: In eight hundred meters... cliff ahead!

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We jump on my mark!

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi & Kisugi Ai
content: Understood!
As the police closed the distance, the three sisters wrenched their throttles tighter, waiting with bated breath for the perfect moment to act.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Three... two... one...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: —Now!
The instant the countdown ended, the three sisters launched their motorcycles over the cliff's edge. In one fluid motion, they sprang from their bikes mid-air.

Propelled by the fiery blast from their cycles erupting below, they soared onto waiting hang gliders and rode the thermal updraft toward their far-off goal. Left behind, the stranded officers could merely stamp the ground in furious helplessness.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Rui, Hitomi, come on, come on! Open it up, let me see!
Back inside the Cat's Eye Café, having changed from her catsuit, Kisugi Ai eagerly beckoned to her sisters, urging them to hold their newly acquired painting under the light.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Don't rush. We have all the time in the world.

With a careful motion, Kisugi Rui unfolded the soft velvet swaddling the painting, unveiling an exquisite and heartwarming scene. To the sisters, every visible brushstroke seemed to radiate the artist's profound love.
It depicted three lovely, elegant angels, their faces beaming with contentment and joy as they gathered around a small, glittering pile of gems.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Three angels and their treasure... This must be how Dad saw us...
Another painting reclaimed meant the sisters were now a step closer to finding their father. Huddled together, they gazed at the piece with tear-filled eyes.
One drop, two drops, three drops...
Their warm, joyful tears fell quietly, but on the floor beneath their feet, each drop formed a strange, spreading ripple.
The rings spread slowly, persistently...
Then, with no warning, the ripple ripped apart into a yawning chasm and devoured the entire café. There was no time to react—only an immediate, total plunge into darkness.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Rui!

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Hitomi! To me!

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: ARGH—What is going on?!

An inexorable, boundless power from the eerie abyss dragged the sisters downward. As they were pulled deeper, the painting in Kisugi Hitomi's hands—the source of their joyful tears—began to fracture, webs of cracks spreading across its surface.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: No! The painting... It's being torn apart!

The moment the darkness consumed them, the cracks multiplied across the painting's surface. Kisugi Hitomi made a desperate, grasping reach, but it was too late. The three angels, once so peacefully nestled, were already torn violently apart.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: No... Don't!
Helpless, the three sisters watched as the cherished painting splintered into three separate pieces before their eyes.
When they opened their eyes again, the world was spinning.
With great effort, the three sisters pushed their impossibly heavy bodies up, sitting slowly until their minds could catch up and steady themselves.
Their surroundings came into focus: the familiar ceiling, the familiar counter, the familiar aroma of coffee filling the air.
However...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: Wait... This place...?!
Leaning on each other for strength, the three sisters staggered toward the floor-to-ceiling window. A flood of blinding sunlight made them wince and raise their arms in defense.
As their eyes adjusted, they took in the view.
Everything—the people, the cityscape, the streets—looked precisely like the world they remembered. But it felt profoundly wrong.
Astonishment locked them in place, quickly smothered by a tide of dread. That same vertigo and pain, the terrible signature of the abyss, seized them once again without warning.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: How is this possible...? What happened?
Kisugi Rui rubbed her temples, then took a deep breath to calm herself.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We're still alive—for now, at least. A small mercy, all things considered.
Steadying her own nerves first, the eldest sister opened her arms to her younger siblings.
The two younger sisters rushed into her embrace in silence, throwing their arms around her and burying their faces in her chest.

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: We just need to think. Calmly. As long as we have each other, we can handle anything.
The magic of her words immediately soothed their panicked hearts.
Suddenly, Kisugi Ai rubbed her nose, her expression sharpening with an idea. She hurried toward the computer on the first floor.

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: The computer...! I'll—I'll find out where we are!
Gathered beside the computer desk, the three sisters all wore grave, troubled expressions. Even Kisugi Ai, usually the most optimistic, found herself frowning deeply.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: According to the information we just found, we're in a place called <color=#fb9259>DisCity</color>. And our café is located in... "Eastside"?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
content: Huh... And further west, there's a place called <color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color>. I feel like I've heard that name somewhere before...

speaker: Kisugi Rui
content: But the "why"... Why were we brought here?
No one had an answer.
In the heavy silence, Kisugi Ai clicked back to the homepage. Her fingers hovered over the keyboard, typing half-formed queries only to delete them, lost for a starting point.
At that moment, Kisugi Hitomi pointed to a link marked in red below the input field and gestures for her little sister to open it.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Here, try this one!
The link led to a news compilation page. A new browser window sprang open, dominated by the image of a gleaming, monumental structure flanked by a gray-haired man.
female_content: The link led to a news compilation page. A new browser window sprang open, dominated by the image of a gleaming, monumental structure flanked by a gray-haired woman.

content: "The Great Expo Successfully Held! Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control Led Sinners to Attend!"
"Humanity Will Triumph over Mania!"
"Black Rings and Sinners Can Be Artificially Created"
With each scroll, another strange term surfaced. Kisugi Ai began listing them, frantically opening new tabs to search for definitions.
Yet the more they investigated, the darker their faces grew. A chilling truth settled over them: this world was saturated with the recorded atrocities of beings called Sinners.

speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
content: Let me get this straight... This world has a power called "Mania." It twists people into these... um... powered individuals called "Sinners"?

speaker: Kisugi Ai
