Night lights gleam softly against the marble floor. All around, sculptures and display cases hold their silent vigil, the air here thicker, more solemn than in the previous gallery.

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief? Hey, can you hear me?
Your eyes are still scanning the area when Wynn's voice cuts in, right on cue.

speaker: Wynn
content: Okay, you're in. This is the Eastside Museum of Humanities.

speaker: Wynn
content: But heads up... their security system's way tighter than the last place.
A slight lift of your head triggers the transparent interface to snap open. A new floor plan and objective markers appear before you.

speaker: Wynn
content: Just stick to what worked last time, and you'll do great!
You nod and steer the phantom thief's body carefully forward.

speaker: Wynn
content: Y'know, honestly... it wouldn't even surprise me if this place got robbed.
Why is that?
Wynn seems to catch her own poor word choice and quickly backpedals.

speaker: Wynn
content: Oh! No, no, I mean, a lot of the items here aren't being maintained properly.

speaker: Wynn
content: It's just... how do I put it... total "paperwork-only" vibes!

speaker: Wynn
content: We checked earlier and their exhibit management is kind of... sloppy.
She clears her throat and earnestly produces several images.

speaker: Wynn
content: See these display labels? Some are hanging off, and nobody's fixed them.

speaker: Wynn
content: And their patrol logs... Theoretically, different staff check each hall every hour...

speaker: Wynn
content: But some shifts just say "1AM check," "2AM check," "3AM check"—

speaker: Wynn
content: Same handwriting every time. One person clearly filled the whole thing out!
She spreads her hands, arriving at her own conclusion.

speaker: Wynn
content: I mean, sure, not just anyone can waltz into a gallery... But with security this lazy? Any decent thief would be tempted.

And so, you call the Public Security Bureau without another word. Upon connection, you request strict supervision of the Eastside Museum of Humanities' security protocols and daily exhibit management.

speaker: Chief
content: This is... the Central Gallery.
You've been here constantly lately, preparing the venue. You know every corner intimately.
But the strange part is that the simulation's scene doesn't match the real gallery. It's an exact copy of your prepared setup.
At first, you assumed the gallery staff helped reconstruct it. But with each entry into the simulation, the feeling grows: something is wrong.
Every scene in this simulation is a location where you once faced the phantom thieves!
The suspicion hardens into a cold knot. Did the phantom thieves create this themselves?
It's the only explanation. No one else could replicate those moments so perfectly.
Who sent this device?
You remove the simulation device and turn to ask Wynn, who is standing beside you.

speaker: Wynn
content: Well... it was brought in by this lady wearing a suit. Oh, and I think there were two people walking right behind her?

speaker: Wynn
content: Hmm, that's so weird... How come... I can't picture their faces at all?
Before she finishes speaking, you notice the simulation device you just turned off has gone completely dark.
You fumble to restart it. Nothing. You try charging it, pressing every button, but the screen remains a dead, blank slate.
With the incident concluded, the MBCC personnel prepare to return to headquarters.
During the cleanup, the stubbornly inactive simulation device tumbles to the floor before you.
Its power button blinks with a rhythmic, breathing light.
The pulse is gentle but strange, out of sync with the moment, as if awaiting a response.
Driven by instinct, your fingers brush against the glow.
Instantly, the device activates itself.
No sound announces it. No projection materializes. The familiar simulation sequence fails to load; instead, a wave of Mania erupts and expands.
You open your eyes—
—and find yourself standing in the final gallery the Cat's Eye ever walked through.
Your consciousness steadies. The ground solidifies underfoot...
It reveals marble floors, silent exhibition halls, and the glint of surveillance cameras... This is unmistakably the gallery. You never made it back to reality after the last simulation ended.
Searching for an anchor, you find a mirror. The reflection gazing out holds your own features.
Is anyone there?
Silence swallows your voice.
But in the stillness, a wisp of Mania floats beside you. An almost imperceptible touch, like a weightless finger, taps your shoulder and urges you forward.
You step; it glides an inch ahead. You pause; it hovers, waiting.
It's as though... it is leading you for someone else.
Drawing a breath, you follow it deeper into the hall.
The note's script clearly reads:
"Chief, we're really glad we met you. If fate allows it, I hope... our paths cross again."
When you open your eyes again, the simulation device is still silent on the ground. You press the button.
No light erupts, no surge of Mania this time. The scene inside is simply a gallery—ordinary, belonging to Eastside.
A quiet smile touches your lips. Without a word, you lay the device next to the Cat's Eye calling card, securing both within your collection.

[Eastside Public Security Bureau - Class A Arrest Warrant]
Case No.: E.P.S.B.-W83401
Threat Level: Critical

[Target Info]
Codename: "Marauders"
Identity: Suspected Sinner
Unit Size: 3-4 individuals

[Case Report]
Recently, a series of malicious break-ins targeting private collections and public art galleries has occurred in the city. The suspects constitute an organized group that plans thefts and robberies targeting rare artworks and antique paintings.
Unlike ordinary thieves, this group is suspected to include Sinners among its members. During their operations, they have repeatedly inflicted serious injuries on security personnel and innocent civilians, rendering the nature of their crimes exceptionally severe.

[Suspect Profile]
Physical Description: All members wear masks or simple face coverings during operations. According to eyewitnesses, some members are dressed in tactical gear or dark clothing.
Linguistic Profile: Speaks Disian with noticeable difficulty.

[Bounty Notice]
A public bounty is hereby offered for the aforementioned criminal group. Any individual who provides actionable intelligence leading to the location of the suspects will be rewarded with 50,000 DisCoins and awarded the "Eastside Honorary Citizen" medal.
You close the Eastside forum chat, rubbing your brow as you mentally sort through the intelligence on the "artwork thieves" gathered over the past few days.
First, the Marauders operate as a group, one that recently infiltrated Eastside with clear, specific objectives: they only target rare artworks.
Second, their methods are exceptionally violent, far from the theatrical flair typically associated with phantom thieves.
More critically, the Marauders are highly skilled and will resort to force without hesitation.

...Something doesn't fit. You recall the brief confrontation yesterday at the museum: the figure's demeanor and movements were nothing like the brutish enforcers described in the intelligence reports.
Unless the thief recognized you and was deliberately performing.
Enough. Best to leave this to the specialists. You shake your head, unlock the terminal, and send quick messages to a few contacts.
Ask Jane
Ask Pricilla
Ask Tetra
Review current intel
The Marauders, suspected Sinners your shackles cannot detect, and the sudden spike in M-value across Eastside...
Moreover, the M-value fluctuates every time an art exhibition is held.
Could this mean that both the suspected Sinners and the Marauders are after a Mania-contaminated item in the exhibition?
One that they believe is key to their goal?
If so, you need to see it for yourself.
—!! Mmph!
In the dark alley, a man's body goes rigid before breaking into uncontrollable convulsions.

speaker: Number Two
content: Hey, Boss! You alright?!

speaker: Boss
content: Pant... Pant... That's it... That's the spot! Heh... Hehehahaha! I can feel it... It's right there! My nose never lies!

speaker: Boss
content: Those people... they've got what we missed last time! I can smell it on them!

speaker: Number Four
content: You sure, Boss? They just look like three regular ladies... Doesn't exactly scream "loaded."

speaker: Boss
content: Don't you doubt the nose of the Marauder! That painting they're carrying... Its scent... It's cleaner, purer than anything I've ever caught before! That's the one!

speaker: Number Four
content: So... same plan as always?

speaker: Boss
content: We wait till they get close to the alley, then we move—Mmph...

speaker: Boss
content: Keep it quiet, folks... If this goes sideways, that one in gray... will come for us!

Originally, they were all short-term inmates at the Eastside Public Security Bureau's detention center. They had each been locked up for theft of varying degrees, and with such common ground, they quickly became sworn brothers.
On the eve of their release, one of them suddenly awakened as a Sinner.

speaker: Number Two
content: Hey, come quick! Look at Boss! He's... chewing on something...
Everyone rushed over and discovered their boss, his eyes wild, gnawing frantically at a Public Security Bureau propaganda poster as if possessed.

speaker: Boss
content: Not enough! I need more! This isn't cutting it! Quick... find me paintings... I'll make you all rich!
Number Two rushed over and grabbed Boss's shoulders, trying to steady him. Across the room, the rest of the underlings exchanged bewildered glances.

speaker: Number Three
content: What do we do? Get him a painting to chew on? Otherwise, before we're out, they'll transfer him straight to MBCC.

speaker: Number Four
content: Yeah, guess that's our only move for now.
After leaving the detention center, the group began plotting their next moves.
Boss's ability isn't particularly powerful, but for thieves, it's invaluable: he senses any famous painting within a one-kilometer radius.

This human radar—who also fights with the prowess of a Sinner—is why the gang thrives. They pull off heist after heist, make fortunes fencing stolen goods, and slip away right under the Public Security Bureau's nose.
Yet the drawback of his ability is equally clear. It creates in him a craving for famous paintings; the more valuable the piece, the harder it is to suppress the hunger.
Exactly as is happening now.

speaker: Boss
content: —GRAAAHHH!!

He casts aside the promise to his underlings, the torment of his hunger now irresistible. In a sudden, feral lunge, he blocks the path of the three Kisugi sisters as they stroll through the evening streets of Eastside.

speaker: Boss
content: Give... me... the painting!
The confrontation is brief.
Though not Sinners, the Kisugi sisters dismantle the thieves' attack with flawless coordination, making quick work of them.
Realizing they are utterly outmatched, Number Three screeches the car to the curb and frantically whisks the others away.
Hitomi... that still counts as self-defense, right?
I'd say so. This area really isn't safe after all.
Oh yeah—Rui, what were we talking about again before all that?
Why they call them the "Marauders."
Right! They must be those terrifying-looking Sinners, all savage and bloodthirsty—rawr!
Ai, your imagination is as wild as ever.
Chatting casually, the three sisters leave the alley.
It is a story they will likely never hear: the true origin of the Marauders and their name.

speaker: Number Two
content: Boss... you really oughta get those bleeding gums checked. Every time you eat a painting, your mouth ends up a mess... It's kinda unsettling.

speaker: Boss
content: ...Like hell I will! Your face ain't on the wanted posters; mine is!

speaker: Boss
content: Ugh... I need that painting! I missed it last time at the gallery... This time, I'm getting it for sure!!

speaker: Boss
content: I heard they're selling Mania weapons on the black market... Get my hands on one of those, and no one's stopping me! HAHAHA!!

speaker: Number Three
content: How about... we aim for something else, Boss? This is way too risky. Can't we just lift the usual stuff and fence it...?
The underlings look uneasy.

speaker: Boss
content: That painting... that smell... I smell it every time I close my eyes! I wanna eat it. I wanna eat it so bad...!

speaker: Number Four
content: Boss... it's a painting. Not food.

speaker: Boss
content: Painting is food... Painting is life!!

speaker: Boss
content: ...I know you're all scared. Scared of MBCC, scared of that one in gray, scared of going back behind the bars.

speaker: Boss
content: But I'm even more scared. Scared I'll never catch that scent again.
The crew stares, stunned; they've never seen the boss this unhinged. A tense silence hangs until Number Four breaks it, stepping forward.

speaker: Number Four
content: ...Boss, Mania weapons... that's not for people like us. Touch one, and it's a death sentence.

speaker: Boss
content: A death sentence? Then so be it! If I can eat that painting, it'll be worth it!!

speaker: Boss
content: Next time... Next time... I'll—

speaker: Number Two
content: Enough! Boss... snap out of it!
Number Two can't hold back. He steps forward and seizes the boss by the shoulder.
But as he presses down, an icy shock shoots through his palm. His heart plummets. This is no longer human skin.
Hop on!

[Eastside Public Security Bureau - Class A Arrest Warrant]
Case No.: E.P.S.B.-W83507
Threat Level: Medium

[Target]
Codename: "Cat's Eye"
Identity: Suspected Sinner
Unit Size: 3 individuals

[Case Report] Recently, a series of break-ins targeting public art museums has occurred in the city. The suspects are part of an organized group that planned the theft of the renowned painting Otherland Angels. Unlike ordinary thieves, this group demonstrates highly specialized capabilities. They can bypass or disable multiple security systems within an extremely short timeframe and complete their infiltration without triggering standard alarms.

[Suspect Profile]
Physical Description: All members wear tactical form-fitting suits during operations. They exhibit high agility, but their body types show noticeable variation.
Behavioral Profile: Acquisition of standard valuables does not appear to be the suspects' primary objective.

[Bounty Notice]
A public bounty is hereby offered for the aforementioned criminal group. Any individual who provides actionable intelligence leading to the location of the suspects will be rewarded with 30,000 DisCoins and awarded the "Eastside Honorary Citizen" medal.
You study the arrest warrant in your hands and give a dry, humorless laugh.
It's no easy thing being an Eastside sheriff nowadays. The "Marauders" go quiet, and two days later, the "Cat's Eye" surfaces.
With every new Otherland Angels exhibition, Eastside's M-value ticks upward in a steady, noticeable creep.
Fortunately, everything is progressing just as you expected.
You'll have to watch that café more closely, of course. Not just for the coffee, though it is good.
You watch it because that's where the rising M-value begins.
Pricilla & Tetra
Risk Assessment
Risk Assessment 2
Fox and Rabbit's Final Operation

speaker: Pricilla
content: Hey, sly fox, eyes over here! See what I got!
With a flourish, Pricilla presents an elegant white card before her partner. On its face is the stylized design of a red cat's head.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Ohhh? How did you know I got my hands on a little souvenir from the legendary phantom thief group "Cat's Eye"? Was my aura just that dazzling?

speaker: Tetra
content: ...Who asked?

speaker: Pricilla
content: Hmph, I knew you'd think it's some back-alley fake! Okay, fine, look closer!

speaker: Pricilla
content: See this embossing? And this ink, faded just so... Heh. No cheap knockoff gets these details right.
She smugly waves the little white card, loosening and tightening her grip as if deliberately teasing her partner.
She looks away, but her fingers pause unconsciously at her sleeve cuff.
Pricilla notices her partner's subtle movement all the same.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Oho?
Pricilla's grin broadens, and she edges closer to her partner's side.

speaker: Pricilla
content: Hehehe... That's the face! The "I'm secretly jealous but too proud to admit it" face!
Mid-sentence, she realizes her body feels impossibly heavy, as if filled with lead. Sensing something, she looks up at her partner beside her.
Only to find her own grin now sitting on her partner's face.

speaker: Tetra
content: How should I put this... Letting all that envy get to your head isn't exactly a good thing.

speaker: Pricilla
content: You... with your dirty trick...
Casually, Fox plucks the card from her hand, then gives her partner a light pat on the cheek.

speaker: Tetra
content: Save your breath. This card is mine now.

speaker: Option
options: Say it again... Whose card is it?

content: A voice, flat and emotionless, reaches them. Though not loud, it carries a chill that can tighten the spine of any Sinner.

speaker: Option
options: Pricilla. Did you take something from me again?

speaker: Pricilla
content: Wha—?! N-no! Chief, I was just... borrowing it! Right—

speaker: Pricilla
content: I was totally gonna... return it when I was done! Seriously!

speaker: Pricilla
content: Chief! Chief, wait, not the shackles! We can talk this through!

speaker: Chief
content: Don't worry. I'll make sure you're not alone.

speaker: Tetra
content: Hold on. I had no part in th—

speaker: Pricilla
content: Heh! You're not wriggling out of this, you sly fox!
Seizing Tetra's moment of distraction, Pricilla breaks her hold. They are on the verge of clashing when you act.
In that instant, you release your shackles, winding them securely around both figures.
From the air, the white card with its red cat design drifts gently down, coming to rest once more in your open palm as though it had never been gone.
I have to show you a grand adventure unique to Whitesands!
Scorching sand, clear skies, and the blazing sun!
Get a new hairstyle, throw on some light clothes, hop in the car, and put the pedal to the metal!
A fight to the death against desperados? That's the most common beginning of an adventure story!
Of course, there will be bounty hunters too! They're all the same, cunning yet generous. Bang. They always hit the bullseye with a wide grin!
The wind, the car races, and the sand that gets into your mouth from all the laughter...
Blow it up, blow it up! Dazzle everyone with a mind-blowing hero's entrance!
Who's the hero?
...Ha, do you even need to ask?
Of course it's the great hero who beat the desert bandits, tamed the bounty hunters, and defeated all the chumps...

speaker: Hella
content: Bounty my ass! Quit acting cool and save your own f**king skin first! Why am I driving??? I don't have a license, ahhhh!
The engine roars, and bullets whiz through the air. Hella screams as she grips the dune buggy's steering wheel.

speaker: Hella
content: I haven't even sat in the driver's seat much, let alone get a license! If we crash into something, we're all f**king doomed!
The figure next to Hella leisurely flicks the brim of her hat and gazes at the relentless pursuers behind with a smile.
Don't worry. It's no biggie.
There's a first for everything. I was around your age when I first drove, too.
This is the steering wheel, and that's the gas pedal. Got it? Now drive!

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhh! We're flipping! We're gonna flip over!!!!
[WhiteSands Market]

A few hours ago
Marketplace, WhiteSands Region

The market is bustling with small stalls and crowded with people. Caravans passing through WhiteSands stop here to replenish supplies and gather information, while some merchants try to sell off surplus goods.
Blending into the crowd, a small group inconspicuously slipped into the marketplace.

speaker: Horo
content: Stay alert. The target is cunning. We need to gather as much intelligence as possible. We must not lose track of it.

speaker: Legion Member
content: ...Horo, is it okay to leave that MBCC girl alone in the car?

speaker: Horo
content: It's really dangerous here. It's for her own good to leave her there. She'll understand.

speaker: Horo
content: First things first. Let's move.
Horo gestures to the other Legion members, and they quietly throw on their cloaks, disappearing into the crowd.
The bustle of the market offers the Legion excellent cover, but... it's not quite as kind to the "little tail" trailing behind them.

speaker: Hella
content: Damn it, there are too many people here... How did Horo and the others disappear with just a few turns?!

speaker: Hella
content: Did they find out I was tailing them and ditch me on purpose? No way...

speaker: Hella
content: ...Just trying to learn from you guys. It's not like I'll hold you back! Why do you have to keep me out?

speaker: Hella
content: ...I'm not that useless. Seriously.
After struggling to navigate through the crowd, Hella finally finds a high vantage point. Standing on her tiptoes, she scans the crowd but finds no trace of her target.
Hella ruffles her hair in frustration, takes a deep breath and exhales loudly.

speaker: Hella
content: Who cares! I will definitely get stronger as long as I keep trying! Alright, I need some intel now. Hmm... crowded places are always good for intel...
There's a little stall nearby, where shabby parasols cast shade over a low table. Next to the table is a tall wooden board with a few wanted posters fluttering in the dry wind.
And the wanted individuals... are sitting and having a blast right under their own wanted posters.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Keep goin'... I just scored some <color=#fb9259>pricey goods</color>. My luck is on fire!
On the table, dice rattle happily inside wooden beer mugs. The wanted posters over their heads do not ruin the desert bandits' mood at all, playing cards and bragging about their haul loudly.

speaker: Hella
content: Goods? I remember Horo mentioned something about keeping an eye on some goods too...

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe, I'll listen in for you...
She crouches low and carefully sneaks closer to the desert bandits, trying to catch snippets of their conversation. Luckily her tiptoeing goes unnoticed in this overly busy market.

To her disappointment, the bandits' conversations hold little substance—just talk of food, drinks, fun, and loot. There’s no mention of the "pricey goods" at all. Hella listens for so long that her legs nearly go numb, but she still learns nothing of importance.
—Until a figure brushes past Hella towards the desert bandits, and takes a seat at their table.
The sun shines on the hot ground, and a gentle breeze rustles the thick layers of wanted posters.
The woman removes her hat, locks eyes with the bandits, and speaks in a relaxed tone.
Playing a game? Can I join?
Dice, poker? Or how about something more thrilling...
A wanted poster is slapped onto the table—it’s the one of the desert bandit leader.
How about a <color=#fb9259>bounty game</color>?
Long time no see, old buddy. Pulled off some big heists recently? Your bounty's gone up quite a bit. Congrats...

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Bounty hunter... Korryn, this is not your place to talk.

speaker: Korryn
content: What, don't want to see me? Feeling scared? Don't want to play some cards? Or maybe...
The green lizard perched on the woman's rifle darts its eyes around.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh, I get it, you're afraid you can't even beat a little lizard, and that I'll send you back in, right?
Before she even finishes her words, the table is flipped over with great force. A desert bandit suddenly attacks, heading straight for Korryn!
...Bang!
The woman's movements too fast to follow. She doesn't even fire her rifle, but simply knocks the enemy to the ground with the butt of her gun.
Disregarding the glares of the other desert bandits, Korryn puts on her hat with panache and pulls out another wanted poster from her pocket to compare.

speaker: Korryn
content: Wow, you're the one with the highest bounty. Looks like I'm in luck today...

speaker: Korryn
content: How about the rest of you? Wanna come at me all at once?

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: Damn you, who the hell do you think you are?
Seeing their leader knocked to the ground, the other bandits grow furious and dash toward Korryn, but their fallen leader stops them.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Wait a sec, why's my pocket so light? Something's wrong... where's my stuff?!
The "goods" are missing. The bandit leader glares at Korryn, but the bounty hunter shrugs innocently, as if to say it has nothing to do with her.

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: Boss, everything we robbed this morning is gone! The boxes we put there are gone too! Carajo... There's a thief! A thief!
The crowd of onlookers finally starts to stir. Everyone frantically checks their pockets to see if they've been picked.
And Hella, who has been watching the farce throughout, can't hold back her laughter any longer.

speaker: Hella
content: Pfft...!
It's too late to cover her mouth. Her snickering face is spotted by the bandits at the crime scene.
Their eyes meet, and Hella finally gets a good look at his face... It's the same old dumb desert bandit she tangled with the last time she came to WhiteSands!
The good news is, Hella is wearing a new outfit today to secretly follow Horo. Plus, it's been two years—he's probably long forgotten her.

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: Boss, this girl looks familiar... She's a cop from DisCity! Hey, was it you who stole our stuff?!
The bad news is, these desert bandits might be dumb, but their memory is sharp.

speaker: Hella
content: What cop? A cop in WhiteSands? You got the wrong person, bro!

speaker: Hella
content: I proudly serve Syndicate Legion Commander Horo—the shorty with the big axe! We're childhood buds! I knew her when she was just this tall!
As she speaks, she gestures to the height of her knees.

speaker: Korryn
content: ...Legion?
The crowd hesitates upon hearing that famous name. The Legion's reputation does work wonders, even outside Syndicate.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: No, wait... Legion my ass! I recognize you!! You're that damn BBQ-C cop who beat us up two years ago!

speaker: Hella
content: Pff, hahahahah! BBQ-C...hahahah.

speaker: Hella
content: Ahem, no, no... what BBQ? I really don't know what you're talking about, the Legion left a long time ago, we...

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: You little vixen, still lying?! I'll break your leg!
Playing dumb didn't work. Time to run!
Without a second thought, Hella dashes off, not forgetting to flip a finger back at them.

speaker: Hella
content: So you want things the hard way, huh? I just wasn't in the mood to stir up trouble. It's not because I'm scared of you!
Passing a corner, Hella suddenly kicks over a nearby stall. The toppled wooden board forms a shield in the narrow passage.
The Rat Queen of Syndicate spins around and grabs a pipe, preparing to face the enemy.

speaker: Hella
content: Break my leg? Hah! I haven't been in the Syndicate all these years for nothing! I'll grow a new leg for every one you break! Come on, let's go one-on-one. Wonder how long you WhiteSands punks can last!
[WhiteSands Market]

speaker: Hella
content: You WhiteSands punks have no f**king shame! The whole lot of you ganging up on one little girl? Come and fight me one-on-one... hiyaa!

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Get her!!
More bandits close in. Escape is Hella's specialty, but this isn't Syndicate, and Hella is unfamiliar with the terrain. She soon gets surrounded.
Hella jumps onto a pile of goods, whacking whoever tries to approach. As she swings her pipe, someone grabs her arm from behind, pulling her backward.
Follow me! This way!
Hella is led through twists and turns, running around the market several times before finally ducking into a hidden corner.
The two squat behind a wooden fence. The desert bandits don't notice this little hideout and run past, shouting. Hella, panting heavily, finally gets a chance to look at her "savior."
Korryn notices her gaze and turns to smile back at Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Are you that bounty hunter?

speaker: Korryn
content: Yup, that's me. The best bounty hunter in WhiteSands. And this is my trusty partner—Sheriff the Lizard.
The lizard flicks its tail at Hella to say hi.

speaker: Korryn
content: You can call me Korryn, or any other nice words you can think of. It's all good.

speaker: Korryn
content: As for you, little one... are you a cop or with the Legion?
Korryn looks at Hella inquisitively. The scrapes from her recent fight are healing rapidly. Hella's eyes dart around, and she quickly speaks up.

speaker: Hella
content: Why would the cops hire a child? We Legionnaires are the mortal enemies of the cops. We beat them up, stole their clothes, then beat up the desert bandits in their clothes. It's all a misunderstanding.

speaker: Hella
content: If we weren't so scattered now, I would have summoned 800 fellow Legionnaires to pummel them silly!

speaker: Hella
content: Well, that's not important now. Getting away is our priority! Could you please cover me, pretty lady? The Legion will definitely thank you big time later.
The bounty hunter ponders, seemingly not convinced that a kid can offer much of a reward.

speaker: Korryn
content: Thank me, huh? How big of a reward are we talking about? We bounty hunters have a clear price tag.

speaker: Hella
content: I'll thank you with a chariot! Plus a month's salary of some big dummy as your pocket money!
The bluff slips out easily. Korryn pauses, then bursts into laughter.

speaker: Korryn
content: Salary... hahaha! Alright then, for the sake of our fateful encounter!
She pulls out the crumpled wanted poster from her pocket, showing the desert bandit's portrait to Hella.

speaker: Korryn
content: The desert bandits chasing you just stole someone else's Hypercube, but they didn't keep an eye on it. Now they're taking it out on you, thinking you're the thief who stole their loot.

speaker: Korryn
content: These guys are incompetent, but they hold grudges like no other. It's not easy to escape. Let me think...
Footsteps echo on the other side of the fence. Korryn quickly holds her breath, shielding Hella with her body, and looks out warily.
The desert bandits are back. There's only one path outside the hiding spot, and they'll soon search here.

speaker: Hella
content: S**t! We're cornered...!

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't worry.

speaker: Korryn
content: These desert bandits always stick together. Beat them on the left and more will come from the right. It's like fighting cockroaches. They're not that strong, but just won't die.

speaker: Korryn
content: However, this fighting style has many loopholes. If you find a gap in their encirclement, you can easily slip away.
Korryn speaks in a lighthearted manner, as if everything is under control, and that beating the desert bandits is as simple as swatting bugs.
Hella can hardly see Korryn's backlit face clearly, but she can't help but grab her outstretched hand.

speaker: Korryn
content: By the way, what's your name, miss?

speaker: Hella
content: Hella! I just go by Hella!

speaker: Korryn
content: Nice to meet you, little Hella. It's a bit sudden, but get ready and take a deep breath...

speaker: Korryn
content: Time to make a run for it!
Before the girl can react, Korryn yanks Hella into her arms and kicks over the wooden fence in front of them.

speaker: Desert Bandit
content: So there you are! Get 'em, boys!
The bandit leader barely finishes his sentence before Korryn kicks him over.
Hella staggers as Korryn pulls her forward. She looks up and sees Korryn's big smile.

speaker: Korryn
content: Let's go! I'm gonna take you for some thrills!
A shabby buggy speeds past, stirring up a cloud of dust. The desert bandits are still in hot pursuit.

speaker: Hella
content: Holy cow, you know how to drift?! That's so cool!

speaker: Korryn
content: Like it?

speaker: Hella
content: Love it! That old dummy drove by the rules... so boring and slow... Finally, I get to enjoy the ride!
Seeing Hella's excited face, the bounty hunter laughs heartily.

speaker: Korryn
content: Great. There's no one to stop us in WhiteSands. We can drive as fast as we want. Come, little Hella! You hit the gas!

speaker: Hella
content: Wow... Ah?
Saying this, Korryn leaps from the driver's seat, grabs Hella by the collar, and drops her in the driver's seat. Then she turns around, gun aimed towards the back.

speaker: Hella
content: What??? No, no, I've only ever been a passenger! Come back here!

speaker: Korryn
content: Haha, your short arms are perfect for driving, darling. You'll be fine!

speaker: Korryn
content: You are easily a natural, who, like those daredevils, simply won't crash—just floor it and hold tight to the wheel!

speaker: Korryn
content: As for me...
Korryn gets her rifle loaded.

speaker: Korryn
content: I have to show you a grand adventure unique to WhiteSands!

speaker: Hella
content: Holy s**t...!

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhh! We're flipping! We're gonna flip over!!!!
[CG - Car Chase A]
The shabby dune buggy bursts out, bouncing a few times on the ground before finally stabilizing. Hella is sitting in the driver's seat, scared but safe.
Korryn tries to lean out and shoot but nearly gets hit by bullets from behind.

speaker: Korryn
content: ...Tsk, can't hit 'em. Need a better position...

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Haha! Give it up now!
Another wave of gunfire crackles. The shabby little buggy speeds along the transport route, trailed by shrieking desert bandits.
Holding down her hat with one hand, Korryn finally gets a chance to glance back at the trembling Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: Steering wheel... gas pedal... gears... wait, which one's the brake?!

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh, it's simple. Hold the wheel tight and floor the gas—the brake? What of it? You won't need it.

speaker: Hella
content: So why am I the one driving ahhhhh...!
She steps down on the gas pedal all the way, pushing the vehicle to its limits, but the bandits are still closing in.
Misfortunes always come in a bundle. A flash appears in the rearview mirror—a gleaming cannon barrel is aimed right at the little shabby buggy!

speaker: Korryn
content: Little Hella, get ready. We're gonna jump out of the car.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh?

speaker: Korryn
content: Now!
Korryn grabs the steering wheel, slams it to the left, and the car instantly veers off course.
The rifle muzzle flares, and traces of Mania crawl up the shooter's face. The Sinner shooter spins around and fires—the bullet hits the engine of the vehicle behind.

speaker: Korryn
content: Bullseye.
The next second, flames shoot skyward. The two are blown away by the explosion's shockwave, landing in the sand below the cliff.
[White]
The wind sweeps across the sand. The entire area is deserted.
Half a ruined car frame tilts on the sand. Parts and metal scraps are scattered everywhere, while the near totaled engine emits a puff of black smoke.
Rustle... rustle...
A green lizard scurries across the sand, leaving a trail of tiny footprints. It carefully circles the ground and finally finds a softer patch of sand, patting it gently with its claws.
Puff! A hand bursts through the sand. Korryn crawls out, pulling out a coughing Hella with her.

speaker: Hella
content: Cough, cough, cough... pfft, pfft!

speaker: Korryn
content: Little Hella... Hey, snap out of it! Still alive?

speaker: Korryn
content: Still mad? Oh, come on, you did great. Here, if it helps, you can pinch my left cheek to let off some steam...

speaker: Korryn
content: Please be gentle. My skin's delicate. I can't take too much pain.
Korryn actually leans her face closer, only to find Hella looking up with shining eyes.

speaker: Hella
content: That was awesome!!!!

speaker: Hella
content: Didn't expect driving to be this fun! Is bounty hunting always this thrilling? I had a blast!!!

speaker: Hella
content: I really wish that dummy and Hecate were here to see this. When we were retreating, they wouldn't let me touch the wheel. But look at me now, ${PlayerName}! I'm a fantastic driver.

speaker: Korryn
content: ${PlayerName}? Hmm... That name sounds familiar...
Korryn seems to ponder something. Hella quickly waves her hand to change the subject.

speaker: Hella
content: Oh, and that shot of yours! The last one, bang—it made the desert bandits bite the dust! So cool!

speaker: Hella
content: Can you teach me? I want to be a badass like you. This is why I left the city!
Hella wields her pipe like a gun, striking a cool shooting pose. Korryn bursts into laughter.

speaker: Korryn
content: Pfft, hahaha!

speaker: Hella
content: What's so funny? I'm serious! You saw how I helped earlier, right? Even though I didn't know how to drive, I took you on a wild ride. I'm quick learner! Pleeeeease teach me~

speaker: Hella
content: After what we've been through together, we are now kind of, you know... partners, right?

speaker: Korryn
content: Of course, I'm delighted to meet a "partner" like you. But...
The wind suddenly picks up. As the blazing sun starts to set, the wind in WhiteSands gradually turns cold. Hella gets hit by the chill and sneezes hard.

speaker: Korryn
content: See, the wind in WhiteSands is deadly. After a whole day of adventure, the heroes need to find a place to rest.
Korryn checks the sun to determine the direction and makes a decision.

speaker: Korryn
content: We're not far from the old route. There's a place nearby where we can stay. The town's small, but we will probably be able to get a new car.

speaker: Korryn
content: So, can you still walk?
After a long, bumpy journey, Hella finally sees her destination before her legs give out.
It's really small town, nestled in the lee of a massive wall of sand. The buildings are old and look like they'll soon be swallowed up by the sand.
A wooden sign hangs over the town's gate—if that shaky frame can even be called one. Looking up, Hella sees a few big letters carved on it. It's a really simple word, even Hella can read it out.

speaker: Hella
content: ..."Tuco"?
[Desert - Daytime]

speaker: Male Townsman
content: That's right! This is Tuco!

speaker: Male Townsman
content: It's an oasis in the desert, a traveler's paradise, and the perfect vacation spot! No trip to WhiteSands is complete without visiting Tuco!

speaker: Male Townsman
content: Now, let me show you the grandest building in Tuco... The magnificent, unparalleled <color=#fb9259>Tuco Palace</color>!

speaker: Young Boy
content: Yeehaw!
[Tuco - Motel]

speaker: Male Townsman
content: So, what do you think? Impressed?

speaker: Hella
content: ...This is the magnificent, unparalleled Tuco Palace...?
Hella looks up at the dilapidated building covered in cracks. The welcome sign overhead looks ready to fall at any moment. A little gray mouse pokes its head out from the sign, staring at her.

Looking down, a woman clutching a vihuela lies unconscious at the front entrance. In front of her are two suspicious figures, one with shifty eyes, and the other around Hella's age. They are striking strange poses.

speaker: Motel Owner
content: Welcome to <color=#fb9259>Tuco Motel</color>, my dear guest!
The Motel Owner's attitude is warm and friendly. She emphasizes the words "Tuco Motel" with particular clarity.

speaker: Motel Owner
content: I'm in charge of this place. Please call me Mira.

speaker: Mira
content: That big loudmouth is Wright, the town sheriff. The little loudmouth is Timmy, one of our Tuco kids.

speaker: Mira
content: They're not bad people. Just a little bit... odd.
Ignoring the man in the ill-fitting uniform muttering about the "grand desert hotel," Mira shuffles over and lowers her voice mysteriously.
Her gaze flickers and drifts toward Hella's side. Hella turns her head, just in time to see Korryn entering and ordering food like a regular.

speaker: Mira
content: They're actually quite honest, compared to some people.

speaker: Hella
content: You mean... her?

speaker: Mira
content: That's right. In WhiteSands, the ones you should be most wary of are bounty hunters. They only care about money, not people. Today they're your friend, tomorrow they could be after your life.

speaker: Hella
content: Jeez... are those bounty hunters really that despicable?

speaker: Mira
content: I have a friend who's a bounty hunter. She's been sneaky from a young age, and only hangs out with a lizard. She says that friends should always stick together, but in reality, if she sets her eyes on something, she'll snatch it by any means...
The description is so familiar. Hella just had a really bumpy trip with such a bounty hunter.

speaker: Hella
content: That person wouldn't happen to also wear a white hat, would she?

speaker: Mira
content: Long hair, white hat, and a lizard.
Mira nods to each word.
A few meters away, Korryn turns her head, cheeks puffed with food. As she meets their gaze, she points at herself.

speaker: Korryn
content: Ah?... Me?

speaker: Drunken Woman
content: Yes! You! It's... you!
The woman with that vihuela, who was lying unconscious by the front entrance earlier, suddenly stands up shakily and points a trembling finger at Korryn.

speaker: Mira
content: Oh no, Maggie's at it again...

speaker: Maggie
content: You promised me that we'll dine and dash together! You said that the signal was smashing a glass!

speaker: Maggie
content: But you left me behind! I was stuck washing dishes for a week be-be-before they finally let me go...!
She suddenly grabs Korryn and shakes her wildly.

speaker: Korryn
content: Wait, wait... you've got the wrong person, it's not me...
The bounty hunter tries to argue, but her denial clearly triggers the drunkard even more.

speaker: Maggie
content: Lying again! You liar! You bastard!

speaker: Maggie
content: I won't let you go until you admit your crimes! I'll... keep watching, I'll keep...
The recently eaten food churns in Korryn's stomach as she gets violently shaken. She has to cover her mouth in agony.
Korryn closes her eyes, raising her hands in surrender.

speaker: Korryn
content: Uh... ugh... stop, stop shaking me!

speaker: Korryn
content: I admit it, I admit it was me, okay...? I just finished eating. I really don't want to throw up... ugh!
The drunken woman suddenly releases her grip, and Korryn, caught off guard, falls sideways from the chair and crashes hard onto the floor.

speaker: Hella
content: Hahaha, what a dummy... hmm?
Her vision suddenly darkens, prompting Hella to look up.
She’s suddenly pulled into a warm embrace, the scent of alcohol, rich perfume, and exotic spices swirling around her, overwhelming her senses!
Maggie clings to the young girl. Tears stream down her face, but her hands are tightly wrapped around the girl's neck.

speaker: Maggie
content: Sob, you're so young, so naive. You can't let this wicked liar harm you!

speaker: Hella
content: No... the person who messed with you is over there! Why the hell are you grabbing me...!

speaker: Maggie
content: Look at how cute you are... and your clothes are brand new! You're obviously an easy target...
Gasping for air, Hella's face twists as she desperately pries at Maggie's choking grip, calling for help.

speaker: Hella
content: Help, help! Let go of me! Korryn, Korryn!
Beside the struggling pair, Korryn lies curled up on the ground, clutching her stomach in agony, barely able to fend for herself.
Luckily, before Hella completely suffocates, the kind-hearted motel owner steps in.

speaker: Mira
content: Maggie! Let go!
The grip around her neck loosens. Hella finally breathes in some fresh air.

speaker: Mira
content: I'm really sorry, Maggie loses control whenever she drinks... This meal's on me, as an apology to you!

speaker: Hella
content: (Pants) ...Oh?
Hella turns and locks eyes with the bounty hunter lying on the ground.

speaker: Korryn
content: Seize the deal...!

speaker: Hella
content: ...while it's on the table!
Reaching a consensus, the two little stinkers exchange knowing smiles.

speaker: Hella
content: Haha, you are too kind! I don't mind at all! We're all family here.
Korryn raises her arm, and her lizard obediently perches on the back of her hand. The lizard, Sheriff, starts "dancing" on her hand as she voices him like a ventriloquist.

speaker: Korryn
content: "Better accept graciously! Better accept graciously!"
There's nothing a free lunch can't fix. If there is, just throw in a cold drink with unlimited refills.
Tender steak paired with juicy cactus slices, followed by big gulps of icy mint tea... there's no greater comfort for Hella after a long day.
Drunken Maggie is already curled up asleep in the corner, finally bringing a rare quiet to the restaurant.
Korryn sips the last of her drink and crunches the ice in her mouth.

speaker: Korryn
content: Now that we've escaped and had a proper meal, what's your next move?

speaker: Hella
content: Mmm... Borrow a car to find the Legion?

speaker: Korryn
content: Borrow a car?
Korryn lifts her chin and gestures for Hella to take in their surroundings. It's hard not to sigh at the sight of the shabby "Tuco Palace."

speaker: Korryn
content: Are you sure... there's a car here you can borrow?

speaker: Mira
content: Hehe, don't worry. We're remote, but there are local products that need to be taken to the market for sale. There are trucks around.

speaker: Mira
content: We rarely have out-of-town visitors. The townsfolk will be thrilled to see you...
Mira clears away the dishes and gets ready to take Hella to borrow a car...
...Until a sudden commotion erupts outside.

speaker: Timmy
content: Who... Who are you?!

speaker: Timmy
content: What did you do to the others?! Someone... help! Mmm! Help...
Where are those two wenches?! If you don't speak up, I'll crush you too!
Hella recognizes the intruder's voice and jumps up from her chair.

speaker: Hella
content: It's those desert bandits! They found us!
[Tuco - Street]

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Tell me, where are the goods? Where are those two wenches?!

speaker: Little Timmy
content: Mmmph... No, no idea... I don't... I don't know anything!!

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Ha, both young and old are playin' dumb with me, eh?
Timmy is thrown to the ground. Beside him, a uniformed Wright is gagged and bound, unable to move.

speaker: Wright
content: Mmmph, mmmph!
The desert bandit leader viciously kicks Wright's stomach a few times. When he can no longer make any sounds due to the pain, the bandit draws a knife and hands it to his underling.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: If you're not gonna talk, I'll make sure you never speak again.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: You, in the uniform, open your eyes wide and watch how I tear this kid apart...

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Don't gag him, let him scream! The louder the better. I'm sure they won't ignore his cries... Ah!
The desert bandit leader was interrupted by a metal bucket thrown at the back of his head.

speaker: Hella
content: Let 'em go! The invincible Hella's right here!

speaker: Hella
content: ...Take this!
Hella swings her steel pipe, slamming it into the bandit's gun before striking his face.

speaker: Hella
content: Hell yeah! Another point for Hella!
The bandit stumbles back, clutching his nose. He then steadies himself and roars in fury.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Damn! You really want to have things the hard way, huh? Bring out the weapons, boys!
Three cannons simultaneously rise from behind them, all aimed at Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: ...For f**k's sake...

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Heh, this is some good stuff from DisCity. Just three shells, and we'll blow this dump to smithereens...

speaker: Hella
content: Shameless!

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Haha! In WhiteSands, the only sin is weakness!

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Instead of bickering with me, kiddo, why not check on your "companions"?
Hella suddenly senses something wrong. She turns around and sees the townsfolk surrounded by the bandits.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Now, make your choice... Would you rather die under these cannons, or surrender the Hypercubes and beg for a quick death?

speaker: Hella
content: Surrender? Heh. In your f**king dream!
The bandit's threat doesn't work. Hella steps forward heroically, standing at the front of the crowd, using her body to shield the townsfolk.
She hates being framed for no reason, and despises bullies even more. She doesn't care who stole the bandits' looted Hypercube; she just wants to beat them to a pulp with her steel pipe.
Plus, her confidence stems from one more thing.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm not fighting alone here, okay? Two Sinners against you losers... it'll be an easy peasy fight!
The desert bandit is stunned for a moment, then bursts into laughter.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Ha... hahaha, alright, I get it... so that's how it is...

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: You talkin' about innocence, huh? We ain't good guys though, but that wench with the gun... she prolly didn't get her Hypercube in a clean way either.

speaker: Hella
content: Stop your bull***tting! Throwing dirt 'cause you can't win? Well listen up, your spinning won't work on us...

speaker: Hella
content: ...Right, Korryn?
Hella turns and spots Korryn at the back of the crowd... This "trusty friend" is trying to sneak over the wall, one leg already in the air..
Korryn turns her head stiffly, locking eyes with Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: Eh...What are you doing?

speaker: Hella
content: The enemy's over here, where are you going...?

speaker: Korryn
content: Hahaha... That was quick. You guys done talking already?

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't mind me. Take all the time you need... Hella darling, you were super cool just now! Hang in there! Tuco is in your hands!

speaker: Korryn
content: I've got something else to attend to. Be back in a jiffy~
Korryn blows a kiss and nimbly flips over the wall in the next moment, vanishing completely.
...Poor little Hella is left behind, dumbfounded, to face the fierce desert bandits alone.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Ha! Only one obstacle left... Aim the cannons at her! Ready to fire!

speaker: Hella
content: Ah...Huh?? You big liar!!!!
[Tuco - Street]

speaker: Hella
content: Korryn, you bastard!! Get back here!!

speaker: Mira
content: Hella, don't go!

speaker: Hella
content: Why?! Did you realize that she...
Hella wants to chase after Korryn, but Mira grabs her.

speaker: Mira
content: It's dangerous! A sandstorm is coming...
The wind picks up, stirring up the coarse sand. The sky turns dark as a heavy black mass approaches swiftly in the horizon.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: No biggie! Plenty o' time to send you on your way before the sandstorm hits!

speaker: Hella
content: ...Nonsense! With me here...

speaker: Mira
content: Enough, Hella! Just go! Don't worry about us.
Mira seems to have made her decision and tugs on Hella's sleeve. Her hand is trembling, but her tone is firm.

speaker: Mira
content: Korryn is a liar. We trusted the wrong person, but you're different... Forget about us. Without us, you alone can definitely get out before the sandstorm hits.

speaker: Hella
content: But you guys have no bullets left! If I leave, you're all dead!

speaker: Mira
content: That's still better than everyone being trapped here. Leave, now! Time is running out!
Mira's tone is firm, but Hella can still feel her hand trembling uncontrollably.
The sandstorm is approaching, and her pipe is no match for the cannons, let alone the raging Mania within it. Without Korryn's help, she probably won't even be able to stop the desert bandits.
...Then, should she flee alone?

speaker: Hella
content: No, I can't leave... gotta use my head and think! That dummy wouldn't give up at a time like this. He'd figure something out... There's gotta be a way...
female_content: No, I can't leave... gotta use my head and think! That dummy wouldn't give up at a time like this. She'd figure something out... There's gotta be a way...

speaker: Hella
content: ...If he were here, he'd definitely...
female_content: She looks down at the woman fallen at her feet.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Leave? None of you are leaving! Y'all doomed today!... Ahhh!!
A flying object hits him square in the face. This time, the bandit is knocked over by the shovel Hella threw.

speaker: Hella
content: You mean yourselves! Y'all are doomed today!

speaker: Hella
content: Who cares about guns, shells or sandstorms... I'm <color=#fb9259>Syndicate's littlest big shot, and the pride of the MBCC!</color> So what if you have cannons? I've seen it all in the Black Ring!
Hella raises her weapon, pointing straight at the enemy.
Everyone has things they can't let go of or battles they can't escape from. She's no longer the little mouse fleeing from gunfire.

speaker: Hella
content: These folks are under my protection! By your own rules in WhiteSands, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth...

speaker: Hella
content: Wanna mess with them? You gotta get past me first!

speaker: Hella
content: ...Ha, ha... Holy crap, how are there still so many...

The wind grows more violent. Coarse sand grains scrape against her skin, leaving red marks. Her Sinner power works hard to heal her, but it can't keep up with the rate of her injuries. Struggling to swing her pipe, she's barely holding on.
The sky darkens, and the desert bandits who are still attacking start to panic.

speaker: Desert Bandit Minion
content: Boss, we're not gonna make it! The wind's getting stronger! It's the <color=#fb9259>Tide of Ashes</color>! We should retreat!
The wind roars. The desert bandit leader glares viciously at Hella, then finally waves his hand to signal retreat.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Ptui! You think you can run away? Without the protection of Hypercubes, you'll all die in the sandstorm!
The roar of the sand ship's engine fades away, and Hella finally collapses onto the ground.

speaker: Hella
content: Ow, my arm... If I fought any longer, I'd have lost...

speaker: Hella
content: But the sandstorm's coming. That Tide of Ashes is no joke. I can't stay here. I gotta tell the Tuco folks to get out...
In the earlier battle, most of Tuco's residents retreated to the town center under Hella's cover. Now that the bandit threat has been cleared, they must escape the town before the storm hits.
Hella stumbles towards the square and spots a bunch of busy figures in the distance.

speaker: Hella
content: Quick, the desert bandits have left! The Tide of Ashes or something is coming! We have to leave! I'll help you pack, I...

speaker: Familiar Female Voice
content: Alright, everyone speed up! We need to make a run for it!
A familiar voice, a familiar figure.
The Tuco townsfolk are deftly straddling the low wall, struggling to haul a large, strange box with all their might. Hella bursts into the square, and everyone freezes, their eyes fixed on her...
In the middle of the crowd pushing the big box is the one who had just "fled in panic"... Korryn.

speaker: Korryn
content: Yo, Hella darling! I'm back to save the day! Ready to make a dash?
Korryn salutes Hella without a hint of embarrassment.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Why are you here? Trying to trick us again?

speaker: Hella
content: Mira, don't let her fool you, this bastard...

speaker: Mira
content: Ahahaha, well, um...
Mira lets out an awkward chuckle. Hella's death glare sweeps the square, causing a few townsfolk to guiltily avert their gaze and look at the large box instead.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What is this?

speaker: Korryn
content: Just a bit of... luggage we borrowed from the bandits?
Another gust of wind blows through, and the welcome sign at the town gate crashes to the ground. The noise jitters the townsfolk, causing them to drop the box onto the ground.
A few blue Hypercubes tumble out, rolling slowly to Hella's feet.

speaker: Hella
content: What the hell! A den of thieves!!! You're all in on it!!

speaker: Wright
content: Don't say that, little lady! We're not like the desert bandits! They're a "faceless" bunch, who ain't know nothing about "law 'n otter".

speaker: Wright
content: But we... are the "caterpillars" of building a better tomorrow! We'll "conspire" this together!

speaker: Hella
content: Bullcrap! There's no "we" in this! And I am not a bug! You are!

speaker: Maggie
content: Hehe, well, it's an emergency... How about I share some of my goods with you? One Hypercube? Two? I can't give you more than that, or else I won't have enough!

speaker: Hella
content: You think I care about splitting the damn loot?! Huh?!

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh dear, it's not good for kids to swear! Swearing will stop you from growing tall!
The more she tries to soothe Hella, the angrier Hella gets. She curses and stomps, charging at Korryn with a flurry of punches. But Korryn blocks the attack and tries to explain in a softer tone.

speaker: Korryn
content: The direction of the wind has changed, and the sandstorm will hit soon. The sand ships here aren't as good as the ones in DisCity, so someone had to prepare in advance without alerting the bandits.

speaker: Korryn
content: Problem was, not many people in Tuco can fight. I had to get to the ship, but someone also had to hold off the bandits...

speaker: Korryn
content: Luckily, with you here, we gained enough time to retreat with an adequate Hypercube supply... Now that we're fully prepared, let's set off!
After her long-winded explanation, Korryn waits for Hella's wrath, but it doesn't come as expected.
Hella lowers her head, her expression unreadable and her fist freezing three inches away. Korryn scratches her head and cautiously bends down.

speaker: Korryn
content: Still mad, little hero?

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh dear, I really planned to stay and fight with you... Look, I came running back to pick you up as soon as I finished.

speaker: Korryn
content: There, there. If we linger any longer, we'll really be swallowed up by the sand. Come with us, okay?
Hella angrily slaps away Korryn's outstretched hand.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Get lost!

speaker: Hella
content: Bounty hunter my ass! WhiteSands town my ass! I came back because I was so worried about you guys! What a fool I was!

speaker: Hella
content: You... you're all nothing but a bunch of scammers!! Using me as a shield to save your own hide, huh?! Shameless!! Screw you!

speaker: Hella
content: I'd rather be buried in the sand than believe another word you say!
Korryn is shocked. She wants to say something, but her gaze suddenly shifts to behind Hella, and her expression changes dramatically.
At that moment, a fierce windstorm starts to rage.

speaker: Korryn
content: The sandstorm has arrived early!

speaker: Korryn
content: Everyone, grab onto something heavy and go to the sand ship! If you get blown away, you're done for!
There's no time to activate the shield. The howling sandstorm swallows up everything. As Hella gets pushed to and fro by the wind, she sees someone reaching out to her through the sand.

speaker: Korryn
content: Damn it... hold on to me!
Hella vaguely sees a group of people running towards her. Korryn at the front looks uncharacteristically anxious. She tries to grab Hella, but only manages to pinch the edge of her clothing.
Hella tries to hold on... but the wind grows stronger, and the fabric serving as their connection flutters precariously.
Hella gets swept away by the raging sandstorm! Before losing consciousness, she vaguely hears Korryn shouting something.
What is she saying? Are these people good or just as bad as the desert bandits? Everything is so blurry in the raging sand. Hella can neither see nor tell.
Her consciousness gradually blurs, then fades into darkness.
Hella wakes up not on rough sand, but on a rather soft bed. The hum of machinery sounds around her. She's clearly not in the sandstorm anymore.

speaker: Hella
content: ...What's going on? Didn't I get buried in the sand...
She doesn't know how long she's been unconscious. Her injuries have mostly healed. Not opening her eyes all the way, Hella sneaks a peek through her eyelashes...

Sure enough, she's lying in a sand ship. Hella recognizes the ship's design. It's similar to the one from the Outland Affairs Bureau on her last trip to WhiteSands. The people around are wearing DisCity uniforms.
Footsteps approach. Hella quickly shuts her eyes tight, but it's too late.
Looks like our little guest is awake.
Upon hearing this, Hella gives up pretending to be asleep and sits up, staring warily at the speaker. A young man smiles kindly at her, seemingly unfazed by her hostility.
Great. You look like you're alright.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Who are you? Where am I?

speaker: Scotch
content: I'm the ship's captain, <color=#fb9259>Scotch</color>. I'm in charge of the current Cleansing Operation for transport routes.

speaker: Scotch
content: Don't worry, we've already investigated you. Your identity is vouched for by the MBCC, so you're trustworthy. This ship will return to DisCity after the cleansing, and you can come back with us, but...
Scotch gazes at Hella in anticipation.

speaker: Scotch
content: Let's have a chat, Miss Sinner. Are you interested in <color=#fb9259>collaborating</color> with us?
On a faraway cliff of WhiteSands, Korryn peeks between the rocks and watches the OAB security team's sand ship sail into the distance.

speaker: Korryn
content: Ah... A step too late. The little mouse got taken away.
Korryn sighs. But her friend is not as sentimental as her.

speaker: Wright
content: What are you sighing for? You're the one who drove her away. Do you like her that much?

speaker: Korryn
content: Yeah, it's been a while since I've met such a cute little girl. Just looking at her makes me happy.
Korryn watches the sand ship from afar, her eyes flickering with thought.

speaker: Korryn
content: Of course... it would be even better if we could lure her to our side.
[Inside the sand ship]
Inside the OAB security team's sand ship
Hella looks at the young man in front of her with a hint of suspicion. The captain smiles back at her.

speaker: Hella
content: <color=#fb9259>Cleansing Operation</color> for transport routes...?

speaker: Scotch
content: That's right.

speaker: Scotch
content: In simple terms, we're a WhiteSands security team formed by the DisCity Outland Affairs Bureau. We blockade and eradicate bandits near transport routes.
A team member standing by the side hands over a document. Hella leans in and sees the seal of the Outland Affairs Bureau on it.
DisCity Outland Affairs Bureau... An image of a furious middle-aged man pops into her mind. He had been rambling about eliminating bandits two years ago. They're still at it?
Seeing Hella's distrustful expression, Scotch continues to explain calmly.

speaker: Scotch
content: This round of cleansing should have been completed half a month ago, but the frequent sandstorms have delayed progress...
The man's words are interrupted by a sudden alarm.
The monitor projects the external situation: as Hella had suspected, the ship is surrounded by sandworms. Roaring, ferocious creatures try to climb onto the ship.

Warning: Enemy attack. The ship has entered an active sand beast habitat. Please clear obstacles as soon as possible...

Target locked: Large number of sand beasts. Requesting permission to fire...

speaker: Hella
content: Why are there so many monsters? Those things are tough. Quick, tell your guys to leave her...
Request approved. Countdown: 3, 2, 1...
Fire!
The sandworms on the ship's hull shriek as they fall. The gunfire completely overwhelms the tide of monsters.

speaker: Hella
content: ere...? What the hell? That was so f**king cool!!!
A soft chuckle echoes from beside Hella.

speaker: Scotch
content: Sailing in a straight line is always the fastest, isn't it?

speaker: Scotch
content: What a perfect opportunity to show our sincerity in collaborating to our MBCC guest... We'll have a proper discussion once it's over.
The cannon muzzle rotates, aiming at the next batch of sand beasts.
The battle ends quickly. A bewildered Hella stares at the sand beast corpses strewn around outside.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Holy cow! This is way cooler than the desert bandits' cannons...

Unlike the cannons captured by the desert bandits, the ones on the OAB ship are clearly superior in both accuracy and firepower. The sand ship shimmers with a faint blue light—even the Hypercube shielding system is much stronger than two years ago.
In short... a formidable team, and a valuable potential ally.
As for her other ally...
Hella gulps nervously, looking at the comms device she was given. She tried calling ${PlayerName} just now...—busy signal, no answer.

speaker: Hella
content: That dummy... always nagging me, but not around when I finally call home? What's the big idea...
She has no choice but try to text them.
Upon logging in to her account, an unexpected wave of unread messages floods in like a tide.

<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: Hella, it's me, Hecate.

<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: Chief gave me a new comms device and said I could reach you with it... but the signal in WhiteSands is bad. Not sure when this message will get you.
<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: Don't know how far you've gone now... Have you gotten stronger? Did you come upon any dangers? Have you caused trouble for the Legion?

<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: You got this.
<color=#fb9259>Hecate</color>: I'm waiting for you to come back.
Hecate's messages went on for months, the most recent one just a couple of days ago..
...Since when did she become so mushy?
At the end of the message is a photo of a blue-haired girl typing seriously on a comms device. Judging by the angle, it seems to be a candid shot.
She types out a request for help, hesitates for a moment, then deletes it and logs out.
Revenge, after all, is something one has to take oneself.
She turns and sees Scotch close by, having waited for a long time.

speaker: Hella
content: Alright, let's talk. What kind of collaboration are you talking about?
The brief exchange of information ends. Scotch lowers his head, deep in thought.

speaker: Scotch
content: I see. So you met some roaming outlaws as well. They stir up just as much trouble as the desert bandits.

speaker: Hella
content: What do you mean? You guys got screwed over by those bastards too?

speaker: Scotch
content: No, they're very cunning and never directly engage with official personnel. Fortunately, you escaped safely. Many have been tricked and abducted to the Outlands, never to be heard from again...

Swindling, cheating, abducting... According to Scotch, the people of Tuco have committed every kind of crime. Not only do they loot and plunder, but they also take pleasure in harming passersby. Truly despicable.

speaker: Scotch
content: Moreover, they've also targeted <color=#fb9259>Hypercubes</color>.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Huh?

speaker: Scotch
content: Nirvana recently lost a very important shipment. The climate in WhiteSands has been changing rapidly. Disasters are worsening, and many city-states are relying on this shipment for survival. The demand for Hypercubes was already greater than the supply, and now the gap is even larger.

speaker: Hella
content: Hypercubes...

speaker: Korryn
content: The desert bandits chasing you just stole someone else's Hypercube, but they didn't keep an eye on it. Now they're taking it out on you, thinking you're the thief who stole their loot.

speaker: Korryn
content: Just a bit of... luggage we borrowed from the bandits?
So that big box contains the stolen Hypercubes after all! The desert bandits first robbed the Hypercubes from Nirvana, then Korryn stole them from the desert bandits.

speaker: Scotch
content: That group is very cautious. They flee at the sight of any patrol ship, making it difficult to locate their hideout.

speaker: Scotch
content: That's why we wanted to collaborate with the MBCC... but it seems that your Chief is too busy to do so this time.
${PlayerName} clearly doesn't have time. He's not even answering his phone. He's definitely handling other matters.
female_content: ${PlayerName} clearly doesn't have time. She's not even answering her phone. She's definitely handling other matters.

content: However...
Hella clears her throat, drawing back Scotch's attention.

speaker: Hella
content: Ahem. Don’t bother trying to contact that dummy. He’s indeed very busy. But, collaborating with the MBCC isn’t entirely impossible.
female_content: Ahem. Don’t bother trying to contact that dummy. She’s indeed very busy. But, collaborating with the MBCC isn’t entirely impossible.

speaker: Hella
content: Isn't there someone who just escaped from Tuco right in front of you?

speaker: Hella
content: To Korryn, I'm just a loser. Those bastards avoid you, but they sure as hell don't hide from me. They're always trying to trick me into joining them.

speaker: Scotch
content: The Outlanders like Sinners. They probably see your value.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Hmph... That's perfect, then. I'll deliver myself right to them.
Perhaps it's true. Her mind races like never before. A plan is gradually taking shape.

speaker: Hella
content: Bring it on, Tuco chumps! Let's see who screws over who this time!
[WhiteSands Market]
The WhiteSands market is as bustling as ever. Vendors loudly advertise their wares to the endless flow of travelers.
Suddenly, people halt their steps and gather under a wooden board. Everyone whispers, curiously looking at the girl beside the bulletin board.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't miss this! Come and take a look!
A new batch of wanted posters cover the wall.
The fierce images of the desert bandits are gone. In their place are the silly portraits of the Tuco folks, with bounties stamped on their faces.

speaker: Hella
content: WhiteSands' vilest, most disgusting scam is revealed! The evil scammers who ought to win acting awards! Beware of their tearjerker performances!

speaker: Hella
content: But they've messed with the wrong crowd! You've all heard of the MBCC, right? You've all heard of the legendary Chief, right?

speaker: Hella
content: Whoever can take me back to Tuco for revenge, I'll reward you with ${PlayerName}'s salary on behalf of the MBCC!
There are many onlookers, but most are just there for the spectacle.
A few half-believers step forward to talk to Hella, but soon shake their heads and leave. The spectators eventually think she's just seeking attention and leave as well.
A few hours past, but no one is willing to take the job.
However, Hella isn't sweating it. She leisurely packs up her little stool, muttering to herself.

speaker: Hella
content: Ah, looks like I didn't find any suitable recruits today. It's too hot and there are too few people at noon. Might as well go back and take a nap...
Pretending not to notice the shadow following her, Hella turns into an alley.
Then, the sack and club fall together.

speaker: Hella
content: Mmph...!
[Black Screen]

speaker: Hella
content: Damn, my head... hurts like hell...
After a while, her consciousness gradually returns.
The thwack to the back of her head hurt more than expected. Someone is speaking near her, but the voice is unclear, fading in and out.
Why isn't she waking up? Did you hit her too hard and crack her skull?
N-no way! I didn't use much force! I was even much gentler than usual...
Don't worry, she seems to be waking up now.
The voices become clearer. Light flickers before her eyes, and the darkness begins to fade...

speaker: Hella
content: Is this... Tuco?

speaker: Korryn
content: Yeah, it's Tuco. The Tuco you dream of coming back to for "revenge"...
Several grinning faces suddenly pop into her view. Korryn and a group of Tuco folks squat around, looking down at her with smiles.
...Looking down?
An unusual feeling of restraint comes from all over her body. Hella stiffly lowers her head... only a flat ground is visible. There's no sign of her body.
She has been "planted" in the ground like a carrot!!!
Korryn holds up and waves a pile of their wanted posters.

speaker: Korryn
content: As you said: You'll reward whoever takes you back to Tuco and helps you get revenge.

speaker: Korryn
content: I've completed half of it. As for the other half... how about we settle it after you transfer the Chief's salary to my account?

speaker: Hella
content: Hell no! I'd rather toss that money in a ditch than give it to you, you bunch of deceitful, club-wielding scumbags!
The soil around her isn't packed. Hella suddenly frees a hand and punches Korryn in the face.
Revenge can come later. Right now, she just wants a brawl to vent her anger!
Greatly outnumbered, the outcome of the brawl comes as no surprise.
Ropes coil around her body, tightening into knots... Korryn hums a tune as she deftly bounds Hella.

speaker: Hella
content: So many of you ganging up on me! Have you no shame?! So you've won, fine! But why tie me up? You gonna sell me off, too?!
Hella pauses, then completely gives up and lies flat.

speaker: Hella
content: Ha! Go ahead then, sell me. If you've got the guts, sell me to a place far, far away!

speaker: Hella
content: But I'm telling you, Horo's Legion and the MBCC love me! Messing with me is messing with them!
Korryn chuckles and stops her tying.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh, now that you mention it, that does seem to be the case, huh?

speaker: Korryn
content: So, my dear Hella, what should I do to escape this tragic fate...?
Hella's eyes dart around, deliberately putting on a wary, panicked expression.

speaker: Hella
content: Wh-what are you thinking? You're not planning to keep me hostage, are you?

speaker: Hella
content: No! You can't do that! They care too much about me! I would become their weak spot! I can't be a hostage!
To her surprise, Korryn bursts into laughter.

speaker: Korryn
content: Hahaha! You can be a hostage, then! We're really short on helpers lately, so from now on, you can go with Wright to organize the depot!

speaker: Hella
content: Wait, hold on! I'm a hostage, not a laborer! Why do I have to work for you guys?!

speaker: Korryn
content: Hehe, little Hella, that's not the right description...
Korryn lowers her hat brim slightly, her expression mysterious.

speaker: Korryn
content: Do you think we'd pay you?

speaker: Hella
content: Eh... No.

speaker: Korryn
content: Exactly. Since there's no pay, you aren't working for us.
Korryn picks up Hella, unties her, and pushes her into the depot.

speaker: Korryn
content: From now on, you're a little damsel in distress captured by the Tuco villains. You're not in a position to refuse! Feel free to surrender anytime.

speaker: Hella
content: Y-you bastard! I'll tell the Legion Commander! I'll tell the BBQ-C! I won't surrender!!
The door slams shut, followed by a set of tools thrown in through the window.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Alright, alright, I'll surrender tomorrow, and start working for you.

speaker: Hella
content: <size=38>Hmph, fine, I'll work. What a bunch of idiots. You dare keep Hella hostage? Just wait and see! I'll get back at you all at once!</size>
[Tuco - Street]

speaker: Hella
content: I'm not even a slave... They're using me like cattle! Bastards!
As it turns out, Tuco does need extra hands desperately.
Hella follows Wright and toils nonstop from morning till night. Even during the occasional break, Korryn orders her to help out in the kitchen or clean the square.

speaker: Hella
content: Damn that bastard Korryn...
Hella grumbles quietly, but doesn't forget to keep an eye on her surroundings.
During her work hours, she searches nearly all of Tuco, and she still couldn't find a single trace of those stupid Hypercubes!
But... Hella looks ahead and spots Wright squatting and yawning in front of the little depot. A string of keys hangs from his waist, glimmering in the sunlight.
This little locked depot is the last spot she needs to investigate.

speaker: Hella
content: Mr. Wright, are we almost done organizing the big depot?

speaker: Wright
content: Once these things are moved to the little depot, we're done. You go rest. I'll handle the rest.
The man waves his hand, motioning her to sit down.

speaker: Wright
content: You've been working hard these past few days, Hella. Take a good rest after this. And if anyone asks, just say I let you. Even Korryn won't say a word!

speaker: Hella
content: N-No need! I'm not that delicate!
It's definitely in that little room! Hella's eyes sparkle even brighter, putting on the look of an earnest, sweet girl.

speaker: Hella
content: Back when I was in Syndicate, I also did hard labor for food. I've been through it all. Don't worry about me.

speaker: Hella
content: You've been helping me a lot these days, Mr. Wright. I want to help you in return.

speaker: Wright
content: Aww, what a sweet thing to say! That's really comforting to hear...
Wright takes out a ragged handkerchief from his pocket and dabs the corner of his eye.

speaker: Wright
content: What a... what's the word for someone who says nice things? Oh right, what a chatterbox! What a tattletale! What a loudmouth!

speaker: Hella
content: Uh... Hehe. Th-thanks for the compliment...?
Thud! A lunchbox falls on Wright's head. It's Mira and little Timmy delivering food.

speaker: Mira
content: Just bear with it a bit longer. Next month, I'll get him a dictionary, but I can't guarantee he'll get things right.

speaker: Mira
content: You've been busy all morning. You must be hungry, right?
She opens the lunchbox, and the aroma of roasted meat wafts over.

speaker: Timmy
content: This one's for you, Mr. Wright. And Hella, this one's yours...
Hella takes the lunchbox, but little Timmy keeps holding onto the other end. He hesitates for a long time, then pulls something out of his pocket to place on top of the lunchbox.

speaker: Timmy
content: And this, this is for you too...!
It's two Hypercubes.

speaker: Timmy
content: It's... I learned how to make this dessert from Mira... and these are Hypercubes I got from three months of savings. It's not much, but I hope it helps...

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? For me?
Timmy nods gently.

speaker: Timmy
content: I want to apologize for what happened.

speaker: Timmy
content: The day the desert bandits came, you saved me. If it weren't for you, we wouldn't have been able to get rid of them so easily. But when the sandstorm came, we couldn't take you with us... and now...

speaker: Timmy
content: It's really, really great that you're okay...
Tears well up in his eyes. Hella quickly takes the lunchbox and stuffs the Hypercubes into her pocket.

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe. It was just a few pesky bandits... nothing that would've killed me. Don't worry about it!

speaker: Hella
content: I accept your apology. Stop looking so sad. People at the market don't like doing business with cry babies...

speaker: Hella
content: But this is all you were able to buy after three months of work? Are prices in WhiteSands that high?

speaker: Wright
content: Yeah, Hypercubes are really expensive! Kiddo, if you want to make big money, you've got to hustle harder!

speaker: Mira
content: If you want to grow tall, you should eat well and on time. You two as well. Don't forget to get some rest after all the work.
After that, Mira and little Timmy say their goodbyes and leave.
