Hella finishes her lunch quickly and volunteers to clean the little depot. She uses sweet words like "the early bird catches the worm" and "kids clean faster" to make Wright unlock the depot door...
The little depot is not the splendid treasure trove that Hella had imagined. Amidst all the dust, there are just some old furniture and the big box that the Tuco folks had tried to flee with.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? Why does that box look familiar...?

speaker: Wright
content: Oh, that's the one we snatched from the desert bandits!
Just as expected! The Hypercubes are here!

speaker: Hella
content: What a big box! There must be quite a few treasures in there, right?

speaker: Hella
content: With the prices here, even if it's only half-filled with Hypercubes, it'll be enough to get you all to DisCity!

speaker: Wright
content: Yeah right! I got to admit, we've really got lucky this time!

speaker: Wright
content: This box really does have good stuff inside. It's just a small bag that takes up less than a tenth of the box, but it's definitely something!

speaker: Wright
content: Tuco has a lot of old folks and kids, but if we have this kind of luck a few more times, we won't have to worry about the next sandstorm at all. And I, for one, am always the luckiest in Tuco!
After a burst of proud laughter, the smile on his face fades a little. He looks at Hella with a complex expression.

speaker: Wright
content: But no matter our situation, we really shouldn't have dragged a little girl like you into this.

speaker: Wright
content: Little Timmy said you're a good girl who helped us a lot, and you're just a child... Look at me. I'm a full-grown man, and not even as clear-headed as a kid. Silly me!

speaker: Hella
content: Mr. Wright, we're such close friends already. Do you really have to do all this bowing and apologizing, too?

speaker: Wright
content: It doesn't matter if we're friends or not, it's the right thing to do! You saved those Tuco folks and beat those desert bandits to a "pope." I have to thank you properly!
The middle-aged man who always misuses words rummages through his pocket and puts a paper-wrapped snack on her hand.

speaker: Wright
content: But... the sandstorms are coming more frequently, and supplies are getting more expensive. Ultimately, it's because I haven't been a good sheriff for Tuco, otherwise Korryn wouldn't have to go out hunting for Hypercubes everywhere, and you wouldn't have been dragged into this.

speaker: Wright
content: Hella, if you want to blame someone, blame me! But Korryn is a good lass, so good... she's dragged down only because of our weakness.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Weakness...
The Syndicate girl lowers her head, looking at the snack on her hand.
The lunchboxes Mira sends are always filled to the brim. Abuela Susan specially wove her a sun hat, and Maggie nonchalantly "passes by" the depot with a cold drink at least three times a day.
As for Korryn... she sometimes suddenly pops up at her workplace, spooks her with Sheriff the Lizard, then leaves some snacks and disappears.
The wind lifts Hella's hair from behind and cools her hot, sticky neck.

speaker: Hella
content: ...She's not weak at all. She's a big liar.

speaker: Hella
content: I, Hella, trusted her with all my heart, but she deceived and used me. Revenge must be taken. I never forgive.

speaker: Wright
content: Haha, only half of what she says is true, and I'm the only one in town who can tell which half! I can tell Korryn really likes you...

speaker: Hella
content: Ah, enough!! Don't you know that no one likes sugarcoating? Enough of this topic!
A stronger gust of wind smacks the girl's back, making her stagger forward.

speaker: Hella
content: ...! Why is the wind getting stronger? It's just like a few days ago...
She turns her head, and her complaint gets stuck in her throat.
On the horizon, a massive storm rolls in like a tidal wave, blotting out the sky.

speaker: Wright
content: Oh no! It's a sandstorm!
Dropping the lunchbox, Wright grabs Hella and starts running.

speaker: Wright
content: Go to the square! Meet up with the others!!
[Tuco - Street]
Hella dashes towards the square, her heart pounding as if it's about to leap out of her chest.

speaker: Hella
content: There's only one car and it can fit at most five, no, eight people...?

speaker: Hella
content: I need to get them out... What do I do... What do I do!?
In her head, plans pop up and then get ruled out one after another.
The square finally comes into view. She sees the figure in the center...
[Tuco - Square]

speaker: Timmy
content: Everyone! Follow me back inside!
Timmy calls out to the townsfolk, guiding them towards the town hall.

speaker: Timmy
content: Don't worry, I'll be guarding the door. If any monsters come in, I'll protect you!

speaker: Timmy
content: Maggie and Korryn are both outside. We'll be fine!
He yells with all his might, but his voice gets drowned out by the fierce wind.
Mira kneels on the sand-covered ground, prying open a sharp trap with her hands. Her face no longer bears her trademark smile.

speaker: Mira
content: There's a hole in the northern wall that we built earlier. If it's not patched up, something might get in.

speaker: Mira
content: Korryn has already gone to the main gate. She probably can't handle it alone. We need to seal the side gate first and then go help!

speaker: Maggie
content: Understood! I'll go right away.
Wright pants from all the running. His throat is hoarse, and he can't stop coughing. He finally staggers to a stop in front of the town hall.

speaker: Wright
content: (Cough) ...Mira! I'll go with you!

speaker: Timmy
content: Mr. Wright! No, you can't go, not when you're this sick...

speaker: Wright
content: I'm fine! You guys go back! It's just a cough. It's not like I have a broken leg! I can still fight those monsters!

speaker: Wright
content: Timmy, let go of me... ouch!
A strong force pushes both of them through the door. Hella blocks the door and uses a wooden pole to bar the town hall's entrance.

speaker: Hella
content: If you're sick, don't try to be tough!

speaker: Hella
content: I won't let any sickly folks or liars be the hero! I'm gonna go fight this sandstorm! Just wait for my victorious return!
[Tuco - Square]

speaker: Hella
content: Huff, huff... We won...
Thanks to the hard work of Hella and the townsfolk, the monsters that came with the sandstorm all got driven away.
The wind weakens, and the tide of monsters starts to retreat. Hella sighs in relief, failing to notice a straggler lunging from behind.

speaker: Sand Beast
content: Roarrrr—!
(Transition, gunshot)
The sand beast's body topples to the ground. Hella, still shaken, looks back to see the bounty hunter's smoking gun.
Korryn spins the gun handle flamboyantly and blows a kiss to the young girl. Hella can't hear her words, but reads her lips...
"See, I stuck around to fight with you this time, didn't I?"
...Hmph. That silver-tongued devil.
The next moment, Hella suddenly feels weightless, and her view rises. Someone has lifted her up, and she's surrounded by cheers.
Cheering in celebration of their victory against the sandstorm, the townspeople of Tuco surround Hella and hold her up, ready to have a feast.
At the edge of the crowd, Wright huffs as he drags over the box from the little depot. He opens the box, and blue Hypercube light quickly spreads to dispel the remaining contamination in the town.

speaker: Korryn
content: Hey, big hero, why the long face? We just won a hard battle. Why not crack a smile?
A pair of hands rescues Hella from the crowd's embrace; it's Korryn.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Don't you realize that I just saw all the Hypercubes you guys stashed away?

speaker: Korryn
content: Hmm?
She takes a moment to process the words, then pats Hella on the head with a smile.

speaker: Korryn
content: No worries. We've been in the same boat for quite a while now.
The crowd is already cheering and celebrating. Mira collects the remaining Hypercubes and takes the box back to the motel, storing it in a hidden compartment behind the counter.
They did everything out in the open, making no effort to hide it from Hella. The people of Tuco already see her as one of their own.
Korryn ruffles Hella's hair once more.

speaker: Korryn
content: Let's go to the celebration banquet! They're gonna show off their cooking skills today. If we don't hurry, we won't get any food!
Hella doesn't respond, but just silently follows along towards Tuco Motel.
The bonfire is dying down, and the feast is nearing its end. Wooden beer mugs lie toppled across the square, along with the townspeople who have drunk themselves into a stupor.
Korryn lies slumped next to a barrel, her hat pulled over her face, deep asleep.
A figure sneaks up, cautiously poking Korryn.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, Korryn... you big liar... big jerk... are you in there...?
She stops and waits for a while, but there's no response.
Hella is the only one still sober in the square. She had already tied up all the other drunk townsfolk, rendering them unable to fight.
Hella quietly takes out a rope, looping it left and right. After finishing, she looks up and sees a pair of crystal clear eyes.

speaker: Korryn
content: Sheriff, Sheriff, how are you climbing so fast... wait for me...
Luckily, it's just drunken rambling. Judging by the situation, the woman didn't even recognize the girl in front of her, and thought that Hella was her pet lizard.
Hella tightens the rope, tying Korryn to the post in the center of the square. She stands up, but doesn't immediately take action.
She looks down at the dazed woman in front of her, thinks for a moment, then turns and walks towards the motel.
[Coffin or Tavern image]
(Display artwork, Hypercube Shield)
Skillfully walking behind the counter, Hella mimics Mira's actions, fiddling among the bottles and jars. She triggers a mechanism and a trapdoor opens, revealing an old box inside.
As she gently opens it, blue fluorescent light shines out from the box.
Little blue crystals pile in the corner of the box... they're Hypercubes. Perhaps partially consumed from the afternoon, only a small amount remains.
Hella's hand reaches for the box but stops midway.

speaker: Scotch
content: The Outlanders like Sinners. They probably see your value.

speaker: Wright
content: But... the sandstorms are coming more frequently, and supplies are getting more expensive. Ultimately, it's because I haven't been a good sheriff for Tuco, otherwise Korryn wouldn't have to go out hunting for Hypercubes everywhere, and you wouldn't have been dragged into this.

speaker: Korryn
content: No worries. We've been in the same boat for quite a while now.
A little mouse scurries down the rafters, jumps onto the counter, and grabs a piece of bread. It turns to run but locks eyes with Hella behind the counter.
The mouse is clearly startled. It freezes with the bread in its grasp, fearing the wrath of the giant in front of it.

speaker: Little Mouse
content: Squeak?
But nothing happens. The little mouse seizes the opportunity and quickly scurries back into the shadows.
[Only leave the sound of closing the box]
Returning to the square, the townspeople of Tuco are still lying around in drunken stupor.
[CG - Hella's Revenge A]

speaker: Wright
content: (Sob) ...Sophia... Sophia, don't leave me Sophia, what am I gonna do without you...

speaker: Maggie
content: Hehe... Cactus pick-me-up, so good! More...
Korryn groggily opens her eyes and spots the person in front of her.

speaker: Korryn
content: ...Little Hella? How come there's one, two... three little Hellas spinning around...

speaker: Korryn
content: C'mere! C'mere... Wright found a new treasure, let's go get it together...

speaker: Hella
content: ...Hmph! You want to recruit someone from an enemy organization? You must really be drunk.

speaker: Hella
content: You lied to me, used me, and almost got me buried alive in WhiteSands! I haven't settled these scores yet! Hella never forgives. Don't think you can buy me off with a meal!

speaker: Hella
content: So, now...
[Black screen, sound of writing]

speaker: Korryn
content: ...? Oh, that tickles!
[CG - Hella's Revenge B]
Hella waves the marker back and forth, leaving doodles all over their faces. Then, clasping her hands, she finally flashes a satisfied grin.

speaker: Hella
content: Revenge is served! This is the punishment you get for crossing the great Hella! Think about what you've done!

speaker: Hella
content: Now that I've taken my revenge, I'm out! Bye-bye!
[Desert - Night]
Hella steers the small sand ship she stole from Tuco towards the transport route. The wanted posters for the Tuco townsfolk flutter beside her hand.
The rearview mirror reflects the little town behind her. Across the darkness of WhiteSands, only Tuco twinkles with some lights. They're small, but warm.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Mice might steal, be dirty and smelly, and only care about saving their own skin... but in the end, they just want to survive.

speaker: Hella
content: Tuco... isn't a bad place.

speaker: Hella
content: Blah. I've stopped hating you guys for a long time now. Next time...

speaker: Hella
content: Forget it! We better not meet again! Bye-bye, liars! No matter where you go or how hard things get, be kind and survive!
She looks up at the sky, feeling a sense of openness in her heart. The stars above are no longer obscured by the yellow sand, and the shimmering star trails are clearly visible.
One streaks across the night sky, getting closer and closer, then...
[Screen shakes, firelight]
A missile hits Tuco, turning it into a sea of flames.

speaker: Hella
content: What?!
Hella has no time to react. Suddenly, a male voice rings in her ear.

speaker: Scotch
content: Thank you for your help, Miss Hella. You did well.

speaker: Hella
content: It's you?! Why?! Weren't you supposed to wait for my signal?

speaker: Hella
content: I just finished investigating. There are many things that are still unclear, those folks are actually...
She suddenly realizes something.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait, how do you know about my situation? How are you able to talk to me...
There's no one near the sand ship, nor any other equipment that can broadcast, yet Scotch's voice is coming directly into Hella's ear.

speaker: Scotch
content: Thanks to the time you bought, the missile from our ship was able to pinpoint Tuco's exact location.

speaker: Scotch
content: You gained their trust faster than I expected, and even found where they stored the Hypercubes... Why didn't you continue the mission? Ran into trouble? No worries, we'll <color=#fb9259>clean things up</color>.

speaker: Hella
content: ...You've been watching me...

speaker: Hella
content: What the hell did you put in my body?!
Scotch sneers softly. The once-kind voice becomes ice-cold.

speaker: Scotch
content: Aren't Sinners so impressive? I've seen the bit on your file about your ability—<color=#fb9259>healing and regeneration</color>. Even if a tracker is implanted, you will heal perfectly without leaving a trace.
Hella quickly touches her ear, and indeed feels an unusually shaped bump under the skin.

speaker: Scotch
content: You trust your <color=#fb9259>partners</color> a lot. That's good.

speaker: Scotch
content: Pleasure working with you, Miss Sinner.

speaker: Hella
content: How dare you... you...

speaker: Hella
content: Bastards!!!!
Hella's voice shakes as countless emotions turn into rage and fury. She rushes toward the Tuco firestorm in a frenzy.
[WhiteSands - Night]
The desert night wind is bitingly cold. The piteous townsfolk of Tuco have nowhere to flee, and can only hide in rocky crevices.
A wounded Wright is surrounded by many townsfolk, his face devoid of color. Many are injured. Some are crying, and some are quietly comforting others.
Hella can't hear anything clearly. She sits away from the crowd, head down, face buried in her knees.
Someone comes over and sits next to Hella. Without speaking, she places a cup of hot milk down, then silently treats Hella's wounds.
The wound on her ear is almost healed, with only some half-dried blood stains left. Looking down, Hella's fist is clenched so tightly that small trails of blood seep out.

speaker: Korryn
content: Let go, Hella. This must hurt.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Give the meds to someone else. I don't need them. These little scratches will heal in a few minutes.

speaker: Korryn
content: Yeah... Yeah, I know.
She slowly pries open Hella's clenched fist. Fragments of a tracker are embedded in her palm, preventing the cuts from healing.
Korryn stays silent as she helps remove them.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Aren't you gonna ask what this is?

speaker: Hella
content: Aren't you gonna ask how they found this place? Why I left, or why I'm here?

speaker: Hella
content: ...You know everything. Why aren't you blaming me?

speaker: Hella
content: It's all my fault... Those bastards blew up the town because of me... I led them here, and now you've all suffered...

speaker: Hella
content: You left your Hypercubes back in the town. Another sandstorm will come again soon. What the hell are you gonna do...

speaker: Hella
content: Say something... Yell at me, hit me... it's all my fault!
Tears blur Hella's eyes from seeing the person beside her, but she feels a hand gently patting her head.
Then, a warm cup of milk is pressed into her hand.

speaker: Korryn
content: Actually, I've got milk in my cup too.

speaker: Hella
content: Huh...?

speaker: Korryn
content: I happened to see a little mouse who screamed for revenge, but who then just stared at the Hypercubes for ages before running off after drawing silly faces.

speaker: Korryn
content: Where do you think you are? This is Tuco, a scammers' den; we saw right through your little tricks.

speaker: Korryn
content: As for why no one blew the lid off...

speaker: Korryn
content: It's not every day we meet such a charming little girl. Of course we'd want her to stay a bit longer, right?

speaker: Korryn
content: Tuco's just a small town. There's nothing here to make you stay... If we just said "we like you and admire you," you'd have bolted ages ago, right?

speaker: Hella
content: Em... That's true...

speaker: Korryn
content: So we had to rely on trickery. We're all deceiving each other. It's fifty-fifty, fair and square.

speaker: Hella
content: But because of me... the whole town was destroyed... Even... even Mr. Wright is...

speaker: Korryn
content: But you also saved us from the town. You rushed back again and again to retrieve things, even when your power couldn't keep up with how fast you were getting hurt. That's why your wounds haven't healed yet.
A cotton ball gently wipes the blood off Hella's hand. Then, a bandage is applied on the wound.

speaker: Korryn
content: In WhiteSands, you'll meet all sorts of people. To survive, you've got to stay clear-eyed and see them for who they are. So...
Korryn ties a crooked bow on Hella's hand and then ruffles her hair.

speaker: Korryn
content: We didn't trust the wrong person.

speaker: Korryn
content: Maybe you're not strong enough now, and will make many mistakes... but that's okay. You have plenty of time. One day, you'll grow up, and become strong enough to face any challenge.

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't rush, and don't feel sad about it.

speaker: Korryn
content: Hella is the best girl in the world, the toughest little mouse. No one can say otherwise.
Hella lowers her head, finally unable to hold back her tears.

speaker: Hella
content: Sob... sob... sob... waaaah!
Regret, guilt, and indescribable bitterness... Uncontrollable emotions well up, spilling out as tears that wet her hands and drip into the glass of milk in front of her.
This time, Korryn doesn't try to stop Hella from crying. She gently strokes Hella's back, then helps her to stand up again.
Not far away, the Tuco folks gather to hold a "ceremony."
Wright's body is placed in a wooden boat. In WhiteSands, there are no fresh flowers, so people weave tumbleweed branches into wreaths and place them on boats accompanying the dead.
The frail man is covered in ash, wounds and burns. With the wreaths hiding these scars, his face looks unexpectedly peaceful.

speaker: Korryn
content: Wright wasn't in the best shape and had to rely on his lock-picking skills to get by. Every time his enemies chased him, it nearly cost him his life. In the end, he couldn't take it anymore, so he stole those fancy clothes to wear.

speaker: Korryn
content: That's how it is in the WhiteSands. Resources are scarce, so everyone else is an enemy.

speaker: Korryn
content: But even Hypercubes won't necessarily keep you safe. Everyone has to keep fighting to survive... Even if you hadn't come, things would still turn out the same.

speaker: Korryn
content: But we're never afraid of that. We're only afraid of living unfreely, or dying with no one caring.

speaker: Korryn
content: He's already luckier than most people in WhiteSands to have lived happily to this age. He loved to joke about it himself, and surely wouldn't want you to be sad for him.

speaker: Korryn
content: He always liked you, and would definitely be happy to see you safe and sound.

speaker: Korryn
content: Go on. Take a wreath and say goodbye to him.
People step forward one by one to whisper their farewells to Wright. There's no crying, only blessings.
The starlight spills from the sky, illuminating the sand and turning the ground into a sea of stars. The wooden boat drifts forward with the quicksand, entering the river of starlight.
Behind, Maggie starts playing her vihuela again. The melody, combined with the crowd's blessings, forms a unique rhythm.

Congratulations, for witnessing the most magnificent desert sunset. Congratulations, for keeping the most genuine smile in these times. Thank you. Your path will guide our way forward. Your soul will ignite hope for life in WhiteSands.
Thank you. We will keep telling your story, and bless your rebirth.

speaker: Korryn
content: Thank you, for living so brilliantly.
Korryn gently wipes away Hella's tears and places more dried wreaths in her palm.

speaker: Korryn
content: Now that you're one of us, want to say a blessing?
Wright's little boat sails toward WhiteSands, getting smaller and smaller amidst the music, before finally merging with the starlight.

The vast desert, the Milky Way, the simple blessings, and the Outlanders' singing... Hella stays silent for a long time. Before the boat completely disappears, she steps forward and scatters the dried tumbleweed in her hands toward the sea of stars.

speaker: Hella
content: Thanks for trusting me and protecting me. I don't know how to say goodbye in the Tuco way, but...
The sky begins to brighten, and dawn pierces through the darkness. Hella lifts her head, her tears not yet dry, but her gaze resolute.

speaker: Hella
content: If someone bullies you, hit 'em back hard. I'll get revenge for you the Syndicate way.
Beside Hella, Korryn puts her hat back on and flashes a smile.

speaker: Korryn
content: I'll be looking forward to it, my Syndicate friend.
[WhiteSands - Daytime]
A small sand ship races through the desert. The engine is running at full power, trying to shake off the sand beasts in hot pursuit.
Korryn is steering, while the injured townsfolk crowd in the middle. This bloated little sand ship is severely overloaded, yet it speeds along in determination.

speaker: Korryn
content: Now's the time, they're catching up! Start attacking!
Hella and a few other townsfolk stand at the back of the ship, shooting at the monsters. The battle doesn't look promising.

speaker: Hella
content: Two down, five more to go!

speaker: Hella
content: The remaining firepower is only enough to take down one more. How far is that place you mentioned?

speaker: Korryn
content: Almost there! Don't worry!
Korryn floors the pedal, making the sand ship drift sideways and leaving the sand beasts behind.
Boom! The sand ship hits the ground with a loud crash. At the same time, a bullet strikes a scrawny sand beast in the head, downing it instantly in the dust.
But as one sand beast falls, countless others swarm over.

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't worry, we'll be there soon! We'll be fine!
[WhiteSands - Night] (Can switch to another map. Please align with the previous shelter!) (Memory filter)

A few hours earlier
In the temporary shelter

speaker: Korryn
content: Right now, we've got three enemies: the desert bandits, the security team, and the unpredictable Tide of Ashes.

speaker: Korryn
content: The Tide of Ashes is the most dangerous. We have no Hypercubes left. If we run into it, we're dead.

speaker: Korryn
content: So, we need to get Hypercubes first. I stashed some "emergency supplies" near Tuco for times like these...
A branch scratches the sand, adding a few circles to the map.

speaker: Hella
content: Not here. This was where Scotch and his team found me. They've stationed a small squad here.
A shoe wipes away one circle. Two remain, not far apart.

speaker: Hella
content: I remember this part. We'd have to cross the sand beasts' territory. They might attack. Let's go to the third spot.

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't worry. I've got a plan.
Korryn dusts off the sand from her knees, tosses the branch aside, and stands up.

speaker: Korryn
content: As long as the ship goes fast enough, and we shoot accurately enough from the back. Once we reach that big sandstone, they won't catch us.
(Memory filter ends)
[WhiteSands - Daytime]

speaker: Hella
content: Korryn, all the sand beasts behind us are down!
Hella wants to call out, but notices a frowning Mira reloading next to her. A speeding shadow is looming larger... it's another sand ship!

speaker: Mira
content: Oh no, it's the desert bandits! They've found us!

speaker: Hella
content: Huh? Didn't we drive them off already?!
The desert bandits' ship quickly approaches. Hella doesn't have time to raise her gun before seeing the familiar metal glint on the enemy's ship.

speaker: Hella
content: Get down, they're gonna shoot!

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Hahahahah! Time for our revenge! Beat 'em while they're down! Go go go!!
Steel cables fire, embedding their barbs deep into Tuco's sand ship. The two ships get pulled closer. The desert bandits cackle maniacally as they climb towards the Tuco ship along the cables.

speaker: Hella
content: Get your filthy paws off, you bastards!
Hella kicks them and smashes them with the butt of her rifle, but there are too many bandits for her to hold off alone.
Bang! A gunshot explodes in her ear, and a Mania-laced bullet pierces the steel cable.
Korryn came to the sand ship's rear when Hella didn't notice, snapping all the cables with two shots. She then sweeps away a desert bandit trying to sneak up on Hella.
Hella doesn't have time to react before she sees Korryn nimbly flip and jump onto the ship's edge.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey, what are you doing?!

speaker: Korryn
content: Sorry, little Hella, I'm gonna trick you again.
Korryn reaches out, ruffles Hella's hair, then falls back without hesitation.

speaker: Korryn
content: Take care of everyone for me. I'm leaving the rest to you.

speaker: Maggie
content: Korryn! Don't...!
Korryn's figure swiftly disappears into the dust stirred up by the rear of the ship.
The next second, a burst of light erupts!
A streak of light cuts through the air, striking the bow of the desert bandit's ship... then, the bullet skews, forcing the pursuing ship to a halt.
It's Korryn! She raises her long gun, forming a one-person defensive line for Tuco's retreat.
The people on the ship go into an uproar. Hella tightens her grip on the edge of the sand ship, then reach out to stop the townsfolk behind her. She takes a deep breath and shouts:

speaker: Hella
content: Don't think you can just dump this mess on me and leave! Come back alive!!

speaker: Hella
content: You got it? You big bastard!!!
The desert bandits swarm like fish to bait, but Korryn remains unmoved, like a boulder in a river.
She raises her long gun without looking back, but gestures to Hella behind her.
Clenching her fist, she points to the sky... She won't break her promise this time.
[WhiteSands - Daytime]

speaker: Maggie
content: Korryn, Korryn, Korryn, why isn't she back yet...
Maggie mutters as she constantly looks back.
After Korryn left, Hella took over the wheel. No pursuers are left in sight. The Tuco folks have successfully shaken off the desert bandits, but their compatriot hasn't returned.
Timmy sits in the corner, hugging his knees and weeping silently. Silence spreads like a plague among the injured townsfolk... until someone speaks up.

speaker: Hella
content: She'll be back. I believe in her.
Miraculously, Hella's voice doesn't tremble at all.
Calm, rational, and determined... her words are no longer hesitant, just like the person in her memories.

speaker: Hella
content: It's Korryn, after all. You guys know her better than I do. No one is better at getting in and out of danger than her.

speaker: Hella
content: Don't worry. She's probably already kicked those desert bandits' butts, and will pop up any second now...!

speaker: Mira
content: You're right. We have to trust her.
Mira walks over to Hella and helps her steer. Little Timmy wipes his tears and joins Maggie in looking out from the back of the ship.
The sand ship speeds along, and the destination is in sight. Just as Korryn said, everything is under control, and everyone will be fine.
Suddenly, a glimmer flashes through the sand.
Hella doesn't miss this fleeting flash.
...How could I forget? There's more than one "pursuer."
She clenches her fist tightly, then relaxes it again. She has made up her mind.

speaker: Hella
content: I know what to do now. Keep my guard up, notice every suspicious detail, and then bravely...

speaker: Hella
content: Turns out... I really did learn something from that liar...
The small sand ship, exhausted from many hours of travel, gradually stalls and comes to a stop on the sand.

speaker: Hella
content: You guys go ahead first.

speaker: Hella
content: There might be other enemies nearby. The sand ship is too loud. If the Hypercubes get snatched, it's all over.

speaker: Hella
content: Actually... I'm still a bit worried about Korryn. Before she jumped off, she whispered to me that if I got you all to safety, it would be best to go back and pick her up.
Mira looks at the injured townsfolk. She seems to notice something too, but doesn't voice any objections.
After a moment of silence, she leads the way by jumping off the sand ship, and calls the other townsfolk to disembark.

The townsfolk don cloaks the same color as the sand, blending in with the desert. Before leaving, Mira turns to glance at the girl on the ship one last time. Hella waves casually, restarting the engine.

speaker: Hella
content: After you get the Hypercubes, find a safe place to hide. Don't let anyone else find you! I'll be back as soon as I pick her up!
Hella turns and heads off in the other direction.
[WhiteSands - Daytime]
A sand ship glides slowly, almost leisurely, through WhiteSands.
After finally stopping, it honks twice, then honks twice again.

speaker: Hella
content: Hey... hey hey hey!

speaker: Hella
content: With a puzzled frown, you step closer.
The sand shifts, revealing a squad hidden beneath.

speaker: Scotch
content: Long time no see, Miss Sinner. Where are your Tuco friends?

speaker: Hella
content: What Tuco friends? I don't have any friends from Tuco!

speaker: Hella
content: I've been with you guys from the start, don't you remember? We're partners, after all.
Scotch pretends to suddenly come to a realization.

speaker: Scotch
content: Oh then I'm relieved. I thought you were deliberately acting as bait.

speaker: Scotch
content: Let's go, back to the ship... We need to have a good talk.
Inside the security team's sand ship
The hot tea in front of Hella quietly gives off a gentle aroma. Scotch smiles as he pulls out a file, reading it with satisfaction.

speaker: Scotch
content: In this raid against the WhiteSands bandits by the security team, you performed exceptionally and made significant contributions.
Scotch shows Hella the application in his hand. It indeed states that Hella successfully led to the destruction of Tuco.

speaker: Scotch
content: These achievements have all been recorded and will soon be forwarded to my superiors. If the application goes smoothly, the MBCC will soon get a beautiful medal for you.

speaker: Scotch
content: The medal awarding ceremony, bonuses, and commendations will all be there. You've done well, and I'm sure your Chief will be proud of you.

speaker: Scotch
content: However, I do have a small question...
The steam from the tea rises, and Hella remains still, calmly watching Scotch.

speaker: Scotch
content: Before the transmitter was destroyed, we tracked your location, and found that you had returned to Tuco. I don't want to speculate about your choices, but... Miss Hella, you didn't choose to defect at that time, did you?
After a few seconds of silence, Hella bursts out laughing.

speaker: Hella
content: Hahaha! You sure have a wild imagination.

speaker: Hella
content: I went back to see if there were any survivors. I didn't expect them to be waiting to ambush me. Not only did they catch me, but they also dug out and smashed the transmitter. Damn that hurt.
As she says this, Hella dramatically pinches her ear, which is now spotless and scar-free.

speaker: Hella
content: Anyway, I managed to flee and return to you with some news...

speaker: Hella
content: Right now, all of Tuco's remnants are running to the safe house in the market. Hurry up and catch them before they get away.
Scotch watches the girl's exaggerated performance and just smiles.

speaker: Scotch
content: We counted the Hypercubes seized from the town. It's not much, and should be their main reserve. Even if they have hidden stock elsewhere, it won't be a lot.

speaker: Scotch
content: Relying solely on those Hypercubes, they wouldn't be able to withstand even one sandstorm... Perhaps we don't need to waste manpower to pursue them.
Hella freezes, almost jumping out of her chair. But she manages to control her expression, pretending not to care as she stands up.

speaker: Hella
content: Well, whether you send people after them or not is your business. I don't care.

speaker: Hella
content: I've had a long, busy night. I'm dead tired right now. Get me a quiet room. I need to get some good sleep... Hey, open the door! Let me out!
The guard stops Hella from leaving. Footsteps approach from behind, followed by a man's sigh.

speaker: Scotch
content: Miss Hella, no one gets this nervous over people they "don't care" about.

speaker: Scotch
content: You're a kind girl, even covering for them after being deceived. They must have threatened you, right?

speaker: Scotch
content: They're truly scum, not even sparing a little girl like you...

speaker: Hella
content: Tuco didn't steal that batch of Hypercubes. The real robbers are those desert bandits!
Hella turns abruptly, interrupting the man's false accusations.

speaker: Scotch
content: Desert bandits? Sounds like a lie they made up to fool you.

speaker: Hella
content: No, it's not!

speaker: Hella
content: I saw the weapons the desert bandits had. Their artillery, machine guns and new vehicles had official logos on them! Though repainted, those models are not the ones the bandits should have!

speaker: Hella
content: I've been to Tuco and searched all their depots. Half the people there are old, sick, or disabled... I can assure you, they don't have the power to rob Nirvana!

speaker: Hella
content: They might trick people, but they don't harm anyone. If they really had the means to rob Nirvana, then... there wouldn't have...
There wouldn't have been that funeral. Hella lowers her head, wiping away the tears in her eyes.

speaker: Scotch
content: It's indeed possible that the robbers are desert bandits.
Hella looks up in astonishment at the unexpected reply.

speaker: Hella
content: Wait... you believe what I'm saying? You believe the desert bandits are the masterminds behind the robbery?

speaker: Scotch
content: We won't know who the real culprits are until we find them.

speaker: Scotch
content: We're in no hurry... but as for your Tuco friends, without Hypercubes or a stronghold, they definitely won't survive the next sandstorm.

speaker: Scotch
content: In other words... turning themselves in is the only way for them to survive.

speaker: Scotch
content: Right now, you still have a choice. Only you can save them.
It's more a threat than a suggestion. Scotch throws out a bargaining chip that Hella can't resist. She has no choice but to accept with gritted teeth.

speaker: Hella
content: Is there... really still time to save them?

speaker: Scotch
content: As long as you decide before the sandstorm arrives.
Hella takes a deep breath, then finally speaks as if she's given in.

speaker: Hella
content: ...I can tell you where the Tuco folks are, but you gotta call the MBCC.

speaker: Hella
content: I need you to personally promise ${PlayerName} that you're going there to save the Tuco folks. You must ensure their safety, and not harm any innocents!

speaker: Scotch
content: Of course. You have my word.

Sure enough, the call still doesn't go through. After half a minute of busy tone, the call goes to voicemail. Unfazed, Scotch carefully explains the current situation, the impending sandstorm, and the plan to rescue the Tuco folks.
After he hangs up, a tense Hella marks some coordinates on the map.

speaker: Scotch
content: I see. So they stashed the stuff there. Interesting.
Scotch sighs thoughtfully and turns to the guard at the door.

speaker: Scotch
content: You heard that, right? The whereabouts of the Tuco robbers.

speaker: Scotch
content: Go find and kill them all.

speaker: Hella
content: Robbers...? Screw you, Scotch! You lied to me!
Hella tries to rush forward, but a guard, already anticipating her move, stops her.

speaker: Hella
content: You already promised ${PlayerName}! There's a record of your promise in the MBCC's voicemail! If you go back on your word like this, the MBCC won't let you off the hook...!

speaker: Scotch
content: Go back on my word?
The guard covers Hella's mouth. Scotch stands at a safe distance, leisurely picking up the files on the table.

speaker: Scotch
content: We said we'd try to save them, but we never guaranteed any results. WhiteSands is vast, and the sandstorms are terrifying. It's normal for us to try and fail.

speaker: Scotch
content: As for "witnesses"... it's not hard to find some actors.
Leisurely pacing back and forth, Scotch seems to remember something.

speaker: Scotch
content: The identity of the criminal was never important from the start.
Scotch crumples the paper in his hand, which holds the evidence provided by Hella and her achievements in dealing with Tuco, into a ball.

speaker: Scotch
content: Move out. This kid is stupid, but the others are smart. Remember to use another ship. Be careful not to alert them.

speaker: Scotch
content: Oh right, keep a timid one... Do whatever you need to to find the remaining Hypercubes and take them all back.

speaker: Hella
content:
Mmmph... mmm—mmmph, mmmph!
(F**king bastard! I'll kill you!)
Scotch looks at the red-eyed girl gnashing her teeth and trying to lash out. He calmly takes a few steps back and instructs the guards beside him.

speaker: Scotch
content: Lock her up somewhere secure for now, then throw her into the sandstorm later.

speaker: Scotch
content: Her killer could be the Tuco folks, or desert bandits. Anyway, we've done our best. In the end, we can only recover her corpse and send it back to the MBCC for her companions to mourn...
Hella is dragged away. Scotch casually tosses the scrunched-up paper ball into the waste basket, which lands with a soft thud.
As the door is about to close, a faint snicker is heard from within.

speaker: Scotch
content: As expected of a B-Class Sinner.
[WhiteSands - Reef Sandworm]
A small sand ship stops outside the hideout. On the sand, a line of fresh footprints covers the previous ones.
Inside the hideout, the townsfolk are forced by the security team into a tiny corner. They watch helplessly as the team unearths a large box and places it in front of Scotch.

speaker: Security Team Member
content: Sir, we've found it.
Scotch casually kicks the padlocked Hypercube box. The seemingly heavy box slides over by an inch, scraping loudly against the ground.

speaker: Scotch
content: This is too light. They definitely have more. Keep searching.
Scotch turns around, looking at the trembling townsfolk.

speaker: Scotch
content: Quit acting. There's no way you can protect your town with so little stock.

speaker: Scotch
content: Any honest lady or gentleman kind enough to share the location of the remaining Hypercubes? Hmm?
No one answers his taunting question.

speaker: Scotch
content: No one? What a pity.

speaker: Scotch
content: Then let's try a more efficient method. That little one over there... Yes him. Take him away.

speaker: Timmy
content: Wha... mmph! Mmm mmmph!
With a point of his finger, Scotch's men drag out Timmy from the back of the crowd. Sharp cries of protest immediately erupt from the crowd.

speaker: Mira
content: What are you doing?! What does this have to do with a child?! Don't touch him!!
A furious Mira is stopped by a team member. He hits her face with the butt of his gun, then pins her firmly to the ground. Scotch walks over to her and leans in, savoring the hate in her eyes.

speaker: Scotch
content: Looks like someone is ready to talk. So, where are the remaining Hypercubes?

speaker: Mira
content: ...Get lost! You're not welcome here!

speaker: Mira
content: I locked the box. I hid the Hypercubes. If you want the password and location, come at me! What kind of scum threatens a child?!
Instead of getting angry, Scotch laughs.

speaker: Scotch
content: Little lady, it's not hard to open the box, but there is only one chance to let you all live. You better think it through.

speaker: Mira
content: Hmph...
Mira is pinned to the ground and her lips are cracked from thirst, yet her eyes shine like springs in the night.

speaker: Mira
content: Slaying the innocent and treating life with contempt... is this how you do things in DisCity?!

speaker: Mira
content: And you claim to be the last beacon of DisCity? Shame on you!!!
Scotch bursts out laughing, as if having heard an amusing joke.

speaker: Scotch
content: Beacon? Haha... yes indeed, a beacon, and so much more. It's the "light of civilization," the "torch of humanity," the "center of the world," and the "hub of salvation."
To Scotch, Mira's furious questions are nothing but dinnertime jokes, making him guffaw with laughter.

speaker: Scotch
content: Everyone should be like you right now, groveling on the ground, serving us.

speaker: Scotch
content: Do you know why?

speaker: Scotch
content: Because without DisCity, there would be no Hypercubes. You've only managed to survive till now thanks to those blue little cubes being endlessly shipped out of the city.

speaker: Scotch
content: Indeed, they're expensive. But so what? Rare things should fetch a high price, shouldn't they?

speaker: Mira
content: Stop twisting the facts!

speaker: Mira
content: Half a year ago, it didn't cost this much. You've been using climate change as an excuse to raise the prices! How many have died because they couldn't afford Hypercubes... You don't see us as human!
Scotch slowly crouches down to meet Mira's furious gaze. His voice is as cold as a viper.

speaker: Scotch
content: Oh, why so pessimistic? These are all <color=#fb9259>necessary</color>.

speaker: Scotch
content: Rest assured, the money you risked your lives for will be put to good use. They will be invested in some... as they say, <color=#fb9259>greater causes</color>.

speaker: Scotch
content: DisCity must be the "torch of human civilization," so the flow of Hypercubes cannot be disrupted. You just need to bow your heads and cough up your money.

speaker: Mira
content: What...
An amused Scotch reaches out and lightly pats Mira's cheek.

speaker: Scotch
content: What, dumbfounded? No worries. DisCity doesn't exactly care about human rights or morality either. The social hierarchy there is just like yours.

speaker: Scotch
content: We didn't have any grudges initially, but you broke the rules, and I get paid to deal with rule-breakers.
Scotch grabs Mira's hair, forcing her to look up at the townsfolk beside her.

speaker: Scotch
content: Such a pretty face. What a waste to feed it to the sandworms. Let me think... Oh right, you're so brave and selfless, you must really care about them, right? Do you want to watch them get chewed up by sandworms?

speaker: Scotch
content: Who should be the first? After I throw them out one by one, someone might "remember" the remaining locations...
Mira tries to resist, but can't stop the security team. Immobilized, she finally breaks down.

speaker: Mira
content: Stop!

speaker: Mira
content: Stop... I'll tell you...

After getting the locations of the other hideouts, the guards restraining Mira immediately head out to search. Scotch stands up and dusts off the sand from his clothes. As he prepares to leave, he hears Mira's pained voice from behind.

speaker: Mira
content: We've saved up for a long time. Just take it. Please let go... no, I mean, please spare us this once.
Scotch doesn't turn back. He just waves for someone to drag Mira away.

speaker: Scotch
content: Ha, such a piteous amount... as expected of the Outlanders.
The sobbing girl is dragged away. Since she's already given the information, she is of no value anymore.
And things without value should be discarded.

Scotch walks towards the final target of his mission. There probably aren't that many Hypercubes in the box, but it's better than nothing. It'll be enough for him to report back with. Crouching down, he inputs the code and opens the box...
But he doesn't see the familiar blue glow.
Thick white smoke rapidly pours out of the box, rushing into his nose and mouth. Scotch quickly covers his face and steps back, but the back of his head hits something cold and hard.
The safety pin releases with a crisp click.
What a performance you gave. Now, it's my turn.
As the smoke clears, the gun-toting bounty hunter reveals herself.

speaker: Scotch
content: Korryn?! You're still alive?!

speaker: Scotch
content: Ha, you got lucky. But this ends here... Listen up, everyone! Shoot her!
No one responds. The sobbing Mira had broken free from her restraints and kicked the remaining security forces to the ground.

speaker: Mira
content: Oh dear, who are you ordering around? This one, or that one, or... both of them?
Mira releases her grip, and the unconscious soldiers slump to the ground.

speaker: Korryn
content: Now it's my turn to say: it's not hard to keep resisting, but you've only got one chance to keep your head. You better think it through, okay?

speaker: Scotch
content: ...Ha! You dare attack the security team with just these few stragglers?

speaker: Scotch
content: Know your place! Our sand ship is docked outside Tuco. A single cannon can flatten your entire town! You'd better be smart and surrender...

speaker: Korryn
content: Huh? What sand ship? You mean the one that's about to go up in flames?
Korryn's tone is flippant. Scotch suddenly understands the implication behind her words.

speaker: Scotch
content: ...Korryn, you conniving b***h...
(Boom! A ship explodes in the distance)
The explosion unleashes a grand fireworks display, illuminating Scotch's plaster-like expression with a kaleidoscope of colors.

speaker: Korryn
content: Wow! This is much more exciting than fireworks!

speaker: Korryn
content: You're right. Normally, even I wouldn't dare cross you big shots... After all, I have many people to protect, and can't afford to mess with you.

speaker: Korryn
content: So... I found some helping hands. I quietly invited some bold but brainless guests over.
[Enter Memory, WhiteSands - Daytime]

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: Run, eh? Dare you to run, pendejo! Pull that crap again and see what happens!

speaker: Korryn
content: Uh... ahh... huff... huff... Hey buddy, calmed down yet? If we keep delaying, our Hypercubes will end up in someone else's pocket.
The wounded bounty hunter leans casually against the post she's tied to. A young desert bandit, whose ear she shot off, raises his gun warily, but she pays no mind and even flashes him a smile.

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: "Our" Hypercubes? Puta madre! If you lot from WhiteSands hadn't stolen our friggin' goods, how would we have lost it?!

speaker: Korryn
content: That's not the right way to look at things. Without Tuco as a sitting duck, the security bigwigs will target you desert bandits next.

speaker: Korryn
content: They control the Hypercube economy and inflate the prices, so we have no choice but to steal and rob... You and I have never been enemies. The real enemies are the DisCity folks controlling the Hypercubes.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: ...Cut the crap. What you gonna do?

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: No no no boss! We can't trust this woman! We've been screwed over several times already!
The young desert bandit's gun is knocked away in annoyance by his leader. Korryn suppresses a smirk, then dishes out her bait.

speaker: Korryn
content: No matter how much we rob, there's a limit to the amount of Hypercubes controlled by the desert bandits and Tuco... Why don't we team up and go big?

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: You're going after the security team's sand ship?!

speaker: Korryn
content: That's right. Tuco will help divert their firepower. Not only will you get Hypercubes, but also their heavy weaponry. Their gear is way better than your knock-offs.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: So we get the Hypercubes, as well as the gear? You sure make it sound sweet, Korryn. You think I'd believe that you won't take a single cut?

speaker: Korryn
content: Because you have no choice but to believe.

speaker: Korryn
content: DisCity has opened a new mine. They need to establish authority and clear threats along the trade routes, so they'll invest more on military upgrades. The WhiteSands security team is just the beginning. Soon, our firepower will fall behind DisCity.

speaker: Korryn
content: If you don't dare to rob now, there'll be no chance to rise up later.

speaker: Korryn
content: The world is changing. Those who don't struggle will eventually be devoured by WhiteSands.

speaker: Korryn
content: That includes us both.
(Boom... The sound of the security team's sand ship exploding in the distance)

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: Holy cow, boss! That bounty hunter didn't trick us this time! The security team is really dumb enough not to guard their ship?

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Cut the crap! Hold your gun right! Hit those security bastards hard while we can!
The desert bandit ships rise from the sands, speeding towards the smoking security ship. Sandstorms swirl in the air. Korryn cups her hands over her eyes, gazing towards the blazing site.

speaker: Korryn
content: Wow. They move pretty fast.

speaker: Korryn
content: Aren't you going after them? If you don't, your ship and Hypercubes are all gonna be gone!
To show her "friendliness," she even withdraws her gun. But Scotch's face has already turned dark.
At this moment, several team members who went to investigate the other Hypercube hideouts rush back.

speaker: Security Team Member
content: Sir, there's nothing at the location that woman told us...

speaker: Scotch
content: Shut up, you useless fool!
No longer able to maintain his composure, Scotch slaps his subordinate in anger. After a brief assessment of the situation, he strides quickly towards the little speedboat.

speaker: Scotch
content: Start the speedboat! Prioritize breaking up those desert bandits!

speaker: Scotch
content: No matter what, get our ship back first!
The security team hurriedly starts the speedboat and speeds away. Korryn lowers her hat brim, covering the gleam in her eyes.

speaker: Korryn
content: The show is just starting. Let's have some fun.
Under the sand wall, Korryn leisurely watches the far-off drama.

The well-prepared desert bandits clearly hold the upper hand. Most of the security team's main force is diverted to capture the remnants of Tuco, weakening the sand ship's defenses. Though their firepower is stronger than the desert bandits, they can't fend off their ambushes.
Korryn watches intently, but a resentful voice suddenly comes from her side.

speaker: Security Team Member
content: Do you think the desert bandits will spare Tuco? Don't be foolish. If you go help us now, you might still be able to save your skins...

speaker: Security Team Member
content: We are an official DisCity team. If you want to survive, you'd better hurry and cooperate with the security team...

speaker: Korryn
content: I know.

speaker: Security Team Member
content: Huh?
Korryn brushes off the white sand from the brim of her hat, revealing a half-mocking, half-pitying smile.

speaker: Korryn
content: You silly boy. They're bandits. Do you really think they'd give up such a fat sheep?
On the sand ship, the desert bandits have already reached the deck. They're about to break into the cockpit and take control of the entire ship.

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: Damn, feels great! Hypercubes and weapons... we scored big this time!

speaker: Desert Bandit Member
content: Boss?
The desert bandit leader looks at the figure standing in the distance under the sand wall, his eyes gleaming.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Heh... a bunch of old and sickly fools, only meant for the worms.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: Screw their "unfortunate souls" crap... They don't know what's survival of the fittest? I thought that Sinner woman would be useful, but they're all idiots. Might as well take them all out!
A burst of gunfire takes down the guards by the cockpit door. He's just one step away from fully controlling the sand ship.
That's right, just reach out and push the door. The "treasure" is right at the doorstep...
Suddenly, a strong wind gushes in from behind. The desert bandit ducks, narrowly avoiding the steel pipe that slammed down where he was standing.
Whoa, you dodged pretty fast.
I'd say this pipe isn't as good as the original.
A petite figure makes a dazzling entrance with the alarm blaring. She stands above, looking down on everyone.

speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
content: What the... it's you?! Weren't you locked in the...?

speaker: Hella
content: Cage? I've fought countless Corruptors, taken down three Black Rings, knocked some sense into that dummy ${PlayerName}, and even broke out of the MBCC. You think your crappy cage can restrain me?

speaker: Hella
content: The tables have turned. Now it's my turn... Hands up, this is a stick-up! Hand over all your treasures!

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph! This is the price you pay for underestimating the great Hella!
[WhiteSands - Reef Sandworm]

speaker: Scotch
content: Damn it! You were in cahoots from the start...?!
Scotch's team breaks through and rushes onto the deck, but his expression is just as grim as the desert bandit leader's.
At this moment, both of them finally understood: Tuco is no pushover.
What backup hideout? What joint heist? Those scammers planned it all along!!!

speaker: Hella
content: Hey hey hey, be careful, don't get too close! My pipe won't spare anyone or anything. If I accidentally smash something, this ship won't be going anywhere!
Hella waves the pipe near the cockpit's door lock, grinning as she watches Scotch fume.

speaker: Hella
content: How does it feel to be played by the "scammers" you look down upon?

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe, look at your dumb faces! Your jaws are about to hit the ground. Are you really that scared? Furious?
Scotch doesn't take the bait, and lets out a low chuckle instead.
Bang bang! With a few gunshots, Scotch and the other security forces leap into action, taking down the remaining desert bandits on the deck.
The security team advances again, trying to surround Hella and reclaim the cockpit before more desert bandits arrive.

speaker: Scotch
content: Heh... haha... you're talking about dumb?

speaker: Scotch
content: Who got used by Tuco as a tool?

speaker: Scotch
content: I bet they've seized the chance to run away again! Haven't you learned your lesson? They just sent you to die!
Scotch points his gun at Hella, savoring the anger on her face.

speaker: Scotch
content: Oh, I get it now. No wonder your Chief let you out so easily. Keeping someone so weak is useless. That's why they sent you out to gather intel, so that you'll finally have some value!

speaker: Scotch
content: Hahaha! You know it yourself, don't you? You're the weakest Sinner there is. You can't even block a few bullets! You're not still cosplaying as the hero, are you?

speaker: Hella
content: You f**king bastard...!
Scotch changes his tone, offering Hella a new deal.

speaker: Scotch
content: It's okay, you still have a choice.

speaker: Scotch
content: The MBCC doesn't value you, but we do! The security team rewards merit. As long as we team up and capture the Tuco bandits, you can gain a status higher than at the MBCC!
He stands only several inches away from Hella. Gazing at the trembling girl before him, he extends his hand smugly.

speaker: Scotch
content: Money, status, fame, you'll have it all! You'll truly become someone <color=#fb9259>strong</color>!
[Flashback: Past events of Hella and the Tuco folks]

speaker: Timmy
content: It's... I learned how to make this dessert from Mira... and these are Hypercubes I got from three months of savings. It's not much, but I hope it helps...

speaker: Wright
content: But... the sandstorms are coming more frequently, and supplies are getting more expensive. Ultimately, it's because I haven't been a good sheriff for Tuco, otherwise Korryn wouldn't have to go out hunting for Hypercubes everywhere, and you wouldn't have been dragged into this.

speaker: Korryn
content: That's how it is in the WhiteSands. Resources are scarce, so everyone else is an enemy.

speaker: Korryn
content: But even Hypercubes won't necessarily keep you safe. Everyone has to keep fighting to survive... Even if you hadn't come, things would still turn out the same.

speaker: Hella
content: Yeah, we're weak. There are many things we can't do or protect. Life isn't glamorous or carefree.
Mice are born into darkness, forever crawling where there's no light. They can't protect themselves, or their companions.

speaker: Hella
content: And I might really be the weakest, most gullible Sinner there is. No matter where I am, I get fooled easily...

speaker: Hella
content: But...
A little mouse got the chance to live in the light, and she hates always being so weak. So she left, seeking new adventures beyond the light.
The journey was bumpy. The little mouse met a naughty lizard, and also befriended the lizard's naughty companions.
The little mouse discovered... that the lizard was also quite weak, but had found another way to survive.

speaker: Korryn
content: Maybe you're not strong enough now, and will make many mistakes... but that's okay. You have plenty of time. One day, you'll grow up, and become strong enough to face any challenge.

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't rush, and don't feel sad about it.
There are things in this world that only the little mouse can do, and paths that only she can take!

speaker: Hella
content: To do what I couldn't before, and to protect those I want to keep safe... I'm bound to get stronger, a million times stronger than I am now! Then I'll return to them! That's why I set out!

speaker: Hella
content: So until then, I ain't going down here!
The steel pipe swings down. Scotch sidesteps to dodge the blow.

speaker: Scotch
content: Ha... haha, just as I expected, you're a useless piece of trash...

speaker: Scotch
content: You think only one lowly B-Class can stop everyone here?

speaker: Hella
content: Who said I'm the only one here?
Scotch senses something wrong. He looks in the direction of Hella's gaze...
A group of people stand on a nearby sand dune, their silhouettes against the light.

speaker: Korryn
content: Humming~

speaker: Mira
content: ...Korryn, you're off-key again.
The Tuco folks stand behind Korryn, holding various crude weapons. Maggie raises her vihuela, while little Timmy holds up Wright's portrait.
There is rare fervor in everyone's eyes.

speaker: Korryn
content: My my, little Hella grew to be so trusty in the blink of an eye! How wonderful.
Ready, aim, fire... Korryn's muzzle flares with the light of Mania.
[CG - Korryn Fires]

speaker: Korryn
content: Alright dears, the two dogs have started to bite each other! Now's the perfect time for us to plunder!

speaker: Korryn
content: If we miss out on today, who knows when the next big fleecing chance will come!

speaker: Korryn
content: Little Hella is already at the front of the line for us. We Tuco folks have to pull our weight as well...

speaker: Korryn
content: Let's go! Time to bring her back!
[WhiteSands, Sandstorm Background]

speaker: Hella
content: One, two, three... Hey, I'm talking to you! Don't even think about running!
The brawl ends, and the defeated are tied up and neatly laid on the sand.

speaker: Scotch
content: ...Ha... hahaha...
A disheveled Scotch laughs with his head hanging low.

speaker: Hella
content: What, you hit your head and lost your mind?

speaker: Hella
content: Wait... could it be...
In the horizon, a thick blackness is rapidly expanding. The massive shadow of Apostles looms over the sand. It's the Tide of Ashes!!!
They must escape, but with what ship? The security team's big ship is nearly crippled from the recent battle, while the small sand ship can hardly carry anyone.

speaker: Hella
content: Crap! We got too caught up in the fight! We should've saved the ship for backup!

speaker: Scotch
content: Haha! The Apostles of Ashes are arriving... The ships are destroyed, and your piteous amount of Hypercubes won't help much. None of you can escape...

speaker: Scotch
content: Unless Tuco can sprout legs, you're gonna die with us in WhiteSands!

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh? Is that so?
A voice responds slowly.
Korryn casually hands over Wright's portrait, which she was using as a weapon, to Hella, and asks her to take good care of it.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Korryn?
Korryn steps onto a boulder, the wind tousling her long hair. Hella can't see Korryn's face clearly, but she hears her make a strange whistling sound.

speaker: Korryn
content: Little Hella, let me teach you one last trick for surviving outside the city.

speaker: Korryn
content: To face the enemy with a brave heart is precious, but cunning adults always leave themselves a way out...

speaker: Korryn
content: Bounty hunter tip: not only do you run, but you also take the "bounty" with you. If you don't strip them down to their underwear, how can you say you're from Tuco?
As the whistle dies down, a massive roar echoes!
On the other side of the storm, a giant shadow slowly approaches... it seems to be in the shape of a ship.
Unlike the harsh sound of sand scraping in the storm, this noise is deeper, more rhythmic, and approaches quickly with a rumbling buzz.
The intense sandstorm obscures the view, but Hella can still vaguely see something is getting closer from the other side of the storm. Is it... a giant ship or the mirage of a town?

speaker: Scotch
content: Ha... lunatics, you're all lunatics...

speaker: Scotch
content: How is this possible?! Who could possibly transform an entire town into...?!
The next second, darkness descends completely, and the sandstorm engulfs everyone...
[CG Sand Ship Launch]
When the light shines again, Hella is still dizzy from being forcibly hauled onto the ship.
She looks in shock at the sand ship beneath her feet... The familiar shabby buildings, the familiar welcome sign, and the familiar little mice covered in dust.
Beneath the "magnificent, unparalleled Tuco Palace" was a massive sand ship, as large as the entire town of Tuco!

speaker: Hella
content: So this is the real <color=#fb9259>Tuco</color>...?
No wonder no one can find Tuco's location. Every time they're exposed, they cunningly move the entire town!

speaker: Korryn
content: Desert dwellers can't have too many footholds, but nothing beats a hideout that can run away with you. See, isn't this way cooler than their ship?

speaker: Korryn
content: This time, it's a real WhiteSands adventure. Keep a lid on your screams...
Korryn raises her hand in command and points towards the light.

speaker: Korryn
content: Floor it! Full speed ahead!
[Desert - Daytime]
Rustle... rustle...
The sandstorm passes, and the weather clears.
A green lizard scurries across the sand, leaving a trail of tiny footprints. Not far from the lizard, Hella clutches the docked Tuco sand ship, vomiting as Korryn pats her back.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh dear, you were so spirited swinging that pipe earlier. Now look at you...

speaker: Korryn
content: There there, feeling better? Want some water?

speaker: Hella
content: Ugh... I'm never taking your ship again! What a bumpy ride... Urgh...

speaker: Korryn
content: No probs. Next time we collab, you drive. You're way better at it than me.

speaker: Korryn
content: Thank you for everything. Had fun working with us?
Hella turns her head awkwardly.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph! For folks who usually flee at the drop of a hat, y'all just had to jump in and fight with me this time, even though none of you know how to fight... Good thing we won. If anything bad happened...

speaker: Korryn
content: Nah, I knew we'd win. After all, we had you on our side!

speaker: Hella
content: Cut it out, I'm being serious!

speaker: Korryn
content: I'm being serious too, Hella.
Korryn's expression softens, her eyes warm and gentle.

speaker: Korryn
content: Just like you said, Tuco is really weak. No stable Hypercube supply, no cannons... Look, we don't even have a proper sand ship.

speaker: Korryn
content: Of course, in a place like WhiteSands, if you want to "be strong," you can join any desert bandit group. But... some people just don't want to live like that.

speaker: Korryn
content: If the powerless want to live in freedom, they must band together and use their wits and bonds to survive in this dire world.

speaker: Korryn
content: What we've always lacked isn't strength, but companions who can carve out a future with us.
Korryn stretches out her hand, officially extending an invitation.

speaker: Korryn
content: Haha... You always thought of me as the bad guy, and never took my invitation seriously.

speaker: Korryn
content: Little Hella, would you like to stay and continue adventuring with us?
Hella hesitates a bit and looks towards the ship. Sure enough, the townspeople are peeking at her, quickly hiding after being spotted.
Hella's hand twitches, but ultimately doesn't take Korryn's hand.

speaker: Hella
content: Sorry, I can't stay.

speaker: Hella
content: I... I really like you guys, too! The car chase was a blast, and fighting desert bandits with you was awesome! I've learned so much from you, but... that's still not enough.

speaker: Hella
content: The world outside DisCity is nothing like I imagined—it's vast and dangerous. You guys showed me a new way to become strong. Maybe I can find other kinds of "strength" elsewhere, too.

speaker: Hella
content: I think that's the whole point of adventure! My journey's just starting. It's not just about Tuco—there are so many places waiting for me!

speaker: Hella
content: I'll get stronger, and bring that strength back with me—I already have a place I really want to return to, and people I want to be with forever. I've gotta get back to them.

speaker: Hella
content: ...Oh geez, how cheesy of me! You're making me blush!

speaker: Korryn
content: Is that so? Well, there's nothing I can do then.

speaker: Korryn
content: When you put it like that, how can I keep trying to poach you?

speaker: Korryn
content: Is it that ${PlayerName} and Hecate you mentioned before? Seriously, anyone who can keep you thinking about them like this, I wanna meet. Bring them along next time?

speaker: Hella
content: Sure! They're both really interesting people.

speaker: Korryn
content: So... goodbye, then?

speaker: Hella
content: Yeah, goodbye. See you around!
As they bid farewell, the roar of motorbikes comes from afar—Hella contacted the Legion after escaping from the cage, and they are coming to pick her up.
She waves vigorously at the Tuco folks, then turns around, striding forward without looking back.
A Tuco ballad echoes in the wind. It's a melody that Hella is familiar with.
Congratulations, for witnessing the most magnificent desert sunset. Congratulations, for keeping the most genuine smile in these times.
Bless you. Your adventures will guide our way forward. Your story be sung across WhiteSands!
May you always charge ahead bravely! May your journeys always be smooth!
In a daze, Hella thinks she hears Wright's familiar raspy voice. She suddenly remembers she still has Wright's portrait with her.

speaker: Hella
content: Ah, I need to return this to you...

speaker: Wright
content: Ah?
In the crowd seeing her off, the "deceased" Wright is standing right there.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh... we didn't expect you to really turn around! If we'd known, we wouldn't have made it so melodramatic... Turn back around, sweetie. Just pretend you were seeing things. Keep this beautiful memory so we can...

speaker: Hella
content: You lying vixen!!! Korryn!!! You tricked me again!!!
[CG Farewell Moment A]

speaker: Hella
content: Biatch! Liar! So frigging shameless!!!!!

speaker: Korryn
content: Hahaha, the little mouse is mad! Run, run!

speaker: Korryn
content: Of course, if you really can't bear to part with me, you can still join Tuco. You can reach out to me anytime—got it?
[CG Farewell Moment B]

speaker: Hella
content: In your dreams! Damn it! You almost conned me out of my shorts!

speaker: Hella
content: Get lost! Hella here is in high demand, I don't need an invite from you!
[CG Farewell Moment C]

speaker: Korryn
content: Hahaha... Alright, this time it's really goodbye!
Korryn's figure almost merges into the light. Only her brightly shining eyes stand out.

speaker: Korryn
content: Go and become stronger! Meet different people, explore new cities, and see what the world really looks like on my behalf! Let me know what's at the end of WhiteSands!

speaker: Korryn
content: It's okay to be confused. It's okay to get lost. Don't stop, keep moving forward...

speaker: Korryn
content: ...At the end of your journey, you'll definitely find the answers you seek!
A few days later...

The desert bandit leader and security captain Scotch were dumped somewhere along the transport route by unknown individuals. They were left with only their underwear and a small amount of Hypercubes. Fighting when found, the discoverers had to exert all their strength to separate them.
At the same time, a letter is secretly delivered to the security force office. Inside, a photo of Scotch and the desert bandit fighting in their underwear is placed meticulously on top.
As for the Tuco folks...

speaker: Korryn
content: ...Ah, it would've been perfect if we succeeded in keeping little Hella. What a pity.
A group of Tuco folks is sitting under some wanted posters, chatting nonchalantly.

speaker: Maggie
content: That Legion... that's what she called it, right? Holy smokes, that convoy was really freaking something else! It looked so powerful, even from afar. Think we could drop their name if we run into trouble again?

speaker: Mira
content: It's a pity that someone couldn't keep their mouth shut and had to bellow out during the farewell. Otherwise, with the Legion covering us, WhiteSands would've been our backyard!

speaker: Wright
content: Hehe, well... it was just an outbreak... yeah outbreak.

speaker: Mira
content: Yeah you bet. Talk to my hand.

speaker: Korryn
content: No biggie. We were doing just fine before Hella came along, weren't we?

speaker: Korryn
content: However...
Korryn's gaze zooms in on the wanted list, focusing on the word "DisCity."

speaker: Korryn
content: DisCity... that Minos Chief is quite interesting. Should we go meet him?
female_content: DisCity... that Minos Chief is quite interesting. Should we go meet her?

content: [WhiteSands - Daytime]
Hella leans against the Legion's vehicle, sulking. Horo glances at her several times before finally speaking.

speaker: Horo
content: Come on now, cheer up. You look happy and you've become stronger, a little bit.

speaker: Hella
content: Hmph, so next time you'll take me with you on a mission?

speaker: Horo
content: Well, even if I kick you out off the car, you'll still climb back on, so be it.

speaker: Hella
content: Hooray! I'm a big shot now, you know. I know everything about WhiteSands... all the local routes! I'll cover you from now on!

speaker: Horo
content: Okay.
Horo agrees nonchalantly, leaving Hella momentarily stunned.

speaker: Hella
content: What?...Are you out of your mind? Is this a joke?
Horo doesn't respond. She just smiles and pats Hella's head.

speaker: Horo
content: You've indeed gotten stronger, so I guess I can use some help from you.

speaker: Horo
content: After all, the <color=#fb9259>"goods"</color> the Legion needs to keep an eye on this time aren't anything sweet...
Horo takes out a file folder. Inside are many scattered clues, including a particularly strange one.
Blurry lens, a strange box, glaring patterns—the Underground's crimson mark looks extremely eerie in this picture.

speaker: Horo
content: Let's go. We'll see exactly who's going to send what, and where they're going to send the bogeyman this time...
Horo steps on the gas. The convoy accelerates, leaving the route and delving deeper into WhiteSands.
In the depths of desolate WhiteSands, a few travelers are sitting inside Tuco's only shabby motel.
Beside the counter, the motel owner is personally attending to an out-of-town merchant. The man slams his empty beer mug on the table, his boastful voice echoing throughout the motel.

speaker: Merchant
content: I've been in the business for so many years. There's no treasure I haven't seen! I ain't bragging, but my eyes are sharper than those frigging instruments!

speaker: Merchant
content: Look at the antique I got this time. With just one glance, I knew it was genuine. That dumb bumpkin even thanked me for taking this junk off his hands. Haha!

speaker: Merchant
content: He didn't even know he was being swindled. That's why he's poor!

speaker: Mira
content: Wow, that was really impressive! Let me get you a refill on the house—it's my honor.
Mira refills the merchant's empty mug. Leaning on the table with her elbow, she lowers her torso with a gaze of admiration and awe.

speaker: Mira
content: The moment you walked in, I felt your aura was different from the other guests. What a worldly gentleman!

speaker: Mira
content: Not like me. All my life, I've never known what an antique looked like...

speaker: Merchant
content: That's easy! Since you're interested, I'll show you.
Drunk on flattery and beer, the merchant waves his hand and eagerly opens the bag containing the antique ceramic jar.

speaker: Mira
content: So this is an antique... I might not have the right words for it, but it looks rare and valuable. Oh, only an expert like you deserves to have something so exquisite!

speaker: Merchant
content: Of course! Do you know who I am? Let me tell you, this antique is so special because...

speaker: Drunkard
content: Hey, you! Yeah, you!
Suddenly, a drunkard appears out of nowhere, forcefully grabbing the merchant's collar, cutting off his unfinished boasts.

speaker: Drunkard
content: You have the audacity to come back, you ungrateful wretch? After you, hic, gambled away my life's savings? How did I end up with a son like you... (Cries loudly)

speaker: Merchant
content: What the heck? Who the hell are you? How dare you call yourself my dad?!
The two men push and shove each other, toppling a chair and crashing into the counter. Mira quickly moves the mugs and bag to the side, anxiously waving her hands.

speaker: Mira
content: There must be some misunderstanding! Please stop fighting! It won't be good if you damage anything here.
But the two men, tangled in their brawl, completely ignore Mira. Amidst the chaos, the motel's wooden door is forcefully pushed open from the outside.

speaker: Sheriff
content: What's going on! Who gave you the right to fight in the motel? Stop it, both of you!

speaker: Drunkard
content: Oh, the injustice! A son not recognizing his father! I'll report this to the police! I must... report this!

speaker: Sheriff
content: How can a twenty-year-old be a father to a forty-year-old... Are you two causing trouble? Come with me down to the station. Save your words for then.

speaker: Merchant
content: Wait, wait a minute, my antique is still in there...

speaker: Sheriff
content: So on top of fighting, you also want to obstruct justice? You better behave if you don't want to land in jail!
This bizarre farce concludes with the sheriff taking the two men away. Meanwhile, in a corner of the motel, a figure stealthily approaches the counter without anyone noticing.
But before he can touch the antique, a gentle reminder rings in his ear.

speaker: Mira
content: Hey there, in my motel, no one touches other guests' belongings.
The thief shivers, turning to see that the speaker is a frail, unarmed young girl.

speaker: Mira
content: If there's something troubling you, you can tell me, but you can't take someone else's things... ah!
Mira didn't get to finish her sentence. The thief suddenly tries to grab the bag she's protecting.

speaker: Thief
content: Cut the crap! Hand it over!

speaker: Mira
content: Don't push... ah!
In the scuffle, the ceramic jar slips out of the half-open zipper and hurtles through the air in a graceful arc.
Crash!
Silence fills the room as the fragments scatter everywhere. The thief turns pale and tries to flee, but Mira reacts quicker.

speaker: Thief
content: Eek?! What are you doing! Let go of me!
Mira smiles gently, effortlessly grabbing the thief by his collar. No matter how hard he struggles, the delicate hand that he easily swatted away earlier now has an iron grip on him.

speaker: Mira
content: That's not going to work. If you leave, I won't be able to explain to the guest when he returns.

speaker: Thief
content: What do you want, then! Don't expect me to take the blame alone! I have no money!

speaker: Thief
content: P-plus, you're also at fault for breaking the jar! If I'm going down, you're going down with me!
In the face of the thief's hostility, Mira sighs softly. Her face dims slightly from being misunderstood.

speaker: Mira
content: You've misunderstood. I don't want to harm you. I want to help you.

speaker: Mira
content: That merchant has many connections in DisCity. Breaking his jar will certainly make him hold a grudge against you. Even if you escape from me, he'll catch up with you later.

speaker: Mira
content: If you run off now, you'll truly seal your own fate.
Her words make sense. The thief feels a bit shaken. While he still struggles vigorously, his strength is a lot weaker than before.

speaker: Thief
content: ...Is that buffoon really a big shot? But I'll be dead if I stay here, too! Let me go!

speaker: Mira
content: Oh, don't worry. I have a plan.
