A great many shadows ooze out of the moon. These are living things bent on luring innocent souls into the dark. They snake their way to where your broken consciousness lies, toying with it before latching onto it.
You're finally... back...
We've... found you...
No, this isn't the place... I've come to the wrong place.
Stay away from me!
Special Effects (Earring)

A drop of icy water breaks the surface of a still pool, and a voice sounds in the deep recesses of your consciousness. As the moving mist disperses, your eyesight returns. You are greeted by a scene the likes of which you've never seen before.
It's a dream-like space, confusing and disorienting. The whispering of a distant tide caresses your eardrums, like a sleep-inducing lullaby. You search for a way out but to no avail.
Come, let me show you the way...

Shallow footprints extend to the distance. They move apart, only to come together shortly after; they disappear, only to reappear moments later. At the end of the trail stands a thin apparition. It is flickering.
Only the crisp sound of a bell can be heard.
The apparition is standing right under the red moon, not so far away from you. It looks nothing like any other apparition you've encountered.
The apparition doesn't turn around, nor does it answer your question. You see the red moonlight slowly encroaching on its body. Suddenly, you hear a monstrous roar.
The gray filth on the ground has gathered to form a mud monster. It is now gliding quickly toward you.
The mud monster is driven off. You see the flickering image of the white apparition again, a short distance away. It is walking toward the red moon in a daze, murmuring under its breath.

speaker: Apparition
content: <size=30>It slowed down even before it entered the atmosphere. The speed before it started slowing down... reached the speed of light?! Could that explain why it had gone undetected? ...No, that's impossible. Maybe I should consider the whole thing in the framework of a wormhole? Or maybe I miscalculated...</size>

speaker: Apparition
content: <size=30>What about the mass? If my rough calculation isn't far off, then the element is... heavier than Element 118... A new element? It's been 22 years... considering the radioactive decay process... how is it possible that such extraterrestrial matter has caused so many disasters?</size>

speaker: Apparition
content: <size=36>Quick... I need to act fast... Got to find it now...</size>
It is a woman's voice. It sounds familiar to you, although you can't quite put your finger on it. Dazed and confused, you take a step in her direction.
Special Effects (Earring)

As if coming out of a daze, she turns around to face you. She looks at you for a long while before recognition registers in her eyes. Her voice is gentle when she speaks to you, and her flickering figure begins to stabilize.
She looks familiar to you.
As you rack your brains, trying to remember where you have seen the face before, she reaches out a hand and, before you can do anything in response, touches something attached to your ear.
It's an earring.

speaker: Apparition
content: It's you...

speaker: Apparition
content: What are you doing here? Are you lost too?

speaker: Apparition
content: Just kidding. We'd be in a lot of trouble if even our guide got lost too.
She pauses, as if deep in thought.

speaker: Apparition
content: Look likes I got separated from the rest of the team again. I was looking for the Perishing Star. Got to find it as soon as possible. Captain must be furious with me.

speaker: Apparition
content: I'm sorry. I'll return to the base now. Are you here to take me back, my dear guide?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't know what this place is. I don't know the way back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't know who you are.

speaker: Apparition
content: Is that so... I guess we're both lost then.

speaker: Apparition
content: Are you scared?

speaker: Apparition
content: Really? Good for you, our brave little guide. I wish I could be as brave as you are.

speaker: Apparition
content: Hehe... Quite understandable. You're barely an adult. But don't worry, I got your back.
She extends her hand to you, a warm smile on her face.

speaker: Apparition
content: You are familiar with this place. You've found me, after all.

speaker: Apparition
content: And I'm sure you can find your way back.
She is still a blurry image, but you can feel the warmth in her smile, the only source of warmth in this unsettling place. You reach out your hand to take hers, as a question escapes your lips.
Her lips were moving, but you didn't catch the answer.
The white light is receding, and so is the murmuring.
Are you awake? Are you out of that ominous illusory realm?

No, you haven't left it. You can still see the swimming red light in the distance, except that it is very far away now. You find yourself standing in front of a ruin. This should be the base the woman mentioned, or what's left of it.

The woman who brought you here is gone. There is a cool sensation in the hand that she was holding. You look down and see a light-blue crystal flower. The light it emits feels familiar and gives you a sense of security.
It's safe here, you think to yourself. You look ahead, at the object that stands solemnly at the center of this deserted piece of land.
It's an ink-black stele, with its surrounding area scattered with dots of blue light.
You realize that they're the broken remains of many blue crystal flowers as you approach the stele. You come to its foot and look up at it. By this time, you're completely clear-headed.
Engraved on the stele are the patterns you saw on the beach, followed by many neat rows of words. The words seem to be written in some strange language. They're fuzzy and incomprehensible.

You try hard to make sense of the words. You feel that you can understand them. But their meaning seems within reach and unreachable at the same time, like a slippery fish that you're unable to hold on to.
Special Effects (Earring)

speaker: Apparition
content: You are familiar with this place. You have found me, after all.

speaker: Apparition
content: And I'm sure you can find your way back.
The earring hums. In response, some of the engraved words light up. And you have an epiphany.

options: This stele is the way back

content: You have to decipher the words, or, rather, recover a lost memory, before you can locate the real exit.
The woman who led you here may be the only person who can help you get out of this illusory realm. You need to go back to her.
You leave the deserted place and make for the red light in the distance. You glance up at the Illusory Moon, feeling sure that she is waiting for you under the moon.

The red moon grows in size as you draw nearer. It is not just your physical body that is approaching it, but your consciousness as well. You stare at it, your eyes boring into it, as your consciousness disintegrates and regroups.
Special Effects (Earring)

You are back, but not actually walk here. As you stared at the red moon, your consciousness disintegrated and regrouped, and you were transported back. Now, all around you, you can see shadow figures and hear bone-chilling murmurs.
The place isn't how you remember it. <color=#fb9259>She</color> is nowhere to be seen, and your surroundings look somewhat different.
I must find her, you remind yourself. She will show you the way out.
You eliminate all the contorted shadow figures and set her free. You see no indication of fear on her face as she watches these ghostly creatures disappear.

speaker: Apparition
content: ...Did you destroy them all?

options: Yes, thankfully you are safe and sound.

speaker: Apparition
content: <size=31>I see... but they could have been extraterrestrial beings that rode piggyback on the Perishing Star. What a shame they're all gone now... There hasn't been any breakthrough in the research on the Perishing Star for ages. I thought my day had come...</size>

speaker: Apparition
content: Ah... Sorry, I digressed. Thank you, for coming back for me.

speaker: Apparition
content: Did I... get lost again?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's okay. I'm lost too. Glad to see you again. I need your help.

options: Can you tell me who you are?

speaker: Apparition
content: Me?

speaker: Apparition
content: I'm a scholar, an astronomer.

options: I'd like to know your name.

speaker: Apparition
content: My name...
She lowers her head, trying hard to recall her own name, but it's not forthcoming. However, she doesn't seem confused or troubled.

speaker: Apparition
content: That's not important. The purpose of this operation is to unveil the truth about the Perishing Star. What they need is an astronomer. It doesn't matter what name the astronomer goes by.

speaker: Apparition
content: Yes, the <color=#fb9259>Perishing Star</color>.

speaker: Apparition
content: What a strange name that is. There isn't such a thing as a city here, not anymore.

speaker: Apparition
content: The Perishing Star landed in the center of the desert, and the subsequent catastrophe pushed our civilization into an era of eternal night. We have to locate the Perishing Star, unveil its dark secrets, and bring light back to humanity.
Her voice is steady when she shares her lifelong passion with you, not nervous or anxious at all. There is even a hint of a smile on her face.

options: You don't seem to be afraid of it at all. On the contrary, you sound like a little excited.

speaker: Apparition
content: I guess I am a little excited. What scientist wouldn't? When the ultimate truth is so close at hand. I've been dreaming about it lately.

speaker: Apparition
content: I do hope it can lift the veil of ignorance before my eyes and let me see the ultimate truth. I want to... hold it in my hand.
She looks into the distance, up at the Illusory Moon in the sky, red and ominous.

speaker: Apparition
content: Where did it come from? What path did it take?

speaker: Apparition
content: We humans are insignificant before the ultimate truth, which is magnificent and all-encompassing. It is within reach now.

She takes a step forward, as if oblivious to your presence. She walks toward the Illusory Moon in a daze, as she did when you first met her. Through the red light, you catch a glimpse of the craziness in her eyes.

speaker: Apparition
content: How did you elude our observing eyes? What tricks did you employ to get to our world?

speaker: Apparition
content: Why did you choose this place? Why are you in my dreams? Are you toying with me? You don't think I can catch you?

speaker: Apparition
content: Or have you... come here to tell me something?
You take her hand. She turns to look at you. She doesn't seem to recognize you at first. It's some time before she speaks again.

speaker: Apparition
content: It's you...

speaker: Apparition
content: Sorry, I did it again, didn't I? The Perishing Star is very near. It's hard not to be led astray.
She is right. It's hard to stay clear-headed around here. But it seems that she is easily led astray. Can you really count on her to show you the way out?

options: Stay awake. Don't let your pursuit ruin you.

speaker: Apparition
content: Sorry... I will try my best to resist it. Someone said, "Even if annihilation is inevitable, we shall not leave this world ignorant of the thing that has brought about the annihilation."

speaker: Apparition
content: I like this sentence. It's an apt description of the purpose of this expedition. Not knowing can lead to despair, whereas knowledge can bring hope.

speaker: Apparition
content: I have you, don't I? Show me the way, my dear guide.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Oh, please! I'm just as lost as you. I was hoping you could help me get out of here.
She smiles and extends her hand to you.

speaker: Apparition
content: Let's join hands then. Two lost souls... Together, we shall emerge victorious.

Carcasses of Corruptors pile high all around. In their midst stands a figure in a white dress tainted with filth. How did a feeble-looking scholar like her survive such a battle? What kind of power does she possess? Where did she acquire her power?
It's obvious that she is growing weaker, but not just from the effort of defeating the Corruptors.

speaker: Apparition
content: Hu...hu... hah...Hahah... This doesn't make any sense...

speaker: Apparition
content: It's not a celestial body or a meteorite... It's not made of organic matter... or inorganic matter...

speaker: Apparition
content: Mass-energy equivalence doesn't apply, the speed doesn't make sense, everything is topsy-turvy. Bring in extra dimensions to explain all this? Could it be consciousness distortion? No, it can't be. There must have been a miscalculation. Start over...

speaker: Apparition
content: Theories, hypotheses... Doesn't matter from which field... I need more tools to tackle it. I must have miscalculated, I must have failed to include some important factors. We have done so much work on this, we can, we will unveil its secrets.

speaker: Apparition
content: Who's there?!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You were led astray again. It's dangerous here. Let's go back.

speaker: Apparition
content: Back? Back to where? You want me to leave the Forbidden Sea?

speaker: Apparition
content: You want me to go back too? First the captain, now you. You think I can't protect myself?

speaker: Apparition
content: Or is this your roundabout way of saying I'm no longer needed as an astronomer, because you think that's not a real "meteorite"?

options: It's because it's dangerous here and you're being affected by Mania!

speaker: Apparition
content: I am not scared of danger! Don't you underestimate science!

speaker: Apparition
content: I am a scholar. The ultimate truth is right around the corner. It is calling me, the Perishing Star. It is very close.

speaker: Apparition
content: It laughs at the futility of our efforts. Well, laugh away. I'm not leaving until I've found the answer.

speaker: Apparition
content: One theory is disproved, the next comes along. Step by step, we will solve the ultimate equation. Anything that can be known will be known. We will find the ultimate truth.

speaker: Apparition
content: <size=29>I don't fear death. And even if the existence of the Perishing Star disapproves everything we know about the laws of science and shows us how ignorant we are, well... We're no strangers to that! We've done this many times over. Science progresses on the ruins of old. Now, it's my turn to build new theories.</size>
Maniac contamination is encroaching on her body, but her eyes are burning with sheer determination.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Take a minute to collect yourself. Your expedition has not ended yet. If you die here or go insane, everything you've worked so hard for will go to waste.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're a scientist. You should keep a clear head. Please come with me. You don't want to get lost, if you still want to capture that meteorite.

speaker: Apparition
content: ... Decided to continue?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Go and seek the ultimate truth. You have the Guide here to help you, and I will always point you the path.
The look she gives you is gentle, but still tinged with uncertainty and confusion. She forgets who you are again.

speaker: Apparition
content: Sorry... who are you again? I can't remember your name...
You pause for a second. And then a name comes to your foggy mind.
${PlayerName}.
You take her hand.
The shackles run through the apparition, as if through air. You hear a voice before you leave her.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: It's too late... too late...

speaker: Apparition
content: It's all wrong. All wrong. Have to start over. Do a new round of calculations... Go back to Step 34. No, no... I keep going. I will prove it...

speaker: Apparition
content: <size=30>We have seen stars that lie millions of light years away from my planet. Our shared memories, they pass on from generation to generation. What one generation learns is a foundation that the next can build on. Our efforts are not futile. What we believe in is not a pipe dream...</size>
She's losing her grip. Mud climbs up her body, enveloping it. You see tears rolling down her cheeks. Those tears represent the last residues of her humanity.
You hear no response. Her insubstantial figure is all but entirely consumed. A shadow monster slowly wrapped itself around the thin figure of the scholar.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: It's too late...
The phantom blocking your way is finally gone. You run as fast as your legs can carry you toward the disappearing scholar.
You reach out, but your hand catches nothing. The scholar is gone. Nothing is left behind but a puddle of mud on the ground.
With her gone, the illusory realm starts bending this way and that. Red light splashes down onto the ground, melting away everything it touches like a corrosive acid.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: Human beings are as insignificant as specks of dust. You're trapped for eternity in this tiny planet of yours. You look up at the night sky and see millions of shining stars. They are but a drop in the ocean that is the universe.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: You're a feeble-minded species. The knowledge you've gleaned over hundreds of generations is negligible. Even if you were in the presence of the ultimate truth, all you could do is scratch your head in confusion. You tilt at windmills, you fight losing battles. As for her, she is the embodiment of the stupidity of your kind.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: But the ultimate truth admires her quixotic efforts. She treats all creatures equally. She'll accept anyone with open arms, as long as they're willing to admit their inferiority and become part of something greater.

speaker: Chaotic Voices
content: **** has made her choice. She has chosen to become part of the ultimate truth, part of me.
You dig in the mud in a frenzy, hoping against hope that you can find something she left behind. You need her to give you directions. You need to get back to the stele. You have a place to return to.
And you want to take her with you.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: It's too late. You don't belong here. You can't take anyone away from here.
Dark descends. When you're about to lose consciousness, you hear a voice.

speaker: Feeble Voice
content: ...Are you lost too?
You want to call out her name, but can't remember what her name is. Your hand, still submerged in the mud, feels warm. And then you see dots of blue light through the mud.
Pieces of crystal come out of the mud. They grow, expand. And they blossom. Before long, light blue crystal flowers are everywhere. They give out a gentle, soothing light.
A warm current runs through your body. And vaguely, you hear a familiar voice.

speaker: Feeble Voice
content: Go back where you came from, my dear guide...

speaker: Feeble Voice
content: I hope... you can find your way back...
She sends you back, to where the stele is. It stands silent and solemn, just as it did the last time you were here, but now you understand the words engraved on the stele.
They are names, 42 of them.
The stele is a monument to the 42 individuals who lost their lives while venturing into the unknown to learn about the source of the catastrophes.
Their bodies, their clothes, and their souls have been reduced to nothingness. All that is left is their names.
And the only name that's shining, you recognize it too.
<color=#fb9259>Dreya</color>, that's the name of the astronomer who was a member of the Expedition.
What you saw are her memories before she departed from the mortal world. You saw how she gave herself up to the Illusory Moon.
She's gone, but she's left her name behind, to guide you out of this illusory realm.
You're free to go now, but...
You look up at the sky. The Illusory Moon is contorted, getting more menacing by the second. A shadow figure is taking form, and it is roaring.
You know that the stubborn scholar has lost the chance to leave. She'll be trapped here forever...
Unless...
You walk into the scarlet sky studded with stars.
The red light consumes everything. It toys with your consciousness.
Horrifying monsters are floating in the air under the Illusory Moon. Her body is covered with filth, and she is wearing a mask, but you know she is looking at you.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: You stayed. You've come back. I knew you would come back.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: I hope you're here to stay. This is where you belong. She and the others, they have been waiting for you.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: Waiting for you to come back here.

options: I have places I want to return to.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But this isn't the place for me. This isn't the place for her either.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm gonna take her with me and leave this place.

speaker: Wild Voice
content: Hahaha, she will never leave with you. This is what she truly wants, a desire that runs deep in her soul.

speaker: Wild Voice
content: Lowly creatures like human beings don't deserve the ultimate truth.

speaker: Wild Voice
content: That's why she is giving up her filthy, temporary human shell, to become part of something timeless, to become one with the ultimate truth.

speaker: Wild Voice
content: The ultimate truth, that's what her heart truly desires, not salvation, whatever that is.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You look down on us, you taunt us. Still, you covet her soul, the soul of a lowly human being; that's because you can see how pure her soul is.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: <size=31>She's brave; she's confronted her fears and ignorance. Time and time again, she has overcome the impossible to get to your territory. She has given all that she's got to conquer the unknown, even her life. You have no right to belittle her heroic endeavor.</size>

speaker: Wild Voice
content: All souls lie bare under the light of the Illusory Moon! Only I understands her true desire!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You filthy thing, you have no right to talk about what any of us wants. You have no idea what a true scholar takes pride in.
She opens her eyes slowly.

speaker: Dreya
content: It's you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm bringing you back. I am here to get the scholar Dreya back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's leave this place together.
Dreya still looks dazed, but she slowly raises her hand and gently rests it on your palm.
Light flows out of the place where her palm touches yours and drives off the shadows around you. You start losing consciousness, feeling as if you're parting ways with the world.

options: Dreya, is your mind still clear?

speaker: Dreya
content: It is...
Consciousness is slipping away from her. You hold her hand tightly, reassuring your groggy mind that she is still there at your side. The two of you march ahead.
There's light ahead. That must be where the exit is. You want to take the scholar out of here. There are so many questions you want to ask her once you get out.
What era did you live in? Where do you come from?
Why is your name on the stele? What kind of language are those engraved words? What happened to the other people?
Why did that monster say to you? How did it seduce you? How did it torture you?
How long have you been trapped in the abyss? Why didn't your guide come to get you? Am I the one who failed you?
Have we really met before?
But you don't ask any of these questions.

options: ... Have you seen the long sought after stars?

speaker: Dreya
content: Almost... there...

speaker: Dreya
content: It was offered to me... but I turned it down... at the last minute...

speaker: Dreya
content: ...Why? Why did I refuse the ultimate truth when it was right before me... I rejected it, and it trapped me in the darkness of ignorance...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What you were dealing with was an evil thing. If you had done what it told you to, you would be trapped forever. You're seeking the ultimate truth, because that's your calling, because you want it to be a badge of honor.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're in the vanguard of the human race's conquest of the unknown. You would never bow down to that evil thing. You're a proud scholar, and you saw through its ruse. That's why you've come back; you know there are other ways to gain knowledge.
She gives a gentle smile.

speaker: Dreya
content: But I always forget the way back.

options: It'll be alright, you'll always have "guide".

speaker: Dreya
content: In this expedition, we all lost ourselves at some point, some to fear, some to desire, some to despair. It's you who guided us out of the mire over and over again...

speaker: Dreya
content: Thank you for finding my name... I'm back, and it's all thanks to you, my dear guide...

speaker: Dreya
content: But you... you don't belong here...

She releases your hand. You turn to look at her, and her eyes are clear for the first time since you met her. It seems that she's finally recognized you. But she is drifting away from you, or, rather, you are drifting away from the illusory realm.

speaker: Savage Monster
content: Ahhhhh!
The Illusory Moon is gone. Beams of red light burst forth from inside the DisSea monster's body.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: The monster... it has been restrained!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Is that light...?
The monster falls, smashing against the ground. It roars in the direction of the glamorous city. The FAC soldiers open fire to beat it off. Their bodies are wounded, but their spirits are high.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Attack! This is our chance. Repel it! Don't let it break through the Broken Frontline!

speaker: Savage Monster
content: Ahhhhh!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Get lost, monster of the Black Ring! Want to bring us down? Not one freaking chance!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Is it the shackles? But Chief is...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: MBCC! Mark that monster! We will assist you in capturing it!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Copy that! Listen up, everybody, there might be a Sinner or a creature of the same class on the loose. Arrest Squad, head out and control it, but know your limits. Intelligence Squad, proceed and gather intelligence.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief will come back. When that day comes, we will be able to detain this Mania entity.

speaker: Dreya
content: You don't belong in this timeline. Still... I'm glad that I met you here...

speaker: Dreya
content: Go back where you came from... my dear guide...

speaker: Dreya
content: I hope... you can find your way back...
She stands motionless in the sea of blue crystal flowers, seeing you off, as she disintegrates and vanishes into thin air, leaving behind the solemn stele.

On April 30, N.F. 113, with the Mania entity subdued, the DisSea Black Ring became less active, and the Third Broken Frontline remained intact.
Since the Mania entity that came into existence because of the Illusory Moon resonated with the shackles, it is classified as a Sinner, coded S-087.
The MBCC conducted an investigation to confirm its identity. The answer was found in a classified document.

One of the profiles of the Expedition's members reads:
<color=#fb9259>Dreya</color>, postdoctoral fellow with the National Academy of Astrophysics of an unspecified country; area of research: the Perishing Star and its effects. She joined the Black Ring Expedition in 20 N.F., and made a great contribution to the effort with her boundless knowledge and tremendous willpower. In 21 N.F., she entered the DisSea dead zone voluntarily.
Shortly afterward, the team went radio silent.

In 23 N.F., when Keylan returned from the DisSea dead zone, it was confirmed that the rest of the team had perished, including Dreya.

Cause of death: disintegration of the mind and mutation of the body due to the effects of the Perishing Star, at the young age of 32.
...Rustling...
Amidst the chaos, a vague and hazy voice gently stirs your consciousness.
A voice tries to touch and awaken you, and to convey some kind of message or emotion. There's a familiar, nostalgic essence to it. Your consciousness begins to coalesce to chase after it.
...You... you can truly hear us...
...You can hear our voices... you... can sense our existence...
Wonderful... You've been lost for too long... Let us take you back...
Something emerges from the murky darkness. One of them, two of them... they caress your body, affirming your existence.
...Back to your companions... your most cherished companions...
Four of them, five of them, six... More and more of them cling to your skin, blocking the senses you've just regained.
A sense of suffocation strikes you. Fear jolts you awake, and you open your eyes...

What cherished companions? What's crawling all over you are countless hard, black Mutant Bugs. Their mouths tremble as if ready to bite, and in their hollow compound eyes, you can't see any emotions, only the reflection of your own twisted face.
Before you can scream, your mouth is filled with these writhing creatures. They speak for you, and their buzzing resonates directly into your mind.

speaker: Mutant Bug
content: Welcome back. We are taking you back, back to...

speaker: Mutant Bug
content: Her side!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Ahhh!

speaker: Staff A
content: The contamination is leaking. ${PlayerName} is unstable. Those without protective gear retreat immediately! Go get the Hypercube and activate the blocker!

speaker: Staff B
content: The Hypercube can't suppress it! This contamination is like the one in April. Could it be another...

speaker: Signaller
content: I detect signals from the FAC. Something happened to BR-000 over at DisSea!

September 8, N.F. 113 
DisSea Outskirts,
No. 2 Broken Frontline Monitoring Station

speaker: FAC Captain
content: A massive number of Mania contaminants are approaching. All units go into S-Class alert status. The FAC's main force is at the BR-002 defense line, guarding against attacks by the Underground. We can only rely on ourselves here.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Activate the anti-Mania field and defense armor. Ground combat troops should also...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Visuals of the contaminants have arrived. They are not land units, not Corruptors, they're... flying!

speaker: FAC Captain
content: ...Is that... a <color=#fb9259>Mantis swarm</color>?

<color=#fb9259>Mutant Bugs</color> are anomalous creatures that appeared after Nightfall. With sightings of them worldwide, they have been captured on film in exploration shows long before the expedition. They appear in swarms and are highly aggressive towards humans, but luckily, their individual strength is limited. They are common, easy-to-defeat calamitous apostles that lack stability.

It was not until the DisSea Explosion in N.F. 84 that a new and more powerful type of Mutant Bug was sighted near BR-000.

The new Mutant Bugs are far superior to regular ones in numbers, strength, stability, and aggression, boasting astonishing <color=#fb9259>group attributes</color>. A thorough investigation found that as early as prior to the founding of DisCity, rare records of the DisSea expedition mentioned the existence of higher-level Mutant Bug colonies in the forbidden zone. The experts on the team named them <color=#fb9259>Mantises</color>.

Rough calculations based on these records indicate that a swarm of Mantises can be as dangerous as an <color=#fb9259>A+</color> WhiteSands Apostle.

Fortunately, like the WhiteSands Apostles, they are also attracted to the depths of BR-000 and have never left the Black Ring's range since N.F. 84. Humans only observed their form during the DisSea Explosion in N.F. 84 when the Black Ring was not yet fully stable.

They have never left BR-000... until now.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Find cover! Don't expose yourselves! Those creatures aren't coming to pillage... their target is us! I'll cover the rear, everyone immediately... Ahh!!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Captain!!
Before he can finish speaking, the Mutant Bugs swoop down with a shriek. Their spear-like claws shatter the FAC captain's armored arm and lift him into the air.

The man roars and shoots at them with the gun in his other hand. The bullets bounce off their hard shells one after another. One of the bugs knocks his gun away with its third arm and yanks him into the sky towards the Illusory Moon.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Don't mind me! Get back to base and use the anti-aircraft weapons! They must have a leader. I'll confirm the location. Comms is still working, I... I'll give you the coordinates! I...

speaker: FAC Captain
content: I see the Mantis Queen! She's... a Sinner?!

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: ...Hehe... Hehehehe...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: You're back... All of you... Back to my side...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: My most cherished... companions...

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Ahhh...!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Where is this?

Your shackles disperse the swarm of bugs. Your consciousness instantly clears, and you find yourself thrown back into the desolate depths of the nightmare. Unlike before, this time it's like a twisted jungle of contamination filled with chilling buzzing sounds.

Those Mutant Bugs are nearby, hiding themselves in the misty darkness. They are wary of the red glow in your hand, but they haven't completely left... they are just waiting and guarding their prey. You must find a way to leave and wake up. You step forward, looking for a way out.
Amidst the fear, you are tugged by the inexplicably familiar aura emanating from the depths of the mist.
...It's as if an old friend is whispering softly.
Following a faint glimmer of light, you break out of the dense forest and come to a small clearing.
The half-split Illusory Moon hangs high in the sky. Under the red light, you do indeed see an old friend.
It's a person with no visible signs of contamination. You easily recognize her face and remember her name.
She doesn't respond to your call. She stares at the Illusory Moon and walks forward in a daze. In front of her, the blurry shadows of bugs have already gathered.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't go, it's dangerous there!
The scholar looks at your hand around her wrist, then glances at you. Her expression changes from confusion to terror as she struggles to free her wrist.

speaker: Dreya
content: ...No, let go...

options: It's me. Don't you recognize me?

content: She backs away as if she didn't hear you, her gaze darting between you and the encroaching Mutant Bugs. Her expression becomes increasingly panicked, as if there's no difference between you and the approaching creatures.

speaker: Dreya
content: ...I don't want to... I haven't seen it yet... I haven't found out the truth... I...

She doesn't recognize you, but you don't have time to feel sad about it. This might be the influence of the Illusory Moon. In any case, the Mutant Bugs are closing in. You have to take her away, so you try to pull her towards you by force.
If it's Mania that's causing her consciousness to become chaotic, do you have a way to sober her up?

speaker: Dreya
content: Don't!

When the shackles touch Dreya, the part of her body that gets touched turns transparent. The red light spikes pass through like piercing a hologram, and this hologram doesn't give you the same feeling that initially attracted you here.
This isn't the real Dreya. She's just a part of the dream, and the one dreaming is...
Let her go!

A sudden flash of light zips by, and the Mutant Bugs in front of you immediately fly away in terror with broken wings. Something high-speed instantly crushes all the enemies. Before you have a chance to see what it is, the light teleports next to you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mmph...!
Something hits you in the gut, hurling you out several meters. Even if this is a dream, it still hurt, and you feel a little dizzy from the pain.
You see a strange figure protecting Dreya, adopting a defensive stance against you.
...I don't want to fight you, but you can't hurt my companion.
Back off, Mantis! Go back to your territory!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your... companion?
Clutching your stomach, you struggle to prop up your body and look at the attacker.
Its face is blurry, but the scythe-like arms, rock-hard body, and strange buzzing sounds all confirm one thing...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're just like those bugs, a Mania monster...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, that's what you are! Don't hurt my companion!
Power gathers in your palm again. You grip your red light spike, which has become more powerful in this chaotic space. It cuts through the air, piercing towards the shadow across from you.
However, all it does is shatter a hard spike on its shoulder. The monster disappears in an instant, taking Dreya with it.
The next second, your wrist is seized, and you're flipped over and pinned to the ground.

The monster is on top of you. Its hard, scythe-like arms are clearly visible, pressing against your neck with terrifying force. Layers of filth cover its head. You can't see its face, but you can feel the gaze of this strange creature.
I knew you could understand my words. If that's the case, then go back. Go back and find your own heart.
If you were once human, don't hurt your past. Otherwise, I really will...
Wait, you are...?!
It suddenly pauses. The force pinning you lessens, and the scythe across your neck slowly dissolves into a soft arm.
The hand moves away from your neck, gently caressing your earring. You feel human fingertips on your earlobe. A bit cold, but very real. Then, you hear a woman's crisp laughter.
...Why did you come here, too? You scared me.
This is Mantis territory. It's very easy to hallucinate here. We almost started fighting each other.

options: ...Who are you? I don't know you.

content: But at this moment, you do feel a sense of familiarity.
The filth and spikes on the shadow fade away. The one sitting on you is no longer a terrifying Mutant Bug, but a chuckling, short-haired woman who has calmed down.

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: Haha, how can you not know? It's me, ☐☐☐, the naturalist of the expedition team.

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: Although I made a mistake in my haste just now, I was also the one who saw through the illusion. You can trust my professionalism, right?

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: No hard feelings, okay? I didn't expect a kid like you to follow us all the way out here. Good on you.
She pulls you up from the ground, dusts you off, and pinches your face, as if trying to squeeze out a smile like hers.

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: Thanks for coming to find us, little guide. With you here, I feel much more at ease.
The green-haired woman walks forward holding your hand in one hand and Dreya's in the other. This time, the frightened scholar doesn't resist. She has recognized her companion.

speaker: Dreya
content: Mantis... Thank you for coming to pick me up...

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: Don't mention it.

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: But my name isn't Mantis; I study <color=#fb9259>Mantises</color>. Look... It's those dark flying creatures over there. That idiot Keylan calls them DisSea cockroaches. It pisses me off. He knows nothing about Nightfall ecology!
She points at the shadowy Mutant Bugs in the distance, then points at herself with the hand holding Dreya's hand.

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: My name is ☐☐☐. Don't you remember? You even complimented my name the first time we met.
Her soothing words finally makes Dreya smile.

speaker: Dreya
content: Yes... Mantis is indeed a beautiful name.
The astronomer is completely at a loss.

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: ...Well, that is indeed a good name. After all, I was the one who discovered and named these Mutant Bugs.

speaker: Short-haired Woman
content: Since Dreya likes it, you can start calling me "Mantis" from now on, I guess.

speaker: Mantis
content: "Mantis" knows Mantises the best, and will lead everyone to escape from them... that plot isn't half bad. If the DV had power, recording it would surely make for a good show.
"Mantis" leads you to a dilapidated car. She ushers you two in, then gets into the driver's seat.

speaker: Mantis
content: Dear little guide, can you please help take care of dear Dreya? Get her to get some good sleep and she'll be fine.

speaker: Mantis
content: She is just temporarily affected by the Illusory Moon. Astronomers love the moon the most, right? Once we're back, Doctor Banyan will be able to awaken her quickly. By then, she might be able to find the Perishing Star.

Those comforting words obviously have no effect in such a setting. The dark twisted forest spreads out in every direction, and the shadowy bugs are closing in from behind the car. Clearly, this entire area is Mantis territory.

speaker: Mantis
content: Who are you asking?

"Mantis" remains unfazed. She skillfully fiddles with a homemade device in the car, which emits a bizarre buzzing sound similar to the Mutant Bugs and launches something into the distance. A few of the approaching bugs swoop past the old car, chasing the bait.

speaker: Mantis
content: See, this is a mimicry effect. I worked a long time on it. It not only imitates sound waves, but also uses contamination resonance. Now, the bugs think we are also Mantises, and Mantises rarely attack their own kind.
She fiddles with the console again, and it starts playing music that is completely out of place with the current setting.

speaker: Mantis
content: I'm the most famous naturalist of the Nightfall Era, and a survival expert who has traversed the apocalypse. I led my team to film the best-selling documentary series <color=#fb9259>"☐☐☐ and Friends' Wilderness Trek"</color> as soon as the expedition began. That title is a bit wordy; let's just call it <color=#fb9259>"Wilderness Trek"</color>.

speaker: Mantis
content: No matter how many terrifying monsters are born in the apocalypse, we can find a way to deal with them if we understand them enough. Fear comes from the unknown, and evasion can't solve the problem. What we need is the courage to explore and seek knowledge.
Her smile is bright and touching. As if affected by her courage, your mind recovers a bit.

speaker: Mantis
content: I dug up some earthworms along the way and brought them here in case you were hungry. Earthworms don't think, so they aren't affected by the contamination. The simpler the life form, the more resilient they are.

speaker: Mantis
content: Want to eat some? They're high in protein!

speaker: Mantis
content: All right, I know you guys can't stomach it. I also packed some compressed biscuits before we set out. You can eat those. The delicious earthworms are mine then.
You watch as she picks up a wriggling, juicy earthworm and slurps it into her mouth. She chews a few times with a look of enjoyment on her face before swallowing...
This scene makes you lose your appetite for the compressed biscuit in your hand, and your sanity deteriorates a bit.
With your eyes closed, you pick up a wriggling, juicy earthworm and slurp it into your mouth. After an indescribable assault on the taste buds, you swallow it...
You do feel a bit full, but your sanity seems to have deteriorated a bit. "Mantis" claps for you.

options: Where did you get the courage to eat this...

speaker: Mantis
content: Haha, well, I've got you guys～

speaker: Mantis
content: With you guys around, I can traverse the apocalypse and face the unknown. Thinking about how my efforts can also bring courage to everyone fills me with energy.

speaker: Mantis
content: So, let's go back. Let's go back to everyone...
The battered pickup truck bounces along in the dense fog of shadows. The driver hums a tune cheerfully as if carrying a little sun on the road.
You still can't remember this overly familiar person. You don't even understand her real name.
But her smile is so familiar, nostalgic, and soothing, healing your weary body and mind. After a rest, you'll ask her more about it...
The pickup truck rushes forward as fast as it can, almost falling apart from the rocky bumps on the road.
Chasing close behind is a large swarm of Mantises.

speaker: Mantis
content: I haven't been this popular for a long time. Hold on, we're almost there!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Didn't you just say you knew a lot about them? Why are we still being chased like this!!

speaker: Mantis
content: It's all different under the Illusory Moon!

speaker: Mantis
content: Ouch!

After the pickup truck goes over the last ditch of its life and crashes heavily into a rock, it breaks down completely. Mantis is the first one to get back up. She grabs all the cartridges and kicks open the car door.

speaker: Mantis
content: You guys stay in the car. I'll lure them away!

The bullets had run out long ago. The naturalist only realizes this when she pulls the trigger of the empty gun. All she could do is turn the gun around and use it as a bat. She then tosses a homemade bug repellent smoke bomb near the car door and runs out of the smoke, leading the bugs away from you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mantis——!

speaker: Mantis
content: Don't make a sound! Protect Dreya, and wait for your companions to come! I'll be fine!
Before she can finish her sentence, a Mutant Bug knocks her aside. She can barely block its sharp claws with her firearm.

speaker: Mantis
content: No! I have my own companions. I need to go back somewhere else! As for you guys...
The swarm of bugs lets out an indistinguishable, terrifying shriek. "Mantis," however, seems to understand and starts yelling back at them.

speaker: Mantis
content: Take a good look at what you're doing! Would humans treat their own kind like this?!

She drops the firearm that had been holding off the creature and finds something to thrust in its face. The bug lets out a shrill screech, pushing "Mantis" away and convulsing in the sky with trembling wings.
In that moment, she also seems stunned. But more Mutant Bugs are rushing at her, and this time, "Mantis" has no strength left to fight back. You must help her!
The shackles are successfully released, but you can't see the result.
A dazzling white light suddenly engulfs everything, followed by the sound of bullets, shouts, and fierce resistance from the bugs.
Soon, the light dims. A few Mutant Bugs twitch on the ground, while many more have been forced to keep their distance.
Three people in protective suits stand in front of "Mantis," guarding against the sky with crude weapons. Only after confirming the bugs have left do they turn their heads to curse at "Mantis."

speaker: Armed Person
content: Didn't we say we were going to find help? Why did you run out here? Are you trying to scare us to death? If you keep this up, I'm really going to knock you out and lock you in the car!

speaker: Mantis
content: Ahaha, I knew you guys would come for me...

speaker: Mantis
content: It's so good to have you guys here...
You help Dreya out of the smoke, and someone immediately comes over to you. Are they teammates of "Mantis"'? Are they... humans?
"Mantis" sits paralyzed on the ground. The naturalist gasps for breath, staring at the motionless Mutant Bug remains nearby with a mixed expression.
The "magic weapon" in her hands that scared off the Mutant Bugs a few minutes ago is just an ordinary mirror.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: Here, eat this to replenish your energy. No biscuit for you. That's what you get for running off like a little kiddo.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: But we saved a piece of candy for you. A brave child who protects companions deserves a reward.
You take the stone-hard bread and broken hard candy. You're not hungry and don't have to eat, but one still has to talk tough.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: Okay okay, go over there and take care of Dreya and the wounded. Or get some sleep. We'll be on the move again soon. Little kids should keep their strength up.

This is the eighth futile rebuttal you've made. To these "people," you're not an adult at all, no matter how tall you are. Or rather, anything you do that exceeds what a "child" does is ignored. It's as if you're acting out a scripted movie.
You've tried to secretly cast your shackles, but they just pass through them. These "teammates" and "Dreya" are all holograms.
The only person the shackles ever touched is now discussing something with her teammates, an unprecedentedly serious look on her face.

speaker: Mantis
content: They evolve too quickly. Brute force won't work. We need to change our approach to get our remaining companions back... If we consider the Mutant Bugs as a type of Apostle of Ashes and analyze their habits, we might find a breakthrough.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: But all the Apostles of Ashes are heading for the Perishing Star. You said that this behavior is the core feature of the Apostles. The Mantises only stay on the outskirts of the forbidden zone, and even occasionally leave DisSea to prey on humans. They're different.

speaker: Mantis
content: ...Only what's manifested is different.
You eavesdrop from under the car and get a rough understanding of the situation:

The sudden Illusory Moon anomaly disrupted the expedition's plans. A four-person team including the astronomer went missing, and an investigation revealed that they were forced to flee into Mutant Bug territory.

As a naturalist studying Mantises, "Mantis" led a rescue team deep into the hinterland to find her teammates. A few days passed, and they found three people but lost two more. Including the "guide" who popped up, the six people here now are all that's left.

speaker: Mantis
content: In their natural state, the Apostles of Ashes have no stable form. Their energy and radiation changes unpredictably, and their collapse or re-emergence cannot be logically explained. People attribute this to the unique power of the Apostles of Ashes and fear it.

speaker: Mantis
content: But no one really knows for sure. This phenomenon could still have other explanations.

speaker: Mantis
content: Before joining the expedition, I led a team to track and observe the Apostles of Ashes. Rather than saying their forms are unpredictable, it's more accurate to say that their material existence in this world is extremely unstable. It's as if they have some <color=#fb9259>serious flaw</color>.

speaker: Mantis
content: Apostles of Ashes worldwide do share a common feature: they migrate to the Perishing Star without stopping. They don't do it to feed, reproduce, or evolve, but I have a guess...

speaker: Mantis
content: Perhaps these apocalyptic creatures are seeking the Perishing Star to <color=#fb9259>fix</color> their own flaw. The Perishing Star, or something in this forbidden zone, allows them to exist more stably in our material world.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: ...You've discussed this many times. Without knowing what the Perishing Star is, this hypothesis is hard to verify and doesn't help the expedition.

speaker: Mantis
content: Yes, we can't reach the Perishing Star. But the Mantises provide another research direction... a simple <color=#fb9259>extrapolation</color>.

speaker: Mantis
content: They are a relatively weak Apostle, afraid to go deeper into the forbidden zone and face stronger "mutants." Thus, they only hover around the outskirts of DisSea in swarms. But they also need to fix themselves, so they constantly kidnap humans nearby... I guess humans are a <color=#fb9259>substitute</color> for the Perishing Star.

speaker: Mantis
content: From when they were first recorded till now, the Mantises' form has grown visibly more stable. Their behavioral intelligence has improved, and their perception towards humans has deepened. Their flaw is being remedied by "hunting" humans and human belongings.

speaker: Mantis
content: They're curious about humans. They try to understand humans and even imitate humans. I can occasionally scare them off with a mirror. The perception they have of themselves and humans may have shifted, or merged.
She whispers, her voice gradually lowering, but her speech quickens, and her emotions become increasingly fervent.

speaker: Mantis
content: Perhaps this is the <color=#fb9259>essence</color> of the Apostle of Ashes. The so-called "creature" is a manifestation of a certain collective human consciousness invading reality. The Mantis has a strong swarm attribute, so it could be a manifestation of the human concept of collectivity.

speaker: Mantis
content: The instability of the collective subconscious leads to the instability of the Apostle. Strengthening their own collective consciousness is their way of stabilizing themselves. This can be proven over time, but more importantly...

speaker: Mantis
content: If they really are manifestations of human consciousness, then we might be able to understand these terrifying creatures, and even communicate with them. If their origin is also "human," we might be able to awaken their <color=#fb9259>humanity</color> and...

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: Communicate with them? Do you have a death wish?! This isn't one of your television shows! You think your naive and baseless guesses can keep us all alive?!

A sharp rebuke interrupts the scholar's fervent analysis. "Mantis" snaps her head up as if waking up with a start. She meets the iron-faced gaze of her companion and comes to her senses, the color gradually draining from her face.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: ...I understand how you feel. If the monsters could be understood, humanity could avoid many deaths. It's a beautiful wish, but...

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: It's too difficult. These monsters have claimed countless lives worldwide. Your guesses, on the other hand, lack evidence and persuasion. Humanity doesn't have the resources to prove it... Pure hope and desire is not enough.

speaker: Mantis
content: ...No, I should be the one apologizing. I really have no way to prove it. The apocalypse isn't a TV show... acting on assumptions will only lead us all into danger.

A sense of guilt lingers in the silence following the outburst. Seeing Mantis hang her head, the woman's face shifts from anger to remorse. She grasps the scholar's hand, but can only muster a painfully sorrowful smile.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: Your positivity has always encouraged us, but in the end, it's your rationality as scholars that saves lives and brings salvation to humanity.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: Let's go back to base. This rescue mission's goal is to find you scholars and ensure your safety. The Mutant Bugs will be back. We can't stay here for long.

speaker: Mantis
content: ...Now? Some people haven't returned yet. Your husband was taken away by a Mantis. If we leave now, he will...

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: If we leave now, at least you, Dreya and the guide will survive. The expedition team can't lose you. After taking you back, I'll come back to rescue the others.

speaker: Rescue Team Member
content: My husband... he would make the same choice. He would also do everything to protect humanity's top scholars and safeguard the hope to defeat the apocalypse.
"Mantis" opens her mouth but says nothing. A look at her companion's expression tells her there's no room for negotiation. She lowers her head.

speaker: Mantis
content: <size=28>...I'm not that strong... if it weren't for all of you...</size>
The team member seems to want to say something else. "Mantis" lifts her head again, forcing a somewhat strained smile.

speaker: Mantis
content: It's nothing! I'm going to prepare some weapons that can repel bugs. They always come in handy.
A few minutes later, the scholar is silently assembling ammunition with her back to you. You're hiding under the vehicle, undecided on what to do. She starts to speak.

speaker: Mantis
content: Come out, kid. I know you've been eavesdropping.

You crawl out from under the vehicle and silently stand by the scholar, helping her with the ammo. She turns to smile at you. You can't shake the feeling that her smile is somewhat forced, which makes you sad.

options: Everyone's just looking out for you.

content: As soon as the words leave your mouth, you realize how feeble your attempt to comfort her is. In this illusion, how much help can a "child's" comfort be to a scholar facing the immense pressure of life and death?
Seeing you stop mid-sentence, Mantis doesn't press for more. After a while, she softly continues.

speaker: Mantis
content: Before joining the expedition team, I filmed four seasons of the blockbuster documentary series, "Wilderness Trek," which became a worldwide hit. When people talk about me, they praise me as a heroic survival expert and a trustworthy naturalist.

speaker: Mantis
content: To be a heroic survival expert, one must be romantic and brave, ready to face disaster and unveil the truth. One must never give up, and bring courage and confidence to everyone in the Nightfall era.

speaker: Mantis
content: On the other hand, to be a trusted naturalist, one must be prudent and cautious. One must collect data bit by bit, then analyze and summarize it. One must boldly hypothesize and carefully verify the results, and face countless disappointing failures without cheating or lying.

speaker: Mantis
content: Which identity do you think suits me better, kid?

options: Survival expert. You gave me courage.

speaker: Mantis
content: Hehe, thank you. Actually, I'm good at both, like a superhero. Pretty cool, right?
She smiles brightly again. Then, the smile fades into an expression that you cannot tell is gentle or forlorn.

speaker: Mantis
content: Because I am not alone...

speaker: Mantis
content: Back then, I had an entire filming crew with me, traveling north and south, traversing the apocalypse. We were chased by all kinds of monsters. Together, we celebrated our victories and shouldered each other's failures. We overcame difficulties with one another, and collectively dreamed of a brighter future.

speaker: Mantis
content: Grouping up is truly humanity's most wonderful attribute. Even though I'm just an ordinary person, with them, I can keep going no matter how dark the night. With them, I am invincible.

speaker: Mantis
content: So, for me, my most important identity is clear... "everyone's companion."

speaker: Mantis
content: Just like now, some people comforted me, some shook me back to my senses, and some made me worry... I won't be lost. With you guys, I'm a superhero.

speaker: Mantis
content: This superhero will definitely take you all back. No companion left behind.
Her contagious laughter is devoid of any gloom.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I haven't watched "Wilderness Trek" yet. Will you show me when we get back to the camp? After the expedition is over, I'll apply to join the filming crew, too. It looks fun.

speaker: Mantis
content: ...Haha, now that you mention it, I never thought about filming a fifth season.

speaker: Mantis
content: There will be many delicious bugs to eat once we're out. Don't be a picky eater, okay?
She ruffles your hair, and is about to say something else when a scream suddenly interrupts. You both rush over immediately.

The female team member who just comforted Mantis is now staring pale-faced at the entrance of the hideout. A man covered in filth is robotically and manically destroying the surrounding bug repellent devices.

"Mantis" also freezes, then quickly steps forward to shield you. She raises her gun and shoots decisively at the man's leg. The monster falls to his knees with a muffled thud, but "Mantis's" teammate lets out a cry.

speaker: Mantis
content: Back off! I only incapacitated him, but he's not your husband anymore! Protect yourself!

The man on the ground is making chaotic noises, and starts to bite with his mouth. His face is shriveled, as if he's been drained dry, and there's no sign of humanity in his eyes. Yet this appearance is vaguely familiar to you.

speaker: Mantis
content: Watch out!!

The last device is paralyzed, and two giant scythes break out of the man's body. A black, evil arthropod creature is born from the bloody rain. The scene is too overwhelming. As everyone is frozen in place by shock, the incoming swarm of Mutant Bugs snatches them away.
As the monster charges at you, a gunshot rings out, and several Mutant Bug heads are blown apart. You turn to see "Mantis" holding a gun, shielding you behind her.
Her sunny disposition had disappeared, replaced by a terrifying power that is suppressed but stirring in the darkness.

speaker: Mantis
content: ...Kid, take care of the injured. Don't leave them. It's all up to you here...

speaker: Mantis
content: I'm going to bring our companions back.
Green flames flash in the scholar's eyes. She rushes out so fast that you have no time to react. You couldn't stop her at all.

Scarface vomited over the rail, then crushed a writhing creature that had crawled aboard and hurled it back into the sea. A trail of foul slime sprayed across the deck, releasing a putrid, fishy stench.
The moment she rushed out, you saw black spikes growing out of her body.
You must find her and get her to come back. You have a bad feeling about this.

You venture out deeper and deeper alone. You've lost count of how many battles you've experienced, dodging contamination and Mutant Bugs. Now, you are lost in the distorted chaos. You don't know when you fell down, or how long it's been.
When your consciousness returns, you feel as if you're floating in the air or on the sea, bobbing up and down.
...Didn't we agree that you'd wait for me back there? What would I do if something happened to you, too...
You struggle to open your eyes and roughly make out the person talking to you.
"Mantis" is carrying you through the twisted forest, returning to the shelter that had just been attacked. The scholar walks steadily, with strength that does not match her figure.
The female rescuer who just lost her husband is also back. She is still in a coma, but the wounds on her body have been properly treated.

speaker: Mantis
content: You're the last one. I've saved all the people I can.

speaker: Mantis
content: Now, you must leave Mantis territory. You can't stop even for a moment.

speaker: Mantis
content: I'm going to the bug nest to bring back the people who were captured.

options: There's no way we're letting you go alone!

content: "Mantis" smiles, opens the car door and puts you in the driver's seat, then starts to treat your wounds.
Yet she is one who clearly has more contamination and wounds. The scholar still has a faint smile on her lips, but her eyes are somewhat hollow. She begins to whisper softly.

speaker: Mantis
content: My guess was correct. The Mutant Bugs are interested in "human wisdom and behavior," particularly "group sentiment."

speaker: Mantis
content: They keep repairing themselves at astonishing speeds, and now they are using human relationships and feelings to set traps. Their understanding of human nature is progressing too fast... way too fast...

speaker: Mantis
content: I was too naive. Because they crave the human heart, I unconsciously got close to them mentally, hoping that they could be communicable peers. Ha...

speaker: Mantis
content: There are clearly more ways in nature to acquire intelligence, and more ways to repair... It's my fault that a naturalist like me was so unimaginative...

speaker: Mantis
content: ...There's no time. They could die at any time while waiting for rescue. Now the only one who can act is me...

options: It's too dangerous. If you go, you'll also just...

speaker: Mantis
content: Don't underestimate me. I just single-handedly saved you from a swarm of Mutant Bugs. You missed quite the exciting battle while you were passed out.

speaker: Mantis
content: I'm the one who knows them best. While researching how to fight them, I also gained some power. I can also occasionally understand their communications. Only I can do this.
You remember what she looked like when you first saw her: covered in spikes and with prominent signs of mutation... You thought that was just from the illusion, but now it seems that's not the case.

options: You may have been contaminated by Mania.

speaker: Mantis
content: "Mania"... what's that? The abnormal radiation of the Perishing Star? Sounds like a pretty good name. Keylan would definitely like it.
Her giggly optimism might be infectious to many, but now it feels like a fishbone stuck in your throat.

options: I'm going with you. You can't venture out alone.

content: An uncomfortable silence ensues. After a while, she finally speaks, but dodges your question.

speaker: Mantis
content: You said that after getting out, you want to shoot the fifth season of "Wilderness Trek" with me...

speaker: Mantis
content: I'm sorry. That show has been permanently canceled. The fourth season ended halfway during the production.

speaker: Mantis
content: The production crew, my most precious companions, have already gone to another world. They died on the journey of exploring the apocalypse. I joined the expedition team on their behalf to continue our journey.

speaker: Mantis
content: I believe in my wild conjectures. I believe that their spirits still exist in this world, perhaps inside an apostle we don't understand yet. I believe that I will eventually find them...

speaker: Mantis
content: But I really don't want you to meet the same fate.

speaker: Mantis
content: I know that humanity needs a great superhero scholar, but... this superhero is a bit selfish. She needs you. I don't want to lose any more companions. Not a single one.

options: ...I can fight too. I'll go with you.

content: You want to prove it to her with your shackles, but "Mantis" gently takes your hand.

speaker: Mantis
content: I know. It feels different carrying you now.

speaker: Mantis
content: You've gotten heavier and taller, kid. So much taller...

speaker: Mantis
content: You are no longer the kid we knew, right?

speaker: Mantis
content: I'm not "Mantis," but I'm sure you don't remember my real name.

speaker: Mantis
content: It's okay. I'm glad you stumbled back here, back to me.
She tightens her grip on your hand.

speaker: Mantis
content: ...Our little guide has become more mature, braver, and smarter. You've become more powerful, kinder, and better at taking care of everyone.

speaker: Mantis
content: We used to take care of you, but now you've grown up, and we can depend on you.

speaker: Mantis
content: I can only temporarily repel the Mutant Bugs, but this is still their territory. They'll be back soon. If you have the power and really want to help me... then protect my companions on my behalf.

speaker: Mantis
content: Take them back to the camp, and find Keylan's stone slate. You know the way. Everyone is waiting for you there. You won't be lost.

speaker: Mantis
content: Even if you don't remember, you can hear where your heart wants to lead you.
She smiles, reaching out to gently touch your earring.

speaker: Mantis
content: Once you find the stone slate, use it to return to your own era safely.

speaker: Mantis
content: This is not your era, nor where you ought to be. You have real companions to worry about, and more important things to do.

speaker: Mantis
content: Don't forget the way back.
You are speechless. It takes you a while to respond.

options: ...I promise you, I'll definitely get them back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I don't want to leave just like that. I'll wait for you at the stone slate. If you don't come back, I'll come find you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even if I don't belong here, even if I'm destined to leave... I want you to see me off. I want to leave on happy terms. That's not too much to ask for, is it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Aren't we companions?

speaker: Mantis
content: ...Of course we are.

speaker: Mantis
content: No matter where or when, or what we turn into... you will always be my companion.

The car starts, and you look back at her. Mantis stays in place, watching you. Before she disappears into the thick fog, her silhouette subtly starts to change. You can't see her face, and you don't know what happened.
...You only know that now she is alone.

speaker: Mantis
content: Find Keylan's stone slate. Everyone is waiting for you there. You won't be lost.

speaker: Mantis
content: Even if you don't remember, you can hear where your heart wants to lead you.

speaker: Mantis
content: ...Protect my companions on my behalf.
You grit your teeth, gripping the steering wheel tightly. As the earring swings, you vaguely sense the direction through the fog. You stomp on the accelerator and zoom the car forward.
Even if the ones in the car aren't real "people," you must do what you promised. Besides, by now, you have your own guess about what's happening here...
Safeguarding these "companions" is safeguarding the heart of that human scholar, and her heart is what's holding up this illusionary realm of chaos.
The realm of chaos distorts, gradually crumbling away. You feel the buzzing of the Mutant Bugs right by your ear, chasing and pressuring you.

Yet some other kind of determination lights up the road ahead for you, resisting everything that is hunting you. The two clash, causing violent vibrations from time to time. You struggle to move forward amidst their shadow.
...Finally, you see the faint light of the camp in the fog. You immediately spot the conspicuous stone slate, and stomp hard on the accelerator to zoom towards it.
The car flips over at the guardrail. You struggle to push the door open and tumble out.
The crash blurred your vision, but you can hear chaotic footsteps approaching.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: ...Take Dreya to the infirmary. The Illusory Moon isn't over. I'll handle it.

speaker: Vague Voice
content: I'll deal with the car. It can't be scrapped.

Someone takes over the injured from the car, while someone else reaches out to you. You try to grab their hand, but keep missing. Everything in front of you is increasingly distorted. Your head hurts terribly, and the buzzing of the bugs is getting closer.

options: She's still there. Go save her, please...

speaker: Vague Voice
content: ...Kid, you...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Mantis" went to the bug nest. She's alone, hurry...
Finally, you grab someone's hand. You lift up your hand, wanting to shout. At this moment, everything in front of you suddenly shatters like glass...
Something broke. The world blurs and fades. The view becomes distorted and drifting, and the sounds become ethereal. The figures of those helping each other gradually become transparent and unreal.
Only the black stone slate in the center of the camp remains motionless and unfazed.

speaker: Mantis
content: Once you find the stone slate, use it to return to your own era safely.

speaker: Mantis
content: This is not your era, nor where you ought to be. You have real companions to worry about, and more important things to do.

The pure determination that escorted you back has dissipated. The barely stable world suddenly shatters, and the buzzing of the Mutant Bugs surges in. Under the Illusory Moon, a more frenzied consciousness has defeated the will that hindered it and begins to devour everything.
The will of the naturalist that protected you has disappeared.
Because you protected her companions, you can now leave safely. Her wish has been fulfilled, so she can rest easy... right?

speaker: Mantis
content: I don't want to lose any more companions. Not a single one.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Aaahhh—!!

There is no choice. A stronger emotion takes over your heart, forcing you to your feet and swat aside all the illusions with a roar. You run away from the stone slate and into the chaotic, rolling illusions of the nightmare. There's only one thought on your mind...
...Bring her back.
Once you left the stone slate, everything in front of you has become clear. As you run, you see this world for the first time as it is.

The radiance of the red moon illuminates a fearsome forest that twists and writhes as if it is alive. Swarms of bugs dance between the branches, and low, frenzied murmurs penetrate your mind. Now, you can finally understand their fragmented meanings.

speaker: Mutant Bug
content: Welcome back. We are taking you back, back to...

speaker: Mutant Bug
content: Her side...
This is the "understanding" and "communication" she desired. But at this moment, it only fuels your fear and anger.

You've lost count of how many times you've cast your shackles. The red light obliterates the frenzied Mutant Bugs and severs the thorns blocking your path. As you destroy everything, your consciousness becomes murky and distorted. Your brain aches like it's being pricked by needles.

The more this continues, the clearer you see. Under the red moon, up high and glowing green in the center of the insect swarm, is the Mantis nest. When you look at it, you hear that familiar voice, like a distant, continuously echoing call.
...Hehe... Hehehehe...
You're back... All of you... Back to my side...
Oh companions of Mantis...
You fix your gaze on the bug nest. Your pace quickens, and finally, you start running.
Human items are scattered all over the depths of the nest. You try to check them out, but eventually give up because they make you vomit repeatedly. You can only proceed on foot.
There are thousands upon millions of Mutant Bugs, but they no longer attack you. Their tiny insect eyes glow in the dark, watching you, quivering and rustling...
Though still fragmented, they are communicating with you in human language that can be fully understood.

speaker: Mutant Bug
content: ...We... are weak... Here... we can't fight against more terrifying beings... we... can't embrace the Ultimate End...

speaker: Mutant Bug
content: But the weak can huddle for warmth... when tiny bugs gather to form a swarm, we can also become strong... and survive...

speaker: Mutant Bug
content: ...The yearning for companions... the yearning to be part of a group... this kind of determination turned into Mantis...

They're speaking in human language, yet it feels like some kind of malicious and clumsy imitation, making you instinctively vigilant and resentful. The naturalist's years of thought are now spoken out of these alien mouths.
You are... looking for me?

A gust of wind suddenly blows from behind you. Just as you're about to turn around, a green light flashes. Two huge scythes cut through the darkness, forcefully clamping your arms and lifting you up. A cold, rugged shell presses painfully against your back.
A woman's voice mixed with the nauseating sound of trembling mouthparts rings in your ear.
I am Mantis...
Your... companion...

Your shackles blast off a corner of the bug nest, but you are violently thrown into the air and land heavily on the other side. Two scythes pin down your wrists, pressing you hard against the hard, uneven filth of the bug nest.
<color=#dg1f1f><i>Hee hee hee hee, yes, and no... Not yet, at least.
<color=#dg1f1f><i>You are still... human. Humans... are much weaker than Mantises.
Having been struck to the point of almost vomiting blood, you have no strength left to resist. The owner of the scythes slowly approaches from the darkness, revealing her figure.
...Unlike all the other Mutant Bugs, this monster actually has a somewhat human form. The familiar stature and green hair of the woman chills you to the bone.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: ...The human heart is complex, yet... fragile and easy to break... It is contradictory... and unpredictable...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: It's why "I," regrettably born from you... have different forms, unstable, and not strong enough...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: I want... to fix myself... a spirit similar to mine, a more determined will... I need... a true anchor of my own...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: I want the Perishing Star...or you...

You indeed sense the scholar's aura on her. On the bright side, at least she can converse, and still remembers her theories. Maybe... you can still awaken her. Think... think carefully what you should do...
She comes close to your neck, sniffing like an animal, her mouthparts quivering. She sticks out her tongue to lick the cold sweat seeping from you and laughs tremulously.
...This is the affection of a predator. A chill rushes to your head, and your shackles strike aside the greedy-faced monster, but she simply laughs as she leaps into the air.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Release the humans you've captured! Give me back my companions! Otherwise, I'll tear down your bug nest and kill you!

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: Hee hee hee hee hee... so you want companions too, like us.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: You fear loneliness and weakness... hence you yearn to be part of a group, to be protected by those stronger than you...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: You and I... Humans and Mantises... In this respect, we're all the same... The companion you're looking for shares the same feelings as us...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: I enjoy talking to her very much. I like her a lot.
An ominous premonition surges in your heart.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: Here, in the swarm, in my heart.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: ...Turn ...around.
Behind you, the rock-hard filth suddenly throbs like a monstrous heartbeat and turns soft, slowly wrapping around your hand.
Your mind goes blank, and your body rigidly turns around.
The previously dark and rock-hard filth is now glowing, revealing a semi-transparent, jelly-like outer wall. It resembles a huge egg, but also looks like it's dissolving and digesting something.
You can vaguely see something soaking inside...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: Humans... are weak... but not all are weak...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: In those frail shells, there occasionally are... strong, steadfast, unwavering spirits...

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: That's what we need...
You touch the semi-transparent outer wall with trembling fingers, trying to discern the mess within the egg. They have already been dissolved, but you know what's inside.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: She wanted to converse with me. She came searching for companions, too. Apart from her weak body and fleeting lifespan... she's very much like me.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: So, I brought her to the companions she was looking for. I made her my "companion." We became stronger together. Isn't that good?

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: She became me. From now on, we will embrace the Perishing Star together.
Your shackles violently tear through the space, obliterating every Mutant Bug that approaches you as well as destroying the bug nest, as if exacting vengeance.
But the real enemy is floating in the air, watching all this, and waiting for you to gradually run out of energy.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: I like your power.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: More importantly, your loyal persistence to your companions.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: She was the same. Stubborn and crazed.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: She was obstinate about a hypotheses that no one believed in and kept focus on the abyss. She kept trying to approach and converse with me, searching for those who have departed.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: But that's not a real companion.
With a wave of her hand, another wave of bugs attack you, breaking past the shackles and knocking you to the ground.

speaker: Mantis Queen
content: Companions are our strength. The more companions we have, the stronger we are. Creatures band together for survival, not the other way around...
