Rather than to help a former comrade, she's probably agreed to go in order to monitor any potential meddling on your part. But that doesn't matter.
You've achieved your goal.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: He was a good superior, once.
The FAC soldier guarding the confinement cell lights a cigarette. The blue-grey smoke rises under the corridor lights.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Just a few months ago, he was a humorous and gentle friend, a respected role model, and an admirable team leader...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: And now?
Through the cell window, he takes a quick glance at the person inside, then hastily averts his gaze.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: In just a few months, Mania has messed up his brain and now he's spouting nonsense all day, heh...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: ...Poor madman.
The FAC soldier nips the cigarette butt spitefully and tosses it on the ground, as if taking it out on it.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Forget it. We all know we'll end up like that eventually, it's dumb to get sentimental...
A beep signals that a temporary key has been sent to your personal terminal.
The man steps aside, and you aim the key at the electronic lock on the door.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: ...Do me a favor.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: I know you're an anti-Mania expert, and you've saved many people... including Sinners who everyone has given up on...

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Even if there's only a slight chance... please save him.
The confinement cell is dark, and you can only see a vague figure in the darkness.
Just as you're about to switch on the light, Rahu stops you.
She doesn't speak and only shakes her head. You understand what she means.
For someone who's used to the dark and has been through a lot of trauma, the sudden brightness will only irritate his fragile mind.
You walk over slowly. With the dim light from the corridor, you can make out the man in front of you.
You hear a score of strange and unnerving noises in the background. Thick, heavy panting. Rustling of fabric in tandem with breathing. A hum of surveillance devices.
There you find an astonishingly pale and gaunt face. His eyes are tightly shut, but his eyeballs are constantly moving. His expression is grotesque, as if he's having a terrifying dream.
Seemingly noticing your presence, he abruptly opens his eyes.

speaker: Conrad
content: ...Who are you?!

The man's pitch-black, hollow pupils seem like an abyss of resentment and hatred. His body lurches forward, straining the straitjacket. The tough synthetic fibers and fabric rub together to produce an unsettling rustle.

It's hard to imagine that a man with such a skeletal body could possess such terrifying strength, like a rabid beast. You have no doubt that had he not been restrained, he would have pounced at you the moment he opened his eyes and bitten your throat open.

speaker: %u
content: Nice to meet you, Mr. Conrad Cage...

speaker: Conrad
content: Rahu?!
The man ignores you and stares directly at the person accompanying you, uttering that name in a voice so harsh that it sounds like he's about to shatter his teeth.

speaker: Conrad
content: Haha... Hahaha... How dare you come back?

speaker: Rahu
content: To pick up your bones.

speaker: Conrad
content: Haha... You still remember that...

speaker: Conrad
content: And who is this?
The man's glance shifts to you, eyes filled with undisguised hostility and wariness.

speaker: %u
content: I am ${PlayerName}, the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.

speaker: %u
content: Rahu just got transferred to work at the MBCC. Think of me as her direct superior.

speaker: Conrad
content: Yet another superior? Hahaha...

speaker: Conrad
content: Watch out, ${PlayerName}, that one bites.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...They weren't lying when they said Mania had screwed up your brain.

speaker: Conrad
content: Yes, it's been so long, after all. Nothing surprises me anymore.

speaker: Rahu
content: It's only been a few months.

speaker: Conrad
content: A few months is a long time. Enough for me to turn into this ghost of a man, and for you to betray us and wag your tail at Paradeisos...

speaker: Rahu
content: What exactly happened?
Rahu doesn't respond to the man's accusation and only presses him for his side of the story.

speaker: Conrad
content: What happened? Hahaha...

speaker: Conrad
content: The same that happened in N.F. 103. Everyone died, right before my eyes and without reason. I was the only one lucky enough to have been salvaged like a piece of garbage...

speaker: Conrad
content: I'm beginning to understand what you felt back then, Rahu. I even thought you were the crazy one at the time. Turns out I just hadn't seen the truth yet.

speaker: Conrad
content: Someone must pay for this... Paradeisos... will pay for this...
The man's voice is filled with spite and grudge and black veins are emerging on his face.

speaker: %u
content: What exactly is this truth you're talking about?

speaker: Conrad
content: Heh...
The man lets out a cold snort.

speaker: Conrad
content: Why should I tell you?

speaker: %u
content: Anyone, even Paradeisos, must be held accountable for their crimes. This is a rule I live by.

speaker: %u
content: But there must be evidence that can prove all of this...
The man squints at you, then his gaze shifts to Rahu beside you. After a moment, he speaks.

speaker: Conrad
content: Of course I've got evidence... Proof that Paradeisos killed Varna... and sent us on a suicide mission for nothing... West District, Inner Bay, DisSea, everything they've meddled in over these ten years...

speaker: Conrad
content: The question is: Why should I believe that you're not one of them?

speaker: Conrad
content: Paradeisos has got plenty of lapdogs.
As he gives these answers, the man's gaze is fixed on Rahu, as if expecting her to react in some way.

speaker: Rahu
content: Where's the evidence?
Rahu's voice is cold and her eyes are locked on Conrad. Before you can say anything, you feel an intimidating aura about her, warning you to shut up and back off.

speaker: Rahu
content: Those are all false information, lies fabricated by the Underground to confuse people. You've been used. Hand it over to me, I'll handle it.

speaker: Rahu
content: FAC soldiers are obedient, disciplined, and dedicated to the battlefield. You are the most honorable and honest people who haven't seen true evil. You don't have the time to seek the truth and validate it.

speaker: Rahu
content: It doesn't matter who gave you this evidence, it's all fake. They're just using you to undermine Paradeisos.

speaker: Rahu
content: Hand it over.

speaker: Conrad
content: ...That's all you have to say to me? Even now, you've got nothing else to tell me?

speaker: Conrad
content: To hell with the Underground! False information? You ever wonder who gave me this fake evidence? ...You did!

speaker: Conrad
content: This is the evidence you collected yourself! You wanted this! The real Rahu wanted this! You went through hell for the truth, and listen to what you're saying now!

speaker: Conrad
content: You're not Rahu. Who the hell are you?!
The man screams maniacally, breaking free from his restraints and lunging at you. His almost pitiful wails fill the air, bringing with it a wave of contamination.

Rahu pushes you aside and catches Conrad's flailing hands, pinning him to the ground. She mercilessly drives a Hypercube into his palm, brutally subduing this man driven to madness by grief. Her movements are swift, precise, and without hesitation.
Meanwhile, your shackles are subtly pulsating.

speaker: Rahu
content: I am Rahu. I am the lucid one.

speaker: Rahu
content: You're simply caught in the illusions of your past, lying to yourself. If you stay too far from the true reality, you'll only die trying to reach it.

speaker: Rahu
content: Look ahead, Conrad, just like you once told me... Look ahead! Weren't you always the level-headed one?

speaker: Conrad
content: ...Look ahead?

speaker: Conrad
content: Like a mad dog, your rage was satisfying, and it freed me from my hatred. I was only able to be level-headed because you vented the anger for all of us.

speaker: Conrad
content: And look at what you've become. How am I supposed to keep looking ahead?!
The man jerks his head up. Mania has eroded his sanity, allowing his deepest emotions to spill out uninhibitedly. His dark pupils are filled with despair and grudge.

speaker: Conrad
content: I shouldn't have let you go to that villa... I shouldn't have let you go alone... What happened there?

speaker: Conrad
content: Was it Paradeisos? Or those assassins... What did they do to you? Why did you become like this...?

speaker: Conrad
content: Where is Rahu... Where did my last comrade go...

speaker: Conrad
content: <color=#fb9259><size=45>Did you kill her?!!!</size></color>
The man screams hysterically. The veins on his face twitch uncontrollably and dark scars appear on his pale skin. His emotional outburst is causing his Mania to flare up.
Rahu's Hypercube is almost pressed into his body and it's being rapidly depleted. Contamination keeps spilling out and starts to corrupt Rahu's body, her face showing crimson traces of Mania...

But she doesn't let go. Rahu holds her grip on Conrad firmly, staring intently into his eyes. You see intense emotions in her gaze. The shackles tremble violently. You can't tell whether it's from Conrad's Mania or Rahu's overflowing emotions, but now is not the time to get distracted.
You must react at once.

speaker: %u
content: Rahu, step aside!

You impose a prohibition on her. In that instant, anger burns in her eyes. She looks as if she's about to pounce and bite at your neck just to protect that man. For the first time, you see the real her, and you make sure to remember this.

Then you try your best to subdue this furious Sinner, almost exhausting the power of the shackles to force her to step back. She must stay away from the contamination, and you must do what has to be done...

speaker: %u
content: Hang in there, Conrad!

Conrad's Mania is on the verge of eruption, and you use all your strength to suppress it with the shackles. You've been warned by the medical department that compensating for those on the brink of Corruptor transformation is extremely dangerous, but this man cannot die.

The man finally opens his eyes. After the torment of Mania, his gaze is now confused, cloudy, and shattered. He glances at Rahu, then at you. Conrad slightly opens his mouth.
Finally, he speaks.

speaker: Conrad
content: Again... Not enough... Just a little longer...
Squirming, he extends his hand to you.

speaker: Conrad
content: Just a little longer...
The man's cloudy eyes turn to you but fail to focus.
His eyes remain closed, but he grips your hand tightly with surprising strength, his fingers stroking your palm as if cherishing this moment of tranquility and clarity.
But you quickly realize something is off. The rhythm of the man's fingers is too regular, as if he's conveying a short message to you...
Ornstein 47 301 Ornstein 47 301 Ornstein 47 301...
He repeats it over and over for fear that you don't understand his intention.

speaker: Choice
options: Let him know you've taken note.

content: You firmly grip the man's hand. He understands your meaning.

speaker: Conrad
content: Haha... Get lost... All of you, get lost...
The man closes his eyes wearily, falling silent. But he's obviously still alive, his Mania temporarily stabilized.

You look at Rahu. Her emotions have been perfectly concealed. The knight in black silently stands behind you, watching the two of you without giving away any of her true feelings. Only the forgotten cold sweat on her forehead is proof of her fleeting true self.

speaker: %u
content: He's safe for now. Someone will take care of him. Let's go, we still have things to discuss.

She watches as you help Conrad onto the bed and cover him with a blanket. Wordlessly, she watches the man trapped in despair and pain fall into a deep sleep. Rahu simply closes her eyes for a moment, then looks at you.

speaker: Rahu
content: Yes, Commander.
Leaving the dim sickroom, you and Rahu are back on the other side of the door.
You nod to the guard and drag your still-exhausted body through the deserted corridor.
The corridor is empty and quiet save for your and Rahu's footsteps. Suddenly, you hear her icy voice from behind.

speaker: Rahu
content: What did he give you?
As expected, she noticed Conrad's discreet gesture. She must also remember that soldier's secretive nature.
You make sure there's enough distance between you two and judge that you'll probably be able to use the shackles for self-defense, then turn around and spread your hands completely.

speaker: Choice
options: Are you interrogating me? Me, your Commander?

content: She doesn't avoid your gaze and her tone is emotionless.

speaker: Rahu
content: No, but it's my duty to keep the Commander safe.

speaker: Rahu
content: Conrad was reckless and flouted the taboo, and he ended up in this state. He's not a Sinner. Your shackles can't suppress the contamination in him. He's already become a huge threat to DisCity.

speaker: %u
content: Are you asking me to banish him? Or kill him? You know I won't do that.

speaker: Rahu
content: I know you won't. He's useful to you.

speaker: Rahu
content: Then heed my advice. Keep this confidential. Lock him up in the toughest prison cell you can find and post your best fighters to guard him around the clock. Otherwise, the people who provoked him will surely come knocking on your door.

speaker: Rahu
content: This is all... for your own safety.

speaker: %u
content: Of course, I will do as you say.

speaker: Choice
options: If you're so keen to protect him through me...

content: Rahu is momentarily taken aback, then her face hardens again. She opens her mouth to say something...
She is stumped by your remark. You watch her reaction with a grin and begin leisurely.

speaker: %u
content: I'll apply to the FAC to transfer him to the Bureau. Although he's not a Sinner, my power did work on him just now. We could use an extra observation subject.

speaker: %u
content: And I am indeed interested in him. I really want to know... what is it that he is fighting so desperately for all by himself.
You look at Rahu, who is staring back at you intensely. Having seen her true anger, you can now discern her emotions to some extent.

She is again suppressing her anger, probably grinding her teeth under her mask, doing a pretty good job at holding it in. It makes you want to poke at her again, maybe she will blurt out a heartfelt remark or two.
But the next second, she closes her eyes and takes a few slow breaths. When she opens them again, Rahu has regained her composure.

speaker: Rahu
content: You misunderstood. The only one I must protect is my Commander.

speaker: Rahu
content: As you just said, he's been wrecked by Mania and his mind is in tatters. You're taking him in as an experimental subject to test your shackles' power. This is an acceptable reason. Anything beyond that, keep it to yourself.

speaker: Rahu
content: No matter what he's passed onto you, no matter what interest you have in his ramblings. Those are very dangerous things.

speaker: Rahu
content: The danger lies not in their value, but in your desire to cross the line. I will handle these dangerous matters myself, including all who attempt to touch them.

speaker: Rahu
content: Next is my advice to you: Don't overreach yourself. Don't pry into things you shouldn't. Forget whatever he just told you. Otherwise, you will end up like him.
Once again, her tone is threatening. You look at her and pose your question slowly.

speaker: Choice
options: Is this a warning from your real master?

speaker: %u
content: Or are you protecting me like you protect Conrad?
It's the same old trick of yours, but she doesn't waver like she did a few seconds ago. She just looks at you stiffly like a statue carved out of stone.

speaker: Rahu
content: Same difference.

speaker: Rahu
content: You shouldn't be dragged into this. For your own safety, don't cross the line.
The door opens, and a few guards come to greet you. Rahu doesn't utter another word and simply follows you closely like a silent and loyal guard.
But you know that this loyal guard will never obey your commands. And she too is hiding unspeakable secrets.

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: A Blue Rain warning has been issued. It's going to rain soon, Chief.
You look up. He's right, the sky is overcast. You can faintly hear the distant rumble of thunder.

speaker: %u
content: Let's speed up and try to reach our destination before it starts raining.

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: Got it.
Since you visited Conrad Cage two days ago, you've been looking for the evidence he mentioned.

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: We're here, Chief.
This is an abandoned residence located at the border of Eastside and the Rust. Besides passing vagrants and scavengers, no one else would set foot here.

You enter the room, which is a long-uninhabited apartment. Piles of clutter fill every corner of the room. The dust has mixed with the humid air before the rain, making it a bit difficult for you to breathe.
The footprints and drag marks on the floor are covered with a thin layer of dust. They were probably left by Conrad.
The howling wind blows through the broken window into the room, lifting the curtains and stirring up the dust. With the dim light and dilapidated room, it looks like a scene taken out of a noir film.
You don't wait aimlessly for Rahu to arrive. Instead, you start looking for Conrad's evidence.
A few minutes later, you find a dusty notebook hidden behind a dirty painting on the wall.

April 1
According to the old man in the Drifter Camp, the Rustfire incident followed the exact same track as the incident in N.F. 104. This matches the existing information.
In the incident in March, they manipulated public opinion, incited conflicts, and failed negotiations. Internally, they claimed that Rustfire attacked and killed important officials. Externally, they put the blame on Rustfire through public opinion and media, completely omitting Rustfire's demands and initial attitude. These methods are very similar to those used during the BR-002 outbreak in N.F. 104. They were possibly put forward by the same group of people.
Organizations like the FAC, the Executive Committee, or the MBCC don't have this kind of power. Only Paradeisos is capable of that.

Detailed information is backed up at ██████. File password: ████████████.
This battle will help me learn more.

April 5 The MBCC has lost control. From what I've heard from the Rustfire rioters, that Chief with the shackles has gone missing and has likely died during the riot. No wonder the MBCC didn't come to our aid. I heard all the Sinners have gone manic. The situation in the West District is dire. The Underground runs rampant and fake news is spreading everywhere. I can now confirm that Paradeisos is indeed involved in all this. Is this good news? Probably. And I've heard about an even better opportunity... The FAC is discussing an emergency recruitment of special Sinners. With the MBCC paralyzed, becoming a Sinner now won't get me detained. Instead, I may be able to skip the usual FAC operations and take on higher-level missions. I've waited in this position for too long. I can only get access to so much information as a regular FAC soldier. I must take it a notch higher. This is an opportunity... I can't wait any longer. To move forward, I must take risks.

April 9 Injected Mania Crystal. Waiting for results. April 12 Passed out for three days. My physical reactions were intense, but it was all worth it... I drove back a large group of rioters who attacked the camp and received direct instructions from higher-level management. Conrad cursed for hours. He even cried in the end. Haha... What's he crying for? I can protect him now. From here on out, I can do even more... April 16 The meeting ended. I've been given permission to act freely and I've joined the special task force. I reclaimed several refugee camps, and then received some higher-level missions. They want me to protect the Executive Committee, along with the Nirvana surveyor...

April 29
Attempted to speak with the Nirvana surveyor and was rejected.

May 9
Tried again to get in contact with Nirvana. They're very cautious, so no success.
The battle is too stagnant. Both the Black Ring and the riots are getting out of hand. But in my current position, the information I have access to is dozens of times more than before.

Despite the high confidentiality, the deployment of security forces can still be inferred... More and more Paradeisians are joining the command. If they really have something to do with the Inner Bay Black Ring in N.F. 104, then... they must also be connected to what happened to N.F. 103.
The information dealers on the dark web are not reliable. I should find another channel.

July 18
Several Paradeisian officials have been attacked in Eastside. The FAC receives all kinds of calls for support, all related to Paradeisians, but they are never answered. This is not normal... But I can't find more clues.
This is my only chance to get in touch with Paradeisians. The situation in the West District is cooling down and there have obviously been fewer major missions. The FAC has begun their casualty count too. Those Paradeisians will leave soon. I must act now.

The location is Erica Villa in Eastside, where there's clearly a shortage of guards. They keep asking for support but in vain.
This is an opportunity. If I go now, I won't be rejected like before.

I'll surely come back with more clues this time.
There are no more new clues after that. You silently close the notebook.

speaker: Conrad
content: This is the evidence you collected yourself! You wanted this! The real Rahu wanted this! You went through hell for the truth, and listen to what you're saying now!

speaker: Conrad
content: I shouldn't have let you go to that villa... I shouldn't have let you go alone... What happened there?

speaker: Rahu
content: Next is my advice to you: Don't overreach yourself. Don't pry into things you shouldn't. Forget whatever he just told you. Otherwise, you will end up like him.
You recall the weird sensation the shackles detected inside her, and the inconsistency between the author of this notebook and her in real life. You try to make out the differences.
But another clear feeling is reminding you that there's no need anymore.
Bang—
After the thunder, the downpour follows as expected.
At the same time, something made of cold, hard metal is pressed against your lower back.

speaker: Rahu
content: Don't move. Keep your hand still.
Using the thunder as cover, Rahu finally appears behind you.

speaker: %u
content: Didn't you say you'd follow the orders of your Commander? Why did you sneak out of the MBCC and then sneak up on me like that?

speaker: Rahu
content: You didn't heed my advice either. You touched something you shouldn't have.

speaker: %u
content: How did you escape?

speaker: Rahu
content: I have my ways.

speaker: Rahu
content: Don't worry, your people are competent. They've done everything they could.

speaker: %u
content: What about the people downstairs?

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm not a maniac who kills for fun. I just made sure they'd leave me alone for a while.

speaker: %u
content: Good.
Rahu subtly closes in, the tip of her blade pressing against your back.

speaker: Rahu
content: You don't seem surprised that I came.
Yes, the shackles sensed her arrival a long time ago. You knew she would come, and you were waiting.

speaker: Choice
options: So, you here to kill me?

speaker: Rahu
content: That depends on your choices.

speaker: Rahu
content: Give me what's in your hands and leave. Forget the contents of the notebook and what happened these few days. Go back to being the Chief of the MBCC and mind your own business... Maybe you'll be spared. Who knows?

speaker: %u
content: What about you? After completing this mission, what are you going to do?

speaker: %u
content: Escape from the MBCC? Return to your master?

speaker: Rahu
content: That's none of your business.

speaker: %u
content: No, that's exactly why I'm here waiting for you.

speaker: %u
content: It wasn't easy for me to find a chance to talk to you alone. You've already cleared all possible eavesdroppers. Now, let's talk about what really happened, Rahu.

speaker: %u
content: The old Rahu that Conrad knew, the person who went to great lengths to seek the truth in this notebook, where did she go? What happened to you after you left Conrad?

speaker: Rahu
content: Is this another interrogation? You're gonna pry the answer out of me?

speaker: Choice
options: You don't have to tell me.

speaker: %u
content: But I will look for it myself. I will find out everything that happened in Erica Villa in July.

speaker: %u
content: I've already crossed the line many times now, and yet I've only been mildly <color=#fb9259>warned</color> by you <color=#fb9259>alone</color>...

speaker: %u
content: Believe me, I'll uncover the truth soon. After all...

speaker: Choice
options: You've always protected me, just like you've protected Conrad.

content: Suddenly, a hand violently grips your neck from behind, almost lifting you off the ground.

speaker: Rahu
content: Don't push your luck! The only reason I haven't killed you is that I've received no such order. It may not be the case if you go a step further.

speaker: Rahu
content: One word from them, and I'll snap your neck instantly.

speaker: Rahu
content: Everyone around you will then pay the price of your reckless arrogance.
You cough painfully twice and struggle to muster a small laugh, making sure she hears it clearly.

speaker: Choice
options: Like how you dragged Conrad into this?

speaker: %u
content: [CG Farewell Moment B]
You're thrown onto the floor with a painful hit. As you come to your senses, the evidence in your hand is already tightly clenched by its original owner, almost crumpled into a ball.

Rahu clenches her fists, and from beneath the mask comes the suppressed breathing of a cornered animal. She turns her head away from you, and you know she's closing her eyes again, using all her strength to tame her anger.
This time, you won't let her put on her disguise again.

speaker: %u
content: I once thought you were brainwashed or controlled. Now it seems that's not the case. I'm more inclined to believe that someone with that kind of determination wouldn't change so drastically in such a short time.

speaker: %u
content: I've read the notes, and as you've said, there isn't much valuable information.

speaker: %u
content: You were a regular FAC soldier. During those ten years, you obeyed orders and fought in battles. Busy fighting for your life, you couldn't possibly find the opportunity to climb higher and gain more.

speaker: %u
content: Even though you risked your life to become a Sinner and endured the torment of Mania alone, you were only able to advance a small step. You were nothing more than just an FAC soldier, you couldn't go any further.

speaker: %u
content: So, you decided to take a different path, even if it meant walking alone into the depths of darkness with an iron mask on. Like you do now.

speaker: %u
content: But who do you think you're fooling? The shackles felt it all too clearly. In Conrad's cell, your pain could barely be concealed. You were too eager to protect him.

speaker: %u
content: If Conrad hadn't been struggling with Mania, he would have seen it clearly too. He would have slapped you awake, you stubborn fool.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Enough!

speaker: %u
content: Like you, I have things I must do, and I need to delve into danger to find the truth. I understand your determination, and I understand your instinct to protect others.

speaker: %u
content: The shackles felt it all too clearly. In Conrad's cell, your pain could barely be concealed. You were too eager to protect him.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Enough.

speaker: Rahu
content: I have no intention of protecting Conrad, let alone protecting you.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm not that strong, and there's only so much I can do. If they notice you've crossed the line, I don't have a way to keep you alive right now.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...There are already people seeking the truth you want, and there will be people to eradicate threats against you in the shadows.

speaker: Rahu
content: So... don't cross over. Stay under the sun and don't go any further.
She looks at you, her eyes no longer filled with anger, only an empty sadness.

speaker: %u
content: I think I can understand your determination. But must you shoulder all of this yourself?

speaker: %u
content: When Conrad... and many others are eager to back you up. I can give you a hand too. Do you insist on going alone even though we're on the same side?

speaker: %u
content: What is it that you see... Who is this enemy that you fear...
Bang—

Lightning illuminates her face, and the deafening thunder drowns out her response. The wind brings the rain through the shattered window. The torn curtains are drenched in rain, dancing wildly in the wind.
What follows is a gunshot. The bullet whizzes toward the notebook in Rahu's hand. Rahu reacts instantly, blocking the attack.
Rain spatters on her face and red light bounces off her skin. Her face turning vigilant, she instinctively shields you with her own body and bellows.

speaker: Rahu
content: Who's there?!
Her gaze is directed at the corner of the room, which is pitch dark.

speaker: Rahu
content: Show yourself!
Under Rahu's stern warning, several figures emerge from the shadow. They are clad in heavy armor, but they make no sound when they suddenly appear in the room.
An acute sense of danger creeps up your brain. You've never seen these people before, but you're certain they're not friends.

speaker: Rahu
content: HUSH... What are you doing here?

speaker: HUSH
content: Executing a mission.
The voice of the intruder is cold and mechanical, as if naturally devoid of emotions.

speaker: Rahu
content: What mission?

speaker: HUSH
content: Destroy everything related to her, including all those who know.
female_content: L.L.

content: They're staring at the evidence in Rahu's hand.

speaker: Rahu
content: This is my mission. And I've already completed it.
Underneath Rahu's detached and terse tone, there lies a strong sense of caution.

speaker: HUSH
content: No... you haven't.

speaker: HUSH
content: You haven't executed Conrad Cage, and you've let another person in on it.

speaker: HUSH
content: You are the source of the intelligence leak. And now you want to hand it over to another outsider.

speaker: Rahu
content: <color=#fb9259><size=45>I've never done anything like that!</size></color>
She glances over her shoulder at you, gritting her teeth.

speaker: Rahu
content: Enough. The longer we talk, the more we're giving away, and the more unnecessary things you'll have to do later.

speaker: Rahu
content: This person here saw nothing. I have the evidence. Now, take me back to Paradeisos.

speaker: Rahu
content: Run as many loyalty tests on me as you want when we're back. As long as it's within my protection range, I can comply.

speaker: HUSH
content: No need. The test begins now.

speaker: HUSH
content: Eliminate Conrad Cage. Prove your loyalty and reliability.
You see her clench her fists from behind clearly. She's desperately holding back and maintaining her disguise, trying not to expose herself.
But it's becoming clear... You look across and can't help getting a bad feeling.

speaker: Rahu
content: I said... within the stated range. My role is a guard, I... cannot undertake the responsibility of destruction and harm.

speaker: HUSH
content: He's already an enemy of DisCity. Just like the Underground, he's not within your protection range.

speaker: Rahu
content: That's not for you to decide. You don't have the authorization to determine this.

speaker: Rahu
content: The FAC and the 9th Agency will set up a special investigation team. Are you questioning their reliability on behalf of Paradeisos?
She grits her teeth, uttering these words with distinct pauses. The HUSH soldier stops.

speaker: HUSH
content: ...You're right.

speaker: HUSH
content: But we have the authorization to get rid of you, a parasite on HUSH.
Those strange puppet voices convey no emotions. They raise their guns.

speaker: HUSH
content: Your emotional state has been abnormal and you are highly unstable. As someone who's been marked, you've fallen out of the safe range.

speaker: Rahu
content: This is the influence of the shackles. My stability has been affected precisely because of this useless transfer order. Let me go. There's no point in staying here anymore.

speaker: HUSH
content: You are a guard chosen and deeply marked by X. During her confinement, you serve as a reference on her condition. Fluctuations in you mean fluctuations in her. Your betrayal means her betrayal.

speaker: HUSH
content: As the executors of HUSH, we judge that you and she have become obstacles blocking the system. With the two of you present, the next Hush cannot take over.

speaker: HUSH
content: We need the next Hush. So now, HUSH needs to get rid of you first.

speaker: Rahu
content: I see... This is your goal... This ridiculous transfer is also your doing...

speaker: Rahu
content: You sent me here just to set me up. You wanted to use me to remove your obstacles from the very start.

speaker: HUSH
content: We don't know about any transfer orders. We serve only Paradeisos and HUSH.

speaker: HUSH
content: The Hush position has been vacant for too long. We will find the optimal solution ourselves.
Another flash of lightning cuts through and the muffled thunder shatters the silence. The light illuminates her expression.

It's filled with suppressed rage and you can see all her indignation. She's not ready to give up the path she's endured and erase all her sacrifices. She's still scouring for a solution, one that doesn't require fighting or lifting her disguise.
But Rahu's body has already reacted.
As the guns are pointed at you, a dim halo gathers and revolves above Rahu's armguard. She subconsciously steps back and stands in front of you, assuming a combat stance.
The face masks cover the HUSH soldiers' faces and you can't see their reaction, although you think this is probably going as they wish.

speaker: HUSH
content: All your rebellious behaviors just now will be uploaded as surveillance records and serve as evidence of your misconduct.
You go too far, Hush!
A small knife cuts through the silence, stabbing into the shoulder of the leading HUSH elite. That's the weapon Rahu was just pressing against your back.
Unfortunately, you missed. You were aiming for its forehead.

speaker: HUSH
content: Chief... of Minos.

speaker: %u
content: I thought you were purposely ignoring me.

speaker: Rahu
content: He's...
female_content: She's...

content: You impose a prohibition on her. Sharp spikes of light burst from her body. Caught off guard, she falls to her knees, looking at you incredulously.
You peer at her coldly and deliberately tilt your head up, giving your best performance.

speaker: %u
content: I know you're in cahoots with them, Hush's lackey. Now that you're shackled by me, don't think of defying me.
The HUSH Unit fall silent for a moment, then shift their guns toward you.

speaker: HUSH
content: You've already seen things you shouldn't have. Are you sure you want to meddle further in this?

speaker: %u
content: You already did a number on me that time in the West District, remember? I'll let that one slide, since Paradeisos gave the order. I was mad, but I got over it. How am I supposed to tolerate this again?
You speak with righteous indignation, sounding furious.

speaker: %u
content: This Sinner named Rahu, she's the one Hush has marked, right? Did you see how your lapdog just brazenly attacked me?

speaker: %u
content: She wants to kill me just because I wanted to understand why I was treated that way and uncover some truth?

speaker: Rahu
content: Shut up! You have no idea what you're doing!

speaker: HUSH
content: We'd advise you to speak and act carefully, Chief of Minos. Paradeisos needs you right now, but they need a more cautious and reliable version of you.

speaker: HUSH
content: Everything you say and do here will be uploaded as surveillance records. You...

speaker: Choice
options: Being watched is nothing new to me.

speaker: %u
content: If you guys really had direct instructions from Paradeisos, you wouldn't need to test someone in such a roundabout way.

speaker: %u
content: You act recklessly without your master's orders. If Paradeisos really cared about you, they wouldn't have let HUSH stay abandoned for so long.

speaker: %u
content: Without Hush, you guys can't even be considered as tools, can you? That's why you jump and bite the first person you see desperately.

speaker: %u
content: Listen, Conrad is with me, and I won't hand him over to you. Let the real Paradeisian talk to me, or I'll go to him tomorrow.
The HUSH Unit fall silent, but their guns are still pointed at you.

speaker: HUSH
content: Hostility confirmed. Reporting threat. Requesting target elimination. This is your final warning: Watch your words and actions. Don't make Paradeisos question your credibility.

speaker: HUSH
content: If we judge that you pose a threat to HUSH, we can eliminate you ourselves. Right now, you cannot defend yourself.

speaker: HUSH
content: Be cautious with your words and actions.
You turn away from those emotionless mannequins. Your gaze shifts to Rahu.
The woman who's been trudging with heavy steps and gone too far to turn back. Now you finally understand her.

At the other end of the shackles, she's blind with the urge to rush over and push you out of this battlefield. You're exhausting all your strength to suppress her impulse so she doesn't cut off her own retreat, even though you know she was born with this protective instinct.

speaker: %u
content: I respect those who are prudent, and when necessary, I will learn from them.

speaker: %u
content: But sometimes, I end up being suspected no matter what I do. So you see, there's no need to worry too much, and I often just follow my heart. I also make sure I clean up the mess I create.

speaker: %u
content: Besides, it's not like there's really big trouble now. I can handle the consequence of swatting a few flies.

speaker: %u
content: Rahu, I've decided I want my revenge now. This is an order from the shackles, you can't say no!

speaker: HUSH
content: Rahu, refuse the order! The shackles can't control you. You obey Paradeisos, Hush, and the system. Kill him now!
female_content: Rahu, refuse the order! The shackles can't control you. You obey Paradeisos, Hush, and the system. Kill her now!

speaker: Choice
options: Listen to me and take them down!

content: Without Hush, you guys can't even be considered as tools, can you? That's why you jump and bite the first person you see desperately.

speaker: %u
content: Listen, Conrad is with me, and I won't hand him over to you. Let the real Paradeisian talk to me, or I'll go to him tomorrow.
The HUSH Unit fall silent, but their guns are still pointed at you.

speaker: HUSH
content: Hostility confirmed. Reporting threat. Requesting target elimination. This is your final warning: Watch your words and actions. Don't make Paradeisos question your credibility.

speaker: HUSH
content: If we judge that you pose a threat to HUSH, we can eliminate you ourselves. Right now, you cannot defend yourself.

speaker: HUSH
content: Be cautious with your words and actions.
You turn away from those emotionless mannequins. Your gaze shifts to Rahu.
The woman who's been trudging with heavy steps and gone too far to turn back. Now you finally understand her.

At the other end of the shackles, she's blind with the urge to rush over and push you out of this battlefield. You're exhausting all your strength to suppress her impulse so she doesn't cut off her own retreat, even though you know she was born with this protective instinct.

speaker: %u
content: I respect those who are prudent, and when necessary, I will learn from them.

speaker: %u
content: But sometimes, I end up being suspected no matter what I do. So you see, there's no need to worry too much, and I often just follow my heart. I also make sure I clean up the mess I create.

speaker: %u
content: Besides, it's not like there's really big trouble now. I can handle the consequence of swatting a few flies.

speaker: %u
content: Rahu, I've decided I want my revenge now. This is an order from the shackles, you can't say no!

speaker: HUSH
content: Rahu, refuse the order! The shackles can't control you. You obey Paradeisos, Hush, and the system. Kill him now!
female_content: Rahu, refuse the order! The shackles can't control you. You obey Paradeisos, Hush, and the system. Kill her now!

speaker: Choice
options: Listen to me and take them down!

content: As the HUSH Unit prepare to pull the triggers, you release all the restraints on her.
You impose a prohibition on her. Sharp spikes of light burst from her body. Caught off guard, she falls to her knees, looking at you incredulously.
You peer at her coldly and deliberately tilt your head up, giving your best performance.

speaker: %u
content: I know you're in cahoots with them, Hush's lackey. Now that you're shackled by me, don't think of defying me.
The HUSH Unit fall silent for a moment, then shift their guns toward you.

speaker: HUSH
content: You've already seen things you shouldn't have. Are you sure you want to meddle further in this?

speaker: %u
content: You already did a number on me that time in the West District, remember? I'll let that one slide, since Paradeisos gave the order. I was mad, but I got over it. How am I supposed to tolerate this again?
You speak with righteous indignation, sounding furious.

speaker: %u
content: This Sinner named Rahu, she's the one Hush has marked, right? Did you see how your lapdog just brazenly attacked me?

speaker: %u
content: She wants to kill me just because I wanted to understand why I was treated that way and uncover some truth?

speaker: Rahu
content: Shut up! You have no idea what you're doing!

speaker: HUSH
content: We'd advise you to speak and act carefully, Chief of Minos. Paradeisos needs you right now, but they need a more cautious and reliable version of you.

speaker: HUSH
content: Everything you say and do here will be uploaded as surveillance records. You...

speaker: Choice
options: Being watched is nothing new to me.

speaker: %u
content: If you guys really had direct instructions from Paradeisos, you wouldn't need to test someone in such a roundabout way.

speaker: %u
content: You act recklessly without your master's orders. If Paradeisos really cared about you, they wouldn't have let HUSH stay abandoned for so long.

content: Rahu, refuse the order! The shackles can't control you. You obey Paradeisos, Hush, and the system. Kill him now!
female_content: Rahu, refuse the order! The shackles can't control you. You obey Paradeisos, Hush, and the system. Kill her now!

speaker: Choice
options: Listen to me and take them down!

content: As the HUSH Unit prepare to pull the triggers, you release all the restraints on her.

speaker: Rahu
content: Ahhhhhhhhhhh!
The caged beast finally lets out a long-suppressed roar.
The intense battle destroys the already shaky shack. Blue Rain pours down on the raging warrior.

speaker: %u
content: They must have everything on record. It's all my doing. I threw a tantrum and forced you to turn against your comrades.

speaker: %u
content: Paradeisos knows me very well. In fact, it'll surprise them more if I don't do this. They'll think I'm up to no good.

speaker: %u
content: Leave the rest to me. It's okay.
You struggle to undo Rahu's armguard and hold her hand. Her mind is being consumed by Mania and rage, and her arms are trembling uncontrollably.

speaker: Rahu
content: You shouldn't have interfered... It's not time yet...

speaker: Rahu
content: They're going to make a move. They won't let you off. I can't protect you either...

speaker: Rahu
content: Let me go. Let me go back to Paradeisos... In the end, at least let me...
She can't hear a word you're saying, the excessive burden weighing on her. You look into her eyes and see only darkness.

speaker: %u
content: You must have protected a lot of people. You won't have to fight alone.

speaker: %u
content: Let's talk properly when everything is over...
The power of the shackles surges from within you. It's an extension of your soul, a tendril of your spirit. But that indescribable obstacle has disappeared at some point, making way for you.
Without hesitation, you exhaust every bit of strength in your body, pouring everything you've got into it.
Until the ringing in your ears drowns out the thunderstorm. Until darkness obscures your vision.

speaker: Varna
content: ...Rahu.

speaker: Varna
content: Rahu?

speaker: Varna
content: Rahu!
Rahu snaps back to reality, realizing that Captain is calling her.

speaker: Rahu
content: Yes! Captain!

speaker: Varna
content: You were distracted.

speaker: Rahu
content: Captain, I was just thinking...

speaker: Varna
content: I don't need to know that. Your mission in the mock battle is to protect the Commander.

speaker: Varna
content: Now, due to your negligence, your Commander is dead. You have failed in your duty.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm sorry...

speaker: Varna
content: Can an apology bring the Commander back to life?

speaker: Varna
content: Next time, I don't want any more excuses or apologies.

speaker: Varna
content: Learn from your mistakes and don't repeat them. That's the meaning of failure.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Understood, Captain.

speaker: Conrad
content: With that injury... it will take at least three months before you can return to your duty.

speaker: Conrad
content: Pay more attention next time. Don't get overheated all the time.

speaker: Rahu
content: That one nags...

speaker: Conrad
content: Do you ever listen?

speaker: Conrad
content: Indeed, it's thanks to you that we took down that Corruptor that came out of nowhere. Otherwise, Captain would have been the one injured.

speaker: Rahu
content: Protecting her is my duty.

speaker: Conrad
content: Duty or not, we all saw how you risked your life to protect her.

speaker: Conrad
content: No one is more grateful to you than Captain herself. You didn't see the look on her face. It was the first time I saw her so worried.

speaker: Rahu
content: Hmm...

speaker: Conrad
content: What's with that look? Don't tell me you think Captain is always so strict with you because she doesn't like you?

speaker: Conrad
content: Surely you know what kind of person she is, don't you?

speaker: Rahu
content: Why are you so talkative today?

speaker: Conrad
content: Alright, alright, my bad for talking too much.

speaker: Conrad
content: Forget about that. Rest up and come back as soon as possible.

speaker: Rahu
content: Got it...

speaker: Varna
content: By the way, Rahu, you...

speaker: Varna
content: Rahu?

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Yes!

speaker: Varna
content: Don't be so tense, we're not on the battlefield.

speaker: Rahu
content: No... I was just...

speaker: Rahu
content: I was just thinking that this place is really nice...

speaker: Varna
content: Of course it's nice, it's not a dormitory. This is my home. I took out a 25-year mortgage to buy it and I'm still paying it off.

speaker: Varna
content: Back when I first joined the FAC, I thought I might die any day and not have to pay off the mortgage. But here I am, still alive.

speaker: Varna
content: I haven't been back here in two years. You two are the only guests I've invited to my home in nearly a decade.

speaker: Varna
content: Sit down, we're not in training.
Rahu looks around. In front of the warm fireplace, she, Captain, and Conrad are seated around the dining table and enjoying dinner.

speaker: Conrad
content: By the way, Captain, didn't you have something to say?

speaker: Varna
content: About that...

speaker: Varna
content: Rahu, while you were gone, the G47 squad went through several tough battles.

speaker: Varna
content: Jonah and Sheldon... they didn't make it. Conrad was also injured and will be out for a while. This has forced me to consider the future of the squad.
Rahu looks at Conrad, whose leg is in a cast.

speaker: Varna
content: If anything happens to me, you'll take over as the captain.

speaker: Rahu
content: No.

speaker: Rahu
content: You will continue to lead the G47 squad. I will protect you.
Varna seems at a loss for words.

speaker: Varna
content: Be realistic, Rahu. Every FAC soldier dies on the battlefield. It's only a matter of time. I've never thought I would be an exception.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...I'm not ready yet. You've always been the captain.

speaker: Varna
content: Then start getting ready now.

speaker: Varna
content: Captaincy aside, even if you're not ready to take my place now, you must always be prepared for when I'm not around.

speaker: Varna
content: When the higher-ups send someone new, make sure to hold back your temper and listen to their commands...

speaker: Rahu
content: I can't do that!

speaker: Rahu
content: You're my Captain, and my loyalty belongs only to you, not anyone else!

speaker: Conrad
content: I knew it was pointless to talk to her about this.

speaker: Varna
content: Sigh...
The afterglow of the setting sun filters through the car window, casting a faint but warm glimmer over the passengers.

speaker: Varna
content: Why the sudden nervous look?

speaker: Rahu
content: No... I'm just... thinking.

speaker: Varna
content: Thinking about what? It's almost our turn, don't drop the ball on this one.

speaker: Rahu
content: I was thinking... even if we fight battle after battle, the people around us all leave in the end.

speaker: Rahu
content: I want to do something... but I can't... I...

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm scared that in the end, I'll be the only one left...

speaker: Varna
content: I'm glad you're sharing these thoughts with me, Rahu.
Looking at this child she personally recruited into the team, Captain gives a familiar smile.

speaker: Varna
content: We all get lost sometimes. We trip and we lose our way... As long as we're alive, we're bound to go through troubles like that.

speaker: Varna
content: To be honest, I've spent half my life at the FAC and I'm still unsure if I've truly overcome it.
Captain places her hand on Rahu's shoulder.

speaker: Varna
content: At times like this, look back and see the people around you.

speaker: Varna
content: Look at the people who have dedicated their lives to justice and fairness, and your comrades who you've trusted with your life time and time again... You've still got these lovely folks around you, haven't you?
Captain gazes at Rahu, her eyes firm and gentle.

speaker: Varna
content: You've never been alone, Rahu.
By the time Rahu realizes, a woman has already emerged behind her.
I was wondering when you'd remember.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...I wouldn't forget even if you didn't pull these tricks.
Can't help it, you get angry whenever you remember the past. If you get so mad that you start a fight with Paradeisos, I can't save you.
But now, even if you dream of them, you can sleep peacefully... Everything seems fine now.

speaker: Rahu
content: Yes.
You've got one now.

speaker: Rahu
content: Thank you.
I'm the one who should be thanking you... Go for it.
The chaotic scenes fade like melting snow. Memories of the past find their way back to her mind.
The white room, the bright lights, and the smell of disinfectant. The tangible sensations gradually calm Rahu's mind.
Until she turns her head and sees you sitting by the bed.
Memories of the rainstorm come rushing back. Rahu jerks up on the bed, gripping your upper arms tightly.

speaker: Rahu
content: Where are the HUSH soldiers?! And the notebook?! Where are we? Where did they take you?

speaker: Rahu
content: Did the news get out? Did they come for you? Where's Conrad?

speaker: Rahu
content: My weapon, give me back my weapon, I can't let them do this to you too...

speaker: Medic
content: Calm down! Your M-value is unstable. You've been unconscious for days and you still have a PICC line on you... Lie down immediately!

speaker: Medic
content: You're in the MBCC! The MBCC!
Rahu keeps glaring at you. You know she's not looking away until she gets an answer from you.
You smile and ask the medics to leave, making sure to close the door behind them.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...How many days have I been unconscious? What happened?

speaker: %u
content: After that battle, I immediately called the 9th Agency and the FAC. Gave them a lot of trouble.

speaker: %u
content: I said the HUSH Unit came to confront me. The evidence at the attack scene was irrefutable. I demanded an explanation and to meet with Hush. I was going to give her a piece of my mind, or I wouldn't be able to get over this.
You watch her as you speak. Rahu is breaking out in a cold sweat and her tight knuckles around your arms are turning white. Even the back of her clothes is soaking wet.

speaker: Rahu
content: So... what did they say?

speaker: %u
content: What else could they have said? I got an earful from my boss. They said Paradeisos had claimed that those soldiers were mere system errors and they were going to look into that.

speaker: %u
content: The higher-ups were playing it down, basically telling me: "We know you're right but let's call it a day."

speaker: Rahu
content: But they... surely that's not the end of the story...

speaker: Choice
options: Of course that's not the end.

speaker: %u
content: I made a big fuss and took the opportunity to bargain. I even threw in a list of materials the Supply Office had to restock. You know me, my honesty is my biggest flaw.

speaker: %u
content: The two departments sent everything over right away. They were reluctant, but they didn't miss a single item. It was a great harvest for the Bureau. Faye couldn't stop grinning.

speaker: Rahu
content: Is that enough for you?

speaker: %u
content: Yes, I was very satisfied and came back with a big smile.

speaker: Rahu
content: I can't understand why...

speaker: Rahu
content: Aren't you afraid of being targeted?
She lowers her head as she speaks, a lot less prickly than she was a few days ago. Her frustration is on display.
It feels bratty to tease a genuine person like her. You put away your joking expression and put on a serious tone.

speaker: Choice
options: Don't overthink it. I've always been their target.

speaker: %u
content: I don't know how you managed to come so far while shouldering everything alone, but... my journey hasn't been easy either. I've endured a lot.

speaker: %u
content: They put me here only to keep an eye on me. Whatever I do, Paradeisos won't feel at ease.

speaker: %u
content: So, instead of behaving and risking their suspicion, I choose to meet their expectations.

speaker: %u
content: After all, if I make them uneasy by throwing tantrums from time to time, it'll be more convincing to play dumb afterward.

speaker: %u
content: I guarantee you, they prefer a straightforward and easily satisfied troublemaker like me.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Are you sure?
You nod.

speaker: Choice
options: Conrad is doing a lot better too.

speaker: %u
content: With help of the FAC, we've arranged a convalescent site for him outside of DisCity and informed Paradeisos.

speaker: %u
content: Conrad will receive protection as a victim of HUSH's system errors and an FAC hero. All of this is on public record. If we're lucky, he might become a Sinner. At that time, we can formally transfer him back.

speaker: %u
content: If you wish, you can visit him too. We'll just say you're escorting the Chief of Minos.
There's another moment of silence.
Then, surprisingly, she manages a small smile, her gaze a lot softer now.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'll never understand people like you and your roundabout ways.

speaker: %u
content: My roundabout ways won't work if I'm on my own. It's all thanks to my previous connections.

speaker: %u
content: In any case, things are not as bad for me as you think. Even I can stand up for myself.

speaker: ...This look on her always makes you hesitate. But... you know you have to ask.
content: Yes. My intuition tells me that no one should ever mess with you.

speaker: Rahu
content: I meant it as a compliment.
Oh, should I be flattered?
She opens her mouth to say something, but finally just shakes her head with a smile.
You look at her and begin slowly.

speaker: %u
content: By the way, there's one more thing on my list of required items. This one is a little complicated, and Paradeisos is not so generous this time.

speaker: Rahu
content: What is that?
The light on her face quickly fades away.

speaker: Rahu
content: ...What did they say?

speaker: %u
content: Nothing. Just that the transfer order was a system error, and that Paradeisos needs you. They want you back.

speaker: Rahu
content: Is that so...

speaker: Rahu
content: Hmm... I see.
Her voice changes, as if she's made some kind of decision. It makes you feel uneasy.
Her determination always reminds you of someone venturing alone into darkness. That's not what you intended.

speaker: %u
content: I won't let them have their way. You're a Sinner shackled by me who resisted the HUSH soldiers under my control. They should know better.

speaker: %u
content: Even if it means making some concessions, I'll keep you. They could always use some help from me.

speaker: %u
content: Did you seriously think I'd let you go so easily? Took me enough effort to finally reel in a Paradeisian.

speaker: Rahu
content: Are you saying that you expect me to repay you for doing all this?
Her tone changes, and the confusion in her pale silver eyes is gone. As you're observing her, she's also scrutinizing you.
Her gaze softens a little at your dumbfounded face.

speaker: Rahu
content: I can tell from your face that you don't mean that. You're smarter than that, Chief.

speaker: Rahu
content: It seems I'm always caught in some trouble whenever you see me. How embarrassing.

speaker: Rahu
content: What happened with Conrad was unexpected. I admit I made a blunder. I've always felt like I owed him. So I almost fell into HUSH's trap and did something stupid.

speaker: Rahu
content: Now that you're watching over him, I can finally rest easy.
You jerk up and grab her arm.

speaker: Choice
options: What do you mean by that?

speaker: %u
content: I didn't do all this just so you can be gone without worries. Don't do anything stupid.

speaker: Rahu
content: I understand. Don't worry. I haven't been faring too badly in Paradeisos, otherwise I would have died there four days ago.
She looks at you.

speaker: Rahu
content: I assume you're desperate for information about Paradeisos now. That's why you're so interested in a nobody like me.

speaker: Choice
options: I genuinely wish the best for you.

content: Rahu smiles. She's been smiling more lately.

speaker: Rahu
content: I'm glad you need this. I want to repay you.

speaker: Rahu
content: These days, I've taken on many tasks from Paradeisos. I've been taking note of the things I see.

speaker: Rahu
content: Not all Paradeisians are enemies, or should I say... If you consider them all as your enemies, you'll end up in a dead end.

speaker: Rahu
content: Although I can't yet tell who can be trusted, I know how to deal with certain individuals and who can help me.

speaker: Rahu
content: When the day comes that you need it, they might just be able to lend you a hand.

speaker: Choice
options: You're more reliable than I thought.

speaker: Rahu
content: After all, I've been through a lot.
She stays quiet for a moment, as if contemplating something. Lowering her gaze, slowly, she begins to speak in a soft voice you've never heard before.

speaker: Rahu
content: There have been times when I've gained more than I've lost... There were people who helped me, pulling me back from the brink of hell time and time again.

speaker: Rahu
content: The first person taught me to seek the light.

speaker: Rahu
content: The second person walked with me through darkness.

speaker: Rahu
content: And you... you showed me something other than pitch-black vengeance.

speaker: Rahu
content: I was once stripped of everything. You reminded me that there's more... I don't have to give up anything to move forward. I still have many important things worth protecting.

speaker: Rahu
content: Thank you for helping me break free from the curse. So...

speaker: Rahu
content: Let me return to Paradeisos, ${PlayerName}.
She lifts her head. Sunlight filters through the veil and illuminates the sickroom, clearing away all the shadows on her face.

speaker: Rahu
content: That's the path that suits me most.

speaker: Rahu
content: I've received a lot of help from you. This time, I'll return the favor.

speaker: %u
content: ...What do you mean by let you return to Paradeisos? Don't tell me you expect me to give you that terrible order.

speaker: %u
content: I'm not giving you that order. You'd be better off sneaking back on your own.

speaker: Rahu
content: Haha... You've ordered me to do way worse things. What difference will one more make?

speaker: Rahu
content: ...Then consider it a blessing.

speaker: Rahu
content: We're living in a time when we must see clearly ahead if we want to keep moving. I'll find my way.

speaker: Rahu
content: From now on, I'll be a nail you've hammered in Paradeisos. I may be silent for a long time, but someday, you'll hear my echo.

speaker: Rahu
content: Before that, give me your blessing. I want to protect all of you in my own way.
In a neat uniform and with her shield polished shiny, she comes to your desk.

speaker: Rahu
content: I should go now, Commander.

speaker: %u
content: I'll leave your MBCC position open. You can come back anytime.

speaker: %u
content: I'll take care of Conrad for you... Don't forget you're not alone. Here, at the MBCC... the doors are always open for you.

speaker: Rahu
content: Understood. And remember, no matter how difficult your path may be, there's always someone guarding you in the shadows.
She gives you her last soft smile, resumes her warrior posture, and turns to leave.
You call out to her. After a long pause, you speak.
She smiles and gives you a standard FAC salute.

speaker: Rahu
content: Best of luck to you too, ${PlayerName}.
Finishing her gesture, Rahu puts on her mask and confidently sets out on her new journey.
Nine months have passed since the end of the series of conflicts in West District.
During these nine months, Syndicate, a place once filled with chaos and violence, has gotten back on the right track.
Eastside's attitude toward this close neighbor is gradually shifting too. Understanding and cooperation are seemingly becoming the new trend.
Of course, DisCity hasn't been peaceful during this period either. The emergence of the dark web has wreaked havoc, becoming a new predicament for the city.
April. The Gray Mirror Vote incident. Over two thousand people were infected with Mania. Among them, about one hundred and fifty suffered severe mental trauma, which remains incurable to this day.
June. The Elysiland incident. More than ten people went missing and nearly three hundred were affected, resulting in severe detriment to society.
The anonymous nature of the dark web made the series of events in the first half of the year the talk of the town in DisCity.
Fortunately, the MBCC led the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center to defend against dark web attacks. The dark web hasn't made any major moves since June.

Peace and stability have consistently been the main theme of DisCity over these nine months. These minor incidents did not pose a substantial threat. They were nothing more than discordant interludes interrupting the long-lost tranquility. At least, that's what the vast majority of DisCity's residents believe.
But you are not one of them.
The peaceful July is already over. Toward the end of a short break at the end of the month, you say goodbye to Hecate, EMP, and Labyrinth, and return to the office to your usual work.
Bzzz.
A new email notification. You glimpse the sender: Nirvana Cybersecurity Center. You immediately open it.
Two minutes later, you let out a long sigh of relief.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You seem to be in a good mood, Chief.
Nightingale walks into the office and puts the coffee cup on your desk.

speaker: Nightingale
content: An update on the dark web investigation?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes. Got the answer from Cybersec. They're sending someone over. The technician who helped during the Elysiland incident. Apparently, she's a dark web expert.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Sinner Moore... I remember her. She's been very active in the recent dark web-related incidents. Indeed, she's the best choice when it comes to external help.
Nodding, you take a sip of coffee. This new unknown blend of coffee beans is unusually aromatic. You feel invigorated.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The email says she's arriving early tomorrow. I'll reserve the conference room.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you.
Nightingale glances at your nearly empty coffee cup and smiles.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Another cup?
You hand over the cup habitually and see Nightingale off.
