speaker: 9th
content: We've finally tracked down the source of the dark web and eliminated the uncertainty that's been plaguing us. The shackles of the mastermind have been broken too. You should let go of whatever premonition you have and just relax for a moment.

speaker: 9th
content: Or else... how can we face the upcoming war?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're right. It's just that...
You suddenly remember there's still a place you must visit.
[Transition to the Underground]
It's finally over
I can take some time off
So where should I go next?
The thoughts are suddenly interrupted by the image of that home, the fire, the burned car, the white sheet, and...

speaker: Henie
content: Who... are you...

speaker: Henie
content: It was you who took them away, wasn't it...

speaker: Henie
content: Where are they?! Bring them back! Give me back my kids!
[Black Screen]

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You said a part of you died in N.F. 110. It sounded... disgustingly genuine.

speaker: Moore
content: ...Hehe. Of course, I was only fooling you, silly.

speaker: Moore
content: Longing, guilt, or a belated sense of humanity... These things don't exist in me. It was only a line of code containing an error that I didn't bother to correct for years, which finally died just now.

speaker: Moore
content: Thanks for helping me spot this little anomaly. Well then...

speaker: Moore
content: The next time we meet, don't expect the same leniency, Chief.
[Hospital]
Back at the hospital, you see Granny Henie lying quietly on the hospital bed. You have not yet reached an agreement on whether to proceed with the surgery, and no one can make this decision for her.
And that murder command you intercepted back then... was somewhat different from what you'd imagined. It didn't contain any digitalized Mania either.
It couldn't even be called a command, for it was just a simple, plain message:
<size=44>Have a sweet dream, Granny Henie</size>
As wild geese herald spring's return, peace blossoms across the realm.

A month has passed since the Hazy Fete in a Daze. Though secluded today, the place where the wisteria tree once flourished in the city's heart retains its mysteries—those who pass by often speak of gentle breezes caressing their faces and ethereal laughter floating on the wind...
As for the participants of the Hazy Fete in a Daze, some were led for remedy, while others... were guided to their fateful destination.
You ask where their fateful destination is? Hehe...
Rows of fangs transformed into iron barriers, ensnaring souls in perpetual darkness; a crimson tongue coiled into thorn-laden tangles, binding them in an unfathomable abyss...
That fateful destination... naturally, it unfolded as...
You rest your hand gently against the door. In the depths of night, a muffled voice drifts from the other side, like bedtime stories whispered in drowsy ears.
Though the words are indistinct, you can hear the speaker's voice rising and falling with emotion, her tone so vivid that you can almost see the changing expressions on her face.
As you push the door open, the clamor of the crowd that had been held back by the door now washes over you like a tide.
The room is modest in size, with a raised platform at the end. Below it, fewer than ten small tables are arranged, yet every seat is filled, the atmosphere electric with excitement.
You find an inconspicuous corner and lean against a pillar to watch.
But the performer seems to sense something, slowly raising her downcast eyes. Her unbearably captivating gaze meets yours, enveloping you in both her voice and her presence.

speaker: Yugu
content: When catastrophe strikes, none shall escape unscathed. In these dark times, even heroes struggle to rise.

speaker: Yugu
content: The fierce tiger bares its bloodstained maw—but does it hunger to devour or desire to protect? And is this world truly in need of such a beast...

speaker: Yugu
content: Dear audience, what fate awaits beyond? That shall be revealed... when next we meet.
The taleteller's clapper strikes with a sharp crack. The audience falls silent for a brief moment before erupting into thunderous applause.
You join in with a few nonchalant claps. Amidst the cheering crowd, you watch as Yugu rises, dons her veil, and takes a graceful bow before quietly retreating from the stage.
Only after Yugu disappears backstage with her banner does the audience gradually rise and file out of the room.

speaker: Peddler A
content: Business is booming today! Ever since that taleteller came to Eastside, this place has been packed every night.

speaker: Peddler B
content: Yeah, but what's she even saying with all that fancy talk? Did you understand any of it?

speaker: Peddler A
content: Nope, not a word. Bet most of the folks here didn't either... What do they call this trend again...

speaker: Peddler A
content: Oh right, Eastia, that's it! Everything Eastian is all the rage in the city these days... Look over there—someone's so hooked, not even budging after the show's over!
You pretend not to hear them, clearing your throat and keeping your eyes fixed on the black curtain by the stage.
Moments later, the taleteller who had just held the audience spellbound lifts the curtain, approaching you with measured steps while gently fanning herself.

speaker: Player
content: The story seems to have ended quite hastily today.

speaker: Yugu
content: A good taleteller knows when to leave their audience craving for more. That's what makes a story truly captivating.

speaker: Yugu
content: So, did you make a special trip just to hear my story?
You shrug and say nothing.

speaker: Yugu
content: Did my humble performance today meet with your approval?
Yugu moves to your side and walks with you toward the door. Her veil conceals the markings near her lips, leaving only her eyes visible as she gazes at you.
Just as she did on stage.

speaker: Player
content: I picked up quite a few literary expressions from Eastia during the fete the other day.

speaker: Player
content: The locals from DisCity might have missed your hint, but I caught it for sure.

speaker: Player
content: MBCC is a tiger with a bloodstained maw, I see—

speaker: Yugu
content: Heh... You know that wasn't my intention at all. Though I must say, ever since the fete ended, I seem to spot you at every one of my performances.
Yugu quickens her pace slightly and opens the door before you can reach it.

speaker: Yugu
content: After all, I was the one who asked MBCC to "detain" me, all for the sake of learning this city's stories, was I not?
Outside, the streets of Eastside bustle with life. Inside, the "Eastian trend" lies dark and silent. For some reason, you can't shake the taste of conspiracy in the air.
You walk straight out through the door, offering a slight nod of appreciation.

speaker: Player
content: Since you're so eager to explore and learn DisCity's stories, why don't I show you around?

speaker: Yugu
content: Oh? Have you truly grown so fond of...

speaker: Yugu
content: ...my stories?
Yugu deliberately draws out her words, a playful smile dancing on her lips behind her veil.

speaker: Player
content: While you were deeply involved in the fete incident, the higher-ups are still pretty focused on keeping things smooth between DisCity and Eastia. That's why they ended up easing up on your movements.

speaker: Player
content: However, in certain situations, you just need to have a supervisor present.
You pull a pass from your folder and hand it to her, suggesting she think about where she'd like to visit.
Yugu accepts the pass without a glance and tucks it into her sleeve, then offers you a graceful Eastian bow.

speaker: Yugu
content: In every corner of the world, at every fleeting moment, countless tales unfold. Therefore, it is not the destinations that hold significance...

speaker: Yugu
content: ...but who accompanies me in unraveling these tales.

As the new year draws near, Eastside embraces the prevailing Eastian trend, with numerous locations adorned in traditional Eastian style. It appears as if the city is completely undisturbed by the recent wisteria incident.

speaker: Yugu
content: The people of DisCity possess quite a remarkable resilience.

speaker: Player
content: They trust us deeply despite the frequent unusual crises we encounter, which is why they can stay calm.

speaker: Yugu
content: Quite intriguing in its own right. Not a bad approach to weaving your own tale, I must say.
Yugu observes your surroundings with keen fascination, occasionally sharing her thoughts with you. Though her eyes burn with passion, her movements remain gracefully composed.

speaker: Yugu
content: My, what a sight—people braving the winter cold in such a long queue. What treasures could be worth such dedication, I wonder?

speaker: Player
content: Hmm... Looks like it's just an ordinary cafe. Maybe they're running some sort of limited-time collaboration event?

speaker: Player
content: Or... they've launched some weird new products that became the latest trend.
You make your way to the front of the line to check the sign, then return to Yugu with a grimace.

speaker: Player
content: It's not just a limited-time collaboration but also some kind of canned fish flavor product. Want to give it a try?

speaker: Yugu
content: Well, since we're here—

speaker: Player
content: Looks like you Eastians can be just as wild as DisCity folks sometimes.

speaker: Player
content: Despite different upbringings and environments, Eastians and DisCity people are human all the same. Human nature has a way of being remarkably similar everywhere.
Yugu gracefully makes her way to the end of the line, offering no response to your comment.
By the time you and Yugu emerge from the line, each holding a cup of coffee that's not exactly delicious but at least palatable, neither of you has spoken for a while.

speaker: Yugu
content: Could this truly be what the artist wanted—to have their name associated with such a flavor?

speaker: Yugu
content: And so the renowned artist could only watch helplessly as people splashed the dark liquid across their cups, staining the delicately colored artwork beneath.

speaker: Yugu
content: The people's faces twisted in displeasure, their smiles strained and hollow. Yet, having spent their hard-earned coins, they forced themselves to consume it all, allowing the flavor of long-dead, putrid fish to linger on their tongues.

speaker: Yugu
content: Lastly, beholding the piles of defiled artworks abandoned by the wayside, one could only utter a single word... of disgust.

speaker: Yugu
content: Heh... Whether it's the coffee, the canned goods, the artist, or the consumers... everyone meets a bitter end in this venture...

speaker: Yugu
content: I admire how you DisCity people so eagerly embrace your own "path to destruction."
Yugu offers a faint smile as she gently lifts her sleeve to cover her face before swiftly gulping down her coffee in a single motion.
You eye the coffee in your hand with a frown. Not wanting to waste food, you follow Yugu's lead and drink it all.

speaker: Player
content: At least... cough... at least this taste will probably stick in our memories longer than the artist's name. That's quite a unique experience in itself.

speaker: Player
content: And you know, when people buy their coffee and hold it in their hands, that moment of joy is genuine.
Yugu offers you a clean handkerchief. You accept it with a word of thanks.

speaker: Yugu
content: You always have such a novel way of perceiving the world.

speaker: Chief
content: Novel? I'd just say everyone sees things differently.

speaker: Yugu
content: Indeed, those are wise words.

speaker: Yugu
content: Even the same tale, when told through different eyes, will always yield a different effect.

speaker: Yugu
content: And you... you always guide these stories toward brighter paths.

speaker: Chief
content: I just try to make things a little better when I can.

speaker: Yugu
content: Thus, no matter how alike humans may be, different paths of growth will always lead to different stories.

speaker: Yugu
content: Nevertheless, humans are creatures of curiosity... Once they grow accustomed to peace and happiness, they begin seeking out novel, exhilarating experiences to script fresh chapters in their tales.

speaker: Yugu
content: And thus... we bear witness to such tragedies as that unpalatable cup of coffee, or those millennium eggs that make DisCity residents dread at the very thought of consuming them.
Yugu's gossamer veil sways with her graceful steps as she gazes at you, amusement dancing in her eyes.

speaker: Yugu
content: But you speak true... The taste of suffering lingers in our memories longer than anything else.

speaker: Chief
content: That may be right... But will those people truly feel the same way in the end? Let time work its magic.
Yugu pauses briefly at your words, yet her smile only grows wider.

speaker: Yugu
content: Heh... I too am curious to see what tale will unfold.

speaker: Yugu
content: And that is precisely why I came to DisCity...

speaker: Yugu
content: I've witnessed too many tales in Eastia to be satisfied anymore. DisCity, this metropolis at the heart of calamity... What narratives will it unveil before me, I wonder.
There's a hint of excitement in Yugu's voice as she eagerly anticipates seeing through your eyes what DisCity has endured in the years following the calamity.
She yearns to discover how the citizens here cope with their daily lives in this apocalyptic age, expecting to find beautiful madness in their survival.

speaker: Chief
content: Well... You might be disappointed then.

speaker: Chief
content: As you said, the people of DisCity might appear a bit too calm, in their own crazy way. They not only rave about absolutely horrible coffee, but also...
You point to something in the distance. Following your gesture, Yugu realizes that your casual stroll has led you to the area where the wisteria mania incident occurred.

Surprisingly, a crowd has gathered around the area still under cleanup operations. People are holding up their phones, taking selfies or photos for their friends amidst countless camera flashes lighting up the scene.

speaker: Yugu
content: My, my, Chief. Could it be you're still dwelling on the tale I shared? Why else would our little stroll lead us precisely here?

speaker: Chief
content: I actually had another official task today—besides delivering your pass, I need to assist FAC with their cleanup operations here.

speaker: Chief
content: After the incident, the Public Security Bureau and FAC launched a joint emergency operation to clean up the remaining Mania and debris, but for some reason, the containment protocols weren't properly implemented.

speaker: Chief
content: With the recent Eastian trend, curious citizens have been flocking here to take photos and post them on social media... Who would've thought a Mania incident site would become a tourist hotspot?
You ignore Yugu's teasing remarks and lead her toward the cleanup area.

speaker: Chief
content: Now that you have your pass, you're authorized to enter this area. Besides... You were involved in this incident anyway, so I thought maybe having you assist with the cleanup might help us better understand its origin?

speaker: Yugu
content: So, it falls upon whoever tied the bell to untie it? But do they not fear that I might orchestrate another magnificent spectacle?

speaker: Narration
content: You turn around and give her a casual, skeptical glance.

speaker: Player
content: If I could handle a story with two S-Class Sinners in hiding, I can certainly deal with one S-Class Sinner's "magnificent spectacle."

speaker: Yugu
content: I was merely jesting, no need to take it seriously... I found it curious that a simple stroll warranted supervision. So this was your design all along...

speaker: Yugu
content: I see you're quite skilled at expectation management as well.
Yugu gracefully adjusts her sleeves as she follows behind you, her gaze fixed on the people taking photos near the remnants of the Mania wisteria.
Perhaps due to her traditional Eastian attire, Yugu's presence creates quite a stir among the crowd.

speaker: Passerby A
content: Wow! Your outfit is so stylish! Did you dress up specially to take photos here?

speaker: Passerby B
content: Where did you get it? None of the shops in Eastside sell anything nearly as chic as yours!

speaker: Passerby A
content: Wait a minute... Are you Eastian? You have that elegant air about you, just like they show on TV!

speaker: Passerby B
content: Really?! Can I take a picture with you?
Catching your glance, Yugu gracefully cups her hands in an Eastian greeting as she addresses the gathering crowd.

speaker: Yugu
content: Please, accompany me to that spot. The lighting there is exquisite—it shall make for a most splendid photograph.

speaker: Narration
content: As Yugu leads the crowd away, you coordinate with the site supervisor while keeping an eye on her movements.

speaker: Narration
content: You open the supervisor's report and find several anomalies documented within.

speaker: Chief
content: So besides becoming a tourist hotspot, there are also remnants of the Mania entity wandering within the perimeter that can't be located?

speaker: Chief
content: Even after thorough cleanup operations, it keeps reappearing within the area...

speaker: Narration
content: You discreetly tap into your power to probe the area. Apart from the lingering wisteria Mania, you detect another Mania force gradually gathering in close proximity, then beginning its movement.

speaker: Narration
content: —And slowly drawing closer to you.
Chief, would you like to take a photo with me too?

speaker: Narration
content: The woman in traditional Eastian dress returns to your side with the photos, leaning in with a question. You redirect your gaze towards her and gesture at the report clutched in your hand.

speaker: Chief
content: Once we've handled these matters, and there's still time... I suppose I wouldn't mind following the trend and taking a photo with you here.

speaker: Yugu
content: Truly? What if I told you... taking a photo with me might reveal some rather unusual clues?

speaker: Chief
content: You already tried this trick with the little Wisp in your story. Are you going for an encore?

speaker: Narration
content: Despite your words, you take the photo from Yugu's hand to examine it closely: in the center stands the woman with dignified poise, surrounded by several young people in vibrant clothing.

speaker: Narration
content: And it's precisely because of this contrast that you notice something peculiar—between Yugu and the others, at their feet, there's an unexplained circular white shape.

speaker: Narration
content: Noticing that you've spotted the anomaly, Yugu hands you another photo—a candid shot someone took of her approaching you. In this photo too, the same white shadow appears beside her feet.

speaker: Chief
content: Turn your face slightly to the right.

speaker: Yugu
content: Like this?

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, taking the shot now!

speaker: Yugu
content: We are merely confirming a detail with a swift snapshot. Why the solemnity?

speaker: Chief
content: True enough, but there's nothing wrong with taking a nice photo. Let's make it a memento of today.

You return the camera to the young tourist and instruct the staff to escort her away and clear the area. Then, holding the photo, you give it a gentle shake. Under the sunlight, the image gradually comes into view.

speaker: Chief
content: Just as I thought, this one's no different.

speaker: Yugu
content: Indeed. Right beside my right foot is that round white shape.

speaker: Chief
content: It really is a little Wisp...

speaker: Yugu
content: How curious. By all accounts, you should have "concluded" all the characters from that story.

speaker: Yugu
content: To think that a little Wisp—its lingering will and power so faint that it couldn't even take shape—managed to endure the final "eruption"...

speaker: Yugu
content: Fascinating, truly fascinating... Following you always leads to the most intriguing tales.
Yugu holds the photo, resting her chin on her hand in contemplation.

speaker: Yugu
content: If memory serves me well, you mentioned an encounter with a similar little Wisp at the fete—one bearing a camera and photographs akin to these?

speaker: Chief
content: Right. If I'm the only one who can sense it now, and only this kind of camera can capture it...

speaker: Chief
content: Then the only missing piece to make it manifest... would be your power, wouldn't it?
Yugu nods, gently plants her long banner into the ground, and removes her veil.

speaker: Yugu
content: Dearest audience, allow me to regale you with... a most enthralling narrative.
Her voice, now unveiled, takes on a different tone, a mesmerizing melody that weaves through the air. As if guided by unseen strings, you find yourself drawn into yet another "tale."
While the surroundings remain unchanged—even the nearby staff members haven't turned to look—you both clearly see it: a small, round white shadow lying motionless among the ruins and debris.
You crouch down and clear away the debris, then reach out with a single finger to gently poke the ethereal form.

speaker: Chief
content: Wake up, little one. Are you still conscious?

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Uh...

speaker: Chief
content: Looks like it might still be conscious...

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Who... who's... what is this...

speaker: Chief
content: No more sleeping, little one. Wake up and see where you are.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Where? But I was at... at home... Huh?!
If with the darkness of night, you might be able to see more clearly how the misty white shadow trembles in shock. But even without a visible expression, its surprise is palpable.

speaker: Yugu
content: I'm afraid this place isn't your home, poor little one.

speaker: Yugu
content: Can you remember anything? For instance... why are you here?
Your presence beside Yugu evidently instills shock in the little one, causing it to instinctively back away until it bumps into some rubble.

speaker: Chief
content: Don't be afraid. We just want to figure out what's going on together with you. We mean you no harm.
You reach out your hand, offering it to the little Wisp as one would to a skittish kitten upon first meeting. Seeing this, Yugu kneels down and follows your example, extending her hand as well.
Perhaps sensing the similar power emanating from both you and Yugu, the little Wisp finally stops flinching and begins to speak in halting words.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: jojo

speaker: Little Wisp
content: First there was the smell of flowers, and then... then the sound of someone reading, and lots of... laughter...

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Then, then there were yellow-orange lanterns... the moon... and after that... after that...
The little Wisp grows agitated, circling in place and stirring up some dust around itself.

speaker: Yugu
content: Most Wisps are born from intense lingering attachments. Though they lack physical form or power, they often retain quite a few fragments of their memories.

speaker: Yugu
content: Take it easy. Give yourself a moment to remember.

As Yugu's soothing words reach the Wisp, you perceive her gradual release of power. As a spiritual remnant born from Mania and sustained by the same power, the little one eventually calms down and settles.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: After that... I walked for a long time... a very long time...

speaker: Little Wisp
content: I saw a fete... and a... huge tree, with the same scent of flowers I smelled...

speaker: Little Wisp
content: But then... there was a boom, a crash so loud, and shaking ground, fire...

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Everyone was crying... running...
You and Yugu remain silent, listening as the little one rambles through its memories.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: It hurt so much, like I was breaking apart into a thousand pieces. I floated around, trying to find somewhere safe. Right when I was almost gone...

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Something came down from the sky and wrapped around me. It got all dark, but the hurting wasn't as bad as before.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: And then... and then it was... just now, when you woke me up...
You glance beside the little one and spot a fragment of fabric nestled beneath the debris. Despite being worn and torn, the material and hue seem familiar—it appears to be the coat you usually wear.

speaker: Chief
content: Could it be from when I changed into that... whatever that mystical garment was...

speaker: Yugu
content: It appears that your benevolent spirit has influenced even your possessions, Chief. They too have embraced the art of offering refuge, mirroring your noble ways.

speaker: Chief
content: Perhaps that's not the only reason. As you mentioned, these beings are formed from lingering attachments. To survive that collapse, this one's desire must have been incredibly strong.

speaker: Chief
content: Do you remember what you were really attached to? You showing up here... could it be because of some unfinished business?
Your question is met with a long silence from the little Wisp. Finally, it trembles slightly before speaking in a halting voice.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Unfinished business... my unfinished business...

speaker: Little Wisp
content: I think... there was something I really wanted to do... but...

speaker: Little Wisp
content: What was it... Ugh!

A faint wave of Mania radiates from the little Wisp, causing the "flame" enveloping it to grow more violent. Both you and Yugu furrow your brows in concern as you sense the temperature abruptly spikes.
You stand up and exchange a meaningful glance with Yugu, who shakes her head slightly.

speaker: Yugu
content: It's not in a good state.

speaker: Chief
content: Yeah, I can tell.

speaker: Yugu
content: It was supposed to vanish with the illusion's collapse, yet through a curious turn of fate, it endured.

speaker: Yugu
content: However, it was exposed to an excess of Mania in this course of events, causing disruptions in its memories.

speaker: Chief
content: It's not just living in the illusion you created anymore. The situation has gotten a lot more complicated for it. I can see it's starting to show signs of instability, and I'm worried about what could happen next.

speaker: Chief
content: Even if you incorporate it into your stories now, there's no telling how its influence might affect you, adding another layer of unpredictability.
Seemingly oblivious to your words of worry, Yugu unfurls her fan with a flick of her wrist, partially concealing her face, her voice carrying a trace of delight.

speaker: Yugu
content: Heh, with you keeping such close watch over me, what mischief could I possibly get up to?

speaker: Yugu
content: Or perhaps... could it be that you are actually worried about me, Chief?

speaker: Chief
content: Since you're under MBCC's custody, it's my duty to ensure your safety.

speaker: Yugu
content: As MBCC's Chief, you wouldn't simply walk away from this situation, would you?

speaker: Yugu
content: Go ahead, tell me how you would like me to cooperate.

speaker: Chief
content: If I recall correctly, you mentioned that Wisps are manifestations of obsession. Once we find a way to resolve that obsession, it'll naturally fade away.

speaker: Chief
content: But given its current state, I think we've got our work cut out for us.

You take off your coat, turn around, and crouch down, gesturing for the little Wisp to hop in. The little one seems to recognize your coat as the same item that fell from the sky to protect it before. After a slight hesitation, it bounces right in.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: You... you'll help me, right?

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Help... help me find out... why I showed up here?
You give the little Wisp a gentle pat as your answer, then gesture toward Yugu beside you.

speaker: Chief
content: You see this lady? She's got some amazing power. When she tells stories, she can make you "see" them come to life.

speaker: Chief
content: So try your best to remember, piece together the elements of what happened, and tell us about it. We'll craft it into a story and see if it reveals the "unfinished business" that's keeping you here. How does that sound?

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Thank you... Thank you both, Mister and Miss!
female_content: Thank you... Thank you both, Misses!

content: Yugu gracefully waves her banner before planting it in the ground, then waits with composed patience for your signal.

speaker: Yugu
content: My, you certainly know how to command others. Yet, as you have offered me refuge, I shall naturally comply with your desires.

speaker: Chief
content: Whether they be wishes or regrets, they all stem from the same desire—to find closure.

speaker: Chief
content: In that case, all we need to do is figure out what binds it here, and help it find its closure.

speaker: Yugu
content: Sigh... Closure...
With a soft sigh, Yugu slowly lifts her veil. A mystical mist begins to gather around her—her unique Mania power manifesting to craft her a taleteller's sanctuary.

speaker: Chief
content: I've got my eyes on you—no tricks up your sleeve now.

speaker: Yugu
content: Pay me no mind, Chief. I am simply indulging in a moment of wistfulness.

speaker: Yugu
content: Unfulfilled wishes and lingering regrets from life become the anchors that bind souls after death.

speaker: Yugu
content: Even if we fulfill the desire of a lost soul, can its past life truly represent this present moment?

speaker: Yugu
content: Woe is me, for when I awakened from the shadows of a cold slumber, I found myself the sole bearer of the eternal river of time—embracing all, yet profoundly solitary.

speaker: Yugu
content: No one bears witness, no one takes notice, no one shares in my revelry—and so I alone shall redefine the spectrum of human emotions.

speaker: Yugu
content: Like a solitary bird, like a guttering flame, I know only to follow the path beneath my feet, ever forward... Until at last I realize my desperate awakening was all in vain, for wherever I turn lies nothing, nothing, and nothing.

The mist darkens into storm clouds that bear down upon you, trapping you in their embrace. Yugu's veil falls away completely, revealing a smile playing on her lips—but in her eyes, you see nothing but pure, unbridled frenzy.

speaker: Yugu
content: Perhaps... obliterating this world entirely might offer a more profound satisfaction.

speaker: Chief
content: The story... is yet to begin.

Perhaps sensing the warning in your voice, the swirling mist suddenly halts, its violent motion gradually softening. The woman before you reins in her power and turns her attention to the little one in your arms.

speaker: Yugu
content: Forgive me, little one. I allowed myself to be swept away... My heart merely yearns for "stories," nothing more.

speaker: Yugu
content: Come now, tell me... what do you remember of your lingering attachments?

speaker: Yugu
content: What made them... become your lingering attachments?

speaker: Yugu
content: In all the stories I have told, people's wishes and regrets always fall into the same motifs.

speaker: Yugu
content: Birth, aging, illness, death, yearning for what they cannot have, pains of facing what they despise, and parting from what they cherish.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu reclines against the banner, her folding fan resting lightly against her cheek as she studies the little Wisp with evident fascination.

speaker: Yugu
content: But you're a departed soul—your attachments could not have arisen from birth, aging, or illness.

speaker: Narration
content: The little being in your arms, already rattled by Yugu's Mania fluctuations, grows even more speechless under her scrutinizing gaze.

speaker: Narration
content: You cradle it gently as you begin asking questions, hoping to eliminate some possibilities.

options: Were you murdered in your past life?

speaker: Yugu
content: How about this, little one? I shall narrate a tale, and all you must do is respond with a simple yes or no.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu gently caresses her taleteller's clapper, her gaze lowered in contemplation.

speaker: Yugu
content: You were drawn into the Hazy Fete in a Daze... Your lingering attachment must be connected to that fateful star of calamity.

speaker: Yugu
content: I have wandered through all of Eastia, listening to myriad cries of sorrow and words of delusion beneath ill-fated stars. Surely I can piece together your unique tragedy.

speaker: Narration
content: A sharp tap echoes through the air as Yugu strikes her taleteller's clapper against the stone pavement. The sound cuts through your thoughts, drawing all attention to her presence.

speaker: Narration
content: The world around you is shrouded in shifting shadows, but as Yugu's words flow forth, reality slowly takes on new forms. It's as if she's not merely changing the world around you, but drawing you into her tale entirely.

speaker: Yugu
content: Lend your ears to this elegant verse, as I weave a tale of a beloved maiden—

speaker: Yugu
content: Within this narrative, there resided a mansion of opulent riches—adorned with vermilion gates and carved beams, crowned with gilded roofs and jeweled halls, encompassing expansive courtyards where ornate fountains danced, and housing vast chambers brimming with innumerable treasures.

speaker: Yugu
content: One blessed day, as divine light painted the heavens in splendor, a daughter was born to the household. From her first breath, she was showered with boundless affection, treasured like the rarest jewel by every soul within the estate.

speaker: Yugu
content: The young lady grew to be a vision of beauty, with features like delicate brushstrokes and skin like pristine snow. Born to privilege, she flourished amidst splendor—adorned each day with fresh jewels, clothed in the finest silks. Her table brimmed with the rarest delicacies and the freshest seasonal fruits.

speaker: Yugu
content: Such a blessed life of luxury, all the world's love lavished upon one soul... How it stirs such burning envy, makes one wish to tear flesh from bone, to take her place, or perhaps to crawl inside the moth...

speaker: Chief
content: Hold on, we're getting off track.

speaker: Narration
content: As the eerily lifelike mist begins to materialize the grotesque scene from Yugu's tale, you quickly put a stop to it.

speaker: Chief
content: So basically, this is about a child born into a wealthy family, living a happy life, cherished and doted on by her parents, right?

speaker: Yugu
content: Yes, little one. In the beginning, you must have had such a home of joy and warmth too, didn't you?

speaker: Narration
content: The little Wisp bounces happily in your arms, clearly delighted.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Yes, yes! That's right! I remember now!

speaker: Little Wisp
content: My home was just like she described! My mom and dad loved me so much!

speaker: Father
content: Yu, shall we read this story before bed tonight?

speaker: Father
content: It's about a kind person who saved an injured phoenix in the depths of winter. In return, the phoenix blessed their village with bountiful crops, ensuring that the people would never go hungry. Thus, the village became a paradise on earth.

speaker: Mother
content: You're going to grow up to be just as honest and kind, Yu.

speaker: Young Yugu
content: Yes, Mother! Please, please read me the story!

speaker: Yugu
content: Very well, I shall make note of this clue.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu taps her folding fan against her taleteller's clapper, and the sharp, clear sound draws your attention back to her.

speaker: Yugu
content: In this noble household, the loving couple lived in perfect harmony. Their daughter, upon first learning of human nature, witnessed how her parents treated each other with utmost respect. From them she learned that to receive kindness, one must first show kindness to others.

speaker: Yugu
content: They taught their daughter to look beyond social status, encouraging her to follow her heart's calling.

speaker: Yugu
content: And so the young lady made friends far and wide, regardless of their wealth or status. Each was a person of exceptional character and talent. They not only resonated with her passions but also embraced her essence—occasionally steering her away from frivolity and at times, listening attentively to her deepest musings.

speaker: Yugu
content: Her very being, it was agreed by all who knew her, infused their lives with immeasurable joy.

speaker: Narration
content: The little Wisp in your arms, moved by the tale, suddenly struggles free and rushes toward Yugu. You rub your eyes in disbelief as you watch the little Wisp, under Yugu's power, slowly take on a human form.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: That's exactly right! My friends were wonderful to me too!

speaker: Little Wisp
content: We supported each other, encouraged each other... They were truly wonderful friends!

speaker: Young Yugu
content: Mother, Father, what does it really mean to be happy?

speaker: Mother
content: Let me think... Happiness is being loved by your parents, cherished by your friends, enjoying delicious food, and finding comfort in good books. All these things can bring happiness.

speaker: Father
content: What made you ask such a question, Yu?

speaker: Young Yugu
content: My friend said happiness is something that makes you tremble with joy, but I feel like... I've never experienced that...

speaker: Father
content: Oh, sweetheart! That's because you're surrounded by happiness every day. You're just so used to feeling it.

speaker: Chief
content: From what we've seen, could your lingering attachment be to these happy memories from when you were alive?

speaker: Cyrus
content: So to help you find peace... would you like to see your parents and friends one last time?

speaker: Narration
content: The little Wisp wavers uncertainly, its response lacking its previous conviction.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: I... I'm not really sure. If what you said was true, I should have remembered what I wanted right away.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: But...

speaker: Yugu
content: Take it easy, little one.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu gently caresses the little Wisp, and her mesmerizing voice once again reaches your ears.

speaker: Yugu
content: Allow me to narrate the conclusion... then, you may delve once more into your memories...

speaker: Narration
content: Dark clouds roll in like an encroaching storm, and your hands instinctively clench—you know what kind of tale Yugu is about to unfold.

speaker: Yugu
content: Yet even as the maiden came of age, she had never found anything that brought true happiness to her heart.

speaker: Yugu
content: However, fate is a fickle master. One fateful year, the heavens themselves changed. Crimson clouds painted the sky as a massive star of ill omen plummeted to earth. The world descended into chaos as monsters arose, leaving devastation in their wake.

speaker: Yugu
content: Her parents sought to flee the chaos and calamity with their daughter, never imagining that the anguish and hardship they encountered would be forever etched in the maiden's eyes, settling deep within her heart.

speaker: Narration
content: Crimson light floods the heavens, while flames rage and blood spills, accompanied by piercing screams of torment and the chilling sounds of devouring—truly a hell on earth. This is no mere story, but a catastrophe that actually befell this world.

speaker: Yugu
content: When the protective walls her parents built around her crumbled, she ventured forth among the masses, their bodies and souls scarred by catastrophe.

speaker: Yugu
content: She offered food and medicine, bowing her head with feigned tenderness, all to hear their heart-rending tales. All to savor that exquisite agony that shattered her soul and sent shivers of dark pleasure through her body...

speaker: Servant A
content: Master! The young lady has returned! But—but!!

speaker: Father
content: You... you want to stay here?! With these monsters?!

speaker: Mother
content: What nonsense are you talking about, Yu? You...

speaker: Yugu
content: My mind is made up, Father.

speaker: Yugu
content: I know I have failed you both, betraying the years of loving care you have bestowed upon me, dear Father and Mother... Thus...

speaker: Narration
content: The daughter, kneeling formally before the steps, brandished a sharp dagger. With a resolute hand, she sliced open her abdomen, extracted a piece of bone, and carved out a chunk of living flesh.

speaker: Narration
content: A pitch-black mist howled like a beast as it enveloped her wound, licking at the edges of the cut.

speaker: Father
content: Monster... You're just like them! You've become a monster!!!

speaker: Father
content: You're not our daughter anymore!!!

speaker: Yugu
content: As I depart to pursue what I yearn for... I... can no longer linger by your side to bring you joy as a dutiful child... My sin is truly unforgivable...

speaker: Yugu
content: And so, I offer my flesh and bone... as my final...

speaker: Mother
content: Go now. I'll have someone gather your belongings and valuables.

speaker: Mother
content: I've always known you are bright and independent, with your own beliefs different from ours. If this is what you wish, then go pursue your path.

speaker: Mother
content: I only wish... that you would remember us.

speaker: Servant A
content: M-my lady... Master and Madam asked me to give this to you...

speaker: Servant A
content: After you left, they were... despondent day after day. In the end, they couldn't withstand the misfortune brought by that ill-fated star...

speaker: Servant A
content: On their deathbed, they entrusted this to me... asked me to deliver it if I ever found you... The household is no more now... My lady, I've fulfilled my duty, and it's time for me to go...

speaker: Narration
content: Inside the package left by the loyal servant, she found a blackened bone and a lustrous jade pendant.

speaker: Narration
content: Under the crimson-stained sky, where countless cries merged into one, her body trembled amidst her tears. Her limbs grew weak, and her heart felt as though it had been carved by knives.

speaker: Narration
content: Yet amidst the devastation, she broke into laughter—this was it, the sensation she had sought for years. Her soul trembled with an indescribable bliss, and never had she felt more viscerally alive than in that moment of ultimate revelation.

speaker: Yugu
content: I am indeed... a monster.

speaker: Narration
content: The woman murmured these words to herself, then gathered up her small bundle and turned back toward the inferno, stepping once more into that purgatory.

speaker: Yugu
content: Even the most enduring bliss and delight are ephemeral instants, merely casting faint imprints upon the surface of recollection.

speaker: Yugu
content: Only the agony of loss and the torment of regret can linger in the depths of memory, etching eternal scars.

speaker: Chief
content: So, you... wish to return to the time before the tragedy?

speaker: Chief
content: Or do you wish to prevent such tragedies from happening again?

speaker: Narration
content: The clouds cease their movement, and in an instant, the fleeing crowds and their screams freeze in place. Even breathing seems suppressed by some invisible force.

speaker: Narration
content: You feel your heartbeat accelerating as the shackles within your body begin to violently tremble, sending sharp pains through your nerves.

speaker: Narration
content: Beside you, Yugu raises her taleteller's clapper to her chest. With slightly reddened eyes, she begins to speak softly.

speaker: Yugu
content: No, what she truly desired was destruction...

speaker: Narration
content: A deep rumble suddenly explodes into being. Everything that was frozen lurches into motion as red light flashes through the air and the wind begins to howl like a mourning dirge.

speaker: Yugu
content: After all... not everyone yearns for a perfect ending where all live happily ever after together, isn't that right?

speaker: Narration
content: The little Wisp suddenly leaps from your arms. You instinctively rush to stop it, but it's already too late—like a calamity, it all happens in an instant.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu's whispers act like an igniting spark, stirring something within the Wisp. Like a ravenous beast, it greedily devours the surrounding Mania before transforming into a dazzling light that instantly envelops Yugu in its potent embrace.

speaker: Narration
content: The Wisp absorbs Yugu's power, growing increasingly stronger until it begins to overtake her presence. You can sense it merging with her, becoming one.

speaker: Chief
content: ...I knew it. Letting you tell stories would never end well.

speaker: Narration
content: The humming of the shackles still echoes in your mind, your vision blurring. Despite this, you clench your teeth in determination and sprint towards Yugu.

speaker: Chief
content: Maybe I should just take away your pass. If you're causing trouble right under my nose, who knows what chaos you'd create if I let you out of my sight?

speaker: Narration
content: The fact that the little Wisp only appears within the range of Yugu's power has already led you to a subtle realization—it's targeting her power, or perhaps... its very existence is tied to Yugu herself.

speaker: Narration
content: During the fete, the Wisps discovered Yugu's power to create "story worlds." Now it seeks to harness her power to craft a new tale—one where the world meets its destruction—and this narrative plays perfectly into Yugu's own desires.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu remains motionless within the ethereal mist, but the scene around her grows increasingly real as Mania seeps out. The explosions, the searing heat of flames, the screams of people—they all return, yet somehow different from before.

speaker: Narration
content: Some run naked through the streets, faces streaked with tears, muttering incomprehensible words as if having forsaken reason. Some clutch treasures looted from the ruins, holding them close even as flames sear their flesh as if these cold riches are their last hope for salvation.

speaker: Narration
content: Worse still, a group huddles together, their faces contorted and eyes wild with madness as they proclaim the coming apocalypse. This chaos becomes their stage to unleash humanity's most primal insanity.
They dance atop the ruins, raising cups and shouting, drinking wine mixed with dirt as the earth trembles and flames swallow them whole, reducing their forms to meaningless shadows.

speaker: Narration
content: The ground slowly ruptures, and every being in this world plummets into the abyss.

speaker: Narration
content: You walk through these scenes of madness step by step, until you stand at the edge of the final cliff, gazing at the sphere of light.

speaker: Narration
content: Red thorns of light swiftly coil around the luminous sphere, continuously compressing it inward.

speaker: Narration
content: You sense the power's struggle—it refuses to submit, determined to spread this "apocalypse" further.

speaker: Narration
content: You witness the Wisp transform into a near-transparent white figure, its limbs wrapped grotesquely around Yugu as it forces its fingers into her mouth, compelling her to continuously release her power.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: She is your Sinner... and the source of this devastation.

speaker: Little Wisp
content: Will you stand by and watch as her power drains away completely, letting this story become reality?

speaker: Little Wisp
content: You'll save her... right?

speaker: Player
content: This is your story.

speaker: Player
content: Whatever ending you choose, that's what it will become.

speaker: Player
content: I will only step in to stop you if you really threaten reality and public safety.

speaker: Player
content: You won't like how that feels... so...

speaker: Narration
content: The crimson thorns encircling Yugu and the Wisp grow increasingly dense, lashing out like savage claws against the nimble dark mist, blocking every path it attempts to break through.

speaker: Player
content: I suggest you stop "telling" this story about yourself, rather than trying again to manipulate me into acting out your tragic ending.

speaker: Player
content: Miss Yugu.
Your eyes gradually adjust to the light, as blurry patches of color slowly come into focus.
The apocalyptic scene around you dissolves like a fading mirage, while the sounds of explosions, screams, and crackling flames retreat like an ebbing tide.
In the silent interrogation room, surrounded by iron-grey walls, a single iron lamp casts its triangular beam across the table, illuminating both you and your subject, each drenched in sweat.

speaker: Chief
content: I must say, it's quite something to feel this exhausted from your "story" even when no one was actually coveting my Qi.

speaker: Yugu
content: It is a "story" after all—the most profound experience comes from complete immersion.

speaker: Yugu
content: How else could it feel so authentic?

speaker: Chief
content: So authentic that it turned into a "life or death situation."

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu leans back in her chair, tilts her head back, and lets out a soft laugh.

speaker: Yugu
content: I shall take that as a compliment.

speaker: Chief
content: I stepped into your "story" the moment I entered this interrogation room, didn't I?

speaker: Chief
content: It all started with that unfinished tale of yours, where you painted MBCC as a ferocious tiger.

speaker: Yugu
content: You knew from the beginning?

speaker: Chief
content: ...Of course.

speaker: Chief
content: You're such a great storyteller. When I came in, I couldn't help but wonder what story you'd come up with this time.

speaker: Chief
content: For that, I'm willing to see where your narrative leads.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu seems pleased with your response as if having received applause. Her eyebrow arches elegantly as a subtle smile plays across her lips.

speaker: Yugu
content: So trusting of me this time, are you?

speaker: Yugu
content: Yet you absolutely refused to play your part in my script during the fete.

speaker: Option
options: I'm not following it this time either.

speaker: Chief
content: And that's precisely why we "meet" here again.

speaker: Narration
content: You pinch the bridge of your nose before reaching for the documents on the table, leafing through several pages.

speaker: Narration
content: As it turned out, finding information about Yugu wasn't difficult. You had your contacts at the Eastian delegation conduct a thorough investigation.

speaker: Narration
content: A wandering taleteller known for her tales of tragedy and calamity, she is as famous as the spiritual myths that drift through the alleys of Eastia.

speaker: Narration
content: Though the information is fragmentary, you've managed to piece together enough for a dossier that would satisfy an interrogation.

speaker: Chief
content: The Wisp... is you, right?

speaker: Chief
content: Or should I say... the past you?

speaker: Narration
content: The records match what you have learned: she came from the happiest of families, sheltered like a hothouse flower from all suffering. Yet when calamity struck and her family tried to flee, she chose to face it head-on—a decision that led to the destruction of everything she held dear.

speaker: Narration
content: No one understood why she made that choice. Even her parents were deeply bewildered, though they eventually let her go.

speaker: Option
options: Can I ask what drove you to this path?

speaker: Chief
content: What really made you...

speaker: Yugu
content: To be honest with you... this is the first time I have included myself into one of my tales.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu cuts off your question and takes the liberty to speak on her own.

speaker: Yugu
content: I've chased after calamities and Corruptors, listening to countless tales that would bring anyone to tears of grief and anguish.

speaker: Yugu
content: I wove them into stories and spread them far and wide. People fail to comprehend—they see me as an ill omen, unable to fathom why I have chosen such a path.

speaker: Yugu
content: Hehe... Why seek so many reasons, though?

speaker: Yugu
content: It's simply because... what makes my soul shatter and my body tremble isn't happiness, nor is it the so-called love... but rather the tragedy that erupts when both are destroyed...

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu's shoulders quiver slightly as if savoring the tragic ending of the story woven from her memories.

speaker: Yugu
content: In these chaotic times, I once lived a false life—treating happiness as commonplace and mistaking my sheltered paradise for the whole world, all thanks to my family's wealth and influence.

speaker: Yugu
content: Yet in this vast world beyond, wounds, flesh, and tears—these are the essence of reality! They are what genuinely stir one's soul, making my very marrow burn with excitement!

speaker: Yugu
content: My heart aches and pulsates with exquisite agony... Ah... This! This is what elevates a tale to true sublimity, deserving to be preserved and recounted for generations to come!

speaker: Yugu
content: The supposed happy endings and joyful plays are mere fleeting illusions of peace, fading with time. It is when the most exquisite things are shattered and obliterated, with the agony lived through and engraved in memory... It is only then that people will recall the taste of blood on their tongues, like a sweet kiss of a blade.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu is lost in ecstasy, and the Mania in the interrogation room seems to resonate with her emotions, threatening to manifest another "story."

speaker: Narration
content: Crimson thorns flash through the air as you suppress Yugu's growing agitation.

speaker: Narration
content: Though visibly displeased, the subject in the interrogation chair straightens her posture and continues to comply with your investigation.

speaker: Yugu
content: However... my narratives are but reflections of what I have observed, tales woven from the experiences of others.

speaker: Yugu
content: It can never truly capture that deep, personal agony...

speaker: Chief
content: So that's why you wrote yourself into a story—to experience your own tragedy?

speaker: Chief
content: But you also wrote me into it. You should've known since the fete that I would never stand idly by in the face of suffering.

speaker: Yugu
content: Indeed... Akin to all, you too harbor a fondness for happy endings.

speaker: Yugu
content: Despite recognizing the individual before you is distinct—a soul drawn to tragedy, embraces chaos, and craves the world's demise—you would extend a hand to rescue me.

speaker: Yugu
content: Just like a saint.

speaker: Narration
content: Her sudden frankness leaves you at a loss for words. Watching your expression, Yugu purses her lips, barely containing her obvious delight.

speaker: Chief
content: ...When I save someone, I don't judge them based on who they are.

speaker: Chief
content: Your stories are too dangerous. As your appointed "supervisor" in custody, it's my duty to prevent things from escalating further.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu raises her hand slightly and draws her veil halfway down—no surge of Mania emanates from the surroundings, signaling to you what this gesture stands for.

speaker: Narration
content: No storytelling tricks, no imagined scenarios—what follows will be her true words, her genuine thoughts, expressed in their most direct form.

speaker: Yugu
content: That is why I chose to weave you into my tales.

speaker: Yugu
content: You have experienced and witnessed countless tragedies. Though you know the path ahead is fraught with hardship, you still strive to grasp what little hope remains in this world, yearning for its survival.

speaker: Yugu
content: I wonder, how far would you go to fulfill that desire?

speaker: Yugu
content: If one day you were to lose your life in this pursuit, what tragic fate would befall this world?

speaker: Yugu
content: Around you, a plethora of stories could unfold... And almost every one of them leads to the tragic endings I so adore.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu gazes at you as if you were her favorite character come to life—torn between preserving your essence and yielding to her urge to mold you into someone who would perfectly satisfy her desires.

speaker: Yugu
content: Throughout my extensive journeys, I have encountered numerous individuals like you—honorable souls embodying true humanity.

speaker: Yugu
content: Yet... when it comes to someone who could genuinely embrace me and forge such a deep bond with me...

speaker: Yugu
content: You emerge as the only one.

speaker: Narration
content: The last words are spoken with tender intimacy, yet they send a cold shiver down your spine.

speaker: Narration
content: You recall her earlier story, and realize that more than the MBCC she painted, she herself is like a tiger lurking in the shadows, bearing its fangs, viewing you as dying prey awaiting consumption.

speaker: Narration
content: Yet you willingly choose to be this tiger's feast.

speaker: Narration
content: You fidget with your pen cap, clicking it open and shut. The sound echoes through the interrogation room.

speaker: Chief
content: Like many others, I really dislike feeling tired, I struggle with tough times, and I absolutely love vacations.

speaker: Chief
content: It's just that I accepted these powers bestowed upon me by someone unknown.

speaker: Chief
content: These powers came at a price. Countless lives paved this path with their flesh and blood. And I... have already started walking down it.

speaker: Chief
content: On this path lie fates far worse than my own death, but I will do everything in my power to prevent them.

speaker: Narration
content: You pick up a notebook from the table—it's Yugu's record of stories. The previously nameless cover now bears the title Once Upon A Spring Eve, written in elegant Eastian script after the fete.

speaker: Narration
content: You turn to the last written page, which details the events of that night at the fete.

speaker: Chief
content: Humans are greedy, arrogant, and pleasure-seeking. As you said, once they grow accustomed to happiness, they descend into maddened despair when disaster strikes.

speaker: Chief
content: But you still underestimate "humanity"... You underestimate their pursuit of happiness.

speaker: Chief
content: Some are stubborn enough to attempt reversing time itself, while others willingly give their lives for this cause.

speaker: Chief
content: Even in the face of catastrophe, you'll see lovers in a tight embrace and children nestled in their parents' arms. Even among strangers, if you seek comfort, someone will hold you close as you face the end together.

speaker: Narration
content: You uncap your pen and, clumsily mimicking Yugu's handwriting from the previous pages, add a few words in Eastian script after the story of the fete: "To be continued."

speaker: Chief
content: So you see, your sought-after "spectacle of humanity's madness as their world crumbles" is actually people's final expression of the very happiness you despise.

speaker: Chief
content: No matter what, this world will not end in despair—and even if it does, I still hope that everyone experiences at least one moment of happiness before the end.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu falls silent, her unwavering gaze fixed upon you as if trying to peer into your very soul.

speaker: Narration
content: After a long silence, you hear her break into stifled laughter.

speaker: Yugu
content: I'm thrilled... that you still hold true to these beliefs.

speaker: Yugu
content: Thank you for writing "To be continued" for me, but... I think it's time I start a new volume.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu rises slightly and reaches for a new notebook lying on the table, taking it into her hands.

speaker: Yugu
content: Heh... I know full well that if destruction were to befall this world, you would pour every ounce of your strength into saving it.

speaker: Yugu
content: You possess a natural inclination to rescue others. With you in existence, this world will forever hold the promise of revival.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu gazes at you as emotion-laden words flow from her lips, stirring the Mania and weaving your powers together.

speaker: Yugu
content: The perfect shall shatter, and happiness shall fade.

speaker: Yugu
content: Yet you and those like you never cease gathering fragments of hope.

speaker: Yugu
content: Your existence will lead all my tales down different paths...

speaker: Yugu
content: And perhaps... because of you, I too shall find my place within these narratives.

speaker: Narration
content: Yugu gently channels her power, letting it caress your hands and back like a gossamer touch as if giving you an ethereal embrace across the void.

speaker: Yugu
content: Your future is inscribed with countless tribulations, nearly equivalent to living through the end of the world...

speaker: Yugu
content: But until that time comes, please allow me to remain by your side.

speaker: Yugu
content: I accept your restraints on me and await your command. For your prosperous reign, I shall fulfill any request you make of me.

speaker: Yugu
content: Even if it means bringing your vision of a beautiful world to life.

speaker: Yugu
content: Yet I shall persist in waiting, observing for the final chapter to unfold... For I am, above all, a teller of tales, and I do love... a perfect tragedy.

speaker: Chief
content: What matters to me is never the ending, but rather every moment along the way.

speaker: Chief
content: Living each moment with a clear conscience, one after another... I believe that will lead me to a worthy ending.

speaker: Chief
content: And even if I don't succeed, that's fine too.

speaker: Chief
content: If the doom is destined, I'll make sure I'm the last one standing. Whatever comes after that... well, who cares?

speaker: Yugu
content: Heh... Fate is the greatest playwright of all. Who knows what dramatic twists await you?

speaker: Yugu
content: Just thinking of all the possible plot threads makes my veins tingle with thrill.

speaker: Chief
content: In that case, stay close to me.

speaker: Chief
content: Only in this way can you witness everything firsthand and experience a story that involves you as well. Isn't that what you want?
Yugu dons her veil once more and offers you a graceful bow, every bit the picture of a demure Eastian lady. Yet you can see the madness lurking in her eyes—and you've chosen to embrace it fully.

speaker: Yugu
content: Naturally... Chief.

speaker: Yugu
content: From this day forward, I shall remain by your side, unwavering until death.

In August of N.F. 115, the combined efforts of multiple forces finally destroyed BR-005. EDGE covertly recovered the suspected Underground inheritance, securing it under maximum custody. With that, the anomalous Tides of Ashes ceased, and the farland forces requested a ceasefire. The specter of war that had loomed for nearly a year finally dissolved.

But EDGE found no peace in victory.

In the wake of the BR-005 crisis, EDGE moved with unsettling speed. Using unknown means, they re-concealed the BR-003 suspended in the sky. Orders flashed to FAC, the 9th Agency, MBCC, and others: intensify sweeps of Black Ring ruins and hunt the suspicious.

They were watching for the Underground, as if it were a terror eclipsing war itself.

Two days later, the hunt yielded its first catch.

Unidentified Mania fluctuations pulsed along the contamination trail of BR-005's migration. A joint operation was immediately launched, tracking the signal to a single, suspicious figure hiding within the blighted zone.

The pursuit proved punishing, not just because of the complex contamination saturating the tear zone...

August 25, N.F. 115
DisCity
WhiteSands
BR-005 Ruins
Bang, bang, bang—BOOM!!

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Target's broken loose, vector 3 o'clock! O26's in position! We're pushing him that way—thirty meters! Get ready to intercept and—
As the order is still being spoken, the target is already pivoting. He narrowly dodges the paralysis rounds fired from O26's automated turret, then raises his own weapon in reply.

His precise shots—somehow placed through the chaos of gunfire and cover—hit O26's critical systems. The turret shudders and dies. With an easy vault over the disabled machine, he disappears. Beside the monitors, the commander is left slack-jawed.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: ...His anticipation is perfect. Was the op compromised? No. He's read our tech and tactics before we even move. He knows us.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Outland infiltration? Or a turncoat from inside?
Your eyes flicker across the combat data logs, then the grainy footage from the field. Static washes over the feed, but you lock onto a detail in the enemy's movements.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Those aren't standard rounds, more like some Mania contamination. He's manipulating the ambient contamination in the ruins. Clearing paths, sealing routes. It's too fluid.
—You switch to the Mania scanner.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The signature isn't Sinner-derived... If this reading's right, it's likely some <color=#fb9259>Underground sorcery</color>. But why's his movement pattern...
You don't get to finish. Your own words—certain keywords, already out—have just tripped the security alarm.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: An <color=#fb9259>Undergrounder</color>?! This is bad! The 9th Agency is exposed!

speaker: FAC Captain
content: All units, listen up! The target could be from the Underground, capable of sorcery-based contamination manipulation! Ambient contamination is his weapon!

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Non-Mania combat units, do not engage solo! I repeat, do not engage solo! This is extreme risk!

The warning comes a few seconds too late. Across the way, an agent, codenamed <color=#fb9259>Thorn</color> from the 9th Agency, has already abandoned his cover. For years, he's survived the brutal front lines against the Underground. His experience is vast, his resolve unshakable, and it's focused entirely on the present moment.
Surveillance was the assignment, but it no longer matters. He has already chambered a round, his aim steady on the approaching target.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: It's Underground sorcery! "Thorn," fall back!! You're getting yourself killed!!

speaker: 9th Agency Combatant
content: No... That's one of those Underground bastards. I'm not letting him slip through!

Thorn charges out, gun blazing. Rounds strike the suspect squarely in the chest, yet the lethal barrage only tears through the man's outer garment. As the fabric shreds, something tumbles from the suspect's chest pocket, catching Thorn's eye.

It's a thin fragment of red crystal. It slices through the contaminated air as it plummets. One glance is all it takes; Thorn's pupils dilate in shock. He lunges, reaching out, but his fingers close on empty air. The crystal shatters against the ground instantly, lost in the swirling dust and sand.
A brief, profound silence cuts through the chaos of the battle.

speaker: 9th Agency Combatant
content: ...That belongs to <color=#fb9259>him</color>. Why do you have it?

speaker: 9th Agency Combatant
content: ...Did you kill him...?

speaker: 9th Agency Combatant
content: Did you kill <color=#fb9259>Rust</color>, you son of a *****?!!

His rage erupts. In a zone this saturated with Mania, such fury is a flashfire to a soldier's reason. Thorn charges in, a reckless blur through the contaminated air, hell-bent on tearing his enemy apart.

The man across from him hesitates for a moment, then holsters his gun and raises his hand. A red mark sears into the palm of his leather glove, and instantly, the surrounding contamination surges to life. Half of it weaves into a net before him, while the other half lashes out like tendrils, coiling around Thorn's protective boots and yanking him off balance. Thorn crashes hard to his knees.
He refuses to yield. Even grounded, he fires shot after wild shot. In that moment, he feels a presence from behind as another figure vaults over him and charges ahead.

speaker: Thorn
content: Chief?!
Your sudden arrival freezes them both. Reacting first, the "Undergrounder" casts a sorcery—not in front, but behind you, catching Thorn's already-committed bullets in a wall of swirling corruption.

That's all the confirmation you need. Your eyes, attuned to Mania's flow, see past the spectacle. None of the "sorcerer's" attacks were meant to connect. They were misdirection. Thorn is untouched. His recklessness has become a trap, and the "Underground sorcerer" is the one who's been cornered.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...The openings are too obvious.

With that thought, you accelerate, aiming yourself like a projectile at the swirling wall of contamination separating you from your target. A heartbeat from impact, it tears open, a perfectly timed exit you fully anticipated.

speaker: Undergrounder?
content: Ugh...

The ruins' own contamination empowers you as well. From two meters out, your shackles lash forward, spearing the murky air to plunge deep into his body. You don't stop moving. Your momentum carries you into him, crashing him to the ground and pinning him down with your full weight.
It's shockingly easy.
He offers no resistance. Once pinned, he just lies there, resigned. He even begins to catch his breath.
Your shackles continue to pulse with agitation, their red glow undimmed. It illuminates half of his face: deathly pale, and smiling.

speaker: Undergrounder?
content: Heh... As brave and reckless as ever.

The voice is unfamiliar. The face, one you have never seen. Yet in an instant, a tremor passes through your shackles—a jolt that stirs fragments of memory buried deep within. They rise to the surface, sharp and achingly familiar.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Who are you?

He offers no answer, only a cryptic smile as his eyes shift to a point just over your shoulder. Your reaction is a fraction of a second late. A blurred figure clears you in a vault, and the hardened stock of a rifle crashes into the captive with brutal force.

speaker: Thorn
content: Let go!
BWAK!
[Black Screen]

The manhunt is a success. The captive is a confirmed Sinner—and one who wields Underground sorcery, no less. This revelation draws considerable attention.
"Thorn," the 9th Agency operative instrumental to the operation, insists on participating in the man's interrogation.

You politely but firmly decline every request.
Before a more rigorous interrogation can begin, there are personal matters you need to confirm with <color=#fb9259>that person</color>. Alone.
When you see him again, his wounds have mostly healed, far faster than any normal person could recover.

speaker: Stranger
content: Hello, Chief. You look well, much better than before. It's good to see.

The man sits across from you in the sterile glare of the interrogation room. His unnervingly radiant smile only accentuates the impression of a corpse's grin. You find yourself mentally reviewing the cold facts again:
A face you've never seen. A voice you've never heard. DNA that returns no match in any database, civilian or covert.

speaker: Stranger
content: Alright, let's get this over with. What do you want me to explain? BR-005? Mania contamination? Underground sorcery?

speaker: Stranger
content: I hope I haven't caused you too much trouble. Wouldn't want to cut into your downtime.
He's playing the cooperative role. You pick your first question.

speaker: Stranger
content: Suspect, spy, Underground madman... pick one. Your colleagues have been very polite about it.
...Heh. You shrug.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do people call you? Friends, family, enemies, and what do you call yourself?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I want to know your <color=#fb9259>real name</color>.

speaker: Stranger
content: Not everyone has a name, Chief ${PlayerName}. And not everyone has someone who remembers them.

speaker: Stranger
content: So call me whatever you like. I'd be honored.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is that so? Then I'll call you...
The man tilts his head, playing the connoisseur.

speaker: Stranger
content: A bit rough around the edges, isn't it? I was hoping for something more dashing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It came to me as soon as I saw you. I think it fits.

Your gazes lock. Eyes betray more than words ever could; in that silent exchange, mutual assessment is instantaneous. He recognizes you—this much is clear. His demeanor is amicable, yet deliberately reserved. For your part, you make no secret of your probing intent.
The charade ends. You simply hand him a document.

[Personal File: "Rust"]

Classification Level: A

"Rust" was recruited as an informant by 9th Agency operative Thorn in Eastside. Following severe Mania corruption during a support mission in N.F. 106, he was withdrawn from service for intensive treatment.
Operations recommenced in N.F. 107. Under directive from upper management, he was reassigned as a stationed informant in the West District. Primary duties involved monitoring Mania-weapon trafficking within the Inner Bay area and observing suspect activities of Rustfire.

During this tenure, he sustained regular contact with "Thorn". All activities are logged. No anomalies have been identified through subsequent audit cycles.

In N.F. 112, authorization was granted for his involvement in special operations targeting crypts in the West District outskirts. He provided advance warnings of the risks posed by Parma. While only partially implemented, these warnings were later validated. Proactive measures by FAC, informed by his intelligence, contributed to containing the BR-004 crisis. This outcome facilitated the 9th Agency's subsequent negotiations with FAC to secure control of the MBCC.

Post-transfer, operational protocols for "Rust" were substantially eased. He was granted autonomous operational status with direct reporting channels to Intelligence Director Langley Blackett. At his personal request, he continued his post at the Inner Bay Drifter Camp, maintaining solitary surveillance of Rustfire. Though certain intelligence was selectively reported during this phase, he delivered critical, timely briefings on Underground plots and potential locations of Corpus 002, providing material support to the MBCC Chief's anti-Mania operations.

After the Rustfire riot in April, N.F. 113, he was repeatedly tasked to assist EDGE in recovery operations for the missing MBCC Chief. While he supplied the requested intelligence, all search initiatives concluded without success.

In November N.F. 113, preceding the High Tower Black Ring operation, "Rust" declined participation in a scheduled EDGE search operation for the first time. He subsequently ceased all communication. His last recorded position indicated an entry into the active BR-002 contamination zone.

speaker: Stranger
content: Hmm... A low-level informant recruited by the 9th Agency. The records are surprisingly thorough. I'm impressed.
He flips to the next page.

speaker: Stranger
content: Intelligence operations continued until November of N.F. 113, right around the time the High Tower Black Ring erupted in the West District. Then he went dark...

speaker: Stranger
content: He must be dead by now. Are you grieving for him?
He offers a smile as he slides the documents back across the table to you.

speaker: Stranger
content: There's no need for that, Chief. This was the 9th Agency's failing.

speaker: Stranger
content: For assets like this, everything is strictly compartmentalized. Even if they die, word wouldn't—and shouldn't—reach your ears.

options: What can I do? I already know.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: And I want to know more.

[Death Report: "Rust"]

Classification Level: A

In December of N.F. 113, cleanup operations at the West District High Tower Black Ring ruins reached a temporary conclusion.
Among the recovered remains of former Rustfire insurgents—most killed during BR-002's berserk state—one male corpse, found near the former Black Ring core, was flagged as anomalous.

The body exhibited extreme trauma, originating not from the Black Ring or Corruptors, but from a series of exquisitely precise and brutal Mania sorceries. Forensic analysis identified nearly twenty distinct types, all classified as Underground sorcery, administered by multiple perpetrators.

Evidence confirms the subject endured prolonged torture. The perpetrators deliberately sustained his biological functions to facilitate profound psychological devastation.
Termination occurred only when the High Tower Black Ring began exhibiting anomalous activity, immediately prior to the destruction of BR-002.

A preliminary identification was made by Agent "Thorn" based on a unique Mania-crystalline residue recovered from the remains. Biometric verification confirmed the deceased as the missing operative, "Rust".

All prior charges of defection against "Rust" have been formally rescinded. His operative status is reinstated; his death is registered as an honorable sacrifice.
However, all related data has been sealed under direct orders from the 9th Agency command.

Ring researchers have claimed the remains for study of the inflicted Underground sorceries. "Rust's" operative records have been expunged from active databases. He will rest in silence—as a Rustfire insurgent, another anonymous casualty of the High Tower Black Ring.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: He cared a great deal about his partner. He's never come to terms with it being a cold case. Spent the last two years digging for answers, and for whoever's really responsible.

The man studies the photographs. The remains are mutilated beyond recognition—images so profoundly grotesque that they have, on more than one occasion, overwhelmed even you. His expression, however, remains flawlessly composed. After a moment, he lifts his deathly pale face and turns it toward you.

speaker: Stranger
content: ...Then calling me by that name would only make things worse, wouldn't it?

speaker: Stranger
content: That agent, "Thorn," is convinced I killed his partner. That "Rust" died at the hands of an <color=#fb9259>Undergrounder</color>—me.

speaker: Stranger
content: To have his comrade's life taken, and then his name stolen by the same person... It will be devastating.
You look at him.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What Thorn needs is the truth. The truth about what happened to "Rust."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you're feeling charitable and don't want to upset him, then tell me everything. I'll pass it along. Might give him some peace.

speaker: Stranger
content: You're asking an Undergrounder for the truth?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Corruptors, Puppets, humanoid monsters like Parma... my shackles have touched them all. That sickening sensation is something I will never forget.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you're nothing like them. You're a <color=#fb9259>Sinner</color>, with a unique constitution that lets you operate inside a Black Ring. It's why my shackles can stay within you.

speaker: Stranger
content: Perhaps you simply haven't met enough of my kind.
