content: Negotiations?
You skip all the niceties and go right for the heart of the matter, leaving Jones momentarily taken aback.

speaker: Jones
content: I don't quite follow you...

speaker: Donald
content: Drop the pretense. You're well aware of our purpose here.

speaker: Donald
content: Bring Margaret out, process her hospital transfer, and do it quick. We don't have all day.

speaker: Jones
content: Margaret, is it... Heh, interesting...
Jones removes his glasses, giving them a quick wipe.

speaker: Jones
content: Haha, Chief, are you interested in hearing what your Sinner has to say?

speaker: Jones
content: Time to face reality. A fugitive from Nirvana, swaggering into Banyan Fourth Hospital to lay down conditions with me?
Whatever he says, consider it coming from me.
The director stares intently at both of you. Following a brief, tense silence, he suddenly erupts into loud laughter.

speaker: Jones
content: ...Hahaha.
Jones theatrically dabs at his eye, as if he's just heard the funniest joke ever.

speaker: Jones
content: Let's cut to the chase, Margaret is definitely in our custody...

speaker: Jones
content: But on what grounds do you reckon you're in a position to bargain with me?!
Behind, the towering nurse steps forward, a threatening glare on his face.

speaker: Jones
content: Taking Margaret with you? Sure, but this guy stays behind...

speaker: Jones
content: I'm sure you know the high price on his head. Nirvana will be thrilled...

speaker: Donald
content: Heh, sorry, I'm not keen on returning to your creepy joint.

speaker: Jones
content: The minute you entered the Fourth Hospital, you lost control of the situation.

speaker: Jones
content: Das managed to keep your last visit a secret, but this time, you won't have the same luck.
Upon hearing that, Donald retreats a step, ducking behind you.

speaker: Donald
content: So, is the Fourth Hospital thinking of making a move on the MBCC Chief?

speaker: Jones
content: Not at all. Given the Chief's present standing, who'd dare make a move on him?
female_content: Not at all. Given the Chief's present standing, who'd dare make a move on her?

speaker: Jones
content: But capturing a criminal on Nirvana's most-wanted list doesn't sound all that difficult, right?

speaker: Jones
content: Sure, as an S-Class Sinner and with the MBCC Chief in tow... if you really insist on leaving, stopping you might be beyond us.

speaker: Jones
content: Just remember, the aunt you're dying to bust out is still in our clutches.

speaker: Jones
content: See, Syndican, it's your call now—scurry back with your Chief and wait for the bad news about the old woman...

speaker: Jones
content: Or, like ten years back, be the hero again, swapping your freedom for your aunt's?

speaker: Jones
content: Go ahead, decide.
This director's face is plastered with a sickening grin, seemingly certain of his triumph.
Yet, Donald just lets out a low chuckle.

speaker: Donald
content: Sorry, pal, I'm not keen on either option.
Jones's expression turns stormy in a flash.

speaker: Jones
content: Heh, that's quite the bummer...

speaker: Donald
content: Easy there, tiger. Curious why I knew it was your trap but still waltzed right into it with Chief in tow?

speaker: Jones
content: I don't need the details. What matters is you shot down my proposal...

speaker: Donald
content: Ah, hold up! It's not me turning you down; you're the one who's dissing our proposal.

speaker: Donald
content: Remember what we said at the beginning? We're here to negotiate. Yet, you tuned out our fair offers, hell-bent on making this messy...

speaker: Donald
content: But hey, in a negotiation, it's not just you who's got cards to play, got it?
Donald fishes out a videotape from his backpack and slaps it on the table.

speaker: Donald
content: Here, give this a watch.

speaker: Jones
content: ...What's that?
Looks like Donald's unexpected show of force has thrown the director off his game, making him falter as he asks.

speaker: Donald
content: Why not just watch and find out?
The director flicks a knowing glance at the nurse, who swiftly pops the tape into the projector next to them.
Then, an image flickers to life on the screen.
Through the glass, the patient in the bed jerks a bit and then goes still.

speaker: Researcher A
content: Great, he's gone.

speaker: Researcher B
content: I said to ease up on the juice, to take it easy, but no, you had to go your own way!

speaker: Researcher A
content: It's all because the top brass won't stop hounding us for results...

speaker: Researcher B
content: Ah well, let's not sweat it. One thing's for sure, our Fourth Hospital has no shortage of guinea pigs.

speaker: Researcher A
content: Hurry up and bring down a few more. If we hold up Nirvana's data crunchers, we're in deep trouble...

speaker: Jones
content: Hey!
As soon as he catches sight of that scene, the director jumps up and hastily shuts off the projector.

speaker: Donald
content: Hey, why the sudden pause, "Director"?

speaker: Donald
content: The best parts are still ahead.
The director, barely containing his breath, demands with a menacing edge:

speaker: July 26, N.F. 115 20:00
content: How on earth did you stumble upon this...
Donald throws up his hands.

speaker: Donald
content: Don't sweat the details.

speaker: Donald
content: The bottom line is, we've got these tapes. And that's not all—we've got more proof up our sleeves. Enough to show the world that your Fourth Hospital is nothing but a monstrous place that tramples on human decency and ethics.

speaker: Donald
content: If you want to keep this under wraps, then play ball and meet our demands...

speaker: Jones
content: Dream on!

speaker: Jones
content: Banyan Fourth Hospital... Nirvana doesn't play these games. Your so-called "proof" can't touch us.
...Still acting all hard-nosed, huh?
You glance at Donald, pretending to be at a loss. Together, you both shake your heads and let out a sigh.
Well, if this was six months back, that attitude might have worked.
But, have you seen what's going down in Eastside lately?
Donald chimes in with your line of thought.

speaker: Donald
content: All these politicians and bigwigs are hustling to cut deals and make alliances with us in the West District... scared stiff of not seeming firm enough or not making enough waves in the media.

speaker: Donald
content: And here's your secret lab, still playing with fire—experimenting on people, snatching folks from the West District for torture... Boy, if this ever leaks, it'll be a real spectacle for those political showboaters.

speaker: Donald
content: Better mull it over, because you guys really aren't in a position to say no.
The director goes quiet.
He ponders for what seems like ages, before finally eking out a few words:

speaker: Jones
content: I don't have the clearance for this... I need to check with the dean.

speaker: Donald
content: Could've just said you weren't the big boss. It would've spared us the hassle of yapping with a minion like you.
Brushing off Donald's taunt, the director reaches for the desk phone. After a short pause, an unfamiliar voice echoes from the other end.

speaker: Dean
content: What is it?

speaker: Jones
content: Madam, MBCC's Chief... plus that Rustfire fugitive who showed up earlier are here.

speaker: Jones
content: They're trying to blackmail our Fourth Hospital, insisting we transfer that new patient from the West District.

speaker: Dean
content: A transfer? Heh...
A sly chuckle echoes from the other end of the line.

speaker: Dean
content: Where to, exactly?

speaker: Dean
content: I'm pretty sure Ms. Margaret's got mental exhaustion and Alzheimer's caused by Mania, right?

speaker: Dean
content: Banyan Fourth Hospital is the top mental health facility in DisCity. You want to transfer her out just like that, doubting our capabilities? That's not going to look good for Banyan's standing.
That call from the dean spells out her attitude loud and clear.
You give your throat a quick clear, ready to pitch the "solution" you have been cooking up.
Madam, if maintaining your reputation is so important, how about setting up a branch in the West District?
Right now, the West District's knee-deep in the Mania mess. How about teaming up with MBCC to set up a fresh hospital in the Fourth Hospital's name?
Let's pull together all the medical assets there, like the famous SALVA Hospital, and work some magic for the folks in the West District...
I've got the perfect pick for the new branch's boss—Dr. Das. He's a Fourth Hospital guy through and through. That's showing good faith, right?
You could even ship over some of the tougher cases from Eastside, and it'll spruce up your hospital's success rates too...

speaker: Dean
content: Hmm...
Madam, what do you think?
But it isn't the dean who answers. Instead, the appointed director cuts in, unable to hold back.

speaker: Jones
content: So, you're proposing that we pay up and do all the work, and even move the Fourth Hospital's resources... the patients, to that place?!
Right, and we'd also like you to close down that secret lab you've got going under.

speaker: Jones
content: So, the Fourth gets nothing out of this?
Isn't a shiny rep a good enough perk?
If you really wanna know, I'm willing to overlook the dirty little secrets of the Fourth Hospital for the time being. Your thoughts?
The line goes dead silent.
Then, after what seems like an eternity, a brief two-word reply breaks the silence.

speaker: Dean
content: Deal.

speaker: Jones
content: Madam, about this...

speaker: Dean
content: Follow their instructions.
The dean's firm tone silences the director's mild objection.

speaker: Dean
content: The Chief of MBCC, huh...

speaker: Dean
content: Can't wait to see you face-to-face.
█/25, 18:20, at the entrance of the West District's Banyan Branch Hospital

speaker: Donald
content: Back it up, back it up, keep going, OK, and stop!

speaker: Donald
content: Careful now, don't roughhouse with the gear—this stuff costs a pretty penny... and yeah, you're the one I'm pointing at!

Donald takes charge, guiding the movers as they carefully offload the brand-new medical equipment from the truck. He swiftly moves on to coordinate with the hospital staff on the ground floor for checking and inventorying the equipment.
Once done with all this, Donald, wiping away the beads of sweat on his brow, finally turns his attention to you, seemingly noticing you for the first time.

speaker: Donald
content: Ah, what's up? Got some time to spare today, huh?
Thought I'd swing by and see how the hospital's coming along.

speaker: Donald
content: Don't sweat it, everything's right on track.

speaker: Donald
content: Just took a run to satellite town a few days back. Picked up some fancy new medical gear—should take some of the pressure off Das and his crew...
Donald stretches out, yawning effortlessly.

speaker: Donald
content: Man, once we're past this hectic period, it looks like we'll have a break from the hospital hustle.
So, are you planning to take a break anytime soon?

speaker: Donald
content: Take a break? Not a chance. I've got a ton of stuff lined up in satellite town and Outland...

speaker: Donald
content: Folks like us? We're wired for the grind, always on the move.

speaker: Donald
content: Thankfully... it's all paying off.
In the dying light of the sun, the workers bustling at the hospital's entrance, the crane still humming away in the background... everything's cast in this warm, golden-red glow.
Yes...
You've been working your socks off, Big Hero.

speaker: Donald
content: Hey, drop the hero talk, will you? That's a mantle I'm not ready to wear.
Donald quickly waves off the suggestion.

speaker: Donald
content: Seriously, if you're lining up the West District's heroes by their achievements, I'm nowhere near the top.

speaker: Donald
content: Just your average Joe here. Had my ups and downs, a few slip-ups along the way. Made it this far by a stroke of luck... These days, I'm just trying to pitch in where I can, make some use of what's left in the tank.
...Sounds a bit cheesy.

speaker: Donald
content: It's heartfelt, really.

speaker: Donald
content: These days, all I'm thinking about is networking for the West District, making a few more "friends," leveraging that for better deals...

speaker: Donald
content: Kind of amusing to think back: A decade ago, I wouldn't have known the first thing about this stuff. Just brawling and causing a ruckus all day, and in my wilder moments, roping others into my shenanigans.

speaker: Donald
content: These days, with the West District crying out for a revamp and understaffed at every turn... What can you do? It's sink or swim, learning as you go.

speaker: Donald
content: In moments like these, I can't help but think of Julien... The West District right now, it's just the right place for a brainy guy like him...

speaker: Donald
content: Ah, never mind all that. I nearly let the real business slip my mind.
Donald leaps onto the truck, fishes around in the back, and pulls out a bunch of flowers.
So, this is the "real business" you were talking about? Who's the lucky girl?

speaker: Donald
content: How does that even connect?
Donald grumbles, clearly a bit annoyed.

speaker: Donald
content: Today's the day... Margaret, my aunt, is finally leaving the hospital!
Donald straightens his hair and steps closer to inquire:

speaker: Donald
content: And?
Think about what?

speaker: Donald
content: About me—do I look sharp right now, or what?
Looks the same as always to me...

speaker: Donald
content: Really? But I got a new hairstyle and everything. Was that just a waste of money?
You laugh a little at the hint of annoyance on Donald's face.

speaker: Donald
content: Enjoying my little crisis, are you?
Nah, I'm just wondering—what's up with the sudden hairdo? It doesn't seem like your thing.

speaker: Donald
content: All this fuss? It's just for my beloved aunt, you know.

speaker: Donald
content: Think about it—when I last bumped into Margaret, she had no clue who I was...

speaker: To the great victory of good over evil, and to the upcoming full exposure of those scum. Cheers!
content: So, looking at it through her eyes, today's pretty much a decade-long-awaited reunion, right?

speaker: Donald
content: I mean, as her nephew, I've got to step up my game, right? Gotta make a solid impression on the old folks...

speaker: Margaret
content: Hey, you little troublemaker, what are you cooking up about me this time?
At the sound of that elderly but gentle voice behind him, Donald straightens up in a snap, alert and tense.
A beat later, gathering his resolve, he turns around, his face blossoming into a bashfully green, boyish grin.

speaker: Donald
content: Aunt Margaret...

speaker: Margaret
content: Oh, you remember I'm your aunt, do you?
The old woman, shaky and frail, makes her way over, her cane lightly thumping against Donald.

speaker: Margaret
content: Years I've spent looking this way and that, never a sign of you. Where in the world have you disappeared to, you little scamp?
Donald parts his lips, ready to respond to the old woman's question. He has his excuses and stories all lined up, but when push comes to shove, his brain hits a wall, and not a single word comes out.
Somehow, without him realizing it, his eyes have brimmed with tears.

speaker: Donald
content: Sorry...

speaker: Margaret
content: Sorry for what? Hey, why the waterworks? Come on, you're grown up now...
Margaret moves closer and tenderly wraps her arms around her nephew.

speaker: Margaret
content: Never mind, never mind. You've always been the silent type, keeping everything to yourself... You've probably been through so much.

speaker: Margaret
content: The important thing is you're home now, you're home...
The dream is shrouded in fog, the boundaries not at all in sight.
Only something warm slowly approaches you, dispersing the surrounding grey mist, making everything bright and clear.
Trip Helene
When you open your eyes, the source of that warmth in the dream is now lying at the head of your bed, staring down at you.
Seeing you awake, she grins, shakes her head, with sparks fluttering out of her mouth.
You quickly grab the document from the bedside and stuff it into the metal cabinet next to the desk.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Good morning, Yao.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What I told you? Knock on the door before entering somebody's room, hmm?

speaker: Yao?
content: Hmm...
The little one stands with hands behind her back, pouting and frowning, looking unconvinced.
As if to say, "you're not just somebody, though."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Alright...
You let out a sigh, then lead Yao to the desk, sit her on your lap, and let her scribble on the draft paper with a pen. Those draft papers were sent along with a letter from Du Ruo.
After the incident was resolved, Yanyan expended a lot of effort to finally find the reborn Yao.

She had been in a deep slumber, growing slow. Upon receiving the message, you immediately led people to Yanyan's location. There, you tried to connect her with shackles, and to your surprise, Yao woke up.
As soon as Yao opened her eyes, she clung to you. You then bring her back to the Bureau.
After much deliberation, you decided to send a message to Du Ruo.
Right upon receiving your message, Du Ruo gives you a video call.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Chief, I suppose you don’t need my special reminder to realize that...

speaker: Du Ruo
content: You spoil her too much.
Du Ruo pointed at the little doll dozing off on top of your head.
She seems to retain the bird-like habits of the "Sun Crow," enjoying sitting on your shoulder, leaning against your hair to sleep.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's... just a kid.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: You're right, but she's not "just a kid."

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The real Yao died seven years ago, Chief.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: The one dozing on your head is a newly born... well, let's just call her "human" for now.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: She... is no longer the "Yao" you once knew.
Du Ruo's words are blunt, yet you can't refute them.
But someone has to say it, someone has to remind you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even if it's a new soul that was born in her, or perhaps she's even taken on a new form of life...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's been reborn, so I'll bet on a new story for her. And I'm willing to take any risks that may occur.
You recall the first time she opened her eyes and focused her gaze at you in the forest, deep in her eyes held something so clear that you could never forget.
After a long chat, the little one atop your head seems to wake up, smacks her lips, stretches, and sparks from her tail scatter onto the back of your hand.
It slightly tingles, but leaves no mark.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She'd grow safe here. I will take care of her, and I will be responsible to everyone's safety, make sure she won't... become a threat.

speaker: Yao
content: Chief...?
The little bird flaps her right hand, patting your arm, pulling you out of your memories.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hey, what a drawing. Have you done yet?

speaker: Yao
content: Yep! All done!
You pick up the stack of letters sent by Du Ruo, which are now all covered by suns drawn with your red pen.
A simple red circle with light radiating from it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How wonderful, well done!
Hearing your praise, the little bird gently rubs against your arm and burrows under your palm.
You stroke her hair, watching her squint her eyes and nod amusedly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You must have sneaked out, did you? Come on now, time for breakfast.

speaker: Yao
content: Hmm... no... I don't wanna...
Yao seems reluctant to leave your room. You gently take her hand, your voice becoming softer.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's okay. I'll go with you. No worries.
You take her hand and walk her to the cafeteria.
At first, staff were hesitant to approach Yao. Seeing her feathers and the occasional sparks, they're unwilling to get close to this former <color=#fb9259>Apostle</color>.
Later, seeing how docile she was with you, some of the staff began to step close.

speaker: Staff A
content: Hey, would you like to try this candy?
Seeing someone approach, Yao quickly ducks behind you, clutching your trousers and frowning at the staff, letting out an indistinct sound.

speaker: Yao
content: (Grumbles)...

speaker: Staff A
content: It's okay. It tastes like fresh fruit—sweet and sound, I promise.
Yao looks up at you. Seeing that you nod to the person with the candy, she cautiously steps out, tilts her head, and snatches the candy from his hand.

speaker: Yao
content: ...Ah, hmm...
Yao's eyes widen as soon as she tastes it. She squints and starts nodding quick, and then pulls out a slightly wilted flower from her pocket, placing it in the staff's hand.

speaker: Staff A
content: Whoa, thank you for the flower!
The staff rises, showing off the flower to you with a grin.

speaker: Staff A
content: Though she used to be an Apostle, I heard she was once a widely beloved <color=#fb9259>seer</color>. She's still got a kind heart, Chief.

speaker: Staff A
content: Look how polite she is! Maybe stay here a while longer, she'll recover her memories and become the kind one she used to be.
The staff turns to Yao, still smiling.

speaker: Staff A
content: What do think, Yao? Do you remember anything from before? Do you want to become the person you were, hmm?
Yao chews on the candy for a moment, then again hides back behind you, burying herself into your coat and gently shaking her head.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She will, perhaps. But either way, as long as the shackles are in place, I can ensure that the contamination left inside her by the Sun Crow doesn't flare up again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As for the rest... whether she remembers or not, I hope she can live a life free from the troubles of disasters and Mania, a happy life.
You pick up Yao, allowing her to lie on your shoulder.
As she comfortably stretches her body and feathers, sparks fly off.
The staff tingled by the sparks laugh, saying in jest he's now been blessed by the grace of the seer.
But Yao clutches the corner of her own clothing, tucking it inwards, leaning into your embrace, and falls silent again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No worries, Yao. I'll protect you, and everyone.
Yao is almost always clinging to you wherever you go.

She somehow grows much faster than that of normal human children. The Ring Research Institute shows a vigilant attitude about this, taking her away for checks every now and then, even adding surveillance devices to her room.
You remember that those devices were used specifically for the Apostles of Ashes.

speaker: Ring Research Institute
content: After all, she was born from an Apostle of Ashes. Now that she grows again, will she become human, or turn into a "Sun Crow"... Can you give a definite answer?
That said, Yao always manages to pull out a small flower or a shiny object from her pocket, handing them to those who smile at her.

speaker: Yao
content: This is for you... Take it. No worries...
Seeing that, you put aside concerns and accepted the long-term mission to investigate the anomalies in WhiteSands.
Though Yao seemed a bit uneasy when you left, the WhiteSands case required your immediate presence.

Recently, the Tide of Ashes values monitored in WhiteSands have been unusually high, even reaching critical levels. You and the soldiers patrol day and night, but still haven't found any traces of Apostles of Ashes or anything else.
Just as you've become increasingly dubious, wondering if the Apostles of Ashes showed up elsewhere, an alarm occurs within the Bureau.

speaker: Alarm
content: High M-value Sinner breaking through the defenses! High M-value Sinner breaking through the defenses!

speaker: Alarm
content: Protective personnel get into position immediately! Protective personnel get into position immediately!
Upon receiving the urgency message, you immediately return from WhiteSands. By the time you get back to the Bureau, it's in complete chaos.
As soon as you step into the building, you feel a rapid rise in temperature.
At the center of the incident, the instigator of the turmoil, with all her feathers spread out, lies on the ground, baring her teeth, like a frightened little creature.

speaker: Yao
content: Get away!!

speaker: Yao
content: Let me out!!!

Yao's voice, mixed with the roar of a wild beast and flames, keeps people at bay. Her golden eyes emit a dangerous aura, her feathers stirring up heat waves to fend off attacks, searching for an escape.

As Yao's attacks grow more intense, everyone has no choice but to increase firepower, to prevent her from getting close to the main gate. But you can see, beneath the wings, she is trembling, her aggression masking her unease.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's going on?!

speaker: Security Personnel
content: Chief, 16 hours before your return, Sinner Yao suddenly went berserk, attacking Bureau personnel and causing multiple damages!

speaker: Security Personnel
content: We crossed fire, now we determine that Sinner Yao was attempting to break out!
Seeing you return, a security officer quickly approaches to report the situation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yao, stop it now!

speaker: Yao
content: Let me out!!!

Seeing you return, a security officer quickly approaches to report the situation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yao, stop it now!

speaker: Yao
content: ${PlayerName}!!!
The moment you appear in her sight, she doesn't even retract her feathers and flames before rushing straight towards you, flying into your embrace.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's okay, Yao. Don't be scared. I'm home. No worries now.
The flames, along with Yao, envelop you, reddening your exposed skin with a scalding touch, quickly turning into a piercing pain that makes you clench every muscle on you.
But you endure the pain, gently patting Yao's shoulder. You know how scared she is right now.

speaker: Security Personnel
content: Chief?! Is this Mania attack?! Quick! The Apostle is using her powers! Protect the Chief!
Seeing you injured, the security personnel, regardless of their fear, pull you away from her and guard you back, binding Yao with special Imprisonment shackles.
With the comforting embrace taken away, Yao looks up, finding everyone's eyes filled with caution and blame.
"She hurt Chief!" "She's no seer any more!" "What a monster!"
Voices explode in Yao's ears, loud and whispery, intensifying her unease.

speaker: Yao
content: Arrrgh—!!!
The flames surrounding Yao, which had slightly subsided, explode once again, burning the people around her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't move! I'll handle this! Everyone, step back!
You reach out, gently stroking the top of Yao's head, just like when she was little.
A flash of red light passes, and the power of the shackles calms the girl's unease, soothing her emotions.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Everything was good, right? ...What happened? Why did you do that?
Yao, bound by the shackles, lowers her head in silence, tremblingly lifts her hand to grasp your sleeve, her whole body shaking.
You quickly check and, finding no other discomfort, let out a sigh of relief. Yao finally calms down, no longer frightened and restless, and the people around momentarily relax as well.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's okay, everything's under control...

speaker: Alarm
content:
Attention! A Tide of Ashes has appeared in the WhiteSands! Contamination detected extremely high!
Attention! A Tide of Ashes has appeared in the WhiteSands! Contamination detected extremely high—
You try to calm everyone, but an urgent <color=#fb9259>Tide of Ashes</color> alert is unexpectedly issued within the Bureau.
This is the first time the Bureau has received such a red-level alert, indicating an impending Tide of Ashes inch-close to DisCity.
The crowd instantly spreads out, all personnel immediately rush back to their posts to start emergency rescue operations.
The rest focus their attention on Yao, who had just gone berserk with body bearing flames.
—This former <color=#dg1f1f>Apostle of Ashes</color>.

speaker: Security Personnel
content: Chief, Sinner Yao is regarded extremely dangerous now! We need...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I headed to WhiteSands to specifically probe into the Tide of Ashes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What I can share with you now is that we have not found any signs of the Tide of Ashes occurring in WhiteSands.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As for whether the alert was caused by Yao, or to say, whether this is even related to her—

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I will find it out.
You produce the communicator and dial Nightingale.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nightingale, I need to interrogate Sinner Yao. Please prep the room immediately.
You arrange for Yao, who's still bound, to be taken to the interrogation room. Before leaving, facing the many worried gazes, you nod and make a promise.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I will take responsibility for everyone's safety. No worries.
The room's lights on, the person in the seat curls up a bit.
Only after seeing it's you, does she reveal her face from behind her arms.

speaker: Yao
content: Are you going to catch me?

speaker: Yao
content: Just like those people.
Yao's eyes fixate on you, her mouth nervously pursing. Small flames explode around her occasionally, and you can even see her shoulders heaving with her breaths.
During this time, she has almost grown into the appearance you first met her.
Only now, there's a wall between you two. You can't give her a comforting hug when she's uneasy, like when you first brought her back to the Bureau.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm here just to figure out what exactly happened... See, I've never hurt you, have I?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't mind what they said. They don't know what happened in Sunsink, so they were just... uninformed.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's no one else here. Everyone's out, so it's just us. You can rest a little, okay?
You tone is slow and careful, as you've always been when talking to her.
Yao doesn't answer, continuing to bury her face.
test
test
test
test
test
test
You flip through the stack of investigation report hastily prepared by the staff, reading it carefully.
Aside from routine physical examination data, the rest are mostly records of abnormal behavior reports and complaints.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: First, can you tell me, is everything alright? Anything feel off?

speaker: Yao
content: ...No. Everything's fine.

speaker: Yao
content: I'm fine.
Fine... really?
The report in your hands shows that Yao's abnormal behavior has been ongoing for a while.

speaker: Nightingale
content: We all thought she was just having a stress response from your long-time leave.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But besides you, she hardly listens to anyone else, often denying what she did, which really causes headaches for other staff.

speaker: Nightingale
content: During the time you were away in the WhiteSands, her mood was quite unstable, showing hostility towards anyone who approached her, like... a wild critter encountering humans.

speaker: Nightingale
content: She would scratch other people's hands, pull their hair, and also liked to play with fire, causing damage in the Bureau.

speaker: Nightingale
content: And more...
Nightingale, while handing you the report, summarized Yao's abnormal state during this period, which sounds like quite a headache.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I don't know if it's just me, but these days, sometimes she acts like the Apostles of Ashes. We're unable to communicate with her, like she's not even in a normal human state...

speaker: Nightingale
content: The worst incident was this most recent outburst. She seemed desperate to <color=#fb9259>escape</color> here. Chief, I'm worried if...

speaker: Ring Research Institute
content: After all, she was born from an Apostle of Ashes. When she grows up, will she become human, or turn into a "Sun Crow"... Can the Chief give a definite answer?
Could it be that Yao also showed abnormalities in this alarm of the Tide of Ashes, which we couldn't find the source of?
You put down the report and look at Yao seriously.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You don't have to be nervous with me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know, you've always listened to me, right?

speaker: Yao
content: Yes... I... I do.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then, would you tell me why did you scratch others?

speaker: Yao
content: They... when they came back from outside, I saw some bugs on them, so I wanted to help get rid of them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I see... Then why did you pull everyone's hair?

speaker: Yao
content: ...The wind. It was the wind that messed up their hair. I was just trying to help them tidy up.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Okay. Now, why abuse your powers and damage equipment with fire?

speaker: Yao
content: ...'Cause this place is too small.
Yao mutters softly, her eyes darting around somewhat guiltily.

speaker: Yao
content: It was just an accident. I just touched those things, very lightly... and they... somehow started burning.
You let out a sigh.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Personnel dispatched from outside always go through rest and inspection, so there shouldn't be any bugs sticking to them.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Next time you see someone's hair messed up, just reminding them would be enough.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: As for this place being too small...
You recall the super large playground specially allocated to the Bureau by FAC—of course, compared to nature, it's definitely still too small.
The creatures outside, the weather outside, the small rooms that feel constricting after being called by instinct.
Yao is not good at lying, you completely understand the thoughts behind these words.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So... you really want to go outside the Bureau, right?

speaker: Yao
content: I... I just...
Yao's eyes lower, like a child who has done something wrong, waiting fearfully for punishment.
You quickly soften your tone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's okay, they will get it, and I'm not here to blame you, I promise.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm just worried about you... So, if you really feel anything uncomfortable, just tell me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like, did you see something, or... hear something, that made you instinctively do those...

speaker: Yao
content: No, I can't remember! Everything in the dream is just—
Yao almost immediately gives a huge no, straightening up, with restless sparks flying out, somewhat disturbed like her master.
But then she shifts her gaze away.

options: Did you dream about the past?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What kind of dream was it? Can you tell me?

speaker: Yao
content: No... I didn't, I... don't remember...

Her eyes flicker, and her hands twist together, her brows furrowed as she evidently recalls the dream, making you nervous too. You can't help but lean forward slightly, looking directly into those golden eyes.

options: Yao, tell me, this is important.

content: In her dream, did she see the seer of Eastia, or... the Sun Crow destroying the seer?
Unable to escape your gaze, she bites her lip and finally speaks.

speaker: Yao
content: ...I dreamed that I was... standing high, even touching the sky, fighting... fighting monsters... Nothing else, really. Nothing else...

speaker: Yao
content: The me in the dream is different from me now, it's my past. I... I can remember it all. And when I do, I won't blaze fires, and I won't hurt others...

speaker: Yao
content: Could you... wait for me? ...I will become that seer that is safe for everyone, I promise... Could you, just wait...?

speaker: Yao
content: I'm regaining my memories, I am!
Yao stammers, also trying hard to gather her feathers and little sparks, trying to make herself appear as the mature and respected seer she mentioned.
But this lie is even clumsier than the previous ones, and you see through it instantly. You also regret your impatience just now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It okay if you can't remember. It's okay if you can't change back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I didn't mean to make you change back, to be that seer once again that I take care of you so long.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I didn't realize those questions would make you so uneasy, or fear your own instincts, even. I'm sorry.
Yao is somewhat surprised by your apology.

speaker: Yao
content: I thought... you would blame me...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, how could I? But after this, you are gonna apologize to every one, okay?
Yao nods, looking somewhat embarrassed.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So now, can you tell me what's really on your mind?
Yao's hands grasp her own arms, encircling herself under her wings, as if this could give her the courage to speak her mind.

speaker: Yao
content: ...I'm sorry. I lied to you... About those dreams...

speaker: Yao
content: I dreamed I became a woman... wearing strange clothes, standing high in the sky, holding a sword, fighting against a big bird on fire like me...

speaker: Yao
content: But I also dreamed, quite the opposite...

speaker: Yao
content: That I was the monster attacking her, burning her with fire, tearing her apart with my claws. I dreamed I... ate her...
Yao's expression is pained, she closes her eyes and shakes her head, seemingly trying to fling those chaotic voices and images out of her mind.

speaker: Yao
content: After you left, I started having these dreams. I'm scared. I'm afraid to sleep. Then in the daytime, I heard voices, too many times that I don't know which ones are real, and which ones are not...

speaker: Yao
content: And some voices are like... chaotic monsters. They call me, saying that <color=#fb9259>I don't belong here</color>.

speaker: Yao
content: Afterwards, there's a voice in my mind constantly shouting at me to go outside, to go... to the Tide of Ashes! To the Apostles of Ashes!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you didn't listen to them. You stayed, you're by my side.

speaker: Yao
content: But I know, this time you went out for the Tide of Ashes, to find those Apostles, to eliminate them for good.

speaker: Yao
content: I know the Tide of Ashes, the Apostles—they are all your enemies.

speaker: Yao
content: So I'm afraid... I'll become your enemy, become one of them.
She bends in pain, almost curling up in the interrogation chair.
Golden eyes reflect your face. In the past, similar eyes in dreams watched you, even the struggling souls long dead tried to pass messages to you, to fight the Mania disaster with you.
Now, the same bright as the sun eyes are once again covered with mist, the person in front of you is still tormented by the Tide of Ashes.
You can't help but feel grief.

options: You'll never be a deceiving monster.

content: You slowly organize your words.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They don't understand the past—the seer from before, she was even more deceptive than you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your clumsy little lies are nothing compared to the Great Seer.
You straighten your posture.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No matter what else you're still doubting about me, the memories, experiences, and feelings of our life together are real.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The shackles link us together, I will continue to help you suppress the contamination within you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't care what you think you are, but I can accompany you, until you find out who you really are.
You stand up, crossing the invisible wall between you and her, and take her hand.
Yao flinches like a startled bird, the flames beside her suddenly blossom.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If we were outside, I think I should give you a hug.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't be afraid, Yao.
Yao finally shows the smile you've longed to see for so long, she instinctively stretches out her hand, seemingly wanting to respond to that hug you just mentioned.

speaker: Door Slam
content: Bang!!!!
Chief! Get away from her!! She's very dangerous right now!!
The warm atmosphere lasts only a few seconds before FAC combatants burst in, making you frown.
Yao, sitting in the interrogation chair, is startled by the sudden change, and the flames around her burst uncontrollably, burning you who were holding her hand.
Seeing you burned by the flames, the warriors nearby become even more agitated. They surround Yao, isolating you from her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Please wait, my interrogation isn't over yet, and also, I didn't call for backup.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: It was after we received the search results and analyzed them that we determined the need to assist the Chief and defend against Sinner Yao.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What search results? How come I don't know about this?!
The leading combatant hands you a report, densely filled with search results and conjectures.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: We urgently deployed and thoroughly searched WhiteSands and DisCity in a short time, but didn't find any large Apostle matching the alarm.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: However, based on the power level, within this range, only one person could trigger such an alarm from the system.
The FAC personnel glance at the surrounded Yao, speaking with a serious tone.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: Paradeisos reviewed the report you received before entering, and they confirmed that the Sinner detained within the Bureau, Yao, is the Apostle who triggered the alarm!

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: She's habitually deceitful, and this innocent appearance now is also her guise to deceive you so that you get close to her and she can hurt you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If she wanted to harm me, there had been plenty of opportunities before.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Moreover, the shackles have been put on, she can't harm me, and also, I believe she doesn't have such intentions.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: But is she worth your trust?!

The leader raises their voice, the combatants raise their weapons, surrounding Yao. Outside, footsteps and voices of discussion go back and forth, everyone is on guard against the person at the very center of the room.
The air is filled with anger and fear, and with clear hostility. Yao, who was originally scared and curled up on the chair, now suddenly stands up, standing in front of everyone.
The flames around her become more visible, exploding little by little inside the interrogation room.
A peculiar gray gradually climbs up Yao's limbs, feathers splay outwards, the tips sharp, completely taking on a stance for attack.

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: Monster... Monster! She indeed is a monster!

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: Don't come any closer!!!
In the chaos, some couldn't help but shout out, raising their guns at Yao.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Calm down! Don't provoke her!

speaker: Yao
content: Why... why do you see me as your enemy?

speaker: FAC Combatant
content: All personnel on alert!! The subject Sinner has fallen into chaos! Prepare for battle!!!
For a moment, the interrogation room is in complete disarray. You want to rush over and grab Yao's hand, but no matter what, you can't touch her.
She struggles between weapons and armor, unleashing her Mania and power.
She looks at you, her eyes conveying an indiscernible emotion.

speaker: Alarm
content: A large Tide of Ashes detected!! Attention all personnel!! A large Tide of Ashes detected!! Attention all personnel!!
The piercing alarm sound brings everyone back to their senses, they stare at Yao, holding onto anything they can hold tightly.
The temperature in the room suddenly drops, Yao's expression calms down, as if called upon by something, she suddenly retracts her flared feathers, standing tall and looking up.

She looks afar, her gaze passing through the humans surrounding her, through layers of concrete walls, to a world even you can't see; listening intently, amidst the loud alarms and chaotic shouts, hearing what you cannot.
You can't feel everything she perceives, but you instinctively feel a chilling panic throughout your body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yao!! Are you hearing that chaotic voice again?! Don't listen to it! Stay with me!
You push through everyone, rushing to Yao's front. You extend your hand towards her, red light converging in your palm, shackles almost triggering.
But she just gives you a glance.
In an instant, the world quiets down, through those golden pupils you feel cold for the first time, a kind of irreversible sorrow of realization.
She spreads her feathers amidst the flames, howling towards the sky, breaking through the crowd, rushing outwards.
It was like a swift blade made of fire that no one can stop, or dare to stop.
The moment she gazes at you, everyone feels it.
An unparalleled power, monstrous, an Apostle-level Mania power.

Not far away, heatwaves carrying coarse sand hit in waves.
FAC's anti-Mania soldiers line up in a formation, their weapons emitting a faint blue light, resisting the flames that are exceptionally dazzling even in broad daylight.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Press the attack! It's the Apostle of Ashes! This Tide of Ashes is indeed her doing!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Set up the maximum power anti-Mania weapon! Quick!
Yao, surrounded at the center, is covered in flames, her eyes once clear, now swallowed by the flames, making it impossible for you to see clearly.
With a wave of her hand, her feathers block the bullets, causing explosion and smoke in the air.
In the midst of WhiteSands, she is almost indistinguishable from the Apostles that follow the Tide of Ashes.

A FAC soldier beside you sets up their weapon, pulling the trigger, but you step forward, stopping their action before they can complete it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's not the look of the Apostle of Ashes, things haven't escalated to that level yet.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Attacking blindly might backfire, let me try first.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She is a Sinner, the shackles are still responsive, I can hold her off first, you guys act based on the situation.

At this moment, Yao is indeed different from when she was at the Bureau, attacks seem to have no effect on her, seeing the situation turning into a stalemate, the frontline personnel had no choice but to agree with your plan.
This area is permeated with an abnormal Mania, amidst the vast Tide of Ashes, in a hostile environment, Yao has completely entered another state.

Her wings blaze with fire, her golden eyes sharp, the non-human fangs and claws all revealed, confronting the numerous anti-Mania weapons in the contamination storm without being overpowered, yet appearing desolate.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's me, Yao.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let me help you, okay? I've made them stop.
You slowly approach her, extending your hand towards her against the scorching winds.

speaker: Choice
options: Don't be afraid, come, give me your hand.

content: You want to step forward, but you can't. Scorching debris hitting the mask, the protective suit starting to dissolve, your body instinctively pulls you back, and even your consciousness starts to fade.
And Yao just watches you, not attacking, nor coming closer.
She no longer looks so panicked, standing tall in the center of the heat, full of power, like a siren in the flames, and a stranger far away from you.

speaker: Yao
content: I didn't want you to come, but I knew you would...

speaker: Yao
content: So, I also have something to tell you...

speaker: Yao
content: ...You don't need to look for me, not anymore. Stay away from danger... I am... the danger...
You are stunned. You've never heard her speak to you in this tone before, even though not long ago, she was the little one sticking close to you.
She has grown again, growing overnight into someone you don't recognize.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's a misunderstanding. They're not afraid of you, but something else. They're afraid you'll become something else.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I know you won't, I know what kind of person Yao is, I know what kind of person you want to become. Even if there's trouble, I'll work with you to get it over.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come back, Yao. You are not, and you never will be my enemy, as long as you don't want to.
Yao slowly lowers her head, silently looking at her feet.

speaker: Yao
content: No... it's not their fault... not any of you...

speaker: Hypatia
content: It's me, who can't become what you all expected...

speaker: Yao
content: I often dream, dream of here, dream of farther places... dream of the seer everyone is expecting.

speaker: Yao
content: She wields a sword and stands against monsters, in front of the storms, the disasters, protecting everyone. She's always smiling, walking among the crowd, trusted and beloved by all—she always belongs to the human world.

speaker: Yao
content: I know, that's the "Yao" everyone hopes to see. So you kept me, through my eyes, searching for that beautiful human.
Her voice is slow, but fluently expresses herself to you.
But now her voice is tinged with the echo of Mania, constantly reverberating in your mind.

speaker: Yao
content: But I'm no longer human.

speaker: Yao
content: Even if I dreamed it, remembered it, the things about that person are so far from me. Everything just becomes chaotic and impure.

speaker: Yao
content: Even by your side, I can't feel at ease. I only see my monstrous body, see how different I am from everyone else. I can't go back to the past, I can't meet your expectations.

speaker: Yao
content: But in the dreams, I see a wider world, broader time, greater life... There's no need to imprison my strength, no need to suppress myself...

speaker: Yao
content: I can't be caged. I have my own calling. I want to <color=#fb9259>burn bright</color>...

speaker: Yao
content: I know... I long to return to the disaster... long to face the Apostles... long for my true self...
Yao says no more, the wings formed of flames slowly spread behind her, without any grand gestures, the slowly rising heat is enough to drive you all back.
You understand Yao's intention, she is driving all of you away.

speaker: Yao
content: Go. I don't want to hurt you, nor can I return to you.

speaker: Yao
content: All this is just what was. And there's going to be something after.

speaker: Yao
content: The seer named Xu is dead. The current me can't escape Mania and disaster—I'm destined for them.

speaker: Yao
content: ...Let me go... I'm sorry...
She speaks calmly and decisively, with convincing power. But she is also your Sinner, subtle emotions from the other end of the shackles pierce through this nearly perfect lie.
You understand her pain. You feel her sadness.
Ignoring the persuasion of those around you, you step forward on the scorching white sand.

speaker: Choice
options: I should be the one saying sorry.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm sorry, trapping you in the Bureau wasn't my intention, I didn't know it would be so painful for you there.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It was presumptuous of me, I naively assumed from my perspective that you belonged there.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But I never needed you to become the "seer," from the moment I took you back, it was never necessary.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Moreover, I remember the message Yanyan sent me when she found you.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Chief, Chief! Big news! Tremendous news!!

speaker: Yanyan
content: We found Yao! It's really her!!

speaker: Yanyan
content: You gotta trust me! She's exactly like Yao, even they confirmed it. And her energy system is the same as Yao's!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What we're looking for isn't the "seer," but... <color=#fb9259>Yao</color>.
The movement of those wings gradually stops, and strands of pure white smoke slowly disperse.
You reach out your hand, again slowly, slowly walking towards Yao.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm glad you were born into this world, glad you came to my side. No matter what form you take, where you choose to go, I hope you can find happiness.

options: I hope you can be happy.

speaker: Yao
content: But I... I'm not human. I can't stay by your side.

options: Yet you will never be our enemy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Look, you can now precisely control the flames, not even a spark escapes, nor does it harm anyone.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So don't scare me anymore, let's talk some more, okay? Tell me what you really think, where you want to go.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even if you have to go... just like that, without any explanation.
Yao stares at you blankly, her beautiful eyes once again revealing that unique clarity.

speaker: Yao
content: ...The one who can't bear to leave... is me...
Yao, who had been gazing at you, suddenly stops dead in her tracks, her hand that was about to reach out to you no longer moving towards you.
She frowns, looking around as if sensing something...
But in an instant, the flames that Yao had gradually calmed suddenly reignite!
Her eyes flash a wild, dangerous signal, and she fiercely pounces in your direction!

speaker: Yao
content: Leave! Go!!!
At the same time, the alarm of the Tide of Ashes goes off, tearing through the calm and agitating everyone's nerves.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Protect the Chief!! Increase the firepower!!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Stop the rampaging Sinner from getting close!
The armed personnel you asked to put down their weapons see Yao rushing towards you, immediately raise their guns, and shoot at Yao.
Yao, disregarding the bullets hitting her, sees only you. She spreads her golden wings, flying towards you like a light breaking through the sky.

Her eyes flash a wild, dangerous signal, and she fiercely pounces in your direction!

The black figure distorts your consciousness, flinging you harshly to the ground from mid-air!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Where did this come from?!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: No... Quick!! Prioritize protecting the Chief!!!
The sudden appearance of the Apostle of Ashes catches everyone off guard, they almost seem to harbor the thought of swallowing you in their attack.
The pain of impact and fracture nearly makes you lose consciousness, the despair brought by the Apostle of Ashes tightly entwines you, making it nearly impossible to breathe.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Damn it!!! Our attacks can't stop them!!

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Call for backup immediately!! Immediately!!!!
Death-like blackness envelops you, but through those flowing gaps, you glimpse a flame as dazzling as the sun.

speaker: Yao
content: Let him go... Don't you... hurt them!!
female_content: Let her go... Don't you... hurt them!!

content: You feel the shackles trembling.
The golden figure crosses the boundary of death and stands in front of you, dispersing the painful aura.
Flames blaze furiously, burning away the black contamination that sought to swallow her. Accompanied by blood-curdling screams, Yao attacks the giant Apostle recklessly.
Ignoring the damage, regardless of the consequences.

speaker: Yao
content: <size=44>Stay away!! Stay away from them!!</size>

speaker: Yao
content: Your opponent is me!

speaker: Yao
content: Solarfire!!
Yao, like a wild beast, tears through the Apostle of Ashes, driving them away from you.
And the flames on her body, with her burst of power, form a red firewall in front of you, blocking all harm.
It's an unparalleled scene, the first time everyone directly felt such natural and savage power.
Your eardrums vibrate, your consciousness evaporates with the flame, leaving only awe in the depths of your heart.
Yeah..., you thought to yourself.
You know very well, if Yao wanted to hurt you, there were plenty of opportunities in the Bureau, she didn't need to wait until she was trapped in the WhiteSands.
She never intended to harm any of you. She was simply following her instincts—not the instincts of belonging to a monster, but the kindest instincts to protect humans and eliminate calamities.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Attack! Now!! Attack the Apostle!!!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They are the source of the alarm!! Quick!!!
The giant bodies of the Apostles of Ashes gradually fall under the relentless attack of everyone, but the unsettling buzzing sound still stubbornly persists.
You know, they are gathering all their strength, preparing to launch their final attack.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Watch out!!!
As the power full of contamination targets Yao, you instinctively run towards her. The shackles on your hand glow faintly, wanting to give Yao more strength.
But the moment you step into the attack range, the Apostles of Ashes, as if sensing something, ferociously shifts their attack towards you!
The giant golden wings once again appear, burning all unease to ashes.
The flaming greatsword has been thrown aside, Yao blocks all attacks for you, her hands propped by your side, trying not to touch you, to keep a distance.
Yet even at this distance, you still feel the scorching heat, Yao in battle is as hot as the sun.

speaker: Yao
content: The things you said... how could I ever leave? But you know we can't go back...

speaker: Yao
content: Look, this body of mine... it can't even touch you anymore...
Her arms, dark with a red glow, the sand in her palm sizzles, even the tears that drip on your face feel scorching.
This time, you see her eyes clearly.

speaker: Yao
content: Look, this body of mine... it can't even touch you anymore...
Her arms, dark with a red glow, the sand in her palm sizzles, even the tears that drip on your face feel scorching.
This time, you see her eyes clearly.
You know who she is. In both past and present lives, she possesses the sharpest sense of disaster and bravely charges into calamities alone, facing powerful enemies on her own.
Regardless of memory loss or physical distortion, even with the contamination of the Sun Crow Apostle mixed in her body, she never abandons her love for humanity.
Whether in life or death, as Yao or as Xu... You might not understand "souls," but you understand her in front of you, and that has never changed from the beginning to the end.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yao, the sunlight... represents hope.
You raise your hand through the scorching flames, the crimson shackles linking two entirely different bodies.
But this time, it's not a prohibitive command, but a warm, embracing force.
You dream again.
The dream is still shrouded in fog, with that familiar source of warmth by your side, quietly lingering.
You reach out, touching the edge, and instantly light bursts forth, dispersing the fog around.
Hehe... then take it to heart—this is the warmth of the sun.
Whenever this sunlight shines, it should be time to wake up.
All creatures, at this moment... all wake up.
You struggle to open your eyes, seeking the source of the speaking voice.
Through the haze, the heat source approaches you, and you feel as if a feather brushed across your forehead.

speaker: Yao
content: Whoa, you still remember me?
The familiar smiling face comes into view, Yao, as before, is leaning over the bed, looking down at you from above.
Her feathers beside her fall on your face, radiating warmth.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's been a while.

speaker: Yao
content: Right, it's been a long time. You were so badly injured. You've been lying here for three years.

speaker: Yao
content: Look, my hair has even grown longer.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You know I can tell the time with the clock on my desk, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I should have gone unconscious for just three days.
Yao turns her head away for a while, and you hear her let out a slight "tsk."

speaker: Yao
content: There's an old saying from Eastia. You've probably heard of it.

speaker: Yao
content: "A single day apart feels like three autumns." So, let's just say I haven't seen you for three years, alright?
You prop yourself up, sitting against the headboard.
Yao pours a cup of water from the side and hands it to you, trying to make out a taste.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So you've been waiting here for me to wake up?
Yes, she's been there almost every second.
Wynn comes in through the door, carrying a stack of files, and places them with a thud beside your bed.

speaker: Wynn
content: Hehe, excuse me Chief! The head officer said, as soon as you wake up, you have to sign all these documents immediately.

speaker: Wynn
content: Nightingale and I have protested for you many times, but they say these are related to the calamity, and must be dealt with as quickly as possible.
Wynn smiles apologetically at you and Yao.

speaker: Wynn
content: Miss Yao has already controlled the Sun Crow Apostle and resumed being the Great Seer, so why the rush?

speaker: Wynn
content: ...Huh, don't get it...

speaker: Yao
content: It's related to the calamity, so everyone just wants to address it quickly after all.

speaker: Yao
content: And... I still don't remember much, so I'm not the seer as yet.

speaker: Wynn
content: Understood... then... among the things you remember, is it true you can channel gods?

speaker: Yao
content: Oh. That, yes, that's true.

speaker: Yao
content: I once found someone's great grandfather to help convince that person to leave home and flee from disaster.

speaker: Wynn
content: Whoa—That's amazing!!

speaker: Wynn
content: Oh, and they also say, the Great Seer has read many books, seen a lot of things, and has her unique vision of the world, and can even communicate with all beings!

speaker: Wynn
content: Is that also true?
Wynn hops over to Yao, who gently taps her nose, smiling as she speaks.

speaker: Yao
content: This is what a seer should do. Just like you, as a member of the Bureau, there are things you know that I don't.

speaker: Yao
content: I might need to ask you for help sometime.

speaker: Wynn
content: Aww... Great Seer, you're so good! If there's anything Wynn can help with, please don't hesitate to ask!
As you watch Wynn leave with eyes full of admiration, you pick up the documents and speak in a faint voice.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Great Seer, huh...

speaker: Yao
content: Heh, stop it. Show some respect, would you? You might actually have to call me "big sis" if we're talking about age.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Believe it or not, I have a clip of you calling me "big bro" on my terminal.
female_content: Believe it or not, I have a clip of you calling me "big sis" on my terminal.

speaker: Yao
content: Sorry, but your terminal was smashed in WhiteSands.
The DisCity Hound and the Eastern Sun Crow face off with a smile for a while, both breaking into laughter.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I got it, people from legends are really good at messing with others.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's left, no need to keep sitting upright.

speaker: Yao
content: Quite a keen eye, huh?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your legs have been shaking, I saw it.

speaker: Yao
content: I've deceived all of them, making them believe I'm the seer. I've made things easier for you, right?
Yao shrugs her shoulders, moves the chair away, and sits beside you.
Golden feathers spread across the plain room, just like sunlight shining in.

speaker: Yao
content: Fortunately, you woke up.

speaker: Yao
content: Didn't cause a scene.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've always chosen us, and I should have noticed sooner.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We thought about the escalation of the calamity but didn't want to face it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: On the surface, everyone looks down on those chasing myths, but who isn't the person longing for miracles?
You open the latest report, which describes everything happening in WhiteSands.

speaker: Yao
content: The Apostle of Ashes has grown again, proving that the Mania that births the Tide of Ashes is also getting stronger.

speaker: Yao
content: I never wished to deify myself... but now I'm grateful, that I've made the myth a reality again, to protect you well.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You made the myth come true again in Sunsink.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This myth wasn't created by you, Xu.
At the mention of the familiar name, Yao pauses, her gaze wandering.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Shackles can't lie, Yao.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You might deceive others into thinking your memory has returned and you've become the seer.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you can't fool me... and there's no need to hide anything from me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: From the beginning to now, I've always considered you as <color=#fb9259>Yao</color>, and being <color=#fb9259>Yao</color> is enough for me.
Yao buries her head even lower, slowly leaning forward to rest on your shoulder.

speaker: Yao
content: No way. I've been doing this for days...

speaker: Yao
content: They all say I've been good, surely I have turned human again and become the seer everyone thought I am.

speaker: Yao
content: Only you saw through me at a glance.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I raised you, of course, I know you best.

speaker: Yao
content: Then I guess I will have to try harder to mess around with you.
Yao doesn't lift her head, and you feel the temperature on your shoulder rising.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So, you can still hear their call, can't you?

speaker: Yao
content: ...Yes.

speaker: Yao
content: At every moment, I can feel the call from the calamity.

speaker: Yao
content: I want to fly out of here. I want to enter the Tide of Ashes.

speaker: Yao
content: I want to eliminate more calamitous apostles, it's my instinct, and my duty.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You were meant for a much broader world.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The appearance of higher-level Apostles of Ashes indicates that Mania is strengthening the Tide of Ashes. The former seer, even if shattered and reborn as a beast, would return to this world to protect humanity.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now her life has entered the next stage, leaving only this obsession. And you, born from this obsession, how could you lack such a desire?

speaker: Yao
content: But I can't bear to leave.
Yao lifts her head, staring at you like a child, unwilling to let go.

speaker: Yao
content: I can't, and I'm also afraid...

speaker: Yao
content: The way you ran towards me recklessly in the WhiteSands, and these past few days of unconsciousness—it scared me too much. I was afraid you wouldn't come back.

speaker: Yao
content: So even if I have to stay in this cage, even if I have to tell lies I'm not good at, pretending to be that person and deceiving all humans...

speaker: Yao
content: I can do it.
You smile and reach out to touch her forehead, remembering when she was in her juvenile form, she would burrow into your palm, rubbing against your hand and nodding happily.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How could I bear to leave you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But...
You hand the report to Yao, pointing out the current page for her to see.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But it must be suffocating, right? I can tell your feathers are dwelling. Although acting as the seer is quite good, you're definitely not happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Here, you have to fight against your instincts, endure the whispers tempting you. And being in a crowd must be uncomfortable, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I don't want to see you like this, I'd rather see the person who bravely hunts Apostles in the storms of the WhiteSands, the god-like person who is surrounded by the splendid wild flames.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry.
You smile at her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You don't need to worry about me, I can't bear to see you sad, how could I let myself make you sad?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So, you shouldn't and don't need to shrink in this tiny birdcage, becoming a flappy bird.

speaker: Yao
content: You're the one who's flappy. You're the birdbrain, hmph!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did I say anything about birdbrain?

speaker: Yao
content: Your eyes did.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your instincts are as sharp as a wild beast's, you can even notice that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So, follow your instincts, they've been there since you were born.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then, fly to a bigger, more suitable world for you.
You give Yao a hug, just like you used to.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But you must take good care of yourself, don't be too reckless, don't push yourself too hard, otherwise, I won't be at ease letting you return to the Tide of Ashes.

speaker: Yao
content: Says you, you're the one who's always reckless, pushing yourself...

speaker: Yao
content: Don't worry about me. I've grown. But I can feel it, the source of DisSea, calamity, is all related to you—if not, they wouldn't have sensed you so precisely in the WhiteSands before.

speaker: Yao
content: We're both given fates that require us to fight with all our might... I promise I won't act recklessly, and I hope every time I miss you, I'll be able to see you here.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I promise you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You must.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll miss you a lot if you go.

speaker: Yao
content: Okay, I will.

speaker: Staff A
content: Gosh... is our air-con broken?

speaker: Staff A
content: Why does it keep getting so hot after a while?

speaker: Staff B
content: So it's not just me? I thought it was because I've been eating too much fried chicken and getting hot from it...
The Bureau's temperature is constant, to try to meet the diverse needs of Sinners and staff, different temperatures are manually adjusted in different places.

However, for some reason, in recent times, there has been a day or two when the entire Bureau's temperature went up by several degrees, leaving people confused about whether or not to wear a coat to work.

speaker: Staff B
content: Hey, Chief, could you help us get this system fixed when you have the time?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content:
Quack!
(Yes, sir!)
You readily agree, but turn around with a helpless smile.
At the door of the room, a cluster of sparks has just extinguished, pushing open the door, a wave of heat mixed with the distinct dry scent of the WhiteSands comes through.
A female wrapped in flames sits on the ground, her golden-red feathers shining with a special glow, making her look like a deity.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let's make a deal, next time you come, can you not let the Bureau's temperature rise so much?

speaker: Yao
content: That's not possible I'm afraid.

speaker: Yao
content: Unless of course... I'm not too busy thinking about you.

Six months had passed since the Ash Campaign. The Fraser Unity Gala came to an end, and the strife between DisCity and the Farland Alliance settled into a tentative pause. The perilous Rancor weapons have slowly been brought back under control.

A long while passed after that. Then Jasmine awoke.
But what followed brought no good news.

March 3, N.F. 116 
Special Containment Department of Banyan Fourth Hospital

speaker: %u
content: What do you mean, "put her back under"?!

speaker: %u
content: I read the reports from EDGE. LINK was working. It was stabilizing her Mania disorder. The numbers were solid for a while. She was supposed to be getting better. Banyan told me she'd be back soon. Now, just a few days later, you're telling me something completely different?

speaker: Doctor
content: Please, Chief, try to stay calm. We've overhauled our treatment protocols, and we score very highly on all humanitarian reviews. I understand your concern for the Sinner, and I can assure you, no irregular procedures will be performed on her.

speaker: Doctor
content: The LINK session was a success. The patient, Jasmine, has regained consciousness. The problem... well, it's what happened after she woke up.
He gathers the thick sheaf of reports and moves to pass them across, only to stop halfway. He hesitates, then speaks:

speaker: Doctor
content: ...Actually, this won't explain it well. You'd better come with me.

The deeper wards of Banyan Fourth Hospital carry a familiar chill. Its security and surveillance match the MBCC's suffocatingly rigorous standards. Here, too, the ones confined and studied are "patients" branded as dangerous lunatics.
As you press further in, the shackles stir with growing agitation. The madness of the Sinner tethered at the other end bleeds into you, driving your steps faster.
Yet before you arrive, a sharp, anguished scream cuts you down.
[Flash]

speaker: Jasmine
content: Stay back! Get away from me!!

speaker: Jasmine
content: My blades! Where are my blades?! Give them back! I want them back!!

speaker: Jasmine
content: Ahhhhhhhh!!

Then comes a sight that grips your heart. Through the thick one-way glass, you glimpse Jasmine: hair wild and matted, expression savage. Inside the cold grey concrete isolation chamber, she hunches low to the ground, back arched like a furious cheetah, roaring, her gaunt frame made starker by the pose.

Burly orderlies have trapped her in a corner. Though she is unarmed, they approach with syringes, sedatives, and medical kits in hand, only to be forced back several meters with every cautious half-step. It's clear this stalemate has worn on for quite some time.

speaker: Doctor
content: Now you see the situation. Her mental state has deteriorated severely. She needs proper medication and psychiatric intervention. But as you can see, we haven't been able to get her to accept any form of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
content: If this continues, putting her back in stasis may be our only option before something far worse happens.
Before he can finish, an orderly is hurled across the room and slams hard into the one-way glass right in front of you. Several nurses scream, some breaking into sobs.

speaker: Nurse
content: ...Sedative! Quick, the sedative!
You steady her trembling hand beneath yours and take a step forward.

speaker: %u
content: ...Let me try. MBCC knows Sinners better. And Jasmine... we spoke before they put her under. Let me try.

You press forward, eyes trained on the far side of the isolation wall. Jasmine remains coiled in her attack stance, snarling at the orderly she knocked away, and now, she is looking right where you stand.
Through the one-way glass, you meet her bloodshot, frayed eyes at last.
She freezes.
Is it weariness? A glimpse of the orderlies' shifting faces? Did she just feel the shackles nearby amid the chaos? Or... did she somehow see you through that unseen wall?
Her rage falters. In its place, a trace of confusion surfaces.

speaker: Jasmine
content: ...Chief?

You move closer by slow degrees, allowing the shackles to grow warm, hoping that slender warmth can gentle her fury. The alarms quiet. The medical staff waver, then cautiously, at last, open the door.

The distance between you is small now, and the barrier is gone. Jasmine sees you. A daze sweeps over her, like waking violently from a nightmare, like she cannot trust her eyes. Then, at the soft sound of her name, it is her body that reacts first.
Reeling, stumbling, her steps feeble, yet she rushes toward you in quick, desperate strides.

speaker: Jasmine
content: ...Am I dreaming? Chief, is it really you? I—
Then she stops dead, just a few paces off. A shadow falls across her face.

speaker: Jasmine
content: ...Why... you smell like... them...
You know at once what she means.
[Flash: Chief in Shattered Blade uniform]
Is it the stench of war? Lingering traces of the Shattered Blade? Months later, anything capable of triggering her should have faded entirely, and yet Jasmine caches it anyway.

speaker: Jasmine
content: You were with them, weren't you... You've become DisCity's blade too?

speaker: Jasmine
content: Then die with them!!!

speaker: Doctor
content: Chief, use your shackles!!

options: Unleash the shackles to protect yourself
Hold back and try not to aggravate Jasmine

content: She lunges at you, and the shackles answer. Spikes rip through her body, stopping her cold, and the agony tips her into pure rage.

She screams, a raw and terrible sound, and her momentum carries her crashing into you, bearing you down to the floor. With her hands rendered useless, she resorts to her teeth, biting into the side of your neck, nearly chewing through the fabric to gouge out the flesh.

Everything you felt—grief, guilt—is devoured by primal fear. Your body bucks and shudders, helpless as any animal beneath a hunter's jaws, until the staff pour in and ram a heavy sedative into Jasmine's neck.
Jasmine collapses, pulled off you at last. Your blood glistens on her lips, stretched into a garish crimson grin.
One heartbeat more, and your throat would have been torn out. She could have done it.

You fight the instinct to subdue the "threat" with your shackles. She barrels into you, slamming you to the floor, her thin, skeletal fingers locking tight around your throat. The medical staff struggle to tear her away, but she holds fast, screaming, accusation and desperate plea twisted into one.
Then, just before the darkness takes you, a strong sedative sinks deep into her neck.
Jasmine slumps against your chest. Her eyes, bloodshot and wet, never close.
They hold you, full of hatred, swimming in tears.
[Cut to Black Screen]

[S-105 Psychiatric Evaluation Report]
LINK has restored S-105's psyche from the damage caused by Mania. The Fourth Hospital's evaluation confirmed her stability was sufficient for awakening. However, following the procedure, her personality and behavior have driven a sharp deterioration.
Persistent nightmares and prolonged refusal of sustenance have left her mental state dangerously unstable. Medical personnel cannot approach her safely, standard sedative protocols cannot be initiated, and there exists no means to "convince" an S-Class Sinner to accept treatment.

...Physicians believe she has activated a psychological defense mechanism, restructuring and fusing insurmountable trauma with past memories and cognition, resulting in a misalignment of emotional perception. She refuses to accept reality and is unable to trust the outside world. Mania has further amplified her aggression and real destructive potential...
The symptoms are excessively complex, clinical management prohibitively difficult, and no treatment plan can be formulated. S-105's mental state will only degrade further with time.

After thorough consideration, we strongly recommend that cryosleep be reinitiated for S-105.

Rancor suppression technology has been largely perfected. The Fourth Hospital can no longer use "research assistance" as grounds to protect her from actions by higher authorities. The assault on the MBCC Chief has attracted widespread attention. If she is not returned to containment, there is a high probability of a more severe security crisis in the future. Should that occur...

...the only outcome that may await her is humane termination.
For several nights after that day, you were haunted by vague, restless nightmares. They only began to fade once your application was granted and Jasmine's transfer to the MBCC was finalized.
