content: Why the hell would I care what they want? After all the torture in that lab, after mutating into... this... they should've died a long time ago!

speaker: Synex
content: Listen, are you misunderstanding the situation? Do you think I'm their guardian? That they follow me because they want to live?

speaker: Synex
content: Wrong. Dead wrong! These things follow me because they want to die.
...Die?
As she speaks, Synex rests a hand on her abdomen, as if sensing the other souls residing within her.

speaker: Synex
content: They believe if I eat them after they die, they'll live on inside me. Amusing, isn't it? Not that I mind. I've always had a healthy appetite. A few bites here and there are no trouble at all.

speaker: Synex
content: See how strange humans are? Saffar took the Alchemic Beasts that still had a mind, and they chose a form of belonging. But these mindless things that follow me... they still crave a purpose, too.

speaker: Synex
content: It's all so pointless. As if this world has enough purposes and endings to go around.
If you don't want anything, then why take me? Why make me your prisoner?

speaker: Synex
content: For fun, of course!

speaker: Synex
content: Hehehe... How could I pass up the chance to get my hands on little Hella's precious Chief? It'd be a waste not to play with you.
Her claws grip your head as she shakes it roughly from side to side, treating your skull like a stubborn control lever.

You try to wrench your head back, but she retaliates by cracking your forehead against the unyielding stone wall. A lance of pain shoots from the point of impact, and a wave of dizziness washes over you.
You...

speaker: Synex
content: I like that look in your eyes. Don't worry, as long as you behave, we'll have plenty of time together.
To emphasize her point, Synex gives the top of your head two condescending pats, then flicks the bridge of your nose.
You flinch back, barely avoiding her touch.
FAC will scour WhiteSand for me. You won't be able to hide for long.
In response to your warning, Synex merely lets out a slow, exaggerated yawn.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, really? I think it's the opposite. Letting you go is what would bring them down on me. Keeping you right here... keeps things nice and quiet.

speaker: Synex
content: Now, be a good little toy and keep me company. Once I get bored, I'll toss you back. Soon enough.
Having said this, she gives your head a final, sharp pat with her claws before turning and leaving the cave.
[WhiteSands Cave]
Like all deserts, WhiteSands is a place of stark extremes—blinding, scorching days give way to bone-chilling nights.

The long-term residents have developed intricate strategies to cope, but Synex's method is brutally simple. At night, she uses the Alchemic Beasts as living thermal blankets, compelling them to lie beside her for warmth, only to kick them away at sunrise as the heat returns.
Lately, the physical decay of the Alchemic Beasts has accelerated. During your captivity, several have died each day.
True to her promise, Synex consumes each fallen beast in a solemn ritual, while the others keep a devoted vigil, just like what you witnessed before.

However, this massive consumption has dire consequences. You observe the Aurum Secretum on her skin spreading, her mutations worsening. After analyzing the changes, you arrive at an inescapable conclusion:
Her body is nearing its capacity to contain the Aurum Secretum. She is approaching her breaking point.

speaker: Synex
content: Stop? Oh? What do you mean, "stop"?
I've been observing your feeding pattern these past few days, and I've seen how it's affecting your body.
You're pushing past your limits. The physical mutations are accelerating. If you keep consuming this much Aurum Secretum, your body will break down.
Upon hearing this, a wide grin spreads across Synex's face, and she rubs her hands together in keen anticipation.

speaker: Synex
content: Sounds perfect to me. So, where's the downside?
...You're not even slightly concerned about your own survival.

speaker: Synex
content: I do care about this body, especially about the power it gives me. And these past few days, that power has been growing exponentially. It's put me in a wonderful mood.

speaker: Synex
content: What's the matter, little Chief? Worried my new strength is getting away from you? Afraid you won't be able to keep me on a leash?
She pats your cheek with her claws.

speaker: Synex
content: Too bad. It's exactly what I had in mind.

speaker: Synex
content: Well, my time's up. I'm off to play with some Apostles of Ashes. You just stay there all tied up. Bye!
With a casual whistle, Synex turns and saunters out of the cave.
...Tsk.
You look down at the subtle, rhythmic blink of the tracker on your chest. The signal is away. Interpreting the code, you estimate FAC's arrival in just a few hours.
Your mission now is clear: contain Synex before then, or failing that, ensure no one else dies.

Edging toward the cave wall, you work at the ropes by grinding them against the jagged surface. It's a battle of attrition—coarse rock against stubborn fiber. After what feels like an age, you're rewarded with a slight slackening of the bonds.
Just as you struggle with the ropes, the daylight suddenly vanishes, plunging the world into a murky ochre. All around, the Alchemic Beasts lift their heads, tense and watchful.
...Eclipse? No... a sandstorm?

speaker: Alchemic Beast
content: Grrumph—!
As if summoned by your deduction, a bottle-shaped Alchemic Beast materializes in the cave mouth, backlit by the sickly, dimmed light.
What's going on? Did something happen to Synex?
At that moment, the rope finally gives way, yet the beast shows no surprise. Its only response is to clamp onto your arm and haul you forcibly out of the cave.
[WhiteSands - Night]
Emerging from the cave, you look up to a sky choked by a massive sandstorm.
The ominous gloom bleeds into the night, making it impossible to see more than a few feet ahead. Squinting into the chaos, your eyes finally catch a glint of gold.

It's Synex. She's at the storm's very heart, locked in combat with a colossal Apostle. In the faint glow of the Aurum Secretum, you watch as a boulder, guided by the Apostle's will, smashes into her chest. Yet despite the devastating impact, the eerie smile on her lips doesn't even flicker.
Synex!! Get back here!!
The storm is creeping toward you. Even at its outermost edge, you can feel the surging waves of Mania.
The power is overwhelming—a calamity on a scale that could erase an entire town!

speaker: Synex
content: Well, well. Look who it is. The little hamster from the cave finally chewed through its ropes. Come to play with the grown-ups?

speaker: Synex
content: Too bad the grown-ups are busy. I don't have time for you.
Snap out of it, Synex! No one has ever taken on an Apostle of Ashes alone and lived. If you go through with this, you will die!

speaker: Synex
content: Oh, I'm going to die? And what exactly is that to you?

speaker: Synex
content: You're the one who said I'm living on borrowed time. So tell me, should I spend my final days tiptoeing around, living some safe, boring life? How is that any different from being dead already?
In that moment, understanding crashes over you. This woman has been doing this deliberately all along.
She actively seeks out the most lethal conflicts, a creature of dual thirsts: she yearns to tear her enemies apart, and she aches for them to rip her own body in half.
It is as if only when she is drenched in blood, poised on the razor's edge between life and death, that she can feel any satisfaction with the value of existence.

speaker: Synex
content: If you're scared of getting hurt, then stay back. If you want a show, then watch. But when the bloodlust takes over, I won't remember your face.
The familiar golden patterns flare across her skin once more, but this time they do not flow; they surge like violent rapids, a golden flame threatening to consume her from within.
Once again, she hurls herself into the storm.

Empowered by the Aurum Secretum, her claws tear through the shadowy form—one gash, then a second, a third. The Apostle howls in agony as the golden light sears the wounds, preventing the black sand from reforming no matter how it tries.
But simultaneously, identical golden rifts split open across Synex's own neck. Her hands twist at an unnatural, bestial angle, reminiscent of those Alchemic Beasts' limbs.

Excessive Aurum Secretum has saturated her body. Her consciousness is likely fading, making any attempt to call out to her futile. The optimal solution would be to disperse the Aurum Secretum from her system, but you lack the proper equipment.
It seems that leaves only one option, the most direct and forceful approach.
[Sandstorm Background]
The raging storm swallows you instantly. You fight to reach out toward Synex, a blurred figure just an arm's length away—
Synex!!!
Use the shackles
Synex!!!
Use the shackles
(Shackles Effect)
The power of your shackles punches through the Aurum Secretum barrier, seizing the transformed beast as she thrashes within the maelstrom.
[Release the shackles again]
The power of your shackles punches through the Aurum Secretum barrier, seizing the transformed beast as she thrashes within the maelstrom.
[Release the shackles again]
Your power temporarily suppresses the twisted Mania within her. The golden light at her neck flickers and dies, replaced by stark, crimson markings.
These are my shackles. I know you probably won't like them, but in your current state, you don't have a choice.
Just this once... be my marionette.
Wave after wave of red light envelops Synex. As the shackles tighten their hold, a glimmer of awareness returns to her eyes.

speaker: Synex
content: Oh... Ohhhhh? What is this? What is this?!

speaker: Synex
content: This feeling... being bound tight, pierced through, completely overwhelmed—it's incredible! Absolutely incredible!

speaker: Synex
content: Why didn't you ever tell me the shackles could feel this good?!

The power of your shackles crashes through her, a violent tide quelling the Aurum Secretum's rampage. Synex, who stood on the brink of death moments before, now stands before you fully conscious. A perverse smile graces her lips as she admires the brands of red and gold warring across her skin.

speaker: Synex
content: ...My, my. What a transformation. So the innocent act was just a disguise? Finally showing me your true self?

speaker: Synex
content: I like this power... I'll play along. I'll obey your commands, do your bidding... until the battle is over.

speaker: Synex
content: So, may I attack now? My dearest Chief?

speaker: Synex
content: As you wish. Hahahahaha!
The words are barely out of her mouth before Synex launches herself back into the storm surrounding the Apostle.
She becomes a gold-red streak, a bullet piercing the storm wall. Each time she shoots through the Apostle's form, the air tears between its inhuman roars and her own maniacal laughter.

The brutal exchange lasts nearly an hour. Though Synex fails to behead the creature, the shackles hold; her sanity remains her own. Together, you stand firm, forcing the Apostle into a final, retreating lurch.
Stop! Don't chase it, Synex!!

The shackles have siphoned your mental strength to its dregs, while Synex's body is a hollow vessel, drained of all physical power. You collapse onto the sand almost in unison, heads falling side-by-side, bodies stretched in opposite directions. The crimson blood soaking her begins to seep into the fabric of your clothes.
Synex turns her head, her gaze finding yours. In the bloody scarlet of her eyes, something new and unfamiliar now stirs—an emotion you have never seen in her before.

speaker: Synex
content: Hehehe... That was even more incredible than I imagined...
If you can, I need you to stop this. You're burning through your own life.

speaker: Synex
content: What a shame the battle's over. I don't have to listen to you anymore. Don't you think it's a pity we didn't push it further? That we didn't risk our lives a little more?

speaker: Synex
content: But of course... I wasn't talking about the Apostle of Ashes just now. I meant you. Or to be precise... your shackles.

speaker: Synex
content: How exhilarating! Two forces crashing and colliding inside this body of mine. It made fighting feel completely new, like my body had returned to its prime. Such a nostalgic feeling...
Synex's voice grows faint, a dying whisper, yet it still brims with undiluted delight.

speaker: Synex
content: Hah... Never thought a little bunny like you would actually have some teeth. I wasn't planning to go back to the MBCC with you...
...And now?
Come back to the Bureau with me. We can treat your condition. You won't refuse this time, will you?
A long silence settles between you. Hearing no response, you turn to look, only to find she has already drifted into sleep, a faint smile still gracing her lips.
You...

You understand her exhaustion all too well. The grueling battle and the strain of the shackles have drained you both, physically and mentally. The only thing keeping you conscious now is a thin, fraying wire of concern for your collective safety.
Your own body gives way, and you collapse beside her. Your vision blurs, gazing past her sleeping form toward the distant horizon.
There, against the fading light, you see them—the silhouettes of the people most familiar to you.
Summoning a final reserve of strength, you push yourself upright and raise a hand in a feeble wave. Finally, one of them turns, and your signal is seen.

speaker: Distant Voice
content: Captain, someone's over there!

speaker: Distant Voice
content: That's... the Chief! And a blood-covered woman! Get the stretchers, quick!

speaker: Subtitles
content: Two days after the operation to capture the Aurum Secretum test subject, Synex, FAC search and rescue teams located the missing ${PlayerName} deep within the WhiteSands region.

speaker: Subtitles
content: ${PlayerName} was found suffering from multiple wounds, moderate dehydration, and other related symptoms. After receiving treatment, the prognosis is favorable.

speaker: Subtitles
content: Authorities also apprehended Synex at the scene, a suspect in multiple serious crimes, including the Fraser Institute information leak. The subject's threat level was assessed as significantly diminished at the time of capture. Due to the sensitive intelligence she possesses, her immediate interrogation has been requested.
[Inside the Sand Ship]

speaker: Escort Soldier
content: Chief, the interrogation room is ready. The walls have been reinforced per your orders, but our resources on the sand ship are limited.
Understood. We're working with what we have. Just maintain a secure perimeter and keep the area clear.
A stack of relevant documents in hand, you make your way to the interrogation room.
[Inside the Interrogation Room]
The door swings open to reveal an empty space.
However, you've spent nearly a week with Synex and know this ruse. You step back swiftly, narrowly evading the whip-crack of a black tail.

speaker: Option
options: Cut it out with these games.

content: Your hand finds the switch on the wall. A surge of intense pressure slams the woman hiding in the shadows flat against the floor. Closing the distance, you see her face is a mask of wild, barely restrained excitement.
Synex, return to your seat.
Your cold response seems to have dampened her excitement. With a theatrical pout, she collects herself and crawls back into her seat.
Synex. The memory of your recent alliance in battle is still fresh, yet now she sits across from you, her beast-like eyes radiating a playful, calculating scrutiny.
What shaped her deranged nature: the influence of the Campbell family, or something she was born with?
A chronological inquiry seems best. You should go through the events one by one.
Synex smiles as you slide the files toward her.

speaker: Synex
content: What do you want to know? The people I killed?

speaker: Synex
content: To be honest, most of them weren't even a challenge. I can barely remember their faces. When you're a dog, you just bite whom your master tells you to.
A review of the case files confirms it: every assassination victim was linked to the Campbell family, with no personal connection to Synex. Her statement checks out.
It sounds like you were very loyal to the Campbell family.

speaker: Synex
content: Loyal? You should know, I once tried to assassinate Adelaide. After I failed, he spared my life in exchange for this dog leash.

speaker: Synex
content: So rather than the family's dog, I'm more accurately Adelaide's personal hound. Everything I did was on his direct order.

speaker: Synex
content: It's just that Adelaide had an unusually long list of enemies. If I'd been assigned to one of the other family members, my life might have been easier.

options: You seem quite familiar with Hypatia.

speaker: Synex
content: Heheheh... What, you think I'd help her swindle people and ruin their lives? Those crimes sound just as serious as assassination, don't you think?

speaker: Synex
content: Though, that lady's influence stretches much further than Adelaide's. If I'd been assigned to her, I might have met you much sooner.
As she delivers this final line, Synex's tongue darts out to wet her lower lip. You deliberately refuse to interpret the implication.

speaker: Synex
content: The young lady... she's one of the few decent people in the Campbell family.

speaker: Synex
content: But if I had served her, I'd still have blood on my hands from protecting her. She just wouldn't have known about it.

speaker: Synex
content: So you see, no matter who I served, I was destined to be a criminal. Heh, don't you find that pitiful?
Her voice holds no self-pity; instead, a distinct, mocking undertone colors her words.
