So you're putting all the blame on Adelaide and the Campbell family...
But from what I know, there's one crime you committed that the Campbells could never have ordered.

speaker: Option
options: The Fraser Institute Information Leak & BR-005 Incident

speaker: Synex
content: Hmm, fair point. I should clarify my earlier statement. While I was Adelaide's attack dog, I was never what you'd call "loyal."

speaker: Synex
content: Or, let me put it this way... I'd been wanting to stab him in the back for ages. That incident was just when I finally pulled it off.

speaker: Synex
content: After all, whether I was being dragged to the institute for modifications, sent out on an assassination, or prepped as a sacrifice for the Black Ring... it was all so boring. Mind-numbingly dull. Not a shred of fun to be had.

speaker: Synex
content: So in the end, I got bored of being Adelaide's dog, and I bit through my own leash.
If things had stopped there, I might have called it justified vengeance.
But the Black Ring incident you triggered affected far more than just the Campbell family.

speaker: Synex
content: Well, the Black Ring wasn't part of my plan. How was I supposed to know those crafty old foxes had so many backup schemes?

speaker: Synex
content: I thought that as the designated core sacrifice, my escape would shut down their entire operation.

speaker: Synex
content: Instead, they just turned around and set their sights on poor little Hella.

speaker: Synex
content: So I guess I do owe the little one for that. But hey, I helped you during the battle later, didn't I?

speaker: Synex
content: I've been good to you all, right? So, instead of all these boring questions, why not give me a little reward? Come play with me instead...
"Play" with you...?
Before her meaning registers, Synex explodes from her restraints. One hand locks around your wrist as her previously concealed black tail snakes around your lower back.

speaker: Synex
content: Yes, come play with me. I've missed your power...
Her tail slithers from your back to twine around your wrist. Its tip traces the rivers of your veins with a lover's delicacy, a predator admiring a weapon in its scabbard.

speaker: Synex
content: Use those shackles on me again! The way you did last time, with all your might and murderous intent... Do it to me again! I don't care if it tears me in half!
She fixes you with a gaze of feral excitement, but your response is a firm, unyielding shake of your head.
I don't want to hurt you, Synex. I'm going to keep you here and help you heal.
Easy now. Let's talk this through. Your medical report just came in, and we've already prepared a treatment plan...
Whoosh!
In one fluid motion, Synex backhands the documents aside, seizes your wrist, and slams you against the wall. She pins you there, her forehead pressing firmly against your neck.
Let go of me!
You wrench your wrist and drive a knee hard into her leg, fighting to break her hold.
But your struggle only fuels her. A wild grin spreads across her face as she tightens her grip, her fingers crushing your wrist with renewed force.

speaker: Synex
content: ${PlayerName}, I've already told you. I couldn't care less about healing this body. The only reason I came back with you was for your shackles... they felt so good.

speaker: Synex
content: So instead of healing me, why not just... satisfy me with them?

speaker: Synex
content: You enjoyed our little game in the storm too, didn't you?
Her words are punctuated by a sudden, sharp bite to your palm, leaving a bloody imprint in your flesh.
Seeing her triumphant smile, you understand this is a deliberate provocation—a ploy to make you use the shackles and play right into her hands.
Are you trying to force me to use my shackles on you?
You could easily indulge her madness, but that would only feed the dangerous game she's addicted to, a cycle with no end.
Your shackles bind her with crushing force.

speaker: Synex
content: Hehe... Hahaha!

speaker: Synex
content: Yes! That's it... Oh, I'm completely addicted to you now, ${PlayerName}!

speaker: Synex
content: More? Tighter?

speaker: Synex
content: Ahahahaha! This is incredible! That raw power crashing over me... it's absolutely intoxicating!!
You completely release all tension from your body and open your hands in surrender.

speaker: Synex
content: ...Huh?
I won't use the shackles on you again until you agree to my terms.
And I won't resist you anymore, either. Do whatever you want.
But if you do, I will never play with you like this again. I mean it.

speaker: Synex
content: ...? You won't resist?

speaker: Synex
content: You'd really just stand there? Even if I tried to kill you?
The world whirls as Synex slams you to the ground, her full weight pinning you.
Your words seem to have ignited a fury. Her jaw unhinges, baring rows of razor-sharp teeth before she sinks them into your neck.
A jolt of white-hot agony electrifies your body. Blood wells up, but true to your word, you only stare back, your gaze unwavering.
Synex, I understand you. You're willful and completely unrestrained. But if you think you can manipulate everyone with a mix of childish tantrums and violent threats, you're wrong.
My shackles aren't a toy, and neither is your life. At least in my eyes, your life is something to be treasured, not treated as a game.

A shift occurs in her blood-red eyes. The last vestiges of reason vanish, leaving a sharp, naked predation. Yet, within that feral hunger, you slowly discern something unexpected—a faint, flickering emotion that looks almost like loss.

speaker: Synex
content: ...How boring.
With a look of dejection, she releases you and stands up.

speaker: Synex
content: Didn't you say you'd do anything to catch me? To put a leash on me like a dog?

speaker: Synex
content: And here I thought I'd finally found the perfect toy. But I suppose... I'm the only one who can ever truly satisfy myself.

speaker: Synex
content: Since you won't play this game with me... I'll just have to find my other playmates instead.
Synex leaps onto a nearby filing cabinet. With a single swipe of her claws, she shears it clean in two, sending a blizzard of paper swirling into the air.
You watch her rampage with a deep frown, seeing through her game immediately.
This isn't mindless chaos; it's a calculated performance to provoke you. To lose your temper and activate the shackles would be to play right into her hands.
Undeterred by your disapproving gaze, she shreds a monitoring screen, glass exploding into jagged shards. Broken cables hiss and spit sparks like enraged serpents.
As papers settle on the live wires, they ignite, and in an instant, piercing alarms shriek in unison with Synex's wild, unrestrained laughter.

speaker: Escort Soldier
content: The interrogation room is under attack! Quick, protect the Chief!

Soldiers burst through the door, weapons trained on her. She ignores them completely, casually extending her Aurum Secretum-infused claws and pressing them to the reinforced wall of the interrogation room.
With an ear-splitting screech of tearing metal, golden energy ripples across her claws, and the fortified hull of the sand ship disintegrates at her touch.
Through the fresh breach, a swarm of Alchemic Beasts pours into the ship in coordinated waves, immediately engaging the soldiers in a deadly fight.
In the chaos, Synex seizes her chance. She leaps from the ship, landing gracefully on the back of a massive Alchemic Beast, and flees at a tremendous speed.
I can't let her escape!
Her contained rampage was one thing, but her escape into WhiteSands multiplies the uncertainties exponentially, including the danger to herself.
[Shackles Effect]

speaker: Escort Soldier
content: Open fire!

Bullets streak through the air as crimson light from your shackles lances toward her. One pierces her shoulder. Her body jerks violently, but instead of faltering, she covers the wound and laughs maniacally, showing no intention of slowing down.

speaker: Synex
content: Hehehe... Hahahaha...

speaker: Synex
content: You played with me after all! I'm so happy... so blissful! Hahaha... This is the power I've been craving!

The soldiers' fire targets her head while your shackles bind her legs. Though protected by her beasts, she stumbles slightly. But this barely hinders the creature beneath her as it continues its desperate escape.
You have to make her stay!
(Multiple Shackles Effects)

Sensing your intensified resolve, the Alchemic Beasts leap up, one after another, forming a living shield between you and their master. But how could mere creatures hope to block the power of the shackles?

In an unexpected move, Synex twists around with an air of eerie anticipation, her arms flung wide toward you. Multiple crimson shackles pierce her body simultaneously. Her frame convulses violently from the impact, yet she somehow resists your control, her laughter growing only more maniacal.

speaker: Synex
content: ...Hahahaha! See? In the end, you couldn't resist giving me exactly what I wanted!

speaker: Synex
content: Next time, let's dive into madness together. Let's play until the whole world spins! Just like today... just like before...

speaker: Synex
content: Don't you forget me. And don't you dare disappoint me.

speaker: Synex
content: When the mood strikes, I'll come find you again. Until next time, ${PlayerName}.
Synex!!!

Another swirl of sand gusts through the breach. The fleeing Alchemic Beasts converge upon their master, and the figure—her body pierced by countless shackles—is swallowed by the veil of dust, vanishing into the howling winds of WhiteSands.

speaker: Subtitles
content: Synex has escaped. Fortunately, the shackles allow you to constantly monitor her location and movements.

speaker: Subtitles
content: She appears to know your location as well, using the very shackles embedded in her body to periodically return to the MBCC, cause a disturbance, and then vanish again.

speaker: Subtitles
content: You've decided to end the pursuit. Now, you simply wait, knowing she will return. You use these fleeting confrontations to your advantage. Deep down, you know the truth: she will never truly break the bond of the shackles, nor will she let Aurum Secretum fully claim her life.
[Dream, Xiaofeng's Past. Background: Mountain Path]
Somewhere in the mountains of Eastia, a small group of villagers was climbing upward along a narrow path.

It had snowed just two days ago, and the cold was cutting to the bone. Through the endless white expanse, something flashed past from within the forest, brushing against the branches. The limbs shook violently, dislodging clumps of snow, before everything fell still once more.
One of the travelers shuddered, turning to his companion with a trembling voice.

speaker: Timid Villager
content: Hey... did you hear something?

speaker: Panicking Villager
content: Don't just freeze up! Get a move on! You see those tigers goin' at it? They finish with each other, and we're what's for dinner!
The mountain folk in their straw cloaks and hats jostled each other as they hurried away. In a place they had failed to notice, a pair of eyes hidden beneath the snow watched everything unfold.

Once the humans were gone, she could no longer hold herself up. Her legs gave out, and she slumped against a nearby tree trunk. The wound on her leg tore open again from excessive movement, searing pain igniting through her nerves. Blood was trickling down her calf, staining the white snow at her feet a deepening red.
She needed to move, to find somewhere safe to let her wounds heal... but her body refused to rise. The pain was intensifying, and her consciousness was beginning to fade.
Pain had dulled her senses, so when a gust of wind blew through, making the leaves rustle and sway, only belatedly did she realize that something else lay tangled within the sound.
[Two seconds of silence, then footsteps]

speaker: Muffled Voice
content: You...
[Transition to reality. Present, Eastian mountains]
Birds suddenly take flight. The sound of beating wings pulls the woman from her dream, and her eyes drift open.
The white tiger nestled beside her yawns wide, licks its paw, then coils back up, casting a sideways glance at the person still sleeping soundly against its warmth.
Mmm... Yawn...
The woman stretches with a lazy sigh and drags her fingers idly through the fur beside her. The tiger's sleek, glossy coat is now a rumpled mess.
Before the beast can protest, she finds the sweet spot under its chin. Bribed by the attention, it butts its heavy head contentedly against her palm, pressing in for more.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Heh, a full belly and a warm rock... can't beat that kinda sleep. Right, Meowy?
The white tiger answers with a low rumble.

Xiaofeng gives the tiger's head a pat, then rises to gaze down the mountainside. The sun shines bright today, and the ice and snow are just beginning to thaw. Something seems to surface in her mind, and her expression turns thoughtful.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Weather's mighty fine today. Perfect for heading out and about...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Whaddya think, Meowy? Wanna go see if there's a place more fun than down there?
[Background: Inside MBCC]

N.F. 116, After the Northsnow Manor Incident
Inside the MBCC Bureau
So... year-end crunch time already, huh?
You sit at your desk, eyeing the new stack of documents Nightingale has just deposited there. It glares back at you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Yes. The West District Reconstruction Committee has requested our support. A high-risk individual has been sighted in Syndicate, already responsible for multiple incidents. Both the scope and impact exceed standard parameters.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The West District is only just stabilizing after the BR-002 incident. The Committee is hoping for a swift, quiet apprehension to prevent further destabilization.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Additionally, this year has been... irregular. The general from Paradeisos has submitted repeated requests regarding your paid leave. And your written action reports, compared to last year's volume, have been indeed...
So I should thank them for caring so much about my time off that they're sending me a little performance bonus.
Alright. Let's see where this suspect's gotten to.
[Scene Change: Another Street in Syndicate]
You lead the arrest squad through the district, tracing the trail of crime scenes this vandal leaves in their wake.
The sheer scope and quantity of destruction the target causes leaves a trail impossible to miss. By all logic, tracking them down should be simple, but...
[Quick transition]

speaker: BBQ Restaurant Owner
content: Two chickens, eighteen pig's trotters, a whole lamb, and those three dumpster cats from out back, just gone! That freak definitely snatched 'em up and ate 'em!

speaker: BBQ Restaurant Owner
content: Just like that Godz... what? You ain't heard of it? Guess imports ain't made it here yet... Hey! I ain't runnin' no bootleg racket! Who's got a projector in this neighborhood anyway? Haha... yeah...

speaker: BBQ Restaurant Owner
content: Please, you gotta nail this crook! Here, take a bite, take it! Don't be shy now... and you come back anytime, ya hear?
[Quick transition]

speaker: Jewelry Salesperson
content: Between us? They cleaned out the VIP lounge snacks and made off with the tiger claw bracelet from the window. But here's the weird part: they didn't even graze that wobbly dessert stand. I bump it with my hip all the time, and they didn't knock it over? Very odd.

speaker: Jewelry Salesperson
content: Here, this is the set that was taken. Take a look... You're welcome to try it on, of course!

speaker: Jewelry Salesperson
content: You know, that cat's eye fits you really well! No pressure, but I have a feeling about these things. Here's my card. Stay in touch!
[Quick transition]

speaker: Amusement Park Manager
content: Stolen? Nothing was stolen, but eight kids are missing!

speaker: Amusement Park Manager
content: Cameras show nothing, and I haven't seen a soul who looks shifty... I'm more of a wreck about this than you are! We haven't even started counting our damages yet!

speaker: Amusement Park Manager
content: Look at this mess! Popcorn machine's trashed, the seesaw's snapped, duck floaties popped, and the cat mascot suit is just... shredded! Total write-off!

speaker: Amusement Park Manager
content: The mascot suit? Kids love it; they chase it all over. But you need a real big guy to wear it—over six feet, built like a fridge—otherwise the skirt just droops and looks sad. Trade secret, though. You didn't hear it from me.
[Quick transition]

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...That concludes all current intelligence on the target at large in Syndicate.

You stand now at the latest crime scene, a space that used to be a parking lot. Cargo trucks lie in a twisted heap, their cabs crumpled into grotesque shapes, wheels frozen mid-rotation and pointing uselessly at the open sky. It is, by any measure, quite a spectacle.

speaker: Nightingale
content: This was a neutral exchange point for several remaining gangs. Following the West District purge, most of them were eliminated, but some logistical remnants persist.

speaker: Nightingale
content: These trucks were running contraband between Eastia and DisCity. They likely arrived to offload goods and were intercepted by a third party. They lost the cargo and the fight.
The metal plating of the nearest cargo container bears several gashes, terrifyingly deep, carved into the surface. It is easy to picture the fierce struggle that unfolded here.
You examine the scene and begin building a profile of the suspect from what little you know.
Okay, so we've got fast, we've got stealthy, and based on these marks, we're looking at close to two meters tall with strength to match. Snatches kids, but also swipes alley cats...
The profile only grows more bizarre with each passing minute. You find yourself rubbing your temples again. Whoever this is, they are going to be a nightmare to pin down.

You step closer to the damaged truck. Around your feet, boxes once packed with contraband lie gutted and scattered, their contents spilled across the ground in a careless mess. Something in the corner catches your eye, and your expression hardens into a frown.
...Wait. Food?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Specialty foods and imported snacks. Typically used as cover material layered over the actual contraband from Eastia.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief? Did you find something?
You lean into the cargo box and pluck a short stick from the debris. Dry and brown, the twig shows clear evidence of teeth. Something has worked it over, leaving bite marks along every inch.
What on earth...

You crouch and sweep the scattered debris aside with your hands. Beneath it all, you uncover two ceramic jars where wine still pools at the bottom, several animal skeletons picked clean to the bone, and a rough but thick blanket.
Just as I thought. This is where they started. Someone hitched a ride from Eastia in this shipment.
And as for who...
Nightingale, call the Committee. We need a favor.
Let's set out a welcome mat for our guest.
[Scene Change: Another Street in Syndicate]
A large cargo truck pulls up behind the building. The driver climbs out and knocks on the back door with practiced ease, where someone dressed in black waits just inside.

speaker: Figure in Black
content: You got the goods?

speaker: Freight Driver
content: Obviously. The stuff we brought before was just snacks for the road. This batch is the real thing.

speaker: Figure in Black
content: Good. Anyone tail you?

speaker: Freight Driver
content: Relax, I know what I'm doing. Even brought the "chef" myself. Right there in the truck.
The driver turns and gestures toward someone climbing down from the passenger seat.
The figure in black gives a final nod and orders the inspection to commence. The driver seizes the moment, sidling up to the "chef" to speak in a hushed tone.

speaker: Freight Driver
content: Chief. Still no sign of the target. We going ahead with this?
...Yeah. And next time, lose the banner. Anyone with half a brain would smell a trap.
You glance up at the banner overhead: "Welcome Renowned Eastian Chef for Culinary Guidance." Your collar, starched and stiff from the chef's uniform, digs into your neck. You tug at it.

Nearby, the arrest squad, disguised in black, gathers around the side of the truck. The door creaks open inch by inch. Everyone holds their breath, tense with anticipation, as one team member steps forward and retrieves the strategic resources you specifically requisitioned—
Several authentic Eastian smoked chickens, their skin a perfect golden-brown, their aroma wafting through the air.
Everyone stay sharp. Wait for my signal...
One second. Two seconds... The smell of smoked meat hangs in the air. The back alley goes quiet, so much so that only footsteps break the stillness.
You wait in silence, watching as the box of smoked chickens is lifted out and drawn closer. Just one second before it is carried indoors—
[Tiger's roar and pouncing sound]
A thunderous roar splits the air. An enormous figure swoops over your head and crashes down from the top of the truck!
Now! Move in!!

The cargo truck crumples like a tin toy, metal screeching in protest. From above, a massive net drops and swallows the attacker whole. The arrest squad, hidden and waiting, surges forward to pin their target down.
The attacker thrashes, kicking up clouds of dust with every desperate lunge. The sheer strength nearly shakes the squad loose.
The net tightens, and the struggles slowly fade. You squint through the settling dust at the massive creature, and freeze. That shape. You know that shape. You saw it not long ago. It is...
A tiger?????

speaker: Arrest Squad Member
content: —Argh?!
A scream tears through your ears. You spin, only to find squad members crumpling beside you, bodies folding at wrong angles, swallowed fast by the churning dust.
Human screams, gunfire, and bestial roars echo through the alley. In this critical moment, you have only one choice—
The shackles pulse with faint red light, a dim glow lost in the smoke. You cannot see a thing, but in the next moment, you feel your body lifted into the air.
The world spins around you, then a hard surface presses against your stomach. You belatedly realize that someone has grabbed you off the ground and slung you over their shoulder.
The Mountain Lord graces DisCity with her presence—
Hey, Tiny. It's been a while! Miss me?
Are you out of your mind?! Put me down, now!!! —Ugh!

Upside down, the world is nothing but chaos and noise. The arrest squad screams, panic and fury tangled together, and then your stomach lurches with another brutal jolt. Xiaofeng lands hard on the truck's roof, already bounding away from the incoming blows.

speaker: Arrest Squad Member
content: Get the adjutant! Suppressing fire! Get the Chief back!

speaker: Tiger
content: Roarrrr...!
Someone charges. Xiaofeng meets them with a single blow and knocks them back. A long roar tears free as her tail whips in a wide arc, scattering every arrest squad member in reach.
Stop it!! Xiaofeng, what are you doing?!
That lazy, delighted voice sounds right above your head like a phantom. You struggle to lift your head and find yourself face to face with a smug, triumphant grin.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: I come all the way from Eastia to play, and this is the welcome I get? No "oh wow, Xiaofeng's here"? No "hey, good to see you"?
A tiger from the Eastian mountains showing up in DisCity isn't a "wow." It's a heart attack! Did you even read the banner?!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Course I read it. Got eyes, don't I? But you humans always say, "Can't catch a wolf without bait." And your traps usually have the good stuff inside...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Guess I caught something even better!
You...!
The world spins before your eyes—ground surging close, then falling away—as Xiaofeng races and leaps between buildings with you slung over her shoulder.
Your stomach churns painfully against her frame. You have never been carried like this. You fight to tighten your core, desperate to keep your head from flopping uselessly in the violent wind.
Wait... Can you not carry me like this... I'm gonna throw up...
You should know better. Of course she sees the banner. Of course she does not have the sense to stay away.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Alright, finders keepers! Sorry, little ones, borrowing your boss for a bit!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Eastia's been boring me to death. But this place is not bad at all. And since I need a guide...
Another sudden leap into the air. Xiaofeng spins you around into a different position, and you find yourself staring directly into her vertical pupils, gleaming with amusement.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hah! Change of plans. I'm here, you're here, so show me around!
[Blue fragmented dynamic background]

All she sees is darkness. In her ears, a constant buzzing drones on, thin and persistent as a cloud of mosquitoes. She tries to swat it away, but the weight holds her down. Her body is impossibly heavy, her arms leaden and useless.

Her body lies pinned beneath a massive weight, unable to move despite your greatest efforts. As restlessness stirs within her, the buzzing in her ears grows louder, gradually coalescing into sounds that almost resemble comprehensible words.
[Dream, Xiaofeng's Past. Background: Mountain Woods in Eastia]

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Oh, you're awake. Finally! How's the leg feel?
The disheveled child bolted upright, only to accidentally jostle the wound on her leg and collapse back down.
A pair of hands was reaching out from the side, gently touching her skin. The girl with the herb basket crouched beside the child, her eyes brimming with concern.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Does it hurt a lot? That's no good. The wound's gone bad. The herbs need more time to work.

Something cold pressed against the leg. Almost on reflex, the child's jaws snapped shut around the girl's wrist. A pulse throbbed beneath sharp fangs; the wrist was so slender it seemed as though it might shatter under the slightest pressure.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Shh... shh... It's okay. I promise it won't hurt much...
The girl did not pull away. Instead, she kept speaking in a soothing voice, using her free hand to show the child the herbs she held.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: I found you while I was picking herbs. The snow had almost buried you. Lucky thing, it's just scratches and bruises. Nothing's broken. Two weeks, maybe, and you'll be good as new.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Nobody comes up here this time of year. Tigers hunt here. Wild things. It's dangerous. You must've had your reasons...

There had been no hostility. This was not an enemy. Catching the scent of common hemostatic herbs, the child determined the stranger posed no threat. Only then did she give the girl's wrist a perfunctory lick before pulling away.
The girl's hands moved swiftly and gently. Within moments, she had dressed the wound properly and secured it with a decorative red cord.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: There. All done.
The girl patted the child's head and smoothed out the tangled hair. But the moment she turned away, the child shook her head and tested her limbs, preparing to bolt.
Unfortunately, the escape attempt had been cut short before it even began. The girl had caught and pinned the child down once more.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Your leg needs rest. You'll have to stay at the temple for now. Don't worry, I'll come up every day. Bring plenty of medicine... Hm?
A faint rustling sound drew her attention. The girl turned to find that fuzzy head had somehow crept close, and was sniffing intently at the cloth pouch hanging from her waist.
The girl slapped her forehead and pulled out two round, flat objects from her waist pouch.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Oh! How could I forget—

The disheveled child remained guarded at first, only leaning in to sniff. But the aroma had proved irresistible. She took a tentative bite from the girl's hand and swallowed without tasting. Then another bite. Her eyes lit up.

This time, the taste registered fully. She snatched the rest and devoured it, meat juices smearing across her mouth. After savoring every last morsel and licking her fingers clean, she looked up expectantly, her hand reaching toward the pouch for more.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Haha! Drink some water first. Slow down. I'll bring more meat pies tomorrow when I come back—
Before she could finish, the girl noticed the child had grabbed another gourd and was gulping it down.
The child blinked. The girl before her had seemed to multiply into eight identical copies, each face etched with anxiety, all shaking her shoulders and urging her to spit it out.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: No! That's for cleaning wounds! You can't drink that!
...Burp...
Warmth flooded through her body. The child tried to stand and take a few steps, but the world tilted and spun around her. Once more, she collapsed face-first onto the ground.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Yes?
I'm... strong... Not... stupid...
Bad things... killed them. All gone. Here... my place. Safe now...

As she spoke, the child's eyes began to glaze over, her eyelids growing heavy and drooping. Her words slurred into incomprehensible murmurs. The girl didn't know whether to laugh or cry, and could only coax her gently, lifting the water to her lips.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Alright, alright. I hear you...

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Rest now... May the Mountain Lord watch over you. When you wake and your wounds are healed... you can go down the mountain...
[Syndicate Street]

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hahaha, this place is great!
Xiaofeng leaps down from the building, her voice brimming with barely contained excitement.

The wind howls past your ears, tangled with the boom of her laughter. Slung over her shoulder, you are nothing but dead weight as she weaves through the city, the clamor of the chase fading behind you. The relentless jostling churns your insides until your stomach finally reaches its limit.
Okay, okay! Whatever you want, we'll talk! But if you don't want me puking down your back, put me down—!

A soft chuckle drifts down from above. You are lifted once more, then gently lowered until your feet finally meet solid ground. When you look up, the culprit herself is crouched before you, regarding you with undisguised curiosity.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Still scrawny. Don't you ever use those muscles? They starvin' you here or what?

options: I'm in way better shape than last time.

content: Look, business first. You wanted me to play guide, right? Answer a few questions, and I'm yours for the day.
Xiaofeng tilts her head. Apparently, a simple outing isn't supposed to involve this many conditions.
The amusement park. That was you, right? The kids who went missing with you. Where are they?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Barbecue stall over there. Eating skewers. Those cats too.
And the missing jewelry... Wait. Barbecue stall? How'd you pay?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: You humans like shiny rocks. So I gave 'em to the meat guy. Left some on the fake cat suit too, but nobody grabbed 'em. Were they fake?
What about your tiger? It's already been taken back to the MBCC. Aren't you worried?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Meowy? Nah. We play first. When she misses me, she'll find her own way back.

Xiaofeng plops down beside you and cheerfully launches into the tale of her journey to DisCity. She tells you how she and her tiger stow away on a cargo ship bound for the city, one that conveniently delivers them straight into Syndicate. Unable to locate you right away, she simply wanders around, content to wait for you to come find her instead.

She gesticulates wildly as she recounts the adventure, utterly oblivious to the chaos she has left in her wake. You cover your face, struggling to contain your exasperation, and manage to pose another question.

So let me get this straight. The mighty Mountain Lord graces DisCity with her presence because...? Because right now it's feeling less like a friendly visit and more like you're just yanking my chain...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: To have fun, of course!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: After you and that plum branch girl left, all the troublemakers back there got themselves killed or busted up. Boring! But this place? So much noise! So much going on! And the people here are real friendly, practically throwing gifts at me!
Xiaofeng licks her lips with satisfaction. You do not dare to dwell on what she truly means when she says people "throw gifts at her."
Still, keeping her under your watch is surely better than letting her roam free and wreak havoc.
...Fine. Just—please—stop wandering off alone. You'll just get grabbed again. Where else do you wanna go? I'll take you myself.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Oh! Yeah, I saw lots of good stuff on the way in—
Xiaofeng's eyes light up. A wave of dread washes over you, but before you can muster a single word of protest, you are hoisted up by your collar once more.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Be a good little guide, yeah? Stick with me. I'll show you how to really have a good time!
[Syndicate Street]
In the end, you severely underestimate what Xiaofeng means by "having a good time."

The list, as it turns out, includes mooching meals, pilfering trinkets, storming gang trafficking deals, and stirring up general chaos. If something piques her interest, moral boundaries simply cease to exist.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Cargo? What cargo?
You try asking Xiaofeng why she attacks the gangs that smuggle goods from Eastia. She tilts her head, her expression one of genuine bafflement at the question.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Ohhh, those metal boxes? Yeah, the stuff inside was boring. But those wooden sticks on top? Those were good. Can't even find sticks that nice back home.

After several chaotic escapades, you have gotten a read on how Xiaofeng operates. She thrives on mischief and excitement, always diving headfirst into danger, her body moving long before her brain even catches up.
As for dealing with the aftermath...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Ahahahaha!
The philosophy is obvious: fight first, and if that does not work, run!
All you can do is stay behind Xiaofeng and pull your coat over your face, just in case tomorrow's wanted posters happen to feature the Minos Chief before they get around to featuring her.
[Keylan Square]
Evening settles over the plaza, where crowds gather for the festivities below. You and Xiaofeng stand above it all, perched on the edge of a high rooftop.

Several clay jars sit beside Xiaofeng, silent evidence of multiple rounds of drinking. You decline her invitation to join, but she hardly seems to care. She sprawls out completely, as though the rooftop beneath her is nothing more than an oversized cat tower built for her personal comfort.

The festival lights below cast dancing shadows around her, shifting and flickering. She watches the patterns beside her hand for a long, focused moment before finally lunging, only to swipe at empty air. The sight reminds you of those plump cats always lounging outside the Bureau, chasing things only they can see.
Pfft...
Your laughter earns you an eye roll from Xiaofeng.
She lets out a burp, shaking off the last of her drunken haze as she rises to her feet. She dusts herself off with casual indifference and calls down to the children watching from below.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Oi! You kids down there!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: New to this city. What's worth knowing around here? Someone tell me a good one. Make it interesting. I got candy.

The children below startle at first, flinching back before the candy in Xiaofeng's hand works its magic. After a brief hesitation, hands shoot into the air as they eagerly compete for her attention. Xiaofeng surveys the small crowd for a moment, then casually points at one who has pushed her way to the front.

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: I know all about the Sinners! There's Zoya, a cool lady who runs the Legion! And EMP, the Uncrowned Ruler of Syndicate, who calls down lightning! And... and the little mouse Hella! Nobody beats Hella in WhiteSands!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Yeah? Not bad. Catch.

Xiaofeng tosses down a handful of candy, and the children watch it rain down upon them. Seeing that she keeps her word, they buzz with fresh anticipation, eager for whatever question she might ask next.

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: Me! Me! Pick me! I got another one!

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: This one's from Eastia! Heard it from a trader at the Drifter Camp...
[See if we can use an Eastian background for this sequence]

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: Long time ago, during a big war in Eastia, a whole village ran away. Settled at the bottom of a huge mountain.

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: But the mountain was dangerous. Hunters had to stick together or the beasts would get 'em.

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: One day, a kid wandered off and got lost on the trail. His mama cried and cried, yelled herself hoarse, searched everywhere... couldn't find him...

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: Then one day, he just walked back down!

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: Yeah! Not a scratch on him either! Said he met a big tiger in the mountains, its fur all silvery-white. The tiger watched over him, gave him a red string bracelet, and showed him the way down!

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: Everyone said the Tiger Deity blessed him. After that, people wore red strings going up the mountain. Left offerings too. With the Tiger Deity watching, they weren't scared of anything!
[Back to AVG]
The first child tells the story with such vivid detail that the others around her gasp in wonder.

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: Wait... Where'd the Tiger Deity come from, though?

speaker: Onlooking Child
content: Dummy! That tiger's a deity! It was always there!
Didn't know your greatest hits made it all the way to DisCity. Right, Mountain Lord?

You mean to tease her, but the words are met with silence. When you glance over, you find Xiaofeng's face bathed in the glow of neon lights. She seems to be smiling yet you cannot quite read what lies beneath it.
...Xiaofeng?
[White flash + flashlight click, screen shake]

speaker: Sheriff
content: Hey! You two up there, get down! Now!

A sharp command shatters the gathering like a stone through glass. The children scatter in an instant, melting into the shadows. The searchlight sweeps upward, its beam catching the two figures perched above—you and Xiaofeng. Time to make yourselves scarce.
But... knowing Xiaofeng, there is no way she makes a conventional exit.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hah! Good timing. Belly's full, so I could use a stretch. Alright, folks! Got coin? Toss it. No coin? Clap loud. I'll take that too!

Xiaofeng stands atop the Keylan statue, an imposing silhouette against the night sky, looking down at the officers below with their batons and shields raised. Her loose coat snaps and billows in the wind, alive with motion.
But just before she pounces, a glint of light flashes across her vision.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: ?! What's that?!

Instinct takes over. Xiaofeng lunges headfirst toward the glint in the flower bed, and everything she has somehow collected—candy, colorful scraps, trinkets, loose gems and pearls—goes flying in a dazzling cascade around her.

As for you... you quickly switch off the flashlight, tug your collar up to hide your all-too-recognizable face, and slip past the officers. Amid the children's delighted gasps and the officers' confused shouts, you dash to the flower bed to pull her out of the chaos.
[Scene Change: Syndicate Back Alley]
You sprint through the winding back alleys of Syndicate, dragging Xiaofeng along by the hand.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Huh. Look at you. Those legs actually work.
Had to learn. Someone around here's even quicker, and way worse at staying out of trouble.
You gasp for breath, and the words that escape you come out sharper than intended, though Xiaofeng doesn't seem to mind in the slightest. Her voice remains light, still threaded with amusement.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Heh. So you noticed, huh? How'd you figure I'd go chasing after that little flash of light?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Sharp eyes. I like that. You ever think about ditching all this and running with me instead?
And do what, exactly?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Go wherever the road takes us. Eat big, drink deep, pick a fight when the mood strikes. Simple as that.
Gonna have to turn that one down.
Your answer comes swift and resolute, carrying an edge that is almost righteous in its certainty.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Ah, too bad. Real inconvenient timing, too, 'cause those boys ahead look like they've got their sights set on both of us...

Xiaofeng's voice drops. Before you can process what is happening, a sharp tug yanks you backward and straight into an embrace that reeks of alcohol. You open your mouth to protest, but her hand clamps down on your head, pressing your face firmly against her chest.

Shh— Xiaofeng presses a finger to her lips, then gestures ahead. Through the dim glow cast by a nearby bar's garish neon signs, you make out shapes shifting in the darkness. An unmarked truck idles at the mouth of the alley. Two groups of figures dressed in black scan the area, their gazes wary and searching.
The man leading them slowly turns his head, revealing a face marred by scars. His eyes settle on you and Xiaofeng, frozen there in your awkward embrace.

speaker: Figure in Black 1
content: ...Who's that? One of yours?

speaker: Figure in Black 2
content: Nope. Thought you called for extra hands.

Good news: they haven't recognized you. Bad news: they clearly have no intention of letting you go. The men in black shift to block the alley entrance, their hands sliding into their jackets, ready to draw a gun at a moment's notice.

You are still weighing your options when Xiaofeng suddenly flashes her fangs in a grin and pulls you forward two steps. Her gait wavers, every movement dripping with drunken haze. She is the picture of a tipsy fool who has stumbled into the wrong alley.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hey now. My friend here might've had a few, but the name still carries weight. Take a good look. This is the one and only Noms Chief.

speaker: Figure in Black 2
content: Noms Chief? You mean this sorry sack with the collar up trying to look mysterious? And you, an idiot gnawing on a stick?
The men's eyes dart between you and Xiaofeng, uncertain and searching. Then they lock onto her face, and something clicks.

speaker: Figure in Black 1
content: Wait... tall. White hair. Ears on her head...

speaker: Figure in Black 1
content: That's the ***** who jacked our shipment!
You whip your head toward her. Xiaofeng grins back, the very picture of innocence.

options: Do you just collect enemies everywhere you go?

content: Before Xiaofeng can respond, a dozen thugs in matching outfits pour out of the truck, flooding the alley and forming a tight circle around you both. The narrow space suddenly feels suffocating.

speaker: Figure in Black 1
content: Hmph! Hand it over. Now. Or you're not walking out of here.
Clack. The sound of rounds being chambered is unnervingly clear and unmistakable.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Heh... A bunch of stray pups, puffing up 'cause the tiger's not home...
With your face still pressed against her chest, you cannot see her expression. But you can feel that coiled energy thrumming through her body.
You do not doubt Xiaofeng's ability to win this fight for a second. The problem lies in the aftermath. If she cuts loose here, in this cramped alley, the collateral damage will be catastrophic.

Your hand moves instinctively toward your pocket, only to remember that your communicator is long gone, tossed aside earlier by the very same Mountain Lord who now holds you captive. You scan your surroundings from the corner of your eye. Surrounded on all sides. No obvious exit. How do you break through? How do you escape?
Your eyes drift upward. Suddenly, an idea clicks into place.
Xiaofeng! Do <color=#fb9259>that thing</color> again! Show them what you've got!

speaker: Figure in Black 1
content: That thing?

speaker: Figure in Black 2
content: What thing?
Hemmed in on all sides with no path forward, you abandon the ground entirely and point straight up instead.

speaker: Figure in Black 2
content: **** the riddles! You cops all brain-dead or what?!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Oh... that.
A smile tugs at Xiaofeng's lips.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Well. Since you asked so nicely... this Mountain Lord can spare one more show.
Xiaofeng's expression turns serious. She raises a single finger skyward, holds it there for a breath, then slowly draws it back, curling her thumb and index finger into a circle at her lips.
[1s silence, whistle sound, immediately followed by cats yowling]

speaker: Figure in Black 1
content: Huh?! What the—?!

At the whistle's call, countless pairs of eyes ignite in the darkness—pinpricks of eerie luminescence blinking to life all around you. A horde of shrieking creatures plummets from above, diving like living shadows onto the encircling thugs.

speaker: Figures in Black
content: Cats?!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hahahahahaha—!

Xiaofeng whips her coat forward, shrouding the thugs ahead. A swift kick follows, then a wrist bone cracks with a sickening snap. The gun clatters to the ground, but she snatches it mid-fall and tosses it your way without a second glance.

options: Catch the gun and join the fight!

content: Tiger claws flash. Clubs swing. Fists and feet fly. Modified pistols bark. The narrow alley erupts into utter chaos.

The thud of bone meeting bone, the sharp clang of metal, and a chorus of anguished curses blend into a savage symphony. Bodies stumble and fall back, crashing into one another. Amid the blur of swinging clubs and flashing muzzles, screams and groans rise and fall like a brutal tide.
Finally, only you and Xiaofeng remain standing. The rest sprawl across the ground, a groaning, whimpering carpet of defeat. Only then do you call for Xiaofeng to stand down.
That's enough. We need some of them conscious for questioning.
You approach the cargo truck and begin your search. Pushing aside the top layer of silvervine branches used as camouflage, you pry open the lead-sealed crates.
Level 2 contraband pharmaceuticals. That'll put them away for a while.

You retrieve the gang's communication devices and put in a call to the Syndicate Security Bureau. From the corner of your eye, you notice that Xiaofeng has stopped moving as well. She is now elbow-deep in the crates of contraband, rummaging through them with obvious fascination.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: See? Told you. You locked up all the fun ones. These scraps weren't even a warm-up.
She pulls out a silvervine branch and sticks it between her teeth, then grabs a generous handful and tosses them to the stray cats—her valiant little helpers who answered the whistle's call.

In an instant, the narrow alley fills with cats nuzzling the silvervine and rolling about in pure, unbridled bliss. Their satisfied purrs rise and fall, mingling with the thugs' feeble groans, and together they paint an oddly comical picture.
Even without your tiger, you've got an army of cats on call. That's fitting, Mountain Lord.
Xiaofeng crouches on the ground, running her hand along a calico cat's back with practiced ease, the exact same technique she uses when she strokes her tiger.

You crouch down as well, hoping to pet one yourself, but the cat's ears suddenly perk up, sharp and alert. It springs away and bolts into the shadows before your hand can even reach it. You stare after it, bewildered, until the faint wail of sirens registers in the distance. Of course, these little tigers have far sharper ears than you ever will.
A soft snort of laughter reaches your ears. Xiaofeng stretches languidly, every movement unhurried and feline, and rises to her feet. But you call out to her.
Xiaofeng.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hm?
Next stop. Somewhere more... thrilling. You in?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hah! Lead the way.
[Black Screen]

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: ...Huh. And here I was wondering what you had in mind...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: So this is what you call more thrilling?

The interrogation room's lights hang dim and cold, cutting through the space like a dull blade and carving it into stark halves of shadow and glare. You and Xiaofeng sit across from each other, separated by mere inches of table, though it might as well be worlds.
The standoff stretches. Finally, a grin breaks across her face, wide and toothy, but her eyes remain cold.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: What happened? You were all chatty before. Something got your tongue?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Well? Spit it out. What's this all about?
The smile curves on her lips, but it never touches her eyes.
This is MBCC. DisCity's agency for handling Sinners.
Look, I know you're pissed. I get it. Let's just... take a breath. Talk this through.
Xiaofeng tilts her head slightly, and a laugh escapes her lips.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Course you get it. Big Noms Chief's got rules to follow. Can't be seen running around with some stray, right?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Go on, then. Let's hear it. Sooner you talk, sooner I'm out of this box.
Xiaofeng leans back, slouching against the chair with an air of ease until you notice those slit pupils locking onto you, unblinking. A chill runs down your spine.
...I'm sorry. I didn't want this. But there's a way things have to be done.
test
test
test
test
test
test
You lay the file on the table between you. It contains a detailed record of the damage Xiaofeng has inflicted across Syndicate.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: The hell's that? Can't read your fancy papers.
...It's a compiled record of the damage you've caused throughout Syndicate since entering DisCity.

A meat stall robbed, a jewelry store hit, and kids snatched from the park... Setting aside the potential ramifications of smuggling and illegal entry, your actions have directly damaged the property and safety of West District residents. I had no choice but to step in.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Heh. Funny. I remember helping you bag those smugglers. Didn't see any medal for that.
You did... And the way you did it left the streets looking like a warzone. Catching bad guys doesn't erase the cleanup.
I'm sorry. But my job—my first job—as the MBCC Chief is keeping citizens safe.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Tch. All these damn rules, twisting everything around. Good's good. Bad's bad. Why make it messy?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Ha. Should've known. Here I was thinking we were the same kind. Thought maybe we could run together. Eat, drink, stir up some fun... Guess I was the fool. Some smiles don't mean a thing.
You know exactly what Xiaofeng wants to hear: if you toss these files aside right now and ask her to continue your adventures together, she agrees in a heartbeat.
But you have your own principles to uphold.

We can't allow an S-Class Sinner to roam DisCity unchecked. But fortunately, regulations on Sinners aren't as strict as they used to be. We've had cases of foreign Sinners being granted parole before.
I promise, as long as you cooperate and pass the evaluations, I'll fight to secure you as much freedom as possible.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: ...Freedom?
Xiaofeng leans back in her chair. There is a slight softening in her tone now.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Fine. What kind of freedom?

Within the Bureau, many Sinners continue to pursue personal interests and maintain individual lifestyles. We do not impose blanket restrictions on daily conduct. You can continue living as you normally would.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Mm... Figured. So you're slapping one of those shackle things on me?

Correct. I require the ability to monitor your location and, if necessary, to enforce compliance. However, as long as your behavior remains within acceptable parameters, I will not interfere with your activities.
Because... I know that you don't act out of malice.
You look at Xiaofeng. By now, you understand her nature. She is not so much a person as a wild thing descended from the deep mountains.

Strength grants her simplicity. Her mind works in straight lines, untouched by the weight of others' opinions. When someone catches her interest, she plays with them for sport. The moment that interest fades, she vanishes, never lingering.
Many of the Sinners here are similar to you, restless, with more energy than constructive outlets. That's where friction comes from.
With the right channels—assignments, missions, objectives—those tensions can be redirected. I'll ensure you have access to those opportunities.
And if your evaluations come back favorable, you could earn expanded privileges. More time outside the facility—
You don't get to finish. At the keyword, Xiaofeng lunges forward like a predator seizing prey, closing the distance in an instant and cutting you off.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: How long outside? What do I have to do? And how much can I push it?
...It depends on the individual case. But I'll secure whatever latitude I can.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: ...There it is. You can't even give me a straight answer.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: I've seen that type. Soon as they get a little authority, all they care about is covering their own hide. If I'm so dangerous, someone who needs locking up right now, then your bosses wouldn't let me roam free for a second.

Before she finishes speaking, she lunges, the motion too fast for you to do anything but flinch. Her hand sweeps toward the folder at your side, fingertips hooking the pages inside, and with one sharp jerk, she tears them free.

They scatter through the air like snow: approval numbers, red stamps, classified text—all of it flashes once under the light and dissolves into chaos. Amid the swirling mess, Xiaofeng's eyes find their target with predatory precision. Her hand darts out and seizes a single page.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Can't read much. But I know my own name when I see it.
She glances down at the paper and then back up at you, her smile cold and never reaching her eyes.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Go on, then, Tiny. Read it to me. What's it say?
Slap. The paper hits the table squarely in front of you. The enlarged, bolded Eastian characters stare up, stark and unforgiving.
Silence stretches between you, and Xiaofeng's gaze cuts through it, sharp as a blade, piercing every careful word you have laid down.
Those words mean nothing now. You have no choice. You must tell her the truth.
...I've been ordered to detain you. And to process your deportation back to Eastia. There's a deadline.
You gather the scattered documents, and beyond the dense text of your action reports, you find another file: an investigation report.
I know an Eastian scholar who specializes in mythology. After hearing about the White Tiger Mountain Lord, I reached out. She came back with some interesting findings.

In Eastia, there's a mountain range called White Tiger. Stretches hundreds of miles. Local legend says a tiger deity lives there. Offer tribute, and the deity grants safe passage through the mountains.

The myth paints a peaceful picture, but reality's messier. Wildlife and humans still clash, hunting each other, fighting over territory. But there are accounts of something unusual. Some claim they've seen a human figure... walking alongside a white tiger.
Whether there's truly a deity on White Tiger Mountain isn't something we can verify. But we can confirm one thing with reasonable certainty. A powerful human lives there.
Someone strong enough to command a white tiger. Someone who earned the title "Mountain Lord." In DisCity terms, an S-Class Sinner.
You lift your gaze and lock eyes with Xiaofeng.
Xiaofeng. That person is you.

I understand now. The smuggling, the fights, and even what happened at Northsnow Manor... You were just bored. You weren't trying to cause harm. You were simply playing, passing the time, and having fun. To you, chaos is just... entertainment.
But to ordinary people, what you call entertainment is a <color=#fb9259>disaster</color>.

That's why DisCity doesn't want an unpredictable variable like you roaming freely within its borders. And I... I'm genuinely glad you came to see me. But perhaps we can find a better way forward. Something more stable and safer, for both of us.
The room falls silent. Xiaofeng isn't smiling. For the first time, her gaze shifts away, and something uneasy stirs in your chest.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: ...Heh. So that's how you see me...

Clang! The woman across from you explodes into motion. Her restraints shriek warnings and then snap apart as a blur streaks across the table's edge. You barely raise your hand before a tremendous force slams you back into your chair.

Metal screeches as the shackles on her hands twist and break completely. She slips past your defenses with ease and slams you against the wall, one hand pinning you there. Her cold fingertips find your throat.
Ugh!
Xiaofeng bares her teeth in a grin, stark white fangs flashing, and a low laugh escapes her throat.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Too strong, so I'm dangerous? Might hurt someone, so I should roll over and let you put a leash on me?

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Tiny... do you even know what a "Mountain Lord" really is?
Her cold fingertips trail slowly along your neck, hovering and teasing, until they find your pulse. They begin to tighten. And when she speaks, her voice drips with danger.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: You humans... Soon as you leave the mountains behind, soon as your bellies are full, you love looking down on everything else. Passing judgment. Forgetting what it took to survive out there.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Being a <color=#fb9259>Mountain Lord</color>... First, you live through the endless snowstorms. Then you sink your fangs into every beast that challenges you. Fight for every scrap of food. Every inch of ground. No one speaks pretty out there. You lose once, and you're dead.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: You fight until nothing dares challenge you anymore. Then you're safe, for a while. But you're always watching, waiting for the next cub that grows strong enough to kill you and take your place... That's the mountain. It's either they die, or you die.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Heh... Funny, isn't it? Humans don't raise their young but dump them in the mountains. Leave them for the tigers to drag off. If it weren't for this "Mania" you keep talking about, I would've frozen solid in the first storm.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Tell me, if there really was some great deity on White Tiger Mountain... why didn't they come for me first?
You...

Overlooked details click into place, forming a single clear conclusion: Xiaofeng disregards rules because she was never taught them, never civilized, never truly human. She survives on forest and instinct alone.
She lowers her head now, leaning close to your neck. Her breath falls warm across your skin. It takes you a moment to understand... that she is smelling you.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Heh, relax. I don't care about any of that. It's just... some fools can't tell the difference. They mistake me for some tiger deity, come begging for blessings. But the second they see real teeth, they piss themselves and run...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Isn't that rich? This is exactly what they asked for. They're just lying to themselves.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Humans never raised me. By rights, I don't owe your rules a damn thing. But you...

The pressure on your throat increases, and Mania flows from the point where her hand meets your skin. The shackles surge within you, lunging toward the "enemy" before you. You fight to hold them back, but Xiaofeng only grows more excited by your struggle.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hahahaha! There it is!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: I can smell it. You're just like me... But you've been caged too long. By this little iron box. By that buzzing little communicator. By all those obedient, foolish Sinners wagging their tails for you...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: And by whatever ideas they poured into your head! Who knows where they came from!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: "Greater good." "Justice." "Heroism." Just pretty words. That girl with the plum stick, she's the same. You could both be free like me...
Her hand tightens further around your throat, your vision blurs, and the violent pounding of your heart thunders in your ears.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Why not just live free and easy?
Xiaofeng... let go...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Come on! Fight back! You've got those shackles. Use them!
No... I can't...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Tiny... if you don't take this seriously, you're going to die.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Take a guess. How many rivals do you think I tore apart with my own fangs to become the Mountain Lord?
Her growl swallows the alarms until they fade to distant buzzing. Your vision tunnels toward black. You are at the edge now. If you do not act—

Crimson light flares hot and sudden. Shackle marks bloom like burning brands where your skin meets hers. Perception and will snap together—yours and hers, one chain. Xiaofeng's body locks. Her fingertips still rest against your throat, but the pressure stops. She cannot push further.
Enough. I'm not here to fight you to the death. Or to prove who's stronger.
If you want a fight, maybe no one here can stop you. Not these people, not these walls, not this entire Bureau. But I'm not playing your game, the one that drags everyone into a dead end with you.
I'm not here to argue about who's right. I don't expect you to agree with me now. But I want to hear you out. And I hope... you'll hear me out too.
The pressure on your throat vanishes, and Xiaofeng takes half a step back. The excitement drains from her face, leaving only obvious disappointment.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: ...Forget it. I'm done. This is boring.
What...

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: I came looking for you because I thought maybe... Tch. I was wrong about you.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: You're no different from the rest of them. All those so-called heroes.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: ...Boring. I'm leaving.
You clutch your throat. The ghost of pressure still lingers around your windpipe. Xiaofeng shakes out her hands and rises to her feet.
Then the security team bursts in. Weapons snap up, every barrel trained on Xiaofeng. Grim faces, ready to fire. But you do not let them stop her. She walks out untouched.
...The ship back to Eastia is ready. It leaves in a few days.
You'll stay at the Bureau until then. If... whenever you feel like talking, I'll be here. You know where to find me.
Xiaofeng's ears twitch, but she says nothing and walks out of the interrogation room without looking back.

From that day onward, the young girl visited the injured child each time she ascended the mountain to forage for herbs.

She spoke to the child often. A word or two might come in answer, but usually the child just stared and listened, eyes luminous and untamed, like the wild beasts the girl had encountered on those same slopes.

As the days wore on, the child's defenses lowered. There was no more squirming when the bandages were changed, and occasionally the child crept a little closer, drawn by curiosity as the girl pulled one strange thing after another from her bag.

The child watched in bewilderment as the girl drew a length of red string from her bag. With practiced hands, she tied it carefully around the child's wrist. Unused to the feel of anything against her skin, the child shook her arm several times, but the string held fast. In the end, she simply gave up.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: This is a protective charm. I went all the way to the Mountain Lord's temple just for this.
The girl lifted her hand, and there around her own wrist lay an identical string. Against the endless white of the snow, that slash of red seemed to burn with particular intensity.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: This place used to be a temple too, though it had fewer worshippers than the one down the mountain. Anyone who walks White Tiger Mountain wears one of these. If your heart is true, the White Tiger Mountain Lord keeps you safe. No harm will come to you here.
White... Tiger...?

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: That's right. See? Now the Mountain Lord watches over you, too.

The hand that bore the red string moved gently over the child's crown, taming the wild locks and plaiting them into a neat braid. The child's ears flickered with hesitation, but she did not draw back.
Another day slipped by. The girl had yet to show herself on the mountain.
More than half a month had gone by. The child's injured leg had nearly mended. She could have long since returned to her cave across the mountain, yet she remained.
The child crouched in the grass outside the ruined temple, then scrambled up onto the roof beneath the shade of the tree. She lay down, drifted off, rolled over several times, then sat up once more.
The girl was late again today. The sun had already set. The child touched her nearly-healed leg, and at last, made up her mind to leave—

She passed several old, sickly wolves. Their pack had long since forsaken them, yet hunger drove them to circle a young deer with a broken leg. The mother deer stood firm between her fawn and the predators, hooves raking the earth in mute warning.

She passed a hunter whose eyes had long gone dark. He hunched low in the underbrush, a crude crossbow held in his hands, patient as stone. Across the clearing, a wild boar rooted contentedly among the fallen fruit, deaf to the fate coiling nearby.

She passed a robbery unfolding on the road. Faced with the glint of bandits' blades, a figure had thrown their arms wide, a living barrier between the knives and the trembling mother and daughter huddled at their back.
...Huh?
The child finally stopped in her tracks.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Don't be afraid! They just want money. They won't dare hurt anyone. People from town will come soon... They'll drive these scoundrels away!

The bandits erupted in laughter. Sweat traced a path down the girl's temple, yet she held her ground. Only when one of them lunged forward to tear the child from the mother's grasp did her composure finally crack.

speaker: Herb-Gathering Girl
content: Don't touch her—Ah!

speaker: Bandit
content: Aaahhh!

Enraged, the others swung their weapons toward the child.

Clang. Claws met iron in a shriek of grinding steel. She slipped between the bandits like a wraith, every motion carving crimson arcs through the frozen air. The snow beneath them bloomed red. Some turned and fled, while others dropped to their knees, pleading. It made no difference.
The slaughter ended as swiftly as it had begun. The bandits lay sprawled in spreading pools. She shook out her hands with a flicker of irritation, annoyed by the slick warmth clinging to her skin.
Then she remembered why she had intervened at all. She turned to see if the ones she had shielded were unharmed—
And found only terror staring back at her.

speaker: Terrified Child

Xiaofeng lies sprawled across a sun-drenched platform, rolling over with listless boredom.

A rare dream of the past is souring her mood, though she is too lazy to bother venting. After spending so long surrounded by steel and concrete, she finds herself missing her den deep in the mountains.

The MBCC recreation yard is spacious enough; Sinners gather in small clusters while high walls and wire mesh gleam with an almost surreal softness in the sunlight. Distant voices of other Sinners drift over, but to her, it is nothing but noise.
An enormous tiger head nudges in from the side. Purring, the white tiger nuzzles into her palm, then mirrors her posture and settles down beside her, its tail curling around her feet.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Tch... Meowy, when we ditch this dump, you wanna eat first or nap first?
The tiger offers no answer, just a purr that grows louder.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Hmph. You lazy furball...
The wire mesh overhead is nothing but an eyesore, sealing off any route of escape, but Xiaofeng can't muster the will to care. It all feels so pointless.
She drifts back to her spot and lets her eyes fall shut under the warmth of the sun, waiting for the team due to escort her back to Eastia. However...
A verse says thus! At Hundred Treasures Peak's winding turn, the tiger veils its sacred form. The mortal world fears what it cannot know, a divine heart, forever scorned!
A child's bright voice rings out suddenly from below the platform. Xiaofeng cracks an eye open and spots a figure waving a lion head mask in the air.

speaker: OwO
content: Ladies and gentlemen! Today, I won't regale you with tales of the Rust's 108 Forbidden Acts, nor the epic of the three Campbell siblings! No. Today, I speak of a legendary Eastian mountain! And that mountain is—

speaker: OwO
content: White... White-something Mountain!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: How's a cage this small stuffed with this many people... Can't even catch a damn nap around here...

Grumbling beneath her breath, Xiaofeng rolls onto her side, clamps her hands over her ears, and buries her face deep in the tiger's fur, trying desperately to drown out the swell of cheers and applause from below.

speaker: OwO
content: Hello, everyone! I am the super-duper mega ultra spectacular incredible amazing undefeated supreme Lion Dancing Queen—umm, whatever-number-generation successor! OwO!

speaker: OwO
content: Today, I bring you an all-new production, Tale of Descending the Mountain, also known as Legend of the Tiger Deity! Anyone who wants to join in, hop on up! Show me that fire!

speaker: EMP
content: Director! Question!
EMP leaps onto the stage first. In her hands, she clutches pages that might generously pass for a script, squinting at the messy handwriting while stumbling her way through the performance.

speaker: EMP
content: If it's a tiger but also a deity... like, tigers eat people and deities save people. That's totally contradictory. What gives?

speaker: OwO
content: Ah, patience, dear audience! Allow me to explain in due time.

Legends whisper of a sacred mountain deep within the wilds of Eastia. Where tigers stalked the crags and virgin snow crowned the summit. That place was the White Tiger Mountain. An unbroken veil of mystic mist clung to its heights. Below, villagers prostrated themselves, burning fragrant incense toward the unseen peak, beseeching the mountain's mighty spirit for sanctuary.

Their earnest devotion bore wondrous fruit. When wolves slunk close beneath the moon, a tiger's thunderous roar shattered the silence, scattering the pack like leaves. When children lost their footing on sheer drops, unseen gales cradled them softly back to earth.

This mountain deity was both just and benevolent. Though their visage remained forever hidden, their hand moved only in grace. Present your finest wines and warmest welcome, and the deity's favor is assured.
The woman curled on the platform flicks her ears, and her body shifts instinctively toward the sound of the voices.

speaker: OwO
content: But one day, disaster struck the village! Little EMP ventured out to buy supplies for the New Year festivities, only to encounter... mountain bandits!

speaker: EMP
content: Uhh... Go, go! Bandit time!

Lightning-quick, EMP snatches hold of Ninety-Nine, who has been swinging her sword in practice nearby, and hauls her into the unfolding scene. Ninety-Nine blinks in confusion, then gestures toward herself.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Me?

speaker: EMP
content: YES, you! Make it convincing!
Following a barrage of theatrical winks and overblown gestures from EMP, Ninety-Nine reluctantly takes the script and starts to read.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Your money or your life. Empty your pockets. Coins, bills, all of it. Or else...

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Consider yourselves dead!

A beat of silence passes before the crowd erupts. Some reel backward with dramatic flair; others dive for cover, hands clamped over their heads. Screams ricochet across the room. Their acting abilities may range from passable to hopeless, but every last one of them throws themselves into the role of a terrified villager.
Xiaofeng turns her head, her gaze locking onto the scene below.

speaker: EMP
content: Uh... candy? Nope. Gone. Ate it all. And my DisCoins... you've been holding those, right? I got nothing! Zip! Zero!

speaker: EMP
content: Oh Mountain Lord, Mountain Lord! Hear my prayer! I'll offer you all my snacks! Years' worth! They're stashed under the beanbag cushions! Chi—I mean, the village chief worked so hard sneaking those in for me. I've been hoarding them forever!
She presses her hands together, and her voice shifts into something unexpectedly reverent, as though she is channeling every last drop of desperation into her improvised rambling.

speaker: EMP
content: Ninety-Nine, I mean, such a kind bandit will totally let us go... right?

speaker: OwO
content: No, no, no! The bandit is SUPER! MEGA! ULTRA! FURIOUS! You won't fork over a single thing?! Time to teach you a lesson!

speaker: OwO
content: Bandit, attack!

speaker: EMP
content: ???? Wait—WAIT—you're for REAL?!

Ninety-Nine brings the greatsword down exactly as instructed. EMP scrambles backward in pure panic, her lines dissolving into wordless shrieks. She plows straight into the crowd of spectators, and bodies go tumbling in every direction. The scene descends into utter chaos.

speaker: EMP
content: MOUNTAIN LORD! MOUNTAIN LORD, SAVE ME! NINETY-NINE'S GONNA KILL ME—AAAHHH!
The greatsword slices through the air until a figure slips between them. Metal collides with metal. A shower of sparks erupts.

Xiaofeng catches Ninety-Nine's greatsword in one hand, feet rooted to the ground. She rides the momentum forward, leaning in close and flashing a wicked grin. A flick of her wrist sends the blade aside, and the next strike meets the same casual deflection.

speaker: Ninety-Nine
content: Hyah!

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Well, well! You got some bite! C'mon, keep it coming!

speaker: EMP
content: Mountain Lord! You came! I got your back! Get her! Get her!

For all her talk, EMP stays well clear of the brawl's center, firing arrows from the safety of the sidelines. Her aim, unfortunately, proves less than stellar as stray shots find other Sinners among the crowd.

speaker: Hecate
content: ...! You...! Chief said no fighting!
Now locked in combat with Hecate, Xiaofeng finds she cannot disengage—the white tiger and the Nightmare, one tumbling through open air, the other darting swift and low.

Around them, the other Sinners are either swept into the chaos or hurl themselves into it headlong. The air rings with laughter, shouts, and the crashing din of bodies and blades meeting. Shockwaves roll across the yard in quick succession, each burst of force held carefully in check.

Xiaofeng gives herself over to the fight. Her strikes come faster, her laughter rises freer. For a breath, she is no longer here; she is back in the deep forests of Eastia's mountains, moving on instinct alone, untamed and wild as the tiger she has always been.
Until the final blow lands, and the last clash echoes into stillness. One by one, the exhausted fighters drop to the ground.
Heavy breathing mingles with scattered laughter and breathless swearing. The brawl settles into a warm, weary quiet, and with it, the tale of the Tiger Deity nears its ending.

speaker: OwO
content: At last, with the Mountain Lord's aid, the villagers returned home safely, New Year supplies in hand! The village chief, who had waited so anxiously, prepared a gift of gratitude for the Mountain Lord!

speaker: OwO
content: From that day forth, below the Hundred Treasures Peak, some glimpsed children playing beside a white tiger. Others saw villagers shading the Mountain Lord with leaves. Villains gave the place a wide berth... and peace settled over the village. Forevermore!

speaker: OwO
content: And so the tale concludes! All beings don mere mortal guises, yet compassion reveals the divine. The fierce tiger needs no solemn bearing, for within beats a hero's heart!
Xiaofeng lies sprawled on the ground. When she looks up, she finds someone crouching beside her, a tray in hand.
Pleasure's all mine, Tiger Deity.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: You...

speaker: OwO
content: And that's a wrap! Everyone killed it! Especially YOU, the lady who played the White Tiger Mountain Lord!

OwO shoves through the crowd and bounds straight up to Xiaofeng, circling her with careful, meticulous attention. She studies everything: the ears, the tail, every last detail. Her eyes gleam with undisguised wonder.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Pretty slick, little one. I've caught storytellers and operas at the mountain's foot for years, but you're the first one who actually made me wanna jump in and stir things up myself.

speaker: OwO
content: Hehe... I heard all those White Tiger Mountain stories from folks back in Goldionville! Never thought they'd be real! And I never dreamed I'd get to make a movie with the actual Mountain Lord herself! This is my first time seeing a real tiger up close!
Not far away, Meowy stands encircled by a cluster of curious Sinners. OwO, having secured permission, darts over with her camera in hand, eager to snap a few close-ups of the great tiger.
And as for the white tiger's master... Xiaofeng makes her way toward you, hands clasped loosely behind her back, her eyes narrowing with a glint of knowing intent.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: Didn't you say I was utterly vicious? Needed to be kept under strict watch? Tch. What a load. Aren't you scared the spirits will crawl out at night and get you for lying to kids like that?
Well... I wouldn't call it a lie. Exactly.
After that day... I had a few friends in Eastia poke around for me. Tracked down some folks from the villages near White Tiger Mountain.

Just like you said, that Mountain Lord legend's been around forever. Nobody knows exactly when White Tiger Mountain or the Tiger Deity first showed up, but the stories haven't gone anywhere. If anything, the last ten years or so, people are telling them more than ever.
Hunters who work those mountains told me something interesting. They leave food at the Mountain Lord's shrine all the time. And those offerings...
You offer Xiaofeng the jerky from the tray, and catch the brief flicker of surprise that lifts her brows.
I got a feeling the Mountain Lord takes what's offered and keeps an eye out. Makes sure they all get home safe.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: ...What's your game? You try to trick me into running my mouth?
Not really. Just saying, this Mountain Lord seems like the soft type. All bark, no bite.

Xiaofeng offers no reply. She takes the jerky and begins to gnaw at it, grumbling what you can only assume are Eastian curses beneath her breath. The sight of her—cheeks full, still muttering—pulls an involuntary smile from you.

speaker: Xiaofeng
content: What? You want me to smack you?
Nah. I was just thinking. About that question you asked the other day.
Why not just live free and easy?
