Oh, that's okay. I wasn't expecting that anything conclusive would come out of it so soon anyway.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I'll tell them to continue the investigation.
Good, but in the meantime, we can't let what we've achieved go to waste.
Get the interrogation room ready. I'm gonna have a little chat with Ms. Bai.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Yo, I've been expecting you.
Bai Yi is sitting in a relaxed posture, as if she's in her own home.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: A private conversation, huh? You want to discuss something shady, don't you?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Ah, don't be shy. Get it off your chest. I promise I won't make fun of you.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: And as usual, I get paid by the minute for my chatting service. Every minute is billable, even if you choose to be silent.

options: You're in no position to negotiate.

content: Sinners are obliged to cooperate in interrogations.
...You're being interrogated. Be serious.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Just kidding... I wouldn't actually charge you for such trivial stuff.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Ask away. I'm all ears.
The main reason I'm here today, I want to ask you about Whitestone Industries.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Whitestone Industries? Sure! I have so much to say about my company. Um...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Can I interest you in our new package, a seven-day guided tour around Syndicate?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Place your order now, get 20% off.
I am curious about your business operations.
But that's not why I'm here. I'm here for the secrets behind Whitestone Industries.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Oh...
Bai Yi narrows her eyes and leans forward.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: So that's what you want to know... but, this is secret information we're talking about here...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I can give it to you free of charge, but, don't you think you should do something in return?
Bai Yi leans further.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: West District Mall, Big Discounts for a Limited Time Only, Invite Your Friends to Help Cut the Prices.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Latest Personal Terminals, Weapons, Tickets to DeadLover Radio Meet-and-greets... We provide all manner of sought-after merchandise.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: What are you waiting for? Scan the QR code and download the app!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Scan the QR code and download the app!
Bai Yi points at her chest again.
You raise your terminal and scan the suspicious-looking QR code.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Haha, that's more like it.
The internet speed of the MBCC is incredible indeed. In the blink of an eye, the progress bar is full.

The next second, the screen of your terminal is assaulted by a colorful array of pop-up ads, with low-fidelity cheesy music blasting in the background. There are so many of them that you're overwhelmed as you try to turn them off.
You turn off the terminal and pocket it.
I've done what you asked. Now, you should hold up your end of the bargain.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Okey dokey.
Bai Yi stretches lazily.
Tell me the basics first.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Whitestone Industries exists to serve your needs, from walking your dog to taking revenge for you.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: It is a well-established company that values honesty and integrity, with a wide range of services and a high task-completion rate. It's been voted the most popular company in all of Syndicate five years running.
Your company was founded in N.F. 105, if I'm not mistaken?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Ah, you don't understand; in Syndicate, you can call your business well-established if it's stayed afloat for two years.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Cough cough... We only had two members when we started out. Later, we were joined by a third member. And ever since then, the team has been quite stable. Despite the lack of new blood, our business has been expanding.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: We've been growing our business steadily in Syndicate for many years. We even established a stable business relationship with the Legion, the big-time gang of Syndicate...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Sigh... I don't remember what comes next. Anyway, all you need to know is this: Whitestone Industries is a big shot, and nobody in Syndicate can afford to be disrespectful to us, not even the Legion, which, by the way, used our services.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Do you follow me?
No, not really.  I mean, K.K. is also a member of Whitestone Industries, but her account is totally different from yours.

...You are saying that Whitestone Industries is not in a good condition, right?

speaker: K.K.
content: An awfully terrible condition!

speaker: K.K.
content: We're six months behind on rent. We've never paid any utility bill. At this rate, we'll soon starve!

speaker: K.K.
content: Che does nothing but plays cards and loafs around every day. Sometimes he'd disappear for days. When I do see him, he is full of excuses and nonsense. You simply can't make him do anything.

speaker: K.K.
content: I'm the one who has been doing all the work. What choice do I have?

speaker: K.K.
content: I deliver food, I unclog toilets—day in, day out. And the little money I earn will be all gone whenever Bai Yi botches up a commission and has to compensate the customer.

speaker: K.K.
content: She can't possibly have no idea why she's named one of the Three Pests of Syndicate... All she ever does is get into trouble and accumulate debts. How I wish she could just stop all that foolishness for a while!

speaker: K.K.
content: I do feel hopeless sometimes. I feel I can't go on like this anymore...
If the situation is so bad, why didn't you leave?

speaker: K.K.
content: ...One is totally unreliable, the other won't lift a finger even if his life depends on it... And they don't cook; when I am out, they just have instant noodles.

speaker: K.K.
content: They have no shame. They even call me Mom. They'd definitely be dead without me.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Good for you, K.K., insulting me like that in front of the Chief...
I never thought the good old Ms. Bai was the deadbeat of the Three Pests of Syndicate. You do live up to the name.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: No, apparently, some malicious people are trying to ruin my reputation out of jealousy, I, um...
Bai Yi heaves a sigh.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Okay, Okay... What K.K. said is true, I admit. Our company is in a bit of a pickle.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: So, how does it benefit you, me admitting this?
I just want you to be honest with me, is all.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Huh? That's the reason? You guys are really twisted...
My next question is very important. Please answer honestly.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: How am I supposed to know?
Ms. Bai rolls her eyes.
But you've just said, you <i>established a stable business relationship with the Legion, the big-time gang of Syndicate<i>.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: What? Now I'm not allowed to brag? Besides, didn't you just expose me as a liar?
On the day BR-004 appeared, Che entered the Black Ring. Ordinary people can't survive in a Black Ring for that long, but Che was not affected.
Does Whitestone Industries have some hidden secrets?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: No.
Bai Yi's tone is curt.
You were up there at the top of the statue with Zoya, weren't you?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: No.
Bai Yi denies the claim.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Who'd risk their lives to get inside a Black Ring?
That day, Che said it's a friend of his who helped stall Zoya.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Could have been one of that little brat's cronies. I don't know any of them.
Where were you those few days?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Out for business. What else could I have been?
Can anyone vouch for that?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: What? You can't be serious... K.K. is having the time of her life in your bureau, Che is inside the Black Ring, how am I gonna find someone to vouch for me?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I'm the boss of the company, and I have to work my fingers to the bone to put food on the table. It's so demeaning...
Bai Yi wipes the non-existent tears from the corners of her eyes, and steals a look at you.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: My employees are a bunch of Judases. I'm their boss, but they show me no respect. Now they are making me a scapegoat... Sob...
Obviously, Bai Yi is lying. But unfortunately, you don't have enough information to disprove all this mumbo jumbo of hers.
You decide to use the information you have to test your theory.
I guess I'll have to give you the benefit of the doubt on this for now.
But there's something else I want to ask you...

The MBCC caught a small ringleader of the organization. He said he was working for Whitestone Industries...
Care to explain, Ms. Bai?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Defamation! This is pure defamation!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Must have been some senseless gangster. The balls on this guy! How dare he try to pin this on me?
So you're not involved in the Mania weapon business, even if you've been so hard-up for cash?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: This is ridiculous! I'll never stoop to that, no matter how poor I am.
Bai Yi snatches the clipboard from your hand. Pointing at the picture of the man, she starts hurling cursewords.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Who is this guy? I don't even know him. No way I'd hire someone I didn't know.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: And besides, Whitestone has three members: Che, K.K., and me. That's it; there's never been a fourth member...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Wait a second. Could it be that Che has been getting in with people like this man?
Bai Yi's face is distorted with fury.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: That little brat! He loafs around all day, and now this... hanging out with people who are out to hurt the company's reputation.
Calm down. This is just your guess.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I don't care. I'll make whoever poses as a member of Whitestone Industries pay!
Bai Yi steals another look at you.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: You've got to help me.
That's your own business. Why should I get involved?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I can give you a hand in eradicating the dealings of Mania weapons in Syndicate, and you help me get rid of my impostor. Win-win!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Don't tell me that the MBCC is not gonna do something about this Mania weapon business?

options: There's no way the bureau is staying out of that.

content: Bai Yi is not wrong. As long as Mania weapons are involved, you can't just stay on the sidelines, whether the other Whitestone Industries is real or not.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Great. You can rest assured, I'm gonna help you, and I'm not gonna drop the ball. I'll make whoever tries to be a counterfeit of me pay the price.
As things stand, you can't get more information out of Bai Yi for now.

Eradicating Mania is indeed the MBCC's top priority. It is your intention to get rid of the organization that deals in Mania weapons. Bai Yi's offer of help might be a chance for you to get to the bottom of the whole situation.
I'd love to use your help in this operation.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: You can count on me.
Bai Yi puts her palm on her chest.
You leave the interrogation room, and find that Nightingale is waiting in the doorway.

speaker: Nightingale
content: How did the interrogation go? Everything all right?
Not really. Bai Yi's not very forthcoming. Looks like she's an old hand at dealing with a situation like this.
We don't have conclusive evidence at the moment. We're not able to expose her yet.

speaker: Nightingale
content: So what are you going to do next?
Anyway, we have to do something about those Mania weapons.
You fish out your terminal.
I'm gonna get in touch with the response team. We must handle this problem as soon as possible. Maybe we can even fi...

content: Nitroglycerin for Sale, Discounts for Bulk Purchases!

speaker: Ads
content: Canned Food from Eastside, In Short Supply, First Come, First Served.
The moment you turn on your terminal, a dozen of in-your-face ads pop up, giving you a start.
You know what? Why don't you contact them for me? I have to go handle the dispatch thing. Ask the person in charge to meet me in my office in fifteen minutes.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Copy that.
You pocket the terminal, and hurry out of the premises.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Relax! I've got this. I promise you I won't drop the ball.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: God, just relax, nothing can go wrong...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Hahaha, you're so endearing, Chief... I'm gonna be fine...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Blargh...

speaker: K.K.
content: Are you okay?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: ...I have to go again...
The whole response team are staring at the tiny public bathroom. It is an awkward atmosphere.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: You sure everything is fine, Chief?
Fine is hardly the right word for the current situation.
The several dozen members of the response team are gathered outside the tiny bathroom.
The corner of Che's mouth twitches involuntarily. Veins pop out on K.K.'s forehead. And the others are feeling too awkward to say anything.

speaker: Che
content: It's getting dark.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: What about... you go on ahead without me...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I'll catch up with you... Blargh...
Bai Yi's voice issues from inside the bathroom.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Chief, I suggest we send a small team to do a recon. Once we've attained some information about the enemy, the main force can then mount an attack.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: As for Bai Yi, well, S-class Sinners are an important asset in a battle... While we're doing the recon, that's an opportunity for her to take a break.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: This way, we'll have a better chance of success when we go in and make arrests, that is, if she's already back on her feet by then.
There is a murmur of general agreement in the crowd.
You ponder for a moment: The modus operandi of this elite MBCC response team might not work well in a place like Syndicate. It's probably not a good idea to assign them to do the recon.
Then the right persons for the job are there with you.
K.K., Che, we three go in. The rest of you stay put for further instructions.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Copy that.
The three of you cross ██ Street. It was one of the most vibrant areas in Syndicate. Now, the buildings here have long been in bad repair, paint peeling off the walls.
The street is largely deserted. The few people around are elderly. Barely any youth is in sight.
You frown at this sorry sight.

speaker: K.K.
content: Never mind about Bai Yi. She always does that.

speaker: K.K.
content: You'll be used to it when you get more familiar with her. My point is, don't get your hopes up when dealing with her... But I'm not saying don't have any hope at all either.

speaker: Che
content: Sorry to interrupt, but I don't think the Chief was thinking about our boss.

speaker: Che
content: You should worry about yourself. You've attracted some attention.
You glance in the direction Che is looking. An elderly woman is staring at you three, neck craned, eyes narrowed. K.K. looks away, in an effort to avoid being recognized.
But it seems to backfire. The woman appears to have confirmed your identies and is now hurrying over, a surprised smile on her face.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: If it isn't you, K.K.! You're finally back!

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: You girl. Always sneak out on your own without a word. You've worried us sick.

speaker: K.K.
content: ...I'm fine.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Of course you're fine. It's not like someone can give you trouble. A lot has happened here in your absence though.

speaker: K.K.
content: Like what?

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Plenty of things. Here is one: the toilet over at Mr. Li's has been clogged for almost a month. We are out of our depth. You are the one who has been doing these things for us.

speaker: K.K.
content: I'm... er... busy today...

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Remember to drop by Mr. Li's house tomorrow then. See? I always send jobs your way.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: And... who are you?
The woman looks you up and down.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Oh, a cop, I guess, by the look of it.
Do I really look like a cop to you?

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Come on, don't play coy with me. Nothing escapes my eye.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Just as well. I told you long ago not to work for your last employer. She dumped everything on you. She's despicable.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: And you, you yellow-haired brat, where have you been all day? Running like a bat out of hell whenever I ask you to do something.
Che is impervious to the woman's reprimand, looking up at the sky whistling.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: I heard that your last employer has just set up a company or something and is fighting for territory with the gangs. Bah! Walking around like a millionaire; she still owes money to my shop.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: It's good that you work for a cop now; it's much more stable. I'm happy for you.
Cough...

speaker: K.K.
content: Uh... I've got things to do. I have to go now. See you around.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Oh, okay. I'll get out of your hair.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Don't forget about Mr. Li's toilet.

speaker: K.K.
content: ...I'll be there in a couple of days.

You leave the enthusiastic woman. You turn a corner, then another, and finally find yourselves in sight of an old building, which is your destination—the headquarters of the fake Whitestone Industries.
In today's Syndicate, where most gangs have been broken up, the ferocious-looking guards standing in front of the gate stick out like a sore thumb.

speaker: K.K.
content: Look at those guards. Sneaking in might not be possible.
Now that we've found the place, I can order the response team to attack.

speaker: K.K.
content: You don't want to alert them.
You're right. Maybe... we can find a way to take care of those guards.

speaker: Che
content: That's too much trouble. Let me handle this.
What are you gonna do? You sure you can pull it off?

speaker: Che
content: Relax... I'm nothing like Bai Yi.
The moment Che steps out of the shadows, the guards point their guns at him.

speaker: Guard
content: Who are you?

speaker: Che
content: Easy, bro, I'm just a messenger.

speaker: Guard
content: A messenger? How did you manage to find this place?

speaker: Che
content: First time here. This is 43 ██ Street, right?

speaker: Guard
content: Yes. What are you doing here?

speaker: Che
content: My boss found a new customer.
Che lowers his voice.

speaker: Che
content: You have some products for sale here. This guy is loaded. I hear it's urgent. A chance for you to fleece this customer good.

speaker: Guard
content: Who is your boss?

speaker: Che
content: Mr. Jackal. He used to be part of the Carnivore gang. You must know him. He was here a few days ago.
The guards exchange a few hushed words.

speaker: Guard
content: Who is this Mr. Jackal?

speaker: Guard
content: I can't recall knowing a Mr. Jackal...

speaker: Guard
content: The name does sound like he belongs to the Carnivore gang though.

speaker: Che
content: He's quite fat, and he likes wearing leopard prints.

speaker: Guard
content: Does that ring a bell?

speaker: Guard
content: Not really. But sounds a lot like our boss.

speaker: Guard
content: Birds of a feather...

speaker: Guard
content: I say screw it... He's here to buy our products; why don't we just let him in?

speaker: Guard
content: Not so fast. Let me ask him something more.

speaker: Guard
content: Cough cough... Oh, Mr. Jackal, now I remember. You should've opened with that. Why isn't he here with you?

speaker: Che
content: Ah, it's embarrassing. Yesterday, he took the customer to dinner, and ended up with diarrhea and couldn't stop vomiting. Now he's too weak to go out, while the customer is as good as new.

speaker: Che
content: That's why he sent this newbie here.

speaker: Guard
content: Where is the customer? Why are you here alone?

speaker: Che
content: If I had come here with the customer without talking to you first, and you decided not to let us in, we might risk losing a customer.
The guards exchange glances, looking less tense now.

speaker: Guard
content: Mr. Jackal still hitting the bottle hard? Is he trying to drink himself to death?

speaker: Che
content: You know what he's like. That's his vice. He has half a mind to stop paying us, just so he can have more cash for drinking.

speaker: Che
content: jojo

speaker: Guard
content: Why didn't you leave?

speaker: Che
content: Times are hard. The Carnivore gang is gone... You count yourself lucky if you're not starving in such times.

speaker: Guard
content: Yeah... Times are hard indeed.

speaker: Guard Flunky A
content: These employers in Syndicate, they're all the same. You can't find a half-decent one here.
The other guard chips in.

speaker: Guard Flunky A
content: Our boss is no different. We don't know how he got his hands on those Mania weapons. He should've kept a low profile at a time like this. It's like he wants the whole world to know his business.

speaker: Guard Flunky B
content: Exactly. I'm constantly worried about the FAC finding their way here. I can't even sleep well. If you ask me, this Mr. Bai can't be a native of Syndicate...

speaker: Guard Flunky B
content: I would've **** left long ago if it weren't for the fat paychecks.

speaker: Guard
content: Hey...
The guard in charge, seemingly worried that his men are talking too much, interrupts the conversation.

speaker: Guard
content: You can bring the customer over, if you really are Mr. Jackal's guy. But we can allow three persons in at the most. Deadline for the pick-up is tomorrow, and it's final.

speaker: Che
content: Only three?

speaker: Guard
content: Special times call for special measures. People have been drooling over our products.

speaker: Guard
content: Don't worry. Whitestone Industries is legit. We don't do things like kidnapping or blackmailing.

speaker: Che
content: ...Okay then. I trust you, bros. I'll bring the customer over now.

speaker: K.K.
content: You convinced them just by bullshitting them?

speaker: Che
content: What else were they gonna do? They're running a business. They can't afford to be too paranoid, if they don't want to go bankrupt.

speaker: K.K.
content: ...Please tell me Bai Yi was wrong; you're not a mole, right?

speaker: Che
content: Don't be ridiculous...

speaker: Che
content: So here is our situation. They won't let too many of us in, but if there are too few of us inside, it might mean trouble later on. Going in or not... that's for you to decide.
What do you think?

speaker: Che
content: Me? I think it wouldn't hurt to take a look. They sell Mania weapons; they're making big money, so I don't think they're gonna kidnap you for some ransom money.
K.K., what do you think?

speaker: K.K.
content: Like I said earlier, if we attack now, it'll alert them. This area is like a maze; if they run, we might not be able to catch them.
Let's go inside and take a look then.
The three of you, accompanied by the guards, enter the building.

speaker: Guard
content: Sorry, our boss is in the middle of something. He'll meet you later.

options: Ask the guard to show you around

speaker: Guard
content: Will do. What do you want to see?
You are guided around Whitestone Industries' conference room, dormitories for employees, and workspace, which are all fitted out nicely, on a par with those in any small business in Eastside.
It's hard to believe that a Syndicate organization selling Mania weapons is as well equipped as a decent company.

speaker: Che
content: Wow, very impressive. It's as well equipped as Yagyu's building, if not better.

speaker: Guard
content: All just a fuss. Now you understand why they say Mr. Bai is from Eastside.

speaker: Guard
content: What really matters here are these babies; all the other stuff is just for show.
You realize what the guard is indicating. Each person in the building is holding a Mania weapon, a fact that is hard to ignore.

speaker: Guard
content: This is the employee breakroom. That is the reception room. Our boss is not done yet. Why don't you go inside and relax for a bit?
As the guard is talking, Che gives you a meaningful look.

options: Excuse me, could you tell me where the bathroom is?

speaker: Guard
content: Of course, out the door, then turn right.
Thank you.

speaker: Guard
content: I hear you drank some Mr. Jackal under the table yesterday. You're quite slim. You don't strike me as someone who can hold the liquor.
I was lucky... I was wasted too.
Under the guard's admiring gaze, you quickly leave for the bathroom.
Having shaken off the guard temporarily, you loosen up a little. Looking at your reflection in the mirror over the sink, you wipe the sweat from your temples.

speaker: Che
content: I didn't expect them to have so many Mania weapons. Tricky... We might not have the manpower to take it down, I'm afraid.
During your tour around the building, you've noticed that almost every guard inside is armed with a Mania weapon.
The number of Mania weapons in this building is astounding. It's even more impressive when you consider that the overall number has dramatically decreased in the past few months.
Indeed...
We'd better not attack this time, just to be on the safe side. We'll bring more Sinners with us next time.

speaker: Che
content: Good idea. We could have been in great trouble if we hadn't done the recon.
Hmm...
When the boss comes out, we'll go through the motions and then leave. Meet the boss and get out, and that's it.

speaker: K.K.
content: Hi, I...
The unexpected voice startles you and Che. It belongs to K.K., who has poked her head in.
Che takes a glance at the sign on the door. It's the men's room all right. He runs a palm over his face.

speaker: Che
content: What are you doing here? Next time, say something to identify yourself before you come into a room.
K.K. looks embarrassed.

speaker: K.K.
content: I drank too much water... The toilet next door is clogged up.

speaker: Che
content: Be quick then.
Without saying another word, K.K. opens the door to one of the stalls and walks in.

speaker: K.K.
content: ...There's no lock on the door.

speaker: Che
content: They perked up the other rooms, and they slacked off on the bathroom. It's so confusing.

speaker: Che
content: Don't worry. We'll keep watch for you.
You stay outside the door for a moment, and then, a funky smell wafts out.

speaker: Che
content: What's that oniony smell? K.K., what did you eat yesterday?

speaker: Che
content: Wait a second. Are you doing a number two?

speaker: K.K.
content: No! It isn't me!
K.K.'s angry denial issues from inside the stall, followed by the sound of the toilet flushing.

speaker: Che
content: If it's not you, who was it then? The Chief?
K.K. comes out of the stall, her face all twisted. Apparently, the smell inside the stall must've been stronger.

speaker: K.K.
content: It's you!

speaker: Che
content: Nonsense. You don't know what kind of person I am? I would own up to it if it was me.
Then it could only be...
The three of you turn your heads slowly in the same direction, at the only other stall in the bathroom.

speaker: Che
content: Gosh, s-someone is in there?

speaker: K.K.
content: You guys didn't check?
No...

speaker: K.K.
content: So, the guy in there heard everything you just said?

speaker: Che
content: Yes, unless whoever is in there is deaf...

speaker: K.K.
content: They have too many Mania weapons, and you don't have enough people.
During your tour around the building, you've noticed that almost every guard inside is armed with a Mania weapon.
The number of Mania weapons in this building is astounding. It's even more impressive when you consider that the overall number has dramatically decreased in the past few months.
Indeed...
We'd better not attack this time, just to be on the safe side. We'll bring more Sinners with us next time.

speaker: K.K.
content: Yes, we should leave nothing to chance.

speaker: Che
content: Are you done? Can I come in?
The unexpected voice startles you and K.K.
K.K. takes a glance at the sign on the door. It's the ladies' room all right. She runs a palm over her face.

speaker: K.K.
content: Are you a pervert...
Che couldn't care less about the abuse directed at him.

speaker: Che
content: The toilet next door is clogged up... let me use the bathroom.

speaker: K.K.
content: ...Be quick about it.
Without saying another word, Che opens the door to one of the stalls and walks in.

speaker: Che
content: There's no lock on the door...

speaker: Che
content: They perked up the other rooms, and they slacked off on the bathroom. It's so confusing.
Che complains for a bit, and then, a funky smell wafts out.

speaker: K.K.
content: Told you to cut down on garlic.

speaker: Che
content: I did.
From the stall comes the sound of the toilet flushing, and then Che comes out, looking confused.

speaker: K.K.
content: If it's not you, who was it then? The Chief?
Seized by an uneasy sense of foreboding, the three of you turn your heads slowly in the same direction, at the only other stall in the bathroom.

speaker: Che
content: You guys didn't check?

speaker: K.K.
content: Does that mean... the person in there heard everything we just said?
For a moment, the air seems to become solid.
As if to confirm your suspicions, a loud plop comes out of the stall in question.
K.K. rushes over and yanks the door open. Sitting on the toilet is a fat man with a horrified look on his face; he is wearing a leopard print and holding a newspaper.

speaker: Fat Man
content: Help!! Cops in here!!
A spark of menace glinting in her eyes, K.K. produces her truncheon from behind her back.
Che grabs her wrist.

speaker: Che
content: Don't do anything stupid! No one cares if he is alive or dead. It won't make any difference even if you kill him. Let's get out of here!
K.K. frowns, and then lands a blow on his head with her truncheon. He is knocked out and goes limp, still seated on the toilet.

speaker: Che
content: ...Run.
The three of you rush out of the bathroom, only to be confronted with a few armed guards.
Che and K.K. exchange quick glances and swing into action, each taking care of one side. In only a few seconds, they got rid of the guards.
But you're still too late. The other guards have arrived to block your way out.

speaker: Che
content: Haha... They are quick.

speaker: K.K.
content: The usual?

speaker: Che
content: Fine with me.
They play a game of rock-paper-scissors right in front of you. And unsurprisingly, K.K. loses again.

speaker: K.K.
content: I never win in this game...

speaker: Che
content: Don't play rock next time.
K.K. tightens her grip on the truncheon, facing the swarm of enemies.

speaker: K.K.
content: Win or lose... doesn't make much of a difference now, I guess.
Apparently, she's staying behind so that you and Che can retreat.
I've informed the response team. You only have to stick it out until they get here...

speaker: K.K.
content: Cut the crap.
K.K. dashes into oncoming heavy fire and cracks open the wall of guards. She loses balance and falls onto the ground.

speaker: K.K.
content: Go!
Before you can say anything, Che tugs you along behind him, running down the path cleared by K.K.'s attack.
You and Che come down the stairs. Che pokes his head into the doorway to the stairwell, but retracts it immediately when bullets come flying in.

speaker: Che
content: ...I never thought I would get myself in such a predicament.

speaker: Che
content: I should've let K.K. win. That way, I wouldn't be in so much trouble.

speaker: Che
content: Don't give me that look. We suggested you coming in here. No reason to ask you to pay the price.

speaker: Che
content: One more thing... When you come back with your men, save K.K. first.

speaker: Guard
content: Give **** up!

speaker: Guard
content: We've captured the one upstairs. Now, be smart and surrender.
Che makes no response. Instead, he throws a short knife at the guard.

speaker: Guard Flunky A
content: My hand, my ******* hand!

speaker: Guard
content: These ***** cops are a bunch of lunatics. Take them down!
A confusion of footfalls can be heard as the guards troop in. Che slams the door by the stairwell, and the two at the front are knocked over.
Half a dozen men throw themselves on Che, immobilizing him under them.

speaker: Che
content: W-window!
Despite being in a dire situation, Che makes an effort to tell you to escape through the window.

options: Break the window and jump out

content: The glass shatters, and you jump out.
It's a jump of about three or four meters. Your vision goes blurry from the impact, and your face has been lacerated by shards of glass.
But you waste no time in escaping the premises.

speaker: Guard
content: Don't let that rat run away!
After escaping the building, you run and run, but can't seem to shake off your pursuers.

speaker: Guard
content: Stop running!

speaker: Guard
content: F*** me! The skinny little rat can run.

speaker: Guard
content: Open fire! Don't let him get away, he's a cop!
female_content: Open fire! Don't let her get away, she's a cop!

content: Bullets whizz past you. You continue running, legs pumping.

speaker: Guard
content: ****! What are you aiming at?

speaker: Guard
content: You do it, Mr. Marksman.

speaker: Guard
content: Stop it. Get rid of him. Quick!
female_content: Stop it. Get rid of her. Quick!

speaker: Guard
content: Hold on. Did you **** hear it?
You hear it too. It is getting closer, the sound of an engine.
A motorcycle turns the corner and comes into sight, leaning dangerously close to the ground.
The driver is none other than Bai Yi. She reaches out a hand, speeding in your direction.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Hop on!
You don't have a chance to hop on. Bai Yi has turned the corner at such a high speed that she is thrown off the vehicle and smashes into you.
The motorcycle races toward the pursuers and hits them head-on.
Boom—
An impressive explosion ensues, lighting up the street.
Bai Yi gets off you.
K.K. and Che... they... they got caught...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I know.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Chief, I need your help.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I want to get them out.
Bai Yi looks at you with a strange look on her face.
You didn't have to ask. I will not leave them there.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: That's all I need to hear... Ow...
Bai Yi clamps a hand on the head where it's been hit.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: That hurts...
So this is your plan?
You and Bai Yi lie prone in a ventilation duct, which is cramped, stuffy, and really smelly.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Relax. I've done this before all the time, and I've never failed.
Bai Yi's face, close to yours, is the epitome of confidence.
Really?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Wait... Shhh... Blargh...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Phew, that's close.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: ...What were you saying?
Nothing.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Oh, carry on then. We're at the third floor now. Almost there.
You and Bai Yi crawl ahead. As horrendous as it is, crawling inside the ducts, with the enemies milling around beneath you, seems the least worst option.

You have decided against storming this place, because this course of action might be costly and compromise the safety of K.K. and Che. Instead, you have favored a stealthy operation, in which Bai Yi's skills will come in handy if you have to escape in the event the rescue mission fails.
But now, looking at Bai Yi, you can't help but wonder if you have made the wrong decision.

speaker: Guard A
content: Can you smell something funky?

speaker: Guard B
content: ...I think I can. F***! What a bummer. Can you turn on the ventilation?

speaker: Guard A
content: Will do.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Bullshit, I am not smelly.
Bai Yi gets worked up. She brings her face close to yours, trying to prove her point.
You shove her face away. Right at this moment, the ventilation system is turned on. It makes a few strange sounds, and then the age-old ventilation ducts start vibrating.

speaker: Guard B
content: It is me, or is the smell getting stronger?

speaker: Guard A
content: No idea... Just give it a few minutes.
The ventilation system is making a racket, providing an extra cover for your activities. Withstanding the violent vibrations, the two of you move along, now at a much faster pace.
After crawling on all fours for a long distance, you notice Bai Yi has turned pale-faced.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: ...Chief...
What?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I don't want to puke over you, so...
What did you say?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: ...I can't hold it in any longer...
Before you realize what's happening, Bai Yi kicks open the vent and slips out.
Bang! Wham!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Blargh...
A few seconds later, when you poke your head out of the vent, Bai Yi, looking fresh now, gives you the V-sign.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I'm okay now. Chief, you can come down too.
Okay?! You're standing on a man, and you've barfed all over him.
Wait a second, isn't this the man from the toilet?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Ah? You know this fat man?
I don't know him. He's the one who reported us last time.
You jump down from the vent. Once outside, you look around the room. It's an office, spacious and elegantly decorated.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: He can't be some minion. Look how huge this place is!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: It's a good thing I knocked him out as soon as I came down.
Yeah, you did the right thing. He is really loud.
What do we do now?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: He looks like a manager or something. Maybe he knows where Che and K.K. are.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I'm not going up there; that's for sure. It's a torture.
You're the one who suggested the ventilation duct...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Haha.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Hey, look at that... The fat man is filthy rich. Even his cardholder is gilded.
Bai Yi changes the subject, picking up a fancy-looking cardholder on the desk.
There may be information about his business partners. Open it.
Bai Yi opens the cardholder, from which she withdraws a deck of business cards. Then she slips the gilded cardholder into her own pocket.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Mr. Jackal... No idea who that is. Tatsuya Usami... sounds like one of Yagyu's people...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Bai Yi?!
She goes through the rest of the cards, all of which are printed with the name Bai Yi.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: So. It's you...
Bai Yi turns around slowly and stares at the unconscious man on the floor with hatred in her eyes.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: You're the impostor... You're probably the one who captured Che and K.K...
Bam—

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Ahhh!
Bai Yi doesn't go easy on her impostor, slapping his face hard.
Mr. Bai finally comes around.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Stop whining! Or I'll feed your fat ass to dogs.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Mmmm... Mmm!
Bai Yi quickly duct-tapes his mouth, and ties him to a chair.
Then she, now wearing a menacing look, produces a short knife and holds it against the neck of her captive.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Speak, where are you keeping my guys?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Oooooo...
His mouth is still duct-taped.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Oops, sorry, force of habit from kidnapping.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Cough cough... Mr. Bai, right? I'm gonna ask you a few questions, and I want you to answer them honestly.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I'm not like those two you met earlier. I have a bit of a headache at the moment, and I'm not in a very good mood. If you don't cooperate, don't blame me if I get heated and hurt you by accident.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Also, your men outside, they haven't worked for you long, huh?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: They know we're cops. If they come in and I use you as a human shield, will they open fire? What do you think?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Ooo!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Be a good boy, and don't get any ideas. Understand?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Oo.
Bai Yi removes the duct tape on his mouth and sets the chair upright.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: You again? Why do you keep coming for me...
Mr. Bai looks at you, bitterness written all over his face.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: No chit-chat. Where do you keep the guys you captured earlier today?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: They're in the reception room.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Liar!
Bai Yi kicks him in the shin. The pain sets every ounce of fat on his body shaking, but he doesn't dare to make a sound.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: I-I am telling the truth! Y-you ran away. I was worried about the cops coming to give us trouble, so I didn't dare to lay a finger on them.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: I'm just a businessman; I don't keep a place aside to hold people hostage. The reception room is the only place not occupied most of the time...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: ...Okay.
As you open your eyes, blooming roses fill your sight. Looking at the bright red color all over the place, you're sure you're in a mirage now.
No need to rush. Let me ask him some more questions.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Ask whatever you want. I'll tell the truth.
Where are you from?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Eastside.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: An Eastsider coming to Syndicate for business? You're nuts?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: My business in Eastside went belly-up... It just so happened some sucker offered me money, and he told me he had some rare products in hand.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: My creditors in Eastside had been on my ass, so I decided to take my chance and come over here.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: A sucker? What's in it for him?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: No idea. He's very elusive. I haven't even seen his face.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Oh, he did have one condition. He said the company I was going to establish must be called Whitestone Industries. And that was the only condition.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: I took a precaution though: I did a little research about this Whitestone Industries. Guess what? It's a shell corporation, with only a couple of people.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: People say they had a connection with that Legion. There's a lot of hype. Well, the Legion fell apart not so long ago, and this Whitestone Industries disappeared as well.
So you went ahead and used the name, without a qualm?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: What do you expect? No one in their right mind would say no to that.
Weren't you afraid of retaliation?

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Retaliation? They had only a few people. Besides, that old Whitestone, even their registration information was fake.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: They didn't own the name. Why couldn't I use it?
Bai Yi's lips twitch unnaturally, and then twist into a grin that hardly looks like one.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Take a look at this.
Bai Yi raises her hand.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Take a look at what?
Bai Yi's raised hand balls into a fist.
Thud!
The fist connects with Mr. Bai's face. His giant body, along with the chair, falls onto the floor, and he passes out again.
You come forward, and put the duct tape back on the unconscious man's mouth.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Phew...
Bai Yi has let off some steam.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Alright, let's go save Che and K.K..
Do you have a plan? The guards in the building saw me last time. I won't be able to move around in the building freely.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Let me think...
Bai Yi looks around and sees a cleaning cart in a corner of the office.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Got it!
Bai Yi murmurs as she pushes the cleaning cart along at a brisk pace. You're hiding behind the curtain that hangs down along the side of the cart.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Thank goodness you're small-boned. A bigger person might've had a hard time fitting in.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: One more thing. When we get there, don't come out until I've taken care of all the guards. Then the four of us make a dash for the exit.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: This time, with me on board, we're definitely going to make it out.
Yeah, I've contacted the response team. As soon as we exit the building, they'll come and help us.
Turn right at the end of the hallway, and you'll see the reception room.
Following your instructions, Bai Yi trots on pushing the squeaky cart. Soon enough, you arrive at the reception room.

speaker: Guard
content: Stop.

speaker: Guard
content: Never seen you before. New here?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Uh, yes, I am.

speaker: Guard
content: Why are you still cleaning?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Mr. Bai asked me to...

speaker: Guard
content: Why bother? Whitestone will soon be no more.

speaker: Guard
content: Whatever. You're new here; I don't want to make it difficult for you... Just go ahead.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Oh.
Bang!
You hear a loud noise and poke your head out from behind the curtain. The guard is lying on the floor, passed out.
What did you do?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: He said Whitestone was doomed; it got my goat, so...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Correction—this is part of the plan. Now we have one less enemy to deal with when we escape.
...Do something about him. We don't want to blow our cover.
You have no time to argue with her. The two of you lift the unconscious guard, dump him in a trash can, and return to where the door to the reception room is.
You can hear noise coming through the door.

speaker: Guard A
content: Full house! I won!

speaker: Che
content: Ah, I thought I had it in the bag with two pairs.

speaker: Guard A
content: You've got a lot to learn, bro... But you're a decent card player, I have to say. If you weren't a cop, we'd probably become card-playing buddies.

speaker: Che
content: Oh my, I told you I'm not a cop. They forced me to work for them...

speaker: Guard A
content: Either way, I'm gonna quit after I get my paycheck for this week. If you're not a cop, then you are very welcome to play cards with me in the future.

speaker: Che
content: All righty... I'm gonna win my money back next time.
It doesn't look like they are in any danger...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: That's just the kind of person he is. He fits in wherever he goes...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Wait a second. What did they just say? They are wrapping it up?
If that's true, now might not be the right time to attack.
We'd better wait and see. I'll ask the response team to stay put.
You take out the terminal, intending to inform the response team using the instant messaging app. But as you do so, you accidentally tap on another icon...

speaker: Ads
content: Crossing over the Rust, 100 Thousand Discoins Each, Ready to Go!
Your heart jumps when the tagline, accompanied by the lousy, cheesy Syndicate-style music, hits your ears.
Undoubtedly, that's the rogue app that Bai Yi tricked you into downloading yesterday.

speaker: Guard A
content: Who's there?! Jason! Jason?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: What's going on with you?
You're asking me?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: God, you don't delete sketchy apps after you download them?
You didn't delete it, because you thought it might provide some useful information. But that's not something you want to tell her.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: ...Never mind. It's too late now. Let's take them down!

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Ha!
Bang—
Bai Yi kicks open the door and swiftly knocks down the two guards close by with her saber.
There are a dozen of people in the room, Che and K.K. among them. They are stupefied for a moment, lost for words as they stare at Bai Yi.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: What are you waiting for? Come on!

Che, who is sitting not far away from you, snaps out of the stupor and punches the face of the distracted guard who has just invited him for future card games. He then snatches the weapon from the guard's hands.
In the meantime, you hurry over to the corner where K.K. is and untie her.

speaker: K.K.
content: Thank you...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Save the pleasantries. Run!
The four of you waste no time, running out of the room and dashing down to the ground floor.
To your surprise, the escape goes without a glitch. You encounter little resistance, and you are soon out of the gate.
K.K. smashes the glass of a van parked on the roadside. Che slips inside, and hot-wires it.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I'll drive!
Bai Yi sits behind the wheel. The engine roars to life; the van shudders before speeding out of the parking lot outside the building.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Ha, that's too easy. How you got caught by those guys is beyond me. Very humiliating for you.

speaker: K.K.
content: ...They had no intention of stopping us.

speaker: Che
content: Their boss is planning on skipping town. You think they'd risk their necks to stop us?
Anyway, we've escaped. That's all that matters.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: You're right. How about a celebration tonight?

speaker: Che
content: I don't see why not.

speaker: K.K.
content: You two shut up.
Bai Yi has the grace to look embarrassed.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Okay, okay, no celebration tonight, no need to get angry...

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Sorry, Chief, we still haven't found out about Bai Yi's background info.
You're sitting at your office desk, briefed by the intelligence officer on the work they've done in the past few days.
No need to rush. It could be a long haul, this undertaking. Just be patient, I'm sure you'll find something sooner or later.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Chief...
The intelligence officer looks uneasy.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Is it possible that the intelligence we've got is accurate—She really is just an ordinary Sinner?

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: The rumors and testimonies match up, and your experience with her can also back it up.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Except for those hotheads from the Legion, she doesn't seem to have any connection with any major organization. If there really is something fishy about her, we should've found something already.
Here is something you missed.
That day, when we stormed the fake Whitestone Industries, the owner said some mysterious person had given him start-up capital and Mania weapons...
On only one condition, that he founded his company in Syndicate and named it Whitestone Industries.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: That was just his unsubstantiated claim. Not enough to prove...
It's not enough by itself, of course.
But what interested me was how Bai Yi reacted to the claim...

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Her reaction?
Do you think, based on your own observation, that she is the kind of person who cares about the reputation of Whitestone Industries?
The trap set by that mysterious force was too obvious. There's no doubt they had set the trap for Bai Yi.

And she took the bait, drawn to where her opponent wanted her to be. This might be some tacit understanding between them. But she didn't enter the lair unprepared; she took advantage of me, and the entire MBCC.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: I see...
Ms. Bai is a very good actor, with a small imperfection: she is too eager to prove to me that she's just a harmless good-for-nothing.
Let's play along, until the time has come to expose her for who she is.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Chief, this just in: Our intelligence agency has found out who Rhett Bai is.
The impostor?

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Yes.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Rhett Bai, Eastsider, gone missing after bankruptcy half a year ago.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: We've just heard from our informer: a man answering the description of Rhett Bai has been spotted at Sartre Street near the Rust. It's likely that he's running back to Eastside.
Men his size are a rarity in Syndicate. This piece of intelligence is probably accurate.
I guess this is our chance to expose Bai Yi. Get our men ready, we've got an arrest to make.
Still no sign of him?
You and your MBCC response team have been lying in ambush for three hours, without hearing a word from those on the stakeout.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: The Eastside-bound ferry service ends in twenty minutes. If we don't act now, we'll have to wait until next week...
If the intelligence is not false, then something might have happened to him.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Should we comb through the area?
We don't have enough men. We might not be able to cover the entire area.
...Ten more minutes; if the target still doesn't show up, we're moving in. We'll give priority to hotels, restaurants, and such.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Copy that.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Time's up, Chief.
No sign of the target for another ten minutes.
The waiting game is over... Move in.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Yes, Chief!

The MBCC response team springs into action, quick and efficient. They're divided into several teams, two of which block the main exits out of the block, and the rest of which start searching the places you've just mentioned.
Two minutes later, you hear back from the response team.

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Chief, Region 7-4, we have the target!
Stay there, I'm coming over!

speaker: Intelligence Officer
content: Here it is!
You push open the door, which has been shattered as a result of forced entry, and take in the shambolic room.
The cupboards and desks have been smashed, and the bed is missing a corner. Blood stains are also found.
In the center of the room is a chair to which an unconscious Mr. Bai is tied, his mouth duct-taped, the corners of his eyes moist with tears.
He was in a similar state the last time I saw him...

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Chief, we found this in the room.
You are handed a plastic bag holding a mini-camcorder.
You open the bag, take out the camcorder, and turn it on to view the recorded video.
A terrified big face takes up the entire screen.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: They... They, they are out to get me!

speaker: Boss Bai
content: The Syndicans are all bad seeds. Gave me money, gave me products, all just a ruse to use me as a tool!

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Now that the cops are after me, they want me dead.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: I... I, I gotta record this. Even if I'm dead, I gotta let the cops have this camera...

speaker: Boss Bai
content: G-G-Gentleman or l-lady, whoever you are, for the sake of justice in the DisCity, please help make sure my death is avenged...
He's not that stupid after all. But he underestimated his pursuers.
What made him think his pursuers wouldn't find this camera? And even if they knew the video was out, they wouldn't hesitate for a moment about doing what they intended to do.
He took himself too seriously too. He's just a nobody. His death wouldn't cause any ripples.
The video rolls on. Mr. Bai tosses and turns, the bed squeaking under his weight. Nothing much is happening on screen for some time.
You fast forward the video until you hear a suspicious sound, which seems to have come from outside the window of the room Mr. Bai is in.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Who's there?!
The noise startles Mr. Bai. He rises to his feet, comes over to the bed, and picks up the camcorder.
He inches towards the window, attempting to find out what's caused the noise.
A dark shape appears on the screen, moving so fast that it leaves a lingering blur behind, its movements indiscernible.

speaker: Boss Bai
content: Ahhhh...!
The camera is knocked off Mr. Bai's hand, flies across the room, and lands in a corner. It's facing the wall, and on the screen is nothing but blackness, but it's still recording sounds.
Ding—
Then comes a clash of blades. Seems like someone is confronting the attacker.
I knew you guys would get impatient.
How dare you come to challenge me?
The attacker makes no response. All you can hear is the sharp sound of blades.
The noise soon dies down, and it is quiet again.
That's where the video ends.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Chief, what do we do?
Keep Rhett Bai from running away, and I bet there's a trail of blood starting from the window.
Follow the trail of blood. Go!

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Got it!
The response team springs into action, following a trail of blood with the help of a spectrometer.
Presently, you reach a dark alley, where a fight clearly took place not so long ago. Ahead, darkness swallows everything.
An unaccountable unease rises in your chest at the sight of the impenetrable darkness. You stop in your tracks, not sure if you should order your men to continue the pursuit.
If I were you, I'd stop right here.
A familiar voice pipes up in your ear. A gust of wind finds its way into the valley, carrying with it a could of dust. You have to shut your eyes.
I like you a lot. And I admire your bravery.
But sometimes, bravery alone is not enough.
You hear the voice, but you don't see the person speaking.
What is it that you're hiding from me?
Just some dangerous secrets...
Once you learn the secret, you can't unlearn it. Everything you value will come under grave threat.
Do you still want to know?
You swallow hard, eyes focused on the overwhelming darkness.
You'll know the secret, you have to know. But not now...
Be a dear and go home. The time hasn't come yet. Enjoy the last of your peaceful days.
The wind dies down. You realize that barely a minute has passed.
Did you guys hear anything?

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Just the wind.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Did you hear something else?
No.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Should we continue?
You catch sight of a deep mark, courtesy of a sword, on the pavement.
Let's call it a day.
By the time you and the team arrive at the MBCC, it's already early morning. You make your way to the cafeteria, where you find the Whitestone Industries trio in the doorway.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Scan the QR code.

speaker: Hella
content: Get lost!

speaker: Hella
content: Everyone knows that stupid app of yours is full of stupid ads. The Chief had to get a new terminal thanks to you.
Having received a good talking-to from Hella, Bai Yi calls it quits.
Why are you in the mood for work all of a sudden, the mighty Ms. Bai?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: ...K.K. is injured, can't work. And Whitestone is on the brink of bankruptcy...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Bankrupt or not, I don't care about it too much. But the thing is, we really need money. So here I am, being the breadwinner again.

speaker: K.K.
content: Hehe...

speaker: Che
content: Breadwinner? Don't make me laugh. It's been half an hour, and not a single soul has come to scan your stupid QR code.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: H-How could you guys be so disrespectful to your boss?! Can't you see how I am working my guts out to provide for you?

speaker: Che
content: All right, all right, you're the provider.

speaker: Che
content: Hey, Chief, wanna play cards? I hear you've just closed a case. You deserve a break.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Playing cards? I'm in!

speaker: Che
content: Don't you need to earn money to provide for us?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: I've worked for quite a while. I'm all about work-life balance.

speaker: K.K.
content: It's only been half an hour.

speaker: K.K.
content: Let me remind you, this month is almost over, and we haven't got a penny in our accounts.

speaker: Che
content: If playing cards is off the table, we've got to find something else to do. How about a hotpot?
I don't think the MBCC cafeteria serves hotpots?

speaker: Che
content: Not a problem. K.K.'ll take care of it.

speaker: Che
content: Do you have any idea how miserable my life was when you were kept in the MBCC? All I ate for the whole two months were instant noodles and plain bread. I didn't even have pickled vegetables...

speaker: K.K.
content: Why didn't you learn to cook then?

speaker: Che
content: Couldn't be bothered.

speaker: Che
content: Oh K.K., my dear friend, could you please make us some hotpot broth? It wouldn't be too much trouble. I'll go get the ingredients...
Che gives you and Bai Yi a grimace and yanks K.K. into the cafeteria, leaving the two of you in the doorway.
You have so many questions to ask her. They come up to the tip of your tongue, but refuse to come out of your mouth.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Am I so scary? Why are you being quiet?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Or maybe you have some little secrets you want to share with me, but you are too embarassed?
...You guys have been keeping things from K.K., right?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Yes...
Why?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Because she's a good kid, and she... means a lot to me. I don't want her to be dragged into this mess.
What about Che?
Bai Yi smiles.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Che escaped from that mess, just like I did.
So you were the one in BR-004, weren't you?

speaker: Bai Yi
content: What if I was?
I want to know the whereabouts of Zoya.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Ah, you're such a caring person...

speaker: Bai Yi
content: She is in a place no one can find. God, wish you could be so caring to me.
I value you a lot too. But Zoya's safety...
Bai Yi closes your mouth.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: No more questions, please.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Let's go enjoy the hotpot. K.K. makes the best broth. You don't want to miss it.
Wait...
...Forget it. One of these days, I'll find out what game you're playing.

speaker: Bai Yi
content: Oh... Really?
Bai Yi's expression is neutral, but you see a ghost of a self-satisfied smile flit across her face, there is no denying it.

On (month redacted) 4, the intelligence agency located the last known batch of Mania Crystals in Syndicate. On the same day, the MBCC set up a special task force targeting this specific batch of the dangerous substance.

On (month redacted) 6, led personally by the MBCC's Chief, the special task force raided an underground hideout and captured the Thou Voodoos members there. Despite that, the task force was unable to find the targeted Mania Crystals in the hideout.

During (month redacted) 7 to 16, the task force continued to search for the remnants of Thou Voodoos in Syndicate. The MBCC captured and interrogated two hundred people within a week but obtained no insightful leads due to the complexity of the gang.
On (month redacted) 16, a small-scale Mania outbreak was seen in a certain neighborhood. The MBCC found a small amount of Mania Crystals on one of the deceased.

On (month redacted) 18, the MBCC captured three Thou Voodoos members on the loose during a raid. They later claimed in their interrogation that the Mania Crystals possessed by Thou Voodoos had already been stolen ten days ago.
And the culprit is another organization that's been lurking in Syndicate for a long time, the Homeless.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Crache is ready, Chief. You may begin anytime.
Got it.
You close the file on the desk and draw in a deep breath, fighting the fatigue.
Still, when you stand up, the pain in your prefrontal lobe makes you stumble slightly.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Perhaps you should get some rest first? You haven't slept in almost two days.
The lead didn't come easy. I can't slack off at this juncture.
Also, I don't think I can get a good night's sleep before this crisis of Mania Crystals is resolved.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I see...
Nightingale seems to think of something and reminds you again.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Please don't let your guard down with Crache.
You get what Nightingale means: don't have any unrealistic expectations or mercy. Before she's a child, Crache is first an extremely dangerous S-Class Sinner.
Don't worry. I've got this.
Seeing you walk into the interrogation room, Crache simply lifts her gaze once, then looks away.
Under the halogen lamp, her skin has a sickly pallor to it, a sharp contrast to the deep shadows under her eyes.
The truth is, even without Nightingale's warning and the knowledge of her S-Class Sinner identity, you can tell she's no ordinary kid.
You don't look too well. Have you not had any proper rest since coming here?

speaker: Crache
content: Heh...
She snickers in response.

speaker: Crache
content: Look at yourself.
You know you're in a bad shape now, but she's not saying this because she cares. She's only giving you an obvious warning.
Of course, to these Sinners born in Syndicate, starting a conversation with kindness is no different than baring your weakness.
The tough living conditions make them naturally vigilant to kindness. It's probably wiser to start with a stern attitude.
To these Sinners born in Syndicate, starting a conversation with kindness is no different than baring your weakness.
A stern attitude may make communication more effective, but be sure not to provoke them too much. After all, even the shackles can't guarantee absolute safety in the face of S-Class Sinners.
You take a deep breath to keep your mind clear. Then, you cut to the chase.
Let's talk about the Homeless.
Crache didn't answer, but you see an expression in between vigilance and threat on her face.
She doesn't like to hear those words from you, the Homeless.
test
test
test
test
test
test
You hand the report to Crache.
The Homeless has quite a wide range of services. From what I see in this report, I may even think it's a gang which has existed before BR-004.
The several Sinners in the Homeless have accomplished many things even adults cannot...

speaker: Crache
content: What are you getting at?
Crache doesn't even glimpse at the report once and interrupts you with a frown.
Nothing. I just think you're different from ordinary kids. You guys are outstanding.
You are outstanding.

speaker: Crache
content: What does that have to do with me?
Aren't you the boss of the Homeless?

speaker: Crache
content: Where did you learn that?
I asked the members of the Homeless, of course...
Having said that, you feel the air tenses up instantly. Crache's face turns scarily gloomy.
Relax, I asked them in a different setting, not like this. After all, the Homeless had never been involved with Mania before this. They're not the MBCC's responsibility.
They didn't tell me your name. They only told me to piss off and stay away from their territory.
That if I dared mess with the Homeless, their Guardian would surely find me and erase me permanently.
Crache stares at you slightly suspiciously, the mysteriously dangerous air about her slowly fading. After a moment of silence, she says coolly.

speaker: Crache
content: They were lying to you.
They might have reasons to lie, but those gangsters didn't.
My people grilled more than twenty former gangsters under the Executive Committee's control. They came from Yagyu, Red Falcon, and Thou Voodoos.
Wanna hear what they had to say about the Homeless?

speaker: Crache
content: Like I care.
After a pause, she says again emphatically.

speaker: Crache
content: I don't want to know.

speaker: Gangster
content: "Dregs, little brats, scoundrels, vermin..."

speaker: Gangster
content: "But no matter what crappy deeds they've done, as long as they're some kids who know how to paint that ugly graffiti, that ******* Sinner will watch over them."

speaker: Gangster
content: "She comes and goes in the shadows. No one can get her. Plus, she's like a ******* mad dog, you can't reason with her. Every Syndican gang has been tricked by her badly before."
Hearing you relay the gangsters' complaints, Crache reacts a little differently than you expected.

speaker: Crache
content: Hahaha, how funny. These adults who have no skills other than committing crimes think the kids are being unreasonable... Who are they to judge?

speaker: Crache
content: The rulers of Syndicate who rode roughshod over everyone throughout the years? Now that someone finally overpowers them, they're acting like crybabies with you?
I know what those gangsters have done in Syndicate, but that has nothing to do with their testimonies. The Guardian of the Homeless and that Sinner they described, it's you, isn't it?
Or perhaps, you can tell me if there's another Sinner in Syndicate whose power is comparable to that of yours and has a motive to help the Homeless frequently?
Crache looks at you with amusement and answers.

speaker: Crache
content: So you believe them? Believe a bunch of heartless Syndican gangsters would get frightened to death by a random kid?
Crache's response makes you momentarily speechless.
At least regarding this, they didn't have a reason to lie, and they couldn't have colluded with one another.

speaker: Crache
content: Haha, is that so?
Crache has lost the interest to argue with you further.
You can keep on denying it. But regardless, you've got some kind of connection with the Homeless, haven't you?

speaker: Crache
content: Tsk...

speaker: Crache
content: What do you want? Do you want me to threaten the Homeless for you? You're barking up the wrong tree.
No, I'm not going to threaten the Homeless.
You collect the report from the desk and look straight at Crache, flashing her a smile.
It doesn't matter whether you're their guardian or leader or not. Sure, if you are, it'll make things a lot easier.
I have a matter of utmost importance to verify with the leader of the Homeless.

speaker: Crache
content: I have no interest in being a messenger.
It concerns the Homeless and even the safety of the entire Syndicate. I hope you could cooperate with me.
Crache remains silent after that. She knows you're a tricky opponent, but she seems unmotivated by your serious request and doesn't so much as glance at you.
It doesn't unsettle you. You have enough information on hand to make her waver.

Fourteen days ago, the MBCC discovered that the remnants of Thou Voodoos held a batch of Mania Crystals. But after going through most of these remaining Thou Voodoos members, we still weren't able to find the Mania Crystals.
At the mention of Mania Crystals, Crache frowns conspicuously. Clearly, she knows about that thing.
Considering the relations between Crache and the Homeless, you know your next sentence will turn this interrogation over completely.
We're convinced that the Homeless has stolen this batch of Mania Crystals from Thou Voodoos.
Crache jerks her head up, a look of disbelief on her face.
But the expression vanished quickly and she regained her cool. She bows her head slightly and says in an almost eerie tone.

speaker: Crache
content: For your own good, joke about something else.
The excessive grimness on the surface means she's wavering inside. This piece of news has completely gone beyond her expectation.
Iron
test
test
test
test
test
test
test
"Beginning (month redacted), the Homeless has become abnormally active. Both the frequency and severity of their acts have gone up. They've even begun planned and organized illegal activities."
"On (month redacted) 18, the Bureau arrested three Thou Voodoos members. They claimed that the Mania Crystals had been stolen by the Homeless. Their testimonies are as follows..."

speaker: Crache
content: Cut it out.
Crache glares intently at the document on the desk. Her voice is glum and harsh.
I assume you know nothing about this, do you?
Crache doesn't respond directly. Her expression is so dark that she no longer looks like a child.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Have you done anything to the Homeless?
No. Their members are very alert. We've had great difficulty getting in touch with them.

speaker: Crache
content: You don't know much about the Homeless?
Indeed. That's why I hope you could provide the relevant information. I need to verify with them whether this series of incidents is true.
Can you tell me where they're located? Or a way I can communicate with them?

speaker: Crache
content: Haha.
Crache snickers, as if mocking your naivety.
Let me try again. Is it possible that while you were away, some other power instructed or threatened the Homeless to...

speaker: Crache
content: No.

speaker: Crache
content: They wouldn't dare.
Crache's tone is calm and matter-of-fact.
That leaves us with another possibility...
The Homeless did plan this and stole the Mania Crystals from Thou Voodoos.

speaker: Crache
content: ...This is all just your speculation. The Homeless is nothing more than a bunch of kids. They're not capable of that.
Contrary to the previous firm denial, Crache shows a brief hesitation this time.

But based on the information we have, the Homeless has skills comparable to those of a professional thief gang. It's not entirely impossible that they could have stolen the Mania Crystals from the gangsters.
They could have acted on their own while you were away...

speaker: Crache
content: We're not idiots.
...You seem to be fully aware of the danger of Mania Crystals. But can you guarantee every one of the over one thousand members of the Homeless does too?
Suppose they all do, but what if they didn't know those were Mania Crystals before they acted?

speaker: Narration
content: Crache's face is growing more and more ashen.
I wish I didn't have to suspect the Homeless either, Crache, but they're not beyond suspicion.
As soon as the Homeless got in direct contact with the Mania Crystals, this has become bigger than them... We can't just sit back and do nothing.

speaker: Crache
content: Can't just sit back and do nothing... Hahaha...

speaker: Crache
content: Then why didn't you do anything when those parentless little punks were dying in Syndicate?
It's neither a hysterical scream nor an emotional accusation. Her attitude is cold and sarcastic, as if she's only a bratty kid making some mean joke.

speaker: Crache
content: Just when we've found a way to survive, you servants of justice finally decide to show up.

speaker: Crache
content: Telling us to always think of the greater good, to consider the safety of Syndicate...

speaker: Crache
content: What does your greater good matter to the Homeless?
The look on Crache's face is so indifferent that it's almost cold.

speaker: Crache
content: Though I have to admit... First the Public Security Bureau, then the Executive Committee, then you...

speaker: Crache
content: From colluding with the gangsters to pretending we don't exist, to these gentle talks... At least you've learned how to act like it.

speaker: Crache
content: But you're no different than them. You just want to use us.
No, that's never been my intention. I only want to help.

speaker: Crache
content: Oh?
There's an icy sarcasm in Crache's voice.

speaker: Crache
content: If it's not because of the Mania Crystals, will you still give a damn about the Homeless?
Before you answer, Crache lifts her head and looks into your eyes again.

speaker: Crache
content: You won't, none of you will. We can only count on ourselves.

speaker: Crache
content: The greatest help you adults can give us is to stay away from the Homeless and stop bothering us.
Alright, I see what you mean, and I trust that you have a genuine bond with the Homeless.
But can you really be certain that the Homeless has nothing to do with this Mania Crystal incident?
A muscle twitches on Crache's face. She presses her lips tightly together. Even so, she can't hide the look in her eyes.
Her distrust of adults and bias toward the Homeless have been outweighed by her concern for her companions' safety.
Consider this, what if someone from the Homeless really did steal the Mania Crystals? Can they really handle this situation safely on their own?
Your words have finally shaken Crache's attitude. She can no longer conceal the anxiety on her face.
Crache, we're not against each other on this. We can cooperate.

speaker: Crache
content: I don't need to cooperate with anyone. I can handle it on my own.
...I know you can't trust me easily, and you think I want to take advantage of you. But this is really not something that you or the Homeless can resolve on your own.
Without the proper equipment, you can't even dispose of the Mania Crystals safely without harming yourselves.
You press on the pulsing vein on the side of your head and go on explaining patiently.
The Homeless... are only a group of children, after all. Whether or not they've touched the Mania Crystals, they'll always be the most vulnerable bunch.
I don't want them to face this kind of danger. We agree on this at least, don't we?
I need your help. More precisely, the Homeless needs your help.
Brow tightly wrinkled, Crache ponders what you've said and stays silent for a long moment.
After an almost too-long, repressing silence, she finally speaks.

speaker: Crache
content: ...One person.

speaker: Crache
content: Just you, and me. No one else follows us.
At this, you finally press on your chest and exhale deeply. Your tireless persuasion and unreserved honesty finally pay off. You even feel the days of accumulated exhaustion suddenly all vanish.
Seeing your reaction, Crache says with a snicker.

speaker: Crache
content: Don't get carried away.

speaker: Crache
content: If I notice you're lying to me or doing anything that can harm the Homeless... The shadow will follow you.
Smiling, you wave your hand.
That won't happen.

speaker: Crache
content: Haha, try not to have too much faith in your shackles... Chief.

speaker: Gang member
content: Stop!
In the narrow alley, the tall man grabs the boy by his sleeve and throws him onto the ground violently.

speaker: Gang member
content: Give it back!

speaker: Boy
content: I didn't steal anything from you...

speaker: Gang member
content: **** you! All you do is lie, you little punks!
The man throws a solid punch.

speaker: Gang member
content: Where are your friends? Where did you hide the things you've stolen, you little *******?!
The screeching screams sound especially raucous in the alley.

speaker: Boy
content: I don't know... I don't know!
Almost out of breath, the boy is sobbing and pleading, but there's not a hint of mercy on the man's face.

speaker: Gang member
content: You know, you're useless if you won't talk, you little son of a bitch...
The man raises his dagger high in the air.
You don't have any weapons on you that can resist the dagger, so you do the only thing you can. You catch it with your hand.
The man seems stunned by your sudden intrusion. He only begins to curse a moment later.

speaker: Gang member
content: Who the **** are you?!
He raises the dagger again, ready to also get rid of you who's interrupting his business. Suddenly, a horrifying chill seeps into every pore on his back.
The chill spreads from his spine all the way to the back of his head. The dagger in his grip frozen mid-air, he turns back slowly and mechanically to see a dark petite figure.

The next moment, the shadow wriggling on the ground solidifies and pierces hard into the man's abdomen. He's overturned by this massive power like a ragdoll being pulled and twisted by a mischievous child.
Hold on, Crache!
We can get leads about those gangsters out of him.
You reach out your hand. The wound cut by the dagger is bleeding, but you don't have time for it now.
If you don't stop her, after what the man's done to the boy, you're sure Crache is going to take his life.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Mind your own business.

The two gangsters guarding the entrance of the alley have also already flopped down and fallen silent. If that two men hadn't slowed Crache down, you probably wouldn't have had to grab that dagger yourself.
They're not dead, are they?

speaker: Crache
content: No, but it'll be a while before they can move.
Crache answers half-heartedly. She ignores you and walks straight to that boy. The shadow scoops him up gently.

speaker: Boy
content: Cr... Crache? You're back?!

speaker: Crache
content: Hmm... Yeah.
Crache mumbles in response to the boy's question.

speaker: Boy
