content: Finally! No one knew where you'd gone, we were all so worried about you!
The boy looks at her with wide eyes and flashes a smile with two front teeth missing.

speaker: Crache
content: Hmm, I'm fine.
The boy seems so accustomed to Crache's coldness that his expression doesn't change. Until he sees you behind Crache.

speaker: Boy
content: Who's... this man?
female_content: Who's... this woman?

content: An instinctive vigilance emerges on the boy's face. Even though you've just saved him, his distrust of adults can't be so easily erased.
As you try to come up with an explanation, Crache glances at the wound on your hand, and surprisingly, speaks for you.

speaker: Crache
content: Don't mind him. He came with me. He's not dangerous.
female_content: Don't mind her. She came with me. She's not dangerous.

speaker: Crache
content: Let's go to the base. I need to talk to them.

speaker: Boy
content: Are you coming to the Playground too? Hurray!
Cheering, the boy seems to have completely forgotten about the danger he just got out of.

speaker: Boy
content: You haven't been back in ages. Everyone misses you!
Led by the boy, you take a long time to traverse the complex, meandering streets of Syndicate.
Finally, you stop in front of a small playground.
It's an incredibly crude facility with nothing other than a swing and a slide. Around it, tall, run-down buildings block the sun, shrouding the dilapidated playground with a thick shadow.

speaker: Boy
content: Look who's back?
Many tiny mushrooms peek out from under the slide.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Crache?

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Crache's back!
A dozen black mushrooms come running to Crache. They surround her, all hopping and cheering as if they're having some kind of festive celebration.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: The Almighty Crache!

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: I've missed you so much, wahhhh...

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Those bastards have begun bullying us again while you were away.
The Homeless have completely surrounded Crache, all chirping non-stop. Despite that, some of the more alert children have noticed you.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Why is an adult following you?
Several kids mumble as they reach for the weapons on their waists.

speaker: Crache
content: He's different from the others. He's here to help us... I suppose
female_content: She's different from the others. She's here to help us... I suppose.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: An adult? Here to help us?!
Though they find this hard to believe, they don't doubt it. After all, their trusty Almighty Crache has said so.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: By the way, I've found this. I'm sure you'll like it!
A small hand lifts a recorder among the crowd, flaunting it in Crache's face desperately.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Stop it, you're gonna stick it in her nose...

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Here's a picture card I've found. I've been saving it for you!

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: I've got one too!
The kids all scramble to shove their gifts at Crache. The first boy you've met has even brought over a globe-shaped candy vending machine out of nowhere.

speaker: Boy
content: Beans nicked this last month. We've saved all the blueberry-flavored ones for you.

speaker: Crache
content: I hate lollipops... Ugh...
A bluish-purple lollipop is shoved into Crache's mouth. She frowns and begins to grumble, but seems to suddenly find the taste quite pleasant.

speaker: Crache
content: Just pass it to me next time, don't shove it at me like that...
In the middle of her sentence, Crache notices you staring at her. She glares at you with some irritation and doesn't finish.
A quarter of an hour later, the kids of the Homeless finally quiet down.

options: Ask them about the Mania Crystals

content: You look at Crache, who instantly realizes what you want to do. She frowns slightly but doesn't stop you.
With Crache's approval, you walk over to the boy next to the candy vending machine.
I'd like to ask you a few questions. Can I?
The boy clutches the candy vending machine instinctively and flinches. He looks at Crache, then at you, and answers after a moment of hesitation.

speaker: Boy
content: What do you want to know?
The kids' attention is all on you now. Apparently, a conversation with an adult is not a common scene in their daily lives.
Have you heard of Mania Crystal?
The boy looks slightly perplexed at the question, and most of the other kids simply look at one another in confusion. Only very few of them seem to react to the term.
You go on.
It's a red, translucent, and irregularly shaped stone.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: I've heard of it. That stone is no joke, you can sell it for so much money. One piece for a hundred candies.
Hearing the boy link Mania Crystals directly to money, a shadow flickers over Crache's face.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: That sounds useless. We never pay to get our candies anyway. That's why I joined the Homeless.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Is it the kind of red stone Sandy and the others have found recently? I think I've seen it...
At the mention of Sandy, Crache's face changes completely.
But the kids haven't noticed the changes in Crache's expression and continue chattering.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Sandy is our deputy boss.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Yes, she's the brain of the Homeless. She's awesome, the right-hand woman of the Almighty Crache! Even adults are respectful to her.
Do you know where she is now?

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: She came back once last month, saying she got a big job... I think she's gone to get those red stones?

speaker: Crache
content: Enough!
Crache interrupts abruptly. The kids finally notice the look on her face.
They exchange looks with each other and look at you, finally realizing they've spilled more than they should have.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Sorry, Crache, I forgot there's an adult here...

speaker: Crache
content: I'm not mad because of that.
The atmosphere is still tense. The kids dare not go on further.
You don't want me to know about Sandy, do you?

speaker: Crache
content: That's none of your business.
But you heard the kids. Sandy's found the red stones recently... You're mad because she's actually touched those Mania Crystals, aren't you?
Our priority is to solve the problem. We must find Sandy.
Crache's face is stiff with a complex expression. She seems caught in some thoughts anxiously and pays no mind to you.
The awkward silence goes on. After a while, one of the kids suddenly asks sheepishly.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: That red stone, is it dangerous?
Yes. Very, very dangerous. Ordinary people get hurt simply by touching it.
This type of injury is hard to heal. Most people will even turn into monsters because of it.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: W-what should we do then... Sandy hasn't come back since the end of last month. She can't have...

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Don't say that! I'm sure Sandy's fine.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: But... But Beans and Melon have gone with her too, and we haven't heard from them since.
Hold on. You're saying besides Sandy, you've lost contact with other members of the Homeless as well?

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: Yeah... Normally everyone swings by once every few days.

speaker: The Homeless" Member
content: But Beans, Melon, and a few others haven't been back in a long time...
A strange premonition hits you suddenly. You turn to the boy beside the candy machine.
The guy who chased you today. Why was he coming after you? What happened between you?

speaker: Boy
content: Huh?

speaker: Boy
content: I don't know? I haven't done anything special these days. It wasn't even me who nicked the candy machine...

speaker: Boy
content: That guy just started hitting me randomly. I don't know him at all.
Missing members of the Homeless. Gangsters going crazy. Stolen Mania Crystals.
A terrifying theory is forming in your brain. You stride up to Crache.
Thou Voodoos didn't attack the Homeless by chance. You've become their target.
Crache's face stiffens. She too has realized the severity of the situation.
Sandy... I'm afraid she's their primary target. Does she have a hideout? Somewhere only you guys know about?

speaker: Crache
content: ...I don't know.
No, I wasn't thinking straight. If she's fleeing, she most likely won't stay in a fixed spot... We must find her asap.
You call Nightingale immediately.
Tell the intelligence department to locate members of the Homeless and anyone that looks like they belong to Thou Voodoos. I need their real-time locations.
Quick!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Copy that.
Five minutes later, a dynamic map is sent to your personal device.
The packed green dots give you a headache. Even if you mobilize the entire MBCC, it's impossible to screen all of them within a short time.
Crache, you can reach every shadow in Syndicate with your ability. You're the only one who can do this...
I can trust you, right?
You pass your personal device to Crache. She takes a quick glance at the screen and activates her power without hesitation.
In a split second, the small body fuses with the shadow and disappears.
In a back alley piled with trash, a pink-haired girl is panting heavily. She's hiding inside a metal trash can, trying her best to ignore the menacing laughter of those scary adults.

speaker: Gangster
content: You can't hide forever, you little bastard! Give us back the Mania Crystals!
She keeps praying silently that those scary adults will not find her. Despite her wish, she hears the footsteps nearing and her heart leaps to her throat.
Creak...

The pink-haired girl freezes for a moment before she leaps up from the trash can and with all her strength, hugs the person before her. Standing before her is not the Thou Voodoos guys hunting her down, but her long-missing dear friend.

speaker: Sandy
content: Crache... Crache...

speaker: Sandy
content: You've finally come back to save me, I almost got killed...

speaker: Sandy
content: But we'll have nothing to worry about anymore, I've just made a hefty sum. I can protect the Homeless without you from now on.
Sandy lets go of her friend whom she's been missing dearly. But right now, the Crache before her looks scarily glum.

speaker: Sandy
content: You haven't shown up in a while... I thought you...

speaker: Crache
content: Got into a little trouble. Nothing serious.

speaker: Crache
content: Did you steal the Mania Crystals?
Sandy freezes for a second, then flashes a big smile.

speaker: Sandy
content: Of course not. Why would I touch that dangerous stuff?

speaker: Crache
content: Yeah? Thou Voodoos doesn't seem to think so.
At the mention of Thou Voodoos, Sandy starts unconsciously and peeks at the entrance of the alley.

speaker: Sandy
content: Where are they?

speaker: Crache
content: Got rid of them.

speaker: Sandy
content: Haha, I knew it!
Sandy smiles again. She brushes off the trash stuck to her clothes and crawls out of the trash can.

speaker: Sandy
content: ...Look, it's just a misunderstanding. I stole a batch from them, but it's certainly not Mania Crystals. I'm not sure why they keep chasing after me.

speaker: Crache
content: Really?
Sensing the doubt in her friend's tone, Sandy explains immediately.

speaker: Sandy
content: Yes, Crache, yes. You're the last person I'll lie to.

speaker: Sandy
content: Why the worried look? Aren't you back now? If those pushovers from Thou Voodoos dare mess with the Homeless, you'll get rid of them.

speaker: Sandy
content: Just like in the old days. Right?
To Sandy's surprise, Crache doesn't give her an affirmative response right away. Her expression still looks severe.

speaker: Crache
content: Are you sure you didn't touch the Mania Crystals?

speaker: Sandy
content: How many times do I have to say this? No.

speaker: Sandy
content: Why are you all worked up? Is there something you can't settle?
Crache is not in the mood for this type of questions from her. She simply asks about the other members of the Homeless.

speaker: Crache
content: Where are the others who came with you? Are they being chased too?
The lack of direct response from Crache unsettles Sandy a little. She answers promptly.

speaker: Sandy
content: No, I've asked them to go and hide in the old depot. Melon's gone to notify the base. It's gonna be okay.

speaker: Sandy
content: ...Are things really that bad?

speaker: Crache
content: What do you think?

speaker: Crache
content: Leave here immediately. Someone tricky may follow me here soon.

speaker: Sandy
content: Who? Thou Voodoos?

speaker: Crache
content: ...The Bureau's Chief.

speaker: Sandy
content: The Bureau's Chief... You mean the one who caught you? I've heard he's kind of a yes-man...
female_content: The Bureau's Chief... You mean the one who caught you? I've heard she's kind of a yes-woman...

content: Sandy's eyes suddenly light up.
Though Crache has taken your device and left on her own, you've been tracking her with the shackles.
Finally, you find Crache in a hidden alley.

speaker: Chief
content: Crache, have you found Sandy?
Seeing you, Crache puts herself in front of Sandy instinctively.

speaker: Crache
content: Stay away!
Relax, Crache. I'm not here to punish you. We'll provide shelter for Sandy, then we'll find out the truth about the Mania Crystals.

speaker: Crache
content: I'll protect her. We don't need your help.
Surprisingly, it's Sandy who raises a question first.

speaker: Sandy
content: So you're that Chief?
Yes.

speaker: Sandy
content: You said you could protect me? Good, take me with you now.
Sandy's words surprise both you and Crache, but you collect yourself quickly.
No problem, but...

speaker: Sandy
content: I know what you're thinking. I didn't steal Thou Voodoos' Mania Crystals, but I know who did it. The way I see it, they want us as their scapegoats in their dog-eat-dog games.

speaker: Sandy
content: How about we make a deal? You want to find the Mania Crystals, don't you? I can help you, given that you ensure my safety.
Just your safety? What about the other kids of the Homeless?

speaker: Sandy
content: Don't worry, they'll be fine. I've made them go to a highly secure hideout. They only have to wait it out until you catch all of those Thou Voodoos bastards.
A highly secure hideout?
You ask a little suspiciously. Seeing your reaction, Sandy explains slightly impatiently.

speaker: Sandy
content: God, what an idiot. Their primary target is me. Why would I possibly go there now? Won't I be exposing the location?

speaker: Sandy
content: Anyway, if you don't say yes, Crache won't help you! We're best friends. She'll listen to whatever I say!
As she speaks, she tugs at Crache's sleeve.
Crache, are you sure that hideout is safe? Will the other members of the Homeless involved be okay? Do you need my help?
Crache hesitates for a moment and finally decides to trust her good friend. She gives you an affirmative answer.
Alright then.
Okay, I'll help you.
The MBCC will send a team here to capture the Thou Voodoos guys, and you can follow me back to the Bureau for now.
But you must keep your promise and help me find the stolen Mania Crystals...

speaker: Sandy
content: No problem!
Sandy agrees fervently.
In the pitch-dark room, starlight filters through the window onto the floor.
The two children are not yet asleep. Sandy keeps jabbering on and on.

speaker: Sandy
content: By the way, that Chief seems a little simple-minded, not as cool as you described. Haha.

speaker: Sandy
content: A little sweet talk and I'm here now. Didn't doubt a word I said. They even let us share a room...

speaker: Sandy
content: They even believed me when I said I couldn't sleep if didn't stay with you. How gullible, hahaha!
Despite Sandy's gleeful laughs, Crache's face doesn't look exactly pleasant in the dark.

speaker: Crache
content: I'm gullible too, aren't I?

speaker: Sandy
content: What? What are you talking about? Why would I...

speaker: Crache
content: Stop trying to change the subject. What happened to those Mania Crystals?

speaker: Sandy
content: I told you, it's Thou Voodoos. They were biting each other within the gang, and someone got swindled.

speaker: Crache
content: Got swindled by who? You? With your usual trickery for adults?

speaker: Sandy
content: Crache! You're suspecting me!
Sandy pretends to be mad, then starts making puppy eyes.

speaker: Sandy
content: Did that Chief say something to you? Boohoo, Crache suspects me because of some adult! My heart is bleeding!
She fusses, faking cry and trying hard not to laugh. When she reaches out to tickle Crache, she's met with a pair of icy eyes.

speaker: Crache
content: I don't give a damn about what he says. I just want to know if you've touched that stuff.
female_content: I don't give a damn about what she says. I just want to know if you've touched that stuff.

speaker: Crache
content: If the others from the Homeless have touched that stuff.

speaker: Crache
content: Answer me!
Crache is hidden in the shadow, but Sandy senses her friend's anger sharply.

speaker: Sandy
content: Crache... Crache, don't be mad... I just haven't seen you for too long. I'm too happy, I got carried away.

speaker: Sandy
content: I, I swear to you! I'll never touch that dirty stuff from those wicked adults. We've got you with us! You know it. The Homeless will always stay together. I'll never ever lie to you!
Crache doesn't speak, so Sandy tugs at her carefully.

speaker: Sandy
content: I know, you're anxious because you worry about the Homeless. We're all fine. We've never touched that dangerous stuff. Everyone's okay.

speaker: Sandy
content: So... Don't be mad, okay? You scare me when you're like this...

speaker: Crache
content: ...I'm not mad.

speaker: Crache
content: I just... want to make sure you guys are okay.
Crache's voice softens. Sandy notices and smiles contentedly. She grabs her hand and swings it in the air.

speaker: Sandy
content: Hehe, we haven't seen each other for so long. I think we've never been apart for such a long time. Growing up, we've always been together.

speaker: Sandy
content: These days have been scary without you. It feels like we're back to those days when we ran errands for Yagyu.

speaker: Sandy
content: It was the worst time. You hadn't got your power yet, and we didn't have our Guardian to help us. Those bastards scolded and kicked us every day, just because we were powerless, because children are the weakest of all...

speaker: Sandy
content: Now that you're back, everything will be fine again. We'll catch a chance to escape and go back to the Homeless!

speaker: Sandy
content: Or I'll stop bullying that Chief. I'll treat him as a genuinely good guy. He'll let us go, right?
female_content: Or I'll stop bullying that Chief. I'll treat her as a genuinely good person. She'll let us go, right?

speaker: Crache
content: ...He is a good guy. A bit dumb, but... he's serious about helping us.
female_content: ...She is a good person. A bit dumb, but... she's serious about helping us.

speaker: Crache
content: He's asking around about the Mania Crystals now. He told me Thou Voodoos had taken some of the kids.
female_content: She's asking around about the Mania Crystals now. She told me Thou Voodoos had taken some of the kids.

speaker: Crache
content: Sandy, tell me the truth.

speaker: Crache
content: If you'd never touched that stuff, why was Thou Voodoos coming after you?

speaker: Crache
content: Why did they take our friends?

speaker: Sandy
content: Hmm...

speaker: Sandy
content: Just don't get mad at me.

speaker: Crache
content: Say it. I won't be mad.

speaker: Sandy
content: To be honest... After you got caught by that Chief, I... I thought about it. I heard that Mania Crystals could turn a regular human into a Sinner...

speaker: Crache
content: You...!

speaker: Sandy
content: Wahhh! You said you won't get mad! You weren't there, okay?! I wanted to become like you so I could protect everyone.

speaker: Crache
content: You guys can't handle that stuff! You don't choose to become a Sinner. Most people just turn into monsters! And die!

speaker: Crache
content: And it makes no difference even if you do turn into a Sinner, someday I might also just...!

speaker: Sandy
content: No, no, no, I didn't touch it! I chickened out, alright? That's what I do, you know me, don't you?

speaker: Sandy
content: I only asked about it. All I did was ask Thou Voodoos about it once, and they marked me. They blame me after they failed to keep their own goods safe!

speaker: Sandy
content: Those adults are all the same! Calling us thieves and bad eggs, blaming everything on us! You must believe me!

speaker: Crache
content: What else are you hiding from me?

speaker: Sandy
content: Nothing else. I swear.

speaker: Sandy
content: Everyone will be fine. They don't know about the crystals. Also, we've got that Chief on our side now, no?

speaker: Sandy
content: I'll take him to Thou Voodoos' base tomorrow, and he'll crush those bad guys. Once Thou Voodoos goes down, the Homeless will truly be safe.
female_content: I'll take her to Thou Voodoos' base tomorrow, and she'll crush those bad guys. Once Thou Voodoos goes down, the Homeless will truly be safe.

speaker: Sandy
content: It's alright, Crache. Everyone's gonna be okay. You're here to protect us.

speaker: Crache
content: ...Tsk. You should know better than to ask for trouble. I can't be there all the time.

speaker: Crache
content: Sleep. I'll come with you tomorrow.

speaker: Sandy
content: Cool! I know you won't let me go alone. You're the best, Crache!
Inside the Bureau's car, Crache leans against the window, staring at the view wordlessly.
While Sandy won't stop talking.

speaker: Sandy
content: You know, Chief, you owe me a favor.
Oh? How so?

speaker: Sandy
content: Don't play dumb. I told you where Thou Voodoos' nest is. If you catch them and find those Mania Crystals, it'll be a huge achievement for you, won't it?

speaker: Sandy
content: When you get the prize, don't forget to thank me.
Sandy says as she wriggles her eyebrows at Crache, trying to get her to play along.
That will depend on whether your information is true.

speaker: Sandy
content: How can you still doubt me? You're a paranoiac, aren't you? Even if you don't trust me, you must at least trust Crache?
What if you've lied to Crache too?

speaker: Sandy
content: Crache, you see that? This one's trying to get between us even now.
Sandy shouts. Crache turns to you two, looking a little annoyed.
You sigh and decide to ask her something else instead.
What happened to the other kids from the Homeless?

speaker: Sandy
content: I told you. They've gone to the secret hideout where no one can find them.
No one can find them... It can't happen to be the place you use to store your loot, can it?

speaker: Sandy
content: That's none of your business. Are you planning to let the Executive Committee get us when this is over? I knew it, adults are all evil!
As she speaks, Sandy looks out of the window a little anxiously.

speaker: Sandy
content: What's wrong? You took the wrong route, didn't you?

speaker: Driver
content: A riot broke out recently and ruined that road. We have to take a detour.

speaker: Sandy
content: ...All right.

speaker: Sandy
content: I just have a feeling you're up to no good. You're not planning to do something bad, are you?

speaker: Sandy
content: Whatever, I'm not afraid of you. Crache, if this one tries anything, you have to protect me.

speaker: Crache
content: Okay.

speaker: Sandy
content: He... He...
female_content: She... She...

content: Despite your arrival, Sandy still hesitates to speak the truth.
I've worked so hard to uncover your secret hideout. You should know what this means.
The Mania Crystals are inside, am I right?

speaker: Sandy
content: No... No!
You sigh at Sandy's stubborn denial.
I've given you a chance, Sandy. I've given you many chances.
Before you speak a word, the mission operatives advance in sync and open the factory's iron gate.
But it's only when you enter the factory that you realize the situation may be worse than you imagined.
There are no kids from the Homeless, no Mania Crystals.
The crude beds, tables, and chairs are all overturned. The storage racks are toppled over. Suspicious bloodstains are everywhere.

speaker: Sandy
content: What... What has happened?!
The worst-case scenario has happened.
In the previous operations, Thou Voodoos has always been a few steps behind you in terms of information and reaction. They were only resisting the investigation with their number.
But somehow on this critical matter, they've beaten you to it.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Chief, we've checked the surveillance footage from the Executive Committee. Thou Voodoos were here six hours ago.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: They took the Mania Crystals... and the kids.
Why?!

speaker: Mission Operative
content: It could be an act of retaliation. It's also possible that... they want to use the Mania Crystals on the kids... After all, the monsters can still fight after losing their minds.
Keep tracking Thou Voodoos' whereabouts and keep me posted. Besides, tell the entire operation department that their break is over. I need them to be on standby.
The worst has happened. You rub your brow and suddenly think of something. You turn to Sandy.
Sandy... Do you know...
You're not in the mood to blame Sandy for anything. You only want to get any useful information from her.
But she looks extremely frightened and dashes toward Crache at your question.

speaker: Sandy
content: Crache! Help!
She grips Crache's hand, praying her long-time best friend and guardian would help her again and rescue her from this hell-like scenario.
But this time, Crache shakes off her hands.

speaker: Sandy
content: Crache...
Crache suddenly looks like a stranger to her. Sandy sees a look on her she's never seen before, a look that frightens her. She starts crying uncontrollably.
Under these circumstances, you're not going to get anything out of her.
Meanwhile, you receive a new message on your personal device.
We have their location... Inform the operation department to set off now.
Also, request support from the Executive Committee and FAC. Get as many people as possible. I don't want any missteps in this operation.
Without any hesitation, you walk outside. Crache follows you silently.
Her condition worries you indeed. You reach out a hand, then draw back.
Don't worry. Nothing will happen to them.
You try and try but still can't think of more comforting words to say to her. All you can do is repeat it once more, as if convincing yourself as well.
...I promise you, nothing will happen to them.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Chief, the stealth team has failed. Four members have been injured and require emergency Mania treatment...
The mission operatives report to you. Meanwhile, the Executive Committee representative who's just arrived keeps grumbling.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Ridiculous. What kind of world do we live in? Where do all these Mania Crystals and Mania weapons come from?! Something on this scale was rare even before BR-004...

speaker: Executive Committee
content: We'll launch an attack. I don't want to waste any more time on these scums!
It's too risky.
The Homeless are still in there. An attack will mean instant death for them.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: What does that matter to us? Just a bunch of little *****. Are they worth more than Syndicate's safety?
You look at Crache on the side. She shows no reaction to the Executive Committee representative's words and seems surprisingly calm.
No, I'm against that.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Then what's your plan? Your stealth team is useless now. What else can you do?
You turn to face Crache.
I can trust you, right?
If you can't do it, no one else can.
Still, Crache says nothing. A silent, raging shadow wraps around her body as she walks straight ahead to the building in front of her.
This is her answer.
Once Crache vanishes from your sight, you hear the Executive Committee representative's irritating voice again.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: She's alone. Are you sure you're not sending your Sinner to die?
She'll make it...
The Homeless have always trusted her, and she's never let them down.

speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
content: ****, that ******* Bureau just won't let us loose.

speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
content: Good thing we warded them off. We lost nine brothers though...

speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
content: Don't get carried away. That was only a few of them. The real attack is coming soon.

speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
content: **** it, let's use all the Mania Crystals we have left!
The woman in charge knocks on the table to silence the clamoring crowd.

speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
content: Silence.
The High Priest in a black cloak stands up silently and slowly makes her way to the children who are trembling in the corner.

speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
content: But we do have some available sacrifices here, don't we?
Recognizing their boss's meaning instantly, the Thou Voodoos members walk toward the kids of the Homeless with menacing smiles.

speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
content: You've stolen our Mania Crystals. Now it's time to pay your interest.
Puff!
A sharp shadow appears out of nowhere and gently penetrates the cloaked woman's chest.
The woman who's survived the most ruthless gang fights is unable to resist and flops down noiselessly.
The Thou Voodoos' guys are responsive and show no hesitation after the collapse of their boss. Their blind faith and the Mania Crystals' influence have long destroyed their sanity.
All that's left in their brains is madness. If anything, their boss's death has shattered their last strand of sanity.

speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
content: Mon... Monster!!!
They're perhaps right. Monster. The figure wrapped in a wriggling shadow is just like a monster descending from darkness.
All attacks prove futile. Even Mania-loaded bullets and blades are like sunken stones in a lake, devoured by that vast darkness.
In return, the darkness extends her furious tentacles, mysterious thick spikes bursting out of the ground.
Pierced, torn, devoured... These so-called monsters who've consumed Mania Crystals have now become the prey of another monster pathetically.
It's a chaos made of interwoven malice, rage, and pain.
When you barge in with the team, it's already over.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Confirm safety of hostages.

The mission operative shines his flashlight toward the corner of the walls. Having been deprived of sunlight in the dark room for several days, the children seem sensitive to light and cover their faces tremulously.
Their expressions are confused and agonized. It's hard to imagine what they've been through in the past few days.
On the other side, Crache stands in the center of the room, the furious darkness fully retracted back into her body. Right now, she looks just like an ordinary child.
Well done... Crache.
Crache doesn't respond.
The darkness has engulfed everything that's occurred here, as well as Crache's small face.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Chief, the battle has damaged the building's structure. This place is very dangerous now... Please retreat asap!
Soon after all of you have retreated from the apartment, the old building can no longer support its own weight and collapses into a massive pile of rubble.
The operation has gone on for two hours. This is a residential area, and some of the residents have been gathering around.

speaker: Passerby
content: My home... My home is gone! What on earth just happened...

speaker: Passerby
content: It's all because of those little ***** from the Homeless. They've drawn Thou Voodoos and the police here.
A woman is yelling at you at the top of her lungs. She picks up a piece of rubble and throws it in your way.

speaker: Passerby
content: It's all your fault!
The early spring air is still cool, and many of the rescued children are only wearing tattered thin clothes.
Standing in the ruin, they shiver under the chilly wind and curses. You see the boy who once led the way for you and Crache cringe like a scared rabbit, too scared to make a sound.

speaker: Passerby
content: Hey you cops, keep these little ***** locked up in the prison. Never let them back out again!

speaker: Passerby
content: In the prison? What good does that do?!

speaker: Passerby
content: You owe me my home!

speaker: The Homeless
content: Wahhhhh...
Surrounded by these adults, the youngest child finally breaks down and cries out loudly.
Infected by the mood, the other kids start tearing up too.

speaker: Passerby
content: Oh, now you're crying? You little bastards liked to play gangsters in the past.
You can't bear watching this and ask the mission operatives to disperse the crowd. Meanwhile, the Executive Committee representative comes next to you.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Oh? You've really caught them all. Good job, Chief of the MBCC. Your Sinner is indeed very useful.
I'm only doing my best to get my job done.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Hmm, it's great to have a reliable partner like you as our support.
What do you plan to do with these kids?
Syndicate is now under the Executive Committee's administration. Officially, only they have the right to decide the next step. But out of concern, you can't help asking.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: These little punks? Don't mind them. Just release them later.
Release them?!

speaker: Executive Committee
content: What? They're alive and Mania-free. They're not your responsibility.
But they're clearly traumatized... Thou Voodoos may still be lurking around too. What if they retaliate?
The Executive Committee representative looks you up and down in an amused fashion.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: I've always heard the Chief of the MBCC has a kind heart. So the rumors are true.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Go easy on yourself, Chief. Things like this happen everywhere in Syndicate. You can't help everyone.
But they desperately need help.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Then help them yourself. The Executive Committee is not a charity.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Besides, if we let these little punks survive this, they'll grow up to be the new Thou Voodoos or some new gang in a few years. That's why they say Syndicate doesn't have a future.
You notice something wrong with Crache behind you and want to stop the Executive Committee representative from talking. But blunt as he is, he keeps jabbering on.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Anyway, it doesn't matter. In a few years, when they're of age, they'll fall into our hands. By that time, the Ethics Committee can't bother us anymore...
He seems to suddenly think of something and says.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: That being said, we still need to close this case. I recall the instigator of this incident is a pink-haired kid, right?
He looks toward the group from the Bureau and spots Sandy in the crowd.
Sandy is presently in a similar mental state as the kidnapped members of the Homeless. The series of happenings these few days has resulted in a mental breakdown in her.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: How very considerate of you. You've even brought the culprit to us.
The Executive Committee representative walks toward your team and grabs Sandy by her hair.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: We can't let little punks like you go easily, or else Syndicate's safety will be in a shambles...
Screaming, Sandy falls down and gets dragged on the ground by her hair.

speaker: Sandy
content: Crache! Help me...
You rush over to stop the Executive Committee representative's cruel act, but you're too late.

speaker: Executive Committee
content: Ah!!
A painful cry interrupts your conversation. You notice that the shadow has already swum by you and penetrated his foot forcefully.
Crache has acted.
You turn around instantly and call out to Crache.
Crache, calm down!
Crache glances at you placidly, then turns her gaze back to the man from the Executive Committee.
They're entangled in countless shadows. You dash toward Crache and grab her hand.
Don't let your anger control you! What they say doesn't matter. What matters is you, and the Homeless... You still have a future...

speaker: Crache
content: Back off!!!
Crache struggles free from your hand. An immense power throws you to the side, and you fall onto the ground.

speaker: Crache
content: The Homeless needs no future from you!
Crache roars, and an enormous shadow shrouds the ground and the sky.
You can't just stand back and watch Crache make a huge mistake. That leaves you with the only choice.

At last, the Homeless were taken by the Executive Committee, but were released two days later. They have completely vanished in the next two months.
As the culprit, Sandy's been detained by the Executive Committee.
Crache refuses to talk to anyone.
The silence in the confinement cell is almost creepy.
Three months have passed since the Mania Crystal incident. In these three months, you haven't had even one normal conversation with Crache.
She's attempted several escapes but was stopped by you each time.
You've been wanting to talk to her, but you're not sure where to start.
This time though, to your surprise, Crache speaks first.

speaker: Crache
content: How's Sandy?
Her real age is older than sixteen...
The Executive Officer insists that she's the chief instigator of the Mania Crystal incident. In a month, she'll be trialed at the West District Provisional Court.

speaker: Crache
content: Haha... Hahaha... They've caught the perfect scapegoat... Must be good for their performance review...

speaker: Crache
content: Mania Crystals have plagued the city for years. Have those scumbags ever done anything about the gangs? Now that the gangs are gone, they've decided to make an example of an innocent kid?!
I'll fight for her.

speaker: Crache
content: Fight for what? For them to release her? Then what? The Homeless, there are still so many of them in that hellhole Syndicate. They can't survive on their own. They'll keep stealing, keep robbing, keep getting arrested.

speaker: Crache
content: You're gonna fight for each one of them?

speaker: Crache
content: I appreciate your perseverance, Chief.
Syndicate... is indeed not the best environment for them. I plan to find a suitable organization to adopt them.

speaker: Crache
content: See, you don't even believe in it yourself.
It's perhaps not possible... in the Syndicate today.
But I and many other people are still working hard to reestablish order and build trust among the citizens...
One day...

speaker: Crache
content: It's too late!

speaker: Crache
content: I know, I know... Even if you release her, Sandy won't change. She's used to that way of life. She even lied to me. She'll never come around.

speaker: Crache
content: But who can steer clear of the filth when you live in that damn gutter Syndicate? Can those adults even do that?!

speaker: Crache
content: It's not like that? Chief, you have a good heart, you really do. You want to give everyone a hand.

speaker: Crache
content: But so many of them need a hand. Can you save them all?

options: Even if I can't, I must try...

content: Crache, you face a burden too heavy for a child. You're still too young. Let adults handle it. We have the power and responsibility to protect children. We will protect you.
You want to grab her hand.

speaker: Crache
content: Don't touch me!
She slaps off your hand almost reflexively.

speaker: Crache
content: Adults... Haha... Adults who protect children... Haha... I'm afraid you're the only one...

speaker: Crache
content: If they have the power, shouldn't they save it for themselves? This is Syndicate. Weak kids like us should be at their mercy. Why do we deserve protection?

speaker: Crache
content: Save your talks of justice and ethics. The powerless kids of the Homeless are at the bottom of the food chain. There's only one way to survive.

speaker: Crache
content: Do whatever you must to get stronger, grow up, become an adult, become the next generation of scumbags, and create the next generation of the Homeless.

speaker: Crache
content: Don't you understand? Born in Syndicate, we're all the same! Do you still think you can save any of us?!
Her eyes are red from dryness, but there's a deep sadness in her cracked voice that tightly grips your heart.
For so long, you were the only one to protect the children, with your power as a child. Even in a place like Syndicate, you have always steered clear of the filth.
But you're only a child, that duty shouldn't fall on your shoulders. I'll help you. We'll create a future you want to see.
You grab her hand again. She tries hard to struggle free, but you hold it tightly.
Finally, she's tired of struggling and gives up.

speaker: Crache
content: Haha... What am I doing... Throwing a tantrum at you...

speaker: Crache
content: Chief... No... ${PlayerName}... Sorry... You're a good person... A really good person...

speaker: Crache
content: Don't feel sorry for me... And don't... pity me...

speaker: Crache
content: I'm lucky enough to be detained here...

speaker: Crache
content: Too lucky... I became a Sinner... and met you...

speaker: Crache
content: But ${PlayerName}... The world... is so big... The night... is so long...

speaker: Crache
content: Not everyone is as lucky...
She turns her gaze away from you. Her body begins slipping down the wall slowly.

speaker: Crache
content: Most kids from the Homeless won't turn into Sinners... They'll either become degenerates themselves or die together...

speaker: Crache
content: Most Sinners won't meet you... They'll be ripped apart and tortured until they become total monsters, only then will they find relief...

speaker: Crache
content: You and I being here today... is a miracle that should have been impossible...

speaker: Crache
content: Most other kids like Crache are not as lucky... They won't even get a chance to throw a tantrum at you...

speaker: Crache
content: They're the majority... ${PlayerName}, that's the reality... In a world like this... there's no future I desire...
You open your mouth, but no words come out. You can only grip her hand tightly, even though that scrawny hand has given up struggling.

options: At least I've grabbed your hand, here, now.

content: Have faith in yourself, Crache... You said you're lucky enough to have met me. I'm sure... you'll be lucky enough to find a way to change the future...
I can't promise you anything... except that... I won't let go of your hand, and I won't let you face anything on your own again...
In the shadow, tears glide down Crache's face noiselessly. After a long moment, she answers.

speaker: Crache
content: Yeah? Then I'm really...

speaker: Crache
content: Too lucky...
She doesn't meet your gaze again.
This darkness feels familiar.
So is the sensation. It feels as though a snake has wrapped itself around your neck, cold and suffocating.

speaker: Chief
content: Serpent...?!

speaker: Serpent
content: Hehe... Take a guess! Is this a dream, or reality?

speaker: Serpent
content: Or maybe... neither. Maybe we're in a realm of pain!
Serpent materializes by degrees in the darkness. She is on top of you, her greenish-gray eyes quivering.
A warm drop of liquid alights on the corner of your mouth. It glides into your mouth, and the tip of your tongue tastes something faintly salty. It's a teardrop, you realize.
Are you... crying?
The feeling of constriction around your neck intensifies. You have no time to reflect on what the teardrop represents, because you don't want to miss the window of opportunity.
There is a flash of red light, and a tangle of tendrils flows out of your palm and onto Serpent.
The second your psyche is connected to hers, countless cries of pain, sorrow, and hatred flood your consciousness.
The darkness recedes. Your ears start humming, but you know what just happened wasn't a hallucination, for Serpent is lying in your arms.

speaker: Soldier
content: Found Chief!! Medical team, hurry up!

speaker: Soldier
content: Chief, are you all right? Should we do anything about that Sinner?! She just whisked you away, like some kind of magic trick...

speaker: Chief
content: I'm okay. She passed out. I've used the shackles on her. But something is amiss with her.

speaker: Chief
content: We're going back to the Bureau for now. Give her the best treatment. I need to talk to her as soon as possible.

speaker: Soldier
content: Yes, Chief!
It has been ten days since the Ambrosia incident. You have been searching for Serpent, hoping to prevent a recurrence of the incident.
But locating a masterfully-camouflaged snake in the forest is no easy task. Besides, nothing untoward has happened in these ten days.
It could be the lull before the storm, however. Serpent is still at large. You can't feel at ease, nor can you let your guard down, because she could be waiting for a chance to fight back.
Then in your most recent operation, she, much to your surprise, gave herself up.

speaker: Serpent
content: Ow, the light is harsh...

speaker: Serpent
content: Is this how the MBCC treats someone who just came to?

speaker: Serpent
content: Oh, I get it... I don't deserve to be treated nicely, because you don't think of Sinners as human beings, right?

speaker: Chief
content: We didn't mean to make you feel that way.

speaker: Chief
content: You've just woken up, and now you have to stay in an interrogation room. This is hard on you, I know. But... there is a ton of unfinished business we have to deal with now.

speaker: Serpent
content: Yes, yes... a ton of business, some out in the open, some hidden in the dark...

speaker: Serpent
content: Chief, you're very busy indeed. Haha.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll cut to the chase. Where is the Bottle of Dreams now?

speaker: Serpent
content: Why does it matter? No matter where it is, now... I am in your hands.
Serpent blinks at you. Her voice is saccharine.

speaker: Chief
content: As the Chief of MBCC, I have to be cautious.

speaker: Chief
content: After all... experience has taught me that Sinners who're willing to give themselves up tend to be more dangerous.

speaker: Serpent
content: It seems you've been through a lot, Chief... How about giving Ambrosia another go? It might just help you let go of those painful memories.

speaker: Serpent
content: Oops, I almost forgot...

speaker: Serpent
content: Ambrosia can't bring you happiness.
Serpent tilts her head, and gives you a smile that reveals her pointed canine teeth.

speaker: Serpent
content: But that doesn't matter. Happiness... Happiness is something that can be made.

speaker: Serpent
content: You know how happiness is made, right? You've seen it; you've been there.

speaker: Chief
content: Making happiness... Are you still so hung up on Ambrosia?
Serpent twirls a stray lock of hair around her finger, studying your eyes as if in admiration. It's some time before she speaks again.

speaker: Serpent
content: You've eliminated Marv already... Why are you still worried about Ambrosia?

speaker: Chief
content: What I'm worried about is the Bottle of Dreams you took.

options: Ask about the source of the original Ambrosia

speaker: Chief
content: You told me it's Marv that created the original Ambrosia and used it to bewitch humans before sucking their life force dry to turn them into Corruptors. Marv was nothing like those Mania-turned monsters in the FAC records; it's powerful and elusive.

speaker: Serpent
content: Your point?

speaker: Chief
content: You said you came upon it by accident... Can you tell me more? When and where did you come upon it? And where did it come from?
Serpent doesn't seem eager to answer your questions. She looks away to stare at the clock on the wall, beating time to the passing of each second.

speaker: Serpent
content: I don't remember, and... I don't think it's important.

speaker: Chief
content: You don't remember, or it didn't happen at all?

speaker: Serpent
content: What do you mean?

At first, the MBCC found nothing useful when it went through the files on the Sinners. Then, thanks to a thorough investigation conducted by the 9th Agency, you found something worth noticing about her identity.

speaker: Chief
content: I have reason to believe that... you created Ambrosia and the monster with your power.
Serpent takes a sideways glance at the files on the table without turning around to look at you.

speaker: Chief
content: A few years ago, pet snakes were all the rage in Eastside, and a girl who could speak to snakes was the talk of the town for some time on social media.

speaker: Chief
content: Shortly afterward, an accident happened: a pet snake attacked its owner. It prompted the introduction of a bill in Eastside prohibiting its citizens from keeping large snakes as pets; and those who do, do so at their own peril.

speaker: Chief
content: The Public Security Bureau still hasn't found that pet owner, and in the end, they gave a verdict of "death due to mistakes made in raising of a pet snake."

speaker: Chief
content: You were the girl who could speak to snakes, weren't you? And you spoke to the snake of that victimized family.

speaker: Serpent
content: What if I was? I was no longer there when they were bathed in intoxicating happiness.

speaker: Chief
content: I know that.

speaker: Chief
content: I discovered through my investigation that the family did get their pet through some illegitimate channel. I followed up the lead and found something amiss.

speaker: Chief
content: Other than number, weight, activeness level, there's an additional item of information on their purchase record.
You point at the handwritten information on the photo.

speaker: Chief
content: Foodstuffs. It didn't specify the type of food or the weight. Simply alive.

speaker: Serpent
content: Yes, it meant me.

speaker: Serpent
content: That's why you think I was the perpetrator?
Serpent looks at you, her lips set in a pout of annoyance.

speaker: Serpent
content: They played with fire and got burned. And you're blaming me. Be reasonable, Chief.

speaker: Serpent
content: Anyway, they signed me over to an entertainment company, which, in a way, freed me from the hellhole.

speaker: Serpent
content: Hmph. I was happy with my life, why would I get myself tangled up with them anymore.
The smirk on Serpent's face lingers; she seems certain that you can't do anything about her.

The first case was closed as the police couldn't find anything suspicious. At the time of the incident, Serpent was already an employee of **** Entertainment. How could she have had anything to do with the case?
Seems like she is not going to be honest with you. Looking her in the eye, you decide to change the subject.

speaker: Choice
options: All right. Let's talk about something else.

speaker: Chief
content: Let's talk about the entertainment company you just mentioned.

speaker: Serpent
content: What's there to talk about? There's nothing illegal about them signing me. The family... got me a temporary ID card.

speaker: Chief
content: That's not what I want to talk about.

speaker: Chief
content: Your performance with snakes was a huge hit. You became quite a celebrity on Eastside's underground novelty-show scene, and you were often hired to perform at various venues.

speaker: Chief
content: You brought in handsome revenues for the company. That's why they covered up your involvement in the incident.

speaker: Serpent
content: Yeah, right! Like that shitty company would do something like that for me; they wouldn't even give me a bigger cut.

speaker: Chief
content: Like the victims in the pet snake case, all those people involved in this case vanished without a trace. Plus the entertainment company tried very hard to suppress the news. So in the end, the case was shelved.

speaker: Chief
content: Of course, the authority given to us has allowed us to learn more about these two cases.

speaker: Chief
content: For example, both in the pet snake case and in the entertainment company case, the scenes had been trashed, turned completely upside down.
It looked like the work of some extraordinary monsters... Corruptors, I suppose.

speaker: Chief
content: Ever since then, you have been using Ambrosia to... to torture them, am I right?

speaker: Serpent
content: What if I have? Like I said, I was creating happiness! I am helping them build sweet dreams!!

speaker: Serpent
content: So what if they end up vomiting up black sludge, end up turning into Corruptors? Those painful memories are supposed to be discarded! Why... why are you resisting Ambrosia?! I want the happiness, the sweet dreams of you all!!
Serpent spits out her words like venom. She huffs and puffs, her shoulders heaving, as if saying those words were a great effort for her.
You've known a thing or two about Serpent's obsession with happiness. But in District 14, when she stirred things up, she was not as uncontrollable or hysterical as she is now.
The shackles are throbbing like crazy. Dimly, you sense Serpent's feelings. Her life force seems to be in the grip of some mysterious entity, making her go berserk.

speaker: Serpent
content: You... You wouldn't understand their happiness, let alone their pain.

speaker: Chief
content: You don't understand their pain either... You simply ignored it.

speaker: Chief
content: Indulging yourself with sweet dreams can't fix everything, Serpent.

speaker: Chief
content: I once met a Sinner who lost herself in an amusement park of her own. I don't know if I helped her, but such excessive indulgence brought her only pain.

speaker: Chief
content: I don't want you to suffer the same fate.
You rise to your feet, walk around the table to stand in front of Serpent, and look her in the eye.

speaker: Serpent
content: How can you be so sure that it will cause me pain?

speaker: Serpent
content: You can't experience happiness or have sweet dreams, and here you are, sitting on your high horse criticizing me?
Serpent lifts her head, staring at you like a kid hoping for an answer to a question just asked.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm not criticizing you.

speaker: Chief
content: The sleepwalkers' symptoms have been worsening since day one, and Ambrosia is getting more potent. If you don't keep your power and the Bottle of Dreams in check, you'll suffer even more...

speaker: Chief
content: Stop losing yourself in the Realm of Dreams. Stop using Ambrosia. Serpent, could you please tell me where the Bottle of Dreams is?
Serpent falls silent, so does the interrogation room.

speaker: Chief
content: It's dangerous to indulge in those sweet dreams that can't bring you true happiness.
Serpent remains silent. You continue persuading her, to no avail.

speaker: Serpent
content: My happiness, my dreams... Chief, you asked me why I came back.
Serpent trailed off, and when she speaks again after a long pause, her voice is as cold as ice.
You feel cold on the nape of your neck. A small snake has found its way there without you knowing it, and it is hissing in your ear.
Serpent looks up at you from her seat, a chill in her eyes.

speaker: Chief
content: Ambrosia doesn't work on me.

speaker: Serpent
content: I know.

speaker: Serpent
content: I just want to make good on my promise. In the last minute, I want to give you happiness. So, now I'm going to present to you... a grand circus show.
Serpent leans forward ever so slightly, whispering to you in a hypnotizing tone.

speaker: Serpent
content: Chief... Would you give me your hands?
You raise your hands, which Serpent takes in hers gently and brings close to her lips. Her palms are as cold as the snake around your neck.

speaker: Serpent
content: Good... Aren't you afraid that I might do something, Chief?

speaker: Chief
content: Surely you can sense that the shackles are already on you.

speaker: Serpent
content: Hehe... Yes, I can.

speaker: Chief
content: Which means... you are at my mercy. If anyone should worry, it should be you.

speaker: Serpent
content: Aren't you confident that you won't get lost in the Realm of Dreams? Take another gamble with me then. You do everything you can to break and untangle the mess to find the answer, and I... I will risk everything I have to give you happiness.
You could use the shackles to force her to tell you who gave her Ambrosia and where the Bottle of Dreams is. But that wouldn't solve the problem at its source.

You are not concerned about or afraid of what she's going to do to you. For one thing is sure: you must shatter her twisted obsession with happiness and sweet dreams, much the way you must shatter the Realm of Dreams.

speaker: Chief
content: Okay then, take me to the show.
Looking at her pointed canine teeth, you give her a faint smile.
The shackles tremble, and your psyche and Serpent's respond in sync. It's as if you're laying everything bare for each other to see, but at the same time, hiding everything from each other.

speaker: Serpent
content: Fantastic! My beloved Chief, my beloved audience...

speaker: Serpent
content: Let's go enjoy the merriest, grandest circus show!
The announcement is followed by a gentle kiss on your fingertip.

speaker: Chief
content: Ow!
You feel a sudden stab of pain in your fingertip, and look down. A scarlet blob is blossoming.

speaker: Serpent
content: Really sorry, Chief.
Serpent doesn't let go of your hands. Instead, she tightens her grip and bends down to kiss your fingertip for a long second.
Your vision blurs, and you feel something moving up from your fingertip where it has been punctured. You start feeling lethargic.
You have a vague feeling that you are still in the interrogation room. And then a white mist rises around you; you give yourself over to that lethargic feeling, sinking deeper and deeper...

speaker: Serpent
content: <color=#e45515>The awake one does not enter the Realm of Dreams... Come in to my story then.</color>
You come around to find yourself surrounded by darkness. You have a vague feeling that you haven't left the interrogation room, but everything around you is blurry.
Your nostrils are assaulted by a familiar unpleasant smell. The smell of the Rust.
Fear not, my friend. The curtain to the Starry Theater is about to rise... Please enjoy!
A voice in your head demands your attention. It's Serpent's voice. As soon as she makes the announcement, all your senses, switched on like light bulbs, are drawn to the stage before you.

speaker: Serpent
content: Here comes... Act one of the story.

speaker: Merchant
content: **** this shithole! Monsters everywhere. Hope this load of goods can survive the trip to Eastside.

speaker: Merchant
content: Those Syndican idiots... they clung to me like a bad cold when they smelt a chance of going to Eastside. There's no shaking them off.

speaker: Merchant
content: **** whatever. Those bad boys in the back aren't vegetarians anyway!

The view before you clears up. You see what looks like the inside of a truck trailer. Gigantic boxes are piled high, inside one of which there's a black snake wrapping itself tightly around an object.

speaker: Serpent
content: And this is where our heroine starts her journey in search of happiness.
You see Serpent by your side. She points at the long snake, inviting you to take a closer look. It's only then that you make out the object enveloped by the snake. It's a girl.
The snake is resting its head against the side of her neck, its forked tongue flicking. She clutches her wrist, her lips bloodless.

speaker: Serpent
content: Come and enjoy the show with me! And... experience it with me...
Serpent's voice turns dreamy, and your vision goes blurry for some reason. You feel there's something wrapped around your body.

The shackles have linked your psyche and consciousness to those of someone else. Your heart is beating faster, your skin is turning cold, and every inch of your body is aching. Along with these sensations comes an intoxicating mirage.
Then it hits you: You're feeling what the girl is feeling. She stowed away with others in a truck trailer, but little did she know that she was to travel with snakes.

speaker: Merchant
content: The batch is topnotch. Those *** in Eastside have paid good money for them. When the transaction is done, what do you say we go have a happy time in Eastside?

speaker: Girl
content: Happy...? What is it like?
A gruff voice comes through from the cab. The girl cranes her neck, trying to catch what the man is saying.

speaker: Merchant
content: Syndicate is a *** place. It has nothing going for it. We may have to survive on the monsters one day! Eastside is another story. It has everything you can ever dream of. You don't have to worry about anything in Eastside.

speaker: Merchant
content: Yeah, with the money from the deal, we can have fun for the rest of our lives in Eastside. The best wine and ****... we can have whatever we want! Every day will be a happy day!

speaker: Merchant
content: That's the happiest place in the entire DisCity!
The snake venom courses through her veins as she listens to the merchant babbling on. Her hallucinations are getting more intense by the minute.

speaker: Girl
content: Eastside... there's happiness to be found... in Eastside?

speaker: Girl
content: Will my pain become... less severe, if I find... happiness?
Just before her life drains away completely, something in her vision seems to inject into her a new desire for life...

speaker: Girl
content: Let me go find happiness, Let me... live!

You feel your heartbeat increases and your breathing quickens. Every inch of your body is in excruciating pain, but at the same time, you feel itchy all over, an itch that runs deep and thorough, as if there's a new body growing inside of you.
It wants to free itself from the fetters of the past, to rid itself of all long-established weaknesses...
You're soaked through with sweat when it's done and dusted. With an effort, you lift your head to look around. The girl has freed herself from the snake's embrace and is now sitting next to it.

speaker: Girl
content: Thank you... for showing me the visions. I'll get that kind of happiness, right?

The girl strokes the snake gently, her vertical pupils filled with ferocious longing. The snake, which almost killed her a moment ago but utterly fears her now, is lying at her feet, as docile as a pet.
You sense the reason why the snake is afraid of her. It's because she holds extraordinary powers, and because she is even crazier than the snake—she has become a Sinner.
Thud! Thud! You hear the sound of something being hammered. Then shafts of bright white light burst in.
You shield your eyes with your hand against the sudden glare.

speaker: Man
content: What the **** is this?
When the glare subsides, you see two people standing in front of you. They are looking at the load of a truck trailer.
A smartly-dressed man is holding a device pointed at the wooden crates. Looks like he's making a recording.

speaker: Man
content: Tsk! I paid for the snake, not for all these humans! Thank goodness I didn't press the Live button. If I had, and the world saw this, you'd be in big trouble!

speaker: Merchant
content: Hey, this baby is very vicious; it hasn't developed an appetite for ordinary foods yet! That's why we included... some stuff to tide you over.

speaker: Man
content: Oh! That's great. Let me pick a good-looking one for my baby then.
Hearing the conversation between the two men, the "Syndican idiots" in the trailer moved away from the door, and some of them even passed out.
But the girl stood up and walked over to the man.

speaker: Girl
content: Are you from Eastside?

speaker: Man
content: You can speak?

speaker: Man
content: Yep, this is the legendary Eastside! You got to see it before you die... Count yourself lucky.

speaker: Girl
content: Take me with you, please.

speaker: Man
content: Huh? Are you listening to yourself?

speaker: Girl
content: I want to... find happiness here.

speaker: Man
content: ...Are you crazy? Ummm... But if that's what you want... I guess we can find a way to make it work.

speaker: Merchant
content: Fantastic! You've been living with this young gentleman's goods. You two must be good friends, right?

speaker: Girl
content: Friends... Yes, we're friends.
The girl smiled, revealing her pointed canine teeth.
She crouched down and whispered something to the black snake. It raises its body shakily from the floor and stares the man in the face, its forked tongue out.

speaker: Man
content: Wait... You... you can speak to the snake?!

speaker: Man
content: **** me! This is gonna be big!!

speaker: Man
content: Say something more. Go on!!
The man, overcome with excitement, yells encouragement at the girl with his phone held aloft.
She instructs the snake to carry out each and every one of his requests, all in the hope of being taken on a journey to happiness.
<color=#e45515>That's how she came to stay in Eastside.</color>
From that day forward, the <color=#e45515>girl who can speak to snakes</color> became popular on the internet.
Because of her popularity, she gets to wear <color=#e45515>dresses</color> that she has never dreamed of wearing, eat <color=#e45515>foods</color> that she has never dreamed of eating.
What her audience doesn't know was that... Off camera, she still had to live next to a pet house <color=#e45515>in the courtyard</color>.
<color=#e45515>No one</color> cares what she thinks, <color=#e45515>no one</color> understands how she feels, and her <color=#e45515>only</color> source of warmth is the cold-blooded snake.
On stage, the family's house is <color=#e45515>expanding</color>, along with the <color=#e45515>pet house</color>.
<color=#e45515>The only thing not growing is the nest beside the pet house.</color>

speaker: Man
content: Huh, what's that look? You want to rebel?

speaker: Girl
content: I thought... You could bring me happiness.

speaker: Girl
content: The things you've given me... they can't make me happy at all. They make me tired, they cause me pain...

speaker: Man
content: I spared your life to bring me happiness! Money makes me happy! Understood?!

speaker: Man
content: So be quiet and make money! That's your only job.
The man stumbles drunkenly into his room, a bottle in his hand.

speaker: Man
content: I'm the only reason you're still alive. Don't fantasize about getting things you don't deserve. Like I told you...

speaker: Man
content: Some people are meant to be the downtrodden; that's their fate.
The man and Serpent say in unison. Then the door is slammed shut.

speaker: Girl
content: You want happiness? I want it too...

speaker: Girl
content: But can you get it in some other way...? In a way that doesn't hurt me and take my happiness away. This is not the right way...
The girl stands motionless in the garden, her face turned skywards, not making a sound.

speaker: Girl
content: How about this? I'll give you another kind of happiness, the kind of true happiness I once experienced... You're gonna love it.
You see all the doors in the house close one by one. And then you hear a rustling sound; something is slithering around.

speaker: Girl
content: Hahaha! Dreams, happiness, everything here is going to be shrouded in happiness!
A serpentine shape flies past before your eyes. And then you see something oozing out from under the doors, staining the carpet.

speaker: Chief
content: That's... the Pet Snake Case?

speaker: Chief
content: Hold on, you did that with snake venom and your power?

speaker: Choice
options: Is this really your Realm of Dreams?

speaker: Chief
content: But your dreams...
You want to say that this is not happiness, but you can't get the words out, because at that very moment, your heartbeat skyrockets, as if you're about to drop dead.

Your senses slowly become entwined with those of the character in the show. You feel as if you're trapped in a house from which you can't escape. A myriad of emotions rises in you: anger, disdain, and... a strange excitement.

speaker: Serpent
content: It's a story, a show, not a sweet dream brought about by Ambrosia.

speaker: Serpent
content: But... aren't you feeling happy?
You can't move, and Serpent looks at you with a smile on her face.

speaker: Serpent
content: You told me to look for true happiness. I did, and I've found it, the sort of happiness that belongs only to me! I want you to experience it too, so you can build your own happy dreams...

speaker: Serpent
content: Be patient. We're going to experience more of it... You'll love it, I promise.

speaker: Serpent
content: Anyway, the man was right about one thing though, that this place is the only path that leads to the happiness back then.

speaker: Serpent
content: So, when the path disappeared, she was in a daze.

speaker: Girl
content: Where should I go? Where can I find true happiness?
You see the girl wandering aimlessly around the streets.
A woman accosted her. The girl stopped in her tracks.

speaker: Talent Scout
content: Wow! Miss, I've seen your performance on the dar... On the internet.

speaker: Talent Scout
content: Really exciting, insanely thrilling! Ooh, that was a real snake!

speaker: Talent Scout
content: Here you are, in the flesh. Oh my gosh, you're amazing; the look in your eyes and your aura are simply perfection. You're literally the embodiment of insanity and craziness!

speaker: Talent Scout
content: Sorry about what happened to your ow... Your agent. But don't feel sad; we can do a better job of helping you than him.

speaker: Girl
content: Helping me...?

speaker: Girl
content: Can you... make me happy?

speaker: Talent Scout
content: Of course! Whoever has signed with us is living a life of happiness and merry-making.
The scene on stage starts changing. It swirls and spins, and eventually a new scene comes to existence before you.
You recognize it as the entertainment company you came upon while investigating Ambrosia.

speaker: Talent Scout
content: If you sign with us, you'll be as happy as you want to be!

speaker: Girl
content: You must keep your word; I'll find happiness.

speaker: Girl
content: I'll find happiness if I sign with you.

speaker: Talent Scout
content: Yes, yes, definitely!
The woman pushed a pen across the table in the office. The girl didn't hesitate for a moment before she picked it up and signed the contract.

speaker: Talent Scout
content: Great, from now on, you're an artist of our company. Apply yourself to make more profits.

speaker: Talent Scout
content: ...With your partner, of course.
The talent scout put the contract away and pointed at the object around the girl's arm.
It's the black snake that once put the girl's life in danger. It has succumbed to her power, and has willingly become a part of her being by shrinking in size and then wrapping itself around her arm.

speaker: Actress A
content: Big deal! She's just riding the wave of her old reputation on the darknet as the so-called “girl who can speak with snakes.” That's just playing on people's desire for novelty. But the novelty will wear off, and she'll become worthless!

speaker: Actress B
content: Sigh... She is getting traffic, so it's understandable why they're providing her with tons of resources. I hear she even gets to attend private parties of the upper class now.

speaker: Actress A
content: Pfft, who knows how she pulled that off! The way she carries herself... it makes me sick. Why the pretense? She's just a tool for making money.
The girl hears a high-pitched voice coming from inside the green room as she walks past.

speaker: Actress A
content: A tool is entitled to nothing. I'd love to see if she can keep up her smile in front of the camera when she...
The girl's communications device beeps. She's just received a message from her agent.

speaker: Text Message
content: "Great performance! You've done a wonderful job!"

speaker: Text Message
content: "Tonight, you'll be performing for a private banquet downtown. The host liked your performance earlier today, and wants you there to liven things up."

speaker: Text Message
content: "Someone will come and pick you up momentarily. This is a great opportunity. Don't blow it."

speaker: Text Message
content: "It's going to be a happy occasion. I think... You're gonna love it!"
The girl stares at the message for a long while before bursting into the green room.

speaker: Serpent
content: I don't care what will happen to me when the novelty wears off. At least I can provide such novelty!

speaker: Serpent
content: It would do you good if you could spend some time thinking about how to find your own happiness... instead of gossiping all day.
The girl storms out of the room, without a backward glance.
The scene on stage changes again. You and the girl, as if dragged along by some unseen force, arrive at the tallest building downtown.
The innermost hall, where the banquet is held, has been turned into a brightly-lit place of entertainment.
All the guests are wearing revolting getups, and grotesque domino masks underneath which are fake scars created with makeup.
They cheer the girl dancing with her snake on stage.

speaker: Guest
content: You're the best monster here! A real monster!!
The last remark of the guests fades away; for a long time afterward, only music can be heard in the brightly-lit room.
You raise your head involuntarily, fighting to ward off the emotions the girl is conveying to you: distaste, disgust, and disdain.
On stage, the girl is sitting with her small snake nuzzling up against her cheek affectionately. Off stage, confusion and disorder reign.

speaker: Serpent
content: What you brought me was not happiness either. Why? She said... that this would be a happy occasion.
Lying at her feet is a wide-eyed "monster", looking at the girl and squeezing out a broken sentence.

speaker: Guest
content: You... you are... just a tool... tool... for making us happy...
You realize the situation immediately.

speaker: Chief
content: Serpent, you're slipping deeper and deeper... Wake up, before it's too late.

speaker: Serpent
content: That's not a place where she can find happiness either. She still has to look for it... by herself.

Serpent ignores you and falls silent. You turn your attention back to the stage. Music floating, light dancing, the girl comes to the center of the hall and picks up a magazine with filth all over it.

speaker: Serpent
content: Girl and Snake... Novelty... Monster...

speaker: Serpent
content: Heheh... Right, how come I never thought of it? The reason I can't find happiness, is because I'm a monster.

speaker: Serpent
content: A monster... that's what they've been calling me. They called me a monster just now.

speaker: Serpent
content: I've been unhappy since the very beginning. I've never been able to find true happiness that belongs to me... I can't find it among humans.
Then the girl's mask-like face is cracked open by a spooky smile as she flips through the magazine, which is peppered with pictures of monsters, as if looking for something.

speaker: Serpent
content: So... where can I find happiness as a monster?! Where?!

speaker: Serpent
content: Ah, Endless... Carnival?
Your emotions are in tumult, your consciousness runs wild, and your shackles start throbbing violently. You sense that the Mania inside her is quivering, ready to break out and wreak havoc.

speaker: Chief
content: Serpent, you mustn't go there. You're not a monster.

speaker: Chief
content: You can't find happiness there!
The tumult of emotions keeps on running into you through the shackles. In your state of confusion, you hear a voice.

speaker: Serpent
content: Let's go together... To find the ultimate happiness!

speaker: Chief
content: Serpent, let's go...
Serpent's voice is full of enchantment. You almost want to say yes to her invitation without thinking about it.
A tingling sensation comes over you. It's a warning from the shackles, an instinctive reaction.

speaker: Choice
options: I'm not going with you, Serpent.

content: All the emotions that have just seized you retreat in a tide. You see the person before you.

speaker: Serpent
content: ...You're so stubborn.
Serpent leans gently against your knee, her hand still holding yours, so tightly that your fingers hurt.

speaker: Serpent
content: Almost there. You'll see it in a moment...

speaker: Chief
content: Serpent, you look sick. What's the matter?

speaker: Chief
content: I don't know what you've done to me. But you can't go on like this, you must stop exhausting yourself, you...

speaker: Serpent
content: I understand... why you're refusing my offer of happiness. Because you don't think this happiness is satisfying enough for you, right? It's okay, it's okay...

speaker: Serpent
content: Any minute now, we're going to experience happiness on a grander scale, a happiness that's more eternal!
Your surroundings blur again, and you realize that Serpent is about to resume telling her story.
This Sinner before you, connected to you through the shackles, is oozing danger. You feel everything she is feeling.

You know that Serpent is baring her soul to you, and that she will drag you under with her. But this girl, whose life force is draining away fast, is still smiling at you, though with an effort, and wanting to share true happiness with you...

speaker: Chief
content: Lay it on me, let me feel everything you've gone through, if you so wish.

speaker: Serpent
content: Legend has it that there's an amusement park for monsters.

speaker: Serpent
content: But... She's not sure if she can find the happiness that belongs to monsters in that place, the happiness that never ends.
In the darkness, Serpent's voice turns doleful. You seem to see the girl who wandered around the bright streets of Eastside looking for happiness.

speaker: Serpent
content: The girl is strange-looking and has been so from birth, with her unusual eyes and ears, and her peculiar birthmarks. This has made her an object of ridicule and a source of fear.

speaker: Serpent
content: She has always been an outsider. That's why she couldn't find her own happiness among humans.
There seem to be objects swimming in the darkness around you. Slowly but surely, they come together to build a scene you're only too familiar with.

speaker: Chief
content: Is this the Endless Carnival?!

speaker: Serpent
content: Yes... Endless Carnival, an amusement park for monsters. Surely they'll welcome me and let me find happiness?
Serpent's voice merges with that of the character in the story again.
The eyes on stage are lightless, but filled with longing.

speaker: Chief
content: Serpent, you won't be able to get in there.
"Serpent" hears you and turns around, smiling down at you from the stage.

speaker: Serpent
content: I am... a human?

speaker: Serpent
content: Are you dreaming?
Serpent moves on ahead, as the Corruptors in the park stir.
They notice the presence of an unwelcome intruder and come rushing over to chase her out.

speaker: Serpent
content: Why... why are they turning me out?!
Her puny body is swaying, and her face, arms and abdomen have been lacerated by the Corruptors.
From beyond the warped gate of the park come furious shouts.

speaker: Corruptor
content: Get out! Get out! You don't belong here! This amusement park is not for you!

speaker: Chief
content: Serpent, stop!

speaker: Chief
content: Or you will be consumed by the Corruptors! That's not the kind of amusement park you have in mind!

speaker: Chief
