content: Little monster, soft and small, lonely as the dust that falls. No one near to hold her tight, till a nun brought loving light.

speaker: Graves
content: Little monster, sweet but feared, eyes would wince when she appeared. Wedding lights shone bright as day, but stones chased her far away.

speaker: Graves
content: Little monster, sighs so deep, moonbeams kiss her while she weeps. If her face shone like a star, would love find her where they are?
With eyes closed, Graves gently sways her head, softly murmuring the nursery rhyme she wrote herself.

speaker: Graves
content: I really thought this time, I wouldn't be left behind again. I believed Elsie would stay with me forever!

speaker: Graves
content: But in the end, she was scared of me too. I was left all alone again...

speaker: Graves
content: After she left, the castle faded into dust, and I became that unwanted little monster again. A monster in a ruined castle... how perfect.

speaker: Graves
content: Then, as time went by, new faces came to the castle... No. 15... Dullahan... At last, I had friends who were just like me.
Graves's voice drifts, hazy with recollection.

speaker: Graves
content: I made a wish upon the ring, and there you were. You promised you'd never leave, then brought me to the Bureau. I've never been this happy!

speaker: Graves
content: But this place... it's too wonderful. So wonderful that I feel I don't belong here at all...

speaker: Graves
content: I'm so scared. Can a monster like me really keep all this...? Do I really deserve to feel happy?
Graves stretches out her hands. They're empty—hands that have never truly held onto anything. That's why when she finally has something to call her own, it all feels too surreal to be true.
Although you've told her to "embrace herself fully" and to "love herself," years of pain still pull her thoughts toward darker places.
To truly instill belief in this anxious, insecure girl, you must do something, something that's more than just words.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You really are a wonderful person, and you deserve everything you have right now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You don't have to fuss over me or go out of your way to prove anything. I'm the one who failed—I never noticed how insecure you felt.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've had so little to hold onto in life. You're scared that, just like before, this happiness is nothing but another bubble, ready to pop at any time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: In your world, love always comes with conditions, and being left behind is the norm. But that's wrong.
You deliberately keep your speech slow, as if trying to imprint these words deep into Graves's heart.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You can trust my promises. I will honor every word I've spoken to you. No matter what happens, I won't leave you, and I won't let anyone hurt you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course, if you feel the urge to do something to put yourself at ease, to prove everything you have now is real...
You pause for a moment, the corners of your mouth lifting into a faint smile.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Then why not just work with me directly?

speaker: Graves
content: Work... with you?
She tilts her head in confusion, her voice tinged with uncertainty.
You nod, already having a plan in mind.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even in fairy tales, after the happy ending comes ordinary, everyday life.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Alright, the interrogation is over. As we agreed, I'll walk you back now.

speaker: Corruptor
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Roarrr!<i>
On the battlefield at the Rust, the roars of Corruptors pierce the air from every direction. Graves activates her power, struggling to control the enemies before her.

Confronted by the overwhelming horde of Corruptors, well-equipped contamination cleanup units, MBCC staff, and Sinners fight together in a coordinated effort, steadily pressing the Corruptors into a tightening encirclement.
Yet, for Graves, a novice to the battlefield, the circumstances appear far from promising...

speaker: Graves
content: My eyes... can't keep track of everything... and my power... too slow to activate.
The Corruptors' howls resonate like mournful death knells, their grotesque faces looking even more terrifying in the dim light.
Having already subdued one Corruptor, another suddenly emerges from the shadows. Graves finds herself unable to concentrate on both.

speaker: Graves
content: ...It's too late!
The Corruptor's claws are mere inches from Graves, her power still not taking effect on this one. She barely twists her body to the side, bracing herself for the inevitable impact...
Snap out of it! This is a battlefield!
Bang!
A bright red baseball bat delivers a powerful blow to the Corruptor's head, sending it spinning several times before slumping lifelessly to the ground, its body collapsing in a heap.

speaker: Dolly
content: You... new here? Name's Dolly. Stick behind if you're scared. Wouldn't want my bat to accidentally knock you into next week.
The Sinner before her shows a wide grin. Unlike Graves, Dolly shows not a trace of fear toward the Corruptors. Instead, she swings her bat powerfully through the air, winding up for her next strike.

speaker: Dolly
content: These disgusting freaks are ruining my view! I'll wipe out every last one! Come on, let's see how many pieces I can break you into!

speaker: Dolly
content: Like... THIS!
Even before her words fade, another Corruptor is sent hurtling through the air by the force of her bat, producing a dull thud as it crashes into the distance.
Immediately after, a burst of electricity lights up the surroundings as an arrow crackling with sparks shoots down from above, accurately piercing through the Corruptor's skull.

speaker: EMP
content: Oh dear, is our fiery little girl throwing another tantrum? Looks like you still need the invincible EMP to deliver the fatal blow! How's that for skill?
A flamboyant figure sporting a bow on her back emerges, a self-satisfied smirk dancing at the edge of her lips as she boldly juts her chin towards the Sinner brandishing the baseball bat.

speaker: Dolly
content: Oh? You wanna talk big? Fine—my bat vs. your arrows. Let's find out who bleeds first!

speaker: EMP
content: Whoa whoa, I was just kidding! Point that bat at the enemies, crazy! We've still got the newbie watching us—hey, hey!
Retreating at lightning speed, she narrowly avoids Dolly's bat, comically shielding her rear end before pivoting towards Graves.

speaker: EMP
content: Hey, first time on a mission? Relax—with the invincible me watching your back, these losers won't even know what hit 'em.

speaker: Graves
content: ...Thank you both.
Graves's voice trembles with nervousness, but her tone carries genuine heartfelt gratitude.
After eliminating the Corruptors near Graves, Dolly and EMP return to their positions, playfully squabbling with each other along the way.

In the midst of the chaos, Graves grapples with her own power, striving to acclimate swiftly to the battlefield. Her abilities are potent, but the cadence of genuine combat proves to be quite a challenge for her.

Chaotic shouts and violent collisions echo across the battlefield. Graves's heart pounds frantically in her chest as she fumbles through each movement. Without her teammates' cover and support, she would certainly have been injured by now.
Graves's gaze drifts toward the front line, where ${PlayerName} is intently monitoring the battlefield, adjusting strategies and directing the combat operations.
The entire team executes the battle plan with clockwork precision, apparently unaffected by her mistakes.

speaker: Graves
content: Am I actually being helpful?

speaker: Graves
content: Then... what can I do?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since this is your first combat mission, just stay behind the team and provide mobile support.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Don't worry, I'll be close by.
You noticed the commotion around Graves earlier, but with EMP and Dolly there to help, you weren't concerned.
With the battlefield situation now stable, you temporarily leave the front line and make your way towards her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: How's it? Not as scary as you imagined, right?
Graves looks up, forcing an awkward smile, then gently smooths down your upturned collar.

speaker: Graves
content: Everyone's so good at this. I'm really grateful they helped me earlier.

speaker: Graves
content: I'm not much help... And I've been holding everyone back...
Her voice gradually fades into a whisper, tinged with self-reproach. Her gaze descends lower and lower, as if she yearns for the ground to swallow her whole.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not at all. Every single person is a vital part of our fighting force.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: They're all very grateful for your help.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hmm... Maybe a little bit.
Graves looks like a pitiful puppy with drooping ears, fidgeting awkwardly in place with nowhere to hide.
You quickly drop your mock-serious expression.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry, I was just teasing you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Teamwork isn't about fighting solo. Everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Real teamwork means everyone focuses on their own tasks while also doing everything they can to protect their teammates.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So don't worry about burdening others. Victory comes only when everyone works together and supports each other.

speaker: Graves
content: Teammates... Yes, I have teammates now.

speaker: Graves
content: I'm not... alone anymore.
As Graves recalls the Sinners who just helped her and the friendly greetings she has received at the Bureau, a smile returns to her face.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief, multiple high-threat units just appeared, and the engagement zone's heating up fast!

speaker: Eugene
content: Team A's got no counters for this Corruptor variant. Their defenses are limited there...
Before Eugene can finish his report, a group of Corruptors with threatening power levels breaches the left flank of the encirclement, throwing the entire formation into disarray.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eugene, move your team to shore up the left flank now! I'm sending backup to plug that breach!
Before you can finish deploying the forces, a lightning-fast Corruptor vaults over a vigilant cleanup member. In the blink of an eye, it appears right beside you and leaps high into the air.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief! Look out above—!
Eugene's alarmed shout comes through your communicator. Your heart plummets as you look up toward the sky, but before your eyes can even focus, a grotesque face fills your entire vision...
The Corruptor's massive body dives down from above, threatening to tear you apart the next second!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: At this distance...
Daowei
At the last possible moment, a sharp pain sears through your mind. Simultaneously, the Corruptor clutches its own head and unnaturally halts in mid-air, frozen in place.
A surge of intense emotions flood over from the other end of your shackles. You realize it's someone using their power!
A red figure springs up from beside you, creating a powerful gust of wind as they rocket towards the suspended Corruptor...

speaker: Corruptor
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Gaaah!!<i>
The Corruptor's form hurtles several meters through the air before violently crashing to the ground, sending clouds of dust and rubble billowing into the air.
You duck down, lowering your head to avoid the flying debris. Everything has happened in mere seconds, leaving you and everyone around you frozen in shock.
When you look up again, the person standing protectively in front of you is...
Graves remains on high alert, her eyes locked on the Corruptor, too focused to acknowledge your call.

Black winds swirl with dust around her. The Mania enveloping her body resonates with the contamination lingering in the Rust. Surges of Mania energy pulse through the air, converging into an oppressive force.

She stands amid the crimson haze, her shoulders rising and falling with each labored breath. Her once-porcelain skin blooms with splotches of red, the delicate fabric of her dress now a canvas of spreading stains of Mania.
Mania has twisted her delicate features into something feral. A rising tide of red spreads across her eyes, erasing their former composure and leaving only murderous intent and menace.
She stands before you, transformed into something almost monstrous—the same form you once witnessed in the castle.
Her condition is highly unstable, with the infection rate continuing to rise, but the shackles that bind her to you have not yet completely failed.

speaker: Corruptor
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Roarrrr!!<i>
In mere seconds, the Corruptor that was knocked away has already regained its footing. It moves with frightening speed, the impact making the ground tremble and sending up clouds of dust.

Graves moves in unsettling ways you can't quite follow. Almost imperceptible waves of power ripple through the air, and suddenly the Corruptor stumbles, its limbs growing sluggish as if its senses are being suppressed by some unknown force.
Yet even with its movements restricted, the Corruptor continues to attack on pure instinct.

Though it can't control its body, its wildly flailing punches are enough to keep everyone at bay. Several times, those massive fists nearly touch Graves, missing her only to strike the ground with a thunderous impact.
Graves grows impatient. The shackles binding you together tremble as her emotions crash over you like a violent tide. Her skin has now turned completely red.
She furrows her brow, all her attention focused on ending this battle. Suddenly, the Corruptor's legs twist unnaturally like a puppet being forcibly pulled away from its intended path.

Mania surges around her, whipping up her hair and dress like a spectral wind. An overwhelming pressure descends over the battlefield, causing every Corruptor and team member within range to struggle for breath.
Finally, the Corruptor's resistance breaks. Its massive body freezes like a jammed gear, unable to move even an inch.
In stark contrast to the paralyzed Corruptor, Graves moves with fluid grace. Like a ghost, like a fish through water, she dances through the air toward her frozen prey.

Time seems to stand still as she descends, her face obscured by her veil. A dagger—appearing in her hand from nowhere—glides forward with gentle precision, skillfully slipping between bones to pierce the Corruptor's heart.

speaker: Corruptor
content: <color=#dg1f1f>Gaaarrrggghh!!!<i>
Flesh tears as the Corruptor releases its final wail before going completely still. Graves twists her wrist, rending the wound wider until the dagger pierces straight through the enemy's chest.
The Corruptor crashes to the ground with a thunderous impact, and the oppressive weight of Mania instantly vanishes.

speaker: Graves
content: I won't let you harm...
Graves stands still, her gaze dark and intense. Slowly, she lifts her foot and then viciously stomps on the fallen Corruptor, again and again, until she's certain it's nothing but a lifeless corpse.
The battlefield falls silent.
You feel the weight of every stare—from the cleanup members, Bureau staff, and her fellow Sinners. No one approaches. No one speaks.
Finally sensing something amiss, Graves slowly turns around as if waking from a trance, searching for you among the crowd. The smile on her face freezes in place.
The very people who fought beside her just moments ago are now staring at her. With painful clarity, she realizes their gazes are nothing like before.
In a flash, these stares merge with the ones she has seen before—burning into her, searing holes through her very being.
These stares... It's as though they're looking at... a monster.
Could it be...?!
Graves looks down at her hands. Blood is still dripping from the dagger, and her hands—just like in her recurring nightmares—are tainted a bright red.

Now that she realizes everyone has seen her red-skinned monstrous form, terror floods through her. With practiced ease, she drops to the ground, drawing her knees to her chest, and curls into a tight ball.
Will they be afraid of her?
Will they laugh at her?
Will they throw stones at her?
Do they see her... as just another Corruptor? Another monster to be purged?
She buries her head forcefully into the crook of her arm, too afraid to look up.
Until a gentle breeze stirs around her, until the sound of leather shoes approaching reaches her ears, until Graves has exhausted every terrible consequence her mind can conjure.
The silence stretches, thick enough to choke on—then shatters as cheers erupt around her, catching her completely off guard.

speaker: Dolly
content: Nice work, rookie! Straight through the Corruptor's heart! That was a perfect home run!

speaker: EMP
content: Holy hell! If I'd known you packed this much firepower, I'd have dragged you everywhere! Just imagine how invincible we'd look together—the invincible EMP with an ace like you!

In response to their cues, a chorus of admiration reaches Graves's ears. Bewildered, she raises her head just enough to peek through a small gap, and finds the team already moving, reinvigorated, charging toward the remaining Corruptors with newfound ferocity.

speaker: Dolly
content: Tch, these Corruptors are disgusting when they cluster. Let's move! Don't leave a single one alive!

speaker: EMP
content: Hell yeah! Now I'm amped! Since I'm stuck on this mission, I'm gonna make damn sure they remember me!
Dolly and EMP continue their usual rowdy banter, while what Graves considers earth-shattering seems to be just another moment in the mission to them.

speaker: Staff A
content: Chief, a heads-up about our one-Sinner army would've been nice. Could've left half the team at home!

speaker: Cleanup Member
content: No way we're getting shown up! Can't let MBCC steal all the glory—let's mop up the rest in one go!

No one seems to care that Graves looks different than before. There are no stones thrown her way, no hushed voices gossiping behind covered mouths, and certainly no one collapsing in terror at the sight of her.
You approach Graves, crouching down beside her as she remains curled up in confusion, and give her a reassuring pat.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: See? I told you. Even when you reveal your true self, they don't hate you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That was a close call. Thanks for the save.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You were unstoppable out there. Maybe Nightingale's right—I should step back and let you take center stage and shine.

speaker: Graves
content: Take center stage... and shine?

speaker: Graves
content: If people saw the real me... they would run away screaming, wouldn't they?

speaker: Dolly
content: Nice work, rookie! Straight through the Corruptor's heart! That was a perfect home run!

speaker: Graves
content: No one wants to be friends with a monster. Not everyone is you, willing to stand by a monster's side.

speaker: EMP
content: Holy hell! If I'd known you packed this much firepower, I'd have dragged you everywhere! Just imagine how invincible we'd look together—the invincible EMP with an ace like you!

speaker: Graves
content: I'm so scared. Can a monster like me really keep all this...? Do I really deserve to feel happy?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You really are a wonderful person, and you deserve everything you have right now.
You extend your hand, assisting Graves to her feet. Her dress is marred by contamination, blood, and mud, her veil in disarray, yet none of it can obscure the radiance that shines from within her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Your dress got dirty because of me... again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've been watching you this whole fight. At first, you couldn't keep up—your eyes unsure, reactions just off—but then you gradually found your groove. You even protected me at a critical moment.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I wasn't really sure about throwing you into battle this soon... But I worried the longer I waited, the more insecure you would grow.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If I were always by your side, then I would be your only source of security. That's no way to grow.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I want you to connect with others—learn how teamwork feels, or that other people need you too. It's not just my recognition that matters... it's everyone's.

speaker: Graves
content: But what if... I messed everything up?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Want the real truth? I've got a tiny selfish streak in this too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I want everyone to know that this "bride" of mine who's newly joined the Bureau isn't just beautiful—she's also an incredibly powerful Sinner.
You glance toward the other Sinners locked in fierce combat in the distance, tilting your head up slightly.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Besides... even if you make a mistake? That's why we're a team. I trust them to cover for any gaps.
Noticing that Graves still looks anxious, you lean close to her ear and whisper so only she can hear...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: See? No one is afraid of you. Nothing you worried about has happened, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like I said, you are a wonderful person, and you deserve everything you have right now.
Your words linger in Graves's ears, causing a ticklish sensation while her heart pounds rapidly. Like magic, they dissolve the anxiety that has been weighing on her heart.
The gloom and fear on Graves's face vanish completely as she throws her arms around your neck, her voice brimming with excitement and joy.

speaker: Graves
content: I helped! That means I'm useful to you, right?
Emboldened by your approval, Graves abandons her fear and hesitation, unleashing her power as she charges toward every place that calls for her help.

Wherever Graves goes, Corruptors either stumble like marionettes—tripping over their own feet and crashing to the ground—or flail wildly at thin air as if they're hallucinating, completely losing control of their bodies.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Someone's getting a little too excited, huh?

Watching Graves dart enthusiastically across the battlefield, fueled by her newfound motivation, you decide not to interrupt her moment of glory and return to the front line to continue commanding the battle.
Thanks to Graves's exceptional performance, the Corruptors are eliminated far more quickly than expected.

speaker: Graves
content: Is this... the last one?
Having pushed herself to the limits, Graves is now completely depleted of energy. She wrestles to maintain her balance, her eyelids at war with gravity itself.
You notice her condition and rush to her side.
Seeing you approach, Graves musters what little strength she has left to wave at you.
But suddenly her world spins, and Graves feels herself tumbling—until a pair of warm arms swiftly catch her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you okay? Did you get hurt?

speaker: Graves
content: I'm fine... not hurt...

speaker: Graves
content: Is the battle... over?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's over. Let the others handle the final cleanup.

speaker: Graves
content: Hehe, I was... helpful...
Graves closes her eyes, a guileless smile spreading across her face. You respond in agreement.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Helpful? You were vital. We couldn't have done it without you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Graves?
You give her a light shake, but she's dead weight in your arms. Uncertain if she has drifted off to sleep or lost consciousness, you quietly murmur a few resigned words under your breath.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Going full burnout on your first mission? You really went all out.
Her clothes are stained with blood and mud, yet her face radiates a contented smile as if she's fallen into the most pleasant of dreams.
Dense fog hangs in the air as grayish-white moonlight struggles to penetrate the mist, seeping through the dilapidated windows.
Mottled reflections from stained-glass windows paint the floor where a small figure stands utterly alone.
What is this place?
Looking forward or backward, the corridor seems to stretch endlessly in both directions.
The small figure wanders the corridor aimlessly, finding no doors or exits of any kind. Her mind fluctuates between lucidity and haziness.
Familiar voices emerge from the fog, seemingly coming from all directions at once. Mockery? Insults? Though the words are indistinct, she knows what they're saying all too well.
—She remembers this corridor.
<color=#fb9259>This place... I've been here before...</color>
Clank!
As if responding to her realization, a distant bell begins to toll.
The sound acts as a command or conditioned reflex, compelling her to involuntarily extend her hand to touch the fog before her...
The fog suddenly thickens, completely engulfing her.
As the white light fades away, the fog dissipates entirely.
As soon as she opens her eyes, she finds herself pushed to the ground by someone, with a half-eaten, shriveled piece of coarse bread lying on the floor beside her hand.

speaker: Child A
content: Hey! That was my half-eaten bread, you thief!
The two shadowy figures standing before her have indistinct features, as if intentionally blurred, revealing only dramatically oversized mouths that incessantly open and close.
I thought nobody wanted it... so I took it...

speaker: Child B
content: Taking things without permission is stealing!
Her stomach emits a low growl. Devoid of the strength to argue with the two older children who appear to be collaborating against her, she can only hope and silently pray they'll leave soon.
She shrinks further into the corner, her eyes fixed longingly on the piece of bread.

speaker: Child A
content: Ooooh! Not just a stray nobody wants—you're a thief too! No wonder your parents left you!
No... I'm not...
She begins to protest, but as her gaze falls upon her own reddened arms, panic sets in. Hastily, she retracts her arms, trying to hide the evidence of her secret.
But it's already too late—the older children have spotted her red skin and grow even bolder in their mockery.

speaker: Child B
content: Ewwww! Look at your gross red skin! Freak!

speaker: Child B
content: Still pretending you're not a monster? If you weren't one, why'd they throw you away?

speaker: Child A
content: Yeah! When that old nun grabbed you, did she even know you were a freaky little monster?
Tears well up in the little monster's eyes as she desperately rubs her arms, but no matter how hard she scrubs, the red patches stubbornly stain her skin.
She wants to say she's not a monster, to deny she was left behind, but in this space, she finds herself unable to voice words she has never uttered before.
She is not like the others—that is truth. She was abandoned here—that, too, is truth.

speaker: Little Monster
content: I'm sorry... I don't want it anymore. You can have it all... It must be because I'm not good enough... That's why no one wants me...
She covers her face. These words have echoed countless times before, and she believed she had grown numb to their sting, that they could no longer make her cry.
But these words still cut like sharp knives, slicing through her skin and shredding her clothes piece by piece.

speaker: Little Monster
content: Right, I... I've heard these words before. I...
<color=#fb9259>She has been here before, countless times</color>—strangely, this vague sensation surfaces within her.
Clank!
Once more, the bell tolls, shrouding her in dense fog... She drifts weightlessly, grasping at memories that vanish the moment they take shape...
Amidst jeers and mocking laughter, the little monster opens her eyes.
This is a wedding. She was just hiding herself in a corner of the hall, yearning to witness snippets of others' happiness, when the guests stumbled upon her.

speaker: Guest A
content: A wedding dress?! This little freak actually thinks she can wear a wedding dress like others?!

speaker: Guest B
content: What's this filthy monster doing here? Come to ruin the ceremony?

speaker: Little Monster
content: I didn't mean to ruin anything... I just wanted to watch... Is that not allowed either?
Unfortunately, the little monster's plea and vulnerability elicit no empathy from the guests. Before she can finish speaking, more and more guests gather, instantly surrounding her.

speaker: Guest C
content: She's a damn curse! Get her out of here before she snaps and hurts someone!

speaker: Guest A
content: Drive her away! Get her out!
A stone lands at her feet, quickly followed by a second, then a third. The crowd seems to have found their method of driving her away, as one by one they begin picking up stones from the ground.
The little monster stares blankly at the guests, watching the stones fly toward her with no thought of dodging.

speaker: Little Monster
content: What's the point? Why bother dodging? This always happens... When has running ever helped?

speaker: Little Monster
content: No... <color=#fb9259>not even once</color>.

speaker: Little Monster
content: Then there's no need to struggle. Just accept it.

speaker: Little Monster
content: Mmph!
She closes her eyes, awaiting the inevitable pain about to come.
But the familiar pain from her memory never comes. With caution, she opens one eye.
She sees a pair of leather shoes planted firmly in front of her, while stones pelt that long gray coat instead.
She can't make out the person's face, yet feels a strange sense of familiarity.

speaker: Gray-Coated Person
content: It takes how many of you to pick on one? Must be so proud.
The figure casually tosses a stone up and down in their hand before hurling it at the child who has been shouting the loudest.

speaker: Rowdy Child
content: OW! Who the heck do you think you are?! You can't just peg rocks at my butt!

speaker: Gray-Coated Person
content: That's exactly why I did it.
The figure swiftly hurls several more stones, hitting the guests on their hands and legs, compelling them to retreat.

speaker: Little Monster
content: Th-that's impressive!
The little monster gazes at the gray-coated person before her, her eyes wide and shining with wonder.

speaker: Little Monster
content: A-are you... an angel sent by heaven to save me? Are you my guardian angel?

speaker: Gray-Coated Person
content: ■■■, you can't just sit there and take their crap. You have to fight back.
The little monster, covered in dirt, is gently lifted to her feet, a warm hand enveloping her cold, tiny fingers. The person then picks up a stone and places it in her palm.
Mimicking her protector, she positions herself in a throwing stance.

speaker: Gray-Coated Person
content: Aim at your target, ready...
She anxiously tightens her grip. This nightmare has haunted her many times before, but this time, something is different.

speaker: Little Monster
content: This time... can I break this nightmare?
However, the dreamscape appears to possess its own will. Before she can act, the familiar toll of the bell rings again...
CLANK... Thick fog appears once more, forcibly pulling her away.

speaker: Little Monster
content: What's... happening?

The previous scene remains vivid in her mind as the little monster surveys her surroundings in bewilderment. Neither the figure in the gray coat nor the guests are within her view. Ahead of her lies the familiar corridor, enveloped in mist.
She is no longer the child from her memories—she now wears a wedding dress, her figure tall and slender.
Her tightly clenched hand trembles as she gradually unclasps it. The stone is now gone without a trace.

speaker: Little Monster
content: I thought someone might finally love me...
She covers her face with her hands, letting the tears flow freely.
Voices from the fog converge as if gathering from all her nightmares, a persistent reminder—

speaker: Voice in the Nightmare
content: You don't deserve love. You don't deserve anyone to love you!

speaker: Voice in the Nightmare
content: A monster should stay where monsters belong, not crawling where humans walk!!

speaker: Voice in the Nightmare
content: That dream was just a mistake. How could anyone take it seriously? Don't be so foolish!

speaker: Little Monster
content: ...No, it was not a mistake...

speaker: Little Monster
content: Bring it back, please bring it back...
The voices around her multiply, growing louder and more numerous. To escape them, she curls into a ball, hugging herself tightly.
Under the brainwashing pressure of these voices, her mind grows foggy once again, filling with thoughts that are not truly her own.

speaker: Little Monster
content: Yes... I'm just an ugly monster. How could I ever dream of a grand wedding or eternal love...

speaker: Little Monster
content: Will anyone ever love me? Do I deserve to be loved?

speaker: Little Monster
content: Will that person from just now... ever come back?
She lifts her head in confusion, struggling to remember, yet the person's face remains just beyond her grasp.

speaker: Little Monster
content: That person... who are they again?

speaker: Little Monster
content: And I... who am I?
The mist drifts like flowing vapor, transforming the moonlight into a delicate veil that drapes over her head.
Time thickens to syrup as she loses herself in thought. Then—amid the floating motes of dust—a single glint of light winks at her. Mesmerized, she reaches out in a daze.

speaker: Little Monster
content: A... ring? Wasn't it already...
Despite the obscuring mist, the ring on her finger still reflects a faint sliver of moonlight.
It's an ancient ring with elaborate patterns centered on a single staring eye. Though it's never appeared in her dreams before, she somehow knows it has already shattered and vanished in reality.

As this thought forms, the ring truly shatters, dissolving into specks of light that drift throughout the dreamscape. The bell that used to chime whenever she recalled something now remains eerily silent.
A multitude of dreams rush before her eyes, a myriad of grotesque faces intertwine with each other, and a cacophony of voices overlap, all beckoning her.
She remembers now...

speaker: Graves
content: I am not a "little monster." I am...<color=#fb9259>Graves</color>!
The moment she remembers her name, moonlight outside the window surges brilliantly, instantly dispersing the fog that has lingered here since time immemorial.
Finally, the corridor comes into focus. The voices that have persistently haunted her ears emanate from faceless shadows concealed along the corridor.
They emanate a cold, repulsive aura, trapping her in an endless cycle of past nightmares night after night.

speaker: Familiar Voice
content: Did you forget? You're no longer alone.
A familiar voice resonates from behind her, as if it has traversed hundreds, thousands of dreams to reach her side.

speaker: Gray-Coated Person
content: Don't listen to those meaningless voices. You're not a monster—not even close.

speaker: Gray-Coated Person
content: You are beautiful, kind, and resilient. You deserve a wonderful wedding, and more than that, you deserve to be loved!

Graves doesn't dare lift her gaze to meet his, wary that the damned toll of the bell might reset everything back to the start. Fear tightens her heart, dreading that he might vanish again at any moment.
female_content: Graves doesn't dare lift her gaze to meet hers, wary that the damned toll of the bell might reset everything back to the start. Fear tightens her heart, dreading that she might vanish again at any moment.

content: Yet her fears fail to come true. Instead, one by one, figures exuding warmth start to materialize beside her.

speaker: Blurry Figure
content: Graves, you're amazing!

speaker: Blurry Figure
content: If it weren't for you, those Corruptors would've ended me!!

speaker: Blurry Figure
content: So what if you're a monster? You're an awesome monster who protects us!
More and more blurry figures with indistinct faces gather around Graves. Through their gestures, they convey to her, "We're on the same side."

speaker: Gray-Coated Person
content: Look, all these people acknowledge you. They need you.
The person in the gray coat reaches out a hand to her, just as before.

speaker: Gray-Coated Person
content: You should have thrown this stone long ago.
The stone she had been unable to throw somehow reappears in her palm. The warm hand withdraws, returning control of her body to Graves.

speaker: Graves
content: I can... throw it now!
Graves's voice grows increasingly determined. Under the watchful eyes of all the warm figures, she steps forward and throws the long-overdue stone at the dark shadows with indistinct faces.
Bang—
The scene before her shatters like glass. The grotesque faces crack and fall away, dissolving into weightless dream-dust. Then everything—including Graves herself—plummets rapidly downward.
Graves startles awake, sensing a coolness on her face. Raising her hand to her cheek, she finds it damp with tears.

speaker: Graves
content: Am I... crying?
She unfolds her palm to reveal faint traces of moisture. In her hand, she notices crescent-shaped marks, likely left by her nails from clenching her fist too tightly during her dream.

speaker: Graves
content: Strange. My face and hands feel cool, but deep down inside... something feels so warm.

Graves crosses her hands over her chest, trying to calm her racing heart after waking from the dream. That hollow place inside her seems to have been filled with something new—only warmth lingers now.

speaker: Graves
content: This is... not my room...
The space before her isn't the vast, dilapidated castle, nor is it the stark room assigned to her by the Bureau. Instead, it's a simple room exuding a reassuring, homely atmosphere.
The lights are on here, as if intentionally left that way for someone who might wake at any moment.
Less than twenty centimeters away from Graves, at the bed's edge, rests a figure that she knows all too well.

speaker: Graves
content: My dear?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: See? No one is afraid of you. Nothing you worried about has happened, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Like I said, you are a wonderful person, and you deserve everything you have right now.
As Graves hazily recalls the words she heard before losing consciousness, her cheeks grow warm.
She wraps herself in the blanket and inches closer to the figure beside her. Her long hair spills across the bedsheet and pillow, intertwining with the other person's.
She has no idea how long she's been unconscious, only certain that the person who has promised not to leave her is now faithfully staying by her side.

speaker: Graves
content: Hehe... waking up in a cozy room with my love lying beside me... I'm so happy...
Graves giggles with a silly grin. She feels pink bubbles fizzing in her heart as everything around her shimmers with a dreamlike glow that feels almost too wonderful to be real.
She props her cheek on one hand, lying on her side and gazing with a beaming smile at the person whose face was indistinct in her dream.

speaker: Graves
content: You're the one in my dream... <color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>.

speaker: Graves
content: It must be you. That gray coat... I could never mistake it.
Not content with just looking, Graves reaches out with a single finger and begins to carefully trace the contours of that face.

speaker: Graves
content: Forehead, nose, eyes, lips... I'm memorizing it all. Next time you appear in my dreams, I'll definitely know it's you.
Her finger pauses on those soft lips, reluctant to move away.

speaker: Graves
content: Now... what are you dreaming about? Am I there too?
Thump-thump... thump-thump... only silence and the sound of her own heartbeat answer her question.
Graves gazes at the person, utterly mesmerized. The distance between them gradually closes until she can feel the slow, steady breath against her skin. Her own breathing quickens in response.

speaker: Graves
content: There are no cameras watching us now, no staff, no other Sinners... just you and me...

speaker: Graves
content: So... if I do something "naughty," no one would ever know, right?

Brushing the strands of hair away from her face, Graves closes her eyes and leans slowly toward those soft lips—approaching with the same devotion she had witnessed in countless kisses at the old castle.
The fleeting touch makes the person's eyelashes flutter, brushing against Graves. Her newly gathered courage bursts like a punctured balloon, instantly deflating.
Graves freezes in place, holding a push-up position for several seconds, terrified the person might open eyes and catch her in this compromising pose.
Fortunately, the person only furrows brow slightly before falling back into deep sleep.

speaker: Graves
content: Phew...
With the crisis now averted, Graves lets out a deep exhale. She meekly lies back down, wary of making any sudden movements.

speaker: Graves
content: Wh-what am I doing?! Ugh, so embarrassing...
It's well into the night, and the bed is comfortably warm. That tense little moment has even left Graves slightly sweaty.
Still, Graves nestles closer to the source of warmth, her shoulders touching the other person's as a gentle warmth passes between the two.

speaker: Graves
content: It's odd... Whenever I'm near you, I always seem to have so much to say.
Her pounding heart is yet to calm down, and she is not ready to drift off to sleep.

Graves softly turns her head to the side, eliciting a response from the person beside her. ${PlayerName} shifts to the side, settling into a more comfortable posture. The arm furthest from Graves emerges from beneath the blanket and rests on her.
The gesture seems both like soothing a restless child who won't settle down to sleep, and like a gentle embrace.

speaker: Graves
content: Huh?
The courage she had just let slip away slowly begins to return. Graves turns onto her side as well, curling her body so they're now facing each other.
She takes her hand out from beneath the blanket and grasps the hand that has so conveniently presented itself.

speaker: Graves
content: My dear, do you know? Since coming here, I think I've become greedy... wanting more than just a wedding...

speaker: Graves
content: Going on missions, helping with logistics, I'd do anything! We could cook a meal together, or plant a tree... Anything as long as I'm with you.
As Graves carefully lists all the things she wants to do together, she slowly slides her hand into the one larger than hers.
female_content: As Graves carefully lists all the things she wants to do together, she slowly slides her hand into the one slightly larger than hers.

content: She gently spreads those fingers one by one, then interlocks them with her own until their hands are tightly clasped together.

speaker: Graves
content: Yes... this is how it should be. This is... how close we belong.
With a look of contentment, Graves holds their interlaced fingers against her chest, like a maiden deep in prayer.

speaker: Graves
content: Let me think, what else could we do together... hmm... I can't think of any more!
The emptiness in Graves's heart is gradually being filled—not just with warmth and love from others, but also with her own newfound dreams of future happiness.

speaker: Graves
content: Thank you for teaching me all this. Thank you for saving my dreams.

speaker: Graves
content: As long as I stay by your side, these wishes will all come true, right...
As she continues speaking, her soliloquies about the future gradually melt into gentle whispers, scattering throughout the room.
Graves's eyelashes flutter gently as a sweet smile plays on her lips. This time, her dreams are bound to be beautiful ones.

In her dreams, gone are the impenetrable fog and haunting whispers. In their place is a lover who cherishes her with tenderness and friends who accept her for who she truly is. Together, they stand guard, allowing her to slumber peacefully in sweet dreams.
Night falls over the Bureau, its corridors silent and still. Suddenly, a soft blue light emerges from one of the walls.
Following the light, a young girl materializes, strolling through the corridor without making a sound. As she passes by one of the rooms, she sniffs the air before coming to a sudden stop.

speaker: Letta
content: Oh well... someone got a bit too excited for their midnight Bureau adventure. Even so, you should still remember to close the door, pretty lady.
She steps forward carefully and gives the door a gentle pull—the lock clicks into place with a crisp snap.

speaker: Letta
content: So many careless people these days. Good thing yours truly—the nighttime guardian of the Bureau—Letta is on duty! Heehee.
As another good deed is accomplished, the lantern in her hand seems to radiate a little brighter in response. Content with her actions, Letta moves forward, resuming her nighttime adventure.

July 18, N.F. 115
The Day After Returning to DisCity from the Black Tide at WhiteSands Border

speaker: Wynn
content: Chief, I thought you finished all the work that piled up while you were out! Why are you still getting this many messages? Did... something happen outside?

Wynn's gaze is fixed on your terminal, her worry etched in the furrow of her brow. The entire MBCC has been tiptoeing around you for days, speaking in hushed tones. That Wynn has broken that silent accord speaks volumes. You are a ghost of your former self—all sharp edges and shadowed eyes. With a heavy hand, you reach out and mute the terminal, finally silencing its relentless, pulsing stream of alerts.
These are external materials I requested. I asked the Intelligence Department to organize them before sending, but apparently, I underestimated how much there would be.

speaker: Wynn
content: It's all about that border outpost program, right? The... "Lighthouse keepers"? And there's the research on the Rancors. Some of these files are super old, and others have really high clearance. They've been working on this for ages! But with this much to read, are you sure you don't need a hand? I can help!

No, I need to review this myself... I have to prove that Rancors can be controlled, even without restrictions, and justify my collaboration with them. This power will be essential for the conflicts to come. My experience with the lighthouse keeper is the best evidence I have.

But no matter what proof I give them, the higher-ups refuse to approve my collaboration with the Rancor units... They just see this power as a bunch of rabid dogs. I need more documentation. More evidence... more...
A sudden, violent shudder from your terminal cuts your rambling short.
Wait... A highest-priority emergency dispatch?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, we've received an urgent distress call from the FAC border defense forces. They report an unidentified Sinner, disguised as a refugee, attempting to breach the city! A young girl is with them, displaying DisCity traits, suspected to be a hostage!

speaker: Nightingale
content: The target passed all initial screenings and registration. However, they failed the test from our newly implemented Rancor detection device. The FAC immediately raised the alert level and attempted an intercept, but the target erupted with Mania and forced their way into the city! This is a confirmed S-Class Sinner.
An S-Class Rancor? Are we in direct conflict already?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Affirmative. The special Rancor containment protocol was activated, but suppression failed. The target has already breached the West District. This is now a top-level emergency situation. The MBCC must respond immediately to apprehend the target and secure the city's defenses.

The emergency is a slap to your senses, shocking your weary mind back into sharp, painful clarity. Coat slung over an arm, you grab the terminal and stalk toward the elevator, your focus locked on Nightingale's report.
Understood. I'm heading to the on-site command post immediately.
In DisCity, "Rancor" is a word steeped in the briny stench of blood and metal. You force your exhausted body into combat readiness, hoping this attack won't disrupt the report you've been preparing.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Chief, over here! We've been laying down suppressive fire as per the new anti-Rancor tactical manual, but with limited effect. We've had to extend our defensive line to keep the target contained.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: The support teams have completed the evacuation, and the combat zone is clear. We are ready to hand over command of the operation to you!
According to the data and their behavior, the target's speed and strength are significantly enhanced, but there are still signs of rationality... Your tactical decisions were sound.

You burst onto the scene and, within moments, are directed into the heart of the operational grid. The heat hits you first, then the choking scent of scorched metal and ash. Your eyes slit against the haze, every nerve ending tightening with the old, cold familiarity of a live battlefield.

speaker: FAC Soldier
content: Release the hostage and surrender! I repeat, you cannot overcome DisCity's defenses! Let the hostage go and stand down immediately!

Your assessment concludes the FAC's response was tactically sound. While they failed to capture the target, they successfully evacuated all civilians and contained their movement. The situation is more stable than you anticipated. Now the problem is...
Where's the hostage? Is that the girl on the target's back?

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Yes. According to the follow-up briefing, the target initially attempted to enter posing as a refugee. She claimed to have found the hostage in WhiteSands, kidnapped from DisCity by another group, and said she was taking her home. However, this story has little credibility.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: We assess that the target took the hostage from the start, planning to use her as a means of infiltration. Even after her cover was blown, she has maintained tight control over the girl. We must consider the possibility that she will use the hostage as a shield or a weapon against our forces.

Your eyes track the distant Sinner, a lone figure holding her own against a storm of gunfire. Even from here, you can see the distinct bulge beneath her WhiteSands cloak. It's the hostage, shielded and secure.
You may not be a combat expert, but you recognize mastery when you see it.
She flows through the chaos with a decisive grace, rising, falling, and evading without a single misstep, all while maintaining perfect stability for the person in her grasp.
For confronting a Rancor, the suppressive fire is being held back... they're prioritizing the hostage's safety. A confirmed DisCity resident... so that's why she's acting so recklessly?
Her movements are calculated. She seems skilled at attrition and crowd control. Is this formal training, or just Rancor instinct? But holding a Rancor alone shouldn't...

Shouldn't make it feel so familiar. The style is agile, precise, and utterly fierce. A dance that never yields, evading every bullet while cutting through the suppressive fire. A ghost of a memory tugs at you; you've seen this style before. In the curtain of gunfire, she moves like a...
...Storm petrel.
You wrench your gaze away. This isn't the time for unexplained intuition. You need to end this, now, before the situation spirals beyond control.

The hostage seems safe, for the moment. But I can't rely on the suspect's conscience. I need to create an opening to bind her movements with my shackles... Maybe if I reveal my command position, I can draw her in...

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Chief! Watch out!!
Thud! Thud, thud!

The dull thud of bodies hitting the ground snaps you from your thoughts. Your head jerks up just in time to see the Rancor wielder shatter the defensive line, charging directly at you. She's spotted you, and she may know exactly what you're worth!

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Hold the line! Maintain formation! Rear ranks, advance and fill the gaps! Do not let up the suppressive fire!
Amidst the chaos, the Rancor wielder abandons all defense. With sudden, terrifying purpose, she charges, cutting a direct path toward you as if the intervening soldiers were mere ghosts.

The FAC troops react, surging forward to form a barricade of flesh and steel. It's futile. The S-Class Sinner doesn't break stride, effortlessly kicking them aside like scattered stones. In a heartbeat, the path between you is clear.

There is no time to think, only to act. You stand your ground, refusing to dodge, your gaze locked on the approaching figure. Every ounce of your will is focused on finding the perfect moment to unleash your shackles.
Clank!

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Chief!!!
Under your intense focus, the world distorts. Time stretches and sound warps; the clash of metal and the FAC captain's warning cry reach your ears a critical second too late.
A dagger—drawn from beneath the Sinner's cloak—scrapes against a soldier's armor. The shower of sparks still dances in your vision, yet you remain rooted, paralyzed by instinct or inevitability.
Ceto...?!

speaker: Ceto
content: It's you...?!

Then, a gust of wind. It tears back the assailant's hood and sweeps the dust from the air. The cheap fabric flies away, revealing the face hidden in shadow—and a pair of slightly widened, hauntingly familiar eyes.
The Rancor wielder who kidnapped a girl, forced her way through the city gates, infiltrated Syndicate, and violently resisted arrest... turns out to be Ceto.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: That's an opening! Now!

Your hand acts on instinct, your fragile shackles reaching Ceto a heartbeat before the FAC's strike. A dozen questions flash through your mind, but one truth eclipses them all: a confrontation between her and the FAC must be prevented at all costs. It could only end in ruin.
You have to move first to seize control, but there's no time to explain—

speaker: Ceto
content: You're... controlling me?

A crimson light bleeds through her sand-colored cloak as the mental channel between you slams open once again. Her emotions hit you not as a wave, but a raw, violent storm. This connection is agonizingly familiar, the very bond that once made you comrades in the churning tides.
I don't mean to harm you. I know you must have your reasons for all this...

speaker: Ceto
content: You're on their side? You think I'm here to threaten this place too?
Her gaze locks with yours, a maelstrom of incomprehension, anger, and a coldness that chills you to the bone. You try to form words, but help arrives with its predictably catastrophic timing.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: Chief, excellent work! Fall back, watch for a counterattack! Over here! Chief has contained the target with the shackles! Disarm her, now!

speaker: Ceto
content: So... you're here to capture me too.
No, that's not it—

The FAC soldiers, your dutiful protectors, shove you into their designated safety zone without a chance to object. Your shouts are swallowed by the chaos. Helpless, you watch as Ceto—her movements still hampered by your shackles—loses her balance and falls hard to the ground.

Soldiers swarm over her, pinning her limbs while shouting the mantra of the moment: "Dangerous Rancor!" Again and again, she struggles to lift her head, her eyes desperately searching the crowd for you. Each time she finds your gaze, a soldier forces her face back into the dirt.
Don't hurt her! I know her! Let her go. I'll take responsibility!
Let her go!
But the FAC is lost in the euphoria of subduing an S-Class threat. Only Ceto hears your voice. She manages to lift her head, sees your anxiety, and answers you with a cold, bitter snort.

speaker: Ceto
content: ...Stop making such a damn fuss. This isn't your problem, so back off... Just stay out of it!
She's deliberately cutting ties with you.
You're hiding something, aren't you? What are you really trying to do? If someone is threatening you, you could just tell me. I can help!

Ceto ignores you, then suddenly freezes, her struggles ceasing as she stares at something behind you. The tension drains from her body all at once. Defeated, she allows the soldiers to lead her away without another ounce of resistance.

You turn to follow her gaze. There, standing with a female sheriff, is the young hostage girl—rescued immediately after Ceto's arrest. Wrapped in a warm blanket and clutching a steaming drink, she is safe.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief! Reports confirm the Sinner has been detained. Are you alright? Are you injured?!

Your adjutant vaults from the transport and closes the distance between you in hurried strides, concern written on her face. You wrench your gaze from the little girl and meet her with a shake of your head.
I'm fine. I know that Rancor wielder, and I've used my shackles on her before. Thanks to that, we managed to keep the situation from spiraling completely out of control.

But the woman I know holds no ill will toward DisCity. She isn't the type to orchestrate a kidnapping or an attack for personal gain. There must be another reason... Now that the FAC has captured her, can we still get access to her for interrogation?

Your mind replays that final image of Jasmine, etched in memory. The uncertainty of how other departments will handle Ceto fades next to one clear truth: an interrogation is the greatest opportunity you will get—for the case, and for her.
Yet Nightingale hesitates, words caught in her throat, as she hands you the terminal.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I understand your concern, Chief. But before we proceed with the interrogation... you need to see this first.

The cold screen light stutters, then stabilizes as the connection seals. The face that appears is unfamiliar: an official whose smile is a perfunctory gesture, starkly at odds with the cold, assessing hardness in his eyes. His identity tag marks him as part of the newly formed City-State Security Bureau.

speaker: Official
content: Chief, impressive work containing the situation. Your reputation is well-earned. However... the reality of this incident may be more complex. This Rancor wielder has a suspicious background and exhibited dangerous behavior. We suspect an external actor is involved.

speaker: Official
content: An organization, most likely. As you know, the Rancors have a history of orchestrating conspiracies against DisCity. We need you to initiate special interrogation protocols immediately. Extract all viable intelligence.

options: It's too early to draw conclusions.

content: The details don't add up. She took a hostage, but her primary action was protecting that girl. She engaged only combatants and had no backup.
She also never once weaponized her Rancor against anyone. That's not the pattern of a calculated attack. I don't see the hand of an organization here. Not yet.
Despite his mild tone, the official's attitude is impervious to challenge, his every word meticulously engineered to serve his agenda.

speaker: Official
content: There it is. I've heard much about your... principled stance, Chief. But you must see that Rancors and DisCorps are, by their very nature, a threat to DisCity's stability.

speaker: Official
content: They are unstable, uncontrollable humanoid weapons. Paired with an exiled warlord who feeds on chaos... do you truly believe they have the city's best interests at heart? Some patriotic defense? Let's be realistic.

speaker: Official
content: Chief, Rancors operate outside the bounds of reason. We cannot afford to apply normal logic. We need to know who planted this bomb. This is for the safety of every citizen in DisCity.

My thoughts exactly. For the safety of the city, I will be conducting the interrogation and leading the investigation. I brought her in. If I hand her over prematurely and your people miss a crucial detail due to... procedural haste, that negligence would be on me.
You refuse to back down. The official, recognizing a futile debate, chooses to disengage—or perhaps he simply disdains to entertain what he sees as your sophistry.

speaker: Official
content: Very well. We can discuss the interrogation plan. You may conduct the first round, but please understand that, given the severity, we will dictate the procedure and provide the questions with full oversight. If any security risks emerge, we will assume control immediately.

speaker: Official
content: I trust in your professionalism. We share the same goal, after all: to neutralize all threats to our stability. All of them.
A perfunctory goodbye, and the line goes dead. You stand rigid, staring at the screen, watching the pulse of the indicator light slow... and then blink out completely.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, the preliminary interrogation protocol for Ceto has been filed. I've been notified that a specific list of questions will be sent to your terminal shortly. Regarding this matter... what do you plan to do?
...First, have Wynn pull all external files on the border outposts from my terminal.
As long as the interrogation happens at MBCC, in our facility, we still control the room.
I know that Rancor wielder, the lighthouse keeper <color=#fb9259>Ceto</color>... I trust my judgment of her.

speaker: Ceto
content: We meet again so soon, DisCity native. Right... everyone here is.

speaker: Ceto
content: What do they call you? Chief? Is that a high rank?
You don't need to be so defensive. I do trust you.

speaker: Ceto
content: Hah. So this is your "trust"?

The simple addition of a remote observer watching through cameras transforms the familiar interrogation room into something alien. A blast of cold air sweeps through as Ceto sits with a defiant posture, her arms bound by metal restraints threaded through leather.

These extreme security measures are a perfect embodiment of the fear and wariness DisCity's leadership holds for "Rancors"—an attitude Ceto has clearly internalized. It is no wonder, then, that her every word drips with sarcasm.
These are... precautions. Sinner interrogations are normally handled by the MBCC alone, but this case is an exception. I'll be honest with you; our conversation is being monitored by several guests.

speaker: Official
content: A moment, Chief. Revealing such operational details to the suspect... is that your considered judgment? I fail to see the benefit.

speaker: Ceto
content: So your "guests" have a voice, too. And here I was, almost believing you. Turns out your word doesn't mean much.

Ceto's enhanced hearing, a common trait among Sinners, leaves no syllable of your internal dispute a secret. The derisive snort she lets out is a clear and mocking judgment on the ridiculousness of your team's discord.
It is my decision. I am directly responsible for this interrogation, and my experience supports my judgment. Honesty facilitates communication.
A firm, deliberate push is your only answer to the warning. Then, you lift your head, your eyes meeting Ceto's in a stare as steady as stone.
And that's what I want you to know, Ceto. I'm here to find the truth, to resolve this peacefully. We don't have to be adversaries.

speaker: Ceto
content: I'm a Rancor who forced my way through DisCity's checkpoints. And you think we're on the same side? Would the puppet masters in your ear agree?
If we're talking about sides, my position is neutral. I'm not here to pass judgment. As I said, I believe you have your reasons, and I will ensure you have the chance to state them.
Ceto's gaze cuts with razor-sharp intensity, her presence as imposing as that of the DisCity officials.

Your self-claimed neutrality is also a line for the puppet masters in your ear. In truth, you are maneuvering to secure the most advantageous position for her, ensuring her arguments are properly seen. You will seize every opportunity to make it so.
Let's start with the little girl. You protected her carefully during the fighting. That suggests you meant her no harm. How did you come to be with her?

speaker: Ceto
content: Hardly know her. Found her on the road.
On the road? Records show you have no entry or exit documentation, and your attempt to enter was blocked. Are you saying you found her outside DisCity?

speaker: Ceto
content: Yes. She was taken out. Your precious city leaks; the wrong people get in, the vulnerable get tossed out. If I hadn't grabbed her, she'd be sold off to some godforsaken corner of WhiteSands by now.
Are you saying... the reason you gave at the border was actually true? You weren't lying, or taking a hostage; you were just trying to take her home?

speaker: Ceto
content: Why lie? If I wasn't dragging that deadweight, your soldiers never would've caught me. If I wanted to sneak in alone, I wouldn't waste time on theatrics.
Ceto's attitude is far from earnest, but her explanation holds a grim logic. Your experience, however, flags lingering discrepancies that keep you from fully accepting her story.
But if that's true, you weren't trying to illegally enter. There was no need to force the checkpoint and cause that chaos. Why not just tell the customs officer what you're telling me now?

speaker: Ceto
content: Go ask your trigger-happy guards who point guns first. Maybe you'd sit down for a chat with them. I'm a Rancor wielder, a "combat lunatic" who only knows to swing a blade. I don't have the patience to roll over and take it.

speaker: Ceto
content: You know what kind of hell I survived. I'll just kill whoever threatens me!

options: Now isn't the time for stubborn pride.
It's because I've spent time with you that I know...

content: I know you're a soldier, a lighthouse keeper. Your enemies are hundreds of times more vicious than any border guard. Your blade was wielded to tear monsters apart.

Whether you admit it or not, you've stood for DisCity before. With or without the Rancor, you don't start fights without reason; you'd consider it beneath you! ...You're still hiding something from me. I know it.

Her silence is not a surrender, but a fortress. Though her glare sharpens, the flinch in her eyes confirms it—you've found a crack in Ceto's armor. Seizing the opening, you draw out that half-finished report.

I haven't mentioned this yet. Upon returning to DisCity, I filed a report on the lighthouse keepers' achievements. But many still refuse to believe anyone can resist the Rancors' influence... So I've been gathering evidence.

I want to prove that even under severe mental erosion, the lighthouse keepers never lost their humanity. Ceto, you are the last soldier of Lighthouse Seven. Your actions are the most compelling evidence. If you don't want your name to be synonymous with madness, tell me your reasons.

speaker: Ceto
content: ...Are you using the lighthouse keepers' name to threaten me?
I'm doing this because I understand you. I trust you. <color=#fb9259>I want to help</color>.

A chorus of sharp, staticky protests erupts in your earpiece, but you drown them out, your gaze locked with Ceto's. You search her eyes desperately for a glimmer of the bond once forged in the crucible of death.
For a long moment, your words hang in the air, and Ceto's gaze falls. When she finally looks up, her lips twist into something sharp and ambiguous, not a smile, but a blade thinly disguised as one.

speaker: Ceto
content: Still so stubborn, I see... You really want to know that badly?

speaker: Ceto
content: Then see for yourself.

Just as you suspected, the restraints could never hold her! In a single, fluid motion, she closes the distance. Her bound hands snap up, her fingers locking around your wrist like a vice. A searing light erupts from the shackles, piercing the space between you—

speaker: Customs Officer A
content: You crossed WhiteSands and made it back with the kid? Damn, she hit the jackpot! If she hadn't run into someone with your skills, she'd never have made it back alive.

speaker: Customs Officer B
content: Yeah, it's really remarkable! Worthy of the Sinner title! Here's your form; registration is complete. Please proceed through the security screening over there, then hand this to the staff at the end.

speaker: Ceto
content: Security screening? I already passed one at the entrance.

speaker: Customs Officer A
content: That one detects Mania, for Sinner registration. This new one inside is for... oh, Rancors! The higher-ups are cracking down. They say if one Rancor slips through, our heads are on the block!

Ceto faltered momentarily at the words. Fortunately, her hood was pulled low, and her shock passed in a heartbeat. By the time the others glanced her way, she had mastered her expression. She gave the girl's hand a gentle squeeze, making a silent promise that she would handle this.

Their "heroic crossing" immediately drew the officers' attention, their gazes sharp with confusion and impatience. In one fluid motion, Ceto swept the girl into her arms, holding her close, and with feigned nonchalance, strode briskly through the newly set "door."

Instantly, crimson lights strobed, and a piercing alarm shattered the air. The synchronized clack-clack of weapons being loaded echoed sharply through the space. Ceto's eyes swept her surroundings: the dark barrels of every stationed guard were now leveled directly at her and the child in her arms.

speaker: Customs Officer A
content: You... you're a Rancor!

speaker: Ceto
content: So what if I am. I never tried to hide it. I never lied. Everything I told you was true. I'm only here to take this kid home.

speaker: Ceto
content: If DisCity doesn't welcome my kind, I won't enter. I'll leave immediately; just take the girl and get her home. You've verified it, right? She's one of yours.

Ceto remained still, her gaze steady as one of the customs officers frantically scrambled behind the protective circle. In a deliberate act of peace, she kept her hands in clear view, the girl held gently in her arms as proof of her benign intent. Her calm was met not with understanding, but with his frantic, hysterical shouting.

speaker: Customs Officer A
content: You think I believe that? You people are maniacs who love to slash and kill! Why would someone like you ever help a little girl?!

speaker: Customs Officer B
content: Well, we shouldn't paint them all with the same brush... I've heard some of those Nirvana Port veterans can be useful in a pinch...

speaker: Customs Officer A
content: You think Corruptors recognize family and loyalty? That's bullshit! They're murderous psychos! When they snap, they don't care who you are; they just slash!

speaker: Customs Officer A
content: Stop standing there like an idiot! Get over here! Are you hoping she'll kill you up close?! For all we know, that kid could be a damned Rancor, too!

Ceto's increasingly threatening gaze failed to resolve the situation, instead provoking the customs officer into more extreme reactions. Forcing herself to suppress her emotions, she turned toward a soldier who was steadily aiming his weapon. Their eyes met, making a silent exchange between two warriors that spoke volumes.

speaker: FAC Captain
content: We cannot allow the child entry. Our orders are clear: anyone or anything that has contacted Rancors is a major security threat. No one enters without thorough screening. And the screening methods... aren't something a child could take.

speaker: Ceto
content: I've done nothing wrong, yet because of a weapon, you label people monsters, lunatics, murderers... Fine. Have it your way.

The standoff had drained all the oxygen from the air. Ceto broke the silence with a cold laugh. Deftly, she swung the girl onto her back and unleashed her Mania. The stalemate shattered, and the defensive perimeter dissolved as the S-Class Sinner burst through their blockade, as effortlessly as a storm petrel cutting through a curtain of rain.

speaker: Ceto
content: Since that's what you think of me, wouldn't I be letting you down if I didn't solve this the "Rancor way"?! You hypocrites!
[Blade Flashes]

speaker: FAC Captain
content: She's broken through! I'll lead the pursuit! The rest of you, contact MBCC for backup! Highest priority alert!
[Exit Flashback]
Your earpiece buzzes with static and urgent voices, a reality you deliberately push away. Nothing is more important than bearing witness to this memory.

You see the exact moment the insults about the lighthouse keepers hit Ceto. A tremor runs through her, her voice sinking into a guttural range as every muscle in her frame locks solid. A sharp creak from the interrogation chair underscores the immense pressure building within her, a stark contrast to the deceptively calm expression she maintains.

speaker: Ceto
content: It's just that simple. I understand your point. But I've seen their true faces, and I've made my choice. Those armored, bulky guys... I didn't know who they were. Their recited laws meant nothing to me. I felt no guilt using force.
I'm sorry about the prejudice you've faced. You have every right to be angry. But by lashing out, by fulfilling their worst expectations, is that the truth you choose for yourself?

speaker: Ceto
content: ...Destruction. Killing. That was my survival. It's what I knew. They weren't wrong about me.
Who decided that's all you are? Isn't protection your true skill? Defending your lighthouse, protecting that little girl—

speaker: Official
content: Chief, I must insist you stop leading the subject!
The voice in your earpiece turns sharp, the official's patience snapping. The veneer of politeness vanishes, replaced by naked anger as he abandons all pretense.

speaker: Official
content: No amount of rhetoric can redefine this as some "well-intentioned act of necessity." You cannot change the fact of her tyrannical, uncontrolled disregard for the law! I believe our prepared list of questions will better serve DisCity's security interests.

speaker: Official
content: We need intelligence on her backers. The more she talks, the better. And we are counting on your shackles' perceptive abilities to uncover... deeper truths. Such as who is truly pulling her strings.

The final seconds of your hard-won leeway drain away. You meet Ceto's gaze, searching for a reprieve, but find only an impassive mask; she has heard the official's demand and offers no objection. Trapped between two immovable forces, you have no choice. With a stiff, reluctant motion, you open the document and begin to read, your voice tight.
...Question: Where did you obtain your Rancor?

speaker: Ceto
content: From the lighthouse keepers.
Next question: Were the lighthouse keepers affiliated with DisCorps?

speaker: Ceto
content: **** no. The lighthouses had no contact with the outside world until the day the last one went dark.

speaker: Official
content: In terms of organizational structure, were the lighthouse keepers subordinate to DisCorps?

speaker: Ceto
content: Tsk... Yes.

speaker: Official
content: Third question—
...Did DisCorps provide you with financial support? No, I object. Isn't this question deliberately leading?

speaker: Official
content: Isn't the weapon in her hand evidence enough of their support?
You...!

speaker: Official
content: Continue!

The pointless interrogation drags on, draining the room of all energy. Ceto's patience has frayed to a breaking point, and your voice is now a dull monotone. Finally, you reach the last few questions on the list—
Tests show a fragment from another Rancor is attached to yours. Is this fragment connected to your attack...?!

Your voice dies in your throat as revelation hits. You see the same stunned realization dawn on Ceto, a shared shock that clearly pleases the official. His next question comes softly, but it's preceded by a wave of static that crackles like a serpent's warning, the sound feeling unnervingly slick and moist against your ear.

speaker: Official
content: Why did you stop, Chief? Remember, you are being monitored throughout this process. I advise you not to skip or modify questions based on personal sentiments and judgments.
Did you plan to kidnap the hostage, bring her into DisCity, and use that fragment to corrupt her for an attack? Were these actions ordered by the lighthouse keepers or DisCorps...?!

You hold the fraying threads of your control until the question hangs, complete, in the air. The silence that follows is the sound of your composure breaking. Deliberately, you turn a searing gaze upon the camera, realizing it was a calculated act to keep you in the dark.
What Rancor fragment? I was never informed about this!

speaker: Official
content: Please remain calm. We only discovered it at the last moment—it was cleverly hidden. Perhaps in this plot to destabilize DisCity using a Rancor, the hostage and the fragment were the actual weapons?

But I filed a complete report on Ceto's identity! Her Rancor's origin is properly documented, along with its limited purpose! This sounds like a predetermined theory. Are you going to condemn a soldier who dedicated her life to DisCity over a single Rancor fragment—

speaker: Official
content: This is merely a theory, Chief. But do you have a better explanation for why she hid it? No offense, but our job is to investigate all risks, even those you find absurd.

speaker: Official
content: I'm sure you recall how she deliberately held the hostage in her arms during the detection scan. Maybe it was to use her own Rancor signature as cover, making us detect only one Rancor, all to blindside us when we least expected it.

The official twists every fact into something sinister, reducing the girl to a mere bomb component. Your shackles tremble with the raw, churning heat of Ceto's emotions, and you fear she is on the verge of splintering. Then you look up. Her expression is a lake of perfect calm, its serene surface giving no hint of the depths below.

speaker: Ceto
content: Is this the best story you could cook up? Quite the imagination. But like I said, why would I bother with something so complicated while dragging along dead weight? If I wanted to kill my way in, could any of you actually stop me?

speaker: Ceto
content: Since you've figured me out, I'll drop the act. Yes, the brat was a decoy. I bought her to lower your guard. If I'd known I'd have to force my way through anyway, I could have saved myself the—

To the watching officials, Ceto's demeanor is unwavering. But through the shackles, you feel what churns beneath her cold exterior: a storm of anger, calculation, and anxiety. She's performing. But why?
You rip the earpiece out, throw it to the floor, and turn off the camera, severing the connection.

speaker: Ceto
content: Hey! What are you doing?!

Relax. I'm not the one in the crosshairs here. You are. What are you hiding? I can't protect you if I don't know what we're dealing with. What's so important you'd rather take the fall than talk? He can't hear us. So tell me the truth now.

speaker: Ceto
content: Tell the truth? To you? Or to the DisCity people with all their "opinions"?
They could resort to more extreme measures against you at any moment. When that happens, you won't even get a chance to explain yourself, and that kid won't be any safer for it.

speaker: Ceto
content: But even if a Rancor tells you the truth, would anyone actually believe it?
I will believe you. And I will make everyone else believe, too. I'll make them "see."

speaker: Ceto
content: ...See?

Yes. Exactly what you're thinking. You won't have to say a word. You won't have to prove a thing. Just give me your trust and let me touch your past. Let me shoulder this for you. I promise I won't betray that trust.
