content: But I need some time...
You look at Oak Casket, whose eyes have regained their usual tranquility.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Go back to the Bureau first. There are things I must tend to here. Please rest assured. I won't go anywhere before I've fulfilled our agreement.
Three days later, you receive an invitation in black.

Dear friend, you are cordially invited to preside over the funeral of a nameless one. May her tears stop now and her suffering end here. The funeral will be held at the Romanesque stele garden at the following time and date.
The invitation is plainly decorated and bears no signature. Nevertheless, you decide to attend the ceremony.

You arrive at the stele garden. As expected, there are no other participants. You walk up to the small podium, read the opening lines at the time stipulated on the invitation, and then make the speeches according to the agenda.
The atmosphere is somewhat bizarre, as the only audience are those stelae of different sizes.

Greetings, dear friends. I know it's strange to say this because you can't even respond to me. Or perhaps you hear my words, but I can't understand your secret language. But I know there is someone here who can understand you.

The world is populated with living beings. This hasn't changed even after Nightfall. One day, I came to the sudden realization that even though the dead outnumber the living, we have never paid attention to the voices of the dead.
I want to thank a friend who made me realize this.
The wind stirs the forest, sounding like the revenants' whispers. You think you hear Oak Casket's chuckle.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: The living believe their prayers can cleanse the souls of the dead, helping them find relief. They cover up their sins with such grandiose rhetoric, as if they can earn forgiveness from the dead just like that.
The dead need not answer the living's confessions, for the path and the past both belong to the dead themselves.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: What's the point? He threw me into the darkness, but told me to find the light.
The dead need not bear the blessings of the living, for the dead can reach the gate of life with their own strength.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Does the pocket of hope exist in this world?
A world without hope is the collective sin of the living. I will cover her eyes until a new world replaces the old one.
Your gaze sweeps across the undulating stelae, finally landing on one that's already been repaired.
This is your answer to all of Oak Casket's questions. You believe she's hearing it.
Last but not least, I would like to recite a poem, one she knows by heart.

The wanderer in the wilderness no longer carried the burden of the past. The golden falcon asked her: Where came you? She said: I do not recall the way I came. Dawn is near, as is the end of everything.
You shall endure hardships and surpass all stelae in this world. You shall meet the golden falcon, and the winged traveler will guide you to the light. Where there is light, there you shall be.
You understand Oak Casket's intention. She held a funeral for her younger self to bid her bitter past farewell.
After the funeral is done, you walk to the repaired stele. An open casket made of oak lies there.
Now that the little girl named Nona has been laid to rest, I have a question for the messenger of the dead. Sinner Oak Casket, why do you continue to linger in this mortal world?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: The day I was saved by the dead, I gained my power, so I chose to become a messenger for them, serving those lingering between life and death. Yet there was one thing I never understood: What kept them lingering in this world?
And has she figured it out now?

The cover of the casket is left open. You suddenly realize the casket is made of fresh oak wood. Oak Casket must have collected the trunk of that blasted oak tree, as there are burn marks on the wood.
This is a real Oak Casket.
Oak Casket's voice comes from the shadow inside the casket.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: No. But maybe you can help her figure it out.
You reach out to Oak Casket. Gently, she takes your hand and stands up from her casket.
The oak tree was felled by the explosion and will never sprout again. But the seeds of hope will.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: Thank you for seeing Nona off.
If you really mean it, maybe stop chasing after me with the coffin you've made for me?

speaker: Oak Casket
content: I won't urge you to come back to my side so soon before we see a new world.

speaker: Oak Casket
content: I've always wondered why I stay in the world of the living...

speaker: Oak Casket
content: But your existence may help me find the meaning.

1:21 p.m., October 13, N.F. 112
MBCC Bureau Chief's Office
The turmoil stirred by the Bottle of Dreams is finally calming down, and you're nearly done with your tasks for the MBCC as well.

speaker: Wynn
content: Here are all the action reports, Chief. Once you sign them, they'll be ready for archive.

options: Swing by Nightingale later to pick them up.

speaker: Wynn
content: Adjutant Nightingale is out on duty today. Before she left, she specifically instructed me to keep an eye on you and ensure you're not shirking your duties or wandering off.

speaker: Wynn
content: ...Ah, avoiding eye contact, are we? Feeling a bit guilty, Chief?

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: Chief, an unknown Sinner has arrived at the MBCC.

options: You need shackles, right? I'm on it—

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: Uh... Not quite like that... this person isn't for capture. She's been personally escorted by the higher-ups—a VIP, actually.

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: Per the notice, <color=#fb9259>no shackles are needed</color> for her.
As you say this, a brief message pops up on your communicator—just a few simple lines.

Observer, Shalom—Sinner inspection report M-value 463, mentally stable, no evidence of Mania capabilities, non-aggressive.
The subject has served in the public sector for 8 years and is highly trusted. She'll be aiding MBCC's day-to-day and combat operations going forward.

Confirmed by the FAC, the 9th Agency, and Paradeisos, <color=#fb9259>there's no need to shackle the individual</color>.
She is your partner.

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: The subject has been escorted to the interrogation room, Chief. She's expressed a desire to speak with you.
You walk briskly into the interrogation chamber and lock eyes with the woman across the room.
A coat, gloves, a long skirt—she's almost fully covered, leaving you unsure of how to approach her. Additionally, a mysterious piece of black quartz hovers beside her.

speaker: Shalom
content: We should have met sooner. I went to the party at the Midsummer Night's Club as well, but unfortunately, I didn't get a chance to speak with you. You looked dazzling that night.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's been a long time, dear Chief.
The woman named Shalom sits in front of you, gazing at you calmly and softly with a smile on her face.
Most Sinners are tinged with an uncontrollable restlessness, a madness they can't contain, induced by the Mania. Yet, she seems different.
...Even so, there's something oddly familiar about her. Does she know you?

speaker: Shalom
content: I've heard. After the riot, you lost much of your memory—you probably don't remember me anymore.

speaker: Shalom
content: Given that, allow me to reintroduce myself.

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't be nervous, I know that the riot at the Bureau disrupted your recovery and your memory may still be a bit jumbled.

speaker: Shalom
content: You probably don't remember me anymore, do you?

speaker: Shalom
content: I'm Shalom. I've been entrusted to assess the situation with the MBCC and the Chief. There might be something I can assist with.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'll likely be bothering you guys for a while, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes, we crossed paths at MBCC and engaged meaningfully. You made a lasting impression on me, so perhaps we could be considered more than mere acquaintances—<color=#fb9259>friends</color>, I'd like to think.
Were you, before losing your memory, "friends" with a high-ranking, unshackled Sinner?

speaker: Shalom
content: You look a bit surprised.

options: It's rare to see a Sinner in such a high position
You're quite an unexpected "friend," wouldn't you say?

speaker: Shalom
content: Is that so? Madam Langley of the 9th Agency is a very powerful Sinner, and given her disposition, she's never one to downplay it.

speaker: Shalom
content: Did you, by any chance, forget about your direct superior? Be careful, she might come knocking on your door.

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes. You're free to regard this as my own unilateral sentiment; don't sweat it. Friendships rely on shared memories and emotional bonds, so for the time being, allow me to be the keeper of our cherished recollections.

speaker: Shalom
content: If you choose to see me as a new colleague, that's fine too. I'm glad to make a fresh start with you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Feel free to ask any questions, that's why I requested this "additional Interrogation."

speaker: Shalom
content: It was tough to arrange this meeting, and I'd hate to see you looking so anxious.
Her lax smile seems to let through a hint of almost imperceptible resignation.
After thinking for a moment, you decide to start with something simple and point to the odd floating object next to her.

speaker: Shalom
content: Call it Schorl; it's the latest innovation from the Black Ring Research Institute. Since I lack the ability to defend myself independently, it's been assigned to assist with protection, communication, information gathering, and analysis among other tasks.

speaker: Shalom
content: The enhancement materials from MBCC designed for Sinners don't really work on me. However, if I share them with Schorl, it can optimize its combat efficiency through analysis, thereby better safeguarding everyone.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's a reliable companion.
After being praised, the black, stone-like triangle beeps, as if eager to prove its "competence." It then morphs, projecting a formal official document into the space.
Above, you see the logos of MBCC, FAC, and the 9th Agency, along with a seal you've seen on numerous significant documents.
Not long after the conclusion of BR-001, this same seal was also present on the individual who interrogated you. You have a vague idea of its origin.
<color=#fb9259>Paradeisos</color>, a hidden sanctuary whispered about among the people of Dis, appears intimately connected to Dr. Keylan's legacy.

The official description of it remains vague, saying it is "focused on exploration and development to continue human civilization." While it generally avoids engagement with city-state life and seldom exercises clear authority, it holds substantial sway over key organizations, including the FAC and the city council.
You've had the opportunity to encounter them, but given that you weren't treated well, it's understandable that you harbor ill feelings toward these mysterious elites.

options: I'm surprised Paradeisos is even paying attention to me.
I didn't expect Paradeisos to be so invested in MBCC.

speaker: Shalom
content: I get it—you've always had a tense relationship with Paradeisos.

speaker: Shalom
content: I don't want to hide anything from you. Yes, Paradeisos has been watching you, particularly your involvement in the two Black Ring incidents.
Monitoring? Or is it caution? Before all this, my only interaction with you was a two-week detention and interrogation.

speaker: Shalom
content: Just admit you despise it. You're a candid person; there's no need for pretenses with me.

speaker: Shalom
content: Aside from public misconceptions, Paradeisos isn't exactly winning any popularity contests, but they're acutely self-aware. I picked up a saying from your overworked colleagues that hits the nail on the head when it comes to describing Paradeisos's attitude:

speaker: Shalom
content: "Ugh whatever, just roll with it."
As the Chief, you nearly choke. Shalom watches your reaction, a playful look in her eyes, as though she's relishing the moment, yet also genuinely pleased.
That smile vanishes in an instant.

speaker: Shalom
content: With your current level of clearance, I can't disclose much about the true nature of the situation. However, the stance of Paradeisos is no secret.

speaker: Shalom
content: From the moment of its founding, Paradeisos has been driven by a singular goal—to seek out the nearly impossible solution for preserving human civilization in the face of apocalypse. This is their unwavering commitment, and they are willing to sacrifice everything to achieve it.

speaker: Shalom
content: All worldly temptations hold no allure for them. In turn, they must fervently detach from worldly attachments to navigate the complexities of reality. Consequently, their actions may often appear cold and unyielding.

options: You're saying they're like the FAC?

content: Shalom shrugs.

speaker: Shalom
content: The FAC is much more popular than them.

options: What about you? The observer from Paradeisos.

content: My "unfamiliar friend from the Paradeisos," and this so-called "friendly visit"... How am I to make sense of your arrival?

speaker: Shalom
content: This comes from their genuine regard for you, coupled with my own subtle yearning to see you again.

speaker: Shalom
content: Paradeisos has acknowledged all your efforts to date; they need you and wish to convey this. Of course, they're aware they lack the emotional connection needed to regain your trust. That's why they've specifically sanctioned my visit.

speaker: Shalom
content: Given our past interactions, they seem to think that a greeting from me would yield a more favorable response.
...Is this their leniency or some form of subterfuge?
As a representative of Paradeisos, what are your directives for me?

speaker: Shalom
content: Setting aside my personal feelings and speaking from an official and rational standpoint, I want you to know this:

speaker: Shalom
content: Every faction has its own viewpoint, but being made up of individuals, differing perspectives and interpretations are inevitable.

speaker: Shalom
content: You possess a force that is both potent and enigmatic, eliciting fear, hatred, or envy from people across all organizations. How you are perceived can shift at any given moment.

speaker: Shalom
content: So, firm up your own convictions, keep your eyes peeled, and gather all the intel you can. Seek out the force that you can wield and believe in; that's what you should be focusing on.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're not fundamentally at odds with them. You're not the kind to incite Mania for personal gain, so you're not inherently opposed to Paradeisos. That means there's a pathway to mutual progress.

speaker: Shalom
content: At least, I'd hope so.
She gazes at you with unabashed openness, her words brimming with candor, leaving you somewhat at a loss for words.

speaker: Shalom
content: Of course, I wanted to see you.
The smile blooms on her face again.

As if she had just wrapped up a monotonous job and was finally off for the weekend, Shalom leans back in her interrogation chair. It's as if she's leaning on a late-night bar counter, blissfully enjoying your long-missed companionship.

speaker: Shalom
content: Tell me about your journeys. You've been awake for over two months now, and I've heard you've traveled far and wide, meeting all sorts of people.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're looking healthier, more vibrant even. Word around here is you're well-liked. You've made quite a few friends, haven't you? Share with me the highs and lows, what you've gained and what concerns you.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's been a while. I've been wondering how you're holding up.
The ambiance in the Interrogation Room shifts, almost as if yanking you into a forgotten past that feels strangely intimate, leaving you momentarily disoriented.

speaker: Shalom
content: Playing the humble card, are we? According to the reports, your accomplishments are far beyond just "okay."

speaker: Shalom
content: Alright, enough with the suspense—I've been eagerly awaiting this. Let's hear it.

speaker: Shalom
content: Even with such a competent adjutant by your side? Heh, word has it that you're a real risk-taker, involved in some jaw-dropping exploits.

speaker: Shalom
content: Come on, tell me—I promise, your secret's safe with me.
She couldn't help but laugh.

speaker: Shalom
content: Wow, you're really living on the edge, aren't you? You're key to our operations; we can't afford to have you abducted.

speaker: Shalom
content: So, who's been audacious enough to come at you, and how did our Minos Chief pull off a clever victory?
She gently prods you on, but her eyes merely lock onto yours, filled with a tender, expectant gaze. It's as if just teasing you brings her immense joy, as if these moments are worth savoring.
...Given she'll definitely read the report later, best to keep the conversation to trivialities.
You ponder briefly, then finally break the silence.
...Upon waking, I found myself in the midst of a riot. A mysterious woman interfered with my memory Repair Program and shattered my memories. Most of the Sinners managed to escape.
We then gathered intelligence indicating she's made her way to the Syndicate...

You speak cautiously, carefully choosing your words at first. Yet, as you peel back the layers of your past, reflecting on the road you've traveled, deeper and more intricate emotions come surging forth.

I've been to many places—Syndicate, the Rust, WhiteSands, Eastside... and even the Black Rings. Life's been a relentless series of events, to be honest. I've been overwhelmed and have certainly faced my share of adversity.

speaker: Shalom
content: Indeed... reports can make it seem straightforward, but living it is another story altogether.

speaker: Shalom
content: What about now, has waking up to this world dimmed its horrors for you?
...I don't know. This world remains opaque to me.
For a long while, I've been grappling with what I can do and what I should do—just staying afloat has been a monumental task.

speaker: Shalom
content: But you've come so far, gained a solid footing—this Bureau is your fortress now.

speaker: Shalom
content: Not only are you secure, but you also offer sanctuary to countless others. Each Sinner draws strength from you, and along the way, many have found their salvation through your influence.

speaker: Shalom
content: Everyone seems to put their faith in you. That's quite the achievement, wouldn't you agree?
…I'm not as impressive as you make it sound.
There are things beyond my comprehension, and things I grasp but can do nothing about.
Exposed and vulnerable, you feel a knot tighten in your chest. Fighting to maintain composure, you bow your head and shield your eyes.
I've been aided more times than I can count, some debts I'll never be able to settle. I want to give back to this city, but I don't know how.
...No one told me what to do.
You lift your gaze to meet Shalom's.

options: You said you were a friend of who I used to be.

content: What kind of person was I back then? How would he have dealt with a situation like this?
female_content: What kind of person was I back then? How would she have dealt with a situation like this?

content: Would the outcomes be handled better?

speaker: Shalom
content: Sigh.

speaker: Shalom
content: I don't get many chances to see you, so it's hard to anticipate your every move. Instead, you always seem to surprise me when we meet.
As if your words have stirred a cascade of memories, she lowers her gaze and speaks softly.

speaker: Shalom
content: <color=#fb9259>The first time</color> we crossed paths was here, earlier this year, before you lost your memory. Back then, you were a storm of raw emotions, a spectacle of pure, unfiltered feeling. Unyielding, you charged forward without a second thought.

speaker: Shalom
content: I wasn’t around for long, but long enough to see the chaos you left in your wake—a constant thorn for the Bureau.

speaker: Shalom
content: <color=#fb9259>The second encounter</color> was just last month, at the Midsummer Night's Club. Quite the unexpected setting—you were all dressed-up. A single glance told me it was your covert assignment garb, so I held back, not wishing to interfere. Yet, there you were, being approached by someone entirely unexpected.

speaker: Shalom
content: That Sinner provoked you, throwing your plans into disarray. In the past, you would've erupted in rage. Yet, in that moment, you responded with calculated grace, maintaining just a sliver of your old temper, allowing no room for them to save face.

speaker: Shalom
content: And <color=#fb9259>the third time</color>? That's happening right now.
Shalom looks at you with a smile.

speaker: Shalom
content: You've become adept at playing along with my words, revealing just enough genuine emotion to gain my trust and soften my resolve. Simultaneously, you subtly fish for information, attempting to unlock aspects of your <color=#fb9259>past</color> that remain sealed off to you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't get me wrong; I'm not holding it against you. In fact, I find it comforting.

speaker: Shalom
content: The sober world can be overwhelmingly intricate. Watching your every move through the cold detachment of those reports is nerve-wracking. Unable to be with you, all I can do is worry.

speaker: Shalom
content: Now that we've finally met face to face, I'm at ease. You've been evolving—maturing, steadying, and deepening your thoughts. At the very least, you've become resilient enough that no one can easily break you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Most importantly, even with all these transformations, some core aspects of you remain the same.

She rises and approaches you. Tenderly extending her fingers, she grazes the tips of yours. A moment of hesitation passes before her fingers make their way to your palm. Finally, she takes your hand, gripping it softly but assuredly.

speaker: Shalom
content: We've held hands like this before. I still remember the touch, just as I remember who you were back then.

speaker: Shalom
content: You remain as unyielding as ever, going to great lengths to preserve your true self. You don't back down easily. I admire that kind of defiance.
...Is that so?

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes.

speaker: Shalom
content: Back to your question. You asked me if a past version of yourself would have performed better. My answer is, no.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're always moving forward. Even the loss of memory hasn't hindered your progress; you continue your relentless journey forward. Each step you take represents the best you are capable of, right here and now.

speaker: Shalom
content: But I can't just trivialize your experience with applause, because the pain and loss you've endured cut deep, they are palpable, and I feel it as if it were my own.
The gloves soak in your shared warmth, as if dissolving, leaving no barriers between.

speaker: Shalom
content: Today, I am no longer permitted to remove these gloves and feel your touch. We each have boundaries that must not be crossed, but you should sense the sentiments I hold.

speaker: Shalom
content: We are fated to experience loss, but as long as you continue to move forward, the ones you hold dear will inevitably reunite with you at the journey's end, amidst a celestial ocean of azure blossoms.

speaker: Shalom
content: And for those memories you've lost, forever beyond reach and unable to be mourned...
The grip on your hand subtly intensifies.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Don't worry, even if it's a mere fragment, I'll hold it in memory for you.
You find yourself at a loss for words, as if language pales in comparison to the raw sincerity of physical expression. Strategies and schemes seem hollow next to such genuineness.

Stance, identity, intelligence, caution, even the interrogation room you find yourself in, all blur into insignificance. The enduring fatigue and loneliness that have awoken within you, the sense of drift and aimlessness when facing a bleak past, now coalesce into uncontrollable instincts.

As you lock eyes with her, your hand tightens around hers in response. Through the softness of her palm, you feel a restrained yet deep affection that leaves you yearning, desperate for her to reveal more.

options: I need to know... Please tell me...

content: Chief!
The door to the interrogation room bursts open, and you see Nightingale dash in.
An anxious expression becomes etched onto her face, gradually morphing into a form of panic you've never seen on her before and can't comprehend.
Her gaze ultimately lands on the Paradeisos "guest."

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I didn't expect you to show up in person, ma'am. There's an urgent document requiring Chief's authorization; could you spare a few minutes?
A palpable, unsettling mood fills the air, instantly shaking off the prior sense of unreality.
Shalom glances at her, shifts her gaze to you, offers a faint smile, and releases your hand.

speaker: Shalom
content: Go on. Your adjutant is waiting. I'll hand you back to her for now.

speaker: Shalom
content: There will be plenty of time for us later.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I appreciate your understanding. Chief, would you kindly follow me, please?
You follow Nightingale out of the confinement cell. Instead of discussing any paperwork, she nervously takes hold of you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Have you shackled her yet?
Not yet. She's an inspector from Paradeisos, poses a low risk, and doesn't require MBCC's supplementary control. What's wrong?
Nightingale gives a nod, her body remaining taut with tension. She quickly murmurs in a low voice.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...I see.
She is trembling.

speaker: Nightingale
content: My apologies, I overreacted. She is, indeed, a pivotal figure. Whatever happens, you must pass this <color=#fb9259>trial</color> safely.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Please, don't ask any further questions. I must go.
Nightingale doesn't elaborate on her emotional response and departs hastily.
You pull open a drawer and are met with a cloud of dust.

speaker: Wynn
content: The earlier records from the Bureau should all be on this shelf—Cough cough, haven't been cleaned in a while. Cough, it's a bit... disorganized...
Shalom... Paradeisos...
No matter how hard you search, you come up empty-handed.

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes, we crossed paths at MBCC and engaged meaningfully. You made a lasting impression on me, so perhaps we could be considered more than mere acquaintances—<color=#fb9259>friends</color>, I'd like to think.
Records should be left by anyone who visits, so why is nothing showing up?

speaker: Wynn
content: More files? Oh, right! We've got even more classified stuff here, the kind of legendary tales you only hear whispered about in the Bureau!

speaker: Wynn
content: However, security tightened up after the unrest. Looks like they've sealed off all those juicy files. I can't get at them; I don't have the clearance.
Access Denied. Wynn seems oblivious to your action, meticulously organizing the bookshelf as she casually converses.

speaker: Wynn
content: I'm not really well-versed with the documents predating my employment here; I wasn't on board at the time! Huh, now that I think about it, I've only actually encountered Chief in the last few months since joining... What have you been up to all this time?

options: Search for records related to yourself

content: These are MBCC's daily work logs for the past year. Your name doesn't appear anywhere, nor does the title of MBCC Chief.
The role of Chief has been vacant for nearly an entire year, with all official duties managed by the acting supervisor, Nightingale.

speaker: Shalom
content: <color=#fb9259>The first time</color> we crossed paths was here, earlier this year, before you lost your memory. Back then, you were a storm of raw emotions, a spectacle of pure, unfiltered feeling. Unyielding, you charged forward without a second thought.
Where were you back then? If you weren't the Chief, then who did Shalom visit? And if it was you, in what capacity?
What was her agenda at that time, and what actions did she take? Now that she's returned, what is she after?
A multitude of questions flood your mind, crystallizing into two pivotal inquiries:
Just who were you before the loss of memory?
And who is this woman who "can't" be shackled?

1:21 p.m., October 14, N.F. 112
Inside the MBCC Bureau
Due to the arrival of the Paradeisos guest, there have been subtle shifts within the Bureau.

speaker: Wynn
content: Take a look! These are the flowers I had Miss Shalom pick out for the office. Hehe, she's even going to teach me flower arranging later. What a wonderful person!

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: ...Does the office usually keep flowers around?

speaker: Wynn
content: Ah, there's the philistine who can't appreciate beauty!

speaker: Arrest Team Captain
content: Weren't you deeply skeptical of the new inspector before? What made you switch sides so quickly?

speaker: Wynn
content: Ahem, she's not only gentle and attractive but also a high-ranking official from Paradeisos. She was exceptionally cooperative when I had her sign the visitor's log last time—no pretense whatsoever.

speaker: Wynn
content: I always thought Paradeisos folks were enigmatic, but who knew you'd find such a gentle soul among them, huh?

speaker: Staff A
content: Wow, is it really proper for someone like that to be in a regular room? Every time I bring food, I'm on pins and needles. I can't even bring myself to joke with the Sinners nearby anymore.

speaker: Staff B
content: What's the issue? The real power players are here for this very scrutiny. I've been watching— she observes the Bureau casually while engaging in light conversation. She's nothing like the empty suits in Eastside; these are people who genuinely make things happen.

speaker: Staff B
content: We had a conversation, and she remembered me—and my job—from just a single meeting. Do you think if I impress, that high-ranking Paradeisos official might green-light my transfer? This place is alright, but I have my sights set on something better...
Nightingale steps into the corridor, but suddenly stops, her eyes filled with tension as she looks toward the far end of the hallway.
Her gaze settles on Shalom. Standing beside an MBCC employee, the Hush listens attentively, as if deeply contemplating the question posed by the other person.

Seemingly aware of others's gaze, Shalom turns her head and locks eyes with Nightingale. Upon seeing Nightingale's pallid face, Shalom smiles. She responds to the question posed by the person beside her, but her eyes remain fixed on Nightingale until she hastily turns away.
Just as she observes the entire Bureau, you are also closely watching Shalom. You know very little about her background, but one thing becomes increasingly clear: she is highly dangerous.

Unlike any other Sinners you've encountered, Shalom hasn't shown any extraordinary Arcane Tendencies. Yet, she has an uncanny knack for pinpointing vulnerabilities and exerting her influence. Just like she did with you yesterday, all of it happened without a trace.
You can't control any of this. You can't read her, much less rein her in, and you're starting to question — has the Bureau already fallen under her influence?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Have you shackled her yet?
...If there's a chance to put the shackles on her, would things really get better?
What's on your mind?
A voice, cool and piercing, jolts you into lifting your head. Shalom has appeared beside you at some point, wearing a smile.

She's wearing gloves, as if Paradeisos is subtly warning you about using your shackles. Yet, the unabashed openness of her exposed skin seems to brazenly communicate: even if it's the MBCC, as long as you're under their watch, you're powerless to make any moves.
You take a fleeting glance at the task sheet in your hand and offer her a smile.

options: I've just been assigned a field mission.

content: Care to join, Envoy? It's not too challenging, but... our approach has always been a bit unrestrained. We could use some guidance in standard procedures.
Hmm... we might encounter some skirmishes, nothing too serious but not too light either, if you're up for it...
Shalom's smile lingers, her eyes opening just a touch to lock onto yours. After a brief silence, she speaks with an unhurried grace.

speaker: Shalom
content: No, I'd be more than happy to go with you.

speaker: Shalom
content: I'd also like to bear witness to your battle.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, I've forwarded the map to you. The MBCC squad will coordinate with FAC forces to intercept smugglers along Route B. High chance the target is infected with Mania—exercise extreme caution.
Combat stretched through the morning. The mission wasn't particularly tough but did prove to be a hassle, as the battlegrounds kept shifting.

The West District remains a cauldron of chaos and violence, but the esteemed envoy from Paradeisos seems perfectly at ease amid the grueling fieldwork. She stands beside you, buffeted by the fierce wind. Today, she's exceptionally close.

Close enough for you to clearly see every inch of her exposed skin, enticing you to contemplate certain "justifiable" uses for shackles, such as... shielding her from the ravages of Mania amidst the chaos.

speaker: Hella
content: I've been waiting so long I'm starving... Hey, ${PlayerName}, is your intel accurate or not?

speaker: Hecate
content: Keep it down, the enemy could show up any second. You'll blow our cover.

speaker: Hella
content: We've conquered the Black Ring together; there's no hurdle we haven't overcome.

speaker: Hella
content: Are you saying you're actually scared of these underlings, Hecate?

speaker: Hecate
content: ...Taking down the enemy is only part of the mission. We're also responsible for the safety of Chief and the Inspector—there's no room for complacency.

speaker: Hella
content: Right... it's not just ${PlayerName} this time; even the new inspector can't fight.
Hella turns to Shalom, sizes her up, and lets out a sigh.

speaker: Shalom
content: ${PlayerName} once mentioned that he's surrounded by many who are not just capable but also deeply trustworthy. Among them is a Sinner from Syndicate, someone he deems reliable.
female_content: ${PlayerName} once mentioned that she's surrounded by many who are not just capable but also deeply trustworthy. Among them is a Sinner from the Syndicate, someone she deems reliable.

speaker: Shalom
content: Your deeds have been chronicled in our operational reports and, to put it simply, they're extraordinary. We're deeply grateful for the sacrifices you've made for DisCity.

speaker: Hella
content: Capable? Ha, hahaha... Isn't it obvious? Do you even know who you're dealing with? I'm the most formidable Sinner in all of Minos!

Hella is clearly riding high on the praise, completely ensnared by the other party's trap. You furrow your brow, continue sifting through the clues as you step back, and covertly switch your earpiece to a private channel without making a sound.
Nightingale, allow Hella and Hecate to back up the other squads. I can handle things here with Shalom.

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...Chief, please don't act on a whim. We can't afford another mishap; I'm really worried about you.
The talks fall apart. Your adjutant stands her ground, clearly distressed by Shalom's presence.
You hadn't anticipated this tension would so quickly spread to you as well.

speaker: Hecate
content: Hella, stop messing around and stay sharp.

Your eyes meet Shalom's, but she's not looking at you for once—her focus is entirely on Hecate. You've never seen her wear such a look before—a complex mix of observation, deep thought, and a hint of caution.
An instant wave of dread surges up your spine as you instinctively leap forward to break them up, completely blind to the impending peril. A sudden, focused onslaught of Mania firepower engulfs you.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief!

Just in the nick of time, Nightmare leaps in to shield you—and you bitterly wish it hadn't. The trio stands dangerously exposed, a looming explosion threatens to engulf them. In this dire moment, at this close range, you stretch your hand to release some unseen shackles, but they, too, elude your grasp.
A dense blue laser sweeps by, setting off a burst of fireworks less than a few meters away from them.
Shalom steps forward; Schorl floats up in tandem with her hand gesture. A halo of light locks onto the unseen assailant, instantly neutralizing the ambush with a wave of cold, silent killing intent.
Shalom mutters, and you clearly grasp her command.

speaker: Shalom
content: Attack.
Lasers pour down from the sky, and a colossal shockwave nearly upends you.
When the blinding light fades, only you and the Sinners remain standing.

speaker: Hella
content: *****... What is that...?

speaker: Shalom
content: The mission's complete, ${PlayerName}. We can head back now.
She takes a slight step back, unveiling Hecate who was hiding behind her. Hecate is taken aback as she sees the wound on Shalom's shoulder.

speaker: Hecate
content: You...
A wave of tension washes over you, as you anticipate Shalom making some sort of comment.
But she doesn't say anything, simply lets go of Hecate's hand, stands up, and walks straight towards you.
She avoids eye contact, but as she glides past you, she leaves behind a whisper meant solely for the two of you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Did you think I was going to do something?
Your breath hitches. Shalom's smile persists, but now it's tinged with coldness, a blatant sneer shining through.
She derides your exaggerated caution, which has only blinded you, causing you to lose your cool and make poor decisions. Even if she says nothing, you're rendered speechless.
Yet she chooses to speak.

speaker: Shalom
content: Don't worry, I have no intention of harming her. These are the people who mean the most to you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Go on, she needs you more than anyone else.
She walks away, leaving you rooted to the spot.
On closer look, you see that the envoy's shoulder wound is more serious than you initially thought, skillfully masked by her unwavering composure.
After Hella's spirited promotion, word of the envoy's prowess on the battlefield quickly spread across the Bureau. Rumors casting the Chief in a less-than-flattering light also started to circulate.
Nightingale is noticeably anxious, while Shalom remains unflappable. Schorl, on the other hand, seems more invigorated than ever, becoming a chatterbox whenever it receives a compliment.
You feel somewhat disheartened.

speaker: Shalom
content: Attack.
You grasp the first point—the underlying message behind the Paradeisos announcement: <color=#fb9259>shackles aren't needed</color>, signaling dire consequences for anyone daring to defy.
To put it bluntly, as long as she remains, you're powerless—reduced to a mere observer. And you're left wondering how long she'll stay and what other cards she has up her sleeve.
As for the second point... it comes from an intuition you can't quite pin down, making you hesitate just before letting things simply unfold.

speaker: Shalom
content: Go, she needs you more than anyone else right now.

Before she navigated the intricate dynamics of the cutthroat workplace, you distinctly recall her taking that step not to intimidate the enemy but to shield the young girl behind her. All the unsavory actions that followed seemed more like a masquerade to embellish this rift.
Is that really the case? You hesitate to confirm, fearing this may just be a projection of your own hidden agenda.

Every action this woman takes is subject to dual interpretations. Trust her, and you're awash in sweetness; doubt her, and you plummet into an endless abyss of suspicion, fraught with unease over her vagueness. Strangely, this makes you yearn for the fleeting moments when you allowed yourself to be vulnerable around her.

speaker: Shalom
content: You possess a force that is both potent and enigmatic, eliciting fear, hatred, or envy from people across all organizations. How you are perceived can shift at any given moment.

speaker: Shalom
content: So, <color=#fb9259>firm up your own convictions</color>, keep your eyes peeled, and gather all the intel you can. Seek out the force that you can wield and believe in; that's what you should be focusing on.
At least you would agree with these words no matter who said them.
Rather than blindly following others, you tread your own path.
You rise and send a communication request to the chamber of the Paradeisos envoy.
As you approach the door, Shalom is gently tapping on Schorl. She watches a triangular device hum to life, her face lighting up as if she were playing with a kitten.
I want to talk to you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Hmm? Do you want to talk about the past, or some new problems you've run into?

options: No, this time it's you I want to talk about.

content: The room falls silent for a beat. Schorl hovers silently in the air.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...I've noticed, you've been watching me intently all day.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's clear you're questioning my motives for being here. You'd like nothing more than to shackle me, wouldn't you?

Thank you for helping everyone today; I've done some soul-searching myself. Holding onto such childish animosities really serves no purpose—I've only been someone else's puppet. Going forward, I won't act recklessly until I have all the facts.
You said you came here to dissolve my mistrust toward Paradeisos, but it seems the tables have turned. Paradeisos doesn't trust me; that's why they sent you.
She gazes at you in thoughtful silence for a lingering moment.

speaker: Lynn
content: ...Making you uneasy was never my intent—it runs counter to everything I meant to do.
If you genuinely despise me, why not just attack outright? You've flaunted your overwhelming power but haven't aimed it at me.
Does this mean Paradeisos is genuinely seeking to engage with me, an encounter I can't dodge?
Well then, I'll meet it head-on.

options: What does Paradeisos make of me? What are they after?

speaker: Shalom
content: I can't reveal any further details.
Like you pointed out, Paradeisos's sole aim is to seek out the nearly impossible solution for preserving human civilization in the face of apocalyptic ruin. My mission is just as singular—

options: to guard this haven and protect those who mean the world to me.

content: I'm not so complex as to warrant such earnest treatment from you. I have no hidden past; what you see is what you get. You've shaped me, and so there's nothing for me to hide.

If you're interested in fostering a good relationship, simply respecting this stance will suffice. If you're concerned I'll sow chaos, just avoid crossing the line. My impatience today arose because I felt threatened by you. I'm being honest and would appreciate it if you'd cease such actions.
Beyond that, I can't foresee any inherent conflict between our positions, so I'm open to exploring a path of mutual advancement—consistent with what you've previously conveyed to me.
You look into her eyes, and she looks back at you. Those eyes remain enigmatic, a misty veil you can't quite see through—but that's not what matters anymore.
What's important is the clarity you've found in your own thoughts.

options: The above are intended for the <color=#fb9259>envoy</color> as well as the <color=#fb9259>friend</color>.

content: Next, I ask that you demonstrate and substantiate the stance of Shalom. I shall respect your choice.

If you are ${PlayerName}'s friend, we have much more to discuss, and I genuinely need your assistance. If you're the envoy of Paradeisos, then the Chief of the MBCC has said all that's necessary; from this point, we can proceed in a strictly official capacity.
I have a multitude of tasks awaiting me; there's no need to squander time wallowing in ceaseless mistrust.
After a brief pause, Shalom looks up and says to Schorl,

speaker: Shalom
content: I'd like to speak with him. Could we have some privacy?
female_content: I'd like to speak with her. Could we have some privacy?

content: The triangular elemental appears to ponder for a moment before finally stepping back, giving you two your privacy.
You find yourself with a rare chance to be alone with Shalom, a situation that exceeds your expectations in an oddly unsettling way.

options: ...Is it really okay to let it go?

content: Paradeisos doesn't want you to accept the shackles, signifying they're wary of you forming a deep connection with me. Taking such a step would only raise their suspicions further.
Shalom looks at you and smiles. You suddenly feel as if one of her many facades has just fallen away.

speaker: Shalom
content: It doesn't need eyes to understand what's happening.

speaker: Shalom
content: I sent it away primarily for your sake.

Before you can even question it, Shalom is suddenly next to you, so close you can almost feel her breathing. As you take it all in, her hand softly lands on your shoulder, her body leaning in, her whisper almost touching your ear.

speaker: Shalom
content: You'd feel awkward if we weren't alone, wouldn't you?
With just a gentle push, you find yourself falling back onto the lounge's bed.
Her force is minimal; you could've easily resisted, but you can't. You're immobilized, your body feels like lead, and your thoughts blur into confusion.
It's as if something intangible has bound you—something that's neither her nor anything physical. A dim light seems to ascend your body slowly, almost hauntingly.
...Let go! What are you doing to me?!
The other person grins, eyes locking onto yours as she looks down.

speaker: Shalom
content: Why so tensed up? You've come a long way; yet so naive still?

speaker: Shalom
content: Shh... stay still... I won't hurt you, don't worry; I won't go further. Just relax, it won't hurt.

speaker: Shalom
content: If you keep resisting, it's hard on me too—you'll end up hurting both of us...

With a soft thud, the sound of fabric meets the ground. She removes her black gloves, and her slightly cool palms touch you again. Her slender fingers lightly grasp your wrist, gently caressing your skin as they slide upwards to intertwine with your fingers.
Simultaneously, the light climbs up your waist, tightening its grip, leaving you disoriented. Shalom's soft laughter brushes against your earlobe.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're torn between fleeing and drawing closer, between fearing me and wanting to surpass me. You shy away from my deep scrutiny, but you yearn to unveil every part of me.

speaker: Shalom
content: You wish to delve into my true thoughts, to have me lay bare my entire being before you. Then use the shackles; I'll show you the depths of my soul.

You feel increasingly frustrated as you struggle with all your might. One hand does manage to break free and reaches for her collarbone, attempting to push her away. However, your movements are arrested by the vivid white light that holds you in place. Almost immediately, a hand that looks all too human gently rests on the back of your own.
She smiles and, holding your hand, slowly glides it across her skin. Ultimately, she places it against her neck, exposing her vulnerability as if inviting you into a psychological hunt.

speaker: Shalom
content: One of the conditions for activation is skin-to-skin contact, right?

speaker: Shalom
content: If not having shackles on me is unsettling you, then go ahead. It's all good. I completely understand. I'll meet your needs.

speaker: Shalom
content: Isn't this what you've been yearning to do? You've gone through so much; you've earned this.

Something is infiltrating your awareness. You yearn to resist, but you find yourself drained of strength. You can't help but watch her as she leans over, her face drawing closer to yours with deliberate slowness, her voice increasingly elusive as it drifts into your ears.

speaker: Shalom
content: I grant you permission to do whatever you desire. Anything you wish to do, it's not a concern; you have the prerogative.

speaker: Shalom
content: Just be certain. What do you truly seek from me?

speaker: Shalom
content: Be certain... And then proceed...
Your hand involuntarily tightens, gripping Shalom's throat. The shackles crawl up Shalom's skin, hot patterns spreading within her, only to be hindered.

The shackles feel off to the touch. A more aggressive force seems to have been roused by you, erupting through Shalom's body—almost skewering her. Its form is unsettling, nearly shattered to pieces. Is this—
Whose is it?! Who else could...
Shalom wears an expression of regret.

speaker: Shalom
content: So you really can't remember, huh? Look carefully... The one who bestowed me with the shackles...

speaker: Shalom
content: Is <color=#fb9259>you</color>.

A triangular glyph appears in Shalom's right eye. Something penetrates your flesh, intruding directly into your mind and compelling a connection. Is this a shackle or merely a light? Either way, it's foreign to you.
Your body starts to go numb, but your soul quivers from the raw contact. In an instant, you feel weightless—swept away entirely by the experience.
As you slowly open your eyes, an oppressive darkness surrounds you. You find yourself standing in a space that's unfamiliar, yet oddly haunting.

The walls seem to press down from all sides, shaping into a meticulously geometric triangular corridor. Though you're certain you've never set foot here, the light beckoning from the tunnel's end radiates a warmth that feels both comforting and eerily familiar.
As you move along, the narrow tunnel starts to expand. Suddenly, you find yourself flanked by sheer vertical walls. Emerging from this passageway, you're enveloped by an overwhelming darkness.
A sliver of light pierces through the rift of this void, drawing you in while something deep within warns you of its peril.
Maybe it's best not to get any closer.
Looks like you've gotten more cautious. Guess I won't have to worry as much from now on.
Shalom stands quietly behind you. You try instinctively to unleash your shackles, yet like a snuffed-out flame, nothing happens.

speaker: Shalom
content: Give up; the power of Mania has no sway here, and that includes your shackles.
Did you use some kind of power? Is it spatial manipulation, or perhaps mental control? Is this an illusion you've conjured?

speaker: Shalom
content: I do possess certain neuroinduction capabilities, but don't mistake this place as my creation—I've simply guided your consciousness here.

speaker: Shalom
content: This is the Consciousness Observatorium, a realm that has been tirelessly developed by Paradeisos over years. It represents the outermost boundary where human reason can venture into the Mania.
She points toward the rift.

speaker: Shalom
content: Beyond that rift lies the realm of primordial Mania, the origin of all things. Anything that ventures into it will instantly warp and disintegrate, while any sentient being will be swiftly overtaken, assimilated, and lose their sense of self.

speaker: Shalom
content: You've seen the Black Ring. Should it intensify, it will ultimately forge a link to this locale. This is the cutting edge of cataclysmic studies, and undoubtedly the most perilous zone.

speaker: Shalom
content: That's why Paradeisos has implemented the most stringent counter-Mania protocols on this side of the rift, to ensure the malevolent forces from beyond never breach this realm.
So that's why the shackles were ineffective... You’ve abducted me to this forsaken place just to quell my spirit. What is it that you’re truly after?
She offers a resigned smile.

speaker: Shalom
content: You wanted a heart-to-heart, didn't you? Naturally, I'd pick a sanctuary where you can speak your mind—a true "intimate universe" between us.

speaker: Shalom
content: There's no prying machinery or listening ears here. Only those with a unique link to the realm beyond the rift can access this place. It's solely our world now.

speaker: Shalom
content: I am a Sinner of unique designation, tasked solely with fulfilling dire necessities. My role situates me on the frontline of turmoil, monitoring the volatile currents of Mania and the shifting landscapes of reality. I report my observations to higher authorities and offer strategies for intervention.

speaker: Shalom
content: Alright, I've laid my cards on the table, showing you my true stance. However, I suspect that these matters may feel quite distant to you. Surely you have questions that are closer to your heart—go ahead and ask.

speaker: Shalom
content: Personally, I'll be completely upfront about what I can discuss. And when it comes to what I can't reveal, due to certain rules, I'll be straightforward about that as well.

speaker: Shalom
content: I trust you'll grasp the nuances between the two.
This is indeed the most honest answer Shalom has ever given.
You ponder briefly, then finally break the silence.

options: Your real reason for coming to MBCC

speaker: Shalom
content: A <color=#fb9259>greeting</color> that doubles as a <color=#fb9259>test</color>. The objective is to gauge the loyalty of the present Chief of MBCC.

speaker: Shalom
content: Paradeisos has been watching you; your unique abilities are vital to this city. They're considering entrusting you with an even greater responsibility.

speaker: Shalom
content: All the more reason to deepen mutual understanding. Before they task you with important responsibilities, they want to gauge the extent to which they can place their trust in you.
Entrusted with great responsibility... is that a form of validation? Yet, you find no joy in it. The language is cloaked in ambiguity, always hinting at an ulterior motive.
For example, what happens if you fail the test? How will you be dealt with?

options: Has the test ended? Did I pass?

speaker: Shalom
content: We're nearly there; this is the final stretch.

speaker: Shalom
content: So far, everything falls within acceptable bounds. Well done.

speaker: Shalom
content: Paradeisos has its own set of judgment criteria, which I'm not permitted to reveal to you.

speaker: Shalom
content: But believe me, actions of that severity would certainly be beyond what you could stomach as well.
An ambiguous answer.
What happens if I reach the level of "unacceptable"? How will I be handled?

speaker: Shalom
content: It would be a manner of dealing with a threat to humanity that you, too, would find justifiable. Unfortunately, the specific details can't be disclosed.

speaker: Shalom
content: Relax, ${PlayerName}. You're a person of integrity and good character. As long as you don't make an enemy of the city, you won't be regarded as a foe by Paradeisos.

She smiles—a smile with the power to melt hearts. Yet this time, it instills in you a deeply unsettling sense of dislocation. It's not the familiar facade of upper-class hypocrisy; it's an emptiness so alien, so unnatural; it's as though you're standing before a mere husk of a human.
And the likelihood that this is another layer of her deception only serves to intensify your agitation.

options: What's going on with the shackles on you?

speaker: Shalom
content: Though they may appear different, these are your own shackles—originating from <color=#fb9259>your past self</color>.

speaker: Shalom
content: I am a Sinner, and you bestowed these shackles upon me on the day we first met. Do you remember?
And beyond that, I'm utterly powerless over them—I can't even sense their existence.
These enigmatic shackles feel so alien; I can neither control them nor use them to influence Shalom. I'm completely blind to their presence.

speaker: Shalom
content: Hmm... maybe your <color=#fb9259>amnesia</color> has led to a subtle shift in your identity. Because of this, you can no longer connect with the shackles of your past, losing your grip on them as a result.

speaker: Shalom
content: In a sense, their hold on me has weakened considerably compared to the past. Shackles are the power of the mind, and a fragment of that power has faded along with your memories.

options: What was the old me like?

content: Who was I before I lost my memory? Why did I use the shackles on you? What happened between us?
Would he be under such tight security as well? Did he pass the test of Paradeisos?
female_content: Would she be under such tight security as well? Did she pass the test of Paradeisos?

content: You let out a sigh.

options: I suppose this is another one of those "off-limits" topics, huh?

content: You say you're laying all your cards on the table, but every question gets a "can't be disclosed." I don't hold it against you; it's all rather futile.
In a way, making it clear what you can't disclose is a form of openness in itself. Your attitude has been transparent enough.
If that's the case, don't expect any heart-to-heart from me either. I don't bear my soul to things I can't see.
If you have nothing more to reveal, then let me go. I've got no more questions.

speaker: Shalom
content: Ah, the old "draw back to leap forward" tactic to bait me. Clever, aren't you?
She takes a step closer to you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Paradeisos has nothing to tell you, but I do.

speaker: Shalom
content: When I said I once considered you a friend, I meant it. If possible, I'd like to find that "friend" again.

speaker: Shalom
content: But what good would it do to fill you in on the past?

She lifts her eyes to meet yours, sending an icy shiver up your spine. You wish to step back, but you're not just held; you're gripped by her as if bound. The temperature in the lifeless room plummets; all you can do is lock eyes with her.

speaker: Shalom
content: What if I told you that your past self was a fearsome monster—despised and shunned by the world, leaving destruction in your wake?

speaker: Shalom
content: Would you believe me now?

speaker: Shalom
content: What if I told you that all you hold dear is nothing but a velvet leash, skillfully crafted to control you? That the love you receive is merely a ruse to tame your spirit. They've taken what truly matters to you, replacing it with hollow substitutes.

speaker: Shalom
content: Do you have the courage to shatter this illusion?
Those doll-like eyes remain void. Yet, right here, in this very space, you're suddenly overtaken by an emotion so intense it sets your heart racing.

It's an insatiable yearning, an irresistible allure. For a fleeting moment, you plummet into an uncharted past, engulfed in an eternal darkness of solitude. Before you lies but a glimmer of light—and you wish to turn it into a spark that incinerates this world.

speaker: Shalom
content: Once, you were a force to be reckoned with, an unyielding edge that bent to no one and broke for nothing—even willing to consume yourself to incinerate this world. But that power has long since faded in you.

speaker: Shalom
content: Do you wish to confront your true self? To reclaim <color=#fb9259>him</color>?
female_content: Do you wish to confront your true self? To reclaim <color=#fb9259>her</color>?

content: Of course, you hope to reclaim your past.
Yet before you can, a loathing washes over you, as if someone is tightening a noose around your neck—seeking to strip you of your autonomy and provoke an instinctual urge to resist.
Suddenly, you sense a rift in the woman's otherwise compelling "performance." Seizing the moment, you grab the hand she's using to restrain you.
Why do you want me to come back?

speaker: Shalom
content: Because you are my friend. I want to help you.
I don't care how you see me, nor what you want to do for me.
What I'm asking is, <color=#fb9259>what do you want</color>?
Pulling her closer forcefully, you lock eyes with her to stave off the odd sense of unrest welling up inside you. You search for something real in her doll-like void of an expression.
To keep from losing yourself, you need to sharpen your resolve with clarity.
What's in it for you if I go back in time, shattering everything, only to end up bruised and broken?
What's your endgame with me? What are you trying to extract? If you've got a wish or demand, lay it on the table. Speak up, just like you forced me to be upfront with you.
You want to hold my sincerity hostage? Then offer yours first. That's what a <color=#fb9259>real conversation</color> is.

It's a momentary silence, but you seize it. That silence is her vulnerability, and within that vulnerability, an emotion is blazingly resonating with you, magnifying an aspect of your own soul, compelling you to dig deeper. This may be your one and only shot.
You're at a loss for words? You were so forceful earlier, but now that it's about you, you've got nothing to say?
I see now—this isn't a conversation at all. It's a top-down <color=#fb9259>test</color>.
Both the allure and the threats you've thrown my way are the will of Paradeisos, aren't they? This is the final <color=#fb9259>loyalty test</color>, isn't it, Envoy?

She locks eyes with you, unflinchingly silent. Gradually, you sense a nebulous wave of emotions coming to the surface—regret and sorrow, yet also relief, satisfaction, and a form of resolve. The complexity leaves you wondering for a moment if it's all just an illusion.

For a long moment, she smiles. Her hand, which had been cradling your cheek, gradually loosens its grip, as does the force with which you were holding her wrist. Emotions dissipate as quickly as they have surged, becoming an illusion before you can even make sense of them.
She takes a step back, resuming the poise of an elegant but detached doll, and maintains a calculated distance from you. The only trace left of your tense confrontation is a red mark on her wrist.

speaker: Shalom
content: So you've seen through me.
She smiles at you.

speaker: Shalom
content: All of this was a test set by Paradeisos.

speaker: Shalom
content: Will you give me your answer now?
The rift has sealed, and in this moment, she finally gives you a clear answer.
The woman who once claimed to be a friend from your past has vanished. All that remains before you is an envoy from Paradeisos, here to conduct your final test.

In this moment, you vividly perceive a profound chasm between you—a divide she has always bridged. Now, with her retreat, you see it in stark clarity. This abyss isn't just a matter of perspectives or choices; it's a rift shaped by... time itself.

options: ...I think I understand you guys a bit now.

content: In your eyes, my problem isn't about what I've done or want to do; it stems from a <color=#fb9259>past</color> I'm completely unaware of. You fear it, and you fear me.
So there's really nothing left to discuss. You guard yourselves so vigilantly against me that you only trust what you can see.

But that's fine; my position remains unyielding. I'm committed to preserving my present with all my being. When it comes to the past, I see no reason the me of then would disapprove of the me I am now.
As long as he remains "me," I believe he would resonate with every arduous step I've taken.
female_content: As long as she remains "me," I believe she would resonate with every arduous step I've taken.

content: While it's unfortunate I couldn't hear any tales from an "old friend," I'll leave the quest for lost memories to my future self.
You take a pause. Everything is already decided; there's no more room for doubt. It's only now that I truly feel a tinge of regret.

options: Articulating this thought owes largely to you.

content: Whether those words were lies or not, what you said during our first meeting had a profound impact on me. It's given me more assurance about the path I've traveled.
I only wish you were actually my friend—I'd love to know what's truly in your heart.

speaker: Shalom
content: Is that so... Do you really believe that...
Her eyes close partially as she loses herself in thought, then she lifts her gaze and offers a subdued smile.

speaker: Shalom
content: You're correct; I have nothing more to reveal. Henceforth, your conversations will be with Paradeisos.

speaker: Shalom
content: Congratulations, the test has concluded. You've proven to be a person of true integrity and kindness.

speaker: Shalom
content: Paradeisos eagerly awaits this news. I shall take my leave from your Bureau; you no longer have to live in a state of anxiety.
Her words resonate more than ever as those of someone from Paradeisos, but her expression shifts to genuine sincerity.
It's as if she's bidding a heartfelt goodbye.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's good to see you again, and even better to see you happy.

speaker: Shalom
content: Farewell.
The woman lifts her hand. You think she's offering a handshake and find yourself hesitating, unsure whether to reciprocate.

Instead, she gives you a gentle nudge, causing you to lose your balance and fall backward. Unbeknownst to you, the pale blue rift behind you has drawn closer. You plunge into it, landing in a sea of flowers that feels strangely familiar.
Bathed in the ethereal touch of myriad rays of light, you discern a hazy figure. Locked in its gaze, enfolded in its arms, in that fleeting union of minds, you catch glimpses of fractured memories.

speaker: Researcher A
content: The data is recovering more quickly than anticipated. We're on the right track, and the experiment is proceeding smoothly.

speaker: Researcher A
content: HUSH Project is advancing to Phase 3, time to bring in new elements.

speaker: Researcher A
content: What's wrong?

speaker: Researcher B
content: Subject 17... She harbors intense animosity towards her overseers, evidenced by multiple incidents of assault during surveillance. Could her emotional volatility compromise the integrity of our experimental data? Should we consider replacing her?

speaker: Researcher A
content: A <color=#fb9259>Dissenter</color> among the Sinners, huh... Let's go ahead and use her for a trial run.

speaker: Researcher B
content: Subject is in place; confirm M-value fluctuations are within acceptable parameters. Commencing the final phase of Hush.

speaker: Researcher B
content: Initiating the extraction of Mania; entity formation underway, 20% complete.

speaker: Pinned Monster
content: Roarrrr!!

speaker: Researcher B
content: Channel confirmed open; initiate specialized intervention... Channel is stable; the experiment is now linked to the Corridor Zone.

speaker: Researcher B
content: Extraction phase complete; proceed with the activation of Rule Control Mechanism.

speaker: Researcher A
content: Data has stabilized; positional anchor point secured. Stable link established between the Manic Entity and the test subject.

speaker: Researcher A
content: Experiment successful; the outcome is flawless and potent, heralding an unparalleled stable point of observation. What shall we name it?

speaker: Researcher A
content: We'll name her <color=#fb9259>Rebel</color>, a fitting memorial to her former unruliness. We won't be seeing that defiant spirit again.

speaker: Researcher A
content: She will surpass us in <color=#fb9259>marking</color> all Dissenters.

speaker: Researchers
content: Blessings upon you. Blessings upon you. Blessings upon you. May you witness the ultimate end.

speaker: Schorl
content: Eclipse Operation has resulted in significant losses. The 6th Hush has prematurely reached its limits, and the recycling and destruction work has already commenced. In three days, you'll step into her role. Your new designation will be <color=#fb9259>Hush-X</color>, and you will inherit the Second Observatoriumas well as the No. 2 Schorl.

speaker: Schorl
content: The No. 2 Schorl is deeply anchored in Rebel. All observation data will be automatically synchronized and collected. This energy will be converted into the power of the Schorl itself. Commands will be relayed to you through the Schorl by the Paradeisos.

speaker: Schorl
content: 90% of your time will be dedicated to observation. During exceptional periods, unique tasks will be assigned and you'll be awakened for them. Rest assured, your stability is our highest priority. Schorl will continually ensure this.

speaker: Schorl
content: The marking ability has also been successfully implanted. Given the high stakes and resource consumption involved, the majority of Sinners will be shackled. The power will only be unleashed on exceptionally valuable <color=#fb9259>Dissenters</color>. Paradeisos needs more reliable tools, through you.

speaker: Schorl
content: Immediately sync all existing data. We've received a distress call from Nirvana: the mining facility in Inner Bay has gone rogue. They're requesting assistance from Paradeisos. This could also be an opportunity... Paradeisos is keen to discover the true nature of xxx within the Lone Island base and what the Underground intends to do with it.

speaker: Schorl
content: This is your mandate. For your inaugural observation mission, seek out the <color=#fb9259>Ultimate Answer</color>, and identify pathways for us.
....Copy that.

Across the rift, the woman's delicate silhouette recedes into the distance, leaving behind a tumult of emotions forever imprisoned in this floral expanse. It remains ambiguous as to who, among the two torn asunder, is the true captive.
You wrestle with the urge to call out—only to realize you've forgotten the name that should escape your lips…
As the light pulses, its luminescent blue hue drowns out the crimson glare and the monster's ferocious roar, expelling you entirely from this realm.
Chief, Chief!

speaker: Hecate
content: Are you alright? You passed out for 4 hours... Are you feeling unwell?

options: ...What just happened? Who was here a moment ago...

speaker: Nightingale
content: The inspector is already en route back to Paradeisos. Ms. Shalom left a specific verbal message: The test has concluded, and Paradeisos is highly satisfied—you've met our expectations.
Nightingale visibly exhales, relieved. It's clear that Shalom's departure has lightened her mood considerably. A lot must have happened.
...What happened? It feels like you've just woken up from a nap, and your eyes are somewhat dry.
Shalom... who is she?

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhhh! Big dummy, you finally decided to wake up, huh? Do you have any idea how worried I've been?
The Sinners burst in, interrupting your train of thought.
...Maybe ask later; it doesn't seem that important right now.

Shalom opens her eyes, weary and drained. Schorl has been by her side for a while now, its glow pulsing—both awaiting her answer and scrutinizing her intently. This must be a Level 4 alert. Had she taken any actions just now, she would have awoken to find the entire area reduced to rubble.
The Hush stands up, a smile gracing her lips. Even though the observed findings are already in sync, vocalizing them serves as a good icebreaker for the discussion ahead.

speaker: Shalom
content: Investigation complete. The target has ingested at least <color=#fb9259>3</color> fragments: a full activation from BR-004, a semi-activated entity from BR-001, and an inert, restricted version from the White Cube. It seems the Underground has already made contact with him.
female_content: Investigation complete. The target has ingested at least 3 fragments: a full activation from BR-004, a semi-activated entity from BR-001, and an inert, restricted version from the White Cube. It seems the Underground has already made contact with her.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...We've hit a historical threshold with these numbers. Based on <color=#fb9259>prior data</color>, this container's on the verge of failure.

speaker: Schorl
content: It's even more critical considering it's defective.

speaker: Schorl
content: What's the Hush's take on this? Is the risk too great? Should we destroy it immediately?

speaker: Shalom
content: I don't think it's necessary. He's more stable than any subject we've had before. The absorption of Corpus and link with the Sinners hasn't tainted him severely.
female_content: I don't think it's necessary. She's more stable than any subject we've had before. The absorption of Corpus and link with the Sinners hasn't tainted her severely.

speaker: Shalom
content: Perhaps it's tied to his unique past. Even though he's the final flawed specimen, his stability is remarkable. I'll sync the data accordingly.
female_content: Perhaps it's tied to her unique past. Even though she's the final flawed specimen, her stability is remarkable. I'll sync the data accordingly.

speaker: Schorl
content: Got it.

speaker: Schorl
content: So, before our next action against the ring, let's activate the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> within him. All associated risks have been communicated to Paradeisos.
female_content: So, before our next action against the ring, let's activate the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> within her. All associated risks have been communicated to Paradeisos.

speaker: Schorl
content: If that Rule ends up annihilating the subject, well, that's a hard pill to swallow. It just goes to show, some things are better left untouched by human hands.

speaker: Schorl
content: Next, we'll continue to enhance the Hush's capabilities. By the eighth or, at the latest, the ninth generation, they should have full <color=#fb9259>marking</color> capabilities. At that point, they could also take on the duty of detaining the Sinners.
With an unreadable expression, Shalom slips into her coat and trails behind Schorl as they exit the lounge.

speaker: Shalom
content: This is a reasonable judgment; I have no objections.

speaker: Schorl
content: You've done an excellent job, X. Your performance has consistently been outstanding.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Interacting with him has drained me. Please allow me some time to recover.
female_content: ...Interacting with her has drained me. Please allow me some time to recover.

content: You won't be seen as an enemy... You'll be seen merely as a tool.
A tool that's unstable, unreliable, and can be sacrificed for various "necessities" at any given moment.
When the time comes, it might be me who takes action.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: New irregular activity has been detected at the BR-004 ruins, confirmed to originate from Corpus 02, dormant for the past 9 years.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: As we suspected, following X's observations, BR-002 was never fully neutralized. Corpus 02 has gained new <color=#fb9259>invisible capabilities</color>, and its risk level has now surpassed acceptable limits.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Any movements from the Underground? Their Shepherd failed to fully consume BR-002 in N.F.104; now, the enemy could resurface. She's always had a penchant for Corpus 02.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: The 9th Agency has reported increased enemy activity, but their motives are still a mystery. If the Underground Shepherd truly surfaces, she must be stopped. We can't risk letting her grow more powerful; the stakes are simply too high.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: How's the M-value looking in the West District? And what's the likelihood of another Black Ring incident triggered by Corpus 02?

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: The city council made a grave error when they passed the West District Order Management Regulations. It wasn't reason that guided them, but a crime fueled by selfish motives.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Are you suggesting we initiate the <color=#fb9259>Purge Order</color>?

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: How else can we mitigate these risks? This marks the second major incident involving the Black Ring in the West District within a year. First, it was the gang activities, and now we have Rustfire. Given our current management resources, we can't stamp out the Underground issues plaguing the West District. It's becoming a fertile ground for the Black Ring's Underground operations.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Representatives from Eastside and several Paradeisos members have submitted another petition. They're deeply concerned about the deteriorating situation in the West District and hope to prevent an even larger catastrophe...

The West District has a total population of 6.5 million, with fewer than 300,000 involved in gang violence. Fewer than 100,000 people could trigger the Black Ring, and fewer than 200,000 might be affected by its radiation.

The extra costs you're willing to pay to sidestep what you call risks, and the impending damage you're poised to inflict, have both already outstripped the harm from the Black Ring you claim to despise.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Activating the Purge Order now is within the Executive Committee's capabilities. When viewed from the angle of minimizing sacrifices, it's also the most manageable approach.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Indeed, there's no need for concern about the population. The overall populace is remarkably stable, presenting an opportunity to elevate our city-state's standards.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: A sacrifice of this magnitude is within the realm of acceptable losses. The real issue is...

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: For unknown reasons, Corpus 02 has developed extraordinary stealth capabilities. While it remains in the West District—or anywhere in the city-state, for that matter—nothing is predictable.
Accustomed to self-hypnosis through acts of sacrifice, convincing ourselves that everything we do holds greater value... The sunk costs only deepen our entrenchment in our own perspectives.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Time is running out, the stakes are too high. We can't allow the Underground force to continue to gain strength. We have no idea how close that Shepherd is to the Source…
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: ...For the sake of humanity, to stand against our gravest enemy, we must heed reason. It's the only way.

You've inherited nothing but the sterile logic and coldness of rational thought, yet both your origin and your aims have been compromised by fear. It's this paralyzing dread of risk that stifles any chance of a breakthrough.
Naturally, I would never voice these thoughts. Instruments don't question directives; setting off a Level 6 alert would be catastrophic. A Hush can't afford such pointless blunders.
She raises her hand and emotionlessly taps the outer wall of Schorl with her index finger. Schorl vibrated, initiating a Level 1 Scan, and scanned the Hush from head to toe.

This is the lowest level of irrational, meaningless action. Not long ago, Shalom started employing this little tactic for risk assessment. Now, it's just a game she plays to pass the time—although even the subject of her amusement is rather uninteresting.

speaker: Schorl
content: ...You're an exceptional Hush, X. The next time you find yourself deep in thought, try to rectify such purposeless physical tendencies; they could trigger system errors.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Initial discussions have concluded. We're aligned on using the West District Purge Order as our primary strategy, based on the precondition of preventing the Black Ring outbreak from sustaining the Underground Shepherd. Let's now move on to confirm the specifics.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The situation with Rustfire has intensified. Given the various risks involved, a straightforward approach to the purge operation is not viable. X, this is a multi-faceted operation; Paradeisos requires you to conduct a risk assessment for each variable. Make every effort to prevent the resurgence of BR-002 and ensure the successful implementation of the Purge Order.
