<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Additionally, on March 16th, the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> on SHP-13 activated autonomously for the first time, taking place at the Drifter Camp in Inner Bay. SHP-13 encountered the invisible Corpus 02, and the situation has escalated to uncontrollable risk levels. Hence, you are assigned a secondary mission.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Maintain surveillance using Rebel. Schorl will determine the optimal timing for their encounter. Paradeisos will enforce the Rules to its fullest extent to eradicate both SHP-13 and the BR-002 Corpus. Regrettably, as an asset on the verge of becoming defective, this is his final and greatest utility.
female_content: <color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Maintain surveillance using Rebel. Schorl will determine the optimal timing for their encounter. Paradeisos will enforce the Rules to its fullest extent to eradicate both SHP-13 and the BR-002 Corpus. Regrettably, as an asset on the verge of becoming defective, this is her final and greatest utility.

content: Just as I suspected... I'm the one to go.
That makes things easier...
She bursts into laughter, making Schorl hover a few centimeters higher mechanically. HUSH-X now showing pointless emotions, Schorl initiates a Level 3 scan.
Shalom allows its chilling blue light to scan her from head to toe as she tunes into the channel.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Understood. Understood. Given the high stakes of this complex operation, let me first confirm what’s required.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Whether we're taking down the foundation of the Black Ring to enact the Purge Order or employing SHP-13 to eliminate Corpus 02, our objective remains the same: to prevent the resurgence of BR-002.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: So the crux of stopping BR-002's resurgence is to confront Paradeisos's most formidable threat—the Underground Shepherd, sparing no expense. Is that accurate?


<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Precisely.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: I doubt the cost sits well with you. What's your strategy for "fine-tuning" this time?

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Expense is a secondary concern; Paradeisos's needs take precedence. The cost, including enacting the Purge Order, is justified to neutralize the Shepherd threat.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Still, constantly playing defense means we'll never seize control. This isn't the last we'll see of the Black Ring. Their knack for staying hidden keeps us perpetually at a disadvantage.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: That said, now's our chance to experiment with a bolder, yet effective strategy.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Let's catalyze the explosion of BR-002, turning it into the ultimate lure for the Underground Shepherd—then we annihilate her.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: I'll handle the nitty-gritty; no extra support or costs needed. All Paradeisos has to do is confirm one thing:

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: <color=#fb9259>Is eliminating the Underground Shepard</color> genuinely aligned with your objectives?

<color=#fb9259>??-All</color>: ...
Alright, employ the unassailable logic you so trust to address those pathetic, laughable fears, and devise an irresistible solution. In the end...
fulfill my purpose.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What I'm asking is, <color=#fb9259>what do you want</color>?
What do I want? You, of course.
It's good to see you haven't lost your edge. If your past self were here, he'd be just as relieved as I am.
female_content: It's good to see you haven't lost your edge. If your past self were here, she'd be just as relieved as I am.

content: She gazes down the other end of the channel, at the faceless operators of the Hushes who claim to be righteous.
I have six months left; let's find the Ultimate Answer.

In N.F. 113, this March, chaos erupts in the West District due to the Rustfire Uprising. Unexpectedly, BR-002 is reactivated three days ahead of schedule, and its capabilities far exceed our projections.

SHP-13 has gone missing, and we suspect its sensory systems are being tampered with.

Upon verification of the anomalous data by the Paradeisos analysis team, it quickly became evident that the Underground Shepherd is implicated, and they're actively seeking a method to infiltrate BR-002. The 9th Agency's lead intelligence officers have swiftly pivoted to pursuing these Underground forces.

Attempts to recover SHP-13 have been unsuccessful and are currently suspended.

In April, the FAC Commander-in-Chief urgently enacts an emergency protocol, decisively mobilizing operations in the West District. The main forces are redeployed from Eastside to the West, triggering the city-wide Blue Rain initiative and exacerbating the financial strain on the city-state.

SHP-13 remains unaccounted for.
In N.F. 113, this June, the battle for control of BR-002 has reached a tense stalemate. Concurrently, a covert operation is being conducted in the shadows.

7:20 p.m., June 21, N.F. 113
The periphery of Syndicate-controlled BR-002.
The resurrected Black Ring looms ominously over the city, its streets awash in a cacophony of roars and curses. Here and there, the fading glimmers of a Sinner's special power can be glimpsed.

speaker: Tactical Operative
content: The intel is rock-solid; our target is right here. Minos' Chief has been hidden out in this location!

speaker: Tactical Operative
content: Whose turf is this? Rustfire? Some other gang? Or could it be those Underground types—

speaker: Tactical Operative
content: It doesn't matter, and it's not important. What's crucial is that we retrieve him today.
female_content: It doesn't matter, and it's not important. What's crucial is that we retrieve her today.

speaker: Tactical Operative
content: With the Hush on-site, there's no way we're losing this.
A blinding burst of white light emanates from the core of Schorl, forcefully obliterating the barriers ahead.
Debris flies in all directions, while a haze of dust and smoke obscures what lies deeper in the tunnel.
Yet, undeterred, the Hush strides forward towards the enigmatic abyss. Her expression is one of chilling detachment.

speaker: Schorl
content: X, prioritize your safety. You're not cut out for the front lines, and we've gone over the risks already.

speaker: Schorl
content: This is merely a special deployment; your role is to validate the intel and issue commands. You're not expected to engage in combat.

Shalom doesn't reply; she's well aware. This risky, covert operation has flirted with danger multiple times. Moments like this were bound to occur. If it weren't for the suspicions raised by the 9th Agency, compelling Paradeisos to clandestinely reassign HUSH to helm the operation, keeping it under wraps would have been quite difficult.

There's no time left; she can't rely on Rebel and must find the target herself. She remembers the bits of scattered intel she caught a glimpse of earlier, rummaging for lost medical supplies amid the chaos—particularly the Hypercube.
Whoosh!
A bullet pierces through the smoke, shot towards Shalom, but is intercepted by Schorl.

speaker: Schorl
content: This gear— it's from <color=#fb9259>Rustfire</color>, isn't it? Just as I thought, they've gotten their hands on it.

Sure, it's Rustfire ammo, but if one has been paying attention, they'd know there's more to it. The situation here is even more intricate than it seems—everything from resources to tactics, customs, and temperament come into play.
Shalom has someone in mind.
As the first shot pierces the air, additional barrels materialize from the gloom, effectively restraining the combat forces.

However, Shalom vanishes into the maelstrom of bullets, locating the clandestine door she's been searching for all along. She navigates the hidden passage, finally reaching a securely sealed iron door.
She pushes it open.

speaker: Schorl
content: The Chief is located. You've done well.

speaker: Schorl
content: He remains manageable for the moment. HUSH Elite will arrive shortly for retrieval; your only job is to keep him alive. Remain on standby here.
female_content: She remains manageable for the moment. HUSH Elite will arrive shortly for retrieval; your only job is to keep her alive. Remain on standby here.

content: Light cascading from above cleaves the room into distinct halves.
Shalom refrains from stepping into the luminous divide. She lingers by the bed, scrutinizing the figure ensnared by the light, as she finds solace in the surrounding darkness.

speaker: Shalom
content: Yes, he's very weak...
female_content: Yes, she's very weak...

speaker: Shalom
content: A rare opportunity indeed. Let me do a test.
Shalom slowly walks over.

speaker: Shalom
content: ...I've come to see you, ${PlayerName}.
The listener's face lies veiled in the glow of the ceiling lamp—still as the night, as though in slumber, but their breathing is so faint it's almost indiscernible.

speaker: Shalom
content: You've slimmed down; you look rather pallid. It's as if all the Bureau's hard work over the past six months has come to naught. Your adjutant must be concerned.

speaker: Shalom
content: Your hair has grown, reminding me of the first time we met.

Shalom gently caresses ${PlayerName}'s forehead and the side of their face. The person in the bed appears to be enveloped in a dream, their eyes darting beneath closed eyelids as if striving to awaken. Shalom waits a moment, but ultimately, they remain ensnared in their dreamworld.
Shalom gently grazes their fingertips; this time, with no fabric between them, both hands share the same coldness.

speaker: Shalom
content: I did all this.

speaker: Shalom
content: The Black Ring, the uprisings, even your path—everything has been calculated to lead us here.

speaker: Shalom
content: Can you hear my words? You must despise me by now...

speaker: Shalom
content: ...Then come back. Try it; I want to bring you back.
Shalom's voice gradually diminishes, nearly fading into a whisper.

speaker: Schorl
content: Do you want to mark him?
female_content: Do you want to mark her?

content: Her expression is enigmatic, shrouded in shadows. Darkness writhes around her, tendrils of dim light creeping up the bed. These wisps encircle Shalom, as though yearning to caress the person lying there.

The line between light and dark blurs; those ethereal filaments become the brightest luminescence in the room, piercing through windows, cutting across the wide-open door, and ultimately weaving together to envelop the two in a radiant cocoon.

speaker: Schorl
content: This time, the shackles don't recoil...
Shalom remains silent, her grip on the hand of the person in the bed unyielding. Shalom stares at him intently, as if entranced.
female_content: Shalom remains silent, her grip on the bedridden person's hand is unwavering. She stares at her intently, as if entranced.

content: Simultaneously, a dense corruption seeps from ${PlayerName}, instantly ensnaring the wisp of light and nearly consuming it whole.

speaker: Schorl
content: Hush! Move, it's the Mania of Corpus 02!
A burst of blue light pierces through Shalom instantly. Concurrently, an electric hum emanates from beyond the open door.

speaker: Schorl
content: Alert!
Zaaaap! Before Schorl can activate, a surge of electricity immobilizes it, forcibly propelling it through the window.
Finally.

Shalom finally releases ${PlayerName}'s hand and stands up tall. The blue light that enveloped her vanishes, leaving behind faint scorch marks. She doesn't seem to mind; her composure suggests that all of it might as well have been an act.
She turns her attention to the lone onlooker who interrupted her show. Evidently, he was drawn by the light—quick on the uptake. A satisfied smile graces Shalom's face.
The cloaked man bursts into the basement, a one-man army fueled by palpable tension; his muscles are rigid with anticipation. An electric charge surges along his weapon, coursing toward Shalom.
Back off. Don't even think about using your tricks.

speaker: Donald
content: ...Ahhh!

The electric glow shatters under the weight of intangible Awe; the last vestiges of his power make a defiant lunge at Shalom, only to dissipate into thin air. Donald is immobilized by unseen restraints, his weapon plummeting to the ground with a resonant clang.

speaker: Shalom
content: So frightened? You should've seized the chance to kill me when you had it.

speaker: Shalom
content: <color=#fb9259>Nine years</color> without using your power—must be quite the struggle to hold back, isn't it? You know, if you just let go of that animosity and show me a little kindness, you wouldn't have to worry about me manipulating you.

speaker: Shalom
content: See how alive and kicking you still are right now. You owe some of that to me, don't you think?
She looks at the man pinned to the ground.

speaker: Shalom
content: It's been a while, <color=#fb9259>Representative of the Inner Bay</color>. Or should I say... <color=#fb9259>Leader of Rustfire</color>?
Her eyes narrow in a smile. That grin instantly triggers a shiver in Donald, jolting long-buried memories to the surface as he visibly scratches at his rising goosebumps.

speaker: Donald
content: No, no, no, better we never cross paths again. Could you turn back? This humble abode of mine is ill-suited for one such as you—

speaker: Donald
content: An utter monster!

This is hardly the time for nostalgia. With a clenched fist, electrical arcs dance again. An iron basin nearby hurtles toward Shalom. She dodges, her eyes flickering with triangular flashes. A muffled grunt escapes Donald, as if he's been violently slammed to the ground.
Simultaneously, a gunshot reverberates, shattering the remaining glass of the window—a bullet penetrates Shalom's throat without resistance. Collapsing forward, she hits the ground.

Almost instantaneously, the sniper's perch is obliterated by a cascade of blue light. Struggling, Donald rushes to the sickbed, hoists the frail figure onto his shoulders, and pivots to flee. Just then, a voice resounds within him.
Run... Run as far as you can with him; if you're found again, it's all over.
female_content: Run... Run as far as you can with her; if you're found again, it's all over.

content: He wants to say something more, but immediately reminds himself that this is no time for hesitation.

speaker: Donald
content: Yikes—goosebumps! There's a ghost!
He grabs the person and vanishes like smoke. Quickly, Schorl re-enters the deranged ward, coolly evaluating Shalom's injuries.

speaker: Schorl
content: The situation outside has become abundantly clear. It appears we're entangled in some sort of spatial incantations, likely connected to the Underground.

speaker: Schorl
content: The ones who assaulted me and aimed at you are all Sinners. The damage they've inflicted will require significant time to mend. I really shouldn't have pushed you to take the front lines.

speaker: Schorl
content: Your recent behavior was dangerously excessive. Upon our return, we'll have you undergo a thorough evaluation.

speaker: Schorl
content: Exercise greater caution, X. You're not just an exceptional Hush; you're also a high-value target.

speaker: Schorl
content: If there’s even a whisper of a chance you could be compromised, I'll be forced to enact an emergency protocol to eliminate you then and there. I would much prefer to part ways with you amicably when your term of service concludes.
Shalom manages a smile, her throat wound sparing her the need to speak. Blood oozes from the gash, rapidly sapping her strength.
Yet she's pulled through this perilous moment. From this point forward, that man will undoubtedly exercise greater caution; he has the aptitude for it.
Still, it's insufficient. More safeguards must be layered onto him—safeguards that cannot raise any alarms...
female_content: Still, it's insufficient. More safeguards must be layered onto her—safeguards that cannot raise any alarms...

content: The Hush closes her eyes, focusing on the slow process of healing. Although the battlefield is out of reach for now, she cherishes this rare moment of solitude for reflection and rest.
As the pivotal moment draws near, her long-buried memories grow increasingly vivid. Every now and then, she wants to pause and savor them—let's refer to it as "dreaming," for lack of a better word.
I've been transformed into an instrument for human well-being, stripped of my desires, and eradicated of impulsivity, all in the pursuit of becoming a rational cornerstone.

My heart has been severed, transformed into an alien entity, laden with unyielding shackles, and banished to realms where humans fear to venture, exiled into the void. It is tasked with observing the Mania within the abyss far removed from reality, in search of humanity's elusive "ultimate answer."

Through the rift, I observe its agony, fury, struggles, and wails day after day. I watch as it grotesquely oppresses its own kind—yet I remain utterly unmoved. I possess no heart with which to feel pain.
...Can I even be considered human anymore?
I guess not.

I underwent an indoctrination of reason, becoming an instrument for humanity. Until the day my usefulness corrodes and I become unreliable, a new instrument will emerge to take my place. I recognize the logic and soundness of this cycle.
Any ethereal ripples of emotion, any lingering doubts, will find their most rational explanations—only to be systematically extinguished by reason.
Reason was the armor bestowed upon me.
Until another monster shattered it.
The adjutant storms out of the holding cell, nearly colliding with the Hush. Visibly shaking and emotionally wrought, she finds herself at a loss for words upon encountering her commanding officer.
The Hush wordlessly steps aside to let Nightingale pass, then enters the room with a composed smile, ready to perform its duties with precision.

speaker: Shalom
content: Good evening, I'm from the Hush unit. You can call me Shalom.

speaker: Shalom
content: My mission is to neutralize any lingering side-effects from prior operations, stabilizing your condition in the process. Rest assured, this will ease your suffering.

speaker: Shalom

Erica Villa

How many options do I have, who else can I trust, how far can the current me go...
Are there any loopholes to exploit, what should I zero in on, what will they focus on, how can I sidestep surveillance...
Being alone really feels like treading on thin ice; the odds of pulling this off are less than 1%.

The heart they stole has been rejuvenated, flourishing with each passing moment, all while they remain unaware.
Moonlight bathes Shalom, impartially casting its glow on each intertwining fate soon to alter one another.

Simultaneously, Coquelic has successfully evaded the HUSH troops that were after her and made it back to the Garden. To her dismay, she discovers her cherished purple carnation is missing. Filled with rage, she slices through the folding screen, grabs her floral sword, and finally makes a long-overdue decision.
The guard clad in black ventures into the depths of the night. Though haunted by nightmares and facing a point of no return, she's resolute in walking this path to its end.

The Fortuna theatrical troupe was formed in N.F. 106. For many years, the troupe staged shows on the outskirts of Eastside. Their performances were fairly popular with certain circles.

In N.F. 112, this small company was acquired. It has since grown into the luxurious immersive theater that it is today.

Lady Pearl, the current owner of the theater, comes from a wealthy business family. In the early years of her career, she involved herself in various business ventures and became an investor of some renown in Eastside.

Upon acquiring Fortuna, she dismissed most of the original members and conducted a complete overhaul. The theater is where it is today all thanks to her.

Nowadays, only one show is produced in Fortuna every year; it never puts on the same show twice, and a completely new group of actors is cast for each show.

In addition, the Intelligence Department has gathered information on all of Lady Pearl's past business dealings—
none of her investments, including the acquisition of Fortuna, ended up in failure.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Our intelligence department has looked into the identities of all the actors involved in that night's performance. Some of them were among the audience who came to this theater last year and went missing right afterward.

speaker: ${PlayerName}

content: Those troupe members who pose no threat will be treated properly. The theater—your most valued asset, I presume—will be kept as it is to the greatest extent possible.

speaker: ${PlayerName}

content: It's indeed a generous offer, dear. I can see your sincerity.

content: But I think my theater is worth more than you think.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Fortuna was in a real pickle when I took over. It took me quite an effort to turn this losing deal into a profitable one.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: If you really want to get me to sell the theater, you'll have to come up with a better, more... interesting offer.
Lady Pearl picks up the report on the table and flicks it with her forefinger. Her gaze is sharp and composed.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Let me teach you a negotiation trick, my dear.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: When you're trying to make a deal, sometimes it's advisable to focus less on the numbers, and more on what the potential seller's actual needs are.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Take me for example. In my eyes, Fortuna is more than just a cash cow.
Lady Pearl's tone takes a dramatic turn. The atmosphere in the room becomes menacing almost instantly, and the overwhelming aura emanating from the Sinner exerts pressure on every inch of your body.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Fortuna... What a lovely place! A place where dead dreams are revived, where a beggar gets to be rich, an old man gets to be young again... They know that they're play-acting, and yet they're fully committed to the act.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Here, in this world of make-believe, they see the versions of themselves they want to see, live out the versions of their lives they wish to live out, until their small but bright fires of desire die out...

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Their sincerity, their struggle, their passion... To me, that's the true value of Fortuna!
Just like what happened at your first meeting behind the curtain, Lady Pearl's eyes are burning brightly with anticipation, longing, and complex emotions that seem beyond your understanding.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: And I'd do anything to hold on to it.
Cracks begin to appear on the walls. The interrogation room is distorting out of shape as she speaks. Then slowly, she rises to her feet and walks over to your side.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I've seen two incomparable shows here. One was when I first set foot in this place...

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: The other was when I met you for the first time.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: If you really want to make a deal with me, well...

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Bear witness to it with me. Let's refine it together, find a perfect ending for it...

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I want to feel that surge of passion again... This is my condition.

The man is the unknown impresario of an obscure troupe. He has great talent and capable employees, but has failed to achieve financial success. The profits generated by the performances are not enough to sustain the troupe's operations.

Fortunately, something good does come out of his talent—financial support from an investor. The investor attends the theater once a month to watch a show, and leaves a sum of money after the curtain call. This is how the troupe stays afloat.

speaker: Lady Pearl

It's the second day of the monthly series of performances. The impresario is sitting in his grandiose office, surrounded by a myriad of luxuries; he looks all hot and bothered.
He rummages through the contents of the safe in frustration, the sound of rummaging punctuated only by the occasional curse.

▉Number: MBCC-S-033
▉File: Supervision Records Following the Fortuna Incident

In the aftermath of the Fortuna Incident, Sinner Lady Pearl willingly left with the Chief for the MBCC, where she was subjected to the most stringent form of restraint that the Chief's shackles can impose.

During this supervision period, the Sinner has not participated in any theater-related creative activities.

She has maintained good relations with the other Sinners in the Bureau, although, on more than one occasion, she has been caught engaging in teasing behavior that could be deemed inappropriate. When questioned, she explained that she was merely inquiring about their interest in becoming actors.
Other than that, she hasn't done anything out of line.


Judgment: The Sinner's threat level is low. In accordance with the Sinner Bail Regulations, she is hereby granted the freedom to travel outside the premises of the MBCC.

The Fortuna Theater has been taken over by the MBCC.

After the removal of the Mania contamination, the theater has been put back into use.

*Appendix:
After Lady Pearl left, the remaining members banded together to form a new troupe, and they've been performing in Fortuna.

Lady Pearl receives theater tickets from the troupe on a regular basis. Occasionally, she attends a performance in Fortuna; she arrives after the show starts and departs before the curtain call.

Chief ${PlayerName} judges this sort of behavior to be harmless and allows it to continue.

content: The curtain has fallen on the Syndicate unrest, but it's obvious to the sharp-eyed that another show, much grander in scale, awaits DisCity.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: The City Council, the West District, the FAC, and that unfathomable Paradeisos... They will all come on stage to perform.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: And DisCity will be the grandiose theater for this epic show. This time, even the audience will become part of it, whether they like it or not.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Life is but a series of stories. All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: It seems that I've already secured myself a front seat to the show.
The show ends. All the actors come on stage for the final curtain call. The audience gives them a standing ovation. The atmosphere is just as it was the night she first stepped into Fortuna.
It's an electrifying atmosphere of passion, sincerity...
Lady Pearl rises, joining the crowd in celebrating the actors.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: The new chapter I've been looking forward to is about to start. This one will have an indefinite runtime; it ends when the curtain comes down.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: I've invested everything I value in you, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Lady Pearl
content: Please, please don't let me down.
It's midday. You're hard at work.

speaker: Street Interviewer
content: Recently, a social media app called Gray Mirror has won widespread popularity, due in no small part to its distinctive voting feature, which has captured the imagination of a great many citizens.

speaker: Street Interviewer
content: However, our sources report that this voting game has caused massive user data leaks. To prevent further issues, the app is being revised, and the voting feature is temporarily suspended.
As a participant in the Gray Mirror vote, you're well aware that that hasn't been about information leakages, as the reporter lightly put it, but about a trial.
The truth of the matter is detailed in the investigation report sitting in front of you.

█File Number: FAC-M-307-V
█File Name: Gray Mirror Incident Investigation Report

*Annex I - Sinner Tracking
At the moment of the Mania Polymer's eradication, an abnormal M-value surge was detected near DisTV. The perpetrator, Bianca, is suspected to have awakened her power and become a Sinner.
As of the making of this report, the perpetrator's whereabouts remain unknown. The MBCC's search is ongoing.
No one knows where Bianca is right now. The only clue is an email under the account that has an apple as the avatar.
This is a real headache.
Argh...
Dwelling on it won't help matters. You return your attention to the news broadcast. The screen is now showing a street somewhere in Eastside.

speaker: Passerby A
content: Gray Mirror? Ah, I know all about it! I was the one who put that super popular vote up there last time. I did the public a service, if you ask me.

speaker: Passerby B
content: I've never heard of this app before. Are you doing promotions? Do you give out gifts for downloads?

speaker: Passerby C
content: TV station? Interview? Mom, mom, I'm on TV, mom...

speaker: Street Interviewer
content: It seems that life is slowly returning to normal. Let's interview one more person before we wrap up. Miss, do you have a moment?
The camera pans to a young woman. She's shaking the can of apple juice she's holding.
Me?
Sure, sure, just remember to blur my face. I do interviews, but I've never been on the other side of the camera before.
What do you want to know? There hasn't been any big news in DisCity lately. Talk about myself? Sorry, I'd like to keep that part a secret. If I must give a name—well, you can call me Apple Juice!
The camera doesn't capture the interviewee's face, but her voice sounds familiar.

speaker: Street Interviewer
content: Nice to meet you, Miss Apple Juice, I'm a reporter for DisTV's News at Noon program. Could you share your thoughts on Gray...
Someone bumps into the cameraman from behind, it seems. The camera shakes, and for a second, the interviewee's face is on camera.
Ah!
The blonde hair, the apple on her headband... It's Bianca, a wanted person on the run.
In an Eastside alley, a cat is lying in the afternoon sun, grooming itself leisurely.
The next second, Bianca nimbly jumps over the wall and lands right beside the cat. The hair of the startled feline bristles in response.

speaker: Bianca
content: Sorry, kitty. Big reporter on the run here. Sorry for disturbing you.

speaker: MBCC Member
content: She ran this way. Don't let her get away!

speaker: Bianca
content: Wow, looks like I've got some enthusiastic audience! Unfortunately, I don't have time to do interviews today; Must finish my investigation now. Peace out!
Bianca dashes around in the labyrinth of alleys. Her pursuers are soon left in the dust.

speaker: MBCC Member
content: Update: We've lost sight of the target. We're losing her!

speaker: Bianca
content: See ya, my friends. See you next time!

As Bianca, humming a merry tune, turns the corner, she almost runs smack into a pedestrian coming from the opposite direction. Bianca quickly jumps out of the way to avoid collision, only to lose her balance and start falling.
Luckily, the pedestrian catches hold of her in the nick of time.

speaker: Bianca
content: Phew! That was close. Are you all right, sir?
female_content: Phew! That was close. Are you all right, miss?

content: I'm fine. You?

speaker: Bianca
content: Hehe, no worries. Thank you so much. I was this close to kissing the ground just now.
Holding on to the kind person's arm for support, Bianca rights herself. As she does so, she catches a glimpse of the hem of the kind person's gray coat.

speaker: Bianca
content: Wow, I've got a strange sense of déjà vu. I was in a similar setting the last time I ran away: the narrow alley, the gray coat, and... Uh-oh!
It's déjà vu all right.
I hate to break it to you, but the chasing game is over. We've got you.

speaker: Bianca
content: Ouch! My arm, my arm... My dear Chief, we were comrades in arms once. Can't you be a little gentler with me?

options: Gotta make sure you're not running away again.

speaker: Bianca
content: Boohoo... Ashy, how can you be so heartless? Look here. This wound from when I jumped from the building hasn't healed yet. And now you're being so rough with me. My body is literally falling apart.
You take a look at Bianca. Her cheeks are rosy, and her voice is full of life. She's the farthest thing from a patient.
Your wound hasn't healed yet, you say?
test
test
test
test
test
test

You have in your possession a record of the attempts at catching Bianca. She jumped from a tall building and disappeared without a trace. You and your team conducted a two-week search, but to no avail.
You breathed a sigh of relief when a sighting of Bianca was reported back to you. Little did you know that what happened next would cause you endless headaches.

In total, there have been fourteen sightings. On eight occasions, Bianca was nowhere to be seen when the MBCC arrest team arrived at the scene. On the other six occasions, she was able to shake off her pursuers and escape.
The file also includes an assessment from Captain Eugene: The target is agile and cunning. Recommend an encirclement operation involving multiple units.

options: Do you have anything else to say about your "unhealed" wound?

speaker: Bianca
content: I may have exaggerated a bit. You have no sense of humor, Ashy. I ran away, because I needed to do a field investigation, so that I could continue to fight the bad guys.

speaker: Bianca
content: Believe me, I have turned over a new leaf. I swear on my honor as a reporter!
Bianca sounds deadly serious, but you don't trust her an inch.
A truly reformed character wouldn't go out of their way to avoid being captured.
Why don't you tell me what you've been up to lately? You've been busy, haven't you? You've been sighted all over Eastside, even in the vicinity of the Rust.
The Rust is a no-go area for ordinary citizens. What were you doing there?

speaker: Bianca
content: Hehe, you look so sincere. Well, I, Apple Juice—the greatest reporter in the world, am gonna reward your sincerity by answering your question honestly.

speaker: Bianca
content: I've traveled far and wide to investigate, and finally I've brought back a major case for the MBCC. The kind that, even though I was wanted, I felt the burning, uncontrollable need to investigate thoroughly.
She says "a major case," but what you hear is "more trouble."
Somehow, what you just said makes me feel uneasy.

speaker: Bianca
content: Come on, give me some credit. It's really all about fighting the villains this time. You'll definitely be interested, I promise.
Bianca takes out a thick notebook, presents it to you like a treasure, and flips it open.

speaker: Bianca
content: Please hear me out! It won't take long. Please!

She is as persistent and enthusiastic as ever. Last time, when you agreed to work with her to get her off your back, you thought she was just an ordinary reporter investigating Gray Mirror, but now you're fully aware of her obsession with achieving her goals.
If you turn her down now, who knows what crazy things she might do. You decide to accommodate her. This way, the risk will be more manageable.
All right, let's hear it.

speaker: Bianca
content: Fantastic! Here, have a look at this.

speaker: Bianca
content: The Cohen Group, an emerging company that specializes in clean energy. It has run a massive marketing campaign and successfully convinced a lot of simpletons to invest in it. This is how it has become so flush so quickly.

speaker: Bianca
content: Nothing out of the ordinary. That's what you're thinking, right? Well, thanks to my outstanding powers of observation, I noticed something fishy.
Bianca taps her finger on the open page. You look down and see the two heavily circled phrases: waste treatment plants and abnormal waste discharge.

speaker: Bianca
content: While investigating this so-called clean energy company, I found they had several undisclosed waste treatment plants. No one knew about them, not even dark web users. Why would a clean energy company hide their waste plants?

speaker: Bianca
content: So I continued with my field investigation...
She points to the part of the record that details her recent movements.

speaker: Bianca
content: My efforts paid off. I got the addresses of these mysterious plants from a source. All of them were located outside Eastside, in the Rust area.

speaker: Bianca
content: That was suspicious, super suspicious. No Eastside company would set up their factory anywhere near the Rust. It would go belly up in no time. So why did the Cohen Group build theirs in that area?
Is it because they could profit a lot more this way?

speaker: Bianca
content: Bingo! Five points to you, Ashy, but that's only half the story. Those capitalists are way worse than you'd imagine.
Is it because they were trying to cover something up?

speaker: Bianca
content: Bingo! Ten points to you, Ashy!

speaker: Bianca
content: Since I'm a regular customer, that source I mentioned earlier was kind enough to give me an extra piece of information.
Bianca's finger slides down the page until it reaches the end of the paragraph.

speaker: Bianca
content: Abnormal waste discharge. I suspected that was what they were hiding.

speaker: Bianca
content: Long story short, I, the intrepid Bianca, ventured into the dangerous Rust area on a fact-finding mission. I overcame obstacles, I evaded capture, and finally I found my way into one of their factories and caught some important evidence on film!

speaker: Bianca
content: Yes!

speaker: Bianca
content: That was the first time I had ever been to the Rust area. I didn't realize up until that point how high the concentration of Mania was in that place. An ordinary person wouldn't be able to last a few seconds there.

speaker: Bianca
content: Eh? Chief, why do you look so serious all of a sudden? Are you worried about me? Don't be fooled by my appearance. I was once placed first at the DisTV Non-dominant Hand Photography Contest.

speaker: Bianca
content: Moreover, I feel like my physical condition has further improved, though not hugely, ever since I became a Sinner. I can run faster now if I'm being chased. Cough... The infiltration was like a walk in the park to me, really.
Bianca takes out the camera that she always carries on her person and shows you the display screen.

speaker: Bianca
content: This segment is about the exterior of the plant, this one is about the machinery inside the plant, and the last one, I filmed it after I was discovered by the security posted at the entrance; I was chased all the way to the Rust.
The footage is shaky. Bianca must have been running.

At the center of the frame is a huge complex of machinery. Workers wearing protective clothing move in and out of the frame; they're transporting something, it seems. Aside from the odd location of the factory, you think to yourself, nothing seems out of the ordinary.
The camera zooms in, and you see something unusual.
The protective clothing is too thick. They don't need that level of protection over there.

speaker: Bianca
content: That's not the only fishy thing. Take a look at what they're moving. This is supposedly a waste treatment plant, but I don't think that's what the machinery is for.

speaker: Bianca
content: What are in all those boxes? And why do they need to transport so much stuff if it's just about waste treatment?
Yeah. If you were looking for a place to hide some shady business, the Rust area would be a great choice.
Normal companies wouldn't think to put their assets near the Rust, but that's exactly why the Rust area has become something of a blind spot in the authorities' vision.

Cases involving ordinary citizens are handled by the Public Security Bureau, but since the Rust area is contaminated with Mania, it makes sense for the MBCC to step in. You wonder if an on-site investigation will lead to more clues.
Bianca, where this factory is located?
You look up. Bianca looks at you with a "gotcha" expression on her face.

speaker: Bianca
content: So you're interested? Told you that I wouldn't lie to you. This is gonna be a mega case, the kind that is sure to make the headlines!
Don't change the subject. Are you really expecting me to forget the fact that you went to the Rust area without permission?

speaker: Bianca
content: Hehe, I just did what any upstanding reporter would do. It's called an undercover investigation.

speaker: Bianca
content: Anyway, there's a lead now. The next step is to find incriminating evidence and bring those guys to justice.

speaker: Bianca
content: This kind of thing normally falls within the jurisdiction of the Public Security Bureau, but I wonder if, um, there's a more low-key, clever solution.
For a moment, you're inwardly amazed at Bianca's circumspection, but that sentiment quickly goes away when you see the cheesy grin on her face.

speaker: Bianca
content: My kindest Ashy, my dearest Chief...

speaker: Bianca
content: Would you like to join me in investigating this case, so that we can expose and punish the bad guys?
Let's get one thing perfectly clear. The MBCC is obligated to supervise your actions.

As a main instigator of the Gray Mirror voting incident, Bianca should be prosecuted by the Public Security Bureau. However, as a Sinner, she is now under MBCC's custody. Per MBCC rules, Bianca is prohibited from leaving the premises until her threat level decreases significantly.

speaker: Bianca
content: All I need is your approval and a computer with internet access. I promise I won't cause any trouble.
Really?

speaker: Bianca
content: Of course, it would be even better if you'd allow me to go outside, my dear Chief.

speaker: Bianca
content: I didn't get to visit the other waste treatment plants the first time around. So if you'd allow me to go out there to investigate, I could probably dig up more clues, earth-shattering clues.
I remember you saying the exact same thing to me once, back when you were investigating Gray Mirror.

speaker: Bianca
content: Did I? Hehe, I'm a different person now. I've seen the error of my ways, and I won't make the same mistakes again.
Bianca clears her throat, straightening her shoulders before continuing with her little speech.

speaker: Bianca
content: You're right, Chief; one must take responsibility for the consequences of their actions. I really have changed, and the situation is different this time. We have to stop those criminals. If we don't, it's likely that there will be dire consequences.

speaker: Bianca
content: So can you let me off this time, please? Give me a chance to redeem myself?
Bianca looks at you with a pitiful and earnest expression on her face.

The two of you met because of the Gray Mirror incident. Although you haven't spent much time with her, you're well aware of her all-consuming passion for upholding justice and exposing wrongdoers. Still, it's hard to see past the fact that she almost turned the city upside down once.
You still have doubts about whether Bianca's purpose in pursuing this investigation is as pure as she's making it out to be.

speaker: Bianca
content: What do you say, ${PlayerName}? Chief... Ashy... When it's all done, I'd treat you to apple juice. Ten cans of apple juice... Thirty... One hundred!
You know you should turn her down. But she did have a point; this is a good opportunity.
Will this reporter who went astray choose the old path again? You decide to join her in the investigation and find the answer to this question in the process.
Okay, I'll go with you.

speaker: Bianca
content: Yay! You're fantastic, Ashy! You're the best chief in the world!

speaker: Bianca
content: And you don't have to worry about a thing. I'll be on my best behavior this time, and I'll obey your commands to the letter.
The MBCC has a whole set of rules in place regarding Sinners doing fieldwork. I'll accompany you, but you still have to follow these rules.
Rule No.1: Keep a low profile. Rule No.2: Do not use abilities without permission. Rule No.3: Do not act alone. That's basically it.

speaker: Bianca
content: Hehe, got it. Going incognito, that's what we reporters are good at.
Grinning, Bianca pats her own chest, as if to say "You can count on me." You doubt if she truly understands what it means to stay low-key.

speaker: Bianca
content: Investigation 2.0! After a long hiatus, Defender of Justice Ashy and Super Apple Bianca have joined hands once again for another adventure.

speaker: Bianca
content: No time to waste. Let's go!
Morghan and Ethan crane their necks to take another look at the conspicuously unoccupied desk in the office. It used to be Bianca's cubicle, but now it's used as storage space.

speaker: Ethan
content: Have you heard from her?

speaker: Morghan
content: No. Her dismissal was very sudden. She didn't even take the apple-themed blind boxes on her desk with her when she left. I was the one who put them away.
Morghan and Ethan exchange glances and sigh.

speaker: Morghan
content: On the bright side, knowing Bianca, a restless spirit to the core, maybe we'll see her on the news soon...

speaker: Bianca
content: Hmmm...

speaker: Bianca
content: I'm a reporter, skilled and polite... I capture bad guys, left and right, and soon there will be no villains in sight!
Ahhh!
You're bone-tired when the destination is close.

speaker: Bianca
content: Tired again? Hang in there, Chief. We're almost there. News waits for no one.
As you adjust your breathing, you glance over at Bianca. She is walking in a quick light step while humming a tune, looking as if she doesn't have a care in the world.

options: You still remember our objective, right?

speaker: Bianca
content: Keep a low profile. Don't use abilities without permission. Don't act alone.

speaker: Bianca
content: Sneak into the factory, uncover its dark secrets, and reveal them to the world. Wow, that sounds really cool!

speaker: Bianca
content: Look, we've arrived. That's one of the other factories kept hidden by Cohen.
You look up at the factory ahead, its towering walls hiding the structures inside from view. You can hear the muffled sound of heavy machinery running.
You see no outlets from the outside, and every entrance is heavily guarded. The factory looks to you like an impregnable bastion.

options: How did you get in last time?

speaker: Bianca
content: Easy. Look over there. Under that wall, there is a small hole, just big enough for one person to squeeze through. I found it by accident last time.

speaker: Bianca
content: What's the matter? You look annoyed. Relax! I was just messing with you. I'm Eastside's number one reporter. I know how to get into places.
Like what?

speaker: Bianca
content: Under the right circumstances, the most dangerous place can be the safest place. The same logic applies to infiltration operations. As long as you know how to think outside the box, any enemy that stands in your way can be easily dealt with.

speaker: Bianca
content: We'll go straight in, through the main entrance!
You and Bianca are holed up in a confined space crammed with God knows what.
Moreover, the box that holds the two of you vibrates at a rhythmic pace. The box is in transit, you're sure.
Is this what you meant by going in through the main entrance?

speaker: Bianca
content: Hehe...

speaker: Bianca
content: We're hiding in a box, and the box will be carried in through the main entrance. Technically, I wasn't wrong.
The vibration stops, and you hear the sound of a forklift. Then you feel a sudden sense of weightlessness. The transportation is over, and you're being unloaded.

speaker: Puzzled Worker
content: Why does today's cargo feel so much heavier than usual? Did they change the supplier?
The voice draws near. You fear that its owner is going to open the box and examine the contents, but that doesn't happen. Another voice pipes up.

speaker: Trouble-averse Worker
content: Leave it be! Let's hurry up and get this over with. I don't want to stay in this dump a minute longer than necessary.
After a while, you can no longer hear the two voices outside. You press your ear against the box, and the only sound is the hum of machinery.
We can get out now.

speaker: Bianca
content: All right, it's my turn to shine! Step back from this spot and cover your ears. Yes, yes... Be careful not to get hurt.
It's too dark to see what exactly Bianca is doing, but you seem to hear something being pressed against the inside of the box.
Bang!

speaker: Bianca
content: Hooray! Infiltration successful!
The box has been broken open. You turn to Bianca. She's holding the weapon responsible for the destruction of the box—the camera she always carries.
Do not use abilities without permission. What part of this sentence don't you understand?

speaker: Bianca
content: Hahaha... It's not like we're shooting a James Bond movie. No need to complicate things. Special times call for special measures, don't you think? Blasting it was just quick and quiet!

speaker: Bianca
content: You angry with me again, Chief? You may have your reason, but can we just finish our investigation first?
Bianca climbs out of the box first. She holds out her hand with a grin on her face.
Fine, we'll settle the score when this is all done. You caused quite a commotion just now. Let's hurry up and complete our investigation before the patrol arrives.
The patrol won't circle back to where the two of you are for another half an hour. That should be enough time to investigate the place.

You look around. The interior of the factory has a simpler layout than you expected. Other than some massive pieces of machinery and the large boxes stacked in the corners, there isn't much else to see. Strangely, at this moment, no one is here but you and Bianca.
How come there is no one on duty here? The workers you've seen so far are either guards posted at the entrances or movers wearing thick protective clothing who never stay long inside.

As you suspected, the concentration of Mania here is not particularly high—probably because the Rust is still some distance away, and certainly not high enough to warrant the wearing of protective clothing that thick.
Why is it that they're so reluctant to linger in the workshop, even though they're adequately protected?
There must be something else hidden in the room. Bianca, let's go over there and check.
Bianca?
You turn your head to look at Bianca. She's squatting beside the box you just hid in, filming the contents.

speaker: Bianca
content: I didn't really see what was in it when I got inside. I only knew it was something shiny. And sure enough...
When Bianca turns her head, you see that she's wearing an uncharacteristically serious expression.

speaker: Bianca
content: It's <color=#fb9259>guns</color>.

speaker: Bianca
content: Semi-finished guns, to be precise. Based on what little knowledge I have of weapons, I think the ammo-loading part has been modified; these guns don't use bullets, at least not ordinary bullets.

speaker: Bianca
content: Haha, now I see why they set up the factory in such a dangerous place. The Public Security Bureau would have a field day if they found out what they're up to.

speaker: Bianca
content: This is no waste treatment plant. It's an illegal factory for weapon manufacturing!

speaker: Bianca
content: Still, that doesn't answer everything. The mysterious objects, semi-finished guns, peculiar location... The Mania concentration in the Rust area is quite high, not ideal for any arms dealer. There must be something more for them to set up business here.

options: Maybe they have other game plans.

content: Maybe they need something from the Rust? But besides Mania, there's nothing but the contaminated—
You don't finish the sentence. You and Bianca lock eyes, as realization dawns.

speaker: Bianca
content: Let's go check the assembly line. I bet we can find evidence there.
Bianca leaps to her feet, grabs your hand, and pulls you along to a roaring piece of machinery that is busy turning a large number of semi-finished products into deadly weapons.
Bianca puts her camera to use. The glass tubes of the finished products are filled with a repulsive-looking crimson fluid. It's Mania extract.

speaker: Bianca
content: Ashy, we've struck gold.

speaker: Bianca
content: They're making Mania weapons!

speaker: Security Guard
content: Hey! Who's there?
The beam of a flashlight shoots into the workshop as a security guard walks in, a suspicious look on the face.

speaker: Security Guard
content: Weird. I could have sworn I heard someone talking just now. Was I mistaken?
The light beam moves between the boxes and machines. You and Bianca are wedged in a narrow nook where the light can't reach, not making a sound.
The security guard moves around. You and Bianca start mouthing messages to each other while gesturing, hoping against hope that you've known each other well enough to get the messages across.

speaker: Bianca
content: (Someone's coming! What do we do?)
The footsteps are getting closer, and soon the light will reach your hiding spot.
(There's no way out. If this investigation fails, they'll know that someone is onto them.)
(We must bring the evidence out.)

speaker: Bianca
content: (Must what? Break it now?)
(WE MUST BRING IT OUT.)

speaker: Bianca
content: (Break it out? No prob. On the count of three. One, two—)
(Wait a second, Bianca!)

speaker: Bianca
content: Three! Run!
Bianca grabs hold of you. The two of you dash out of the hiding spot, heading for the exit.

speaker: Security Guard
content: What the heck! Intruders! Close the gates! Quick!
The iron gates slowly close. You run as fast as you can, but the gates fully close before you reach them.

speaker: Bianca
content: Won't that break the rules?
Special times call for special measures! Aim for the gates and fire!

speaker: Bianca
content: Hehe, copy that!

speaker: Bianca
content: Here we go, obstacles in our way! Look over here and say cheese!
You see something flash on the edge of your vision. And then a beam of intense light hits the gates and blows a hole in them.
You and Bianca bolt into the open air, shake off the pursuers, and head back to the urban area. Bianca wastes no time in posting your findings on the internet.

[Ongoing Exposure! Source of Eastside Mania, leaked video about Cohen Group factory! To be deleted in 24 hours!] 
Poster: Extra-Rich Apple Juice 2.0
Views: 20k+ Comments: 1086
Bianca immerses herself in the world of cyberspace, as if what she sent out isn't just a post, but a declaration of war on the forces of darkness in the entire DisCity.

speaker: Bianca
content: The topic is gaining momentum. Every internet forum is talking about it now. Let's wait some more, and then we'll get the mainstream media involved; before too long, there will be an official statement denouncing this evil company, and that will be the final nail in their coffin.

speaker: Bianca
content: Hehe, what a perfect plan. I truly am the best reporter in the MBCC.
When the chilled aluminum can touches her cheek, Bianca gives a shiver, startled.

speaker: Bianca
content: W-what's that? W-why is it so cold? Is it made of metal? P-please don't do this. Except for that one accident, I-I've never caused serious harm to anybody. Chief, I-I don't deserve such severe punishment.

speaker: Bianca
content: Phew, it's just apple juice.
Never thought a can of apple juice could scare you so.
Bianca, grinning, takes the proffered apple juice, pulls the tab, and raises the can to clink it against yours.

speaker: Bianca
content: To the great victory of good over evil, and to the upcoming full exposure of those scum. Cheers!

You take a sip of your fizzy drink. As you swallow, you feel that familiar burning sensation at the back of your throat. Not wanting to make a fool of yourself again, you drink slowly this time around.
The two of you are perched on the highest point of the main MBCC building. You can see Eastside in the distance; its illuminated areas look bright and shiny, a sharp contrast to the unlit areas.

speaker: Bianca
content: Yahoo, apple juice sure is an invaluable treasure, a symbol of truth, the patron saint of all reporters...

speaker: Bianca
content: Sigh... Too bad that what I truly want, I can't attain through Gray Mirror or the apple juice deity...
Bianca sits with her knees drawn up to her chest and her head down, muttering away, more a sulking child than a legendary reporter.
This may be a good opportunity to learn how she really feels inside.

options: Bianca, what do you truly want?

speaker: Bianca
content: What do I want? Hah... Too many to count.

speaker: Bianca
content: I want to try the new flavor of apple juice in that convenience store; I want to buy the latest apple-themed blind box just released in Eastside; I want clues to come to me without me running around all day to do interviews...

speaker: Bianca
content: I want everything to go as smoothly as I hope; I want to catch all the bad guys, to see them punished by Super Apple...

speaker: Bianca
content: I want my reports to circulate as widely as possible. I want them not to be ignored like they used to be.

speaker: Bianca
content: And...
