I hear your boss lost a precious little mouse recently? What a coincidence—I picked up a dusty little thing during a stroll in WhiteSands—
She tilts her head and dangles a standard-issue MBCC notebook in her hand.
How about it? Why don't you take me back for a little chat with your boss?
Well, well, Chief... you've finally come to see me.
She lounges casually in the interrogation chair with a playful smirk, completely at ease.
Perched on her shoulder is a little lizard that seems oddly out-of-place in this setting. When you enter, the lizard even gives you a little nod, as if to say hello.
I heard you're quite the busy bee—thought you'd keep me waiting for a day or two. But you came so soon! I haven't even finished my tour of the Bureau.

speaker: Chief
content: You wanted to have a chat with me? Let's begin.
You ignore her banter and take a seat directly across from her. Unfazed, she narrows her eyes with a smile and cuts to the chase.

speaker: Korryn
content: I see you've done your homework on me, so I'll cut to the chase. Tell me, Chief, does this look familiar?
Korryn leans forward, and with a flick of her wrist, slides a notebook across the table to you.
It's a standard-issue notebook with a dark cover bearing the MBCC logo—the kind every Bureau employee carries.

speaker: Korryn
content: Lean in and take a closer look...
You remain silent, so Korryn leans in closer. She flips to the first page, which is filled with messy handwriting and a sketch of a snarling little mouse—you recognize it immediately as Hella's work.
She taps the paper, a hint of menace in her voice.

speaker: Korryn
content: Get it now, Chief? Your precious Hella is in my hands—and this is the proof.

speaker: Korryn
content: I wanted to bring something more convincing, but she wasn't very cooperative. I didn't want to hurt her, so I just helped myself to some of her belongings.

speaker: Korryn
content: Well? Believe me now?

speaker: Chief
content: You're right, this is Hella's handwriting.
You calmly close the notebook and, under Korryn's puzzled gaze, activate the comms device beside you.

speaker: Chief
content: Please bring in some drinks and refreshments—from the VIP menu please, with both hot and cold beverages. As for the snacks and fruit...

speaker: Chief
content: Do you have any dietary restrictions, Miss Korryn?
You look up at Korryn, making a show of the MBCC's legendary hospitality. She plays along, feigning surprise.

speaker: Korryn
content: My, my, Chief, what's this about? Trying to bribe me?

speaker: Chief
content: Not at all. I just want to resolve this situation as peacefully as possible.
After arranging everything as requested, you end the call. The door opens, and a young clerk enters with drinks and refreshments.

speaker: Chief
content: You have Hella, and I'm concerned for her safety. I don't want to put her at risk by provoking you... or any accomplices you might have.

speaker: Chief
content: Let's be frank. Where is Hella? And what do you want?
Instead of answering your questions, Korryn helps herself to some snacks without hesitation.

speaker: Korryn
content: Heh, relax, Chief. This is a solo job—no accomplices involved.

speaker: Korryn
content: WhiteSands has been pretty rough lately, and jobs are scarce. I have even less money than morals right now—no way I'd split the loot with anyone else.

speaker: Korryn
content: No need to worry too much. I'm not some violent thug—I'm just in it for the money. I don't want to hurt anyone. As long as...
Korryn wipes the crumbs from her lips and holds up four fingers.

speaker: Korryn
content: If you can give me this number—I promise, your precious Hella will be home first thing tomorrow morning!
Forty thousand? Four hundred thousand? Four million? Unable to decipher the bounty hunter's code, you furrow your brow in confusion.

options: How much are you asking for?

speaker: Korryn
content: No, no, no—not DisCoins. What I want is <color=#fb9259>Hypercubes</color>.
She presses her four fingers together and taps them lightly on the notebook in front of you. Her voice rings out as sharp and clear as the tapping sound.

speaker: Korryn
content: Hypercubes are the good stuff. Those Nirvana bigshots keep 'em locked up tight—we can't even get near their routes without getting shot. We all want to get our hands on some. And now I have the perfect opportunity!
Indeed, Hypercubes are hard currency in WhiteSands—high value, high demand, and low supply... The perfect target for extortion.
But even with your authority, there's no way to get such a massive amount of Hypercubes immediately.

speaker: Korryn
content: That's right. This many Hypercubes.
As she repeats your words, Korryn leans in even closer across the table.

speaker: Korryn
content: I've done my research. As Chief, getting this number of Hypercubes shouldn't be too hard.

speaker: Korryn
content: Think of it as a safekeeping fee for Little Hella. A small price to pay for her safe return—quite a bargain, really.
A bargain? You're not so sure about that. But for Hella's sake, it looks like you'll have to dig into your personal funds this time.
You lower your head and exhale deeply before looking back up at her.

options: Very well. I accept your terms.

speaker: Chief
content: I don't care how, but Hella must be back at the MBCC tomorrow morning, safe and sound.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh, perfect! As decisive as I'd expect from the MBCC Chief. It's a deal!
Your acquiescence clearly pleases Korryn. She relaxes back into her chair.

speaker: Korryn
content: Didn't you read my file already, Chief? I, Korryn, am famous for being honest and efficient in all my dealings!

speaker: Korryn
content: By the way, you want my contact info? For any future kidnapping requests—or other services! Call me and I'll give you a discount.

speaker: Chief
content: Let's focus on the present matter.
You raise one hand to shush her and respond to messages on your comms device with the other.

speaker: Chief
content: The Hypercubes have been secured and are on their way. Remember, if you go back on your word—

speaker: Korryn
content: If I break my word, may lightning strike me down and my name be forever erased from WhiteSands! Don't worry, I know the rules of the game. Your little mouse will be returned without a hair out of place.
Just as Korryn finishes speaking, footsteps echo from beyond the door. Her payment has arrived.
Instead of getting up, she briefly glances at the door before turning her attention back to you. Her lizard matches her piercing gaze.

speaker: Korryn
content: One, two, three... How interesting. Chief, does the Bureau always get heavily armored personnel to deliver Hypercubes?

options: Well, it's valuable cargo after all.

speaker: Chief
content: Hypercubes are a crucial military resource, so it's normal for the FAC to handle their transport. And as it happens, I've just asked them for a small favor...

speaker: Chief
content: ...to apprehend Sinner Korryn, proceed to WhiteSands, and recover our MBCC colleague.
The footsteps grow louder. With the deal off, the squad members outside no longer need to conceal their presence.
In mere seconds, the squad will have the interrogation room completely surrounded and the only exit secured. Korryn will have nowhere to run.
The woman sighs and lazily raises her hand.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh dear, I really didn't want to resort to this, but you leave me no choice...

speaker: Korryn
content: Come, say hello to Sheriff!
Before she finishes her sentence, Korryn suddenly flings her arm upward—her green lizard leaps high into the air, lunging straight for your face!
The green lizard opens its mouth, and its slender tongue flicks out a knuckle-sized smoke bomb. The device clatters to the floor, releasing thick plumes of smoke.
BANG! The security team reaches the door and bursts in.
You cover your nose and mouth with one hand while reaching out with the other, trying to grab something—anything—but Korryn's silhouette flips backward and vanishes into the smoke.

speaker: Eugene
content: Locate the Chief! Apprehend the Sinner!

The smoke continues to spread until it fills the entire interrogation room. Your vision is completely obscured by thick white clouds. You can hear the security team's footsteps nearby, but can't pinpoint their location.
You take a few steps backward, trying to find a wall for orientation, but instead bump into a warm body.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh... dear... Chief—
Her voice comes from behind as the cold barrel of a gun presses against the nape of your neck. The Mania radiating from her paralyzes your body, leaving you completely immobile.

speaker: Korryn
content: How does it feel to have your own trap backfire?
Korryn reaches out to retrieve her little Sheriff from your shoulder.

speaker: Korryn
content: I know, hiding a smoke bomb in my lizard's mouth to slip past your security check was a bit unscrupulous, but...

speaker: Korryn
content: If you hadn't broken our deal first and tried to arrest me, I wouldn't have had to resort to such an underhanded trick, right?

speaker: Korryn
content: Now that negotiations have fallen through, I'm afraid your little mouse belongs to me!
The gun barrel moves away from your neck as Korryn shoves you forward.

speaker: Eugene
content: Chief!
Eugene quickly pulls you behind him. On the other side, two guards collapse to the ground simultaneously as Korryn's figure vanishes down the far end of the corridor.

speaker: Eugene
content: The reinforcements from Adjutant Nightingale will be here any moment. If we seal off the exits now, we can still catch her!

speaker: Chief
content: No... stand down. Let her go.
You reach down to retrieve several of the scattered files at your feet.
These are the investigation files you didn't get to use yet—the MBCC's complete dossier on Korryn. A lone bounty hunter, WhiteSands Market, several untraceable hideouts...
And one key name: <color=#fb9259>Tuco</color>.
You circle several locations from the files in red on the WhiteSands map. Though scattered, they form a rough circular pattern—too perfect to be coincidence.

speaker: Chief
content: She wouldn't have dared come here without an escape plan ready.
You circle an empty spot in red, then hand the map to the security officer beside you.

speaker: Chief
content: I need information on every city, town, and village in this area. Her accomplices are somewhere out there, and they've most likely got Hella with them.

speaker: Chief
content: And one more thing—I need you to go to WhiteSands Market...
[WhiteSands Market]
The MBCC has issued a new bounty notice: The infamous Tuco swindlers have been apprehended, and the MBCC is now seeking the individual responsible for bringing them to justice.
—Within two hours, the news had spread throughout all the major markets on the outskirts of WhiteSands.

speaker: Merchant A
content: Huh? Tuco? What's Tuco? Has anyone been to that town before?

speaker: Merchant B
content: Ha! Justice is finally served!

speaker: Merchant B
content: Those heartless swindlers finally messed with the wrong people. Serves them right to get caught!

speaker: Merchant A
content: Oh? You know about Tuco? Don't tell me you're the one who turned them in! The notice mentions a big reward!
The merchants continue their hushed discussion, unaware that someone has been listening to them for quite some time.

speaker: Korryn
content: Excuse me, mind if I take a look at that bounty notice?

speaker: Merchant B
content: Oh... oh, sure, here you go—
Caught off guard by her sudden approach, the merchant hands over the crumpled bounty notice with slight hesitation.
A contact number and address is listed at the bottom of the page. The deadline is... today.
[Black Screen]
The security on the MBCC sand ship is more lax than expected. Korryn slips past the patrol units almost effortlessly, successfully infiltrating the lower deck.
Under the cover of the shadows along the wall, she silently approaches the Power Core Control Room and she expertly picks the locked door with a twisted wire.

Breaking just one thing here would immobilize the entire ship. Whether they replace the ship or repair it, either option would give her enough time to escape deep into WhiteSands with the whole Tuco gang.

speaker: Korryn
content: ...Heh, those lockpicking skills are really paying off.
With a silent smirk, Korryn quietly turns the handle and leaps into the darkened room—
A net drops from above as combat units instantly surround her with their weapons aimed.
Korryn looks up to find countless guns pointed at her. Behind the expressionless soldiers, a familiar figure sits beside the eerily glowing blue power core. She lets out a chuckle.

speaker: Korryn
content: Well, well... so this is where you've been waiting for me?

speaker: Korryn
content: Planting false intel, clearing out the guards... Tsk tsk, you crafty adults are so different from the kids. Little Hella is much more endearing than a sly fox like you!
Opportunities always work both ways.
You eye Korryn as she raises her hands in surrender, then rise and walk towards her.

speaker: Chief
content: It's been a while. Shall we continue our interrupted conversation?

speaker: Chief
content: —My dear defeated opponent.

Four hours after Korryn's capture
In front of the Security Bureau at WhiteSands Market
A group of desert bandits lie bound and tied on the ground outside the assembly hall. The jarring scene draws everyone's attention.
You stand near your captives as the clerk beside you exclaims in amazement.

speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
content: Thank you for your patience, Chief. We've finished processing all the suspects you brought in—
The Security Bureau clerk shuffles through the papers, organizing all the checked-off bounty notices.

speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
content: Everyone who tried to catch these cunning, stealthy bandits complained that they're slipperier than eels. You're the first one to not only find their hideout, but catch them all in one sweep!

speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
content: As expected of the MBCC Chief! You really are remarkable!
I just happened to be passing by. It was no trouble at all.
Happened to be passing by? No trouble at all?
You look across the square and see Korryn, who is under task force surveillance, next to the tied-up desert bandits. Catching your eye, she grins and waves.
—An hour and a half ago, she wore that exact same smile.

speaker: Korryn
content: This is the place—head west, that's definitely the right way—
With one hand cuffed to the armrest, Korryn gestures dramatically with the other, pointing out directions for the sand ship.

speaker: Korryn
content: Gimme another chance, Chief! My brain is just a bit fuzzy. With a few more tries, I'll definitely figure out which way is right!
I've already given you two chances.
Your eyes drift to a cracked window of the sand ship, its once-pristine exterior now covered in scratches.
The first time, you led us to a desert temple full of booby traps. The second time, you led us straight into a massive pit of quicksand.
Why don't you save us both time and tell me what you've got planned this time?
Korryn leans back, resting her chin in her hand with a smile that spells nothing but trouble.

speaker: Korryn
content: Aww, but where's the fun in spoiling the surprise?

speaker: Korryn
content: We're almost there, Chief. You'll find out soon enough!
Before she can finish speaking, the sand ship's cabin door bursts open.

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: Chief! We've been led to a desert bandit hideout. They're attacking us from three directions!

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: If we retreat the way we came, we could get surrounded. Awaiting your orders, Chief!
You turn to Korryn, who moves her hand from her cheek to flash you a victory sign.
What are you going to do about it? Her voice seems to taunt in your ear. You turn to the task force member, ignoring her provocation.
Well, we're here now. Let's take care of them quickly.
And—assign someone to guard Korryn. Don't let her slip away. Everyone else, move to engage!

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: ...Chief, Korryn says she just remembered another location.

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: This... this is the <color=#fb9259>fourth Tuco location</color> she's given us, we...
You look at the task force agent before you. You remember him well—a promising young officer, both capable and dependable, who's always kept his weapons and gear polished to perfection.
Now his pants are torn, and his face and hair are caked with sand. He hides his face behind his armor, clearly too embarrassed to speak.

options: You've been through a lot today.

content: Let's move out. Bring Korryn—we'll discuss this further back on the ship.
As you lead the task force back toward the sand ship, an enthusiastic security clerk calls out after you.

speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
content: Thank you for dealing with the bandits! Be careful on your journey—WhiteSands has been having unusual weather lately, with lots of sandstorms—
The officer's voice fades into the distance, drowned out by the bustling sounds of the market.

Your group keeps to one side of the road. The market isn't crowded today, so you're not worried about getting separated by the crowd. But as you pass an alley, a small dark figure suddenly darts out and crashes right into you.
Ow! That hurts!
After crying out in pain, the scrawny, grimacing child tumbles to the ground with a thud, clutching his head.

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: Is that... a child?
A task force agent, who had instinctively drawn his weapon, puts it away and reaches down to help the fallen child up.
The child silently pushes away the helping hand and makes a dash for the crowd. Before anyone else can react, you quickly reach out and grab his arm.

speaker: Gaunt Child
content: Let go! Y-you... let go of me!
As the task force agent watches in surprise, your wallet slips out from the child's hand and drops to the ground.
I won't turn you in to the authorities, but I need you to return what you've taken. I still need 'em.

speaker: Gaunt Child
content: I'm sorry! Th-this is my first time stealing, I have younger siblings who are starving... I'm sorry! Please let me go, I'll never do it again, I—
A knowing voice drifts in, cutting off the child's sobbing.

speaker: Korryn
content: Ah... the classic WhiteSands pickpocket routine—sick mother, drunk father, starving siblings, and a poor broken soul...

speaker: Korryn
content: I used the exact same story when I got caught as a kid. Come on, haven't you folks updated your script in all these years?
The boy freezes as his lie is exposed, then begins to struggle even more desperately.
Korryn bends down to pick up your wallet, but instead of returning it to you, she dangles it teasingly in front of the boy.

speaker: Korryn
content: So, Chief, what should we do with them? This little rascal's not even worth putting on a wanted poster. Since we can't get a bounty, maybe we should find a nice quiet spot to give him a good beating, then toss him out in WhiteSands to teach him a lesson—
As Korryn's threats grow more and more outrageous, the boy becomes truly terrified at the thought of being fed to sandworms. His brave facade crumbles into real tears.
You let out a sigh and put an end to Korryn's little performance by taking your wallet from her hands.

options: I believe this wallet belongs to me.

content: You remove your ID and magnetic cards from the side pocket, close the wallet, and hand it back to the child—along with all the cash inside.

speaker: Gaunt Child
content: Huh? W-what are you...?
The tears in the boy's eyes are frozen in disbelief. Too stunned to speak, he can only stare at you in bewilderment.
Whether or not you're telling the truth, stealing is wrong. But I hope that once you're able to support yourself, you'll choose a more honorable—and safer—way of living. Otherwise...
You point to the nonchalant woman standing beside you.
If you get caught again, you might end up like her—getting dragged around town for everyone to see.
Go. This money should keep you fed for a while.
The boy, tears still on his face, thanks you profusely. As he turns to leave, Korryn pats his shoulder and, lowering her voice, discreetly slips a bullet into his pocket.

speaker: Korryn
content: Take this and find a bearded man called Andrei at the far east end of the market.

speaker: Korryn
content: Tell him Korryn sent you. He'll take you in—the work's tough, but at least you'll get fed... Oh, and sweetie? You really need to work on those fake tears. That performance was painful to watch...
The task force agent glances at you, but you shake your head. Korryn exchanges another few words with the child before standing up to bid him farewell.

speaker: Korryn
content: Sorry to keep you waiting, Chief. Shall we head back to the ship?

options: Who is this bearded man Andrei?

speaker: Korryn
content: Hmm? Oh, he's an old business partner of mine who later quit to run a kebab stall. He still deals in secondhand intel now and then... That kid's got guts though. He'll go places.
...Doesn't sound like the most legitimate line of work.
Korryn lets out a quiet chuckle but says nothing more. She turns to walk with you toward the approaching sand ship.
Set course back to the main WhiteSands route.
Before Korryn can say anything, you enter the cabin and issue the command.
Korryn is escorted back to her seat, where she crosses her legs and sits with the enthusiasm of a player returning to the game table.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh good, round after round we go. Adventure games are my favorite!

speaker: Korryn
content: So Chief, remember that new address I gave you? I'd be happy to repeat it if need be!
You silently take the seat across from her and look into her eyes.
Before we continue this tedious adventure game of yours, I have a question.

options: Korryn, what are you really after?

content: The woman falters for a moment before letting out a scornful laugh.

speaker: Korryn
content: Money, of course! You didn't figure that out from my interrogation? Why else would I kidnap someone?
Yes, that's one of the things you're after—but it's not your only goal.

A typical kidnapper would have given up Hella's location and fled by now. But she shows no urgency, nothing like you'd expect from someone in her position. Instead, she's been using Hella's whereabouts as bait, sending you on a wild goose chase through WhiteSands.
Is she after the ransom she never received? No—your investigation tells you she's after far more than that.

I checked the detention records. Over the past 6 months, you've turned in 7 desert bandits—all associates of that same group we just ran into. They want vengeance on you and your partners, swearing to beat up anyone connected to you.
And then there's the temple and the quicksand... These were all targets you had your eye on.
You've been using the MBCC's forces to clear the path for you and Tuco.
I may not see your endgame or know what you're planning... Maybe you're even using Hella as bait to trick me. But none of that matters...
If you're just using me, fine—but leave Hella out of this!
Korryn, what is Tuco really planning?!
The woman in the hat pauses, reassessing you with a long look. Something new flickers in her eyes.

speaker: Korryn
content: <size=25>Heh... little mouse, your precious Chief is much sharper than you...</size>
Her voice is too soft for you to hear.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh, just lamenting. Our big hero wants to end the show before we even reach Act Two.

speaker: Korryn
content: Let me clarify two things. First, yes, I did want to get close to you, but Tuco has nothing to do with it. They don't know I'm here, and they don't know I caught your little mouse. They're completely uninvolved.

speaker: Korryn
content: Second, your deductions are mostly right, but there's one detail you got wrong...
The woman tilts up her hat brim with a defiant smirk.

speaker: Korryn
content: Who said I wasn't looking for a chance to escape?
(Transition, shaking effect, white out)

Suddenly, the cabin floor shakes violently and tilts—the sand ship must have hit something. In the ensuing chaos, Korryn grabs a chair and hurls it at the already-cracked window, then leaps through the shower of glass shards.
There's no time to weigh your options. Without a second thought, you launch yourself through the window after her—
The momentum of your fall sends you colliding with Korryn.
Tangled together, you two tumble and roll down the sand dune until a shallow depression brings you to a stop.

speaker: Korryn
content: Ahhh... That hurts...
Korryn pushes herself up from the sand, wincing as she caresses where you collided with her.
Behind you, the damaged, out-of-control sand ship carves a long trail through the desert as it speeds away into the distance.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh, my dear Chief! If I jump out of a sand ship, you'll jump out of one too?!

speaker: Korryn
content: If you're dead set on chasing me, at least use some common sense! When you jump onto a rocky sand dune, you need to protect your head. If you crack your skull open, your little mouse will never let me hear the end of it...
The bounty hunter's words trail off. A fierce wind picks up, and you both instinctively turn to look.

Less than a hundred meters away, a massive sandstorm devours the horizon, turning everything into a hazy amber void. Through the murky tempest, huge otherworldly shapes writhe in and out of view, their shrieks slicing through the wind.

options: Is this... the Tide of Ashes?

speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
content: Thank you for dealing with the bandits! Be careful on your journey—WhiteSands has been having unusual weather lately, with lots of sandstorms and sand beast attacks—
This Tide of Ashes is moving faster, reaching further, and towering higher than any you've seen before.
Worst of all... it's so fast. It appeared without a sound, then closed in almost instantly.

speaker: Korryn
content: —Quit dawdling! Run!
The wind erases your footprints the moment they form. Through the amber haze, fanged beasts howl as they lunge for your clothes.
Korryn grips your hand with one hand while firing her rifle with the other to drive back the creatures.
Through the wall of swirling sand, you vaguely make out the silhouette of a building ahead.
To the left—cough... the left! We can take cover over there!
The howling wind thrusts sand into your mouth when you try to speak. Unable to talk, you and Korryn silently feel your way toward the shelter.
The wind grows stronger by the second. Korryn's gunfire becomes more frequent, and the creatures' shrieks are practically next to your ear... then, finally, your hand touches the door of the shelter.
You shove the door open and dive inside, pulling Korryn along with you.
The raging storm outside pelts the shelter walls with sand and stones, making the whole building groan ominously.
You huddle in a corner of the room, holding your comms device as close to your mouth as possible to ensure that your voice gets through clearly.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Stay away from the center of the storm, and don't attempt any rescue operations... Yes, I'm safe for now. I'll contact you again once the storm passes.
You hear voices of the task force from the other end, broken and filled with static.

speaker: Task Force
content: Chief, thank good(static)... relieved you're safe. We found shelter(static)... we met some(static)... they showed us the way...

The wind on the other end grows louder until, after a few seconds of static, the calls cuts out completely. The Mania in the storm is interfering with the signals, leaving you totally cut off from the outside world.
Of course, I wouldn't mind if you called me "darling" instead—after all, we'll be wedded soon enough. You could also call me dear, honey, sweetheart... whatever you prefer, really.
A hand gently pats you on the back.
When you look up, the bounty hunter is nowhere to be seen.
[End of Flashback]

speaker: Chief
content: Sigh...

You set down the comms device and turn to survey the room. It's a mid-sized trading post near a transport route, used for handling accounts and temporary storage. Given the harsh environment of WhiteSands and the threat of desert bandits, it's also equipped with plenty of defensive gear.
But the furnishings are completely wrecked, and sand is spiraling in through holes in the windows. This place has clearly been abandoned for some time.
You approach a table in the room. There's a broken coffee cup on it with dried coffee stains inside—looks like someone had only drunk half of it before it dried out.

Stacks of messy accounting papers litter the desk. On one document, the calculation stops at a particular decimal point—the next number is distorted, with the pen stroke stretching into an unnatural line across the page.
...They left all these things behind. They must have left in a hurry.

speaker: Chief
content: Some kind of emergency... but there's no sign of looting or destruction. This doesn't look like desert bandits or an armed assault...

options: Could it have been a sandstorm?

content: Bingo! You got it right.
A familiar teasing voice rings out beside you—Korryn had returned. She had put away her rifle, and is now holding a worn blanket, emergency rations, and a toolbox.

options: I thought you'd slipped away again.

speaker: Korryn
content: I went to gather some supplies. People take refuge here sometimes. It's a WhiteSands rule—you can take what you need from shelters, but you've got to leave something for the next person who comes along.

speaker: Korryn
content: I mean, I'd love to leave... But all those stories about adventuring through sandstorms are just fairy tales for kids. Even I'm not crazy enough to go into a storm alone.

speaker: Korryn
content: Here, wrap yourself in this blanket. There's no telling how long this storm will last, and it gets freezing cold when the temperature drops.

options: You seem familiar with this place.

speaker: Chief
content: What exactly is this place? What happened to it?
She gives you the blanket and a bottle of water, then walks toward the drafty windows with her toolbox.

speaker: Korryn
content: As you can see, this used to be a trading hub before a massive Tide of Ashes turned the whole place upside down.

speaker: Korryn
content: The old, poorly maintained defenses couldn't hold up against the storm. Lucky for them, they had two sand boats and some Hypercube reserves, so most of the workers here managed to escape.

speaker: Korryn
content: But I heard they later got into legal trouble for misappropriating Hypercubes. Don't know how that turned out.

speaker: Chief
content: A massive Tide of Ashes? When did this happen?

speaker: Korryn
content: Let me think... It happened sometime this year, right around the time of that big incident in DisCity...
As she hammers a long plank over the window frame, Korryn turns to you with a gleam in her eyes.

speaker: Korryn
content: —I think it was the <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color> incident in the Syndicate. What a coincidence, Chief. Any idea how these might be connected?

Dead silence fills the room. Korryn stands in the darkness, her face shadowed by the brim of her hat. You can't make out her expression, but you feel her gaze studying you, as if trying to unearth some hidden secret.
But more chilling than her demeanor are the connections she's suggesting—BR-002 and the Tide of Ashes? Could the escalating disturbances in WhiteSands be linked to the Black Ring?
And... could this be why Korryn kidnapped Hella? Was getting close to you her real objective all along?
Before you can respond, Korryn lets out a sigh.

speaker: Korryn
content: Well, judging by that blank look on your face, I guess you don't know either.
She turns and walks back, as if suddenly remembering something. She feels around her pocket before tossing something your way.
You catch it reflexively. It lands heavily in your palm, and you look down to examine it.

speaker: Korryn
content: Just a little bribe. Don't worry, it's clean. It's expired—but only by about ten days, so no big deal.
Korryn takes out an identical piece of candy, unwraps it and pops it into her mouth. She then walks over to sit beside you.

speaker: Korryn
content: Come on, lighten up. I've got nothing against you. I just wanted to run something by someone from DisCity's upper brass to see if my hunch had any merit at all.

speaker: Korryn
content: Too bad I picked the wrong person. Turns out you don't know anything either.

speaker: Korryn
content: I'll own up to it. I'm sorry for dragging you into this storm with me.
Her apology comes without pretense, and unlike her usual playful banter, her tone carries genuine sincerity.
The lizard Sheriff crawls leisurely around her neck and across her shoulder. It meets your gaze and blinks, as if offering its own apology.

options: This apology comes a bit late.

content: But more than her apology, you're interested in something else she mentioned.

speaker: Chief
content: Besides this theory of yours, what else do you know?

speaker: Chief
content: The intensifying sandstorms and Tide of Ashes, the abandoned trade routes... These are things I can't see from DisCity. WhiteSands might face new threats in the future, but I'm blind to them. You're the one who knows what's really happening out here.

speaker: Chief
content: Korryn, what's troubling you? What did you really see?
You finally see Korryn's carefully maintained composure beginning to crack.

speaker: Chief
content: You've sensed it too... something's at work behind the scenes, right?
After those words sink in, Korryn falls silent for a moment. When she speaks again, it's as if she's surrendering to the inevitable.

speaker: Korryn
content: Oh you silver-tongued devil—I give you candy to help your throat, and you use it to interrogate me? How ungrateful.
The young bounty hunter sits up.

speaker: Korryn
content: Recent events... have started to line up with strange things from the past.
A long time ago... back when sandstorms weren't as frequent, and before I became a Sinner, I'd occasionally take on bounty cases—such as revenge or missing person cases.
The jobs came in all shapes and sizes, and so did the clients. Everyone in WhiteSands was just trying to scrape by, so no one asked too many questions about who was paying.
...but one particular client was different... unsettling in a way I'd never seen before.

speaker: Korryn
content: I've delivered what you asked for. But... isn't the payment a bit too generous? Don't tell me I just delivered something that's gonna get the attention of the cops!

speaker: Shadowy Figure in Black
content: No need to worry, young one.

speaker: Shadowy Figure in Black
content: We harbor no ill intent, nor will we cause you any trouble... We merely wish to establish a friendship.
With the transaction complete, the figure in black extends their hand courteously, and I return the gesture. Their hand was cold and unnaturally stiff.

speaker: Shadowy Figure in Black
content: Trust me, one day you'll be grateful for the payment you received today...
[Black Screen] (Flashback filter)

speaker: Shadowy Figure in Black
content: Farewell, Miss Korryn. <color=#fb9259>A pleasure doing business with you</color>.
It was a strange client and a strange job, and the payment made no sense. As time passed, I pushed the memory to the back of my mind—until—

speaker: Wright
content: Korryn?! Korryn, what are you— cough cough—get out of here!
The sandstorm came out of nowhere. WhiteSands had never seen such a massive, sudden storm before. Tuco needed time to move out, so I stayed behind to cover their retreat.
Good thing I was the only one who stayed behind—the moment the convoy left, the storm devoured everything in its path. Including me, the last one standing.

In the chaos, all my senses blurred into nothing—except for the searing heat in my hands. The burning sensation started at my fingertips, growing hotter and hotter until it became almost unbearable, and then—

speaker: Korryn
content: And then, when I finally woke up, I was wrapped up like a mummy on a Tuco vessel.
Korryn stares at her fingertips, lost in thought.

speaker: Korryn
content: It wasn't until later that I realized that burning sensation was Mania. I'd been infected by the Mania in the Tide of Ashes, becoming what you call a Sinner.

speaker: Korryn
content: ...I still don't know who that person was, but they must have been planning something. My survival in that sandstorm was no coincidence.

speaker: Korryn
content: The world is changing rapidly. WhiteSands is getting more chaotic by the day—Hypercube prices are soaring, Nirvana is monopolizing the trade routes, and sandstorms are spinning out of control. Our chances of survival are slim enough as it is, and if there's more trouble brewing...

speaker: Chief
content: With your abilities, fleeing the crisis to DisCity shouldn't be too difficult.
Korryn laughs softly, but her words are heavy.

speaker: Korryn
content: But it won't be easy for Tuco, will it?

speaker: Korryn
content: You know Tuco. The town has almost no able-bodied adults—mostly elderly, children, and people too weak or sick to fight. In other words, people DisCity won't take in.
As if recalling all those familiar faces, warmth seeps into Korryn's voice.

speaker: Korryn
content: We've survived on lies and tricks so far, but how much longer can we keep it up? No one knows. No one can make any promises.

speaker: Korryn
content: And there are so many places like Tuco scattered across WhiteSands... They might vanish beneath the sand without even knowing what hit them. No one hears their voices. No one even remembers they existed.

speaker: Korryn
content: So I decided to take the initiative and bait out someone from DisCity who looked like they might know something—
She flashes you a knowing look.

options: So I'm the unlucky chump from DisCity?

speaker: Korryn
content: Bingo, dear!

speaker: Korryn
content: I have to thank little Hella. At first I thought she was just bragging, but turns out she really does have deep ties with the MBCC. She's such a sweet girl, and the dummy Chief she trusted and adored must be a softie too—

speaker: Chief
content: So you set your trap, using Hella's kidnapping as bait to lure me to WhiteSands.

speaker: Korryn
content: Yeah, but who knew our dear Chief would be such a handful and actually jump ship to chase after me? If anything had happened to you, that little mouse would've made me pay...

speaker: Korryn
content: Yes?

speaker: Chief
content: Aren't you the same? Love makes fools of us all. You snuck out of Tuco, thinking you could handle everything by yourself... We're not so different, you and I.

speaker: Chief
content: Rushing into danger alone without explaining anything... I've done that before too, but it only torments those you leave behind. It's not the right way.

speaker: Chief
content: Your heart's in the right place, but...
...you've forgotten that it's precisely because the path ahead is so dark and uncertain that we need to face it together with our companions.

speaker: Chief
content: I can share some information with you, but I'm sure your companions wouldn't want to be kept in the dark either.

speaker: Chief
content: No one should die in WhiteSands, or be buried by these merciless sandstorms. At the very least, you all deserve to know what you're up against.

speaker: Chief
content: As for playing hero and acting tough—
You can't help but tease the bounty hunter before you.

speaker: Chief
content: Better save that for Hella—she's more of a sucker for that kind of thing.
Korryn freezes for a moment, about to protest, when a sudden noise interrupts her.
Bang bang! Thunderous strikes echo from the main door. For the first time, genuine shock crosses Korryn's face, like she's seen something that shouldn't be here...
The next second, the metal lock shatters with a spray of shrapnel. The door bursts open, slamming against the wall. Dark figures charge in yelling, lunging toward you like a storm.
Korryn you *******! I'm gonna rip your head off!!!
A group wielding peculiar weapons bursts through the broken door. You instinctively back away, only to realize they're not after you at all—they're going straight for Korryn.

speaker: Elderly Man
content: Korryn! Thank heavens you're safe!
Young and old, strong and frail—the figures all crowd around Korryn. The room goes into an uproar as some burst into tears and others reprimand her.

speaker: Elderly Man
content: You troublemaker! Do you have any idea how worried we were? Breaking into the Bureau, of all places! Since when did you get so brazen, huh?

speaker: Korryn
content: Aw, lighten up, Mayor. Worrying makes you age faster.

speaker: Korryn
content: Just look at Abuela Susan—she's way older than you but looks half your age—ow!
Before Korryn can finish her sentence, she receives a solid whack on the head.

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: You little brat! Think you're something special now, do you?!

speaker: Elderly Woman
content: Get a kick out of playing hero, eh?! You think we old timers are just dead weight that needs your protection?!

The wrinkled old woman, with dual guns and loaded magazines at her waist, is fiercely indignant. Her palm lands on Korryn's back with resounding smacks... not what you expected of the "weak and elderly" folks of Tuco.
Korryn makes a show of dodging, but there's no real attempt to resist. Despite her stream of protests, she can't keep the smile off her face.

speaker: Korryn
content: No, no—ow! Of course not, Abuela Susan!

speaker: Korryn
content: How could I possibly think that? You've been taking care of me since I was a drooling baby... Ouch, that hurts...!
She presses her palms together and bats her eyes innocently to the crowd around her.

speaker: Korryn
content: I promise all of you that this will never, ever happen again! Really!
The crowd stirs restlessly, clearly unsatisfied with Korryn's half-hearted apology. The mayor pushes through the crowd and raises his voice.

speaker: Mayor
content: Alright, alright, everyone calm down!

speaker: Mayor
content: We've found who we came for. Now let's tidy up and head back!
After speaking, he turns to look at you with confusion, as if trying to figure out who you are.

speaker: Korryn
content: Ahem, allow me to introduce—the one and only, Chief of the MBCC! This is the superhero that little Hella can't stop talking about, ${PlayerName}!
The man stares at you in disbelief for a moment before turning to Korryn. After she responds with an emphatic nod, the Mayor explodes.

speaker: Mayor
content: Korryn!! What kind of trouble have you gotten yourself into now?!!!

speaker: Mayor
content: Oh good heavens... I don't know what this troublemaker did this time, but it must be all her fault! Please rest assured, we promise to discipline her when we get back! We won't let her out to cause any more trouble!

options: She snuck into the MBCC without your knowledge.

content: No better time than now to spill the beans. As you list out Korryn's misdeeds, the mayor's face grows darker with each detail. By the end, he's too stunned to even be angry. After shooting Korryn a fierce glare, he turns to you apologetically.

speaker: Mayor
content: What nonsense about Hella! **** sake, that girl left with the Legion ages ago! Don't listen to Korryn's ridiculous stories!

speaker: Mayor
content: Ahem, if you don't mind, you're welcome to travel with us. We'll make it our priority to escort you back to your companions. Consider it our way of making amends for Korryn's reckless behavior!

options: You're planning to cross through the sandstorm?

content: The sandstorm hasn't subsided yet. You're planning to cross through it?

speaker: Mayor
content: Heh, you needn't worry about that.

speaker: Korryn
content: —Wow, where'd you get this sand ship? Is it a new model?
You hear Korryn's voice from outside, eagerly appraising her newest object of fascination.

speaker: Wright
content: Borrowed it from a kind soul on the way. Pretty sweet ride, eh?

speaker: Wright
content: And this baby ain't our only prize. Look what else we've got—

As you approach the door, you spot a small sand ship that's nearly crashed into the entrance, and a middle-aged man with a smug grin. He furtively pulls back the seat, revealing an eerie blue glow that illuminates his face.
Your eyes meet the Mayor's once more, and he gives you a knowing smile.

speaker: Mayor
content: Don't worry, we have our own ways of dealing with danger—they might seem unconventional, but sometimes old tricks work best.
[Black Screen]
It's true that the Tuco folks are mostly children, the sick and the elderly... but can truly helpless people survive this long in WhiteSands?
You quickly realize you've underestimated them.

speaker: Korryn
content: Ladies and gentlemen, we're expecting some turbulence ahead. Please fasten your seatbelts and hold on tight—
Scorching winds whip against your face as the sand ship plows through the storm, breaking free into safety at last.

As the yellow sands dissipate, the surrounding landscape gradually comes into focus. The passengers look visibly queasy from the rough ride... all except Korryn, who stands at the bow with a broad grin, clearly amused by everyone else's distress.

speaker: Korryn
content: You can always count on my flawless driving!

speaker: Abuela Susan
content: You rascal, drive properly for heaven's sake!

speaker: Abuela Susan
content: After all this time with the Chief, you haven't picked up any manners at all! Look how polite the Chief is—even thanking me just now!
Amidst the commotion, you recall the battle in the sandstorm between the Tuco folks and the sand beasts. Working in perfect unison, they swiftly defeated the monsters without needing your help.
This mysterious sand ship, those exceptional driving skills, and the strange weapons and fighting techniques...
Korryn suddenly appears beside you, draping her arm across your shoulder.

speaker: Korryn
content: How about that? Pretty awesome, eh? You'd never see views like this on those big DisCity ships—
Wind-swept sand streams toward the horizon like flowing amber clouds, before dispersing to unveil the blazing sun behind.
She's right—only in WhiteSands can you witness sunlight this pure and unfiltered.
But...
Pardon me, but I'd like to clarify something.
You take another careful look at your surroundings.
—Weren't you supposed to take me to rejoin my MBCC squad first? Why does it seem like we're getting further and further away from DisCity?
The arm around your shoulders freezes for a moment. The Tuco folks burst out laughing nearby.

speaker: Mayor
content: Oh my! I did say that, didn't I? What an excellent memory you have!

speaker: Mayor
content: I'm not as sharp as you. I'm an old man, and I forget many things. Speaking of which, there's another thing I forgot to mention!
The Mayor's face breaks into that same mischievous grin you've seen so often on Korryn as he presents you with a contract.

speaker: Mayor
content: It was no small trouble giving you a ride. After we get a small compensation for our services, we can be on our way.
You turn to Korryn, who is already watching you. When your eyes meet, she flashes you an innocent smile.

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't look at me like that, Chief. I may be fond of you, but I'm still one of them, you know.
Clearly no help will be coming from her. You reach for the contract. They're the hunters and you're the prey, so your options are limited.

"I, ${PlayerName}, Chief of the MBCC, hereby commit in my personal capacity to provide charitable donations to all residents of Tuco, including quarterly provisions of living supplies and additional emergency aid when requested..."

speaker: Mayor
content: It'll just be a small amount of DisCoins and Hypercubes each time—at official rates. That's all we ask. Nothing unreasonable.
"In addition, provide basic welfare to Tuco..." Wait, why is there a separate clause about sand ship repairs?

speaker: Wright
content: Oh, that! The big ship's such a pain to fix, and we can't keep going to the fortress to borrow a new one every time it breaks down—
WHACK! Abuela Susan smacks Wright's head with her cane and drags him away.
Korryn shrugs, pretending she hasn't heard a thing.
...Okay.
Now, how much would I be donating... Huh?
You're surprised at the figure. Unlike Korryn's extortionate demands, the Mayor's contract asks for a surprisingly modest sum.
Based on what you know about Tuco's population, this is the bare minimum they need for survival.

speaker: Wright
content: Do you think the amount is too little, Chief?
The middle-aged man who was dragged away can't help but interject.

speaker: Wright
content: Sigh, I think it's too little too! How's this gonna be enough? We've got a golden goose right here—why are we just letting it go just like that?

speaker: Wright
content: But our Mayor doesn't see it that way! He says "the Chief's a virtual saint who's brain-meltingly, earth-shatteringly, heart-breakingly nice! We can't take advantage of someone like that too much!"
The man spouts one bizarre term after another like a broken faucet, making your head spin.
It's an offer I can't refuse.
The Tuco folks burst into excited cheers—they'd probably toss you in the air if circumstances allowed. You find Korryn in the crowd and continue speaking.
Besides this, I have another proposition I'd like to discuss with you.

In addition to our previous donation, the MBCC will give you resources regularly. You're free to keep them or share them with others who need Hypercubes—I won't ask any questions about how you distribute them.
You meet Korryn's gaze. She seems to guess what you're about to say, and her expression shifts to surprise.
But in return... I want you to be my eyes in this region.
Thanks to Korryn's warm hospitality, I've had the chance to return to WhiteSands and see its people for who they truly are, as well as witness the changes taking place here.
So, after I leave, I hope someone will keep watch over WhiteSands on my behalf. If you see or hear anything unusual, contact the MBCC immediately. We'll provide fair compensation for any information.
When you finish speaking, the ship falls silent for a few seconds before erupting into laughter. Korryn doubles over, tears of laughter oozing from her eyes.

speaker: Korryn
content: Pfft, hahahahaha...! And here I thought you were going to say something else, hahahahaha!

speaker: Abuela Susan
content: Well, well! This young man has such big ambitions—Korryn, you've brought us quite a handful!
female_content: Well, well! This young lady has such big ambitions—Korryn, you've brought us quite a handful!

speaker: Korryn
content: Yeah, quite a handful indeed, but awesome enough to be worth it...
Korryn wipes the tears from her eyes and gives you a hearty pat on the back.

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't worry, sweetie. From today on, you're not just my friend—you're Tuco's friend...
Korryn grabs the wheel and slams down on the accelerator.

speaker: Korryn
content: Time to take our good friend home!
[Black Screen]
True to their word, the Tuco folks quickly return you to the MBCC squad's camp.
As you leave the sand boat, the crowd surrounds you with hugs, refusing to let go until Korryn finally comes to shoo them away.

speaker: Korryn
content: Well then, my dear Chief. You're home now. I should get going.
She leans against the sand boat and tosses you another piece of candy.
Is this the ten-days-expired kind?
Korryn gives you a sly wink.

speaker: Korryn
content: No, this one expired today.

speaker: Korryn
content: Sorry about using little Hella to lure you out, and for making you sign such a ruthless contract. How about this—take me back to the MBCC, give me a title, and I'll do whatever you want. As long as the pay is good—

options: Alright, that's enough out of you.

content: My offer wasn't just for you—it was for everyone in Tuco.
If you try to keep it all for yourself, that abuela will knock some sense into you, no?
The bounty hunter shakes her head with a smile, brushing the sand off your shoulder.

speaker: Korryn
content: Yeah, that won't happen again.
After dusting off the sand and smoothing out your clothes, Korryn gives your pocket a casual pat.

speaker: Korryn
content: Alright, time to say goodbye for real. I left you a little gift—take a look when you get back.
A gift? When did you slip that in?
Korryn responds with a wink before boarding Tuco's sand boat. The vessel roars to life and vanishes amidst a cloud of dust.
You feel your pocket and pull out an envelope. In the distance, task force agents spot you and hurry over.

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: Chief! Something terrible has happened!
They rush forward urgently, their faces full of anxiety and guilt.

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: Our Hypercubes have been stolen! Everything in storage is gone—they took everything except the few pieces our squad members had on them!

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: It must have been those guides... they claimed to be a local rescue team from WhiteSands that helps people caught in sandstorms. They were the only ones who saw us handling the Hypercubes, but... we were with them the whole time! They shouldn't have had any chance to steal them...

speaker: Korryn
content: —Wow, Wright! Where'd you get this sand ship? Is it a new model?

speaker: Wright
content: Borrowed it from a kind soul on the way. Pretty sweet ride, eh?

speaker: Wright
content: And this baby ain't our only prize. Look what else we've got—
You spin around, but Tuco's sand boat is already speeding away, becoming nothing but a speck in the horizon.
The restless hot wind carries fragments of distant voices to your ears—Hurry up! Move it!

speaker: Task Force Agent
content: Ch-Chief? What are you looking at?
You look down at the opened letter in your hand.
The messy handwriting gleefully details how Korryn played Hella for a fool, tricking her over and over again till she had nothing left.
Just made a deal—jury's still out on whether it was worth it. Let's head back to DisCity.
Korryn leans against the boat, observing the frantic task force agents in the distance, as well as the composed grey figure who stands among them.

speaker: Korryn
content: How can you hire WhiteSands' finest bounty hunter with such a measly sum?

speaker: Korryn
content: Silly Chief... too kind and soft-hearted for your own good.

speaker: Korryn
content: Don't worry, I'll handle what you can't. I'll be your eyes in WhiteSands and keep track of everything that happens here. And maybe you'll find ways to change the things I can't...
This is a unique arrangement, neither purely transactional nor based in friendship. Each has become an extension of the other's sight, illuminating paths the other cannot see.

speaker: Korryn
content: Let's see what you can really do.

December, N.F. 113
After the BR-002 High Tower Black Ring Crisis

MBCC Chief's Office
The Black Ring crisis has finally concluded against all odds, but the troubles hidden beneath never truly cease. Just as old problems are resolved, new ones emerge.

West District's reconstruction is a pressing matter. Months of backlogged documents have piled into a heap on the desk. If this office ever experiences a brief moment of peace, it's merely a prelude to the next knock on the door.
Just like today...
On your desk lies a dark web investigation report from the 9th Agency. At the top, an anonymous account stands out conspicuously.

speaker: 9th Agency
content: This account was registered approximately one week ago. Initially showing no suspicious activity, it began frequently logging in two days ago to browse and post in numerous sensitive forums as well as download data.

speaker: 9th Agency
content: We've extracted its search keywords. The account shows particular interest in Black Rings and Mania phenomena. After viewing each batch of information, it offers high prices to purchase the related documents.
Advanced Theoretical Studies on Mania, The Black Ring: Comprehensive Analysis and Potential Crisis Assessment, Underground Hypercube Research and Utilization Protocols...
Every single transaction revolved exclusively around Mania. Underground experiment logs, document fragments, unsigned research notes... This person hoards everything and is ready to pay generously.
..."Collect the latest BR-002 samples on site"? It's even issued a bounty?

speaker: 9th Agency
content: Yes. However, as of now, no one has responded to the bounty. Even professional contractors from the dark web must ask themselves whether the money is worth dying for.
The agent from the 9th Agency pauses briefly, then points to a highlighted entry in the report.

speaker: 9th Agency
content: What concerns us more is that it's showing equally strong interest in <color=#fb9259>Quinn and West District's latest activity</color>. The Outlands have long wanted to meddle with the new mine, and now with unknown individuals stirring things up on the dark web, we must exercise extra caution.

speaker: 9th Agency
content: Additionally, since yesterday evening, a new keyword has appeared in this anonymous account's searches.
<color=#fb9259>"MBCC Chief"</color>... Looks like it's taken an interest in me as well.

speaker: 9th Agency
content: Yes, Chief. Beyond the Bureau's public records, it's also searching for your personal information and background history.

speaker: 9th Agency
content: But no new transaction posts so far. We've applied quadruple encryption to all your information online. Currently, it can only access content that's already available to the public.

speaker: 9th Agency
content: They're very cautious. The account is encrypted through the dark web, making it difficult to trace with our current technology. Investigation will take time.

BR-002 was just over. West District can't afford another blow now. You need to nip this threat in the bud. If this can't be achieved with tech, it's time to switch to a more primitive and direct approach.

speaker: You
content: Since this person has now turned their attention to me, why not give them what they want and use that as our way in?
After a few seconds of contemplation, you look up and speak calmly but assertively.

options: I need you to do me a favor.

speaker: You
content: Get an anonymous account ready for me as soon as possible. Make sure it's not too recently registered and looks "natural" enough that it won't appear suspicious.

speaker: You
content: When they come online next time, I'll deal with them personally.
The 9th Agency is highly efficient. In less than twenty minutes, they've already sent the anonymous dark web account you requested to your device.
The account was registered about six months ago, with the gender and IP location strategically exposed. Most of its bookmarks are posts related to the MBCC Chief.
The dark web is chaotic as always. People are always talking, trading, arguing, their voices ultimately drowning in a dizzying flood of information.

You quickly locate the forum where the mysterious account is most active and cast your bait: a tip about your current whereabouts, accompanied by several candid photos taken from questionable angles—blurry, but close enough to be enticing.
You don't turn off your device, but instead turn the notification volume to the max before returning to your work, patiently waiting for your target to take the bait.
Two hours later, you hear a chime. The forum notifies you that your account has received a new private message.
<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Hello, I was wondering if those photos were taken by you in the post you published two hours ago?
The fish has taken the bait.

options: Hello. Yes, they were taken by me. Why?

content:
<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Nothing. Just a little curious about them. Are those people from the MBCC? I think I spotted their logo.

<color=#fb9259>Gray</color>: You can tell even from those photos? You must know a thing or two about the MBCC.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: It's not that hard to make out. I'm just guessing from certain details... But I'd like to confirm, is that person the MBCC's Chief?
You pause for a moment. Their response is tactful, deflecting the question back to you without revealing anything about themselves. Just as the 9th Agency said, this person is relentlessly cautious.

options: Yes. So, you're interested in this Chief too?

content: <color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Yes. I am indeed curious about him, so I've been gathering all kinds of information.
female_content: <color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Yes. I am indeed curious about her, so I've been gathering all kinds of information.

content: Their response continues to give away nothing. Going on with this usual, roundabout approach will likely lead you nowhere. You need to try a more direct strategy.
<color=#fb9259>Gray</color>: What a coincidence. I see you've saved quite a few posts about Chief as well. Since we seem to share an interest, why don't we keep in touch and trade info?

This time, they remain silent for a full five minutes. You worry you've overplayed your hand, and begin rehearsing what excuse might sound convincing enough when they inevitably ask what you're really after.
But the message that finally appears on your screen leaves you wide-eyed.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Would you mind clarifying what you mean precisely by "keeping in touch"?

<color=#fb9259>Gray</color>: ...?
You read and reread this short line of text, unable to grasp what they're actually asking. Thankfully, their explanation follows immediately.
<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Using what means? At what frequency? Any rules? Should we use secret codes to prevent leaks?

Orderly, structured, and utterly precise. This barrage of unexpected questions immediately reminds you of a research survey. Rather than the sly probing of a dark web veteran, it feels more like... a rigid assessment by a scholar?
There's no time to analyze further. You gingerly cobble together vague answers to the questions. Just as you think you've successfully dodged the interrogation, they send another message.
<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: I see. I'd like to confirm something else. How did you manage to take photos from that distance? Who are you? Do you know Chief personally?

<color=#fb9259>Gray</color>: I'm a sheriff. I took these photos while on a mission with Chief.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Sheriff? May I ask which precinct? What's your work ID? Your rank? And when and where exactly were these photos taken? Did you take them for the mission, or for some other reason?

Unconsciously, you wipe sweat from your brow. You thought assuming an official identity would dispel any further doubts, but you're instantly bombarded with specific details you can't possibly fabricate convincingly.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Assassin? Is Chief your target then? Who hired you? How much do you charge? If you could get this close, why haven't you made your move yet?

Just a little over ten minutes of "interrogation" have thrown you into what feels like a silent battlefield. The stubborn, relentless questioning from the other side of the screen is even harder to defend against than actual weapons.

Overwhelmed by your predicament, you don't even notice when Wynn enters the room. Coffee pot in hand, she refills your empty cup skillfully, then spends a moment studying your screen before suddenly blurting out something.

speaker: Wynn
content: Why not just say you're a fan? "Number one fan from the Eastside MBCC Chief Fan Club" or something.
You freeze momentarily, almost convinced you misheard. But there's no time to hesitate now, so you type out the frankly absurd identity.

options: I'm President of the Eastside MBCC Chief Fan Club.

content: You wait anxiously for their response. After a while, a message finally appears.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: A fan club? Sorry, I'm not familiar with these kinds of organizations. What exactly do you do?

<color=#fb9259>Gray</color>: We collect and share everything related to Chief, of course. Chief is such an enigmatic figure. We have all kinds of fans in our group. Theorists, researchers, you name it.
With Wynn coaching you, you're now handling the conversation with ease. Interview recordings, speech videos, gossip articles... You fire off all the "evidence" she's feeding you.

<color=#fb9259>Gray</color>: And that's not all! We also make our official fan club merch: limited-edition badges, collectible postcards, Chief's briefcase replicas, mini Chief keychains... You name it, we've got it!
You stop abruptly.

speaker: You
content: ...Wait, do these things actually exist?
You turn to Wynn with a suspicious look, but she just innocently shrugs her shoulders.

speaker: Wynn
content: Faye takes care of all that. I don't really know the details. You'll have to ask her yourself.

speaker: You
content: ...Forget it. I'll deal with her about this later.
The "typing..." message keeps flashing at the top of the chat window, but no new text appears. Clearly, they're still hesitating about how to respond.
You're just one step away from gaining their trust. You make your finishing move with confidence.
<color=#fb9259>Gray</color>: Young people are into this stuff these days. You seriously don't know? How old are you anyway? Don't you go on the normal side of the internet sometimes?
Finally, the message notification chimes.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: ...I see.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: I'm not familiar with what young people are interested in these days. Please excuse my ignorance.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: I live in a satellite town and work as an independent scientist, primarily studying Mania phenomena.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: I rarely go out, so I don't keep up with these popular trends.
They seem to feel obligated to reciprocate after you shared your supposed identity.
But how would an independent scientist have so much money to splurge on intel from the dark web? At least come up with something more convincing...

After a moment's hesitation, you reexamine the 9th Agency's investigation report. This account has indeed purchased substantial amounts of intel, but you can tell that many of these expensive leads are, in fact, false information.

You thought this might be some mysterious organization with deep pockets and powerful connections. Now it seems more like an easy, wealthy target being circled by predators. No wonder rumors about it are everywhere on the dark web.
While you're still processing this, several new messages suddenly pop up. They seem to think you're still doubting their identity and hastily provide more explanation.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: I'm only interested in that Chief because I heard he's an expert in the field of Mania. I have no other intentions.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: The Ring Research Institute is hard enough to get into, and coming from a satellite town means I practically have no chance. But even so, I don't want to give up... Finding ways to defend against disasters is a topic that concerns every researcher.

<color=#fb9259>Anon</color>: Please rest assured, I'll keep any information about him confidential, and I promise I won't do anything that could harm him in any way.
