content: It's all thanks to your name and business connections. As soon as they heard the intel is from Vautour Bleu, even the senior officials at the Border Bureau took it seriously.

speaker: Chief
content: Normally, they'd have never followed my orders outside the chain of command, let alone switched to non-lethal training rounds. Oh, so this is what it feels like to be in the lion's skin, huh.
You say unflinchingly, not concealing the fact that you exaggerated and twisted Vautour Bleu's words which led to this investigation about the disrupted Outland relations.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: So you were the one stirring things up behind the scenes... You're pretty good at this, foxy little Chief?

speaker: Chief
content: Says you, Miss Vautour Bleu the great merchant. This all went according to your plan, didn't it? You were the one who took Lyman in, geared him up, and gave him the chance to reach DisCity.

speaker: Chief
content: You were also the one who wrote to me, giving me the chance to intervene in Lyman's entry. Now he's thriving at school in Syndicate, all because you were willing to take one more gamble. One to prove the path to happiness isn't always a death sentence.

speaker: Chief
content: But then you sealed the ending before the story reached a conclusion. Deep down, you believed Lyman would never make it safely into the city, that his dreams were destined to shatter. Am I wrong?
Your eyes meet. Vautour Bleu offers no answer, and none is needed.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm not you. I don't know what you've been through or what made you so cynical. But I've seen schools get rebuilt on ruins, abandoned mines return to prosperity, and the chaotic Syndicate transform back into West District.

speaker: Chief
content: That's why I believe as long as someone lives on, their story continues. There is no such thing as a fixed ending. If you don't like how things are going, you can always take action to rewrite the story.

speaker: Chief
content: Just as you saved Lyman this time. You can save many more like him in the future, if only you're willing to embrace change.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Heh... You truly are a wonder, Chief.
After a moment of quiet contemplation, Vautour Bleu stands and solemnly extends her hand to you.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: In the past, all I could do was protect fellow dreamers from harm, but you can offer so much more.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: If you truly have a way to rewrite these tragedies... then make me your Sinner.

speaker: Chief
content: Are you proposing a deal?
Vautour Bleu nods, smiling.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: Of course. And my offer is myself. In return, I want you to deliver me... a future.

speaker: Chief
content: Then it's settled.
You reach out to grasp her pale, cold hand. Before you can bring out your shackles, you sense the Mania boiling in her, pulling you in like a whirlpool, forcing your shackles to dominate it.
A crimson light flashes unbidden, forging a deeper connection that binds you together. This close, you can see Vautour Bleu's knowing smile.

speaker: Vautour Bleu
content: The deal is done, and there's no going back now. I'll be checking the books regularly, so please take good care!
The charge for disrupting Outland relations was cleared, and Vautour Bleu has returned to her caravan in WhiteSands.
Before leaving, her only request was for you to keep in touch. She also promised to pick out more interesting souvenirs for you in the future.
After all, for all my connections in DisCity, you're the only one who's truly avail to me, my dear Chief.
Sometime later, the Bureau receives another letter from Vautour Bleu.
Accompanying the letter is a dried plant-based snack that smells weirdly like tobacco. Nightingale distributes it among the other Sinners and the reviews have been rather positive.

speaker: Levy
content: Chief, you still got any of that dried fruit? What? It was from Vautour Bleu? Never mind, forget it. Who knows how much she'd charge me for it.

speaker: Chief
content: I can write to her to order some, and squeeze it into the Bureau's regular expenses if not much.
After seeing Levy off, you return to your desk and open that WhiteSands-smelling letter.

To the ever-busy Chief of the MBCC,
Well met.

I'm delighted to hear that the people of Désir have integrated well into the Drifter Camp and taking on important jobs—remarkable progress!

Knowing their temperament, they'll probably cause some trouble. But I'm sure they'll also prove their worth. Only you can tell if it's a profitable investment, though I doubt you'll be at a loss.

As for Lyman, I suppose his probation period will be over by the time this letter reaches you. If he's still having trouble finding work, please let him know my team's alway open to him.

He'll have the basics, though the first three years' salary would be deducted for the supplies he took, at wholesale prices. Just kidding—consider it a gift for his fresh start.

Speaking of money, I've caught some interesting news in WhiteSands. Apparently, your next month's salary has been promised to some desert bandits as collateral by an adventurer girl.

If you need a reliable payment method, let me know. I can offer you a discount on the handling fee. Of course, you can always try writing me letters to win my favor.

If you notice any ink smudges or tears on the following pages, it's probably because of the sandstorm. So don't worry, the desert bandits know better than to mess with me.

I've traveled this trade route many times. It's always been so wild and unforgiving... yet also prosperous. Last time I was there, I still went by the name Madeleine.

Back then, all I wanted was to leave this wretched place with its terrible weather and worse temper, but it repaid my scorn with kindness by teaching me the best lesson in business I've ever learned.

It's another long story, and perhaps not a particularly interesting one. But I think you might be willing to hear it.

10:30 AM
Unspecified date, N.F. 115
The MBCC's hallway

speaker: Wynn
content: Hey there! Looking for Chief? He just finished the morning meeting. Should be taking a break in his office now.
female_content: Hey there! Looking for Chief? She just finished the morning meeting. Should be taking a break in her office now.

speaker: Eugene
content: Yeah, Chief left the comms terminal at the cafeteria.

speaker: Wynn
content: Huh... Never thought Chief could be so forgetful too... Come to think of it, he hasn't been looking well lately. Always nodding off too. Wonder if he's not getting enough sleep at night?
female_content: Huh... Never thought Chief could be so forgetful too... Come to think of it, she hasn't been looking well lately. Always nodding off too. Wonder if she's not getting enough sleep at night?

speaker: Wynn
content: Pulling all-nighters playing video games? Or maybe binging TV shows...?

speaker: Eugene
content: Look who's talking...

speaker: Nightingale
content: What are you chatting about?

speaker: Wynn
content: Adjutant Nightingale! We were just talking about Chief. He hasn't been looking well lately... Should we get him some health supplements?
female_content: Adjutant Nightingale! We were just talking about Chief. She hasn't been looking well lately... Should we get her some health supplements?

speaker: Wynn
content: I kept count during the morning meeting. He yawned exactly nineteen times, spaced out twice, and even signed the documents in the wrong places.
female_content: I kept count during the morning meeting. She yawned exactly nineteen times, spaced out twice, and even signed the documents in the wrong places.

speaker: Eugene
content: —And left the terminal at breakfast.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I understand. I'll take care of the device. You two can return to your duties. Chief's been having some rough days lately, so I've already scheduled a medical check-up for him.
female_content: I understand. I'll take care of the device. You two can return to your duties. Chief's been having some rough days lately, so I've already scheduled a medical check-up for her.

speaker: Nightingale
content: As for whether supplements or sick leave are needed, let's leave that decision to the doctor.

speaker: Wynn
content: Always so trustworthy, Adjutant! In that case, we'll leave Chief and his device in your capable hands. See you later!
female_content: Always so trustworthy, Adjutant! In that case, we'll leave Chief and her device in your capable hands. See you later!

content: Wynn tugs Eugene along as they leave the hallway.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, I'm coming in.
As Nightingale opens the door, she finds ${PlayerName} resting at the desk with closed eyes, faint dark circles visible beneath them.
She places the device on the desk and, before leaving, takes a moment to examine the wisteria branch on it.
After quelling the calamity of the frantically growing wisteria that winter night, Chief brought back a branch taken from the Mania-infected plant.
Now planted in a pot on the desk, the once greyish, withered branch has sprouted several delicate new buds. Fresh crystal-clear droplets of water adorn the tips of the leaves like tiny jewels.
...It's still emanating a faint trace of Mania.
Meanwhile...

You've been treading through this misty dreamscape for a while now, and this time the journey feels especially long. Roughly the distance between the MBCC and the remains of that Mania-infected wisteria, you estimate.
Leading you forward, drawing you onward, is a single wisteria flower drifting gently before your eyes.
[Scene: Under the Wisteria Tree]

speaker: Yingying
content: You've come to see me again, sweetheart.

speaker: Yingying
content: Did you notice this place has grown bigger on your way here?

speaker: Yingying
content: I was getting bored here, so I tried recreating DisCity, just the way you described it to me.

speaker: Yingying
content: Building it all up piece by piece takes quite some time, you know.

speaker: Yingying
content: Not at all! I've been keeping myself busy, building this place while imagining all your heroic adventures here and there... Hehe, it's been quite entertaining.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Once you're better, we'll go see the real thing.
You pause thoughtfully, roll up your sleeve, and extend your hand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Since I'm here, don't you want an extra helping?
This is a tacit agreement between you two.

Ever since the Wisteria incident, Yingying's physical body remains trapped in the Mania-contaminated ruins, unable to fully withdraw from it. She's extremely weak, kept alive only by Wuhuanzi's treatment and the stabilization equipment, yet unable to truly recover.

You brought that delicate sprout back to the Bureau, but that only allows you to meet her in dreams for brief chats. In these dreams, she claims she's getting better day by day, but you always wake up to the same reports showing no progress.

After some time, you finally turned to the unorthodox remedy from the story: transferring your own Qi—your vital energy—to heal her. It's such a reckless attempt, so you can only do it without anyone knowing.
After all, a connection has formed between the two of you through the shackles. Giving her a little of your energy each day seems to be working.
But the progress is painfully slow, so slow it fills you with anxiety.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Here, my dear Wisteria Fairy. Your faithful devotee has come with offerings.

speaker: Yingying
content: I have dear Wuhuanzi looking after me, so there's no need.

speaker: Yingying
content: She comes often to treat the wisteria with acupuncture, and she tells me everything, like how her friend ${PlayerName} has been dozing off and tripping over things all day.

speaker: Yingying
content: I'm afraid we may lose your life before saving mine... Heh...
Yingying gives you a playful glare, then reaches out to poke your face petulantly.

speaker: Yingying
content: I've told you. You need to stop it if you begin to feel unwell. Did you think you could fool me?
You try to speak, but her words cut you off.

speaker: Yingying
content: I know, that you only need to rest for a few days, that my recovery is more important, blah blah.

speaker: Yingying
content: But you're important to me too.

speaker: Yingying
content: So, let's try something different today.

speaker: Yingying
content: I've been watching Wuhuanzi work and learned some authentic Eastian massage technique. It's great for relaxing muscles and improving circulation! Let me help restore your health! Consider it a thank you for giving me your Qi!
As she speaks, she flexes her wrists with determined enthusiasm.

speaker: Yingying
content: You've shared so much of your Qi with me. It's about time I return the favor.

options: Wuhuanzi gives massages to trees too?

speaker: Yingying
content: Come on now, sweetheart. Let's begin~

speaker: Yingying
content: Uh-uh, it won't be as effective if I'm gentle!

speaker: Yingying
content: Leave it to me. Just sit back... and enjoy yourself.
[Black Screen]
Yingying guides you to lie down on a carpet of wisteria blossoms under the tree. As you settle in, the accumulated fatigue washes over you like waves.
Each time you visit Yingying, you transfer most of your Qi to her. Despite Wuhuanzi's repeated warnings, you believe you can handle it.
But as soon as you lie down, every muscle and joint in your body screams in protest.
Several wisteria petals drift down onto your eyelids, tinting your vision with a dreamy shade of purple.

speaker: Yingying
content: Here I go, then!
Her fingers glide up your cheeks, tap gently between your eyebrows, then slide to the back of your head.
Her movements are gentle yet precise. When she presses down on the pressure points, instead of pain, you feel an indescribable tingling sensation.
Before you know it, your entire body melts into relaxation.
So gentle...
Such warmth...
The touch of her wandering fingers grows bolder. From your scalp to your shoulders, then down your back, to your waist, and...
Wherever her fingers pass, a gentle warmth flows from her fingertips into your body.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wait!
Your body feels weightless.
As familiar energy flows from her fingertips, your Qi rapidly returns.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hold on...
[End black screen]
You sit bolt upright and grab Yingying's hand.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why are you returning the Qi to me?
In response to your question, she just interlaces her fingers with yours, then pushes you back down onto the wisteria blossoms.

speaker: Yingying
content: Cause you can't take care of yourself, so I'll just have to do it instead.

speaker: Yingying
content: A certain someone thinks he should—and can—shoulder every responsibility alone. But he only ends up burning himself out without even realizing it, hurting those who care about him too.
female_content: A certain someone thinks she could—and can—shoulder every responsibility alone. But she only ends up burning herself out without even realizing it, hurting those who care about her too.

content: She reaches out, a single wisteria blossom pinched delicately between her fingertips.

speaker: Yingying
content: Look, the wisteria is sprouting new buds. I'm just like these plants. All I need is some water and sunlight to thrive. There's nothing wrong with taking things slow, so why insist on making me the wicked spirit who drains all life and energy out of you?

speaker: Yingying
content: If you really collapse because of me, I'd lose my favorite partner, and everyone at that "Noms" would never forgive me.

speaker: Yingying
content: So... be a dear and stay put. Today is your designated recovery day.

speaker: Yingying
content: Phhh...
[CG or Close-up Shot: Wisteria Tree]
With her gentle breath, the wisteria buds burst into bloom all at once, cascading down like a purple waterfall to envelop the two of you in their embrace.

With the earth as your bed and the wisteria as your canopy, under a shower of falling purple petals, the beauty takes advantage of your distraction to lean in close and plant a sly kiss on the tip of your nose.
Your anger melts away in an instant. It's simply impossible to stay mad at her.

speaker: Yingying
content: I'm not that fragile! Three days of sleep is all I need. It's nothing compared to what you're putting yourself through.
She gently rests her head on your shoulder.

speaker: Yingying
content: Thank you, sweetheart. Even with how busy you are, you still remember to water my flowers, come visit me, and even share your Qi with me. That alone makes me so happy.

speaker: Yingying
content: Please, at least let me do something for you in return.

options: But that'd mean delaying your recovery indefinitely.

speaker: Yingying
content: Aha, here we go again! What's the rush? Is it the Eastian scholar? Or your Paradeisos boss? Are they that desperate to wake me up to question me?

speaker: Yingying
content: Well, there are rules to these things, you know. In the old tale, when the spirit's soul and form are completely destroyed, it takes centuries or even a millennium to recover. I'd say I'm making quite good progress in comparison.
Her delicate, porcelain-like fingers poke at your cheek twice coyly.

speaker: Yingying
content: If I were really to rely on that frail body of yours, that tiny bit of Qi you share wouldn't even help me sprout. No, no, I'd have to grow my own, drawing strength from nature itself.

speaker: Option A
options: So you actually think you can photosynthesize?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I go to the gym every day now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're not a vegetable, you know. A human's Qi is what you need to heal, so just take it from me. It's not like I'm giving you permission to harm others.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you're going to be so picky about it... I'll work out more to build up my strength, okay? That should satisfy you, right?

speaker: Yingying
content: Where would you even find the time? You're already losing sleep because of me, drowning in work... I get exhausted just looking at you.

speaker: Yingying
content: Things are just fine now. Even though I often have to wait, your visits always make my day.

speaker: Yingying
content: In this little world of ours, it's just you and me. No one to disturb us, we can stay as long as we like. Isn't it wonderful?

speaker: Yingying
content: I don't mind if we stay this way forever. It's like our own romantic fairy tale, hehe.
She's always smiling when she makes these playful remarks, but that faint detachment behind her cheerful words is never lost on you.

Ever since the fete ended, she's grown much quieter. Despite how eager you are for her recovery, Yingying doesn't seem to care about it herself. Perhaps she's concerned for your health, or is still not used to this new world a century later, or perhaps...
She only chose to stay to please you, to fulfill your wish... Could it be that she never truly wanted this herself?
You can't utter these exact words. Like her, you can only keep smiling, concealing your careful questions within playful banter.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm thinking of something more fun. Once you've recovered, shall I take you for a walk through the real streets of DisCity? Seeing you're so keen on it that you're building your own version of it in this world.
Her face lights up with surprise and anticipation, but you can tell she's only putting on this smile to please you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I've already submitted a formal request to the Eastian delegation. They'll look into ways to speed up your recovery, to help you break free from your current state as soon as possible.
She claps her hands in gratitude for your efforts, but her eyes betray no real enthusiasm for the prospect.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: If you recover soon, maybe next year we could organize another fete in DisCity together? We could invite all our familiar faces from last year.

speaker: Yingying
content: Hmm?!
For the first time, Yingying's eyes glisten with genuine interest, but she immediately shakes her head.

speaker: Yingying
content: What am I, a child you can sweet-talk? I won't fall for your tricks! Now shoo, shoo! You've been lounging around here long enough. Time for you to go, and I need my beauty sleep too!

speaker: Yingying
content: If you show up looking this haggard again next time, I won't let you in! Off you go!
[Scene transition: Chief's Office]
You jolt awake, suddenly torn from your peaceful reverie.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I woke up? No, wait... I got kicked out, didn't I?
Beep-beep...

Your communication device rings urgently. As you reach to answer it, your eyes fall on the wisteria branch on your desk. The dew on the tender green leaves is gone, and the waves of Mania have grown extremely faint.
A tingling sensation still lingers where Yingying touched you, confirming that wasn't just a dream.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Sorry, Chief. I didn't mean to wake you from your nap.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, actually, I got kicked out. Don't worry about it.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Understood. Chief, there's also a meeting request from the Eastian Embassy that requires your attention.

speaker: Nightingale
content: They'd like to meet you personally. They seem very serious about it. Apparently, it concerns Yingying... and her fete.

Several days later, N.F. 115
4:00 PM
The MBCC's Reception Room
You enter the reception room. The first thing that catches your eye is an elderly man surrounded by several caregivers.

His body is bony and gaunt as he lies amid an array of medical equipment. Multiple IV lines run into various blood vessels throughout his body, keeping him alive. The cardiac monitor emits a steady, rhythmic beeping.
A woman in purple steps forward from the delegation. She extends her hand courteously to shake yours, then speaks in rather fluent DisCity tongue.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Greetings, Chief. Thank you for taking the time to meet with us despite your busy schedule.

speaker: Ziyi
content: My name is Wei Ziyi. I'm the proprietor of Hengyun Hall, an apothecary in Eastia. This is my great-granduncle, Mr. Wei Weixiao, who founded our establishment.
Noticing your puzzled expression, she calmly offers an explanation.

speaker: Ziyi
content: My great-granduncle, brother of my great-grandfather, has never married. He raised me as his own daughter and the eventual successor to take over Hengyun Hall.

speaker: Ziyi
content: During the Wisteria Mania incident, Miss Du Ruo made a special visit to our apothecary to discuss possible solutions. As one of the few witnesses of the Perishing Star, my great-granduncle's journals proved invaluable.

speaker: Ziyi
content: By the way, he's 119 years old.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Yes, 119. He's approaching his 120th year. As the founder of Hengyun Hall, he's mastered the art of longevity through his medical expertise. Even by Eastian standards, his age is quite remarkable.
You find yourself filled with profound respect for this elderly gentleman and his pharmaceutical enterprise.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thank you for sharing the historical information. It has been tremendously helpful for our operations.

speaker: Ziyi
content: You're too kind. My great-granduncle is quite sentimental about the old days. He often told us stories about the fetes he visited in his youth and the wish-granting Wisteria Fairy. Such traditions have become rare in modern Eastia as disasters make travel rather difficult these days.

speaker: Ziyi
content: That's why the news of the legendary Wisteria Fairy appearing in DisCity has caused such excitement among us. Even my great-granduncle seems to have regained some vigor at the news. He wishes to see it himself, and he's delighted that we can be of assistance in this matter.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Later, we learned that the Wisteria Fairy had stayed behind and was revealed to be a Sinner. Naturally, we want to do what we can to help with her recuperation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Does that mean you know of ways to help her?

speaker: Ziyi
content: Indeed. I've already visited the quarantine zone, but I heard you brought back something crucial, Chief...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, please come with me.
[Scene transition: Chief's Office]
You lead everyone to your office and pick up the wisteria branch from your desk, briefly explaining the situation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I used to be able to communicate with her spirit through this branch. Though I don't understand the exact mechanism, she's told me things about Eastia that I won't otherwise know, so I don't think it's just my imagination.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: But lately, even this connection has grown weak. I haven't been able to see her these past few days. The branch has stopped growing, and the quarantine zone has been inactive... It's deeply concerning.
You think it all started after she kicked you out last time. Since then, no matter what you try, you haven't been able to reach Yingying.
It's one thing if she's just being stubborn and refusing your Qi. It's another if something happened to her on the other side, leaving her unable to answer you. You're worried.
While you're lost in thought, the elderly man's eyes flicker. Slightly agitated, he tugs at Ziyi's clothes and shakily points to his luggage.

speaker: Ziyi
content: I understand, Grandpa. Leave it to me.
Wei Ziyi retrieves a small ceramic urn from the luggage and immediately removes its lid, revealing what's inside.
A handful of earth.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Please replace the soil with this, and we'll observe what happens.
Wei Ziyi nods, and a scholarly-looking man steps forward from among her companions.
With utmost care, he lifts the glass cover protecting Yingying's branch, then takes out his tools to remove some of the old soil from the pot.
He replaces the old soil with the earth from Eastia, then thoroughly waters the newly repotted plant.
There's no need to check the readings. Your shackles are already reacting.
The once-fading presence, which seemed ready to vanish at any moment, now awakens and becomes deeply connected with you.
The branch begins emanating a faint trace of Mania.
It gradually fills the entire office, and then...

speaker: Ziyi
content: ...Is it working?
As a pure floral fragrance fills the air, everyone present seems to hear the gentle voice of the Wisteria Fairy.

speaker: Yingying
content: Hehe... I can smell the scent of my homeland. Are you also from... Eastia?

speaker: Yingying
content: Please accept this wisteria as my greeting gift, and may peace and fortune be with you always!
In the crowded reception room, wisteria petals appear from nowhere, drifting down softly onto everyone's shoulders.
While the others are still in awe, Wei Ziyi gently picks up the wisteria petal from her shoulder and places it back in the flowerpot in your hands.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Just as expected.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Chief, in Eastia, we have this old saying: Two trees of the same kind, when planted in different soils, may produce different fruits. It means that the fate of something depends on the environment it is placed in.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Even within our vast country, a fruit from the south cannot survive in the north. Similarly, I believe it's this environmental incompatibility with DisCity that has left Yingying in such a weakened state.

speaker: Ziyi
content: It's not just the climate and soil. It's the culture, the people, the diet, the medical practices, and even the Mania-contaminated environment near the Black Ring. All these factors are impeding her recovery.

speaker: Ziyi
content: As it happens, my great-granduncle has a habit of carrying an urn of soil from home whenever he travels to ease his homesickness. This may now help prove our theory.

speaker: Ziyi
content: But... it remains just a handful of soil. It's far from enough.
She stares at the flower branch, her brow furrowed.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Yingying is from Eastia. Not just by birth, but in her very essence. That's why her body naturally thrives better in Eastia's environment.

speaker: Ziyi
content: If she stays in DisCity, she might live on, but she could remain in this state for years—decades, even—without improving. Taking her back to Eastia might be our best chance at her recovery.
All eyes turn to you. You've interrupted the discussion, but now you find yourself at a loss for words.
After a brief silence, you begin.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Eastia is far away, and bringing her back would involve significant risks. We'll first need more comprehensive proof.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Regarding Yingying... she is the oldest living Sinner we've ever known. She has survived numerous Mania-contaminated environments over the past century. She is invaluable to DisCity.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We need more information to prove your claims about environmental compatibility and Mania exposure. There are also the issues of security protocols during her transfer, risk management measures, and methods to control her internal Mania...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, she needs the shackles to stabilize her Mania levels. She's staying here for a reason.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I apologize if this sounds harsh, but Yingying is crucial to me... to this city, and even to all of humanity. I believe such stringent measures are absolutely necessary.
You barely register your own words. You just know that they need to be said.

speaker: Ziyi
content: ...Your points are entirely valid. These details certainly need to be included in the proposal, and we have much work ahead of us. However, before we continue, please allow me to ask this:

speaker: Ziyi
content: Do you not trust us?

speaker: Ziyi
content: Do those who govern DisCity believe Eastians have ulterior motives? Is that why you are so wary of us?

speaker: Option
options: Let's hear what Yingying herself has to say.

content: You gesture at the flower branch in your hand. Out of everything you've said, this sentence feels the most genuine.

speaker: Ziyi
content: I understand. Let's call it a day. We'll go back to refine our proposal and continue our discussion with you later.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Our sincerity is what has driven us here. This has been my great-granduncle's cherished wish for many years. If there's any way to prove we are sincere, we are willing to do it.

speaker: Ziyi
content: We truly hope she can recover and return to her homeland.
...Their sincerity is hard to doubt.
But at the thought of Yingying leaving DisCity, you feel an inexplicable emptiness and unease in your heart.
You can't even understand why yourself.

speaker: Old Man
content: You do not distrust us... nor are you being too careful...
Just as you are about to leave, the old man speaks up.
His voice is hoarse and hollow, as if it has traversed ages.

speaker: Old Man
content: You just... don't want to part with her, that's all.

speaker: Old Man
content: I understand, I do... But how long can you wait? And Yingying... how long can she wait?

speaker: Old Man
content: Will you keep waiting until you're old and dying... Will you still be telling that young sprout then... Just a little longer...
He gazes at you with eyes that seem to have glimpsed the truth of time.

speaker: Old Man
content: Life is... too short... If you don't start running now, you might never... reach where you want to go...
His words and gaze strike your heart like a sledgehammer.
Coughing, the old man lies back down and closes his eyes.
After seeing Wei's group off, you examine the wisteria branch in your hand once more. However, as if that brief moment of manifestation has drained all her energy, the branch has fallen silent again.
That night

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: Treating her with the right environment? Hmm... It's true that some Eastians buy into that theory.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: When they travel, they pack months' worth of provisions, both food and drink, as they often struggle to adjust to unfamiliar environments.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: Some elderly travelers, those who've come to terms with their mortality, carry an urn of soil from their homeland. It not only helps make adaptation easier, but also ensures that they can return to their roots like falling leaves should any accidents happen during the journey.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: At his age, that old man traveled such a long way just to see the wisteria, and he even gave you his precious soil... Hmm... he must be a good person.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: Two trees of the same kind may yield different fruits when planted in different soils. The laws of nature vary from one place to another, and so do plants grown in different environments.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: Wisteria requires four essential elements to grow: soil, water, air, and sunlight.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: This city is far from Eastia, so naturally the soil is different. It's only normal that the wisteria is having trouble adapting.

speaker: Option
options: You could have told me that sooner.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: What difference would it have made? You wouldn't have let her go anyway.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: You were right to turn those people down today though. Too risky. As for whether this treatment is worth trying... that's all up to Yingying. Have you asked her about it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...She can't answer me right now.
Since that encounter earlier today, the wisteria branch has become completely unresponsive. Only when transplanted into Eastian soil did it show some signs of revival.

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: Sounds pretty bad... But don't worry, I'm here and I won't let her die. That being said... ahem, I can't predict exactly when she'll wake up.
Over these past few days, Wuhuanzi has drilled holes around the roots of the ancient wisteria, irrigating it with medicinal solutions.
The medicine and the Qi you've been transferring to Yingying are what's keeping the millennium-old Wisteria alive.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let me ask one last question. Setting aside all personal factors, tell me honestly: Would returning to Eastia give her a better chance of recovery?

speaker: Wuhuanzi
content: Since you're being so direct... Yes, I'm certain of it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I understand. Thank you.
[Scene transition: MBCC entrance]
Back at the MBCC's entrance, you see Nightingale coming toward you hurriedly.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief! Miss Wei just called. She wanted us to send someone to the Eastian Guildhall asap.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Both Yingying and Mr. Wei have gone missing!

2:50 AM, unspecified date, N.F. 115
Suite A502, Embassy Hotel

The opened suite door shows no signs of forced entry, and all windows remain tightly shut. Yet Mr. Wei, who should normally be in bed, is nowhere to be found. Only a faint trace of wisteria fragrance lingers in the room.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, the hotel's surveillance footage is heavily distorted by Mania interference. We could only salvage a few frames. At 1 AM, Mr. Wei's wheelchair was seen pulled out of the hotel by some strange vines.

speaker: Nightingale
content: All hotel staff fell temporarily unconscious at the time. Likely Yingying's doing as well.
You examine the surveillance footage closely.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's no trace of fear or panic on his face. Instead, he appears to be having a pleasant conversation with someone, looking much more spirited than when you last met.
You attempt to sense with your shackles, but can only detect the remains of that massive wisteria standing in the city. The branches are too small to track.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Miss Wei, time is running out and we need every lead we can get. I hope you'll be completely honest with us.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Mr. Wei didn't come here just to rebuild the fete, did he? His real target was the incarnation from your legends, right?
Wei Ziyi sits on the nearby sofa, her eyes red-rimmed, one hand pressed against her forehead in visible exhaustion.

speaker: Ziyi
content: My great-granduncle hadn't been lucid enough to speak with us for a long time. But when he heard that the Wisteria Fairy had awakened in DisCity, he suddenly became agitated and insisted I get involved.

speaker: Ziyi
content: I know he still yearns for the old days and I understand his determination to preserve those old tales. But I don't know why he pushed himself so hard to come here. It must be some deep-rooted desire he's been harboring all this time.

speaker: Ziyi
content: But one thing is certain.

speaker: Ziyi
content: Even if equipped with Hypercubes, anyone who gets near the Wisteria in its current state will suffer from corruption. For someone as critically ill as him, the risk would be far greater.
She rises to her feet, places her hands over her heart, and bows deeply before you.

speaker: Ziyi
content: I implore you...
Her words carry unmistakable honesty. You take a deep breath, gradually unclenching your fists.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know where Yingying has taken him. Let's head to the Wisteria remains.

speaker: Old Man
content: This place... this is...

speaker: Yingying
content: Don't you recognize it? This is the fete you've been so eager to visit.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...The same one from a hundred years ago that you missed.
The place is vibrant and lively. Crowds of festivalgoers fill the streets as vendors' calls echo through the air.
Every passerby wears a genuine smile, their eyes bright with hope for tomorrow.
The elderly man takes an instinctive step forward, suddenly aware that his once-frail body now feels incredibly light and agile.

speaker: Boy
content: How... What's happened to my body?

speaker: Yingying
content: Now that you're here, you should be allowed to enjoy it as your younger self, and have some fun!

speaker: Yingying
content: My power won't last as long as it used to. Better make the most of it while you can, right?

speaker: Yingying
content: Shouldn't you be looking for someone?

speaker: Boy
content: I... I understand.

speaker: Boy
content: Farewell, Wisteria Fairy!
He runs a few steps, then suddenly remembers something, and turns back to shout.

speaker: Boy
content: Thank you!
Yingying watches the boy run off, then stretches contentedly.

speaker: Yingying
content: Now... what should I do next?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: First, explain to me exactly what you did.

speaker: Yingying
content: Eek! Sweetheart, you startled me!

options: You nearly gave me a heart attack too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not a note, not even a single word. You simply vanished without a trace. That's not good for my heart, you know.

speaker: Yingying
content: Hmm? Were you... worried about me?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, I was worried. Worried you'd drained yourself completely and would never wake up again. Or you'd be captured and sent back to Eastia. Or you'd agree to their terms and leave DisCity forever.

speaker: Yingying
content: I'm so happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is a serious matter. You left the Bureau without permission, then took Mr. Wei from his hotel, and brought him to this dangerous place. It's my duty to escort both of you back.

speaker: Yingying
content: Oh, so it's not me you were worried about.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Because... Mr. Wei and his associates brought a technique from Eastia today. They suggested they could transplant your wisteria back to Eastia.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You've been terribly weak these past few days, but when he brought out the soil from Eastia and transplanted you into that pot, it did revive you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I consulted Wuhuanzi, and even she admitted that the Eastian environment would be highly beneficial for your speedy recovery.

speaker: Yingying
content: So you thought I would leave with them? That I would abandon DisCity?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course I don't want you to leave, but if staying here puts your life at risk, I'd rather...

speaker: Yingying
content: Shhh...
She presses her index finger to your lips.

speaker: Yingying
content: Don't say it if you don't mean it.

speaker: Yingying
content: I won't leave, just as Mr. Wei never would.
She lowers her finger with a smile, takes your hand, and leads you back to the Wisteria Pavilion.

speaker: Yingying
content: Long ago, he made a wish to take his "Little Orchid" to the fete here.

speaker: Yingying
content: That wish has transcended from that fete a century ago to this very day...

speaker: Yingying
content: Even as his life drew to a close, his determination only grew stronger. He journeyed from afar, willing to spend his last breath here if needed. And that roused me.

speaker: Yingying
content: Tell me, how could I not honor such dedication?

speaker: Yingying
content: Now Mr. Wei has come here, like a drop of fresh water joining a pool, and his task is to find that girl he loves among the thousands gathered at the fete.

speaker: Yingying
content: This will be a long search reserved only for him. Come, let's help him along his way.
[Scene transition: Wisteria Pavilion]
You arrive at the Wisteria Pavilion with Yingying, where craftsmen are putting the finishing touches on a prayer altar beneath the wisteria tree.
Above them, pale purple wisteria buds are beginning to bloom, their petals scattered across the offering table below.

speaker: Hawker A
content: Look, it's the Wisteria Fairy! The prayer ceremony is tomorrow. Shouldn't you be preparing at the Wisteria Pavilion instead of wandering about?

speaker: Merchant
content: Oh hush now! What a fine young companion you have there... Here, have some of my fried fruit. May it bring you a harmonious union!

speaker: Yingying
content: I should thank YOU. The stalls are much grander than last year. I'm sure everyone who comes to pray will be delighted.

speaker: Yingying
content: As you can see, the wisteria has bloomed earlier this year. Would you please spread the word that we'll begin the prayer ceremony today?

speaker: Hawker A
content: Oh, that's perfect! These past few years, we could only have the ceremony on the last day. The place became so packed that some folks could only pray from afar. I'll go and tell everyone!

speaker: Merchant
content: In that case... could I be the first to pray? My wife is due in two months. Please bless us with a safe delivery, dear Fairy.

speaker: Yingying
content: Of course. The Wisteria Fairy has heard your prayer. Stay by your wife's side, and she will surely have a safe and smooth delivery.

speaker: Yingying
content: Fortune may favor you, but remember to do your part as well.

speaker: Merchant
content: Of course! Thank you, Fairy. Take these treats as my thank-you offering for you and your date here. When my child is born, I'll treat you both to celebration eggs!

speaker: Hawker B
content: Me! Let me be next!
This is your first time seeing Yingying addressing the prayers of Yunhuai's residents one by one as the Wisteria Fairy.

She sits gracefully upon her dais, listening attentively to everyone's words. She records their wishes on tags while you hang them on the wisteria tree. The residents quickly warm to you, the Wisteria Fairy's new assistant.
But this isn't just a time for blessings and good wishes.

speaker: Yingying
content: What?! That scoundrel swindled you out of sixteen pieces of silver! How absolutely outrageous!

speaker: Hawker B
content: That's right! That lying bastard! I hope misfortune follows him for the rest of his life!

speaker: Yingying
content: A lifetime is a bit too much... Let's make it a year of misfortune instead. I'll note down your wish!
...The prayers go on.
The sun sinks as time slowly drifts by.
At last, you and Yingying meet the person you're waiting for.
A round-faced young girl approaches the prayer altar. She kneels down reverently, takes some snacks from her pocket to place on the offering table, and begins her prayer in a soft voice.

speaker: Youlan
content: Revered Wisteria Fairy, I am Youlan from Valleyville at the river's end.

speaker: Youlan
content: Please hear my prayer. There's a boy I'm into. He'd call me little orchid, but he's so dense when it comes to this sort of thing... When will he finally take the hint?

speaker: Yingying
content: ...Hehe.

speaker: Youlan
content: We've been neighbors since childhood. Mom says we even shared the same baby clothes when we were little.

speaker: Youlan
content: When I gave him flowers, he gave me a handful of wildflowers in return. I shared my candy with him, and he slipped me some persimmon cakes. I'm not good at embroidery, so I made him some leaf ornaments... and he... he gave me three beautiful beaded flowers in return. I heard he spent a whole month's salary on them.

speaker: Youlan
content: I'm really fond of him... I just don't know if he feels the same way about me.

speaker: Youlan
content: Mom says if he likes me, he'll tell me himself... but when? I've been waiting since last year, and now this year is almost over too.

speaker: Youlan
content: Oh, Wisteria Fairy, if you can hear me, please give him a little push.
A gentle evening breeze rustles by, and a cluster of wisteria flowers quietly blooms above the young girl's head. Hidden in the tree, the other one pinches her nose and speaks.

speaker: Yingying
content: Shall I tell him in his dream? Or perhaps change his heart? You see, I can't force him to come to you. But why don't you just ask him yourself?

speaker: Yingying
content: Whatever he might think, at least you're sure about how you feel about him, aren't you?

speaker: Youlan
content: He... he's been ill...

speaker: Yingying
content: Shall I cure his illness? Or perhaps arrange a chance encounter between you two?

speaker: Youlan
content: Oh, no no no! I... I'm afraid he doesn't like me. That would be so embarrassing.

speaker: Yingying
content: Haha, there's nothing embarrassing about having feelings for someone! Whether he accepts them or not is his business, and your feelings are your own. It's not like you're causing him any trouble.

speaker: Yingying
content: I can't promise to make him fall in love with you, but...

speaker: Yingying
content: Since you've made a wish, I should do something about it...
Just then, as if on cue, the courtyard's door knocker rings.
It's as if time is beginning to flow again after going still for ages, in sync with his advancing footsteps.
He rushes forward.
With each stride, it feels as though time itself is turning backward.
A devotion that has lasted a hundred years finally finds its reunion in the present.

speaker: Youlan
content: You're still running a fever! What are you thinking, coming here like this?

speaker: Boy
content: Eh?

speaker: Youlan
content: Come here, let me see if the Wisteria Fairy has really cured you.

speaker: Boy
content: W-wait, there's something... something I must tell you. Please, listen to me first.

speaker: Boy
content: I've walked all the way from home to the fete just to tell you this... The trip has taken me so very long.

speaker: Youlan
content: ...Go ahead then. I'm listening.

speaker: Boy
content: Let's never be apart again, shall we?
(Fade in a slow white light effect)

speaker: Old Man
content: Thank you, Wisteria Fairy.

speaker: Old Man
content: Please give this to my Ziyi, and tell her I won't be coming back.

speaker: Old Man
content: I also hope... your wishes come true.
(White light fades - Under the wisteria tree)
A paper crane drifts into Yingying's palm, and she carefully tucks it away.
As you watch the two figures disappear into the distance, Yingying gently grips your hand.

speaker: Yingying
content: May I borrow a little more of your Qi, ${PlayerName}?

speaker: Yingying
content: I want this illusion to last just a little longer.

speaker: Yingying
content: Because when this dream ends, we'll both need to move forward.
[Scene transition: Wisteria ruins]
Dawn slowly breaks.
As you emerge from the illusion, you see the FAC's patrol vehicles have completely surrounded the area around the wisteria remains.
Yingying is gone, leaving only a single wisteria branch in your hand.
The elderly man beside you has drawn his last breath, but his face is perfectly serene, as if he has returned to his youth once more.
In the interrogation room, a flowerpot with a wisteria branch planted in it sits on the Sinner's seat.
The scene before you is completely out of the ordinary, but you've already accepted it. Resigned, you water the branch generously, then settle into your chair and gradually drift off to sleep.
Yingying has made herself comfortable, curling up in the interrogation room's chair.

This place remains an illusion created by the wisteria branch, much like the DisCity she attempted to recreate before. Even this interrogation room is a space Yingying crafted in her own fantasy, tailored to her own taste.
In reality, you and Yingying are indeed also in the interrogation room, but just as a wisteria branch and a person fast asleep.

speaker: Yingying
content: So, in the end, you still have to interrogate me...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: There's no helping it. Your crimes were too blatant.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You broke into the suite of an important diplomat, took the leader of the delegation away without permission, and ultimately caused his death... It also doesn't help that Mr. Wei's status is so special. So, I'll need answers.

speaker: Yingying
content: Oh, that girl from Eastia. I remember her. She's always trying to take me back.

speaker: Yingying
content: Now, what would you do, sweetheart? Are you feeling so apologetic that you plan to hand me over as compensation?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That's a separate matter, but we do need to have a serious talk.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I know you've told me before, but I need to ask you again.
You fall silent for a moment.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why?

speaker: Yingying
content: Mmm... Because he made a wish to me.

speaker: Yingying
content: ${PlayerName}, you might have noticed. When I first met him, I felt a massive surge of Mania power. It was all because his wish was so intense that it infected me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: So it wasn't because of the Eastian soil he gave you?
She pouts.

speaker: Yingying
content: Do you think I'm some kind of vegetable?
Then, her gaze softens.

speaker: Yingying
content: Though the familiar Eastian accent did comfort me, true recovery comes from the spirit... the Qi... or the soul of a human.

speaker: Yingying
content: Normally, the power of mortal wishes shouldn't be enough to rouse me, but his wish wasn't a sudden impulse or fleeting desire... It was a devoted longing he'd held onto every minute, every moment for decades without ceasing.

speaker: Yingying
content: That's why I was able to move, but there wasn't much time. I had to find him quickly.

speaker: Yingying
content: His yearning was powerful enough to wake me, yet so weak it could barely sustain his own flickering life.

speaker: Yingying
content: On his deathbed, he longed to go back in time, to find his beloved, to fulfill a promise long broken.

options: But the wish wasn't made to you.

speaker: Yingying
content: Ah, so you've noticed too, sweetheart.

speaker: Yingying
content: He was 119 years old. Back when I was still holding the fete, he was only five. Way too young to be grabbing a girl's hand and swearing eternal love, right?

speaker: Yingying
content: I'm afraid his memory might be playing tricks on him... Fetes like that were quite common back then. Perhaps it was another flower fairy enshrined at some other temple.

speaker: Yingying
content: He was almost 120... At such an age, wealth and status no longer matter, responsibilities can finally be set aside, and even past wisdom fades away. He could no longer remember when he made his wish, where he wanted to go, or to which deity he prayed.

speaker: Yingying
content: He just heard a rumor about some wish-granting flower fairy appearing. Not caring whether it was true, he rushed all the way here just to fulfill a promise he had made.

speaker: Yingying
content: He had even forgotten that his beloved hadn't simply gone astray... she had long passed from this world. That promise... was already lost so many years ago.

speaker: Yingying
content: Yet despite everything, he still remembered the one person he longed to see.

speaker: Yingying
content: When he entrusted his final moments to me, everything else in his mind had grown hazy, yet his memory of Youlan remained crystal clear.

speaker: Yingying
content: Perhaps he held onto life for so long just for the chance to see her one last time? While not every wish can come true, the power of a wish can still sometimes create small miracles.

speaker: Yingying
content: So when his wish came true, he could finally find peace and let go.

speaker: Yingying
content: I... I understand him deeply. Looking at him is like looking at myself.

She lowers her eyes and falls into silence. After the fete, she often unconsciously wears this expression. When the Wisteria Fairy's bright smile fades, her eyes reveal such profound, heartbreaking loneliness.
...This look on her always makes you hesitate. But... you know you have to ask.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: That you both pine for the old Eastia? That you both have overcome disasters for your beloved, refusing to forget for decades?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Or... that those dearest to you are gone and there's nothing left to hold onto... Do you wish to go with them too?
She meets your gaze, pondering your words. As she becomes lost in thought, her eyes grow distant.

speaker: Yingying
content: You're right. I've been wondering too. Why didn't I leave with everyone else back then? Why did I stay behind...

speaker: Yingying
content: Staying in a place where I know no one, can't speak the language, can't adapt to this foreign land, my body constantly ailing... What good has it done...

speaker: Yingying
content: My lifelong wish has already come true, so why can't I... pass on peacefully like Mr. Wei did...
Her voice grows fainter with each word, yet her words fall upon your heart with an ever-increasing weight.
The interrogation room falls silent. Breathing grows heavy and labored as your thoughts race wildly through your mind. Every cell in your body feels like it's sinking, and each second stretches on.
After what feels like an eternity, you finally force yourself to speak.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Even though this isn't your homeland, and after a century later, this world isn't as beautiful as before... but as you've seen, it's not all that bad either.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I cherish this world deeply, and I want to show you all the endearing parts that make it worth cherishing. Just as you once told me...
Is she looking at you? You don't know. The weight of your emotions is too heavy to bear, forcing you to bow your head, unable to meet her gaze.
Speaking those words has drained every ounce of your strength.
But you must tell her.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I hope you can move past the pain of your past and find new hope when you look to the future. I hope you can find happiness again.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...I don't want this to become your chain. I don't want to force you to stay in a place that... can't make you happy.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You are free, Yingying. The only thing I wish for is your happiness.
[Transition] 2s

speaker: Yingying
content: Pfft... Hahaha, I called you dense before, but you really are completely clueless!

speaker: Yingying
content: Didn't I stay because some big clueless idiot kept me from leaving?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wait, are you joking around again? I'm being serious here. Do you know how much courage it took me to...
Before you can finish, she rises from the interrogation chair with a laugh and closes the distance between you. Her sweet perfume envelops you like a garden in full bloom.

speaker: Yingying
content: Hmm? Are you really made of stone? Or are you just playing coy? Must I spell it all out for you, sweetheart?

speaker: Yingying
content: I might have to dig into you to see what's really in there...
She leans in with a smile, bringing her lips to your ear, her voice turning soft and gentle.

speaker: Yingying
content: Staying alive hasn't been easy for me. It's as hard as the long journey was to Mr. Wei. But I've persevered through it all.

speaker: Yingying
content: For the sake of those who loved me, my neighbors, my family, I've endured countless disasters and endless cycles of suffering, all in the hope of finding peace.

speaker: Yingying
content: But when salvation finally came, I couldn't reach it in time.

speaker: Yingying
content: With nothing else to lean on and everything from my past gone, I thought I had nothing left. But when I turned around, someone was there, holding my hand.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...Perhaps that was when a new sprout grew in my heart again, and a new wish took root.

speaker: Yingying
content: Would you... help make this one come true?

speaker: Yingying
content: I want to... always stay by your side.
Her gaze grows tender, clear and deep like still waters.
You find yourself at a loss for words. After a long pause, you speak.

options: ...You're not just playing along to humor me again, are you?

content: She shakes her head without a word, but her eyes shine with such brightness. Her cheeks flush pink as she breaks into a radiant smile, the liveliest you've seen her since your first meeting.

Like the sun shining through storm clouds, all the worry, guilt, reluctance, and sorrow weighing on your heart suddenly vanish. As you look at this person who has a painful past and an unclear future, all that comes to mind is that...
Thank goodness, spring has finally returned to her.

options: ...What about Eastia then? Do you still want to go back?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's your homeland, and the place that could heal you. You're not going back? ...Don't you miss it?

speaker: Yingying
content: Mmm... Of course I do. I want to see what flowers bloom in that land after the wisteria withered, how people live now, what kind of wishes they make.

speaker: Yingying
content: Mr. Wei mentioned that people are still holding fetes even after the disaster. I'd love to go back and see them.

speaker: Yingying
content: But... I'll have to take you with me. Otherwise, you'd be worried sick. You wouldn't want to let me go because you're afraid that I might wander off and never return... Right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I guess I'll need to apply for my annual leave then.
Her smile grows even brighter.

speaker: Yingying
content: Just as wisteria needs a tree to survive, I once relied on the illusions of New Year fetes. But from now on, I'll rely on you instead, twining myself tightly around you.

options: Get off me first, then we'll talk.

content: Without you noticing, she has wrapped herself around your neck. ...Of course, this is all an illusion she created after all.

speaker: Yingying
content: Since we've agreed I'm not going back to Eastia, I'll just have to depend entirely on you, sweetheart.

speaker: Yingying
content: I can wait for you to get stronger before taking your Qi again, but for now... at least give me your heart.

speaker: Yingying
content: You're a rational person, so you rarely make wishes. That's why I can't hear your heart's desires or receive power from your prayers.

speaker: Yingying
content: But I want to know your deepest longing, your wishes, your true self, and your determination. I want to know everything about you.

speaker: Yingying
content: Oh? Do tell...

options: I want Yingying to get better soon.
I hope we can always be together.

speaker: Yingying
content: Hehe, then we'll both have to work hard, so we can be together forever.

speaker: Yingying
content: ...Always be together.

speaker: Yingying
content: Remember your wish now. Remember me.

A few days later, Yingying met again with the Hengyun Hall delegation from Eastia led by Wei Ziyi.

Thanks to the farewell letter Mr. Wei left in the paper crane, Wei Ziyi doesn't give Yingying too much trouble and agrees to let Yingying stay in DisCity for now. They'll also arrange to supply her with soil and water from Eastia through import channels.

Hengyun Hall also signs a special aid agreement with DisCity, agreeing to cover all restoration costs and subsequent compensation for damages caused by the wisteria calamity and the fete. They also purchase the land closest to the wisteria remains at a high price.

Delighted to have found such a generous benefactor, DisCity's upper echelons quickly green-light everything. Hengyun Hall officially establishes their presence in DisCity, maintaining close contact with Wuhuanzi, the wandering herbalist from Eastia.
Of course, none of this matters right now to the MBCC's Chief, who's too busy snoring away in the office.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Zzz... Zzz...
On his desk, the wisteria branch has sprouted new buds. Someone is watching him through the tender leaves.
female_content: On her desk, the wisteria branch has sprouted new buds. Someone is watching her through the tender leaves.

content: You're a mind reader, sweetheart. You always see through people's smiles and unveil their hidden thoughts.
Yet your own mind is so easily stirred. All it takes is a little Eastian-style sweet talk to make you blush. You even forgot to question me thoroughly.
Still sleeping. Must be exhausted from work, huh? Yingying's heart aches at the sight. She reaches out, and a gentle breeze caresses ${PlayerName}'s hair in her stead.
Then, she raises her head, her gaze piercing through the impenetrable walls toward distant horizons.
My sorrow isn't from being bound to you. Nor am I hiding any desire for liberation.
Unease wafts through the city winds as sunlight is slowly distorted... Something stirs in the depths beneath your feet.
...I know this feeling too well. Even after a hundred years, though its form has changed, I still recognize it.
That star is lurking near. It's awakening.
Ethereal floral vines rise from the ground, gently enveloping ${PlayerName}'s body.
From this moment on, even if the rivers boil and the mountains crumble, even if the entire world turns to dust...
I will be here with you...
After Euphoria was destroyed, many Sinners were escorted back to the Bureau through the passage between FAC and MBCC.
As an S-class Sinner, Milly should have been among the first to be escorted back, but due to her physical condition, she was forced to remain for extensive treatment in the meantime.
She's a bubbly one. Only a few days after she woke up, the whole hospital knew about how hard she'd fallen for the Chief.
[Hospital Ward]

speaker: Milly
content: R-really? The one who saved me really was... the hero of DisCity.

speaker: Milly
content: I thought I was hallucinating before I died... Wait, does that mean he saw me looking like a total wreck?
female_content: I thought I was hallucinating before I died... Wait, does that mean she saw me looking like a total wreck?

speaker: Milly
content: Oh no! I was hoping to make a perfect impression for our second meeting. Now that's completely out the window.

speaker: Nurse
content: It's okay. Even if you missed the first and second chances, there's always a third time, and a fourth.

speaker: Nurse
content: Here you go, Miss Milly. Your photo. It was in the inner pocket of your coat, with all the other items under investigation. Almost got confiscated as evidence. I had to file several reports with Adjutant Nightingale to get it back for you.

speaker: Milly
content: Oh! Thank you! That's wonderful! I was so sure I lost it in the ruins.
She clutches the photo to her chest, a faint blush creeping up her deathly pale cheeks.

speaker: Milly
content: On that ship, this photo was what kept me going. I looked at him every day, talked to him... hoping that one day, he'd show up again...
female_content: On that ship, this photo was what kept me going. I looked at her every day, talked to her... hoping that one day, she'd show up again...

speaker: Milly
content: Now, just thinking that Chief is so close to me makes my heart race. It feels like a dream.

speaker: Nurse
content: You really adore Chief, don't you? Come on, time for your medicine. Once you get your strength back, you'll be your radiant self again. Chief will surely fall for you.

speaker: Milly
content: How much longer will it take? I've been stuck in bed for... did you say it's been almost a week? What if Chief forgets about me?

speaker: Nurse
content: I'm sure that won't happen. But if you're that anxious, I can go file a request with Adjutant Nightingale right now. Ask Chief to come visit you?
The girl's face flushes bright red.

speaker: Milly
content: N-no! Please don't! I haven't recovered yet! Look! My cast is still on! I can barely move, I-I haven't done my makeup in days, and I'm seriously behind on my skincare! I—cough cough...
She breaks into a coughing fit. The nurse hurries to help her catch her breath.

speaker: Milly
content: So please don't! I'm not ready...

speaker: Milly
content: But... could you take this letter to Chief for me?
She carefully pulls a pink envelope from under her pillow.

speaker: I remember too.
content: Oooh... a love letter?

speaker: Milly
content: Please? I really need your help! But no peeks!

speaker: Nurse
content: Alright, I'll take it. But it might take a few days. I think Chief and the others are already on their way back to DisCity.

speaker: Milly
content: ...Huh?

speaker: Nurse
content: Something important came up, I think. But he made sure to arrange all of your follow-up treatment, accommodations, and transfer to the Bureau. He hopes you'll...
female_content: Something important came up, I think. But she made sure to arrange all of your follow-up treatment, accommodations, and transfer to the Bureau. She hopes you'll...

content: Milly doesn't hear the rest.

speaker: Milly
content: ${PlayerName} is leaving?

speaker: Milly
content: No, I don't want this! ...cough...

speaker: Milly
content: I don't want to be left here all alone. I want to go with ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Milly
content: I've... waited so long to see him again.
female_content: I've... waited so long to see her again.

speaker: Milly
content: I can't... I can't just wait here. I have to go see him!
female_content: I can't... I can't just wait here. I have to go see her!

content: Milly struggles to wriggle her legs over the side of the bed.
The monitors connected to her blare warnings, but she pays them no mind.
Crash!

speaker: Nurse
content: Miss Milly! You can't move around like that!
Hearing the alarms from the room, guards and doctors rush in. They restrain Milly, trying to get her back onto the bed.

speaker: Milly
content: No... let me go! I, I need to see Chief...

speaker: Milly
content: Please, I'm begging you, don't let him leave me behind... Let me go with him...
female_content: Please, I'm begging you, don't let her leave me behind... Let me go with her...

content: As she struggles, a scent sweet as honey begins to emanate from her body.

speaker: Milly
content: Huff... huff... take me... take me to Chief, please. I'm begging you, please take me there!

speaker: Nurse
content: ...Okay.
[Inside the Sand Ship]
On the landing pad, a massive sand ship is preparing for departure.
You lean against the window, watching the sand kicked up by the engines, when a flash of honey-gold catches your eye.

speaker: Chief
content: What's that?

speaker: Milly
content: Chief! Chief!!!
You can't believe it. There, on the landing pad, is Milly—who should be on bed rest—escorted by nurses and doctors.

speaker: Milly
content: Chief!!
You can't make out her words over the engine's roar. You only see her waving one arm frantically, the other encased in a cast and promptly pressed down by a doctor.

speaker: Chief
content: Nightingale... isn't that Milly? Why is she here?! She's supposed to be resting!
Is her Mania out of control again? Or is she still under the effects of mind control?
A wave of alarm overwhelms you. The lingering influence of the Black Ring sends a throbbing pain through your head, and your vision goes dark for a second.
Nightingale strides to the window, glances out, and presses her earpiece.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Landing pad security, report. An S-Class Sinner has been spotted on the landing pad. Is this an attack?

speaker: Nightingale
content: ...? Really? She's calmed down?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Understood.
Nightingale ends the call.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Don't worry, Chief, she's not out of control. Milly... she heard you were returning to DisCity ahead of schedule while she was to remain here and rest. She couldn't accept it, so she came after us. They just reported that she's stabilizing now. She knows she can't catch up to the ship and has accepted the situation.
You sigh and rub your temples.

speaker: Chief
content: What we're heading into is too dangerous for her. She's been through enough. Now that she's free from Euphoria, I just want her to have some time to heal in peace.

speaker: Chief
content: I signed the paperwork for her transfer back to DisCity, didn't I?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Yes. But it seems she ran off before she had a chance to see them. If you're worried, Chief, I can contact her again and reiterate the arrangements.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I'll see to it immediately.

speaker: Nightingale
content: You need to rest.
Nightingale gestures at the monitor beside you.

You glance over. The screen shows the erratic patterns of the Black Ring superimposed over your own vitals. The brief spike of agitation just now has triggered a bright red warning, a clear sign that you're in no condition to leave.

speaker: Chief
content: Right. Sorry, I'll leave it to you then.
[Outside the Sand Ship]

speaker: Milly
content: They... they're gone...
Milly slumps weakly to the ground.

speaker: Milly
content: Sob... why...
The guards have already surrounded her. But seeing the Chief's ship disappear into the distance, Milly has no fight left and lets them restrain her again.
One of the FAC soldiers walks up and activates a remote communication device.

speaker: Nightingale
content: MBCC-S-459, Miss Milly. Your presence here violates the detention protocols we previously agreed upon. Technically, this qualifies as an escape attempt. The guards have every right to use force.

speaker: Milly
content: I don't care! Miss Nightingale, I want to see Chief! I want to go back to DisCity with him!
female_content: I don't care! Miss Nightingale, I want to see Chief! I want to go back to DisCity with her!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief cannot see you right now. The BR-005 outbreak has severely compromised his health. He was already pushing himself to the limit to resolve the Euphoria incident. What Chief needs now is extensive rest and treatment. He's only leaving because circumstances have forced his hand.
female_content: Chief cannot see you right now. The BR-005 outbreak has severely compromised her health. She was already pushing herself to the limit to resolve the Euphoria incident. What Chief needs now is extensive rest and treatment. She's only leaving because circumstances have forced her hand.

speaker: Milly
content: What... ${PlayerName} is sick too?

speaker: Nightingale
content: However, Chief understands how you feel and has made special arrangements for your return journey. I hope you won't let Chief down.
Nightingale deliberately emphasizes her last sentence. A staff member steps up and produces a travel document bearing the Chief's personal signature.
Milly takes it, stunned. She blushes as she traces her finger over the handwriting, caressing the name.

speaker: Milly
content: This is... Chief personally...
She lets out a soft breath and presses the document to her heart.

speaker: Milly
content: Um...

speaker: Milly
content: About Chief's illness... is it...

speaker: Milly
content: If I don't disturb Chief, would the peaceful rest help with a faster recovery?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Yes. And the same goes for you, of course.

speaker: Milly
content: I understand. The next time we meet, I'll be fully recovered. I won't make Chief worry about me again.

speaker: Milly
content: B-but! Can I ask you to deliver this letter for me?
Finally, she carefully holds out a pink envelope.
[Scene change, screen dims]
My dear ${PlayerName},
I couldn't stop myself from writing to you again.

I'm not very good at writing. The person who taught me when I was a kid used to hit me, so I didn't like to write for a long, long time. But if I don't write, how else can I tell you how very, very much I love you?

I think about you all the time. The last time I saw you, your shirt had blood on it. Did someone wash it for you? I want to be with you so badly, to secretly wash the blood out of your shirts. I'm so jealous of whoever gets to do your laundry. Who could be so lucky, to always be by your side?
If I had the chance, I'd stay right by your side and never leave. I would wash all of your clothes and iron them perfectly. No one could do it better than me.

I look for you even in my dreams. But I don't know where to find you. The place I go the most is the place we last saw each other, but I know I'll never see you there again, even though that place hasn't changed at all in my dreams.

I'm begging fate to give me one chance to see you again. I know you hold me in your heart, too. I'll seize that chance with everything I have, and I'll show you how much I love you. I can be the perfect lover for you.
My love, may this letter carry to you a million of my silent kisses.
A few weeks later.
The massive sand ship cruises through the WhiteSands, a great black whale in a sea of dunes.
[Sand Ship Deck]
Milly stands on the deck, her eyes fixed on the horizon where a wall of leaden clouds has gathered, closing in on them.

speaker: Staff A
content: Sand Ship 4A calling MBCC, come in.

speaker: Staff B
content: Cyclone detected to the northeast, Force 12. Particulate concentration at 3,500 micrograms per cubic meter. Visibility in the northeast quadrant down to 300 meters. Sandstorm core expected to hit in ten minutes. Over.

speaker: Staff A
content: Copy. Unable to contact headquarters. Requesting switch to emergency channel.

speaker: Staff C
content: Switching to Channel 112.

speaker: Staff A
content: Sand Ship 4A calling MBCC. Experiencing high-intensity convection, possible sandstorm. Requesting assistance, do you copy... Dammit! Signal's gone!

speaker: Milly
content: Captain, are we in big trouble?

speaker: Staff C
content: Don't worry, it'll take more than a little gust to sink this ship. But we'll be in real trouble if we get blown off course into dangerous lanes. Now, get yourself below deck. Let's hope our mast can take this!
Milly glances at the tallest mast behind her. It's swaying violently in the wind.

speaker: Milly
content: Captain, the mast... Wait, Captain?
But the crew's already gone, and no one else notices the danger she's spotted.

speaker: Milly
content: Okay, Milly, calm down. You... you can do this. The storm's not here yet. It's only a few minutes' climb. All you have to do is secure the signal device on the mast. You can't let this ship go down. If it does... you'll never see Chief again.

speaker: Milly
content: You can do this, Milly. Go for it.
With a surge of determination, Milly begins to climb the towering mast.
The air thickens with sand. She feels the coarse grit stinging her face.
Suddenly, the ribbon binding her hair is snatched by the wind, sending her locks whipping in the gale.
Yet in the swirling chaos, her golden hair seems to shimmer, catching the light from colored minerals caught in the strands.
When she finally reaches the crow's nest, the sight before her takes her breath away.
This is the first time she's seen a sandstorm. She's only ever hidden from them in the safety of a cabin; her patrons never talked about such grim things on their trip.
This is her first time witnessing and feeling the raw power of nature.

Chaos presses in. Only the sand ship's stark, white searchlights pierce the dense fog of dust, carving a path forward. But the path reveals only more dark, churning sand and endless dunes, now twisted into unnatural shapes, as if something monstrous is stirring underneath. The hull shudders violently, gravel rattling against the metal in a constant patter.
Milly can no longer hear any other sounds. She trembles before the fury of nature.
She clings to the railing, struggling to keep herself steady. With tremendous effort, she manages to relatch the fallen lock. The swaying mast stabilizes, now secure against the raging sandstorm.

speaker: Staff A
content: Storm core's hit early. Calling for aid, calling for aid... Dammit, emergency channel's dead too.

speaker: Staff B
content: Visibility down to 50 meters. Bridge, kill the engines, recalibrate course. Deploy emergency shields.

speaker: Staff A
content: Roger that. Hey, Captain! Look! Is that someone out there?! Who in their right mind would be wandering outside in this storm?

speaker: Staff C
content: What the hell, it's the girl. Milly! Get down from there!
Larger pieces of gravel pummel the ship. A rock hits the hull near the mast, shattering a metal part. A shard whizzes past Milly, drawing a thin line of blood.
Milly struggles to climb down, her petite frame swaying precariously in the wind.

speaker: Milly
content: Come on, Milly, just a little farther. Don't give up now.

speaker: Milly
content: You worked so hard to see Chief!

speaker: Milly
content: If you die here, all of it will be for nothing. Chief will never know how you feel, or even remember you!

speaker: Milly
content: You have to live! You promised! You promised you'd live to see him, and you'd be your best self when you did!
female_content: You have to live! You promised! You promised you'd live to see her, and you'd be your best self when you did!

content: Just as her strength begins to fail, a flashing light pierces the darkness.

speaker: Staff B
content: Beacon sighted, northwest quadrant! It's the Bureau!

speaker: Staff C
content: Thank goodness! The brats actually earned their pay for once. I was starting to think they'd clocked out for the day and left us out here to rot. I'll go get Milly. Poor girl must be terrified. If it weren't for her, we'd have lost that mast for sure.

speaker: Staff A
content: Adjusting coordinates. Northwest, three degrees deviation. That'll take us out of the core of the sandstorm. We're gonna make it!
Guided by the light, the sand ship sails forward. Curiously, the wind on this new course begins to die down, and the ship stops rocking so violently. The storm begins to recede on both sides.
As the storm subsides, Milly's legs finally give out, and she collapses to the ground.

speaker: Milly
content: I'm... alive? I'm not... going to die?
The sand ship slowly follows the beacon. Soon, the familiar statues of the DisCity port appear ahead.
[Port at Night]
After the ship docks, Milly finally sees the person who lit the beacon: a young man in a surveyor's uniform with the MBCC logo on it. He vaults onto the deck and greets everyone energetically.

speaker: Young Man
