content: Hey! You okay? That was a nasty storm, but it's over now. Can you stand?
He offers Milly a friendly hand.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I'm Kawa-kawa. I heard you guys got lost out there. Are you feeling alright?

speaker: Milly
content: Hello, I... I'm Milly. Did the Bureau send you to get us?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Not exactly. The weather in WhiteSands has been unusual these past few days. I knew some Bureau folks would be returning today, so I came to help guide you in.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: The Bureau doesn't usually assign Sinners to escort duties. Chief just lets me do whatever I want. I have lots of important work in WhiteSands—mapping the terrain, guiding travelers, recording the weather... These are all part of my job.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Your face is bleeding. Must've been a piece of rock in the storm. Here, let me clean it up for you.

speaker: Milly
content: Thank you, you're so kind.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Hehe. The sandstorms here are no joke. You're lucky you only got a scratch and didn't get pulled into quicksand.

speaker: Milly
content: But I saw those giant moving sand dunes, like monsters... It was breathtaking.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Wow, you've got guts. Sand dunes are a WhiteSands specialty, but you only see the giant moving ones during a storm.

speaker: Milly
content: Perhaps it was the power of love that kept me going. I just kept thinking that I couldn't die there, and I held on... and then I saw them. My legs are still weak just thinking about those dunes.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: The dunes are one side of WhiteSands. But we also have a brilliant starry sky that you won't find anywhere else.

speaker: Milly
content: Did you say... stars?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Yep. Especially after a storm, when the sky is perfectly clear.
He points upward and gestures for Milly to look.

speaker: Milly
content: ...Wow.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Chief once told me that the terrifying sand dunes and the beautiful starry sky share the same WhiteSands.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: To see the stars, you just have to be patient. And don't forget to look up.

speaker: Milly
content: Don't forget to look up...

speaker: Milly
content: Do you talk to Chief often?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Not really. Chief came to WhiteSands on business once, and I was the guide. It was wild... holy flowers, bandits, sandstorms... you name it. Chief showed up and solved one crisis after another. It was so cool.

speaker: Milly
content: That's a story about Chief I've never heard before. Could you tell me about it?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Huh? Well, I suppose I could. But I'm not much of a storyteller, so...
(End of CG)
Kawa-kawa briefly recounts his adventure with Chief.

speaker: Milly
content: That's so different from the stories I've heard. In my versions, Chief is always a lone hero, charging into enemy lines and single-handedly saving the day. They rarely mentioned Chief's companions.

speaker: Milly
content: I... I care for Chief a lot. He's saved me time and time again. I want to tell him how I feel, but whenever I'm in front of him, I get so nervous I can't say a single word.
female_content: I... I care for Chief a lot. She's saved me time and time again. I want to tell her how I feel, but whenever I'm in front of her, I get so nervous I can't say a single word.

speaker: Milly
content: Is that why you all do so much for Chief? So Chief will like you and you can talk without getting nervous?

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Uh, I don't think you need to go through all that just to talk to Chief.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: I guide people in WhiteSands because I love it. I like helping people. Hmm... I guess you're not wrong. Chief is included in "people," after all.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Chief is really nice. He never puts on airs. So you don't need to be so nervous. Honestly, he's the most easy-going person I've ever met. You can tell him anything.
female_content: Chief is really nice. She never puts on airs. So you don't need to be so nervous. Honestly, she's the most easy-going person I've ever met. You can tell her anything.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Alright, my job here is done. I gotta get to my next observation point. Next time you're in WhiteSands, come find me. I'll take you to collect the beacons. You can see all sorts of unique plants and animals along the way. It's a lot of fun.

speaker: Kawa-kawa
content: Hope the rest of your trip goes smoothly. And good luck with Chief! I'll be rooting for you!

speaker: Milly
content: Thank you, Kawa-kawa. I know what to do now.
As arranged, someone will pick Milly up at the DisCity port.
She carefully takes the document bearing Chief's signature from an inner pocket, and reads it over and over.

speaker: Milly
content: ...Wait for me. We'll see each other again soon.
Helicopters and aircraft occasionally pass overhead. Some fly close to the ground, emitting deafening roars.

speaker: Zephyr
content: There you are! Finally found you.

Milly turns her head to see a girl in a flight jacket pelting toward her like an aircraft in a nosedive. The Bureau's logo is emblazoned on her clothes, and her striking orange hair is impossible to miss.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Hey, Milly! I'm Zephyr. Great to meet you!

speaker: Zephyr
content: Where do you wanna go? How about a bar? I know all the best spots in Eastside. Or we can catch a movie? Or... are you hungry? We can grab a bite. Nobody knows the food scene in Eastside better than I do.

speaker: Milly
content: Um... I'm not really here for fun. You can just take me to MBCC!

speaker: Zephyr
content: We'll get there, of course. But come on, you have no idea the hoops I had to jump through just to get this assignment and stretch my legs. Can't we just get back a little later? Staying cooped up in the Bureau all day... might as well bury me alive.

speaker: Milly
content: Oh, is it like that? On my way here, I got the impression that everyone at MBCC was really friendly and open-minded.

speaker: Zephyr
content: You'll see how dreary it is once you get in. Sure, there's the parole policy, but at the end of the day, we're still inmates. We just get a tiny bit of freedom back, that's all.

speaker: Milly
content: Hmm... I don't need to go anywhere else. As long as I'm in the Bureau, I can be with Chief all the time.

speaker: Milly
content: Just being able to see Chief every day... that's all the happiness I need.
Zephyr stares at her like she's an alien.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Jeez. They told me I was picking someone up from Euphoria, but they never mentioned the place was a breeding ground for lovesick puppies... Being stuck with the same person, in the same place, every single day? Wouldn't you die of boredom?
Seeing the blank look on Milly's face, Zephyr sighs and softens her tone.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Look, think about it. If you're with someone day in and day out, what would you even talk about?

speaker: Milly
content: That wouldn't be a problem. Just looking at that person is enough to make me happy.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Stop. Okay, I get it. Give me a sec.
Zephyr ponders for a couple of seconds, then gets an idea.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Alright! I'll take you to some new places. Chief is no fun, all work and no play. If you're just trailing after him 24/7, what would you have to talk about? But if you go out, have some fun on your own, see some cool stuff... then you'll never run out of things to share with him.
female_content: Alright! I'll take you to some new places. Chief is no fun, all work and no play. If you're just trailing after her 24/7, what would you have to talk about? But if you go out, have some fun on your own, see some cool stuff... then you'll never run out of things to share with her.

speaker: Milly
content: Hey! Chief is the best! The kindest, most wonderful person I know!
Before Milly can protest further, Zephyr hooks her arm and begins dragging her into the city.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Fine, fine, whatever you say. Well then, let's go. Think of it this way: you're having fun for Chief's sake. If you care for Chief and want to make him happy, you've got to be happy first. That way, you can share your joy with him.
female_content: Fine, fine, whatever you say. Well then, let's go. Think of it this way: you're having fun for Chief's sake. If you care for Chief and want to make her happy, you've got to be happy first. That way, you can share your joy with her.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Come on, let's grab something to eat first. I just found this amazing pastry. You're going to love it.
[Cafe]
Zephyr pulls Milly through the streets of Eastside and into a small shop.

speaker: Shop Owner
content: Hello, Zephyr! The usual? Melon buns?

speaker: Zephyr
content: You know it! Make it three!

speaker: Milly
content: Is someone else joining us?

speaker: Shop Owner
content: Zephyr usually has two. She has to load up before long flight missions. Can't take off on an empty stomach.

speaker: Milly
content: So you really are a pilot...

speaker: Zephyr
content: Hehe, how about that? Wanna go for a ride?
Milly freezes for a second before breaking into a smile. It's an almost instinctual reaction to fear—a perfect, gorgeous smile, like a flawless mask.

speaker: Milly
content: You'd take me flying?
Zephyr glances at Milly and purses her lips. Then she brushes her hair back and laughs.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Yeah, I would. But only when you really want to. When you're not afraid anymore.
Zephyr grabs a menu from the counter.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Gonna borrow this.

The owner, seemingly used to this, smiles and disappears into the kitchen. A moment later, she returns with a tray of piping hot melon buns. The crust is a beautiful golden brown, and the air is filled with the faint, sweet scent of melon.

speaker: Zephyr
content: There's no other place in all of DisCity that bakes with real, fresh melon. They say this is what melons tasted like before the Nightfall. You can't get this flavor anywhere else.

speaker: Milly
content: How did you find out about this place?

speaker: Zephyr
content: Well...

speaker: Shop Owner
content: The recipe was my mother's. Zephyr and I met at the amusement park. I passed out from fear on the drop tower ride, and she was the one who brought me back.

speaker: Milly
content: Drop tower?

speaker: Zephyr
content: Oh? Interested? We can go later. It feels... just like a plane crash.

speaker: Milly
content: A... a plane crash?
Milly stares, and Zephyr wiggles her fingers to mimic an airplane. Something flutters from her hand.
Milly flinches back before realizing it's a paperplane, freshly folded from the menu.

speaker: Zephyr
content: A plane crash. It's simple. Your heart pounds for a bit. You feel weightless, like you're floating for a good long while... and then it's over.

speaker: Milly
content: Like... falling in love?
Zephyr bursts out laughing.

speaker: Zephyr
content: You're really something else, you know? I'm starting to like you more and more.
She grabs a knife and cuts into one of the buns. The golden crust cracks open, revealing an oozing, bright green melon filling. Zephyr presses a small fork into Milly's hand.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Try it.
Milly puts a piece in her mouth.

speaker: Milly
content: It's... it's so delicious...
It's a flavor she's never known. Rich and sweet, but with a surprising freshness. The soft, fluffy texture and the lingering heat from the oven warm her from the inside out.

speaker: Zephyr
content: See? I bet even Chief hasn't tried this yet. Next time, you can tell him you know a place that sells melon from before the Nightfall, and then, you'll get yourselves a sweet little date.
female_content: See? I bet even Chief hasn't tried this yet. Next time, you can tell her you know a place that sells melon from before the Nightfall, and then, you'll get yourselves a sweet little date.

content: Milly's face goes a little red.

speaker: Milly
content: It's... so warm. I thought only love could feel this warm... Thank you, Zephyr. I'll definitely bring Chief here next time.

speaker: Zephyr
content: ...Oh. Well, that's great. See? I told you you'd love it. Okay, let's go to the cinema next. Then there's the amusement park, the bars... we've got tons of things to do!

speaker: Milly
content: Okay!
[Bar]

Several hours later. A thunderous crash echoes through the Sky Bar in Eastside. A tower of a man topples from his chair, dead drunk, while the blonde girl, his drinking opponent, takes a long sip from another Tequila Sunrise.
The crowd erupts into cheers and applause.

speaker: Bartender
content: Miss Milly wins! Mr. Jequin will be picking up the tabs for Milly and Zephyr! Ladies and gentlemen, looks like we've crowned our new Golden Goblet Queen. Let's give it up for... Milly!
The cheers grow louder as Milly's cheeks flush under the lights.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Milly, you're unbelievable! Was that your 23rd drink?

speaker: Milly
content: So, I won our bet! Now can you tell me how you won that paperplane contest?

speaker: Zephyr
content: Ah, but a pilot never reveals her trade secrets!

speaker: Milly
content: Then let's have a rematch!

speaker: Zephyr
content: You're on.

The crowd cheers as they both launch their planes. Milly's veers off course, nosediving into a partition near the bar. Zephyr's sails cleanly over the grooving crowd and disappears into the neon lights outside.

speaker: Milly
content: I'll go see where it landed.
She hops off her stool. The alcohol makes her a little unsteady, but her steps are light as she heads for the door.
The music grows sensual as the lights paint the dance floor red and purple. The joyful crowd dances to the rhythm, waving and whistling pleasantly to Milly, their Golden Goblet Queen.
Milly smiles.

This kind of attention feels different from what she's used to on Euphoria. There's no love or lust in their eyes, only simple joy and ease. She feels light, like a deer bounding through the woods, freed from a suffocating shell.
[Rooftop]

Milly finds herself on the rooftop terrace, but the paperplane is nowhere in sight. She leans over the glass railing and peers down. In the pale light of dawn, even Eastside, the city that never sleeps, begins to dim its lights.

speaker: Milly
content: Ahhh...
She takes a deep breath of DisCity's morning air, so different from the scorching heat of WhiteSands. The cool breeze seems to calm her racing heart.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Milly, what are you doing out here?

speaker: Milly
content: Hmm? Looking for your plane, of course.
She holds it up.

speaker: Milly
content: It flew so far! I want to keep it... as a memento of tonight.
More lights go out across the city as the sky brightens.

This is the tallest building in Eastside. From here, they can see all the way to the horizon, where the clouds begin to blush red as a crimson sun slowly rises from the darkness. Long shadows retreat across the land, like great phantom ships sinking into the sea.

speaker: Milly
content: That was a magical night. Thank you for everything.

speaker: Milly
content: I think... I'm starting to get it. What Kawa-kawa, you, and even Chief have been trying to tell me.

speaker: Milly
content: On this trip, I've seen so many things I'd never seen before... or things I'd seen but never really noticed.

speaker: Milly
content: I like the stars, and the sunrise. I like the movies, the bars, and paperplanes. I like DisCity, and the people who live here.

speaker: Milly
content: I'll cherish all these happy moments. I'll always hold them dear to my heart.
She turns to Zephyr, smiling.

speaker: Milly
content: But "like" isn't the same as "love." I can like lots and lots of things. But there's only one person I love.

speaker: Milly
content: He's the one I can't get out of my head, the one who makes me restless. Just one glance from him is enough to make me giddy with joy. And if I had to, I'd gladly give my life for him.
female_content: She's the one I can't get out of my head, the one who makes me restless. Just one glance from her is enough to make me giddy with joy. And if I had to, I'd gladly give my life for her.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Milly...

speaker: Milly
content: But now I know this isn't something that can be rushed. Since Chief arranged this trip for me, it probably means he isn't ready either.
female_content: But now I know this isn't something that can be rushed. Since Chief arranged this trip for me, it probably means she isn't ready either.

speaker: Milly
content: If I kept trying to force my feelings on him, it would be just hollow, wishful thinking that would only make things awkward for him.
female_content: If I kept trying to force my feelings on her, it would be just hollow, wishful thinking that would only make things awkward for her.

speaker: Milly
content: So, it's time I change my approach.

speaker: Milly
content: I'm going to see more of the world, explore new things, and meet all kinds of wonderful people. I'll gather all these amazing stories and let them become a part of me. Then, when the time is right, I'll share them with Chief. We can even go see them together.
female_content: I'm going to see more of the world, explore new things, and meet all kinds of wonderful people. I'll gather all these amazing stories, and let them become a part of me. Then, when the time is right, I'll share them with Chief. We can even go see them together.

speaker: Zephyr
content: Phew... I'm glad you figured things out. Man, I gotta say, I'm starting to get a little jealous of Chief.

speaker: Milly
content: Don't worry, Zephyr. You're amazing. You'll find your true love. I'm sure of it!

speaker: Milly
content: It's such a big, wide world. Somewhere out there, there's got to be someone you love, who loves you back.
The sun rises behind her, bathing her hair in a radiant halo of light.

speaker: Milly
content: I'm ready to see Chief now. Please, take me to MBCC.
Several months have passed since Milly was formally admitted to the Bureau, and you've finally made your way back.
You've barely sat down at your desk when an interrogation request appears before you.

speaker: Chief
content: I heard Milly's been settling in well. She's made a lot of friends among the Sinners, too... That's a relief.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I believe your arrangements have proven effective, Chief. There's no need to be too concerned.

speaker: Milly
content: Good afternoon, Chief. I'm so happy you've finally come to see me.
This is the first time you've properly seen her face-to-face since she woke up.
She sits relaxed in her chair and offers a smile as sweet as honey.

speaker: Milly
content: It's been months since we parted on Euphoria. I've missed you so much.

speaker: Milly
content: Whenever I missed you, I'd ask the staff about you. They were always very kind and would tell me what you were up to. Whether you'd returned safely, whether you were hurt, or... I worried, but there wasn't much I could do.

speaker: Milly
content: I knew you were busy with important things, and that's why you couldn't come see me. So I tried my best to be patient.

speaker: Option
options: I heard you've been doing well here.
I'm sorry it took me so long.

speaker: Milly
content: I have. There are so many interesting people in the Bureau. Thanks to them, every day has been rewarding.

speaker: Chief
content: Are you getting used to things here?

speaker: Milly
content: Yes! There are so many interesting people in the Bureau. Thanks to them, every day has been rewarding.

speaker: Milly
content: I've talked about dance with Miss Hamel, and discussed the best donuts in Eastside with Miss Poffy. Miss Yugu always has fascinating stories about Eastia to share with me.

speaker: Milly
content: There are other Sinners I've only seen in passing. We haven't had a chance to talk yet. But my next goal is to become friends with everyone.

speaker: Milly
content: Some might find life here boring, but coming from Euphoria, I'm used to being locked in one place. Besides, everyone at the Bureau is so much more interesting than the ones back there.
She pauses for a moment.

speaker: Milly
content: I... I've been trying my best to put into practice what Kawa-kawa, Zephyr, and you wanted to tell me.

speaker: Milly
content: I know what you've been trying to tell me: that I need to love myself before I can love others, and love the world before I can love all the people in it. I get the idea, and I've found many things I enjoy now, but... I think it would make me happier if I could share them with the person I love most.

speaker: Milly
content: These precious memories... I want to share them with you, Chief.
Cautiously, she looks into your eyes.

speaker: Milly
content: Can I?

You can feel the intensity in her eyes. The rise and fall of her chest betrays the excitement she's trying so hard to contain. Her words are measured, her actions restrained. She doesn't want to make you uncomfortable, but the love she feels is threatening to spill.
You choose your words carefully.

speaker: Option
options: I heard you ran into a sandstorm on your way back?

content: Milly's expression brightens.

speaker: Milly
content: Yes. We were on the sand ship, and the captain said it was a huge, rare storm. It was so dangerous. All I could think was, if I died there, I'd never see you again. So I knew I had to be strong.

speaker: Milly
content: I climbed to the top of the mast—it was about to be blown away—and secured the transmitter. And there, I saw them. The giant moving dunes that they say you can only see in a sandstorm.

speaker: Milly
content: It was breathtaking! The dunes rolled like colorful dragons. And the sand that flew into my hair... it was colored, too.

speaker: Milly
content: Kawa-kawa told me that the sand dunes and the stars are made of the same stuff. And that the most beautiful night sky is the one that comes after a sandstorm.

speaker: Milly
content: Then, I met Zephyr in DisCity. She took me to so many places. I tried melon from before the Nightfall and watched the latest blockbuster movie. We spent the entire night at the bar. Everyone here looks at me differently from those people did on Euphoria. They don't "love" me; they simply treat me as an equal, a person just like them.

speaker: Milly
content: Meeting them made me realize... I'm so glad I left that place. I'm so glad to be alive.

speaker: Chief
content: I didn't do much to help you. You did it all yourself.

speaker: Chief
content: You never gave up on yourself, even when you were afraid. Not during the sandstorm, and not on that cruise.

speaker: Chief
content: I never thought of you as someone who needed saving. You fought to survive in that hell on your own, and you had the courage to help others.

speaker: Chief
content: Having help is certainly important. But the greatest reason you're here right now is because you refused to give up on yourself.
Silence falls. Milly seems lost in thought.

speaker: Milly
content: ...Do you really not know what it is, Chief? The reason I refused to give up, the reason I found the strength to live, no matter the hardship?

speaker: Milly
content: Do you remember, Chief? That gang shootout in the West District?

speaker: Milly
content: You saved a girl in an alley on that rainy day. She came from nothing. Her parents were horrible people who sold her to a gang just because she had pretty, golden hair.

speaker: Milly
content: She tried to run, many, many times, but they always caught her. And every time, they'd beat her senseless. All she could do was escape into her fantasies to numb the pain and heal the wounds. Eventually, she got so good at it that she could even use her fantasies to numb the men with the sticks. At least, enough to make the beatings hurt a little less.

speaker: Milly
content: Then one day, the revolution came. Rustfire swept through the West District, and the gangs were wiped out. She was finally free. She could escape and not be dragged back.

speaker: Milly
content: But... she was so weak. She got hurt in the escape, and she couldn't keep up with the crowds. She ended up lying in a filthy alley in the rain, waiting for the monsters to come, waiting to die.

speaker: Milly
content: So she retreated into her fantasies one last time. She dreamed that someone would come, someone who would love her and protect her. Someone who would give her a happy home, a happy life. She was dying. The least she could do was imagine his face before the end.
female_content: You can count on me to have your backs! Go and fight them without worry!

speaker: Milly
content: And then... as if the heavens heard her plea, someone ran toward her, driving back the growling monsters with flashes of red light.

speaker: Milly
content: With rain and blood blurring her vision, she couldn't make out her savior's face. All she could tell was that he had shoulder-length hair and smelled of blood and gunpowder. He carried her to safety and gave her a dagger for self-defense.
female_content: With rain and blood blurring her vision, she couldn't make out her savior's face. All she could tell was that she had shoulder-length hair and smelled of blood and gunpowder. She carried her to safety and gave her a dagger for self-defense.

speaker: Milly
content: Then he was gone... he seemed so busy. The dagger he gave her was sharp. Sharp enough to slit the monsters' throats. Or her own.
female_content: Then she was gone... she seemed so busy. The dagger she gave her was sharp. Sharp enough to slit the monsters' throats. Or her own.

speaker: Milly
content: But in the end, she didn't bring the blade on herself. Because now she had the hope to live. She believed that just like all her other fantasies had come true in one way or another, this person had to be her fantasy come true, too. The one who would love her, protect her, and give her a happy life.

speaker: Milly
content: But it was just a fantasy, wasn't it? A fantasy that carried me through so many hardships that... I started to believe it was real.
The sweet scent of honey fills your senses.
Something flutters in your chest, pulsing, surging, fighting to break free.
You seem to see Milly rise from her seat and walk toward you. She takes your hand and places it against her cheek.
Her eyes are wet, like a newborn fawn's. The air she breathes seems laced with the sweetness of honey.

speaker: Milly
content: I wanted so badly for it to be real...
She leans in with a delicate peck. Once isn't enough. She does it again.
First your nose, then your cheek, and finally a careful, tentative touch against your lips.
Yet she lingers there, afraid to go any further.
Her movements are shy and cautious, terrified of shattering this fragile dream.
You feel something wet on your face and realize—she's crying.
Both bitterness and sweetness pass from her lips to yours. It seems that only here, in this illusion, can she finally have what she's always wanted.

speaker: Milly
content: Hah...

speaker: Milly
content: ...Thank you, Chief.

speaker: Milly
content: Hmm... Just the reaction I expected.
(Paths converge)
The illusion fades. The power Milly released was so minimal that it could hardly be considered a threat, and the interrogation room's alarm remains silent.
She's back in her chair, a faint smile on her lips. Her eyes are glistening, as if on the verge of tears.

speaker: Milly
content: Thank you, Chief. For letting me have my dream.

speaker: Milly
content: Really? You're so kind, Chief. But you don't have to comfort me like this...
You take an unconscious step toward her.

speaker: Chief
content: I remember that battle. I remember saving a girl with golden hair, the color of honey. Her smile was adorable, and she was brave. I knew she could protect herself.

speaker: Chief
content: Then, not long after, I saw her again. She had become brighter, more dazzling than before. She had survived, with the dagger I gave her. Not only had she survived, but she'd helped so many others survive, too.

speaker: Chief
content: But a part of me was always worried. Worried that she was just blinded by a crush, that her love would end up trapping her.

speaker: Chief
content: But she proved me wrong. She showed me that she wouldn't be confined to a small corner. She's taking new steps, finding a bigger world, embracing a more beautiful life.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm sorry, Milly. This time, I was the one who was afraid.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm looking forward to the day you invite me out, whether it's to see the stars in WhiteSands, or to enjoy the food in Eastside. I'd be delighted to go with you.

speaker: Milly
content: Chief... why are you only saying these things now?

speaker: Milly
content: I've already prepared myself for heartbreak! Do you have any idea how long I've spent readying myself for rejection? How many nights I cried?
Milly's face flushes red, her eyes welling up with angry tears.

speaker: Milly
content: I thought you didn't care for me at all! I'm already prepared to win you over from scratch.

speaker: Milly
content: Forget it, I'm not taking you with me! I'm taking someone else! You can just stay here and work yourself to death for all I care!
You easily catch her flailing hand and, unfazed by her tantrum, hold it gently in yours.

speaker: Chief
content: Alright. When you find an even more special place to take me, we'll go then.
The crimson curtains are drawn open, revealing the seats filled with audience.

speaker: Announcer
content: Coming up next is a solo dance!
Clack. Right after the announcement, the spotlight shoots out a burning beam, scorching the top of your head.
You finally make out the faces in the audience. They're black phantoms gleaming with an eerie, ghostly light, and with a murderous air around them, they're charging at you!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief?
Nightingale's voice pulls you back to reality.

speaker: Nightingale
content: According to your request, the FAC has sent as many forces as possible and the contamination has mostly been cleaned up.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But the issue you're concerned about most, the Sinner Hamel, her...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Her mental state is not very stable.
...For 23 years, she's been living among Corruptors and dancing ceaselessly in the illusory realm, without any concept of time. Of course, she can't cope with returning to reality all of a sudden.

speaker: Nightingale
content: No... The situation may be worse than you think. Her mental condition has affected her memories and even her Catalyst power.

speaker: Nightingale
content: As for the cause of her mental instability, I'm afraid you'll have to find out more about it through interrogation, Chief.
Nightingale seems a little tense. But even after her preamble on Hamel's condition, when you enter the interrogation room, Hamel's confused state still surprises you.
Hamel...

speaker: Hamel
content: Ch-chief...
She still seems unaccustomed to this title, clutching at the hem of her dress nervously.

Elegant, gentle, strong, kind... Your entire impression of her in the Carnival is now sealed under confusion and horror. You cannot imagine the kind of spiritual power one must pay as the price to subdue Corruptors...
We're all very grateful for your efforts, and we hope to help you find out the cause of your mental instability. If you don't like the format of this conversation, we can take it somewhere else.

speaker: Hamel
content: You're all grateful?
Yes. You helped Hella and Hecate get rid of the darkness in their hearts. You suppressed the Corruptors, saving the FAC and the MBCC from depleting their forces. You've helped many people.

speaker: Hamel
content: Me? ...I've helped you?
You really don't remember anything? In the Carnival, there were a Hamel who was your impersonator, three puppets who wished to protect your dance, and Parma with his subordinates in raincoats...

speaker: Hamel
content: My impersonator... Puppets...?
The sudden overflow of information is giving her nerves. She frowns, repeating your words while shaking her head constantly.

speaker: Hamel
content: I, I don't remember. I only know I was dancing... I kept twirling and twirling...

speaker: Hamel
content: From the moment I stepped onto that dance floor to the moment I got woken up by you, decades seemed to have passed, and yet it also felt... as short as a blink of an eye.

speaker: Hamel
content: Dancing, and dancing... That's the only clear memory I have from that dream.

options: Then do you still remember me?

content: The shackles are gleaming with a red light, sending warmth from your fingertips to her. Hamel merely looks down and gives a faint smile.

speaker: Hamel
content: It's a familiar and kind warmth... I wish I could remember what it is.
It seems like she's forgotten about you too.
I'll come back to get you!
This is not the end!
Dance for yourself!
I'll give you a stage!
Wait for me...
We still have a lot of time, you will remember everything... Right now, our priority is to find out the cause of your mental instability and help you adapt to the world outside the Ring.
You still remain gentle and patient, but you can't help feeling a little down. You've fulfilled the promise between the two of you, yet she's already forgotten it.
Still, Hamel captures your unexpressed frustration and disappointment.

speaker: Hamel
content: I really want to help you, want to recall the story behind this red light, but... That voice has ripped open the past, too many memories are flooding out. I...

speaker: Hamel
content: I can't find you in them fast enough...
Voice? What voice?
It could be what's disturbing Hamel's mind.

speaker: Hamel
content: The final words he left before leaving...
Hamel's gaze falls upon the evidence bag beside your hand.
I got it from an elderly man at the Carnival's gate. He said I could find your location with this...
At the bottom of the lake, I gave the pendant back to you, until you were rescued by the FAC.
What did you hear from it?

speaker: Hamel
content: An... elderly man?
Her voice sounds a little choked with sobs.
Yes, a white-haired old man. Why?

speaker: Hamel
content: No, nothing. It's just that I've forgotten that, time is not the only thing that ages people...
She lets out a soft sigh and smiles a little sorrowfully.

speaker: Hamel
content: It's him. He keeps repeating this to me, time after time...
Hamel cups the keepsake next to her ear.

speaker: Hamel
content: "I'm sorry, Sister, I can finally... meet you..."
Sister?
Before you have time to follow up with questions, a boy you've never seen before suddenly appears in the interrogation room.
Sister, quickly! Before they find us, I need to take you somewhere no one can find us!
The boy has a melancholic and immaculate air about him, seeming extremely determined as he speaks those words.
Don't worry, I'm young and full of strength. I can handle any job, delivering goods, pulling a rickshaw, I can do them all.
I know you're fed up with a life like this. You fear the stage. But as long as I'm here, no one can force you to dance.
This is?
The shackles have sensed the answer for you. This is an illusion Hamel has created with her ability.
The boy in the illusion has long blue hair and a pendant around his neck, looking strangely familiar.

options: Is that boy your younger brother?
That boy is the old man at the Carnival.

speaker: Hamel
content: Yes, that's my story before I entered the Black Ring...
She stares at the pendant in her palm, her fingertip brushing the yellowed portrait of herself.
For Hamel, time has stopped with the Black Ring, so there hasn't been any changes in her appearance. But her younger brother, Norman, has become a white-haired old man...
Both time and talent have not treated the sister and brother fairly.

speaker: Norman
content: Never go on stage again! The doctor said you feared the stage! If you don't want to faint and trigger your illness again, listen to me!

speaker: Norman
content: I only want you to stay here, stay with me! You don't have to worry about money!

speaker: Norman
content: I'm doing all of this for your sake... It's all for you!

speaker: Hamel
content: Norman... I'm sorry...

speaker: Norman
content: You don't understand anything... What should I do... Please, what should I do...
The boy turns around in despair, a chasm separating him and his sister.
You seem to have had some arguments.

speaker: Hamel
content: His feet were entangled in mud, making him irritable.
By mud, do you mean stress from his daily life?
You are slowly catching up with the tempo of Hamel's expressions.
She nods, and with a wave of her hand, a new illusion unfolds.

speaker: Younger Brother
content: I won't have to worry about tomorrow's dinner... I won't have to bear the foreman's beating and swearing... I won't have to worry about Sister being taken away...

speaker: Hamel
content: Norman... Where have you been today? You seem a bit strange...

speaker: Younger Brother
content: Don't worry, as soon as I step inside the Carnival, all my troubles will vanish...
In the illusory realm, Hamel pulls the boy back, trying to talk sense into him again and again...

speaker: Hamel
content: No, stop now!
She walks into the perilous carnival alone, pushing Norman away.
The marching crowd drowns her figure. With her dance, a brand new massive illusion unfolds, separating the siblings on the two sides of the new park's walls.

speaker: Hamel
content: Leave this place, never come back inside...
The illusion fades, leaving only the sad message from Hamel's past echoing in the interrogation room.
The protagonist of the story looks down at the only keepsake in her hands, closing the locket gently.
That's why you stayed in the Black Ring?

speaker: Hamel
content: It was all because of me that he suffered so many troubles and became obsessed with the Carnival's bustle. To stop him from reentering that dangerous place, that was the only option I had.

speaker: Hamel
content: I thought he could let go of the past and begin a new life of his own. But I'd overlooked that...

speaker: Hamel
content: As siblings, besides our appearances, we resemble each other in some other ways after all. Our stubbornness and persistence... I didn't expect he would linger outside the Carnival for so many years.
Who'd have guessed, that a missing Black Ring case that's impacted the DisCity for decades all started because a sister was trying to stop her brother from ruining his life?
The cause of awakening of the first publicly known Sinner is not some tale filled with intense grief or hatred. Rather, it is somewhat mundane?
I'm so sorry, your brother Norman...

speaker: Hamel
content: I know, I can sense that... he's no longer alive, is he?
No. When the FAC eliminated all the Corruptors in the lake and brought you out, we double checked and found no other survivors.

speaker: Hamel
content: I see... Perhaps the finale of the dance has already been written long ago.

speaker: Hamel
content: I entered the Carnival because of Norman, and before I left the Carnival, I also heard... his final voices.
Her head bowed, her resigned and pitying eyes pass slowly over the marks left on the pendant by time.

speaker: Hamel
content: It's my fault...

options: It's all in the past now...

content: It's the passing of her closest family. They've been missing each other but never seen for over twenty years. There are no words to console this kind of sorrow.
Before he left, he asked me to watch your dance in his stead. His wish was granted, I think he didn't suffer much when he passed away...
He's already gone. You should be freed from this as well.

speaker: Hamel
content: Freed...?
No, she can't be freed yet...
Who's talking?

Buzz...
Before you can react, dizziness overcomes you and your ears are ringing, a new illusion taking over your entire vision.
Dark chaotic colors cover all the lights in the interrogation room. A phantom is extending its tentacles to envelope both of you.
You've seen this phantom before! In the vision you had in the dazed moment before the interrogation, in the audience facing the stage.

speaker: Hamel
content: No... It's...

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: I'm a part of you. Your confusion, your perplexity, your loneliness, everything you see in your nightmares...
Nightmares? Could it be that what you saw before the interrogation was caused by the spiritual link of the shackles?
The phantom brushes your cheek as if with compassion.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: He has his own doubts, purposes, and desires. What about you? Hamel, what is your answer?
female_content: She has her own doubts, purposes, and desires. What about you? Hamel, what is your answer?

speaker: Hamel
content: I... I've already given my answer...

speaker: Hamel
content: The Carnival was dangerous... I, I could only...

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: The Ring had shattered and Norman had left, you had no more reasons to stay... Why did you sacrifice yourself? Why did you dance with the Corruptors? You know it, you must know the answer...
The phantom approaches Hamel step by step. Though she is the owner of the illusory realm, Hamel can't stop its questioning and can only muffle her ears helplessly.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: It wasn't only for Norman. It wasn't only to trap the monsters in there. Say it, what is it that you've always desired! Why did you stay in the Carnival!

speaker: Hamel
content: What I desire... What do I desire...

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: You're still feeling anxious, you're still confused, that's... why you've created me! You're not freed from this yet! You cannot be freed!

speaker: Hamel
content: I don't know, I don't know...
Hamel keeps shaking her head. Your temples continue to hurt too.

options: Ask Hamel to end the illusion

content: Don't respond to it. Don't let that devilish voice in the illusion entice you.
Calm down. Breathe deeply. Forget what it said.

speaker: Hamel
content: Norman... The reason I stayed in the Carnival... Ugh...
Your comforting words prove useless. Cradling her head, Hamel crouches on the chair in agony, repeating the phantom's questions.
If it's part of your emotions and your mind, then its existence depends on your illusions.
Continuing to use the Manic power will only worsen the chaos in your mind. Breathe deeply, end the illusion, make it go away.

speaker: Hamel
content: I... I can't!
Cradling her head, Hamel crouches on the chair in agony.
Buzz... The ringing in your ears and the headache are coming back.
As expected, if you're to control a Catalyst Sinner with such great empathic power, you yourself must be burdened with a corresponding price.
The Sinner's shaken mind, the unstable empathic power, and the spiritual burden from the shackles. These three things make up a vicious cycle!
Hamel, end the illusion now!

speaker: Hamel
content: What is... this place? Where... should I go?
Hamel!
The red light from the shackles has banished the sticky phantom, but it's also tearing hard at your nerves at the same time.
Fortunately, the interrogation room has finally quieted down.
There are no Norman, no jellyfish-like phantom, no dancer from the past. Everything has only been a projection from Hamel's heart.
Voice a little dull, she's staring at your ashen face helplessly, hands pressing on her chest trying to steady her own breaths.

speaker: Hamel
content: Was that... a part of me?

speaker: Hamel
content: It was questioning me? It... It hurt you...
I was briefly affected when your illusion went out of control.
Hamel lowers her head apologetically, her eyelashes dampened and fluttering slightly.

speaker: Hamel
content: I want to tell you everything about myself, but there's another voice stuck in my chest constantly, thump, thump...
That means the voice causing your mental instability isn't Norman, but the numerous memories emerged after Norman's departure. Is something from your memories 23 years ago worsening your perplexity?

speaker: Hamel
content: I can't make it clear... It won't recognize my answer. To question me, it even willingly takes on a physical form and appears in my nightmares and illusions all of a sudden...
Hamel's words have gotten even more abstract than before. You try to understand what she means.
Appears all of a sudden? The perplexity and loneliness signified by that phantom, have they only gotten exceptionally intense recently?

Judging from the time frame, it has to be directly related to her leaving the Carnival. The messy memories, leaving the Carnival, the perplexity and loneliness... The reason she stayed in the Black Ring is gradually becoming clear.
But looking at Hamel who's still in a daze, you realize it's not yet the right time to reveal everything. You can't further burden her fragile mind.
That phantom with a physical form said you were confused, perplexed, and lonely... But that's not your fault.
You managed to spend 23 years in the Black Ring, and have prevented Norman and more people from slipping into danger. You've already done an excellent job.
Hamel's brow is still tightly frowned.

speaker: Hamel
content: Can I still find the answer today, 23 years later? The reason that even I myself have almost forgotten, the reason why I stayed in the Carnival...

I'm sure you can.
Unconscious thoughts usually reveal your true desires in your subconsciousness. I'll help you find the answer.
The crimson curtains are drawn open, revealing the seats filled with audience.
You're certain you've seen this scene before.
You have experienced the same dream before the interrogation. As you've been expecting, you hear the announcer's voice behind you.

speaker: Announcer
content: Coming up next is a solo dance!
Clack. The spotlight shoots out a burning beam, scorching the top of your head.

The audience is going to turn into jellyfish-shaped phantoms and charge at you. You prepare yourself mentally. The spiritual link doesn't happen without a reason. She must have recalled an important past event, and perhaps the cause of her perplexity lies here.

speaker: Audience
content: That's the legendary dancer?
No charging phantoms. This time, the dream seems slightly nuanced, the audience is only murmuring among themselves.

speaker: Audience
content: We're watching the show to celebrate our anniversary, why is she pulling a long face?

speaker: Audience
content: Well, dance! Don't just stand around!

speaker: Audience
content: Think you're too famous to dance for ordinary people like us?

speaker: Audience
content: Where's the music? Let the show begin, entertain me!

speaker: Audience
content: What's that sulky face for? How unpleasant! Get *** off the stage if you're not gonna dance!
The audience keeps chattering and the spiritual link is throbbing lightly, synchronizing the discomfort of the dream's owner with your senses.
What's the matter, my child? They're all here for you, go on, dance for them.
A well-dressed woman emerges from behind the curtain.

speaker: Hamel
content: Mother... What they want is a decadent dance full of joy and pleasure.

speaker: Mother
content: So what? Just give them the dance they want. You're a genius, I know it. You can bring any kind of dance to reality!

speaker: Hamel
content: But sad melodies are floating everywhere in the world. How shall I dance for joy?
You follow the gaze of the dream's owner. Bluish-purple smoke flows before your eyes, forms a familiar ring shape, then suddenly shatters, dispersing in the air as tiny specks of sadness.
Is this the pseudo-illusion Hamel had been able to see growing up?

speaker: Mother
content: Shush, never mention that again! I don't care what filthy thing the great explosion of DisSea has made you see. Promise me, never speak a word about it. You're a great dancer, we can't let them see you as a lunatic...

speaker: Hamel
content: But...
Hamel wants to say something more, but her mother has already reached out eagerly from behind the curtain and pushes her onto the stage.
Vibrant drum beats begin at the next second, and the dream's owner is forced to present herself on the stage.

speaker: Hamel
content: One, two, three, four...
As Hamel is counting the beats silently, your perspective keeps spinning joyously following Hamel's movements.
You see that wherever her sleeves pass, a bluish-purple mist rises, and the stage is becoming blurry and dreamy in Hamel's eyes. A familiar figure forms amid the mist.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: You were born to dance. Dancing is your way of connecting to the world. You perceive everything with your body. Yet, what have you truly perceived?

The dream's owner is moving back and forth amid the mist, feeling the flow of the air with her fingers. The sadness she feels with her fingertips and the joy of the music are grappling in her veins. She's only keeping her steps orderly relying on muscle memory.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Broken, sad... This is what you want to narrate, what the great explosion has left this city with... but this is not what they wish to see.

speaker: Audience
content: Bravo! Praises for the legendary dancer's expressiveness are no exaggeration!
The colorful mist has grown a little dimmer, and the dance moves are gradually growing weak.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Do you remember their faces? They don't understand, and they don't want to understand... A medium to numb themselves with, a tool to help them escape from reality. That's what you are to them, nothing more.

speaker: Audience
content: Keep dancing! One more! One more!
The illusory mist has mostly vanished. Cheers and applause have almost covered the music of the dance.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Is this your art? Is this the dance you want?

speaker: Mother
content: My good daughter, dance well, bring me so much wealth with your dance so I can be rich for the rest of my life...
The mist is gone, and reality has become extremely clear.

Your perspective is no longer spinning joyously, and you can't feel the most sentimental desire in her blood anymore. All the urge to express broken beauty has been defeated in this grapple with false joy. Hamel halts her steps.
Her gaze passes over the smirking faces in the audience who have convinced themselves they're happy. She wobbles.
Thump!
She falls under the spotlights.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Have you found the answer? Why did you choose the Black Ring? Why did you stay there?
In the dark, the phantom brushes against Hamel's face.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: There's no place for you in the outside world. Go back, you can only find what you truly desire there.

speaker: Hamel
content: Go back, go back...
The scene changes. A dazzling light refracted through the ice surface leads you into the next dream.
The stage at the center of the lake in the Carnival?
This is a place both you and Hamel know very well. Black jellyfish are frozen above the center of the lake, as if they've been waiting for Hamel to return.

speaker: Hamel
content: Will I find the answer by coming back here?

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Of course, do you not trust me?

speaker: Hamel
content: It's just that, you're an illusion that's only recently appeared in my dreams...

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: No...
The phantom closes in on Hamel.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: I've always been by your side.

speaker: Void Puppet
content: The dancer doesn't need to be greeted. She only needs to dance. We will be your audience.

Townspeople
Well, dance! Don't just stand around!

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: Once I see your dance, my heart regains peace.

Audience
Where's the music? Let the show begin, entertain me!

speaker: Fear Puppet
content: All our unspeakable sorrow, all our inexpressible pain, you understand them and empathize with us, mourning on behalf of us with your dance.

speaker: Mother
content:
Mother
Freak, lunatic...

Corruptor
Dance, Hamel, dance... Use your dancing... to make our dreams a reality!

speaker: Younger Brother
content:
Younger Brother
Stop dancing, Sister!

Corruptor
Thank you, we love you...
Plunk!
You hear the sound of someone diving to the bottom of the lake. Bone-chilling ice water rushes into your mouth and nose. A despairing feeling of suffocation drags you back to reality.

speaker: Hamel
content: That's right, you've always been by my side... What I truly desire... The reason I couldn't bring myself to leave...

speaker: Hamel
content: Always been here...
I know what it is that Hamel truly desires...

Dancing is the most straightforward aesthetic exchange between the audience and the dancer. Hamel's dance of brokenness will never be accepted by the ostentatious big stages in the DisCity. The only beings that will accept her are...
Corruptors who have also experienced brokenness.

The dream was very long. It's already past midnight now, and most people in the Bureau are already in their sleep, but you can't suppress the urge to share your conclusion. You must tell Hamel the entire answer as soon as possible.
Hopefully... she still remembers what she saw in her dream.
But you arrive at the detention area of the Sinners only to find Hamel's room empty.

speaker: Alarm
content: Warning! Warning! Sinner S-008 has gone missing! All guards please search every section of the Bureau!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief! Your guess is correct. Hamel has indeed gone in the direction of the Carnival.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Besides, we've detected that the Corruptors scattered along the Rust seem to have received some kind of summoning and are converging on the Carnival!

speaker: Nightingale
content: I've contacted all the available police forces we can mobilize along the way, to slow her down as much as possible and minimize the impact of the loitering Corruptors on scavenging civilians along the Rust.
Corruptors... Audiences...

speaker: Nightingale
content: You don't look well. Is it because you got startled out of sleep? Or is it the shackles...
No, there's nothing wrong with the shackles. I've just got something on my own mind...

The audience treated her as an entertaining plaything. Her family alienated her and treated her as a cash cow. The public only cared about her gossip. Even the Bureau... has only treated her as a Sinner with a very high risk.
Just like she was determined to stay inside the Black Ring, now she wants to escape from reality and return to her final stage.
Are you really going to stop her?
"Keep your distance, and do not harm her." This was the only order you gave the guards before you leave.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But after all, she's able to suppress the Black Ring with her illusions...
I will never do anything that goes against the MBCC's stance. Do you trust me on this?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Of course.
Then please trust my judgment too. I'll find a solution that works for both the MBCC and Hamel.
Between resisting and self-sacrifice, she's always chosen the latter.
Going back to the stage and dancing what she wants to dance. That's the only choice she's made for herself. I hope to help her achieve that.
Based on the location sent back by the guards ahead, Nightingale, you, and the others finally catch up with Hamel at around 1 kilometer from the Carnival.
The guards who've arrived beforehand have been following Hamel. Because of your order, they've been keeping a distance without taking any further actions.
She seems unable to hear any other sound, her mind fixed on making her way to the Carnival unhurriedly.
Hamel, I already know what you truly desire. You want a stage that will accept you, right?
She still doesn't turn back.
Hamel!
The Rust is covered in sewage and mud, but none of these has soiled Hamel's feet.
Like a ghost who's eager to be home, she's floating slightly, approaching the remains of the Black Ring, the true appearance of the ruins now revealed.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: It's useless...
The familiar shadow is blocking your way.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: She just wants to go back there. No one can stop her.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: No one...
As the phantom finishes, an indigo illusion is immediately filling your sight.

Everyone is being engulfed in the deep sea-like illusion. The phantom rises in the air, and the illusion is expanding rapidly, sealing every corner of the road as well as completely blocking Hamel's figure ahead of you.
It's you again... You're the embodiment of Hamel's negative emotions, aren't you? What are you going to do this time?

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: I won't let you guys near her.

options: I only want to help her.

content: I saw her past in my dreams. I completely understand her feelings of wanting to return to the Carnival.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Haha, you understand...

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Do you know how many people have lied to her like that? I've already stopped believing...
"Swish!" Before you have time to object, the phantom attacks you without any warning.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, watch out!
Nightingale shoots in time, the bullet and the tentacle canceling out each other's impact.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: You've got a good adjutant. You've also got so many subordinates who obey you, and those Sinners... They all see you as a friend and agree with your decisions...

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: But what about Hamel?
The phantom is drifting left and right, its tone sometimes sad and sometimes angry.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Hamel doesn't have family who understand her nor friends who appreciate her.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Worse still... She only knows the DisCity 23 years ago. She doesn't even know a single place in the present DisCity.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: You have eliminated the Corruptors, removed all her audience, and now... all she has left is the Carnival...
The phantom closes in on you once again, and Nightingale instantly aims her gun at it.
Although the Jellyfish with its severe speech before you has a completely different character than Hamel, it's essentially the vessel of all of Hamel's negative emotions.
Behind its words, perhaps there lie Hamel's thoughts that she has never expressed.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Sorrow, brokenness, fragility. Such is the DisCity's future, a prophecy of beauty, it is everything she perceives!

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: You can never bind the dancer's limbs. You can never silence her over the beauty she sees. You can never put her back into the cage!

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: The dancer must return to the stage!!!
And with that, the phantom begins spinning on the spot. At the same time, the indigo illusory realm starts twisting and transforming with it as well.
The spinning surroundings make you sick at once.
I'm not trying to capture her...

The phantom doesn't spare you any chances to explain. The illusory realm is expanding further, so that now on top of the tormenting vision, a voice like a croaking siren has also joined in, worsening your dizziness.
You're not the only one being affected. The guards, and even Nightingale, are all suffering from dizziness and nausea.
Buzz! A familiar sting surges from the shackles again. Something new is happening.

speaker: Hamel
content: I've come back to dance for you. Do you still remember me?
Facing the empty ruins of the Carnival, Hamel smiles nostalgically. Meanwhile, outside the Carnival, large crowds of loitering Corruptors are looking up at the sky.

speaker: Wandering Corruptor
content: Hamel... Dance... Tell the story... for us...
They keep repeating Hamel's name and moving slowly in the same direction.

You can't wait any longer. Whether it's to stop the Corruptors from converging on the Carnival or for the sake of Hamel's mental stability, you must finish off this damned jellyfish as quickly as possible.
It wasn't my intention to fight you, because you've said you're part of Hamel. I don't know if harming you will cause any side effects in her.
But since you can't calm down and listen to me, I can only force you into cooperating with me.

You reach out your right hand. The shackles spill out a crimson gleam in your palm, but it turns into deep sea foam the moment it touches the phantom. <color=#fb9259>The shackles don't work on it?</color>

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, the foam is only an illusion. Its power has gotten significantly weaker. If you try once more, this time it must...!

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Shut up! I won't let anyone stop Hamel!
As it's speaking, it leaps in the middle of the air. The black illusion expands and stirs the air, lifting everything around it in the air.

The innocent participants of this battle have all been whirled into the illusory realm, amid rubble, debris, and illusions... Besides you who stand in the center, everything is spinning with the phantom's illusory realm.
The foam envelopes your hand and once again devours the shackles' red light. The phantom is standing before you.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Do you really understand her? Can you really accept her? Then what are these shackles in your hands for?
The shackles also serve to suppress her Mania and prevent her mental state from getting worse.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: But the illusions brought by Mania is a part of the soul of her dance!
That's why I must go there! Compared to the Corruptors who will only worsen her Mania and her mind, I'm a better audience, because I can prevent accidents with the shackles.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: You... you're not here to capture her?
I'm here to take her back, but more importantly, I want to try to make her wish come true.

She wishes for audiences who can appreciate her dance of sadness. Stop manipulating the Corruptors, I'll be her audience instead. No matter what kind of world she perceives, as long as it's Hamel's dance, I'll watch it, I'll appreciate it.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: No ulterior motive, no plan to use her, no coercion? You will always let her dance the way she wants to?
Of course.
She can dance to her heart's content.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: To her heart's content...
The jellyfish-like shadow is expressionless, but you can tell it's lowered its guard.
This time, there are no more illusions disturbing you. The red spikes are spreading all the way out of your palm.
Hamel has always considered others' feelings first and buried her most pressing wishes in the deepest corner of her heart, leaving them to pile up there.
Confusion, perplexity, and loneliness... Still, I need to thank you, for letting me see her nightmares, so I could help her put those thoughts into words.
The shackles' spikes and the phantom become entangled with each other, and with a slight tug, it becomes a cloud of black smoke.

As the phantom vanishes, the indigo illusory realm is gradually fading as well. After snapping out of the dream in the middle of the night and chasing your way here in the dark, you realize it's already dawn outside the illusory realm.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, do you really have to go on your own?
All those who got whirled up in mid-air have been gently lowered back onto the ground.
Hamel has never thought of hurting anyone. Even the embodiment of her most extreme and negative emotions has never caused any loss to the MBCC.
Don't worry, I've got the shackles with me, I'll be fine. I got out of the Carnival when the Black Ring was still active, why would I get trapped by these ruins?
Before I come back out, you guys stay here and stand by.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But...
Your adjutant is still worrying about you.
Don't forget you've promised to trust my decisions on our way here.
I'm only going to see a dance. Once the show ends, I'll bring back the dancer and make sure she's well and conscious.
With guidance from the shackles and the pendant left by Norman, it's not hard to locate Hamel. She hasn't gone far and is still around where the main gate used to be.
When you find her, she's touching the broken ruins curiously, examining them carefully.

options: Hamel, what are you looking at?

speaker: Hamel
content: Chief.
She seems unsurprised by your arrival.

speaker: Hamel
content: I've seen the ugly, terrifying Carnival before it was shrouded by the illusions, and I've also seen it in its most bustling, prosperous prime under the fake delusion.

speaker: Hamel
content: But the Carnival ... it's the first time I've seen it like this.
In order to eradicate all risk of spreading Mania, most of the amusement facilities have already been removed. These remaining ones will probably be removed soon too.
Before long, this place will become a desert, or may even be covered again by the waste from the Rust.

speaker: Hamel
content: I guess the DisCity will soon forget the Carnival, and forget me as well...
I will remember you, and I will help you remember what happened here. That's why I came here today.
That meddlesome jellyfish has already told you, hasn't it?
The sudden joke makes Hamel laugh. She presses her hands on her chest gently.

speaker: Hamel
content: It told me everything... You're willing to watch me dance, right?
Yes, even though I'm the only audience.

speaker: Hamel
content: Only one... is good enough.
Along the desolate bank, only you, Hamel, and two shadows elongated by the sun are walking side by side.
You need to continue into the depths of the remains of the Carnival and go back to the stage at the center of the lake that belongs only to Hamel.
Around here is where I met the three puppets, Void, Misery, and Fear. They all loved your dance. Do you still remember?

speaker: Hamel
content: Void, Misery, and Fear... Are these their names?
Yes.

speaker: Hamel
content: Such sad names...

speaker: Hamel
content: I recall part of it now... My dance could help them forget their troubles briefly, but it couldn't truly console these souls.
She reaches out her hand, brushing through the invisible air, and three tiny jellyfish illusions emerge before you.

speaker: Hamel
content: Go, go to that world free of trouble. When they're in need of my dance, you'll keep them company in my stead.
Hamel waves her hand, and the three tiny jellyfish rise in the air unhurriedly.
Though you know this is merely a visual ceremony and they can't really reach another world like this, you still can't help lifting your gaze to see the three little jellyfish off in the sky.
You keep going in the direction you're given until the soil not far ahead reveals a large stretch of charred remains left by an intense battle.

speaker: Hamel
content: You faced danger here?

speaker: Hamel
content: You've mentioned that there was another Hamel here.

speaker: Hamel
content: I think... I once knew her existence. She was the center of the blissful realm, but also the loneliest child here, wasn't she?
What did you recall?

speaker: Hamel
content: A baby's lonely cries that form part of the music of the dance. Perhaps I've known her well since long ago.
She envied you for getting the love from everyone in the Carnival, that's why she impersonated you.

speaker: Hamel
content: Envied me...
Hamel crouches down to feel the soil's temperature with her fingertips carefully, as if interacting with her impersonator in this way.

speaker: Hamel
content: How lucky you are, to know what you want. I should be the envious one.
A small flower blooms where her fingertips are touching.

speaker: Hamel
content: The soil, the air, the sun, and the rain, they'll all love you... This time, please thrive.
The flower is only a tiny illusion, yet its leaves still sway as the wind blows by it.
You continue walking for a while. You're getting closer to your destination, and there are fewer and fewer objects in your surroundings.
Finally, before a stretch of empty, flat land, Hamel grinds to a halt.

speaker: Hamel
content: This place feels... familiar?
This was once a sacred territory in the Carnival. The crowd of the parade guarding Hamel's dance blocked off the area completely.
After the Black Ring shattered, this place became a deep lake that suppressed tens of thousands of Corruptors.
You once put the shackles on Hamel here and promised to take her out of this place. Sadly, she's already forgotten that.
Now that the illusions have all faded away, this place turns out to be just a stretch of empty, bare land...

Hamel tries to take one step forward, then another, then another... Her steps are gradually picking up a rhythm, as if she's getting used to the touch on her toe tips and her body is becoming lighter and lighter.
Once she reaches the center, she turns to face the only audience today. The audience is quietly waiting for her performance to begin, but she can't calm down her heart...

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: To dance freely for everything you perceive... Have you made this wish come true?

speaker: Hamel
content: I don't know. But he's removed the restraints on my powers. I can dance with everything I've got for this show.
female_content: I don't know. But she's removed the restraints on my powers. I can dance with everything I've got for this show.

speaker: Norman
content: But what if he's only trying to loosen your guard, what if he's just lying to you and using you like all those people in the past?!
female_content: But what if she's only trying to loosen your guard, what if she's just lying to you and using you like all those people in the past?!

speaker: Hamel
content: No... I can feel it. He... he's different.
female_content: No... I can feel it. She... she's different.

speaker: Corpus
content: How is he different? From what I see, he's not really different from that stupid audience in your memories!
female_content: How is she different? From what I see, she's not really different from those stupid audience in your memories!

speaker: Hamel
content: No. Please don't speak of him like this.
female_content: No. Please don't speak of her like this.

speaker: Old Man

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: The thoughts hidden at the end of the memories are being uncovered layer by layer.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Stop hiding your desires. It's about time, let the story between you and him reemerge in your mind.
female_content: Stop hiding your desires. It's about time, let the story between you and her reemerge in your mind.

content: Even if there's a dark hollow in my heart, I don't need to fill it with anything. I will carry it and keep on fighting.

I came to see you, Hamel.
You've done enough. You don't need to make sacrifices anymore. We're going back together, like I promised. I can't leave you here alone!
That phantom with a physical form said you were confused, perplexed, and lonely... But that's not your fault.
You managed to spend 23 years in the Black Ring, and have prevented Norman and more people from slipping into danger. You've already done an excellent job.
Hamel has always considered others' feelings first and buried her most earnest wishes in the deepest corner of her heart, leaving them to pile up there.
Confusion, perplexity, and loneliness... Still, I need to thank you, for letting me see her nightmares, so I could help her put those thoughts into words.

speaker: Hamel
content: Right, why couldn't I recall... He's different, he's different from everything in this world woven with pain.
female_content: Right, why couldn't I recall... She's different, she's different from everything in this world woven with pain.

speaker: Hamel
content: Disasters have brought crumbling dust and ash, and hysterical sadness has composed a pessimistic future. But behind the dust and ashes...

speaker: Hamel
content: There is glistening starlight.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: He hopes you can do as you please.
female_content: She hopes you can do as you please.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Make your choice, how you're going to dance...
Hamel?

speaker: Hamel
content: Can you... dance with me?
The sudden invitation catches you off guard. Before you have time to consider your answer, you've already followed her to the center of the stage.
Hamel smiles and doesn't answer, simply crossing her fingers with yours.
She keeps her gaze on you. Slowly, the surrounding sounds are beginning to blur and you've caught up with her pace.
Is this the world you perceive? This is different from the memories in your nightmares.

speaker: Hamel
content: This is... you, perceived by me.
The hem of her dress extends freely to form a scroll of canvas. As if you've already rehearsed it many times, the two of you compose a new illusion on it.

speaker: Hamel
content: Together, let's dance to our hearts' content...
She leads you to start twirling. You're standing so close to each other that you can even hear her peaceful breaths and feel the throbbing joy in her pulse.
The illusion created by the duet dance is starkly different from the Frozen Lake, portraying the warmth on a spring day.

Grass is thriving and warblers are twittering... It's as if the natural scenery is reciting a poem full of love, sometimes subtle and intimate, sometimes intense and passionate, layering it onto this once-destroyed land again and again.

speaker: Phantom Shadow
content: Her dance has changed?

speaker: Void Puppet
content: No coercion, no scheme. This joyful song is purely her heart's creation.

speaker: Fear Puppet
content: Then will she still sing about sadness and pain for us?

speaker: Misery Puppet
content: No, we're no longer her last audience.

speaker: Norman
content: It's time to say goodbye.

speaker: Old Man
content: This time...

speaker: Crazy Puppet
content: It's the true farewell.
Is someone speaking?

speaker: Hamel
content: That's the sound of blessing...

speaker: Hamel
content: Thump... Thump... They're blessing this dance...

speaker: Hamel
content: That the curtains of its stage shall never fall.
The woman in the blue dress is sitting up straight in the interrogation room.
As usual, there's a smile on her face, just like the first time you met her.

speaker: Enfer
content: It's been a while. Sorry for causing you trouble while I was asleep.
After the Witching Hour incident was resolved, having absorbed the manic power, Enfer awakened as an S-Class Sinner. She fell into a coma and has only come back to consciousness a few days ago.
Having heard from the doctor that she's been recovering well, you decided to come and meet her.

options: Don't worry, I was just doing my job.

speaker: Enfer
content: Your job... Haha...

speaker: Enfer
content: That word makes our relationship sound... Quite distant.
Enfer raises her hands and gestures the distance between you and her.
Sorry. This is just a standard procedure.
I don't mean to make things difficult for you.

speaker: Enfer
content: No worries, me neither.

speaker: Enfer
content: But... I don't think you came all the way here just to say hi, Chief.
Indeed, I didn't. But still, I'm glad to see that you're well.

speaker: Enfer
content: It's all thanks to you.
That's good.
I know this could seem a bit... rushed, but there are things I want to know, too, so...
If you think you can't answer these questions at this moment, we can take our time.

speaker: Enfer
content: Go ahead. I'm not that fragile.
test
