test
Here's some information about the current situation of the Belphegor Art Museum.
Although you've already absorbed the Witching Hour and I've put the shackles on you, we still haven't figured out where the Witching Hour's power came from.
Enfer stares at the documents and photos you've laid out on the desk wordlessly.
Her fingers touch the photos gently. In the photos, almost all the artwork displayed in Belphegor have been crushed into pieces.
I'm sorry. Perhaps I shouldn't have shown you these...

speaker: Enfer
content: That's alright.

speaker: Enfer
content: It wasn't you who broke them.

speaker: Enfer
content: Go on.
You look at Enfer, grit your teeth, and continue.
The power of the Witching Hour was strong enough to make a regular Sinner evolve into an S-Class Sinner.
Even though I was there, I still can't figure out the origin of this power.
Its origin is unknown, the cause of evolution is unknown, and most terrifying of all... even its limit is unknown.
You must know that Eastside... has always been prejudiced against Mania. They refuse to take charge of the cleanup work in the Belphegor Art Museum.
Since we still can't fully comprehend the Witching Hour... in a sense, the fear and chaos brought by it haven't come to an end yet.
Enfer draws back her hand thumbing the photos and lifts her head to stare at you firmly.

speaker: Enfer
content: I don't know...
But...

speaker: Enfer
content: Before you put the shackles on me, I didn't really know what a Sinner was.

speaker: Enfer
content: And I have no idea why the Witching Hour's power could turn me into what you refer to as an S-Class.

speaker: Enfer
content: But since it could cause such an outcome, perhaps it means... the Witching Hour's power is the same as a Sinner's power.
Enfer props up her face and seems to be caught up in her thoughts.
So... you mean to say that the Witching Hour's power has the same origin as a Sinner's power?

speaker: Enfer
content: Yes... So...

speaker: Enfer
content: Where does a Sinner's power come from?
Enfer looks at you with a faint yearning in her eyes.
You raise your hand and gesture for her to look at the blue heart-shaped accessory on her own chest.
I think Sinners' powers probably come from their own hearts.

speaker: Enfer
content: If you're right...

speaker: Enfer
content: You're the Chief, the Sinners' manager... You ought to be right.

speaker: Enfer
content: According to you, could it be that the Witching Hour's power came from my heart?
I think part of the Witching Hour's power came out of Parma's stones from which your sculptures were made, and part of it came from the visitors' inner fear.
As for the power to accept and absorb everything, awaken as an S-Class Sinner, and defeat the Witching Hour... That came from your heart.
Enfer gives a laugh and then falls silent again.
When Sinners... awaken, their hearts are usually filled with some kind of thought, emotion, or... desire.
Does that remind you of anything?
Enfer looks at you and laughs again.

speaker: Enfer
content: Both you and I experienced the Witching Hour firsthand, do you still not understand?

speaker: Enfer
content: For me, my heart has always been yearning for fear.

speaker: Enfer
content: That's the truth in people's hearts. That's the truth of the world.
Enfer taps on a photo on the desk. In the photo, there's a broken sculpture.

speaker: Enfer
content: For example, the traces of wind...

speaker: Enfer
content: Everything in this world, even the wind, leaves its traces.

speaker: Enfer
content: After it spreads sickness, wails, and despair all over the world, what's left is this devilish dead branch.

speaker: Enfer
content: These dead branches are all around us. That's the truth told by the wind.
As Enfer pushes the photo in her hand away and is about to tell you about the truth of fear in the next photo, she halts.
The devastated sculpture in that photo is Sosia.

speaker: Enfer
content: But Sosia... seemed to be different...

speaker: Enfer
content: She's indeed a piece I created. Yet, she seemed to understand me better than I do.

speaker: Enfer
content: She believed that I was lost and weak... She thought my fear was not pure, and that I didn't understand myself.

speaker: Enfer
content: ...She thought that I've never abandoned love, all this time.
Enfer frowns and recalls the words Sosia once shouted at her.

speaker: Enfer
content: But... I have abandoned love such a long time ago...

speaker: Enfer
content: I have seen how fake, how fragile, how defenseless love is...

speaker: Enfer
content: When the land cracks and dark clouds gather in the sky, only fear can keep us barely alive.

speaker: Enfer
content: How can love... still possibly exist? Or perhaps I should say... How can it possibly still exist in me?
Enfer is deep in thought again. You shake your head slightly and ask her a question.
Have you ever heard of that fable?
The North Wind and the Sun.
Enfer looks dazed for a second, then nods at you. She seems interested in your words and signals you to continue.
The North Wind and the Sun have a bet on which of them can make people take off the coat they're wearing.
No matter how hard the North Wind blows, no matter how it raises the dust and lowers the temperature, it only makes them pull the coat tighter and tighter.
Meanwhile, the sun emerges behind the clouds and shines over the land, making everyone sweat. All the passers-by wearing coats begin to take them off.

speaker: Enfer
content: So... you think I'm the North Wind?

speaker: Enfer
content: ...It's just fear.

speaker: Enfer
content: Yes... I am indeed a little lost.

speaker: Enfer
content: I've always thought I'm pure enough, but I can't even refute you promptly.

speaker: Enfer

speaker: Enfer
content: And when I created them... Was there really... only fear?

speaker: Enfer

speaker: Enfer
content: Surprise, even the Witch doesn't know where her power comes from!

speaker: Enfer
content: Huh?

speaker: Enfer
content: Thank you, Chief.

speaker: Enfer
content: In that case... why don't you come with me to Belphegor?

speaker: Enfer
content: If we want to find the source of the Witching Hour's power, that should be the best place to start!

speaker: Enfer
content: Who knows, I may be able to recall something from my past creations.

content: Hehe...

speaker: Enfer
content: Am I not obedient enough, Honored Chief?

speaker: Enfer

speaker: Enfer

speaker: Enfer
content: ...Huff.
A moment later, the sound stops. You lift your head and see Enfer propping up her face on the platform and staring down at you with a smile.

speaker: Enfer
content: I thought you fell asleep.

speaker: Enfer
content: Come and see my work, will you?
She reaches out a hand to you, pulling you up like inviting you to dance.
Next to her are a few small sculptures carved with the fragments.
What... are these?
The broken pieces have been sculpted and polished by Enfer and turned into several cocoon-like objects.
But the irregular shapes make you feel like something is struggling inside them.

speaker: Enfer
content: Just some artistic residue.
They're one of a kind.
But even you can tell that these small sculptures... are indeed nothing close to Enfer's previous works.
You don't know how else to console Enfer, so you pick up the small sculptures and examine them carefully.
You see that in the center of each sculpture, there's a tiny heart-shaped mark.

speaker: EMP
content: You can be more honest with me.
Enfer raises her hand and taps on one of the sculptures lightly. The cocoon falls instantly.

speaker: Enfer
content: These things... can't even compare to what I made three years ago.
You're... exaggerating.

speaker: Enfer
content: No, I'm not.

Enfer scans the empty exhibition hall. The room filled only with broken fragments is like an airtight prison. Suffocating and heart-wrenching, it feels impossible to break free from it no matter how hard you try.

speaker: Enfer
content: But that's nothing to be afraid of.

speaker: Enfer
content: That's... how an artist should be.

speaker: Enfer
content: As we create, we struggle, we grow, we go back to zero, and eventually we evolve into our complete form.
Enfer spreads her arms, flying up the blue fabric of her dress. You feel as if you're seeing a pair of wings lined with shiny scales.

speaker: Enfer
content: The works we created are the proof that we tear ourselves apart time after time.

speaker: Enfer
content: Like breaking one cocoon after another, eventually, a stunningly beautiful moth is born.

speaker: Enfer
content: And...
She turns back and looks at you, smiling.

speaker: Enfer
content: After impressing everyone, it'll plunge into the flame and leave the world with a perfect residue.

speaker: Enfer
content: These artworks...
Enfer hands a fragment to you. It's a piece of alabaster with pure coloration. Its sections are rough, but the outer surface is finely polished.
The dented carved lines resemble a veil on a woman's body blown by the wind. A heart-shaped mark is also hidden among them.

speaker: Enfer
content: These are the cocoons artists shed off, or the marks left by a fire that destroyed everything...

speaker: Enfer
content: Even if they're completely broken, they're proof that the artist once existed.

speaker: Enfer
content: It's just that... fragments tend to be forgotten by the world.

speaker: Enfer
content: That's why... I want to create an unforgettable, perfect mark.
The fragment is being crushed in Enfer's hand, falling through her fingers.

speaker: Enfer
content: No matter what perplexity lies ahead... I'll destroy it.

speaker: Enfer
content: Haha... You're so adorable.

speaker: Enfer
content: Thank you, I guess.

speaker: Enfer
content: After all, I've made the decision to crush the perplexity troubling me.

speaker: Enfer
content: Sosia has failed, and I'm stuck in a bottle right now.

speaker: Enfer
content: But that doesn't mean I'll keep failing. Just like how I crushed Sosia, I'll find the reason for my weakness, crush this bottle, and break the cocoon once again.

speaker: Enfer
content: No matter how much pain I'll have to endure.

speaker: Enfer
content: That being said...
Enfer drags out the word, making you a little nervous.

speaker: Enfer
content: If we don't start cleaning up soon, I'm afraid we'll experience the Witching Hour again.
You shrug and begin tidying the place with Enfer again.
As you're working, you pay extra attention and notice that there's also a heart-shaped mark on the fragments of other works as you expected.
You recall what Enfer said and suddenly realize that if an artwork is a mark left in this world by the artist...
Then likewise, the marks on these works are also the traces the artist wanted to leave in the world!
So what exactly... do they mean?
Hmm... but this painting...?
You pull out several fragments from under the rubble and piece together an oil painting.
You've seen this painting in the Witching Hour. From the strokes, you can tell this was painted when Enfer was very young.
But it's not its immaturity that makes it special... This painting doesn't have that heart-shaped logo on it.
Holding the painting, you come next to Enfer.

speaker: Enfer
content: Oh? You found it.

speaker: Enfer
content: How nostalgic...
If I guess it right... You painted this when you were little?

speaker: Enfer
content: Yes, when I was very young... When my mother was still alive.
Mother...
Enfer, did you realize that... there's a special mark on all of your works?

speaker: Enfer
content: Mark...?
Right... A heart-shaped mark.
And not just the works displayed here...
You pick up the cocoon-shaped sculpture on the platform and show Enfer the mark.
You even unconsciously carved this mark on the pieces you casually made just now.
Enfer takes the painting and sculpture, examines them carefully for a while, then speaks again.

speaker: Enfer
content: This painting... was painted when I was very young. It's a copy of a photo...

speaker: Enfer
content: You know, my mother was an oil painting artist, and I learned some oil painting techniques when I was little.

speaker: Enfer
content: But... ever since my mother passed away, I've almost never painted again.

speaker: Enfer
content: To organize the Witching Hour, I dug out all of my works, and this exhibition hall happened to be missing an oil painting.

speaker: Enfer
content: I found this painting by chance and filled the empty spot with it.
But there isn't that heart-shaped mark on this painting.
Enfer touches the mark on the sculpture, frowning slightly.

speaker: Enfer
content: But...

speaker: Enfer
content: Why did I carve this mark on it...?

speaker: Enfer
content: It seems to have crept into my bones, branding this mark in the depths of my consciousness.
Enfer bows her head, as if wanting to burn a hole in the painting with her gaze.

speaker: Enfer
content: I left this mark on my works unconsciously. But why?

speaker: Enfer
content: And when did I...
Enfer places the painting on the platform and stares at it for a moment before turning to you.

speaker: Enfer
content: I want to know what this mark really means.
You left this mark unconsciously. Sosia also said there was something you had been unwilling to let go of...
I'm wondering... could this be the source of your perplexity?
Enfer's eyes light up and she looks at you with a surprised and thrilled look on her face.

speaker: Enfer
content: Then... are you willing to go and search for this source with me?
Before hearing your answer, Enfer grabs your hand.

speaker: Enfer
content: Come, go home with me!
After leaving the museum, Enfer brings you to a residence near the suburbs.
The carved black marble door reminds you of the Gate of Hell in the museum.
Seeing you gazing at the door, Enfer guesses your thought.

speaker: Enfer
content: Scared?

speaker: Enfer
content: Relax, it doesn't have that kind of power.
Enfer smiles and drags you into the depths of the residence.
You pass by a poorly maintained garden. Had all of these withered flowers bloomed, they would have looked the same as the flowers in that painting.

speaker: Enfer
content: Go inside the small room behind the garden, walk downstairs, and you'll find my studio.

speaker: Enfer
content: Be careful. The stairs there are a little steep.
Pushing open the door and taking the stairs step by step, you and Enfer gradually sink into darkness.
Just as you begin to feel worried, with a snap, Enfer switches on a lamp carved into a grimacing pixie.
The pale light illuminates the path beneath your feet and somehow you feel that it leads straight to hell.

speaker: Enfer
content: But... twenty years ago, this was once my father's studio too.

speaker: Enfer
content: He created countless works here...

speaker: Enfer
content: Including that sculpture, The Truthful One.
It looks like... a studio full of stories.

speaker: Enfer
content: Would you like to hear... those stories that took place in its belly?
Enfer is walking ahead of you. She lifts her head to look up at you while you bow your head slightly.

speaker: Enfer
content: Did you notice we're in a perfect position... for a hug?

speaker: Enfer
content: Yes, in exchange for the stories, but not now.
Enfer continues walking down and switching on the lights on the way. The blinding white lights keep extending, unraveling with the stories Enfer is telling.

speaker: Enfer
content: Though I was born into a family of artists... there was nothing artistic about the union of those two.

speaker: Enfer
content: Just like breeding purebred cats, when you put two sets of excellent genes together, you're bound to get even more excellent genes.

speaker: Enfer
content: Heh...
Enfer presses the button. White light pours down, coating her with a layer of fragile and blinding light.

speaker: Enfer
content: My mother tried to love her husband and tried to manage this home that appeared happy and artsy to outsiders.

speaker: Enfer
content: She was a master of oil painting. As soon as I learned how to walk, she taught me how to hold a paintbrush.
Finishing the last step, you feel that you've entered a spacious room. The lights are switched on one after another, and you watch Enfer walk forward.
As the girl before you is telling her stories, she picks up a long chisel on the workbench, swings it in the air like she's painting something, and finally lowers her hand limply.
As if she's spilled paint outside the canvas, and the painting has lost its meaning.

speaker: Enfer
content: But Sosia was right. What can love bring us?

speaker: Enfer
content: Eventually, she lay beneath his feet.
With a clank, the long chisel is dropped on the floor.
Ignoring it, Enfer walks straight to the depths of the studio, the only part of this place still drenched in darkness.

speaker: Enfer
content: Thunderstorms can bring a different kind of stimulation. He needed inspiration, needed caprices as visceral as lightning and thunder.

speaker: Enfer
content: So he ignored her cries and pleas and ignored me who came following the noise... Pain can rouse the truth, and fear can elicit inspiration. He didn't hesitate to make us sacrifice for him.
Enfer glimpses at the chisel by her feet, her reminiscing gaze is filled with an icy chill.

speaker: Enfer
content: With the clinks of the chisel inside and the howling thunderstorms outside, eventually... he carved her fearful expression in the depths of my mind... He also completed his masterpiece...

speaker: Enfer
content: For the first time, I understood the meaning of fear and what it represented...
Enfer turned to look at you. Your slightly shocked expression satisfies her.

speaker: Enfer
content: Truth, and power.

speaker: Enfer
content: I thought that would be my end as well... Who'd have known...

speaker: Enfer
content: Perhaps it's because he needed a witness! I was his witness who saw his breakthrough... No one could ever say he was not as good as his wife again. No one could ever mock him for not having anything to show for his work.

speaker: Enfer
content: He took everything she'd given him and turned it into a sculpture. His most acclaimed work, The Truthful One.
This story sounds a bit different from the one you told me in Belphegor.

speaker: Enfer
content: Hmm... Take a guess... Which one is true? Which one is false?
As long as it's told by you, either could be true.
Enfer smiles wordlessly and switches on the last light in front of her.
Under the light, every part of the entire studio is clearly visible. All kinds of sculpting tools are scattered everywhere, covered in dust and debris.
The most unsettling sight is the white sculpture standing quietly before Enfer, in the depths of the studio.
It's completely white, yet it feels twisted, dark, and cold. Both his facial expression and body language show that he's going through immense fear.

speaker: Enfer
content: As his witness and successor, surely I'll have to create a piece that can shock the entire world, just like he did.
On August 20, BR-004 erupted and your father went missing...
Which means he was...

speaker: Enfer
content: Inspiration always dries up quickly for someone who's totally disloyal to the world and to nature...

speaker: Enfer
content: He found me. He told me that he loved me, so I must be like my mother and sacrifice for our family, for him...

speaker: Enfer
content: But I'd always remembered the thunderstorm on that day.

speaker: Enfer
content: And so I... also made him sacrifice for my work, and just like he did... now I own a work of art praised by everyone.

speaker: Enfer
content: Do you want to see it? The work that made my name.
Enfer reaches out a hand to you again.
She's already sealed her fear of her father in this sculpture. Then why is her hand still shaking?
You go ahead and look at it with Enfer.

speaker: Enfer
content: It was... an ultimate sight. Inspiration, mixed with fear, terror, and panic, was exploding.

speaker: Enfer
content: In that ring of red flames, I once again confirmed the feeling in my heart, confirmed the purpose of the works I'd created.

speaker: Enfer
content: He carved fear in the depths of my consciousness, giving me great power...

speaker: Enfer
content: So I, who walk in hell and peep at the truth, ought to present everything I perceive.
She says with fascination, as if once again reminiscing what she saw at that time.
But when you finally see the sculpture clearly, cold sweat breaks out on your back. Not only because of the fear oozing out from the inside of this sculpture, but also because you recognize it...
In the Witching Hour, an illusion broke Sosia's fear. And this sculpture... is the spitting image of that illusion!
Enfer... This sculpture wasn't displayed in the Witching Hour, was it?

speaker: Enfer
content: Of course not. I've... always kept him here.
But...
Sosia's fantasy of fear was broken by him.

speaker: Enfer
content: ...That's impossible.

speaker: Enfer
content: I've already conquered it... I won't succumb to the fear he gave me anymore. Why...?!
Through the glass shell, Enfer is glaring viciously at the sculpture she created.
Her gaze scrutinizes it slowly inch by inch, as if trying to fathom how her old self created this piece.
But as soon as she sees the chest of the sculpture, she looks dazed.

speaker: Enfer
content: Why... is it on here as well?!
You see it clearly too. On the chest of this contorted sculpture, there's a small heart-shaped dent.

speaker: Enfer
content: Haha... I see... I see... I was already imprisoned by weakness on that rainy night...

speaker: Enfer
content: That's why I... I got broken by you?!
This is her work, a piece she believes with which she conquered fear, and the reason why she is completely restrained by fear...
Enfer lets out a low laugh. Her hands press on the glass, scratching it with her nails, making an uncomfortable noise.

speaker: Enfer
content: I should be just like him. I should become even more skillful and create a perfect piece that makes people discover their inner fear!

speaker: Enfer
content: Let everyone witness what the world really looks like!

speaker: Enfer
content: But why... why do I fear him?! Why am I so weak?! Why must I be restrained...?
The surrounding temperature is dropping suddenly, and the pale light bulbs are making an unpleasant electrical buzz.
The sculpture inside the glass protection remains stationary, but somehow it makes you feel like... it's waiting for a chance to charge at you.
The shackles throb in your mind, prickling your spirit. You feel a familiar power awakening.
You're not weak, and you are absolutely capable of creating a perfect piece!
If this mark is your weakness and perplexity, I'll help you find out the reason it exists and we'll resolve it together.
Your power is fluctuating. This is not a good sign. Enfer, calm down.
Enfer bows her head, as if not taking in anything you're saying.
You raise your hand to pull her back...

speaker: Noise of something breaking
content: Bam—!!
In a mere moment, the glass display windows surrounding the sculpture shatter amid the shaking. The darting broken glass cuts your cheek, leaving a red mark.
Enfer! Don't give in! Your ability is not stable enough now, be careful...!
Hehehe...
Rage... Marvel...
A creepy voice interrupts you. You're shocked to realize that the sculpture named "The False One" is beginning to melt like asphalt.
Enfer, your power is going out of control! It's starting to influence the surrounding art again!
You're in a very dangerous state now. Come, give me your hand!

speaker: The False One
content: Shut up!
The white liquid suddenly hardens and pierces right at you, forcing you backward and away from Enfer.
And while you can't approach Enfer, the melted, soft liquid wraps around her feet and begins devouring her from the bottom up.

speaker: The False One
content: I know... Only I know that you...

speaker: The False One
content: You're searching for... your weakness... your perplexity!

speaker: The False One
content: Your mother's love... his love... makes you weak! Makes you ignorant! The biggest hindrance between you and perfection!
female_content: Your mother's love... her love... makes you weak! Makes you ignorant! The biggest hindrance between you and perfection!

speaker: The False One
content: Come... Come to your world... Get rid of her!

speaker: The False One
content: Get rid of those... who make you weak...
The melted sculpture is already enveloping Enfer's neck. The shackles are throbbing and warning in your mind, alerting you to pay attention to the danger before you.
Enfer's power is too strong. When BR-004 erupted, her power entered these artworks through her creation without her knowing.
The Witching Hour has been completely devoured by Enfer, and the artworks in the Belphegor Art Museum have all been destroyed.

But as long as Enfer still exists, the power in those works will exist. This sculpture is connected to Enfer's perplexity and trauma. If it resonates with Enfer's uncontrolled power, it's very likely to trigger another Witching Hour!
Enfer! Answer me! Don't get carried away!

speaker: The False One
content: The outsiders... Those people... What are they saying again?!

speaker: The False One
content: Don't listen to them... Go create your perfection... Get rid of your weakness!
You've just awakened as an S-Class Sinner. Perhaps you're still not capable of fully controlling this kind of power...
But I can help you! Answer me!!
Enfer doesn't respond. She's almost been completely devoured, turning into a standing white sculpture.
No!!!

speaker: Jarring Noise
content: Clank!
Seeing you try to wake Enfer, the wriggling liquid on the floor once again turns into spikes and charges at you.

options: Enfer! Come on, try to hear me!!

content: The spikes' attacks are quickening, and you can only do your best to dodge them while calling to Enfer, hoping she will hear.
I'm sure you can hear me, can't you?
This is just another cocoon! Don't get sucked in!
Even if you can only struggle! You must try to jump out! Or else... you will fail again!
The spikes hit the workbench. Dust and debris fly instantly, blurring your sight.
Cough... Enfer, fear shouldn't be your only power!

speaker: Enfer
content: Chief...
Amid the blur... you hear Enfer's voice.
But the next moment, darkness overwhelms everything. You feel the shackles on your hand throbbing, gradually fusing with the person on the other end. You know that Enfer has used her power.
The thick darkness drowns everything in an instant. Just like that, the world falls silent.
In this boundless space, only vague shapes are flashing before your eyes, strange and ceaseless.
But this place feels familiar. You recognize this is Enfer's power. The False One is Enfer's work. And what you're seeing now is...
Enfer's own fear.

speaker: Enfer
content: Chief, look. I can't believe... I used to be scared of these things...
Suddenly hearing Enfer's voice in the dark, you look ahead. Not far from you, with her hands on her back, Enfer is staring at a glowing object resembling a screen in a cinema.
Images of Enfer you've never seen are being played on a loop on it.

speaker: Little Girl
content: Wah...! Mommy! The bee stung me!

speaker: Little Enfer
content: It hurts... I'm afraid of bees... Sob... I want a world without bees!
The little child sticks up her injured finger and runs into a woman's embrace with teary eyes.

speaker: Young Enfer
content: Ptui!

speaker: Young Enfer
content: It's so hot... It must have burned off my skin...

speaker: Young Enfer
content: Ouch...
Watching the girl on the screen push the cup filled with hot black tea away, Enfer can't help laughing.

speaker: Enfer
content: Haha... For a child...

speaker: Enfer
content: Fear is nothing more than a sting of a bee or hot tea burning your palate.

speaker: Enfer
content: The things they created are... extremely childish, lively, and naive.

speaker: Enfer
content: But also so fragile that they shatter upon a mere touch... just like their creators.
Enfer walks forward, even beckoning to you after a few steps.

speaker: Enfer
content: There should be even more visual engravings in the depths of my memories. Come see them with me.

speaker: Enfer
content: Wasn't it screaming that... it knew my weakness, knew why I was lost...

speaker: Enfer
content: Then let me go and find out what exactly is hidden in the deepest part of my fear and making me lost.
You follow her and advance slowly tracing the path left by Enfer.
Until another screen pops up before you.
The screen is no longer bright. It's very dim, as if covered by heavy dark clouds.

speaker: Enfer
content: I recognize these clouds.
Staring at the screen, Enfer murmurs.
As if proving her words, thunder explodes on the screen, blinding you, but still unable to light up this fear.

speaker: Young Enfer
content: Dad...?

speaker: Young Enfer
content: Have you seen... Mom?

speaker: Enfer's Father
content: Mom? Isn't she right here?
Lightning flashes and thunder rolls. The sight before the girl's eyes is illuminated...
The warmth under her feet is not the hot water she imagined, and the smell lingering in her nose is not that of soil on a rainy day.

speaker: Enfer's Father
content: Remember it! Learn it well!!
The young girl is dragged close to her father's face and then dropped to the floor. Her father grabs her face, forbidding her to turn away.

speaker: Enfer's Father
content: Only in this way... Only in this way can I succeed! They say that the most exhilarating inspiration lies in the space between life and death! Hahahaha!

speaker: Enfer's Father
content: You will have... an extremely successful father! And family!
All of the girl's senses are amplified, except for her hearing. She can't hear any sound, not even her own heartbeat.
She stares at the still trembling corner of fabric before her, her entire mind blank.

speaker: Enfer
content: Go...
Enfer clenches her hands, shivering slightly.
A scream rips through the silence. You turn to its source at once...
In the screen, the girl is shoved away, her body tumbling to the side.
Her eyes widen fearfully, watching her father's chisel falling again and again.
Is this...?!
The scene on the screen begins rewinding, going back to when the girl is shoved away. It keeps replaying the same scene endlessly.

speaker: Enfer
content: Why... Why would I see her here... This... shouldn't be.
Light and shade intertwine on Enfer's face. You can't make out her expression but only hear her mumbling.

speaker: Enfer
content: Mother... Mother...
Enfer calls out softly, her voice flowing toward you.
Everything is still being replayed on a loop on the screen, like a curse deepening in the heart with each hit of the chisel.

speaker: Enfer
content: ...What?
The person shoving Enfer away. That figure. You've been looking at her for a while and realize she looks exactly like the person taking the final blow for Enfer in the Witching Hour.
I know why she's here... Enfer.

speaker: Enfer
content: No... She shouldn't... From that day on, she's been taken away from my world...

speaker: Enfer
content: There's only ever been fear in my mind ever since!
You leave that mark unconsciously because... she's branded love in the depths of your consciousness.
That's why you've always feared love, Enfer.
This... is your source of love.
Enfer lifts her head slowly and stares at you with wide eyes, as shocked as the girl on the screen.

speaker: Enfer
content: Source of... love?

speaker: The False One
content: Hah... Yes, yes! This is the love left in you all along! The love you haven't abandoned all this time!
The surrounding darkness is stirring, and the terrifying voice speaks again, enveloping both of you in the center.

speaker: The False One
content: Because of her, because of this so-called love! You are lost and treading water!

speaker: Enfer
content: I am... Because of her... Her redemption... Her love...

speaker: Enfer
content: That's why I'm weak...

speaker: The False One
content: Yes!!

speaker: The False One
content: You've witnessed it. You must be able to inherit it!

speaker: The False One
content: Pure fear, and terror of mankind! Only with them can you create the most perfect piece!

speaker: The False One
content: You need no love. All you need is fear... fright... wails!

speaker: The False One
content: Get rid of her! Chop her up! Give up! Forget! Abandon!

speaker: The False One
content: You know what to do.
The darkness under your feet begins stirring. Once again, it transforms into a melted liquid, pouring in like asphalt.
Enfer! Don't listen to it!!
As soon as you notice something's wrong, you begin sprinting toward Enfer. But no matter how fast you run, the distance between you doesn't seem to be shortening at all.
These memories are planted deep in your consciousness! The love you've been given is hidden in the depths of your consciousness!
Do you really want to erase them?!
This thing... This so-called erasure! It's no solution to your perplexity and weakness at all! You're only running away! You have to face it!

speaker: The False One
content: Shut up... Shut up, shut up, shut up!!

speaker: The False One
content: You... There's no fear in you, no truth in you! You don't deserve to, should not, and cannot exist here!

speaker: The False One
content: Get away from her! Get away from me! Get away from her! Get away from me!
Your words seem to have crossed The False One. It's screaming, stirring up the tsunami-like black silt to charge at you!
It turns into one spike after another, clinking and clanking as they rip this space apart like countless black chisels.
You... You are the one who should leave!
Enfer! This is your mind! Your consciousness!
All of your power comes from here, doesn't it?!

speaker: Enfer
content: But my power... is restrained by my weakness...
Don't listen to its nonsense!
Pure fear can grant you immense power to go forward, but it can't get you out of the abyss. It'll only turn you into part of it.
A moth doesn't break the cocoon to purify herself. The intricate patterns and colors are her stunning features too.
You said she would burn in the flame... But who can say for sure that the moth only has fear in her heart when she plunges into the flame?
Enfer shudders and turns around to look at you silently, her eyes filled with an inquisitive light.
Maybe, she loves the flame, and that's why she plunges into it unwaveringly despite her fear?

speaker: Enfer
content: She... loves the flame?

speaker: Enfer
content: There isn't only fear in her power. There's love too, right?
Yes.

options: Don't run away from love, Enfer.

content: The False One is angered again. Its throat is rumbling, like thunder brewing in the dark clouds.
Controlling those black spikes, it engulfs Enfer completely while turning the spikes into black needles, raining upon you!
Tsk... Guess I missed the good timing...
Then I guess I can only... bet everything on this.
You turn around and look at Enfer who's been completely devoured not far away. The red shackles on your hand grow and spread out like thorns.
The black rain pours down...
Stop. You don't deserve to touch him.
female_content: Stop. You don't deserve to touch her.

content: The black needles halt a few centimeters from you, unable to move.
You glance at the shackles, but they're still an inch away from reaching your Sinner.

speaker: Enfer
content: That's right. This place is my mark, my consciousness...

speaker: Enfer
content: Everything here should serve me.
The colors in the darkness are stirring anxiously, as if chased by immense fear and eager to escape from this place.
You see the black liquid enveloping Enfer begin struggling. Each movement obviously takes a toll on it, but it refuses to stop... until a small hole gradually opens up in its chest.
Soon, a pair of lithe hands reach out from the hole, grip the terrifying black substance, and rip it apart vehemently...

speaker: Enfer
content: You thought you could trap me... with just this?
The blue figure emerges from the thick black cocoon. She lifts her head proudly and gazes at the shadows filling her consciousness.
Her gaze reminds you of the person who broke open the Gate of Hell before you in the Witching Hour.
Lofty and arrogant.

speaker: Enfer
content: Erase... or bury my own perplexity and weakness?

speaker: Enfer
content: Ha, then I'll only become like you, become a sculpture that will eventually be forgotten a century later, slumbering in a dark basement eternally!

speaker: Enfer
content: And finally... turn into ashes and vanish.
Enfer raises her hands and grips her weapons, the blue hammer and chisel.
She makes her way to you step by step, showered in the black needles with you.

speaker: Enfer
content: I... named you False because everything about you was your own illusion. You were trapped by your own falsehoods.

speaker: Enfer
content: The one who can't see the truth... Is you.

speaker: The False One
content: It can't be! It can't be! She's made you weak. She's kept you in hell!

speaker: The False One
content: You've always thought that! I know it!
Enfer raises her chisel and aims it at a point in the air, smiling.

speaker: Enfer
content: Yes, she gives me no choice but to walk in hell... But isn't that my favorite place? ...Hell?

speaker: Enfer
content: I... am your witness, but definitely not your successor.

speaker: Enfer
content: You fear love, fear the hell that love will eventually bring you... so you don't want to face it.

speaker: Enfer
content: But I am different.
Holding up the blue hammer, Enfer slams it hard on the chisel, making a loud clank when it hits that spot in the air.
The black color peels off bit by bit to reveal a heart-shaped mark, the mark present on every one of Enfer's works.

speaker: Enfer
content: It's all thanks to love... that I can survive in this living hell.

speaker: Enfer
content: And even in a world like this, someone has told me that... just like terror, love can become my power too.
Enfer comes next to you and helps you up. She lets you hold the chisel with her to aim at that heart-shaped mark.

speaker: Enfer
content: I'm the ruler of fear, so I will not fear love... I will carve through it... Make love a part of my power, so I can keep on creating, tearing, and reincarnating...

speaker: Enfer
content: Until the most perfect artwork is created.
Enfer looks at you as she speaks.

speaker: Enfer
content: Cast the shackles, Chief.

speaker: Enfer
content: I will break the cocoon with you.
Red and blue light outshines everything in the consciousness, devouring darkness and chasing it away completely.
Under the light, you see a vibrantly blue moth struggle free from a black cocoon, spreading its wings in the air.
Wings flashing a fiery light, it flutters and flies off to somewhere far away.
Hell may be its destination, but this time... you're certain she isn't only accompanied by fear.
The familiar feeling of suffocating dread hits you.
You feel as if someone has dragged you into the pool again. You're unable to move your hands and feet.
All you can do is watch the air escape from your mouth bit by bit, before vanishing completely...
Where... where am I...
You're... on my plate...
Step by step, Cabernet closes the distance. All too soon, she's right in front of you. She reaches out her hand. The moment her fingers touch you, you feel your soul being separated from your body.
Your limbs go numb with cold, as if drained of life force.
Every nerve in your body seems to be shutting down. The only thing you're conscious of is a tickling sensation behind your ear when a soft voice whispers...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Time for me...

speaker: Cabernet
content: To enjoy the fruits...
Milly
Was I having a nightmare?
The screen of your communications device is displaying the message you received an hour ago.
Cabernet, a Sinner who was the main figure involved in the banquet incident, has been detained. The MBCC is running a test to determine the nature and scale of her power.
Furthermore, the prime suspects, Carley and Greg, have been arrested by the FAC.
These two Mania-infected individuals turned up at the banquet as a human-mermaid chimera and caused mayhem.
They have been separated from the mermaid. No Mania residue has been detected in their bodies; their M-values are normal. But they are still mentally unstable.
They haven't been cooperative with the FAC investigators. Since Chief ${PlayerName} had contact with them before, the MBCC has been requested to assist in the investigation.
You look out of the window. Judging by the view outside, you're close to the destination now.
Carley and Greg are still mentally unstable...
You look down at the file in your hand.

[Results of Background Checks on Carley and Greg] Carley, Eastsider, 22 years of age, a servant working for Cabernet, missing for unknown reasons. Greg, Eastsider, 25 years of age, a junior-level chef who once applied to work for Cabernet as a private chef, missing around the same time as Carley for unknown reasons. The two missing persons might be a couple, according to the other servants working in the Cabernet household.
One name keeps popping up in the file.
<color=#fb9259>Cabernet</color>...
A knock on the window interrupts your train of thought.

speaker: Communications
content: Chief ${PlayerName}, we've arrived at our destination. The clerk assigned to work with you is waiting in the sickroom.
You're greeted by a scene of chaos when the door of the sickroom opens.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: I know you've been traumatized. But we mean you no harm. Please put down the knife...
The clerk and guards stand around, not daring to get any closer.

speaker: Carley
content: No! You have to prove you have no value to her. Say it, Greg, say it, say you don't love me. Prove to her yours is tasteless...

speaker: Greg
content: No, no, let her have me.

speaker: Greg
content: That's why... That's why I should show her my love for you!
They talk as if there's no one else in the room. And then the man points the scalpel at his own throat, sending everyone else in the room into a panic.
That's what you see when you arrive at the sickroom.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: Finally, Chief of the MBCC! I've been waiting for you. They've been saying things that make no sense to me.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: Like "I've got to prove mine is tastier," "Say you don't love me," and things like that. All sound like lines from some crazy soap opera.
But they look nothing like characters in a soap opera.
You take a step towards them. They shriek in response.

speaker: Carley
content: NO!! Don't take us away!

speaker: Greg
content: We don't want to be <color=#fb9259>locked up</color> again! Please leave us alone, please...
I have a basic knowledge of your situation. Don't be afraid. Tell me what exactly happened to...

speaker: Both
content: No!!
They shriek before you can finish the sentence.

speaker: Carley
content: Don't take us away!

speaker: Greg
content: We don't want to be <color=#fb9259>locked up</color> again! Please leave us alone, please...
Again?
Who locked you up? Cabernet?

speaker: Carley
content: Stop! Don't say her name.

speaker: Carley
content: Sh-she sent you here! You smell like her.

speaker: Greg
content: Cabernet Franc! She's here?!

speaker: Chief
content: She's not here. She's kept under control by the MBCC. Please calm down...

speaker: Greg
content: That's not true! She's always here, watching us. She's planning to <color=#fb9259>consume our souls!</color>
The name Cabernet seems to fill them with dread.
Don't be afraid. She can't get her hands on you now.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Put the shackles on me. I choose to become a Sinner in thrall to your power. Use it to keep my appetite for souls in check.
A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

speaker: Cabernet
content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Put the shackles on me. I choose to become a Sinner in thrall to your power. Use it to keep my appetite for souls in check.
A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

speaker: Cabernet
content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Put the shackles on me. I choose to become a Sinner in thrall to your power. Use it to keep my appetite for souls in check.
A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

speaker: Cabernet
content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Put the shackles on me. I choose to become a Sinner in thrall to your power. Use it to keep my appetite for souls in check.
A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

speaker: Cabernet
content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Put the shackles on me. I choose to become a Sinner in thrall to your power. Use it to keep my appetite for souls in check.
A chain of red thorns latches onto her wrist and pierces the skin.

speaker: Cabernet
content: From now on, I'll be forever at your command.

speaker: Chief
content: Her power is under control now. I won't let her hurt you again.

speaker: Chief
content: She must obey my commands, which means I can stop her from feeding on souls.
The red light emanating from your palm seems to have soothed their fears, even if temporarily.

speaker: Carley
content: Did you say she obeys you? That's impossible. She's from the Franc family.

speaker: Carley
content: She's held in high regard by everyone. No one dares to offend her.

speaker: Carley
content: Any grievance against her is like a tiny pebble thrown into a deep river. No splash can be heard.

speaker: Greg
content: Exactly! There's no way you have her under your thumb. Unless... you're wealthier and more influential than the Franc family.

speaker: Greg
content: If... if that's the case, can you take us under your wing? We'll be your most obedient servants!

speaker: Greg
content: Wh-what's your name?
${PlayerName}, Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.
What my name is is not important. All you need to know is I'm here to help deal...

speaker: Greg
content: I heard them call you Chief, I'm sure.
He cuts you off, looking at you like you're their last hope of escape.

speaker: Greg
content: This is good news, Carley. The Chief owns us now. Cabernet isn't a threat to us anymore.
Hand in hand, they lunge forward to try to hug you. Before they can get too close, however, the FAC people in the room stop them.
Please calm down. You're not owned by anyone. The FAC got you out of the banquet. You're free now.
Please tell me what Cabernet did to you. I promise I'll try my best to help you.

speaker: Carley
content: No! We can't escape from her. We tried, but she caught us every time.
The two patients move away from you, shaking their heads and mumbling to themselves.

speaker: Carley
content: Greg, we're on our own. You've got to prove to her that you don't love me. Then she'll believe that you have no value to her.

speaker: Greg
content: Don't be silly, Carley. You know I won't be able to prove that. You should be the one who gets away. I dragged you into this...
Now they're back in soap opera mode, as the FAC clerk put it.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: They were like this in my previous dealings with them. No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get them to believe that they had escaped the control of Cabernet.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: They seem to have lost their sense of self.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: I wonder...
The clerk looks up at you, opening and shutting her mouth.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: They have been seriously traumatized, to the point where they seem to have lost their sense of self.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: I believe your Sinner didn't just "lock them up" and "consume them." She must have done something much more terrible to them, even more terrible than...

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: Turning them into a human-mermaid chimera at the dinner party...
As if to confirm the clerk's suspicions, Carley and Greg dissolve into blood-curdling laughter.

speaker: Carley
content: The red-haired witch, she's coming!

speaker: Carley
content: Hahaha, are you here to feed on my soul again? All right, you can have it, all of it! But please let Greg go.

speaker: Carley
content: This is no place for him, not at all. He hasn't fulfilled his dream of becoming a head chef...

speaker: Greg
content: You shouldn't say things like that, Carley. Don't you remember what that monster likes the most about you?

speaker: Greg
content: It's the way you stand up for me. Like what you're doing right now.

speaker: Greg
content: I don't want to be a coward hiding behind you anymore. Let me bear the brunt. You must escape!

speaker: Carley
content: Escape? Where to? No matter where I hide, she'll find me, even if I'm kept in a fish tank as a monster.

speaker: Carley
content: It's Cabernet Franc. There's no escape from her.

speaker: Greg
content: Oh, I remember now. We're her "ingredients."

speaker: Carley & Greg
content: We...can't escape...
Carley and Greg pace the room, repeating how it's impossible to escape. You decide not to deal with the file in hand for the time being.

speaker: Chief
content: With them so out of it, there's no chance of getting anything useful out of them. Would you relay this message to the FAC for me?

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: Sure thing. Are you going to...

speaker: Chief
content: Yes, I'll talk to the source of their fears.
You can still hear that laughter of utter despair in your mind,yet Cabernet remains detached as you finish recounting your meeting with Carley and Greg.
Do you have anything to say about the way they reacted upon hearing your name?
You look up at the woman in front of you. To all appearances, she is listening with rapt attention. But you can't help noticing how her eyes are roaming all over you.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Of course I'm listening. I savor every word that comes out of your mouth.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I'm looking at you. I savor every expression that runs across your face.

speaker: Chief
content: Why are you acting like it has nothing to do with you?

speaker: Chief
content: The mere mention of your name filled them with so much dread.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Really? Didn't you tell them about our unforgettable encounter?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I've allowed you to use the shackles on me. I can't feed on souls when you activate them. There's no reason for them to be afraid of me.
Cabernet shrugs, somewhat ruefully.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I loved the way they behaved so bravely for each other. So yummy...

speaker: Chief
content: It's not just the clout you wielded that they feared, but the way you wielded it.

speaker: Chief
content: They feared you so much that they threatened to end their own life if the other didn't stop loving them.

speaker: Chief
content: You did more than just consume their souls, didn't you?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Why are you so curious about what I did to them? Are you concerned about them, or...
She leans closer to you with anticipation.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Are you angry with me?

speaker: Choose
options: I'm the one asking questions, not you.

speaker: Chief
content: Now answer my question. What exactly did you do to them?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Hahaha, you're more serious now as the Chief of the MBCC than when you were at the dinner party.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I like it when you're serious, though, and I also like this face-to-face format of questioning.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You want to know what I did to them?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Okay, I'll tell you all about it, morsel by morsel.

speaker: Cabernet
content: It'll give me a chance to...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Savor each of your reactions.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Where should I begin?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I can't serve the main course right away. Let me start you off with an appetizer.

speaker: Cabernet
content: How about I tell you about the childhood story of the princess of the Franc family?
——　Appetizer　 ——

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're not expecting it to be about an innocent girl living an ordinary life, are you?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Sorry to disappoint you, but that's not the case.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Every Franc is born with a silver spoon in its mouth. That's inevitable. My childhood was one of luxury and extravagance.
She gets into her story. She sounds as if she's telling someone else's story, her face expressionless and her voice empty of nostalgia.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Whatever I asked for, I got it on a silver platter. People rushed to indulge my every whim, no matter how unreasonable it was.

speaker: Cabernet
content: They'd do just about anything for a chance to show their faces at my house.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Having the entire amusement park to myself for one day, getting the most popular singer to perform in my home... I had only to say the word.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Clothes, jewelry, cars, watches, gourmet foods from the distant Outlands, even young, beautiful men and women... You can have whatever you want if you're a Franc.

options: Why is it that you don't look happy?
That's not enough to make you feel content?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Those things are just a mundane aspect of my life, like breathing and drinking water.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Does working for the MBCC make you happy? You curry favor with this individual or that, you strike deals here and there... Aren't you already bored with this whole business?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Those things are just a mundane aspect of my life, like breathing and drinking water.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Does working for the MBCC make you feel content? You curry favor with this individual or that, you strike deals here and there... Aren't you already bored with this whole business?

speaker: Chief
content: What you take as a mundane aspect of your life is an impossible dream for most people.
You've been to Syndicate, where you've seen so many people struggling to put food on the table and keep roofs over their heads, sometimes at the cost of their lives.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Chief, are you feeling angry on behalf of the less fortunate, because you think they have been unfairly treated?
Cabernet changes the subject, which seems to you an ill-concealed attempt to stir up strong emotions in you.

speaker: Chief
content: We know each other fairly well, I'd like to think. You must know that's not what I want to talk about today. So please don't change the subject.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ah, looks like the appetizer is not to your taste.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Let me present the next course. You're gonna love it.

speaker: Cabernet
content: It's about how I slowly became a slave to gourmet food.
——　Soup　 ——

speaker: Cabernet
content: Each gemstone has a clarity grade, and each article of clothing on sale has a price tag. By and large, the value of a gemstone or an article of clothing is straightforward. However, the same can't be said of foods.

speaker: Cabernet
content: A delicacy speedy-delivered by Nirvana Logistics from the north is not necessarily more delicious than a bowl of noodle soup from a roadside food cart.

speaker: Cabernet
content: It's amazing when you think about it. The fact that something that satisfies one of our basic needs can be transformed into something almost magical, subject to its creator's interpretation of the ingredients. It's almost like...

speaker: Chief
content: Art?
You blurt the word out. Cabernet is obviously satisfied with your answer.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Well, I must say, I made the right decision when I chose you to retrieve my lost "ingredient." We're on the same wavelength. And I've had this feeling since the banquet.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're right. Food is like art. There isn't a one-size-fits-all standard for what makes for good food. That's why they say to each their own.
The subject of food seems to have brought back an amusing memory to Cabernet, who is now wearing an enigmatic smile on her face.

speaker: Chief
content: Are you just talking about food?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Yes and no.
She dwells on the memory with obvious pleasure. She swallows, and the interrogation room is so quiet that it's clearly audible.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Once you've tasted the richness of goose liver mixed with the sweetness of jam, you'll start wondering about their combined texture in low temperatures.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Once you've tasted the lightness of a coffee liqueur, you'll start wondering if it blends in well with a molecular gastronomy dessert.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Once you've enjoyed all of the tastes the physical world has to offer, you'll start looking for...

speaker: Cabernet
content: A new taste that is... out of this world, so to speak.
Her lips curve in a smile that chills you.

speaker: Chief
content: A taste out of this world? Are you referring to humans?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I'm not interested in cannibalism, if that's what you're implying. I'm not that cruel.

speaker: Cabernet
content: What I'm interested in is human souls, pure and fiery human souls packed with emotions and feelings.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Carley and Greg, the selfless way they supported each other and the intense love they felt for each other, it just made me...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Ah, I don't know how to put it exactly. All I can say is that it was nothing short of a transcendent feast for all my senses.
Her eyes turn dreamy, gleaming with thinly-veiled greed.

speaker: Cabernet
content: It was intense and complicated... I could feel their love exploding on the tip of my tongue, feel it breaking down and running through my veins.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Their unshakable love, mixed with their intense desire to protect each other, was a rare delicacy. It would've been a shame to consume it all in one go.
Cabernet reaches over and taps her finger on the sheet of paper in front of you, which lists all the evidence you've gathered.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You must have gone to a lot of trouble to gather this evidence, considering how hard the Franc family guards its secrets.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Do you know what the basement of the Franc mansion was used for before it was repurposed? I'll give you the answer, as a thank-you to the MBCC for helping me out once.

speaker: Cabernet
content: It was a storage room for my "ingredients."
——　Side Order　 ——

speaker: Cabernet
content: You don't look surprised. You already guessed the answer?

speaker: Chief
content: More or less.

speaker: Chief
content: You contacted the MBCC for help in retrieving your "treasures," but you didn't tell us what they really were. Whether you viewed them as ingredients or human beings, you treated them as your personal possessions.

speaker: Chief
content: And I later learned that Carley and Greg had gone missing. So the fact that you took away their freedom of movement at some point isn't a surprise to me at all.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Knowing they were locked up is not enough for you, isn't it? You want to know more about their experiences and find a way to turn them back to normal. Am I right, my good-hearted Chief?

speaker: Chief
content: Now that you know what I'm looking for, why don't you stop wasting our time and show me the "main course"?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Be patient. It takes time to prepare a perfect dish. And by the way, I don't have the cure you're seeking for whatever is making them "sick."

speaker: Cabernet
content: Like I said earlier, precious souls like theirs deserve to be savored over and over again.

speaker: Cabernet
content: To create a constant supply of ingredients for the perfect dish, simply keeping them close was not enough.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I stoked the fire of their love whenever it burned low. I kept them simmering in a stock of despair.

speaker: Greg
content: Could you please let her go? You can keep me in her stead.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Of course. You two are indeed an extraordinary couple. She told me the exact same thing.

speaker: Greg
content: Last time, you told me Carley still had value to you. What about now? Could you let her go and keep me instead?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Sure thing.

speaker: Greg
content: Please let her go. Can you promise me that this time?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I promise.
The way she speaks about her victims' suffering gives you the impression that it was all just an elaborate ritual in her eyes.

speaker: Chief
content: You tricked them.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I'm not much of a rule follower, as you must know.
The two of you met at the dinner party and got to know each other while trying to put an end to that ridiculous game.
Besides, the Franc family didn't get to where it is today by following rules and keeping promises.
Too bad that Carley and Greg didn't realize that.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Carley, I liked that girl a lot. That's why when I found out she was stolen, I used all the connections at my disposal to get her back.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The way she confronted me about her boyfriend was so cute, so yummy. Reminded me of a fresh, succulent piece of fruit.

speaker: Cabernet
content: She was just so delicious. When I saw her neck, vulnerable yet alluring, I couldn't resist the temptation to...
She trails off. And in a theatrical gesture, she bites down on her finger gently.

speaker: Cabernet
content: And Greg's expression when he saw me "feeding" on Carley, it was equally irresistible.

speaker: Cabernet
content: To save the person they loved, they were willing to have their soul extracted and made into food on my plate.

speaker: Cabernet
content: They begged, they got their hopes up, they despaired. And the cycle started anew. They were a dish made to perfection for my sole enjoyment.

speaker: Cabernet
content: They were innocent, kind, and brave, just like...
She stares at your neck, her eyes gleaming with greed. You can feel the arteries pulsing in your neck.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You, when you tried to save all your companions at the banquet.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, the FAC clerk has requested help. Something to do with Carley and Greg.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Greg is asking to see Cabernet.

options: What did you do to them?
Why does he want to see you?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Oh, I did have a little chat with my recovered treasures near the end of the banquet.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Um, could be because of the little chat I had with my recovered treasures near the end of the banquet.

speaker: Chief
content: What other false promises have you made to them?

speaker: Cabernet
content: You got me wrong. I didn't make any promise to them.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I did all this for your sake, Chief.

speaker: Chief
content: What do you mean?
She doesn't answer; she only smiles, looking at you playfully.
You don't know what's behind that enigmatic smile. But you know that her M-value is climbing, and that the hold of the shackles on her is showing signs of instability.

speaker: Chief
content: Nightingale, tell the FAC to keep them under control. I'll be there with Cabernet in a minute.

speaker: Chief
content: Keep them safe. Use force if necessary.
Cabernet's smile grows wider as she watches you giving orders.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I'm your friend, they're not. So why do you care more about them than me?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Toward the end of the banquet, I promised you that I'd never feed on any souls other than yours. You've given me a reward; I will not go back on my promise.

speaker: Chief
content: Is this your way of saying they won't come to more harm?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Hehe. All right, Chief, are you ready for the "main course"?

speaker: Cabernet
content: For what is worth, if you do sense harm coming their way, you can always stop me by drawing strength from your sense of justice and anger.

speaker: Greg
content: Who bound my arms and legs? Oh yes, it's those armored soldiers who restrained me.

speaker: Greg
content: The FAC? Oh, I remember now. I'm in a hospital, and so is Carley.

speaker: Greg
content: Where is Cabernet? Why is she not here?

speaker: Greg
content: Unable to move... it's a familiar feeling. I thought she had got us again...

speaker: Greg
content: You worked late again, huh? What do you want for dinner? I've got some ingredients from one of the neighbors. How about I make your favorite dish—Roast Stuffed Mushrooms?

speaker: Carley
content: Let me share some news with you first. Good news and bad news. Which one do you want to hear first?

speaker: Greg
content: Um, the bad news.

speaker: Carley
content: The manager of the Réver Hotel told me that they didn't need a new cook for the time being.

speaker: Greg
content: No surprise there. Must've been my Syndican origins again, right?

speaker: Carley
content: (Sighs) How many now for this month?

speaker: Greg
content: Thirteen, fourteen, I've lost count.

speaker: Carley
content: Just because Syndicate is plagued with Mania and gangsters, doesn't mean every Syndican has a violent streak.

speaker: Greg
content: It's all right. We'll keep looking. Earning a living in Eastside as a Syndican, I never expected it to be easy. And even if I can't find a job in a high-end restaurant, I can still do what I'm doing now, working part-time for roadside diners.

speaker: Greg
content: Eastside is so big and so prosperous. I'm sure we'll find our place here sooner or later.

speaker: Carley
content: You graduated with distinction from DisCity Blue Ribbon Culinary School. Working in those roadside diners is a huge waste of your talent. We'll find a way to get you a decent job.

speaker: Carley
content: Check this out!
Carley withdraws a piece of paper from her bag, smoothing out its curled corners with care.

speaker: Greg
content: Application for Employment as Cabernet Franc's Private Chef? This is your good news, right?

speaker: Greg
content: Franc. Isn't this the family you work for?

speaker: Carley
content: Yeah. I heard about the job opening from the butler. Miss Franc is a picky eater. She has been looking for a cook, but with no luck.

speaker: Carley
content: You're a talented cook. You were one of the top students at DisCity Blue Ribbon Culinary School. Just give this a go. Have faith in yourself!

speaker: Greg
content: Cooking for a princess of a wealthy family... This might be more demanding than working in a restaurant.

speaker: Carley
content: I don't know much about her personality. But I hear she doesn't care about a candidate's origins, as long as the candidate is good at the job. So I'd guess she's...

speaker: Carley
content: A decent person.

speaker: Carley
content: I beg your pardon.

speaker: Cabernet
content: The smell of Number 787.

speaker: Cabernet
content: This, well let's call it a dish. This dish prepared by this Greg guy tastes interesting. It reminds me of the smell that fills my nose whenever I walk past Number 787. I've never tasted anything like this before.

speaker: Carley
content: Number 787. The garbage-processing plant?

speaker: Carley
content: I-it can't be. This is his best dish. Maybe it's because you ate something else early, and the tastes got mixed up. Please do try it again.

speaker: Carley
content: He put his heart and soul into this dish.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Heart and soul? Sorry, but I don't get that impression from this dish.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Or if by heart and soul, you mean the smell of Number 787, then yes, I do get the impression.

speaker: Butler
content: Carley! How dare you throw your employer's plate?

speaker: Butler
content: I recommended Greg out of the goodness of my heart. And this is how you repaid me, by being rude to your employer?

speaker: Carley
content: Sorry, I... I didn't mean it. It's just that this meant the world to Greg. Even if you didn't like it, you shouldn't have called it...

speaker: Carley
content: Called it garbage.

speaker: Butler
content: Enough! You Syndicans are all the same, a bunch of thugs with no self-control. We shouldn't have hired you in the first place!

speaker: Butler
content: Get out! Your services are no longer needed!

speaker: Carley
content: I apologize for my earlier behavior, Miss Cabernet. But you didn't really try the dish. It's kind of disrespectful to the cook.

Carley looks down at the shards on the floor and then up at the dish on the table; Cabernet sampled only the sauce of the dish. The butler is trying to pull Carley away from the table, but she doesn't budge.
She's not being entirely reasonable right now. She knows that. But she also knows, without a shadow of a doubt, that Greg's dish deserves a much better reception.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Carley. That's your name, right?

speaker: Cabernet
content: It has a nice ring to it. Palatable, just like the way you smell.

speaker: Carley
content: Palatable?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Let her stay. She intrigues me.

speaker: Greg
content: Carley? Why is she here? Wh-what happened to her?

speaker: Greg
content: What did you do to her?!

speaker: Cabernet
content: I cherished her. Her soul is a treasure trove of deliciousness.

speaker: Greg
content: You're crazy!
Greg shoves Cabernet out of the way to get to Carley. Cabernet doesn't take offense at his "rudeness."

speaker: Cabernet
content: I remember you. You're Greg, the cook.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Not as good, but good enough.

speaker: Greg
content: You don't deserve my food. Stay away from us, you crazy woman! Let Carley go!

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're mistaken. When I said "good enough," I didn't mean your food.

speaker: Greg
content: What?!

speaker: Cabernet
content: You, the love of her life, also have a pure, vibrant soul. The souls of you two are like nothing I've encountered before.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Stay. I'll make sure that the two of you live happily and never have to leave each other's side.

speaker: Cabernet
content: As long as your souls remain to my taste, I'll always...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Cherish you with all my heart. I won't...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Consume every bit of you all at once and reduce you to empty shells.

speaker: Cabernet
content: It's not enough. I want more. I want something even more delicious...

content: Take this. It's your soul. It tastes like desire.

speaker: Greg
content: Why did that demon give me these Soul Grapes? Ah, I've got it...

speaker: Greg
content: A soulless me and a greedy you would have no value to her.

speaker: Greg
content: This is our only way out. This is the only way to free ourselves from those painful memories that never end.

speaker: Greg
content: Come, Carley, eat this, eat my soul. This is the ultimate dish I made for you.

speaker: Greg
content: Eat all the grapes. Don't leave any for Cabernet.

speaker: Greg
content: We are free.
The patients' actions after they came to take everyone else in the room by surprise. The FAC guards move in to stop them, and you activate the shackles, but it's too late.
Forced by Greg, Carley has consumed his entire extracted soul.
Greg has sacrificed every last bit of himself to free the love of his life, or so he thought.

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: Mr. Greg! Can you hear me, Mr. Greg?

speaker: FAC Clerk
content: Guards, separate them! Protect the Chief! Come on!!!
No one expected this would happen. The sickroom is in total chaos. Cabernet, who has come to meet Greg, gets out of the way of the moving guards and sits down.

speaker: Chief
content: We are too late. Cabernet, why is it that you didn't look surprised at all?

speaker: Chief
content: You knew this would happen, didn't you?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I used my power to help him extract his soul and taught him a trick or two. But I never made him do this...

speaker: Cabernet
content: It was his own choice. He did this of his own volition. And he wanted me to see it.

speaker: Chief
content: He wanted you to see it, or you wanted me to see it?
She doesn't contradict you. If anything, she seems eager to hear whatever you have to say next.

speaker: Chief
content: The last time I met Greg in this sickroom, he was desperate to prove he was worthless to you, desperate to be freed from your control.

speaker: Chief
content: Now he's proved it, at your instigation. At the same time, you have lost an "ingredient."

speaker: Chief
content: A gourmet like you would never give up a precious ingredient without a good reason. You encouraged him to feed his soul to Carley, and then led me here to witness his unraveling.

speaker: Chief
content: You did all this on my account. This is the...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Main course.
She finishes your sentence, raises her cane, and playfully rests its tip against your chest.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Sharp, perceptive, intelligent, honest, kind... Your soul tastes divine. I wish I had met you sooner.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I can't begin to tell you how much I love this helpless look on your face.

speaker: Chief
content: I've been your target all along. Your promise—that you would never feed on other people's souls, was just a lie. It meant nothing to you.

speaker: Chief
content: If you did all this just to anger me, to make me more to your taste, then congratulations, you succeeded.

speaker: Chief
content: You want to consume my soul. Be my guest. But don't drag another innocent person into this.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Hahaha... Sounds like you really are angry. But we've just started on the "main course."

speaker: Chief
content: What do you mean? Greg is unconscious. Isn't that enough for you?

speaker: Cabernet
content: Of course it isn't enough. I'm gonna show you something that will make your soul more enticing.
She lifts your chin and turns your head in Carley's direction.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Here, see for yourself. Souls can be irresistibly delicious; no one knows this better than me.

speaker: Carley
content: How strange...

speaker: Carley
content: The thing I just ate was in the shape of a bunch of grapes, but it tastes like roast stuffed mushrooms.

speaker: Carley
content: My favorite dish...

speaker: Carley
content: It's delicious. It gave me a familiar, warm feeling. I want more, more!

speaker: Carley
content: Where can I find more? <size=45>I haven't had enough! Not enough at all!</size>

speaker: Carley
content: <color=#fb9259><size=50>I want more! Give me more!</size>  </color>

speaker: Carley
content: Stop! Where are you taking him?

speaker: Carley
content: Don't take him away. He's mine! I'm still hungry!
Carley makes a frantic attempt to stop the medics from carrying Greg away.

speaker: Chief
content: Enough! There is nothing left of his soul for you to consume.

speaker: Chief
content: Guards, restrain her, but don't get her hurt.

speaker: FAC Guard
content: Yes, Chief.
Carley has lost her mind and turned aggressive. The guards move in to restrain her while trying hard not to hurt her in the process.

speaker: Cabernet
content: You're kind, Chief. Through and through. You even find it in yourself to be kind to a glutton.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Would you be so kind if it were me?
You seem to catch a flicker of uncertainty in her eyes, and then it's gone.
Your unhesitating reply seems to surprise Cabernet.

speaker: Cabernet
content: There's a rumor about a soul-eating Sinner going around out there. Aren't you afraid?

speaker: Chief
content: What's there to be afraid of? I have put the shackles on you, after all.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll treat you the way I treat any other Sinner. I'll try to understand your past, and I'll respect your choices, but...

speaker: Chief
content: This can't happen again. You can't go around manipulating innocent people again.
Having witnessed how Cabernet manipulated the couple today, you're even more unsure of your ability to stay patient with her.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Is it because of the rumor about the soul-eating Sinner?

speaker: Chief
content: What's there to be afraid of? I have put the shackles on you, after all.

speaker: Chief
content: Manipulating innocent people for personal gain... That's what's scary.
Cabernet stares at the red light emanating from your palm and starts laughing.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I thought you'd be less composed when you got angry. Well, I like the way you are now anyway.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm serious.

speaker: Chief
content: They had a chance to build a bright future in Eastside. They had a chance to fulfill their dreams together.

speaker: Chief
content: You took that away from them. You forced them to stay by your side as your personal possessions.

speaker: Chief
content: What they wanted might not have been much in your eyes, the princess of the Franc family. But for them, that's all they got.
You look to Carley, who is still struggling, her crazed face drained of all animation. You feel a sense of helplessness at the sight of her.

speaker: Carley
content: No, it's not the right smell. It should be purer and more intense!

speaker: Carley
content: Where is my food?!
The guards have surrounded her and are shouting warnings at her. She pays them no heed. She wants one thing, and one thing only...

speaker: Carley
content: Souls! Delicious souls! Give me delicious souls!!
Cabernet, the culprit for all this mess, listens to your condemnation of what she did absentmindedly, like a bystander.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll do everything in my power to get Carley back to normal. As for you, Cabernet...

speaker: Chief
content: I'll apply to have your level of detention reassessed.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Oh, you don't want to fix me anymore, my good-hearted Chief?

speaker: Chief
content: Carley has lost her mind only because she was forced to consume Greg's soul. There's hope of getting her back to normal if we manage to calm her down, and help her remember her dream, the love of her life, things worthier of pursuit.

speaker: Chief
content: You're different. You want to consume souls. That's your obsession, your only obsession.

speaker: Chief
content: Even this show you put on today, you did it only to make my soul more palatable to you.

content: Hahaha, you're more serious now as the Chief of the MBCC than when you were at the dinner party.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I like it when you're serious, though, and I also like this face-to-face format of questioning.

content: But a Sinner's power comes from their heart...

content: My heart... is filled with the desire for delicious food and "souls."

speaker: Cabernet
content: I hope that the growth of your power can catch up with...

speaker: Cabernet
content: The expansion of my desires.

content: As a Franc, you can have whatever you want. But you want nothing but "gourmet foods."

speaker: Chief
content: I can help Carley, but I can't help you, at least not in the same way. Thank you for showing me your "main course." Now, let's end this "banquet."
Cabernet doesn't say anything in response. She only looks at you; her expression is hard to read, but seems to carry a hint of joy. This time, she's looking at your eyes, not your neck.

speaker: Cabernet
content: I want nothing but "gourmet foods"...

speaker: Carley
content: Yes!
Cabernet is about to say something else when Carley lets out a shriek of delight. Carley, standing only a few steps away, is staring at you; she then bursts out laughing.

speaker: Carley
content: Pure, sincere, passionate... Isn't this the noblest soul there is? It's right in front of me!

speaker: Carley
content: I found it! The ultimate delicacy!
