content: When did she get hold of the knife?!

content: We didn't notice. She got freakishly strong all of a sudden and broke free.

speaker: FAC Guard
content: Thank God Chief is unharmed. Restrain her. Quick! And where are the medics? We've got a wounded Sinner here!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Yes?

Looking at Cabernet, you remember the poolside where you met her properly for the first time. Her eyes on you are as calm as they were back then, except that there's now a faint metallic smell in the air.
Are you hurt?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I guess. I've got a hole in my back. Kind of painful, to tell the truth.

options: You don't look like the kind...

speaker: Cabernet
content: What? The kind of person who would throw herself in front of you to save you?

speaker: Cabernet
content: What if I told you I did it because I wanted to protect the most impeccable soul I've ever seen?

speaker: Cabernet
content: You don't know?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I did it because I wanted to protect the most impeccable soul I've ever seen.

speaker: Butler
content: Miss Franc, this dish was prepared by the most sought-after head chef of the most sought-after 3-star restaurant in all of Eastside.

speaker: Butler
content: Under the theme of "Impeccable Souls," as you requested.

speaker: Butler
content: What's the matter? Is it not to your taste?

speaker: Cabernet
content: What I'm looking for is a dish that draws me in even before I taste it.

speaker: Cabernet
content: A dish that stirs something deep inside of me the moment I lay eyes on it. This is not it.

speaker: Butler
content: We've tried every renowned chef in DisCity. None of them was up to your standards. How about I look further afield and get some chefs from Outland?

speaker: Butler
content: I'm sure they'll open the WhiteSands route for us if you make the request.

speaker: Cabernet
content: How are my "ingredients"?

speaker: Butler
content: Still unconscious. Your last meal has taken a great toll on them.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Is that so?

speaker: Butler
content: Sorry, Miss Franc, for disappointing you. So... We've just received a batch of new clothes for this season. Would you like to see them?

speaker: Butler
content: And the construction of the new horse riding arena is complete. You can go down there to kill time...

speaker: Butler
content: Or...
The butler lifts his eyes and flicks a discreet glance at Cabernet. He catches a glimpse of her eyes, which seem devoid of feeling.

speaker: Butler
content: Whatever you want, I can arrange for you... It doesn't matter if it's allowed or not. Anything other than gourmet foods that taste like souls, that is.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Anything other than gourmet foods that taste like souls...

speaker: Cabernet
content: Is there any?

speaker: Cabernet
content: You have helped me find the answer, I believe.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Yes, I am a bottomless pit. But there's nothing wrong with that, is there?

speaker: Cabernet
content: I seek out ingredients, nurture them, and turn them into foods. I pursue them the way others pursue dreams and love. And I won't stop pursuing them!

speaker: Cabernet
content: Anger, sadness, heartache, anxiety, confusion...

speaker: Cabernet
content: What emotions did Carley and Greg evoke in you? What emotions did I evoke?
She rests her head against your shoulder, feeble from the stab wound. You put your hand on her back to comfort her.
You feel something warm and sticky on the back of her exquisite gown. That brings home the fact that she's badly injured.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Condemn me, fear me, or even resent me... However you feel about me, there's no denying...

speaker: Cabernet
content: ...that you understand me.
You feel her warm breath on your neck, but the feeling of dread that you associate with your soul being extracted doesn't come.
You hear her swallow as her cold fingers brush against an unruly strand of hair behind your ear. You know she's trying hard to restrain herself from doing the thing she wants to do so much.

speaker: Cabernet
content: Chief, I don't need you to save me, the way you do with the others. Nothing brings me more joy than being with my perfect "ingredient" forever.

speaker: Cabernet
content: If you want to help me, then stoke up my insatiable thirst for deciduous souls...

speaker: Cabernet
content: See through my hunger and greed, like you did today.

speaker: Cabernet
content: And then stop me by drawing strength from your sense of justice and anger.

So far Cabernet has kept her promise.
Since joining the MBCC, she has never fed on souls.
Nor has she orchestrated any shenanigan that puts innocent people in harm's way.
But she's never given up the idea of nurturing her "ingredient."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I will. I promise you that.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: Was everything smooth today? You weren't discovered, were you?

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Don't worry, I wasn't exposed. Hiding one's identity is fundamental for an assassin.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: I'm afraid the Mentor still needs to hide out here with us a bit longer.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: ...The Mentor?

speaker: Garden Member A
content: Shh... Don't disturb her. Just keep your guard up.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: By the way, while I was out today, I found an abandoned apartment.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: There're large floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in plenty of sunlight. It also got a courtyard, big enough for all of us.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: An apartment that can accommodate more than a dozen people is rare in Syndicate. Why was it abandoned?

speaker: Garden Member B
content: My guess is a Mania outbreak occurred there, but it doesn't affect Sinners like us anyway.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Mentor, should we move there?
Everyone in the house turns their eyes to the white-haired woman by the window. However, she seems lost in thought, simply watching the people passing by outside.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hm? I've told you, there's no more Garden and Mentor anymore. Just call me Ms. Coquelic.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Ms. Coquelic, I've found a great place that could serve as a new home for the Garden.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I said, there's no Garden anymore! Cough, cough...
Her sudden outburst silences everyone.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: Your health...

speaker: Coquelic
content: I'm fine... Go on with your tasks.
Realizing she lost her temper, Coquelic curls back into her spot by the window.

speaker: Shalom
content: I can give you life, give you time to find a new Garden, and keep you far away from all the troubles.
Heh... you must have used your power to control me in the end... Otherwise, how could I have been so stupid to believe you...
You Paradeisos bastard, where are you... where have you hidden them...

speaker: Coquelic
content: I have to find them as soon as possible...
Coquelic falls weakly into the mud. Her fine white nightgown is covered in mud.
Normally, she would have been disgusted and gone back for a hot petal bath. But now, she couldn't care less with the wounds and blood stains all over her body.
Mentor! I've found them!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Thistle! Is this everyone...? Where are the rest?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Where is Garofano?!
They lower their heads in silence. Looking at the wounded members of the Garden, blood surges up Coquelic's throat.
In the dim light of the street lamp, they finally see the blood stains all over Coquelic.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Cough, cough... Cough...

speaker: Thistle
content: Mentor! You're injured! It looks really bad...

speaker: Coquelic
content: I'm fine... When have you ever seen me not okay?

speaker: Coquelic
content: We should get going. Those armored bastards have sharp noses. The blonde chick bought us some time. Don't let them find us.

speaker: Thistle
content: Christina said, most of them were sent to Syndicate. We'll go find them. As long as everyone comes back, the Garden will...
At the end of the dimly lit alley, the sound of armor hurriedly passes by.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...Listen, the Garden was completely destroyed in the confrontation with the FAC.

speaker: Coquelic
content: From now on, there's no Garden.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Before the words are fully out, a figure clad in orange blasts free from the duct, her disruptive power active. The entire venue's systems instantly fail.
Coquelic doesn't raise her head, as if she is avoiding the hopeful gazes.
She just helps a wounded companion get up while supporting herself with her wand, and leads the way.
Better not tell them and make them worry. It will only cause trouble.
I don't have much time left, seven days... What else can I do?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ugh...

speaker: Garden Member A
content: Mentor! Are you okay?! Your old injuries act up again?

speaker: Garden Member B
content: That damn woman from Paradeisos. I'll settle the score with her sooner or later!

speaker: Garden Member A
content: Even the Mentor is not her match... What are we going to do? We've finally found some comrades in Syndicate, are we going out to be targeted again?

speaker: Garden Member B
content: But... she hurt so many people in the Garden. Shouldn't we do something about it?!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Cough, cough... Who said we're not going to do anything...

speaker: Coquelic
content: There's no such thing as "tolerance" in the Garden's mottos. If someone hurts us, I'll pay them back.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I won't let those flowers suffer in vain.
I just need an opportunity, an opportunity "created by others."

speaker: Garden Member A
content: How many days has the Mentor been sitting by the window?

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Shh, she might be thinking about something, don't disturb her.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Come help me in the kitchen. It's time for dinner.
Five days left. Those guys really know how to bide their time...

speaker: Garden Member A
content: I've checked it out. That apartment was indeed abandoned because of Corruptors.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: It was once occupied by a gang for a while, but they were defeated in a fierce battle and left.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Maybe we can move there and set up a new base.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: In the new base, we'll double our training. One day, we'll revenge those who are gone.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: I want to plant lots of flowers in the courtyard and make a garden...

speaker: Garden Member A
content: Those destroyed flowers will surely grow back.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Yeah, Mentor will definitely like it!

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Mentor...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hmm? Oh.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Whatever... You guys can decide.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Oh... okay.
Seeing how halfhearted she is, everyone stops discussing the topic with disappointment. Coquelic remains lost in thought.
Three days left. It's about time.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: It seems like the outside world has really forgotten about us.

speaker: Garden Member B
content: It hasn't been that long.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: There have been a lot of big events in Syndicate recently. And in a turbulent time like this, assassins are most needed.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: The Garden may have stopped taking orders, but there are still Yagyu and Carnivores... they definitely won't miss this opportunity.

speaker: Garden Member A
content: Now the streets are full of Sinners, and one less Sinner organization makes no difference.
No. He will come, I know better than anyone else.
female_content: No. She will come, I know better than anyone else.

content: As long as that power exists, he is the last threat, the existence that binds the Garden.
female_content: As long as that power exists, she is the last threat, the existence that binds the Garden.

content: Bang!!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Finally...!

speaker: Garden Member A
content: What?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Everyone inside the house, you are surrounded. Please do not resist and cooperate!

speaker: Garden Member B
content: It's the MBCC!

speaker: Garden Member
content: Mentor, we'll cover you. You retreat first.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I repeat: Sinners of the Garden, you are surrounded. Surrender now. We mean no harm.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hahahaha... cough cough!

speaker: Garden Member A
content: ...Mentor?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I told you, remember to hide your identity. Call me Ms. Coquelic.
Finally leaving her spot by the window lazily, she positions her wand at the door.

speaker: Coquelic
content: They're such an important guest. I should personally receive them.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Go now, useless girls. You're not needed here. Live the lives you want!
As Coquelic speaks, she releases powerful Mania, blasting the house's front door wide open.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Careful, it's high concentration pollution! Raise the Hypercube shields for protection!

speaker: Garden Member B
content: Mentor, your wounds haven't healed. You can't use this power again...

speaker: Coquelic
content: It doesn't matter anymore, none of it matters!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Get lost, even if you have to step on my body!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hahaha, there's no Garden anymore! What use does the Mentor have?
The currents of Mania are eating away at Coquelic's life, distracting the enemy.
Blood is dripping from the corner of Coquelic's mouth, but instead of slowing down, she pushes forward with immense pressure.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Maintain your defense. Seal the perimeter!

speaker: Guard
content: They have a secret passage at the back! A dozen of Sinners have escaped!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Then focus on the front door, trap the S-Class Sinner!

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's the Chief's order. Coquelic, the Garden's Mentor, must be brought back!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hahaha, finally! Finally!

speaker: Coquelic
content: MBCC, we should have met long ago!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Concentrate fire!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Come on! Shoot me. Let me die with my secrets! Hahahaha...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Let's see just how powerful the famous MBCC is!
...Just how much of a threat it can pose to my Garden!
Coquelic is a completely different person from the weak patient a few days ago.
She raises her dangerous power high, laughing wildly amidst the flashes of gunfire and smoke. Her bare feet step on the hot bullet shells as she nonchalantly strides towards the enemy.

speaker: Guard
content: She's coming!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Don't back down! Keep firing! Block her escape route!

speaker: Coquelic
content: My dear Adjutant, don't worry. I won't run, I've been waiting for you!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Don't you want to take me back, to catch up with Gekkabijin and Sumire? Cough cough...

speaker: Coquelic
content: By the way, your Chief must be eager to see me, right?
Her old wounds are torn open again, but Coquelic's laughter becomes even more manic. The bullets are blocked by her Mania, unable to harm her.

speaker: Guard
content: Is she planning to take all the attacks alone?

speaker: Guard
content: Our ammunition won't last much longer! Requesting support from the Bureau!

speaker: Nightingale
content: No... there's no need.
Nightingale waves her hand, and the guards slow their attack in confusion. When the smoke clears, they finally see that Coquelic has fallen to the ground.

speaker: Nightingale
content: She's drained her power.

speaker: Nightingale
content: What about the other members of the Garden?

speaker: Guard
content: They all ran away. Should we chase them?
Everyone is waiting for a definitive command. A figure in a grey coat steps out from among the guards.
It's fine. Let them go. Perhaps that was her goal.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll put the shackles on her. Let's take her back.
I still have... one last day...
He finally came.
female_content: She finally came.

content: The blurry environment sounds mix with the monologue in her mind, until that familiar yet strange voice echoes in an enclosed space.
Wake up.
Stop pretending you're asleep, Mentor of the Garden.
Tell me, what exactly happened in Eastside. You and the Garden, why did you get involved?
The strange feeling of the shackles in her veins is crystal clear, and the blinding light finally forces her to open her eyes.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Cough... Chief, should I say, "It's nice to meet you," or...

speaker: Coquelic
content: "It's been a while"?
He's not what I expected, I thought he'd be more assertive. Why does he look even weaker than when he was unconscious?
female_content: She's not what I expected, I thought she'd be more assertive. Why does she look even weaker than when she was unconscious?

content: He probably doesn't know yet. That bastard from the Paradeisos wanted me to free him... Now I found him, but I'm about to do the exact opposite.
female_content: She probably doesn't know yet. That bastard from the Paradeisos wanted me to free her... Now I found her, but I'm about to do the exact opposite.

content: Why are you staring at me and laughing?

speaker: Coquelic
content: It's a long-awaited reunion. Shouldn't you be happy to see an old friend?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Or is it because...
Coquelic takes a strand of her hair, playfully twirling it like teasing a cat.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Don't tell me you've forgotten about me after a good night's sleep, Chief.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ah, that's a pity.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You probably only remember the beautiful girl in the moonlit flower field, but forgot about the imposing villain behind the screen.
Was that really you? ...We didn't exactly "meet" since there was a screen between us.
After Sinner Sumire's first escape, I brought her back from the "Mentor."
But the Mentor was behind the screen at that time. How can you prove that "Mentor" was you?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Don't be such a killjoy. A close relationship benefits both of us!
She teasingly moves closer to you, trying to touch you while ignoring her wounds.
You instantly distance yourself from her. This isn't a simple "seduction," your shackles clearly sense a rising surge of Mania, constantly tangling with the shackles.
The shackles can suppress Mania. You don't have to fight it.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You're so serious. I was just teasing you. I just wanted to test if the legendary leash is as sturdy as they say... Don't be so petty, Sinners don't like that.
It seems like she gives in, but her body language and M-value say otherwise.
Alright, if you want to "play" with the shackles, you can. But you have to play a game with me too.
Tell me everything you know about the incidents that occurred in Eastside while I was unconscious. We'll exchange information.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Here I thought you would ask for something else. Fine, I'll tell you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: A carnation under my command was deceived and took on a dangerous commission.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I couldn't stand seeing my little flower being tormented, so I helped her out.
She casually narrates, fiddling with her nails.
Don't play dumb, that won't work here.
Who commissioned you?

speaker: Coquelic
content: The client? It doesn't matter anymore, you can't find her. She broke the rules and dragged the little flowers of the Garden into a mess. She already turned into compost.
Who was your target?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Shalom, a scumbag from Paradeisos. And also, to mess with FAC a little bit.
Why target her?

speaker: Coquelic
content: A good assassin wouldn't ask anything unnecessary.
...Then why dragged others into this?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Just a justice ceremony done along the way.
Do you know anything about the inside story?

speaker: Coquelic
content: No, I don't.
She adjusts into a comfortable pose on the interrogation chair. She subtly moves her fingers towards you while blinking innocently.
Coquelic doesn't trust you. You can tell by her perfunctory attitude.
For a commission you know nothing about, you let the Garden confront Paradeisos. It's almost completely destroyed.
You were willing to pay such a high price, and you think I'll believe you know nothing?
You distance yourself from Coquelic, placing a thick stack of evidence in front of her.
test
test
test
test
test
test

speaker: Coquelic
content: Let's see what our little Chief has found.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Oh... "Since the establishment of the Garden, their main targets have always been the Paradeisos and the anti-Mania combat personnel. The source of the Garden's weapons and supplies is deeply connected to the Underground."

speaker: Coquelic
content: "They can even use unknown means to catalyze ordinary people into Sinners. Currently, the only known possessors of this technology are..."
Parma, and—

speaker: Coquelic
content: Their master, the Underground, hahaha!
She can't stop laughing at your serious expression.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You knew everything already. Why are you still playing this game with me?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Yes, there once was a group of self-righteous people who nurtured this place, manipulated the puppets known as "Mentors," and recruited those poor little flowers.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I was once one of them, recruited by my "Mentor" and inspired by her. I wielded my power for her.

speaker: Coquelic
content: But they forgot one thing: flowers and dogs are different. We are not the same as Parma. Some flowers are poisonous...
She takes the investigation report in your hand, and looks at your various speculations about the Underground. As if it's some worthless trash, she scatters the report on the ground.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I don't like working for others, and I hate those self-proclaimed manipulators even more.

speaker: Coquelic
content: So, I presented the most splendid performance for the "Mentor"! Using the quickest, harshest, and most painful method she taught me, I took away everything she had.
Including the position of the "Mentor."

speaker: Coquelic
content: You're such a clever child, Chief. If only my Garden had more people like you...
She giggles softly, and gets a bit closer to you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: But I'm just a kind and beautiful young woman. Even if I sit in the position of the "Mentor," I still can't escape the control of the Underground.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Remember the client I just mentioned?
Didn't you say she's already turned into "compost"?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ah, I almost forgot, before she turned into something useful, she had her own name—Segal.

speaker: Coquelic
content: She, like those in the Parma, can decay into a disgusting sludge.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You see, I'm busy. I don't have time to care about the life of sludge.
Coquelic props her cheek and looks at you, as if she's waiting for an interesting answer.
Sludge can regenerate. I've seen something similar.
You mean, this Segal who was sent by the Underground to liaise with the Garden might still be alive?

speaker: Coquelic
content: That depends on you... Good luck, little Chief.
You just called yourself young...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Rude! Never ask a delicate flower for its age.
She's just pretending to be upset, and she quickly restores her usual inscrutable smile. Her cold pale hands are holding you.
Having physical contact with an assassin will only put me in danger, right?

speaker: Coquelic
content: But you aren't pulling away. Are you still expecting me to say something?
You haven't told the whole truth yet.
Although she's injured, she's still an S-Class Sinner. You can't push her away, and her cold knuckles are moving up along your arm.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I've been so cooperative, so don't reject me. The intel I gave you should keep you busy for a while.
You did give me some useful information, but you haven't told the whole truth yet, have you?
If you don't like being controlled by the Underground, why accept this commission?
After finding yourself caught up in a dispute, laying low seems more like an assassin's style. What were you trying to do here?

speaker: Coquelic
content: You have so many questions... But, isn't this different from the "information exchange" we agreed on?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Perhaps it's time for you to show me your sincerity...
Coquelic points at the red glow on her, feigning innocence.
What do you want to know?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hmm... First, explain how it <color=#fb9259>binds</color> Sinners.
Although it's named "shackles," I've never considered it as a restraint.
I only use it to suppress the Mania in Sinners, not to "bind" anyone.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Oh? Even if the Sinner tries to harm you with their power, you won't force them to stop?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Like this, for example?
Coquelic's nails dig deep into your wrist, and you start to feel a sharp pain.
You seem so hostile, but you chose to be detained by MBCC... What exactly do you want to gain from me?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Gain? Don't be ridiculous. It's not like you would agree to it if I told you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Dear Chief, as long as you're alive, the shackles can never be broken, right?

speaker: Coquelic
content: You have such an unreasonable power. Stop with the pretty words!
The shackles are scorching. A sinister power is constantly emanating from her end.
You have to gather more information, so you keep your hand there.
How would you know whether we're allies if you don't tell the truth?
If the Underground dragged the Garden into this to divert FAC's attention... what about you?
You accepted the commission, exposed the Underground, surrendered to us, and are now testing the limits of the shackles... Are you really doing all these on a whim?
Tell me what you want. I can help you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I don't need you, big hero. The Garden only blooms for itself!
You feel a more intense pain, as though roots are starting to grow into your soil. You can feel beads of sweat forming on your forehead.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Just like I joined the Garden without a reason, I just despise all forms of restraint!

speaker: Coquelic
content: FAC and Paradeisos hindered the growth of the flowers. Breaking free from them is just what I want!

speaker: Coquelic
content: This is my Garden! It thrives freely and fervently within its season!
Obstacles and restraints, do they include MBCC and me?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hahahaha... Congratulations, you guessed it! But it's too late!

speaker: Coquelic
content: You'll be my final work! You will die, along with the restraints and fate you symbolize, with me!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Cough, cough, cough...!
The backlash of Mania on her is exceptionally strong. Her skin is scorching hot. But she shows no intention of letting go, and her power is wandering rudely inside you.
Unlike a Corpus, whose presence can be easily detected, this feels more like a smoke of decay, arbitrarily invading your mind.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Aren't you going to use your precious shackles to restrain me?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Bind me! Make me stop! Show me your anger, your oppression!
Stop it, Coquelic. If you keep going, neither of us will be able to bear it!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hehehe, cough, cough! ...I've lived a great life. Now I just want to see, between your shackles and this, who will see the sun of tomorrow!
Pain spreads from your arm to your heart and lungs, even affecting all your organs. Dizziness, nausea, chill... All horrible experiences envelop you, and you start to tremble uncontrollably.
Coquelic isn't faring much better, but she seems to be numb to it all. She's burning her own life and excitedly watching your pained expression.
She was clearly exhausted after the fight. Where is this power coming from now...

speaker: Coquelic
content: It's power extracted at the expense of my own life... Do you like it? This domineering, filthy, deathly power! It's been inside me, stunting my growth, consuming my mind...

speaker: Coquelic
content: If you like it, I have plenty more! I made a pact with Mania a long time ago. This disgusting power is inexhaustible for me!

speaker: Coquelic
content: I'll use this disgusting power to rip off your hypocritical mask under your pretty words!
How many times do I have to tell you... The shackles aren't meant for restraining Sinners!
But someone has to control your Mania!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ha... I knew it...!
She weakly lifts her eyes, smirking as she looks at the dark red thorns around her.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I knew it, you people with missions and titles love to talk big! In the end, you released the shackles anyway!

speaker: Coquelic
content: You may fool the other girls, but you can't fool me...
The taste of blood fills your throat, making you increasingly irritated.
I have been telling the truth from the beginning, but look at you! You're about to die, and you're still talking nonsense?
Stop being so stubborn. Control your Mania and calm down!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Heh... Are you trying to... prove your kindness to a Sinner...
She murmurs weakly, her thoughts drifting away. She thinks of the Sinners who successfully escaped the Garden, and a future without the Chief.
She brushes the sweaty bangs off your forehead, leans close to your ear, and with a smile, says her last words.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Join me, let Mania... consume us completely...

speaker: Coquelic
content: They have such high expectations for you... I'm looking forward to seeing... the brilliant expressions of those bastards... after you're exhausted...
The pain penetrates your marrow, and your consciousness, along with hers, falls into the abyss.
When Nightingale arrives with the guards and the medical team, all they find are an unconscious Chief and Coquelic. A poppy is blooming where their skin had made contact.
That is the mark left by a Garden assassin after achieving their goal.
What a shame. They were so young... And their poor daughter.
What on earth happened?
I don't know. They wouldn't tell us anything. They wouldn't even allow their names to be written on it.
They just sent over a pair of medals.
Well, it's an honor in a way, dying for DisCity. They died with dignity.
The mourning passersby are driven away by a girl.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Get lost! All of you, get lost! We don't need your mourning!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Heh... No one will even remember your names after you sacrificed for them!
The girl angrily kicks at the poppy in front of the tomb.
That's the seed behind the FAC medal, buried with the merits in the sunless soil.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You really think that other people's lives are more valuable than your own?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Who decided that? Why?
The girl sneers, cutting her wrist with her fingernail, and a strange black mist pours out.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hey, you want to consume me, don't you?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Go on. But in exchange, I have a request.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I don't want to become a meaningless pawn in someone else's hand. No one can measure the value of my life.

speaker: Coquelic
content: As long as I'm strong enough... I can live for myself.

speaker: Official
content: Why...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Why not? Isn't it natural for an assassin to do what they're paid for?

speaker: Official
content: Ha! Yeah... you're just a bunch of money-grubbing lunatics!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Oh? So should I say, you're dying under the hands of a crazy Sinner for the future of DisCity—Does that make your death more valuable, "honored guests"?
The assassin doesn't give them a chance to respond. The alley is filled with the stench of decay.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Hmph... You saw my gorgeous moves, why don't you even smile?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I gave you an "honorable" death. It was your favorite thing, no? Why weren't you happy about it?
Coquelic forces a smile onto the stiff, lifeless face with her fingers, then irritably moves her hands away.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You brought despair, pain, and sadness to others. I was just letting you experience them all over again.

speaker: Coquelic
content: This is how fairness works in DisCity, hahaha... cough, cough!
The emotion triggers pain, but she seems to have gotten used to the torment brought by her power. She nonchalantly wipes her mouth and plants a seed in the pool of blood.

speaker: Coquelic
content: The grand awards you gave out back then, I now return them to you.
The slender figure disappears at the end of the dark alley.
She's lost count of how many poppies she's given out. Maybe ten, a hundred, or a thousand.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Whether it's the Garden's commissions or the nemesis of fate... I can clear them all.
Finally, she got her revenge.

speaker: Mentor
content: It's done?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Yes.

speaker: Mentor
content: Are you sure it's him?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Yes, he was the person in charge of the operation that my parents participated in.

speaker: Mentor
content: Good. You've worked hard over the years, take a good rest.

speaker: Mentor
content: What, you have something to say about it?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Quite a few people were gone while I was away.

speaker: Mentor
content: Yes, there was a dangerous mission from the Underground. To salvage the situation, we had to put out some bait.

speaker: Mentor
content: We achieved our goal, so they didn't die in vain.
The grown-up assassin doesn't answer. She calmly blows the dust off her fingertips.

speaker: Mentor
content: It's their glory as assassins to die for the Underground.

speaker: Mentor
content: Coquelic, don't forget. The Garden supported you, trained you, and helped you gather information for your revenge.

speaker: Mentor
content: One day, you will also...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Die for your plans?

speaker: Coquelic
content: I thought the Garden would be a good place because you accepted Sinners... but it's just the same.

speaker: Coquelic
content: What does your ambition have to do with the rest of the Garden?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Since you're so interested in that sunless place, I'll take you there myself.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I won't let myself become such a self-indulgent joke...

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...nor my flowers.

speaker: Garofano
content: I don't want to lose my family again...

speaker: Coquelic
content: The Garden is your home. You'll have a family.

speaker: Thistle
content: He needs to be punished!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Go all the way then. I'll teach you how.

speaker: Gekkabijin
content: I need to be stronger. I don't want to be stepped on by anyone!

speaker: Coquelic
content: Then beat me, or kill me.

speaker: Sumire
content: Please forgive me, I might have to follow him again.
female_content: Please forgive me, I might have to follow her again.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ha, you bet everything on that person. What if you get betrayed?

speaker: Sumire
content: ...I don't care.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Don't regret it.
Make your dreams come true! Seek your revenge! My flowers, my Garden, should be free, willful, and grow wildly.
If there are any weeds, just get rid of them.

speaker: Mania
content: Roar...
Is it time? Are you taking me?
Just a little longer...
Coquelic is waiting for something, but she can't tell what is it.
She just quietly lies in the corner of her consciousness in the sea of flowers, looking back at her life.
Hatred, violence, chaos, and indulgence—perhaps that's all she was.
Even at the end of her life, she ends it with an absurd interrogation that ends in mutual destruction.
I never answered his question in the end...
female_content: I never answered her question in the end...

content:
"You accepted the commission, exposed the Underground, surrendered to us, and are now testing the limits of the shackles..."
"Are you really doing all these on a whim?"
I transferred so much Mania into that Chief. There won't be much time left.
He won't have the chance to hear the answer, and I... don't need to tell him.
female_content: She never had the chance to hear the answer, and I... I don't need to tell her.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Paradeisos and the Underground think the Garden is obliterated, and I've settled the final threat—the shackles. My Garden...

speaker: Coquelic
content: There's nothing to worry about.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Nothing at all...

speaker: Garofano
content: I'd rather die than let anyone hurt them... You can dream of getting past me...

speaker: Garofano
content: Arghhhh!
This is...

speaker: Thistle
content: I'm sorry... Mentor... forgive me...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Here we go again! Stop crying!

speaker: Coquelic
content: How many times have I told you! Don't act on your own! Don't care about others so much!

speaker: Coquelic
content: I'm just a bad woman who locks you up in solitary every day. Stop pestering me, I'm not your mom.

speaker: Thistle
content: No, I can't... I...

speaker: Gekkabijin
content: I haven't beaten you yet! I haven't become the strongest flower in the Garden!
Why are these memories surfacing right now?

speaker: Garden Assassin
content: Mentor, we'll cover you. You retreat first.
Why, in my last moments...
Why am I seeing these?

speaker: Coquelic
content: How ridiculous... my final attachment? I always accomplish everything alone, how could I have such a thing...
Then why are you still here...

speaker: Sumire
content: ...waiting for us to appear?

speaker: Sumire
content: Do you really... have no attachments left?

speaker: Sumire
content: Mentor...

speaker: Garofano
content: ...Mentor?

speaker: Electrocardiograph
content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>"Beep... beep..."</size></color>
<color=#7683a2><size=30>How is she?</size></color>

speaker: Medical Team
content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>She pulled through! It worked!</size></color>

speaker: Medical Team
content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>But... if we continue, it'll be bad for you, Chief!</size></color>
<color=#7683a2><size=30>It's okay, I know what I'm doing. Keep going, transfer all her Mania to me.</size></color>

speaker: Gekkabijin
content: Hey!

speaker: Thistle
content: I was wrong!

speaker: Garden Assassin
content: Ms. Coquelic...

speaker: Electrocardiograph
content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>"Beep beep beep..."</size></color>

speaker: Medical Team
content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>Monitor her heart rate and blood pressure!</size></color>

speaker: Medical Team
content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>They're all returning to normal!</size></color>

speaker: Medical Team
content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>Chief, the Mania you've absorbed has already exceeded how much the shackles can take!</size></color>
<color=#7683a2><size=30>Keep going!</size></color>
<color=#7683a2><size=35>She still wants to live.</size></color>
<color=#7683a2>...And there are people waiting for her.</color>
A poppy can bloom beautifully on its own... Why are there always fools doing useless things for me...
But this time, do I have a chance... to tell him the answer to that question?
female_content: But this time, do I have a chance... to tell her the answer to that question?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content:
"You accepted the commission, exposed the Underground, surrendered to us, and are now testing the limits of the shackles..."
"Are you really doing all these on a whim?"

speaker: Coquelic
content: No, it's for...

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...my Garden.

speaker: Coquelic
content: What should I say to him...
female_content: What should I say to her...

speaker: Coquelic
content: "Thanks for buying me some extra time."

speaker: Coquelic
content: No, that's a bit lame. Doesn't match the style of the Garden.

speaker: Coquelic
content: "I'll remember your kindness. Let's get along well in the future."

speaker: Coquelic
content: That sounds too ungrateful... Cough cough...
Coquelic has been hesitating outside the office for a long time, her weak body has even begun to feel tired, but she still hasn't figured out what to say to you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: So, it failed?

speaker: Sumire
content: Yes... The Chief tried to absorb all the Mania in your body with the shackles, but it wasn't very effective.

speaker: Sumire
content: MBCC almost mobilized all its medical power, and only then were you pulled back from death.

speaker: Sumire
content: We don't know when the Mania will devour you again next time.

speaker: Coquelic
content: So my life is hanging by a thread. Is that what it is?
Coquelic looks at her palm somewhat dazedly. The red light of the shackles temporarily suppresses the black mist of the Mania.
She lets Sumire comb her hair while staring blankly at the ceiling of the ward. She comes back to her senses after a while.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Where is the Chief? Putting on some melodrama about doing good deeds without leaving a name?

speaker: Sumire
content: He...
female_content: She...

content: Sumire looks away, but Coquelic notices the file that Sumire is trying to hide behind her back.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Give it to me, you're not good enough to fool me.
It's a file with the MBCC stamp on it, containing an important report from the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.

xx, xx, N.F. 113
　　MBCC found traces of a Sinner in Syndicate. After tracking, it's confirmed to be S-Class Sinner Coquelic.
　　According to interrogation and investigation, all members of the Garden were forced to participate in the attack in August under the pressure of the Underground forces.
　　Except for Mentor Coquelic, the rest of the Sinners were killed in the battle with the FAC. The Garden is confirmed to be destroyed.

speaker: Coquelic
content: But he was there when those children escaped...
female_content: But she was there when those children escaped...

content: She realizes something and suddenly closes the file.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Sumire, this report will be submitted to the 9th Agency, right?

speaker: Sumire
content: I think so? Is there a problem?

speaker: Coquelic
content: No, nothing. Everything is going just as I wished... It seems he no longer needs my answer.
female_content: No, nothing. Everything is going just as I wished... It seems she no longer needs my answer.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Heh... Sumire, the person you chose, is really interesting.

speaker: Sumire
content: My apologies, Mentor. I don't understand what you mean.

speaker: Coquelic
content: ${PlayerName}...
She hands back the file.

speaker: Coquelic
content: He's not as innocent as you think, but also not as untrustworthy as I thought.
female_content: She's not as innocent as you think, but also not as untrustworthy as I thought.

speaker: Coquelic
content: He did me a huge favor, but he let me see this report before submitting it.
female_content: She did me a huge favor, but she let me see this report before submitting it.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Now... I must go talk to him.
female_content: Now... I must go talk to her.

content: Coquelic gets out of the bed. Sumire wants to help, but Coquelic raises her hand to refuse.

speaker: Coquelic
content: It's okay. I need to talk to him, just me and him.
female_content: It's okay. I need to talk to her, just me and her.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Whew... I really underestimated you. After enduring so much Mania, you have the strength to write all this nonsense... but didn't even bother to visit me.
Coquelic is walking out of the ward while mumbling something, her steps somewhat unsteady. It's then she notices Sumire looking hesitant by the bed.

speaker: Coquelic
content: What's wrong with you? You've been acting weird.

speaker: Sumire
content: This report... The Chief had it prepared before deciding to use the shackles to save you.

speaker: Sumire
content: Chief asked me to give this to you if you wake up first, so you don't worry too much.

speaker: Sumire
content: The Chief heard about your past. He knows you hate "self-sacrifice," so he asked me not to tell you about his condition.
female_content: The Chief heard about your past. She knows you hate "self-sacrifice," so she asked me not to tell you about her condition.

speaker: Sumire
content: But... I know I can't hide it from you.

speaker: Coquelic
content: And what else?
Coquelic seems to have guessed the answer, but she can't help but ask her to keep going.

speaker: Sumire
content: And... he hopes you can believe that the shackles are not a constraint, and the Sinners are not pawns for the MBCC to use.
female_content: And... she hopes you can believe that the shackles are not a constraint, and the Sinners are not pawns for the MBCC to use.

speaker: Sumire
content: His attitude towards the Sinners is just like yours towards the Garden.
female_content: Her attitude towards the Sinners is just like yours towards the Garden.

content: Sumire seems to say something else, but Coquelic is no longer paying attention.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Where is he now?
female_content: Where is she now?

speaker: Sumire
content: Miss Nightingale said the Chief's condition has improved slightly. The Chief has just moved out of the intensive care ward, but isn't accepting visitors.

speaker: Sumire
content: Should be in the lounge at the moment. I think the Chief should be able to talk and eat now.
After Sumire finishes speaking, she looks up to find that Coquelic is already gone.

speaker: Coquelic
content: What should I say...
Thank you for seeing through my weakness? Seeing through the selfishness even I don't dare to admit?
Or... blame him for acting like those children who can't protect themselves.
female_content: Or... blame her for acting like those children who can't protect themselves.

content: Coquelic has been struggling with how to start. But the moment she sees the Chief, she's stunned as if she's been struck by lightning.
Wounds, bruises, and remnants of contamination cover the person in front of her. Some of them are left by Rustfire, and some are newly added when sharing the Mania for Coquelic.
She just quietly examines every wound on you, maintaining a subtle distance from you in this not-so-large space.
But it seems she has crossed this distance and seen many people...
Aren't you going to say something?
You didn't come here just to see my wounds, right?
"Don't worry, I've got a lot of stuff inside my body. Your Mania isn't the worst." You really want to say this, but you hold back.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Don't flatter yourself, do I look like the kind of person who would care about your injuries?

speaker: Chief
content: Hmm, who knows? You're not actually that cruel, right?

speaker: Chief
content: Do you know what Sumire and Gekkabijin say about you?

speaker: Chief
content: You're very picky, even a bit dictatorial, but you love the Garden more than anyone else.

speaker: Chief
content: Whenever a Garden assassin is in danger, you will grumble and fight twice as hard for them.

speaker: Chief
content: You are quite extreme and arrogant. But I have to admit...

speaker: Chief
content: You're a good Mentor.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Tsk, is that supposed to be a compliment?
It sounds as if she's complaining, but there is a relieved smile on her face.
Perhaps I know, what I should say now.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Flowers will always wither after they bloom. It's normal. I just want to ask...

speaker: Coquelic
content: After what you have done for me, how much time do I have left? A year, a month, or...

speaker: Chief
content: It's hard to tell, but the MBCC will do its best.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Okay...
She solemnly fixes her hair and already torn dress, trying to look more serious.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You can ask anything about Paradeisos, the Underground, the Garden, and me... But there's a condition...

speaker: Coquelic
content: You have to promise me three things.

speaker: Gekkabijin
content: Sumire told me you stormed off to see the Chief. It nearly scared her to death.

speaker: Sumire
content: So what were three things you asked for, Mentor?
The ward at night is not as quiet as usual. Sumire is peeling fruit for Coquelic, while Gekkabijin is lying by the bed like a child listening to a story.

speaker: Coquelic
content: First, the MBCC has to track down all the remaining Garden Sinners in secret, and put the shackles on them to suppress their Mania.

speaker: Coquelic
content: The old foxes up above and down below may not let us go so easily. I can only have a good beauty sleep if I hand this over to him.
female_content: The old foxes up above and down below may not let us go so easily. I can only have a good beauty sleep if I hand this over to her.

speaker: Coquelic
content: And the second thing, I hope he'll keep his word...
female_content: And the second thing, I hope she'll keep her word...

speaker: Coquelic
content: You won't expose the existence of Garden Sinners?

speaker: Chief
content: I won't.

speaker: Coquelic
content: You won't use shackles to restrain Sinners?

speaker: Chief
content: Of course not.

speaker: Coquelic
content: Sinners aren't pawns? They're not tools for you to achieve your grand goals?

speaker: Chief
content: No.

speaker: Chief
content: They are friends, partners, seniors, siblings...

speaker: Chief
content: They are family.

speaker: Gekkabijin
content: A liar has to swallow a thousand needles!

speaker: Sumire
content: What about the third one?

speaker: Coquelic
content: The third one is, of course, that your Chief can cherish their own life.

speaker: Coquelic
content: If your Chief keeps charging forward like a wild bull, all my careful planning will go to waste.

speaker: Chief
content: Should you be the one to tell me this?

speaker: Chief
content: You even went as far as to fight on your own. You exposed yourself, and waged a war against Paradeisos and the Underground. All to sever the chains binding the Garden.

speaker: Chief
content: During this time, you had so many enemies, how much of your own life have you exhausted?

speaker: Chief
content: You're no less reckless than me.

speaker: Chief
content: Why don't we both abide by the third agreement? I'll stop being reckless, and you should cherish your remaining time. Don't use that power anymore.
Coquelic stops mid-sentence and chuckles, gently patting both Sumire and Gekkabijin on the head.

speaker: Coquelic
content: What? So engrossed in the story that your sense of perception is dulled?

speaker: Coquelic
content: There is a guest outside the sickroom. Go and greet her.

speaker: Gekkabijin
content: Guest?

speaker: Garofano
content: Mentor, sorry for worrying you.

speaker: Sumire
content: Garofano! I'm glad you're okay...

speaker: Garofano
content: Don't worry, Thistle is doing fine as well. It seems like she's made some new friends.

speaker: Sumire
content: It seems that the Chief is already fulfilling the second promise.

speaker: Garofano
content: Did I interrupt something? What were you talking about?

speaker: Gekkabijin
content: The third promise! Did you agree to it?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Well...

speaker: Coquelic
content: Ordinary powers can't protect those little fools under my command.

speaker: Chief
content: But at least you are safe for now. If you trust me, then promise me not to fight by draining your own life. As long as you don't use such an outrageous power, the shackles can suppress your Mania.

speaker: Coquelic
content: But... we will always encounter stronger enemies. One of us has to risk their life.

speaker: Coquelic
content: I told you, the Chief—

speaker: Coquelic
content: I hope flowers can bloom and grow in every corner and in various ways, and use their leaves to cut through all hardships.

speaker: Gekkabijin
content: What kind of answer is that...

speaker: Sumire
content: It sounds more like a wish?

speaker: Coquelic
content: Yes, it's a wish.
My last wish...
I hope that when the next crisis comes, poppies can bloom for you all, shielding you from the sudden rain.
And then, they can wither, rot, and nourish this land.
Gekkabijin, you are qualified as an assassin. I acknowledge you.
Sumire, may thorns no longer grow in the path you chose.
Garofano... you will have to take care of those immature flowers in the future.
Thistle, remember to hold firm to your justice.
Children, if you like that apartment in Syndicate, start a new life there.
No matter how much time is left, a year, a month... it doesn't matter.
Poppies will turn into compost, nurture, accompany, and protect all the seeds forever...

speaker: Nightingale
content: The Mania flower that Coquelic left in the interrogation room has withered in the storage room.
The adjutant hands over a shriveled evidence bag, the once vibrant flower inside has lost its color.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Has she been here already?
Yes. I also told her that if she used such extreme power again, it would cost her life.
But she didn't give me an answer just now.
This flower is probably her reply. She's refused.

speaker: Nightingale
content: There's a message... on this flower?
Yeah, I can see it. It says...
The Garden...

speaker: Coquelic
content: ...is now in your hands, Chief.
The girl sits in the interrogation chair, entranced and motionless as a real doll.
Eve's eyelashes flutter, but she doesn't lift her head, seemingly unsure of how to interact with you.
An unbreakable icy silence fills the interrogation room.
Her physical injuries from the fire have healed, but the clinic's assessment of her condition is not optimistic.

speaker: Doctor
content: She actually wasn't in critical danger. It's a miracle that she survived such a huge fire.

speaker: Doctor
content: When the rescue team found her, she was trapped between slabs of stone, unharmed.
After Eve was rescued, she was immediately taken to the nearest Syndican clinic. Upon receiving the news, you also hurried to the clinic.
Eve's life is not in danger, but the doctor's brow remains furrowed.

speaker: Doctor
content: We gave her a full examination and found that the most serious issue wasn't caused by the fire.
And... what is the most serious issue?

speaker: Doctor
content: ...How much do you know about her legs?
According to the investigation, her legs were injured in a car accident when she was a child. It has nothing to do with the factory or the Mania contamination.

speaker: Doctor
content: But a Sinner typically has an unusually robust body.

speaker: Doctor
content: The nerves of a severed limb would have extraordinary vitality. We're talking about a Sinner's body. Even if only the brain is left, it can fuse with a full mechanical prosthetic body.

speaker: Doctor
content: According to the examination results, there is no sign of fusion between her prosthetic limbs and the remaining nerves.
You mean she could have been able to stand on her legs?

speaker: Doctor
content: Right...
The doctor sighs and hands you a stack of reports.

speaker: Doctor
content: Her most serious issue is not physical, but psychological.

speaker: Doctor
content: Why would a person who doesn't want to live want to stand up?
Behind the small surveillance window in the clinic room door, Eve is sitting in her wheelchair by the window, lost in thought. Beside her are the untouched food tray and pills.

speaker: Doctor
content: We've confiscated all sharp objects, but still she's tried to take her life several times.

speaker: Doctor
content: Later, she probably realized her drastic actions might lead to consequences for the clinic. She's since been just sitting there blankly like that.

speaker: Doctor
content: She only responds minimally at the sight of you. You might be the only person in this world that she recognizes and is willing to communicate with.
In your pocket, the MBCC's communication device is constantly vibrating. You know there are more important tasks that require your attention.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief! The FAC decontamination team has detected an abnormal increase in Mania contamination in the BR-004 blockade area.
I'll be back soon...
Can you clear out my schedule before I set off? It won't take long.

speaker: Nightingale
content: What do you need to do?
I need to talk to Eve.
Eve.
You call her name again, and she finally responds.

speaker: Eve
content: Hmm...
Eve seems hesitant to look up still. You dim the light shining in her face so it doesn't dazzle her eyes.
You remember me, don't you?

speaker: Eve
content: Of course. You're the gray rag doll. You conveyed the true voices of the family. I'll never forget that.
The first time we talked, I was a rag doll. The second time, you were controlled by Mania. The third time, we're in a place like this.
You're probably not used to this environment, are you?

speaker: Eve
content: It's okay... It's cold, but it's fine.

speaker: Eve
content: I'm used to places like this. The factory deep in the Rust is also chilly. I usually sat in a stiff chair like I do now.

speaker: Eve
content: But the place I'm most familiar with is gone now, isn't it?

speaker: Eve
content: It's in ruins now, and I'm the only one left...

speaker: Eve
content: I've caused trouble for you.
Eve's hands clasp together anxiously. You can feel that she is trying to hide her emotions.
Not just you. In fact, when we found you in the ruins, the rescue team also found some other things.
test
test
test
test
test
test
Covered in ashes from the fire, the broken pieces look no different than a pile of refuse from the Rust. But Eve recognizes them at first glance.

speaker: Eve
content: These are...

speaker: Eve
content: The toy family I made?
When we found you, these fragments were piled around you. If I'm not mistaken, they saved you.
Eve seems incredulous, her fingertips trembling as she tries to reach out, then suddenly pulls back.

speaker: Eve
content: But they were just toys I made...

speaker: Eve
content: I simply assigned them memories and personalities... We were just playing house.
A personality and memories are enough to simulate half a real soul.
It was just playing house to you. But for the toys, these moments were long, real memories, right?
Eve looks at the debris in front of her with a complex expression and bites her lip once.

speaker: Bass
content: Cluck!

speaker: Eve
content: From now on, your name is Bass. You and Benna are the closest. If Benna ever forgets anything, you have to remind him.

speaker: Eve
content: The doll's name will be Polly. Remember, you were once the kindest girl in the world.

speaker: Polly
content: I'm... Polly.

speaker: Eve
content: Yes, this is the mother nesting doll, Maresa.
Eve's gaze sweeps over each of them...

speaker: Eve
content: Idiots... It happened again. You've ended up like this because of me...
When you gave them their identities, they were destined to protect you just like your previous family did.

speaker: Eve
content: Yes, they did the exact same thing... Deceiving me that everything will be fine, then leaving me alone to face the devastating reality...

speaker: Eve
content: Do you really want me to wake up? Is it really better to be awake than asleep?
She looks sincerely and confusedly at the disfigured toys in front of her, carefully pulling your sleeve, as if expecting the adult in front of her to provide a mature answer.
Is reality really better...
That irritable teddy bear asked me the same question too. In fact, many people have asked me that...

speaker: Eve
content: Are they all like me?
Well, you have some things in common.
They each have a different story... Losing their closest ones, feeling helpless in the face of other patients' departure, holding onto the wish to eradicate all Corruptors...
Helplessly witnessing an innocent girl transform into a monster, killing someone kind and loyal and regretting it, wanting to save everyone but lacking the power...
Eve senses the change in your mood, her fingers nervously rubbing against your sleeve.

speaker: Eve
content: What happened to these people?
They're all awake and aware of the harsh reality and the fact that what they believe in could all be lies and illusions, but they're still moving forward.

speaker: Eve
content: How do they do it?
With patience. They endure it until one day the lies become truths.

speaker: Eve
content: Lies... can become truths...?
She seems to have never anticipated this answer.

speaker: Eve
content: But I've seen it... I've seen people be mocked, abandoned, and forgotten...
Are you calling the wonderful things your family promised you a lie?

speaker: Eve
content: Are they not?

speaker: Eve
content: Sincere friends and happy families. These don't exist in reality.
I see... Well, I prefer to call these lies ideals.

speaker: Eve
content: Ide...als?
The word seems so foreign to Eve.
That's right, Eve. These hopeful expectations aren't mere lies. They present the possibility of change.
That's the meaning of tomorrow. Tomorrow, your perspective and abilities may change, and perhaps you can do something new.
The accumulation of tomorrows gives us the power to make the lies true.
For someone struggling in the dirt, as long as she's still got a tomorrow, the possibility of standing up is always there.
Your smile seems to truly empower her a little. She stares at you quietly for a long time.

speaker: Eve
content: Tomorrow. I think I've got one now.
You push those pieces toward Eve.
These are what they earned for you.
Make your choice once more. I'll be waiting for your answer.
More urging calls from your device. You stand up and put on your coat.
Eve holds onto you nervously.

speaker: Eve
content: Where are you going, Chief?
Syndicate. A place where violence and crises abound and various forces are constantly at war.

speaker: Eve
content: You're going there even if you know it's dangerous? Are you... leaving me too?
Seeing Eve's hand trembling with uneasiness, you grip it and gently pat it.
I'm going to turn those lies into truths and use the power accumulated from the tomorrows to create a better world for you, and for everyone.
This is my motivation. What's yours, Eve?

speaker: Eve
content: I've lost... all my motivation...
She lowers her head in confusion, but her hand doesn't let go. She's scared, afraid that you'll leave her alone like her family once did.
Bass and Benna have said it, you're the smartest. I believe you will find your motivation.
Once you do, you'll be able to stand up and walk out of the factory, enduring the pain.
Whether to return to the beautiful dream or to see a new tomorrow, tell me your answer when I come back.
No matter what your answer is, this time, I will support you.
The door of the interrogation room opens from the outside. Nightingale is waiting for your instructions with a team of guards.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The car is ready to take Eve back to the clinic for continued observation and treatment.
Good, we should set off now.
The medical staff enter the interrogation room and help Eve onto the wheelchair, but her gaze follows you the entire time.
That look of incomprehension, shock, and curiosity never leaves you until the door closes.

speaker: Eve
content: What is my motivation...?

speaker: Nurse
content: Voila, this is our reconstructed ward!

speaker: Nurse
content: It's exactly the same as before, isn't it? Eve, have you seen what the clinic looked like before?

speaker: Eve
content: No. Ever since I lost my legs, I've hardly gone out.

speaker: Nurse
content: I see... It's okay, now you've seen it!

speaker: Francisco
content: Hey, is this our new friend?
A burly man greets the nurse with a warm smile.

speaker: Nurse
content: Hehe, Eve is a guest the MBCC has temporarily entrusted to us!

speaker: Nurse
content: Now, let me introduce you. This is Francisco the great painter!

speaker: Nurse
content: How are you recovering?

speaker: Francisco
content: Thanks to you, it's going great! Recreating those Eastside artists' masterpieces is just a piece of cake!

speaker: Nurse
content: Alright, alright, show off your talent once you're discharged.

speaker: Nurse
content: Don't waste it in my notebook!
The nurse tears a page from her notebook and gives it back to Francisco. Eve sees that the drawing on it is just some crooked stick figures.

speaker: Francisco
content: Miss Eve is looking at my drawing? Would you like me to do a portrait for you?

speaker: Eve
content: Um... Thank you?
Eve gives a noncommittal answer while eyeing Francisco's drawing.

speaker: Nurse
content: I still have to introduce Eve to the others here. You're interrupting us.
Francisco laughs unconcernedly and watches the nurse push Eve away.

speaker: Rhona
content: I wrote a new brain teaser! Come and have a guess!

speaker: Rhona
content: What can be produced in the North, East, South, and West of DisCity?
The lively scene not far away attracts the nurse and Eve's attention again. A little girl is standing on a bed, announcing loudly.

speaker: Patients
content: What is it, what is it?

speaker: Rhona
content: Hehe, it's... melon!
The crowd bursts into laughter over the joke Eve can't understand.

speaker: Patients
content: Hahaha! Rhona, you should come and do a stand-up comedy at my diner one day. People will love it!

speaker: Nurse
content: Wow, count me in!
The nurse joins the boisterous crowd.

speaker: Nurse
content: You must think the joke is lame, right?

speaker: Eve
content: Am I a killjoy here?
The nurse smiles and continues to make the introduction enthusiastically.

speaker: Nurse
content: Look over there, that's Andrew. He used to be the owner of a diner before he was admitted to the clinic!

speaker: Nurse
content: That's Albert. I heard he used to be a famous big eater in Syndicate. People keep saying he should go to Eastside and start a livestreaming career. He'd definitely make a name for himself!

Eve looks at the people the nurse is introducing to her. One is in ragged patched-up clothes, and the other is skinny as a skeleton. But strangely, as they bicker with one another, their demeanor seems to still fit the nurse's descriptions.

speaker: Albert
content: Hahaha, if Rhona's doing a stand-up performance, I definitely have to be there! And I'll empty every last bit of food in Andrew's restaurant!

speaker: Andrew
content: Keep talking. As if you can keep up with my cooking speed!
Horsing around boisterously, they don't appear like patients at all.
Eve leans in close to the nurse and whispers.

speaker: Eve
content: What brought them to the clinic?

speaker: Nurse
content: The folks in Syndicate have a rough life. They don't go to the doctor for minor ailments or injuries.

speaker: Nurse
content: The only thing that can bring them here... is Mania.
The nurse's expression darkens for a moment, but she quickly regains her smile.

speaker: Nurse
content: Alright, alright, that's enough bluffing for now! Everyone line up.

speaker: Nurse
content: Time for a blood test!
Like students in a classroom, the lively group obediently return to their respective spaces and quiet down.
As the other nurses start to run tests on them one by one, the nurse pushes Eve to a quiet corridor.

speaker: Helmet Girl
content: Sigh, those guys can't sit still for a minute.

speaker: Nurse
content: I was going to show you around this place, but it turned out a bit chaotic.

speaker: Nurse
content: I hope that didn't bother you too much?
Eve is indeed not used to being surrounded by so many people, but strangely, she doesn't feel repulsed.

speaker: Eve
content: No, it's fine. I'm glad they seem cheerful...

speaker: Eve
content: It feels... familiar...

speaker: Nurse
content: Hehe, did you have boastful friends like that too?
Several figures emerge in her mind, and Eve can't help but smile.

speaker: Eve
content: I wouldn't call them boastful. They simply liked to talk about that beautiful world they imagined...

speaker: Nurse
content: Hmm, even if they knew it might never come true, right?
Her inner thoughts are seen through by someone she just met. Eve widens her eyes uncharacteristically.

speaker: Nurse
content: Of course Chief has told us all about you before entrusting you to us.

speaker: Nurse
content: You've heard a lot of little lies like that, haven't you?

speaker: Eve
content: I truly don't understand... You know Mr. Francisco would never become a great painter. Why are you still telling him those things?

speaker: Nurse
content: Well, I didn't understand it at first either!

speaker: Nurse
content: But when my arm was corrupted, the nurse who took care of me told me that I would be cured and could live a normal life.

speaker: Nurse
content: And just like magic, the wound somehow hurt less...
The nurse touches her arm a little bashfully.

speaker: Nurse
content: Truth be told, it was never possible. After all, I had an entire arm removed. I knew she was just comforting me.

speaker: Nurse
content: But sometimes, a lie might just be the most effective painkiller. At least it made me feel better at that time.

speaker: Nurse
content: That's why I'm giving a dose to everyone now! I've gotten used to it over time...
The alarm suddenly goes off in the corridor, an urgent red light signaling unknown danger.

speaker: Nurse
content: Oh, excuse me, I kept talking about my personal story. I think they need me for an important task. Tell me your story next time, Eve!
The nurse parks Eve's wheelchair in a safe corner and hurries away.

speaker: Eve
content: Friendly, a little careless, and always in a rush. Is everyone here like this?
Alone in that corner, Eve begins observing her surroundings.
Unlike the factory, the hospital's corridor has many windows through which one can see the sky.
A flock of startled birds fly by, seeming to be coming from the direction of the Syndican slum.

speaker: Eve
content: ...I wonder what that rag doll in gray clothes is doing now?
Doll? Do you have a doll too?
She suddenly hears a childish voice behind her.
Eve turns the wheelchair around slowly and sees a little girl holding a ragged doll.
The IV line has left marks on the little girl's hand.

speaker: Lily
content: I'm Lily. Are you also a patient here? I've never seen you!

speaker: Eve
content: Hi Lily, I'm Eve. I'm just here temporarily.

speaker: Lily
content: I see. So you don't have Mania?

speaker: Eve
content: I... I'm already a Sinner.

speaker: Lily
content: A Sinner?! How cool!
Lily excitedly raises the doll in her hand.

speaker: Lily
content: Could you maybe fix my doll with your power?
That thing can hardly be called a doll. It's just a few rags sewn together and stuffed with cotton. Eve can't make out the original shape, but she can feel the traces of corruption.
Eve leans in and unintentionally sees the tag on Lily's hand.
Patient Name: Lily
Mania Contamination Level: High
<i>Contamination Removal Surgery Date: Scheduled within this week<i>

speaker: Nurse
content: But sometimes, a lie might just be the most effective painkiller. At least it made me feel better at that time.
I'm going to turn those lies into truths and use the power accumulated from the tomorrows to create a better world for you, and for everyone.

speaker: Lily
content: Eve? Why are you so quiet... It can't be fixed, can it?

speaker: Eve
content: Yes, it can, give it to me. Soon it'll look as good as new.

speaker: Andrew
content: So, Rhona...
The nurse turns her back and wipes away her tears, shaking her head.

speaker: Albert
content: I see... She's going to tell jokes to everyone in heaven...

speaker: Francisco
content: Then I'll draw a portrait for her. I'm sure Rhona will like it.

speaker: Eve
content: I'm starting to understand what those lies mean...
In her ward, Eve looks out the window at the Syndican streets and pulls out a notebook borrowed from the clinic.
With colorful crayons, she starts writing something like a fairy tale book...

Chief, today is the fourth day since you left me in the clinic.
Today is also the day of Lily's surgery, and I lied.
The doctor said that if the contaminated parts could be removed, Lily could survive.
I lied to Lily, saying the surgery was simple and not painful at all.
I guess I understand now. Lies are like candy, right?
It's not a cure, but at least it brings us sweetness in times like this.

speaker: Lily
content: Eve, what are you writing?
A little head suddenly leans on Eve's knee, but she doesn't push it away.

speaker: Eve
content: I'm writing my answer to a question.

speaker: Eve
content: I made a promise to the person who asked it. Once he comes back, I must tell him my choice.
female_content: I made a promise to the person who asked it. Once she comes back, I must tell her my choice.

speaker: Eve
content: Whether to stay asleep or to open my eyes.
Lily seems baffled, hugging the repaired doll and looking out the window with Eve. But she quickly gets bored and starts showing off the change on her body.

speaker: Lily
content: Look! I've got a prosthetic just like the nurse!

speaker: Lily
content: The doctors fixed me just like Eve fixed the toys! I'm as good as new!

speaker: Eve
content: Did the contamination removal surgery hurt?

speaker: Lily
content: It did! It hurt so much! But tough as I am... I endured it!

speaker: Lily
content: Look how flexible my arm is. It's all good now!

speaker: Eve
content: Hmm, that's great.

speaker: Lily
content: Will you be able to stand on your legs someday too, Eve?
Eve is taken aback. She hasn't had time to think about this yet.

Still no news from you today.
I wish I could tell you in person. Today, I had a private consultation.
The doctor said that my mental condition has improved a lot. The Mania is stable, and the nerves in my body are recovering and gaining activity.
I can feel it, the stabilizing power from the shackles you planted in my body.

speaker: Nurse
content: Who are you writing to?
The nurse suddenly pats Eve on the shoulder from behind. She quickly closes the notebook.

speaker: Nurse
content: Don't hide it. I know what you're writing. But that person is always busy, will he really read it?
female_content: Don't hide it. I know what you're writing. But that person is always busy, will she really read it?

speaker: Eve
content: Of course!

speaker: Eve
content: He read my stories in the toy house. He will surely read it patiently this time too.
female_content: She read my stories in the toy house. She will surely read it patiently this time too.

speaker: Nurse
content: Alright then! Let's give Chief a surprise in that case...
The nurse hands Eve a report.

speaker: Eve
content: What is this?

speaker: Nurse
content: Your latest assessment report from the doctors.

speaker: Nurse
content: Good news, Eve. You will be able to stand up!

My prosthetics are beginning to respond. Sometimes they twitch unconsciously.
Of course, it will be a long, long time before a full recovery. By that time, you must have returned, right?
It's good news, but somehow I can't cheer up...
I heard that a serious riot broke out in Syndicate and Sinners are everywhere on the streets.
A lot of injured people were sent to the clinic.
I wonder if you're doing alright.

speaker: Lily
content: Those people... are they okay?
Lily timidly hides behind Eve's wheelchair.

speaker: Lily
content: Something must have happened, right? Everyone refuses to tell me. The nurses have been so busy lately. They don't even have time to play with me.
The clinic has never seen such chaos. Stretchers are brought in and out and an unpleasant smell lingers. Nurses and doctors are calling out loudly for support everywhere.
Eve holds Lily's hand and pats it gently, just like Chief once did to comfort her.

speaker: Eve
content: Don't worry. The doctors and nurses in this clinic are all so good at their jobs. They will surely handle this properly. Nothing bad will happen.

speaker: Eve
content: The nurse is very busy now, but I can play with you.

speaker: Eve
content: Shall I tell you a story?

speaker: Lily
content: Is it the story about the toy family? Lily has heard it before.

speaker: Eve
content: Then I'll tell you one you haven't heard. A story about a gray rag doll. But I'm telling it for the first time too, so I'm not very familiar with it.

speaker: Eve
content: Once upon a time, there was a gray rag doll. It was brave, strong, and kind, just like the hero of every story.
female_content: Once upon a time, there was a gray rag doll. It was brave, strong, and kind, just like the heroine of every story.

speaker: Eve
content: That rag doll taught lessons all the time. Many people didn't understand him. Even the rag doll sometimes doubted her own choices.
female_content: That rag doll taught lessons all the time. Many people didn't understand her. Even the rag doll sometimes doubted her own choices.

speaker: Eve
content: But in the eyes of the little white bear, the rag doll who painted a beautiful tomorrow seemed to be glowing brightly...
She hears steady breath near her knees. Lily has already dozed off by Eve's side at some point.

Francisco left us today. I heard he was hit by Mania weapon shrapnel.
He was so close to finishing his portrait for Rhona.
I've seen the painting. It was crooked, like a child's doodle.
But Rhona was laughing so happily in it, like she was still telling jokes to everyone.

Lily has recovered. Her family is coming to get her soon. They're going to hide in a safer place. Chief, you've said I have a tomorrow and the choice to rewrite the lies and to realize the ideals and hopes. I've made my choice. I want to find the ideals you mentioned and to see what lies ahead.
When are you coming to pick me up?
Eve closes her notebook, watching everyone send Francisco off for the last time.
The nurse leans on Eve, somewhat exhausted. She hasn't had a good night's sleep in several days.

speaker: Eve
content: From now on, he will have an endless supply of paintbrushes. The rainbow will be his palette.

speaker: Nurse
content: Pfft... Since when have you started talking like that too?
Eve doesn't answer. She takes off her glove and wipes away the nurse's tears.

speaker: Eve
content: Last night, the connecting end of the prosthetic was hurting a little. Is it healing?

speaker: Nurse
content: Really?! You can feel it!

speaker: Nurse
content: I'll get a doctor to check you out right away!
The nurse jumps up from the floor and runs off, mumbling to herself.

speaker: Nurse
content: That's great. Eve's legs are going to get better...

speaker: Eve
content: Yes, everything will get better.

speaker: Eve
content: The lies will come true one by one...
Eve sits in her wheelchair at the entrance of the clinic. The recently renovated clinic is now shabby again, but no one bothers to fix it now.
The road is empty. The world is gray. Debris glowing with sparks fall from the sky occasionally.

speaker: Eve
content: There are fewer and fewer pedestrians on the street. Something serious seems to have happened in Syndicate. Everyone has probably gone there.

speaker: Eve
content: Are you there too, Chief? Fighting for your ideals, for everyone's tomorrow...
A piece of coarse paper falls at the clinic's entrance. Some bright red text is printed on it.
In just an instant, Eve spots a familiar name on the paper.
Having made sure that no FAC armored vehicles are in sight, Eve carefully approaches the roadside.
She bends down to pick up the paper, but as soon as her hand touches the ground, she can already see the words on the paper...

<color=#dg1f1f>Obituary</color>
