Two weeks ago, the Eastside Public Security Bureau received three missing reports, which all pointed to you...
Countess Chelsea.
You place the photos of the missing people in front of her, at which she only takes a sideways glance.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Oh... It's them.
The sheriffs traced where they were last seen, and found that all three of them went back to the Countess's Court with you.
What do you have to say about this?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Chief... There are many people in the world I want as my sugar babies, and I can afford them.

speaker: Chelsea
content: But you, Chief, are my favorite out of all of them, of course!

speaker: Chelsea
content: So my home is actually kind of big and can fit many people... And you can just sleep whenever you're tired! How nice it is live in a place like that—

speaker: Chelsea
content: Right—you, Chief, are the only one for the whole time, to refuse being my sugar baby and even to refuse my gifts. I'm so very sad that you don't want to live with me.
So, let me ask you this. Has this person been living in your... Countess' Court as well?
An old Count, from Eastside.
Almost as soon as Chelsea hears the three words "an old Count," her face becomes gloomy, and her smile vanishes.

speaker: Chelsea
content: ...I've had nothing to do with him since a long time ago.
Even though you inherited his title and all his wealth?
She gives you a condescending glance, which is probably her actual self—the Countess Chelsea who roams around Eastside's vanity fair.
The Public Security Bureau has not found the old Count ever since. Everyone else present at the time is nowhere to be found either. Almost all the clues point to you.
Chelsea stares at you without saying a word, like a different person from before she entered the interrogation room.
She takes a few more glances at the photos on the table, then giggles and goes back to what she was like before.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Hahaha! Chief, if you think... I'm the reason why he's missing, I'll admit it.
After some inner struggling, Chelsea gives an answer that isn't really an answer.

speaker: Chelsea
content: I really do like you, after all.

options: Do you have anything to do with it or not?

content: Chelsea fiddles with the gems in her hand and squints while her lips curl into an eerie smile.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Have a guess, my dear Chief. There's a reward for getting it right!
The reward. It isn't being your sugar baby or something, is it?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Ah... You're ruining the fun.

speaker: Chelsea
content: No reason. It serves him right.
You don't look like someone who has such a disregard for life.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Some lives can't be measured with gems, of course, but some others are different.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Unfortunately, for most people, their traces in the world can be erased with the right amount of money.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Now, Chief, your life is mine and mine only, of course.

speaker: Chelsea
content: How unromantic, Chief.

speaker: Chelsea
content: But I like it!
You ignore Chelsea and try to continue asking her questions, which makes her even more excited.

speaker: Chelsea
content: My ability got awakened then. They seemed strong, but they were capable of nothing more than yelling. Killing them was a piece of cake.

speaker: Chelsea
content: As for the bodies...
Chelsea pulls off a random strand of hair. A light shines in her hand once more, and the hair turns into a clear and shiny gem.

speaker: Chelsea
content: See. I turned them all into gems just like this.
The Public Security Bureau closed the case as a missing person's case without even seeing the old Count's body? Did they not suspect anything?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Does it matter where the old Count is and who the new one is? Anyone can be in this position with enough money.
Did you bribe them?

speaker: Chelsea
content: I did. This is what money can do. Money can silence literally anyone.
To a spendthrift like Countess Chelsea, bribing to get her way and make connections is probably something she takes for granted. However...

options: So, you want to silence me with your money too?

content: So you're trying to humiliate me by offering to be my sugar mama and give me gems?
Chelsea realizes you're really irritated and panics as she explains nervously.

speaker: Chelsea
content: No, no, no. It's not like that. I-I didn't mean to humiliate you with money. Y-You're different. I just want you to have fun and be happy...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, it's a call from the city council about Countess Chelsea. It seems to be very urgent.
You glance at Chelsea, who scratches her head, seeming unaware of what's going on.

speaker: Councilor
content: Is that the chief of the MBCC?
That's me.

speaker: Councilor
content: I heard that you have Countess Chelsea as your guest at the moment. I'd like to apply for bail for her.
She's a <color=#fb9259>dangerous Sinner</color> detained by the Bureau, and therefore not eligible for bail.

speaker: Councilor
content: A dangerous Sinner? She's a Sinner, but she isn't dangerous. Neither has she done any major crime. She's just had a few sugar babies, that's all. And the amount of bail can be negotiated...
The case is still under investigation. And we believe she has something to do with a case from earlier...

speaker: Councilor
content: Guess I'll have a chat with the higher-ups of FAC!
The councilor's voice raises sharply on the other end of the phone line.

speaker: Councilor
content: Be careful when I do, Chief. There's no knowing how long you'll be able to stay in your position.
Thanks for your concern. I've got to go if there's nothing else. Excuse me.
Chelsea is no longer panicking when you hang up the phone. Instead, she gazes at you with her bright eyes.
Did you make this call happen with your money too, Countess?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Wh-What call?
I don't care about money and power. I take full responsibility for all of MBCC's Sinners. You are not getting away.
Chelsea does not show any contempt or resentment at your words. Instead, she bursts out laughing. There's no trace of dismay on her face, and she even looks really delighted.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Okay, okay. I won't run away. I want to be with you for the rest of my life, after all!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, someone from the city council is here. They're at the door now.
They really waste no time. Looks like the interrogation will have to end here today.
Let's call it a day for now. I'll see you again when we've got more clues.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Sure! I'll be here whenever you need me, Chief.
On the way to the reception room, Nightingale speaks again.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, it seems that the news of the gem Sinner being at the MBCC has gotten out...
Hmm. The wealthy gem Sinner that everyone's after...
Your voices dissipate in the wind. You have a feeling that this won't be over that easily.
A few days have passed since the last interrogation.
Ring—Ring—
You stare at the comms interface, which has barely gone off for the past few days, and give a bitter smile.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief...
Probably another request to release Chelsea on bail. Who's it this time? Some governor or commander?
Chelsea has shown you the power of money indeed. These few days, the Bureau's internal comms system has been overwhelmed with thousands and thousands of messages to you.

For the past few days, the office phone's been ringing nonstop, and the mailbox is overflowing. Contents include everything from "let's discuss the price" to "watch out for your life." They're all asking for one thing: to release Countess Chelsea.
Its scale and number of people are beyond your expectations. You can't imagine how many people are involved in this money web.
At first you plan to ignore them. But you received a note from an FAC special agent yesterday during a mission, on which the words "Release Her" were written with blood.

speaker: Nightingale
content: They're using more and more aggressive means.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm curious to see what they will do for money.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's not my place to interfere with your decision, but the Bureau will be further restricted if this goes on.
Instead of wasting time with this endless stream of people, why not just go to her cell and deal with the root of trouble?
The thought of Chelsea's room gives you a headache. Apart from the locked door, the place has nothing to do with the MBCC now.

At your insistence, Chelsea is still locked up in her room. But the room has been re-painted and renovated, with velvet wallpaper, expensive carpets, and lots of antique furniture decorated with gems. It's like a copy of her room in the Countess' Court.

You've been trying to stop it, but those officials and nobles kept pressuring the Bureau through various connections. There's even a group of Sinners outside Chelsea's room, waiting to see you make a fool of yourself.
Nightingale also suggested that you don't need to bother with such trivial matter like renovations.
So you decided not to even go near it. Out of sight, out of mind. But now, you have to face this luxurious room again, with the greatest factor of uncertainty in it—Countess Chelsea.
Before you even get close to her room, you see a mountain of gifts casually piled up by the door. All the gifts are for Countess Chelsea, and there are too many to fit in the room.
Chelsea faces against the door with her whole body sinking into the fluffy, luxury sofa. She holds a comms in one hand as if she's listening to some message.
You're about to open the door when the message coming from the comms brings you to a halt.

speaker: Unknown male voice
content: Your Excellency, what's a mere Chief to you? All you need is to give an order. I can make him fall from here any minute! If you wish, I also have the ultimate means to shut...
female_content: Your Excellency, what's a mere Chief to you? All you need is to give an order. I can make her fall from here any minute! If you wish, I also have the ultimate means to shut...

content: Before the message finishes playing, there is a crunching noise as the comms is crushed to pieces. Its sharp parts cut Chelsea's hand. The blood, affected by her powers, turns into tiny gems, spilling onto the ground along with the broken pieces.
You can't see the expression on her face, but she is clearly very upset. Is it because of the message? Isn't that what she wants?

options: Open the door and go in

content: The noise prompts Chelsea to turn around swiftly. A gem solidifies in her hand, seeming like it's about to bash at the door.
At hearing your voice, the light in her hand fades in an instant.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Ahem... It's you, Chief. I was just working out.
To ease the awkwardness, she swings her right arm and kicks the comms pieces under the sofa.

speaker: Chelsea
content: What brought you here? Have you decided to be my sugar baby?
I'm more concerned about what's under the sofa. I've received many similar greetings to that message recently.
You simply ignore her question about sugar baby and stare at her in all seriousness.
How are they related to you? Did you tell them to do this?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Chief... Are you suspicious of me? You're such a paranoid.

speaker: Chelsea
content: I have nothing to do with them. As I said, I'm not leaving until you agree to be my sugar baby.
Chelsea locks eyes with you, sitting on the sofa.

options: So what's with that phone call just now?

speaker: Chelsea
content: They're just bootlicking me for my money and gems, but trust me, I didn't accept any of them!

speaker: Chelsea
content: I rejected them outright. I won't let them treat the person I like that way!
Chelsea leans closer to examine your facial expression.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Come on... Why do you still look so sad, Chief?

speaker: Chelsea
content: That's not good! Here, have a drink and leave all your troubles behind!
She takes a bottle from the table on the side, removes the cork, and pours the red liquid into a glass, chuckling as she hands you the glass.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Want some? It's N.F.82 Collection drink! I bought it with three gems a couple of days ago. It's superb. Just one sip will make you forget all your troubles!
You look happy.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Yes—I've got so much money, enough to get all the fun I can have, and I get to see my favorite person every day. If this isn't happiness, what is?

speaker: Chelsea
content: If I ever feel down and unhappy, I spend money—there's always something you can buy that makes you happy—that's what everyone says.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Well... I'm referring to my master and... people who hang out with me. It was like that, and it still is.

speaker: Chelsea
content: I grew up learning jewelry craftsmanship from my master. At first, there was nothing in my life other than my master and the gemstones. People would always smile when I gave them gems, no matter what happened to them.
Some happiness can't be bought with money.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Like what? That hasn't really happened to me. Care to give me an example, Chief?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Not really. I had the chef from the best luxury hotel in Eastside cook for me for a whole day and night. And I had the most famous singer in Eastside sing for me for a whole day.

speaker: Chelsea
content: I asked them if they were tired. They said not at all, and told me to let them know anytime I want their company again.
How much did you pay them?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Hmm? Not much, I guess. I just filled their pockets with gems.
Chelsea seems to think that this kind of contracted relationship equals company, like what she typically does. Looks like you need to convince her from a different perspective.

speaker: Chelsea
content: But do not lose your way... Come. Come to Maria City. Here, you shall find the path to <color=#fb9259>vanquishing evil</color>...
Chelsea makes a big stretch and runs to poke her head through the door to peek at other Sinners.

options: Money can't buy sincerity from the heart

content: Those who experienced sincerity from the heart, they smile when they look back on their memories. And that's something you can't buy with money.

speaker: Chelsea
content: ...You seem to have a point.

speaker: Chelsea
content: But those moments, I can record them! How about that? I'm smart, aren't I?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Speaking of which... My master once hired a famous director in Eastside to film a documentary! One that recorded my growth as a lapidarist! I was the protagonist!
Chelsea gets up from the sofa and finds a disc-like object after rummaging around on the bookshelf.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Oh! This is it! Chief, is there a projector here? Let's get one and watch it together! I remember being very happy back then. I wonder if watching it will make you happy too!
There is one, but...

speaker: Chelsea
content: But what? It's too much trouble?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Not a problem at all. Here, take this gem. Give it to your staff, whoever gets the projector here.
Chelsea is instinctively trying to solve problems with money again.
No, it's not about money. The projector hasn't been used for a while and I'm not sure if it still works.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Oh... I see. Then I'll just give this gem to you, Chief! Let's go get the projector here!
You and Chelsea move the projector into her room. Chelsea inserts the disc into the machine, and the big screen begins to flicker.

speaker: Guest
content: How can I wear this kind of brooch? It looks ridiculous.

speaker: Gemsmith
content: Th-This is the most classic style and craftsmanship...

speaker: Guest
content: Humph. This design is already outdated. And look at this cut mark. It's ruined such a good gem! What a waste. I don't think I'll come back to this shop... Oh? Let me take a look at that brooch.

speaker: Guest
content: Hmm... Fashionable and perfectly-crafted. Your craftsmanship can't be that bad if you could turn such a poor-quality gem into this. Make me another one like this with the best gem.

speaker: Gemsmith
content: Oh, Chelsea! Your craftsmanship is getting so much better! A merchant offered a huge amount of money just to have you cut gems for them!

speaker: Chelsea
content: Is that so... Sure. Coming right up.

speaker: Gemsmith
content: But anyway, a family came to our shop with a cat, which I thought looked very pretty, so I bought it. Why don't you give it a name?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Aww it's so cute! Let's call it... Sitri.
Looks like your documentary is pretty inspiring.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Haha... You flatter me, Chief. I'm almost a bit embarassed.
The scene in the documentary changes abruptly. Chelsea, who seems to realize something, suddenly goes up and turns off the video.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Because the rest of it... isn't important.

speaker: Chelsea
content: After that, my master found me some friends, who took me to the dinner parties only the upper class in Eastside could go. I only had to carve a few gems to get all kinds of exotic treasures and compliments from those friends.

speaker: Chelsea
content: At an auction, I bought a gem. But before I could get my hands on it, I was told that the old Count had taken it and left double the price as compensation.

speaker: Chelsea
content: The old Count was indeed richer. My master and I could never acquire such an extortionate amount of wealth accumulated over several generations in our lifetime.

speaker: Chelsea
content: And later, under my master's recommendation, I was invited by the old Count to work under him, carving gems just for him.

speaker: Chelsea
content: For me, it was just making gems in a different place and with a more stable amount of orders.

speaker: Chelsea
content: But... it also meant that I didn't get to see my master very often. Every time he came to see me was to get me to take him to experience the so-called luxurious life. He didn't even craft gems so much anymore.
He just liked your money.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Perhaps. But I don't think there's anything wrong with that. Everyone I know tells me that you can be happy as long as you have money.
And you think so too?

speaker: Chelsea
content: Yup... It can buy everything, so it's the best thing in the world!

speaker: Chelsea
content: We visited so many places, like the best casinos in Eastside and the best cruises...

speaker: Chelsea
content: I've never seen anything like it before. Those friends I had never took me to luxurious entertainment venues like that.

speaker: Chelsea
content: We made a lot of friends. Every day was a different experience. It was all very exciting.
Has he had enough of it and ready for a life of leisure?

speaker: Chelsea
content: He died.
He died? How?

speaker: Chelsea
content: He was already quite old, and he spent all his time in places like that, having lavish meals.

speaker: Chelsea
content: It's only natural that he died of illness. I understand my master all too well. It's impossible for him to leave this kind of life.
Weren't you sad?

speaker: Chelsea
content: ...To be honest, I didn't feel anything when my master died, and I don't know why. I just thought it was a pity.

speaker: Chelsea
content: I heard that he was still muttering about his jewels to his last breath.

speaker: Chelsea
content: After he died, I took over all the Count's jewel crafting. He paid me more money and sent me checks with larger and larger amounts.

speaker: Chelsea
content: But I knew that he had more money than that. When one has enough money, one can get whatever they want, that is, power.

speaker: Chelsea
content: The old Count's wealth and power are all mine now. What happiness can't I buy?

options: Are you and your sugar babies truly happy?

speaker: Chelsea
content: To be honest, I don't know.

speaker: Chelsea
content: But I guess... Sitri must be very happy.
Humans and cats are probably different.
She avoids your eyes by averting her gaze toward the ceiling, then laughs after a few seconds.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Why don't you try being my sugar baby, Chief? You never know until you try. Then you'll be able to tell me the answer!
The typical bright grin, frivolous words, and heartless looks make the Chelsea who plunged into the memory just now seem like a short-lived blossom.
No, thanks. I'll be happy if those people leave me alone.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Don't worry, Chief! I'll stop them all! If anyone doesn't listen... Hmm, I'm going to show them what they'll get when they upset someone I like.

options: Is this your sweet nothings again?
I'm not going to be tempted.

content: At hearing this, Chelsea shows a swooning face and reaches out to place her hand on your shoulder. You quickly dodge her hands, to which she shrugs in response.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Chief, you just sweep me off my feet. My affection for you grows more and more each day.
I hope you remember what you promised. I gotta go now. Goodbye.
You turn around and leave. Even after a good distance out of Chelsea's room, you can still hear her enthusiastic goodbyes.

Hopefully, she will keep her word and deal with those troubles. You suddenly realize that you haven't checked your mailbox and wonder how many new threatening letters you got today. You should probably have a look.
You come to the mailbox. Just when you're about to open it, a shadow sneaks out behind you, then you pass out after a series of electrical noises...
Alone in the room with the lights off, Chelsea turns on the video recorder again.
In the video are her, Sitri, and her master.

speaker: Gemsmith
content: What? You accidentally burned the snow fox fur? It's okay. Just buy a new one. It's not that expensive. Make sure you finish the Count's order today!

speaker: Chelsea
content: Okay.
After the master leaves, Chelsea sinks into the pile of gems in the room, as if she's zapped of all her energy.
Sitri carefully reaches out its paw and gently touches Chelsea's forehead. When it finds that Chelsea doesn't mind, it rolls its entire body toward her.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Haha... It tickles!

speaker: Chelsea
content: Sitri, are you happy being with me?

speaker: Sitri
content: Meow—
Sitri throws itself into her arms as if it's answering her question.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Yeah...? That's great.

speaker: Chelsea
content: I'm so glad you're happy.
Ring... Ring... Dong...
What's the noise? It sounds like... some rocks clashing together, and someone's talking.
You open your eyes, only to be blinded by the dazzling light, which takes you a while to get used to.
Gems that are fit to be heirlooms of nobles form a beaded curtain, behind which stand some gemstone statues, making the whole room looking extremely luxurious and magnificent.
You aren't tied up, but you seem to have been drugged and don't have any strength. It'll probably take some time before the drug wears off.

speaker: Male Voice
content: You wake up.
Your gaze follows the sound and finds a well-dressed middle-aged man admiring the gemstone statues, who is surrounded by a group of servants in black. This face...
Councilor, why did you kidnap me to this place?

speaker: Councilor
content: Be patient. Our host will be here very soon.
A series of footsteps ring out outside the room. Chelsea enters the room under the "escort" of another group of people.

speaker: Chelsea
content: What did you do to the Chief? And I don't remember giving anyone the key to the underground collection room of the Countess' Court. How did you guys get in?
Chelsea's face is icy and filled with hatred, the same as when she heard the old Count's name in the interrogation room. Despite being taken here by force, she fires a series of questions fearlessly.

speaker: Councilor
content: Come on, Your Excellency, don't be so mad. This is a gift I especially prepared for you.

speaker: Chelsea
content: What gift?

speaker: Councilor
content: Everyone in Eastside knows that the Countess owns mountains of gold and silver passed down from generations, and more gems than she can ever spend. But I also happen to know that the Countess has the ability to turn things into gems.

speaker: Chelsea
content: You want money?

speaker: Councilor
content: Oh, money isn't secure. Unlike gems. Gems are great, I like gems. But of course, what I like better... is the status and influence of the Countess. If Your Excellency is willing to help, basically I'll be able to secure the council's top position.

speaker: Councilor
content: And rest assured, I'll treat you fair after this. I'll give you some of my privileges. I'm sure you know very well—money and power, you can't have one without the other.

speaker: Councilor
content: Here's a gift to show my sincerity, Your Excellency... I heard this person is very stubborn. If it weren't for him, you would've returned to freedom enjoying your life now. You must be very eager to put an end to this yourself, right?
female_content: Here's a gift to show my sincerity, Your Excellency... I heard this person is very stubborn. If it weren't for her, you would've returned to freedom enjoying your life now. You must be very eager to put an end to this yourself, right?

content: Chelsea purses her lips tightly while anger almost bursts out from her eyes as she speaks with gritted teeth.

speaker: Chelsea
content: You have offended me, and I reject your offer. The Chief is very important to me. Don't you dare even lay a finger on him!
female_content: You have offended me, and I reject your offer. The Chief is very important to me. Don't you dare even lay a finger on her!

content: The councilor raises an eyebrow and puts on an eerie smile while maintaining his relaxed manner.

speaker: Councilor
content: Well then, let me propose something else.
As he speaks, he points his chin toward you, then the servant next to you instantly places a dagger in front of your neck.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Chief!

You try to use the shackles, but the servant immediately presses down the dagger, which slits through your neck skin. Blood slowly dribbles down. Seeing this, Chelsea no longer dares to move, glaring at the dagger on your neck, her fists clenching.

speaker: Councilor
content: I'll buy your loyalty with this one's life. What do you think? It's a pretty good deal, right?
At hearing his words, Chelsea's body stiffens as she turns around.
You try to break free and stop Chelsea, but the residual effects of the drug allow you but slight movements, which only deepens the wound on your neck.

speaker: Councilor
content: Come. To our collaboration.
The councilor ignores you and extends his hand to Chelsea, looking very confident, while Chelsea only smiles.
She walks up to him with her head down, grabs his hand—and bursts out laughing.

speaker: Councilor
content: What's so funny?

speaker: Chelsea
content: I'm laughing at you, who has no fear for Sinners.

speaker: Councilor
content: No one will be afraid of a Sinner who can turn stones into gems. Besides, I have a "gift" here to keep you in check, haven't I?

speaker: Councilor
content: You're unlike those barbarians in Syndicate, who only know how to fight and kill.

speaker: Councilor
content: You're a tame cat.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Hahaha... Hahaha... Ah! I can't hold it in anymore! I'm too pleased.
Frenzy shines in her eyes, the kind of shine only from Sinners when they reveal their true nature—dangerous, yet fascinating.

speaker: Councilor
content: Are you pleased with this gift I've got for you?

speaker: Chelsea
content: No, I just think your joke is brilliant. I haven't heard such a funny joke in a long time.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Let me think... The last time I heard a joke like this was when someone wanted to buy my loyalty at the cost of a cat.

speaker: Chelsea
content: That cat was the only thing I could rely on.
Chelsea pauses while the councilor frowns, sensing that something doesn't sound right.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Do you know what happened to that person in the end?
Chelsea's head jerks up, murderous rage pouring out from her like a beast that devours. The councilor tries to withdraw his hand, but it's too late.

speaker: Councilor
content: Wh-What are you doing...!!
From where the hands touch, human skin is quickly replaced by shiny gems.

speaker: Councilor
content: The price... can be... negotiated...
Within the length of a breath, the smug councilor has turned into a gem statue with a distorted face, just like the countless statues around him.
Everyone is stunned by what just happened before them. After a few seconds, a terrified scream shatters the silence. The councilor's men start to flee toward the door in terror.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Heh..heh, I thought you guys like gems? Here, take them!
With Chelsea's laughter, a rain of gems flood out, showering down on everyone in the room. A bloody color begins to spread out in the dazzling golden glow.
The person holding the dagger against you lies on the floor, battered and bloodied on the head. It's hard to tell if he's dead or alive.
You try to use every muscle in your body to protect yourself while rushing up to Chelsea with all your strength.
Waves of sharp pain wash over you to stop you and make you fall.
But you keep on moving. You almost can't feel your arms when you touch Chelsea.

She doesn't seem to notice your coming as her fists remain clenched while her nails pierce into her hands and blood trickles from them. She keeps controlling the gem rain robotically, as if she's unaware of any pain.
You grab Chelsea. The patterns of the shackles spread and illuminate the entire collection room with its red beams, instantly devouring the bright glow of gems.
Chelsea's eyes, awakened by the scorching heat, slowly comes into focus. When your eyes meet hers, you see not only anger, but also immense fear and guilt.
When the shackles are completed, Chelsea sits on her knees like a puppet with broken strings.
Chelsea!
You grab Chelsea. The patterns of the shackles spread and illuminate the entire collection room with its red beams, instantly devouring the bright glow of gems.
Chelsea's eyes, awakened by the scorching heat, slowly comes into focus. When your eyes meet hers, you see not only anger, but also immense fear and guilt.

Chelsea's eyes, awakened by the scorching heat, slowly comes into focus. When your eyes meet hers, you see not only anger, but also immense fear and guilt.
When the shackles are completed, Chelsea sits on her knees like a puppet with broken strings.
Chelsea!
She pants rapidly and gives no reply, while her gaze remains on her clenched fist.
You bend down and hold Chelsea's face in your hands, forcing her to look at you.
Don't be scared. I'm still alive.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Chi... Chief...
Chelsea's trembling voice is mixed with lingering fear and slight whimper.
It's all fine now.

speaker: Chelsea
content: I... I killed them.
...When we get back, you'll need to write a report with me about what happened.

speaker: Chelsea
content: I... stained the gems... They're stained with the blood of the scoundrels.

speaker: Chelsea
content: And I even... dragged you into it. I said I would be your sugar mama and make you happy, yet you got kidnapped and nearly died because of me.

speaker: Chelsea
content: This is happening again... I failed to protect... I'm sorry... Sorry...

speaker: Chelsea
content: There was a kitten called Sitri who would read and play with me and be there for me on those sleepless nights. It was such a warm cat.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Chelsea bought everything with money—Family, friends, happiness. Sitri was the only exception.

speaker: Chelsea
content: But that old Count! He killed Sitri in front of my eyes to make me listen to him. He pulled out its heart and put it in my hand.

speaker: Chelsea
content: For a moment just now... I felt as if my hands were full of Sitri's blood, as if I was holding Sitri's heart... As if its heart was still beating.

speaker: Chelsea
content: It's my fault. It's my fault... that I couldn't protect it.
Chelsea opens her hands, on which is the blood trace where her nails just pierced.
Tears stream down her face, and you can feel every cell in her body screaming and wailing.
But you protected me with your gems. If it weren't for you, I would probably be dead by now.
Chelsea's hand is as cold as gems.
No, it's not you and the gems that are dirty. It's the malicious scoundrels. The gems are beautiful, and so are you.
But even the coldest gem will gradually be warmed up by the warmth of another pair of hands.
Thank you, Chelsea.
Chelsea's eyes light up like bright, shining gems.

speaker: Chelsea
content: So... Can I still be your sugar mama, Chief?
...You're in the mood to joke around now?

speaker: Chelsea
content: I'm being serious! I really do want to be your sugar mama. I'll give you my gems! And this castle!
I prefer having a companion I can trust to those gems and castles.
Let's fight together and entrust our lives to each other. Isn't this a companionship a million times better than having sugar babies?
Let's go. We've got to report back to the Bureau and get someone to take care of the rest. The Bureau must be in a real mess.
Chelsea, pondering, does as you say, and you return to the MBCC together.
A few days later...
After your returning from the Countess' Court, the MBCC has been unsettled with many secretly unhappy with Chelsea, yet not a single person has said anything.
As for why... you lift your head to take a look at the Chief's office, which is much more luxurious than before. Even the drinking water has been replaced with the most expensive brand.
There's only one answer—money.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Chief! Did anyone bother you today? I've got it all taken care of.

speaker: Chelsea
content: By the way, after a few days of thinking, it has finally dawned on me.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Being your sugar mama doesn't contradict fighting along with you! So...

speaker: Chelsea
content: Come on, Chief, at least give it some more thought!

speaker: Chelsea
content: I'll buy you nice things, and I'll tell you stories too!
Chelsea still doesn't want to give up asking you to be her sugar baby. You let out a long sigh and give her a resigned look. Never mind. Just let her be and call it even.
I still have to work. Please be quiet.
Chelsea's voice trailed off.

speaker: Chelsea
content: Once upon a time, there was a gem princess in the forest. She had a great companion who fought alongside her...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Got a call for you, Chief.
Nightingale passes the receiver to you. It's a call from Serpent Eye, a renowned private military company regularly hired by Eastside's upper class and highly reputed within the industry.

speaker: Man's Voice
content: My name is Alyosha. I'm in charge of Serpent Eye.
A man's voice comes through the phone. It sounds old, low, and slightly accented.
The same man phoned MBCC's office a few minutes ago, refused to reveal any information to anyone, not even to Nightingale, and demanded to speak with you—the Chief of MBCC—directly.
Hello, this is the Chief of MBCC. May I know your purpose of calling?

speaker: Alyosha
content: I need to requisition someone.
Requisition a Sinner?
For what purpose?

speaker: Alyosha
content: Deputy Speaker Reagan is going on a tour soon. He's appointed Cinnabar as his bodyguard.
With all due respect, requisitioning a Sinner to protect an official is not exactly a sensible request. In terms of both ability and emotion, Sinners are highly unstable...

speaker: Alyosha
content: Cinnabar is different!

speaker: Alyosha
content: ...Cinnabar is an elite in the industry. It's Mr. Reagan's very idea to requisition her.

speaker: Alyosha
content: The requisition document will reach you soon.
A disconnect tone from the receiver. Alyosha has hung up.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: I'm ready. You may interrogate me whenever you want.

Cinnabar initiates the conversation in the interrogation room. With no display of aggression, she's simply sitting there, straight-backed and with a sincere look on her face, looking like a friend who's ready to listen to your rant.

Except that she's not your friend. This subject named Cinnabar has had strict military training and is pretty famous among the mercenary and security industries. Her mild exterior could be nothing more than a disguise.

options: I need to learn about your past.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Are you referring to the crimes I've committed?
Not entirely. I'd like you to tell me more about yourself.
Cinnabar snickers, probably unconvinced by your pretext.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Sure. Where should we start?
Cinnabar's friendly attitude makes you feel at ease. You pick up the first document on the desk.

test
test
test
test
test

From the 100% assignment completion during her early mercenary days, to the later zero on-duty casualty rate as a security consultant for Eastside's City Council, Cinnabar's entire career has been impeccably successful. Her résumé is too perfect to pique anyone's interest in discussing it.
You flip through the pages for a few minutes and finally spot an intriguing talking point.
On February 14th, N.F. 106, you single-handedly rescued Councilor Pend's daughter from a dozen of kidnappers?
Cinnabar considers it briefly.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Do you mean Miss Hilda?

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Indeed, I took part in her rescue, but I didn't do it all by myself. My teammates at Serpent Eye supported me with crucial intelligence.
You take another glance at the document. Here comes the best part of the case.
The incident received long-lasting attention from Eastside's media. I assume you also got your fifteen minutes of fame through all this?

speaker: Cinnabar
content: For people in my line of work, it's not considered a bad thing to be known for your work performance.
But the report says you're well-known mainly because... Miss Pend confessed her love for you on TV?
Cinnabar flushes instantly.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: I... Ugh, Miss Hilda probably mistook me for a man. I clarified that with her afterward...
Is it? Earlier, when you were taken in by MBCC, she even wrote us a protest letter demanding your immediate release.
Besides, it seems that among those in high places in Eastside, quite a few young ladies have a thing for you.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: All I can say is that... I'm grateful for their kindness. But... regretfully, I don't hold affections of this sort for my clients. I find that irresponsible and unprofessional.
Cinnabar's reaction is amusing. But enough of awkward talks. Time is running out, and you still need to pry more information out of her.

options: Ask about the incident two years ago

content: It seems that up until two years ago, you'd been much appreciated by Eastside's powerful and rich.
As the new subject is brought up, Cinnabar, who has been a little flustered just now, quickly collects herself.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: I'm truly grateful to my clients who trusted me fully, but protecting them was only my duty, regardless of their appreciation for me.
Cinnabar's response is intriguing. Whatever happened two years ago should be no simple matter.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test

The document describes a riot that erupted on Pasture Block in Syndicate two years ago. Neither the cause nor the outcome of the riot is clearly elaborated, and the only detailed part of the record suggests that "a security consultant was absent without leave when escorting the delegation from Eastside, and was subsequently wanted for turning into a Sinner."
Reading the document you've passed to her, Cinnabar gives a wry smile.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Is that how they interpreted the situation...
You were hired by the City Council, but went AWOL at the critical moment. That was out of character for you. What was your defense?

speaker: Cinnabar
content: I didn't have any. It happened as recorded in the report. I deserted my unit alone and left the delegation to my teammates at Serpent Eye.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: After that, I became a Sinner... I won't deny having committed those crimes—but I also do not regret committing them.
Dismissed from all job duties and wanted by the authorities for one single incidence of AWOL, the bigwigs of Eastside had no mercy on you at all, did they?

speaker: Cinnabar
content: That's not true. I indeed betrayed the trust of my clients, leaving them to my teammates at Serpent Eye.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: During my desertion, I was infected with the Mania. But even so, I tried to return to the City Council's station, causing a panic... That really shouldn't have been the behavior of a professional.
Cinnabar's response does not offer any explanations for her initial motive.
Could you tell me the reason why you deserted the unit?

speaker: Cinnabar
content: ...It was a gang war. Gang members intruded on a civilian block.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: I'd seen their brutal way. The low-ranking gangsters would not spare a target just because it was a woman or child...

speaker: Cinnabar
content: I couldn't just leave the civilians like that.
Cinnabar pauses, then continues.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Their target wasn't the delegation, and a small gang of thugs wouldn't have posed a real threat anyway. That was why I judged that it was safe to leave the delegation to my colleagues.
Cinnabar gives a gratified smile.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: I saved quite a few people.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: It hadn't been without incident, but what happened didn't change the outcome. What mattered the most was that they all survived.
In exchange, you became a Sinner, lost your job, and were wanted by the City Council...

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Given another chance, I would still make the same choice.
Cinnabar's description does not contradict the facts you know. It also explains why the City Council's document conceals what happened before the misfeasance.
Looking back, the City Council most likely wanted to make an example of her. Now that the controversy has died down, it makes sense to want to put Cinnabar back to work.

options: You still have a chance to go back.

content: Your ability is undeniable. They shouldn't have let you go like that.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Some things cannot be undone.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Even if the City Council is willing to turn a blind eye to my past, my teammates... my colleagues at Serpent Eye will never forgive me.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Serpent Eye suffered a huge loss for my action. Whether I did it to protect the civilians or for whatever other reason, betrayal is betrayal.
Cinnabar casts her gaze aside. Her eyes are dark.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: One cannot handle this job alone. Yet, I let down my comrades who trusted me with their lives...
She is wrong. Serpent Eye has not turned its back on her.
Earlier today, I received a call from a man named Alyosha.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: Alyosha?!
Cinnabar's eyes light up, even her body is beginning to lean forward.
He claimed to work for Serpent Eye. Do you know him?

speaker: Cinnabar
content: He is one of the founders of Serpent Eye, as well as the captain. How... is he doing? Is everything alright at Serpent Eye?
You haven't been in touch for long?

speaker: Cinnabar
content: No...
Serpent Eye is still the security company to serve the City Council and Eastside's bigwigs. Alyosha sounded well too.

speaker: Cinnabar
content: I see...
He's made a pretty unreasonable request, concerning you.
Cinnabar blinks, confused.
He wants me to let you out, so you can take care of a mission.
