speaker: Uni
content: I do. They were my clients. I met them only once or twice. But I haven't seen them since their cosmetic procedures.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The thing is, according to the witnesses, they were last seen on the day they went to your clinic. It seems that you were the last person they saw before they went missing.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where are they now?
You scrutinize her face, trying to pick up clues from her facial expressions.

speaker: Uni
content: How should I know? I'm a cosmetic surgeon, not a brain surgeon. If I had the ability to control their brains—if they had ones, that is, I would've asked them to give me more money, instead of making them disappear.

speaker: Uni
content: I hope you're not accusing me of doing something unsavory during the procedures to make them disappear.

speaker: Uni
content: Well, you know, I had no reason to do that to them. We were basically strangers. Our relationship was purely business.

speaker: Uni
content: Unlike you, Chief, I don't have the means to make humans disappear without a trace. I'm just a humble cosmetic surgeon.

You reach out your hand. The shackles, glowing bright red, run out of your hand and latch onto Uni's wrist. As they make to reach deeper, they collide with another object, which gives out intense purple light upon impart.
The shackles bounce back. You almost lose balance. When you regain your footing, you look up and see Uni's strained face.

speaker: Uni
content: So those are the fabled shackles.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The shackles only work on Sinners. An ordinary cosmetic surgeon might not be able to make humans disappear without anyone being any the wiser, but a Sinner can. And you are a Sinner.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now tell me the truth. I'd hate to resort to any special means again in this interrogation.

speaker: Uni
content: Shackles, the good old shackles, the weapon of the powerful against us Sinners.

speaker: Uni
content: (Sighs)
Uni's demeanor relaxes. She turns her gaze away from your face to a corner of the room. She seems to have lost all interest in you. What has brought about the change, you have no idea.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I beg your pardon?

speaker: Uni
content: I thought you'd be different. It turns out you're just like the rest of them.

speaker: Uni
content: You went to great lengths to track me down and bring me here to interrogate. But this is all just a charade, isn't it? You're gonna detain me no matter how this interrogation turns out. Simply because I'm a Sinner.

speaker: Uni
content: The moment we Sinners set foot in DisCity, we automatically become names on the most wanted list, and more often than not, we'll have some wrongdoing pinned on us.

speaker: Uni
content: In your eyes, we are all criminals that should be put away. It doesn't matter which crime should be pinned on which Sinner, as long as it's a Sinner.

options: That's not what I'm doing here.
I have no intention of wronging you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It's my duty to track down Sinners. But I don't want to wrong anyone or accuse them of crimes they never committed.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm just trying to get to the bottom of this case and find the missing persons, and get to know you as well.
The room falls silent. Uni turns to you.

speaker: Uni
content: You want to know me?

speaker: Uni
content: What are you, some kind of defender of justice?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: No, I'm not. It's just my principles.
Uni covers the lower half of her face with her gloved hand. It's only seconds later that you pick up the scornful look on her face.

speaker: Uni
content: Principles. Hahaha... That's interesting.

speaker: Uni
content: Chief, are you familiar with the story about a duckling who wants to become a swan?

speaker: Uni
content: <size=30>Once upon a time, there was an ugly duckling who didn't fit in with the rest of the world. Time and again, she came to the edge of a lake to look at her reflection, hoping against hope that her feathers had grown thicker. Time and again, she was disappointed. She remained an ugly duckling.</size>

speaker: Uni
content: One day, the duckling saw a flock of swans flying past. She had never seen a creature so beautiful, so glamorous. It was at that moment that she decided that she didn't want to be a duckling anymore. She wanted to be an elegant swan.
As Uni tells the story, she conjures up blinking fragments of crystal above her fingertip, and manipulates them into different shapes to illustrate the story.

speaker: Uni
content: She tried everything she could to become a swan but to no avail. To make matters worse, her feathers, once soft and clean, were now covered with grease.

speaker: Uni
content: Eventually, she gave up her dream of becoming a swan. Exhausted and crestfallen, she returned to the edge of the lake.

speaker: Uni
content: She looked at her reflection. To her surprise, the duckling looking back at her wasn't dirty at all.

speaker: Uni
content: She thought to herself, "Why didn't I think of this sooner? All I have to do is wash the grease off."

speaker: Uni
content: Ecstatic, she dived into the lake in an attempt to wash off the grease, to become herself again...
A crystal duckling takes form above her fingertip and dives onto the tabletop. It vanishes on impact with a burst of light.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What happened next?

speaker: Uni
content: Well...

speaker: Uni
content: The duckling drowned, because she couldn't stay afloat, since her feathers were no longer waterproof due to the grease.

speaker: Uni
content: Let me ask you a question, Chief. What do you think was the culprit for the duckling's death, the grease that had accumulated in her feathers in her pursuit of beauty, or her greed for beauty?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Are you implying that the missing persons had it coming?
Uni gives a chuckle and raises her index finger. Light pools above the fingertip, and a round mirror decorated with symmetrical carvings materializes.

speaker: Uni
content: You said you wanted to know me. Here's your chance. I'm showing you my power.

speaker: Uni
content: My mirror reveals the deepest desire of whoever looks into it, no matter how expertly they have hidden it out of sight.
You sense no hostility coming from the other end of the shackles. It should be safe to look in the mirror. Still, you have misgivings.

speaker: Uni
content: You have the shackles, and there are so many cameras here. So you can just relax. I'm not gonna try to hurt you.

speaker: Uni
content: It's normal to be scared of Mania. But do you know what's more scary?

speaker: Uni
content: Desires! Unsatisfied desires hidden deep inside every soul!
She runs her finger around the curved edge of the mirror frame in an intimate manner, just like her gaze at you right now.

speaker: Uni
content: Come, take a look. Maybe you'll find your missing persons in it.

speaker: Uni
content: Your missing persons looked in the mirror and saw their desires. You don't think there could be a clue or two in there for you?

speaker: Uni
content: The DisCity's sun doesn't shine in this interrogation room, Chief. You'll have to prove yourself worthy of those clues first.
She spins the mirror slowly around to face you.

speaker: Uni
content: Shall we, Chief?
The shackles tremble when you're about to come face to face with the mirror, which, without doubt, has been tainted with Mania.
But nothing out of the ordinary happens.
All you see in the mirror is your own reflection.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do people normally see in this mirror?

speaker: Uni
content: A version of themselves that they desire to see. It's a reflection of their deepest desire, their deepest secret. They see the face they long for. And then I'll come in and make that face a reality.

speaker: Uni
content: So do you like what you see?

Uni can't see what you're seeing in the mirror, yet her eyes growing more intense. When her fingers travel from the frame to the surface of the mirror, you have a strange feeling that it's your actual face that she's stroking.
Her uncomfortably intense gaze is filled with eager anticipation. What's she expecting?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry to disappoint you, but I only see my own reflection.
Almost instantly, all false expressions disappear from Uni's face. She watches your expression with unblinking eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Is there something wrong?

speaker: Uni
content: I found it...

speaker: Uni
content: A blank canvas. I've been right all along. You are the missing piece of my puzzle!
Uni's voice rises. A ripple breaks the smooth surface of the mirror, and the air in the room thickens, making it harder to breathe.
The shackles shake. Uni wraps her hands around the mirror frame, holding it so tightly that her fingertips go white. Her eyes bore into yours, and your eyes burn. Is this her power?!
The red shackles cut through the thick air, shatter the mirror, and confine Uni to her chair.
The scattered shards of glass reflect countless red stars, shining brightly in the dark room. For a moment, you catch sight of Uni's eyes through all the shards, greedy and covetous.

speaker: Uni
content: Hahaha...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What did you do?!

speaker: Uni
content: It's just my attempt to see how much superior you are to me, Honorable Leader versus Devious Trickster. Or you can think of it as a tentative attack.
Attack? Was that really an attack? It might have been, judging by your painful eyes and the bizarre way she was looking at you before her attack. She might be planning something.
A knock at the door interrupts your train of thought. Nightingale walks into the room, with a grim look on her face.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, a councilor is asking to speak with you, right now. It's about Uni the Sinner.
Nightingale shoots a glance at Uni, who responds with a smile.

speaker: Uni
content: Can't stand the thought of leaving me? It's okay. We'll meet again very soon.
MBCC Chief's Office

speaker: Councilor
content: I wish I could, but my hands are tied.

speaker: Councilor
content: Uni is irreplaceable. Her magic hands are a star-maker. And, as you must know, superstars attract investments and generate revenues!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You mean generate revenues for you?

speaker: Councilor
content: Besides... think about our current situation. You're not just here to catch up with me, are you? Someone ordered you to find Carl's killer. Oh, and to apprehend the mastermind behind those three cases.

speaker: Councilor
content: <size=30>I'm hosting a function tonight. A lot of Eastside heavyweights are gonna be there. Come along and bring Uni with you. I'll introduce you to some of the guests. You have Sinners, and they have money; maybe you'll be able to get an investment deal or two out of them.</size>

speaker: Councilor
content: That's settled then. See you tonight.
The councilor hung up, before you could have a chance to turn down the invitation.

speaker: Nightingale
content: What do we do now, Chief?

options: I'll keep an eye on Uni myself.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I see. And there's something else I want to tell you. While you were interrogating Uni, I found something that may be of interest to you.
Nightingale withdraws a photo from her file folder and hands it to you.
It's a photo of a young woman. She is smiling so brightly that for a second you fail to notice the uncanny resemblance between her and Uni.
Her name is Luna, Uni's twin sister. She went missing three years ago, but unlike the other missing persons, she never visited Uni's clinic.

<size=31>Luna worked as a model after she came of age. After she went missing, Uni, who was a student then, basically kept to herself, until two years ago, when she reappeared as a cosmetic surgeon. It was around this time that reports of missing persons started cropping up.</size>
Due to the long time gap, no connection was made between the two incidents in the initial documents. But are these two incidents really not connected?
And there's one more thing that's bothering you.
The moment when the shackles broke the mirror, you saw mirror fragments in the air angled towards Uni.
Yet in those broken pieces, her reflection was nowhere to be seen.

You and Uni are at the function organized by the councilor. Violin music in the background, whiffs of perfume in the air, drinks in pretentious hands... Decadence is the word that pops into your head as you take in the surroundings.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: "Legendary Cosmetic Surgeon, Scarless and Painless, No Hospital Stay Necessary! Beauty is only one call away. For more information..."

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What a load of nonsense.

There is a legion of sketchy websites in DisCity's cyberspace. They mix fact with fiction. But if you're discerning enough, they can be a good source of information, a window to the dark side of the city.
The moment you saw the title Legendary Cosmetic Surgeon, you thought of Uni, the eccentric woman who is the very reason why you're at this boring function.

Uni's interrogation was brought to an abrupt end by the councilor's interference, before you could establish if there is a connection between Uni and the missing persons. And you're still trying to figure out why Uni attacked you.
You're facing a messy situation and having trouble untangling it.
You're now standing next to the culprit who has caused all this confusion.

speaker: Uni
content: Check them out, looking all fancy.
You and Uni are far away from the center of activity, in a corner where the dessert table stands. Two neat rows of plates are all empty, obviously thanks to the Sinner standing at your side.
You turn off the terminal and pocket it. Uni has just finished up the last bit of the dessert in her hand.

speaker: Uni
content: The desserts, like the guests, look good on the outside but have no taste whatsoever.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You would sound more convincing if you weren't gulping them down as if they're going out of style.

speaker: Uni
content: You don't believe me? One o'clock. Do you know how they describe him? They call him "an Adonis as beautiful as a picture."
You see a handsome young man talking to a kind-looking old lady at the cold food table.
She taps on the screen of her terminal and calls up a photo of a plain-looking man with heavy features.

speaker: Uni
content: This is what he used to look like.
There is a world of difference in appearance between the man on the screen and the handsome young man, though you can see traces that point to the two being the same person.

speaker: Uni
content: Do you know what he says when asked why he looks so different from before?
Uni taps her jaw with her index finger.

speaker: Uni
content: He says, "I had my wisdom tooth pulled out."

speaker: Uni
content: And the old man and the man standing in that corner with a drink, do you know who they are?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sorry, I'm not very familiar with the Eastside entertainment industry.

speaker: Uni
content: Ah, you're being modest. Quite a few of the MBCC Sinners are big players in show business.

speaker: Uni
content: <size=30>Anyway, it's not just actors and actresses who need my services. Among my clientele are politicians who want to look more relatable, businessmen who want to look more professional, you name it. I'll never go out of business, as long as human beings stay superficial and greedy.</size>

speaker: Uni
content: Both of their faces are my work. They had a ton of requests. Quite a headache, to be honest.
Uni gives a snort, picks up a cookie from a colorful pile on the table, and takes a bite. She frowns.

speaker: Uni
content: What's this? It tastes like plastic.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Sugar-free macarons, I heard.

speaker: Uni
content: Sugar-free macarons? Ugh! Even worse than those diet drinks. These things look good. But they're all about the appearance, not the content.

speaker: Uni
content: Beautiful on the outside, rotten on the inside.
She crumbles the macaron in her hand.

speaker: Uni
content: All they care about is what's on the outside, just like those who come to me for a new face. All they want is a shiny layer of beautiful skin for the world to see.

speaker: Uni
content: What they want is what I give them. For a reasonable price, I can help them get rid of the things they don't like about their faces.

speaker: Uni
content: I do excellent jobs, and I do them fast. They couldn't be happier with my services.

options: They never suspected that you're a Sinner?

speaker: Uni
content: They wouldn't have cared even if they did.

speaker: Uni
content: Looks are everything in their world. A flawless face is the key to success.

speaker: Uni
content: Their desire to own a beautiful face turns them into risk-takers, and makes them willing to put aside their fear of Mania for a while.

speaker: Uni
content: More than Mania, it's the prospect of being forgotten by this city that fills them with dread.

speaker: Uni
content: It's pointless to try to drag one out of the mire of greed if they don't want to get out. It's like...
As you listen to Uni disparaging the guests, you think back to the recent interrogation.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What do you see when you look into that mirror of yours?

speaker: Uni
content: What a nonsensical question. It's a mirror. I see my reflection when I look in the mirror, just like everybody else.

speaker: Uni
content: It's... me. Who else could it be?
Your conversation with Uni amid the din of the crowd is then interrupted by a booming voice.

speaker: Councilor
content: Well, look who's here! It's our Dr. Genius, the star-maker of DisCity! Don't hide in the corner. You're the guest of honor. Let's go over there.

speaker: Uni
content: I'll pass. Too crowded.
The councilor takes no offense at Uni's refusal, laughing wholeheartedly.

speaker: Councilor
content: And this is?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm a friend of Dr. Uni's.
There is an amused expression on Uni's face. She opens her mouth to say something but catches herself.
The councilor takes a closer look at you. His expression changes as something dawns on him. He pats you on the shoulder knowingly.

speaker: Councilor
content: The arrangement regarding our cuts still stands. Now, let's enjoy ourselves and drink to our hearts' content.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I have you to thank for that.

speaker: Councilor
content: It's Uni, the legendary doctor, that you should thank. Look around. All of these guests are big players in DisCity. But most of them wouldn't have had a chance to be here if it weren't for Uni.
The councilor swings his hand, almost spilling his drink. Then he remarks on the people who Uni has just derided, only from a different angle.

speaker: Councilor
content: These are not one-time clients. If we can maintain good relationships with them, we'll be able to make...
The tipsy man mimes a number with his fingers.

speaker: Councilor
content: At least this much every year.

speaker: Councilor
content: Hahaha... Don't get stressed out just yet. Tonight is all about making friends. One can't get around in this world without friends, right?
"We're friends. Introduce cash cows to me in the future," his smiley face seems to say.
You then notice a beautiful young woman behind the councilor. She's looking at Uni with curiosity and admiration.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: This is...?

speaker: Councilor
content: Oh, I almost forgot. This is one of our new recruits. She's been with us for a while now, but her career still hasn't really taken off. So I took her along to meet some friends of mine.

speaker: Councilor
content: Another superstar in the making, I'm sure, once Uni gets a hand in the project.
You notice that the young woman's eyes are filled with longing as she listens to the councilor's speech.
You turn your head, hoping to get Uni involved in the conversation, only to find that she has retreated to a quieter corner, having taken the remaining snacks on the table with her.
You feel like you're stuck between a rock and a hard place. On your left is the councilor, who is babbling away about nothing in particular; on your right is Uni, who is silently enjoying her snacks.

speaker: Councilor
content: No time like the present. Let's get the surgery done tonight.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Huh?
A chance to untangle the mess has presented itself.
Cosmetic surgeon, Clinic, Cosmetic surgery, Missing persons.
You need a lead to untangle the mess, and a step-by-step plan to get to the truth.
After the function, the councilor left for another social engagement. Before he left, he entrusted the young woman to you and Uni. The three of you are heading for Uni's clinic.

speaker: Uni
content: You're not gonna stop me?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I want to see it for myself, instead of waiting around and doing nothing.

speaker: Uni
content: Aren't you worried that I might do something unscrupulous during the surgery?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm confident that I can stop you before you do anything fishy.

speaker: Maiden
content: Dr. Uni, which parts of my face do you think need changing? The shape of my lips is all right, but I don't like my nose very much.
The young woman speaks as if she is deciding what desserts she should pick for her tea party.

speaker: Maiden
content: What do you think, sir? You're a director, right?
female_content: What do you think, miss? You're a director, right?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Director? Me?

speaker: Maiden
content: Well, you're Dr. Uni's friend, and the councilor treated you with great respect at the function. So I figure you must be a director who has worked with the two of them.

speaker: Maiden
content: So what do you think? Does this face suit me?
You try to picture the face she wants, a face that is an amalgam of features taken from different persons. It looks stiff, unnatural, and even slightly eerie.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I think you're beautiful. You don't need surgery.

speaker: Maiden
content: Well, being beautiful is not enough. My face has gone out of fashion. I won't make it in show business with my current face.
She pauses for a moment, then resumes in a small voice.

speaker: Maiden
content: I have an audition tomorrow. The movie is likely to be nominated for next year's DisCars. That's why the councilor insisted I have the surgery today.

speaker: Maiden
content: I did some research and found out the type of face this director likes in his actresses. If I have my face changed accordingly, I'll get the role and become more popular than those looking down their noses at me.

options: I like the way you look now better.

content: Your remark gives her pause. Then without warning, she bursts out laughing. And that marks the end of your conversation with her.
The car pulls up before the clinic. It's time to execute your plan.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Uni, I just got a message from Nightingale asking for photos of your operating room. It's urgent. Could you go in first and take some photos?

speaker: Uni
content: Me? Taking photos? You MBCC guys are useless.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Not useless, just a minor slip. I gotta give Nightingale a call. You go in first.

speaker: Uni
content: Fine... I'll let you know when I've got the photos.
Suspecting nothing, Uni walks toward the clinic while murmuring complaints.
You take out your terminal, and take a look at the screen, then at the young woman. You let out an audible sigh.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: (Sighs) What a shame.

speaker: Maiden
content: What?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I just got a call from a director friend. She's planning a new movie. She said she's looking for a female lead who is beautiful but doesn't quite conform to today's beauty standards. She asked me to keep an eye out for suitable candidates.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I think you have just the right face. But you won't have it anymore after the surgery. That's why I said it's a shame.

speaker: Maiden
content: What? Who are you talking about? A famous director recently wanting actress... Ah! You're not talking about...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Yes, I'm talking about her. You know how well-received her work is. I bet this new movie of hers is gonna win her multiple DisCars next year. It's a shame that you're not available to play a role in it.

speaker: Maiden
content: Available, I'm available!

You gave the elated young woman a number and a address of the "famous director". She, after giving you her business card and insisting you call her up if another acting opportunity comes up, got out of the car, waved down a cab, and left.
As you look at the receding car, you can't help but heave a sigh of relief. You don't want to drag anyone into whatever is going to happen in Uni's clinic.
Now it's time to execute the second step of your plan: investigate the clinic.
The clinic is spotless. There's no surgical instrument or operating table in sight. You see innumerable mirrors on the walls, each reflecting the room hundreds of times over.
All of the mirrors, you discover when you come closer, are cracked.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Uni...
You call out Uni's name, before going on to explore this clinic, feeling slightly uneasy.
No response.
In the silence, only the hum of an exhaust fan can be heard.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where are you, Uni?
Still no response.
You sense through the shackles that there's a Sinner in the vicinity. You decide to explore the room further before she comes back.
You approach the dark-colored curtains.
When you draw back the curtains, you're greeted by a pair of eyes.
A familiar pair of eyes, one that you've seen thousands of times in the mirror.
They startle you, but you quickly calm down when you realize you're only looking at a portrait of a face on a wall.
Portrait may be the wrong word. The face on the wall is more like a jigsaw puzzle, made of pieces cut from different headshots. On the table under it are the incomplete headshots.
You pick them up. Your stomach churns as you go through them.
You recognize the faces. They belong to the missing celebrities. You had gone through the documents on these celebrities many times before you interrogated Uni.
The last photo is of you, only without the part where your eyes should've been, which has gone on the wall. It takes you aback.

speaker: Uni
content: It's just my attempt to see how much superior you are to me, Honorable Leader versus Devious Trickster. Or you can think of it as a tentative attack.
She wasn't lying. Your suspicion has been confirmed; Uni is planning something. But what's her endgame?
You take a deep breath, put down the photos, and step back to better examine the face on the wall.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Could this be...

speaker: Uni
content: Looks like you've discovered my secret.
You hear Uni's voice from behind, but before you can turn around, a pair of ice-cold hands grab you by the throat. And the air in the room trembles when she activates her power.
She tightens her grip. As you stare at the face on the wall, you grow certain that it's Uni's.

options: Uni, is that you on the wall?

speaker: Uni
content: No. Try again. You're intelligent. You'll guess it.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Stop this! Don't make the same mistake again.

speaker: Uni
content: Like I told you, greed can turn people into risk-takers.

speaker: Uni
content: You once asked me what I desire.
You feel her chilly breath on the nape of your neck. Riveted to the spot, you can only stare at the mirror before you. In it, you see only your reflection, not Uni's.
But you can sense that she is looking greedily into your eyes in the mirror as she traces a finger around their contours.

speaker: Uni
content: I desire your eyes.

speaker: Uni
content: <size=31>The mirror image of the duckling sleeps on the other side of the lake, and the only way to bring it out is to get all the puzzle pieces together... Your eyes are the last piece of my puzzle. Once I complete it, I can bring my mirror image back.</size>

speaker: Uni
content: I've desired them since the moment I spotted them at the DisCars ceremony. They look just like hers.

speaker: Uni
content: Our moment has finally come, Luna.

You sense a menacing energy coming from the other end of the shackles, so you activate the shackles, right at the same time when Uni activates her power. The mirror shatters. Everything goes black, and you slip into unconsciousness.
You're falling, falling, falling... You stop falling and wake up with a start, only to find yourself in a strange room.
The sun slants through the barred window and bathes the two rows of iron beds. The once-white blankets have yellowed, a testament to long years of use.
You come to stand before the mirror, the only object that adorns an otherwise bare wall, and see a little girl looking back at you.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Hmm...

You take a closer look at the reflection. Is it Young Uni? The girl in the mirror is wearing clothes that are studded with patches. The label on her collar has frayed and faded, but you still can make out the word Orphanage.
You can sense the presence of the shackles and a Sinner's power. Is this Uni's power, trapping people in a mirror world?
As you ponder, you hear hurried footsteps approaching. You turn around.
A girl charges into the room and smashes against your chest with such an impact that you stagger back a few steps, feeling a dull pain in your chest.
The girl thrusts her fist up close to your face. You flinch, almost as a reflex action.
The little girl looks up at you. There is a sullenness in her eyes which reminds you strongly of Adult Uni.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Uni?

You see your reflection in her eyes. The two faces—your face as reflected in her eyes and Young Uni's, are identical. You realize what Uni actually sees in front of her is her missing twin sister, whose face she is trying to recover.
You decide not to use the shackles to break out of Uni's mirror world, thinking that this is a chance to discover what happened in her past and understand her obsession with human faces.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: What's in your hand?
Uni shows you her hand. Sitting in her palm are two pieces of candy, their cellophane wrappers reflecting the bright sunlight.

speaker: Young Uni
content: I did it! I solved the most difficult question in class.
Young Uni puts one piece in your palm and starts a stream of abuse directed at her classmates.

speaker: Young Uni
content: You should've seen the faces of those idiots. It cracks me up to picture their stupid faces. They cheated on the test and were caught red-handed by the teacher, and they had the nerve to blame it on me. The teacher saw through it, of course. They have balloons for heads, all air, no substance. All they could do was yelp behind me like mean puppies.
As you listen to Young Uni babbling on, you find her quite adorable, unlike Adult Uni, who seems able to chill one to the bone with the coldness in her eyes.
What happened to her that would one day turn her into a mad cosmetic surgeon obsessed with human faces?

speaker: Young Uni
content: Two candies. One for you, one for me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why don't you keep them both? They are your prize.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Why don't you keep them both? I know you have a sweet tooth.

speaker: Young Uni
content: No!

speaker: Young Uni
content: You have one, and I have one! We're twins. You're my reflection, and I'm yours, like you always say. If I had two and you had zero, there would be no symmetry.

speaker: Young Uni
content: You're not thinking about leaving me, are you?
Young Uni's voice rattles your eardrums. The mirror world, reflecting her emotions, starts shaking.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course not. I will never leave you.
The room stops shaking.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Did you forget that we can communicate without words, that one can know what the other is thinking just by looking at their face?
The words are rolling off your tongue of their own accord.
Are they words that Luna once said to Uni? Or words that Uni wants to hear?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Now look at me. Do I look like I'm gonna leave you?

speaker: Young Uni
content: No. You're smiling inside, you're happy; I can feel it. Only you understand me.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Give me a smile, Uni. Like this...
Her lips twitch into an awkward smile. She looks confused at the amused look on your face. You ruffle her hair affectionately and hug her tightly.
Ha! Found you!
The door has been kicked open. Three kids have waltzed into the room, with a uniformed old woman bringing up the rear.
Young Uni wriggles free from your embrace and plants herself in front of you with a fierce look on her face.

speaker: Chubby Kid
content: This is the girl, ma'am! She cheated on the test today and took away the candies the teacher gave us as an award.

speaker: Young Uni
content: The teacher gave them to me. I was the one who solved that difficult question, not you!

speaker: Little Girl
content: She played the good kid i-i-in front of the teacher. She framed us. She's a b-b-bad kid. She should be put in solitary confinement!

speaker: Skinny Kid
content: Right. Put her in solitary confinement!
Three mouths are more persuasive than one.
Uni's explanation falls on the deaf ears of the caretaker. Who would believe the words of a sullen kid over those of a sweet-talking one?
Thanks to the caretaker's mediation, Uni is no longer the rightful owner of the candy. The moment the caretaker leaves the room, the gang divides the candy among themselves cheerfully.

speaker: Chubby Kid
content: What are you looking at, you sore loser?
The pudgy kid looks from Uni to you, and back again. Something seems to dawn on him.

speaker: Chubby Kid
content: Oh, I see. Your sister didn't know what you did in class today, did she? You were being a good little sister to her, weren't you?

speaker: Chubby Kid
content: You're a sullen mess and a lousy mimic. Stop making a fool of yourself in front of your sister. You're pathetic! Hahaha...

speaker: Little Girl
content: Shame on you. You're so p-p-pathetic!

speaker: Skinny Kid
content: So pathetic!
Uni can't take it anymore. She smashes her fist into his face.

speaker: Chubby Kid
content: What the... Don't just stand there, you guys. Teach this freak a lesson.
On the pudgy kid's orders, his two sidekicks charge at Uni. A scuffle ensues.
You're in the mirror world. Even if you are to intervene, that won't change the bullies' hostility to Uni, or the course of events that follow.
You decide to stand by and ignore Uni's call for help.

speaker: Young Uni
content: I did nothing wrong. Right, Luna?

speaker: Young Uni
content: Luna, why are you not helping me?

speaker: Young Uni
content: You think I'm a bad kid too?
Crack!
The sound of a mirror breaking, or a heart?
The mirror world breaks into hundreds of pieces, shifting before going black.

You can't just stand by and watch Young Uni being ganged up on. You send the pudgy kid flying with a punch and go on to deal with his two sidekicks, who cry for mercy in the face of a more formidable opponent.
You walk over to where Uni stands and stroke her hair.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Everything is all right now, Uni. They are the bad kids. I have taken care of them.

speaker: Young Uni
content: Luna, you'll never leave me, right?
The words are coming out of your mouth without you meaning them to. You feel like an actor reading lines from a script.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Of course. We belong to each other. I'll never leave you again.
Again?

speaker: Young Uni
content: Good... I love you, Luna. If you ever get lost, I'll bring you back. We'll stay together forever and ever...

As you listen to Young Uni mumbling while cocooned in your embrace, her tone affectionate and earnest, you experience a dizzying feeling of happiness and an inexplicable desire to stay in this undisturbed room forever with Young Uni by your side.
But should you stay?
The cracking sound of something breaking... You break out of the dizzying feeling of happiness and open your eyes again.

You're no longer in the orphanage. You're in a spartan room that has seen the ravages of time, but it's been decorated with care and taste. All the everyday items in the room, you notice, come in pairs.

You are sitting on the bed, your face swathed in bandages. You're not sure
if you're alone in the room.
Be careful. Your wounds are still healing.
Someone hugs you from behind. The torso feels familiarly cold. It's Uni. Her fingers touch your bandaged face gently, and her voice is filled with tenderness and guilt when she speaks to you.

speaker: Uni
content: Are you still mad at me?

speaker: Uni
content: I didn't mean to hurt you. I just didn't want you to leave.

speaker: Uni
content: Why did you leave me to become an actress? You had me. Wasn't that enough? Why did you leave me to entertain those empty-headed things?

speaker: Uni
content: I know... I know that being an actress is something you want to do, something you're good at.
You are trembling all over. You try to wriggle free from Uni's tight embrace, but without success.

speaker: Uni
content: Luna...
You run your hand over your bandaged face, feeling lumps and dents here and there.

speaker: Uni
content: You're my sun. Without you, I'll be trapped in darkness for eternity, I'll lose my bearings. You and I, we have the same face, the same soul, we're one and the same.

speaker: Uni
content: Why did you try to ruin your face?

speaker: Uni
content: Why? Aren't we supposed to be the same?

speaker: Uni
content: Why did you move out? Why weren't you answering my calls? Why did you listen to them?

speaker: Uni
content: Why did you leave me?
Uni is in emotional turmoil. In response, the mirror world starts shaking and splintering.
You're falling again...
The myriad fragments of glass float around you, each offering a peek into Uni's memories.
A heated argument between Uni and another girl. It ends with the girl slamming the door and leaving the room.
Uni's trembling hands. She has accidentally disfigured the person she wants to keep by her side.
A look of despair in Uni's eyes. She has finally found her "twin," but that's only a shell; her real twin is forever gone.
You stop falling. You find yourself standing before a flat surface, smooth to the touch. Another mirror?
This time, you're the one who is inside the mirror. Uni is outside the mirror. She touches the mirror and looks at you.

speaker: Uni
content: I've found the last piece of my puzzle. I can bring you back soon, Luna.
How to wake her up? How to get out of this place?

speaker: Uni
content: It's pointless to try to drag one out of the mire of greed if they don't want to get out. It's like...
And then the answer comes to you. The only way to wake her up...
Crack!
The mirror cracks because of the shackles. You no longer appear as Luna, but as yourself.

speaker: Uni
content: Who are you? Where is she? Give her back!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Where is she? You should ask yourself.

speaker: Uni
content: She is here!
From the other end of the shackles comes an overwhelming sadness.
Uni looks into your eyes. You know it's not her sister that she sees.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: She's no longer here with us, is she?
Your words trigger something inside Uni. The mirror world starts shaking and breaking. But one mirror world is shattered, only to be replaced by another one.
You feel a tidal wave of anger coming from Uni. Her personality seems to have split into two: Young Uni and Adult Uni. They start ranting at you.

speaker: Uni
content: You're wrong. She's still here, in the mirror. She's just asleep, and she'll stay here with me, forever.

speaker: Young Uni
content: Yes, she's trapped in the mirror. I must bring her back.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I understand what you've been through, your sadness and helplessness. You can't change the past. But you can enjoy the present, and make new friends.

speaker: Uni
content: Make new friends? That's not gonna happen. Those kids in the orphanage with their freakishly sour candies, those Eastside superstars with their sugar-free macarons, and many others...

speaker: Uni
content: They're all the same. They're all rotten. Only my sister, only my sister really cares about me.
The mirror world starts shaking, with cracks appearing everywhere. Uni's disguise falls away, and you see her for who she is, a lonely soul longing for love and companionship.

speaker: Young Uni
content: My sister doesn't think we belong to each other? Has she grown tired of me?

speaker: Young Uni
content: I don't know what other people are thinking. I don't understand why they don't like me, or why they call me names. If I became my sister, would they love me?

speaker: Uni
content: No, no one will love me. Only my twin sister understands me, only she'll take care of me.

speaker: Young Uni
content: No. We're not the same. She's a swan. I'm an ugly duckling who tries to mimic her. We're totally different on the inside. That's why she got tired of me and left me.

speaker: Uni
content: My sister, my sister who loves me, she is sleeping on the other side of the mirror. I want to take her back, I must take her back...

speaker: Young Uni
content: If she refuses to come back to me, then everything I've been working so hard for will be meaningless.
The mirror world is collapsing fast. You must do something.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Uni, look at me!

speaker: Uni
content: Luna?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm not your sister.

speaker: Uni
content: Your eyes... My sister's eyes...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'm not your sister. Yes, your sister and I have similar eyes, but I'm not your sister. You think I am; that's because we both want to protect you.
The shackles spread out and anchor the collapsing mirror world, linking you and Uni together.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The shackles have linked us together. We can sense each other's feelings even without seeing each other.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You can trust me. Let's go back to the real world, where you can make up for your mistakes and create beautiful experiences.
You step out of the mirror world with the red shackles, and stand before Uni, with your hand held out.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You're stronger than them. You have formidable power. My job is to protect you from being hurt because of your power, from slipping into darkness.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll be there for you no matter what, not as your sister, but as a friend who's forever ready to face the future with you.
You open your palm. Sitting in it is the candy she gave you.

speaker: Uni
content: Not as someone who'll take advantage of me as a Sinner?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Haven't you seen my reflection in your mirror?

speaker: Uni
content: Am I supposed to believe you?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: You can trust your feelings. The shackles don't lie.

speaker: Uni
content: I thought you had the same eyes as her, but they're not the same, not entirely.

speaker: Uni
content: But they are special too.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: The shackles tell you where I am, whether I am alive or dead. They're not a cage, but a bridge between the two of us.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: We're linked through the shackles, forever.

speaker: Uni
content: It's been here all along...

speaker: Uni
content: The thing I've been looking for. Proof of an unbreakable bond.
She puts her hand in yours. There's warmth in her hand now.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Come with me, Uni. It's time to go back.
You and Uni, along the purple mirror, are slowly bound together by the shackles. And then with a crack, the mirror breaks.
One week later...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, Uni's clinic has been closed down on your orders, and all the mirrors there have been destroyed.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The missing persons have been found. They've all lost one or two of their features, and the missing parts have yet to be found.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Our people also found this. A framed photograph. Uni's relative, maybe. What should we do with it?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Leave it with me. I'll give it to Uni.
You want her to keep the photograph, as a remembrance.
You put the photograph in the basket. The photograph shifts inside the frame.
A corner of the mirror underneath peeks out.
Inside the mirror is a sleeping woman with a face composed of features taken from different persons, waiting to be awakened.
Those shrill alarms and PA announcements feel like a thing of the past. Today, only the faint clamor from the distant Recreation Area can be heard.

As you watch the passing staff members and Sinners, you can't help but sigh. It feels like ages have passed since you last had such a leisurely day. You've been so busy with work running around DisCity that it seems like you're out of touch with the daily lives of your subordinates.
Heading toward the Recreation Area, you notice a group of staff members huddling together. They're watching something on a screen and discussing. Intrigued, you join them.
Scene Change - DeadLover Radio

speaker: Love
content: Hi everyone! You've tuned into DeadLover Radio!

speaker: Love
content: How can such a major radio station not have a live chat system...? Are you guys fans of that Nin... Uh, what's her name again?

speaker: Daisy
content: Nino.

speaker: Love
content: Ah, right, Nino!

speaker: Daisy
content: It's been over a year and you still haven't come up with such a simple function...

speaker: Love
content: <size=30>Lil Daisy!</size> Forget about that. I've heard rumors about some paranormal event in Eastside?

speaker: Daisy
content: Ghost Calls.

speaker: Love
content: Yeah, yeah, Ghost Calls. Let's get into that before anyone else does! We don't want those Eastside hosts stealing our thunder with some lame jokes. You know how uncreative and shameless people can be!

speaker: Love
content: I suggest they come and take a look around Syndicate. Experience the great wisdom of this wonderful place.

In true DeadLover Radio style, the interesting duo goes all out for a fun time. This time, they're mocking the Eastside hosts to spice up the conversation, even incorporating some physical gestures into their act.
Live chat messages keep rolling quickly over the screen.

Her provocative remarks have caught the attention of the staff and Sinners in the Bureau. Of course, some also join in the cheering and applause.
The arrogant attitude and cheeky behavior can't be mistaken. This must be Nino the Sinner.
After escaping, not only has she not been hiding her identity, but she also broadcasts her livestream directly in the Bureau...
It's a rather blatant provocation directed at you, the MBCC's Chief.
This is also the first time you've seen a virtual host like this. Normally, the virtual image should differ greatly from the real person...
But the Nino in front of you is streaming with a virtual image that looks almost identical to herself, which is indeed rare.

You shake your head, clearing out the chaotic thoughts. The primary objective now is to detain the known Sinner, especially one who has escaped while being under your watch. You turn to give your order to the staff members.

speaker: Chief
content: Notify Adjutant Nightingale to get ready. I have somewhere to go now.

speaker: Staff Members A & B
content: Yes, Chief!
Scene Change - Black Screen

speaker: Staff A
content: Let's say Chief brings Nino Sama back, do you think I can just go up and ask her for an autograph?

speaker: Staff B
content: ...You need to chill.
(Scene change)
It's 11 p.m., and you've arrived at an old, remote neighborhood in Eastside. According to the investigation, this area is mostly inhabited by elderly people.
And according to the location tracked using the livestream data, Nino is hiding here.
To stay updated, you have Nino's livestream playing on the device in your hand. She's playing a game while continuously berating her teammates.
(Scene change)

speaker: Nino
content: Oi, oi, how can you guys be so **** at this game? Noobs! Losers! Nino Sama is carrying you to victory and you can't even just lie down and play dead?

speaker: Nino
content: You don't know what a ping is and all you do is obsess over the damn DPS. When you see the red circle, move! I can't carry your ass out of the boss's range every time!

speaker: Live Chat
content: There it is, the host is roasting her teammates again.

speaker: Nino
content: I'm just being honest. When Nino Sama points out others' problems, it's always backed by proof. I'll never accuse someone of what they didn't do.

speaker: Live Chat
content: But you can't keep insulting your teammates!

speaker: Nino
content: But think about it! If I don't tell them what they've done wrong, they might not realize their own problems. I'm only helping them improve! It's for their own good. They should thank me!

speaker: Nino
content: Like I always say, if you suck, just practice more!

speaker: Live Chat
content: Stop yelling so loudly at this hour. Aren't you afraid the neighbors may complain about the noise?

speaker: Nino
content: Ahem, <size=29>they better not. There's an old lady living next door, but I've been streaming late at night for so long and she's never come over to knock on my door.</size>

speaker: Nino
content: <size=29>The buildings around here have really good soundproofing... I guess?</size>

speaker: Nino
content: Even though she's so old that she can barely move around... she always greets people cheerfully.

speaker: Nino
content: Why does she try so hard...

speaker: Nino
content: Given her personality, even if my streaming indeed is a tiny bit noisy, she... she probably...
On the screen, the usually overbearing Nino Sama surprisingly seems somewhat hesitant.

speaker: Nino
content: Hey, I've only said like two sentences and my ******* teammate died on me again?!

speaker: Nino
content: Damn it! Now that I'm pissed, I'm even hungrier. Why hasn't my takeout arrived yet? Nino Sama is going to starve to death! Help!
(Scene change)
The next moment, a deliveryman in Supereats uniform is seen jogging toward the residential area, carefully holding a takeout box, afraid of spilling the soup and getting a bad review.

speaker: Chief
content: Excuse me. We are conducting an investigation and need to requisition what you're holding.
You point at the takeout in his hand.

speaker: Deliveryman
content: Uh... is this some kind of new scam? No way, are you even going after a takeout?

speaker: Deliveryman
content: Wow, there are quite a lot of you. Is this some new prank show? Please let me go, I'm really busy. This order is about to be overdue and I'll be penalized for being late!

speaker: Deliveryman
content: See, the customer is texting to ask where I am again. That's really not cool, you guys prank us for fun in these shows and ignore our feelings...
Worried that his loud voice may alert the target, you have no choice but to show your badge.

speaker: Deliveryman
content: Holy ****, you are indeed a cop! What kind of big trouble have I gotten into?

speaker: Old Lady

speaker: Old Lady

speaker: Old Lady

content: ...Okay.

speaker: Nino
content: ...Okay.

The noisy radio waves fill her eardrums. The young girl tries to grasp everything in front of her, but finds herself floating in a chaotic space.

Her schoolmates looked down on her poor family and dull clothes. No one wanted to be close to her.

Grandma passed away. It was just the flu, but elderly people could be fragile. They leave you so suddenly, without any warning.

content: Haha... Sorry about that, bumpkin. We've got something more important to do... Let's talk another day?

speaker: Nino
content: Legion... of Warcraft...

speaker: Nino
content: Play... with everyone...
(Scene change)
Loneliness drives you mad. After all, humans are social creatures.
This computer was one of the few things her parents left her. She started to go on the internet, play games, and join online communities.
This is an alternative reality, where one experiences a second life with an identity different from their real one.

content: You! Stop teaching little Nino your useless crap!

speaker: Teammate A

Soon, she obtained some rare armor and formed her own squad. With her excellent skills and thorough understanding of the game, she naturally became the core of the team.
These people came together because of her. For the first time, she understood what it felt like to be in the spotlight, at the center of attention.
The greetings she got from everyone upon logging into the game became what she looked forward to the most every day.

speaker: Squad Member A
content: Captain's online so early today? I know, I know, not having a job is the coolest thing!

speaker: Squad Member B
content: Nino, help us out, we can't do this instance without you!

speaker: Squad Member C
content: Two guys are arguing again. I'm sure they'll listen if Nino goes to stop them!

speaker: Nino
content: Okay... Um... Can you guys speak one at a time? I can't keep up if you all talk at once...
(Scene change)
But all good things must come to an end. Due to various reasons, that game was shut down not long after.
She simply assumed that everyone would be reunited in another similar game.
But that wasn't the case. After all, those who gamed for a living were very much in the minority.
(Scene change)

speaker: Squad Member A
content: Sorry, Nino, I've found a job. I'll start working next month.

speaker: Nino
content: I see... No worries.

speaker: Squad Member B
content: Hey, Nino, I'm sorry... but I'm leaving for FAC trial training soon, so I'm probably not able to play anymore...

speaker: Nino
content: Oh... That's a good thing. I'm happy for you...

speaker: Squad Member C
content: Nino, you're not like me. You're so good at the game, you should totally become a streamer for another game!

speaker: Nino
content: Haha... A streamer? I... I can't do that...

speaker: Squad Member C
content: Why don't you just give it a try? You never know!

speaker: Nino

Some chose to return to their real lives, some began to get tired of the game, and some even died in reality fighting against Mania... One by one, they left. In the end, she found herself all alone once again.
In order to feel needed and to make friends again, she tried her hand at streaming.
She made her image similar to Nino Sama, her character who once dominated Legion of Warcraft with two super rare armor pieces.
Surely viewers would be attracted by her glorious reputation, she thought.
(Scene change)

speaker: Nino
content: Hi everyone... My name is Nino and I've just recently started streaming. Feel free to follow my channel. I'll be streaming my gaming session... every night.

speaker: Nino
content: If you like my... videos, please click the follow button in the upper right corner to subscribe.

speaker: Nino

speaker: Nino
content: I've only gained a few hundred fans after streaming for half a year. I guess soon I'll be doing my graduation stream? Haha, just joking.
The quiet livestream became the norm. Sometimes, even a single follow would make her day, because that meant she gained a new friend again.
Nino's streaming career didn't pick up after six months. Right before she decided to give up, it happened.
During what would have become her outdoor graduation stream, she encountered the Corruptors.
Endless Mania power was devouring her. To survive, she kept running, exhausting every last bit of her strength.

speaker: Nino
content: Grandma, am I going to see you soon?

speaker: Nino
content: I... I don't want to die! I don't want to die...

speaker: Nino
content: I... want to live! I... want someone to care about me! I... still haven't been surrounded by friends yet!

speaker: Nino
content: I can't die... I won't die!

speaker: Nino
content: ******* Corruptors! I swear I'll destroy you! Even if it costs me my life!
She let her emotions burst out of her, cursing everything she saw, changing into a completely different person from her previous submissive self.
A pixelated sword-shield appeared in her hands. It was her favorite weapon in Legion of Warcraft.
At that moment, Nino metamorphosed into Nino, the Nino she had always dreamed of becoming.
All of this was silently recorded by the camera.
Her ability was activated, and all at once, every audiovisual device in Eastside became connected to her livestream.
It was just a nameless girl cursing the world on her last breath, yet it resonated with countless viewers at the moment.
These waves of emotions collided and traveled back into the girl's body with the reverberations.
The powerful energy allowed the girl to survive Mania's corruption, but before she could rejoice, she realized the problem.
Layers of emotional ripples reflected at each other, breaching the girl's rational defenses like a dam-breaking tide.
The repercussions of her power would continue to spread and intensify, eventually growing into a massive force that could destroy her physically and mentally.
But she couldn't stop now. At the moment she came under the gaze of all the media in Eastside, that recognition-greedy monster within her swallowed her whole.
Having experienced the feeling of being wanted and the attention, she no longer wanted to return to that cramped, dark corner of the past.
Even if she knew this could lead to her end, she'd rather die under the world's admiration.
This is also the price Nino must pay to become Nino.
As her power grew stronger, her viewership also surged, which in turn strengthened her power further.
And you're looking at the consequence.

speaker: Nino
content: Cough, cough...
Alone in that space, the girl coughs up a black liquid uncontrollably.

speaker: Nino
content: Haha... I should have known this long ago.

speaker: Nino

speaker: Nino

speaker: Nino
content: But I guess this ending isn't that bad.

speaker: Nino
content: Isn't loneliness the gist of my life?

speaker: Nino
content: These... idiots...

With them comes a soft voice calling her name.
Nino, keep on playing. If I could play with you, that would be even better!

speaker: Nino
content: It's my fault... I've worried you all...

You successfully seal Nino's unbridled power with the shackles and wake her from unconsciousness.

content: How heartless!

content: So, whose hands is it in now?

speaker: Golan
content: In the most unexpected place, of course!

speaker: Golan
content: Those ******* think they can kick the Iron Gang down a peg and sit on the throne if they snatch it.

speaker: Golan
content: ******* idiots! It's already flown away like a butterfly...
Golan eyes you with a grin, looking indifferent about this coveted weapon everyone's fighting over and even quite happy about its disappearance.
Even more strangely, according to her, the Iron Gang seems uninterested in the weapon either.

speaker: Chief
content: If it's really so great, then why doesn't the Iron Gang want to seize it too?

speaker: Golan
content: They... They're capable enough. The use of this kind of thing will only hold them back.

speaker: Golan
content: The Iron Gang doesn't need this flashy... stuff. Rather, its members despise it, whether it's Mania weapons, or...
Golan mumbles and stops on something unintelligible.
But her unconscious annoyance at the mention of this weapon reminds you of something else you learned before entering the interrogation room.

speaker: Chief
content: Is the Iron Gang's aversion toward it related to the death of their heiress?

speaker: Golan
content: What did you say?
Golan freezes momentarily upon hearing that. Her eyes widen in disbelief and her fingertips start to tremble uncontrollably.

speaker: Golan
content: They're saying the Iron Gang's heiress is dead?
She still looks dazed, but the sharp alarm of the M-value detector reveals her true feelings at the moment.
Golan's sudden outburst and her familiarity with the Syndican gangs, especially the Iron Gang, make you realize something...

options: Is she someone important to you?

content: The shock still hasn't left her completely, but she nods slightly.
Her emotions are so thoroughly exposed that she can't hide them anymore.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm sorry you had to hear about your friend this way.

speaker: Golan
content: ...I'm fine. It's a good thing. This might be a relief for her.

speaker: Chief
content: But the MBCC's received a tip-off that there will be a riot to seize Mania weapons in Syndicate in two days. The word about this got out just a day after the Iron Gang announced the death.

speaker: Chief
content: My speculation is that the Iron Gang wanted to cover something up with the heiress's death, but this act angered the other gangs. The upcoming riot has also arisen because of that dead heiress.

speaker: Golan
content: The riot is in two days?

speaker: Golan
content: But she, she's... Whatever she might have to do with the ready-made weapon, she's already dead.

speaker: Chief
content: It's not hard to deduce from your words that the ready-made weapon is powerful. If the heiress had any connection to it, then surely the gangs wouldn't let her go, dead or alive.

speaker: Chief
content: They might not even believe she's dead. If the Iron Gang is indeed their target, then they're probably planning to turn it upside down.

speaker: Golan
content: Damn... These ******* bastards!

speaker: Chief
content: So, is there any more information you can give me? I want to stop the riot over the Mania weapons, and you want to protect the Iron Gang. I think our goals are aligned.

speaker: Golan
content: ...I've told you what you need to know. You've broken it down more completely than I ever can.

speaker: Golan
content: Thanks to you, I've finally got a clearer idea of their plan.
Having digested your analysis of the situation, Golan gradually turns serious.
She lowers her head, seemingly deliberating over something.
You catch the moment she makes a silent promise to herself.

speaker: Golan
content: Oh, but what can I do? I'm all locked up here now. My hands are tied.

speaker: Golan
content: I'm only thinking...
It seems you can't get more information from Golan, so you decide to end the conversation.
Now that you've confirmed the upcoming heist might be related to the Iron Gang, you should start planning your response.

One day later
MBCC Chief's office
A call from Nightingale.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, at 5:10 p.m. today, Sinner Golan broke free from her restraints and went AWOL on a field mission. Currently, her whereabouts are unknown.
You sigh. You knew Golan had been hiding something when the interrogation ended yesterday.
You believe Golan wouldn't lie to you, but whether it's for Mania weapons or that ready-made weapon she mentioned, the imminent heist will surely spark a gang riot.
But at least, you now know where to find Golan and uncover the truth.

XX/XX
The day of the heist
Somewhere in Syndicate

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, this is Cross Street downtown Syndicate, where Golan was last seen according to the investigation team's arrest report. Cross Street is a lawless zone, teeming with members of big and small gangs coming here to exchange information. A comprehensive search will be extremely difficult here.
With a gang riot imminent, there are only two possible reasons Golan would risk returning to Syndicate...
Either the Mania weapons truly exist and Golan has come back to help the Iron Gang win during the heist, or she's here to deal with that weapon for the Iron Gang.
Her disappearance here suggests that a safe passage to the Iron Gang is nearby. Finding her is the only clue to pinpointing the battlefield.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Meanwhile, the Public Security Bureau has just informed you that a gang brawl has erupted around Margaret Street. It's only one intersection away from your current location, but it's still uncertain whether it's related to the Mania weapons.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Given the precarious situation in Syndicate, please prioritize your safety and retreat ASAP once you find any clues about Sinner Golan.
The street is growing noisier when a large flag sweeps before your eyes. You instinctively duck behind the street, only then registering Nightingale's last instruction.

speaker: Chief
content: Okay...
Before you finish, you feel a familiar pull in the palm of your hand. It's Golan.
You take a step back, and the sensation of the shackles grows stronger.

speaker: Chief
content: Found you.
Ending the call, you bypass the main street, follow the fluctuating signs of the shackles, and run through the meandering alleys toward the summons.
Finally, the sensation of the shackles peaks in an abandoned alley reeking of fish. You've just stepped into the alleyway when you hear Golan's trembling voice.
Golan seems to be arguing with the woman in front of her. You tread lightly, trying to listen in on their conversation.

speaker: Brenna
content: Cub let you in, didn't he? I hope he'll enjoy collecting debts on the outskirts for the next three months. We're about to go to war and he dared let in a deserter who betrayed us in black and white. How can we trust someone who treats his job like a joke?

speaker: Golan
content: Miss Brenna... No, Mom! Listen to me! It's not Cub's fault. I forced him to tell me where you were.

speaker: Brenna
content: Blinded by sentiment even during a crisis. Sounds like someone you trained, indeed. Do you know all the gangs have their eyes on the Iron Gang now?

speaker: Brenna
content: It's my responsibility to the Iron Gang to forbid any cowardly deserter to sneak back in during this critical moment.

speaker: Golan
content: I was wrong... Mom, knowing you, I know you'll never forgive me. Punish me however you want, but can we at least wait till I finish fighting this battle...

speaker: Golan
content: Those riffraff have banded together because they think they can finally trample over us this time. I can't just stand by and watch their arrogance without doing anything!

speaker: Golan
content: I've grown a lot these past few months. I've learned how to use my abilities proficiently at the Bureau! I'm sure this time I can help everyone out, I swear!
You've never seen Golan act like this before. Both her bold behavior at the Bureau and the outrageous deeds documented in her file suggest she's not the demure lady she usually pretends to be.
But even under her obedient disguise at the Bureau, she rarely puts herself in the role of a subordinate.
Now, despite Golan's high volume, she's not the one in control of this conversation.

speaker: Brenna
content: No one cares if you stay or leave. The Iron Gang's victory never depends on one single person.

speaker: Golan
content: Please, Mom, can you just stop being mad at me for a second... You really can't do it without me this time. They're going all in with their firepower for this battle!

speaker: Brenna
content: Mad at you? Can't do it without you? Golan, all this time, you've never learned to read the situation.
The woman scoffs, her laugh not reaching her eyes.

speaker: Brenna
content: Sometimes I really wonder where your education went wrong. How did I raise such a naive fool like you?

speaker: Brenna
content: The lookouts from all the other gangs out there are watching you. They didn't believe your desertion before, and they won't believe you're dead now.

speaker: Brenna
content: Their plan is to have all their men launch a massive attack on us the second they get wind that you get in touch with the Iron Gang.

speaker: Brenna
content: Everyone in the Iron Gang has been denying any connection with you and planning to grit their teeth and weather the attack today. When the enemies arrive and find out you're indeed gone, that will be the end of it.

speaker: Brenna
content: And here you've swaggered back without even the slightest awareness of your circumstances... How am I supposed to explain to everyone that you want to fight alongside them now?
You faintly feel the woman glance at you as she talks, but it's so subtle you're not sure if she's really spotted you.

speaker: Golan
content: I don't want to wait for them to change their mind after they attack us. I don't want them to realize Golan is indeed gone amid the dead bodies of our people.

speaker: Golan
content: And if they find out we don't have any Sinners or Mania weapons anymore, then we'll turn into helpless prey! They won't let the Iron Gang live.

speaker: Brenna
content: Whether we live or die, that's the Iron Gang's fate. It has nothing to do with you.

speaker: Golan
content: You can't sacrifice so much for me... It's not fair to you.

speaker: Golan
content: I... I'll explain to everyone myself. I'm confident as long as I can lead everyone through this battle, they'll remain loyal.

speaker: Brenna
content: Did you see Sunny and Joy on your way here? They must be with Cub. Did you see their wounds?

speaker: Brenna
content: The Deluge guys cornered them in a stinking alley and beat them up to get your whereabouts. Sunny didn't talk even though they got her on her knees. Joy fought back, and they shoved his head to the ground and fed him dirt.

speaker: Brenna
content: They are loyal. If you show up, those idiots will definitely follow your orders. One word from you and they're ready to fight.

speaker: Brenna
content: But what about you? Can you still stand their loyalty?

Despite Brenna's sharp words, you can tell every member of the Iron Gang is willing to sacrifice themselves for Golan's safety. This much is consensus among them. But Golan can't accept this arrangement.
Golan looks like a child who has done something wrong, unable to defend herself. Even when she tries to emphasize how she can be of help, the confidence in her voice shrinks.
She still insists on staying, yet she doesn't know how else to convince the woman in front of her.

speaker: Golan
content: Once this is over, I'll accept any punishment for the responsibilities I'd shirked before according to our rules, and I'll...

speaker: Brenna
content: [Scene Transition - Clementine's Study]
The woman interrupts Golan before she can finish.

speaker: Brenna
content: Your whereabouts have been exposed for quite some time now. I don't know how many people have discovered where you are, but everyone must be poised for action now.

speaker: Brenna
content: Go. The Iron Gang has nothing to do with you anymore.
She glances in your direction, and this time you can clearly feel her gaze landing on you.

speaker: Brenna
content: Even if you're not being tracked, that friend of yours probably is. They won't let any unfamiliar face go at this time.

speaker: Brenna
content: Let alone a cop this conspicuous.
It's only then that Golan notices your presence. She turns to look at you, a mix of despair and annoyance flooding her face.
She stares at her mother's back turned resolutely to her, all the questions she was suppressing and too afraid to ask now washing over her.

speaker: Golan
content: I don't understand...

speaker: Golan
content: If you wanted me to become a worthy and responsible heiress to the gang, why didn't you tell me the truth about our family's business from the start...
Brenna turns her back. You can't see the expression on her face. She simply sighs almost inaudibly.

speaker: Brenna
content: I had no choice.

speaker: Brenna
content: I've spent my whole life in the Iron Gang. I'm used to fighting and killing. You're different. I wanted you to have a choice.

speaker: Brenna
content: Since you chose them when the choices were presented to you, you have nothing to do with Syndicate or the gangs anymore.

speaker: Brenna
content: Get lost, you shouldn't have come here. Don't give us extra trouble for getting that cop hurt when the fight starts.
With that last sentence, Brenna ignores Golan and leaves.
Watching her mother's dwindling figure, Golan stands there somewhat helplessly.
Golan's mother was right. Someone might have discovered Golan's whereabouts. You hear a restless buzz in the distance. Shouts and gunshots.
The noise of the brawl grows near. Communication with Nightingale finally becomes smooth.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, how's it going? The gang fight has started to spread in your direction. For your safety, please move to the suggested location and meet up with us.

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, I'll be there soon.
You want to take Golan and leave this place quickly, but she stands rooted to the spot, still looking in the direction her mother has gone in.

speaker: Chief
content: You can process all that later. We need to leave at once. We're not far from your base, right? If someone finds us, it'll only put your mother and friends in an even worse position.

speaker: Golan
content: ...Let's go. I'll cover you. Stay behind me and be careful.
Golan goes ahead with her head down. But luck's not on your side. Just as you reach the end of the alley, you run into two patrolling thugs.

speaker: Thug A
content: Holy ****! Isn't this our Miss Golan? You really are alive!!!

speaker: Thug A
content: People have been going crazy looking for you out there, and here you are, hiding in plain sight?!

speaker: Thug B
content: I just knew she couldn't be dead! I mean, what a loss will that be? We can take her back alive to the boss! We hit the jackpot, didn't we? Haha!

speaker: Golan
content: You better piss off now and keep your mouth shut out there, or I'll rip your jaw off.
Facing the menacing thugs, Golan quickly steps in front of you. She doesn't initiate an attack but tries to shake them off and keep moving.
A stained baseball bat pokes her on the shoulder.

speaker: Thug A
content: Tsk tsk, quit acting all high and mighty now. Do you think you're still in the ******* Iron Gang after you faked your death and ran away? You should see how miserable you are...

speaker: Thug B
content: Instead of being a street rat, why don't you surrender and join us? How about it?

speaker: Golan
content: **** off! You're lucky I've never beaten you up before, but don't push it. Join you? And become lowlifes like you?
Enraged, the thug picks up the baseball bat and swings it at you. Golan pushes you away and meets the attack with her parasol.
The thug who got hit picks up a brick from the ground indignantly and tries to throw it. You see it and rush over to shoulder the assailant off.
Golan immediately turns around to elbow the attacker.
Beaten up defenselessly, the thugs fall unconscious. But it seems that Golan hasn't recovered from the rush of emotions just yet.
Now you finally understand. Golan is the dead heiress to the Iron Gang. No one else should know about her appearance in Syndicate. So you tie up the unconscious thugs to prevent them from escaping.

speaker: Golan
content: Even these thugs almost got the better of me. My mom was right. I'm too weak.

speaker: Chief
content: You don't get stronger overnight. Give yourself more time and patience.

speaker: Golan
content: No need to comfort me. It's a good thing... to get a proper understanding of myself now.

speaker: Chief
content: Why did they say taking you back would earn them a reward? And that people are looking for you? Does it have anything to do with that ready-made weapon you mentioned before? Did you hide it?

The mysterious weapon, the subtle animosity between the Iron Gang and the other gangs, the heist... These things all seem to be connected by a thin thread, but the piece joining them together is still missing.
But if Golan was related to that weapon, the Iron Gang wouldn't have let her go so easily.
Perhaps because you've already seen her at a vulnerable moment, or perhaps to repay your help just now, she finally speaks after a long silence.

speaker: Golan
content: I've never touched any ready-made weapon. I didn't even know what a Mania weapon was six months ago.

speaker: Golan
content: You might not believe it, but I've never been involved in any dirty work, stuff like dealing Mania weapons, shootouts, smuggling... because my mom wouldn't allow it.

speaker: Golan
content: Since I was little, she's always kept me away from the gangs. She taught me combat skills for self-defense and only sent me to collect debts and put on a show with a bunch of underlings. She never let me near the real dirty work that got one's hands dirty.

speaker: Golan
content: Even if she accidentally slipped up in front of me, she refused to let me help. She even specifically created the harshest punishment within our gang regarding this.
Thud... Thud... Thud...

speaker: Cub
content: Boss lady... Boss... lady... Go get help, quickly... Bring more people... to save the boss.

speaker: Golan
content: Cub? What happened? My mom... You guys... Weren't you guys supposed to be picking up the shipment?

speaker: Cub
content: Hurry... Or it'll be too late...

speaker: Golan
content: It was only then I realized my mom took out the most powerful firearm from the safe to prepare for the biggest gang fight in years.

speaker: Golan
content: It was also the first time I realized that for an infamous Syndican gang to survive, you must take what belonged to others, and in the most violent way. You must become the biggest winner on the battlefield. Otherwise, those who failed to take anything would take advantage of the situation and prey on you.

speaker: Golan
content: By the time I arrived with reinforcements, our people were all injured or maimed, struggling to swat off thugs from all sorts of small gangs.

speaker: Golan
content: Mom! What happened to you? What happened here?

speaker: Brenna
content: Golan? What are you doing here? It's too dangerous. Go back!

speaker: Golan
content: At that time, all I saw was the wreckage of the battlefield. My once formidable mother was covered in wounds, still fighting while protecting a dying subordinate. Everyone else had gone down, leaving her alone to still protect those behind her desperately.

speaker: Golan
content: The battlefield was covered in unconscious bodies and blood. At that time, I had no idea what I was supposed to do, dazed as if I was sleepwalking.

speaker: Golan
content: But when I saw a thug pull out a Mania weapon and point it at my mom, my brain and body went completely out of control. An inexplicable rage exploded in me. I had never felt so angry in my life. I rushed over to protect her.

speaker: Enemy Thug
content: Caught off guard, weren't you? Hahaha, today is the day I'll take the life of this monster of a woman!

speaker: Golan
content: Mom! Watch out!

speaker: Golan
content: Maybe because I was too eager to protect my family, or because I was screaming no inside my head. For whatever reason, in that moment, it felt like some kind of power surged within me.

speaker: Chief
content: You mean, after you took that hit from the Mania weapon for your mother on the battlefield, you awakened?

speaker: Golan
content: Exactly. During that most severe gang fight, witnessed by everyone, I awakened as a Sinner.
It suddenly clicked why those thugs looked as if they had struck gold when they found Golan. And you finally grasped the true meaning of the so-called heist.
The mass destruction Mania weapon they're fighting for is Golan.
That better weapon Golan was hinting at was in fact herself.
In Syndicate, even a stray dog knows a Sinner is worth ten Mania weapons. If trained properly, a Sinner makes the best Mania weapon.
