content: Those businessmen in Eastside are self-proclaimed art lovers. They live lives of tremendous wealth and unfair privilege. But deep down, they are just a bunch of suckers, lost in the maze of lies and deception I create for them.

options: You do not deny your crimes?
Do you really have nothing to say to defend yourself?

speaker: McQueen
content: Heh... I am confessing, dear.

speaker: McQueen
content: Don't you already have hard evidence against me?
McQueen's finger traces the edge of the evidence bag, making its slow way toward your hand. All the while she is gazing at you, with a mischievous light in her eyes.

options: Be serious. This is the interrogation room.

content: When did you start creating and selling forgeries? What's your purpose? Money?
What's this murky past of yours? Does it have anything to do with your business?

speaker: McQueen
content: Easy, easy, hold your horses... You really don't know how to treat a lady, do you?

speaker: McQueen
content: So many questions... Which one should I start with?

speaker: McQueen
content: Ha! I got it!
She makes a show of having a eureka moment, but remains inappropriately close to you.

speaker: McQueen
content: Chief, do you want to hear a story? A long, long story...
A story? About your past?
She makes no response, but gives you a meaningful look.

options: Listen to what she has to say

speaker: McQueen
content: That's more like it. You'll find your answers in this story.

speaker: McQueen
content: Once upon a time, there was an unknown painter named Jennie who entered Eastside's art world.

speaker: McQueen
content: The collectors recognized her skills as a painter, but thought she got nothing else going for her...

speaker: Collector A
content: A hardworking painter. Unfortunately, diligence is not a good selling point.

speaker: Collector B
content: Jennie? Never heard of her. Nice painting though. You can't be a successful artist without knowing how to publicize your works. This one didn't even bother to take out an ad.

speaker: McQueen
content: Artistic expression... Dreams... No one in Eastside cares about these.

speaker: McQueen
content: But... not without exception.

speaker: Woman in exhibition
content: You painted this?

speaker: Woman in exhibition
content: I can see that you've got good skills. I like the clashing colors of your painting; a break with tradition. You are quite an original painter.

speaker: Woman in exhibition
content: But I've got this feeling that something is missing. Do you feel the same way? Such a shame.
The woman stands silently in front of the painting for a long time.
Jennie is on pins and needles, but refrains from saying anything.
It's some time before the woman turns around to face Jennie, smiling widely.

speaker: Woman in exhibition
content: Do you want to have your paintings exhibited in the Belphegor Art Museum? I can help you with that.

speaker: Woman in exhibition
content: You need this opportunity, I believe. And I don't want to miss a future star in the oil painting scene of DisCity.

speaker: Woman in exhibition
content: Here is my address. Call on me anytime.

speaker: Woman in exhibition
content: Ask for McQueen.
McQueen?

speaker: McQueen
content: It's just a name. Not me, the McQueen in the story.
Trust, attachment, longing, confusion, hatred... You don't know what feeling or feelings the name McQueen evokes in her.
Did Jennie visit McQueen?

speaker: McQueen
content: She did. Jennie saw McQueen as a mentor, a confidant.

speaker: McQueen
content: She shared everything about herself with McQueen. She told her about her feelings, about her dream... she told her everything.

speaker: McQueen
content: But to McQueen, Jennie was nothing more than a plaything.

speaker: McQueen
content: McQueen puts Jennie on a pedestal, but that's just her way of manipulating Jennie. She took advantage of Jennie's trust and reliance to coax her into painting for her. Did Lisa tell you about the painting?
McQueen raises her head, looking at you squarely in the eye.
Judy on the Blue Couch. You were Jennie. You created the forgery.

speaker: McQueen
content: Not just this one, mind you. McQueen kept coming up with new excuses to cajole Jennie into painting more. And she always said it'd be the last time. Heh...

speaker: McQueen
content: Forget about the Belphegor Art Museum! Nothing's more important than tricking young people and turning them into meal tickets.
McQueen is being candid with you. She reveals her old name and miserable past, but she does so in such an offhand manner that you get the impression that she's recounting the story of someone else.

speaker: McQueen
content: As for Jennie, she awakened her power and became a Sinner. Then she did something juvenile. She wanted to vent her anger by revenging herself, so she took care of the evil art dealer with a knife. Good for her, huh?
You... Jennie killed McQueen and used her identity?
The seemingly genuine smile on her face baffles you.

speaker: McQueen
content: Jennie... No more Jennie. Her story has ended; forget about her. She's a thing of the past.

speaker: McQueen
content: McQueen, on the other hand, is a microcosm of Eastside's art world. She is everything it stands for...

speaker: McQueen
content: She is a representative of the Eastsiders.
Like an actor on stage at the end of a play, McQueen, still seated, mimes taking off a hat and bowing. She looks completely at ease in the interrogation room, but something feels off.
If she has really let go of her past, then what explained the appearance of the phantom of fear in the basement of the art museum?

options: You really have become the new McQueen?
But Jennie is not entirely gone.

content: You haven't put the past behind you. The frightening memories of creating and selling forgeries came back to you in the art museum, and you even...
You make no secret of your loathing and disgust when talking about the Eastside ways.

speaker: McQueen
content: So? You think I'm good at heart, Chief? And you want to convert me?
...You detest Eastside's art world, which doesn't value artistic expression. Then why are you using McQueen's name and doing what she used to do?
Stop copying the works that other people have put their hearts and soul into. Paint for yourself again; you still have the chance.

speaker: McQueen
content: Paint for myself? Hahaha...
The sudden roar of laughter in the closed room grates on you.

speaker: McQueen
content: The MBCC didn't find out everything about me after all. You have no idea what else I've done, do you?

speaker: McQueen
content: Ah, I shouldn't have been surprised that you didn't find out this other thing I'm doing, considering that they come to me of their own accord.
What? You're not just creating and selling forgeries?

speaker: McQueen
content: I've inherited McQueen's name and career. It's only natural for me to do everything she ever did and take it a step further.

speaker: McQueen
content: Need I remind you that art dealers not only deal with potential buyers, but also painters?
You trick other artists into creating forgeries for you?
Selling forgeries to collectors who failed you to get back at them... isn't that enough?
You can make replicas easily with your power. Why are you dragging other artists into your business?

speaker: McQueen
content: Why do you think I am doing that? I just don't understand why some artists are still holding on.

speaker: McQueen
content: Dreams are nothing but an illusion, a lie they tell themselves that they can change this circle.

speaker: McQueen
content: All I'm doing is rewarding them for their efforts before their worlds are shattered by reality.
That's ridiculous!

speaker: McQueen
content: You feel this way only because you've never been in that situation!
There is an unusual sparkle of excitement in her eyes.

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen
content: I don't even need a McQueen to lure them into my game. I snap my fingers, and one Jennie after another comes rushing to me.

speaker: McQueen
content: It's a win-win situation all around. Hahaha!

speaker: McQueen
content: Dear, one trip to the Belphegor Art Museum doesn't make you an expert on the art world.

speaker: McQueen
content: From top to bottom, from painter to buyer, the profession is rotten to the core.

speaker: McQueen
content: Changes are out of the question. Since a paintbrush can't be washed clean in dirty water, we...

content: Might as well make the water dirtier, and murkier!

options: The art world is not as corrupt as you make it out to be.

content: There must be people out there who are pursuing their dreams. But what happened to you makes you so vindictive that you want to drag everyone down.

speaker: McQueen
content: Change...

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

Her passiveness and madness are still beyond your comprehension.

speaker: McQueen
content: Just so you know, you can never take off the dark gloves once you've put them on.

speaker: McQueen
content: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Welcome to the annual charity auction.

speaker: McQueen
content: Each and every guest here is an outstanding figure in their respective field. More importantly, each of you has left a mark on Eastside's art world.

speaker: McQueen
content: Among you are established artists...

speaker: McQueen
content: Rising stars...

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen
content: We'd like to start the bidding on this painting at 1 million DisCoins. Any taker?

speaker: McQueen

content: DisSea?

Some attendees are tempted to raise their bid cards. The painting is waiting for its first bidder.

speaker: McQueen
content: It's understandable, considering that 1 million DisCoins is more than enough to compensate for the death of a combatant on a broken frontline, right?
McQueen's joke is in bad taste but goes down well. Like a talk-show audience, the attendees start roaring with laughter.

speaker: McQueen
content: No matter. We haven't got to the real meat of this auction yet. Look over here.

speaker: McQueen
content: Ladies and gentlemen, I have the honor of presenting to you another painting...

speaker: McQueen
content: The Rising Sun!

speaker: McQueen
content: Bingo! They are two of a kind.

speaker: McQueen
content: The second painting is a work by Maureen, an outstanding graduate of the art department of Keylan University. Ten years ago, her first work, A Hot Summer Day, was auctioned off at an astronomical number.

speaker: McQueen
content: She was hailed as the Princess of Landscapes, a great artist in the making. Five years ago, she got married and stopped painting, and she's stayed out of the public eye since. Ladies and gentlemen, you must have heard about her before, right?

speaker: Participant
content: Maureen?!

speaker: Participant A
content: 1 million 200 thousand, for the second painting!

speaker: Participant B
content: 1 million 500 thousand, also for the second painting!

speaker: Participant C
content: 1 million 800 thousand!

Two identical paintings, but all they care about is who created them... Is this her way of telling me how superficial and shallow these collectors are?
It's straightforward but not convincing. You've lost interest in this farcical show McQueen's directing. You decide to leave the vying crowd.
But before you can stand up, the murmur of a woman in the corner catches your attention. She's talking to herself.
No, not yet. She promised me she'd get me a higher price.
She looks out of place in this extravagant crowd.

speaker: Participant A
content: She switched the paintings around?

speaker: McQueen
content: I never said it's Maureen's painting that we're auctioning today.

speaker: Participant A

speaker: McQueen

Not preposterous at all. McQueen's just laid out the reasons.

A painting from DisSea, a painting that marks Maureen's forgery career, the one left from the two identical paintings... McQueen really knows what she's doing.
Are these name tags more important than the painting itself?
Yes...

What's painted is not important at all!

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

speaker: McQueen

content:

content: Ahahahaha!

speaker: Lynn

speaker: Lynn

speaker: Lynn's Father

speaker: Lynn's Mother

speaker: Lynn's Mother
content: We'll never ever want to forget you...

speaker: Lynn's Father
content: That's the last thing we want, Lynn...

speaker: Lynn's Father

speaker: Lynn

speaker: Lynn's Mother

speaker: Lynn
content: Chief...!

speaker: Lynn's Mother
content: Your Excellency... Thank you, thank you very much... We'll keep our promise...!

speaker: Lynn's Father
content: Lynn, looks like the three of us will have to work hard together.

speaker: Lynn's Father
content: We'll do our best for a chance to meet you again!

speaker: Lynn
content: ...Me too!

Nice to meet you, Mrs. Garofano-Braun. I'm the MBCC Chief, ${PlayerName}.

speaker: Garofano
content: Hello, Chief. Please, just call me by my first name. I never actually changed my surname.
The widow before you looks somewhat frail, but even though she's incarcerated and burdened by her husband's murder, a soft, gentle smile still graces her face.
I see. All right then, Garofano. Please relax. I'm just here to... ask you a few questions.

speaker: Garofano
content: I promise to tell you whatever you want to know.

Let's review the case first, Garofano.
You pull out the documents from the file folder, laying them out one by one.
After Mr. Braun's sudden death from a critical illness, his will stipulates that all his wealth should go to you, his widow.
However, at this juncture, someone not only anonymously reported you as a Sinner, but also accused you of murdering your husband for his wealth in court.
At their strong insistence, the authorities conducted an autopsy on Mr. Braun's body.
According to the autopsy, an unidentified puncture wound was found in a hidden part of the deceased's body. A lethal, slow-acting poison was extracted from it.
Subsequently, they sealed off your tailor shop and found the murder weapon that matched both the wound and the poison. You were arrested based on this evidence. After that...

speaker: Garofano
content: After that, I ended up here.
A hint of melancholy tints Garofano's smile.

speaker: Garofano
content: Chief, you've been very thorough. You've read all the information carefully.

speaker: Garofano
content: But that... isn't the whole truth.

speaker: Garofano
content: I'm not the one who murdered Mr. Braun.
Her voice trembles, but her tone is firm.

speaker: Garofano
content: But as soon as they found out that I'm a Sinner, they jumped to the conclusion that I was the culprit, without giving me any chance to prove my innocence...

The sentencing was too swift, and there was practically no procedural process. They even let someone anonymous who wasn't family to ask for an autopsy. It was like... they were playing some childish game.
It makes no sense to sentence someone on such scattered evidence.
I don't think that being a "Sinner" should automatically condemn someone to guilt.
Garofano then says something somewhat unexpected.

speaker: Garofano
content: I thought you were also here to persuade me to accept my sentence...
The truth of the matter will ultimately be revealed. I don't categorically believe or disbelieve you. I just think that only after knowing the full picture can one make the final judgment.
So, I'd like to hear your side of the story before making my judgment.
She gently nods, then starts to speak.

speaker: Garofano
content: All right, then... here is my side of the story.

speaker: Garofano
content: In reality, Mr. Braun and I weren't married in a legal sense.

speaker: Garofano
content: We were more like brother and sister than husband and wife.
A de facto companionship?

speaker: Garofano
content: Yes, you could say that.
She tucks a strand of hair behind her ear, immersing herself into deeper memories.

speaker: Garofano
content: Mr. Braun was passionate about charity, and I was an orphan girl he helped.

speaker: Garofano
content: I lost my whole family in a Mania attack. I was the only one left... I barely survived.

speaker: Garofano
content: Although I also became a Sinner because of this, at least... I didn't turn into... a monster that can't even recognize its own family.
A trace of pain flashes across her face, but she quickly suppresses it.
Sorry, I didn't mean to make you remember these things.
You gently hand a tissue to Garofano. A faint smile surfaces on her face.

speaker: Garofano
content: I know, Chief.

speaker: Garofano
content: At the time, I felt helpless, and almost lost the will to live... but fortunately, I met Mr. Braun.

speaker: Garofano
content: He didn't care that I was a Sinner, and gave me a lot of earnest help. He even funded me to open a tailor shop, which got my life back on track.

speaker: Garofano
content: I was very grateful for this and always wanted to repay him.
Is this why you had a sham marriage with Mr. Braun?

speaker: Garofano
content: Yes. Mr. Braun was sickly and needed someone to take care of him all the time. I always helped Mrs. Braun with housework when I had time...

speaker: Garofano
content: Later, Mrs. Braun fell ill. Before she passed away, she asked me to move in to keep taking care of Mr. Braun.

speaker: Garofano
content: As his wife, I also went to burdensome social events in his place. All of this was voluntary.

speaker: Garofano
content: We lived like family, watching over and caring for each other. I thought that life would always be so calm and cozy, until...
Garofano can't help but let out a sob.

speaker: Garofano
content: ...Sorry about that.
I understand... it's not easy to lose a family member.

speaker: Garofano
content: Then you should also understand... having lost my family once, I couldn't bear that kind of heart-wrenching pain again.

speaker: Garofano
content: I... cherished them very much. I would rather die myself than see my family leave me...

speaker: Garofano
content: That feeling is like.. being abandoned to be all alone in this world...
She pauses for a moment, unable to suppress her sorrow any longer... Tears trickle down her cheeks, leaving a faint shining trace.

speaker: Garofano
content: Ah... Thank you.
As Garofano takes the tissue, you brush against her icy fingertips, which feel somewhat rough and callused.
After a moment, she collects herself, and slowly raises her head to look at you seriously.

speaker: Garofano
content: I know... everyone thinks I'm the cruel murderer, but I...

speaker: Garofano
content: ...would never harm my own family.
Garofano's immense grief pours into your consciousness through the shackles... but beneath that tide of pain, there is resolute determination.
You don't want to believe that someone so passionate would lie about her innocence.
But, given the current evidence, the odds are stacked against you.

speaker: Garofano
content: Hmm, I know.
Garofano flashes a bitter smile.

speaker: Garofano
content: If you think I was after his money... I can tell you, we had an agreement. I wouldn't inherit any property from Mr. Braun.

speaker: Garofano
content: Besides, even if that agreement is non-binding, the order of inheritance stipulates that his younger brother—the younger Mr. Braun—would be the one to inherit his estate.

speaker: Garofano
content: As for his will... I only found out about it after his death.
A younger brother...? You recall the case file you saw, which didn't mention Mr. Braun having a younger brother.

But the file was vague about the complainant from start to finish. You thought it might have been a neighbor who was unwilling to disclose their personal information. But now that you think about it, it seems...
You need to find a way to investigate this.
Seeing you fall silent, Garofano lowers her eyes and speaks softly.

speaker: Garofano
content: But actually, I no longer have any hopes about correcting this misunderstanding.

speaker: Garofano
content: As long as someone can listen to my story, I'm happy.

options: I can help you if you want.

content: Although the truth about the case is still unclear, I'm willing to trust you this once. I'm willing to believe how much you cherish your "family."

content: Chief, you... remind me of someone.

speaker: Garofano
content: My younger brother.
female_content: My younger sister.

speaker: Garofano
content: He was just like you, kind and righteous...
female_content: She was just like you, kind and righteous...

speaker: Garofano
content: He always wanted to be like our father, a proud and selfless member of the FAC.
female_content: She always wanted to be like our father, a proud and selfless member of the FAC.

speaker: Garofano
content: Such a pity...

speaker: Garofano
content: I'm lucky to meet someone as righteous as you...

speaker: Garofano
content: I am really... grateful that you are doing this for me.

content: You receive an unidentified call. On the other end of the call is a polite yet haughty stranger.

speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
content: So I hope you respect the privacy of the younger Mr. Braun, and hand over that Sinner to me immediately!

content: Ah... it's you, Chief.

speaker: Garofano
content: Is something the matter?

content: ...The younger Mr. Braun?

speaker: Garofano
content: Sorry, but they stopped contacting each other long before Mr. Braun passed away... So I don't really know much about him.

content: ...All right. Let me tell you what I know, then.

content: Not only did Mr. Braun repay much of his debt, he also scolded him many times, but all to no avail.

speaker: Garofano
content: Over time, I think Mr. Braun lost hope in his younger brother. One day, he told me he just wanted to split assets and cut ties.

content: Yes... Mr. Braun must have realized that limitless help can't make a gambler repent.

content: However, before this could be implemented, he suddenly passed away.

speaker: Garofano
content: I'm not sure...

speaker: Garofano
content: By the way, I remembered another strange thing...

speaker: Garofano
content: The younger Mr. Braun had always despised me. I was an "outsider" to him. He always felt that I had taken his place in his brother's heart.

speaker: Garofano
content: But not long ago, he ordered a suit from my tailor shop.

speaker: Garofano
content: He came to my shop and tried on the suit several times. It seemed quite important to him. But when the suit was finally completed, he didn't come to pick it up...

speaker: Garofano
content: What do you mean...?

speaker: Garofano
content: Please wait a moment...!

speaker: Garofano
content: Didn't you notice that you've lost a button on your cuff?

speaker: Garofano
content: As a tailor, I won't let anyone leave my shop looking unkempt.

speaker: Garofano
content: Please let me mend it for you.

speaker: Garofano
content: Your pulse is beating very fast... Have you not been getting enough rest?

speaker: Garofano
content: I see... Work is important, but please don't put too much pressure on yourself.

speaker: Garofano
content: If you neglect your health because of your work, it would worry those who care about you.

options: You pay a lot of attention to details.
You're great at taking care of others.

speaker: Garofano
content: Hehe... This is my shtick, after all.

speaker: Garofano
content: My brother was a wild little rascal. Almost every time he came back home, I had to check if his clothes needed mending... It was really a headache.
female_content: My sister loved beautiful clothes, but she grew up so fast that I had to keep making new ones for her...

speaker: Garofano
content: And then there's my younger sister, who absolutely adored beautiful clothes. But she grew up so fast that I had to constantly make new ones for her...
female_content: And then there's my younger brother, who was a wild little rascal. Almost every time he came back home, I had to check if his clothes needed mending... It was really a headache.

speaker: Garofano
content: I can still remember how they'd want me to baby them.

speaker: Garofano
content: Don't move... I won't prick you, but it's still better to be careful.

speaker: Garofano
content: There. Should be nice and sturdy now.

speaker: Garofano
content: My mother once told me that a button symbolizes a bond. It not only maintains the emotions between people, but also conveys blessings to each other.

speaker: Garofano
content: So, I sew a button for every person I care about. Now, I'm also giving this blessing to you.

speaker: Garofano
content: I hope this button can stay with you for a long time. When you're out and about, it can keep you safe and sound on my behalf.

...I'll cherish it. Thank you, Garofano.

speaker: Garofano
content: Well, you can get back to your work now. Could you also deliver this to Hella for me, please?

speaker: Hella
content: Wow, Garofano is amazing! What a pro!

Her skills really are outstanding.

speaker: Hella
content: Hehe, Ninety-Nine also wore out a lot of clothes. I also want...
Don't always be bothering and taking advantage of others.

speaker: Hella
content: I'm not! Garofano is so nice. She'll definitely want to help...

speaker: Hella
content: Forget it, pretend I said nothing. Adjutant Nightingale is looking for you. You should go to your office!
You rush back to the office. Sure enough, Nightingale is waiting there with a document.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, your hunch was correct.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The person in charge of this case has a close relationship with the younger Braun brother. They frequently go to underground entertainment venues together.

speaker: Nightingale
content: And the forensic examiner who performed the autopsy on Mr. Braun owes the younger Mr. Braun money.

speaker: Nightingale
content: That examiner purchased a batch of high-risk drugs, supposedly for research. The poison that killed Mr. Braun was also on the list.
...Didn't the court notice and investigate such obvious discrepancies?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Perhaps they just didn't want to investigate.
It's not even a complicated case, yet it was handled like this...
Should someone innocent be slandered just because they're a Sinner?
I won't allow that to happen.

speaker: Nightingale
content: What do you plan to do next?
I will submit all this evidence to the court and request them to reopen the investigation.
I promised Garofano that if she was innocent, I would help her clear her name.
The evidence you submitted worked. Soon the court issued a new verdict, and Garofano was declared innocent.
You step into Garofano's room once again, intending to share this good news with her.

speaker: Garofano
content: Chief, please sit down. You seem to be in a good mood. Is there something to be happy about?

speaker: Garofano
content: Let me guess... There's good news from the court, right?

options: You seem quite sure about that.

content: I haven't said anything yet.

speaker: Garofano
content: Your thoughts are written all over your face. Besides, I've always believed in you... The promise you gave has kept me strong all this time.

speaker: Garofano
content: I'm lucky to always meet saviors in desperate situations.

speaker: Garofano
content: Thank you. I can finally prove my innocence now.
I regret to say that the younger Braun brother is the murderer in this case.

speaker: Garofano
content: After your last interrogation, I realized... how good Mr. Braun was to his only remaining relative when he was alive... What a pity...
Garofano sighs deeply, pausing the mending work in her hands.
If you want, on certain days, you can apply to go out to mourn Mr. Braun... and your family.
But you need to apply in advance. The procedures of the Bureau are a bit cumbersome.
You look into her eyes, trusting that she has understood what you are hinting at.
Even though the matter has been resolved, you still need to stay here. You are a Sinner. You can't go back to your previous life.
She stays silent for a moment, and just gently shakes her head.

speaker: Garofano
content: It's okay, Chief. No one in that world remembers me anymore, so... let all of this be bygones.

speaker: Garofano
content: After coming here, I've prepared for the worst. The current situation is much better than I had imagined.

speaker: Garofano
content: You have done enough for me. No need to feel guilty about this.
Her tone is calm and heart-soothing.
It's as if no hardships can wear her down. Even though she's in a difficult situation, she can still resiliently comfort others.
...If you want, you can think of this place as your new home.
I, along with everyone in the Bureau... can also be your new family.
Garofano is surprised for a moment. She then smiles shyly, a faint blush spreading across her face.

speaker: Garofano
content: In truth, even without you saying this... I've already started viewing this place as my home.

speaker: Garofano
content: Because, I really like it here... especially when I'm by your side.

speaker: Garofano
content: I'm so, so happy... that you're willing to be my family,

speaker: Garofano
content: I will definitely cherish you.
You feel relieved that she seems to have cheered up.
Do you need anything else? I promise to help within the best of my ability.

speaker: Garofano
content: Hmm, there is indeed something I want to do...

speaker: Garofano
content: I want to go back to my tailor shop to retrieve some tools and fabrics. Can you come with me?
No problem. I'll apply for a permit to leave right away. Once everything is arranged, I'll take you there.

speaker: Garofano
content: Please come in, Chief.
Garofano pushes open the long-locked door of her shop and leads you inside.
She flips a switch, and a warm yellow light illuminates the room's furnishings. Even though a thin layer of dust has accumulated, you can still feel how cozy and dainty the shop originally was.
You... made all this?

speaker: Garofano
content: Yes, they're all still works in progress.
She gently caresses a half-made dress on a mannequin and sighs.

speaker: Garofano
content: Unfortunately, the person who ordered it will never have the chance to wear it.

speaker: Garofano
content: I haven't been back for so long that even the carnations in the shop have wilted...
That's okay, you can replace them with fresh flowers at the Bureau.

speaker: Garofano
content: ...That's true. I can redecorate my room to my liking.

speaker: Garofano
content: I'll go pack some things from the storage room. Feel free to look around.
Garofano goes off to collect her things. You wander between the row of mannequins, curiously observing the unfinished garments.
Boom—
With a thunderous explosion, the front door of the tailor shop is suddenly blown open.
Several masked thugs with Mania weapons barge in, followed by a man with the air of a boss.

speaker: Thug
content: Are you sure it's here, Mr. Braun?

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: Yeah, it's this shop! Hmph, I just saw those two go in... find them quickly!
You immediately realize why the younger Braun brother, who had been on the run, came to this place. He had been waiting for an opportunity to retaliate against those who ruined his plan...
It's easy to buy information from sketchy places. The itinerary of a Bureau Chief should not be hard to get.
As you hide amidst the mannequins, you try to think of a way to escape with Garofano.
Suddenly, a pair of soft, cold hands reach around from behind you. They brush past your neck and cheeks to cover your mouth.

speaker: Garofano
content: Shh... Chief, it's me.

speaker: Garofano
content: The shop has a back door. We can escape from there... come with me.
Garofano gestures in a certain direction. Her voice is very calm, as if she's undisturbed by the sudden attack.
You have no idea how she got so close to you. A strange feeling crosses your mind, but there's no time to think. All you can do is nod.
Crouching down, the two of you dodge the thugs as you move slowly between the numerous clothing racks.

speaker: Garofano
content: This is the place... Ah!
A bullet hits Garofano's skirt. You've been discovered.

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: Garofano, you treacherous hag! A sneaky one, aren't you? You always manage to trick others to do your bidding!

speaker: Garofano
content: Mr. Braun, I think there's a misunderstanding...

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: A misunderstanding? If it weren't for that bastard next to you, I would have successfully inherited the fortune by now! Yet now I'm a fugitive!

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: This is all your fault!
You can't blame anyone else. When you poisoned your elder brother and framed someone else for the crime, you should have expected these consequences.

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: I don't want to talk to you! I'll show you... Go, capture those two and bring them to me! I want them alive!
The younger Braun brother waves his hand brashly and the thugs charge at you.
Watch out!!
You push Garofano out the door. A stray bullet grazes your arm, immediately drawing blood.

speaker: Garofano
content: You got injured?!
I... I'm fine. We need to get out of here quickly!
Gritting your teeth, you grab Garofano's slender wrist with your uninjured hand and flee frantically through the alleyways.
The footsteps behind become more and more distant until they can no longer be heard. Only then do you relax, panting and leaning against the wall to sit down.
Okay, we should be safe for now... Those guys had Mania weapons, so they're tough to deal with. We'd better lay low.
Garofano kneels beside you, looking worriedly at your bleeding arm.

speaker: Garofano
content: Let me take a look at your wound, Chief.
She carefully peels the sticky shirt away from the wound. You can't help but gasp as the pain returns to your numb wound.

speaker: Garofano
content: ...Does it hurt?
...It's bearable.

speaker: Garofano
content: I'm sorry, it's all my fault...

speaker: Garofano
content: I'm sorry that you had to shed so much blood for me.
It's not your fault. After all, no one could have expected that the younger Mr. Braun would go crazy like that.
She still looks downcast, so you shake your ragged sleeve and pretend to be distressed.
It's just a pity that the button you sewed on for me fell off.
If you really want to make it up to me... then how about you make a new shirt for me.
Garofano's gaze flickers for a moment, then quickly becomes opaque.

speaker: Garofano
content: ...Sure. I will make you a comfortable tailored shirt.
She unties her hairband, letting her long curls tumble freely.

speaker: Garofano
content: Please bear with me. Let me bandage you up first.
She gently wipes the blood near the wound, then places the hairband over it. The cold touch seeps into your skin, causing you to shiver.
Hmm... You're quite skilled at this. I hardly felt any pain at all.

speaker: Garofano
content: Really?
She finishes up by tying a neat knot with her hairband, then looks up at you with a smile.

speaker: Garofano
content: That's good. I won't let you... get hurt anymore.
You hear the thugs' footsteps again, and try to prop yourself up to stand.
Garofano, I'm leaving my comms device with you. Contact the FAC for backup. I'll go and distract them...
Before you finish your sentence, you feel a pricking sensation in your arm. Then, numbness swiftly spreads from your arm to your entire body, paralyzing you.
Your vision begins to blur. You lose your balance and fall backward, landing in a soft, warm embrace.

speaker: Garofano
content: There, there, don't be scared. This is all normal.

speaker: Garofano
content: You'll be fine. I just wanted you to be quiet for a bit.
You get hoisted up, your cheek buried in Garofano's long, silky hair. Her unique fragrance fills your nose.
Garofano... why... why did you...

speaker: Garofano
content: It's a long-standing hunting habit.

speaker: Garofano
content: I always choose to strike when my prey least expects it, when they trust and love me the most.

speaker: Garofano
content: That would have been... right now. But I don't plan on doing that anymore.
Her tone remains calm and gentle, but it sends a chill down your spine.

speaker: Garofano
content: At first, my goal was to eliminate you. After all, the MBCC is a place that imprisons Sinners, and I... detest that.

speaker: Garofano
content: But I didn't expect... you to be such a person. You are so upright, passionate, and even naive enough to genuinely care for Sinners.

speaker: Garofano
content: You are truly amazing... so I willingly let my guard down.

speaker: Garofano
content: You are still my target. It's just that I want to possess you in a different way.
What... exactly do you want to do?

speaker: Garofano
content: Didn't I tell you? I won't let you get hurt anymore.
She walks into the depths of the narrow alley, finds the most hidden corner, and gently puts you down. Then, she tears off your blood-soaked sleeve.

speaker: Garofano
content: As my possession, all you need to do is stay here and leave everything to me.

speaker: Garofano
content: After everything is over, I will take you home.
You lie in the shadows, watching helplessly as Garofano leaves the alley.

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: Well well, look who walked right into their own demise? Where's your friend? Did you get ditched?

speaker: Garofano
content: Walk into their own demise... ha...

speaker: Garofano
content: Those words... should be for you.

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: What nonsense are you spewing... Forget it, doesn't matter! Go, get her!
However, after a brief silence, a few heavy thuds echo across the ground. Someone croaks in a weak, trembling voice...

speaker: Thug
content: That power... those skills... and that flower...

speaker: Thug
content: You, you're... from the Garden!

speaker: Garofano
content: Correct. Good eye.

speaker: Garofano
content: What a pity... Why did you choose to get on my bad side?

speaker: Garofano
content: Anyone who tries to take away my treasures... must pay the price.
The younger Mr. Braun screams in terror.

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: What... what have you done?!

speaker: Garofano
content: I simply taught some delusional fools a lesson. Don't worry, it's your turn next.

speaker: Garofano
content: I underestimated you, Mr. Braun. I didn't expect such a minor pawn to cause me so much trouble. You even managed to threaten my people.

speaker: Garofano
content: You and your brother were both my targets. Since I got you to finish off Mr. Braun already, it's time for me to finish you off.

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: "Got me to finish off"... What do you mean by that?

speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
content: Were you the one who leaked the news about splitting assets?! And that poison... did you...

speaker: Garofano
content: It seems you're not as foolish as I thought.
The alley falls into complete silence.
At that moment, you feel sensation returning to your limbs. You realize she was being honest when she said she did not intend to harm you.
You slowly stand up, instinctively gripping your arm. You feel something smooth... it's the hairband Garofano used to bandage you.
So she's from the "Garden"...
I will find out... what else you're hiding from me.
The moment you step out of the alley, you're hit by the overpowering stench of blood. The hellish scene in front of you shocks you.
Whoosh! A silver light grazes your cheek and pierces into the wall behind you. You look in the direction the needle flew from and see Garofano, exuding the air of a femme fatale.

speaker: Garofano
content: Ah... as expected of you, Chief. You've recovered quite quickly.
Seeing that it's you, the coldness of her smile instantly melts like snow.

speaker: Garofano
content: See, I've eliminated all the dangerous elements that want to harm you...

speaker: Garofano
content: Now, no one can take you away from me. You're completely safe... are you happy?
You've been deceiving me this whole time.

speaker: Garofano
content: Deceiving? No... everything I said was the truth, Chief. All those things really happened.

speaker: Garofano
content: It's just that... other than being a member of the Garden, everything has been a mask...

speaker: Garofano
content: And if a mask is so perfect that even I'm willing to believe in it... It will become the truth.
Then the one I trusted was the mask, not the Garofano of the Garden standing before me now.

speaker: Garofano
content: ...Do you still remember? Back at the Bureau, you said you'd be my family, and I agreed.

speaker: Garofano
content: And I did indeed protect you from those villains.

speaker: Garofano
content: So why... why won't you trust me now?
She wears a hurt expression. Those melancholy eyes used to tug at your heartstrings, but you don't dare to trust her anymore.
Masks, deception, and a fabricated past... Is this your way of protecting me?
At the very least, I won't trust an armed assassin that easily.
A smile suddenly flashes across her face.

speaker: Garofano
content: I see... You're wary of me now.

speaker: Garofano
content: Then, I'll revert back to the Garofano you're familiar with.
She puts away her needles, tidies herself up, and transforms back to the Garofano you're familiar with.

speaker: Garofano
content: There. I'm unarmed now, Chief.

speaker: Garofano
content: I'm at your mercy, and I won't resist. You can take any measures against me as long as it makes you feel safe.
...You must come back to the Bureau with me.

speaker: Garofano
content: Sure.
Her attitude is composed and calm. Her voice even carries a hint of indulgence.
Amidst the red light, you capture this elusive woman once again. But you also realize... she's the one setting the pace.

speaker: Hella
content: Chief... Chief! Hey, I'm talking to you!
...What is it?

speaker: Hella
content: Do you have a moment? Can you bring these to Garofano?
Grinning, she shoves a bundle of old clothes into your arms.
Wait. Can't you go yourself...?!

speaker: Hella
content: Ahhh, it's time for me to meet Ninety-Nine! I'm off now! Thanks for your help, Chief!
Hella waves goodbye and runs off, disappearing in a blink of an eye. You sigh and go off to find Garofano with the bundle of clothes in your arms.
Since that day, you haven't visited Garofano. It feels a bit awkward to go see her now.

speaker: Garofano
content: Long time no see, Chief. How's your injury?
Yet she's still as calm and gentle as when you first met, showing no trace of that merciless Garden assassin.
A master of disguise indeed, you think to yourself.
...I'm all better now.
Hella asked me to bring over these clothes. She would like you to help her mend them.

speaker: Garofano
content: All right, just leave them there. I'll take a look after I finish this one.
She nods agreeably. You notice the fabric she's cutting and can't help but inquire.
What are you doing?

speaker: Garofano
content: This... is the new shirt I promised to make for you.

speaker: Garofano
content: You don't have to worry about the size. I have the measurements already. It will definitely fit.
She has the measurements already? Could it be...
You suddenly recall the embrace in the dark alley.
...Garofano, do you take all your targets this seriously?

speaker: Garofano
content: Hehe... Of course not. You're not just any target to me.

speaker: Garofano
content: Initially, I did think about eliminating you. But later, I really began to see you as family... as something that belonged to me.
But you started off by lying to me.
Your lies were flawless. Even your emotions were perfectly disguised, fooling even my shackles.
I can't tell whether you're telling the truth anymore.
She stays silent for a moment before answering softly.

speaker: Garofano
content: ...Perhaps, what I said then was the truth.

speaker: Garofano
content: Like I said, the best type of deception mixes truth with lies. A good lie is one that the liar believes in herself.

speaker: Garofano
content: But the reason for my Awakening was real, and so was the loss of my family. To this day, I'm still living in the shadow of losing them.

speaker: Garofano
content: That's why I value you so much. I cherish you to the point of disregarding all consequences to eliminate threats against you.
...Your methods are a bit extreme.

speaker: Garofano
content: Extreme? That's because... I've tasted the consequences of hesitation.

speaker: Garofano
content: I didn't tell you before, but on the night I lost my family, I had the chance to save my siblings.

speaker: Garofano
content: However, when I saw the face of that Corruptor... I couldn't bring myself to do it.
Why?

speaker: Garofano
content: You wouldn't be able to stab your father who loved and cared for you since childhood without hesitation either, right?

speaker: Garofano
content: ...Unfortunately, I was too weak back then. In the end, I couldn't save anyone.

speaker: Garofano
content: After that, I vowed to never make the same mistake again.
Garofano looks at you with that sincere gaze she excels at.

speaker: Garofano
content: That's the truth. I hope... you will believe me.
She seems to notice your hesitation and changes the subject with a gentle smile.

speaker: Garofano
content: I understand that it'd be hard for you to accept me again right away. I don't expect an answer right now.

speaker: Garofano
content: I should be able to finish this shirt soon. Can you give me your answer when you wear it?
...But I have to go to Syndicate for a mission tomorrow. It'll be a while before I can come back.

speaker: Garofano
content: That's all right. I'll wait.

speaker: Garofano
content: When you return, I'll... help you try it on myself.
On March XX, Chief ${PlayerName} of the MBCC was severely injured on a mission to Syndicate and fell into a coma.
On April XX, Sinner Garofano escaped from the Bureau and went missing.
This time, to your great surprise, the Public Security Bureau has sent a pile of "household items" as opposed to the usual towering stack of paperwork.
Rice cookers, hair dryers... Why is this coffee machine constantly pumping water? And this office chair, it's not mine, is it?

One must admit, this office chair looks quite soft and comfy. It perfectly meets all the ergonomic requirements of a modern furniture piece. However, just as you're about to touch the armrest, Nightingale stops you in terror.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, please be careful! This chair will electrocute the sitter.
...Electrocute?
You find it hard to believe your own ears.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Yes. These are household items that have recently become popular in the market, but they all have functional issues. For the specifics, please look at the report sent by the Public Security Bureau.

You take the report and open it. The first line that catches your eye is a warning from the Public Security Bureau: "Do not touch the following items. Risks of electric shock, injury from shooting, etc."

You frown and continue reading. The descriptions of the specific details are even more bizarre: when heated to 65 degrees, the lid of the rice cooker will automatically pop open and spray out rice at high speeds; even when set to cool, the hair dryer will suddenly spout fire...
...Are these really household items? They all seem like weapons, don't they?
As you gaze at the dangerous items scattered on the floor, a vague thought pops into your mind: these outrageous "features" and offbeat modifications remind you of a certain "inventor" in the Bureau.

options: Ask Nightingale about Eureka's recent activities

content: Nightingale, do you know what Eureka has been up to recently?
When you mention this name, a hint of exasperation flashes in Nightingale's eyes.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Eureka is researching how to modify shoe soles into surfboards, and then plans to promote their usage across the Bureau.

Surfboard shoe soles... Eureka does always come up with some incomprehensible oddities, but she has never had any ill intentions. These dangerous products are unlikely to be her work. However, her abilities and experiences may offer some help.
...In that case, please prepare the interrogation room for me and notify Eureka to come over. I have some questions to ask her.

When you enter the interrogation room, Eureka is already there. She sits on the interrogation chair, twiddling her fingers, looking somewhat uneasy and tense. In order to calm her down, you decide to start with some trivial topics.

options: Ask about the progress of her inventions

content: Eureka, how is the research on your surfboard shoe soles coming along?

speaker: Eureka
content: Oh, there's been progress! Based on my observations, each staff member at the Bureau walks at different speeds, so I plan to add a speed control system. This way, the soles can match different speeds and are less likely to cause collisions...
As you expected, you flipped a switch by mentioning her "specialty." Eureka immediately relaxes and starts to enthusiastically introduce her new invention.

speaker: Eureka
content: I also consulted Miss Labyrinth. She was very... friendly, and talked to me about many mechanical principles, as well as her operating methods... uh, I also tried to make a mini-Labyrinth based on what she said, but...
Clack, clack, clack!
A strange knocking sound suddenly rings out. Following the source of the sound, you see Eureka hurriedly stuffing a palm-sized metal robot into her tool bag.
The little robot seems to be deliberately defying Eureka. As soon as she presses it down, it immediately pops its head out again.

speaker: Eureka
content: Don't, don't worry, I'll get it to quiet down... Ah!
The little robot jumps onto Eureka's head, grabbing her hair and pulling it from side to side, laughing squeakily.

speaker: Eureka
content: Don't do that! Mini-Lab... Ah! Chief, watch out! It's coming for you!
After a chaotic chase, Eureka finally catches the little robot. She presses a screw on its back, and everything becomes quiet again.
Eureka sits back down on the chair, scratching her head awkwardly with an apologetic smile.

speaker: Eureka
content: Ch-Chief, I'm sorry. Mini-Laby is still in its testing phase. There are some small functional issues. I promise to fix it...
Seeing her like this, you can't bring yourself to scold her. You replace the reprimand on the tip of your tongue with a sigh.
...Let's talk about the matter at hand. The reason I summoned you is because I want you to take a look at these.
You point at the household items piled at her feet. She seems to finally notice their existence, and curiously picks up a small coffee pot.

speaker: Eureka
content: They connected the power cord to the grinder... Hmm, this might actually generate a reverse power flow when activated. A very interesting way of generating electricity!

speaker: Eureka
content: This home audio speaker has twenty-two built-in amplifiers! If turned on, it will probably blow the decibel meter. If there's a sudden power outage in the Bureau and we need to sound an alarm, it would definitely come in handy!

speaker: Eureka
content: And this, oh my goodness, who would think to equip a portable shower head with a barbecue torch? A two in one contraption! Simply genius!

speaker: Eureka
content: ...Uh, Chief? Why are you hiding so far away?
...Don't mind me, Eureka. What do you think of these things?

speaker: Eureka
content: They're highly eccentric, but very creative designs. Chief, do you know who invented these? If possible, could I... I think we would have a lot to chat about.
Unfortunately, if we find this inventor, we'd probably have to interrogate him or her at the Bureau right away.
test
test
test
test
test
test
These are no ordinary inventions, Eureka. Over a hundred civilians have been injured by them, some even critically. Some of the victims are still in the hospital fighting for their lives.
As if remembering something, Eureka becomes visibly uneasy. She nervously twiddles her fingers.

speaker: Eureka
content: Chief, I'm sorry... I didn't know they hurt so many people... But I promise, I didn't do this, and I have no knowledge of it...
Her eyes are a bit frantic. After looking around, her gaze settles on a dangerous electrical appliance at her feet.
As if making up her mind, she takes a deep breath, picks up a small electric kettle, and places it on her lap.

speaker: Eureka
content: I... I want to help you, Chief. If you need me to, I can start disassembling these devices right now. Maybe there are clues inside!

speaker: Eureka
content: ...Can I help? Even though I don't know much about investigating, I'm pretty good at dismantling machinery...
Of course, Eureka. That's why I brought you here.
Eureka nods, squats down again, and gathers the items around her. She takes a tool out of her tool bag and starts to proficiently disassemble them.
This is your first time watching Eureka work up close. To avoid being disturbed, her workshop is located in a secluded area where few people pass by.

So when you see Eureka effortlessly dismantle the rice cooker that the report described as "an intricately modified and dangerous device that will attack at the slightest trigger" as she mutters to herself, you can't help but feel amazed.
Eureka doesn't seem to be just a maker of small, trivial inventions like she presents herself. Her thinking is quirky, and her behavior is unconventional. It's clear that she has more secrets.
Seems like a great inventor not only needs to be able to create, but also to dismantle other people's creations.

speaker: Eureka
content: Mmm, only by taking them apart can you understand how others think. One can learn a lot this way. Besides...
Eureka wipes the sweat on her forehead with an awkward smile.

speaker: Eureka
content: I'm not a great inventor, and have nothing to show off.
But I think you're amazing, Eureka. Not only can you invent those interesting little things, but you also understand these potentially lethal "weapons" very well.

speaker: Eureka
content: Hey!
Eureka's screwdriver falls to the ground with a clatter. She hastily picks up the tool, but accidentally knocks over the coffee machine next to her. She stands up in panic amidst the scattered parts.
You shake your head and reach out to pick up the coffee machine.
I mean no harm, Eureka. I think you know that you're a trusted friend to me. So, can you tell me more about your connection to this incident?
Eureka fiddles with her tool bag, folding and unfolding the strap a few times. With a soft sigh, she begins to spill the beans:

speaker: Eureka
content: I was once... tricked by someone into joining a factory, where I invented many things that they claimed were all put into use. But it was also there that I accidentally got contaminated by Mania-laced mechanical material, which awakened my power.

speaker: Eureka
content: After my awakening, I realized that it wasn't an ordinary factory, but an illegal one that secretly produced highly lethal weapons. My inventions were also taken by them to be modified into...
Weapons?
Eureka nods stiffly. Clearly, even though this happened a long time ago, she still finds it hard to accept that her hard work has been turned into something that could harm others.

speaker: Eureka
content: I, I was so angry and scared at the time that I couldn't control my power... By the time I came back to my senses, the factory had blown up. I fled and started roaming around... until I found that interesting toy factory by the Rust.
Do you still remember the person who tricked you?
Eureka purses her lips and avoids your gaze, seeming to not want to elaborate on this topic.

speaker: Eureka
content: Uh, sorry, I don't really remember. Anyway, it was that person, that person, she...
Beep...
The conversation is interrupted by a sudden noise. You and Eureka both look down at the source of the sound.
Underneath the dismantled electric kettle that just had its heater removed, a bomb is lying quietly beneath the metal wire mesh, flashing an eerie light.

speaker: Eureka
content: Oh no! Someone just activated this bomb!
Eureka exclaims this as she quickly pulls out a palm-sized object from her pocket and throws it to the ground.

speaker: Mini Robot
content: Clack! Clack clack!
A dazzling white light forms a force field around you just as the explosion goes off!

The ground shakes, and many devices in the interrogation room are destroyed. Coughing non-stop, Eureka feels around the ground with her hands. After the smoke clears, you see a mini robot in her hand... the same "failed" invention that caused havoc in the interrogation room earlier.

speaker: Eureka
content: Cough... Let me check that bomb first... cough, cough...
Having just escaped from the explosion, Eureka is still in shock. She trembles as she gathers the bomb remnants and takes out a small device.

speaker: Eureka
content: The infection rate has exceeded the threshold. I recognize this Mania... it's from that factory I was at! All their raw materials were stained with this kind of Mania! I remember!
You gently press Eureka's wrist, trying to soothe her panic.
Eureka, look at this. Is this letter "J" also a special mark of the factory?

speaker: Eureka
content: No, this isn't a mark of the factory. This is... this is...
Eureka lifts up her head, her face covered in grime. She closes her eyes for a moment, as if making some sort of resolution, then says to you:

speaker: Eureka
content: It stands for Jessie. She was once my best friend, and the one who took me to the factory.
The next day, at the abandoned factory on the outskirts of the city.
According to Eureka, this is where she used to work. The once grand factory buildings now stand as nothing more than ruins, with faint traces of explosions visible on the remains of the structures.

speaker: Eureka
content: There used to be a group of stray cats here. I wonder if the kittens have all grown up by now? I have no idea where they ended up... Huh? The automatic stirring feeding bowl I left at their den is still here? That was the first invention I made when I was a child...

Eureka mumbles to herself as she walks into the factory, her voice growing fainter and fainter. The desolate scene before her eyes takes her back to her past. The memory fragments are harrowing, but tell the story of her entire childhood.

speaker: Classmate
content: What is this? Have you been dumpster diving? Isn't this the can I just threw away? Did you steal anything else, oh great inventor? Hahahaha!

speaker: Eureka
content: No, I didn't steal anything... It's not useless! It's an automatic stirring feeding bowl I made for the stray cats at school... It's still not quite stable, but I made it all by myself... It's my hard work...

speaker: Teacher
content: Eureka, your grades have dropped a lot. They were already low, and now they've fallen even lower. Do you think you can get into university like this? How are you going to make your parents proud?

speaker: Father
content: We scrimp and save to pay for your education, and this is how you repay us?! With these terrible grades?!

speaker: Mother
content: Eureka, stop wasting time on those useless things. Can't you make us happy for once? Why are you always so naughty?

speaker: Father
content: Look at this <color=#fb9259>garbage</color> you're wasting your time on! You should be studying hard to become a rich financier, not burying your head in this <color=#fb9259>junk</color> all day!

speaker: Mother
content: Mommy threw away all your <color=#fb9259>garbage</color> for you. I put a stack of new exercise books in their place. You must complete them before the end of the term.

speaker: Teacher
content: I will give all the <color=#fb9259>garbage</color> you made in class to your parents. Go and tell them to come meet me.

speaker: Classmate
content: <color=#fb9259>Freak! Weirdo! Garbage girl! No one likes you! Go to hell!</color>

speaker: Eureka
content: Sorry, I started talking to myself again. I know no one wants to hear those boring things...
You shake your head. Although you've already read about them in Eureka's file, hearing these stories from her personally still makes your heart ache.
It's not your fault, Eureka. You just didn't meet anyone who could understand and appreciate you at that time.

speaker: Eureka
content: Yeah. Jessie said the same thing... But to meet someone like that is as hard as making a pair of shoes that can walk to the moon.
What was Jessie like?
The corners of Eureka's lips curl up ever so slightly at the mention of that name, yet the faint smile quickly fades into her memories.

speaker: Eureka
content: She was my best friend. Jessie... she praised my inventions as masterpieces. She said that while others might lead ordinary lives, I was different. I was born to create.

speaker: Eureka
content: Jessie was different from me. She was bright and cheerful and passionate about inventions. Everyone liked her and her grades were good... To me, she was exceptional. I knew we were from different worlds.

speaker: Eureka
content: But it's strange... unlike the others, she didn't treat me like air. She took the initiative to talk to me.

speaker: Eureka
content: I still remember the first time we talked. She saw the automatic ink filler I made for my pen. She said...

speaker: Jessie
content: Eureka! You're a genius!

speaker: Jessie
content: Ah! I'm sorry, did I scare you? My name is Jessie. I'm a mechanical engineering student. May I admire your work?

speaker: Jessie
content: It's amazing, Eureka! This is a masterpiece! You're the most talented inventor I've ever met!

speaker: Eureka
content: No one has ever praised me like that before. Her words... were like fuel to my engine.

speaker: Eureka
content: I got 56 and 32 for my main courses, and I don't have enough elective credits. I also racked up 73 absences, and haven't even been approved to take my finals... What should I do? I definitely won't graduate at this rate...

speaker: Eureka
content: I got yelled at again when I went home last time. My dad even hit me... If he sees these grades, he'll probably kill me. My mom will just cry and scream at me...

speaker: Eureka
content: I can't face them, and I don't know what to do in the future... How awful life is...

speaker: Eureka
content: Even a piece of broken glass thrown in the trash can be used to make a vase, but what about me... I might as well go be a capybara...
Eureka stands on the empty rooftop of her school building, staring blankly at the noisy field below. Complex emotions begin to well up in her.

speaker: Jessie
content: Eureka, are you daydreaming again? Are you crying?

Eureka looks up in surprise. Seeing who it is through her tear-blurred eyes, she throws herself into Jessie's arms and starts sobbing. The heavy burden on her chest seems to be relieved by her friend's kindness and understanding.

speaker: Jessie
content: ...I get it. Not being able to graduate is indeed a problem.

speaker: Jessie
content: But Eureka, have you ever thought that maybe graduating isn't the only way out?

speaker: Eureka
content: ...What do you mean...?

speaker: Jessie
content: My uncle has an innovative factory on the outskirts of Eastside. If you want, we can go work there together.

speaker: Jessie
content: We don't need a diploma from you for you to join us, Eureka. If you can't get it, then just forget about it! You're extremely talented! So what if you chose the wrong major and failed your courses?

speaker: Jessie
content: Don't let mundane matters constrain you. You were born to create!
Jessie's words ring out strong and clear, clearing the fog in Eureka's eyes like wind. They warm her up and make her relax again.

speaker: Uncle
content: Let's welcome the great inventor, Miss Eureka, to our team!

speaker: Eureka
content: Hello, I'm Jessie's frie...

speaker: Jessie
content: Enough with the chit-chat, Eureka. What do you think of this work uniform? I prepared it especially for you. Try it on!

speaker: Eureka
content: Thank you, Jessie... But, this color, I don't think it looks very good on me... Uh, I mean, sorry, I actually really like it...!
The sudden shift in her words soothes Jessie's furrowed brow. She gives Eureka a hearty pat on the shoulder.

speaker: Jessie
content: I knew you would like it. The moment I saw this outfit, I knew it was perfect for you, just like this place!

speaker: Eureka
content: Yeah... yeah...

Eureka looks around at Jessie's uncle and the workers, who are all beaming at her. They overwhelm her with their thunderous applause. It's something Eureka had never experienced before, and she can't help but say to herself:

speaker: Eureka
content: ...Yes, I think I belong here.

speaker: Uncle
content: Eureka, good news! Those electronic devices you submitted are excellent. We've discussed with the merchant and decided to put them all into production. This is a big order!

speaker: Eureka
content: Really?! That's great! This is the first time someone has ever said I did a good job...
Eureka flashes a shy smile, rubbing her oil-stained hands vigorously on her leather apron.

speaker: Uncle
content: The factory needs more of your ideas. Your thoughts are the incubators for the future, Eureka. You truly are a genius!
Genius, future, well done... words she had never heard from others before were now being used to describe her. Eureka realizes she's shaking with excitement.

speaker: Eureka
content: I'm working on a new invention. It's a mini propulsion engine made by simplifying the inside of a car engine and adding spring crossbow parts... The advantage of this device is that it can generate a huge thrust in an instant when handheld. As for how strong the force is, I still need to test it out...

speaker: Eureka
content: Maybe I can apply it to the legs. But if it's for people who have difficulty walking, I should add a speed adjuster... Yes, that's right, the speed adjuster needs to be at a reasonable height, so you don't have to bend down to operate it...

speaker: Eureka
content: Maybe it also needs a small temperature control system... Ah, I'm sorry, I was talking to myself again!

speaker: Uncle
content: Great! Go ahead and do whatever you want, Eureka. I hope to see the final version soon!

speaker: Eureka
content: Yes, okay, no problem! Thank you so much!
As she watches the middle-aged man leave, Eureka clenches her wrench excitedly, unable to calm down her pounding heart.

speaker: Jessie
content: Eureka, how many times do I have to tell you, you have to go to Uncle's place today!

speaker: Eureka
content: I can't, Jessie. If they find out that I've awakened my power, they'll surely kick me out! I can't leave the factory. That's the only place I have any value. Please...

speaker: Jessie
content: What nonsense are you talking about? Value? Your power is your greatest value now! Come on, follow me! Uncle is getting impatient!

The unfamiliar underground corridor is humid and stuffy. Mold spots grow in the corners, and the broken light bulb flickers nonstop. Jessie has a steely grip on Eureka's arm, and is practically dragging her along.
Eureka's pleading voice echoes in the cold corridor, but there's no response.

speaker: Jessie
content: Here we are. Go inside.
Eureka is pushed into the brightly lit room at the end of the corridor. She instinctively closes her eyes, then opens them, and sees a sight that makes her blood run cold...

An emaciated man is tied to a post with a dirty sack over his head that muffles his sobs and moans. The shirtless man's body is covered in scars, and it's obvious that these wounds were not caused by a single tool.

speaker: Uncle
content: Eureka, Jessie says you're becoming more and more disobedient lately. You took so long to come here after I invited you.
He has a modified gun tightly bound to his arm. The speed adjuster at the end of it is making a steady beeping sound that makes Eureka dizzy.

speaker: Eureka
content: That's... That's my...

speaker: Uncle
content: Your what? Body speed thruster... or adjuster, or whatever it's called... The name doesn't matter. What matters is that it's a great invention, right?

speaker: Eureka
content: No, it can't be attached to your arm. If the speed adjustment goes wrong, the recoil of the gun becomes a huge safety hazard. You can't... please take it off. Please, I'm really scared... please don't...

speaker: Uncle
content: Eureka. Do you think that just because you made these prototypes, you're so great that you can defy me?
Jessie's uncle slowly walks up to the bound man, raises his arm, and points the gun at his forehead...
Bang!
The man, who was begging for mercy just a second ago, silently drops his head.
Tick-tock, tick-tock...

speaker: Lab Staff
content: Boss, the data is out. 85% of the recoil from firing has been offset by our modified injector. This is not far off from the order requirements. A couple more adjustments should meet the target.

speaker: Uncle
content: Good job. Go clean this place up.

The employee bows and backs away. Eureka stands frozen in shock as dark red liquid pools around her feet. She stares at the limp, lifeless body still hanging from the pillar, and suddenly feels that none of this is real.

speaker: Eureka
content: He... he's dead...?

speaker: Uncle
content: Yes. He violated the factory's rules. After seeing the secrets here, he refused to join us, but planned to escape instead. That's treacherous behavior, isn't it?

speaker: Uncle
content: Eureka, this factory is my blood, sweat, and tears. If you were in my shoes, you wouldn't want your hard work to go down the drain because of others' misunderstanding, right?

speaker: Eureka
content: No, that's not it... My mini propulsion engine is an assistive device, meant to be attached to legs. Its speed adjuster is designed for those with leg mobility issues...
Eureka shakes her head vigorously, desperately and mechanically repeating the original intent of her invention in a hoarse voice.

speaker: Jessie
content: Enough! Eureka, when will you sober up?

speaker: Jessie
content: Don't you get it? The moment your little contraptions get turned into weapons is when they truly gain value. Now, they can truly be called "inventions."
Jessie, who had been silent all this while, suddenly speaks up. She stands behind Eureka, her voice as cold as a venomous snake. Eureka feels like she doesn't know her at all.

speaker: Eureka
content: Jessie...? Did you... know about this all along...?

speaker: Jessie
content: Of course. Why else do you think I had you join my uncle's factory? Out of kindness? Afraid you'd drop out and end up on the streets?

speaker: Jessie
content: Don't flatter yourself. I can't stand your pitiful look, Eureka.
Jessie spits out the last word coldly and turns around without looking back, disappearing into the darkness behind the door.

speaker: Eureka
content: What do you mean... Jessie... We were supposed to be best friends...

Eureka hears the sticky noise of the floor being scrubbed behind her and comes back to her senses. She turns to look at Jessie's uncle, who is fiddling with his beloved gun, and backs away while saying in a hollow voice:

speaker: Eureka
content: The rice cooker is still on musical mode back home... I need to go back to deal with it...

speaker: Uncle
content: Don't talk nonsense, Eureka. Jessie already told me. Your power can give these weapons even more strength. You must stay here. Make the most powerful weapon in the world for me! Bring me a huge order with countless money and checks!
Seeing Eureka's intent to flee, a few security guards rush up to twist her arm, halting her in her tracks.

speaker: Eureka
content: No...
Eureka struggles desperately, feeling intense pain in her arm. All that remains in her ears are the shrill and gruesome cackles of Jessie's uncle.

speaker: Uncle
content: Lock her in the laboratory we prepared. She's not allowed to come out without my permission.

speaker: Uncle
content: An inventor or a test subject. Eureka, which one do you choose to be?

speaker: Eureka
content: I won't stay here anymore!!!
The desire to resist and flee has never been stronger. Eureka yells out loud, fully unleashing her power for the first time. Several partially modified bombs on the workbench explode in response.
Boom—
The dazzling white light produced by the violent explosion instantly engulfs the entire laboratory.
After hearing Eureka's story, your heart is heavy and silent. You didn't expect an eccentric oddball like her to have also endured so much pain and misfortune.
I didn't expect this... I didn't know they forced you like that... I'm so sorry...
Eureka shakes her head.

speaker: Eureka
content: After leaving that place, I've been on the run. I kept myself busy by constantly looking for new inspiration and making new inventions to avoid thinking about the past... But it seems that I've come full circle and ended up back here...
Heh. Even today, you're still dreaming. You still think you're the victim.
The machine nearby suddenly starts up, and the light bulb on the ceiling begins to flicker. In the darkness, a woman's figure slowly appears.
Her venomous gaze is fixated on Eureka. She lets out a sneer.

speaker: Jessie
content: Long time no see, Eureka.

speaker: Eureka
content: Je... Jessie... How... how did you...
Facing this "old friend" for whom she has so many complex feelings, Eureka instinctively becomes panicked and timid. Jessie laughs scornfully, her taunting gaze brimming with mockery.

speaker: Jessie
content: Eureka, you still choose to be a clown instead of realizing your true value. I'm truly disappointed.
What do you know about value? You think your value lies in those things you made?

speaker: Eureka
content: A rice cooker that shoots out rice, a bean grinder with a drill... Jessie, did you make those...?

speaker: Jessie
content: I remember there was also a young kid in your squad back then. Your captain brought it up.

speaker: Eureka
content: ...But why did you sell them to people who had no idea about their functions? Many innocent people got hurt by them!

speaker: Jessie
content: Ha, that's exactly what I want. Aren't these things quite powerful? They lull people into a false sense of security with their harmless appearance, and then unleash the greatest destructive power when they least expect it... This is something I learned from you.

speaker: Eureka
content: But I never made inventions to hurt people! And I don't care who is better than who... I just want... I just...

speaker: Jessie
content: You just want to be accepted, right?
Jessie interrupts Eureka's stammering, laughing to herself.

speaker: Jessie
content: Hehehe... Eureka, Eureka, what should I say about you?

speaker: Jessie
content: Do you know how many times Uncle told me, "Jessie, be nice to Eureka, we need her." "Jessie, why can't you be as good as her? If only you had half as much talent."

speaker: Jessie
content: It's because he valued your talent so much that he stubbornly believed that even if our philosophies differed, you would eventually join us and become a real partner.
As she speaks, Jessie's expression becomes twisted.

speaker: Jessie
content: Yet what did you do? You turned your back on his kindness, and even destroyed his factory! When the explosion happened, Uncle didn't make it out of the lab alive because he was trying to save those blueprints... The factory workers were as heartless as you. Once Uncle died, they took all the valuables and ran away!

speaker: Her hot, humid breath sweeps by you. You feel a certain essence slowly leaving your body, and your vision begins to blur!
content: Good thing those buffoons couldn't tell what was truly valuable. I took all the materials contaminated beyond the threshold, and picked up some of your discarded trash... Those appliances were made from stuff I brought out from the factory years ago.

speaker: Jessie
content: I will prove to you, to my late uncle, and to everyone in this world, that I've never been inferior to you. I can be better than you!
Eureka ponders for a moment, looking at Jessie with some confusion.

speaker: Eureka
content: Huh? So, you made those inventions just to prove a point?

speaker: Jessie
content: Yes. I spent many years creating them. Admit it, those are truly remarkable inventions!

speaker: Eureka
content: They are indeed interesting ideas... but there are many problems in the actual execution.

speaker: Eureka
content: Hmm... let's take that coffee machine for instance. Connecting the power cord to the grinder can indeed generate a reverse power flow when activated, but the amount of electricity produced is too low to be efficient.

speaker: Eureka
content: Your audio speaker can reach ultra-high decibels, but there are too many amplifiers inside, which can easily malfunction and burn out the circuit.

speaker: Eureka
content: And that showerhead flamethrower... it's not easy to control the temperature. The high-temperature steam can cause the pipe to burst and injure the user.
Upon hearing this, the smug look on Jessie's face vanishes. She has no way of refuting Eureka, because all the problems mentioned are indeed present in her inventions.
Eureka scratches her chin and continues.

speaker: Eureka
content: So if it were me... I would use the same reverse flow power generation design for a washing machine. I would reduce the number of amplifiers for the speaker and change their layout to achieve the same or even better effect. As for the showerhead flamethrower, I would use two pipes, one for fire and one for water, and apply heat-insulating materials throughout.

speaker: Eureka
content: These measures are very easy to think of and convenient to implement. Why haven't you enhanced them further for such a long time?

speaker: Jessie
content: Shut up!
Jessie interrupts Eureka, pointing at her indignantly.

speaker: Jessie
content: So what if my inventions have flaws? They can still take your life!
As soon as Jessie says this, a thunderous roar erupts from the darkness behind her...
Countless lethal-looking weapons emerge: huge tanks, ammunition drones, mobile turrets, and many other unnameable monstrosities.
...There's so many! How did she manage to secretly tinker with so many illegal weapons without the Public Security Bureau noticing?!
The next second, a shell flies in Eureka's direction.

speaker: Eureka
content: Oh no!
Eureka screams, but her hands are steady as a rock.
She quickly pulls out a pair of surfboards from her tool bag and stuffs them into her shoe soles, then kicks off, flying out at an incredible speed!
The shell leaves a huge pit where Eureka was standing, but she had already darted behind a large stone slab in the abandoned factory.

speaker: Jessie
content: Eureka, is there any point in hiding? Even if you burrow into the ground, I can dig you out!

This time, Jessie releases a drone. The drone's wings buzz, emitting an infrared detection line that continuously scans the area. Eureka quickly stuffs some bubble gum into her mouth, chews and spits it out, then loads it onto a slingshot-like launcher.
Whoosh... splat! The drone's camera is covered by bubble gum, completely disabling its surveillance function.

speaker: Jessie
content: What... what is this?!

speaker: Eureka
content: It's my new invention: a bubble gum launcher! I recycled and refitted it from the Bureau's security system. It has an automatic aiming function!

speaker: Jessie
content: Hmph, what random junk... You got lucky this time. There's no way your rubbish can defeat a tank!
Jessie waves her hand, and a heavy tank emerges from the side with a loud roar. It slowly aims its cannon at the stone slab that Eureka is hiding behind.
