The look in her eyes changes. You don't want to be seen as an adult with a cruel sense of humor. You drop the jest and get straight to the point.

speaker: Chief
content: Sorry, but I really don't think you're capable of making such a grave mistake.

speaker: Chief
content: If I have to guess... Perhaps you're talking about your twin sister?

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...So you did find out.
The indifferent smile is wiped from Shrooma's face. Under her gaze, you slowly open the folder, revealing an old hospital report.

speaker: Chief
content: That day, I happened to overhear Joshua mentioning your mother and... your sister.

speaker: Chief
content: But according to our records, you're an only child.
With a pop, the longest-lasting bubble Shrooma has blown finally bursts. The clear sound resembles the unveiling of a secret within a glass dome.

speaker: Chief
content: So I visited the hospital where your mother was registered as a maternity patient. With some effort, I finally found her medical records.

speaker: Chief
content: The prenatal check-up records were for twins, but the visits had been interrupted inexplicably. In the end, there was only the birth certificate for one girl.

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...So what? Anything to prove with this?

speaker: Chief
content: This proves nothing, indeed. Usually it just means an unsuspicious pregnancy termination or an unfortunate birth accident. But...
You turn to the later pages in the folder and show Shrooma the medical report from when she first joined the Bureau.

speaker: Chief
content: Your medical report shows several abnormal values. Comparing them to existing cases, our medical department believes you likely became a Sinner due to maternal infection.

speaker: Chief
content: Moreover, we've visited your mother's former neighbors and household employees. They've all confirmed she barely left home during her pregnancy.

speaker: Chief
content: Combining the factors... We can probably deduce that your mother came into contact with some Mania contaminant during her pregnancy, right?

speaker: Shrooma
content: How would I know since I was still in my mother's belly... but I suppose it's something like that!

speaker: Shrooma
content: But then what? Sounds like I'm still the poor innocent victim here? Chief, you're not telling me you've been moved by an evil monster like me and want to clear my name?
The girl in front of you is like a cat trapped in a box, scraping at the lid with her sharp claws, hoping someone would come and check on her to see whether she's dead or alive.
You look at her, and decide to tear those old scabs from her wounds.

speaker: Chief
content: That's everything we have evidence for. From now on, whatever I say is just speculation.

speaker: Chief
content: Because of Mania, you're the only twin that survived. Because of Mania, you became a Sinner and your power awakened, which gave you the camouflaging ability.

speaker: Chief
content: Because she was carrying a baby Sinner in her, your mother only absorbed a trace of Mania and, just like you who was born with the camouflaging ability, she also miraculously survived the contamination.

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...Miraculously?

speaker: Chief
content: Yes, it was a miracle. Because of this one-in-a-million accident, your reputation-conscious family didn't abandon you both.

speaker: Chief
content: Yet they hold a natural fear toward Mania, and even more toward those who can overcome Mania. They blame your sister's death on you, and you've always lived under their scrutiny and surveillance.

speaker: Chief
content: That's why Joshua can show his true nature, but not you. You must always be better than anyone else just to be accepted, right?
A moment of silence follows. The air is filled with nothing but the sinking weight of the question you've just posed.
Suddenly, Shrooma raises her hands and starts clapping vigorously.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Amazing! You nailed it! What an armchair detective you are, Chief!

speaker: Shrooma
content: You're right about everything! I'm an evil seed tainted by Mania, a nuisance my family must watch over, a villain who hides her identity as a Sinner! Even my own mother is afraid of me!
She seems to have suddenly let go of her fear, agreeing with you with a shrill voice, her palms all red from clapping as if she feels no pain.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Someone like me should never be let out, right? Isn't that enough to keep me locked up in the Bureau my whole life?

speaker: Chief
content: Shrooma, calm down!
You grab her wrist, interrupting her outburst reluctantly.

speaker: Chief
content: You said it yourself. You were tainted by Mania. The Bureau has no right to keep a victim locked up for life.

speaker: Chief
content: We'll only help you control the Mania and rid yourself of its influence as much as possible, so you can return to normal life.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Victim? What victim? Me?

speaker: Shrooma
content: That's hilarious. So that's how the Bureau cares for its criminals? Are you some kind of charity?

speaker: Shrooma
content: Oh, shut it please. Even my mother has never covered me up like this!

speaker: Chief
content: I know you're not thinking straight as you speak now...

speaker: Chief
content: But Shrooma, regarding this matter, your understanding seems to differ from reality.

speaker: Shrooma
content: What do you mean?

speaker: Chief
content: I have another testimony that's probably more credible.

speaker: Chief
content: Since you recognize me, does that mean you already know that Shrooma...

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: Of course. Shrooma is my flesh and blood, after all.

speaker: Chief
content: So you also know about those posts, and that Shrooma often...
A rustle of fabric. Perhaps the lady has taken out a handkerchief. After a while, she takes a deep breath.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: I know Shrooma has never been happy in this household. And she's probably done some things she shouldn't have at her age.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: But she's not the one at fault. If anyone has made a mistake, it's me. As her mother, I've failed to protect her.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: When I was pregnant with Shrooma, as a result of some conflicts of interest, someone bribed my maid to place something... "unclean" in my room.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: The family wouldn't abandon any of its members, so I didn't die. I was just sent away and kept under close watch.
Her voice trembles slightly, as if the cold from her memories could freeze her blood.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: I knew any abnormal sign in me would mean my murder. The countdown to my death had long begun.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: So I was scared to death. I was scared of becoming a monster, that my children might not be born, that I wouldn't even get to hold them...

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: Oh... I'm sorry. I know I'm not a brave mother. Even now, I still see that unchanging ceiling from those days in my nightmares...

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: At that time, lying on that hospital bed, I couldn't catch even a glimpse of the sun. I could only hold on to my belly and keep praying.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: I prayed that my children would be okay, that they could survive... If not both, then let at least one of them live!

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: Even if she turned out to be a monster! As long as she could disguise herself and live on!

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: Yes, I wanted to survive. Even if my children and I turned into monsters, I still wanted us to live on together... Have you ever met a more selfish mother, Chief?
She lets out an almost inaudible sob. Clearly, this unspeakable secret has not only crushed Shrooma, but deeply hurt her as well.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: I could feel my child trying hard to meet my expectations, struggling to survive. Finally, I met my Shrooma.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: "Gain more nutrients and become strong." "Even if you become a monster, don't let anyone find out." "Hide it. Conceal your nature carefully and live on."...

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: She was just like an angel coming straight out of my prayers! She saved herself, and she saved me! She allowed us both to survive!

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: It was as if... my cowardice, my fear, my selfishness were transmitted through the umbilical cord to my child, changing her...!

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: ...Thank you. You see, it was my selfish expectations that changed her and made her the way she is. That's why she's now under so much pressure.

speaker: Shrooma's Mother
content: But none of this is a burden she should carry. She did nothing wrong. She is just too obedient...
The recording turns into white noise. Shrooma looks dazed, her face blank with disbelief. At this moment, she finally looks like a child.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Her fault? What does this have to do with her? Why should she take all the blame?

speaker: Shrooma
content: She's always taught me to "Be patient. Be kind. Be considerate. Be sensible." But I've failed her. It's my fault!
Her gaze goes blank, like she's tracing her mother's frail figure in those repressed memories. You sigh and begin gently.

speaker: Chief
content: Yes. "Be patient. Be kind. Be considerate. Be sensible." ...She must have advised you like this many times, right?

speaker: Chief
content: Did you always think that she kept warning and restraining you like the other elders did because she didn't want to accept your true nature?
But in fact...

speaker: Shrooma
content: She didn't mean to discipline or restrain me... She was just teaching me what kind of camouflage I must wear in order to survive in the family...

speaker: Shrooma
content: I never thought... blessings could come in this form too...
Seeing Shrooma's moist eyes and pursed lips, you grow more determined not to let this story end in tears.

speaker: Chief
content: Shrooma, as a victim of Mania, both you and your mother were powerless against this contamination.

speaker: Chief
content: Those responsible for the loss of that life are the merchant behind the plot, the maid who executed it, and Mania that has harmed countless people, but not you or your mother.

speaker: Chief
content: In fact...
You hand Shrooma a research report. It demonstrates with lucid charts the survival rate of mothers and embryos in similar situations. A number infinitely close to 0.

speaker: Chief
content: You and your mother created an almost miracle. You didn't overconsume to the point of even devouring her, and she managed to protect a child under Mania.

speaker: Shrooma
content: ...Is that true? You're not tricking me?

speaker: Chief
content: No. In fact, the current laws can't punish you, and you don't have to fear losing everything because of your identity as a Sinner.

speaker: Chief
content: Someone in your family will always love and support you. Your guardian, your mother, she will take responsibility and protect you from the pressure of the family.

speaker: Chief
content: Just like she protected you at the banquet that day.
Shrooma's slightly confused expression is adorable, making you smile.

speaker: Chief
content: Did you think we gave out leave approval to just any Sinner without the primary guardian's permission?

speaker: Chief
content: She withstood the pressure from the whole family and stopped them from investigating your whereabouts. And she let you attend that banquet to dispel the rumors around you in your social circle.

speaker: Chief
content: From now on, she will visit you regularly. She'll cooperate with the Bureau to teach you everything you need to know as you grow up, including how to properly handle your emotions.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll also help you control your Mania to prevent emotional outbursts and uncontrollable malice from forming.

speaker: Chief
content: Shrooma, you are protected and accepted. What you need to do next is learn the knowledge necessary for a Sinner to return to normal life, then continue living your life. That's all.
Her lips tremble. A childish look of grievance finally emerges on her face.

speaker: Shrooma
content: Is a kid like me worthy of that too...

speaker: Shrooma
content: Someone who... at birth...

speaker: Chief
content: A brave child like you who protected your mother at birth is certainly worthy of that.
Shrooma finally lowers her head. Rubbing her eyes, she begins crying loudly like a child who's finally brought back to the side of her parent.
You reach out and ruffle her hair heavily. This time, she doesn't resist.
A tiny hill of documents is piled up on your desk. Nightingale stands by your side. You rub your brow wearily.

speaker: Chief
content: Let's call it a day.

speaker: Chief
content: By the way, how's Shrooma doing these days?

speaker: Nightingale
content: She's been back to school for about a week.

speaker: Chief
content: What's the situation?

speaker: Nightingale
content: She seems much more cheerful and has made some new friends. However...

speaker: Nightingale
content: She still occasionally posts online. They're mainly complaints about some arrogant classmates.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But her wording sounds much milder and she doesn't post as often as before.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Hmm, I guess she needs an outlet after all.

speaker: Chief
content: Just let her be. She always comes up with some fancy thoughts. It's cute, isn't it?

speaker: Poffy
content: Whoa... So this is the famous must-see spot that every Sinner has to visit—the Interrogation Room?

speaker: Poffy
content: The lighting really sets the mood! These instruments are actually monitoring my vitals, huh. This chair... did you really install these screws yourself, Chief?
The interrogation room is dimly lit, with a table separating the two of you.
Sitting in her chair and swinging her legs, the young Sinner girl named Poffy looks around in all directions with curiosity.

speaker: Poffy
content: This table is so cool! It feels like we could shoot a spy movie here! Oh, a camera! Can Sinners stream from here too?

speaker: Poffy
content: Hello there! I'm going on camera now!
This should be the time to set aside the day's exhaustion and enjoy a peaceful dinner, yet here you are dealing with the Bureau's newest member and her relentless barrage of questions.
You open Poffy's file with a resigned sigh.
[Black Screen Transition]
Five days ago, the Bureau received an anonymous tip.

The letter was short and simple. Rumors have been circulating online that a lurking glutton has been snatching food from passersby near the entrance to Eastside's street food market, and the suspect is believed to be a Sinner. This lurking glutton is allegedly a mukbang streamer and none other than Poffy the glutton.

After verifying the information, the Bureau's staff quickly obtained her residential address. When they arrived at her door, she showed no intention of fleeing. Instead, she had already packed her bags and was waiting at the entrance.

Such an enthusiastic welcome was certainly a first. As you stood there holding up your identification in bewilderment, a head wearing a brown hat poked out from the living room. You've stumbled upon an old acquaintance.

speaker: Luminita
content: Oh my, Chief! You're here too? What a coincidence! This girl here is one of my clients. I had no idea she was a Sinner!

speaker: Luminita
content: You need her to cooperate with the investigation, right? No problem at all! I already told her the Bureau has great food, and the Chief there is a wonderful person. She can totally settle in there without any worries.

speaker: Luminita
content: Back in the Bureau, don't you guys always say that better care for Sinners starts with all of us? She only likes eating a little too much. No need to be so hard on her, okay?
Luminita rattled off a bunch of sentences, leaving you no chance to interrupt. Then she turned to pat Poffy's shoulder, offering earnest advice.

speaker: Luminita
content: Though you're going to the Bureau, rent for this unit is paid annually and non-refundable! But... given that we've had a Sinner in this apartment, I can try to ask the landlord for a discount on the rent next year!
At the time, you didn't think too hard about it, simply focusing on bringing the cooperative Sinner back to the Bureau. Now it seems like you might be the one who got played?
[Black Screen Transition]
Five days later, Nightingale stood in the Chief's office, looking utterly helpless for the first time.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, Sinner Poffy's Emotion Test results came back normal. Her stats are at a stable, above-average level. Her social skills, cognitive function, and values all meet our standards for an ordinary person.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Over these five days, she's spent most of her time in the Bureau's cafeteria, sometimes even helping the staff with cooking. She's earned unanimous praise from the kitchen crew.

speaker: Nightingale
content: She posts photos on social media every day with titles like What I Was Fed Today. The posts are getting a lot of traction, and now her fans are extremely interested in what meals the Bureau serves every day.

speaker: Nightingale
content: She's also getting along very well with people in the Bureau. She's already given Wynn fashion advice, discussed trendy new restaurants with Ignis, and submitted twenty-six suggestions to the cafeteria.

speaker: Chief
content: Doesn't sound like there are any issues? She's lively, cheerful, and gets along well with everyone she meets.
Then Nightingale reluctantly handed you a document, her expression troubled.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The logistics department just filed a formal complaint. According to the statistics, the Bureau's food reserves have decreased by... 37%. At this rate, our quarterly food budget will be exceeded in another two weeks.
[Black Screen Transition]

speaker: Chief
content: Having a big appetite isn't a bad thing, but eating the Bureau out of house and home definitely is...

speaker: Chief
content: Don't tell me she voluntarily came to the Bureau just to freeload meals...
The girl sitting across from you beams with a bright smile, her fingers twining together slightly nervously. It's nearly impossible to harbor any suspicion toward that innocent face.

You shake your head, pushing that ridiculous guess out of your mind. Several faces flash across your mind. Every single Sinner who turned themselves in to the Bureau before her has been nothing but trouble. You can't let her appearance fool you!

speaker: Chief
content: Do you know why you were brought here?
Poffy nods earnestly.

speaker: Poffy
content: Of course I know! Otherwise I wouldn't have come along so willingly.

speaker: Chief
content: This interview should have taken place on your first day at the Bureau, but given your voluntary cooperation and the special circumstances, we're only starting today.

speaker: Chief
content: Most people would run at the sight of a Bureau agent, not pack their bags and wait at the door. Did you get tipped off, or did Luminita tell you something?

speaker: Poffy
content: Oh goodness... I'm just a small-time food streamer. How would I know anything about the Bureau? Actually... even if you hadn't come that day, I would have turned myself in anyway!

speaker: Chief
content: Luminita should have told you that Sinners here don't have the same freedom as ordinary people. Even knowing that, you still chose to come. Why?
Poffy is clearly a little flustered by your serious grilling, though she manages to maintain her smile.

speaker: Poffy
content: Because... because my ability is just too terrifying! If you don't keep me contained and just let me live freely out there, it'll definitely make a disaster!

speaker: Chief
content: Like snatching someone's fried chicken drumstick at Eastside's busiest food market?

speaker: Poffy
content: Oh, that drumstick smelled sooo good! Made me feel like someone was having a percussion session with chicken drumsticks inside my head. I was so hungry I was about to lose my mind... I just couldn't resist!

speaker: Chief
content: Quite a creative metaphor...
You study the girl smiling sweetly across from you, trying to read into her expression, but quickly give up. She seems genuine and friendly enough. No wonder everyone at the Bureau likes her.

But you still believe that as a food streamer who's signed with MCN, Poffy should be able to support herself financially. Her voluntary arrival at the Bureau and ready confession to her crimes suggest her motives go deeper than simply mooching for free meals.

speaker: Chief
content: I've encountered many Sinners—more than your age in years. Among them, quite a few indeed possess abilities that are truly terrifying.

speaker: Chief
content: Compared to them, or at least the vast majority of them, your special power and the impact you can cause are relatively mild. It's nothing worthy of concern.
You slide her file forward, where Danger Assessment: A-Class is clearly written. Feeling her abilities questioned, Poffy puffs out her cheeks in indignation.

speaker: Poffy
content: Hey, don't say that! I... I can be really scary when I'm hungry!

speaker: Poffy
content: I'd lurk around like a starving ghost. Whether it's a steamed bun in a homeless man's hand or a snack a child's munching on, no food can escape my clutches! I'll even charge into bakeries and devour every cookie the staff just finished baking...

speaker: Poffy
content: Simply put... I'm a potentially dangerous Sinner you should not overlook! If you don't detain me today, tomorrow's headline is gonna be Girl Devours City's Last Bowl of Rice!
You can't help but laugh at Poffy's exaggerated threats, shrugging dismissively.

speaker: Chief
content: Honestly, a charge like snatching snacks from people at the street food market... no one would've even bothered to arrest you if it hadn't been for the report.

speaker: Chief
content: If I saw a girl so hungry she was seeing stars, I'd offer her food myself.
Poffy is completely stunned. She stares at you blankly, her cheeks flushing bright red.
Her lips move slightly. Just when you expect her to muster the courage to continue arguing, her defiant spirit suddenly deflates.

speaker: Poffy
content: Can we take a little break? We've been talking for a while and I'm getting hungry... Um, am I allowed to eat here?
Now it's your turn to be stunned.
You were prepared for another round of verbal sparring, but now you're forced to call a halt. If what she said is true, that hunger makes her go insane, then...

options: No food or drink in the interrogation room.

speaker: Poffy
content: Are you serious?! Is the Bureau really that strict?
Poffy's face falls. She fidgets anxiously, picking and scratching at things as she tries to cope with her hunger-induced anxiety.
You watch her every move closely, maintaining your stern expression as you continue questioning.

speaker: Chief
content: Are there any other harmful effects of your special power? Scaring people by stealing their food alone isn't grounds for long-term detention.

speaker: Poffy
content: I can eat thirty rice balls in one sitting!

speaker: Chief
content: ...That's only a threat to your wallet, not to anyone else. You're still young, but you should watch out for diabetes.
You let out a sigh and make a show of closing your notebook, preparing to stand up and end today's interrogation.

speaker: Poffy
content: We... we're not done yet! I've done quite a few bad things! I just... haven't told you everything! What if you let me out and my special power goes out of control and hurts my neighbors? That would be all my fault!
Poffy frantically bites her fingernails, then steels herself and suddenly lowers her voice, a mischievous grin spreading across her face.

speaker: Poffy
content: Once she's starved past a certain point, the big bad Poffy will go rogue! Whether it's cupcakes or people, they'll all become my food!

speaker: Poffy
content: What's even more terrifying is that I don't simply become insane. I also lose all memory of what's happened during an outburst!

speaker: Poffy
content: My first Mania outburst happened while we were recording a program. I chewed on a crew member's arm on the set, which not only interrupted the shooting but also almost brought on a huge publicity crisis.

speaker: Poffy
content: Though Mom paid a lot of money to scrub the videos and comments back then, if you dig deep enough, you should still be able to find some posts from that time.
Poffy swallows hard, her eyes darting around her backpack filled with snacks.

speaker: Poffy
content: The second time was when I was in high school. My hunger triggered a food explosion at school! It hurt my classmates and almost got the school into a scandal...

speaker: Poffy
content: Mom pleaded with everyone and paid a huge sum to keep the press quiet, so we managed to cover that incident up... Otherwise, I would've been arrested long ago.

speaker: Poffy
content: You may not understand just from hearing about it. But seeing is believing, I can give you a demonstration!
Hearing no objection from you, Poffy rummages in her bag and pulls out a bag of corn kernels, pinching one between her fingers.
With a loud pop, the corn kernel explodes suddenly, turning into a piece of popcorn.

speaker: Poffy
content: See? I made the kernel pop with my bare hand! And that's just 10%... no, 1% of my power! See how lethal I am as a Sinner?

Seeing your silence, she grabs another handful of corn kernels. With a series of pops and crackles, the kernels quickly expand, and fluffy white popcorn spills from her palm as the aroma fills the entire interrogation room.
She frees up her other hand to grab yours, shoving all the popcorn into your palm.

speaker: Poffy
content: And mind you, I'm not even starving right now, yet I can already make food explode instantly. During a Mania outburst, my ability will truly scare you!
You hold the still-warm popcorn that continues to crackle softly, pick up a piece, and pop it into your mouth.

speaker: Chief
content: A human microwave, huh...

You can indeed sense the Mania stirring more and more vigorously within her. Perhaps it's because she hasn't reached that level of hunger yet, or maybe your presence is suppressing the Mania within her, but for now she still appears to be perfectly lucid and normal.
Grrr... Her stomach rumbles loudly in the interrogation room. Poffy looks at you with pleading eyes and swallows hard.

speaker: Poffy
content: Um... Chief, look, the popcorn's all ready. Can't we share? I'm really so hungry...
You sigh and pour the popcorn back into Poffy's hands.
Poffy lets out a small cheer, then starts crunching away happily, her face glowing with pure bliss.
Amid the gentle crunching sounds, Poffy's mood quickly settles, and the Mania energy in the interrogation room gradually stabilizes as well.

speaker: Poffy
content: Your file is missing some crucial information! None of the major incidents I caused are even in there. You should investigate more thoroughly!

You gently tap Poffy's file. As she said, the information in this file is incomplete. Apart from including Poffy's past family situation and child star experience, it indeed makes no mention of the two incidents she spoke of.

If it's really as Poffy said, that her mother played the role of protector in those incidents, it's possible they were never reported to the Bureau. You plan to assign someone to investigate more thoroughly once the interrogation is finished.

speaker: Chief
content: I'll arrange for someone to look into them. But I hope the understanding is mutual, Miss Poffy.

speaker: Chief
content: Currently, the incidents you've caused don't meet the severity threshold for detention, but given that you've requested to be detained... if you're really facing some difficulties, the Bureau will find a way to help you.

speaker: Poffy
content: Really?
Poffy's eyes flicker, seeming truly swayed by your words. She unconsciously reaches toward her backpack, but the moment her fingers touch the zipper, she pulls back and looks at you anxiously.

speaker: Poffy
content: ...Will you really help me?

speaker: Chief
content: If you tell the truth.
(Flashback)

speaker: Luminita
content: Anyway, whatever it takes, you must stay in the Bureau. Don't let them kick you out!
(End of Flashback)
Just when you think Poffy would lower her guard and spill the truth, she suddenly buckles at the knees and collapses to the floor, even positioning herself toward the camera.

speaker: Poffy
content: Boohoo... you're all so mean! You think I eat too much, so you want to kick me out!

speaker: Poffy
content: But I've been helping out too! I cooked lots and lots of delicious rice, and everyone praised me! What's a couple extra bites...? Just let me stay! I'll do anything. I can even wash dishes!
Not expecting this turn of events, you rub your temples in exasperation.

speaker: Chief
content: ...You should be cooperating with the investigation, not applying for a job at the cafeteria. We're not understaffed.

speaker: Poffy
content: This is Sinner abuse! I'm going to file a complaint! I demand arbitration! I demand legal intervention! This violates the Sinner protection law!

speaker: Chief
content: Is there such a law? Which provision does it violate?

speaker: Poffy
content: I, I don't know... Anyway, you can't just bully me like this! This is wrong! Boohoo...

As you said, the number of Sinners you've encountered indeed exceeds Poffy's age in years, but you've barely met any with such a childish temperament who would throw tantrums when losing an argument like Poffy.

You feel ridiculous as you watch the girl crying on the floor, but you're beginning to understand something. This little foodie is probably hiding some other secrets, but for some reason, she can't divulge them.

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, get up... You'll remain detained.

speaker: Poffy
content: For real? Can I get extra portions for dinner then? I've been in here for so long, I'm starving!
Poffy's expression immediately brightens, and she nimbly scrambles up from the ground.

Utterly speechless now, you scoff. This girl hasn't stopped snacking throughout the entire interrogation, and now she's still going on about being hungry. You finally understand how the cafeteria storage got cleaned out.

speaker: Chief
content: Fine, you can have my chicken drumstick. Happy now?

speaker: Poffy
content: Oh my gosh! Chief, you're so good to me! I knew you were a nice person!
Poffy patters out of the interrogation room. Your ears can finally have some peace.
You let out a deep sigh and gather up the snack wrappers Poffy has left behind, shoving them all into the trash can.

speaker: Chief
content: Well, it's just one more mouth to feed. Shouldn't be a problem... The investigation needs to continue anyway. Temporary detention isn't unwise.

speaker: Chief
content: But before the investigation is complete, I hope the Bureau's food budget can hold up... Should I apply for additional funding in advance?
[Scene Change]
The next day, Nightingale places a letter on your office desk.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The staff pulled an all-nighter conducting a detailed investigation into Poffy's background. The report will be updated soon. This letter was found in the mailbox at her front door. It hasn't been opened yet.

speaker: Chief
content: It seems she was too eager to seek refuge with the Bureau and forgot to check her mailbox before leaving.

speaker: Nightingale
content: That should be the case.
Nightingale reports on some other tasks and soon leaves.
Sitting at your office desk, you stare at the pristine letter with one line written on it: <color=#fb9259>To Miss Poffy</color>.

Perhaps this letter can answer your questions: Why does Poffy so desperately want to stay at the Bureau, even at the cost of losing her freedom? And why does she worry so much about the potential impact of her special power?
In the Chief's office, steam rises from two cups of hot tea.
Poffy stands in front of your office desk with her head lowered, occasionally stealing guilty glances at you.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Miss Poffy, this is your final warning. According to your contract, you must continue to fulfill your streaming obligations.

speaker: Chief
content: Any breach of contract will result in serious losses to the Company. In such an event, in addition to paying substantial liquidated damages, you will also bear full legal responsibility. The Company reserves all rights to pursue legal action and hold you accountable.
You finish reading out the notice, then look up at Poffy.

speaker: Chief
content: Now, can you explain your reason for coming to the Bureau?

speaker: Poffy
content: Oh dear, nothing escapes you, Chief...
Poffy sticks out her tongue, trying to charm her way out of trouble by acting cutesy.

speaker: Poffy
content: My admirable, kind-hearted, and merciful Chief! Could you please just let this poor, innocent, and penniless Sinner hide in here for a while?

speaker: Poffy
content: The Bureau has detained soooo many Sinners already. What's one more, right?

You wave the bill in your hand. The number of zeros trailing the figure is staggering. The paper flutters to the ground, and Poffy lunges forward to snatch it up, crumples it into a ball, and hurls it into the trash.
She doesn't get up. Instead, she wraps her arms around your leg and breaks down in heart-wrenching sobs.

speaker: Poffy
content: Chief, you've got to help me!

speaker: Chief
content: Quit rolling around on the ground and clinging to people's legs...
You reach out to help her up, but notice her body is trembling slightly.

speaker: Poffy
content: They... they're bad people who'll do anything for money!

speaker: Poffy
content: They would lock me in a streaming room and make me eat all kinds of weird food, then just keep filming videos, nonstop...
Her words come in broken fragments, as if she's remembering something terrible. She's fighting against the memories this notice has awakened and everything she refuses to face.
Seeing her distress, you finally realize this isn't some act, but a genuine cry for help. You drop your teasing tone, your voice turning serious.

speaker: Chief
content: If you're being exploited, why not seek legal action?
Poffy shakes her head vigorously.

speaker: Poffy
content: It won't work... It's not that simple...

speaker: Poffy
content: Sob... If you don't let me stay, I'll be hunted down by those debt collector thugs, or get captured by the company again! It's horrible! Those were portions even I couldn't finish... I really can't gorge myself like that anymore!
Poffy cries for a long time until her stomach begins growling with hunger. She then asks timidly if she could go to the cafeteria to eat something. You nod and ask Nightingale to help comfort her.
After she's left, you call for Mr. Fox.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: I've reviewed the contract. It's fully legally binding. Once signed, there's virtually no way to get out unscathed.

speaker: Chief
content: From what I understand, she appears to have suffered severe psychological oppression and physical abuse.

speaker: Chief
content: Is there really no way at all?

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: Who do you think I am? Of course there's a way, but it's one I wouldn't recommend.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: Or, she could fulfill her contractual obligations for now and complete her current assignments. Then we'll find a way to get her out with minimal consequences.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: You could pose as Miss Poffy's guardian or assistant and visit her workplace. We might uncover something useful.
Mr. Fox smiles, his eyes behind his glasses narrowing into gleaming slits.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: This sort of thing is right up your alley, isn't it, Chief?
You pretend not to catch his teasing tone and carefully consider the plan. Finally, you let out a sigh.

speaker: Chief
content: This is the best option we have right now. At least... it's worth a shot.
[Scene Change]
Early the next morning, Poffy leads you to MCN's building.
Outside the fancy corporate tower, employees in immaculate business attire stride past with hurried steps, while Poffy beside you desperately tries to shrink behind your back, unwilling to be seen.

speaker: Poffy
content: Ugh... Just being back here makes my stomach hurt...

speaker: Chief
content: Poffy, can I ask you a question?

speaker: Poffy
content: Oh, sure. Go ahead.

speaker: Chief
content: You're a huge foodie. Isn't streaming yourself enjoying delicious food exactly what you'd want?

speaker: Poffy
content: That's what I thought at first, so I signed the contract... But things turned out very differently.

speaker: Poffy
content: Sigh, I don't really know how to explain it, Chief. You'll see for yourself in a bit.
Poffy uses her staff card to get you two into the building, then the elevator takes you up to a certain floor.
[Scene Change]

The chaos before you is shocking. Decorations and clothes hangers are scattered across the floor, while staff members navigate through the mess with practiced ease, as if this disorder were perfectly routine.
Hey, Poffy! Stop dawdling around over there!
Poffy instinctively ducks behind you, but the speaker has already stridden forward and grabs her shoulder, dragging her directly toward the makeup room.

speaker: Chief
content: Hey! What are you doing?
So you're that so-called assistant of hers?
The man gives you a cold, appraising look, then turns his attention to Poffy, his tone growing even icier.
If you need something, make a proper request to the company. You can't just hire someone on a whim.

speaker: Manager
content: How many times have I told you? I'm your manager. You need to clear everything with me first.
Poffy's lips twitch, but she can't get a single word out. You catch her eye and signal for her to stay calm.

The manager shoves her into the chair in front of the makeup station, and the makeup artists immediately swarm around her. He keeps refreshing work documents on his device while continuing to grumble about Poffy.

speaker: Manager
content: Do you have any idea how much money you've cost the company by disappearing these past few days?

speaker: Poffy
content: But you literally told me that the company didn't give a damn about me...

speaker: Manager
content: ...And now you've learned to talk back! Sure, you're useless, but still one of our products. Have you ever seen a product on a shelf just up and disappear whenever it wants?!

speaker: Manager
content: You're going to make up for every stream and sponsor you've missed. I'm booking you for both day streams and night streams. Pull an all-nighter if you have to, I don't care!
You can barely stand listening to all this, but meanwhile Poffy just hangs her head as she recites the ad copy, her expression completely numb.

speaker: Manager
content: Get ready, rolling in! Fill lights over here!
[White Screen Transition]

Click! The massive fill lights blind your eyes, making them water reflexively. But Poffy, standing directly in their glare, suddenly springs to life as if someone has just flipped her power switch on.
Tucking away her earlier timidity and anxiety, she straightens her posture and instantly switches into her streamer mode with a beaming smile, greeting the audience beyond the camera professionally.
[Scene Change]

speaker: Poffy
content: Hey everyone, long time no see! I look chubbier? Wow, can't hide anything from you guys, can I? I've been eating well lately, indeed!
She makes a heart gesture at the camera, playfully bantering with her fans before smoothly transitioning to the main topic.

speaker: Poffy
content: Ta-da! Today's mukbang challenge: Rating Cursed Food! Are these suspicious-looking dishes actually edible?

The camera pulls back to reveal her streaming studio setup. Spread across the table are a purple-black jelly, some fluorescent green sushi, a charcoal pudding, and fried durian... All of the dishes are unnaturally colored, and their strange aromas mix in the air.

speaker: Poffy
content: Whoa, the colors don't look too pleasant!
She holds up a piece of jelly and gives it a shake for the camera, its slimy texture gleaming with an ominous sheen under the studio lights.

speaker: Poffy
content: Doesn't this purple thing look like an alien brain? Chat, can I get some encouragement please!
You glance at the stream's real-time analytics and see her views instantly rocket to #1 in the food category.
After hyping up her audience, Poffy heroically swallows the jelly, her smile freezing. A crew member turns away to dry heave, while Poffy quickly recovers and continues her commentary.

speaker: Poffy
content: Hmm... this tastes like... the tears shed after durian and glue had a breakup.

speaker: Poffy
content: As for the texture... it's all gooey and sticky, like biting into a broken pencil tip. But hey, it's still perfectly edible!
Next up is the fluorescent green sushi.

speaker: Poffy
content: It tastes like detergent mixed with wasabi. My mouth feels like it's just been deep-cleansed. Way too intense! My stomach's screaming!

speaker: Poffy
content: Honestly, this stuff's better suited for an April Fools prank. I wouldn't recommend actually eating it yourself! 3, 2, 1! Link's up!
The product link appears, and it sells out instantly. Poffy's eyes crinkle with delight as she laughs and makes teasing comments.

speaker: Poffy
content: Haha, I knew you guys would perk up at the mention of pranks. Huh? Make my assistant try some?
Poffy waves her hand dismissively, feigning a serious expression as she speaks.

speaker: Poffy
content: Nah! Took me long enough to find the right assistant. Don't wanna have to look for a new one so soon!
You cooperatively hold up a sign pleading for mercy, and she smoothly takes the grand finale from your hands. A smoking black pudding.

speaker: Poffy
content: Last but not least, here comes our final product! This is a real treat from our sponsor. Don't miss out!
Poffy takes a big bite, pauses for a few seconds, then smiles and gives a thumbs up while flashing two rows of now completely blackened teeth.

speaker: Poffy
content: It might look icky, but it tastes surprisingly good! The bitter richness of cocoa mingles with the sweet crunch of wafer. Underneath its tough exterior, the inside's actually soft and delicious! See, it even turns your teeth black so you can take the perfect goofy selfies! Hehe!

And with a few rapid taps, Poffy snaps six selfies with her blackened teeth. The chat is exploding with comments and likes. Next to her, you hold up the next prop, but a heaviness settles in your chest.

speaker: Coordinator
content: Hey, check the comments.
The coordinator leans over to direct the manager's attention to the screen. You move closer as well, and several harsh comments immediately catch your eye...

speaker: AAA Foodie
content: When did she get so fat? Has she been gorging herself?

speaker: Notice_Me
content: She's so fat it's making her ads less appealing.

speaker: BreadCart
content: I should go on a diet so I don't end up like her.
The sponsor's expression darkens considerably, and the manager quickly gives an apologetic smile.

speaker: Manager
content: Sure, the comments aren't exactly nice, but look at the engagements! Better to be talked about than ignored, right? Sales are through the roof too. That's what really matters, isn't it?
The tension eases slightly, but the manager immediately turns back to throw a stern glare at Poffy.

speaker: Chief
content: So this is what being a food streamer is really like. Constantly pushing boundaries and even humiliating yourself for attention... It’s so far from her original, simple wish to just eat what she wanted.

speaker: Chief
content: What a shame everyone here has long grown accustomed to this culture. No one cares anymore.

You watch Poffy in front of the camera. She looks like a wound-up doll, mouth curved in a smile while her eyes are hollow. You finally understand what she meant when she said you'll see for yourself in a bit.

speaker: Chief
content: It seems that whatever passion you have, once it becomes work, it gets ruined a little.
[Scene Change]
The two-hour stream finally ends, and Poffy lets out a long breath, like a soldier retreating from battle.
She drags herself back to the dressing room with heavy steps. You offer her a handkerchief, and she manages a weak smile as she wipes her hands, exhaustion filling her eyes.

speaker: Poffy
content: The taste was... well, hard to describe, but at least I got a full meal out of it, hehe.
Not wanting you to worry, she gives her belly a playful pat, trying to keep the mood light.
The next second, her manager storms over in a rage, hurling a thick stack of reports at her—

speaker: Manager
content: Take a good look yourself! The comments were all calling you fat and ugly! Nobody even mentioned the products!
Poffy frantically crouches down to pick up the scattered sheets. Her fingertips tremble so badly she can barely grasp them, her eyes locked on those harsh comments.

speaker: Poffy
content: I... I already tried my best to promote them...
Her voice sounds feeble, as if defending herself against the agent, but also against herself.

speaker: Manager
content: Tried your best? How many projects has the company set up for you? We've tried every single gimmick to get attention, and yet you're still getting crushed by that pretty girl from Hummingbird Entertainment!

speaker: Manager
content: How many times have I told you to lose weight?! People don't want to see another fat girl doing mukbang! Get any bigger and your career is over!
Those words seem to trigger something buried deep within Poffy. She whips around as if struck by a bolt of lightning, rushing toward the bathroom unsteadily.

speaker: Manager
content: Still running away? I don't know what I was thinking when I signed you! Once I'm done with my other tasks, I'll deal with you properly...
It isn't until the manager gets called away by the coordinator that your ears finally have some peace.
You follow Poffy, initially thinking she is just escaping from her manager's verbal abuse, but then you hear someone dry heaving in the bathroom.
[Scene transition, rest area]

When you arrive, Poffy keeps rinsing her hands in the basin. Even though her stomach has already been emptied, her body seems to be protesting habitually, forcing her to purge every last bit of what it deems excess.
Seeing you approach, she hastily wipes her face with the back of her hand, then buries her face in her palms and begins to cry with quiet, restrained sobs filled with anguish.
As if she's afraid of being heard, her sobs are so quiet they're nearly drowned out by the running water, yet they carry a suffocating despair.

speaker: Poffy
content: It should be a happy thing to have my stomach full... So why does it cause me so much pain now?

speaker: Poffy
content: I don't want to throw up, but my body's gotten used to it... I've always been a chubby girl, and back then everyone liked me... Why has it changed now...

speaker: Poffy
content: Why do I still have to lose weight even after I ran away from Mom? What am I supposed to do? I don't know anymore... Please tell me what to do... Chief...
You find yourself at a loss for words. All you can do is gently pat her on the back before leading her back to the makeup room to rest.
When the manager returns and catches the unpleasant smell lingering on Poffy, he pinches his nose disgustedly.

speaker: Manager
content: At least you figured out how to make yourself throw it all up.

speaker: Manager
content: We're shooting an eating contest next. We've fought hard for your spot, and your opponent is a skinny celebrity with a big appetite. If you want to win, you should keep your stomach empty now. The only way to gain views is by winning, got it?

speaker: Poffy
content: But I just threw everything up... That variety show takes hours to record. I'll go insane from hunger if I have to get through the whole thing on an empty stomach...
Poffy tries to explain, but the manager puts his hands on his hips and raises his voice.

speaker: Manager
content: How many times do I have to repeat myself? We need you to control your weight! Small-time streamers like you are a dime a dozen. You're lucky I even signed you!

speaker: Manager
content: I've given you plenty of opportunities and training, and helped you get exposure by putting you next to celebrities. And now you're getting picky with me?
Each cruel word crashes down on her like a blow. Poffy hangs her head and trembles, the gnawing emptiness in her stomach pushing her to the breaking point. You can feel her Mania stirring.

speaker: Poffy
content: No... I can't go hungry... I can't control it... I'll hurt people...

speaker: Poffy
content: I'll ruin everything!
The Mania in Poffy is fluctuating more vigorously, to the point you think that might be what's making the manager so cranky.

speaker: Poffy
content: I'm sorry... for being so useless, Mom...

speaker: Poffy
content: Why can't I just lose weight... It's all my fault... I shouldn't have...

speaker: Chief
content: Poffy? Calm down!
Poffy's face is shrouded in shadow, her gaze unfocused, her words becoming incoherent. You remember what Poffy said in the interrogation room...

speaker: Poffy
content: Once she's starved past a certain point, the big bad Poffy will go rogue! Whether it's cupcakes or people, they'll all become my food!

speaker: Poffy
content: What's even more terrifying is that I don't simply become insane. I also lose all memory of what's happened during an outburst!

speaker: Poffy
content: Ah!!
You grab Poffy's wrist and immediately use your shackles to stabilize her mind. She jolts sharply, then comes back to her senses.

speaker: Poffy
content: Chief...
She calls out to you softly. You gently stroke her head to comfort her, then turn toward the manager who's still berating Poffy.

speaker: Chief
content: Did your parents never teach you any manners when talking to people?

speaker: Manager
content: You...!

speaker: Chief
content: If you call this training, then talent managers are no different than livestock farmers.
The manager lets out a cold snort.

speaker: Manager
content: Poffy is one of the company's products, and unworthy products get replaced. That's just how the entertainment industry works.

speaker: Manager
content: All top celebrities are incredibly self-disciplined. Push yourself hard enough and become a superstar, then you get to be choosy with jobs.

speaker: Manager
content: Do you really think someone like her, who can't even control her own impulses, gets to haggle with me? Everything I do is for her own good.
Everything I do is for her own good. Hearing that familiar phrase, Poffy wraps her arms around herself, as if recalling some painful memories.
The manager leans in close to Poffy, flashing a malicious smile.

speaker: Manager
content: Of course, you could always give up and go home, as long as you can afford the price. I can sort out the paperwork for you right away. How about it?

speaker: Poffy
content: But... but you know full well I can't come up with that kind of money!

speaker: Manager
content: So you're actually not that dumb, huh? Then stop wasting time and get back to work!
The manager suddenly shoves Poffy hard. She bumps into you and cries out in pain. Ignoring her reaction, the manager orders you both to wait backstage before storming out and slamming the door.
The room falls quiet. Poffy sits on the floor with her knees drawn up to her chest, thanking you softly while that practiced smile still lingers at the corners of her mouth.

speaker: Poffy
content: Thank you for standing up for me, Chief.

speaker: Chief
content: You don't have to force yourself to smile.
The smile slowly fades from Poffy's face. She hugs her knees tighter and buries her head in them.

speaker: Chief
content: Rest up. You've been working non-stop all day. Even I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed from just watching.

speaker: Chief
content: Or... if you're feeling upset, we can talk. You won't be able to win the contest in this state of mind.
Her voice is barely a whisper, soft as a feather falling to the ground.

speaker: Poffy
content: I can talk about anything?

speaker: Chief
content: Of course. We can chat about your hobbies, your past, your dreams... anything you want.

speaker: Poffy
content: My dream... is just... to have my stomach full.
[Same Scene Transition]

speaker: Poffy
content: My parents separated when I was very young, so I lived with Mom.

speaker: Poffy
content: She was a career woman who worked long hours and always came home late. I would often go hungry, waiting all day for her to return.

speaker: Poffy
content: Even though we didn't have much money, Mom would gently coax me to sleep and protect me whenever Dad came to take me away.

speaker: Poffy
content: Then one day, a talent scout came to us and said I was cute enough to work as a child model and actor. I became the breadwinner, and Mom quit her job to work as my manager.

speaker: Poffy
content: But my fame didn't last long. As soon as I hit puberty, my body changed, and so did Mom.
[Flashback]

speaker: Mom
content: Nibella, the talent scout wanted you to stick to the slender beauty route. That way, you'll have countless modelling and commercial acting jobs lined up for you.

speaker: Mom
content: But look at you now. Your face, your arms, your legs... My god, you've become so chunky everywhere! Is this still my daughter?
[Flashback]

speaker: Mom
content: Did you really bite someone from the filming crew on set?

speaker: Mom
content: Do you have any idea how hard it was to get you a spot on a variety show? You can't sing, you can't act, your body's out of shape, and you're getting older. How do you expect to survive in showbiz like this?

speaker: Mom
content: The videos and photos of you biting someone have gone viral! Do you know what people are saying about you? That you were on drugs, that you've lost your mind! I spent a fortune hiring people to delete the posts, and I had to bribe the crew so they wouldn't press charges.

speaker: Nibella
content: Mom, I was just hungry and feeling dizzy... I can hold a press conference or do a stream to explain everything!

speaker: Mom
content: Who'd care? People are only interested in catchy headlines and gossip! Now shut your mouth and go back to school for a few months until this all dies down!
[Flashback]

speaker: Mom
content: Have you gone mad?! Have you not caused me enough trouble?! Too hungry so you hurt your classmates?! Can't you even control yourself?!

speaker: Mom
content: Now the school wants you to drop out to contain the fallout, and you can't return to showbiz either. The way I see it, you've completely ruined your life!

speaker: Nibella
content: ...Enough! Mom, do you think I did those things on purpose?

speaker: Nibella
content: If you hadn't left me alone at that filming location, if it wasn't for that shoot, I never would have...!

speaker: Nibella
content: No one in the crew cared about me. They dumped me in a place full of Corruptors. You have no idea how terrified I was! But what about you? You don't care about me either. You only care about squeezing more money out of them!

speaker: Nibella
content: Yes, I've gone mad, I'm a monster! I have rotting scars on my body that won't go away, I bite people, and when I get hungry, I lose my mind and hurt everyone around me! And I can't even remember what happened!

speaker: Nibella
content: You're the one who made me face that kind of danger alone. You're the one who turned me into a monster!
[End of Flashback]

speaker: Poffy
content: Later, Mom kicked me out, saying she didn't want to see me get captured by some strange organization for research.

speaker: Poffy
content: I didn't know how to survive on my own. All these years, Mom took care of everything. I barely went to school, and I was jobless and penniless... Without money, I couldn't even afford food. I had to find a job.

speaker: Poffy
content: That's when I discovered I could make money by streaming myself eating. It sounded like the perfect job!

speaker: Poffy
content: But... after I signed with the company, everything changed...
[Flashback]

speaker: Manager
content: Now that you've signed the contract, you have to do what we tell you. Viewers prefer slender girls. A little chubby might be okay, but never too fat. I've seen your old photos. You've got a pretty enough face. Don't waste your potential.

speaker: Manager
content: Poffy, your numbers have been absolutely terrible lately. Make sure you wear your waist trainer. When you're done with the stream, go throw it all up right away, got it? You need to stay nice and pretty if you want to make real money...

speaker: Manager
content: Trying to run again? Eastside is only so big, where do you think you can go? I don't care if you die from overeating today, you're still going to stream!
[End of Flashback]

speaker: Poffy
content: They made me act like I was happy, but how do you fake happiness? Viewers like girls who are chubby in a cute way, but who gets to decide what that even means?

speaker: Poffy
content: Life was hard. Work was hard. I didn't understand anything. I was just barely keeping my head above water through those years.

speaker: Poffy
content: I thought I had finally escaped Mom's control... I was so overjoyed that I willingly walked into another cage. It turns out... Mom's not the only person who can hold the keys to my cage.
Poffy smiles bitterly, her clenched fists trembling.

speaker: Poffy
content: It's terrifying to be on an empty stomach. Hunger feels like a nightmarish shadow that keeps tightening around me, until I can't break free, until I can't even move...

speaker: Poffy
content: But even eating my fill during streams is so painful... My body wants to throw it up reflexively. I worry that the fatter I get, the more people will reject me.

speaker: Poffy
content: The bigger my fear, the harder it becomes to control my power. Just like Mom and my manager said... what can I possibly achieve, if I can't even control myself?
You can almost see her as a small child, curled up hungry just like now, waiting for her mother to come home.

speaker: Chief
content: You left your mother because you were afraid of losing control of your power and hurting others, didn't you?

speaker: Chief
content: Those are never your intentions, and you can't control those thoughts. You don't want anyone to suffer because of your hunger and fear, so you gorge yourself, trying to suppress the Mania in your body...

speaker: Chief
content: You don't know what else to do, so jumping from one extreme to another becomes your way of solving problems, am I right?
Poffy is silent for a moment, then nods.

speaker: Chief
content: I see.
You have to teach her to listen to her own needs, not just what others demand of her and think of her. You need to help her take back control of her own life.

speaker: Chief
content: Neither binge eating nor making yourself throw up solves the problem. They might even hurt you more. Your Mania is connected to your mental state, so what you need to focus on right now is making peace with your own feelings.

speaker: Chief
content: It's not about handing control over to someone else who holds the keys, but taking them back into your own hands. Does that make sense to you?
Poffy looks completely bewildered, clearly not understanding a word.

speaker: Chief
content: Give me your snack bag.
She says okay softly and reluctantly hands over the small bag she's been clutching to her chest.
You deftly locate the pocket where she keeps her bubble gum and put a piece in her hand.

speaker: Chief
content: Go ahead, have it.

speaker: Poffy
content: Huh...? Oh, okay.
Poffy begins chewing the bubble gum. The sweet taste fills her mouth, sending signals straight to her brain. The fresh dopamine effectively soothes her, gradually pushing down the negative feelings.

speaker: Chief
content: Now, blow a bubble.

speaker: Poffy
content: Blow a bubble?
You nod.

speaker: Chief
content: And you can only stop when I say so.
Poffy doesn't understand any of this, but she trusts you.
The first time, you only let Poffy blow out one breath. She can't seem to hold a lot of air in her lungs, so the bubble bursts before it can even form properly.
The second time, you let Poffy take breaths and keep blowing continuously. The bubble grows enormous, but finally bursts with a loud pop, splattering gum all over her face.
Flustered, Poffy wipes her face, then confronts you huffily.

speaker: Poffy
content: Are you messing with me?!

speaker: Chief
content: What makes you think that?

speaker: Poffy
content: The first time, you made me blow a bubble with just one breath, but how was that even possible?

speaker: Poffy
content: And then you made me keep blowing and blowing until the bubble got too big and burst!

speaker: Chief
content: Exactly. For you, that's precisely the point.

speaker: Chief
content: Both food and your special power are dangerous to you. And anything you can't control feels like a bubble waiting to burst, filling you with fear.

speaker: Chief
content: When you're starving, you're like a bubble blown with just one breath, ready to burst at any moment. And when you can't stop eating, you're like a bubble that keeps being inflated, seemingly satisfied but when it finally pops, the one who gets hurt is really you.
Hearing the word burst, Poffy nervously covers her mouth and asks you in a small voice, the bubble gum still held between her teeth.

speaker: Poffy
content: So, so what should I do? It sounds like maybe blowing just one breath would still be better...

speaker: Chief
content: I'm not the one blowing the bubble. You are. I shouldn't be the one controlling the pace and pauses. It should be up to you.

speaker: Chief
content: It's okay if you don't understand it now. You'll figure it out through practice. This time, you decide when to stop.
Still a little confused, Poffy nods and unwraps a fresh piece of bubble gum. Slowly, gently, she blows another bubble.
This bubble doesn't keep growing larger, but instead moves with Poffy's breathing. Gently, it swells, and shrinks, then swells again in a repeating cycle, maintaining a delicate balance.

The girl's eyes widen as she stares at the bubble she's created. It's so small, so fragile, and yet so resilient. With each inhale and exhale, her appetite and fear seem firmly within her grasp, no longer impossible to face.

speaker: Poffy
content: Mmph mmm... mmph mmph! (Chief, I did it!)
[Scene Change]
Inside the studio, the shooting of the eating contest officially begins.
Poffy takes a deep breath and steps onto the stage decorated to look like a restaurant. She's already ravenous, but she still has to push through the lengthy games and advertising segments.

speaker: Host
content: Let's give it up for our contestant, rising streamer Poffy! Say hello to everyone!

speaker: Poffy
content: Ah... Hello everyone, I'm Poffy. I'm ready and I won't let my fans down!

She forces a smile, mustering what energy she can. As the lesser-known guest, she's assigned all the humiliating performances: getting splashed with water, making silly faces, and duck-walking in circles. Meanwhile, the big star only needs to look pretty and smile in front of the camera.
You watch Poffy with growing concern as she pants heavily, her face deathly pale from hunger, yet she stubbornly pinches her own thighs to keep her Mania from clouding her mind.

speaker: Poffy
content: Not yet... Still one more segment to go...

The host brings out a bunch of products for everyone to praise in creative ways, but Poffy's gaze instantly loses focus. In her eyes, the food looks like salvation itself, and she can't help but reach for it.

speaker: Poffy
content: I'm so hungry... I have to eat something...

The Mania within Poffy stirs restlessly, tempting her to surrender to her desires. But amid this turmoil, she suddenly feels a warm connection pulling her back from the precipice she is about to fall from.

speaker: Poffy
content: Ch... Chief...?
She instinctively looks down the stage, and amid the blurred crowd in the audience, she senses your presence with perfect clarity. Through the shackles, your spirit feels gentle yet unwavering.

speaker: Chief
content: Learn to control yourself instead of assuming I'm right and following me blindly just because I've offered a solution. Otherwise, you'll only turn me into that shadow hanging over your life after your mother and manager.

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, alright, don't look at me like that. I just want you to try handling it yourself first. If you've given it your best effort and still find it too difficult, then don't hesitate to ask me for help, okay?

speaker: Chief
content: Remember, you are not alone.
Under the spotlights, everyone is laughing and cheering, only you reach out in a silent language to ask her, isolated amid it all, if she needs help.
Poffy shakes her head determinedly.

speaker: Poffy
content: Chief, you've already helped me once. This time... I want to help myself.

speaker: Poffy
content: Breathe in... Breathe out... It's not that hard, you can do this...
She takes a few deep breaths, slowly sensing the Mania within her body. With each inhale and exhale, the madness and restlessness are being soothed and guided.

speaker: Poffy
content: Breathe in... Breathe out... From now on, let's be friends, okay?
One minute, three minutes, ten minutes... The Mania gradually settles down. The progress is slow, but steadily effective.
After many deep breaths, she unclenches her tight fists, revealing crimson nail marks clearly visible on her palms. The girl finally manages a weak but resolved smile.

speaker: Host
content: ...And now! Let the eating contest begin!
She's made it through. On her own, this time.
After the shooting is done, instead of heading straight back to the Bureau, you go to Poffy's little rented home.
In that warm little apartment filled with stuffed animals, Poffy cooks a full pot of steaming, fluffy rice.

speaker: Poffy
content: Go ahead, dig in! Promise I cook the best rice ever! Though it's pretty much the only thing I can cook...
Poffy hands you a spoon and dives into her own meal. Even though she just won the eating contest, she still seems ravenous, devouring even the plain white rice with gusto.

speaker: Poffy
content: Mmm!! After-work feasts are simply the best! I'm the happiest person in the world!
The inevitable result of consuming too much rice is that you both end up in a carb coma.
Poffy sits on the soft carpet in front of the couch, chattering away about what happened earlier.

speaker: Poffy
content: To be honest... I know that Mom was suffering too. She was having mental health issues, but she was too busy with me to see a doctor.

speaker: Poffy
content: Even though she kicked me out, she'd slipped a lot of cash in my suitcase, enough for me to live comfortably in Eastside for years... But I was stupid and got scammed by a shady rental agent, so the landlord kicked me out.

speaker: Poffy
content: When I was homeless, I met Lumy. Kind as she is, she found me a cheap place. There were even folks running around upstairs at night, so I didn't feel as scared being alone...

speaker: Chief
content: When you said folks, did you mean ghosts?!
Poffy ignores your shock, shoveling down a couple more spoonfuls of rice as she continues her story.

speaker: Poffy
content: Later, when the company started exploiting me but I couldn't afford the penalty to break my contract, Lumy was the one who told me I could ask the Bureau for help.

speaker: Poffy
content: At first, I was terrified that I'd get dragged off to some horrible place and locked up, like in the movies. But Lumy said you're really kind and that you'd definitely help me! She said you wouldn't leave a stray Sinner out there to be bullied!

speaker: Poffy
content: She said everyone in the Bureau is really nice, and that I'd make friends with other Sinners. Plus, the cafeteria has great food served with unlimited rice!

options: ...So you really just came to the Bureau to mooch free meals?

speaker: Poffy
content: You really are just as Lumy described! You're so kind, hic, the kindest person I've met!

Poffy beams, cupping her face in her hands. Her expression looks completely different than in the streaming studio. You see a beautiful smile that can stop people in their tracks, from genuine happiness radiating from within.

speaker: Poffy
content: Since you're so nice to me, I'll let you in on my secret.
Poffy turns on her streaming device and pulls up a group chat.

speaker: Poffy
content: Actually, when I first started streaming, I just wanted to share what I was eating every day. I never expected I'd end up making money out of it.

speaker: Poffy
content: My fan group only had about ten people at first... They watched my streams every day, talked to me on voice chats, recommended new restaurants for me to check out, and encouraged me to get sponsors...

speaker: Poffy
content: Later, someone from the talent agency reached out to me, so I signed with them. They started arranging my daily streaming content and the products for my mukbang videos, asked me to do gimmicky things, and signed me up for sponsorship deals I didn't even like.

speaker: Poffy
content: My numbers really did keep growing, but I couldn't tell who was real and who was fake anymore. I had no idea if they actually enjoyed watching my eating videos, or if they were just paid accounts.

speaker: Poffy
content: I didn't know if I could still feel genuinely happy eating all these weird foods. I had no idea who I was even trying to impress by acting happy.

speaker: Poffy
content: Then later... my small group of OG fans got drowned out in the crowd, and I never saw them again... But I've kept all the cute little fanarts they made of me! Saved in a cloud album where I can look at them anytime I want!

speaker: Poffy
content: This little seal is a profile pic one of my fans drew for me. Isn't it adorable? I sewed the little seal onto my clothes, so it's like they're still with me...
As Poffy continues, she suddenly looks gloomy again.

speaker: Poffy
content: If... if they saw me eating all this gross food and giving fake praise that goes against everything I believe... they'd be so disappointed in me, wouldn't they? Poffy is no longer that girl they used to like. They're never coming back...
After such an exhausting day, little Poffy slowly drifts off to sleep while murmuring to herself softly.
She lies on the living room couch as the sky begins brightening up. In just a little while, fresh morning sunlight will pour through the windows, illuminating her sleeping face.

You cover Poffy with a thin blanket, your gaze passing over that fan group with only a dozen members. The chat history shows fewer and fewer messages over time, and only Poffy's profile picture is still active.
You move to a quiet corner to make a phone call.

speaker: Chief
content: I've gathered all the evidence. We can start preparing.
[Scene Change]
One month later
The kettle lets out a sharp whistle, and you quickly grab it to pour hot water into your cup noodles. Three minutes later, slurping instant noodles, you watch Poffy's stream replay.
The stream title reads: Celebrating Poffy's 100 Followers! ^^
A month ago, soon after you made that phone call at Poffy's place, you received a reply from Mr. Fox.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: I've made some interesting discoveries. While they're not enough to completely destroy that MCN company, we could easily use them to free that innocent girl from their grasp.

speaker: Mr. Fox
content: Of course, she'll still need to pay a portion of the liquidated damages, and she'll lose access to her account. However, they'll also need to compensate Miss Poffy for emotional damages.

Mr. Fox's good news brought great relief, but you didn't tell Poffy immediately. Instead, you waited until everything was nearly finalized before bringing her back to the MCN building for a meeting with the executives.
Poffy didn't disappoint you. Faced with those people, she suddenly found her backbone.

speaker: Poffy
content: You are all horrible liars! I'm not the only one you've tricked into signing these contracts!

speaker: Poffy
content: I'm the only thing you're losing this time. But next time, and next next time, I hope you lose everything you've stolen from others with your dirty schemes!

speaker: Manager
content: You...!
The manager's raised arm made Poffy instinctively duck behind you. But you weren't disappointed by this show of fear. Quite the opposite, you felt deeply reassured.
You see? Poffy took your advice. When you need help, just ask. You're not alone in this world.
Perhaps because the weight of debt was lifted off her shoulders, the newly freed Poffy smiled exceptionally happily that day.
With Mr. Fox's help, Poffy terminated her contract with MCN and gave up her account.
She started a new account that was entirely her own. In her spare time, she actively participated in special power training at the Bureau while undergoing routine examinations.

After the final examination report came in, Poffy qualified for home supervision and was released from the Bureau. She now only needs to check in periodically and report her location and health condition.
But just thinking about the white rice party she threw in the cafeteria on her last day makes your stomach feel heavy...
Knock, knock. Someone knocks on the office door, and you scramble to close the replay video.
Poffy pushes open the door and bounces over to you, shoving aside your half-eaten cup of instant noodles with sausage and filling your view with two large bags of food.

speaker: Poffy
content: Instant noodles? That's so unhealthy!

speaker: Poffy
content: These are all treats my sponsors sent me, and I brought them especially for you! Chewy octopus legs and new desserts!

speaker: Poffy
content: Hehe, I've got good news! My top fan said they want to send me a congratulatory gift for hitting 100 followers!
Poffy beams with a radiant smile, her eyes sparkling as she looks at you. You avert your gaze and rub your hands together unnaturally.

speaker: Poffy
content: But too bad they'll have to pay for shipping to send the gift. I want to save my fan a few dimes, so I rushed right over after my stream ended!
Poffy spreads her palm and holds it in front of you, grinning mischievously.

speaker: Poffy
content: So, my number one fan, where's my gift? Come on, hand it over!

speaker: Chief
content: ...I thought I hid it well.
You mutter under your breath and reluctantly pull out your personal device, navigating to the video gallery before handing it to Poffy.

speaker: Poffy
content: A video? It's titled... A Challenge Invitation to Miss Poffy?

speaker: Poffy
content: Chief, I had no idea you knew how to edit videos! Did you actually make this yourself?

speaker: Chief
content: Go ahead and play it. I think you'll really like it.

speaker: Poffy
content: You're hyping it up so much I'm actually getting nervous... Honestly.
Poffy pats her chest lightly to manage her expectations before solemnly pressing the play button with her index finger.
On screen, encouraging messages scroll by alongside familiar usernames and profile pictures. Poffy's eyes fill with tears.

speaker: Poffy
content: You... you found them!
Then, a girl she's never seen before appears on screen, holding a tiny seal ornament in her hands. The moment her voice comes through, Poffy recognizes her.

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: Poffy? Of course I remember her! You know that little seal avatar she's been using this whole time? I drew it! Isn't it so cute?

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: Actually, Poffy and I are very different. When I see food, no matter how delicious it looks, I just can't bring myself to eat it.

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: I'm so thin. It's not attractive or healthy at all. But everyone says they envy how skinny I am, that I never have to worry about gaining weight... But deep down... I'm envious of Poffy, who enjoys food so much.

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: I could tell that after signing with the company, Poffy was being forced to diet in extreme ways to maintain her figure. Did I guess right? So many times I noticed she looked really unwell, but I didn't know how to reach out to her, so I drew that little seal instead.

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: I wanted her to see that chubby, mochi-like little seal and know that it is healthy and cute in its own way. To me, Poffy is that little seal. She has the perfect body shape as long as she's healthy. It's the sweet, soft Poffy that I've always adored.

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: Poffy's mukbang videos are the only thing that stimulates my appetite... In a way, Poffy has saved my life.

speaker: Overweight Fan
content: Well... You see, I'm fat.

speaker: Overweight Fan
content: I used to have really low self-esteem. I, I also stutter a little when I talk, so I never really had any friends.

speaker: Overweight Fan
content: But one day, I saw Poffy eating. S-she was so confident, and she loved food, just like me. But she wasn't ashamed of it, which was r-really good. Because of her, I started learning to accept myself too.

speaker: Overweight Fan
content: Poffy taught me that being fat was n-never something to be ashamed of.

speaker: Angry Fan
content: Hehe, just like Poffy, when I'm hungry, I start losing my temper. When it gets really bad, I even end up hurting others. But amazingly, whenever I watch Poffy's eating streams, it always helps calm me down.

speaker: Angry Fan
content: I kept coming back to her videos. After watching so many, one day I suddenly realized I was learning to control my temper, and hunger was no longer so frightening.

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: I came to understand that eating both too much and too little are unhealthy.

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: It must have taken a lot of courage to terminate your contract with the company and start a new life. I can see you're trying to change for the better! So I'll keep working hard too.

speaker: Little Seal Fan
content: I hope that one day, we can all confidently tell ourselves: We're finally in control of our own bodies, and look how healthy and happy we are!

speaker: Overweight Fan
content: To be honest, I still don't like my chubby appearance, b-but I just can't bring myself to commit to losing weight. It's just so hard... Now that I'm seeing you again and witnessing how you're starting a new life, you've given me a lot of strength to improve as well.

speaker: Overweight Fan
content: This time, I-I will be like you. I won't run away from my true thoughts anymore. I m-might never become conventionally fit, but I want to be pretty like you!

speaker: Overweight Fan
content: Let's work hard together! I'll catch up to you soon!

speaker: Angry Fan
content: To tell you the truth, when you were doing those weird mukbang streams, I posted many mean comments mocking you. I thought you were just doing that for attention. It was so lame.

speaker: Angry Fan
content: But you're different now. Actually, no. I should say you look just like yourself when you first started streaming.

speaker: Angry Fan
