A faint smile graces her face. She's likely already aware of those eyes on her back, yet she doesn't acknowledge it. Instead, she pretends not to notice, quietly watching some children play in the courtyard outside while continuing to fill out remittance forms at the counter.
As her pen glides over the paper, bright light filters in.
Golden sunlight falls upon her shoulders, just as it once did on the swing on that dorm balcony, all those years ago.
You push the door to the interrogation room and find the survivor of the crypt sitting on a chair. She is fiddling with her handcuffs while trying to get a good look at the papers on your desk.
One of the handcuffs had long been removed by her.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Come on, take it easy! Roulecca didn't do anything, Roulecca just wanted to take a look around!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Maybe I'm just too lucky? This handcuff just came off by itself!
The fact that the Sinner restraint falls off for no apparent reason makes you on alert.
You prepare to use shackles to prevent Roulecca from turning against you.
But she shows no fluctuation in her emotions and does not activate her ability.
She just looks at you, curious and excited.
Exactly the same as the young face you saw in the profile photo before entering the interrogation room.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, please be fully prepared for this interrogation.
Why?
You put down her profile and asked.
She doesn't seem like a particularly dangerous Sinner.

speaker: Nightingale
content: I've investigated Roulecca and found how "baffling" her ability was.
Nightingale hands the files to you.
On **/**/****, Roulecca played roulette at x Casino in Eastside for 3 hours and won 13 million DisCoins. She also fought off the gangsters who came to give her trouble with only a revolver.
On XX/XX/XXXX, Roulecca planned an explosion at the x block in Syndicate after winning a roulette game. Roulecca was less than five meters away from the root of the explosion but came out unharmed.
On **/**/****, Roulecca's gang, Four-leaf Clover, was wiped out in a sneak attack from other gangs. Roulecca was the only survivor.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Indeed. The FAC's follow-up investigation confirmed that luck was her special ability as a Sinner.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Her combat skills are excellent, and she never minds risking her life in fighting. There is a high probability that she is the "mastermind" behind the crypt incident.
The word "roulette" appearing so frequently in the files catches your attention.
Is this roulette... something she does for fun?

speaker: Nightingale
content: It's a life-risking game. Sometimes, instead of killing her enemies, she'd let them play weird games with her. And such games usually include the use of a revolver.
Did the FAC give any guidelines about safety?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Be 100% prepared against her abilities.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hey, Chief? Chief! How come you froze there just now? Were you fascinated by Roulecca?

speaker: Roulecca
content: We're just going to play a game. There's no need to be that nervous.

options: What about the info you're going to tell?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Yep! Hmm, let's play... Truth or Dare!

speaker: Roulecca
content: You know, the kind of game where the winner can ask the other person a question.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Have you played it before, Chief?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Oh, I forgot to tell you, Chief. You'll have to win Roulecca to make me admit defeat with grace.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Only then will you get the information from Roulecca.
What are we playing?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmm, Roulecca is thinking... How about Truth or Dare? Have you played it before, Chief?
I have, but only a few times.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ah, that's perfect! But don't think you can win Roulecca just because you've played it before, Chief! There will be a few changes to the rules this time!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ah, I guess you don't have many friends, Chief. Don't worry, though. Roulecca will play with you this time.

speaker: Roulecca
content: But compared to the standard Truth or Dare, there will be a few more rules!
Roulecca suddenly shows a sly smile. You instinctively feel that it isn't going to be as simple as "a few."

speaker: Roulecca
content: Find a revolver, just like the ones I usually use. The gun has six bullet slots but you'll put only one bullet in it.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Then we'll take turns shooting ourselves in the head until we hear a bang.

speaker: Roulecca
content: The winner will be decided when one of us gives up or dies. Really old-school game. Roulecca likes it a lot.

options: Is this really Truth or Dare?
Are you sure this isn't some other game?

content: This is exactly the "roulette game" mentioned in the files!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Oh, Chief! It's just Truth or Dare with a little flavor added to it!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Of course, for every shot, the person who shoots will have the privilege of asking one question. No matter what it is, the other person must answer!
Any kind of question?

speaker: Roulecca
content: No matter how private your question is, Chief, Roulecca will answer you truthfully.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I mean, Chief, you were able to catch Roulecca, so maybe you have better luck. Perhaps...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Perhaps you will be able to live and ask all your questions, then finally shoot Roulecca dead in the interrogation room! Ohhhh, this sounds so exciting!
Given her luck, you're afraid that you will die if you play with her.
But fortunately, you took Nightingale's advice and are well-prepared for this game.
So you decide that...
Alright, let's do it.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Yay! Roulecca knew that Chief is the best! Let's get started right away!
But you must stay true to your words. Promise?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Of course! Roulecca always keeps promises! But don't you try to play any tricks, Chief.
After a brief wait, the gun requested by Roulecca is delivered to the interrogation room.
You hand the pistol to Roulecca for inspection.
test
test
test
test
test
test

speaker: Roulecca
content: Wow, so quickly.
She turns over the revolver several times before giving it a final spin. Satisfied, she puts the revolver back in your hand.
You open the cylinder and insert a single bullet.
The cylinder spins with a clicking sound, making you look like a cowboy from centuries prior. Roulecca even whistles at you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Not bad, Chief! But don't forget to stay away from me when the time comes.

speaker: Roulecca
content: The firepower of a .45 is very powerful, and it could pose a problem if you get my clothes stained... Hehe.
Roulecca is arrogant and provocative. Yet she has her asset to be so.
Who's going to fire first?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Do you want to flip a coin to decide who shoots first, Chief? Or, I don't mind if you want to go first.
Roulecca takes a DisCoin out of nowhere.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Alright... This is Roulecca's 33rd favorite game! Hmm, let's go with heads for Roulecca first and tails for Chief first.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmm... I think a new player deserves more chances. Why don't you go first, Chief?
No need to go easy on me. Let's begin.
Roulecca shakes her head and tosses the coin into the air.
It spins several times before bouncing off the table with a clinking sound. When you almost think it'll end up with heads, it bizarrely turns over in the last second.
It's tails. You repeatedly check under the desk for things like magnets but find nothing.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I told you! Nobody can beat Roulecca's luck! Fire the shot, Chief!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmm, fine. Since it was your first time playing, Chief, Roulecca was going to go easy on you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: But I never thought you would be so impatient...
It is said that the brave will be favored by the god of luck.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Haha, yes, Roulecca has heard of that saying. But it's merely the boasting of those who survived.

speaker: Roulecca
content: The unlucky "brave" end up being corpses that cannot speak anymore.
The cold muzzle is pushed against the temple. You may be well-prepared, but you still feel a sense of discomfort.
(Clack)
The cylinder lets out an empty sound. A miss. You can hear Roulecca applauding from the other side.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Wow, amazing! Roulecca was worried you would be out in the first round, Chief but you're awesome!
It does not sound like a compliment, but you pay no mind to it and ask your first question.

options: Why were you in the crypt?

content: To resolve the problem in the quickest manner and reduce risk, you ask the most important question first.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmm, why do you start with such a difficult question?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Let's make this question your reward for winning the whole thing, okay? Roulecca will allow you to change your question, Chief!
Roulecca seems to be avoiding your question deliberately. Looks like she is also prepared.

options: So what else do you know about the crypt?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmm, this is also quite direct, Chief... But to show that Roulecca is a woman of her word, I will answer your question this time!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Let Roulecca think for a bit...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Oh, right! Roulecca had just finished eating dinner and was strolling there. And then, Roulecca suddenly heard gunshots coming out of that crypt-like place.

speaker: Roulecca
content: When I was about to go down, I saw a group of people from the Legion coming out, so I hid away at once. I thought I could enter when they were gone. And then... then Roulecca ran into you, Chief!
That's it?
Do you really not know anything apart from that? Like what was inside this crypt?

speaker: Roulecca
content: No idea! It really was the first time Roulecca went there!
Strange. Intel suggests she is related to the organization in the crypt. However, she doesn't seem to be lying as she does not know about the mania weapons underground or the coffin.
In that case, she should not be the commander of those underground gangsters. If she were, how could she be so laid-back after losing so many men and weapons?
But you don't dare to assume anything and decide to ask for more details.
So you are affiliated with...

speaker: Roulecca
content: No, Chief. Only the winner can continue asking questions. Besides... Roulecca has a lot to ask you, Chief.
Without waiting for you to return the pistol, she makes an effort to lean forward. She takes the pistol, points it at her temple, and pulls the trigger.
Naturally, nothing happens. But she does not give you back the pistol right away.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Now, it's your turn to answer Roulecca's question, Chief. What exactly happened in the crypt?
They were seeking the mania weapons underground but could not withstand the contamination and became monsters.
So we wiped them out, nice and simple.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hahahahaha... Hahahah!

speaker: Roulecca
content: That's so funny! Hahahah... They were so lame, right, Chief?
Roulecca laughs happily.
They got what was coming to them.

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...Okay.

speaker: Roulecca
content: It's your turn, Chief. Make sure you play a couple more rounds.
It may be a misperception, but you sense a hint of loneliness in her words. You do not respond and take the pistol she hands over.
You pull the trigger. (Click)
Another miss. It's time to ask another question.

options: What organization are you affiliated with?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Umm, Four-leaf Clover, I guess.
Not The Homeless?

speaker: Roulecca
content: I see myself as the leader of Four-leaf Clover rather than that of The Homeless.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test
Do you really think one person can be considered a gang?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Whoa, you sure did your homework! You even know Roulecca is the only member left in Four-leaf Clover!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Let me guess... Is this interrogation room also specially prepared for Roulecca?
Sorry, but this is necessary for security reasons.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Sigh... It takes me back. Back then, Roulecca always got into trouble, be it blowing up the wall or tearing down the door. So Dad had to change everything at home to ones made of iron.
Didn't anyone in the gang hate you for this?

speaker: Roulecca
content: This should've been considered a question. However, Roulecca really like it, so this will be a freebie.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Nobody in Four-leaf Clover hated Roulecca! Growing up, Roulecca has always been loved by everyone in the gang. Even if made any trouble, I'd just need to pout to get away with it.

speaker: Roulecca
content: By the way, let me tell you a SUPER IMPORTANT piece of information!
I'm all ears.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Guess what? Roulecca's ability came from being spoiled by everyone!

options: Feels a bit more creative than a fairy tale.

speaker: Roulecca
content: What?! How cold! Roulecca's getting angry! Hand over the gun!
She takes the pistol and points it at herself before fiercely pulling the trigger.
(Clack)
Just like before, nothing happened.

speaker: Roulecca
content: It's Roulecca's turn to ask a question. Where did the mania weapons come from?
Now you're certain that she's not the leader of the gangs in the crypt, but she is curious to know more about the gangs.
Is there something going on between her and the gangsters?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Cat got your tongue, Chief? Is this question too difficult?
The crypt was the depot that stored the mania weapons, which lured in the gangsters.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Oh? Roulecca has never heard of any gangs selling mania weapons. Can you tell Roulecca who sold them to the gangsters?
It doesn't matter who sold them.
Everything was destroyed by the Legion, Everything—the gangsters or the Mania weapons—was destroyed by the Legion.
The Legion has saved the Syndicate and everything has been drawn to a close.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Legion... it's the Legion again.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Sigh... Always one step behind. How unfortunate.
Roulecca slowly sighs and looks unsatisfied with your answer.
But when looking over at the revolver, she starts to smile excitedly again. She slowly raises the gun towards you as if she is handing it to you or about to shoot you.
You silently take the gun and point it against your temple.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Roulecca bursts into laughter.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Never thought there would be a dummy like you. The fifth shot, huh... It's the first time I was this satisfied! I really like you, Chief. You're the best!

speaker: Roulecca
content: So, just shoot at your shoulder or somewhere else. Roulecca does not want to see your brains.

speaker: Roulecca
content: After all, you're the only one who has played with me for this long.
You smile at her. You are not afraid because you have already done the preparations.
The revolver is real, but you doctored the bullets. Nobody will get hurt.
You have tricked Roulecca, though playing a game of luck against someone like her could not be considered fair in the first place.
Everything is for the sake of the truth. She's clearly also trying to get some kind of information out of you. You might as well impress her.
No need. To play a game, you must be able to afford to lose.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Really?

speaker: Roulecca
content: What a shame...
Roulecca looks at you with a smile while slamming her right hand against her chair. You hear the sound of something being unlocked.
She leisurely leans down and pulls out an identical revolver from under the chair.
While you are dumbfounded, she fires four shots in a row towards the air. On the fifth, the barrel pops out a bunch of colorful glitter that slowly flutters to the ground.
The gun in her hand is the one that was doctored.
So, how about the gun in your hand?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Watch out. The gun in your hand has real bullets.
Just how did this unpredictable girl bring a real gun into the interrogation room? When did she swap the guns?
A fifty percent chance that the .45 round will blow out your skull and turn your brain into mush. And your opponent is a crazy gambler with sheer luck.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Now you finally look like you're nervous, Chief. Although your acting was quite good, it lacked a little bit of oomph.
A drop of cold sweat slides down your spine. Is there really a need to continue?
(Clack )
The moment you hear the trigger snap into the cylinder, your heart stops for a moment.
It's empty.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Haha... hahahaha, hahahahahahaha! Interesting, how interesting!

speaker: Roulecca
content: This is the first time someone has beaten me. Is it because of those shackles?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ahhh, it doesn't matter. A win is a win. Roulecca admits defeat!

speaker: Roulecca
content: This time, Roulecca is answering the question that you asked at the beginning, Chief!
I concede. People are dying every day in the DisCity but it shouldn't be me nor you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Tsk, boring! We were so close to the end!
You place the pistol on the desk, intending to ask the guards to take this weapon away.
The moment you look up, you find Roulecca picking up the gun.

speaker: Roulecca
content: If you can't make up your mind, Chief, then Roulecca shall decide for you!
(Clack )
Before you can react, you hear the sound of the trigger snap into the cylinder.
Luckily, it was an empty shot.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Haha... hahahaha, hahahahahahaha! Interesting, how interesting!

speaker: Roulecca
content: This is the first time someone has won against Roulecca! The gun... It, it didn't fire!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Roulecca admits defeat. Now, the very first question you asked, Chief.

speaker: Roulecca
content: But before answering, you need to answer one little question.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Did you already guess why Roulecca was there, Chief?
All I know is that you have no relation with the gangs and are not their leader.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmph, you say you don't know but you've already guessed pretty much everything.

speaker: Roulecca
content: However, you did not get the most important thing right.
You and they crossed paths but that doesn't mean it must be a mutual trading relationship. Besides, you and the Legion have the same objectives.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Oh, you're so clever, Chief!

speaker: Roulecca
content: But there's something you didn't guess right. Not only will Roulecca destroy them, but there's also something really important Roulecca needs to do.
What is it?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Roulecca will let them say it themselves: who exactly is behind them!

speaker: Roulecca
content: After that, I will personally deliver bullets into their heads one by one, and blow out their brains with a "bang!"

speaker: Roulecca
content: I will take revenge with my own hands!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hahahahah... Don't you think it's a little too late for that, Chief?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Didn't you desperately get me to sit here to find out about the group behind the gangs?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Our interests are aligned. Now, I just need you to be honest with me, Chief. After that, I'll help you deal with your crap so you can just relax in your office, sip some tea or read your documents!
The game is already over. That was the fifth bullet. The next one will be a live round.
Let's stop here.

speaker: Roulecca
content: No... the game is not over yet, Chief. If Roulecca wins, you have to tell me everything you know!
What are you doing?!

speaker: Roulecca
content: I have never failed before, not in the past and definitely not now!
She turns the gun around and points it at herself.
She pulls the trigger.

Everything happens in a flash. You have no time to think, except to instinctively lunge forward to grab the gun. You "failed" but it's not so much of a failure. The bullet explodes in the cylinder, and Roulecca is grazed by the broken metal, her hands covered with blood. The alarm in the Bureau goes off.
She does have strong luck. As long as she plans on living, nothing can kill her off.
Unlike her, you get up from the floor with difficulty, the name lists on the table scattered everywhere.
Those are name lists of Black Water members. They have had contact with the gangs in the crypt that you are closely watching.
Her face is pale from the blood loss and pain, but her eyes do not move away from the lists. Her smile becomes the most unsettling at this moment.
Roulecca ignores her hand injury and, despite the blood dripping, she is able to find the list she wants from the pile.

speaker: Roulecca
content: This is what you saw in the crypt the other day, eh?
You marvel at Roulecca's memory. She remembers it so clearly despite only seeing it once.
If you're not mistaken, her objective today is this name list.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Sigh... This wouldn't have happened if you had given me the names, Chief.
They are just suspicious. Don't do anything silly.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Oh, they're suspicious? That means one of them must have sold weapons to the Syndicate gangs, right?
You cannot deny it. During this stalemate, the sound of a break-in comes from the door.
The door to the interrogation room is urgently opened from the outside. Operatives swarm in, pointing their guns at Roulecca to prevent her from making any further moves.
She is injured and doesn't pose a threat for now. Let the EMTs come in.
The EMTs then put Roulecca onto a stretcher.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Let's meet again in Syndicate, Chief.
Roulecca waves her bloodied hand at you while being carried out of the interrogation room by the EMTs.
Sorry, but I cannot play such dangerous games with you. Are there any substitute games?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ugh, you're boring. Roulecca was in such a good mood until someone named ${PlayerName} broke her heart.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Well, never mind. It just so happens that I have other things to do.
You feel an unfamiliar chill coming. From within her smiling eyes is an out-of-control madness.
From the silent interrogation room comes a regular ticking sound.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hehe, since you refused, I'll have to find some fun on my own.
Roulecca taps on the back of the chair with her left hand as if giving a signal.
You quickly try to open the control panel in the interrogation room, but a blast of air sends you tumbling on the ground.
Bang—
The wall of the interrogation room explodes from behind you and all the alarms go off. You do not understand why the Hypercube-reinforced wall is blown up so easily by Roulecca.
Nor do you understand why she did this.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Don't think too much of it, Chief! Losing to the invincible Roulecca is nothing to be ashamed of!
Despite being splattered by the debris, Roulecca is in high spirits. She proudly waves the material you had on the table and leaps down from the hole in the wall.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Goodbye, Chief. Next time we meet, you've got to entertain me more.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, we've captured three target signals. Please use your shackles to locate the Sinner.
Got it.
Though you've reinforced Roulecca's confinement room immediately after the interrogation, you failed to stop the gang girl with that name list of Mania weapon distributors.
At around 3 a.m. the next morning, you wake up with a loud explosion, which, according to the surveillance system, came from Roulecca's room.
Sinners in neighboring rooms declare that they heard a strange countdown that night. Roulecca is always up to odd things, but this time you didn't expect it to be a bomb.
When you arrive, the room is empty, and the Hypercube-reinforced walls have been blown open a big hole.
So Hecate and you head to the slums of the Syndicate to find trails of Roulecca.
After arriving, you realize there is no need to track her.
Roulecca is simply following your name list to exact revenge on those gang members.
Hecate, report on the situation.

speaker: Hecate
content: Evan Kansin, who was hiding in area S21-B, is confirmed dead. His face is disfigured, so we had to confirm his identity via DNA comparison.
Cause of death?

speaker: Hecate
content: Preliminary speculation is that he was killed by a bomb detonated at close range.
Any witnesses at the scene?

speaker: Hecate
content: Yes, they have all been evacuated to the east gate. Incidentally, someone mentioned hearing suspicious sounds at the scene.
Let's go to the evacuation site.
On arrival at the evacuation site, you find it filled with gangsters who cannot stop shivering.
Many are covering their eyes with their hands possibly because they don't want to see you... or what's in front of them. Only one of them is muttering.

speaker: Gangster
content: T-there was a lunatic!

speaker: Gangster
content: The kind with a... with a... death wish! Lunatic!
In the distance comes a gunshot which sounds like a revolver. This is followed by sounds of gunfire with two to three muffled sounds of explosions.

speaker: Gangster
content: Ahhhhhhh! Save me! D-don't kill me!
Calm down, she's not here anymore.

speaker: Gangster
content: Ahhh... t-thank god...
What happened here?

speaker: Gangster
content: A w-woman came here. I thought she was one of those chicks, s-so we let her in to let the boss e-enjoy.

speaker: Gangster
content: Right after seeing the boss, she pulled out a bomb and stuffed it in his mouth!

speaker: Gangster
content: S-she put all our weapons away into that depot.
What's the deal with the suspicious sounds nearby?
Ever since approaching the evacuation site and the depot, you have been able to hear a strange ticking sound.
The man opens his mouth as if wanting to speak.

speaker: Gangster
content: Blegh...
He pukes directly in front of you, perhaps due to the shock and not being able to take all of it in at once. You decide not to pursue further and leave this place.
Evan Kansin is the fourth from the bottom in the 20-people list.
In just one day, Roulecca used her strong luck to take revenge on the gang members.
She attacked them with all kinds of dangerous means since she knew her strong luck would always protect her.
You are unable to catch up to Roulecca and can only pick up after the fiery aftermath.
This cannot go on. Through your shackles, you confirm that Roulecca's signal is extremely weak, meaning she is barely alive.
She's in critical condition. You have to beat her to the next target.
Another battle has already started and you decide to rush there immediately. If you are quick enough, perhaps you will be able to stop Roulecca.
Let's hurry to area S22-A. There are traces of Roulecca there.

speaker: Hecate
content: Copy that.
Hecate nods and follows you.
That weird sound, however, persists until the moment you decide to leave.

speaker: Hecate
content: It sounds like a countdown for something, Chief.
A countdown? This reminds you of the blown-open wall in the Bureau.
A few seconds after you give out the command, the countdown sound abruptly stops.
Hecate, get ready!
Boom!!!
The nearby depot suddenly explodes violently. Even someone as powerful as Hecate is unable to shield you completely.
The explosion pierces through the wings of the Nightmare and sends you flying.

speaker: Hecate
content: Chief... Chief?

speaker: Hecate
content: Thank God, you're alright.
You don't know how long had passed before you finally regained consciousness. The first person you see is Hecate.
How long have I been unconscious?

speaker: Hecate
content: Hmm, can't say I've heard the codename before, but then again, that doesn't mean much in our line of work. The name I just gave you isn't the one I was born with, either.
How's S22-A?

speaker: Hecate
content: It's silent again, so... probably the fighting has ended. We need to proceed to the next area to intercept Roulecca.
You nod and try to get through to Nightingale, only to find that the base stations here have been knocked out of service.
To add insult to injury, your shackle abilities will not be available again for a while due to the blackout.
You are unable to determine whether Roulecca is dead or alive, nor do you have any means to locate her.

options: We need to gamble on this.

content: Hecate tilts her head slightly, showing that she doesn't understand what you mean.
We have to secure at least one informant. We'd better split up and go to different areas.
You glance over the Mania weapons burning inside the depot that just exploded.
If you encounter Roulecca, please try your best to protect the informant.

speaker: Hecate
content: What about you, Chief?
I'll try to negotiate with her. Come to me immediately after you've protected the informant. I'm not gonna die... I think.
I'll head to area S24 and you to S23. Be quick... or we might lose our informant.

speaker: Hecate
content: Copy that. Chief, please be extremely careful.
You make your way to S24 and can already hear gunfire as you approach the area.
It's Roulecca.
Just as you take cover, a bloodied man crawls past you.
He seems to notice you and reaches out his hand for help. However, a foot is immediately planted on his chest, stopping him.

speaker: Roulecca
content: You're... Glenn, right? Not bad, you were able to give me a few surprises and make me bleed a lot.

speaker: Glenn
content: Cough... Save... S-spare me...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Spare you? Why should I spare you?!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Do you remember my face? Remember what you did to the members of Four-leaf Clover?

speaker: Glenn
content: I... haven't been to this Four-leaf Clover... Cough...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hahaha, interesting, how interesting! Even on the verge of death, you're still making excuses!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Oops... that might make sense, though. You've destroyed far too many gangs. How could you possibly remember the insignificant gang with only a few dozens of people?

speaker: Glenn
content: I... Ugh...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Every single one of you bastards must die by my gun!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Also these Mania weapons! Roulecca will destroy them all!

speaker: Glenn
content: You lunatic...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hahahaha! Congratulations, you finally found out that I'm a lunatic!

speaker: Roulecca
content: But you're going to have to keep that secret with you in hell.
Roulecca lifts her arm covered in scars.

speaker: Glenn
content: No, no... you're, you're not a lunatic...
Bang.
The gunshot is brief and dull.
Roulecca walks aimlessly forward towards area S23.
You want to come out and stop her as she has obviously exhausted herself.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hey... Chief. Stop hiding, you're not as good as my family at this.

speaker: Roulecca
content: You should've seen enough, right? How was that? Roulecca used really cool lines on purpose.
You can barely stand.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Oh, believe me, this is nothing.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I've seen worse. A bullet once pierced my lung and even then, I did not die.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Heheh, how's that? Aren't I amazing? I can do anything for the sake of my family!
Looking at Roulecca's blood-red eyes, you understand that she has lost her mind to revenge. Anyone related to those gangs is her enemy.

options: Your family wouldn't want to see you become like this.

content: You've long been consumed by revenge. You're only filling up your empty heart with constant revenge.
But revenge has no end. If one person is killed, there will be others to avenge them.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Haha.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hahahaha...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Turns out you don't understand anything, Chief.
Roulecca suddenly lets out wild laughter.

speaker: Roulecca
content: You actually think that Roulecca likes using her strong luck to take revenge on those she dislikes, right?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Alright, alright... Let me tell you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Exactly twelve years ago, something big happened.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Four-leaf Clover was destroyed, leaving Roulecca alone.

speaker: Roulecca
content: And... so luckily, I became a Sinner.

speaker: Roulecca
content: It's not because I killed someone but because I saw my family and the gang members who treated me like family...

speaker: Roulecca
content: ...die in front of me one by one... only to protect me. That was what made me a Sinner!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Dad, Uncle Jack, Aunt Popper...

speaker: Roulecca
content: The Four-leaf Clover's leaves... fell one by one on my body.

speaker: Roulecca
content: They used their own body to cover me.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Did you know, Chief?!

speaker: Roulecca
content: My luck is my most precious treasure...

speaker: Roulecca
content: Those who make Mania weapons, those gangs... I will kill every last one of them even if it means death to me!

options: Hecate is already dealing with the other side.

speaker: Roulecca
content: So what? You can try to stop me with your shackles all you want. Yet... you have no way of making me stop.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Unless my heart, very luckily, stops beating.
She sheds tears in front of you for the first time.
You finally understand that she is not taking revenge for the sake of duty, but because she lost everything.
Revenge will be her responsibility as long as her strong luck can protect her.
Even if you restrain her with the shackles, you have no way of saving her heart.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I have nothing left now.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Just let me continue my final revenge... hahaha...
Roulecca leaves you behind and limps forward.

speaker: Gangster
content: I will... avenge my comrades!
A gas bomb is thrown towards Roulecca, bouncing.

speaker: Roulecca
content: You... you... gang scums! Cough... Cough cough...
She notices it but her battered body does not allow her to react.
She staggers through the smoke as if about to be overwhelmed by the poisonous gas.

speaker: Gangster
content: Ha... Boss, I did it! Boss...
He hasn't been relieved for long when Roulecca shots him down.
You take off your coat and dart forward to save Roulecca from the smoke.
You cover her mouth and nose with your coat to prevent her from inhaling any more poisonous gas.
But for some reason, your shoulders feel heavy and your vision slowly turns white.
You look back on your shoulder.
Fresh blood oozes and soaks your shirt.
Looks like... you're not lucky enough.
Your consciousness grows hazy, but you do not let go of her.

speaker: Man
content: Roulecca? Roulecca?

speaker: Girl
content: Hmm?

speaker: Girl
content: What's going on, Daddy? I haven't slept enough...

speaker: Man
content: Shhhh... keep it down.

speaker: Man
content: Can you play a game with Daddy?

speaker: Girl
content: Yes!

speaker: Man
content: Quiet!

speaker: Girl
content: Yay! Roulecca loves playing games.

speaker: Man
content: The rules are simple. From this moment on, you have to hide here. Don't say a single word or let out any sound until 8 pm. After that, you can come out.

speaker: Girl
content: Ahh... that's too hard, Daddy!

speaker: Man
content: Your prize will be this revolver that you've always wanted. It's different from what you have now, see?

speaker: Girl
content: Wow! T-then I will play! I will definitely win!

speaker: Man
content: Then from now on, don't make any sounds no matter what happens. Understand?

speaker: Man
content: If you try to play any tricks, don't even think about having the revolver for the rest of your life.

speaker: Girl
content: Mmm!

speaker: Man
content: Daddy's going to leave now, okay? You have to hide well! You'll definitely win with your luck. Daddy believes you.

speaker: Girl
content: Mmm!
As the closet closes, gunshots can be heard from the outside.
The gunshots continue ringing, and the young girl tries several times to push open the closet door. However, each time, she will remember her agreement with dad and draw her hand back.
Be it moaning, unknown voices, or sly laughter, she does not open the closet door.
The young girl is very obedient. After all, the prize is something she has yearned for.
The time is 8 pm. The young girl repeatedly calls for her father's name to ask him to open the door for her.
However, there isn't anyone coming over to congratulate her on her victory.
Usually, Aunt Popper would be the first to congratulate her with her favorite lollipop whenever she won a bet with her father.

speaker: Girl
content: Daddy? Daddy?

speaker: Girl
content: Roulecca wins this time! I'm coming for my prize! You cannot renege on it...
The young girl pushes the door but suddenly finds that something is blocking it.
She opens the door with all her might for the sake of her prize.
The door opens, and at that moment, she is shocked.
Her father's cold body collapses on her.
His body is covered with bullet holes, but he used it to protect Roulecca.
The young girl looks over her father's shoulder and sees what is beyond the closet.
Each and every member of Four-leaf Clover has fallen in front of her.
Trembling, she puts her hand on her father's cheek, hoping for him to speak to her.
But it is impossible as the man is not breathing.
In his hand is the revolver that he promised to give to the girl.

speaker: Girl
content: Daddy... Daddy...

speaker: Girl
content: Everyone...
The girl's voice fades away...
You seem to have dreamed about a young girl and her father.
You open your eyes.
You find yourself in a bed in the Bureau with Nightingale standing next to you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, how do you feel? This is the fifth day you have spent in the Bureau's recuperation room. You are expected to be able to return to work in four days.
It's been five days since you were injured in the operation.
You try to move your right arm, but it still stings.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Please don't push yourself too hard, Chief.

speaker: Nightingale
content: But for the antidote provided by Sinner Roulecca, your convalescence would have been extended by another month.
How did she do it? She was so badly hurt at that time.

speaker: Nightingale
content: According to our investigation at the scene, you subconsciously unleashed the shackles after you saved her life.

speaker: Nightingale
content: That activated Sinner Roulecca's abilities again, which enabled her to get the antidote from those gangsters.
You remember the objective of the mission—to keep the informant alive.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Only one. Unfortunately, he doesn't seem to know any more about the mania weapon trade.
To your surprise, Roulecca didn't kill the one who threw the gas bomb at her.
You ask Nightingale to send some documents in as usual. If you don't deal with them now, they'll pile up when you're back in the office.
Nightingale nods and leaves the room.
There aren't many documents sent in today—around two to three files.
It only takes you an hour to finish reading and commenting on them. You leave a message for Nightingale to pick them up at a later time.
After finishing your work, you take a look at the time. It is exactly 10 am, which is the time you agreed with her.
Seems that this Sinner is not punctual today.
Maybe she got into some trouble, being the troublemaker she is. It wouldn't be surprising if she were kept in close confinement by Nightingale.
You stretch with the arm that can move and walk towards the window. When you pull back the curtains to enjoy the morning sun...
You see a giant face pressed against the window.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Good morning, Chief!
At that moment, you feel the urge to kick the brat down.
Yet you still open the window and let her in.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Can you help Roulecca peel the apple, Chief? My hands are full of bandages...
Roulecca does not see this place as a hospital ward at all.
She said she would visit you every day but turns out the patient is the one fluttering around.

options: How come you're so late today?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Umm... I wanted to come earlier, but I had something to take care of.
What is it? You didn't get into trouble again, right?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Don't be so biased against me, Chief!
Roulecca puffs out her cheeks.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I stopped in time that day!
You feel like keeping lecturing Roulecca, but at least she saved your life in that mission.
Then I guess it's your loss this time.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmph! You're so mean, Chief! You keep imposing these weird rules on me!

speaker: Roulecca
content: And I keep feeling like I'm not as lucky when I'm near you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ahhhhhh, don't say anything anymore! I heard nothing, I heard nothing!
Shhh... we need to be quiet here.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Okay...

speaker: Roulecca
content: How about... I lost today because I failed to arrive by 10 am?
So it's my turn to ask a question today.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hmph, bring it on. I'm not afraid of you.
Did you play games with your family like this before?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Yes.
Roulecca, who lost the bet, sits quietly on the edge of your bed like an obedient child.

speaker: Roulecca
content: My dad would drop everything to play games with me and make me happy. It made me feel I was the luckiest child in the world.
So you've been lucky since you were a child?
You listen to Roulecca while continuing to move your hand. The apple is soon peeled.
Roulecca grabs the apple and takes a big bite, then continues talking about her past.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Of course not, idiot Chief. All that "luck" came from my dad and everyone at Four-leaf Clover.

speaker: Roulecca
content: My dad was the leader of Four-leaf Clover. Mom passed away shortly after I was born, so everyone in the gang helped in raising me. They were all my family.

speaker: Roulecca
content: They really spoiled me. No matter what I asked for, they would try their best to get it for me.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Once, I realized I had lost my favorite teddy bear.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I was very sad because it was a birthday gift from Uncle Jack. But in the end, he managed to find it back.
Is it the one you carry around with you?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Yes. Uncle Jack told me, "This bear is your lucky charm. It's your four-leaf clover and your lucky horseshoe."

speaker: Roulecca
content: As long as I have it, I'm the luckiest girl in the world. No matter how grave the situation is, I will be able to get through it safely.

speaker: Roulecca
content: At that time, the thing about my luck was a lie. A gentle lie of good intentions made by those who loved me the most.
How did they do it?

speaker: Roulecca
content: And here's another file I think that might interest you.

speaker: Roulecca
content: When I was shopping but forgot to bring my wallet, I would always meet Aunt Popper who happened to be "out shopping."

speaker: Roulecca
content: At the beginning, I thought I was really lucky. But after growing up, I learned the truth behind my luck.

speaker: Roulecca
content: But the candy that Charlie gave me was really delicious. Even now, I can remember how it tasted.
How's it compared to the food at the Bureau?

speaker: Roulecca
content: Well... The Bureau's food is good.

speaker: Roulecca
content: But I can't help missing the old days when my family and I could eat a warm meal together.
The sunlight falls on Roulecca's back, adding a hint of shadow to her.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Too bad I will never have the chance again.

speaker: Roulecca
content: If I were a bit braver... would there have been a better ending...?
The sadness of her family's passing is like a swamp that traps Roulecca. This time you decide to give her a hand.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ow, Chief! What are you doing?!
Let's make another bet.
I bet you will no longer exact revenge alone.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Hahahaha, Chief. You're gonna lose soon.
That's because you're going to punish those gangsters with me.
But I am different from your family. I will not spoil you.
If you were to sneak off for revenge and I caught you...

speaker: Roulecca
content: What would happen?

options: I would flick you hard in the forehead.
I would put you in solitary confinement.

content: Get it? Last time you said I was not being serious, but this time I am!

speaker: Roulecca
content: Haha, the Chief's vibes.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I promise you.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Chief, Chief?

speaker: Nightingale
content: There's an emergency.
Go ahead, I'm listening.
Right after you finish making the promise with Roulecca, an urgent transmission comes from Nightingale.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The Sinner Roulecca has once again escaped from confinement. We speculate from their tracks that she is near your ward.
Is that why you didn't enter from the front door today?
You look over at Roulecca, who is sneakily opening the window.

speaker: Roulecca
content: Ha... haha... there were some special circumstances.

speaker: Roulecca
content: I-I'll see you later, Chief. Don't forget our promise!
Roulecca pulls the window open and leaps down.
ROULECCA!
In order to investigate who's behind the Mania weapon production, you have arranged to interrogate a person of interest. The moment you enter the interrogation room, you hear a commotion—

speaker: Guard
content:
"Quick, grab him!" "The chains, the chains!"
"Look out, he bites!" "It hurts! You punk, I'll knock you one!"
The guards are piling at the door with chains in hand. Their target is a young man...
... who was leaping about, jumping and dodging around the interrogation room.

speaker: Guard
content: Tie him up!
Your voice is immediately drowned out in the chaotic interrogation room. No one has noticed your presence.
What are you...

speaker: Guard
content: Sinner S-076! Return to your seat!

speaker: Wolverine
content: I have a name! Don't order me around like that!
The young man shows extreme anger and rushes at a guard, fists flying.
The guard dodges to the side, putting you right in Wolverine's line of sight.
He is clearly distracted for a moment. He tries to turn his fist, but it's already too late—

speaker: Guard
content: Chief? When did you get here! Are you... alright?
Just a bloody nose. As for you all, what are you doing here?

speaker: Guard
content: We were preparing for interrogation, Chief.
This is the interrogation room, not a place for roughhousing. Go to the training room if you want to fight.

speaker: Guard
content: We were not roughhousing, Chief.

speaker: Guard
content: Sinner S-076 is particularly difficult to control. We were afraid he would hurt you during the interrogation, so we wanted to chain him up to keep him from rampaging.

options: He's not dangerous, you just got him upset.

content: Just now, when he saw me, he didn't mean to attack me. It was only an accident. If he was attacking and fighting back against you, he definitely had a reason.
Right, Wolverine?

speaker: Wolverine
content: You're different...
What?

speaker: Wolverine
content: Nothing! They started it!
Wolverine glares indignantly at the chains the guards are holding.
He doesn't want to be chained up and doesn't want you ordering him around by his serial number, so let's take it down a notch. He didn't hurt me on purpose.
Right, Wolverine?

speaker: Wolverine
content: You're different...
What?

speaker: Wolverine
content: Nothing! What are you here for, are you going to tie me up too?
I've got a case here. I want to ask you about it.
If I have the guards take away the chains and leave here, with just us two in the interrogation room, will you return to your seat and let me ask you some questions?

speaker: Wolverine
content: Give your word?
Of course.
The guards retreat one by one, taking the wounded with them, and the door to the interrogation room is closed again.
There is a rustling sound, and a black and white furball pokes its head out from under Wolverine's cloak.

speaker: Wolverine
content:
This is Pippy. He was scared just now. No need to worry about him.
You may just ask what you want to ask.
I'll get straight to it, then.
You provided raw materials for making Mania weapons to gangsters, right?

speaker: Wolverine
content: No.
But a gang member testified that it was you who provided them with Corruptor remains. How do you explain that?

speaker: Wolverine
content: ...Comes from me.
You denied providing them with raw materials for weapons and then admitted that you offered them Corruptor remains. You don't see a contradiction there?

speaker: Wolverine
content: I told you, I only gave the monsters to them. I don't know anything about any weapons.
How could you not know what the Corruptor remains would be used for?

speaker: Wolverine
content: I'm just a hunter. I didn't need to know that.
As a hunter along The Rust, you should know better than anyone how dangerous Corruptors are. You gave such dangerous things to someone else without even asking what they were to do with it?

speaker: Wolverine
content: What the hell business was it of mine...
You try to keep calm and convince yourself not to treat this wild kid like normal.
Corruptor remains are what Mania weapons are made out of.

speaker: Wolverine
content: So?
So what you did benefited the production of Mania weapons, which have been circulating in Syndicate and taken many innocent people's lives!
Putting on an impatient face, he clearly has not yet realized the severity of his crimes.

speaker: Wolverine
content: I don't know anybody from that Syndicate. What does this have to do with me? People die every day.

speaker: Wolverine
content: I trade monsters with the gang for meat, because when I have meat, I can get by. I don't know what those gang guys were doing with them, and I'm not interested.

speaker: Pippy
content: Rawr!
Pippy matched his expression and nodded deeply, apparently in complete agreement with his master's "meat theory."
You feel you couldn't dig out anything from him but "meat."
But the investigation can't stop here. You can only hope you can get some clues from Wolverine about the unknown mastermind behind Mania weapon production.
When you were talking about the gang, it sounded like they were not strangers to you?

options: How do gangsters find you to make a trade?
Are you pretty familiar with "those guys"?

speaker: Wolverine
content: We've met before.
Are you friends?

speaker: Wolverine
content: Hmph, friends...
Wolverine grits his teeth and lets out a sneer.

speaker: Wolverine
content: Would you train a friend like a dog?
Wolverine grits his teeth and lets out a sneer.

speaker: Wolverine
content: Yes, I am... Very familiar.
He grits his teeth and lets out a sneer.

speaker: Wolverine
content: They trained me like a dog every day. Of course I'm "familiar" with them.
Trained? So you've been in contact for a long time with the gangsters we suspect of making Mania weapons?

speaker: Wolverine
content: Yeah, they started doing this a long time ago. Back then, I was still in the gang, helping them fight Corruptors.

speaker: Wolverine
content:
Then I wasn't there anymore, and they couldn't fight Corruptors, so they came to me for help again.
Hmph, worthless trash...
That is to say, the Mania weapon supply chain started long before you knew about it... This is valid new information.
So can you tell me, specifically, what the people on this list have done?
test

content: This one—
