They understand that someone has taken the first bite of the cake meant to be shared.
Time waits for no one.

speaker: Reporter
content: Just now, the representative of the Cavendish family claimed that they have gone into partnership with the West District, and mentioned that they have reached a preliminary agreement on the extraction of resources from the West District mines.

speaker: Reporter
content: This could mean that the West District, which has been in chaos for many years, is finally starting to get back on track...
When you access a news streaming room on your terminal, you are overwhelmed by a barrage of comments that cover almost every inch of the screen.
Public opinion is in your favor. You turn off the terminal.

The dust has settled, and Reagan is nowhere to be found. Ironically, now that he is gone, some of the Speaker's followers are quick to play the "traitor"; they take out their terminals and get to work.
Without saying another word, Matilda steps down from the platform.

speaker: Matilda
content: No, we won.
Matilda gives a tired smile. The speech she just delivered must have taken a heavy toll on her, so much so that even this landslide victory can't lift her spirits.

speaker: Chief
content: Or should I say it's a victory worthy of your perfect aunt?

speaker: Chief
content: She really is... ahead of her time.
Before Matilda can say anything in response, a male voice pipes up from behind you.

speaker: Kadis
content: Miss Matilda, Councilor Bernadette missed today's hearing because she had an aid convoy to arrange.

speaker: Kadis
content: But she will come back to Eastside soon and is hoping to meet with you.

speaker: Kadis
content: Chief of the MBCC, Councilor Bernadette would like to invite you too; she wants to express her gratitude in person to you for taking care of Matilda.
Study of Cavendish Mansion's Guest Wing

speaker: Kadis
content: Please wait here for a moment. Councilor Bernadette will be with you shortly.
The man leaves. You and Matilda are alone in the study.

speaker: Chief
content: You see, I was right when I told you to have faith in your aunt.

speaker: Chief
content: She went to the West District. At least in this regard, your aunt is better than the vast majority of councilors and politicians in Eastside.

speaker: Chief
content: True self isn't unchangeable, is it?
To your surprise, Matilda shakes her head.

speaker: Matilda
content: Ms. Bernadette's true self has never changed.
Under your surprised gaze, Matilda continues:

speaker: Matilda
content: If my performance at today's hearing had not been to my aunt's satisfaction...

speaker: Matilda
content: Kadis would probably have swooped in to save the day. He could've announced to everyone that the Cavendish family had obtained intelligence on the Rustfire leadership and had launched a precise and rapid strike...

speaker: Matilda
content: "The Cavendish family will not waver in its determination to protect the interests of the Eastsiders and to confront any violent group that dares to disrupt the rules of DisCity."

speaker: Matilda
content: Something along those lines...

speaker: Chief
content: But she's your aunt...
This girl, who comes from a political family, looks calm.

speaker: Matilda
content: Why is that any surprise, Chief? Her last name is Cavendish.

speaker: Matilda
content: A long time ago, I had a conversation with Ms. Bernadette, right here in this study...

speaker: Bernadette
content: Are you sure about your choice?

speaker: Matilda
content: Yes, Aunt Bernadette.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I understand why you want to do this.

speaker: Bernadette
content: But the Executive Committee is not a good choice.

speaker: Matilda
content: I know...

speaker: Matilda
content: But... Aunt Bernadette, I want to go to the West District, no matter what, to see what it is really like. I...

speaker: Bernadette
content: What the West District is really like is not important, never has been.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Considering the benefits we're currently garnering from the West District, as well as the risks you may face there, I'd advise you not to go. You could surely find a more suitable position here in Eastside.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Anyway, since your mind is made up, I should stop trying to convince you to stay.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I hope you can find your value in the West District.

speaker: Matilda
content: I see...

speaker: Matilda
content: That might've been the moment when my target diverged from that of Ms. Bernadette.
You're on the verge of asking a question when the crisp sound of footsteps from outside the door interrupts you.

An elegant blonde lady pushes open the door and enters the study. At long last, you see the youngest female councilor of the City Council, a role model for the women of Eastside, and the de facto leader of a well-established political family...
Bernadette Cavendish.
She shakes your hand. After a brief exchange of greetings, Bernadette takes a seat at her desk.
She has a measured, self-assured smile that also seems enigmatic.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Thank you for taking care of Matilda, especially at today's hearing.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I couldn't make it due to a matter that needed my attention. It's thanks to your support that we were able to achieve such a satisfactory result.

speaker: Chief
content: Oh, it's nothing. Councilor, you taking the first step toward cooperation with the West District... now, that's something truly commendable.
The councilor smiles. This exchange of pleasantries ends smoothly.
Bernadette turns to look at her niece.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I questioned your choice once. But it has surprised me how much you've grown.

speaker: Matilda
content: Sorry, Aunt Bernadette, I should've visited you more often.

speaker: Bernadette
content: No need for such formality between us.

speaker: Bernadette
content: You've proven your worth to me and the family, Matilda.

speaker: Bernadette
content: As things stand, the Cavendish family is now one step closer to returning to center stage. However, more challenges will also come our way.

speaker: Bernadette
content: There are a lot of things that Kadis can't handle. I need a personal assistant to help deal with them.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I need you by my side, Matilda.

speaker: Bernadette
content: In return, you'll get a seat on the council after next year's elections.
This is a golden ticket to the corridors of power. You examine Councilor Bernadette's beautiful face, which doesn't betray her true age or emotions. It is wearing a sincere smile now.
What awaits her, however, is a sincere apology.

speaker: Matilda
content: I'm very sorry, Aunt Bernadette.

speaker: Matilda
content: I don't think I'm mature enough. I'm afraid I can't come back to work for you.
As you stare at the councilor's face, your gaze happens to meet hers.
After a moment, in a measured voice the councilor says:

speaker: Bernadette
content: I see...

speaker: Bernadette
content: Are you sure about your choice?

speaker: Matilda
content: Yes, Aunt Bernadette.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Hmm... the MBCC is a nice place, and its Chief is an excellent superior worth following.
You can't detect any negative emotions on the councilor's face. Her gaze remains gentle and composed.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Well, I won't get in your way.
The councilor stands up.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I'm sure you have a lot of things to deal with, Chief. I'm sorry for taking up so much of your time.

speaker: Bernadette
content: I think it's time to say goodbye.
What a straightforward way to say goodbye. You and Matilda stand up as well.
As you and Matilda make to leave, the councilor suddenly remembers something and calls out Matilda's name.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Matilda...

speaker: Bernadette
content: So, have you found your true self?
Matilda gives a smile, her most joyful one of the day.

speaker: Matilda
content: Yes, I have.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Really? That's great.

speaker: Bernadette
content: Well, I'm looking forward to the day when our paths cross again.

speaker: Matilda
content: I feel the same way, Aunt Bernadette.

The Apostle of Ashes Sun Crow has been vanquished, and the Eastian delegation has embarked on their return journey after a brief rest at the MBCC. All of this seems to signify a break from the recent hustle. You're finally able to catch a breath.
However, the illusion is shattered by the stacks of pending reports lying on your desk.

speaker: Staff Member
content: Two days ago, we received a warning from Sinner Yanyan about the aging circuits in the Bureau. She predicted a short circuit last night that would cause a series of explosions with severe consequences.

speaker: Staff Member
content: Logistics took this message seriously. They've organized an emergency inspection and scheduled staff to be on watch. But as of 7 a.m. today, there was no malfunction in the circuits.

speaker: Guard
content: Because of that prophecy about some bad guys who would soon break into the Bureau and destroy valuable data, we've been on heightened security for a week straight, with each team member taking on three additional night shifts.

speaker: Guard
content: But the biggest crisis that occurred this week was just a group of drunks lingering at the entrance yesterday, who we took to the Public Security Bureau. Chief, please advise if we should maintain the current security level?
You close the reports from Logistics and Security and quickly glance through the rest of the documents, whose content is more or less the same.

speaker: Chief
content: In other words... Yanyan has been making prophecies with severe consequences, but they've all ended up being false alarms that put everyone on edge for nothing?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Yes. Serial explosion, break-in, data breach, widespread power outage... These are all potential A-level accidents that could cause massive losses.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Following your instructions, we took every prophecy by Sinner Yanyan seriously and invested substantial resources and manpower into preventing the crises she predicted.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The result is as you can see. The heads of various departments have all expressed their pressing inclination to lower the priority of the prophecies. Personally, I also have reservations about their accuracy.
You get what Nightingale is saying. After all, her job requires her to focus on outcomes, and it's been a long time since Yanyan's prophecies have produced convincing results.
Trust wears off. While you can force the Bureau to continue responding to Yanyan's prophecies, it's not beneficial for either Yanyan or the Bureau.
Moreover, you also harbor concerns about the changes in Yanyan's prophetic abilities.

speaker: Chief
content: Remove Yanyan's prophecies from the crisis response list for now. The departments can resume their normal operations.

speaker: Chief
content: And... Give Yanyan a heads-up. Tell her I would like to have a chat.
As soon as you enter the interrogation room, you notice Yanyan's restlessness. Her slender arms are propped on the seat and her body is swaying back and forth in an agitated way.

speaker: Chief
content: Yanyan, I think you've guessed why I'm here. Recently, your prophecies...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ah, yes. You must have come to learn more about my latest prophecy, right? Our minds are always so in sync!

speaker: Chief
content: Your latest prophecy? No, actually, I...

speaker: Yanyan
content: One second. Yanyan needs to recall the specifics... Every detail in a prophecy counts!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Especially one that clearly involves a power so evil, so scary, so dangerous! Like this one!
Despite her need to recall the details, Yanyan doesn't stop talking and immediately launches into an endless explanation, as if speaking faster could keep whatever she fears from catching up.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Last night, I did as Grandma said and went to bed early. But as soon as I closed my eyes, I felt the ceiling open up into a path!

speaker: Yanyan
content: I'd never seen this path before. The floor and the walls were filthy. I tried to see what was at the end of it, but I ended up glimpsing a huge, living shadow!

speaker: Yanyan
content: "Shadows looming, demons lurking." I even blurted out this sentence in my dream! Then the path disappeared, and I woke up!

speaker: Yanyan
content: To figure out what this prophecy meant, I looked through Grandma's notebook all night...

speaker: Chief
content: Does Grandma's notebook contain records of events happening in DisCity?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Eh, I mean, everything in the world is interconnected! Ah, but that's not important. Just let me finish!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Anyway, I found some folklore in the notebook that seemed relevant! Of course, they were all just bits and pieces, but I pieced them together.

speaker: Yanyan
content: The legend says that in an alley so deep that even sunlight can't reach, darkness and filth will gather and give rise to evil! It will swallow everyone's kindness, turn it into its own strength, and harm everyone in return.

speaker: Yanyan
content: So I've come to a conclusion! At the end of that path, there must be a very terrifying evil spirit! It's going to harm everyone. Chief, we must act quickly to eliminate it!
In stark contrast to Yanyan's fervent words, your reaction is exceedingly calm.

speaker: Chief
content: But let's forget about this prophecy for now. I need to ask you about something else.

speaker: Yanyan
content: W-what can be more important than this prophecy?!
Despite her righteous tone, Yanyan's fingers gripping the edge of the interrogation chair and her darting eyes inadvertently reveal her discomfort and avoidance.

speaker: Chief
content: It's in fact quite important. After all, the delegation has been gone for a while now, but you're still here.

speaker: Chief
content: What I want to know is, why didn't you go back with them? Is there something in DisCity that requires the attention of a seer?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Um, um... Because DisCity is too much fun...? No, no, that makes Yanyan seem too playful...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Oh, I know! It's because Yanyan wants to fully understand what the world outside Eastia is like. I must bring back stories for the folks back home! That's my responsibility as a seer!

speaker: Yanyan
content: I need to stay here and research more in order to do that, that's why I must stay in DisCity! Yes, that's it!

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, I believe you. But have you thought about when you might go back?
Clearly, Yanyan feels uncomfortable at your barrage of questions. She seems to be hiding something. She's fidgeting with her fingers and avoiding eye contact, shifting restlessly in her seat.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Why must you keep asking about this? I just said I'm staying here to understand DisCity more!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Once Yanyan has spent enough time here and learned what needs to be learned, I will definitely go back!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ugh, s-stop looking at me like that. That prophecy Yanyan just told you about is really urgent! It's an emergency! You can't afford to waste one more second!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Chief, we need to set off on an investigation immediately! If something happens, it'll be too late!
Appealing urgently, the girl looks at you with wide eyes and an expression full of genuine worry and unease.

You know she isn't the type to lie to get away from unfavorable situations, but you also know that while Yanyan isn't a liar, her knowledge and abilities might not yet be sufficient to discern the validity of the message.

speaker: Chief
content: Yanyan, are you really sure?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yes! Yanyan can't just ignore this evil spirit. What if it hurts someone passing by...
You sigh and put the reports on the table.

speaker: Chief
content: I mean, are you sure your prophecy is accurate?

speaker: Chief
content: I don't doubt your determination to protect the people. But as far as I know, most of your recent prophecies didn't come true.

speaker: Chief
content: Are you having issues with your power?
Hearing your words, a momentary panic flashes across Yanyan's face, but she quickly manages to calm down.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yanyan's prophecies are derived from divine oracles. Maybe, maybe I made some mistakes in the interpretation... That's why they turned out this way...

speaker: Yanyan
content: If an adult can help correct it, my prophecies will be accurate! Nothing's wrong with Yanyan's power! ...That should be the case, right?
Seeing Yanyan trying to convince herself, you suddenly don't have the heart to point out the issue anymore. But you also know that it won't do anyone any good.

speaker: Chief
content: But... Before this, your prophecies have never deviated so much from reality. Am I right?

speaker: Chief
content: The serial explosion you predicted never happened. The aging circuits were just replaced three weeks ago. The potential intruders were just some passing drunks and stray cats. The costly new backup power system hasn't even been used...

speaker: Chief
content: Yanyan, you're a smart kid. I don't need to go on further, do I?
With the facts laid out openly, Yanyan stammers for a while but still can't utter a word of rebuttal, her eyes threatening to grow teary.
The girl's pitiful look makes you soften your tone.

speaker: Chief
content: This is why I called you here today. Yanyan, I hope you can tell me immediately whenever you encounter any problems. We can face them and solve them together.

speaker: Chief
content: Simply burying your head in the sand won't make the lion chasing you go away. Yanyan, you've learned this lesson from your grandma's stories, right?
Your words make Yanyan's head hang low like a drooping little sunflower weighed down by frost.
After a long while, you finally hear her voice as soft as a mosquito's buzz.

speaker: Yanyan
content: You're right, ${PlayerName}. I'm indeed having some issues with my power...

speaker: Yanyan
content: After the Sun Crow was defeated, Yanyan's prophecies started becoming inaccurate...

speaker: Yanyan
content: At first, it was just that no one believed me and everyone just laughed at Yanyan's myths. At that time, I thought it didn't matter as long as I believed in them.

speaker: Yanyan
content: But later, even though Yanyan made the bow according to the myth, the Sun Shot still failed... Being able to see the Great Seer was not a useful skill, and I even got you injured...
If that's the case... you might have already figured out the connection.

speaker: Chief
content: I understand now. Yanyan, your abilities originated in faith, but the events that occurred after your arrival in DisCity have dealt a blow to your belief.

speaker: Chief
content: Slowly, you began to doubt whether your abilities were of any use, and this doubt, in turn, affected the stability of your power.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Exactly! I feel both so scared and anxious. I want to make some useful prophecies to prove my abilities are still useful, but, but...

speaker: Chief
content: But the harder you try, the more inaccurate they become, to the point where even other Sinners start joking about it.

speaker: Chief
content: The more they joke about it, the stronger your frustration and the more inaccurate your prophecies become. It's a vicious cycle... That's also why you've been dragging your feet about going home, right?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hmm...
Yanyan hangs her head, her voice filled with unexpressed grievances and self-reproach.

speaker: Yanyan
content: My abilities, compared to those of the Great Seer and Du Ruo, are far too lacking... With my power, I can't fulfill everyone's wish or protect the folks of Sunsink City from disasters...

speaker: Yanyan
content: And now even my basic divination skill has gone haywire... How can I become a worthy seer like this...

You can't believe the honest and cheerful girl has become so anxious that she's delaying her trip back home. Her situation has worsened to this extent partly because of your negligence after the battle with the Sun Crow.

speaker: Chief
content: I'm sorry I haven't been taking good care of you. I only realized your difficulties now.

speaker: Cherish your life, my dear. Don't you have someone you're waiting for? Don't you miss her?
content: It's not ${PlayerName}'s fault... It's all because Yanyan isn't strong enough, that's why...

speaker: Chief
content: Don't think like that, Yanyan. It was your compass and myth that led us to find the materials for the bow, and it was your perseverance that helped us seize the final moment to defeat the Sun Crow.

speaker: Chief
content: You are not weak. You will definitely become a worthy seer.

speaker: Yanyan
content: You're just being nice to Yanyan. I know I've been causing trouble all along and haven't been much help...
Your attempt to console her seems futile. The confidence she's lost obviously won't be easily restored with just a few words.
Perhaps, you need to convince her with facts.

options: Invite her on a field investigation

speaker: Chief
content: Listen, Yanyan. You said you can't protect everyone or fulfill their wishes, so you can't be a worthy seer, right?

speaker: Chief
content: Then let's try it out and see if you can protect people and grant their wishes.
Yanyan immediately lifts her head, her eyes wide with surprise as she looks at you.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Can I...? Can Yanyan have another chance?

speaker: Chief
content: Of course. Besides, a crisis happens to be awaiting us now, remember?

speaker: Chief
content: Let's start with that legendary evil spirit at the end of the alley you prophesied about just now.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ah! Granny! Stop, there's a filthy, man-eating presence ahead! It's very dangerous!

You arrive at the alley to find an old woman holding a strange device about to enter the dangerous area in the prophecy. With her impressive agility, Yanyan bursts into action and rushes over to pull her back!

speaker: Old Lady
content: Oh my, what's happening?

speaker: Chief
content: Excuse us, but we'd advise you not to go any further, ma'am. You may fall.
That filthy, man-eating presence indeed exists. But it's just an open sewer. Even Yanyan can't find any other danger beyond that with her persistent search.

speaker: Yanyan
content: It seems Yanyan's prophecy was inaccurate again... I'm relieved there's no real danger, but how can I go on being a seer like this...
After the series of failed prophecies, it seems that Yanyan pinned all her hopes on this prophecy about the evil spirit, but it still didn't come true.

Perhaps that's why although the girl is relieved to find no real evil spirit, her face still seems dejected and frustrated. Just as you make to speak up and comfort her, the old woman standing by suddenly smiles and takes her hand.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Though I don't understand a single word, if you hadn't pulled me back, these old bones of mine would have been struggling in pain down the sewer right now.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Thank you, sweetheart. It's all thanks to you I'm still standing here!
The stranger's gratitude dispels the gloom on Yanyan's face and shifts her attention away from the failed prophecy for the first time. She looks up at the kind old lady, revealing a shy smile.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Don't mention it. It's nothing!

speaker: Yanyan
content: What are all these things you have with you? This one in your hand, is it an iron? Why does it glow? What's it for?

speaker: Old Lady
content: Oh, these? They're equipment for finding aliens. I think this one's called... oh, a peripheral biological detector. It beeps to alert me when it detects the creature I've specified.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Aliens? Do they really exist in this world? Where do they appear? Are you here to research about them? Can you communicate with them?

speaker: Old Lady
content: Of course, child. Look, this scarf I'm wearing is my interpreter. It's carrying so many languages in it. Once I find the aliens, surely we can have a conversation.
This strange old woman is covered in weird gadgets and speaks pure nonsense. Yet, for some reason, you can't bring yourself to be wary of her.

Perhaps it's because of her attitude toward Yanyan. She patiently answers every childish question, watching the girl with an attentive and kind gaze. It's clear she is genuinely fond of the child in front of her.
While you are analyzing this strange old woman, Yanyan's attention is captured by yet another new find on the old woman's wrist.

speaker: Yanyan
content: You must have been wearing this bracelet for a long time, right? My grandma says that a trinket develops a spirit when worn over time and can protect its owner!
Taken aback, the old woman instinctively caresses the old bracelet with her fingertips as if it were her treasure.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Yes, it's a gift from my daughter. She made it when she was little. I've worn it for a long time...

speaker: Yanyan
content: I can relate. My grandma also made me a talisman, which I treat very carefully when I wear it!
Yanyan pulls out the talisman hanging around her neck enthusiastically, showing it off to the old woman and you.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Grandma says this talisman is imbued with her wish, and it'll grant me whatever I desire! I wonder what wish is imbued on your bracelet... It must be for safety or health, right? That's why I was able to save you in time!

speaker: Yanyan
content: But why did you come to a place like this, Granny? Even without the filthy presence from Yanyan's prophecy, it's so dark and unpleasant here! Do aliens like this kind of environment?

speaker: Old Lady
content: What a smart girl. Yes, I came here looking for aliens indeed. Unfortunately, it looks like another miss... I'll have to check another place next.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Another place? Do you know of other places where there might be aliens? Where?

speaker: Old Lady
content: Yes, it's the legendary wishing tree. Everyone says it's very effective, so I think there must be many aliens around. Maybe my old bones will have some luck there.

speaker: Old Lady
content: If it piques your interest, why not come along? Take a walk with me and keep me company, how about it?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yanyan wants to go!
Yanyan's eyes light up. She turns to you, pleading with puppy-like eyes.

speaker: Chief
content: Alright, we'll go together.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yay! Off we go! I can't wait to meet the aliens!
Honestly, it's hard to say no to those eyes. And this trip could be beneficial if it helps her escape from her self-pity.
So you patiently accompany the duo to the next location mentioned by the old woman.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Look at all these reports of alien sightings I've gathered here. Crop circles in the suburbs, mysterious signals received by the radio station at 3 a.m., and wreckage of unidentified flying objects... You name it!

speaker: Yanyan
content: So the radio station doesn't just receive messages from the dead at 3 a.m., but audio notes by aliens too!

speaker: Old Lady
content: You're right, sweetheart. Look, this black crystal was dug out from a ruin. No analysis has been able to find out what it is. If you ask me, it must be a product of alien technology, like a fragment of a spacecraft, that sort of thing.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hmm, let me take a closer look with my magnifying glass... Grandma has taught me that this kind of wavy pattern often indicates the existence of an old marine civilization! Maybe the aliens came looking for water!

speaker: Old Lady
content: I think so too, which is why I've been looking for them for so many years. I believe that as long as I keep searching, I'll figure out the aliens' purpose and trace them.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Exactly! I also believe that as long as I work hard enough, I will once again receive the blessings and guidance of the gods and become a worthy seer!

It's impressive how the two can stay on the same wavelength while they are essentially talking about completely different things. Perhaps this is what the Eastians like to call a serendipitous encounter.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hehe, you're such a great storyteller, Granny. Yanyan used to love listening to tales too!

speaker: Old Lady
content: Oh? What kind of tales? I'd love to hear them too!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Let me see... Got it! Once, Grandma told me a tale called the Magical Deer and the Rainbow Herb!

speaker: Yanyan
content: It's about a magical deer that lives in the forest. After being tricked by greedy humans once, it is heartbroken and takes the life-saving rainbow herb to hide deep in the forest, never seen by anyone again!

speaker: Yanyan
content: In the end, a seer wearing a leaf-woven skirt worships her way into the forest and prays to it. After that, the magical deer finally reappear with the rainbow herb in their mouths!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ever since Grandma had first told me this story, Yanyan always wanted to become a seer, to protect everyone!

speaker: Old Lady
content: Oh, what a wonderful story. I also believe that the trees, plants, and animals in the forest possess great spiritual power and can help everyone. Just like this wishing tree.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Is this the one? Have we found it? Eh, why is the bark of this tree all black?
You all stop in your tracks and look up, sizing up this legendary wishing tree.
Just as Yanyan said, one half of this tree, towering in the middle of the road like a landmark, is completely black. It is also covered in wish notes, making it look rather odd.

speaker: Old Lady
content: I've heard that this tree has been modified by aliens. The black substance on the bark is the trace left by those beings. That's why it can fulfill the wishes people hang on it...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Wow, that sounds awesome! Let me climb up to see if the aliens are living on top of the tree and peeking at everyone's wish note!
Before you realize, Yanyan has already climbed up the tall wishing tree, moving from one branch to another with agile movements.
While she's searching attentively, you also get tasked with the important job of waving the electric iron, diligently looking for signals sent by aliens under the tree.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ah, look over there. There's a strange mark. Maybe it's a code left by the aliens!

speaker: Old Lady
content: Careful, sweetheart! Hold on tight and be safe!

Like a kind grandmother caring for her grandchild, the old lady not only reminds Yanyan earnestly, but also stands under the tree with her arms open and follows Yanyan's movements, ready to catch her at any moment.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Don't worry, I'm an excellent tree climber, I won't fall! Let me see what this is... Oh no, it's bird poop!

speaker: Yanyan
content: What a shame! ${PlayerName}, Granny, move aside, Yanyan is coming down!
Yanyan indeed moves nimbly down the tree, but noticing she's sweating profusely from all the climbing, the old lady still takes out several handkerchiefs and wipes the sweat off her caringly.

speaker: Old Lady
content: You must be exhausted, aren't you? Look at all that sweat. Close your eyes, sweetheart, let me clean your face.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Eh? The handkerchief smells nice. It reminds me of something...

speaker: Old Lady
content: There, now you're a clean and pretty girl again... Why are you staring at my handkerchief? Don't you like the scent?

speaker: Yanyan
content: It's nothing! Um, I just got this idea. We can ask the people living nearby! They must be able to give us more clues!

speaker: Chief
content: Let's hope so...
Eager to test out her idea, Yanyan stands at the corner looking around for a while, then quickly catches a middle-aged man passing by with a shopping bag.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Sir, do you live near the wishing tree? Do you know about the aliens living on it? We're here to hang out with them. Do you know how we can find them?

speaker: Passerby
content: Aliens? All we have here is a tree that survived a lightning strike. I suppose many like to call it the wishing tree, but that's all nonsense! Never heard anything about aliens either!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Really? Hmm, I'm a little skeptical! Could it be that everyone else is just keeping that secret from you?

speaker: Passerby
content: What are you...
At a loss for words, the passerby shifts his gaze toward you and the old lady who seem to be Yanyan's guardians. You can only force a smile and go over, trying to smooth things over.

speaker: Chief
content: Excuse us. She's a bit stubborn... My apologies for taking up your time. I'll have a word with her when we get back.
While you are reassuring the passerby, Yanyan has already quickly found her next target and started a new round of inquiry.
Having just sent the man off, you make to stop her but are stopped by the old lady, who is smiling indulgently.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Look at how happy she is. Let's not dampen her spirits. It's not like it's causing any harm.
You glance at Yanyan with her lively motions and bright expressions, her vibrant energy in stark contrast to her previously downcast demeanor. You swallow the words of objection.
You and the old lady end up watching her bustling around for a while before returning empty-handed in the end.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Why won't anyone admit there are aliens here? Is this the hardship one must go through in pursuit of miracles, according to Grandma?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yanyan wants to keep going, but my stomach is growling...

speaker: Old Lady
content: Come and sit down. You must be exhausted after all that effort, right? Let's eat something first.
The old lady seats you down under the tree and takes out several portions of food from her huge backpack, distributing them to you.
After thanking her, Yanyan picks up one of the pies and takes a bite ravenously. Her eyes immediately light up.

speaker: Yanyan
content: A beef pie! Although it's different from the crispy one Grandma makes, it's so delicious!

speaker: Yanyan
content: How strange... It tastes so nostalgic! Granny, is this your secret recipe?

speaker: Old Lady
content: Oh, it's nothing special. My daughter used to love this pie too. She would get the filling all around her mouth, burying her face into it... So I spent some time perfecting it...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Does your daughter not like it anymore? But it's so tasty.
This time, the old lady doesn't answer her question, simply patting her head.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Take your time to enjoy the food. I'll go and have a look at this tree. Yanyan, eat as much as you want. I've made more than enough, alright?
Yanyan nods emphatically and sees the old lady off, holding the same posture when she got the head pats. After the woman disappears, she turns to you and smiles sheepishly with her greasy lips.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}, do you want more? If not, can Yanyan have it? Hehe, thank you!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Actually, I was quite sickly when I was little. Once, I had a high fever and insisted on having Grandma's beef pie.

speaker: Yanyan
content: It was raining heavily that day, and the roads were dreadful. But Grandma still went all the way to buy the freshest beef and made me some steaming hot pies.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Later, when I became the new seer and told Grandma the news, she was overjoyed. She hugged me exuberantly, laughing and crying at the same time.

speaker: Yanyan
content: She said I was the greatest pride of her life and made me a whole table of beef pies, each filled to the brim.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I ate so much that I ended up with a stomachache in the middle of the night. You should see Grandma's face when she found out!

speaker: Yanyan
content: But every time I think back, I still feel so happy, and I still adore the beef pies. To me, that's the taste of a wish come true.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Maybe I find the taste of this pie particularly nostalgic because, for Granny's daughter, it was also a pie of happiness that tasted like a fulfilled wish!
Holding a beef pie, Yanyan looks up at the wishing tree. Countless notes heavy with wishes hang on the branches, rustling in the wind like murmured prayers.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}, if you happen to have a coin, could I borrow it to make a wish?
You rummage through your pockets to find a forgotten coin and hand it to Yanyan. The girl closes her eyes to make a wish, then skillfully tosses the coin under the tree.

speaker: Chief
content: What wish did you make?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hehe, according to Eastian customs, you should never tell others your wishes, or they won't come true!

speaker: Yanyan
content: By the way, where has Granny gone? Maybe she's waiting for us. Let's go find her!
You look around and finally find the old woman behind the tree.

speaker: Yanyan
content: There you are! Granny, what are you doing here? Is it about the aliens...
Yanyan's cheerful greeting stops abruptly. Bewildered at the old woman wiping her tears under the tree, she steps closer to you nervously and tugs at your sleeve.
But you are equally confused about the reason she's crying, and you don't feel entitled to pry into her private matters.
Finally, Yanyan breaks the silence and approaches her cautiously.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Granny, what's wrong? Are you sad because you couldn't find the aliens?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Don't worry, Yanyan will help you. Together we can surely...

speaker: Old Lady
content: Yanyan, my dear child, don't worry. I'm fine.
The old woman clasps Yanyan's warm hand, as if to comfort her and also to gain some strength from her.
After a moment, she composes herself and splays the hand she used to wipe her tears. In her palm lies a wish note blown down by the wind. The handwriting is childish, and the wish is an innocent one.
[I wish Mommy could be with me on my birthday.]

speaker: Old Lady
content: I'm fine, really. It's just that, seeing the wish on this note reminded me of my daughter, so...

speaker: Old Lady
content: So I got a bit sad.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Granny, your daughter, did she...
With everything that's happened, even the usually cheerful Yanyan senses something is wrong. She moves closer to the old woman, wanting to offer some comfort.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Yes, my daughter has been gone for a long time. And not a day goes by I don't miss her...

speaker: Old Lady
content: I was always busy working and rarely had time to be with my daughter. I only made her favorite beef pies once in a while. Thankfully, she was very understanding and never complained. Looking back, she took care of me more than I did her.
She raises her hand to touch Yanyan's worried face, her tone gentle, as if recalling a story that happened to someone else.

speaker: Old Lady
content: That year, I asked her what gift she wanted for her birthday. I thought she'd ask for her favorite beef pies, but she said nothing. Instead, she gave me a handmade bracelet.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Grandma has said that Yanyan's birthday also marks the day of my mother's suffering. Your daughter must have known how much you sacrificed for her. That's why she did that!

speaker: Old Lady
content: Yes... Just like you said, she was always so considerate. In that way, she was a lot like you.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Even when it came to her birthday wish. She said she just wanted me to grant her a simple wish and not to bother to prepare anything. But she never got to tell me that wish, for before that, she left me for good due to an accident.

speaker: Old Lady
content: I couldn't accept her departure, nor could I accept that I couldn't even guess her wish. It wasn't until I started sorting through her belongings that I found she had collected many alien magazines, and her diary even mentioned...
The old woman lets go of Yanyan and pulls out a worn diary from her pocket. Her fingers tremble as she flips to a certain page.
[Are aliens real? How I wish to find out!]

speaker: Old Lady
content: I guess, maybe that was her unspoken wish?

speaker: Old Lady
content: Did the injury teach you nothing?

speaker: Old Lady
content: That's the only thing I can do for her now...
The old woman's tone is extremely firm. She turns and gently strokes the wishing tree's charred bark, her touch so tender, as if a delicate wish is imprinted on it.

speaker: Yanyan
content: No wonder you've always felt familiar to me... Now I know why. It's because you remind me of Grandma...

speaker: Yanyan
content: The talisman, the perfumed handkerchiefs, always worrying about Yanyan getting hurt, and the beef pies... Even your search for aliens...
She sounds a bit dazed. You lower your head to look at Yanyan and find her staring at the old woman with a stunned expression and wet eyes, obviously harboring something in her heart.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yanyan is so moved by Granny's story. Yanyan can't stand to watch her suffer... ${PlayerName}, I want to help her fulfill her wish.

speaker: Yanyan
content: But, but Yanyan's power is unstable right now. I might not be of much use. I may even end up doing something stupid again...
Her small face crinkles like a steamed bun, that hearty, delicious Eastian snack.
Her hesitation is visible, and even more so is the determination it takes for her to make this decision after much deliberation.

speaker: Yanyan
content: But Yanyan still wants to help Granny. I'll help her figure out what her daughter's last wish really was!
You smile and can't resist patting her head. The girl's body is comfortingly warm, just like her sincere heart.

speaker: Chief
content: If that's what you want, go for it, Yanyan. Not for duty and not to prove yourself... but because you truly believe that wishes can come true, and you want them to come true.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yes! I'll do my best!
Witnessed by you and the old woman, Yanyan sits cross-legged under the tree, takes a few deep breaths, and slowly closes her eyes.

In your perception, the girl's special power is fluctuating rapidly. The power is very unstable and keeps varying in intensity, so much so that even Yanyan herself feels it too, furrowing her brow while keeping her eyes shut.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Wh-what happened?

speaker: Chief
content: Yanyan is capable of channeling. She's calling upon all of her power to help you. Please give her a little time.
The old woman is completely confused, but Yanyan's efforts and goodwill are not lost on her. She stands aside, nervously clutching her handkerchief.
You quietly focus your mind on the shackles, feeling the fluctuations from the other end, paying close attention to Yanyan's state.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Great Seer, I've missed you, and I've got so many questions for you. I... there's too much I still need to do, but I don't know how.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I only need to offer my power to the Sun Crow? I see... I'm coming, I'll listen to you...

speaker: Chief
content: Don't go! It's a trap!

speaker: Yanyan
content: No, it shouldn't be like this... The Almighty Bow is supposed to seal the Sun Crow with a single arrow. That should have done it.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ...Am I not powerful enough?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Where's the bow? Let me try again! No, we need to make another one. Quick, I...

It's as if the disasters Yanyan fears the most are happening all at once on the other end of the shackles. The storms, floods, and earthquakes... are signs of the turmoil in the girl's heart. The more she tries to suppress them, the more uncontrollable the emotions become.
Finally, Yanyan snaps her eyes open, sweating profusely as if she just narrowly escaped from a disaster.

speaker: Chief
content: Yanyan!
You try to shoulder some of the pain through the shackles for Yanyan, while the old woman pulls Yanyan into her arms. She pats Yanyan's back, tears streaming down her own face.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Stop, that's enough. You don't need to do this for me. It's not worth it...

speaker: Yanyan
content: What do you mean it's not worth it? Of course, it's worth it!

speaker: Yanyan
content: What's one failure? Let's do it again! I'm going to fulfill your wish, Granny!
Having said this with determination, Yanyan wipes the sweat from her face and sits back down under the tree, closing her eyes to regulate her breathing.
You know that Yanyan needs your assistance now more than ever.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Apostles of Ashes are products of concentrated Mania, a material projection of collective consciousness. They manifest themselves in this world, in the forms of disasters and Wraith Beasts.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: Hypercubes don't exist in Eastia. Facing the Apostle, people could only rely on their faith in the Sun Shot legend. In other words, they were fighting the product of collective will with their collective will.

speaker: Du Ruo
content: When the Great Seer crafted the Almighty Bow, she was activating this immense spiritual power. Take it up upon you even as you know the truth beneath the lies. No matter how many times you fail, always have faith. This, Yanyan is surely capable of.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Ugh... Uh...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Just a little more... Yanyan can definitely do it...

Various intense and disorderly emotions gather on the other side of the shackles, prickling your head even though you're only sustaining part of them. Taking them all in, Yanyan must be enduring double the pain.
Sweat breaks out all over her forehead. Teeth clenched, her tense facial muscles twitch from time to time. Even her usually rosy cheeks gradually turn pale as time passes.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Sigh... She can't go on like this... We should give up. Let's not make the child suffer anymore...

speaker: Chief
content: Sorry, but even I can't be certain what will happen if we interrupt Yanyan now. Even to us, channeling is a delicate and unpredictable ability.

speaker: Chief
content: Now, we can only trust Yanyan. She must know about what she's doing.
Both you and the old woman are afraid that Yanyan will collapse from overexertion, but worry that intervening now might cause irreversible damage. In this dilemma, waiting becomes a torture.
Time ticks by. Just as the old woman can no longer bear such anxiety and simply closes her eyes and begins praying while fiddling with her bracelet, Yanyan opens her eyes.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Where... am I?

Rising golden light envelops Yanyan's body. Compared to the channeling you've seen before, it feels gentler this time, but the sense of sanctity is as strong as ever, making the girl look like a flower-hugging fairy.

speaker: Old Lady
content: What, what's happening? What's wrong with Yanyan? Is she alright?! It looks like she's been...
You know the word she wants to say, and her guess is indeed not far from the truth.
With the connection of the shackles, you can clearly feel something as light as a wish note overlapping with the warm presence of Yanyan. The girl slowly lifts her head to look at the old woman.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Mom?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Is it you, Mom?

speaker: Old Lady
content: Darling? Is it really you?
As if something is dawning on her, the old woman takes a few steps forward, her hands trembling, but then she hesitates and stops.

Understanding how unbelievable the situation is, the girl stands still as she searches for a way to help her mother recognize her. Pondering, she instinctively rubs her nose with the knuckle of her right index finger.
Capturing the familiar gesture, the woman shudders all over and finally rushes forward, embracing the girl in her arms.

speaker: Old Lady
content: It's you! It's really you! My baby, my darling! You've finally come back!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Mom, did you come to see me? You look so different from before.
The old woman sobs, holding her so tightly as if to rub her into her own flesh and blood, never to be parted again.

speaker: Old Lady
content: I'm sorry. It's all my fault. I failed to protect you.

speaker: Old Lady
content: If I had come home from work earlier that day, you wouldn't have... It's all my fault...

speaker: Yanyan
content: What are you talking about, Mom? I would never blame you!

speaker: Old Lady
content: You... you don't hate me? All I cared about was work, and I neglected you... If only I had spent more time with you... That way, maybe you wouldn't have left me...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Mom, I never felt neglected. If it hadn't been for me, you wouldn't have had to work so hard, right?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Your job was tough on you. I understood. And you've always loved me in your own way.

speaker: Yanyan
content: It's just a pity that I couldn't be your daughter for longer. There were so many games I wanted to play with you, so many stories I wanted to hear from you, but I couldn't...

speaker: Old Lady
content: It's the same for me. I have so much to say to you. Thankfully, we still have this chance...

The old woman wipes her moist eyes, squeezing out a smile. After the initial shock, she's regained her strength. Unwilling to waste the precious reunion on sadness and remorse, she chooses instead to make up for her past regrets.
Cakes, the bracelet, aliens... The two of them snuggle together and chat about the bits and pieces of life, as if time and death never separated them.
However, this scene doesn't last long before the golden light on Yanyan begins to fade gradually.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Why is the light dimming... Darling, are you leaving?

speaker: Old Lady
content: But I've still got so many things to show you and tell you...

Watching the golden light pulsate and dwindle, the old woman seems helpless. She turns around to rummage through a stack of photos and reports, her hands trembling as she hands them to her daughter one by one.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Look, this is the serpentine alien you've done a lot of research on. I went to see it on your twenty-seventh birthday, and I also took pictures...

speaker: Yanyan
content: Mom, we don't have much time left.
The golden light flickers unsteadily, but the girl's face remains as gentle as ever.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Besides these, don't you have anything else to ask me, Mom?

speaker: Old Lady
content: ...Yes, of course, I do, darling! On your behalf, I've been on a search for aliens for years, and I've traveled to all the places you mentioned you wanted to go in your diary.

speaker: Old Lady
content: But that birthday wish you wanted to tell me, I still don't know what it was... Can you tell me?
The old woman grabs the girl's hand and stares at her eagerly, asking in an almost pleading tone. With each pulsation of the light, she grips her hand tighter.

speaker: Yanyan
content: That wish doesn't matter anymore, Mom. Because you've already fulfilled it for me.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Now, all I wish is...

speaker: Old Lady
content: Darling?! No, don't go! Don't leave me, please!
As the golden light pulsates for the last time, the girl's words also dissipate into the air like mist.

speaker: Yanyan
content: For you to live each day safely, healthily, and happily.

The world quiets down. The light, just like the girl who borrowed Yanyan's body, has vanished as if it's never appeared. Everything has returned to normal. Only the wind still rustles the notes on the wishing tree.
Yanyan has returned to her usual self, but the old woman is still holding her tightly, as if trying to grasp something with this persistent posture.
The lively girl also maintains a rare silence, like she's aware that she's the only one who can soothe the old woman's almost overflowing sorrow.

After a long while, Yanyan clumsily stretches out her small hand and gently pats the old woman's back, mimicking how adults always comfort her. This action seems to startle her, prompting her to break the silence.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Thank you, Yanyan.

speaker: Yanyan
content: It's what I should do, Granny.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I'm a seer from Eastia. It's my duty and mission to grant people their wishes with my power and bring hope and courage to everyone.
Tenderly, Yanyan reaches out to wipe the silent tears from the old woman's cheeks.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Also, I was only able to help you see your daughter because she was also trying her best.

speaker: Yanyan
content: For an ordinary person, Yanyan can only sense and connect with their emotions, regrets, or memories if they are particularly deep and intense. And I can't last long.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I'm sorry, Granny. I wanted to hold on a bit longer too, but right now I'm not yet a worthy seer. I can only do so much.

speaker: Old Lady
content: Don't say that, sweetheart. I'm too old to understand all these big words like seer and Eastia and so on. But thanks to you, I've got my hope and courage.

speaker: Old Lady
content: My wish for many years has also been fulfilled. So, to me, Yanyan is the best seer.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Really? I'm so happy!
Yanyan's face lights up again. She jumps up and down happily for a moment, but quickly calms down and says to the old woman solemnly.

speaker: Yanyan
content: But Granny, I must thank you too. Actually, before helping you, Yanyan messed up a lot of things and didn't know if I still had it in me.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Your story moved me so much. It made me want to help you. And it's through that I found back my abilities as a seer.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Now I understand. To be a good seer, you have to think like the person who makes the wish, to hope from the bottom of your heart, and to believe in the fulfillment of the wish.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yanyan has grown up. And I will never ever forget this again!
Listening to Yanyan's serious reflection on what she's learned and her hope for the future, you can't help but show a relieved smile just like the old woman does.

speaker: Chief
content: It seems to me Yanyan has really grown up. I think there's an Eastian saying that goes you see someone in a new light after three days. For Yanyan, it shouldn't take more than three hours.

speaker: Chief
content: At this rate, you would soon become a seer everyone can rely on.

speaker: Yanyan
content: Yes! Yanyan will become the best seer, just like Granny said!
Several days later.
Yanyan is going back to her hometown today. You get up especially early to see her off.
The petite girl is almost swallowed by her bulky luggage, which you know contains mostly DisCity specialties she is bringing back for her villagers. She seems much more at ease than before.
The uncertainty and doubt that once weighed her down have vanished. She seems like that cheerful and sincere girl you used to know again, yet something also seems different about her now.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}, are you here to see me off?
Despite struggling with her luggage, she notices your arrival immediately and runs toward you with a big smile.

speaker: Chief
content: No, I came to observe someone tame their oversized luggage like a wild animal... Just kidding. Of course, I'm here to see you off.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I knew you would come, ${PlayerName}!
A bright smile blooms on Yanyan's face.

speaker: Yanyan
content: ${PlayerName}, do you remember the wish I made under the wishing tree? I even borrowed a coin from you!

speaker: Yanyan
content: I didn't tell you what it was at the time, but I've found all the answers to my questions already. So I can spill everything now!
She pauses for suspense, like a child about to proudly present their treasured possession.

speaker: Yanyan
content: I want to become the best seer ever! That was my wish!

speaker: Chief
content: You're breaking it to me now? Won't that jinx it?

speaker: Yanyan
content: Hehe, Yanyan isn't afraid anymore! Because I will definitely make it happen. It's all up to me!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Everyone's wish and Yanyan's wish... Now I know that as long as we keep believing, they will all come true! Yanyan will make them come true!

speaker: Chief
content: I believe in you. By the time we meet again, you'll have definitely become the best seer there is.

speaker: Yanyan
content: And you'll have become the best Chief there is, ${PlayerName}!
You exchange a glance and laugh together. Yanyan stretches out her hand, signaling you to copy her.
You lock your little fingers and bump your thumbs together. A pinky promise sealed with a stamp of the thumb.

speaker: Yanyan
content: In Sunsink City, that's how we seal a promise! Come on, say it with me: Cross your pinkies, swear you won't regret it, not in a hundred years!

speaker: Yanyan
content: Let's do our best! We'll make it! Then I guess... I'll see you next time!
The girl waves at you one last time, then walks away with her bags of gifts.
Her figure is just as tiny and slender as before, but those small but firm shoulders are now capable of bearing responsibilities.
She turns and walks into the rising sun, advancing in her life and into her future.

speaker: Masked Man
content: Ah, the old sheriff was living a comfortable life before everything went downhill, it seems.

speaker: Masked Man
content: Look at the walls, the chandelier, the ceiling...

speaker: Masked Man
content: Sigh... I wonder what got into his head. A respectable sheriff spending so much time in a casino and ending up with these lowlifes on his tail...
The masked man kicks one of the debt collectors who were shot and are lying on the floor. Then he turns to the woman tightly bound to a chair.

speaker: Masked Man
content: Do you know, my beautiful lady?
Bang!
A gunshot rings out in the dim room. The bullet embeds itself in the wall. The man wearing the eerie mask freezes for a second.
Don't... don't touch my mom! L-let her go!
The voice belongs to a girl. She has her gun trained on the man, her hand trembling visibly. The woman tied to the chair keeps shaking her head, as if trying to tell the girl not to act rashly.

speaker: Masked Man
content: Oh, how impressive! Just so you know, I'm not as easy to deal with as these debt collectors.
Oliver
The man walks up to the girl leisurely. He bends forward to pick up the casing and squints at it.

speaker: Masked Man
content: .40 caliber, right? The Eastside Public Security Bureau's standard-issue semi-automatic pistol.

speaker: Masked Man
content: How many shots did you fire at these idiots? Seven? Eight?

speaker: Masked Man
content: Counting the one you greeted me with... And now five more... Honestly, it's a bit of a waste.
As he talks, the man removes the bullets from his torso one by one. He takes a long look at them before strolling back to the woman.

The man's skin has an almost metallic sheen where the faint moonlight bounces off it. He places the bullets on the woman's upturned palm and squints sideways at the girl who somehow escaped being tied up by the debt collectors.

speaker: Masked Man
content: You have a very talented daughter.

speaker: Woman
content: Leave her alone! Take anything you want! Just leave her alone!

speaker: Masked Man
content: That wouldn't be necessary, madam. The things in this house weren't good enough for these debt collectors. You don't really think the leader of the <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color> are none the wiser, do you?

speaker: Woman
content: <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color>?!
The woman's face turns paler, a study in fear. The bullets fall from her hand onto the floor.
The man wearing the grotesque mask grabs the barrel of the gun in the girl's hand and presses the muzzle tightly against his forehead.

speaker: Masked Man
content: Come on, shoot!

speaker: Masked Man
content: We're birds of a feather. You shouldn't waste your talents here.
The girl's face is dripping with tears mingled with sweat. She tries to let go of the gun, but the man stops her, pinning her hand to the grip.

speaker: Masked Man
content: Shoot, or I'll destroy everything you hold dear, one by one.

speaker: Masked Man
content: Come on, shoot!
Scene change

speaker: Team Member A
content: The Corruptor is right in front of you! Don't just stand there!
The sound of gunfire and her teammates' roars snap the girl out of her daze. She refocuses her eyes on the monster not far away.

speaker: Corruptor
content: Roooar!

speaker: Team Member A
content: It's coming again. Stop shooting and fan out!
Upon receiving the teammate's instructions, the girl reacts instinctively.
She sidesteps to avoid the monster's pounce, rolls behind it. She steadies herself, and trains her gun on it, ready to shoot.

speaker: Corruptor
content: Roooar!
The monster pounces again, its claws slicing through the air, creating an air current.
The girl pulls the trigger. An explosive sound. A specially-made bullet hits the monster's midriff. She reloads and approaches the monster.
The Corruptor, harassed by the humans, becomes even more berserk. It raises its arms high and brings them down on the ground.
A thick cloud of dust rises. Rocks fly every which way. And then there is silence all around. Thinking that most of the pests have met their demise, the monster feels pleased with itself.

speaker: Corruptor
content: Ha!
The monster shakes its body, as if in celebration of its victory over the humans. It makes to eliminate those who are still alive...

speaker: Young Girl
content: Letting your guard down on the battlefield is a fatal mistake.
The girl bursts out of the curtain of smoke, charging at the monster, and leaps into the air when it is close.
She trains the gun on the monster's head, her body curving into the shape of a bow.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Disappear!
She is about to pull the trigger to kill the monster when she notices how its entire body gleams faintly.
It reminds her of the invincible evil being that appeared out of nowhere on that fateful night.
The monster takes advantage of the girl's lapse of concentration and swings at her. The blow comes so fast that she has no time to react. It connects and sends her flying.
My spine will probably hit a nearby building and shatter to pieces, she thinks as she is hurtling through the air.

speaker: Team Member B
content: Jane, are you okay?! Jane, do you copy?
Her teammate's voice over the radio, the howling of the wind, the Corruptor's roars... they blend together, growing fainter and fainter.
It wouldn't be so bad to die like this. There would be compensation. The money could be used to pay for Mom's treatment.
This could be a way to free me from that nightmare.
T-thank goodness we made it...
Don't misuse the shackles... The Undertakers save no man.
Her hearing is back. She's still alive. The excruciating pain in her shoulder is proof enough.
She can hear voices, very close to her. Two voices? They seem to be arguing...
She opens her eyes. A man in gray is standing in front of her, with a chain of crimson thorns extending from his hand. And the other end of the chain is connected to a girl wielding a giant chainsaw.
female_content: She opens her eyes. A woman in gray is standing in front of her, with a chain of crimson thorns extending from her hand. And the other end of the chain is connected to a girl wielding a giant chainsaw.

content: The person clad in gray quickly approaches the girl who has just regained consciousness to check on her.

speaker: Person In Gray
content: You've done enough. To hold the Corruptor back for as long as you did under such circumstances... You're an exceptional sheriff.

speaker: Person In Gray
content: I'll take it from here.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Cough... Thanks...
She makes to get up but is stopped by a restraining hand.

speaker: Person In Gray
content: You need to rest. The medical team is coming. Please allow me to give you first aid. To stop the bleeding.

speaker: Young Girl
content: All right...
The good Samaritan locates the girl's wound and borrows her dagger.

He tears pieces of cloth from his coat with the help of the dagger, places one of them on the girl's wound, and ties the rest around it. Then he snaps a twig off a nearby bush, threads it between the two layers of cloth, and twists it to exert more pressure on the wound.
female_content: She tears pieces of cloth from her coat with the help of the dagger, places one of them on the girl's wound, and ties the rest around it. Then she snaps a twig off a nearby bush, threads it between the two layers of cloth, and twists it to exert more pressure on the wound.

speaker: Person In Gray
content: You hang in there. It'll be over soon. Don't close your eyes. You must stay conscious.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Okay...
She nods ever so slightly, her teeth clenched. Fortunately, the monster's claws didn't hit any artery. The pain is persistent, but the bleeding has stopped, and the dizziness has subsided.

speaker: FAC
content: Give the command! Where is the command?
I want to eliminate every Corruptor here!
The Sinner's voice is wild, almost animalistic. She seems to be on the verge of losing control.

speaker: Person In Gray
content: Wendy, eliminate the Corruptor!
The shackles linking the two start glowing white. Upon receiving the order, the girl named Wendy dashes forward in a strange posture, instantly slicing off one of the Corruptor's arms.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Is this...
The girl watches what's unfolding in front of her in amazement. A powerful current of energy flows gently between the two through the shackles.
This person dressed in gray who just saved her life, she is absolutely certain now, is the legendary Chief of the MBCC.
Wendy parries the monster's attack, and spinning, cuts the ugly Corruptor in half with her chainsaw.

speaker: Person In Gray
content: Wendy, eliminate the Corruptor!
The shackles linking the two start glowing white. Upon receiving the order, the girl named Wendy dashes forward in a strange posture, instantly slicing off one of the Corruptor's arms.

The moment the top half of the Corruptor hits the ground, the red shackles disappear.
"Great power should be restrained and guided by greater power." She came across this phrase in one of the textbooks used in the sheriff academy.

speaker: Young Girl
content: Will I be able to do this too?

You've changed into fresh clothes. You're now in the Public Security Bureau's cafeteria holding a meal voucher in your hand and standing in line for a free meal. A long line has formed in front of each window. You can't help but wonder if you made a wrong decision by agreeing to Dole's request.
Corruptors suddenly appeared on the outskirts of Eastside, near the Rust. The Public Security Bureau decided to engage them to stop their advance.

The Public Security Bureau, with the help of the anti-Mania base, can handle a few scattered Corruptors using their equipment. Nonetheless, mishaps came about. Several sheriffs had been injured, and you arrived just in time to get the situation under control.

As a thank-you, your old friend Dole offered you a voucher for a free meal at the Public Security Bureau's cafeteria, his expression seemingly saying, "The food here is just as good as the MBCC's, if not better." The voucher allows you to order any dish you want and as many dishes as you like.
You took the voucher. Later, you told Wendy to wait at the main entrance for someone from the MBCC to pick her up and left Nightingale a message saying "Social engagements."
You come to the window and order a few of your usual favorites. Nothing fancy.

You give the voucher to the cafeteria lady. She stares at it for a second before picking up a few freshly baked blueberry tarts and placing them on your tray. No one has ever ordered so little with an all-you-can-eat voucher, she says. She insists you take the tarts, or she'll feel guilty.
You glance at the tarts. They look delicious, each with many blueberries in it and a perfectly golden crust. You thank the cafeteria lady and carry the tray of food to the dining area.

The cafeteria is packed, but oddly enough, the tables near the aisle are mostly unoccupied. You don't see objects placed on them or on the seats around them. The sheriffs seem to be giving them a wide berth.
You place your tray on one of the tables. You're wondering if you should find another table to have your meal at when a sheriff approaches you and sets her tray down next to yours.

speaker: Sheriff
content: Please take a seat.
She invites you to sit, tapping the edge of your tray with the handle of her spoon, as if she owned the table.
You recognize her. She is the sheriff you saved from the Corruptor today.
You glance at the girl's abdomen, which is swathed in bandages, but she seems fine.

speaker: Sheriff
content: It's... no big deal. I've been through much worse.

speaker: Sheriff
content: Thank you for today anyway.
While talking to you, the girl keeps her hands busy.
She scoops three teaspoons of sugar and one teaspoon of creamer into her drink, and starts stirring it, thirty times clockwise, thirty times counterclockwise.
Then she wipes the table knife and quickly cuts the croissant into six equal parts, which she butters evenly.
Methodically, she readies all the items on her tray for consumption.

speaker: Option
options: Is this some kind of ritual?

speaker: Sheriff
content: This is what the human body needs for dinner. Six hundred calories.
She flattens and folds the empty skim milk carton and lays it neatly aside.
She needs more nutrients. What she is having is more a meal for someone on a diet than for someone who is recovering from injuries.
You push the blueberry tarts toward her.

speaker: Player
content: Not enough? I've got another voucher here. You can use it to get yourself some meat.
The sheriff in front of you keeps silent, shaking her head.

speaker: Sheriff
content: I don't like that... feeling of not being in control...

speaker: Sheriff
content: It's the same with work. I like capturing criminals, but... when it comes to Corruptors...

speaker: Player
content: You feel you're not up to it?

speaker: Sheriff
content: Yes.

speaker: Sheriff
content: I've seen others successfully defeating Corruptors on TV a few times. Still, I don't know what to do when I actually have to fight them in real life.

speaker: Sheriff
content: If only I were stronger, more capable.
The sheriff looks dejected.

speaker: Option
options: Don't be so hard on yourself.

speaker: Player
content: It's normal to feel scared and confused in the face of unknown dangers... I'm no different.

speaker: Player
content: People like us, we must pluck up our courage and try.

speaker: Sheriff
content: What if you've tried and failed, over and over? What would you do?

speaker: Sheriff
content: Even if in a dangerous situation like the one we were in today, or even more dangerous?
You give no answer. Telling her not to give up no matter the circumstances wouldn't sit well with you. When you're facing an enemy far stronger than you, refusing to give up could cost your life.

speaker: Sheriff
content: I put you on the spot, didn't I? Well, you can just connect me to the shackles. That way...

speaker: Player
content: Cough...
Her remark catches you off guard; you almost choke. You look around to make sure no one can hear you, gesturing for her to lower her voice.

speaker: Player
content: <size=35>Don't discuss the shackles here. It's not something that can be discussed in public. Besides, the shackles are of no use to ordinary people...</size>

speaker: Sheriff
content: Pfft, I know that.
Finally, a smile lights up her solemn face, as a result of a well-executed prank.

speaker: Sheriff
content: Well...

speaker: Sheriff
content: Will you come and participate in other operations in the future?

speaker: Player
content: What do you mean?

speaker: Sheriff
content: Some of the Public Security Bureau's operations involve Sinners.

speaker: Sheriff
content: If you don't, I'll come find you. Think of it as... me returning the favor.

speaker: Option
options: That doesn't sound like something a sheriff would say.

content: The setting sun slants through the window, spilling soft golden light over the snow-white sheets and giving a warm feel to the hospital room.
There is a gentle knock on the door. The door opens. The visitor's long shadow precedes her into the room.
There is a nurse inside. The nurse knows the visitor. She gives a nod and leaves the room.
The girl first checks the window. The paper wedged into the crack is still there. She then unpacks the get-well-soon gifts to see if they're bugged.
Only after making sure nothing is amiss does she allow herself to relax. She replaces the slightly wilted jasmine flowers in the vase with fresh ones.
Next to the vase is a framed family photo. The girl studies the slightly faded photo, an encapsulation of the happiness shared by a family of three.
She reaches behind the photo frame, twists something, and removes the object holding the frame upright.
It's a bullet, a handgun bullet.

speaker: Jane
content: I have the same dream every day. In the dream, I'm being prodded along toward the edge of a cliff... and then falling off it.

speaker: Jane
content: After I woke up from the dream today, I ate a blueberry tart.

speaker: Jane
content: It was much sweeter than I'd expected, sweeter than anything you've ever made me.

speaker: Jane
content: But it was delicious.
She rises to her feet slowly.

speaker: Jane
content: Mom, I want to try again. I'm a sheriff of the Public Security Bureau now, not a <color=#fb9259>Ghost</color> anymore.

speaker: Jane
content: I still have plenty of money left for your treatment... But I must stop associating with those people, or...

speaker: Jane
content: I met the MBCC Chief today. He's amazing.
female_content: I met the MBCC Chief today. She's amazing.

speaker: Jane
content: If only I could be more like him... the two of you wouldn't have ended up like this.
female_content: If only I could be more like her... the two of you wouldn't have ended up like this.

content: After ending her one-sided conversation, Jane leaves the hospital room. She is walking toward the exit when the nurse from just now hurries up to her, a note in hand.

speaker: Nurse
content: Miss Jane... Good thing I caught you. A hooded man came in just now and asked to give you this.
Jane takes the note and reads it. As the words on it sink in, the bullet slips out of her grasp.
Ding—
Is there a place she can escape to? Jane doesn't know.
How to put an end to the nightmare? Jane doesn't know.
How to kill that demon? Jane doesn't know.
She only knows that the bullet has fallen onto the floor, bounced a few times, and rolled to the base of the wall.

speaker: Nurse
content: Miss Jane, Miss Jane... Are you okay?

speaker: Jane
content: I'm fine. I'm fine...

Dear Jane:

Sorry to interrupt your heartwarming reunion with your mother. I found the hospital, though you'd never told me the address.
How is the game of make-believe going? How many criminals have you caught this year? Oh, you must be strapped for cash, if I'm not mistaken. You'll need a cash injection to pay the medical bills and your dad's lawyer, right?

It's about time you came back. We're going to do a major bank job together.

It's more than 37 million DisCoins this time. As usual, see you at the Bank of Eastside.

—Coleman

speaker: Jane
content: Ah, what a coincidence!

speaker: Player
content: Are you supposed to be here?

speaker: Jane
content: According to the regulations of the Eastside Public Security Bureau, the beat of the bureau's sheriffs includes every area of land in DisCity. We're tasked to handle emergencies, and...

speaker: Player
content: Are you saying the MBCC is also part of your beat?

speaker: Jane
content: Yes.
The sheriff nods, her expression serious. You've found yourself in similar situations many times this month.

speaker: Jane
content: Ah, what a coincidence.

speaker: Player
content: It's a coincidence indeed.

speaker: Jane
content: Ah, what a coincidence.

speaker: Jane
content: Ah, what a coincidence!

speaker: Jane
content: You were in the Public Security Bureau when the news was announced. You must already know the intelligence we've received, that the <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color> are making a move.

speaker: Jane
content: It is believed that the organization has recruited a Sinner. So, as a sheriff, I'm required to keep in contact with the MBCC.

speaker: Player
content: Don't you think we've had way too many "chance" encounters lately?
In the past month, this sheriff by the name of Jane managed to "accidentally" run into you every time you were on a mission outside the MBCC.
She'd share with you the latest information she learned about the Ghosts, and then join you in whatever you were doing that day.

speaker: Player
content: How did you know my schedule?

speaker: Jane
content: Telepathy.

speaker: Jane
content: I want your shackles.
This phrase has become a mantra of hers. You've heard her say it more times than you can count.

speaker: Player
content: Let me say this again, Miss Jane; the shackles are of no use to ordinary people.

speaker: Player
content: They wouldn't help you become better at helping the elderly cross the road, unlocking doors for those who've lost their keys, or performing gun disassembly in front of kids.
You list the things Jane has done over the past month.

speaker: Jane
content: Really? That's a pity. But I won't give up.

speaker: Option
options: Why are you so obsessed with the shackles?

speaker: Jane
content: I want to become stronger, much stronger.

speaker: Jane
content: Or you could make me an MBCC Sinner. What do you say?
Jane makes a peace sign, her face betraying nothing. The Band-Aids wrapped around her index and ring fingers are stained with dried blood. She must have been training hard in secret.

speaker: Option
options: If you become a Sinner, you can't be a sheriff anymore.

speaker: Jane
content: I see... That's a pity.
Jane shakes her head, then suddenly looks up at you, as if she's just remembered something.

speaker: Jane
content: Um, there is this person who is a robber turned sheriff. What do you think of that?

speaker: Player
content: Why would this person want to become a sheriff?

speaker: Jane
content: Maybe it's because this person thought they could do better and wanted to live a virtuous life.

speaker: Jane
content: They were sick of cracking safes and robbing banks in Eastside during the day, and sleeping in an armory at night.

speaker: Jane
content: This person wanted to get back at their fellow robbers, so they joined the opposite side.

speaker: Option
options: How is this person adjusting to their new life in the PSB?

speaker: Player
content: It sounds like something that can only happen in fiction.

speaker: Jane
content: Real life can be more fantastical than fiction sometimes.

speaker: Jane
content: Hmm, hard to say how well this person is adjusting.

speaker: Jane
content: Maybe, for this robber turned sheriff, choosing to join the Public Security Bureau means they have found their moral compass. Maybe.

speaker: Option
options: You're quite an expert on this subject, it seems.

speaker: Jane
content: I... This is the personal experience of one of my colleagues. I overheard it while I was slacking at work. Sounds pretty awesome, huh?

speaker: Player
content: A more suitable place for this colleague of yours would be the MBCC. Many of the MBCC Sinners have similar experiences.

speaker: Jane
