Sometime later, the morning news announced Vick's arrest and imprisonment on multiple charges. However, as Pine carefully read through the list of allegations, the blood drained from her face.
The remote slipped from her grip, batteries scattering across the floor. Finally coming to her senses, she reached for her phone with trembling hands and dialed Worthington's number.
It was another rainy night. The young woman sat motionless in the cafe, the storm outside matching the turmoil in her heart.

speaker: Pine
content: The evidence you gave me was all fake, wasn't it? You came to me with fabricated evidence when I was desperate to prove my worth!

speaker: Pine
content: You knew someone like me, with no connections, had no way to verify the evidence. All I could do was trust your word, only to be exploited as your pawn to bring down your superior and clear your path to promotion!
In stark contrast to Pine's outburst, Worthington remained perfectly at ease. He reclined on the sofa, hands folded over his knees, watching the furious young woman with calculated composure.

speaker: Worthington
content: So what if the evidence was fake? He was never a good person to begin with. You know full well what he's done.

speaker: Worthington
content: Pine, this isn't exploitation—it's a mutually beneficial arrangement. I provided an opportunity, and you helped me solve a problem and got your chance to prove your worth. Isn't that the perfect outcome?

speaker: Pine
content: How could you do this?! How could you use fabricated evidence to make me do your dirty work?!

speaker: Worthington
content: You know full well that without the evidence I provided, you could never have written that article, let alone put him behind bars. Your dreams, everything you wanted to prove—none of it would have been possible.

speaker: Worthington
content: Without my fabricated evidence, you'd still be nobody but an unemployed college graduate, sitting in some cheap apartment worrying about how to pay your utility bills.

speaker: Worthington
content: But you're not a student anymore, Pine. This is how the real world works—the end justifies the means. We used fabricated evidence to draw an investigation, which led us to real evidence, and he got the punishment he deserved.

speaker: Worthington
content: You see what this is, right? Different approaches, same outcome. Essentially, we both achieved the same goal—eliminating a threat to society, didn't we?
His rushed tone gradually steadied itself.

speaker: Worthington
content: Pine, you're incredibly talented, but your potential has been wasted all this time. Others may be blind to it, but I see what you're truly capable of.

speaker: Worthington
content: This collaboration has only reinforced my belief that I chose the right person. I want you to work with me—together, we can pursue what we believe is right.

Pine found herself at a loss for words, perhaps because there was nothing left to say. As she watched this ambitious man climbing the rungs of power with such vigor, she was surprised to find only an infinite calmness settling in her heart.
Suddenly, the Worthington before her seemed like a stranger. He appeared different from all the others on the surface, yet somehow, he was exactly the same.
But wasn't everyone just the same in the end? This world, and every single person in it. No exceptions, no one spared.

speaker: Pine
content: You're right. This is just how the real world works. I should thank you for teaching me such a valuable lesson—"the ends justify the means." Truly... enlightening.

speaker: Pine
content: But I'm afraid your only companion on this path will be the one already behind bars, not me—because one day, I'll personally make sure you end up right there with him.
Pine rose to her feet and cast one last impassive glance at the man who sat there, perfectly composed in his arrogance.

speaker: Pine
content: Our approaches are different, and so are our outcomes. This is our last meeting.
Then?

speaker: Pine
content: Then, someone slit my throat on my way home. Lucky for me, I awakened as a Sinner just in time—that's the only reason I'm standing here talking to you now.

Pine's tone remains as abrasive and irritating as ever, but you find yourself quietly relieved. An increasing certainty settles within you that she isn't the unprincipled, irresponsible person she appears to be. Perhaps in Pine's heart, there has always been a delicate balance—a scale that never stops weighing right and wrong.
If you two are done chatting, perhaps it's time to show yourselves?
A familiar voice cuts through the air, and you both suddenly realize that Hale has emerged beside you, unnoticed until now.

speaker: Hale
content: No need to be so surprised. After all, you're not the only ones who know how to use these gadgets.
He leans against the wall, pointing to the blue-lit earpiece on his ear. Pine pulls open your coat and feels around, unsurprised to find a tiny listening device tucked away in your pocket.
Was it when we bumped into each other in the lobby...?

speaker: Pine
content: Heh, seems you're not as stupid as we thought. We underestimated you.
Pine lets out a quiet laugh and carelessly tosses aside the listening device. Then, she walks straight up to the man and candidly reveals both her identity and purpose.

speaker: Pine
content: The Hedgehog's Eye received an anonymous tip accusing you of multiple crimes, including abuse of power, financial fraud, and orchestrating the pharmaceutical factory explosion.

speaker: Pine
content: Based on our investigation, we believe your superior, Worthington, is likely behind the tip. After looking into the conflicts between you two, he's emerged as our prime suspect.
After hearing Pine's words, Hale's face shows no trace of surprise. He shakes his head thoughtfully.

speaker: Hale
content: I'm aware of this... but Worthington isn't behind it.
Do you know who the whistleblower is?
Hale looks at you both and gives a slight nod, an unexpected smile slowly spreading across his face.

speaker: Hale
content: It's me.

The luxury black sedan glides smoothly along the road. Inside, a middle-aged man sips his iced wine while gazing at the city lights coming alive outside his window. Their reflection on the glass transforms into a dazzling constellation.
His phone rings, and the middle-aged man answers it, letting a deliberate silence hang before the caller speaks.

speaker: Hale
content: Mr. Worthington, I've captured the target as per your instructions.

speaker: Hale
content: As I suspected, she had been following me. I've handed her over to your men and sent all relevant information to you.
Just as he finishes speaking, a notification ping sounds in the car. Worthington opens his backup device to find a digital file from his trusted operative.

Pine's personal records have been erased, with her file marked as "dead." The attached photo shows her motionless body lying in an alley corner, covered in mud. Her voice recorder lies shattered on the ground beside her.
Worthington studies the photo for a while before deleting it with satisfaction.

speaker: Worthington
content: Well done. Rest assured, I'll make sure that you receive your share as promised.

speaker: Worthington
content: I'll personally introduce you at tonight's charity gala in Eastside. Make sure to highlight all your recent philanthropic work in town—it never hurts to get familiar with Eastside's elite circles, Future Councilor of Shedde.
Without waiting for Hale's response, Worthington ends the call, tosses the phone aside, and lets out a contemptuous sneer.

speaker: Worthington
content: Ideals and principles? Please. People only stick to their convictions because they haven't been offered the right price yet.
The sedan comes to a smooth stop in front of a hotel. The middle-aged man adjusts his expensive suit and practices his smile before stepping out with the chauffeur's assistance.
In an instant, a surge of camera flashes erupts around him, illuminating what would prove to be a momentous evening.

speaker: Host
content: This year, philanthropy stands as one of Eastside's key development initiatives. Ladies and gentlemen, your dedication to charitable causes deserves our highest commendation and sets an example for us all.

speaker: Host
content: And now, please welcome our distinguished representative from Shedde Town, Mr. Worthington, to deliver his address!
The banquet hall erupts in thunderous applause. Amid waves of adulation and flattery, Worthington makes his way to the stage with measured steps, takes the microphone, and clears his throat.

speaker: Worthington
content: While I stand here as a representative, the truth is that everyone present has contributed far more to our cause and wields greater influence than I do. My presence on this stage is purely thanks to your gracious humility in offering me this opportunity to speak.

speaker: She smothers her agony, forces back the encroaching contamination with a sweeping slash, and plants herself as the final barrier between you and the horde.
content: As many of you may have heard, our town recently experienced a tragic incident. The pharmaceutical factory suffered an explosion due to aging equipment—a devastating accident that weighs heavily on my heart to this day, particularly for those families who lost their loved ones.

speaker: Worthington
content: What you may not know is that in the wake of this incident, amid the overwhelming public outcry, Mr. Hale—my subordinate and Shedde's administrative officer—stepped forward without hesitation. He shared my burden, working tirelessly alongside me in the aftermath to minimize the impact and contribute significantly to the factory's reconstruction efforts.

speaker: Worthington
content: As philanthropy is the theme of tonight's gathering, and since this promising young man has dedicated his career to charitable works, I'd like to invite him to say a few words. I hope you'll all give him your warmest encouragement—after all, making new connections can only benefit us all!
At this point, naturally, no one would object. The host, promptly following the new program, proceeds to invite this supposedly accomplished young man to the stage.
Amid polite applause and curious whispers, Hale makes his way to the stage, takes the microphone, and positions himself at the center.

speaker: Hale
content: I must thank Mr. Worthington for providing me with countless opportunities that have led me to where I stand today, sharing my accomplishments with you all. Regarding the factory incident, as Mr. Worthington mentioned, we've worked tirelessly to resolve numerous issues.

speaker: Hale
content: Such as initiating the factory's reconstruction, consoling the bereaved families, distributing compensation payments, processing insurance claims for injured workers, and securing new employment opportunities for those who lost their jobs...

speaker: Hale
content: However, I believe that Mr. Worthington is the sole reason for all these issues to be addressed and resolved.
Hale's eyes meet Worthington's, who stands nearby nodding with approval and encouragement.

speaker: Hale
content: Ladies and gentlemen, do you know why I say Mr. Worthington is the sole reason?
Hale pauses for a moment, a smile playing on his lips as his gaze sweeps across every person in the banquet hall.

speaker: Hale
content: That's because he is the origin of this incident—the mastermind behind this tragedy!
The banquet hall falls into a stunned silence.
After a moment, murmurs of unrest ripple through the crowd. Seeing this, Worthington rushes forward and snatches the microphone from Hale's hand.

speaker: Worthington
content: Please, everyone, let me explain!

speaker: Worthington
content: This young man got a bit too excited about his introduction today and had one too many drinks! He's just making silly jokes! Someone, please help escort him out so he can get some rest!
Several bodyguards catch their employer's signal and immediately begin advancing along the edges of the banquet hall.
He's not joking! We have proof!
Suddenly, a woman's firm voice rings out from the corner of the hall.
All eyes turn towards the source of the sound—Pine, the woman believed to have been "taken care of," now standing unscathed. You stand behind her, silently watching as events are about to unfold.

Pine gracefully evades the circle of bodyguards and leaps onto the stage, positioning herself right in front of Worthington. A wave of gasps and whispers ripples through the crowd below. At the sight of Pine, Worthington's face turns pale, though he forces himself to maintain a smile.

speaker: Worthington
content: Miss, please step down from the stage. If you have any complaints or suspicions about me, you can file them through proper channels instead of causing repeated disruptions like this.

speaker: Pine
content: Causing disruptions? Are you so eager to get rid of me because I'm being disruptive, or because you have something to hide?

speaker: Pine
content: You want proper channels? Fine, let's show everyone exactly how your proper channels really work.
Catching Pine's signal, you quickly power up her laptop and the hall's projector. A moment later, a scanned document appears on the screen.
Pine clears her throat, pulls out a microphone from her pocket, and turns the volume up to maximum.

speaker: Pine
content: Ladies and gentlemen, take a look at this document provided by the manager of Shedde's pharmaceutical factory. It clearly details the financial transactions between him and Worthington—each transfer worth millions of DisCoins!
A collective gasp echoes through the crowd, but Pine only responds with a knowing smirk.

speaker: Pine
content: We're not done yet. I've also got a video for you.
The screen switches to surveillance footage, clearly showing Worthington and the pharmaceutical factory's manager in conversation within a secret laboratory:

speaker: Factory Manager
content: ...Those researchers are threatening to expose everything we've done. If we don't give them an answer, they're really going to the authorities!

speaker: Worthington
content: Authorities? Out of the question. I won't allow it. And neither will you. An accident would be better, wouldn't it? It can help us eliminate the liability completely, and I'll even gain some sympathy and goodwill...

speaker: Worthington
content: This is fabricated! Illegal methods! This is—
Worthington's face turns ghostly pale as he desperately clutches the microphone to defend himself, only to be cut off by Pine's cold, mocking laugh.

speaker: Pine
content: Fabricated, you say? Well, then how would you explain this internal laboratory report?

The screen lights up again, this time displaying a detailed experimental log documenting research into illegal drugs involving Mania. At the bottom of the document, there's a clear signature from the facility manager, along with Worthington's written instruction: "Provide full support regardless of cost."

speaker: Pine
content: There's a secret laboratory inside Shedde's pharmaceutical factory, dedicated to developing illegal drugs for massive profits. And you, Town Councilor of Shedde, not only have you been taking your cut of the profits for years, but you've also abused your authority to protect these criminals.

speaker: Pine
content: In recent years, the laboratory wasn't content with just illegal drugs anymore—they ventured into Mania research. But the researchers, fearing for their lives, demanded to leave the project.

speaker: Pine
content: They banded together to pressure you and the factory manager, threatening to expose all evidence of illegal research over the years if you didn't let them walk away, ready to bring everyone down with them if necessary.
Pine advances towards Worthington, closing in relentlessly without giving an inch.

speaker: Pine
content: The factory explosion was no accident at all—it was a tragedy orchestrated by you and the manager!

speaker: Pine
content: Covering up illegal research, silencing the researchers, and still managing to win public sympathy while currying favor with Eastside's elite—what a flawless plan, wasn't it?
The crowd erupts into chaos as countless phones point toward the stage, camera flashes lighting up the scene in waves. Worthington tries to speak, but his voice trembles with panic.

speaker: Pine
content: Your so-called "dedication to the factory's reconstruction" was nothing but stepping stones made from innocent blood!
Pine's voice grows more piercing as she jabs an accusing finger right in Worthington's face.

speaker: Pine
content: You thought your power would shield you, but today, I'll show your true colors to all of Eastside—no, to the whole world!

speaker: Worthington
content: You're crazy... You're crazy! Guards! Where are my bodyguards?! Get her out of here!
As Worthington's voice breaks into desperate howls, his bodyguards attempt to approach the podium, only to be intercepted by Public Security Bureau agents who have been lying in wait.
The sound of synchronized footsteps echoes from the banquet hall entrance as a sheriff marches in with his team, fixing Worthington with a cold stare.

speaker: Sheriff
content: Mr. Worthington, you are suspected of multiple charges, including murder and concealment of illegal activities. Please cooperate with our investigation.
Worthington completely loses his composure and tries to flee through the crowd, only to be immediately arrested. Still, he struggles wildly, his face flushed red as he screams in a hoarse voice:

speaker: Worthington
content: Everything I did was for Shedde! The illegal drug research at the factory—it was all to secure more funding and support, to save our collapsing economy! Without the factory, what would be left of this town?!

speaker: Worthington
content: The explosion... it all boils down to the researchers' incompetence! Yes, I may have been careless, failing to supervise them strictly, but everything is to ensure the people of Shedde have food on their tables, jobs to work, and a future to look forward to!

speaker: Worthington
content: You can't arrest me! Do you have any idea how much I've sacrificed for Shedde over the years?! No one will ever love this place and its people as much as I do!

Yet in the face of irrefutable evidence laid bare before everyone, all his elaborate excuses and justifications ring hollow. The only response to Worthington's desperate explanations comes in the form of harsh camera flashes and contemptuous stares.

speaker: Worthington
content: And you... you...
As the security officers escort him past you and Pine, Worthington lunges forward with bloodshot eyes and grabs Pine by the collar.

speaker: Worthington
content: You'll regret this, Pine! You have no idea what you're getting yourself into! This won't make you a hero—you'll get yourself destroyed! Mark my words, you'll go down just like me!

speaker: Pine
content: ...I know I'm doomed sooner or later, and this world is too, Councilor.
Pine takes an apathetic step back. She swats away Worthington's grip on her collar as if brushing off a speck of dust.

speaker: Pine
content: But I refuse to let someone like you outlive me.
This afternoon, in an alley in Shedde.
...So let me get this straight—you reported yourself under Worthington's orders, with the purpose of drawing Pine out and delivering her to him.
And you agreed to this because he promised to make you the next Town Councilor of Shedde once he advances his own position?
Upon Hale's confirmation, Pine furrows her brow.

speaker: Pine
content: I still don't get it. You sent me the email, yet you also led us to this alley—which means you did accept his terms and the plan has been in motion.

speaker: Pine
content: If that's the case, why did you suddenly turn against him and tell us everything?
Hale turns his gaze to Pine.

speaker: Hale
content: Because of you.

speaker: Pine
content: Me?
You and Pine exchange a puzzled look.

speaker: Hale
content: Actually, I've been aware of your presence since you first showed up outside our office building early this morning. Installing cameras, planting bugs, infiltrating for information, going through my files—I knew about all of it.

speaker: Hale
content: To be honest, I've been quite curious about you. I've heard completely different opinions about the Hedgehog's Eye—some say you're nothing but troublemakers, while others call you legendary. I was never sure which view was the right one.

speaker: Hale
content: Watching you today has really opened my eyes to the fact that you're not quite what most people think. Your investigation is thorough and meticulous—you're genuinely seeking the truth, not just chasing sensational headlines.
Hale looks up at Pine, his expression growing grave.

speaker: Hale
content: This has made me see you in a new light, and it reminds me of who I used to be—full of ideals when I first entered this circle, aspiring to be a beacon of light that dispels darkness, instills hope in all, and guides towards a brighter future.
Hale's voice drops to barely above a whisper, as if lost in painful memories.

speaker: Hale
content: But the reality is, my work has made enemies of many superiors, Worthington included. Yes, I've known for a long time that Worthington is nothing but a complete hypocrite. He's been suppressing me, retaliating against me, tearing down everything I've worked for...

speaker: Pine
content: Did you try to fight back?

speaker: Hale
content: How could I fight back? File reports? Lodge complaints? Stage protests? I tried everything imaginable countless times, but in the end, he shut down my every single attempt.

speaker: Hale
content: During that time, I was nearly driven to the edge of sanity. I started to doubt whether my principles would ever work, whether... the only way to bring him down and win my place was to fight in the same underhanded way as he did.
Pine folds her arms across her chest, her brows furrowed as she speaks.

speaker: Pine
content: And then he just happened to extend an olive branch to you?

speaker: Hale
content: That's right. Just a few days ago, he came to me with an offer—if I helped him catch you, he'd let bygones be bygones and promote me.

speaker: Hale
content: I had my doubts about his true intentions... but I also felt that this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity—a chance to completely turn my situation around.

speaker: Hale
content: I thought that instead of fighting him head-on, I could pretend to accept his offer. If I could truly become his confidant, I might find the smoking gun I needed to bring him down for good.
Pine lets out a scoff, her tone remaining contemptuous.

speaker: Pine
content: So you decided to play double agent?

speaker: Hale
content: Yes, that was my original plan, but then... I overheard your conversation, about your past.
Hale turns to Pine, his eyes betraying a storm of emotions.

speaker: Hale
content: You remind me of what I originally stood for. In the end, I just can't bow down to the world like this. I can't let myself become someone like him. I figured I might as well hold onto my naive ideals one last time—
He pauses for a moment, his gaze growing intensely resolute.

speaker: Hale
content: So, if you're willing, I'd like to work with you. I have complete faith in your abilities now. With your help, perhaps we can find a more just way to bring Worthington down.

speaker: Pine
content: I might consider working together, but before that, I have a question—

Despite Hale's heartfelt confession, Pine remains unmoved. Her eyes bore into his with an unwavering intensity as she takes out her phone, pulling up the list of criminal evidence from the tip-off and thrusting it before him.

speaker: Pine
content: How much of this is real? Were you involved? Don't lie to me—think carefully before you answer.

speaker: Hale
content: Of course, it's not true! It's all fabricated!

speaker: Pine
content: Oh? It takes quite some skill to forge evidence without leaving a single trace.
Pine raises an eyebrow, skepticism written all over her face. Her provocative demeanor finally pushes Hale over the edge.

speaker: Hale
content: I'm not lying to you! I couldn't have done any of this! Worthington had all this fake evidence prepared—he just told me to forward it to you!
Pine falls silent for a moment, seemingly accepting his explanation. But she soon strokes her chin, her brow furrowing once again.

speaker: Pine
content: Still... feels like we're missing something here...

speaker: Pine
content: With Worthington's capabilities, he could have made this plan airtight. He wouldn't have left any chance for you to have second thoughts like this... Is he pressed for time? Is that why he's been rushing things? Why is he so desperate to get rid of me?
You purse your lips in contemplation.

If this is just about you disrupting his public speech three days ago, it seems rather far-fetched... He's left you alone all these years without sending another assassin, confident that you couldn't take him down anytime soon. There's no reason for him to rush now, unless...
A sudden realization strikes you. When your eyes meet Pine's, it's clear that you have both reached the same conclusion.
She claps her hands suddenly and continues.

speaker: Pine
content: Unless he thinks I've gotten my hands on some damning evidence against him in the past couple of days!
She quickly scrolls through the evidence on her phone, finally stopping at a photo of Hale at the pharmaceutical factory late at night.

speaker: Pine
content: This has to be it—the factory explosion!
Hale's eyes widen in complete shock.

speaker: Hale
content: So this "accident" was actually orchestrated by him?!

Now everything makes sense. If his plan succeeded, he could use you to eliminate Pine while gaining leverage to keep controlling you. If it failed, he could still use Pine to pin the explosion on you and walk away clean.
Either way, he has all angles covered with his brilliantly calculated scheme.

speaker: Hale
content: So... what should we do now?
Pine breaks into a smile.

speaker: Pine
content: Expose him, of course. How could we pass up such a perfect opportunity?

speaker: Hale
content: But that brings us back to our original problem—we don't have any evidence.

speaker: Pine
content: If we don't have evidence, then we'll find some. Tell me, according to your original plan, how were you supposed to hand me over to him?

speaker: Hale
content: Worthington gave me his trusted subordinate's contact information. This man was supposed to take care of you. He accompanies Worthington everywhere and has unrestricted access to both his office and residence.

speaker: Pine
content: Perfect. Worthington's trust in this person can work to our benefit. You can continue to play along and contact him to come pick me up. Once we have him under control, we'll use his phone to message Worthington, making him believe his plan has succeeded.

speaker: Pine
content: Let's start by squeezing some information out of this trusted associate of his. Even if he keeps his mouth shut, ${PlayerName} and I can still pay a visit to the pharmaceutical factory manager. I'm sure he must've kept some dirt on Worthington from their dealings as insurance.
Pine turns to you with a devious smile.

speaker: Pine
content: These shrewd businessmen are masters at reading the wind. We simply have to intimidate him with your authority, make it clear that we're aware of everything, and hint at leniency in exchange for cooperation. He'll scramble in no time to hand over the evidence against Worthington.
Finally, she gestures at Hale.

speaker: Pine
content: As for you, Worthington is taking you to that charity gala in Eastside tonight, right? Attend as planned and buy us as much time as you can until we get there.

speaker: Pine
content: Any questions? No? ...Then let's get moving!
Outside the hotel, you stand with Hale and Pine, watching the Public Security Bureau vehicles drive away as their sirens fade into the distance. A storm of emotions wells up inside you.

speaker: Pine
content: Hey, are you really going to keep doing this?

speaker: Hale
content: Are you asking me?

speaker: Pine
content: Who else would I be asking? The rookie standing next to me?
Pine rolls her eyes, but her expression quickly turns grave as she addresses Hale.

speaker: Pine
content: I'm dead serious. After everything you've seen—the factory accident, the evidence displayed in the banquet hall, the darkness and hypocrisy of those people—do you still want to stay?
Hale gives a slight smile, his gaze shifting between you and Pine for a moment.

speaker: Hale
content: Of course. If anything, meeting you both has only strengthened my resolve to hold onto these foolish, naive aspirations of mine a little longer.
Pine's eyes darken as she parts her lips, only to restrain herself from speaking.

speaker: Hale
content: I understand your concerns and what you're trying to tell me. But this whole thing has taught me that to change darkness, one must step into it—criticizing from the safety of the light alone accomplishes nothing.

speaker: Hale
content: Only by truly immersing myself in it, experiencing its cruelty and suffocation firsthand as you have, can I find the opportunity to shatter it completely.
Hearing Hale's words, Pine lets out a sardonic laugh, her tone brimming with mockery.

speaker: Pine
content: You make it sound so simple, but do you really understand? Once you step onto this path, there's no turning back.

speaker: Pine
content: You'll only face more situations like this in the future, each more dangerous than the last. And when deeper temptations arise, holding onto your principles will only get harder... One wrong step, and there's no coming back from that abyss!

speaker: Pine
content: Your end could be just as tragic as Worthington's today—tomorrow it could be you in his place. You have no idea what kind of person you might meet down the road, sharing the same end.
Yet in the face of Pine's doubts, Hale simply nods once more, his expression grave and resolute.

speaker: Hale
content: I understand everything you're saying, but my mind is made up. I don't know what the future holds, but I promise to always remember your words of warning in this moment, and everything we've faced together today.

speaker: Hale
content: So if one day I end up like those you despise, I ask that you bring me to justice, just as we did to Worthington today.

speaker: Hale
content: Besides, it's not all that grim. Who says every person in a position of power has to be beyond redemption? Don't we have a perfect example of a decent one right here with us?

speaker: Hale
content: I doubt today would have gone this smoothly without his support, don't you think?
female_content: I doubt today would have gone this smoothly without her support, don't you think?

content: With Hale's resolve clear as day, Pine falls silent. She stuffs her hands in her pockets and turns away, walking in the opposite direction.
On your way back, Pine walks beside you in complete silence, seemingly lost in thought.
What's on your mind? Something troubling you? Mind if your "assistant" helps you figure it out?
After a long silence, you try to break the ice with a playful comment. Pine shoots you an irritated look before retorting.

speaker: Pine
content: Help me? Worry about yourself instead of playing therapist. I've only scratched the surface of all the filth in Eastside, but I can tell you this much—there's serious danger ahead of you.
I know, but worrying about it now won't help. We'll cross those bridges when we come to them... For now, let's focus on what's actually bothering you. You're still worried about Hale, aren't you?
Pine lets out a sigh and shakes her head resignedly.

speaker: Pine
content: Whether Hale chooses to get out now or stays trapped in this mess... it shouldn't matter to me. I've never been one to meddle in other people's business. But today, something changed when he smiled at me. I just... couldn't keep quiet.

speaker: Pine
content: I think I saw myself in him... my past self...

speaker: Pine
content: Back then, I still had hope for this world. I believed light could exist even in the darkest places, while I stood in that light, fighting against the darkness... Just like him, I once thought that was enough to challenge everything.
Pine turns to look at you. The city blazes with neon lights, bright as day, but on this dazzling night, how many realize they're sinking into darkness, trapped in a mire of their own making?

speaker: Pine
content: People change, especially when we grow and age in this filth, eventually consumed by it. Soon enough, he won't be who he is now either.

speaker: Pine
content: He might remember our words and everything that happened today, but he'll just laugh it all off someday. He'll mock how naive he once was, thinking he's finally gained the power to control everything.

speaker: Pine
content: He'll end up just like them. He is their past, and they are his future.
Maybe so, but what difference does it make?
Pine stares at you, somewhat puzzled.
Even if he changes in the future, so what?
We should at least believe in who he is right now. Maybe he really can make the world a better place. Besides, in a world this vast, he's not the only one trying to make a difference.

speaker: Pine
content: You...
Going to call me an amateur or rookie again? Before you disagree, maybe you should remember your own go-to phrase—"Without evidence to prove otherwise, you can't claim what I'm saying isn't true."
Pine pauses, her expression caught between amusement and resignation. She turns to gaze at the luminous night sky and murmurs.

speaker: Pine
content: I never did any of this to make the world a better place.

speaker: Pine
content: I just want everyone living in this world to see its truest and ugliest face. Even those who've always been overlooked deserve to know the truth.
But isn't everything you do proof of your own conviction? You keep saying everyone ends up becoming what they despise, yet you've never lost sight of who you are.
Your methods may be questionable, but from what you've told me, I can tell that repeatedly turning down massive temptation isn't something just anyone could do.
But you've done it, Pine.
Even as shadows of emptiness cloak Pine's form, the flame of her ideals has never truly died out. Light and shadow, Pine and this world—they equally exert influence on everything around.
Pine shrugs. Clearly, she still can't accept your optimism, nor what she sees as your misinterpretation of her character.
This time, though, she doesn't even bother arguing with you. After all, even a simple leave permit application is enough to show just how worlds apart your perspectives are.

speaker: Pine
content: Whatever. This messed up world is going to bring itself down eventually, just not today.
She shakes her head and pulls out two lollipops from her chest pocket, warm from being kept close. She pops one in her mouth and offers you the other.

speaker: Pine
content: In that case, might as well have another lollipop.

One day at the MBCC Bureau

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: A crystal vase, a bamboo screen, a Fraser handwoven rug...

speaker: FAC Operative
content: What you're holding right now is the catalog of Mania-contaminated contraband that we confiscated.

speaker: FAC Operative
content: At first, we assumed having this catalog would make it only a matter of time before we tracked down the mastermind.

speaker: FAC Operative
content: But our opponents are sharper than we expected. Despite all this time, we haven't just failed to uncover the source of the smuggling operation; we haven't even located a single remaining item from the catalog.

speaker: FAC Operative
content: Hiding Mania items this thoroughly isn't something ordinary people could pull off. That's why we suspect Sinner involvement, and why we're asking MBCC to step in and assist with the investigation.

The FAC's suspicions are entirely reasonable, but the exquisitely bound catalog they provided offers nothing more than basic item names and pictures. You've spent the entire afternoon poring over these luxury goods—the kind typically found in high-end auction houses—yet you're no closer to finding a clue.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Huh?

...That's right! My viewers really are the brightest. The place I visited during my vacation was... the Disland Park! And guess what? I brought back little souvenirs just for you all! Anyone who participates in the lucky draw through the live chat right now has a chance to win!
As for what the gifts are... well, I'll save that little surprise for the end of the stream!
An enthusiastic female voice rings out from the lounge, the lively tone bouncing crisply off the corridor walls. Drawn in by her infectious energy, you feel curiosity tugging at you.

Peering inside, you spot Wynn and Eugene sitting together. Eugene watches Wynn's bowl of noodles with a resigned expression. Her chopsticks are buried in the tangled strands, but she's utterly absorbed in her phone, her hand frozen mid-motion.

speaker: Wynn
content: Oh, Chief! I'm watching Thalia's stream.

speaker: Eugene
content: She's been totally obsessed with this streamer ever since the Great Expo. Watches while walking, while eating, like, nonstop.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Thalia? That name sounds really familiar...

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wasn't she really active online during the Great Expo?

speaker: Wynn
content: Right! Wait, no way... are you a fan too, Chief? Come on, let's do this lucky draw together! You've always got the best luck!

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I just need to send a message in the live chat, right?
Image Noise Effect

speaker: Thalia
content: Yeah, the lines at Disland were so long today! After spending the whole day there, I was completely exhausted. My back was aching, and my waist was killing me. Luckily, I had this lifesaver with me—this massage device I'm holding right now!

speaker: Thalia
content: "Can you even carry massage devices around?" Ahh, such a good question! That's actually the best part about this one: it's super lightweight and portable. See? I can hold it up with just one hand, no problem!

speaker: Thalia
content: And guess what? If you order now using the link in my stream, you can get two for just 199! Such a steal, right?
Her tone is disarmingly persuasive, like a friend who genuinely cares about your well-being. It easily tugs at anyone, making it hard to resist the purchase link flashing insistently on the screen.
But you're not listening anymore. Your focus shifts to the display shelf behind her.

There it is, the vase. An exact match to the one from the contraband catalog. It sits there, innocently placed, as if it belongs. The screen dissolves the distance between you; for a fleeting moment, it feels close enough to touch.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Wynn, contact FAC immediately and ask them to initiate a special investigation into Eastside streamer Thalia.

speaker: Wynn
content: Huh? G-got it!
The FAC's report comes back quickly. Unfortunately, aside from the crystal vase, they didn't find any other contraband items at Thalia's location.
Still, the operation isn't a complete loss. They've at least brought you a Sinner: Thalia herself.
Now, the interrogation falls to you.

When you step into the interrogation room, Thalia has been waiting for some time. Yet her composure remains flawless—spine straight, shoulders poised, chin lifted just so, arms folded with effortless grace.
She has actually maintained that exact posture this entire time.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Nice to meet you.
Thalia says nothing, answering only with a few measured blinks. She seems determined to maintain her silence as a show of defiance.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Silence won't get you through everything, Miss Ellington.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Let me introduce myself first. I'm the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control—

speaker: Thalia
content: Your assistant already filled me in. Chief ${PlayerName}, right? Pleasure to meet you.
Thalia suddenly cuts you off, her voice laced with evident annoyance.

speaker: Thalia
content: Pardon me, but... am I being interrogated right now? May I ask what this is about?
Her expression remains virtually unchanged from her livestreams, her tone still gentle, yet her words carry hidden barbs sharp enough to catch you off guard.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: According to regulations, we need to conduct routine investigations on every Sinner in DisCity. This is simply part of that standard process.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I'll be asking some basic questions about your abilities and background. Once everything's verified and registered, you'll be free to go.
Thalia's shoulders relax slightly at your explanation, but she keeps her arms crossed and continues gazing at you with guarded eyes.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: According to our investigation, your ability allows you to target any object and enhance its appeal, thereby influencing anyone who sees or comes into contact with the targeted item.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: It looks like becoming a product promotion streamer is a great fit for your ability.
The moment you finish the sentence, Thalia's brow furrows deeply, her eyes flashing with displeasure.

speaker: Thalia
content: Since I entered this industry, I have never used my power for personal gain. I've been competing fairly with my peers from start to finish.

speaker: Thalia
content: If I've managed to do well in my work, it's simply because I've put in enough effort and have sufficient experience. Growing up, I was immersed in classical arts and fashion shows. And I believe, no matter who you are, appreciating beauty is something we all share. With that perspective, I suppose I've learned to recognize what resonates with people.

speaker: Thalia
content: Chief ${PlayerName}, what you just said could be considered an accusation against my professional ethics. I'd appreciate it if you could reconsider your choice of words.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My apologies, I didn't mean to cause any offense. It was just a routine inquiry, and I made an offhand comment without thinking.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Our records do show that you're from the Ellington family. I imagine your refined taste is closely tied to your upbringing.

The Ellington family—once one of Eastside's most powerful houses—was brought to ruin under Owen Ellington, its final patriarch. His disastrous business decisions and unchecked extravagance drained their vast fortune in little more than ten years.
And now, seated before you, is the family's last remaining heir: Owen Ellington's daughter.

Her family's downfall is probably a sore subject, one she would prefer to avoid. You measure your words carefully. Push too hard, and her defenses will snap shut, ending today's interrogation before it truly begins.
Yet Thalia catches your hesitation. Her chin lifts slightly, a ghost of a smirk playing at the corner of her lips.

speaker: Thalia
content: Please, let's not dance around the truth. Yes, I'm from the Ellington family. But when I was eighteen, my father went bankrupt. Before that, my life was just like any other aristocratic child's.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: ...Thank you for your honesty. Aside from your father, do you have other family or friends who could offer support?

speaker: Thalia
content: My mother passed away when I was little. I do have some distant relatives, but after the bankruptcy, they weren't exactly eager to stay in touch. A few even changed their surname to their spouses'. Now, I'm the only one left carrying the Ellington name.

speaker: Thalia
content: As for friends...
Thalia lets out a cold snort.

speaker: Thalia
content: If even blood relatives acted that way, what hope did I have with friends?

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: Still, it seems like you're thriving over in Eastside these days. If I'm not mistaken, you were even involved in Eastside Fashion Week recently? Once an aristocrat, always an aristocrat, even through temporary setbacks.
Your words clearly strike a chord with her, and she breaks into a pleased smile.

speaker: Thalia
content: Of course. My taste isn't something that just disappears, and many of my followers stick around precisely because of that.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: I totally agree with your points. In fact, I've been really interested in some of the products you've featured in your streams.
You turn on the terminal in your hand, pulling up a screenshot from Thalia's stream. With a quick gesture, you zoom in until only the vase fills the screen.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: My colleague and I were catching your stream the other day, and this immediately stood out to me. Mind sharing where you got it?

She glances up at you, wariness flickering in her gaze. You hold her eyes, your own steady and sincere. For a moment, her eyes dart away, then she schools her expression into something deliberately casual.

speaker: Thalia
content: That... I really can't quite remember.

speaker: Thalia
content: I actually have quite a few sponsored collaborations, but my assistant takes care of all the coordination for me, like which brand sent what. That part isn't really my focus; I'm only responsible for promoting the products for the sellers.

speaker: Thalia
content: It should just be one of the items from a sponsorship deal. I simply thought it looked pretty, so I put it on the shelf in my streaming room.

speaker: ${PlayerName}
content: When you first got your hands on it, did anything seem off to you?

Thalia's gaze immediately turns icy at your blunt question, her lips pressing into a tight line, just as they had when she first stepped into the interrogation room. It's clear she has no intention of speaking.
Given how things have unfolded, you see no point in beating around the bush with her anymore.
