content: Its exterior does live up to its title, the eerie castle of doom and mystery.
As you prepare to enter, you hear some chattering behind you.

speaker: Visitor A
content: So this is it, that super spooky haunted castle?

speaker: Visitor A
content: I only came because you promised it'd be absolutely thrilling. It doesn't look too special to me though.

speaker: Visitor B
content: But, but this is the building from that famous Eastside strange tale! There must be a lot of scary stuff inside!

speaker: Visitor A
content: Haha, who cares about scary tales these days? Is there anything scarier than Mania and Corruptors?

speaker: Visitor C
content: Alright, stop teasing him. This is the first time Parker's led a crew. He's done lots of preparation for our adventure... Hey, good evening!
An older man interrupts the bickering pair. He then notices you and greets you in a casual, friendly manner.

speaker: Visitor C
content: I didn't expect to see other people here. Perhaps there is indeed something special about this place!

speaker: Letta
content: ...G-good evening!
Letta promptly greets them back. The young woman next to the man elbows him and comes over warmly to introduce herself and her friends to you.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Nice to meet you, I'm Jennifer. This is Brown, and that's Parker. They're my friends from an outdoor adventure club. We team up to explore mysterious places sometimes.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Are you here for an adventure too?
You can say that.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Aha, we only came in the middle of the night because Parker swore this was a famous strange tale location.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Since we have a common goal, why don't we go in together?
The suggestion seems to appeal to Letta and she agrees right away.

speaker: Letta
content: Hmm... Of course! The more the merrier!
Having agreed on that, the freshly bonded adventure crew begins their journey in high spirits.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Wow, it's pitch dark here... I told you we should bring some flashlights. You guys said candles were more atmospheric? Awesome, now we can't see a thing.

speaker: Brown
content: That was Parker. I didn't suggest the candles.
The interior of the castle is way bigger, darker, and more complex than you imagined.
There are numerous big and small rooms isolated from each other and only connected by meandering narrow passages. The candles brought by Jennifer and her friends are clearly insufficient.

speaker: Parker
content: The candles are not that useless...
Parker protests feebly. Letta nods in agreement.

speaker: Letta
content: Right, it's super atmospheric to explore an abandoned residence with a candle! Like a scene taken out of a classic adventure tale!

speaker: Letta
content: But if you're worried you can't see the path clearly, come closer to me. My lantern covers a bigger range!

speaker: Jennifer
content: ...You're a lifesaver!
Jennifer is the first to huddle over and she links her arm with Letta's.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Thank god Letta's lantern is bright enough, or we'll fall to our death before we get to experience the strange tale! Thanks so much, Letta!

speaker: Letta
content: Haha... Anytime!
From then on, everyone stays close to Letta so she becomes the center of the illumination.
You pick a room randomly. As soon as Letta pushes the door open, a shadow falls abruptly from above and hits her head.

speaker: Letta
content: Ahhh!
Watch out!

speaker: Letta
content: I, I'm fine!
Letta rubs at where she just got hit and looks down at that unknown object.

speaker: Letta
content: Oh... It's a little pigeon.
She picks up the pigeon plushie that was hanging above the doorway and gently brushes off the dust on it.

speaker: Letta
content: Poor thing, it's missing its eyes and a wing. Now even the cotton is spilling out...
Next to her, Jennifer is also examining the tattered toy.

speaker: Jennifer
content: It's pretty badly damaged. But it's fine, it can still be mended.

speaker: Letta
content: ...Mended?

speaker: Brown
content: Jennifer is a seasoned plushie designer. Mending these fluffy little things is her expertise.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Uh-huh, that's right. This one here is just a piece of cake!

speaker: Jennifer
content: Letta, do you like it a lot?

speaker: Letta
content: Hmm... It's a pigeon. I don't want it to spend its life here where it never sees light.

speaker: Letta
content: At least, I want to give it a pair of intact wings...

speaker: Jennifer
content: How about you give it to me and I'll return it to you once I'm done mending it. I can add as many pairs of wings as you want!

speaker: Jennifer
content: Consider it a gift for my new friend!

speaker: Letta
content: Are you sure? That's too kind of you, thank you!
Hugging the pigeon toy, she lifts her head and looks at Jennifer in amazement.
Jennifer takes the toy from Letta and gently pinches her plump cheek.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Haha, not at all. That's because I like you a lot too, Letta!
Next, the crew explores a few more rooms and finds that the arrangements are more or less the same. Other than abandoned furniture, there's only debris of construction materials.
When the initial excitement wears off, everyone is no longer nervous and the thrilling adventure gradually becomes an ordinary nighttime outing.

speaker: Brown
content: That's the last room on the top floor... I suppose that's everything.

speaker: Jennifer
content: So many rooms and all we've seen is broken furniture. See, I told you there was nothing scary about it. This is just an ordinary abandoned residential building.
Jennifer yawns listlessly.

speaker: Jennifer
content: The places you pick are boring, Parker. Well, let's look for some fun on our own next time.

speaker: Jennifer
content: It's quite late now. Why don't we get out of here first?

speaker: Letta
content: Sigh, so even this strange tale is fake... Anyway, I still had a lot of fun today!
Letta is only disappointed for a brief moment before she cheers herself up and says to you with a smile.

speaker: Letta
content: Let's head back, shall we?
Yes. Adventure done, time to go home.

speaker: Parker
content: No... no way! The strange tale is real. There must be other secrets we haven't discovered!
Parker shoves at the others and dashes straight ahead.

speaker: Parker
content: Wait here. I'll show you guys!

speaker: Brown
content: Hey, don't go alone!
Parker sprints recklessly in the dark corridor illuminated by only the dim candlelight. Before Brown catches up with him, he trips on something and falls. The flame touches the front of his shirt.

speaker: Parker
content: Ahhh!
He throws away the candle clumsily and pats his clothes hysterically. The discarded candle happens to land on a pile of old furniture and the sparks set the wood on fire.
The narrow passage is instantly ablaze, the flames lapping the wall and spreading across the whole plane.

speaker: Parker
content: H-help me!
Still in shock, Parker is yanked back by Brown from the source of the fire. Jennifer immediately seizes his collar and shouts.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Are you out of your mind?!

speaker: Parker
content: I-I didn't do it on purpose...!

speaker: Brown
content: Shut it now!
You try to sprint through the flames, but the fire is too big to break through.
The fire is spreading too fast and the building is filled with inflammable objects. The whole structure will soon become an inferno. We must think of a way to get out quickly.

speaker: Parker
content: But the fire has already blocked the way before us...

speaker: Jennifer
content: What if... we jump out of the window?

speaker: Brown
content: No, it's too high. Even if it doesn't kill you, it'll definitely maim you.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Then, then are we supposed to just count down to our death now?!

speaker: Jennifer
content: No... I don't want to die! I'd rather jump off from here!

speaker: Brown
content: No! Calm down! Damn it... Parker, stop her!
As the three spiral into anxiety and despair, Letta whispers to you.

speaker: Letta
content: Mr. Chief, I have an idea...
female_content: Miss Chief, I have an idea...

speaker: Letta
content: If we move between the rooms, we can avoid the fire. But to do that... I must lead everyone through the walls.
But the second you use your power, your Sinner identity will be exposed.
Your parents have warned you in the letter too. The public is blatantly prejudiced against Sinners. Can you really handle the consequences of exposing your identity?
I don't mean to stop you... I only wish that you can consider it thoroughly before making the choice.
Letta nods firmly.

speaker: Letta
content: I understand what you mean... But no amount of consideration can save us from this now.

speaker: Letta
content: Nothing comes before saving lives!

speaker: Letta
content: Especially when they're so nice to me even though we only just met. She even agreed to mend the pigeon for me. We're friends now... I can't just leave my friends like that.
If you've made up your mind, go for it. I'll support you no matter what.

speaker: Letta
content: ...Thank you!
Having made her decision, Letta walks determinedly over to her panicking friends, the lantern in her hand radiating an even brighter and softer light.

speaker: Letta
content: Everyone, please calm down... I know a way to get all of us out safely, as long as you trust me.

speaker: Jennifer
content: You know a way?!
A spark of hope flickers in Jennifer's eyes, then goes out.

speaker: Jennifer
content: No, there are no other ways. The only path is blocked, unless we can move through the flames...

speaker: Letta
content: That I can't do... But I can lead you guys through the walls.

speaker: Jennifer
content: ...Through the walls?

speaker: Letta
content: Yes. To prove it to you, I'll demonstrate it once!
Under their bewildered gaze, Letta, carrying her lantern, gradually sinks into the wall until she completely disappears.
A moment later, she emerges from the wall again, returning from the other side.

speaker: Letta
content: You see? Now you believe me, don't you?

speaker: Letta
content: Come on, give me your hands. Once we pass through these rooms, we'll find a safe escape route...
Letta reaches out her hand sincerely, but no one responds.

speaker: Brown
content: Normal people can't do that... This power... You, you're a...

speaker: Parker
content: You're a Sinner!
Their expressions grow even more terrified and they step back, as if facing a disaster even worse than the fire.

speaker: Letta
content: I'm sorry I hid that from you, but now is not the time for discussion. It's too dangerous here, we need to get out at once...
Letta wants to grab the hand of Jennifer, who's closest to her, but Jennifer slaps her hand off.

speaker: Jennifer
content: Back off, you freak! Don't touch me!
Jennifer begins screaming in fear and even throws something at her.
Letta freezes. She slowly turns her gaze toward the floor. A dusty little pigeon rolls twice there.

speaker: Letta
content: Why... must you act like that? I'm only trying to save you...

speaker: Letta
content: Aren't we friends?

speaker: Jennifer
content: Who wants to be friends with a freak like you?!

speaker: Jennifer
content: Damn it, she touched me... I don't want to turn into a disgusting thing like that!

speaker: Letta
content: You won't accept my help just because I'm a Sinner?
Facing the group who look at her entirely differently now, Letta seems hurt and confused.

speaker: Letta
content: Perhaps Father and Mother are right. I indeed oversimplify the idea of choice-making...

speaker: Letta
content: Did I... make the wrong choice this time...?
Her hand is still reaching out, but it's shaking slightly now. Her initially firm stance begins to waver too.
You stride over and grab Letta's cold hand. You grip it firmly so that you can pass your warmth and strength to her.
I believe in you, Letta.
I'm putting my life in your hands. Take me out of here.

speaker: Parker
content: Oi, hold on, but she's a Sinner!

speaker: Parker
content: I hear that coming in contact with them turns you into a monster! It'll disfigure you completely! Aren't you scared?

speaker: Parker
content: ...I know, you two were together in the first place! Are you also a...
A disfigured monster? If you don't run now, soon enough you'll become a disfigured, charred body too.
You snicker and refute.
Stay here and get burned into a piece of horrifying charcoal, or get out alive and continue living your life... Anyone with rational judgment knows which one's the right choice.
If you insist on being stubborn, then the regretful result will not be caused by fire or Mania, but foolish prejudice.
Their faces have gone ashen and their expressions are awful. You turn back and ask Letta in a gentle voice.
Do you still want to save them?
It's alright. It's all up to you.
You're free to choose what to do and how to do it. You don't need to change your mind for any reason.
Listen, Letta... Whether or not a choice is right is not that important. What's important is that you won't regret it.
You've told me before that if it's your own choice, even if you're faced with setbacks, you'll accept it.
Therefore, what you need to do now is to face this situation and make your choice once more.
I'll leave you the freedom of choice. I won't question your decision.
Only the crackling of the fire can be heard in the scorching air. The group finally realize the grim reality and begin turning their fearful but anticipating gaze toward Letta.
After a moment of silence, Letta grips your hand again.

speaker: Letta
content: I've decided... I'll take your hand, only yours.
Despair spreads across the group instantly. Letta speaks again.

speaker: Letta
content: But I won't stop anyone from following me.

speaker: Letta
content: I'm also giving you the freedom of choice. I'm not offering my help again. Whether you want to be saved by a disgusting Sinner or not is up to you.

speaker: Letta
content: The fire is worsening... Mr. Chief, let's go!
female_content: The fire is worsening... Miss Chief, let's go!

content: With that, Letta immediately turns around with her lantern and pulls you into the wall.
Hands linked, you and Letta swiftly traverse the unscathed rooms. You notice the silent followers behind you, but you both pay no attention to them.
When you finally make it out, the castle has already become an inferno. The deceptive strange tale will no longer exist.
You contact the FAC to contain the disaster. Once they arrive, you take Letta away from the site quietly.
On the way back, Letta keeps staring out the window silently. So you pull out something and hand it to her.

options: I want to give this back to you.

speaker: Letta
content: ...What?
It's that tattered pigeon plushie, only it's even dustier now having survived the fire. But Letta seems pleasantly surprised and hugs it lovingly.

speaker: Letta
content: You salvaged it!
Yes, I knew you wouldn't want to leave it there.
Some Sinners in the Bureau are good at handcraft. Go find Lynn and ask her for help. I'm sure she'll be more than happy to oblige.

speaker: Letta
content: I will...!
By the way, you've successfully executed your own Growth Plan today. Congratulations.

speaker: Letta
content: Eh, does that count as a success? I've had so many accidents...
Letta bows her head in embarrassment.

speaker: Letta
content: But indeed, what's an adventure if it's without surprises or accidents?
After today, I'm sure you now have a better understanding of what consequences you may face when you make your own choices. Tell me, do you still want to carry on with this plan?

speaker: Letta
content: ...Of course! I won't give up.

speaker: Letta
content: Father and Mother may be right about one thing. I'm probably not good at making the right choices.

speaker: Letta
content: But that doesn't justify taking away the control I have over my life.

speaker: Letta
content: Mr. Chief, thank you so much for leaving me the greatest freedom of all... The freedom to make my own choice under any circumstances.
female_content: Miss Chief, thank you so much for leaving me the greatest freedom of all... The freedom to make my own choice under any circumstances.

speaker: Letta
content: The initial motivation for making my own Growth Plan was to preserve this power.
She flashes a determined and bright smile at you.

speaker: Letta
content: That's why I will continue striving for it!
And my answer is the same. If that's your final decision, I'll support you as always.
I'm curious to know what other thrilling adventures Letta's Growth Plan will lead to.

speaker: Letta
content: Hehe, then from now on... please join me on more adventures!

speaker: Nightingale
content: Here are all the case files the Eastside Public Security Bureau has handed over this time. Please review them, Chief.
test
test
test
test
test
test
Are they all unsolved missing person cases?
You flip through these case files that are from different times and handled by different people.
Aside from the victims all being young and beautiful women, there seems to be no commonality among these cases...

speaker: Nightingale
content: Correct. That's why the Eastside Public Security Bureau didn't combine these missing person cases in the past.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Some of the cases are even considered non-criminal. The files are only kept because the people who reported them have never come to close them.
Some of these files are indeed very thin and contain only the reporter's statement and the missing person's photo, providing very little information.
The girls' radiant beauty makes them shine in the either nicely printed or worn-out photos, but that was also what attracted covetous eyes.
Yet the truth is that they indeed became prey in someone's eyes. They didn't just run away due to their own petulance or unbearable abuse.
If only this evidence... hadn't appeared in such a bizarre form.
In the most recent case file, there's a perfume tester strip sealed in a plastic bag and labeled Rose.
The perfume it was once soaked in has long faded away. Even if you try hard to perceive it, you can only sense a faint trace of Mania in it and nothing more.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Although these cases have remained unsolved, there has been a recent breakthrough. This perfume tester strip here.

speaker: Nightingale
content: It was accidentally discovered by a victim's sister at a perfume gala. The Public Security Bureau has confirmed the remaining personalized perfumes from the catalog of perfumes distributed to the participants and compared them with the missing person case files.
Is there no way to get different perfume samples of a bigger size?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Regretfully, these personalized perfumes are very popular among the rich in Eastside now, and they are only sold at special perfume galas in individual packaging. No one is willing to resell them.

speaker: Nightingale
content: However, the Public Security Bureau has obtained an invitation to a perfume gala. The case is related to Sinners, so you might need to attend it personally.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test

She hands you a beautifully crafted invitation. It specifies the location and time of the perfume gala, but there's no signature. Only a faint fragrance lingers on the paper, hinting at the identity of the host. A skilled perfumer.
Is the FAC's assessment result consistent with that of the Eastside Public Security Bureau?

speaker: Nightingale
content: Yes. Although the personalized perfumes are considered important clues, the Public Security Bureau has been unable to ascertain the real identity of the perfume gala host.

speaker: Nightingale
content: The FAC also believes there is a high possibility of a Sinner's involvement in this case, and that it should be handed over to the MBCC.
The ongoing missing person cases, the personalized perfumes related to Mania, and the mysterious perfumer... Indeed, this is a peculiar case that you can't just ignore.
Got it. I will look for more clues at the gala. I'm leaving the back-end support to you, Nightingale.

Top notes: 
rosemary, Damask rose, pink pepper
In the opulent venue of the gala, expensive, richly fragrant perfumes are displayed everywhere, and a generous amount of tester strips are available for every item.
The carefully designed spacing ensures that different perfumes won't interfere with each other during testing while filling every corner of the venue with a faint fragrance.

You stand in a position overlooking the whole venue and observe the luxurious figures in the hall. The rich young ladies stroll gracefully in this venue free of vice and ugliness, all looking lithe and elegant.
But the affluent middle-aged ladies who hold even more power and wealth are not interested in these expensive perfumes. They seem to be waiting for a different exhibit, some grand finale of the gala.

speaker: Young Lady A
content: What a rich and full-bodied fragrance! I'm dying to know what's the raw material behind such a luscious rose note. Though I also found that citrus note over there very fresh and exquisite. Auntie, do you think my pocket money is enough to buy them all?

speaker: Rich Woman B
content: Haha, you're a greedy young lady, sweetheart. But don't get carried away, those are not our target today.

speaker: Young Lady A
content: Do you mean that perfume that's supposed to grant you eternal youth, as written in the catalog? I thought that was just a tagline.

speaker: Rich Woman B
content: You know nothing. Look at these celebrities and heiresses here, do you think they can be fooled by just a regular perfume? I've heard about that lady who successfully bid for the perfume last time. She's got the skin of a young girl again...
A perfume that grants you eternal youth...? It's probably related to Mania too.
Finding the perfumer means finding the answer to everything, whether it's the connection between the missing person cases and the perfume, or the source of the Mania ingredient in the perfume.
You don't believe the perfumer who actively uses perfume to create buzz will miss such a grand occasion. He or she is definitely in this crowd, watching for an opportunity.
Thinking of how to catch that mysterious perfumer among the crowd?
While you are lost in thought, a stranger is pushed by the crowd to your back. His casual whisper in your ear makes you tense up instinctively.
Relax. I know you're here to investigate the missing person cases, Chief of the MBCC.

...Investigate the missing person cases? Maybe you should call the police instead. Take the exit, turn right, and you'll find the Public Security Bureau. Don't waste your time striking up a conversation with strangers here.

speaker: Lucas
content: Chief ${PlayerName}, you are making it so obvious... My name is Lucas, I'm sort of an investigative journalist. Now, I'm looking into this missing person case, just like you.
...How did you recognize me?

speaker: Lucas
content: Well, I've got my own sources, being in this line of work. I know this case has been handed over to you guys at the MBCC. I've been researching and asking around to try to keep up with you guys... Luckily, I've bumped into you.

The serial disappearances can be traced back to many years ago, but the cases have only become connected and have been investigated collectively recently. The clue concerning this perfume is also only circulating within a small circle.
Unless one is closely following the leads, it's impossible to catch up with the MBCC's operations so easily...
You can't expect me to believe everything you say without any evidence. You need to prove that you're not just a gossip columnist trying to probe for information.

speaker: Lucas
content: A gossip columnist couldn't have made it this far. After all, even the Eastside Public Security Bureau has almost given up on these missing cases that don't bring them any profit or publicity.
So many women have disappeared and have probably even died. And all you care about is profit and publicity?

speaker: Lucas
content: Even in Eastside, it's not unusual for beautiful girls from the lower classes to suddenly disappear.

speaker: Lucas
content: Some are tricked by shady intermediaries into underground businesses, some can't bear the poverty and grasp at the wrong lifeline, and some choose to spend their nights in entertainment facilities...

speaker: Lucas
content: Even if such a case is filed, there's a lower than 30% chance it'll ever be solved. There's no profit in either investigating or reporting it. And why would anyone pay attention to such a mundane incident?
The man in front of you looks dejected, his tone unsurprised and almost emotionless.
But somehow you feel that this isn't lofty indifference, but rather disregard resulting from longtime frustration.
You've said it's neither profitable nor newsworthy, and investigating it is a waste of effort. Then why are you doing this?

speaker: Lucas
content: What else can I do? I gotta do something about my daughter.
You mentally search for the victims' photos from the files and try to compare their facial features with this haggard face worn out by time and agony before you, but come up empty.

speaker: Lucas
content: Don't even bother, Chief. My daughter has been missing for a long time. Those useless sheriffs probably have already lost her file.

speaker: Lucas
content: At first, we were a whole investigative group. Then some people gave up, and now only four or five of us are still persisting.

speaker: Lucas
content: Finally, I found a clue from a luxury product seller. The names of those perfumes. Anna, Marilyn, and so on... The other parents' daughters were all in there, except mine.

speaker: Lucas
content: Some of us thought there must be some kind of connection, and some thought it was a mere coincidence. So I attended three perfume galas, went through all the catalogs, and brought back a few tester strips.

speaker: Lucas
content: They all fell ill after smelling their daughters' scents. How strange that they could recognize their daughters with just a sniff of the perfume even though they hadn't seen them for so many years. And me? I can't even find my daughter's scent.

speaker: Lucas
content: I can only tell myself that no news is good news... This could mean she's still alive and hasn't been harmed. I can still hope...
Seeing the anxiety, sadness, and agony in the desperate father, you can't help but sigh.
I understand your desperation, but there's a hint of Mania in those personalized perfumes. This suggests that the perfumer may very well be a Sinner.

It's too dangerous for an ordinary person like you to go after a suspected Sinner. Before you can save your daughter, you may get entangled in it yourself. Please don't be reckless and trust that the MBCC will give you an answer.

speaker: Lucas
content: No, no, no. YOU should trust me. You've only been on the missing cases for a matter of days while it's been six years for me! I've still got a lot of exclusive leads that the Public Security Bureau wouldn't take but are absolutely reliable...

speaker: Lucas
content: I can help you. Trust me, I can help you find that perfumer! As long as you can save my daughter...
Obviously, you can't take an ordinary person along for the investigation, but it's also impossible to completely get rid of him for now.
Just as you're racking your brains on how to deal with Lucas, you smell a unique fragrance. Even without any professional knowledge about perfume, you can tell the hazy scent is of premium quality.

You can't identify the specific ingredients, but the scent is elusive and incredibly light, as if it's cleansing the dust of time accumulated in your veins. Even Lucas pauses the conversation to get immersed in the scent.
Instinctively, you know that this is a sign of danger, but you can't determine the source of the scent... until the shackles send a warning.
A reaction... to special power... A Sinner?!
You leave Lucas at once and hastily follow the shackles' directions to the source of the special power. But Lucas refuses to give up and follows closely behind you.
You're not sure if you've imagined it, but the closer you get to the source, the more the hazy scent in the air intensifies... The source of the scent is also the source of the special power.
...It's still not perfect yet. The fruity scent is too catchy and bubbly, and lacks poise... It's clean enough though. Let me add this...
In a corner hidden by tall decorations, a young woman is mumbling to a sleeping beauty in her arms.

They seem incredibly intimate, but when the young woman points the perfume bottle at the beauty in her arms and is about to press the atomizer, the shackles suddenly start to pulsate wildly, signaling a warning.
The fragrance quietly floating in the air at the venue is also enlivened with the woman's action. It seems to roll into a torrent and rush toward the woman... No, toward that beauty in her arms.
She is without a doubt using the perfume bottle to activate her special ability. The beauty's breathing is gradually weakening. If this continues, she may suffer irreversible damage!
Let her go!
Yes?
Distracted by you, the Sinner lifts her head. In her lifeless burgundy eyes, you see your own reflection, along with a hint of surprise that surfaces on her otherwise calm demeanor.
You seize the chance, pull the girl from her arms, and toss her to Lucas who's followed you here.

speaker: Lucas
content: So you're the perfumer...!
Protecting the victim in his arms, Lucas confronts the young woman, glaring at her with bloodshot eyes.

speaker: Lucas
content: Tell me, why did you name your perfumes after those girls? Do you know them? What do you know? Were you the abductor?!
Calm down, Lucas!
In that tense moment, you can't afford to hesitate. You grab the perfumer's wrist that's still holding the perfume bottle and activate the shackles.
A red glow spreads out and sinks into the young woman's ivory-white skin before retracting.
You succeeded. Almost instantly, you gain restraint over this unknown Sinner through the shackles. But just to be safe, you swiftly snatch that perilous perfume bottle from her hand.
What a shame...
To your surprise, at the moment of her capture, what she expresses is not resentment, anger, complacency, or boastfulness, but rather regret. The regret of gaining something just to lose it again.
Give it back to me.
She calmly demands, her tone extremely matter-of-fact.
...What do you want?
My perfume, give it back. It's mine.
This is absurd. But from her severe, displeased expression, you realize that the perfume indeed matters to her way more than the shackles binding her.
You're now a Sinner detained by the MBCC. Your perfume bottle will be confiscated indefinitely as a medium of special power.
Of course, if you are cooperative and honest, I will consider helping you get it back as soon as possible.
The perfumer stays silent. You're not sure if this signifies a compromise or a silent protest.
To play safe, you gesture for the MBCC staff sent by Nightingale to put the bottle in an evidence bag and take it away.
...Yes, I believe she's the type that uses a medium to cast her special power. The danger is under control with the restraint. No need to send more people, I can bring her back to the MBCC.

speaker: Nightingale
content: Understood. The transport vehicle is already waiting outside. Please be careful, Chief.

speaker: Lucas
content: Wait, Chief...
Lucas, who has been standing by, steps forward. He's visibly calmer now, but his eyes are still burning with a desperate hope.

speaker: Lucas
content: Eleanor

speaker: Lucas
content: At least... at least help me find out where my daughter is. The worst thing you can get is one extra clue... right?

speaker: Lucas
content: Okay, I'll be waiting for your good news...
From the inner pocket of his coat, he pulls out a faded photo still warm with his body temperature. He hesitates for a moment, but still hands it to you.

speaker: Lucas
content: This is the best photo I have of her... I'm entrusting it to you.
You nod solemnly and carefully stow it away.
The perfumer maintains her long silence on the side, her expression cold, as if she's detached herself from the situation.

Although she doesn't resist arrest violently, you don't feel any more at ease. After establishing a connection through the shackles, you feel as if a bottomless, glacial black hole sits on the other end.
The mental state of this Sinner is obviously way more problematic than you thought. The upcoming interrogation... probably won't be easy.

Heart notes:
saffron, labdanum, patchouli
Cassia, you're the perfumer behind the gala, aren't you?
What was the purpose of the perfume gala? Why did you sell and distribute these Mania perfumes? Please answer me directly!

speaker: Cassia
content: So that the whole world doesn't become suffocating... like in here.
You lift your head for the umpteenth time to gather your thoughts, trying not to be affected by the woman's blunt indifference and perfunctory attitude.

Your premonition has come true. In the past half hour of interrogation, the only practical information you've obtained is her name, Cassia. Any other question is met with her brief criticism of the smell in the interrogation room.
But it doesn't seem like she's dismissing you by lying or avoiding the questions.
You notice that since entering the interrogation room, her complexion has been awful. Her skin is a sickly pale color and her breathing is labored.
I'm sorry if you really can't stand the smell of the interrogation room. But I can't give you back the perfume bottle...

speaker: Cassia
content: No! What is this?! It smells bloody...
The unexpected happens. Just as you switch strategies and try to persuade Cassia to reveal the truth, she suddenly curls up and covers her face in horror, screaming shrilly.
Cassia...

speaker: Cassia
content: No, this smell... Get it away from me...!
After the initial shock at Cassia's sudden breakdown, your first reaction is to check for potential triggers in the interrogation room.
The light, the sound... and even the smell, which has the strongest effect on this Sinner, none of these elements have undergone any noticeable changes before and after her breakdown.
The smell she mentioned seems more like an illusion induced by emotions than real sensory perception. To suppress an emotional outburst of this intensity, the only way is...
To further enhance the calming effect of the shackles, you end up almost embracing the curled-up Cassia in your arms.
Shh, there now...
You can feel her trembling, her skin cool to the touch like a small creature desperately withstanding a storm. The scent you once detected on her is now almost completely gone.
She is afraid. You don't know what she fears, but the feeling transmitted from the other end of the shackles tells you that she is trying to escape from some immense fear that has devoured her soul.
You're in the Bureau's interrogation room now. It's absolutely safe here. Don't be scared... Cassia, Cassia!
Time slips away. Perhaps the shackles have conveyed your thoughts to Cassia, as she finally calms down from her fear, her breathing and heartbeat returning to normal.
How do you feel? Are you okay? Why... why are you looking at me like that?

You take a few steps back to observe Cassia's complexion, only to find that her expression has turned strange. She is staring at you, her gaze tracing the contours of your face, as if admiring a rare gem.

speaker: Cassia
content: Such a unique fragrance...
Fragrance?

speaker: Cassia
content: I've never smelled such a fragrance before... It's solemn, warm, and firm... Ah, how special, how wonderful...
Hmm...
You don't understand what fragrance she's referring to, just as you couldn't perceive the bloody smell she mumbled about earlier.
But based on past experience, you should go along with her for now. This way, you may get more information in the upcoming interrogation and find a breakthrough.
...Just now, did you react that way because you smelled something unpleasant?
If you need it, I can have Nightingale bring in some perfume to help stabilize your mood.

speaker: Cassia
content: No, no need.
A delicate blush appears on Cassia's pale cheeks. Those previously indifferent eyes are now focused on you, reflecting a captivating light.

speaker: Cassia
content: Those mediocre commercial fragrances will only intensify the foul smell here... I just need you, I just need to smell your scent...
Her inexplicable change baffles you.

Not only is the Sinner not under your control, but she's also completely immersed in her own world. But at least, her attitude seems to have softened, and you can try to guide her to reveal more details.
I can't smell the foul smell you mentioned or the fragrance on myself. Do these smells really exist? And how are they related to what just happened to you?

speaker: Cassia
content: ...Are you actually asking a perfumer if the smells she detects really exist?

speaker: Cassia
content: Well, I guess this straightforward and realistic character also makes up part of that vibrant scent of yours...

speaker: Cassia
content: Alright, I respect everything that contributes to your fragrance. And I will do my part to further elicit your sweet scent... That includes teaching a barbarian like you who's ignorant of the beauty of fragrance what defines a supreme scent.
Then I'm all ears.
She seems completely oblivious to the hint of caution in your tone, and continues with the air of a lecturer eager to share all her knowledge.

speaker: Cassia
content: As a perfumer in pursuit of perfection, I'm always searching for aromatic ingredients, extracting raw materials, and adjusting formulas...

speaker: Cassia
content: And what helps me grasp the most subtle nuances, concoct the perfect fragrances, and ultimately craft masterpieces, is my sense of smell.

speaker: Cassia
content: This is a gift from God... I'm not like regular people who cannot discern different smells mixed together. I can smell everything distinctly, especially living things.

speaker: Cassia
content: In my perception, warm flesh and blood emit a variety of unique scents. The vain, the youthful, the insipid... These are the most fundamental scents that only I can detect.

Could she be talking about the smell of pheromones? Scientifically, some people are indeed born with a vomeronasal organ similar to that of an early human and therefore can perceive a wider range of smells.
Perhaps that so-called scent on you falls in that range too, so it's not entirely an illusion.
Like that bloody smell you mentioned earlier?

speaker: Cassia
content: It was from an immensely shocking incident I once experienced. The smell of blood at that time was forever imprinted on my mind because of my sensitive sense of smell.

speaker: Cassia
content: I can't get rid of it. It follows me like a shadow, making me uneasy and restless...

speaker: Cassia
content: Fortunately, my ability allows me to make a perfume with special effects which clears and masks that haunting smell... I can only stay calm under the shroud of the special perfume.

speaker: Cassia
content: Once my ability stops functioning, I will smell that chilling bloody smell again...
At this point, the reason for her sudden breakdown just now becomes clear.
You directly restrained her special power the moment you put the shackles on her. Stripped of the special enhancement, the perfume can no longer mask the bloody smell.
I'm sorry. I only used the shackles on you to prevent you from harming others with your ability, not to make you suffer.

speaker: Cassia
content: Shackles... That's what that connection transmitting your scent is called?
Unexpectedly, Cassia interrupts you. A soft smile appears on her face, illuminating her pale and cold face. But for some reason, you feel an indescribable zeal from this smile.

speaker: Cassia
content: It is the shackles that restrict my ability and remind me of the fear and bloodiness. But they also bring me your fragrance, driving away the terrible bloody smell...

speaker: Cassia
content: It's the shackles that have finally led me to this fragrance... A fragrance that functions on its own to erase my fear and save my precarious spirit, with no need for other ingredients... Finally.
Her demeanor is all decent, but that can't hide the fact that she is really hard to communicate with. To not let the interrogation end in a stalemate again, you must be straightforward.
Since the shackles have calmed you down, let's get back to the point, Cassia.
I hope you can tell me why you sold the perfumes made with your ability at the galas?
And why did you name these perfumes after people? What is the connection between these names and the victims of the serial disappearance case? Why do they highly coincide?

You've just admitted yourself that you can smell the scent of living beings. According to the testimonies of the victims' families, they were able to smell the victims' body scent from the personalized perfumes you made.

It's logical for me to deduce that you not only have met the victims of the missing persons cases, but have also made certain contact with them. Only in this way could you concoct perfumes that matched their scents.
Cassia remains unfazed under your relentless questioning, showing no signs of guilt or unease.

speaker: Cassia
content: Personalized perfumes? Haha... I'd prefer something more poetic, but it does perfectly capture the core inspiration.

speaker: Cassia
content: Yes, inspiration. Perfumery requires not only suitable ingredients, a keen sense of smell, and steady hands, but also a spark of creativity to guide you in the right direction...

speaker: Cassia
content: And these... people, according to you, these beautiful girls, and their exquisite bodies... They are the main source of inspiration for my perfumery.

speaker: Cassia
content: The earliest perfume formulas often drew inspiration from existing scents in nature, extracting and recreating them.

speaker: Cassia
content: What I want is to recreate an atmosphere, an emotion, or an experience... to recreate the captivating texture of the youthful beauties and their unique charms...

speaker: Cassia
content: That's why I'm constantly on the lookout for beauties that meet my requirements, concocting unique perfumes named after them...
Cassia talks enthusiastically with a fervor that only surfaces when she speaks about perfume.
So are you admitting that you made contact with the victims for the sake of perfume-making? Did you harm or abduct them?

speaker: Cassia
content: I did have deep interactions with them. After all, they were the essential ingredients for my perfumes. Every time I got close to them, I could feel the muse favoring me... But, harm them? Why would I?

speaker: Cassia
content: I always cherish the sources of my inspiration. Otherwise, I wouldn't be willing to share my works with the public. I only wish to attract more beauties who understand my passion for perfume and are just as obsessed with the fragrances I create...

speaker: Cassia
content: I'm doing all this to overcome my creative block and craft the perfume of my dreams. That's why I need more and more inspiration...!
You suppose it all somehow makes sense within her unique logic. But your instinct is warning you that something is not right.
You recall Lucas's earnest plea and hopeful gaze, understanding that this interrogation cannot stop here.
test
test
test
test
test
test
Let's change the subject. Since you said that you got in contact with the victims to gain inspiration for your perfumes, you must have a deep impression of their appearances, right?
Then, tell me, have you seen the woman in this photo? She may not look the same age anymore, but her features should not have changed much.
Cassia gazes at the pretty young woman in the photo, seemingly trying to dredge up related details from the sea of memory. But she soon shakes her head.

speaker: Cassia
content: I can't remember.

That doesn't surprise you. After all, according to the information Nightingale gathered, Lucas's daughter disappeared five or six years ago. She was among the earliest victims, so Cassia may not remember her clearly.
Then, you flip over the photo and point at the name written on the back as you ask the next question.
Her name is Fleur. Have you ever named one of your perfumes after that?
Cassia remains silent as she stares at the name written down lovingly.
But you know full well that the shackles have now tightly linked your minds together. You can gauge the Sinner's feelings through means other than superficial language or facial expressions.
You observe the quiet woman in front of you, following up with more questions while feeling for her reactions in your mind.
Fleur might not be a very rare name, but it is filled with her father's blessings. Please think carefully again. Have you ever made a perfume named Fleur?
Despite her silence, your shackles sense that Cassia is responding to that perfume. The repetition of the name Fleur has caused a few faint pulses.
You are certain she knows this name. Or at least... she responds to a certain perfume named Fleur.
You know her, don't you?

speaker: Cassia
content: I have no recollection of this person, but I remember every perfume I've ever made.
Then where are these perfumes now? Or have they all been sold?

speaker: Cassia
content: I do sell them, but I keep the ones that leave the most long-lasting scents.

speaker: Cassia
content: Now, they are all stored in my perfumery.
If you don't mind, take me to see them. Perhaps there are some clues you've forgotten about.
This is an exquisitely decorated perfumery. Numerous perfume bottles are displayed in tall cabinets, creating a magnificent sight.
The unblended essential oils, fragrances, and extraction equipment scatter around the room, making it clear even to a layman like you that this place belongs to a top perfumer.
Elisa, Anna, Marilyn...

Each delicate and transparent perfume bottle carries a handwritten name tag. But upon closer inspection, you realize that besides the containers filled with finished perfumes, the glass bottles that seem to store ingredients are also labeled with names.
They contain a crimson liquid and an ivory-colored powder. Some of them have barely been touched, while others are almost empty.
Are these... the raw materials of your perfumes?

speaker: Cassia
content: That's right. Each of them carries a unique scent that yields a distinctive perfume, perfectly recreating the youthful vitality of those beauties...

speaker: Cassia
content: It's safe to say that no one else but I can truly uncover the fascinating essence within these fragrances...

speaker: Cassia
content: It's lucky for both me and them that they got to meet me, be used by me, and become part of the perfumes I make.
Quality ingredients and an excellent craftsman are indeed a match made in heaven.
If you're already so happy with your craftsmanship and works, why did you host all these perfume galas in such a short time to find more sources of inspiration?

speaker: Cassia
content: ...Because I'm not yet satisfied.
Cassia's fingertips trace over the names one by one as she whispers.

speaker: Cassia
content: Their fragrances don't last long enough. On top of the combination and variation of notes, longevity and projection are also two important things to consider when making a good perfume...

speaker: Cassia
content: You can smell it too, right? Although this fragrance is wonderful, it also vanishes quickly. A perfume made from this ingredient can't possibly be long-lasting...
Cassia picks up a bottle of perfume and sprays it in the air above. The sweet and wonderful scent immediately falls upon both of you, enveloping your bodies.
But in just a moment, that enchanting scent disappears just like a stranger slipping past swiftly.

speaker: Cassia
content: That's why I can only continue searching... for more and better quality fragrances, a rich scent that never fades...

speaker: Cassia
content: I've been searching for a long, long time. Sometimes I found hope, but more often I was let down... until I smelled your scent!
Cassia's tone grows more and more impassioned, but she suddenly stops. Abruptly, she leans in to inhale the scent between your neck and hair obsessively.
You...!
You quickly step back, cautiously watching her. But she is scanning over every detail of your body with an extremely attentive gaze.

speaker: Cassia
content: Clear, but rich. Light, but firm. Warm, but frigid... A scent that perfectly fits my requirements, and yet still manages to surprise me.

speaker: Cassia
content: If I have you... I can definitely create the legendary Immortal Fragrance... I'm sure of it!
Her gaze clings to you like a shadow, filled with obsessive, admiring, and drenched desire. That's not the look one gives to an equal intelligent being... Not the look one gives to a person.

speaker: Cassia
content: Ah... How wonderful. Before my favorite perfume runs out, I've finally found the best fragrance! I feel blessed to have met you!
Fragrance. She refers to you as a fragrance. In her eyes, you are no different from a rockrose branch or a bunch of juniper berries or tonka beans.
Did you think of them... the same way?

speaker: Cassia
content: What?
...Where are these people whose names you put on your labels?! What have you done to them?!
At your question, Cassia looks around and then lets out a rare laugh. Her gorgeous laugh sends a chill down your spine.

speaker: Cassia
content: Why ask such an obvious question? You just need to look around... and you'll find the answer yourself.
Cassia opens the storage cabinet, revealing rows of neatly arranged perfume bottles before you. They all refract mesmerizing lights, their dazzling beauty leaving you breathless.

speaker: Cassia
content: Look at them, smell them. These are their reincarnations, the sweetest fragrances...
You are rendered speechless by her matter-of-fact attitude when suddenly a loud noise comes from behind you.

speaker: Lucas
content: I knew you were behind all this! I knew it all along! You've abducted my Fleur and hid her...

speaker: Lucas
content: Not this one... And not that one either! Just you wait, I'll definitely find her. I'll find the evidence that you took my daughter!
You're shocked to see the intruder is in fact Lucas. You can't imagine how this ordinary man managed to tail you all the way here, driven by sheer determination and a glimmer of hope.
There might be traces of Mania in those fragrances. Stay back, Lucas!
Lucas obviously eavesdropped on your conversation. Cassia's words ignited the sorrow and pain that he had accumulated over many years, turning them into this burning anger.
He has given up rational thinking. Ignoring your instinctive attempt to stop him, he rushes toward the perfume bottles and checks the labels one by one.

Eventually, he picks up a small glass bottle with trembling hands. You see the name Fleur written on the label in beautiful cursive. This seems to be the last straw that destroys Lucas's sanity. He turns to Cassia.

speaker: Lucas
content: What else do you have to say! My daughter... Where on earth is Fleur?! What have you done to her!!!
Facing both of you, Cassia remains absurdly serene as usual. Lucas's anger has no effect on her, and your vigilance feels like a breeze to her.

speaker: Cassia
content: That's why you barged into my territory reeking of dirt, to look for her... No, to look for the gift she's left me, right?

speaker: Lucas
content: What gift?! Fleur would never leave you any gift! Stop playing dumb, you mad woman! Where have you hidden her?!
Despite his previous frustration, Cassia's words have clearly given Lucas a glimmer of hope that his daughter is still alive.
You can practically read his thoughts from his violently shaking pupils and trembling hands that are still carefully holding that perfume bottle.

speaker: Lucas
content: Fleur... is such a kind-hearted, friendly girl... What if she's made friends with this crazy woman? What if she's survived, and that's why her name isn't in the perfume catalog?
Utter despair can turn a person's anger into blazing fire. But now, this mixture of despair and hope is dragging his limbs like heavy silt.
The grieving father doesn't realize he's looking at his supposed enemy with hopeful eyes, eager to hear the sparing of his daughter's life from her mouth.

speaker: Cassia
content: Fleur... Oh, Fleur.

The name seems to evoke melancholy in Cassia too. You can feel that on the other side of the shackles, her emotions are fluctuating violently among bitterness, pain, and relief... The boiling emotions under her calm exterior are surprisingly similar to Lucas's.

speaker: Cassia
content: If it hadn't been for Fleur's help... I definitely wouldn't have survived until today.

Base notes:
incense, moss, metal.

speaker: Young Cassia
content: Yes, I was adopted, but I don't see anything wrong with that. Father is a learned and cultured man. He never berates us and is very fair with rewards and punishments... You should be able to adapt quickly too.

speaker: Tough Girl
content: Fair with rewards and punishments? What do I need to do to be rewarded? Will he be willing to let me go?

speaker: Young Cassia
content: Well... Just like me, you can help Father look for beauties in the slums and bring them back here. Though without a sharp sense of smell like mine, it may be more difficult for you...

speaker: Young Cassia
content: But Father's greatest hobby is to collect and admire beautiful people. If you can do it as well and efficiently as I do, there's hardly any request he wouldn't agree to.

speaker: Tough Girl
content: You mean, like what you did to me? Lure innocent people back here to earn rewards?

speaker: Young Cassia
content: What I wanted was not the rewards, I wanted to help you.

speaker: Tough Girl
content: Help me?

speaker: Young Cassia
content: You were in threadbare clothes adorned only with some flowers and your hands were calloused. I also smelled the pungent cheap detergent... Father always says this is how poor folks with a harsh life look like, but a beauty like you shouldn't suffer like this.

speaker: Young Cassia
content: I brought you back here so you could live well. Father favors beauties like you. You can live happily here, just like I do.

speaker: Tough Girl
content: You think you were helping me when you brought me back?

speaker: Tough Girl
content: This place is indeed luxurious, with many expensive clothes and jewels and premium foods... But you have no friends or family here. Everything feels cold and you can't go out whenever you want.

speaker: Tough Girl
content: You've lived here since you were young. Don't you ever find this confined lifestyle suffocating?

speaker: Young Cassia
content: Not at all. I'm doing well here, and I have everything I need. Why would I find it suffocating?
At that moment, the beauty named Fleur stared at Cassia with a look full of sadness and sympathy.

The young Cassia couldn't understand her, nor did she try to. She firmly believed in her own happiness, just as she was educated and indoctrinated to, in this house constantly filled with a lingering fragrance.

The incense in the mansion was frequently replenished, and the beauties in the rooms came and went. She thought all this was normal. Those beauties were just like carpets that got switched out with the seasons, not deserving extra attention or thoughts.
Until disaster and terror finally descended upon her.

speaker: Young Cassia
content: What is... this smell? It smells rusty... and sweet...

Following this smell that should have been forbidden in the collector's perfect mansion, Cassia came to the usually locked collection room. The heavy door that had always been closed in her memory was ajar, revealing only a corner of the sinful sight.

That was the scene that changed her life. The woman who had just talked to her not long ago was lying on the bench, her life seeming to have faded away with the rosy complexion now gone from her ashen face. Cassia's world collapsed with her.
She probably hit the door lock in her terror. The collector, who was cleaning something by the bench, turned around and found the petrified Cassia standing by the door.

speaker: Collector
content: Oh, it's you, my darling Cassia. What's wrong? Did you smell the decay of the beautiful flower?

speaker: Young Cassia
content: Father... What are you doing...?

speaker: Collector
content: Just some preparation work. You know I'm a naturalist. I never interfere with the growth and change of my collectibles.

speaker: Collector
content: After all, beauty in its natural state is the least greedy, and the most original and valuable... As an admirer, my biggest involvement in their lives is just to provide them with some convenience and aid in life. That's the ideal case.

speaker: Collector
content: But that's assuming they are still seedlings in my garden and items on my display shelves.

He took out a silk handkerchief and wiped the water droplets trickling down the cleaned knife. Cassia could sense the displeasure hidden under his usual gentle tone, as dangerous as the sharp blade wrapped in expensive silk.

speaker: Collector
content: I've always been very lenient with my collection. All I ask of them is just to stay beautiful and self-disciplined. Who else in DisCity could be as generous, asking for nothing in return?

speaker: Collector
content: Sadly, some of my collectibles fail to appreciate my kindness and even try to escape from the showcase I've carefully prepared for them.

speaker: Collector
content: The most unreasonable behavior is to spoil their own grace and squander the gift they've been bestowed with.
The collector's deep regret sounded genuine, which inexplicably terrified Cassia even more that she began to tremble uncontrollably.

speaker: Collector
content: So I'm just trying to save the beauty from disappearing completely, just like saving a withering flower. Clean it, soak it, and preserve it so that it can bloom eternally...

speaker: Collector
content: Cassia, my daughter, my confidante... Come and help your father complete this noble task.
Cassia obediently came to the collector's side as he gestured. With every step closer, another face that had vanished silently flashed across her mind.
The pungent bloody stench, accompanied by inexplicable pain and unease, invaded her senses, making Cassia feel as if even her internal organs were seized.
But she couldn't pay attention to those emotions now, because the collector pointedly tapped her cheek with the knife, leaning affectionately into her ear to say.

speaker: Collector
content: Speaking of, little Cassia, your face doesn't look as beautiful as before up close...

speaker: Young Cassia
content: I'm so sorry, Father. I apologize...
Even though the collector only tapped her with the back of the knife, Cassia was still extremely terrified.
She nervously glimpsed at the weapon tapping her face with her peripheral vision, horrified at the possibility that one of these taps might scratch her skin, making her a valueless defective product.
The extreme tension gave Cassia the illusion that the increasingly intense bloody smell came from wounds on her body.
In her illusion, one after another bloody scratches appeared on Cassia's face. The never-healing wounds emitted a foul stench, sapping her vitality and pronouncing her death.

speaker: Young Cassia
content: Please... Father, please forgive me...

speaker: Collector
content: Fear not, Cassia. Fear only distances you from your beauty. As my daughter, you above all must remain beautiful.
Slowly, silence returned to the collection room. Even though everything had been cleaned up, Cassia could still smell the bloody stench lingering around her.
She mechanically followed the collector's instructions, repeating the cleaning procedure. But her mind was fully occupied by the fear brought by the bloody scent.
Suddenly, she smelled a mesmerizing fragrance emanating from her hands. The scent overpowered the stench and soothed her mind.

speaker: Young Cassia
content: Fleur, Fleur... Is it you? Are you comforting me? Fleur...

speaker: Cassia
content: It was only after that moment that I realized I'd gained a special ability.

speaker: Cassia
content: I could create a perfume that erased the scent of fear and also use it to preserve my youth... If it hadn't been for Fleur's help, I probably wouldn't have been able to stay beautiful until my father's death...

speaker: Cassia
content: Everything I have now, I owe to Fleur... She was the first fragrance that brought me peace and my most precious collectible. I would never let any tasteless stranger see her...

That's why after all this time searching, Lucas has gotten very close to the truth, but never close enough to actually locate his daughter. This twisted, horrifying story leaves you in shock for a long while.

speaker: Lucas
content: Fleur... My Fleur was so kind and beautiful... How could you do this to her...
He seems devastated by the bad news of his daughter's long-ago death. His trembling hands can't hold the perfume bottle anymore. It slips and falls to the ground.

A wonderful rich scent immediately fills everyone's noses. But unlike what Cassia said, this scent doesn't smell peaceful or soothing. Instead, it brings a crashing wave of sadness, making one unable to hold back their tears.
Everyone seems to see and hear the girl whispering to Cassia before closing her eyes:

speaker: Fleur
content: Don't be afraid.

Cassia falls to the ground. She reaches out her trembling hands and grabs the broken perfume bottle, pulling it into her arms. The shards cut her hands, bringing out the unsettling smell of blood already hidden in the perfume.

speaker: Cassia
content: Of course I know how beautiful Fleur was! How truly wonderful is her fragrance... That comforting scent is almost irreplaceable! That's why I've been cherishing her, just so I can keep her with me a little longer...

speaker: Cassia
content: All this time, I've been trying, but I've never been able to make a perfume that can replace Fleur... And yet you've spoiled my one last bit of her scent...!

speaker: Cassia
content: What am I supposed to do... There won't be another Fleur. She can't comfort me when I'm in pain anymore...
Despite her usual calmness, Cassia is having an outburst now. She murmurs to herself neurotically, picking up a perfume bottle next to her and pointing it at Lucas.
Her boiling anger and aggression shake the shackles. You can't ignore her impending urge to use her ability.

speaker: Cassia
content: No... Let go of me!! He... he destroyed my Fleur! My most precious Fleur! Only she can comfort me, only she can protect me!
I won't let you hurt anyone anymore. Stop, Cassia.
You release the shackles and subdue all of Cassia's actions, peering down at her.
You clearly saw the collector in his true colors, why did you continue to stay by his side? Were you using him to get in touch with more victims?
Indeed, the collector was the culprit who hurt Lucas and his daughter, but you were complicit in Lucas's long struggle of losing his beloved daughter too, can you deny that?

speaker: Cassia
content: No... It's not like that... Only those beauties can free me from fear and bring me peace... They are essential to me, I need them just like a person needs air and water...

speaker: Cassia
content: So I found a way to acquire them and make perfume out of them. What's wrong with that? Doesn't it also elevate the value of their lives when they satisfy my desires and soothe my spirit? It's a win-win.
For a moment, there is only silence. You finally realize Cassia's surprise is genuine. She's truly unaware of what's wrong with her actions.
She's both a perpetrator and a victim.

The twisted education from the collector and her abnormal childhood have shaped her into a monster who's obsessed with fragrance and only knows how to satisfy her own desires with no regard for any ethical rules. This flaw will require long-term supervision and reeducation to rectify.
Whether it's for her or for public safety, you must detain and control her.
Cassia, you are now under the control of the MBCC. I will not allow you to treat people as mere perfume ingredients anymore. You must undergo my supervision and education.

speaker: Cassia
content: Haha, suit yourself with your accusation and supervision... I will never give up capturing and collecting fragrances of beauties... Unless...
She stares at you like a predator staring at its prey.

speaker: Cassia
content: Unless you're willing to replace Fleur and become the ingredient for the Immortal Fragrance of my dreams... Only your unique fragrance can surpass even Fleur's scent. I'll only concede in that case...
I refuse. The moment you came to the MBCC, you've become my responsibility. I will never let you harm others anymore, nor will I let you commit evil deeds in the name of perfumery.
As for your mental issues, I will regularly use the shackles to rectify them. Even if a cure is impossible, it can at least prevent future breakdowns from losing your fragrances.

speaker: Cassia
content: Don't turn me down so quickly. Why don't you try my special perfume? I guarantee it will make you...
That is non-negotiable.
Cassia seems reluctant to accept this outcome, but under the shackles' restraint, she has long lost her say and can do nothing to defy you.

speaker: Lucas
content: Fleur... My poor Fleur...

Before bringing Cassia back to the Bureau, you can't help but check on Lucas. He is kneeling in front of the shattered perfume bottle, muttering to himself as he tries to piece together the fragments. It's as if by doing so, he could retrieve the last traces of her daughter, now vanished in the wind.
The shattering of Fleur's perfume hasn't only dealt irreparable damage to Cassia, but also to this father whose determination has been met with a devastating end.
Even more regrettably, since the perfume is a product of Cassia's special power, you can't let Lucas have it, despite your heartfelt sympathy and grievance.
Please accept my condolences. Unfortunately, the perfume cannot be returned to the victim's family. But I promise we will send back any belongings or remains of Miss Fleur that we discover.

speaker: Lucas
content: ...It's my honor to be of help.
...What?

speaker: Lucas
content: When Fleur used to do laundry to help out with the expenses, she would never ignore someone in need even if she was running late... And she always said that after helping someone...

speaker: Lucas
content: My daughter was smart and kind... She didn't forget to help the poor little girl even till the very end...
He shakes his head bitterly.

speaker: Lucas
content: If she were still alive, she would definitely say this.

speaker: Lucas
content: At least no one else will suffer like I did.
Alone in her room, Cassia dips a strand of black hair into the perfume bottle in front of her. She inhales deeply, luxuriating in the smell.

speaker: Cassia
content: Hehe...

speaker: Terminal
content: Bzzz.
The social media app on the terminal sends a familiar notification sound.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Darling, are you there?

<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>: Who are you?

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: That hurts, babe...
<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: We were virtually inseparable online just a month ago. Have you forgotten me already?
A month ago... You try to recall. That was during the Gray Mirror vote incident.
Given the person's cheeky tone, you quickly come to the correct conclusion...

<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>: Are you Shawn?
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>: What do you want from me?

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Nothing in particular.
<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Just wanted to touch base.
The other person types quickly, sending a sentence every two seconds, but there's a slight pause here.
As if she's guessed the expression on your face on the other end, another message pops up in the chat a while later.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Hold on... Actually, I do have a serious matter to discuss with you.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Which is... I love you.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: In fact, I did already confess to you when we first met, but unfortunately, our real date fell through, and now we've lost touch with each other.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: It took me a lot of effort to find your contact. Let's pick up where we left off, you and I...
She may type fast, but you press the delete and block buttons faster.
This isn't the first time you've received such harassing messages, and this is the simplest and best way to deal with them. Responding only makes things worse.

As for this Sinner, considering that she poses no immediate threat in addition to the recent heavy workload at the MBCC, you decide it's not unwise to put her case on hold and arrest her later once you have the time.
Thinking this, you turn off the device screen and continue with your work.
You're just done with a few documents when the notification buzzes again.

speaker: Terminal
content: Bzzz.

speaker: Terminal
content: <color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color> sent a friend request.

speaker: Chief
content: Since when did the Public Security Bureau start contacting me through social media... Why don't they use their own messenger app?
You wonder as your finger instinctively taps accept.
The next second, serial messages swamp the entire screen.

<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: To tell you the truth, from the first moment I saw you, my heart stopped.
<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: Perhaps it was written in the stars. But then, I was afraid that you'd find it too rushed and reject me... As it turns out, I was probably right.
<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: It's been a month now. Maybe time has emboldened me, or the dread of losing you has surpassed the fear of being rejected.
<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: I know, I've always been a coward. But this time, I've decided to be brave.
<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: Call me a moth to a flame. After all, my life and my heart are already battered and bruised. What more do I have to lose?
It takes you less than 1.5 seconds to delete and block this time.
A change of plan is due. You underestimated the harm this Sinner could cause. It seems you have to move the arrest up your schedule.
At lunch, you scroll on your terminal while stuffing food from the plate into your mouth.
Suddenly, a notification pops up at the top of the screen.

speaker: Terminal
content: Bzzz.

<color=#fb9259>Eastside Councilor 24</color> sent a friend request.

Note: Please add me on here. This is my personal account.
You've never gotten along with the council, and that name is too ridiculous even for a personal account. You don't have to guess to know who that might be.
You're getting better at this reject and block thing. It now takes less than one second.
At 3:15 a.m., having finished the day's work and your nighttime routine, you collapse onto the bed.

speaker: Terminal
content: Bzzz.
The ominous notification sound tenses you up.
Out of job duty, you can't just ignore it. But as soon as you turn on the terminal, you immediately regret it.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic 2929</color> sent a friend request.
Note: I understand now. You refuse me. But what

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic 8811</color> sent a friend request.
Note: of it? If I can't have your love, I want your hatred at least. Being hated

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic 0391</color> sent a friend request.
Note: is better than being forgotten. I just want to secure a place

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic 7268</color> sent a friend request.
Note: in your heart. As long as you remember me, I still have a chance
You don't wait for the sweet talker to clog up your chat. Instead, you tap uninstall decisively.
This Sinner poses a significant threat and must not be allowed to roam free. You decide to initiate an arrest as soon as you finish breakfast the next day.

speaker: Unknown Number
content: Ting-a-ling...

options: Hang up and turn off the Terminal

content: So this can't wait until tomorrow.
5:20 a.m., inside an Eastside apartment.
A dozen of fully armed operatives spread out neatly, moving toward the fourth floor without a sound.
Door breaching tool in hand, the operatives are about to barge in...
You knock on the slightly worn and poorly soundproofed door.
Coming!
...Babe, I didn't realize we'd been chatting for so long. My food delivery's here. Just one sec, be right back...
The moment the door opens, a woman with fair skin and a slender figure comes into view.
The two of you lock eyes for a second.

speaker: Chief
content: Aren't we supposed to meet in person, "Hopeless Romantic"?

speaker: Chief
content: Here I am.
As you speak, an incredible range of expressions flashes by the woman's face in just a few seconds.
Finally, she gives a hearty smile and opens her arms towards you.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Watch out! She's going to attack Chief!
The operatives around you raise their guns. Your previous close calls have made them a bit overreactive.
Clearly, the woman in front of you doesn't seem poised for "attack". It seems the only way to spare her some suffering is to subdue her yourself.

Before the operatives can fire, you grab the woman's arm. She's lighter than you expected and seems to be weaker in strength than you. So you muster your power and bend down, the whole sequence clean and swift.
Thump—
Two seconds later, staring down at the unconscious Sinner, the operatives report the situation to the intel center.

speaker: Mission Operative
content: Operation successful. The target is unconscious.
At this moment, you finally feel utterly relieved.

speaker: Chief
content: Take her away. Let's head back.
Since entering the interrogation room, the woman hasn't taken her eyes off you for a second. Those eyes are filled with an unsettling affection that makes your skin crawl.

options: Tell me, why did you approach me?

content: Even when being grilled, Shawn shows no guilt or hesitation.

speaker: Shawn
content: Because I can't shake my feelings for you. Didn't I tell you that from the beginning?

speaker: Shawn
content: I just didn't expect your love to be even more fervent than mine, to the extent that you couldn't even wait for us to get to know each other more before using such an extreme method to approach me...

speaker: Shawn
content: Such desperate measures and possessiveness that would surely be shunned by ordinary people... How could I not fall for you, darling?

speaker: Shawn
content: Now, I'm only afraid I can't keep up with your pace... Let me know before your next flirtatious gesture so I can be better prepared, will you?
Sweet talk is her comfort zone. Her words may sound candid, but none of them is true.

speaker: Chief
content: ...Do you consider an arrest by the Bureau a form of flirtation?

speaker: Shawn
content: Of course. Everyone has their own love language. Given how stressed the average person is in DisCity, I wouldn't even consider this a quirk.
As she speaks, Shawn ruffles her already disheveled hair.

speaker: Shawn
content: That was a nice throw, perfect in strength and form. Not only was I not hurt, but I was also cured of my stubborn insomnia.

speaker: Shawn
content: I could feel all your love and care in that one single throw. Thanks, babe!

speaker: Chief
content: It was meant as a punishment.

speaker: Shawn
content: Encourage her

speaker: Chief
content: A retaliation for your repeated harassment.

speaker: Shawn
content: Haha...
Shawn bows slightly, as if she has discovered a secret about you.

speaker: Shawn
content: So, this is the excuse you use in front of your subordinates, huh?... You're quite self-conscious about your image, aren't you?

speaker: Shawn
content: Relax, you can punish me as much as you want from now on. I won't let it slip. Let this be our little secret...
Shawn's voice is deep and magnetic, but her words give you chills.

speaker: Chief
content: You've probably used this kind of sweet talk on many others too, right?

speaker: Chief
content: You've been casting nets across various social platforms and attracted countless victims. Be honest, tell me all about them and your intentions.

She's never tried to conceal her identity as a Sinner since her capture, as if nothing else matters to her aside from her online relationships. Your investigative instincts tell you there's more to it.
Although faced with your pressing questions, Shawn doesn't seem inclined to come clean. She stretches her back lazily and begins in a wistful and languid tone.

speaker: Shawn
content: That will defy the purpose, darling. Online love affairs are fleeting encounters. What's the point of getting to the bottom of it? You know, mystery is the source of romantic tension.

speaker: Shawn
content: I understand it's just your possessiveness acting up. You want to have all of Hopeless Romantic's secrets to yourself... But sorry, it's not gonna happen.

speaker: Shawn
content: You're right, you're not my only romantic partner online. I belong to every lonely soul in DisCity. A bird destined to soar in the sky can't linger on the same branch forever...
She wraps her arms around herself dramatically, basking in her own self-induced emotions.

speaker: Chief
content: Are you admitting to juggling multiple online relationships? How many romantic partners do you have exactly?

speaker: Shawn
content: Hmm... I haven't actually counted, but probably... around a hundred? What's the matter, Chief? Are you jealous?
The mind-blowing number rolls off her tongue as casually as if she were talking about what she had for dinner yesterday. If you let her babble on, this interrogation will never end.
When you think of how over a hundred ordinary citizens also face the same ordeal as you do, constantly harassed by this professional scammer, a sense of indignation burns within you.

options: Time to take a more drastic approach

content: You approach her with a stiff smile.

speaker: Chief
content: Long-term use of electronic devices can lead to insomnia, which can cause severe mental distress, and a Sinner's mental state is closely related to the stability of Mania! For your health and safety, this bad habit must be regulated.

speaker: Chief
content: Now that you're here at the MBCC, your well-being is my responsibility as Chief... Hand over all of your communication terminals. You have to stay off the internet for a while.
Hearing your words, Shawn freezes for a moment.

speaker: Shawn
content: Ah? Oh... That won't be necessary. That over-the-shoulder throw has completely cured me. I no longer have trouble sleeping now.

speaker: Chief
content: It's only the second day you've been here. How can you know for sure?

speaker: Chief
content: Your condition must be monitored closely. We take the physical health of Sinners very seriously here at the Bureau.

speaker: Shawn
content: Do... Do you confiscate personal terminals from all Sinners here?
You give her a lukewarm smile. Feeling the change in the atmosphere in the interrogation room, Shawn finally realizes you're not joking.
A drop of cold sweat trickles down her forehead.

speaker: Shawn
